translations.translation: zurU (karadA hAM) allAha de nAM nAla jihar3A atiaMta miharabAna ate rahima faramAuNa vAlA hai|
sArIAM tArIfAM te zukarAne usa allAha laI hana jihar3A kulla jahAnAM dA rabba hai| [1]
translations.footnotes: [1] ‘raba’ allAha de sifAtI (guNavAna) nAvAM vicoM he| isa dA aratha hai sArI sarizaTI bhAva dunIAM jahAna dA pAlaNahAra, sirajaNahAra, hAkama, sarizaTI dI dekhabhAla, zAsana calAuNa vAlA ate dAtA Adi|

translations.translation: atiaMta miharabAna te rahima faramAuNa vAlA hai|
badale vAle dina (kiAmata) dA mAlika hai|
asIM terI hI ibAdata karade hAM ate tethoM hI (hara prakAra dI) madada cAhuMde hAM|
(he allAha!) sAnU siddhA rAha vikhA| [2]
translations.footnotes: [2] bhAva hidAita baqhazade| hidAita do tarhAM dI hai, ika uha jihar3I allAha valoM baqhazI jAMdI hai ate dUjI uha jihar3IAM paig2aMbarAM ate allAha de neka baMdiAM dI sikkhiA te tabalIg2a duArA miladI hai| isa thAM hidAita toM bhAva allAha taAlA toM siddhI rAha ’te turana ate usa utte jame rahiNa dI duA hai|

translations.translation: uhanAM lokAM dI rAha jinhAM nU nUM tUM inAma baqhaziA,[3] jinhAM ’te terA karopa (az2Aba) nahIM hoiA ate nA hI (siddhI rAha toM) bhaTake hoe sI| [4]
translations.footnotes:
[3] bhAva nabIAM, sacce lokAM, zahIdAM vAlI rAha jiveM ki sUrata nisA dI 69vIM Aita vica visathAra nAla dassiA giA hai|
[4] nabI karIma (sa:) dA faramAna hai ki jadoM imAma ‘g2airila mag2az2Ube alaihima valaz2z2a-z2AlIna’ kahe tAM picche namAz2a par3haNa vAle ‘AmIna’ AkhaNa| jisa kise dI AmIna farizatiAM dI AmIna nAla ika ho gaI usa de pichale gunAha baqhaza ditte jANage| (sahI buqhArI, vizA az2Ana 113, hadIsa: 782)

translations.translation: alifa, lAma, mIma|
iha (kuraAna, allAha dI) kitAba hai, jisa vica ratA vI koI zakka nahIM (ki iha) muttakIna [1] (rabba toM Darana vAliAM) laI hidAita (dA sAdhana) hai|
translations.footnotes: [1] muttakIna toM bhAva uha loka hana jihar3e kevala rabba toM Darade hoe uhanAM sAre kaMmAM toM bAz2a rahiMde hana jinAM toM rabba ne rokiA hai| uMja tAM iha kuraAna sAre manukkhAM dI bhalAI laI hI nAz2ila hoiA hai para isa toM lAbha uhIo uThA sakade hana, jinAM de dilAM vica rabba dA Dara-bhai huMdA hai, jisa manukkha de dila vica marana toM bAada kise prakAra de savAla javAba dA Dara nahIM, usa de aMdara hidAita prApata karana dI icchA jAM burAI te gumarAhI toM bacaNa dI koI ciMtA vI nahIM huMdI phira usa nUM hidAita kiveM mila sakadI he?

translations.translation: uha, jihar3e g2aibu [2] utte ImAna rakkhade hana ate namAz2a [3] kAima karade hana ate jo vI asIM uhanAM ` (mAla) dittA hai usa viccoM (allAha dI rAha vica) qharaca karade hana|[4]
translations.footnotes: [2] ‘g2aiba’ dA aratha hai aNadekhA| isa zabada vica uha sArIAM cIz2AM dAqhila hana jinAM dA ahisAsa isa dunIAM vica nA akala-samajha toM ho sakadA ru ate nA hI mahasUsa kItA jA sakadA hai, jiveM allAha taAlA dA vajUda, farizate, marana toM bAada dA jIvana Adi ‘ImAna bilag2aiba’ toM bhAva allAha ate usa de rasUla muhaMmada (sa:) dIAM dassIAM hoIAM uhanAM gallAM utte vizavAsa karanA hai jihar3IAM akala toM pare hana jiveM allAha, farizatIAM, akAzI kitAbAM ate rasUlAM utte ImAna rakkhaNA| ise tarhAM allAha ate rasUla valloM bIte sameM vica vAparIAM hoIAM ghaTanAvAM jAM AuNa vAle sameM laI di=tIAM hoiAM sUcanAvAM utte ImAna rakhaNA vI ‘ImAna bilag2aiba’ dA ika ahima bhAga hai| [3] “namAz2a kAima karana” toM bhAva hai ki hareka musalamAna (marada te auaurata) laI dina bhara dIAM paMja namAz2AM uhanAM de niyata sameM te adA karanIAM lAz2amI hana| namAz2a ` masIta vica jamAata nAla adA karanA cAhIdA hai para auauratAM laI ghara namAz2a par3haNA vadhere caMgA hai| nabI karIma (sa:) ne iha vI faramAiA hai ki namAz2a aiveM par3ho jiddAM tusIM mainUM namAz2a par3hade hoe vekhiA hai| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 631) [4] allAha dI rAha vica qharaca karana toM bhAva g2arIba te lor3avaMda lokAM dI mAlI sahAitA karanA hai| isa de nAla hI allAha de dIna isalAma ` car3hadI kalA vica rakkhaNa laI mAla qharaca karanA vI allAha dI rAha vica qharaca karanA hai|1

translations.translation: ate uha jihar3e isa (kuraAna) utte ImAna liAe hana, jihar3A (he muhaMmada!) tuhADe ’te utAriA giA hai ate uhanAM ’te vI (ImAna liAuMde hana) jihar3IAM kitAbAM tuhAthoM pahilAM (nabIAM ’te) utArIAM gaIAM ateu [5] uha Aqhirata utte vI ImAna rakkhade hana|
translations.footnotes: [5] ImAna dA AdhAra muDDhalIAM paMja cIz2AM ’te hai| jiveM hadIsa vica hai (1) isa galla dI gavAhI deNA ki allAha toM chuTTa koI izaTa nahIM ate muhaMmada (sa:) allAha de rasUla hana| (2) namAz2a kAima karanA| (3) z2akAta adA karanA| (4) hajja karanA ate (5) ramaz2Ana de roz2e rakkhaNA| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 8)

translations.translation: iho loka (rabba valloM) siddhe rAha utte hana ate iho safalatA prApata karana vAle hana|
bezaka uha loka jihar3e (kuraAna dA) inakAra karade hana, (he nabI!) tusIM uhanAM nUM (naraka de az2Aba toM) DarAo jAM nA DarAo, uhanAM laI ika barAbara hai, uha ImAna liAuNa vAle nahIM|
allAha ne uhanAM de dilAM te kaMnAM utte mohara lA dittI hai ate uhanAM dIAM akkhAM utte par3adA piA hoiA hai| uhanAM laI karar3I saz2A (dA prabaMdha) hai|
kujjha loka ajihe vI hana jihar3e Akhade hana ki asIM allAha te Aqhirata de dina utte ImAna liAe hAM jadoM ki uha ImAna vAle nahIM|
uha tAM allAha nUM ate uhanAM lokAM nUM dhokhA de rahe hana jihar3e ImAna vAle hana jadoM ki uha ApaNe Apa toM chuTTa hora kise naM dhokhA nahIM de rahe ate uhanAM nUM (isa dI) samajha vI nahIM|
uhanAM de dilAM nUM ika roga (IrakhA dA) laggiA hoiA hai ate allAha ne uhanAM de isa roga nUM hora vI vadhA dittA hai| uhanAM laI dukhadAI az2Aba hai isa laI ki uha jhUTha bolade sana|
ate jadoM uhanAM nUM AkhiA jAMdA hai ki dharatI utte vigAr3a nA phailAo tAM uha kahiMde hana ki asIM tAM sudhAra karana vAle hAM|
suNo! asala vica iho loka fasAdI hana para iha nahIM samajhade!

ate jadoM uhanAM nUM kihA jAMdA ki tusIM vI iMja hI ImAna liAo jiveM dUje loka ImAna liAe hana tAM kahiMde hana, “kI asIM vI mUrakhAM vAMga ImAna liAIe?” qhabaradAra! asala vica mUrakha tAM iha Apa hana para uha (iha galla) jANade nahIM|

jadoM iha (munAfika) ImAna vAliAM nUM milade hana tAM kahiMde hana ki asIM vI ImAna liAe hAM para jadoM uha ApaNe zaitAnAM (bhAva sAthIAM) nUM ikAMta vica milade hana tAM Akhade hana ki asIM tAM tuhADe nAla hAM, uhanAM (musalamAnAM) lokAM nAla tAM asIM kevala makhaula karade hAM|
(jada ki) allAha uhanAM nAla makhaula karadA hai ate uha uhanAM nUM Dhilla de rihA | iha (munAfika) ApaNI sarakazI vica bhaTakade phirade hana|
iha uha loka hana jinhAM ne hidAita dI thAM gumarAhI qharIda laI hai para iha saudA uhanAM laI koI lAhevaMda nahIM ate nA hI uhanAM nUM hidAita hI mila sakI|

uhanAM (munafikAM) dI udAharana tAM usa viakatI vAMga ru jisa ne a=ga bAlI ate jadoM usa (agga) ne usa de Ale-duAle cAnaNa kara dittA tAM allAha ne uhanAM dI (akkhAM dI) rozanI nUM khoha liA ate uhanAM nUM haneriAM vica bhaTakaNa laI chaDDa dittA, jitthe uha kujjha vekha vI nahIM sakade|
iha (kAfira loka) gUMge, bole ate aMnhe hana, huNa iha (ImAna valla) nahIM parataNageM|

jAM ihanAM kAfirAM dI udAharana usa tez2a mIMha vAMga hai jihar3A akAza toM varhiA jisa vica hanera, kar3aka te bijalI (dI lizaka) huMdI hai| uha bijalI dI kar3aka suNake mauta toM Darade hoe ApaNe uMgala ApaNe kaMnAM vica Thosa laiMde hana| allAha ihanAM inakArIAM nUM (kiAmata dihAr3e) gherana vAlA hai|

saMbhava hai ki bijalI ihanAM (kAfirAM) dIAM akkhAM (dI jota hI) ucaka lai jAve| jadoM bijalI lizakadI ru tAM uha usa dI rozanI vica turana lagga paiMde hana jadoM hanerA pasara jAMdA hai tAM khalo jAMde hana| je allAha cAhave tAM ihanAM de kaMna (suNana zakatI) ate akkhAM (vekhaNa zakatI) khoha sakadA hai kiuM jo allAha hara tarhAM dI samarathA rakkhadA hai|
he loko! tusIM ApaNe usa rabba dI ibAdata karo jisa ne tuhAnUM paidA kItA hai ate uhanAM lokAM nUM vI jihar3e tuhAthoM pahilAM bIta cukke hana tAM jo tusIM burAIAM toM bacaNa vAle baNa sako|

uha (raba) jisane tuhADe laI dharatI dA faraza vichAiA ate akAza dI cha=ta baNAI ate use akAza toM pANI (mIMha) utAriA, use rAhIM (dharatI vi=coM anekAM prakAra dI) upaja ka=Dha ke tuhADe laI roz2I dA prabaMdha kItA so tusIM kise hora ` allAha dA zarIku[6]|| (sAMjhI) nA baNAu jada ki tusIM isa ga=la ` bhalI-bhAMta jANade vI ho|
translations.footnotes: [6]|| haz2arata abadu=lA ibane masaUda dA kahiNA hai ki maine nabI karIma (sa:) toM pucchiA ki allAha dIAM naz2arAM vica sabha toM vaDDA gunAha kihar3A hai? tAM Apa (sa:) ne faramAiA ki uha iha hai ki tUM allAha dA koI sAMjhI baNAveM jada ki use ne hI tuhAnUM paidA kItA hai| isa ’te maine kihA ki bezakka iha vaDDA gunAha hai| maine pucchiA ki isa toM bAada vaDDA gunAha kihar3A hai| tAM Apa (sa:) ne faramAiA ki tUM ApaNI aulAda nUM isa Dara kArana mAra deve ki usa nUM khilAuNA pavegA| maine pucchiA ki isa toM bAada kihar3A gunAha vaDDA darajA rakkhadA hai tAM Apa (sa:) ne faramAiA ki tUM par3ausI dI patanI nAla z2anAM kareM| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 4477)

translations.translation: jekara tuhAnUM isa (kuraAna) de saMbaMdha vica koI zaMkA hai jihar3A asIM (allAha) ne ApaNe baMde (muhaMmada) ’te utAriA hai tAM tusIM iho jihI ika sUrata baNA liAo ate chuTa allAha toM ApaNe sAthIAM nUM sahAitA laI sadda lavo, je tusIM sacce ho (tAM karake vikhAo)|
je tusIM (iha kaMma) nA kara sake, ate tusIM kara vI nahIM sakade, tAM usa agga toM baco jisa dA bAlaNa manukkha te patthara hana ate uha kAfirAM laI tiAra kItI gaI hai|

(he nabI!) uhanAM lokAM nUM qhuzaqhabarI suNA dio jihar3e ImAna liAe ate neka kaMma vI karade hana ki beza=ka uhanAM laI ajihe bAg2a hana jinhAM heTha nahirAM vagadIAM hana| jadoM vI unAM nUM ੳtthe koI phala khANa laI dittA jAvegA tAM (jaMnatI) AkhaNage ki iha tAM ohIo (phala) hai jihar3A isa toM pahilAM sAnUM (saMsAra vica) dittA giA sI ate unhAM nUM usa nAla raladA-miladA hI phala dittA jAvegA ate uhanAM laI utthe (savaraga vica) pavittara patanIAM hoNagIAM[7] ate uha (sabha) unhAM bAg2AM vica sadA laI rahiNage|
translations.footnotes: [7] allAha de rasUla (sa:) ne faramAiA hai ki jaMnata vica dAqhala hoNa vAle pahile jatthe vAliAM de cehare caudavIM de caMna vAMga camakade hoNage, uha thakka, sIMDa, padda Adi toM mukata hoNage uhanAM de bhAMDe sone de ate kaMghIAM vI sone cAMdI dIAM hoNagIAM, aMgIThIAM vica oda dI qhUzabUdAra lakkar3a dI varatoM hovegI uhanAM de pasIniAM viccoM muzaka dI khuzabU AvegI, hareka dIAM do-do patanIAM hoNagIAM, jinhAM dI qhUbasUratI te naz2Akata iMnI hovegI ki uhanAM dIAM piMDalIAM dA guddA vI bAhara vikhAI devegA je koI ApasI matabheda jAM gussA Adi hovegA usa toM pAka ho jANage ate uhanAM sabha de dila Apo vica ika ho jANage ate savere zAma allAha dI pAkI biAna karaNage| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 3245)

translations.translation: bezakka allAha isa galla toM ukkA hI nahIM saMgadA ki uha kise vI tarhAM dI udAharana biAna kare bhAveM uha macchara dI hove jAM isa toM vI vadha kise tuccha cIz2a dI hove| jihar3e lokI ImAna liAe uha jANade hana ki bezakka iha (udAharaNAM) uhanAM de rabba valloM hakka ’te adhArita hana, para jihar3e inakArI hana uha Akhade hana ki inhAM udAharaNAM toM allAha dA kI bhAva hai? (jada ki) allAha ihanAM (udAharaNAM rAhIM) uhanAM ’coM kaIAM nUM kurAhe pA diMdA hai ate kaIAM nUM siddhI rAha vikhAuMdA hai ate uha (allAha) ihanAM ulaMghaNAkArIAM toM chuTTa hora kise nUM kurAhe nahIM pAuMdA|

jihar3e loka allAha nAla ikarAra karana picchoM usa nUM tor3ade hana ate jinhAM (rizatiAM) nUM allAha ne jor3I rakkhaNa dA hukama dittA hai uhanAM nUM tor3ade hana[8] ate dharatI ’te fasAda phailAuMde hana uhIo loka ghATe vica rahiNa vAle hana|
translations.footnotes: [8] isa toM bhAva rizatiAM nUM tor3anAM hai ate rizatedArAM nAla badasalUkI te bhair3A varatAo karanA hai isa dI hadIsAM vica karar3I saz2A dassI gaI hai| nabI karIma (sa:) ne faramAiA hai ki rizatiAM nUM tor3aNa vAlA jaMnata vica nahIM jAvegA| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 5984) rizatiAM nUM tor3aNa de mukAbale vica rizatiAM nUM jor3aNA ate uhanAM nAla vadhIA vivahAra karana laI vizeza hukama dittA hai isa dI bahuta vaDDI mahattatA hai |

translations.translation: tusIM allAha (dI hasatI) toM kiveM inakAra karade ho? jada ki tusIM bejAna sI usa ne tuhA nUM jIvana dittA phira uhI tuhAnUM mauta devegA phira uhI tuhAnUM mur3a jiuMdA karegA (ate) tusIM use valla mur3a ke jAuge|

ohIo tAM (allAha) hai jisa ne tuhADe laI uha sabha kujjha paidA kItA jihar3A kujha dharatI vica hai| phira usa ne akAza valla dhiAna dittA ate ThIka saMvAra ke satta akAza baNAe ate uha (allAha) hara cIz2a nUM bhalI-bhAMta jANana vAlA hai|

ate (yAda karo usa sameM nUM ) jadoM tuhADe rabba ne farizatiAM nUM AkhiA sI ki maiM dharatI utte ika qhalIfA (pratInidhI) baNAuNa vAlA hAM tAM uhanAM (farizatiAM ne) kihA, kI tusIM dharatI dA (qhalIfA) usa nUM baNAuge jihar3A isa vica fasAda ate qhUna qharAbA karegA? asIM tuhADI zalAghA sahita usatata karade hoe tuhADI pavittaratA de gunagANa biAna karade hAM| allAha ne AkhiA ki bezakka maiM uha sabha jANadA hAM jo tusIM nahIM jANade|
phira usa (allAha) ne (Adama naM) sArIAM cIz2AM de nAM sikhAe phira usa (Adama) nUM farizatiAM de agge peza kItA ate kihA ki je tusIM sacce ho tAM ratA mainUM ihanAM cIz2A de nAM dasso|

uhanAM (farizatiAM) ne kihA ki terI z2Ata pAka hai sADA giAna isa toM chuTTa hora kujjha vI nahIM jo sAnUM tusIM sikhAiA hai| bezakka tUM hI pUrA giAna rakkhaNa vAlA hai ate hikamata (DUMgI dAnAI) vAlA hai|

allAha ne AkhiA ki he Adama! tUM ratA ihanAM (farizatiAM) nUM uhanAM sArIAM cIz2AM de nAM dassa| jadoM usa (Adama) ne uhanAM nUM uhanAM cIz2AM de nAM dasse tAM allAha ne AkhiA, kI maiM tuhAnUM AkhiA nahIM sI ki maiM hI akAza te dharatI dIAM gupata gallAM nUM jANadA hAM ate uha sabha jANadA hAM jo tusIM pragaTa karade ho ate jo lukAuMde ho|

jadoM asIM farizatiAM nUM hukama dittA ki Adama nUM sijadA karo tAM chuTTa ibalIsa toM sAriAM ne sijadA kara dittA, sagoM usane inakAra kara dittA ate ghamaMDa vI kItA ate (iMja) uha kAfarAM viccoM ho giA|
asIM kihA ki he Adama! tUM ate terI patanI (havvA) jaMnata vica jA raho ate isa viccoM jI bhara ke jo vI cAho khAo (para) isa rukkha de ner3e nahIM jANA nahIM tAM tusIM vI z2AlamAM viccoM ho jAvoge|

para zaitAna ne uhanAM dovAM nUM usa rukkha valla prera ke utthoM (jaMnata viccoM) kaDhavA dittA| asIM hukama dittA ki (tusIM doveM) itthoM (akAza toM) uttara jAo, tusIM doveM (manukkha te zaitAna) ika dUje de vairI ho ate tuhADe dovAM dA TikANA dharatI hai jitthoM tuhAne ika (nizacita) sameM laI usa toM lAbha uThAoNA hai|

phira Adama ne ApaNe rabba toM (taubA karana laI) kujjha bola sikkhe ate allAha ne miharabAnI karade hoe usa dI taubA valla dhiAna dittA|[9] bezakka uhI taubA nUM kabUlaNa vAlA, atiaMta rahima faramAuNa vAlA hai|
translations.footnotes: [9] isa toM bhAva uha taubA de zabada hana jisa duArA haz2arata Adama ne duA kItI sI| iha taubA de zabada ArAfa sUrata dI Aita 23 vica daraja hana|

translations.translation: asIM kihA ki tusIM ithoM (akAzAM toM) heTha utara jAu| jadoM tuhADe kola mere valloM koI hidAita pahuMce tAM jihar3A vI koI merI isa hidAita dI pAlaNA karegA usa nUM (kiAmata dihAr3e) nA tAM kise tarhAM dA koI Dara bhai hovegA ate nA hI koI dukkha hovegA|
ate jinhAM lokAM ne inakAra kItA ate sADIAM AitAM (hukamAM) jhuThalAiA ohI naraka vica jANage jitthe uha sadA laI rahiNage|

he banI isarAIla! tusIM ratA merI usa niamata nUM yAda karo jo maine tuhAnUM inAma vajoM baqhazI sI| mere nAla tuhADe jo praNa sI tusIM usa nUM pUrA karo jo bacana maiM tuhAnUM dittA sI maiM usa nUM pUrA karAMgA ate maithoM hI Daro|

ate isa (kuraAna) ’te ImAna liAu jisa nUM maiM hI nAz2ila kItA hai jo ki usa kitAba (tauraita ate iMjIla) dI puzaTI karana vAlA hai jo tuhADe kola hai| tusIM isa dA inakAra karana vica pahila nA karo ate merIAM AitAM (AdezAM) nUM thor3he mulla utte nA veca suTTo ate maithoM hI Daro|
ate saccAI nUM jhUTha nAla gaDDamaDa nA karo ate saccAI nUM nA lukAo jada ki tusIM (saccAI nUM) jANade ho| [10]
translations.footnotes: [10] isa toM bhAva nabI karIma sa: dIAM uha qhUbIAM hana jihar3IAM tauraita te iMjIla vica likhIAM hoIAM hana jiveM ‘he nabI sAne tuhAnUM hakka dA pragaTAvA, qhuzaqhabarI suNAuNa vAlA ate DarAuNa vAlA (baNA ke bhejiA hai) ate ummIAM (arabAM) nUM (Aqhirata de az2Aba toM) bacAuNa vAlA tUM merA baMdA ate merA rasUla hai| maiM terA nAM mutavakalla rakkhiA hai| uha nA tAM azalIla bhAzA boladA hai ate nA hI kaThora dila hai, nA hI baz2ArAM vica raulA rappA pAuNa vAlA hai ate nA hI burAI dA badalA burAI vica diMdA hai, sagoM aNadekhI karana vAlA ate muAfa karana vAlA hai| allAha usa nUM usa sameM taka nahIM uThAvegA jadoM taka uha usa vigar3I hoI kauma nUM siddhA nA kara deve bhAva iha loka (lA ilAhA ilalla lAha) nA AkhaNa laggaNa ate usa dI barakata nAla aMnhIAM akkhAM, bole kaMna ate g2alAfA vica car3he hoe dila nA khullha jANa| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 2125)

translations.translation: namAz2a kAima karo, z2akAta adA karo ate rukUa karana vAliAM nAla rukUa karo|
tusIM lokAM nUM tAM bhalAIAM (nekIAM) dA hukama diMde ho para ApaNe Apa nUM bhulla jAMde ho [11] jadoM ki tusIM kitAba vI par3hade ho| kI tuhAnUM ukkA hI samajha nahIM?
translations.footnotes: [11]- hadIsa anusAra kiAmata vAle dina ika viakatI nUM vica suTTa ditA jAvegA uha isa vica iMja cakkara khAMdA rahegA jiveM cakkI de pATa ghamAuNa vAlA khotA cakkara khAMdA hai| naraka de vAsI usa de Ale-duAle jamhAM hoke pucchaNage kI tUM uhIo ruM jihar3A saMsAra vica nekI dA hukama diMdA sI ate burAI toM rokadA sI?uha javAba vica kahegA “maiM bhalAI dA hukama tAM diMdA sI para Apa usa ’te amala nahIM sI karadA ate burAI toM rokadA sI para Apa bure kaMma karadA sI|” (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 7098)

translations.translation: tusIM sabara te namAz2a rAhIM allAha dI madada maMgo| bezakka iha bahuta aukhA kaMma hai para rabba toM Darana vAliAM laI (aokhA) nahIM|
(uhanAM laI vI aukhA nahIM) jihar3e loka isa galla vica vizavAsa rakkhade hana ki uha ApaNe rabba nUM z2arUra hI (ika dina) milaNa vAle hana ate use valla parata ke jANa vAle hana|
he banI isarAIla! tusIM merI usa niamata nUM yAda karo jihar3I maine tuhAnUM baqhazI sI maine tuhAnUM saMsAra dIAM sArIAM kaumAM toM vaddha vaDiAI baqhazI sI|

ate usa dina (kiAmata) toM Daro jadoM koI jAna kise dUjI jAna nUM koI lAbha nahIM davegI ate nA hI koI safAraza kabUlI jAvegI ate nA hI badale vica kujjha liA jAvegA ate nA hI uhanAM (kAfarAM) dI madada kItI jAvegI|

ate (uha samAM vI yAda karo) jadoM asIM tuhAnUM firaaunIAM (dI g2ulAmI) toM chuTakArA duAiA sI| uha tuhAnU karar3e kazaTa diMde sana tuhADe puttarAM nUM mAra diMde sana ate tuhADIAM dhIAM nUM jiuMdA rakkha chaDDade sana ate isa vica tuhADe rabba valloM tuhADI bahuta vaDDI az2amAiza sI|

(uha samAM vI yAda karo) jadoM asIM tuhADe (laMghaNa) laI sAgara nUM pAr3a dittA sI, phira asIM tuhAnUM (firaauna toM) bacAiA ate firaaunIAM nUM (samuMdara vica) Doba dittA jada ki tusIM (iha sabha) ApaNI akkhIM vekha rahe sI|
(uha samAM vI yAda karo) jadoM asIM mUsA nUM cAlhI rAtAM de vAade utte (tUra pahAr3a ’te) bulaiA sI| para mUsA de picchoM tusIM vacche nUM izaTa baNA liA (iMja) tusIM z2Alama baNa baiThe|
phira iha sabha hoNa toM bAada vI asIM tuhAnUM muAfa kara dittA tAM jo tusIM dhaMnavAdI baNa jAo|
phira asIM mUsA nUM kitAba (tauraita) ate furakAna (hakka te nAhakka vica aMtara dassaNa vAlI kasauTI) baqhazI tAM jo tusIM hidAita prApata kara sako|

jadoM mUsA ne ApaNI kauma nUM AkhiA ki he merI kauma! bezakka tusIM ApaNe utte Apa hI z2ulama kItA ru (kiuM jo tusIM) vacche nUM izaTa baNAiA hai, isa laI huNa tusIM ApaNe paidA karana vAle dI haz2UrI vica taubA karo ate ApaNe Apa nUM katala karo isa vica hI tuhADe paidA karana vAle dIAM naz2arAM vica tuhADI bhalAI hai phira usa (allAha) ne tuhADe valla dhiAna dittA| bezakka ohIo taubA kabUlaNa vAlA, atiaMta rahima faramAuNa vAlA hai|

(usa sameM nUM yAda karo) jadoM tusIM AkhiA, ki he mUsA! asIM kade vI tuhADe utte ImAna nahIM liAvAMge jadoM taka ki asIM allAha nUM ApaNe sAhamaNe (akhIM) nA vekha laIe| tuhAna (use sameM) bijalI ne A nappiA ate tusIM iha sabha vekha rahe sI|
phira asIM tuhADI mauta magaroM tuhAnUM mur3a jiuMdA kItA tAM jo tusIM (rabba dA) zukara adA karo|

asIM tuhADe utte baddalAM dI chAM kItI ate tuhADe khANa laI maMna ate salavA [12] utAre ate kihA ki ihanAM pavittara cIz2AM viccoM khAo jo asIM tuhAnUM baqhazIAM hana| unhAM ne sADA (kahiNA nA maMna ke) sADe ’te z2ulama nahIM kItA sagoM ApaNe Apa ’te hI z2ulama kItA sI|
translations.footnotes: [12] mujAhida (ra:a:) ne kihA ki ‘maMna’ ika tarhAM dI miTThI gUMda hai ate salavA baTera vAMga ika jAnavara hai| nabI karIma (sa:) ne faramAiA ki khuMbAM vI mana dI hI ika kisama hai kioM jo uha vI binAM mihanata miladIAM hana ate isa vica akkhAM ’coM pANI nikalaNa de roga dI davA hai| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 4478)

translations.translation: jadoM asIM (banI isarAIla nUM) kihA ki tusIM isa basatI vica dAqhala ho jAo ate isa vica jitthoM vI tusIM cAho jI bhara ke khAo para tusIM basatI de daravAz2e vica sijadA karade hoe dAqhala hoNA ate kahiNA ki he allAha! sAnUM baqhaza de, tAM asIM tuhADIAM bhullAM nUM baqhaza devAMge| asIM chetI hI nekIAM karana vAliAM nUM hora vadhere (riz2aka nAla) nivAz2AMge|

para jinhAM lokAM ne z2ulama kItA (bhAva kahiNA nahIM maMniA) uhanAM ne uha galla hI badala dittI jihar3I uhanAM nUM kahI gaI sI phira asIM uhanAM z2AlamAM utte akAza toM az2Aba nAz2ila kItA [13]kiuM jo uha hukamAM dI ulaMghaNA karade sana|
translations.footnotes: [13] isa toM bhAva cecaka dI bImArI hai| hadIsa anusAra cecaka ika tarhAM dA az2Aba hai jihar3A sabha toM pahilAM banI isarAIla dI ika jamAata utte nAz2ila hoiA sI| phira je kise thAM cecaka dI bImArI hove tAM utthe nA jAo jekara use thAM hove tAM utthioM bAhara nA Au| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 3473)

translations.translation: ate jadoM mUsA ne ApaNI kauma laI (rabba toM) pANI maMgiA tAM asIM (mUsA nUM) kihA ki ApaNI soTI patthara ’te mAra so isa (patthara) vicoM bArAM cazame nikale, hara kabIle ne ApaNA ApaNA cazamA pachANa liA (ate kihA ki) allAha de baqhaze hoe riz2aka viccoM khAo pio para tusIM dharatI utte fasAda nA phailAuMde phiro|

(yAda karo) jadoM tusIM (banI isarAIla ne) kihA ki he mUsA! asIM ikko bhAMta de bhojana utte sabara nahIM kara sakade isa laI sADe laI ApaNe rabba toM duA karo ki uha sADe khANa laI uha cIz2AM deve jihar3IAM dharatI ’coM nikaladIAM hana, jiveM tarakArI, kakkar3I, kaNaka, masara te gaMDhe| mUsA ne kihA, kI tusIM vadhIA cIz2a dI thAM ghaTIA cIz2AM nUM pasaMda karade ho? so kise zahira vica cale jAo utthe uha sabha kujjha hai jisa dI tusIM maMga karade ho ate (ihanAM gallAM kArana) uhanAM ’te hINatA te kaMgAlapuNA chA giA ate (zahiroM) uha allAha dI nArAz2agI sahita vApasa Ae| iha sabha isa laI hoiA ki uha allAha dIAM AitAM (hukamAM) dA inakAra ate nabIAM nUM nA-hakkA katala karade sana iha sabha uhanAM dIAM nA-faramAnIAM ate hadAM Tappa jANa de kArana sI|

bezakka jihar3e ImAna liAe ate jo yahUdI, IsAI ate sAbI [14](be-dIna) hana ihanAM viccoM jihar3A vI koI allAha ate Aqhirata de dina utte ImAna liAvegA ate neka kaMma karegA, uhanAM dA badalA uhanAM de rabba kola hai [15] nA tAM uhanAM nUM (naraka dA) bhai hovegA ate nA hI uha udAsa hoNage|
translations.footnotes:
[14] “sAbI” irAka de vAsI sana ate z2abUra par3hiA karade sana| uha kauauma nA yahUdI sI ate nA hI IsAI sI|
[15] isa Aita ate sUrata mAedAha dI Aita 69 toM kujjha lokAM ne sAre dharamAM de ika hoNa dA aratha kaDDhiA hai, bhAva sAre dharama sa=ce hana jada ki iha ThIka nahIM Aita toM ukkA hI iha aratha nahIM nikaladA iha galla kuraAna te hadIsa de viruddha hai| nabI karIma (sa:) dA faramAna hai ki mere utte ImAna nA liAuNa vAlA narakI hai| (sahI musalima kitAbula ImAna, hadIsa: 153)

translations.translation: ate (yAda karo) jadoM asIM tuhADe sirAM ’te tUra pahAr3a jhukA dittA sI ate tuhAthoM (banI isarAIla kauma toM) pakkA bacana liA sI ate asIM AkhiA sI ki jo vI tuhAnUM (Adeza) ditte gae hana uhanAM nUM karar3AI nAla phar3anA ate jo isa (kitAba tauraita) vica liikhaA hoiA hai usa nUM yAda rakkhaNA tAM jo tusIM (allAha de karopa toM) bacaNa vAle baNa jAo|
para tusIM (ApaNe bacanAM toM) phira gae| je tuhADe ’te allAha dI mihara ate usa dA karama nA huMdA tAM tusIM z2arUra hI ghATe vica rahiNa vAle ho jAMde|
tusIM ApaNI kauma de uhanAM lokAM nUM z2arUra hI jANade ho jinhAM ne sabata dA kAnUMna bhaMga kItA sI tAM asIM uhanAM nUM AkhiA ki bAMdara baNa ke z2alIla ho jAo|
phira asIM isa (ghaTanAM) nUM uhanAM laI ate agAMha AuNa vAle inakArIAM laI sikkhiAdAi baNA dittA ate neka lokAM laI nasIhata baNA chaDDiA|

ate jadoM mUsA ne ApaNI kauma nUM kihA ki allAha tuhAnUM hukama diMdA hai ki tusIM ika gaU nUM z2ibaha karo| uhanAM ne kihA, kI tUM sADe nAla makhaula karadA hai? mUsA ne kihA ki maiM (ajihe makhaula toM) allAha dI panAha maMgadA hAM ki maiM vI jAhalAM vica rala jAvAM|

uhanAM (koma) ne AkhiA ki (he mUsA) tUM sADe laI ApaNe rabba toM puccha ke dassa ki uha gaU kiho jihI hove?mUsA ne AkhiA ki allAha kahiMdA hai ki uha gaU nA buDDhI hove te nA hI vacchI hove sagoM vicalI umara dI hove, huNa tusIM use hukama dI pAlaNA karo jisa dA tuhAnUM hukama dittA giA hai|

phira uhanAM (kauma) ne AkhiA ki tUM sADe laI ApaNe rabba toM iha puccha ki uha dasse ki uha gaU kihar3e raMga dI hove hai mUsA ne javAba dittA ki uha gaU pIle raMga dI hove usa dA raMga caMgI tarhAM gUr3A pIlA hoNA cAhIdA hai, jihar3I vekhaNa vAliAM nUM qhuza kara deve|

uhanAM (kauma) ne phira kihA ki sADe laI rabba toM puccha ki uha sAnUM dase ki uha gaU kiho jihI hove? sAna gaU pratI zaMkA ho gaI hai je allAha ne cAhiA tAM asIM z2arUra (raba dI ichA) samajha jAvAMge|

mUsA ne AkhiA ki allAha dA kahiNA ru ki uha gaU kaMma karana vAlI nA hove, nA uha dharatI ’te hala calAuMdI hove ate nA hI khetAM nUM pANI diMdI hove, usa vica kise prakAra dA koI aiba nahIM hoNA cAhIdA nA hI koI dAg2a dhabbA hove| uhanAM (kauma) ne AkhiA ki huNa tusIM hakka dI galla kItI hai| phira uhanAM ne usa (gAM) nUM z2ibaha (kurabAna) kItA laggadA nahIM sI ki uha iha kaMma karaNage|

(yAda karo) jadoM tusIM ika viakatI nUM katala kara dittA sI phira tusIM usa laI jhagar3A kItA (ki isa nUM kisa ne katala kItA hai) ate allAha usa (katala) sapazaTa karana vAlA sI jisa nUM tusIM guppata rakkhade sI|

phira asAM hukama dittA ki tusIM isa (z2ibaha kItI gaU de mAsa) de ika ToTe nAla mare hoe viakatI dI lotha ’te saTTa mAro, uha jiuMdA ho jAvegA| allAha ise tarhAM muradiAM nUM (kiAmata dihAr3e) jiUMdA karegA ate uha tuhA` ApaNIAM nizAnIAM vikhAuMdA ru tAM jo tusIM samajha sako|

isa (ghaTanA) toM bAada tuhADe dila kaThora ho gae| pattharAM vAMga kaThora sagoM uhanAM toM vI vaddha kaThora| bezakka kujjha patthara uha vI hana jinhAM toM nahirAM vagadIAM hana ate kujjha uha vI hana jihar3e jadoM phaTa jAMde hana tAM uhanAM viccoM pANI nikaladA ate ihanAM vicoM kujjha uha vI (patthara) hana jihar3e rabba toM Darade hoe kaMba ke (sijade vica) Diga vI paiMde hana| allAha tuhADIAM z2AlamAnA karatUtAM toM beqhabara nahIM|

(he musalamAno!) kI tusIM iha Asa rakkhade ho ki iha loka tuhADe laI ImAna vAle baNa jANaga, jadoM ki ihanAM viccoM ika guTa ajihA vI ru ki uha allAha dA kalAma (kuraAna) suNadA phira isa samajha laiNa toM bAada vI isa vica phera badala kara diMdA ru jada ki uha isa dI jANakArI vI rakkhadA hai|

jadoM iha (munAfika) loka ImAna vAliAM nUM milade hana tAM Akhade hana ki asIM vI ImAna vAle hAM ate jadoM iha loka ika dUje nUM ikAMta vica milade hana tAM Akhade hana ki tusIM musalamAnAM nUM uha gallAM kiuM dassade ho jihar3IAM allAha ne tuhAnUM dassIAM hana? kI isa laI dassade ho tAM jo uhanAM nUM tuhADe rabba de haz2Ura tuhADe viruddha dalIla vajoM peza karana? kI tuhAnUM ukkA hI samajha nahIM?
kI uha (ajihIAM gallAM karana vAle) nahIM jANade ki bezakka allAha (sabha kujjha) jANadA hai, uha vI jo uha gupata rakkhade hana ate uha vI jo uha pragaTa karade hana|
ihanAM viccoM kujjha aNapar3ha vI hana uha kitAba (vica likhe) nUM nahIM jANade ate chuTTa jhUThIAM AsAM toM uha kevala gumAna hI karade hana|

so uhanAM lokAM laI barabAdI hai jihar3e ApaNI hatthIM kitAba likhade hana phira kahiMde hana ki iha allAha valloM hai tAM jo isa de badale vica thor3hI kImata (saMsArika lAbha) lai sakaNa| ise laI jo vI uhanAM de hatthAM ne likhiA use kArana uhanAM dI barabAdI hai ate uha jihar3I vI kamAI karade hana usa kArana vI uhanAM dI barabAdI hai|

ate ihanAM (yahUdIAM) dA kahiNA ru ki giNatI de thor3he dinAM toM chuTTa (naraka dI) agga sAnUM kade vI nahIM chUhegI| ihanAM nUM puccho, kI tusIM allAha toM isa dA koI bacana liA hoiA hai?(je hai) phira allAha kade vI ApaNe bacanAM dI ulaMghaNA nahIM karadA| kI tusIM allAha de saMbaMdha vica uha gallAM karade ho jisa dA tuhA` ukkA hI patA nahIM?
jisa ne vI koI burAI kamAI ate use burAI vica uha ghiriA rihA uhI tAM naraka vica jAvegA ate sadA use vica hI rahegA|
jihar3e loka ImAna liAuNage ate neka amala karanage uha jaMnatI hana ate uha jaMnata vica sadA laI rahiNage|

ate jadoM asIM banI isarAIla toM pakkA bacana liA sI ki tusIM allAha toM chuTTa kise hora dI ibAdata nA karanA ate mAM, bApa, rizatedArAM, yatImAM ate misakInAM [16]nAla neka ate sohaNA vivahAra karanA ate lokAM nUM caMgIAM gallAM AkhaNA, namAz2a kAima karanA ate z2akAta adA karanA, para tusIM ihanAM (bacanAM) toM phira gae tuhADe viccoM thor3he loka hI (ApaNe bacanAM de) pAbaMda rahe| tusIM bacanAM toM phira jANa vAle hI ho|
translations.footnotes: [16] hadIsa anusAra masakIna uha nahIM jihar3A lokAM de gharAM de cakkara lagAuMdA rahiMdA hai ika burakI do burakIAM ate ika khajUra te do khajUrAM dI cAhata usa nUM gharoM-ghara pheradI hai, sagoM masakIna uha hai jisa de kola iMnAM mAla vI nA hove jisa vica usa dA guz2ArA ho jAve ate koI usa dA hAla vI nA jANadA hove ki usa nUM qhairAta deve ate nA hI uha Apa lokAM toM savAla kare| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 1479)

translations.translation: ate jadoM asIM tuhAthoM pakkA bacana liA sI ki tusIM Apasa vica ika dUje dA qhUna nahIM bahAuge ate nA hI gharAM toM beghara karoge phira tusIM isa dA ikarAra vI kItA sI jisa de tusIM Apa hI gavAha ho|

tusIM hI uha loka ho jo ApaNiAM nUM hI katala karade ho ate ApaNiAM hI gharAM toM beghara karade ho ate tusIM uhanAM de viruddha gunAha ate z2AlamAnA kaMmAM vica dUjiAM dA sAtha diMde ho| je uha tuhADe kola kaidI baNake AuNa tAM tusIM uhanAM dI rihAI laI fiidayA (farautI) laiMde ho jada ki tuhADe laI uhanAM dA (gharoM) kaDDha deNA hI harAma kara dittA giA sI| kI tusIMM kitAba de ika bhAga ’te ImAna rakkhade ho ate kujjha bhAga (AdezAM) dA inakAra karade ho? tuhADe viccoM jihar3A viakatI vI iha (harAma kIte hoe) kaMma karegA usa dI saz2A isa toM chuTTa koI nahIM ki saMsArika jIvana vica uhanAM dI rusavAI hove ate kiAmata vAle dina uha karar3I saz2A (naraka) valla dhakke jANa| tusIM jo vI karatUtAM karade ho allAha uhanAM toM beqhabara nahIM|

iha uha loka hana jinhAM ne saMsArika jIvana Aqhirata de badale vica qharIda liA hai, so nA tAM (kiAmata dihAr3e) unhAM de az2Aba (saz2A) vica koI kamI kItI jAvegI ate nA hI kise tarhAM dI koI madada hI kItI jAvegI|

ate bezakka asIM mUsA nUM kitAba (tauraita) dittI ate usa toM magaroM usa de upparothallI rasUla bheje ate asIM marIama de puttara IsA sAfa-sAfa dalIlAM dittIAM ate usa (IsA) dI pavittara rUha (jibarAIla) de nAla madada kItI| phera jada vI tuhADe kola koI paig2aMbara uha cIz2a (Adeza) lai ke AiA jisa nUM tuhADe dila pasaMda nahIM sI karade tAM tusIM ghamaMDa vica Ake kujjha (rasUlAM) ` jhuThalAiA ate kujjha nUM katala kara suTTiA|

ate uha Akhade hana ki sADe dilAM ’te (inhAM gallAM toM surakkhiata hoNa laI) g2alAfa car3he hoe hana| nahIM, sagoM inhAM de inakArI hoNa kArana allAha ne inhAM ’te phiTakAra pAI hoI hai| isa laI thor3he loka hI (rasUlAM utte) ImAna liAe|

phira uhanAM kola uhanAM de rabba valloM uha kitAba (.kuraAna) A gaI jihar3I usa kitAba (tauraita) dI puzaTI karadI ru jihar3I uhanAM de kola hai| jada ki isa toM pahilAM uha Apa ihanAM (kAfarAM) de viruddha fatiha (dIAM duAvAM) maMgiA karade sana para jadoM uha (hakka) uhanAM kola A giA jisa nUM uhanAM ne pachANa vI liA sI phira vI uhanAM ne usa nUM maMNana toM inakAra kara dittA| allAha dI ihanAM (kAfarAM) ’te phiTakAra hai|

bahuta hI bhair3I hai uha cIz2a jisa de badale uhanAM ne ApaNe Apa nUM veca suTTiA hai| iha usa cIz2a dA inakAra karade hana jihar3I allAha valloM nAz2ila hoI hai kevala isa IrakhA kAraNa ki allAha ne ApaNe jisa baMde nUM cAhiA usa nUM (paig2aMbarI nAla) nivAz2a dittA| isa laI uha upparothalI karopI de bhAgI baNa gae hana| ajihe kAfarAM laI z2alIla karana vAlA az2Aba |

jadoM uhanAM (kAfarAM) nUM kihA jAMdA hai ki allAha valloM utArI hoI kitAba (.kuraAna) utte ImAna liAo tAM Akhade hana ki asIM tAM usa ’te hI ImAna liAe hAM jihar3I sADe laI (tauraita) nAz2ila hoI ru ate uha isa toM chuTTa hora sArIAM (kitAbAM) dA inakAra karade hana| jada ki iha (.kuraAna) hakka hai ate usa kitAba dI puzaTI karadA ru jihar3I uhanAM de kola ru| (he nabI sa:!) ihanAM puccho ki je tusIM ImAna vAle ho tAM isa toM pahilAM tusIM allAha de nabIAM katala kiuM karade rahe ho?
bezakka mUsA tuhADe kola sapazaTa moajaz2e (rabI camatakAra) lai ke AiA para tusIM usa de (tUra pahAr3a utte) jANa toM bAada vacche dI pUjA karanI zurU kara dittI| asala vica tusIM tAM ho hI z2Alama|

ate (ratA usa sameM nUM yAda karo) jadoM tUra pahAr3a nUM tuhADe utte cukka ke asAM tuhAthoM pakkA praNa liA sI ate hukama dittA sI ki jo vI (Adeza) tuhAnUM ditte gae hana uhanAM dI saqhatI nAla pAlaNA karo ate (hukamAM nUM dhiAna nAla) suNo! uhanAM (kauma) ne AkhiA ki asIM (sabha) suNa liA hai para asIM (fera vI hukamAM dI) pAlaNA nahIM karAMge| uhanAM de ise inakAra kArana uhanAM de manAM vica vache dI muhabbata pA dittI gaI (he nabI! ihanAM nUM) Akha dio ki je tusIM momina ho tAM (samajha lavo) ki uha kaMma sAre hI bure hana jinhAM laI tuhADA ImAna (dharama) tuhAnUM hukama diMdA hai|
(he nabI! ihanAM nUM) Akha dio ki jekara allAha de kola Aqhirata dA ghara tuhADe laI hI vizeza kItA hoiA hai tAM ratA mauta dI icchA tAM karo je tusIM (ApaNI galla vica) sacce ho|
uha ApaNe uhanAM gunAhAM kArana jihar3e uha ApaNe hatthI kamA ke agge bheja cukke hana, kade vI isa (mauta) dI kAmanA nahIM karanage| allAha ihanAM z2AlamAM nUM caMgI tarhAM jANadA hai|

tusIM ihanAM (yahUdIAM) nUM sabha toM vadha ke jiuNa de lAlacI vekhoge uhanAM toM vI vaddha jihar3e ziraka karade hana| ihanAM vica hareka viakatI iho cAhuMdA hai ki kAza usa nUM ika haz2Ara sAla dI umara mila jAve jada ki iha laMmIAM umarAM vI uhanAM nUM az2Aba toM bacAuNa vAlIAM nahIM| jihar3e iha kaMma karade hana allAha uhanAM nUM bhalI-bhAMta jANadA hai|

(he nabI!) tusIM Akha dio ki jihar3A vI koI jibarAIla dA vairI hai (usa nUM patA hoNA cAhIdA hai) ki uhane hI isa.kuraAna nUM allAha de hukamAM anusAra Apa (muhaMmada) de dila ’te nAz2ila kItA hai| iha (.kuraAna) usa (tauraita) dI vI (allAha valloM hoNa dI) puzaTI karadA hai jihar3I isa (.kuraAna) toM pahilAM nAz2ila hoI sI ate (isa vica) ImAna vAliAM laI hidAitAM ate qhuzaqhabarIAM hana|
jihar3A vI koI allAha dA, usa de farizatiAM dA, rasUlAM dA, jibarAIla te mIkAIla (farizatiAM) dA vairI hai tAM allAha vI (uhanAM) kAfarAM dA vairI hai|
(he nabI!) jihar3IAM khullhIAM AitAM asIM tuhADe valla bhejIAM hana, chuTTa nA-faramAnAM toM, uhanAM dA koI vI inakAra nahIM karadA|
kI isa tarhAM nahIM huMdA rihA ki jadoM vI uhanAM (yahUdIAM) ne koI praNa kItA tAM uhanAM viccoM hI ika dhira ne usa nUM tor3a suTTiA| ihanAM viccoM bathere loka ImAna liAuMde hI nahIM|

jadoM vI allAha valloM ihanAM kola koI nabI AiA jihar3A ihanAM kola maujUda (allAha valloM AIAM) kitAbAM dI puzaTI karadA sI| jinhAM nUM kitAba dittI gaI sI uhanAM viccoM hI ika dhira ne allAha dI kitAba nUM isa tarhAM piTha piche suTTa dittA jiveM ki uha kujjha jANade hI nahIM|

sagoM uhanAM ne usa dI pairavI kItI jisa nUM zaitAna sulemAna dI hakUmata vica par3hiA karade sana| sulemAna ne kufara nahIM sI kItA sagoM zaitAnAM ne hI kufara kItA sI| uha lokAM nUM jAdU dI sikkhiA diMde sana| uhanAM ne usa dI pairavI kItI jo bAbula vikhe hArUta te mArUta (nAM de) do farizatiAM utte nAz2ila kItA giA sI| uha doveM farizate lokAM nUM jAdU sikhAuNa toM pahilAM kahi diMde sana ki asIM tAM kevala (tuhADI) az2amAiza (laI Ae) hAM, so tusIM kufara nA karo| para lokI uhanAM dovAM (farizatiAM) toM uha jAdU sikhade jisa nAla uha patI patanI vica judAI pA deNa jada ki uha jAdU rAhIM chuTTa allAha de hukamAM toM kise nUM koI hAnI nahIM pahuMcA sakade sI ate loka vI uhanAM (farizatiAM) toM uha giAna sikhade sI jihar3A uhanAM nUM nukasAna pahuMcAuMdA sI, nA ki koI lAbha| jada ki uha caMgI tarhAM jANade sana ki jisa ne vI isa (jAdU) nUM qharIdiA (sikkhiA) Aqhirata vica usa dA kujjha vI hissA nahIM| jisa cIz2a (jAdU) de badale vica uhanAM ne ApaNIAM jAnAM dA saudA kItA sI uha bahuta hI bhair3I cIz2a sI| kAza! uha jANade (ki uha kI kara rahe hana)|
je uha ImAna liAuMde ate rabba toM Darade hoe burAIAM toM bace rahiMde tAM allAha de kola bezakka uhanAM nUM isa dA bahuta hI vadhIA badalA miladA|! je uha jANade|

he ImAna vAlio! (jadoM tusIM nabI (sa:) nUM saMbodhita karo tAM) ‘rAinA’ [17] nA Akho sagoM ‘unaz2uranA’ Akho ate tusIM (nabI dI galla nUM ) dhiAna nAla suNo| inakArIAM laI tAM bahuta hI dukhadAI az2Aba hai|
translations.footnotes: [17] “rAinA” toM bhAva hai sADe valla dhiAna dio para yahUdI isa zabada nUM vigar3a ke “rAInA” Akhade sana jisadA aratha hai mUrakha| iMja uha nabI karIma (sa:) dA nirAdara karade sana| musalamAnAM nUM iha zabada bolaNa toM roka dittA giA ate lor3a paiNa ’te unaz2uranA kahiNa dA hukama dittA giA jisa dA aratha hai sADe valla dhiAna deo|

translations.translation: he nabI! ahale kitAba (yahUdI te IsAIAM) viccoM jinhAM ne vI kufara kItA uha nahIM cAhuMde ate nA hI muzarika cAhuMde hana ki tuhADe ’te tuhADe rabba valloM koI bhalAI (paig2aMbarI) nAz2ila hove para allAha jisa nUM cAhuMdA hai use nUM ApaNIAM miharAM laI cuNa laiMdA | allAha hI vaDDe fajalAM dA mAlika hai|

jihar3IAM AitAM asIM (allAha) rada kara diMde hAM jAM (nabI toM) bhulA diMde hAM tAM asIM uhanAM (AitAM) toM vI vadhIA jAM uhanAM jahiAM hora (AitAM) liAuMde hAM| kI tusIM nahIM jANade ki bezakka allAha hI hara kaMma karana dI samarathA rakkhadA hai?
kI tusIM nahIM jANade ki bezakka allAha laI hI akAzAM te dharatI dI pAtazAhI hai? tuhADe laI allAha toM chuTTa nA koI himAitI ru ate nA hI koI madada karana vAlA hai|

(he musalamAno!) kI tusIM vI ApaNe rasUla (muhaMmada) toM (be-lor3e) savAla karanA cAhuMde ho jiveM isa toM pahilAM mUsA toM savAla kIte gae sana| jihar3A vI ImAna dI thAM kufara dI rAha ikhatiAra karegA bezakka uha siddhI rAha toM bhaTaka giA|

ahale kitAba vicoM bahute loka iha cAhuMde hana ki kAza uha tuhADe ImAna liAuNa toM bAada tuhAnUM mur3a kAfira baNA deNa| uha ApaNe dilAM vica (tuhADe pratI) IrakhA rakkhade hana jada ki uhanAM de sAhamaNe hakka vI sapazaTa ho giA hai| so tusIM uhanAM nUM qhimA kara dio ate uhanAM de hAla ’te chaDDa dio itthoM taka ki allAha uhanAM laI ApaNA koI vizeza hukama lAgU kara deve| bezaka allAha hareka kaMma karana dI kudarata rakhadA hai|

he musalamAno! tusIM namAz2a kAima karo, z2akAta adA karo| tusIM ApaNe laI jihar3I vI bhalAI agge bhejoge usa nUM allAha kola hAz2ira pAoge| bezakka tusIM jo vI amala karade ho allAha uhanAM sabha nUM vekhadA hai|

iha (ahale kitAba) kahiMde hana ki jaMnata vica tAM kevala yahUdI te nasarAnI (IsAI) hI jANage (jada ki) iha sabha uhanAM dIAM (jhUThIAM) AsAM hana (he nabI) tusIM Akha dio ki je tusIM isa galla vica sacce ho tAM koI dalIla peza karo|

kiuM nahIM uha (jaMnata vica jAvegA) jisa ne ApaNe cihare (sIsa) nUM allAha age jhukA dittA hai, jada ki uha nekI vI karana vAlA | usa dA badalA usa de rabba kola hai| nA hI uhanAM nUM (naraka dA) Dara hovegA ate nA hI uha dukhI hoNage|

yahUdI Akhade hana ki IsAIAM dA koI adhAra nahIM ate IsAI Akhade hana ki yahUdIAM dA koI adhAra nahIM jada ki uha doveM kitAba (tauraita ate iMjIla) par3hade hana| ise tarhAM jo loka kujjha vI giAna nahIM rakkhade uha vI ise tarhAM dIAM miladIAM juladIAM galAM karade hana| kiAmata vAle dina allAha uhanAM de vicakAra de sAre mattabhedAM dA faisalA kara devegA|

isa toM vadha ke z2Alama koNa hovegA jihar3A lokAM nUM masItAM vi allAha dA z2ikara (ibAdata) karana toM rokadA hai ate uhanAM nUM ujAr3ana dI koziza karadA hai| jada ki uhanAM nUM cAhIdA sI ki (rabba toM) Darade hoe (masItAM) vica jANa, ajihe viakatIAM laI dunIAM vica vI rusavAI hai ate Aqhirata vica karar3e az2Aba (saz2AvAM) hana|
pUraba te pacchama dA mAlika allAha hI hai| tusIM jisa dizA valla vI ciharA karoge use valla allAha hai| allAha sarava viApI ate sabha kujjha jANana vAlA hai|

iha (ahale kitAba) Akhade hana ki allAha dI saMtAna hai [18] jada ki allAha (ihanAM gallAM toM) pAka hai| jo kujjha vI akAzAM ate dharatI vica hai uha sabha uese dA hI hai, hareka cIz2a use dI AgiAkArI hai|
translations.footnotes: [18]hadIse kudasI hai ki Adama de puttara ne mainUM (allAha nUM) jhuThalAiA hAlAM ki iha usa dA hakka nahIM sI uha mainUM gAlAM kaDDhadA hai jada ki iha usa nUM hakka nahIM pahuMcadA usa dA jhuThalAuNA iha hai ki uha iha dAavA karadA hai ki maiM usa nUM pahilAM vAMga mur3a jiuMdA karana dI kudarata nahIM rakkhadA ate usa dIAM gAlAM iha hana ki uha AkhadA hai ki merI vI aulAda hai hAlAM ki maiM ihanAM sArIAM gallAM toM pAka hAM ki merI patanI jAM aulAda hove| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 4482)

translations.translation: uha akAzAM ate dharatI dA kADhakAra hai jadoM uha koI kaMma karanA cAhuMdA hai tAM isa laI kevala iho kahiMdA hai ki ‘ho jA’ ate uha ho jAMdA hai|

ate uha loka jihar3e kujjha vI giAna nahIM rakkhade Akhade hana ki allAha sADe nAla galAM kiuM nahIM karadA?jAM sADe kola koI nizAnI kiuM nahIM AI? iho jihIAM gallAM ihanAM toM pahilAM bIta cuke loka vI karade sana| ihanAM sabhaNAM dI soca ikko jihIrahai| asIM saccAI utte vizavAsa karana vAliAM laI ApaNIAM nizAnIAM sapazaTa kara dittIAM hana|

bezakka! asIM tuhAnUM (he muhaMmada) hakka (.kuraAna) de nAla qhuzaqhabarIAM suNAuNa vAlA ate DarAuNa vAlA baNA ke bhejiA [19] naraka vica jANa vAliAM de saMbaMdha vica tuhAthoM koI puccha -giccha nahIM hovegI|
translations.footnotes: [19] vekho sUrata Ale-imarAna, hAzIA Aita 85/3

translations.translation: yahUdI te IsAI tuhAthoM kade vI rAz2I nahIM hoNage jada tIka ki tusIM uhanAM de dharama de pairokAra nahIM baNa jAMde| (he nabI!) Akha dio ki bezakka allAha dI hidAita hI asalI hidAita hai| tuhADe kola jihar3A giAna AiA hai je tusIM isa toM bAada vI ihanAM (yahUdIAM) dIAM icchAvAM dI pairavI kItI tAM tuhAnUM allAha dI pakar3a toM bacAuNa vAlA nA tuhADA koI himAitI hovegA nA hI koI madadagAra hovegA|

jinhAM lokAM nUM asIM kitAba (.kuraAna) dittI hai uha isa nUM iMja par3hade hana jiveM isa nUM par3haNa dA hakka hai uhIo loka isa ’te ImAna liAuMde hana ate jihar3A isadA inakAra karadA hai uhIo (Aqhirata vica) ghATe vica rahegA|
he banI isarAIla! tusIM ratA merIAM uhanAM niamatAM nUM tAM yAda karo jihar3IAM maiM tuhAnUM baqhazIAM sI ate maiM tuhAnUM kulla jahAna (dIAM kaumAM) utte vaDiAI (saradArI) baqhazI sI|

ate usa dina toM Daro jadoM koI viakatI kise dUje de kaMma nahIM AvegA ate nA hI koI cIz2a (saz2A de) badale vica kabUla kItI jAvegI ate nA hI usa (aparAdhI) nUM koI safAraza hI lAbha devegI ate nA hI usa dI koI madada hI kItI jAvegI|

ate jadoM ibarAhIma nUM usa de rabba ne kujjha gallAM nAla az2amAiA ate uha uhanAM vica kharA uttariA tAM allAha ne AkhiA ki maiM tuhAnUM lokAM dA imAma (AgU) baNAuNa vAlA hAM| uhanAM (ibarAhIma ne) kihA, kI merI aulAda viccoM vI koI (imAma) hovegA? allAha ne kihA ki merA vAadA z2AlamAM nAla nahIM|

ate jadoM asIM allAha de ghara (qhAnA-kAabA) nUM lokAM laI mur3a-mur3a AuNa vAlI thAM ate amana dA keMdara baNAiA ate (hukama dittA ki) tusIM makAme ibarAhIma nUM namAz2a par3hana vAlI thAM baNAo ate asAM ibarAhIma te isamAIla nUM hukama dittA ki tusIM doveM mere ghara nUM tavAfa (parakaramA) aitakAfa (ThahiraNa laI), rukUa ate sijadA (namAz2a adA) karana vAliAM laI pAka sAfa kho|

jadoM ibarAhIma ne kihA ki he mere rabbA! isa (makke) nUM amana dA zahira baNA de ate isade vAsIAM viccoM jihar3e allAha ate Aqhirata ’te ImAna liAuNa uhanAM nUM phalAM dA riz2aka (roz2IAM) pradAna kara| allAha ne kihA ki jihar3A inakAra karegA usa nUM maiM saMsAra vica hI thor3hA jihA lAbha diAMgA phira maiM usa nUM agga dA az2Aba laiNa laI majabUra kara diAMgA ate uha bahuta hI bhair3I thAM hai|

ate (yAda karo) jadoM ibarAhIma ate isamAIla allAha de ghara (qhAnA-kAabA) dIAM kaMdhAM ucIAM kara rahe sana (ate duA kara rahe sana ki) he sADe rabba tUM sAthoM (iha nekI) kabUla faramA bezakka tUM hI sabha kujjha suNana vAlA te jANana vAlA hai|

(iha vI duA kItI ki) he sADe rabba! sAnUM dohAM nUM ApaNA AgiAkArI baNA ate sADI aulAda viccoM vI ika jamAata nUM ApaNA AgiAkArI baNA ate sAnUM ibAdata karana de DhaMga vI sikhA ate sADe valla dhiAna de, bezakka tUM hI taubA nUM kabUla karana vAlA ate atiaMta rahima faramAuNa vAlA hai|

he sADe mAlika! ihanAM lokAM viccoM hI ihanAM laI vI ika rasUla bheja jihar3A ihanAM de sAhamaNe terIAM AitAM (adezAM) nUM par3he ate ihanAM nUM kitAba ate hikamata (samajha bUjha) dI sikkhiA deve ate inhAM nUM (burAIAM toM) pAka kara| bezakka tUM hI vaDDA z2orAvAra ate hikamata vAlA hai|

huNa koNa hai jihar3A ibarAhIma de tarIke nAla nafatara kare hai chuTTa usa toM jisa ne ApaNe Apa nUM mUrakhatA vica phasA liA hove| bezakka asIM ibarAhIma nUM saMsAra vica (imAma baNAuNa laI) cuNa liA hai ate paraloka vica uha neka lokAM vica giiNaA jAvegA|
ate jadoM ibarAhIma nUM usa de rabba ne AkhiA ki AgiAkArI baNa jA tAM usa ne kihA ki maiM sAre jahAnAM de mAlika dA AgiAkArI baNa giA|

ibarAhIma ate yAkUba ne ApaNe puttarAM nUM isa (saccI galla) dI vasIata karade hoe kihA ki he mere puttaro! bezakka allAha ne tuhADe laI iho dIna (isalAma) naM pasaMda kItA hai so marade dama taka tusIM musalamAna hI rahiNA|

jadoM yAkUba dI mauta AI sI kI usa sameM tusIM hAz2ara sI jadoM usa ne ApaNe puttarAM nUM pucchiA sI ki mere magaroM tusIM kisa dI ibAdata karoge? uhanAM ne kihA ki asIM tere izaTa ate tere bApa dAdA ibarAhIma, isamAIla ate isahAka de izaTa dI ibAdata karAMge jihar3A ika hI izaTa (allAha) hai asIM sAre use de AgiAkArI hAM|

iha ika TolI sI jihar3I bIta cukkI| hareka laI uhIo (badalA) hai jihar3A usa ne kamAiA ru ate tuhADe laI uha hai jihar3A tusIM kamAuge| uhanAM (bIta cukke lokAM) de kaMmAM bAre tuhAthoM pucchiA nahIM jAvegA|

(he nabI) uha (ahale kitAba) Akhade hana ki tusIM yahUdI jAM IsAI baNa jAu tAM hidAita milegI| tusIM Akha diu ki asIM tAM ibarAhIma de dharama dI pairavI karade hAM jihar3A hakka sacca agge jhukaNa vAlA sI ate uha muzarikAM [20] viccoM vI nahIM sI|
translations.footnotes: [20] haz2arata muhaMmada(sa:) de nabI hoNa toM pahilAM bahute loka ziraka vica phase hoe sana, bahuta hI ghaTTa loka tauhIda (rabba ika hoNa) toM jANU sana| haz2arata abadullA bina umara dA faramAna hai ki vahI de AuNa toM pahilAM dA samAM sI ki baladAha basatI vica nabI (sa:) dA sAhamaNA z2aida bina umara bina nafIla nAla hoiA utthe Apa (sa:) nUM bhojana parosiA giA tAM Apa (sa:) ne usa dA sAtha deNa toM inakAra kara dittA, phira z2aida nUM kihA ki maiM ajihI koI vI cIz2a nahIM khAMdA jo tusIM ApaNe butAM Adi de thANa ’te z2ibaha karade ho| z2aida bina umara kuraiza nUM kihA karade sI ki allAha hI tAM hai jisa ne jAnavarAM nUM paidA kItA akAza toM pANI utAriA ate dharatI viccoM cArAha ugAiA phira tusIM allAha toM chuTTa kise hora de nAM ’te jAnavara kioM z2ibaha karade ho| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 3826)

translations.translation: (he musalamAno!) tusIM Akho ki asIM allAha ’te ImAna liAe hAM ate usa ’te vI jo sADe vala (.kuraAna) utAriA giA hai| ate jihar3A vI ibarAhIma, isamAIla, isahAka, yAkUba ate uhanAM dI aulAda laI (rabbI faramAna) utAriA giA ru ate jo mUsA, ate IsA nUM (kitAbAM) dittIAM chagaIAM hana ate jo dUje sAre nabIAM nUM uhanAM de rabba valloM (Adeza) ditte gae sana (sADA uhanAM sabha ’te ImAna hai) asIM uhanAM (nabIAM) vicakAra koI bheda bhAva nahIM karade ate asIM sAre usa (allAha) de AgiAkArI hAM|

je uha (ahale kitAba) vI uhanAM sArIAM cIz2AM ’te ImAna liAuNa jinhAM ’te tusIM ImAna liAe ho tAM uha vI hidAita vAle baNa jANage| je uha ImAna liAuNa toM mUMha mor3ana tAM uha tuhADe virodhI hana so uhanAM de mukAbale laI allAha hI batherA hai ate uha bhalI-bhAMta suNana te jANana vAlA hai|
(he nabI ihanAM nUM Akho) ki allAha de raMga vica raMga jAu usa de raMga toM sohaNA kisa dA raMga ru? ate asIM sAre use dI ibAdata karade hAM|

(he nabI! tusIM) Akho, kI tusIM sADe nAla allAha bAre jhagar3ade ho? jadoM ki uha sADA vI rabba hai ate tuhADA vI uhIo rabba hai ate sADe laI sADe karama hana ate tuhADe laI tuhADe karama hana ate asIM sAre (karama) qhAlasa use (allAha dI raz2A) laI karade hAM| [21]
translations.footnotes:
[21]isa vica dassiAM giA hai ki jihar3A vI kaMma kevala allAha dI raz2A laI kItA jAMdA hai uhIo amala mukatI dA kArana baNadA hai ate isa vica iqhalAsa dI mahattatA vI dassI gaI hai (1) allAha de rasUla (sa:) rAta nUM iMnI laMmI namAz2a par3hiA karade sI ki pairAM ’te sojA A jAMdA| jadoM Apa jI nUM kihA jAMdA ki tusIM iMnA kazaTa kioM uThAuMde ho tAM Akhade “kI maiM allAha dA dhaMnavAdI nA baNA? ” (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 6471) * allAha de rasUla (sa:) ne faramAiA ki bhale kaMma sahI tarIke nAla, iqhalAsa nAla karade raho ate hoMda nA vadho sagoM vicakAra vAlI rAha apaNAo ate qhuza raho (allAha dI rahimata toM be-Asa nA hovo) kiuM jo kevala neka kaMma hI kise nUM jaMnata vica nahIM laike jANage| Apa jI (sa:) toM pucchiA giA ki kI tusIM vI amalAM de sadake jaMnata vica nahIM jAoge? Apa ne faramAiA hAM maiM vI para iha galla vI hai ki allAha mainUM ApaNI baqhaziza ate miharAM dI chatara-chAiA heTha vI lai lave| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 6467) * hadIsa vicca hai ki nabI (sa:) ne faramAiA ki je mere kola ੳhada de pahAr3a jiMnA sonA huMdA phira vI maiM isa gala ’te qhuza hovAMgA ki lagAtAra tiMna rAtAM bItaNa toM pahilAM ika kaNa vI mere kola nA rahe| hAM! je kise dA karaz2a adA karana laI rakkha lavAM tAM vakkharI galla hai| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 6445)
* allAha de rasUla ne faramAiA ika piAsA kuttA khUha de Ale-duAle cakkara lagA rihA sI piAsa kArana usa dA dama nikalaNa vAlA hI sI ki banI isarAIla dI ika badakAra auaurata dI usa ’te nigAha pai gaI tAM usa ne ApaNI jutI utArI ate usa vica pANI bhara ke kutte nUM piA dittA allAha ne ise kArana usa dI baqhaziza kara dittI| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 3467)

translations.translation: kI tusIM (ahale kitAba) iha kahiMde ho ki ibarAhIma, isamAIla, isahAka, yAkUba ate uhanAM dI saMtAna yahUdI jA IsAI sana? (he nabI tusIM) ihanAM nUM puccho, kI tusIM vaddha jANade ho jAM allAha? ate isa toM vaDDA z2Alima kauNa hovegA jihar3A usa gavAhI nUM lukAveM jihar3I uhanAM kola allAha valloM (tauraita te iMjIla vica) AI hoI hai? ate allAha tuhADe valloM kItIAM gaIAM karatUtAM toM beqhabara nahIM|
(iha) ika jamAata sI jihar3I bIta cukkI hai jo uhanAM ne kamAiA uhanAM laI sI ate tuhADe laI uhI hai jo tusIM kamAiA| tuhAthoM nahIM pucchiA jAvegA jo kujjha uha karade sana|

chetI hI iha mUrakha loka AkhaNage ki ihanAM (musalamAnAM) de kibale (dizA) nUM kisa ne badaliA hai jisa valla (mUMha karake iha namAz2a par3hiA karade) sana? (he nabI! tusIM) Akha dio ki pUraba te pacchama allAha de hana uha jisa nUM cAhuMdA hai siddhI rAha dI hidAita diMdA hai|

aiveM hI asAM (allAha ne musalamAno) tuhAnUM vI uttama daraje dI (jamAata) baNAiA hai tAM jo tusIM lokAM ’te gavAha baNo ate rasUla tuhADe laI gavAhI deNa| [22] (he nabI) jisa dizA (baitala makaddasa) valla tusIM pahilAM sI usa nUM kevala isa laI niyata kItA giA sI ki (patA lagge) ki koNa rasUla (muhaMmada) dI pairavI karadA hai, ate kihar3A ApaNe paira pichAMha khiccadA hai| bezakka iha (dizA dA badalAo) hai tAM bahuta aukhA para uhanAM lokAM laI aukhA nahIM jinhAM nUM allAha ne hidAita baqhazI hai| iMja vI nahIM ki allAha tuhADe ImAna nUM barabAda hI kara deve| bezakka allAha lokAM nAla naramI karana vAlA ate rahima karana vAlA hai|
translations.footnotes: [22]- isa dI viAkhiA hadIsa vica ru ki kiAmata vAle dina haz2arata nUha nUM bulAiA jAvegA tAM uha AkhaNage ki maiM hAz2ara hAM he mere pAlaNahAra maiM terA AgiAkArI hAM| allAha taAlA uhanAM toM pucchegA kI tUM sADA paig2Ama lokAM taka pahuMcA dittA sI? uttara vica haz2arata nUha AkhaNage ki hAM mere rabba| phira uhanAM dI kauma toM pucchiA jAvegA ki nUha ne sADA paig2Ama tuhAnUM de dittA sI? uha uttara vica AkhaNage ki sADe kola tAM koI vI DarAuNa vAlA nahIM AiA sI| isa ’te allAha nUha nUM faramAegA, kI tere hakka vica koI gavAhI deNa vAlA vI hai? haz2arata nUha AkhaNage ki haz2arata muhaMmada (sa:) ate uhanAM dI ummata hai phira ummate muhammadiA gavAhI devegI ki haz2arata nUha ne iha paig2Ama ApaNI kauma taka pahuMcA dittA sI ate he ummate muhammadiA! rasUla (sa:) tuhADe utte gavAha hoNage ate iho aratha hai allAha taAlA de isa faramAna dA ki asIM tuhAnUM sabha toM vaddha vaDiAI vAlI ummata baNAiA hai tAM jo tusIM lokAM utte gavAha baNa jAu ate rasUla (sa:) tuhADe utte gavAha baNa jANa| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 4487)

translations.translation: (he nabI sa:!) asIM (allAha) tuhADe cihare nUM mur3a mur3a akAza valla uThadA vekha rahe hAM asIM tuhA` use kibale (dizA) valla mor3a diAMge jihar3A tuhA` pasaMda hai, so tusIM ApaNA mUMha masajide harAma (qhAnA-kAabA) vala phera lavo ate tusIM jitthe kIte vI (namAz2a par3hade) hovo ApaNA mUMha use valla phera liA karo| jinhAM nUM kitAba (tauraita ate iMjIla) dittI gaI hai uha avazza hI (qhAnA-kAabA dI mahattatA nUM) jANade hana ki bezakka iha uhanAM de rabba valloM hakka (vAlA faisalA) hai ate allAha uhanAM (dIAM karatUtAM) toM ukkA hI beqhabara nahIM jo uha (ahale kitAba) karade hana|

he nabI! tusIM uhanAM lokAM de kola jinhAM nUM kitAba dittI gaI sI kiMnIAM hI dalIlAM kiuM nA lai Ao tAM vI uha tuhADe kibale dI pairavI nahIM karanage ate nA hI tusIM huNa uhanAM de kibale (baitula-mukaddasa) dI pairavI karana vAle ho ate ihanAM (yahUdI ate IsAIAM) viccoM koI vI dhar3A dUje dhar3e de kibale dI pairavI karana vAlA nahIM (he nabI!) je tusIM vI uhanAM dIAM icchAvAM dI pairavI kItI jada ki tuhADe kola (rabbI) giAna A cukkiA hai tAM tusIM vI z2AlamAM vica giNe jAvoge|

jinhAM lokAM nUM asIM kitAbAM dittIAM uha isa (rasUla) nUM iMja pachANade hana jiveM ApaNe puttarAM naM pachANade hana| para ihanAM viccoM ika TolA haka nUM jANa bujha ke lukA rihA hai jada ki uha (saccAI nUM) bhalIbhAMta jANadA hai|
bezakka tuhADe rabba valloM iho hakka vAlI galla hai, so tusIM isa bAre kise saMdeha vica nA puo|

hareka laI ika dizA hai jisa valla uha mur3adA hai| so tusIM nekIAM karana vica ika dUje toM agAMha vaddho| tusIM jitthe vI hovoge allAha tuhAnUM sabha nUM (ise dizA valla) lai AvegA| bezakka allAha hara prakAra dI samarathA rakhadA hai|

(he nabI!) tusIM jitthe vI hovo ho ke laMgho ApaNA mUMha (namAz2a vele) masajide harAma (qhAnA-kAabA) valla kara liA karo ate iha tuhADe rabba valloM inasAfa vAlA faisalA hai ate allAha tuhADe kIte amalAM toM beqhabara nahIM|

(he nabI) tusIM jitthe vI ho ke laMgho apaNA mUMha masajide harAma valla (namAz2a vele) kara liA karo ate (he musalamAno) tusIM vI jitthe vI hovo ApaNA mUMha (namAz2a vele) use (qhAnA-kAabA) valla kara liA karo tAM jo lokAM nUM tuhADe viruddha (bolaNa laI) koI dalIla nA mile| hAM! ihanAM viccoM jihar3e z2Alima hana (uha bolade rahiNage) tusIM uhanAM toM nA Daro kevala maithoM hI Daro tAM jo maiM tuhADe ’te ApaNIAM sArIAM niamatAM pUrIAM kara devAM tAM jo tusIM siddhI rAha prApata kara sako|

asIM tuhADe laI tuhADe viccoM hI ika rasUla (niamata vajoM) bhejiA hai, uha tuhAnUM sADIAM AitAM (.kuraAna) suNAuMdA hai ate tuhAnUM pAka karadA ru ate tuhAnUM kitAba ate hikamata (.kuraAna te hadIsa) dI sikkhiA diMdA hai ate tuhAnUM uha gallAM sikhAuMdA hai jinhAM nUM tusIM (ukkA hI) nahIM jANade sI|
so tusIM (he ImAna vAlio!) mainUM yAda rakkho maiM tuhAnUM yAda rakhAMgA|[23] tusIM merA zukara adA karo merI nA-zukarI nA karo|
translations.footnotes: [23] allAha de rasUla (sa:) dA irazAda ru ki allAha dA kahiNA hai ki merA baMdA mere pratI jihar3I soca hai khadA maiM use de anusAra ho jAMdA hAM jadoM uha mainUM yAda karadA hai tAM maiM usa de kola huMdA hAM je uha mainUM dila vica yAda karadA hai tAM maiM vI usa nUM dila vica yAda karadA hAM je uha mainUM kise sabhA vica yAda karadA hai tAM maiM vI usa nUM usa toM vadhIA farizatiAM dI sabhA vica yAda karadA hAM je uha mere valla ika uMgala vadhadA hai tAM maiM ika hattha jiMnA usa de ner3e AuMdA hAM je uha mere valla ika hattha vadhadA hai tAM maiM doveM hatthAM jiMnA usa de ner3e AuMdA hAM je uha mere kola tura ke AuMdA hai tAM maiM usa valla nassa ke AuMdA hAM| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 7405)

translations.translation: he ImAna vAlio! tusIM (allAha toM) sabara ate namAz2a rAhIM madada maMgo bezakka allAha sabara karana vAliAM dA sAtha diMdA hai|
ate jihar3e loka allAha dI rAha vica mAre jANa uhanAM nUM muradA nA kaho uha tAM jioMde hana para tusIM samajha nahIM sakade|

(he ImAna vAlio!) asIM (allAha) tuhAnUM (duzamana de) Dara, bhukkha, jAna, mAla, ate phalAM (riz2aka) de hANa ate ghATiAM toM avazza hI parakhAMge (ki koNa sabara karana vAlA hai)? jihar3e sabara karana vAle hana uhanAM nUM(jaMnata dI) qhuzaqhabarI suNA dio|
unhAM (ImAna vAle) lokAM nUM jadoM koI musIbata AuMdI hai tAM Akhade hana ki bezakka asIM allAha de hI (baMde) hAM ate aMta use valla hI jANA hai|
iha uha loka hana jinhAM laI uhanAM de rabba valloM baqhazizAM te miharAM hana ate hidAita vAle vI iho loka hana|

bezakka safA ate maravA (nAM dIAM pahAr3IAM) allAha dIAM nizAnIAM viccoM hana| jihar3A viakatI allAha de ghara (qhAnA-kAabA) dA hajja jAM umarA kare tAM usa utte ihanAM (doveM pahAr3IAM) de vicakAra phere lagAuNa vica koI gunAha nahIM ate je koI viakatI qhuzI nAla koI nekI karadA he tAM allAha (usa dI) kadara karana vAlA he ate allAha (hara galla) nUM jANana vAlA he|

bezakka uha loka jihar3e sADIAM (allAha dIAM) utArIAM hoiAM sapazaTa dalIlAM ate hidAitAM nUM lukAude hana jada ki asIM uhanAM nUM kitAba ku(.raAna) vica caMgI tarhAM biAna kara cukke hAM, iho uha loka hana jinhAM nUM rabba dI phiTakAra he ate sAre phiTakArana vAle vI uhanAM utte lAanatAM bhejade hana|

para jinhAM lokAM ne taubA kara laI ate ApaNA sudhAra kara liA ate (saccAI dA) sareAma pragaTAvA karade hana tAM iha uha loka hana jinhAM dI maiM (allAha) taubA kabUla karadA hAM| maiM bahuta hI vaddha ke taubA kabUla karana vAlA ate rahima karana vAlA hAM|
para jinhAM lokAM ne kufara (inakAra) kItA ate kufara dI hAlata vica hI uha mara gae, bezakka iha uha loka hana jinhAM utte allAha te usa de farizatiAM dI ate sAre lokAM dI lAanata he|
ate uha isa (lAanata dI hAlata) vica sadA rahiNage, nA tAM uhanAM dI saz2A vica koI kaTautI kItI jAvegI ate nA hI uhanAM nUM koI mohalata dittI jAvegI|
tuhADA sabha dA izaTa ika (allAha) hI he usa toM chuTTa hora koI izaTa nahIM| uha atiaMta miharabAna ate rahima faramAuNa vAlA he|

bezakka akAzAM ate dharatI de paidA karana vica, rAta ate dina de phera badala vica ate samuMdara vica callaNa vAlIAM uhanAM kizatIAM vica, jihar3IAM lokAM laI lAbhadAika vasatUAM laike caladIAM hana ate allAha valloM akAzoM utAre hoe pANI vica jisa rAhIM jihar3I dharatI muradA (baMjara) ho cukI sI usa nUM jiuMdA (upajAu) baNAiA ate hara tarhAM de jAnavara jihar3e usa ne dharatI ’te phailAe hana ate havAvAM de rukha badalaNa vica ate uhanAM ba=dalAM vica jihar3e akAzAM te dharatI vicAle rabbI hukama de pAbaMda hana ihanAM sAriAM vica (allAha dI hoMda dIAM) buddhIjIvIAM laI nizAnIAM hana|

ate kujjha loka uha vI hana jihar3e allAha nUM chaDDa ke dUjiAM nUM (rabba dA) zarIka baNAuMde hana [24] uha uhanAM nAla iMja muhabbata karade hana jiveM allAha nAla muhabbata hoNI cAhIdI sI, jada ki ImAna vAle sabha toM vaddha allAha nAla muhabbata karade hana| jinhAM lokAM ne (rabba dA zarIka baNA ke) z2ulama kamAiA he jadoM uha az2Aba nUM vekhaNage tAM uha samajha laiNage ki bezakka sArIAM zakatIAM allAha laI hI hana ate allAha (kiAmata dihAr3e ’te) bahuta hI saqhata saz2A deNa vAlA he|
translations.footnotes: [24] haz2arata ibane masaUda (ra:a:) toM patA laggadA he ki nabI karIma (sa:) ne ika galla kahI ate maine dUjI galla kahI| Apa (sa:) ne irazAda faramAiA ki jihar3A viakatI isa hAlata vica mara giA ki uha kise hora nUUM allAha dA zarIka samajhadA sI tAM uha naraka vica jAvegA ate maiM bhAva abadullA bina masaUda isa hadIsa dI viAkhiA vica iha kahiMdA hAM ki jihar3A viakatI isa hAla vica hI mara giA ki usa ne allAha de nAla kise hora nUM zarIka nahIM baNAiA uha jaMnata vica jAvegA| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 4497)

translations.translation: (kiAmata dihAr3e) uha loka jinhAM dI (saMsAra vica) pairavI kItI gaI sI ApaNe pairokArAM toM dukkhI hoNage jadoM uha loka az2Aba vekhaNage tAM uhanAM de sAre ApasI saMbaMdha TuTTa jANage|

ate jinhAM lokAM ne (jhUThe lokAM dI) pairavI kItI sI uha (kiAmata dihAr3e) AkhaNage ki kAza sADI ika vAra mur3a saMsAra vica vApasI ho jAve phira asIM vI ihanAM lokAM nAla koI saMbaMdha nahIM rakkhAgeM jiddAM ajja uha sADe nAla sabaMdhAM toM mUMha mor3a rahe hana| allAha uhanAM dIAM karatUtAM ` asafala icchAvAM de rUpa vica uhanAM sAhamaNe peza karegA ate uha agga dI saz2A toM nikalaNa vAle nahIM hoNage|
he loko! tusIM uhanAM cIz2AM nUM khAu jihar3IAM dharatI vica halAla ate pAka cIz2AM hana ate zaitAna de picche nA laggo, bezakka uha tuhADA khullhA duzamana he|
uha tAM tuhAnUM badI te azalIlatA dA hukama diMdA he ate iha vI kahiMdA he ki tusIM allAha de nAM ’te uha ga=lAM kaho jinhAM nUM tusIM jANade vI nahIM|

jadoM uhanAM (zaitAna de celiAM) nUM kihA ki tusIM isa (.kuraAna) dI pairavI karo jihar3A allAha valloM (tuhADI hidAita laI) utAriA giA he tAM kahiMde hana ki (nahIM) asIM tAM use rAha turAMge jisa ’te asIM ApaNe pio dAdiAM nUM turadiAM vekhiA he| kI uha vI uhIo karanage? jada ki uhanAM de bApa dAdA kujjha vI samajha nahIM sI (rakkhade) ate nA hI uha siddhI rAha ’te sana|

ate jinhAM lokAM ne kufara kItA he uhanAM dI udAharana tAM usa viakatI vAMga ru jihar3A usa (jAnavara) nUM pukAradA he jo (ApaNe mAlika dI) pukAra toM chuTTa hora kujjha vI nahIM suNadA| iha bole, gUMge ate aMnhe hana iha (kujjha vI) akala nahIM rakkhade|
he ImAna vAlio! tusIM uhanAM pAka cIz2AM nUM hI khAou [25] jihar3IAM asIM tuhAnUM khANa laI baqhazIAM hana (ihanAM cIz2AM laI) allAha dA dhaMnavAda karo je tusIM use dI baMdagI karade ho|
translations.footnotes: [25] hadIsa anusAra halAla te harAma doveM sapazaTa hana ate ihanAM dovAM de vicakAra kujjha cIz2AM zakka vica pAuNa vAlIAM hana jinhAM nUM kiMne hI loka nahIM jANade| so jihar3A viakatI zakkI cIz2AM khANa toM baca giA usa ne ApaNe dIna ate ApaNI iz2z2ata nUM bacA liA, jihar3A nA baciA tAM uha usa caravAhe vAMga he jisa ne ApaNe jAnavarAM nUM usa carAgAha vica carana laI chaDDa dittA jihar3I kise hora dI he| qhabaradAra hara bAdazAha dA ika uha ilAkA huMdA he jitthe koI vI nahIM jA sakadA tAM jANa lao ki allAha dI uha nA jANa vAlI thAM usa dIAM harAma kItIAM hoiA cIz2AM hana ate jANa lavo ki zarIra vica gozata dA ika Tukkar3A he je uha ThIka ho jAve tAM zarIra ThIka ru je uha vigar3a jAve tAM zarIra vigar3a jAMdA he ate uha Tukar3A manukkha dA dila he| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 52)

translations.translation: allAha ne tuhADe laI qhUna, muradAra, sUra dA mAsa ate uha sArIAM cIz2AM harAma (khANa toM manhA) kItIAM hana ate (uha vI) jinhAM ’te allAha toM chuTTa kise hora (devI devatA jAM nabI, buz2araga Adi) dA nAM liA giA hove| para jihar3A viakatI (bhukkha toM) majabUra ho jAve jadoM ki uha nA hI (rabba dA) bAg2I he ate nA hI haddoM TappaNa vAlA he tAM usa laI (harAma khANa vica) koI gunAha nahIM| bezakka allAha bahuta hI baqhazaNahAra ate rahima faramAuNa vAlA he|

bezakka jihar3e loka allAha valloM utArI gaI kitAba (.kuraAna) dIAM kujjha gallAM (hukamAM) nUM chupAuMde hana ate thor3he jihe (saMsArika) lAbha laI veca suTade hana, uha ApaNe DhiDDAM vica agga toM chuTTa hora kujjha nahIM bharade| kiAmata dihAr3e allAha uhanAM nAla galla vI nahIM karegA ate nA hI uhanAM nUM (gunAhAM toM) pAka karegA| uhanAM laI tAM bahuta hI darada bhariA az2Aba he|
iha tAM uha loka hana jinhAM ne hidAita de badale gumarAhI ate baqhaziza de badale az2Aba qharIda liA he| iha loka agga (dI saz2A) nUM kiMnA sahiNa karana vAle hana?

iha sabha isa laI he ki allAha ne tAM hakka sacca de nAla hI iha kitAba (kuraAna) utArI he para jinhAM lokAM ne isa kitAba vica matabheda kIte, uha virodha karade hoe (saccAI toM) bahuta dUra nikala gae|

nekI iha nahIM ki tusIM ApaNA mUMha pUraba jAM pacchama valla kara lao asala vica nekI tAM usa viakatI dI he jihar3A allAha, Aqhirata de dina, farizatiAM, (akAzI) kitAbAM ate nabIAM ’te ImAna liAve ate mAla dI mahubbata rakkhade hoe vI usa nUM rizatedArAM, yatImAM, masakInAM, musAfarAM, maMgaNa vAliAM ate g2ulAmAM nUM az2Ada karavAuNa laI qharaca kare ate namAz2a kAima kare, z2akAta adA kare, jadoM koI vAadA kare tAM pUrA kare, taMgI ate takalIfa vica ate lar3AI de sameM sabara toM kaMma lave, iho loka sacce hana ate iho burAI toM bacaNa vAle hana|

he ImAna vAlio! tuhADe laI kasAsa (barAbara dA badalA laiNA) faraz2a kItA giA he| Az2Ada viakatI de katala dA badalA use Az2Ada viakatI dA, g2ulAma de badale vica use g2ulAma dA aurata de badale vica use aurata dA katala he| phira je (kAtala nUM) makatUla dA bharA badalA laiNa vica naramI varatadA hoiA muAfa kara deve ate tarIke anusAra daita (bhAva paise) dI maMga hove tAM usa dI adAigI vI sohaNe tarIke nAla kItI jAve| iha tuhADe rabba valloM chUTa he ate ahisAna vI he| phira vI je koI viakatI dhakkA karadA he tAM usa laI daradanAka az2Aba he|
he akala vAlio! kasAsa (badalA) laiNa vica tuhADA (samAjika) jIvana (surakkhiata) he tAM jo tusIM (vadhIkIAM toM) bace raho|

tuhADe laI iha faraz2a kara dittA giA he ki jadoM tuhADe viccoM kise dI mauta (dA velA) Ave je uha mAla (dhaMna saMpatI Adi) chaDDa ke (saMsAra toM) jA rihA he tAM mApiA ate sAka-saMbaMdhIAM laI inasAfa nAla vasIata kare| rabba toM Darana vAliAM laI (iMja karanA) hora vI z2arUrI he|

phira jihar3A koI isa (vasIata) nUM suNana toM bAada vI koI badalAo karadA he tAM isa dA doza uhanAM lokAM ’te hI hovegA jihar3e usa nUM badalaNage| bezakka allAha sabha kujjha suNana vAlA ate jANana vAlA he|

phira je kise vasIata nUM karana vAle valloM kise dA hakka mArana jAM kise gunAha hoNa dA Dara hove ate uha (hakkadArAM vicAle) samajhautA karA deve tAM isa vica koI haraja nahIM| bezakka allAha (bhullAM nUM) baqhazaNa vAlA ate ati rahima karana vAlA he|

he loko! jihar3e ImAna liAe ho! tuhADe ’te sauma[26] (roz2e rakhaNA) use tarhAM faraz2a kIte gae hana jiveM uhanAM lokAM utte faraz2a kIte gae sI jihar3e tuhAthoM pahilAM (nabIAM de pairokAra) guz2ara cukke hana tAM jo tusIM rabba toM Darana vAle baNa jAvo|
translations.footnotes: [26] “sauma” dA aratha he rukaNA| zarIata anusAra isa dA aratha pahu phaTana toM laike sUraja DubbaNa taka khANa-pINa ate saMbhoga toM ruke rahiNA he| isa nUM hI roz2A kihA jAMdA he|

translations.translation: iha (roz2e) giNatI de kujjha dinAM laI hana| je tuhADe viccoM koI bImAra hove jAM safara ’te hove tAM uha (chaDDe hoe) roz2iAM dI giNatI nUM dUje dinAM vica pUrI kara lave je koI roz2e rakkhaNa dI tAkata rakkhadA hove (phira vI roz2A nA rakkhe) tAM fidiyA [27] adA kare (bhAva badale vica ika muthAja nUM bhojana karavAuNA he) je koI ApaNI qhuzI nAla (vaddha) nekI kare tAM iha usa laI vadhIA he| je tusIM sacca jANo tAM roz2A rakkhaNA tuhADe laI vadhere vadhIA he|
translations.footnotes: [27] iha hukama isa toM agalI Aita 185 rAhIM radda kara dittA giA|

translations.translation: ramaz2Ana uha mahInAM he jisa vica.kuraAna nAz2ila kItA giA jihar3A lokAM laI hidAita he ate isa vica sapazaTa ate sacca nUM jhUTha toM vakkha vakkha karana vAlIAM dalIlAM hana| jihar3A vI tuhADe viccoM isa mahIne nUM pAve tAM usa nUM isa mahIne de roz2e rakkhaNe cAhIde hana|[28] je koI bimAra hove jAM safara ’te hove tAM uha (chaDDe hoe roz2iAM dI) giNatI dUje dinAM vica pUrI kara lave| allAha tuhADe laI AsAnI cAhuMdA he, uha tuhADe laI taMgI nahIM cAhuMdA| jadoM tusIM roz2iAM dI giNatI pUrI kara lavo tAM isa laI rabba dI vaDiAI biAna karo ki usa ne tuhA` hidAita dittI tAM jo tusIM usa dA dhaMnavAda karo|
translations.footnotes: [28] ika musalamAna ne nabI karIma (sa:) toM pucchiA ki he allAha de rasUla! mainUM dasso ki mere laI kiMnIAM namAz2AM par3haNIAM faraz2a hana? Apa (sa:) ne faramAiA paMja, je isa toM vaddha par3haNA cAho tAM tere maraz2I| usa ne pucchiA ki allAha ne mere laI kiMne roz2e faraz2a kIte hana, Apa (sa:) ne faramAiA ki pUre ramaz2Ana mahIne de je tUM nafalI roz2e rakkheM tAM terI maraz2I he usa ne phira pucchiA ki mere ’te z2akAta kiMnI faraz2a he dassaNa vAle dA kahiNA he ki nabI karIma (sa:) ne usa nUM isalAma de asUla dassa ditte tAM usa viakatI ne AkhiA, use allAha dI kasama jisa ne tuhAnUM mAna baqhaziA he, nAM tAM maiM koI vAdhU (nafalI) ibAdata karAMgA ate nA hI faraz2AM vica koI kaTauautI karAMgA iha suNa ke nabI karIma (sa:) ne faramAiA ki je iha ApaNI kathaNI vica saccA he tAM uha ApaNI murAda pA giA jAM jaMnata vica calA giA| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 1891)

translations.translation: (he nabI!) jadoM mere baMde tuhAthoM mere bAre pucchaNa (ki maiM kitthe hAM) tAM Akha dio ki maiM uhanAM de aMga-saMga hI hAM [29] jadoM vI uha maiMthoM duAvAM karade hana tAM maiM uhanAM dIAM duAvAM nUM kabUla karadA hAM so uhanAM nU cAhIdA he ki mere hukamAM dI pAlaNA karana ate mere utte hI ImAna liAuNa tAM jo uha hidAita prApata kara sakaNa|
translations.footnotes:
[29] iha hukama isa toM agalI Aita 185 rAhIM radda kara dittA giA|
1 ika musalamAna ne nabI karIma (sa:) toM pucchiA ki he allAha de rasUla! mainUM dasso ki mere laI kiMnIAM namAz2AM par3haNIAM faraz2a hana? Apa (sa:) ne faramAiA paMja, je isa toM vaddha par3haNA cAho tAM tere maraz2I| usa ne pucchiA ki allAha ne mere laI kiMne roz2e faraz2a kIte hana, Apa (sa:) ne faramAiA ki pUre ramaz2Ana mahIne de je tUM nafalI roz2e rakkheM tAM terI maraz2I he usa ne phira pucchiA ki mere ’te z2akAta kiMnI faraz2a he dassaNa vAle dA kahiNA he ki nabI karIma (sa:) ne usa nUM isalAma de asUla dassa ditte tAM usa viakatI ne AkhiA, use allAha dI kasama jisa ne tuhA` mAna baqhaziA he, nAM tAM maiM koI vAdhU (nafalI) ibAdata karAMgA ate nA hI faraz2AM vica koI kaTauautI karAMgA iha suNa ke nabI karIma (sa:) ne faramAiA ki je iha ApaNI kathaNI vica saccA he tAM uha ApaNI murAda pA giA jAM jaMnata vica calA giA| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 1891)
* allAha de rasUla (sa:) ne faramAiA ki roz2A DhAla nUM, so roz2edAra nUM cAhIdA he ki uha nA tAM koI bhair3e kaMma kare ate nA jAhalAM varagIAM gallAM kare je koI usa nAla lar3AI jhagar3A kare jAM gAlAM deve tAM usa nUM do vAra Akhe ki usa dA roz2A he phira nabI (sa:) ne faramAiA ki kasama he usa hasatI dI jisa de hattha vica merI jAna he roz2edAra de mUMha dI gaMdha allAha dIAM naz2arAM vica muzaka dI qhuzabU toM vI vadhIA he kiuM jo uha mere laI ApaNA khANA pINA chaDadA he ApaNIAM icchAvAM nUM mAradA he, so roz2A vizeza kara mere hI laI he ate maiM hI isa dA badalA devAMgA ate ika nekI dA badalA dasa guNA savAba he| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 1894)
* jihar3A viakatI roz2e dI hAlata vica vI jhUTha bolaNa toM nahIM rukadA tAM allAha nUM ukkA hI lor3a nahIM ki uha khANA pINA chaDDe bhAva usa dA roz2A kabUla nahIM kItA jAvegA| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 1903) 1 isa toM bhAva uha faraz2a ibAdata he jihar3I allAha valloM manukkhAM nUM adA karanI z2arUrI he| hadIsa vica heki allAha dA faramAna he ki jihar3A viakatI mere kise mittara (valI) nAla vaira rakkhadAhe tAM uha suNa lave ki maiM usa de viruddha jaMga dA ailAna karadA hAM ate merA baMdA jihar3IAM ibAdatAM rAhIM merI ner3atA prApata karadA he uhanAM viccoM mai` koI vI ibAdata isa toM vaddha pasaMda nahIM jihar3I maiM usa laI faraz2a kItI he ate merA baMdA nafalI ibAdata karake mere iMnA ner3e ho jAMdA he ki maiM usa nAla muhabbata karana lagga jAMdA hAM, so maiM usa dA kaMna baNa jAMdA hAM jisa toM uha suNadA he, maiM usa dI akkha baNa jAMdA hAM jisa toM uha vekhadA he, maiM hattha baNa jAMdA hAM jisa toM uha phar3adA he, maiM usadA paira baNa jAMdA hAM jisa toM uha turadA he, jadoM uha maithoM kujjha maMgadA he tAM maiM usa nUM diMdA hAM, je uha merI panAha cAhuMdA he tAM maiM usa nUM panAha diMdA hAM, maiM` kise kaMma karana vica iMnI duvidhA nahIM huMdI jiMnI jada maiM kise momina dI jAna laiMdA hAM, usa sameM huMdI he| kiuM jo sarIrika kazaTa usa nUM caMgA nahIM laggadA ate mai` Apa vI usa nUM kazaTa deNA pasaMda nahIM| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 6502)

translations.translation: tuhADe laI roz2iAM dIAM rAtAM nUM ApaNI patanI nAla saMbhoga karanA halAla (jAiz2a) kItA giA he, uha tuhADe laI libAsa hana ate tusIM uhanAM (patanIAM) de libAsa (vAMga) ho| allAha tuhADIAM lor3AM nUM jANadA he ki tusIM ApaNe Apa nAla qhiAnatAM (corI toM saMbhoga) karade sI| so usa ne tuhADe valla dhiAna dittA ate tuhAnUM muAfa kara dittA huNa tusIM (ramaz2Ana dIAM rAtAM vica) hama-bisatarI (saMbhoga) kara sakade ho ate allAha ne tuhADe laI jo (aulAda) likha chaDDI he usa nUM (saMbhoga rAhIM) talAza karo| (ramaz2Ana dIAM rAtAM vica) khAo pio itthoM taka ki pahu phaTaNa vele safeda dhArI kAlI dhArI toM sapazaTa ho jAve phira tusIM (khANa pINa te saMbhoga toM rukka jAo) roz2e nUM (sUraja DUbaNa) taka pUrA karo| jadoM tusIM masItAM vica aitakAfa (ramaz2Ana de AqharI dasa dina ibAdata) laI baiTho tAM ApaNIAM patanIAM nAla saMbhoga nA karo| iha allAha dIAM haddAM hana, tusIM uhanAM de ner3e vI nA jAo| allAha lokAM laI ApaNIAM AitAM (hukama) iMja hI kholha kholha ke biAna karadA he, tAM jo uha burAIAM toM bace rahiNa|

tusIM ika dUje de mAla nAjAiz2a tarIkiAM nAla nA khAo ate uhanAM nUM hAkamAM agge (rizavata vajoM) peza nA karo ki tusIM dUjiAM de mAla dA kujjha hissA nA jAiz2a tarIke nAla khA jAo hAlAM ki tusIM jANade ho|

he nabI (sa:)! tuhAthoM (lokI) caMna de (ghaTaNa vadhaNa) bAre pucchade hana| tusIM kahi dio ki iha lokAM laI (mitIAM niradhArata karana) ate hajja laI niyata samAM dassaNa laI he| nekI iha nahIM ki tusIM (hajja de dinAM vica) ApaNe ghara de picchio Ao sagoM nekI tAM iha he ki AdamI burAI toM baciA rahe| tusIM ApaNe gharAM vica uhanAM de bUhiAM rAhIM hI Ao ate allAha toM Darade raho tAM jo tusIM safalatA prApata karo|
tusIM allAha dI rAha vica uhanAM nAla lar3o jihar3e tuhADe nAla lar3ade hana|[30] tusIM vadhIkI nA karo kiuM jo allAha vadhIkI karana vAle nUM pasaMda nahIM karadA|
translations.footnotes: [30] “jihAda” dA aratha koziza karanA he| zarIata anusAra allAha dI rAha vica jaMga karana nUM jihAda kihA jAMdA he hadIsa vica he ki jihar3A viakatI isa galla vica hI saMsAra toM calA giA ki nA tAM usa ne koI jihAda kItA ate nA usa de dila vica kade isa dA vicAra hI AiA iMja samajho jiveM uha jhUThe dI mauta mara giA| (sahI musalima, hadIsa: 1910) * haz2arata ibane masaUda ne allAha de rasUla nUM pucchiA he ki allAha de rasUla! sabha toM vadhIA kihar3A amala he? Apa ne faramAiA ki namAz2AM nUM uhanAM de niyata sameM ’te adA karanA| uhanAM pucchiA ki isa toM bAada, faramAiA mApiAM nAla vadhIA varatAo karanA| uhanAM pucchiA ki isa toM bAada, Apa (sa:) ne faramAiA ki allAha dI rAha vica jihAda karanA| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 2782)

translations.translation: jitthe vI iha (vadhIkI karana vAle) tuhAnUM milaNa tusIM uhanAM nUM katala kara dio ate uhanAM nUM utthoM kaDDha dio jitthoM uhanAM ne tuhAnUM kaDDhiA he| fitanA [31] fasAda tAM katala karana toM vI vaddha bhair3A (gunAha) he| (he ImAna vAlio!) tusIM uhanAM (z2AlamAM) nAla masajide harAma (qhAnA-kAabA) de ner3e (odoM takka) nA lar3o jadoM taka uha isa (qhAnA-kAabA) vica nA lar3aNa| je uha utthe vI lar3aNa tAM tusIM uhanAM nUM katala kara dio| ajihe kAfarAM dI iho saz2A he|
translations.footnotes: [31] “fitanA” dA aratha ru fasAda ate vigAr3a paidA karanA|.kuraAna vica isa dI karar3e zabadAM vica nikhedI AI ru isa nUM katala toM vI vaddha qhataranAka dassiA giA he| phitane dI zakala ika iha vI he ki allAha ’te ImAna liAuNa toM bAada usadA inakAra karanA

translations.translation: je uha (lar3aNa toM) bAz2a A jANa tAM allAha bahuta hI vaDDA baqhazaNahAra he ate rahima faramAuNa vAlA he

uhanAM nAla odoM taka jaMga karo jadoM taka ki upadara (fitanA) qhatama nA ho jAve ate dIna kevala allAha laI hI (qhAsa) ho jAve| [32] je uha bAz2a A jANa tAM chuTTa z2AlamAM toM kise nAla dhakkA karanA jAiz2a nahIM|
translations.footnotes: [32] nabI karIma (sa:) dA irazAda he ki mainUM allAha valloM hukama hoiA he ki maiM lokAM nAla jihAda karAM itthoM taka ki uha gavAhI deNa ki chuTTa allAha toM koI izaTa nahIM, muhaMmada(sa:) allAha de rasUla hana, namAz2a kAima karana, z2akAta adA karana, je uha aiveM karanage tAM uhanAM ne ApaNIAM jAnAM te mAlAM nUM maithoM bacA liA, para isalAma dA hakka pUrA nahIM hoiA| jiveM nA-hakkA katala de badale vica katala jAM z2akAta nA deNa vAle dA katala Adi ate ihanAM de dila dIAM gallAM dA hisAba laiNA allAha de z2iMmeM he| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 25)

translations.translation: (tuhADe laI) satikArayoga mahIniAM dI pAbaMdI uhanAM (z2AlamAM) valloM satikArayoga mahIne dI pAbaMdI de badale vica he ate satikArayoga cIz2AM dA lihAz2a barAbarI vAlA hovegA| so jihar3A koI tuhADe nAla (dhakkA) karadA he tusIM vI usa de nAla unnA hI dhakkA karo jinnA dhakkA usane tuhADe nAla kItA he| allAha toM Daro ate jANa lao ki bezakka allAha parahez2agArAM dA hI sAthI he|
tusIM allAha dI rAha vica qharaca karo ate ApaNe hatthIM ApaNI barabAdI nA karo| tusIM nekIAM karo bezakka allAha nekI karana vAliAM nUM pasaMda karadA he|

jadoM tusIM hajja te umarA (allAha dI raz2A laI) pUrI tarhAM kara lavo [33] ate je kIte tuhAnUM rAha vica roka liA jAve tAM tuhAnUM kurabAnI laI jo vI (jAnavara) mile sake (usa nUM rabba dI rAha vica kurabAna kara dio) ate jadoM taka kurabAnI ApaNe halAla hoNa vAlI thAM nA pahuMca jAve ApaNe sira nA munavAo| para je koI viakatI bImAra he jAM usa de sira vica koI takalIfa he (je uha kurabAnI toM pahilAM sira munavA laiMdA he) tAM uha fidIye (badale) vica roz2e rakkhe jAM sadakA (punna dAna) kare jAM kurabAnI kare| jadoM tuhAnUM amana mila jAve (ate hajja toM pahilAM makke pahuMca jAvo) tAM tuhADe viccoM jisa kise ne vI hajja (de ahirAma) nAla umarA karana dA lAbha uThAiA he usa nUM (ahirAma kholhaNa toM bAada) jihar3A vI (jAnavara) mile kurabAnI kara deve ate jisa nUM (kurabAnI laI jAnavara) nA mile tAM uha tiMna roz2e hajja de dinAM vica rakkhe ate satta roz2e jadoM uha ghara mur3a Ave iha pUre dasa (roz2e) hana| iha hukama usa viakatI laI he jisa de ghara vAle masajide harAma (qhAnA-kAabA) de ner3e nA rahiMde hoNa| tusIM allAha toM Darade raho ate iha jANa lavo ki bezakka allAha bahuta hI karar3I saz2A deNa vAlA he|
translations.footnotes: [33] hadIsAM vica hajja te umare dI bahuta mahattatAM dassI gaI he, jiveM isalAma kabUla karade hI sAre pichale gunAha qhatama ho jAMde hana aiveM hI allAha dI rAha vica hijarata ate hajja dI vI iho vizezatA he| abadullA bina umara dA faramAna he ki hajja te umarA hara musalamAna laI karanA z2arUrI he| haz2arata abadullA bina abbAsa dA faramAna he ki isa Aita vica umare dA biAna hajja de saMbaMdha vica AiA he| allAha de rasUla ne faramAiA, ika umare toM dUje umare taka baMde toM jiMne vI gunAha ho jAMde hana umarA uhanAM sabha nUM Dhaka laiMdA he ate jisa de hajja nUM rabba ne kabUla kara liA usa dA badalA jaMnata he| (buqhArI, hadIsa: 1773)

translations.translation: hajja de niyata mahIniAM nUM sAre jANade hana, so jisa viakatI ne ihanAM (mahIniAM) vica haja karanA ApaNe ’te lAz2ama kara liA tAM uha hajja de dinAM vica kAmavAsanA vAlIAM gallAM nA kare, nA hI allAha de hukamAM dI ulaMghaNA kare ate nA kise tarhAM dA koI lar3AI jhagar3A kare| jihar3e neka kaMma tusIM karade ho allAha uhanAM nUM jANadA he| (hajja nUM jAMde hoe) varataNa vAlA sAmAna nAla lai liA karo ate sabha toM vadhIA safara qharaca ra=ba dA Dara ru| so he akala vAlio! maithoM hI DariA karo|[34]
translations.footnotes: [34] haja karana de tina tarIke hana (1) ‘hajje tamattAa’ je kurabAnI dA jAnavara nAla nahIM he tAM kevala ੳmare laI iharAma baMno, umare toM vihale ho ke iharAma kholo ate makkA jAke navAM iharAma baMniA jAvegA| (2) ‘hajje ifarAda’ isa hajja laI kevala niyyata kItI jAMdI he umarA nahIM ate nA kurabAnI kItI jAMdI he| makke de vasanIka hajje ifarAda hI karade hana| (3) ‘hajje kirAna’ ika hI iharAma vica umarA ate hajja kItA jAMdA he, nAla kurabAnI dA jAnavara vI huMdA he|

translations.translation: je tusIM (hajja de dinAM vica) allAha dA faz2ala (roTI roz2I) talAza (karana laI mihanata maz2adUrI jAM vapAra) karo tAM tuhADe laI koI gunAha vAlI galla nahIM| jadoM tusIM ‘arafAta’ [35] toM parato tAM mazaare harAma [36] (muz2adalafA) jA ke allAha nUM yAda karo| tusIM (allAha nUM) iMja yAda karo jiveM allAha ne tuhA` hidAita dittI he jada ki isa (hidAita) toM pahilAM tusIM kurAhe pae hoe sI|
translations.footnotes:
[35] arafAta” makke toM kujjha hI dUrI ’te ika maidAna he jitthe 9 z2ilahajja nUM sUraja de DhalaNa toM laike sUraja de DubbaNa taka ThahiraNA z2arUrI he|
[36] “mazaare harAma” isa nUM muz2adalafA vI kihA jAMdA he| muz2adalafA makke de ner3e ika prasiddha thAM he jitthe novIM te dasavIM z2ilahajja dI vicakAra vAlI rAta hAjI guz2Arade hana|
