translations.translation: phira jiithaoM sAre loka mur3ade hana use thAM toM tusIM vI mur3a Ao allAha toM (bhalAI laI) muAfI maMgo| bezakka allAha hI baqhazaNahAra ate atiaMta rahima faramAuNa vAlA he|

jadoM tusIM hajja saMbaMdhI sAre arakAna (niyata kaMma) kara lavo tAM allAha nUM iMja yAda karo jiveM ApaNe pio dAdiAM nUM yAda kariA karade sI| sagoM usa toM vI vaddha (allAha dI vaDiAI dI caracA karo)| uhanAM viccoM koI tAM ajihA he jo kahiMdA he ki he sADe rabba! sAnUM saMsAra vica hI (sabha kujjha) de devIM| ajihe viakatI laI Aqhirata vica kujjha vI hissA nahIM|
ate uhanAM viccoM kujjha uha hana jihar3e aradAsa karade hana ki he sADe mAlika! sAnUM dunIAM vica vI bhalAI de ate Aqhirata vica vI bhalAI de ate sAnUM (naraka dI) agga toM surakkhiata rakkha|
ajihe lokAM nUM uhanAM dI kamAI anusAra hI (Aqhirata vica) hissA milegA| allAha chetI hI hisAba laiNa vAlA he|

(hajja de) ihanAM giNatI de kujjha dinAM vica tusIM vaddha toM vaddha allAha nUM yAda karo|[37] phira jihar3A koI chetI karake do dina vica hI (minA toM makke valla) mur3a Ave tAM koI gunAha nahIM ate jisa ne mur3ana vica ika dina dI derI kItI tAM vI koI gunAha nahIM| para zarata iha he ki uha rabba toM DaradA rahe| tusIM sAre allAha toM hI Daro ate caMgI tarhAM jANa lao ki ika dina usa dI haz2UrI vica ikaTThA hoNA he|
translations.footnotes: [37] arafAta toM minA dI vApasI te z2ilahajja dI giArhavIM bArhavIM te terhavIM tArIqhAM vica allAha dA z2ikara ate takabIrAM par3haNa dA hukama he| ihanAM dinAM nUM ‘ayyAme mAadUdAta’ jAM ‘ayyAme tazarIka’ vI kihA jAMdA he|

translations.translation: (he nabI!) koI tAM ajihA he jisa dIAM gallAM tuhAnnUM saMsArika jIvana vica bahuta caMgIAM lagadIAM hana ate jo uhanAM de dilAM vica (khoTa) he usa laI uha allAha nUM gavAha baNAuMde hana (ki uhIo saccA he) jada ki uha (hakka pratI) bahuta hI jhagar3AlU he | [38]
translations.footnotes: [38] allAha de rasUla (sa:) ne faramAiA allAha dIAM naz2arAM vica sabha toM va=dha bhair3A uha viakatI ru jihar3A jhagar3AlU ru| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 4523)

translations.translation: jadoM uha (jhagar3AlU ApaNI asalIata valla) paratadA he tAM uha koziza karadA he ki dharatI vica fasAda phailAve, khetAM ate (manukkhI) nasalAM nUM ujAr3a deve| jada ki allAha vigAr3a nUM (ukkA) pasaMda nahIM karadA|
jadoM usa nUM kihA jAMdA he ki allAha toM Dara tAM usa dA ghamaMDa usa nUM gunAha karana laI ubhAradA he| so ajihe viakatI laI naraka hI batherI he jihar3I ki bahuta hI bhair3I thAM he|
lokAM vica kujjha viakatI ajihe vI hana jihar3e allAha dI raz2A prApata karana laI ApaNe Apa nUM (rabba de hattha) veca diMde hana ate allAha vI ApaNe ajihe baMdiAM utte bahuta miharabAna he|
he loko! jihar3e ImAna liAe ho! tusIM pUrI tarhAM isalAma vica dAqhila ho jAo ate zaitAna dI pairavI nA karo kiuM jo zaitAna tuhADA khullhA duzamana he|
je tusIM (.kuraAna dIAM) khullhIAM dalIlAM AuNa toM bAada vI (siddhI rAha toM) tilaka gae tAM yAda rakkho ki bezakka allAha z2orAvara ate hikamatAM vAlA he|

kI uha lokI isa uDIka ’ca hana ki allAha ate farizate baddalAM dI chatara chAiA vica uhanAM de sAhamaNe A khalovaNa tAM jo unAM dA faisalA kara dittA jAve? aMta nUM sAre muAmale tAM allAha de kola hI peza hoNe hana|

banI isarAIla toM puccho ki asIM uhanAM nUM sapazaTa rUpa vica kiMnIAM nizAnIAM dittIAM sana| phira jihar3A koI allAha dIAM niamatAM mila jANa toM bAada usa nUM badala deve tAM bezakka allAha (ajihe viakatI nUM) karar3I saz2A deNa vAlA he|

jinhAM lokAM ne kufara kItA uhanAM laI saMsArika jIvana nUM sajA saMvAra dittA giA he| iha loka ImAna vAliAM nAla makhaula karade hana ate jihar3e lokI rabba toM Darana vAle hana uha kiAmata dihAr3e uhanAM (kAfarAM) toM ucce darajiAM vica hoNage| allAha jisa nUM cAhuMdA he behisAba riz2aka (niamatAM) diMdA he|

(araMbha vica) sAre hI loka ika hI umatta (jamAata) sana (jadoM ihanAM vica matabheda hoNa lagge) phira allAha ne nabI bheje (jihar3e neka karamAM vAliAM nUM) qhuzaqhabarIAM deNa vAle ate (bhair3e karamAM vAliAM nUM naraka toM) DarAuNa vAle sana ate unhAM nAla usa ne saccIAM kitAbAM vI utArIAM tAM jo jinhAM gallAM vica lokI matabheda karade sana uhanAM vicakAra faisalA kara sakaNa| iha matabheda uhanAM lokAM vicAle haTadharamI kArana hI hoe sana, hAlAM ki jinhAM nUM kitAba dittI gaI sI, unhAM kola khullhIAM dalIlAM A cukkIAM sana| para jihar3e ImAna lai Ae unhAM nUM allAha ne ApaNe hukama nAla (uhanAM kitAbAM duArA) hakka sacca dA uha rAha vikhAiA jisa vica lokAM ne matabheda kIte sI| allAha jisa nUM cAhuMdA he siddhI rAha vikhA diMdA he|

kI tusIM ise gumAna vica (masata) ho ki jaMnata vica tusIM aiveM hI dAqhala ho jAoge? jadda ki hAlAM tuhAnUM uhanAM lokAM vAMga (muzakalAM te musIbatAM) dA sAhamaNA nahIM karanA piA jihar3IAM kaThinAIAM ate musIbatAM viccoM tuhAthoM pahilAM (ImAna vAliAM nUM) laMghaNA piA sI ate uha halUNa suTTe gae sana itthoM taka ki sameM de rasUla ate ImAna liAuNa vAle loka (kuralA ke) AkhaNa lagge ki allAha dI madada kadoM AvegI? jANa lao ki bezakka allAha dI madada mominAM de ner3e hI he|

(he nabI!) lokI tuhAthoM pucchade hana ki uha (rabba dI rAha vica) kI qharaca karana? tusIM Akha dio ki tusIM ApaNe mAla viccoM jihar3A vI qharaca karo uha ApaNe mApiAM, rizatedArAM, yatImAM, muthAjAM ate musAfirAM utte qharaca karo| tusIM jo vI bhalAI karoge bezakka allAha usa nUM caMgI tarhAM jANadA nUM|

(he momino!) tuhADe ’te jihAda [39] karanA faraz2a kItA giA he bhAveM ki iha tuhA` burA lagadA ru| ho sakadA he ki tusIM kise cIz2a nUM pasaMda nA karo ate uhIo tuhADe laI vadhIA hove ate iha vI ho sakadA he ki tusIM kise cIz2a nUM pasaMda karade hovo ate uhIo tuhADe laI bhair3I (siddha) hove| allAha hI (caMgA jAM burA) jANadA he tusIM nahIM jANade|
translations.footnotes: [39] vekho sUrata ala-bakaraha, hAzIA Aita 190 \\ 2

translations.translation: (he nabI!) lokI tuhAthoM huramata (AdaramAna) vAle mahIniAM bAre pucchade hana ki ihanAM vica lar3anA kiveM he? tusIM Akha dio ki ihanAM (mahIniAM) vica lar3anA bahuta vaDDA gunAha he para lokAM nUM allAha de rAha callaNa toM rokaNA, allAha de nAla kufara karanA, masajida-e -harAma (qhAnA-kAabA) jANa toM rokaNA ate harama de rahiNa vAliAM nUM othoM kaDhaNA allAha dIAM naz2arAM vica isa (lar3AI) toM vI vaDDA pApa he ate fitanA [40] bhar3akAuNA (ImAna toM bicalAuNA) katala nAloM vI vaDDA gunAha he| iha kAfira tAM tuhADe nAla lar3ade hI rahiNage| je uhanAM dA vasa calle tAM uha tuhAnUM tuhADe dIna (dharama) toM vI phera deNa| tuhADe viccoM je koI ApaNe dIna (isalAma) toM phira jAve ate kufara dI hAlata vica hI mara jAve tAM uhanAM lokAM valloM kIte karama dunIAM te Aqhirata vica barabAda hoNage ate ajihe sabha loka narakI hana jitthe uha sadA laI rahiNage|
translations.footnotes: [40] “fitanA” dA aratha ziraka he, bhAva allAha dA dUjiAM nUM sAMjhI baNAuNA ate ImAna liAuNa toM bAada usa dA inakAra karanA| jihar3IAM musIbatAM jAM parezAnIAM allAha valloM az2amAiza laI huMdIAM hana usa nUM vI fitanA kihA jAMdA he|

translations.translation: jihar3e loka ImAna liAe, hijarata kItI ate allAha dI rAha vica jihAda vI kItA uha loka hI allAha dIAM miharAM dI Asa rakkhade hana| allAha bahuta hI baqhazaNahAra ate rahima faramAuNa vAlA he|

(he nabI!) lokI tuhAthoM zarAba ate jUae bAre pucchade hana, Akha dio ki ihanAM dovAM vica bahuta vaDDA gunAha he bhAve lokAM laI kujjha lAbha vI hana paraMtU dohAM dA gunAha ihanAM de lAbha nAloM kIte vaddhake he| uha iha vI pucchade hana ki (rabba dI rAha vica) kI qharaca karIe? Akha dio ki jo vI tuhADI lor3a toM vaddha he (qharaca karo), tuhADe (samajhAuNa laI) allAha ApaNe hukamAM ne ise tarhAM sapazaTa karadA he tAM jo tusIM soca vicAra karo|[41]
translations.footnotes:
[41] isa Aita vica jUA te zarAba de nukasAnAM dI viAkhiA kItI gaI he| iha isa saMbaMdha vica muDDhalA hukama sI para bAada vica mAidA sUrata dI navvevIM (90) Aita vica sapazaTa zabadAM vica ihanAM dI manAhI kara dittI| huNa zarAba te jUA doveM harAma hana hadIsa vica inhAM de harAma hoNa dI visathAra nAla viAkhiA kItI gaI ru allAha de rasUla (sa:) ne faramAiA jisa ne bhula ke vI (lAta te uz2A devIAM dI soMha khAdI usa nUM cAhIdA he ki lA ilAha ilallAha kahe (tAM jo naveM sirio ImAna vica A jAve) ate jisa ne ApaNe sAthI nUM kihA ki Ao! ApAM jUA kheDIe tAM usa nUM kaffAre vajoM bhAva gunAha karana de badale vica qhairAta karanI cAhIdI he| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 4860)
* allAha de rasUla (sa:) ne faramAiA jisa ne dunIAM vica zarAba pI laI ate (marade hoe vI) taubA nahIM kItI tAM uha jaMnata dI zarAba toM vAMjhA rahegA| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 5575)
* hadIsa anusAra kiAmata dIAM nizAnIAM viccoM ika iha vI he ki jahAlata phaila jAvegI ate dhAramika giAna ghaTTa jAvegA ate z2anAqhorI Ama ho jAvegI ate zarAba vI zareAma pItI jAvegI purazAM dI ghATa ho jAvegI ate auauratAM dI giNatI vaddha jAvegI aithoM taka ki paMjAha auauratAM dI rakhavAlI ika puraza karegA| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 5577)

translations.translation: (he nabI) lokI tuhAthoM anAthAM de saMbaMdha vica pucchade hana| Akha dio ki uhanAM dI bhalAI laI kaMma karanA vadhere caMgA he| je tusIM uhanAM (anAthAM) dA ate ApaNA qharacA te rahiNI sahiNI sAMjhI rakkho (tAM vI koI haraja nahIM) kiuM jo uha tuhADe bharA hI tAM hana| allAha jANadA he ki vigAr3aNa vAlA koNa he ate suArana vAlA koNa he? je allAha cAhuMdA tAM tuhADe ’te saqhatI karadA| bezakka allAha z2orAvAra he ate dAnAI vAlA (sUjhavAna) he|

(he musalamAno!) tusIM muzariku[42] auratAM nAla udoM taka nikAha nA karo jadoM taka ki uha ImAna nA lai AuNa| ika ImAna vAlI golI aurata muzarika aurata toM kite vadhIA he bhAveM uha (muzarikA) tuhAnUM kiMnI hI bhAMuMdI hove ate tusIM (musalamAna auratoM) muzarika maradAM nAla nikAha nA karo jadoM taka ki uha ImAna nA lai AuNa| ika momina g2ulAma muzarika toM kite vadhIA he bhAveM ki uha (muzarika) tuhAnUM kiMnA hI pasaMda he| iha (muzarika) tAM naraka valla bulAuMde hana ate allAha ApaNe hukamAM nAla tuhAnUM jaMnata te baqhaziza valla bulAuMdA he| (ise laI) uha lokAM nUM ApaNIAM AitAM (faramAna) khola khola ke biAna karadA he tAM jo uha sikkhiA grahiNa karana|
translations.footnotes: [42] “muzarika” toM bhAva kAfara te buta pUjaNa vAle ate jihar3e allAha de ika hoNa ate muhaMmada (sa:) dI paig2aMbarI de inakArI hana|

translations.translation: (he nabI!) lokI tuhAthoM ruz2a (mAsika dharama) bAre pucchade hana| tusIM Akha dio ki iha ika gaMdagI dI hAlata he so tusIM ruz2a (dI hAlata) vica auratAM toM parAM raho (bhAva saMbhoga nA karo) jadoM taka ki uha pAka sAfa nA ho jANa| jadoM uha pAka sAfa ho jANa tAM uhanAM de kola use tarhAM jAo jiveM allAha ne tuhAnUM hukama dittA he| bezakka allAha taubA karana vAliAM nUM ate pAka sAfa rahiNa vAliAM nUM pasaMda karadA he|

tuhADIAM patanIAM tuhADIAM khetIAM (vAMga) hana jiveM cAho ApaNIAM khetIAM vica Ao jAo| ApaNe laI (caMge karama) agge (Aqhirata laI) bhejo ate allAha toM Darade raho| yAda rakkho ki (ika dina) tusIM sAre (allAha) nUM milaNa vAle ho ate iha qhuzaqhabarI ImAna vAliAM nUM suNA dio|

je tuhADA udeza neka kaMmAM toM, rabba de Dara toM ate lokAM vicAle sulAha karavAuNa toM ruka jANA he tAM tusIM allAha dA nAM ApaNIAM kasamAM [43] laI nA varato, allAha hara galla bhalI-bhAMta suNana vAlA te vekhaNa vAlA he|
translations.footnotes: [43] suMha de saMbaMdha vica vekho sUrata ala-mAidA, hAzIA Aita 89 \\ 5

translations.translation: allAha tuhADIAM viaratha (binAM soce samajhe) suMhAM khANa ’te tuhAnUM nahIM phar3adA para uha tuhAnUM uhanAM suMhAM khANa ’te z2arUra phar3egA jihar3IAM tusIM sacce manoM khAMde ho| allAha bahuta vaDDA baqhazaNahAra te miharabAna he|

jihar3e loka ApaNIAM patanIAM nAla (zarIrika) saMbaMdha nA rakkhaNa dIAM kasamAM khA laiMde hana [44] uhanAM (dIAM patanIAM) nUM cAhIdA he ki uha cAra mahIne uDIka karana| [45] je (patI) parata AuNa (saMbaMdha baNA laiNa) tAM ThIka he bezakka allAha (bhullAM nUM) baqhazaNa vAlA ate miharabAna he|
translations.footnotes:
[44] isa nUM “IlA” kihA jAMdA he, jisa dA aratha he patanI nAla saMbaMdha nA rakkhaNa dI suMha khANA| * haz2arata abadullA bina umara faramAuMde hana ki iha ‘IlA’ jisa dI caracA.kuraAna vica kItI gaI he kise viakatI laI isa toM chuTTa kujjha hora jAiz2a hI nahIM ki uha nizacita samAM bIta jANa toM bAada jAM tAM patanI nUM isalAmI sidhAMta anusAra ghara vica hI rakkhe jAM usa nUM talAka de deve jiveM ki allAha dA hukama he| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 5290)
[45] haz2arata ibane ummara dA kahiNA he ki jadoM cAra mahIne bIta jANa tAM puraza nUM majabUra kItA jAve ki jAM tAM ApaNe suMha ’te mur3a vicAra kare jAM patanI nUM talAka de deve ate jadoM taka patI sapazaTa zabadAM vica talAka nA deve talAka nahIM huMdI| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 5291)

translations.translation: para je talAka deNa dA hI irAdA kara laiNa (tAM jANa laiNa ki) allAha sabha kujjha suNana vAlA ate jANana vAlA he|

jinhAM auratAM nUM talAka dittI gaI hove uha tiMna ruz2a (mAsika dharama) taka uDIka karana| uhanAM laI iha galla ThIka nahIM ki allAha ne jo vI uhanAM de garabha vica rakhiA he usa nUM lukAuNa| je uhanAM dA allAha te Aqhirata de dina ’te ImAna he (tAM uha kade vI rabbI hukamAM dI ulaMghaNA nahIM karanagIAM) ate je uhanAM de patI mur3a (sabaMdhAM vica) sudhAra karanA cAhuNa tAM iha uhanAM dA hakka he ki uha isa niyata sameM vica (sudhAra valla) parata AuNa| (kuraAnI) saMvidhAna anusAra auratAM nUM maradAM ’te uhIo adhikAra prApata hana jihar3e maradAM nUM auratAM de saMbaMdha vica prApata hana para maradAM nUM auratAM nAloM ika darajA vaddha prApata he| (iha niyama baNAuNa vAlA) allAha z2orAvara ate hikamata (dAnAI) vAlA he|

(parataNa vAlA) talAka do vAra he, phira jAM tAM (aurata nUM) bhale tarIke nAla (mur3a nikAha karake) roka liA jAve jAM bhale tarIke nAla chaDDa dittA jAve ate tuhADe laI iha jAiz2a nahIM ki tusIM jo kujjha uhanAM nUM (mahira Adi) de cukke ho usa viccoM vApasa lavo| jekara dohAM nUM Dara hove ki uha allAha dIAM niyata kItIAM gaIAM haddAM nUM kAima nahIM rakkha sakaNage jAM je tusIM isa galla toM Darade ho ki uha doveM allAha dIAM niyata kItIAM haddAM dI rAkhI nahIM kara sakade tAM ihanAM dohAM ’te isa galla dA koI gunAha nahIM je aurata fidIye (badale) vica dhaMna de ke chuTakArA hAsila kara lave| [46] iha allAha dIAM haddAM hana, so tusIM ihanAM toM agge nA vadho| jihar3e loka allAha dIAM haddAM dI ੳlaMghaNA karade hana uha z2Alama hana|
translations.footnotes:
[46] “qhulAa” bhAva je auaurata ApaNe patI toM aDDa hoNA cAhuMdI he tAM kujjha zaratAM nAla mahira vApasa karake talAka lai sakadI he jiveM ki haz2arata ibane abbAsa toM patA lagadA he ki sAbita bina kaisa (ra:a:) dI patanI rasUla (sa:) dI sevA vikhe hAz2ara hoI ate benatI kItI ki he allAha de rasUla (sa:) maiM sAbita bina kaisa dI dInadArI ate sadAcAra pakkho koI doza nahIM lagAuMdI ki maiM musalamAna huMde hoe patI dI nA-zukarI karana dA gunAMha khaTTAM| nabI (sa:) ne faramAiA “caMgA kI tUM sAbita valloM mahira vica ditte gae bAg2a nUM vApasa karadI he? ” uhane kihA “jI hAM” phira Apa (sa:) ne sAbita nUM AkhiA ki tUM ApaNe bAg2a vApasa lai ate isa nUM talAka de| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 5273)
* zarIata vica isa nUM “qhulAa” kihA jAMdA he, bhAva auaurata ApaNI icchA ate koziza nAla talAka laiMdI he| aNa-baNa hoNa dI hAlata vica talAka jAM qhulAa rAhIM judAI vadhIA galla he|

translations.translation: phira je uha (patI) tIjA talAka de deve tAM usa toM bAada uha (aurata) usa patI de laI halAla (jAiz2a) nahIM jadoM taka uha (aurata) chuTTa isa (pahile patI) toM kise dUje (viakatI) nAla nikAha nA kara lave| je uha vI talAka de dave tAM ihanAM dohAM (pahile patI patanI) de mur3a milaNa ’te koI gunAha nahIM, (uha vI usa sameM) je doveM allAha valloM niyata kItIAM hoIAM haddAM dA qhiAla rakkha sakaNa| iha allAha dIAM (talAka de saMbaMdha vica) haddAM hana, jihar3IAM uhanAM nUM dassIAM jA rahIAM hana jihar3e (ihanAM dI mahattatA dA) giAna rakkhade hana|

jadoM tusIM auratAM nUM (pahilI jAM dUjI) talAka de devo phira jAM tAM uhanAM nUM iddata (talAka deNa toM bAAda uDIka dA ika niyata samAM) pUrI hoNa toM pahilAM pahilAM bhale tarIke nAla roka lavo jAM uhanAM nUM chaDa dio| uhanAM nUM taMga karana laI nA roko ki tusIM uhanAM nAla vadhIkIAM kara sako| jihar3A vI iMja karegA avazza hI uha Apa ApaNe nAla hI z2ulama (vadhIkI) karegA| (he musalamAno!) tusIM allAha dIAM AitAM (hukamAM) dA makhaula nA uDAu| allAha valloM jihar3e inAma tuhAnUM baqhaze gae hana uhanAM nUM yAda rakkho ate usa kitAba (.kuraAna) ate hikamata (hadIsa) nUM vI yAda rakkho jihar3I usa ne tuhADe ’te utArI he| uha (allAha) tuhAnUM nasIhata karadA he ki allAha toM Daro ate yAda rakkho ki bezakka uha hara cIz2a nUM jANadA he|

jadoM tusIM ApaNIAM auratAM nUM talAka de devo aeta uha ApaNI iddata pUrI kara laiNa tAM tusIM uhanAM nUM ApaNe (pahile) patI nAla nikAha karana toM nA roko, jadda ki uha Apasa vica (mur3a nikAha de) cAhavAna hana| iha nasIhata usa viakatI laI he jihar3A allAha ate Aqhirata vAle dina ’te ImAna rakkhadA he| iho tarIkA tuhADe laI bhalAI vAlA ate pavittaratA vAlA he, (jisa nUM) allAha jANadA he tusIM nahIM jANade|

mAvAM ApaNe bacciAM nUM pUre do sAla duddha piAuNa, iha (hukama) usalaI he jihar3A duddha piAuNa dI muddata pUrI karanA cAhuMdA he| (ajihI hAlata vica) pio dI z2iMmevArI he ki uhanAM (mAvAM) laI pracalita DhaMga anusAra khANa pANa te kappar3hiAM dA prabaMdha kare| para kise ’te vI usa dI himmata toM vaddha bojha nA pAiA jAve ate nA hI mAM nUM usa de bacce karake koI takalIfa dittI jAve ate nA hI bApa nUM usa de bacce kArana (taMga kItA jAve)| (je bApa mara jAve tAM) usa de vArasAM dI iho z2iMmevArI he| je doveM (mAM-pio) ApasI sahimatI ate salAha mazavare nAla (bacce dA) duddha pahilAM chuDA deNa tAM dovAM laI koI haraja nahIM, je tusIM ApaNI saMtAna nUM kise dUjI aurata toM duddha piAuNA cAho tAM vI koI haraja nahIM jada ki tusIM rivAja anusAra jo vI deNA taia kItA he adA kara devo| tusIM allAha toM Daro ate yAda rakkho ki bezakka allAha tuhADe sAre amalAM nUM jo vI tusIM karade ho vekhadA he|

tuhADe viccoM jihar3e loka mara jANa ate ApaNe picche patanIAM chaDDa jANa tAM uha (vidhavA) ApaNe Apa nUM cAra mahIne dasa dina taka (gharoM bAhara jANa te baNAo zigAra toM) rokI rakkhaNa| jadoM uhanAM dI iddata pUrI ho jAve tAM (je uha gharoM bAhara jANa te baNAo ziMgAra karana) tuhADe sira koI gunAha nahIM, uha (vidhavA) ApaNe laI (isalAmI) dasatUra anusAra jo vI cAhuNa (viAha karana dA jAM nA karana dA) faisalA kara sakadIAM hana| allAha tuhADe hara amala nUM, jo vI tusIM karade ho, bhalI-bhAMta jANadA he|

isa galla vica vI koI haraja nahIM ki je tusIM auratAM nUM uhanAM dI iddata de sameM vica hI izAriAM rAhIM nikAha dA sunehA ghalla dio jAM ApaNI icchAM nUM mana vica lukAI rakkhoM| allAha jANadA he ki tusIM ihanAM auratAM dI caracA (dila vica jAM ghara vAliAM nAla) avazza hI karoge| ihanAM nAla nikAha laI gupatI vAade nA karo sagoM iho galla dasatUra (isalAmI zarIata) anusAra hI karo| jadoM taka iddata pUrI nA ho jAve nikAha dI galla pakkI nA karo| qhabaradAra tuhADe dilAM vica jo vI he uhanAM sabha nUM allAha jANadA he | tusIM sAre usa toM hI Daro bezakka allAha (bhullAM nUM) baqhazaNa vAlA he ate bahuta hI sahiNazIla he|

jekara tusIM ApaNIAM patanIAM nUM hattha lAuNa jAM mahira niyata karana toM pahilAM talAka de dio tAM tuhADe sira koI gunAha nahIM phira vI uhanAM nUM kujjha mAla avazza hI de deNA cAhIdA he| khuzahAla viakatI laI usa dI pahuMca anusAra ate garIba nUM usa dI pahuMca anusAra bhale tarIke nAla deNA cAhIdA he| nekI karana vAliA laI iMja karanA lAz2amI he|

je tusIM uhanAM nUM hattha lAuNa toM pahilAM talAka de dio jadoM ki mahira niyata ho giA hove tAM isa mahira dA addhA hissA adA karanA hovegA| hAM! je uha aurata cAhave tAM (mahira) muAfa vI kara sakadI he jAM uha viakatI muAfa kara sakadA he jisa de hattha vica nikAha karana dA iqhatiAra he| je tusIM muAfa kara devo tAM iha nekI de vaddha ner3e he| tusIM Apo vicAle bhalAI te ahisAna vAlA varatAo karanA nA bhu=lo| bezakka tusIM jo vI karade ho allAha uhanAM sabha dI qhabara rakkhadA he|
tusIM ApaNIAM namAz2AM dI vizeza kara vicakAra vAlI namAz2a (asara)[47] dI rAkhI karo ate allAha de agge nimANe jihe baNa ke khar3e ho jAo|
translations.footnotes: [47] “salAte vusatA” vicakAra vAlI namAz2a toM bhAva asara dI namAz2a he allAha de rasUla ne faramAiA jisa ne asara dI namAz2a nahIM par3hI tAM iMja samajho jiveM ki usa de ghara dA sArA sAmAna luTTa liA giA hove| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 552)

translations.translation: je tusIM badaamanI dI hAlata vica hovoM tAM bhAveM [48] paidala hovo jAM savAra (namAz2a par3ha liA karo) jada amana ho jAve tAM usa tarhAM allAha nUM yAda karo (bhAva namAz2a par3ho) jiveM tuhAnUM usa (allAha) ne uha sabha sikhAiA he jisa nUM tusIM pahilAM jANade nahIM sI|
translations.footnotes: [48] isa Aita vica salAte qhaufa bhAva Dara vele dI namAz2a dA hukama he jihar3I lor3a paiNa ’te paidala jA savAra doveM hAlatAM vica par3hI jA sakadI he| sahI hadIsAM anusAra isa namAz2a dI giNatI cAra, do ate ika rakAata par3haNa dI puzaTI vI huMdI he| hadIsa vica isa dIAM vakho-vakkha misAlAM hana| hadIsa vica he ki nabI (sa:) ne ika TolI nUM do rakAata namAz2a par3hAI| jada ki dUjI TolI duzamanAM dA mukAbalA kara rahI sI| phira pahilI TolI haTa gaI te duzamana dA mukAbalA karana lagga paI ate dUjI TolI nUM vI do rakAata namAz2a par3hAI tAM iMja nabI (sa:) dIAM cAra rakAatAM hauIAM ate dUje lokAM dIAM do-do rakAatAM| (sahI musalima, hadIsa: 843)

translations.translation: jihar3e viakatI (tuhADe vicoM) mara jANa ate picche patanIAM vI chaDDa jANa uhanAM laI ApaNIAM patanIAM de hakka vica vasIata karanA lAz2amI ho jAMdA he ki uhanAM (dIAM vidhavAvAM) nUM qharacA dittA jAve ate ika sAla taka uhanAM nUM (patI de gharoM) nA kaDDhiA jAve| phira je uha Ape gharoM calIAM jANa tAM ApaNe bAre sohaNe DhaMga nAla uha jo kujjha vI karana usa vica tuhADA (ghara vAliAM dA) koI doza nahIM| allAha hI z2orAvara te dAnAI vAlA he|
jinhAM auratAM nUM talAka dittI gaI he uhanAM nUM sohaNe DhaMga nAla kujjha (mAla) de ke hI gharoM vidA kItA jAve| iMja karanA parahez2agArAM laI ati z2arUrI he|
iMja hI allAha tuhADe laI ApaNIAM AitAM kholha-kholha ke biAna karadA he tAM joM tusIM (caMgI tarhAM) samajha sako|

(he nabI!) kI tusIM uhanAM lokAM nUM nahIM vekhiA jihar3e haz2ArAM dI giNatI vica sana ate mauta toM Darade hoe ApaNe gharAM toM nikale sana| allAha ne uhanAM nUM AkhiA ki tusIM mara jAo (uha sabha mara gae) phira usa ne uhanAM nUM mur3a jiUMdA kItA| bezakka allAha ApaNe baMdiAM ’te vaDDIAM-vaDDIAM miharAM faramAuNa vAlA he para (fera vI) bahute loka zukara nahI karade|
(he musalamAno!) tusIM allAha dI rAha vica lar3o ate iha yAda rakkho ki bezakka allAha (sabha kujjha) suNana vAlA ate jANana vAlA he|

koNa he jihar3A allAha nUM sohaNA karaz2A deve tAM jo allAha vI usa de mAla vica kaI guNA vadhA ke mor3a deve? kiuM jo ghaTAuNA te vadhAuNA (taMgI te qhuzahAlI) allAha de hI vassa vica he ate tusIM sAre use valla paratoge|

(he nabI!) kI tusIM mUsA toM bAada banI isarAIla dI ika (uha) jamAata nahIM vekhI jadoM uhanAM ne ApaNe nabI nUM kihA sI ki sADe laI ika bAdazAha niyukata kara dio tAM jo asIM vI allAha dI rAha vica lar3AI karIe| usa (nabI) ne AkhiA ki ho sakadA he ki je tuhADe ’te jihAda faraz2a kara dittA jAve tAM tusIM jihAda nA karo| uhanAM (kauma) ne kihA ki bhalA sAnUM kI hoiA he ki asIM allAha dI rAha vica nahIM lar3AMge jada ki sAnUM ApaNe gharAM toM beghara ate ApaNI aulAda toM dUra kara dittA giA he| jadoM uhanAM ’te lar3aNA faraz2a kara dittA giA tAM kujjha lokAM nUM chaDa ke sAre (ApaNIAM gallAM toM) phira (mukara) gae allAha z2AlamAM nUM caMgI tarhAM jANadA he|

uhanAM de nabI (samoIla) ne AkhiA ki allAha ne tuhADe laI tAlUta nUM bAdazAha niyukata kItA he| uhanAM (kauma) ne kihA ki uha sADe ’te hakUmata kiveM kara sakadA he, jada ki asIM usa toM vaddha bAdazAhata de hakkadAra hAM? usa de kola tAM dhaMna dolata dI farAkhI vI nahIM| usa (nabI) ne kihA bezakka allAha ne tuhADe laI use (tAlUta) dI coNa kItI he ate usa nUM giAna ate zarIrika zakatI pakkhoM bahuta khullha dittI he| allAha jisa nUM vI cAhuMdA he rAjapATa baqhaza diMdA ate allAha hI vaDDI farAkhI vAlA ate sabha kujjha jANana vAlA he|

uhanAM (kauma) de nabI (samoIla) ne uhanAM nUM (bAdazAha dI nizAnI pucchaNa ’te) kihA ki usa dI bAdazAhata dI nizAnI iha he ki tuhADe kola uha saMdUka AvegA jisa vica tuhADe rabba valloM tuhADe (dilAM dI) tasallI [49] laI uha sArIAM cIz2AM hoNagIAM jihar3IAM mUsA te hArUna dIAM aulAdAM chaDDa gaIAM sana ate isa (saMdUka) nUM farizate cukka ke liAuNage| bezakka isa vica tuhADe laI ika vaDDI nizAnI he je tusIM ImAna vAle ho|
translations.footnotes: [49] iha uha sakInata bhAva tasallI vAlA sAmAna he jisa dI caracA hadIsa vica kItI gaI he| haz2arata barA bina Az2iba (ra:a:) toM patA caladA he ki haz2arata usaida bina uz2aira (ra:a:) kahafa sUrata par3ha rahe sI ate uhanAM de lAge ika ghor3A rassIAM nAla baMnhiAM khar3A sI ki ika baddalI heTha nUM AuNa laggI, jihar3I uhanAM de ner3e A rahI sI| itthoM taka ki ghor3A usa baddalI nUM vekha ke TappaNa lagga piA| jadoM savera hoNa ’te maiM iha ghaTanA rasUla (sa:) nUM dassI tAM Apa (sa:) ne faramAiA, iha sakInata he, bhAva mana dI zAMtI sI jihar3I.kuraAna par3haNa kArana nAz2ila hoI sI| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 5011)

translations.translation: jadoM tAlUta ApaNIAM fojAM laike (lar3aNa laI) nikaliA tAM usa ne kihA ki he faujio! allAha tuhAnUM ika nahira utte parakhegA, jisa ne vI usa nahira toM (rajja ke) pANI pI liA usa dA saMbaMdha mere nAla nahIM rahegA ate jihar3A usa pANI dA suAda vI nahIM cakhegA uha merA (sAthI) he| hAM! je koI ApaNe hattha vica ika addhI pANI dI cullI lai leve tAM vI koI galla nahIM| para uhanAM (faujIAM) vica thor3he jihA nUM chaDDa ke sabha ne usa (nahira) dA pANI pI liA| jadoM tAlUta ne ate usa de sAthIAM ne, jihar3e usa ’te ImAna liAe sana, usa nahira nUM pAra kara liA tAM uhanAM (faujIAM) ne Apasa vica kihA ki ajja sADe ’ca jAlUta ate uhadIAM faujAM nAla lar3aNa dI hiMmata nahIM para uha loka jihar3e isa galla ’te vizavAsa rakkhade sana ki bezakka uha ika dina allAha nUM milaNa vAle hana, uhanAM ne kihA ki kaI vAra ika choTI jihI TolI vI allAha de hukama nAla vaDDI TolI ’te bhArU ho jAMdI he ate allAha sabara karana (maidAna vica DaTe rahiNa) vAliAM dA sAtha diMdA he|

jadoM uha (tAlUta de faujI) jAlUta ate usa dIAM faujAM de mukAbale laI nikale tAM uhanAM ne duA kItI ki he sADe mAlika! sAnUM sabara de ate (jaMga vica) sADe paira jamAIM rakkha ate kAfarAM de viruddha sADI madada kara|

aMta mominAM ne allAha de hukama nAla kAfarAM nUM harA dittA ate dAUda ne jAlUta nUM katala kara dittA| allAha ne dAUda nUM bAdazAhata ate samajha bUjha (paig2aMbarI) baqhazI ate jo cAhiA usa nUM uhIo giAna sikkhiAiA| je allAha lokAM dI ika jamAata nUM dUjI jamAata rAhIM haTAuMdA nA rahiMdA tAM dharatI dI sArI vivasathA hI vigar3a jAMdI ate allAha tAM kula jahAna ’te ApaNI miharabAnIAM faramAuNa vAlA he|
(he nabI!) iha sADIAM AitAM (AdezA) hana| asIM (allAha) pUrI saccAI nAla uhanAM nUM tuhADe laI varaNana karade hAM| bezakka tusIM rasUlAM viccoM hI ho| [50]
translations.footnotes: [50] isa Aita vica allAha de rasUla (sa:) dI paig2aMbarI dI puzaTI huMdI he ki Apa (sa:) dI paig2aMbarI kiAmata taka de AuNa vAle manukkhAM laI he| Apa jI (sa:) allAha de AqharI paig2aMbara sI huNa hora koI rasUla nahIM AvegA| inhAM sArIAM gallAM dA visathAra sahita veravA vekho| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 335, 3535)

translations.translation: iha sAre hI rasUla hana, asIM ihanAM nUM ika dUje (rasUla) nAlo vaddha ke marAtabe (vaDiAI) baqhaze, ihanAM viccoM kujjha uha vI hana jinhAM nAla allAha ne Apa gallAM kItIAM ate ihanAM viccoM hI kujjha de maratabe (kujjha hora pakkhoM) ucce kIte| asIM marIama de puttara IsA nUM (nabI hoNa dIAM) khullhIAM nizAnIAM baqhazIAM ate pavittara rUha (jibarAIla) rAhIM uhanAM dI madada kItI| je allAha cAhuMdA tAM uhanAM rasUlAM de AuNa toM bAada vica AuNa vAle loka Apo vica nA lar3ade jadoM ki uhanAM kola (nabI hoNa dIAM) khullhIAM nizAnIAM A cukkIAM sana| para phira vI uhanAM ne (Apasa vica) matabheda kItA| so uhanAM viccoM hI kujjha uha hana jihar3e (IsA ’te) ImAna liAe ate kujjha ne inakAra kara dittA| je allAha cAhuMdA tAM uha ukkA hI nA lar3ade para allAha jo cAhuMdA he karadA he|

he ImAna vAlio! asIM jo vI tuhAnUM (mAla) dittA he usa viccoM (allAha dI rAha vica) qharaca karo, isa toM pahilAM ki uha dina (kiAmata dA) A jAve jisa vica nA koI laiNa-deNa hovegA ate nA hI koI dosatI jAM safAraza hI kaMma AvegI| ihanAM gallAM dA inakAra karana vAle hI z2Alima hana|

uha allAha he usa toM chuTTa koI vI (saccA) izaTa nahIM (sadA laI) jiuMdA he, samuccI (zrizaTI) nUM saMbhAliA hoiA he, nA hI usa nUM uMgha AuMdI he ate nA hI uha soMdA he| akAzAM ate dharatI vica jo kujjha vI he uha sabha use dA he| uha kihar3A he jihar3A usa de agge binAM usa dI AgiA toM kise dI safAraza kara sake? uhIo jANadA he jo lokAM (dIAM akkhAM de) sAhamaNe nUM ate jo uhanAM de ohale ru| lokI usa de giAna ’coM kujjha vI ApaNe adhIna nahIM kara sakade, chuTTa usa galla toM (jisa dI jANakArI) uha Apa hI deNA cAhe| usa dI kurasI [51] (bAdazAhI taqhata) ne akAzAM te dharatI (dI hara cIz2a)nUM ApaNe ghere vica liA hoiA nUM ate uha (allAha) uhanAM sabha dI rAkhI karadA hoiA thakkadA nahIM| uha ika mahAna ate saraba-ucca vaDiAI vAlI hasatI he|
translations.footnotes:
[51] nabI karIma (sa:) dA faramAna he ki satta akAzAM dI mahattatAM kurasI de mukAbale vica kevala iMnI he jiMnI kise qhAlI thAM ’te koI muMdara paI hove jada ki araza dI mahattatA kurasI de mukAbale vica aiveM he jiveM qhAlI paI dharatI dI mahattatA isa muMdarI utte hove (vekho sahI hadIsAM dI lar3I, hadIsa: 109)| hakIkata vica allAha, jihar3A araza ate kurasI dA paidA karana vAlA he, sabha toM vaDDI hasatI he| (zeqhula isalAma ibane taiamIA faramAuMde hana ki isa toM siddha huMdA he ki kurasI de nAla ImAna liAuNA ate araza de nAla ImAna liAuNA ati z2arUrI he uhanAM dA iha vI kahiNA he ki sAre hI ahale suMnata dA iho vizavAsa he ki kurasI araza de sAhamaNe he ate iha pairAM dI thAM he|) (ibane taiamIA de fatave)
* haz2arata abU-hurairA dassade hana ki nabI karIma (sa:) ne mainUM ramaz2Ana dI z2akAata (sadakAe fitara) dI rAkhI laI niyukata kara dittA tAM mere kola ika viakatI AiA ate AuMde hI anAja dI muTThI bhara laI tAM mainUM usa nUM phar3a liA ate kihA ki maiM tai` allAha de rasUla de kola laike jAvAMgAM maiM tainUM chaDDadA nahIM phira pUrA kissA biAna kItA tAM uhane kihA ki (he abU-hurairA) jadoM tUM soNa laI bisatare ’te jAveM tAM Aitala kurasI par3ha liA karIM tAM savera hoNa taka allAha taAlA valloM ika farizatA terI nigarAnI karegA ate jihar3A terI surakkhiA karegA ate savere taka zaitAna tere ner3e vI nahIM AvegA| nabI (sa:) ne faramAiA, he tAM uha jhUThA para iha galla usa ne saccI AkhI he, uha zaitAna sI| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 5010)

translations.translation: dharama de saMbaMdha vica koI z2ora z2abaradasatI nahIM, kiuM jo hidAita (saccA dharama) gumarAhI (jhUThe dharamAM) toM sapazaTa ho cukkI he| so jihar3A koI tAg2Uta (allAha toM chuTTa dUje izaTa) dA inakAra kare ate allAha ’te ImAna lai Ave usa viakatI ne ika maz2abUta sahAre nUM phar3a liA nUM jihar3A TUTaNa vAlA nahIM| allAha (hara galla nUM) bhalI-bhAMta jANana vAlA ate suNana vAlA he|

allAha uhanAM dA hI dosata he jihar3e ImAna liAuNa vAle hana, uha uhanAM nUM (kufara de) haneriAM ’coM kaDDha ke (ImAna dI) rozanI vica liAuMdA he ate uha loka jinhAM ne kufara kItA uhanAM dA dosata ‘tAg2Uta’ [52] hana, uha uhanAM nUM hidAita dI rozanI ’coM kaDDha ke (jahAlata de) haneriAM valla lai jAMde hana (ajihe loka hI naraka vica jANage) jitthe uha sadA laI rahiNage|
translations.footnotes: [52] zabada “tAg2Uta” toM bhAva hara uha cIz2a ru jisa dI pUjA asalI izaTa, allAha nUM chaDDa ke kItI jAve jiveM patthara, ruੱqha, kabara, jiuMde jAM murade manukkha, jAnavara, mUratI, caMna, sUraja, tAre Adi) iMja hI haz2arata IsA ate uhanAM dI mAtA marIama ate dUje nabI te rasUla ate jihar3e vI allAha nUM chaDDa ke dUje sAre izaTa jinAM dI vI pUjA kItI jAMdI he uha sAre tAg2Uta akhavAuNage| haz2arata umara (ra:a:) ne faramAiA ika amIra viakatI dI udAharana he jihar3A allAha dI baMdagI vica neka amala vI karadA rahiMdA he phira allAha usa nUM parakhaNa laI zaitAna nUM bheja diMdA he jisa kArana uha bure kaMma karana lagga paiMdA he itthoM taka ki usa de caMge karama vI barabAda ho jAMde hana| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 4538)

translations.translation: kI tusIM usa viakatI nUM vekhiA he jisa ne ibarAhIma nAla kevala isa laI jhagar3A kItA sI ki allAha ne usa (namarUda) nUM bAdazAhata de chaDDI sI? jada ibarAhIma ne kihA ki merA rabba tAM uha he jihar3A jIvana vI diMdA he ate mauta vI diMdA he tAM usa (namarUda bAdazAha) ne kihA ki maiM vI jIvana ate mauta diMdA hAM| ibarAhIma ne kihA ki allAha tAM sUraja nUM pUraba ’coM kaDDhadA he tUM isa nUM pacchama ’coM kaDDha ke vikhA| iha suNa ke uha hakkA bakkA (lA javAba) ho ke rahi giA| uha (allAha dIAM zakatIAM dA) inakArI sI| allAha uhanAM lokAM nUM hidAita nahIM diMdA jihar3e z2ulama karade hana|

jAM ise tarhAM tusIM usa nUM vI nahIM vekhiA jihar3A ika basatI kola dI laMghaiA jisa dIAM chattAM DiggIAM hoIAM sana? usa ne AkhiA ki isa basatI (de vAsIAM) dI mauta toM bAada allAha kiveM isa nUM mur3a jIvata karegA? tAM allAha ne usa (pucchaNa vAle) viakatI nUM sau sAla laI mauta de dittI phira usa nUM jiUMdA kItA| allAha ne (usa toM) pucchiA ki tUM kiMnI dera iMja (muradA) rihA? usa ne kihA ki ika dina laI jAM dina dA vI ika bhAga| allAha ne faramAiA, nahIM tUM tAM mauta dI hAlata vica sau sAla rihA he, tUM ApaNe khANa pINa (de sAmAna) valla vekha uha vI sar3hiA nahIM aeta ApaNe (mare hoe) khote valla vekha| asIM lokAM laI tenUM (ika nizAnI baNA deNA) cAhuMde hAM, so tUM khote dIAM haDDIAM valla vekha ki asIM ihanAM nUM kiddAM jor3ade hAM phira ihanAM ’te mAsa boTI car3hAuMde hAM| jadoM usa ne iha sabha vekha liA tAM usa ne kihA ki maiM jANadA hAM ki bezakka allAha hara kaMma karana dI kudarata rakhadA he|

jadoM ibarAhIma ne kihA ki he mere rabbA! mainUM vikhA ki tUM muradiAM nUM kiveM jiUMdA kareMgA? allAha ne pucchiA kI tainUM isa (merI zakatI) ’te vizavAsa nahIM? ibarAhIma ne AkhiA, kiuM nahIM! maiM tAM kevala mana dI tasallI cAhuMdA hAM? allAha ne kihA ki tUM cAra paMchIAM? lai ate uhanAM nAla saneha paidA kara lai, phira uhanAM nUM mAra ke uhanAM dA ika-ika ToTA vakkha-vakkha pahAr3AM utte jA dhara phira uhanAM nUM bulAIM, uha (paMchI) tere kola nasse AuNage ate yAda rakkha ki allAha z2orAvara ate dAnAI vAlA he|

uhanAM lokAM dI misAla jihar3e allAha dI rAha vica qharaca karade hana usa dANe vAMga he jisa (dANe de bIjaNa ’te) satta ballIAM nikalaNa ate hara ballI viccoM sau dANe hoNa (ise tarhAM) allAha jisa nUM cAhuMdA he vadhA ke diMdA he uha vaDDI guMjAiza vAlA he (koNa qharaca sakadA he) uha caMgI tarhAM jANadA he|

jihar3e loka ApaNA mAla allAha dI rAha vica qharaca karade hana ate qharaca karake koI ahisAna dA pragaTAvA vI nahIM karade ate nA hI dukkha diMde hana, uhanAM dA badalA uhanAM de rabba kola he, (kiAmata dihAr3e) nA tAM uhanAM nUM koI (naraka dA) Dara hovegA ate nA hI uha udAsa hoNage|

bhalI galla karanA ate muAfa kara deNA usa (puMna-dAna) toM vadhIA he jisa de piccho (ahisAna jatA ke) dukha dittA jAve, jada ki allAha (ihanAM gallAM dI) paravAha nahIM karadA ate (nA zukariAM nUM) baradAzata karana vAlA he|

he ImAna liAuNa vAlio! ApaNI qhairAta nUM ahisAna jatA ke ate dukkha de ke usa viakatI vAMga barabAda nA karo jihar3A ApaNA mAla vikhAve laI qharaca karadA he| uha nA tAM allAha ’te ate nA hI kiAmata vAle dina ’te ImAna rakkhadA he usa dI udAharana usa cikane patthara vAMga he jisa utte miTTI paI hove phira usa utte z2ora dA mIMha pai jave (tAM sArI miTTI rur3a jAvegI) ate sAfa patthara rahi jAve| uha loka jo vikhAve laI nekI karade hana uhanAM de hattha kujjha vI nahIM AuMdA| allAha kAfarAM dI agavAI nahIM karadA|

uhanAM lokAM dI udAharana jihar3e allAha nUM rAz2I karana laI ate qhuzadilI nAla ApaNA mAla qharaca karade hana, usa bAg2a vAMga he jihar3A kise uccI thAM hove usa ’te z2orAM dA mIMha pai jAve tAM usa vica dugaNA phala hovegA je mIMha z2oradAra nA vI hove tAM ika fuAra (mIMha dA chiTTA) hI batherA he| tusIM jo vI (qharaca) karade ho allAha usa nUM bhalI-bhAMta vekhadA he|

kI tuhADe viccoM koI iha galla pasaMda karadA he ki usa dA ApaNA ika khajUrAM ate aMgUrAM dA bAg2a hove usa de thalle nahirAM vagadIAM hoNa| usa bAg2a vica usa laI hara tarhAM de phala hoNa uha viakatI Apa tAM buDDhA ho jAve jada ki usa dI saMtAna ajihe kamaz2ora (choTI) hove ate acAnaka hI usa bAg2a ’te ika vAra-varolA A jAve jisa vica agga hove ate uha isa (bAg2a) nUM sAr3a ke rakkha deve| ise tarhAM allAha tuhADe (samajhAuNa) laI AitAM khola khola ke biAna karadA he tAM jo tusIM soca vicAra kara sako|

he ImAna vAlio! tusIM ApaNI pAka kamAI viccoM hI (allAha dI rAha vica) qharaca karo ate usa viccoM vI jo asIM tuhADe laI dharatI ’coM kaDDhiA he| allAha dI rAha vica mAr3IAM te bekAra cIz2AM nUM qharaca karana dA jatana nA karo, jada ki tusIM Apa usa cIz2a nUM laiNA pasaMda nahIM karade chuTTa usa toM ki tusIM isa saMbaMdha vica aNadekhI kara jAo| yAda rakkho ki allAha (hara cIz2a toM) be-paravAha he ate zalAghAyoga he|

zaitAna tuhAnUM taMgadasatI (g2arIbI) toM DarAuMdA he ate be-hayAI (azalIlatA) dA hukama diMdA he jada ki allAha tuhADe nAla ApaNI baqhaziza ate miharAM dA vAadA karadA he| allAha farAqhI vAlA (bhAva khullhA DullA deNa vAlA) ate caMgI tarhAM jANana vAlA he|

allAha jisa nUM cAhuMdA he hikamata [53] (dAnAI) nAla nivAz2adA he ate jisa viakatI nUM siANapa (dAnAI) mila gaI usa nUM sArIAM hI bhalAIAM mila gaIAM (ihanAM gallAM toM) sikkhiA tAM sUjhavAna hI prApata karade hana|
translations.footnotes: [53] “hikamata” dA aratha dAnAI he| para isa thAM isa zabada toM bhAva.kuraAna te saMnata jAM hadIsa he| jisa nUM.kuraAna te hadIsa dA giAna ho jAMdA he phira usa nUM amala karanA vI AsAna ho jAMdA he|

translations.translation: tusIM kujjha vI qharaca karo jAM koI vI sukkha sukkhoM allAha uhanAM sabha nUM jANadA he ate z2AlamAM dA koI vI madadagAra nahIM huMdA|

je tusIM vikhA ke qhairAta devo tAM vI ThIka he para je tusIM fakIrAM nUM gupata dAna devo tAM iha tuhADe laI vadhere caMgA he| uha (allAha) tuhADe gunAhAM nUM (puMna-dAna rAhIM) dUra kara devegA| tusIM jo vI kaMma karade ho allAha usa nUM caMgI tarhAM jANadA he|

(he nabI!) lokAM nUM hidAita deNA tuhADe z2iMme nahIM allAha jisa nUM cAhuMdA he hidAita baqhaza diMdA he| tusIM ApaNe mAla ’coM jo vI qharaca karade ho uha tuhADe ApaNe lAbha laI he ate tusIM jo vI qharaca karade ho allAha nUM rAz2I karana laI hI qharaca karade ho aeta tusIM jo vI qharaca karoge tuhAnUM usa dA pUrA-pUrA badalA milegA tuhADe ’te z2ulama nahIM kItA jAvegA|

(qhairAta tAM) uhanAM lor3avaMdAM laI he jihar3e allAha de kaMmAM vica iMja rujhe rahiMde hana ki (ApaNI roz2I kamAuNa laI) dharatI ’te bhajja-naTTha nahIM kara sakade| aNajANa loka uhanAM dA Atama sanamAna vekha ke uhanAM nUM qhuzahAla samajhade hana| tusIM uhanAM nUM uhanAM de cihariAM toM pachANa sakade ho uha lokAM de picche pai ke savAla nahIM karade|[54] tusIM ApaNe mAla vi=coM jo vI qharaca karade ho allAha usa ` caMgI tarhAM jANadA ru|
translations.footnotes: [54].kuraAna vica ‘ilahAfana’ zabada dI varatoM kItI gaI he jisa dA aratha he ciMbar3a ke jAM picche paike savAla karanA, para imAma tibarI ate dUje viAkhiAkAra isa dA aratha dassade hana ki jihar3e ukkA hI savAla nahIM karade|

translations.translation: jihar3e loka ApaNe mAla nUM rAta dina gupata te khullhe Ama qharaca karade hana uhanAM dA badalA uhanAM de rabba kola he nAM tAM (kiAmata vAle dina) uhanAM nUM koI ciMtA hovegA ate nA hI udAsa hoNage | [55]
translations.footnotes: [55] nabI karIma (sa:) ne faramAiA, satta viakatI ajihe hana jinhAM nUM allAha taAlA usa dina ApaNI chatara chAiA heTha rakkhegA jisa dina chuTTa usa dI chAiA toM hora koI chAiA nahIM hovegA (1) Adila bhAva inasAfa pasaMda bAdazAha (2) uha naujavAna jihar3A allAha dI ibAdata karade hoe javAna hoiA (3) ajihA viakatI jisa dA mana masIta vica hI aTakiA rahiMdA he (4) uha do viakatI jihar3e kevala allAha laI muhabbata (dosatI) karade hana (5) uha viakatI jisa nUM koI qhUbasUrata aurata azalIlatA valla bulAve para uha Akhe ki maiM allAha toM DaradA hAM (6) uha viakatI jihar3A koI dAna puMna kare para usa nUM iMja gupata rakkhe ki uhade khabbe hattha nUM isa dA giAna nA hove ki usa de sajje hattha ne kI qhairAta kItI he (7) uha viakatI jihar3A ikAMta vica allAha nUM yAda karadA he ate allAha de Dara-bhaia de nAla usa dIAM akkhAM vica haMjhU A jANa| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 1423)

translations.translation: jihar3e loka sUda[56] khAMde hana uha (kiAmata dihAr3e) usa viakatI vAMga khar3e hoNage jisa nUM zaitAna ne chU ke pAgala baNA dittA hove| uhanAM nUM iha saz2A isa laI milegI ki uha kihA karade sana ki vapAra vI tAM viAja vAMga hI he jada ki vapAra nUM allAha ne halAla (jAiz2a) AkhiA he ate viAja nUM harAma (nAjAiz2a)| phira jisa viakatI kola usa de rabba valloM nasIhata A jAve ate uha (viAja khANa toM) ruka jAve tAM jihar3A viAja uha pahilAM khA cukkiA he so khA cukkiA, usa dA muAmalA allAha kola he para jihar3A viakatI phira mur3a (viAjU dhaMdA) karegA tAM ajihe loka hI naraka vica jANage, jitthe uha sadA laI rahiNage|
translations.footnotes: [56] sUda mukkha karake do prakAra dA huMdA he| ika iha ki kujjha sameM laI kise nUM sau rupae isa zarata ’te deNA ki vApasa karade hoe ika sau paMjAha jAM ika sau paccI deNe hoNage| iha paccI jA paMjAha usa sameM de badale vica he jisa vica sau rupaA varatiA giA he| dUjA sUda uha he jihar3A che cIz2AM vica ghaTaNa vadhaNa jAM nakada te udhAra kArana huMdA he| jiveM anAja de badale vica anAja laiNa huMdA he jekara hattho-hatthI barAbara barAbara hove tAM ThIka he je isa vica ghaTaNa vadhaNa jAM ika nakada hove te dUjI udhAra hove jAM doveM hI udhAra hoNa uha vI sUda he| (ahasanula biAna)

translations.translation: allAha viAja nUM miTAuMdA he ate qhairAta (dAna) nUM vadhAuMdA he| allAha kise nA-zukare gunAhagAra viakatI nUM pasaMda nahIM karadA|

bezakka jihar3e lokI ImAna liAe ate uhanAM ne neka kaMma vI kIte namAz2a kAima kItI ate z2akAta diMde rahe uhanAM dA badalA uhanAM de rabba kola he, nA uhanAM nUM koI ciMtA hovegA ate nA hI uha dukhI hoNage|
he loko! jihar3e ImAna liAe ho allAha toM Daro| jihar3A viAja laiNA (lokAM sira) bAkI rahiMdA he usa nUM chaDDa dio,[57] je tusIM sacce ImAna vAle ho|
translations.footnotes: [57] hadIsAM vica sUda dI harAma kamAI toM rokiA giA he jiveM nabI (sa:) ne kutte te qhUna kaDDhaNa dI kImata (laiNa-deNa) toM manhAM kItA he, iMja hI khuNana te khuNana vAlIAM, sUda khANa ate khalAuNa vAle ate tasavIra baNAuNa vAle utte lAanata bhejI he, iMja hI badakAra auaurata dI kamAI toM vI rokiA he| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 2086, 5962) * abU-saIda dA AkhaNA he ki ika vAra bilAla (ra:a:) baranI ika vadhIA khajUra nabI (sa:) dI sevA vikhe liAe Apa (sa:) ne pucchiA iha kithoM liAe ho? bilAla ne kihA ki mere kola ika ghaTiA kisama dI khajUra sI tAM maiM isa ghaTiA kisama dI khajUra de do tola de ke ika tola vadhIA khajUrAM dA lai liA tAM jo tuhADI sevAM vica peza kara sakAM| tAM Apa (sa:) ne faramAiA, afasosa he afasosa! iha tAM ukkA hI sUda he, iMja nA karo, je tusIM khajUra kharIdaNI hove tAM pahilAM ApaNI khajUra veco phira vadhIA khajUrAM kharIdo| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 2312)

translations.translation: je tusIM iha (viAja khANA baMda) nA kItA tAM allAha ate usa de rasUla nAla jaMga karana laI tiAra ho jAo| je tusIM taubA kara lavo tAM tusIM ApaNA mUladhana laiNa de hakkadAra ho| nAM tusIM kise ’te z2ulama karo te nA hI (allAha valloM) tuhADe utte z2ulama kItA jAvegA|

je (tuhADe karaz2adAra dA) hattha taMga hove tAM usa nUM hattha khullhaNa taka mohalata dio ate tuhADe laI bahuta hI vadhIA he je tusIM (karaz2a nUM) sadakA [58] (bhAva muAfa) kara devo, je tuhAnUM isa dA giAna he|
translations.footnotes: [58] isa thAM sadake toM bhAva muAfa kara deNA he| nabI (sa:) ne faramAiA ki ika viakatI lokAM nUM udhAra diA karadA sI ate ApaNe naukara nUM AkhadA sI ki je tUM udhAra vApasa laiNa laI kise hattha taMga vAle kola jAve tAM usa nAla naramI dA varatAo karIM ho sakadA he ki allAha sADe nAla naramI varate tAM Apa (sa:) ne faramAiA jadoM allAha nAla usa dI milaNI hovegI tAM allAha usa nUM muAfa kara devegA| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 3480)

translations.translation: usa dina toM Daro jadoM tusIM sAre allAha valla paratAe jAuge ate hareka viakatI ne (saMsAra vica) jo vI (amala kItA) hovegA usa nUM usa dA pUrA-pUrA badalA dittA jAvegA, kise nAla koI vadhIkI nahIM hovegI|

he loko! jihar3e ImAna liAe ho! jadoM tusIM Apo vica ika nizacita sameM laI udhAra dA laiNa-deNa karo tAM usa nUM likha liA karo ate likhaNa vAle nUM cAhIdA he ki tuhADe vicakAra (laiNa-deNa nUM) inasAfa nAla likhe ate likhaNayoga viakatI likhaNa toM inakAra nA kare| jisa nUM allAha ne likhaNA sikhAiA he usa nUM likhaNA cAhIdA he| jisa de z2iMme karaz2a hove uhI viakatI likhavAegA ate karaz2adAra nUM (likhavAuMde hoe) ApaNe rabba toM DaranA cAhIdA he ate iha (likhavAuMde hoe) kise cIz2a nUM ghaTTA nA deve| je karaz2adAra nA samajha ru jAM kamaz2ora ru jAM likhavA nahIM sakadA tAM usa de muqhatiAra nUM cAhIdA he ki uha inasAfa nAla likhavA deve phira tusIM ApaNe musalamAna maradAM viccoM do gavAha baNAo je do marada nA hoNa tAM ika marada te do auratAM, jinhAM nUM tusIM (gavAhI laI) pasaMda karade ho, gavAha baNA lavo| (iha isa laI) ki jekara ika aurata bhulla jAve tAM dUjI usa nUM yAda karavA dave| jadoM gavAhAM nUM bulAiA jAve tAM uha inakAra nA karaNa| muAmalA bhAveM nikkA hove jAM vaDDA usa nUM niyata sameM nAla likhavAuNa vica ghaula nA karo, allAha dIAM naz2arAM vica iho inasAfa vAlI galla he ate gavAhI laI vadhIA tarIkA he| isa tarhAM zaMkAvAM dI saMbhAvanA vI ghaTTa jAMdI he| hAM! jihar3A kArobArI laiNa-deNa tusIM hatthoM-hattha karade ho usa de nA likhaNa vica koI haraja nahIM| jadoM tusIM Apasa vica koI saudA karo tAM gavAha baNA liA karo| likhaNa vAle nUM ate gavAha nUM taMga nA kItA jAve je tusIM (taMga) karoge tAM iha tuhADe valloM (rabba de hukamAM dI) ulaMghaNA hovegI| allAha toM Darade raho ate iha sArIAM (gallAM) tuhAnUM allAha hI sikhAuMdA he| allAha hareka galla nUM bhalI-bhAMta jANana vAlA he|

je tusIM safara vica hovo ate tuhAnUM koI likhaNa vAlA nA mile tAM kise cIz2a nUM giravI rakkha dio|[59] je tuhADe viccoM koI kise ’te bharosA kare jisa viakatI ’te bharosA kItA giA he usa nU cAhIdA he ki amAnata vApasa kare ate ApaNe rabba toM DaradA rahe| tuhADe viccoM koI gavAhI nUM nA lukove, jihar3A koI gavAhI nUM lakovegA usa dA mana pApI he| tusIM jo kujjha vI karade ho allAha bhalI-bhAMta jANadA he|
translations.footnotes: [59] kise cIz2a dA giravI rakkhaNA hadIsa toM siddha huMdA he haz2arata AizA (ra:a:) faramAuMdIAM hana, nabI karIma (sa:) ne ika yahUdI toM ika niyata sameM laI anAja qharIdiA ate ApaNI z2arrAha usa de kola giravI rakkhI| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 2509)

translations.translation: akAzAM ate dharatI vica jo vI he uha sabha allAha dA hI he tuhADe dilAM vica jo vI he tusIM bhAveM usa nUM pragaTa karo jAM gupata rakkho allAha tuhAthoM uhanAM sabha dA hisAba lavegA phira iha usa dI maraz2I he ki jisa nUM cAhe baqhaza deve jisa nUM cAhe az2Aba (saz2A) deve| allAha hara galla dI samarathA rakkhadA he|

rasUla (mahuMmada) ate sAre momina vI use hidAita (.kuraAna) ’te ImAna liAe hana jihar3I uhanAM ’te uhanAM de rabba valloM utArI gaI he| iha sAre allAha te usa de farizatiAM, usa dIAM kitAbAM, ate usa de rasUlAM ’te ImAna liAe hana ate Akhade hana ki asIM usa (allAha) de rasUlAM vica (vaDiAI pakkhoM) koI aMtara nahIM rakhade ate Akhade hana ki asAM hukama suNiA ate isa dI pairavI kItI| he rabbA! asIM terI hI baqhaziza cAhuMde hAM ate asAM tere valla hI mur3a AuNA he|

allAha kise nUM vI usa dI sahiNa zakatI toM vaddha takalIfa nahIM diMdA| hareka viakatI ne jo vI neka kamAI kItI he usa dA phala (badalA) use laI he jo usa ne burAI kItI he usa dA bojha bhAra vI use de sira he| (ImAna vAle duAvAM karade hana ki) he sADe rabbAM! je sAthoM koI bhulla cukka ho gaI hove tAM sADI pakar3a nA karIM| he sADe rabba! sADe ’te ajihA bojha nA pAIM jihar3e tUM sAthoM pahilAM de lokAM ’te pAe sana (he sADe rabba) sADe ’ca jisa bojha nUM cukkaNa dI himmata hI nahIM uha sAthoM nA cukavAIM| sADIAM bhullAM dI aNadekhI kara, sAnUM baqhaza de ate sADe ’te rahima faramA| tUM hI sADe kaMma saMvArana vAlA he, so tUM kAfarAM de mukAbale vica sADI madada faramA|[60] (AmIna!)
translations.footnotes: [60] haz2arata abu masaUda ala badarI (ra:a:) toM patA laggadA he ki nabI karIma (sa:) ne faramAiA ki jisa ne bakaraha sUrata dIAM AqharI do AitAM rAta nUM soNa lagge par3ha laIAM tAM uha usa laI rAta dI ibAdata laI batherI he| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 4008)

translations.translation: alifa, lAma, mIma|
uha allAha he, usa toM chuTTa hora koI vI izaTa nahIM| uha (sadA toM ate sadA laI) jiuMdA he ate (srizaTI dI vivasathA nUM) sAMbhaNa vAlA he|

(he nabI!) use ne tuhADe ’te hakka sacca de nAla kitAba (.kuraAna) utArI jihar3I ApaNe toM pahilIAM (rabba valloM nAz2ila hoNa vAlIAM) kitAbAM dI puzaTI karadI he| use (allAha) ne tauraita ate iMjIla nUM nAz2ila kItA|

use ne pahile lokAM dI hidAita laI (kitAbAM bhejIAM) ate use ne furakAna (.kuraAna) nAz2ila kItA he| bezakka uha loka jinhAM ne allAha dIAM AitAM dA inakAra kItA uhanAM laI karar3A az2Aba he| allAha z2orAvara he (inakArIAM toM) badalA laiNa vAlA he|
bezakka allAha toM dharatI te akAza dI koI vI cIz2a lukI hoI nahIM|
uhIo (allAha) tuhADIAM mAvAM de garabha vica tuhADIAM zakalAM sUratAM jiveM cAhuMdA he baNAuMdA he| usa toM chuTTa koI izaTa nahIM| uhIo z2orAvara ate hikamata (sUjha-bUjha) vAlA he|

(he muhaMmada!) tuhADe ’te uhI he jisa ne kitAba (.kuraAna) nAz2ila kItI jisa vica kujjha AitAM muhakamAta (aTala te sapazaTa) hana jihar3IAM isa kitAba dA mUla AdhAra hana ate kujjha mutAzAbihAta (asapazaTa, guMjhaladAra) hana| jihar3e lokAM de manAM vica viMga he uha uhanAM mutAzAbihAta AitAM de picche lagge rahiMde hana| uhanAM dA udeza kevala fitanA (zakka) phailAuNA ate (.kuraAna toM dUra karana laI) dalIlAM dI bhAla karanA he jada ki allAha toM chuTTa koI vI ihanAM (asapazaTa) AitAM dI hakIkata nUM nahIM jANadA| jihar3e loka ApaNe giAna (ImAna) vica pakke hana uha Akhade hana ki sADA tAM ihanAM (asapazaTa AitAM) ’te ImAna he| iha sabha sADe rabba valloM hI he| nasIhata tAM kevala akala vAle hI grahiNa karade hana|

(akala vAle duAvAM karade hana ki) he sADe rabba! hidAita deNa magaroM sADe dilAM vica viMga-vala nA pAIM ate sADe utte ApaNe koloM rahimata dI baqhaziza kara| bezakka tUM hI sabha toM vaDDA saqhI dAtA he|
he sADe rabba! bezakka tUM ika dina sAre lokAM nUM (ApaNI haz2UrI vica) jamhAM karana vAlA he jisa de AuNa vica kise prakAra dA koI zakka nahIM| bezakka allAha ApaNe bacanAM toM TalaNa vAlA nahIM|
bezakka jinhAM lokAM ne (rabba dA) inakAra kItA uhanAM de mAla ate aulAda uhanAM nUM allAha de az2Aba toM bacAuNa laI kujjha kaMma nahIM AvegI, uha lokIM tAM (naraka dI) agga dA bAlaNa hana|

(uhanAM dA aMta) firaauna de sAthIAM ate uhanAM toM pahilAM de lokAM vAMga hovegA| uhanAM ne sADIAM AitAM (hukamAM) nUUM jhuThalAiA tAM allAha ne vI uhanAM nUM uhanAM de aparAdhAM kArana (saz2A laI) nappa liA| allAha saz2A deNa vica bahuta saqhata he|
(he nabI!) jihanAM lokAM ne kufara kItA he uhanAM nUM Akha dio ki chetI hI tusIM (allAha de) adhIna ho jAoge ate tuhAnUM naraka valla hakkiA jAvegA jo ki bahuta hI burA TikANA he|

hakIkata vica tuhADe laI uhanAM do dhar3hiAM (momina te kAfirAM) vica (sikkhiA laI) ika ahima nizAnI sI jihar3e (badara de maidAna vica) ika dUje nAla bhir3e sI (uhanAM vica) ika dhar3A allAha dI rAha vica lar3a rihA sI ate dUjA (rabba dA) inakArI sI| vekhaNa vAlIAM akkhAM uhanAM (kAfirAM) de dhar3e nUM (musalamAnAM de dhar3e toM) do guNA vekha rahIAM sana| (jada ki) allAha jisa nUM cAhuMdA he ApaNI madada duArA zakatI (sahAitA) pradAna karadA he| bezakka isa (jaMga vica) sUjha-bUjha rakkhaNa vAliAM laI ika vaDDI nasIhata he|

lokAM laI mana bhAMuMdIAM cIz2AM DADhIAM sohaNIAM baNA chaDDIAM hana jiveM patanIAM, puttara, sone cAMdI de bhaMDAra, coNave ghor3e, (pAlatU) jAnavara ate (harI bharI) khetI, jada ki iha sabha saMsArika jIvana dI hI samaggarI he, para vadhIA TikANA allAha de kola hI he|

(he nabI!) tusIM Akha dio kI maiM tuhA` ihanAM cIz2AM toM vadhIA cIz2AM dassAM? (uha iha) ki parahez2agArAM laI (bhAva rabba toM Darade hoe burAIAM toM bacana) vAliAM laI rabba de kola bAg2a hana jinhAM de heTha nahirAM vagadIAM hana| uha uhanAM vica sadA laI rahiNage utthe uhanAM laI pavittara patanIAM hoNagIAM ate allAha dI raz2A vI prApata hovegI allAha ApaNe baMdiAM (de amalAM) nUM caMgI tarhAM vekhadA he|
jihar3e loka duA karade hana ki he sADe rabba! bezakka asIM ImAna liAe hAM, tUM sADe gunAhAM nUM baqhaza de ate sAnUM agga de az2Aba toM surakkhiata rakkha|

iha loka uha hana jihar3e sabara karade hana, sacca bolade hana, rabba de hukamAM dI pAlaNA karade hana, (rabba dI rAha vica) qharaca karade hana ate saraghI vele ApaNe laI baqhaziza dIAM duAvAM karade hana|

allAha ne gavAhI dittI he ki usa toM chuTTa hora koI izaTa nahIM ate (iho gavAhI) farizate ate giAnavAna loka vI de rahe hana ki use sArI srizaTI nUM inasAfa de AdhAra ’te kAima kara rakkhiA he| usa toM chuTTa hora koI izaTa nahIM uhIo z2orAvara dAnAI vAlA he|

bezakka allAha dI naz2ara vica kevala isalAma hI (saccA) dharama he ate ahale kitAba (bhAva yahUdI te IsAI) ne (rabbI) giAna AuNa toM bAada kevala isa laI isadA virodha kItA kiuM jo uha Apasa vica haTadharamI ate IrakhA vAlA vatIrA rakhade sana| jihar3A vI koI allAha dIAM AitAM (.kuraAna) dA inakAra karegA allAha chetI hI (usa toM) hisAba laiNa vAlA he|

(he muhaMmada!) je uha (ahale kitAba) tuhADe nAla jhagar3A karana tAM Akha dio ki maiM ate mere pairokArAM ne vI ApaNA sIsa allAha de agge jhukA dittA he| tusIM ahale kitAba (yahUdI ate IsAI) ate aNapar3ha (kAfira ate muzarika) lokAM nUM puccho kI tusIM isalAma kabUla karade ho? je uha isalAma kabUla kara laiNa tAM uhanAM nUM hidAita mila jAvegI| je uha mUMha mor3aNage tAM (koI galla nahIM) tuhADe z2iMmeM tAM kevala rabbI paig2Ama pahuMcAuNa dI hI z2iMmevArI he| allAha ApaNe baMdiAM nUM caMgI tarhAM vekhadA he|

bezakka jihar3e vI allAha dIAM AitAM (.kuraAna) dA inakAra karade hana, nabIAM nUM nA-hakkA katala karade hana ate uhanAM lokAM nUM vI (nA-hakkA) katala karade hana jihar3e hakka inasAfa dIAM gallAM karade hana tAM tusIM (he nabI!) uhanAM (z2AlamAM) nUM dukhadAI az2Aba dI qhuzaqhabarI suNA dio|
iha uha loka hana jinhAM de amala dunIAM te Aqhirata vica barabAda ho gae ate uhanAM dI koI madada karana vAlA vI nahIM he|

kI tusIM uhanAM lokAM (de vatIre) nUM nahIM vekhiA, jinhAM nUM kitAba de giANa viccoM kujjha bhAga miliA sI| uhanAM nUM kitAba valla bulAiA jAMdA he tAM joM uhanAM de vicAle (matabhedAM dA) faisalA kItA jA sake tAM ika dhira isa toM kaMnI katarhAMuMdA he, uha saccAI toM mUMha mor3a laiMde hana|

isa dA kArana iha he ki uhanAM dA iha kahiNA he ki (jekara sAnUM naraka vica jANA vI piA tAM) sAnUM naraka dI agga kujjha dina hI chUhegI| uhanAM dIAM iho managhar3a gallAM ne uhanAM nUM ApaNe dharama pratI bahuta bhulekhiAM vica pA suTTiA he|

phera kI hAla hovegA jadoM uhanAM nUM usa (kiAmata vAle) dina ikaTThA karAMge jisa de AuNa vica koI zakka nahIM ate (usa dina) hara viakatI nUM uha de kIte amalAM dA pUrA-pUrA badalA dittA jAvegA ate uhanAM ’te ukkA hI vadhIkI nahIM kItI jAvegI|

he nabI! tusIM Akho ki he mere rabbA! tUM jisa nUM cAhe bAdazAhI diMdA he ate jisa toM cAhe khoha laiMdA he ate tUM jisa nUM cAhe iz2z2ata diMdA he ate jisa nUM cAhe rusavA kara diMdA he| sabha tarhAM dIAM bhalAIAM tere hI hattha vica hana, bezakka hara cIz2a tere hI kabaz2e vica he|

tUM hI rAta nUM dina vica ate dina nUM rAta vica dAqhala karadA he, tUM hI bejAna cIz2AM viccoM jAnadAra cIz2AM nUM ate jAnadAra cIz2AM viccoM bejAna cIz2AM kaDDhadA he| tUM jisa nUM cAhuMdA he be hisAba riz2aka (dhaMna dolata, iz2z2ata, AbarU, saMtAna Adi) diMdA he|

mominAM nUM cAhIdA he ki ImAna vAliAM nUM chaDDa ke kAfirAM nUM ApaNA dosata (rAz2adAra) nA baNAuNa ate jo vI iMja karegA phera allAha dA usa nAla koI saMbaMdha nahIM| hAM! usa sameM muAfI he jadoM tuhAnUM uhanAM dIAM zarAratAM toM bacAo karanA hove (tAM dosatI kara sakade ho) allAha tuhA` ApaNI z2Ata toM DarA rihA he[1] ate tusIM parata ke allAha valla hI jANA he|
translations.footnotes: [1] ate allAha dA iha biAna he ki uha tuhAnUM ApaNI z2Ata toM DarAuMdA he bhAva ApaNI saz2A toM, nabI karIma sa: ne faramAiA allAha toM vaddha ke koI g2airatamaMda nahIM he ise laI usa ne azalIlatA vAle sAre kaMmAM nUM harAma kihA he ate allAha toM vaddha ke koI ajihAM vI nahIM jihar3A iha pasaMda karadA hove ki usa dI zalAghAM kItI jAve bhAva allAha isa nUM bahuta pasaMda karadA he ki vaddha toM vaddha usa dI prazaMzA kItI jAve| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 7403)

translations.translation: (he nabI!) tusIM kahi dio ki bhAveM tusIM ApaNe dila dI galla nUM lukAvo bhAveM z2Ahara karo, allAha sabha kujjha jANadA he| akAzAM te dharatI vica jo kujjha he uha usa nUM vI jANadA he ate hareka cIz2a allAha de kAbU vica he|

jadoM (kiAmata dihAr3e) hara koI ApaNIAM kItIAM hoIAM nekIAM te gunAhAM nUM ApaNe sAhamaNe hAz2ara vekhegA tAM uha icchA karegA ki kAza usa de ate usa dIAM burAIAM vicAle dUrI ho jAve| allAha tuhAnUM ApaNI z2Ata toM DarA rihA he ate allAha ApaNe baMdiAM ’te bar3A hI diAlU he|

(he nabI!) kahi dio ki je tusIM allAha nAla muhabbata rakkhade ho tAM merI tAbedArI karo allAha tuhADe nAla mahubbata karegA ate tuhADe gunAhAM nUM vI muAfa kara devegA| allAha vaDDA baqhazaNahAra te bahuta hI miharabAna he|
(he nabI!) kahi dio ki tusIM allAha ate usa de rasUla dI tAbedArI karo, je uha galla nahIM maMnade tAM allAha vI kAfirAM nUM pasaMda nahIM karadA|
bezakka allAha ne saMsAra de sAre lokAM viccoM Adama, nUha, ibarAhIma ate imarAna de gharANiAM nUM (nabI baNAuNa laI) cuNa liA he|
iha sAre ikka dUje dI nasala viccoM sana allAha sabha kujjha suNadA he (ki kAfira tuhADe nabI hoNa toM inakAra karade hana) ate jANadA he (ki uha kevala IrakhA kArana hI ajihA karade hana)|

(allAha usa vele vI suNadA sI) jadoM imarAna dI patanI Akha rahI sI ki he mere rabba! mere garabha vica jo (bAla) he, maiM usa nUM tere nAM ’te vakafa karana dI sukkha sukkhI he, tUM isa nUM kabUla kara lai| bezakka tUM hI suNana vAlA ate (mana dI) hAlata nUM jANana vAlA he|

jadoM usa (imarAna dI patanI ne) dhI nUM janama dittA tAM kahiNa laggI ki he pAlaNahAra! mai tAM dhI janamI he| allAha nUM sabha patA sI jo usa ne jaNiA sI (ate kihA ki) puttara dhI jihA nahIM huMdA| maiM isa dA nAM marIama [2] rakkhiA he| bezakka maiM isa nUM ate isa dI AuNa vAlI pIr3hI nUM zaitAna maradUda toM bacaNa laI terI zarana vica diMdI hAM|
translations.footnotes: [2] marIama dA sahI aratha he allAha dI baMdI ate usa dI sevAdAra he|

translations.translation: usa (lar3akI) nUM usa de pAlaNahAra ne qhuzI nAla kabUla kara liA ate caMgI tarhAM usa dA pAlaNa-pozaNa kItA ate usa dA saraprasata z2akarIA nUM baNAiA| jadoM kade z2akarIA usa de kamare vica jAMdA tAM usa de kola khANa pINa dIAM cIz2AM vekhadA| uha pucchadA ki he marIama! iha roz2I tere kola kithoM AuMdI he, uha javAba diMdI ki iha rabba valloM AuMdI hee| bezakka allAha jisa nUM cAhe behisAba roz2I diMdA he|
use thAM z2akarIA ne ApaNe rabba toM duA kItI ki he mere pAlaNahAra! mainUM ApaNe valloM neka aulAda dI baqhaziza kara, bezakka tUM hI duAvAM nUM suNana vAlA he|

jadoM uha (z2akarIA) kamare vica khar3hA namAz2a par3ha rihA sI tAM pharizatiAM ne usa nUM AvAz2a dittI ki allAha tuhAnUM yAhIyA (nAM de puttara) dI qhuzaqhabarI diMdA he jo allAha de kalame (IsA) dI puzaTI karegA, usa vica saradArI hovegI, saMpUrana saMjama hovegA, ate neka lokAM viccoM hovegA|

z2akarIA (jo ki rabba dA ika nabI sI) rurAna ho ke AkhaNa laggA ki he mere rabba! mere ghara baccA kiveM paidA hovegA? maiM tAM bahuta biradha ho giA hAM ate merI patanI vI bAMjha he? tAM farizate ne kihA ki allAha jo cAhuMdA he karadA he|

z2akarIA ne benatI kItI ki he mere rabbA mere laI koI nizAnI niyata kara de| allAha ne kihA ki tUM tiMna dinAM taka lokAM nAla galla bAta nahIM kareMgA kevala izAriAM nAla hI (ApaNI galla lokAM nUM) samajhAveMgA| tUM ApaNe rabba dA nAM vaddha toM vaddha yAda kara ate savere zAma (bhAva hara vele) usa dI hI tasabIha kara|
jadoM farizatiAM ne kihA ki he marIama! allAha ne tainUM vaDiAI te pavittaratA baqhazI he ate sArI dunIAM dIAM auratAM viccoM ApaNI sevA laI terI coNa kItI he|
he marIama! tUM ApaNe rabba dI AgiAkArI baNa ke rahi ate use nUM sijadA kara ate use de agge jhukaNa vAliAM nAla milake jhukadI rahi|

(he nabI!) iha sArIAM g2aiba dIAM qhabarAM hana jinhAM nUM asIM vahI duArA tuhAnUM dassa rahe hAM| tusIM usa sameM uhanAM de kola maujUda nahIM sI jadoM ki uha (rukala de sevAdAra) iha faisalA karana laI ApaNIAM kalamAM suTTa rahe sI ki marIama dA vAlI-vArisa kauNa hovegA ate nA hI tusIM usa sameM hAz2ara sI jadoM uha Apasa vica jhagar3a rahe sana|

jadoM farizatiAM ne kihA ki he marIama! allAha tainUM ApaNe ika kalame (bhAva bacce dI) qhuzaqhabarI diMdA he jisa dA nAM masIha IsA bina marIama hovegA jo dunIAM ate Aqhirata vica iz2z2ata vAlA hovegA ate allAha de ner3ale baMdiAM viccoM hovegA|
uha (baccA) ApaNe paMghUr3e vica vI ate vaDDI umara vica vI lokAM nAla gallAM karegA [3] ate uha neka lokAM viccoM hovegA|
translations.footnotes: [3] nabI karIma sa: dA faramAna he ki banI isarAIla viccoM mAM dI kukkha vica kevala tiMna bacciAM ne gallAM kItIAM (1) haz2arata IsA, banI isarAIla dA jarIja nAM dA ika viakatI jadoM uha namAz2a par3ha rihA sI tAM usa dI mAM ne usa nUM bulAiA tAM usa ne mana vica sociA ki maiM ApaNI mAM dA javAba davAM jAM namAz2a pUrI karAM usa ne namAz2a jArI rakkhI ate mAM nUM uttara nahIM dittA tAM usa dI mAM ne usa nUM badda-duA dittI ki he allAha! jadoM tIka uha kise badakAra auaurata dA mUMha nA vekha lave usa nUM mauta nA daIM| ika dina jarIja ApaNe ibAdataqhAne vica sI ki badakAra auaurata ne usa nUM badakArI laI bulAiA para jarIja ne inakAra kara dittA uha auaurata ika caravAhe kola gaI ate usa toM bhair3A kaMma karavAiA jisa toM ika baccA paidA hoiA lokAM de pucchaNa ’te auaurata ne kihA ki iha jarIja dA puttara he loka iha suNa ke jarIja nUM gAlAM deNa lagga pae usa dA ibAdaqhAnA tor3a dittA isa musIbata de sameM jarIja ne vaz2U kItA ate namAz2a adA kItI ate bacce nUM Ake pucchiA ki × terA bApa kauNa he baccA boliA ki phalAM caravAhA he tAM loka zaramiMdA hoe ate kihA ki asIM terI ibAdatagAha nUM sone dI baNAvAMge tAM jarIja ne kihA ki nahIM basa miTTI dI hI hove| tIjA uha baccA jisa nUM ika z2anAnI apaNA duddha pilA rahI sI ki ika sohaNA manukkha savAra laMghiA, z2anAnI ne usa nUM vekha ke duA kItI ki he mere allAha! mere puttara nUM vI ajihA baNA de| bacce ne duddha pINA chaDDa ke savAra valla vekhiA ate kihA ki he allAha! mainUM ajihA nA baNAuNA ate phera duddha pINa lagga piA| iha kissA dassaNa vAle haz2arata abU-hurairA biAna karade hana ki Apa sa: ne usa bacce vAMga ApaNIAM uMgalIAM cUsa ke vikhAIAM phera usa z2anAnI kola toM ika golI (g2ulAma auaurata) dA guz2ara hoiA jisa nUM lokI mAra kuTa rahe sI tAM mAM ne duA kItI ki he allAha! mere puttara nUM ajihA nA baNAuNA| bacce ne phera usa dI chAtI toM mUMha parAM karade hoe kihA ki he allAha! mainUM ajihA hI baNAuNA tAM mAM ne rurAnI nAla pucchiA ki ajihA kio?ki tUM usa savAra dI thAM isa z2alIla auaurata vAMga baNanA pasaMda karadA he tAM bacce ne javAba vica kihA ki uha savAra tAM z2AlamAM viccoM ika vaDDA z2Alama sI ate iha golI becArI niradoza he lokI isa ’te alaz2Ama lA rahe hana ki taiM corI kItI he ate z2anA kItA he jada ki usa ne kujjha vI nahIM sI kItA| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 3436)

translations.translation: (marIama rurAna hoke) kahiNa laggI ki he mere rabbA! mere puttara kiveM hovegA? jadda ki mainUM kise puraza ne hattha vI nahIM lAiA| farizate ne kihA, allAha jo vI cAhe paidA karadA he, jadoM uha kise kaMma nUM karanA cAhuMdA he tAM kevala iho kahiMdA he ki “ho jA” ate uha ho jAMdA he|
allAha usa nUM kitAba te DUMghI sUjha-bUjha dI sikkhiA ate tauraita te iMjIla dA giAna baqhazegA|

ate usa nUM banI isarAIla valla rasUla baNAke bhejegA ate (uha) AkhegA ki maiM tuhADe kola tuhADe rabba dIAM nizAnIAM liAiA hAM| maiM tuhADe sAmhaNe paMchI dI zakala vAMga miTTI dI ika mUrata baNAuMdA hAM phera usa vica ika phUMka mAradA hAM tAM allAha de hukama nAla uha (asalI) paMchI baNa jAMdA he ate maiM allAha de hukama nAla jamAMdarU annhe te kor3hI nUM caMgA bhalA kara diMdA hAM ate murade nUM jiuMdA karadA hAM ate jo kujjha tusIM khAMde ho ate jo tusIM ApaNe gharAM vica bhaMDAra karake rakhade ho maiM tuhA` uha sabha dassadA hAM| isa vica tuhADe laI vadhere nizAnIAM hana, je tusIM ImAna vAle ho|

maiM usa dI puzaTI karadA hAM jihar3I tauraita methoM pahilAM (nAz2ila hoI) he| (maiM isa laI AiA hAM ki) tuhADe laI uha cIz2AM halAla kara devAM jihar3IAM tuhADe laI harAma kara dittIAM gaIAM sana| maiM tuhADe kola tuhADe rabba valloM nizAnIAM laike AiA hAM, isa laI tusIM allAha toM Daro ate merI pairavI karo|
bezakka merA te tuhADA pAlaNahAra (ikko) allAha he tusIM sAre use dI ibAdata karo iho siddhA rAha he|

jadoM IsA ne uhanAM dA inakArI hoNA mahisUsa kara liA tAM kahiNa lagge ki koNa he jo allAha dI rAha vica merI madada karegA? tAM havArIAM (sahAika) ne kihA ki asIM allAha dI rAha vica tuhADe sahAI hAM| asIMM allAha ’te ImAna liAe hAM ate tusIM gavAha rahIo ki asIM AgiAkArI hAM|
he mAlika! asIM tere valoM utArI hoI (iMjIla) ’te ImAna liAe hAM ate tere rasUla dI pairavI kItI he so huNa tUM sADA nAM gavAhI deNa vAliAM vica likha lai|
jadoM uhanAM (banI isarAIla) ne (masIha viruddha) cAlAM callIAM tAM allAha ne vI (ApaNIAM) cAlAM callIAM, allAha sabha toM vadhIA (qhuphiA) cAlAM callaNa vAlA he|

(gupata cAla vajoM) jadoM allAha ne kihA ki he IsA! maiM tainUM sahI salAmata (ihanAM toM) vApasa lai lavAMgA te ApaNe valla (bhAva akAzAM ’te) cukka lavAMgA [4]ate ihanAM (kAfarAM) toM tainUM pAka karAMgA ate jinhAM lokAM ne terI pairavI kItI he uhanAM `nUM kiAmata taka kAfarAM ’te bhArU rakkhAMgA| phera tusAM sabha ne mere valla hI parata ke AuNA he| phera maiM tuhADe vicakAra uhanAM gallAM dA nipaTArA kara devAMgA jinhAM bAre tusIM matabheda karade sI|
translations.footnotes:
[4] isa Aita vica haz2arata IsA nUM jiuMdA jI akAza valla uThAuNa dA z2ikara kItA giA he| hadIsa toM siddha huMdA he ki kiAmata de ner3e Apa nUM akAza toM mur3a dharatI ’te utAriA jAvegA| ika hadIsa vica nabI karIma sa: ne faramAiA ki usa allAha dI kasama jisa de hattha vica merI jAna he uha samAM ner3e hI he jadoM marIama dA puttara IsA tuhADe lokAM vicakAra ika inasAfa pasaMda hAkama baNa ke utaregA uha salIba nUM tor3egA, sUra dA aMta karegA, jaz2IA laiNA muAfa karegA ki uMja usa de kola inAM mAla hovegA ki usa nUM kabUla karana vAlA koI nahIM hovegA ate ika sijadA dunIAM dIAM sArIAM cIz2AM toM vaddha kImatI hovegA| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 3448)
* ika hadIsa vica Apa sa: ne faramAiA ki usa sameM tuhADA kI hAla hovegA jadoM marIama dA puttara IsA tuhADe vicakAra utAre jANage ate tuhADA AgU tuhADI kauma viccoM hI hovegA? (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 3449)

translations.translation: jinhAM lokAM ne kufara kItA uhanAM kAfirAM nUM tAM maiM dunIAM vica vI ate Aqhirata vica vI saqhata saz2A devAMgA ate uhanAM dA koI vI sahAI nahIM hovegA|
praMtU ImAna liAuNa vAliAM nUM ate neka karama karana vAliAM nUM allAha pUrA-pUrA badalA devegA| allAha z2AlamAM nUM pasaMda nahIM karadA|
(he nabI!) iha jo asIM tainUM par3ha ke suNA rahe hAM iha dAnAI te nasIhatAM vAlIAM AitAM hana|
bezakka allAha dI naz2ara vica IsA dI misAla Adama vAMga he| allAha ne usa nUM miTTI toM sAjiA ate hukama dittA “ki ho jA” basa uha ho giA|
tere rabba valloM iho saccAI he, (qhabaradAra) zakka karana vAle lokAM vica zAmila nA ho jANA|

he nabI! isa jANakArI mila jANa toM bAada vI je koI IsA de saMbaMdha vica tuhADe nAla koI vAda vivAda kare tAM tusIMM usa nUM Akha dio ki Ao asIM te tusIM Apo ApaNe putarhAM nUM, ApaNIAM auratAM nUM bulAIe ate Apa qhuda vI AIe phera asIM milake duA karIe ki jhUThIAM ’te allAha dI lAanata hove|
hakIkata ihIo he ki iha sArIAM saccIAM gallAM hana ate chuTTa allAha toM hora koI izaTa nahIM ate bezakka allAha hI zakatIzAlI ate dAnAI vAlA he|
phera vI je uha (ihanAM gallAM nUM) nahIM kabUlade tAM allAha vI ihanAM fasAdIAM nUM caMgI tarhAM jANadA he|

(he nabI!) tusIM kahi dio ki he kitAba vAlio! Ao ika ajihI galla valla jihar3I tuhADe te sADe vicAle sAMjhI he ki asIM allAha toM chuTTa kise hora dI ibAdata nA karIe, nA usa dA kise nUM zarIka baNAIe ate nA allAha nUM chaDDa ke kise nUM ApaNA rabba baNAIe (bhAva rabba de AgiAkArI hAM) phera vI je uha mUMha mor3ade hana tAM tusIM Akha dio ki gavAha raho ki asIM tAM musalamAna (AgiAkArI) hAM| [5]
translations.footnotes: [5] isa Aita ’te amala karade hoe nabI (sa) ne IsAI hAkamAM nUM pattarhAM duArA isalAma kabUla karana dI dAavata dittI jiveM ki hadIsa vica he (haz2arata abbAsa ra:a:) jANakArI diMde hana ki abU-sufiAna ne mere sAhamaNe kihA usa sameM jadoM mere ate nabI karIma sa: de vicAle sulAha (hudaibIA) sI maiM zAma vica sI ki patA calliA ki harakala (rUsI bAdazAha) nUM nabI (sa:) dA ika pattara AiA he ate iha pattara haz2arata dahIyA kalabI lai ke Ae sI uhanAM ne isa pattara nUM basarA de hAkama de havAle kara dittA tAM usa nUM agge rUsa de bAdazAha nUM ghalla dittA abU-sufiAna (ra:a:) kahiMde hana ki harakala ne mainUM bulA ke kujjha savAla karake nabI karIma sa: dI nabuvvata ate dUje hAlAta de saMbaMdha vica jANakArI laI jisa toM uha bahuta prabhAvita hoiA| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 4553)

translations.translation: he kitAba vAlio! tusIM ibarAhIma de dharama bAre kiuM jhagar3ade ho? tauraita te iMjIla tAM uhanAM de magaroM hI nAz2ala hoIAM sana| kI tusIM iMnI galla vI nahIM samajhade?

suNo! tusIM loka usa galla vica tAM bahuta vAda vivAda kara cukke ho jisa dA tuhADe kola giAna sI (ki ibarAhIma mUsA IsA toM pahilAM sana) huNa tusIM isa galla vica kiuM jhagar3ade ho jisa dA tuhAnUM giAna hI nahIM (ki ibarAhIma dA dharama kI sI) allAha hI jANadA he tusIM nahIM jANade|
ibarAhIma nA yahUdI sI ate nA hI IsAI sagoM uha tAM hakka sacca dA pujArI sI, uha ziraka karana vAliAM viccoM nahIM sI|
sabha lokAM toM vaddha ibarAhIma nAla ner3alA saMbaMdha uhanAM dA he jinhAM ne usa dI pairavI kItI ate iha nabI ate ImAna vAle hana ate allAha ImAna vAlIAM dA dosata he|
(he! ImAna vAlio) kitAba vAliAM viccoM ika dhar3A tuhAnUM kurAhe pAuNA cAhuMdA he jada ki uha ApaNe Apa nUM hI kurAhe pA rahe hana ate isa galla nUM uha samajhade vI nahIM|
he kitAba vAlio! tusIM allAha dIAM AitAM dA inakAra kiuM kara rahe ho? jada ki tusIM Apa ihanAM de sacca hoNa de gavAha ho|
he kitAba vAlio! tusIM sacca ate jhUTha nUM kiuM gaDDa maDDa kara rahe ho? tusIM jANa bujha ke hakka sacca nUM kiuM lukA rahe ho?

kitAba vAliAM viccoM ika dhar3e ne (ApaNe lokAM nUM) kihA ki jo kuccha vI musalamAnAM utte (bhAva.kuraAna) utAriA giA he, tusIM usa ’te savere ImAna liAo ate zAma nUM usa toM inakAra kara dio| tAM jo iha loka vI ImAna toM phira jANa|

tusIM ApaNe dIna (yahUdI) ’te callaNa vAliAM dA hI vizavAsa karo| (he nabI!) tusIM Akha dio ki hidAita tAM iho he jihar3I allAha valloM he| (kitAba vAle) iha vI kahiMde hana (ki isa galla ’te vI yakIna nA karo) ki kise hora nUM vI uha cIz2a dittI jA sakadI he jihar3I tuhAnUM dittI gaI he jAM jisa rAhIM iha tuhADe rabba kola jA ke tuhADe viruddha koI dalIla peza kara sakaNa he nabI! tusIM kahi dio ki faz2ala tAM sAre hI allAha de hattha vica hana|[6] uha jisa nUM jo cAhuMdA he baqhaza diMdA he| allAha baqhazaNa vica bahuta khullhA he ate hara tarhAM dA giAna rakkhaNa vAlA he|
translations.footnotes: [6].kuraAna majIda vica allAha taAlA dIAM jinhAM sifatAM dI galla kItI gaI he jiveM mUMha, akkhAM hattha, piMDalI usa dA vikhAI deNa vAle AsAmAna ’te AuNA ate araza ’te barAjamAna hoNA Adi bhAva jo vI allAha ne ApaNe saMbaMdha vica dassiA he ate jo hadIsAM vica he uhanAM sabha te ahale suMnata dA ika matta hoNA he ki uha allAha taAlA dIAM ihanAM sifatAM te qhUbIAM utte binAM kise dalIla ImAna liAuMde hana| iha uha qhUbIAM hana jihar3IAM kevala allAha laI qhAsa hana ate ihanAM nUM kise viakatI dIAM qhUbIAM nAla nahIM jor3hiA jA sakadA jiveM allAha ne kuraAna pAka vica faramAiA he ki usa jahi koI cIz2a nahIM (sUrata zUrA Aita11) ate sUrata iqhalAsa vica he ki usa jihA hora koI vI nahIM|

translations.translation: uha (allAha) ApaNIAM miharAM laI jisa nUM cAhuMdA he vizeza kara laiMdA he| allAha vaDDe faz2alAM vAlA he|

kitAba vAliAM viccoM kujjha (yahUdI) ajihe vI hana ki je tusIM uhanAM nUM mAla daulata dA ika Dhera vI (amAnata vajoM) saMbhAla dio tAM vI uha tuhAnUM mur3a adA kara deNage para uhanAM viccoM kujjha ajihe vI hana ki je tusIM uhanAM kola ika dInAra vI amAnata vajoM rakkha dio tAM vI adA nahIMM karanage, hAM iha galla hora he ki tusIM (ApaNI amAnata laiNa laI) uhanAM de sira ’te hI savAra ho jAo| uha iha vatIrA isa laI karade hana ki uha Akhade hana ki sADe utte ihanAM ummIAM (g2aira yahUdI) dA hakka mArana ’te koI gunAha nahIM| uha (yahUdI) loka sabha kujjha jANade hoe vI allAha de sira jhUTha mar3hade hana|
hAM (amAnatAM bAre) puccha gicha z2arUra hovegI| jo vI ApaNe bacanAM nUM pUrA karegA ate allAha toM DaregA tAM bezakka allAha vI burAIAM toM bacaNa vAliAM nUM pasaMda karadA he|

bezakka jo loka allAha de nAla kIte bacanAM nUM ate ApaNIAM sahuMAM nUM ghaTTa mulla ’te (bhAva saMsArika lAbha laI) veca suTade hana uhanAM dA Aqhirata vica kujjha vI hissA nahIM| kiAmata vAle dina allAha nA uhanAM nAla galla karegA, nA hI uhanAM valla vekhegA ate nA hI uhanAM nUM pAka (bhAva muAfa) karegA| uhanAM laI tAM bar3A hI dukhadAI az2Aba he|

uhanAM vica ika TolA kitAba par3hade hoe isa tarhAM z2abAna nUM vala diMdA he ki tusIM use nUM hI kitAba dA hissA samajho, jadda ki uha kitAba viccoM nahIM huMdA ate iha vI kahiMde hana ki iha allAha valloM hI he, jadda ki iha allAha valloM nahIM, uha tAM jANade bujhade hoe allAha de sira jhUTha mar3hade hana|

kise vI ajihe viakatI nUM jisa nUM allAha hikamata ate paig2aMbarI baqhaze usa laI iha ucita nahIM ki phera vI uha lokAM nUM Akhe ki tusIM allAha nUM chaDDa ke mere g2ulAma baNa jAo, sagoM uha tAM iho kahiNage ki tusIM sAre rabba de g2ulAma baNa jAo jiveM ki uha kitAba tuhAnUM iho sikkhiA diMdI he jisa nUM tusIM par3hade ho|
uha tuhAnUM iha vI nahIM AkhegA ki farizatiAM ate nabIAM nUM ApaNA rabba baNA lao|[7] kI uha nabI tuhAnUM kufara karana dA hukama devegA, jada ki tusIM musalamAna ho?
translations.footnotes: [7] bhAva paig2aMbara lokAM nUM kevala allAha valla hI bulAuMde hana ise laI ApaNI prazaMsA vica vAdhU gallAM kahiNa toM rokade hana tAM jo lokIM uhanAM nUM vI rabbI sifatAM vica sAMjhI nA samajha laiNa| nabI karIma sa: ne faramAiA ki merI prazaMsA inI nA karo jiveM IsAIAM ne marIama de puttara IsA dI kItI sI maiM tAM basa allAha dA baMdA hAM tAM tusIM iha kaho ki allAha dA baMdA ate usa dA rasUla| (sahI bukhArI, hadIsa: 3445)

translations.translation: uha velA yAda karo jadoM allAha ne sAre nabIAM toM iha bacana liA sI ki jadoM maiM tuhAnUM kitAba ate dAnAI nAla navAz2AM ate phera tuhADe kola koI rasUla Ave jihar3hA isa kitAba dI puzaTI karadA hove jihar3I tuhADe kola he tAM tuhAnUM usa ’te ImAna liAuNA hovegA te usa dI madada karanI hovegI| allAha ne faramAiA, kI tusIM ikarAra karade ho ate isa utte mere valloM vacana dI z2iMmevArI cukkade ho? uhanAM ne kihA ki hAM! asIM ikarAra karade hAM| allAha ne faramAiA, ki tusIM gavAha rahiNA ate maiM vI tuhADe (ikarAra) dI gavAhI diMdA hAM|
huNa isa picchoM jihar3A vI (ApaNe ikarAra toM) phira jAve uhIo nA-faramAna he|

kI uha loka allAha de dIna nUM chaDDa ke kise hora dIna dI bhAla vica hana jadoM ki sAre hI dharatI vAle te akAzAM vAle cAhuMdiAM ate nA cAhuMdiAM vI allAha de tAbedAra hana| sabha nUM use valla hI parata ke jANA he|

(he nabI!) tusIM Akha dio ki asIM allAha ’te ate usa ’te vI, jo sADe ’te nAz2ila (.kuraAna) kItA giA, ImAna liAe hAM ate jo ibarAhIma isamAIla, isahAka, yAkUba ate uhanAM dI aulAda ’te utAriA ate uhanAM kitAbAM ’te vI jihar3IAM mUsA, IsA, ate dUje nabIAM nUM uhanAM de rabba valloM dittIAM gaIAM uhanAM sabha ’te vI (ImAna liAe hAM)| asIM ihanAM vicAle koI vI vitakarA nahIM karade, asIM tAM allAha de faramAbaradAra hAM|
jo vI viakatI isalAma dharama nUM chaDDa kise hora dharama dI pairavI karegA,[8] usa de dharama nUM kabUliA nahIM jAvegA ate uha Aqhirata dihAr3e ghATe vica rahege|
translations.footnotes: [8] isa toM patA laggadA he ki nabI karIma sa: dI rasAlata ’te ImAna liAuNa pharaz2a he ApajI ne faramAiA usa allAha dI kasama jisa de hattha vica muhaMmada dI jAna he isa ummata de yahUdI te IsAIAM viccoM jihar3A vI mere bAre suNe ate phera vI mere liAe hoe sunehe ’te ImAna liAe binAM mara jAve tAM uha sadA laI naraka vica rahegA| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 153)

translations.translation: allAha uhanAM lokAM nUM kiveM hidAita devegA jihar3e ImAna liAuNa toM magaroM mur3a kAfira ho gae jada ki uha gavAhI de cukke hana ki bezakka rasUla (sa:) hakka ’te hana ate uhanAM kola (nabI hoNa dIAM) khallIAM nizAnIAM A cukkIAM hana| allAha z2AlamAM nUM siddhI rAha nahIM pAiA karadA|
uhanAM dI saz2A tAM iho he ki uhanAM ’te allAha dI, farizatiAM dI ate sAre lokAM valloM fiTakAra he|
iha loka (isa hAlata vica) sadA laI rahiNage, nA tAM uhanAM dI saz2A ghaTAI jAvegI ate nA hI uhanAM nUM mohalata dittI jAvegI|
para jihar3e loka isa (inakAra) toM bAada taubA karake ApaNA sudhAra kara laiNa (uhI saz2A toM baca sakaNage) bezakka allAha baqhazaNahAra ate miharAM karana vAlA he|
bezakka jihar3e loka ImAna liAuNa toM bAada inakAra karana ate inakAra vica vadhade hI cale gae uhanAM dI taubA kade vI kabUla nahIM kItI jAvegI iho bhaTake hoe loka hana|

jihar3e lokAM ne inakAra kItA ate inakAra dI hAlata vica hI mara jANa uhanAM viccoM je koI (kiAmata de dina) ApaNe Apa nUM naraka toM bacAuNa laI badale vica dharatI jinnA sonAM vI deve tAM vI kabUliA nahIM jAvegA|[9] iha uha loka hana jinhAM laI daradanAka az2Aba he ate jinhAM dA koI sahAI nahIM hovegA|
translations.footnotes: [9] nabI karIma sa: ne faramAiA kiAmata de dina kAfarAM nUM jadoM liAiA jAvegA tAM kihA jAvegA bhalAM dassa tAM sahI ki je tere kola isa sameM dharatI jinnA sonA hove tAM kI tUM ApaNe Apa nUM naraka dI agga toM bacAuNa laI badale vica de devegA? tAM uha AkhegA hAM tAM fera usa nUM kihA jAvegA ki dunIAM vica isa toM AsAna galla kevala isalAma kabUla karana laI kihA giA sI para tuhADe ’te be-bhAgI bhArU A gaI ate tusIM inakAra kara dittA| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 6538)

translations.translation: jadoM taka tusIM ApaNI pasaMda dIAM vasatUAM nUM allAha dI rAha vica qharaca nahIM karoge tusIM kade vI bhalAI (nekI) nahIM pA sakoge ate jo vI tusIM qharaca karoge allAha usa nUM bhalI-bhAMta jANadA he|

banI isarAIla laI khANa vAlIAM sArIAM cIz2AM halAla sana, chuTTa uhanAM cIz2A toM jinhAM nUM tauraita nAz2ala hoNa to pahilAM yAkUba ne ApaNe utte harAma kara liA sI| (he mahummada!) tusIM Akha dio ki je tusIM sacce ho tAM tauraita lai Ao ate (usa nUM) par3ho|
isa (dalIla) toM picchoM vI jihar3e loka allAha utte jhUTThIAM gallAM jor3ade hana uhIo asala z2Alama hana|
(he nabI!) Akha dio ki allAha dA faramAna saccA he, so tusIM sAre ibarAhIma de tarIke dI pairavI karo jihar3A ki hakka dA pujArI sI ate muzarakIna [10] viccoM nahIM sI|
translations.footnotes: [10] muzarakIna toM bhAva uha loka jihar3e allAha de nAla kise dUje nUM usa dIAM qhUbIAM te zakatIAM vica zarIka karade hana|

translations.translation: allAha dA pahilA ghara jo lokAM (dI ibAdata) laI mukarrara kItA giA he uhIo he jihar3A (zahira) makkA vikhe he| uha sArI dunIAM laI barakatAM te hidAita vAlI thAM he|

usa vica khullhIAM nizAnIAM hana mukAme ibarAhIma he, jihar3A itthe jAvegA amana vica A jAMdA he| allAha ne uhanAM lokA laI jo isa valla safara kara sakade hana isa ghara dA hajja karanA faraz2a kara dittA he| jihar3A (hajja dA) inakAra kare tAM allAha sArI dunIAM toM beparavhA he|

(he nabI!)tusIM Akha dio ki he kitAba vAlio! tusIM allAha dIAM AitAM (AdezAM) nAla kiuM kufara (inakAra) karade ho| jo kujjha vI tusIM karade ho allAha usa ’te gavAha he (bhAva) uha sabha kujjha jANadA he|

ihanAM kitAba vAliAM nUM Akha dio ki tusIM allAha de rasate ’te callaNa toM mominAM nUM kiuM rokade ho| tusIM cAhuMde ho ki uha viMge TeDhe rasatiAM ’te hI turade rahiNa jadoM ki tusIM Apa usa dI siddhI rAha hoNa utte gavAha ho| allAha tuhADe amalAM toM beqhabara nahIM he|
he ImAna vAlio! jekara tusIM kitAba vAliAM (IsAI jAM yahUdIAM) viccoM kise ika Tole dI galla maMna laI tAM uha tuhAnUM tuhADe ImAna liAuNa magaroM phera (kufara valla) mor3a lai jANage|

tusIM kiveM kufara valla jA sakade ho jadoM ki tuhAnUM allAha dIAM AitAM par3ha ke suNAIAM jAMdIAM hana ate tuhADe vicAle usa dA rasUla (mahaMmada) maujUda he? jihar3A viakatI allAha de dIna (isalAma) nUM drir3atA nAla phar3a lave (bhAva amala kare) usa nUM siddhI rAha jANa vAlI hidAita mila jAMdI he|
he ImAna vAlio! allAha toM Daro jihA ki usa toM DaranA cAhIdA he ate vekho marade dama taka musalamAna hI rahiNA|
