allAha dI rassI (.kuraAna) nUM sAre milake drir3hatA nAla phar3a lao ate (ApaNe vicAle) phuTa nA pAou [11] ate allAha de usa ahisAna nUM cete rakkho jadoM tusIM ika dUje de duzamana sI tAM use ne tuhADe dilAM vica ika dUje laI muhabbata pAI sI ate tusIM use dIAM miharAM sadake hI bharA-bharA baNa gae, tusIM (gumarAhI kArana) agga nAla bhare hoe Toe de kaMDhe tIka pahuMca cukke ki usane tuhAnUM usa vica DigaNa toM bacA liA| allAha ise prakAra ApaNIAM nizAnIAM pragaTa karadA he tAM jo tusIM hidAita vAle baNa jAo|
translations.footnotes: [11] isa Aita duArA musalamAnAM nUM dhar3he baMdI toM rokiA giA he para isade ulaTa mulamAnAM vica iha dhar3hA baMdI qhatama hoNa dI thAM vadhadI hI jAMdI he, nabI (sa:) ne isa saMbaMdha vica bhavikkha bAre dassade hoe musalamAnAM nUM ihanAM fitaniAM toM qhabaradAra karade hoe faramAiA ki yahUdI te IsAI 72 dhar3hiAM vica vaMDe jANage ate iha sAre dhar3e narakI hoNage chuTTa ika dhira toM pucchiA ki uha dhira kihar3I hovegI? Apa sa: ne faramAiA iha uha he jihar3A mere ate mere sahAbAM de tarIke toM bhAva kuraAna te suMnata ’te amala karadA hovegA| (sahI tiramaz2I, hadIsa: 2641; sahI ibane mAjaha, hadIsa: 3992-3993)

translations.translation: tuhADe viccoM ika garoha tAM z2arUra hI ajihA hoNA cAhIdA he jo (lokAM nUM) bhalAI valla bulAve ate neka kaMma karana dA hukama deve ate bure kaMmAM toM roke, iho loka safalatA prApata karanageM (bhAva savaragAM vica jANage)|

tusIM uhanAM lokAM vAMga nA ho jANA jihar3e firakiAM (dhar3hiAM) vica vaMDe gae ate uhanAM kola khullhIAM nizAnIAM AuNa toM bAada vI uhanAM ne ika dUje nAla madabheda kIte| ajihe lokAM laI karar3hA az2Aba he|

jisa dina (kiAmata dihAr3e) kaI lokAM de cihare safaida camakade hoNage ate kaI lokAM de cihare kAle hoNage| (kAle mUMha vAliAM nUM kihA jAvegA) kI tusIM ImAna liAuNa magaroM vI inakAra karade rahe? huNa tusIM ApaNe inakAra karana dI saz2A bhugato|
rozana mukhar3hiAM vAle allAha dI rahimata vica dAqhila hoNage ate uha utthe (savaragAM) vica sadA rahiNage|
he nabI (sa:)! iha allAha dIAM AitAM hana jo asIM tuhAnUM ThIka-ThIka suNA rahe hAM| allAha jahAna vAliAM ’te z2ulama karanA nahIM cAhuMdA|
jo kujjha dharatI te akAza vica he sabha dA mAlika allAha hI he ate sAre mAmale allAha valla hI phere jANage|

(he musalamAno!) tusIM hI sabha toM vadhIA ummata [12] (samudAi) ho jihar3I lokAM dI bhalAI laI paidA kItI gaI he kiuM jo tusIM nekI dA hukama diMde ho burAIAM toM rokade ho (isa de nAla hI) allAha ’te ImAna rakkhade ho| jekara kitAba vAle (yahUdI te IsAI) vI ImAna liAuMde tAM uhanAM laI vadhIA galla sI, ihanAM (kitAba vAliAM) vica kujjha ImAna vAle vI hana para bahute loka nA-faramAna hana|
translations.footnotes: [12] haz2arata abU-hurairA ra:a: isa Aita dI viAkhiA vica kahiMde hana ki sabha toM vadhIA uha loka hana jihar3e lokAM laI vadhIA hoNa tusIM uhanAM nUM z2aMjIrAM vico kaidI baNA ke liAuMde ho ate uha isalAma vica dAqhila ho jAMde hana isa tarhAM tusIM uhanAM nUM naraka dI sadIvIM agga toM bacA ke jaMnata vica dAqhila hoNa vAle baNa jAMde ho| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 4557)

translations.translation: (he muhaMmada sa:!) iha (kitAba vAle) tuhAnUM taMga karana toM chuTTa hora tuhADA kujjha nahIM vigAr3a sakade| jekara (tuhADe nAla) lar3haNa tAM iha piTTha vikhA ke bhajja jANage ate nA hI ihanAM dI kise pAsio sahAitA kItI jAvegI|

hara thAM ’te uhanAM nUM apamAna dI mAra sahiNI paI iha vakkharI galla he ki kite allAha de nAM ’te jAM lokAM dI zarana vica A ke baca jANa| iha (kitAba vAle) tAM allAha valloM az2Aba (saz2A) de hakkadAra ho gae hana isa laI ihanAM utte muthAjapuNA te adhInagI mar3ha dittI gaI he, isa dA kArana iha he ki iha lokI allAha dIAM AitAM dA inakAra karade sana ate nabIAM nUM nA-hakkA katala karade sana isa laI iha saz2A uhanAM dIAM nApharamAnIAM te vadhIkIAM dA badalA he|

iha sAre hI ikko-jihe nahIM hana sagoM ihanAM kitAba vAliAM (yahUdIAM) viccoM ika garoha ajihA vI he jihar3A hakka ’te khar3haNa vAlA he, uha rAtAM nUM allAha dIAM AitAM (kuraAna) nUM par3hadA he ate (ApaNe pAlaNahAra de agge) sijadA vI karadA he|

iha allAha ate Aqhirata de dina utte ImAna vI rakkhade hana nekIAM dA hukama diMde hana ate burAIAM toM rokade hana ate nekI de kaMmAM vica dUje nAlo agge vadhaNa vica chetI karade hana, iha bhale te neka lokAM viccoM hana|
iha loka jo vI nekI karanage uhanAM dI bekadarI nahIM kItI jAvegI ate allAha burAIAM toM bacaNa vAliAM nUM bhalI-bhAMta jANadA he|
kAfirAM dI daulata ate aulAda allAha kola (az2Aba toM bacAuNa laI) kise kaMma nahIM AvegI, iha loka tAM narakI hana ate sadA utthe rahiNage|

iha kAfira isa saMsAra vica jo qharaca karade hana usa dI misAla tAM usa hanerI vAMga he jisa vica pAlA hove ate uha unhAM dI khetI utte calle, jinhAM ne ApaNIAM jAnAM ’te Apa z2ulama kItA he, usa dA satiAnAza kara deve| allAha ne ihanAM ’te z2ulama nahIM kItA sagoM ihanAM kAfirAM ne tAM ApaNe Apa ’te hI z2ulama kItA he|

he ImAna vAlio! tusIM ApaNe (ImAna vAliAM) lokAM toM chuTTa kise hora nUM ApaNA dosata nA baNAo, dUje loka (yahUdI) tuhAnUM barabAda karana vica koI kasara nahIM chaDDade, uha tAM iho cAhuMde hana ki tusIM musIbatAM vica hI ghire raho uhanAM dI duzamanI tAM uhanAM dIAM gallAM toM hI pragaTa ho cakkI he ate jo (IrakhA) uhanAM de manAM vica lukI hoI he uha hora vI vadhake he| asIM tAM tuhAnUM (sAfa-sAfa) hidAitAM de chaDDIAM hana| je tusIM akala vAle ho tAM tusIM uhanAM toM bacake raho|

tusIM tAM uhanAM nAla sabaMdha rakhaNA cAhuMde ho para uha tuhADe nAla prema nahIM karade, tusIM sArIAM akAzI kitAbAM nUM maMnade ho (uha nahIM maMnade phera iha prema kiho jihA he) iha loka (yahUdI) tuhADe sAhamaNe tAM (tuhADe rasUla muhaMmada sa) ate.kuraAna nUM maMnade hana praMtU jadoM ikalle huMde hana tAM karodha vica A ke ApaNe uMgalAM cabbaNa lagga jAMde hana| kahi dio! ki tusIM ApaNe karodha vica Apa hI sar3a maro, allAha dilAM de bhetAM nUM bhalI-bhAMta jANadA he|

je tuhADA (ImAna vAliAM dA) koI bhalA huMdA he tAM uhanAM nUM bhair3A laggadA he je koI bipatA A jAve tAM uha qhuza huMde hana| je tusIM sabara karo ate rabba toM Darade raho tAM uhanAM dA koI vI dAa tuhAnUM nukasAna nahIM pahuMcA sakadA| allAha ne uhanAM dIAM karatUtAM nUM ApaNe ghere vica liA hoiA he|

(he nabI! usa sameM nUM yAda karo) jadoM tusIM savere savere ApaNe gharoM nikale sI ate musalamAnAM nUM ohada dI lar3AI de maidAna vica moraciAM ’te biThA rahe sI| allAha sArIAM gallAM jANadA he ate sabha kujjha suNana vAlA he|

yAda karo! jadoM tuhADe viccoM do TolIAM tAM hiMmata vI hAra cukkIAM sana jaddoM ki allAha uhanAM dA madada karana vAlA maujUda sI| so ImAna vAliAM nUM use allAha dI pAka z2Ata ’te bharosA rakkhaNA cAhIdA he|
badara dI jaMga vica allAha ne usa sameM tuhADI madada kItI sI jadoM ki tusIM bahuta hI kamaz2ora sI| tusIM allAha toM Daro tAM jo tusIM allAha de zukaraguz2Ara baNa sako|
(he nabI! yAda karo) jadoM tusIM ImAna vAliAM nUM kahi rahe sI, kI tuhADe laI iha galla (tassalI laI) batherI nahIM hovegI ki allAha akAzoM tiMna haz2Ara farizate utAra ke tuhADI madada kare?

(kiuM nahIM madada karegA) je tusIM sabara toM kaMma lavo te allAha toM Darade raho ate je vairI tuhADe utte hallA bola deNa tAM tuhADA rabba use sameM tuhADI sahAitA paMja haz2Ara farizatiAM nAla karegA, jihanAM ’te (pachANa laI) vizeza nizAna lagge hoNage|
iha allAha valloM tuhADe laI qhuzaqhabarI he tAM jo isa toM tuhADe manAM nUM tasallI hove| madada tAM allAha valloM hI huMdI he jihar3A DADhA z2orAvara te hikamata vAlA he|
(iha rabbI sahAitA isa laI sI ki) allAha kAfirAM dI ika jamAata nUM mAra mukAve jAM uhanAM nUM z2alIla kara deve ate fera uha sAre nA murAda hoke pichAMha (makke nUM) mur3a jANa|
he muhaMmada (sa:)! tuhADe vassa vica kujjha vI nahIM allAha cAhe tAM uhanAM dI taubA nUM kabUla kara lave jAM az2Aba (saz2A) de deve kiuM jo uha loka z2Alama hana|
akAza te dharatI vica jo kujjha vI he uha sabha allAha dA hI he jisa nUM cAhe usa nUM baqhaza deve cAhe tAM az2Aba (saz2A) de deve| allAha baqhaziza karana vAlA te miharabAna he|
he ImAna vAlio! vadhA car3hA ke sUda nA khAo, allAha toM Daro tAM jo tuhAnUM (naraka dI agga toM) bacAiA jA sake|
ate usa agga toM Daro jihar3I kAfirAM laI tiAra kItI gaI he|[13]
translations.footnotes: [13] allAha de nabI sa: ne faramAiA ki satta barabAda karana vAle gunAhAM toM baco| sahAbAM ne pucchiA ki uha kihar3e gunAha hana tAM Apa (sa:) ne faramAiA ki (1) allAha dA zarIka baNAuNA (2) jAdU karanAM (3) nA hakka katala karanA (4) sUda khANA (5) yatIma dA mAla har3appa kara jANA (6) jihAda vica piTha vikhANA (7) bholI bhAlI pAkIz2A auratAM ’te tuhammata ate alaz2Ama lagAuNA| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 2766)

translations.translation: allAha ate usa de rasUla (muhaMmada) dI AgiA dI pAlaNA karo tAM jo tuhADe ’te rahima kItA jAve|[14]
translations.footnotes: [14] isa toM bhAva isalAma dharama kabUla karana dI preranA kItI jAMdI hee kiuM jo isa toM binAM kiAmata de dina allAha dI rahimata dA hakkadAra nahIM hovegA|

translations.translation: ApaNe rabba dI baqhaziza ate usa savaraga valla nassa ke jAo jisa dA phailAo akAzAM te dharatI de barAbara he, jihar3I rabba toM Darana vAliA laI baNAI gaI he|

jihar3e loka qhuzahAlI jAM maMdahAlI vele rabba dI rAha vica qharaca karade hana, gusse nUM pI jANa vAle hana ate lokAM (dIAM bhullAM) nUM muAfa karana vAle hana ajihe neka lokAM nUM hI allAha pasaMda karadA he | [15]
translations.footnotes:
[15] iha ate isa toM bAada vAlI Aita vica allAha de neka baMdiAM dIAM kujjha vizezatAvAM dI caracA kItI gaI he jiveM ki nabI karIma (sa:) ne faramAiA ki manukkhI sarIra de hara jor3a dA roz2AnA sadakA deNA lAz2amI he je koI kise dI madada kare usa nUM jAnavara ’te savAra karA deve jAM usa dA sAmAna ladavA deve tAM iha sabha sadakA he bhalI galla kahiNA ate namAz2a laI ika-ika kadama jihar3A vI cukkiA jAvegA, iha vI sadakA he ate kise nUM rAha dassaNA vI sadakA he| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 2891)
* hadIsa vica he ki pahilavAna uha nahIM jihar3A kise nUM citta kara deve, sagoM pahilavAna uha he jihar3A gasse dI hAlata vica ApaNe Apa nUM kAbU vica rakkhe| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 6114)

translations.translation: jadoM uhanAM (neka lokAM) toM koI azalIla harakata ho jAMdI he jAM (koI pApa karake) ApaNe utte z2ulama kara baiThade hana tAM (use vele) allAha nUM yAda karade hana ate ApaNe gunAhAM laI khimA cAhuMde hana| hakIkata vica allAha toM chuTTa hora koNa he jihar3A gunAhAM nUM baqhaza sakadA he ate iha neka loka jANade hoe ApaNI karanI utte ar3I nahIM karade|

ajihe (neka) lokAM dA badalA uhanAM de rabba valloM uhanAM dI baqhaziza he ate jaMnatAM de bAg2a hana jihanAM heTha nahirAM vagadIAM hana jihanAM vica uha sadA rahiNage| kiMnA vadhIA badalA he uhanAM neka kaMma karana vAliAM dA|
tuhAthoM pahilAM vI (he nabI!) ajihIAM ghaTanAvAM ho cukkIAM hana, so tusIM dharatI ’te ghuMma firake vekho ki (rabbI faramAna nUUM) jhuThalAuNa vAliAM dA aMta kI hoiA sI|
Ama lokAM laI tAM iha (.kuraAna) kevala ika kitAba he para rabba toM Darana vAliAM laI iha hidAita te nasIhata he|
he ImAna vAlio! tusIM dila nA chaDDo ate nA hI ciMtA karo| je tusIM (sacce) ImAna vAle ho tAM tusIM hI (kAfirAM ’te) bhArU rahoge|

je tuhAnUM (uhada dI jaMga vica) z2aqhama lagge hana tAM ajihe z2aqhama (badara dI jaMga vica) kAfirAM nUM vI lagga cukke hana| asIM (allAha) lokAM vicAle dinAM nUM badalade rahiMde hAM| tuhAnUM iha z2aqhama isa laI lagge sana ki allAha iha vekhaNA cAhuMdA sI ki tuhADe viccoM ImAna vAlA kauNa he? uha (allAha) tuhADe viccoM kujjha nUM zahAdata dI uccI padavI deNA cAhuMdA sI| allAha z2AlamAM nUM pasaMda nahIM karadA|
(iha kArana vI sI) ki allAha ImAna vAliAM nUM pAka sAfa karanA ate kAfirAM nUM qhatama karanA cAhuMdA sI|

(he ImAna vAlio!) kI tusIM iha samajha baiThe ho ki tusIM aiveM hI jaMnata vica cale jAuge? jada ki aje allAha ne iha tAM vekhiA hI nahIM ki tuhADe viccoM rabba dI rAha vica jAna vAra deNa vAle ate sabara karana vAle kauNa hana|
jaMga hoNa toM pahilAM tAM tusIM mauta (zahIda hoNa) dIAM kAmanAvAM karade sI| so huNa tusIM mauta nUM ApaNI akkhIM vekha liA|

muhaMmada(sa:) kevala ika rasUla hI hana, ihanAM toM pahilAM vI bahuta sAre rasUla ho cukke hana| je ihanAM (muhaMmada sa:) dA dihAMta ho jAve jAM iha zahIda ho jANa tAM kI tusIM isalAma toM ApaNe paira picche khicca lavoge? jihar3A (isalAma toM) pichale pairIM phiregA tAM uha allAha dA ukkA hI kujjha nahIM vigAr3a sakegA| allAha (chetI hI hara hAla vica rabba dA) zukara karana vAliAM nUM vadhIA badalA devegA|

allAha dI AgiA toM binAM koI jIva mara nahIM sakadA usa ne (sabha dI) mauta dA samAM likhiA hoiA he| saMsAra dI icchA rakkhaNa vAliAM nUM asIM dunIAM vica hI kujjha de diMde hAM ate jihar3e Aqhirata vica badalA cAhuMde hana tAM uhanAM nUM Aqhirata vica de diMde hAM ate (rabba dA) zukara karana vAliAM nUM asIM caMgA badalA devAMge|

kiMne hI nabI ajihe ho cukke hana jinhAM nAla milake bahuta sAre allAha vAliAM ne jihAda kItA ruai, uhanAM nUM vI allAha dI rAha vica musIbatAM dA sAhamaNA karanAM piA praMtU nA tAM uhanAM ne himmata hI hArI, nA hI kaMmaz2orI vikhAI ate nA hI kAfirAM agge nIveM hoe| allAha (ajihe) sabara karana vAliAM nUM hI pasaMda karadA he|

iha (neka loka) tAM iho kahiMde hana ki he sADe pAlaNahAra! sADe gunAhAM nUM baqhaza de ate sAthoM sADe kaMmAM vica jo tere hukamAM dI ulaMghaNA hoI ru usa nUM vI muAfa karade ate sADe pairAM nUM (jihAda karana vele) jamA de ate kAfirAM de mukAbale sADI madada faramA|
so allAha ne uhanAM lokAM nUM dunIAM vica vI badalA dittA ate Aqhirata vica badalA (isa dunIAM toM) sohaNA baqhazegA| allAha neka lokAM nUM hI ApaNA mitarra baNAuMdA he|
he ImAna vAlio! je tusIM kAfirAM dIAM gallAM maMnoge tAM iha tuhAnUM puTThe phera lai jANage [16] (bhAva tuhAnUM mur3a kAfira baNA deNage) phera tusIM nA murAda ho jAoge|
translations.footnotes:
[16] bhAva jisa thAM ziraka ho rihA hove usa thAM vassaNA nahIM cAhIdA nabI karIma sa: ne faramAiA jihar3A viakatI muzarika de nAla rahegA uha use jihA hI he| (suNana abu dAUda, hadIsa: 2787)
* isa hadIsa toM iha sikkhiA miladI he ki je kise gaira musalima deza vica koI rahiMdA he tAM usa laI z2arUrI he ki dIna dI tabalIga kare|

translations.translation: hakIkata vica allAha hI tuhADA hamAitI he ate uhIo sabha toM vadhIA madada karana vAlA he|

asIM (allAha chetI hI) kAfirAM de manAM vica tuhADA roaba biThAM devAMge isa laI ki iha lokI allAha de nAla uhanAM nUM vI (rabba dI qhudAI vica) zarIka karade hana jisa dI koI vI dalIla rabba valloM nahIM utArI gaI| uhanAM dA TikANA naraka hI he ate iha ihanAM (ziraka karana vAle) z2AlamAM laI bhair3I jaghA he|

he nabI! bezakka allAha ne tuhADe nAla (madada karana dA) kItA hoiA bacana pUrI tarhAM nibhAiA jadoM tusIM (uhada vica) usa de hukama nAla kAfirAM nUM katala kara rahe sI, para jadoM tusIM kaMmaz2orI vikhAI ate ApaNe kaMmAM vica ika dUje nAla matabheda kItA ate jiveM hI allAha ne tuhAnUM (g2anImata de mAla dI jhalaka) vikhAI jisa nAla tusIM muhabbata karade sI tAM tusIM (rasUla dI) nA-faramAnI kItI| iha isa laI ki tuhADe viccoM kujjha loka dunIAM nUM cAhuMde sI ate kujjha Aqhirata de hI ichukka sana| phera allAha ne tuhAnUM kAfirAM de mukAbale vica parAjita kara dittA tAM jo tuhADI az2amAiza kare| phera vI allAha ne tuhADIAM g2alatIAM nUM muAfa kara dittA| allAha ImAna vAliAM ’te bahuta hI vaDDI mihara karadA he|

yAda karo jadoM tusIM (hAra de kArana maidAna viccoM) bhajje jA rahe sI ate kise valla mur3a ke vekhade vI nahIM sI ate rasUla (haz2arata mahuMmada) tuhADe picche tuhAnUM sadda rahe sI| phera allAha ne tuhAnUM uppara thalle dukkha isa laI ditte tAM jo tusIM sikkhiA prApata kara sakoM ki jo vI tuhADe hatthoM khussa jAve jAM tuhADe ’te koI musIbata A jAve usa utte tuhAnUM udAsa hoNa dI koI lor3a nahIM| allAha tuhADe amalAM toM pUrI tarhAM jANU he|

phera usa (allAha ne kazaTa magaroM) tuhADe ’te saMtokha nAz2ila kItA ate tuhADe viccoM ika Tole nUM uMgha AuNa lagga paI, hAM ihanAM viccoM kujjha ajihe loka vI sana jinhAM nUM ApaNIAM jAnAM dI ciMtA laggI hoI sI, iha loka allAha pratI tarhAM -tarhAM dIAM agiAnatA bharIAM gallAM kara rahe sana ki sAnUM vI rabba ne koI adhikAra dittA he? (he nabI!) tusIM Akha dio ki sAre kaMma allAha de hI adhikAra vica hana| uha loka ApaNe dilAM dIAM gallAM tuhAnUM nahIM dassade| kahiMde hana, kI jekara sAnUM vI kajjha adhikAra huMdA tAM asIM isa thAM ’te katala nA kIte jAMde| (he nabI!) tusIM Akha dio ki je tusIM ApaNe gharAM vica huMde phera vI jinhAM dI takadIra vica katala hoNA sI uha ApaNe marana TikANiAM valla Apa hI nikala AuMde| iha sabha kujjha isa laI hoiA sI ki jo kujjha vI tuhADe manAM vica he (allAha) usa nUM parakhe ate jo vI tuhADe manAM vica khoTa he usa nUM pAka kare| allAha manAM de bhetAM nUM bhalI-bhAMta jANadA he|

bezakka jadoM dovAM dhar3hiAM dI ohada vica Takkara hoI sI udoM tuhADe (musalamAnAM) viccoM jinhAM ne piTTha vikhAI sI uha loka ApaNIAM kujjha kamaz2orIAM kArana zaitAna de bahikAve vica A gae praMtU phera allAha ne uhanAM nUM muAfa kara dittA| bezakka allAha DADhA baqhazaNahAra ate vaDDA zahiNazIla he|

he ImAna vAlio! tusIM uhanAM lokAM vAMga nAM ho jANA jinhAM ne kufara kItA sI ate ApaNe musalamAna bharAvAM laI, jadoM uha safara laI jAM jihAda laI nikalade, hamadaradI vajoM Akhade ki je iha sADe kola huMde tAM nA uha kise nUM mArade nA hI Apa marade| iMja allAha ne uhanAM dIAM gallAM nUM uhanAM de dilAM de pachatAve dA kArana baNA chaDDiA he| allAha hI jiuMdA rakkhaNa vAlA ate mArana vAlA he ate allAha tuhADe sAre amalAM nUM vekha rihA he|
je tusIM allAha dI rAha vica mAre jAo jAM mara jAo tAM bezakka allAha dI baqhaziza ate miharAM ihanAM saMsArika vasatUAM toM kIte vadhIA hana jihar3IAM iha loka jor3ade hana|
bhAveM tusIM (ApaNI mauta) Apa maro jAM tusIM mAre jAo, tusAM ikaTThe tAM allAha kola hI kIte jAoge|

(he muhaMmada sa!) allAha dI mihara sadakA tusIM ihanAM lokAM pratI narama subhAa vAle ho, jekara tusIM kaur3I z2ubAna ate kaThora dila vAle huMde tAM iha sAre loka tuhADe Ale-duAle toM khiMDa jAMde| so tusIM ihanAM (dIAM bhullAM) nUM muAfa kara devo ate ihanAM laI (rabba toM) muAfI dI aradAsa karo ate ihanAM toM salAha mazavarA lai liA karo, phera jadoM tuhADA irAdA (mazavare toM magaroM) kise sujhAo ’te pakkA ho jAve tAM phera (usa ’te amala karade hoe) allAha utte bharosA karo| bezakka allAha bharosA karana vAliAM nUM pasaMda karadA he|

je allAha tuhADI sahAitA ’te A jAve tAM tuhADe ’te koI vI bhArU nahIM ho sakadA, je uhIo tuhAnUM (ikallA) chaDDa deve tAM usa picchoM koNa he jihar3A tuhADI sahAitA kara sakadA he? ImAna vAliAM? tAM allAha ’te hI bharosA karanA cAhIdA he|

asaMbhava he ki kise nabI toM kise prakAra dI qhiAnata [17] (herA-pherI) hove ate je koI qhiAnata karegA tAM uha ApaNI herA-pherI nUM laike kiAmata dihAr3e (rabba de haz2Ura) hAz2ira hovegA, jitthe hara viakatI nUM usa valloM kIte kaMmAM dA pUrA-pUrA badalA dittA jAvegA, kise nAla kise prakAra dA dhakkA nahIM hovegA|
translations.footnotes: [17] haz2arata abU-hurairA ne kihA ki nabI karIma sa: ne khar3e ho ke sA` saMbodhana kItA ate Apa sa: ne luTa mAra de mAla viccoM caurI karana de saMbaMdha vica faramAiA ate isa nUM bahuta vaDDA pApa dassiA ate isa laI saqhata saz2A milaNa dI citAvanI diMde hoe kihA ki vekho iMja nA hove ki maiM tuhADe viccoM kise nUM kiAmata dihAr3e ApaNI garadana ’te bakarI laddI hoI vekhAM|

translations.translation: uha viakatI jihar3A (sadA hI) allAha nUM qhuza karana vica laggiA rahiMdA he, kI uha usa viakatI vAMga ho sakadA he jihar3A allAha nUM (ApaNe kaMmAM kArana sadA) nArAz2a rakkhadA he ate jinhAM dA TikANA naraka he jihar3I bahuta hI bhair3I thAM he?
allAha kola unAM (doveM tarhAM de) lokAM laI (vakkhare vakkhare) daraje hana ate uhanAM sabha de amalAM nUM allAha vekha rihA he|

bezakka allAha ne musalamAnAM ’te bahuta vaDDA ahisAna kItA he ki uhanAM vica qhuda uhanAM laI ika rasUla bhejiA jo uhanAM nUM isa (.kuraAna) dIAM AitAM par3hake suNAuMdA he te uhanAM nUM (ziraka toM) pAka karadA he ate uhanAM nUM kitAba (.kuraAna) te hikamata (hadIsa) dIAM gallAM sikhAuMdA he| [18] jadoM ki isa (nabI) toM pahilAM iha loka sapazaTa rUpa vica kurAhe pae hoe sana|
translations.footnotes: [18] isa toM siddha haMdA he ki hidAita ate mana dI pavitarratA laI allAha de rasUla sa: dIAM sunnatAM dI pairavI karanA ati z2arUrI he allAha ne sUrata furakAna vica faramAiA he ki he rabbA! sAnUM parahez2agArAM dA AgU baNA de| mujAhida ra:a; ne AkhiA ki isa toM bhAva he ki asIM bIta cukke lokAM dI pairavI karaIe ate sAthoM magaroM AuNa vAle sADI pairavI karana ate ibane auna ra:a: dA kahiNA he ki tiMna gallAM ajihA hana jihar3IAM maiM ApaNe laI vI pasaMda karadA hAM ate apaNe bharAvAM laI vI pasaMda karadA hAM (1) musalamAnAM nUM cAhIdA he ki rasUla sa: dIAM hadIsAM sikkhaNa ate hadIsa de giAnIAM toM ihanAM de saMbaMdha vica pucchade rahiNa| (2) pavittara kuraAna ’te soca vicAra karana ate isa dI samajha vica nA AuNa vAlIAM gallAM bAre giAnIAM toM pucchade rahiNa (3) chuTTa bhalAI dIAM gallAM toM kise de muAmale vica daqhala nahIM deNA cAhIdA ate nA kise dI cug2alI karanI cAhIdI he ate bhalAI de udeza nAla nasIhatA karade raho (sahI buqhArI, ala aetasAma bAba 2) ika hadIsa vica nabI karIma sa: ne faramAiA merI sArI ummata bhAveM uha gunAhagAra hove ika nA ika dina jaMnata vica z2arUra jAvegA para uha nahIM jihar3A jaMnata vica jANa toM nA karadA he tAM suhAbA ne pucchiA he allAha de rasUla! uha koNa he jihar3A jaMnata vica jANa toM nA karadA he tAM Apa sa: ne faramAiA jihar3A merI pairavI karadA he uha jaMnata vica jAvegA ate jihar3A merI nA-faramAnI karadA he uha inakAra karadA he| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 7280)

translations.translation: usa sameM tuhADA kI hAla sI jadoM tuhADe utte (uhada de maidAna vica) ika musIbata A paI tAM tusIM kahiNa lagge ki iha musIbata kitthoM AI he? jadoM ki isa toM pahilAM badara de maidAna vica tusIM ihanAM kAfarAM nUM dUNI musIbata de cukke ho| tAM (he nabI!) tusIM Akha dio ki iha sArIAM musIbatAM tuhADIAM ApaNIAM saher3IAM hoIA hana| bezakka allAha hara prakAra dI samarathA rakkhadA he|

(he musalamAno!) tuhAnUM jo vI hAnI usa dina (uhada de yuddha vica) hoI sI, jisa dina do guTTAM vicakAra Takkara hoI sI, uha sabha kujjha allAha de hukama anusAra hI sI ate iha isa laI sI ki allAha pachANa lave ki kauNa ImAna vAlA he|

ate allAha iha vI jANadA he ki manAfika koNa hana| jadoM uhanAM (munAfikAM) nUM kihA giA ki Ao allAha dI rAha vica lar3Ie jAM zahira dA bacAu karIe tAM uha (munAfika) kahiNa lagge ki jekara asIM jANade huMde ki ajja jaMga hovegI tAM asIM tuhADe nAla z2arUra jAMde| usa dina uha ImAna nAloM kufara de vadhere ner3e sana| iha (munAfika) loka ApaNe mUhoM uha gallAM Akhade hana jihar3IAM uhanAM de manAM vica nahIM huMdIAM (jada ki) allAha uha sabha jANadA he jinhAM (gallAM) nUM dilAM vica lukAuMde hana|

iha uha loka hana jo Apa tAM baiThe hI rahe ate ApaNe bharAvAM bAre (jihar3e jaMga vica gae sI) kahiNa lagge, ki je uha sADA kahiNA maMna laiMde tAM mAre nA jAMde| (he nabI!) ihanAM nUM Akha dio ki jekara tusIM sacce ho tAM ApaNIAM jAnAM toM mauta nUM TAla ke vikhAo|
jihar3e loka allAha dI rAha vica mAre jANa, uhanAM nUM muradA nA kaho, uha tAM jiuMde hana, ApaNe rabba valloM uhanAM nUM riz2aka dittA jAMdA he|

allAha ne ApaNe faz2alAM nAla jo uhanAM nUM navAz2iA he usa toM uha bahuta qhuza hana ate uhanAM (mominAM) pratI vI qhuzIAM manA rahe hana, jihar3e aje tIka uhanAM nAla nahIM mile| ate uhanAM de picche (allAha dI rAha vica lar3ana laI) rahi gae hana| nA tAM uhanAM nUM (marana dA) koI Dara he ate nA hI (marana magaroM) kise tarhAM dI koI ciMtA hovegI|
uha allAha de inAma ate usa de phaz2alAM toM bahuta qhuza hana (ate isa galla ’te vI saMtuzaTa hana ki) allAha ImAna vAliAM de neka kaMmAM nUM AjAIM nahIM karegA|

jihar3e lokAM ne allAha ate rasUla de hukamAM nUM paravAna kItA jadoM ki uha burI tarhAM z2akhamI ho cukke sana, uhanAM viccoM jinhAM ne bhale kaMma kIte ate burAI toM parahez2a kItA uhanAM laI bar3A vaDDA badalA he|

uha loka ki jadoM uhanAM nUM lokAM ne kihA ki (kAfirAM ne tAM) tuhADe viruddha ika vaDDI fauja ikattara kItI hoI he, tusIM uhanAM (nAla lar3AI karana) toM Daro, praMtU isa galla ne uhanAM de ImAna vica hora vAdhA kara dittA ate AkhaNa lagge “hasabunallAhu va niamala vakIla”[19] bhAva sADe laI tAM allAha hI batherA he, uhIo sAre kaMma saMvAraNa vAlA he|
translations.footnotes: [19] haz2arata ibane abbAsa dA kahiNA he ki “hasabunallAho vA niamala vakIla” haz2arata ibarAhIma ne usa vele kihA sI jadoM uhanAM nUM agga vica suTTiA giA sI ate haz2arata muhaMmada sa: ne iho bola bole sI jadoM lokAM nUM uhanAM nUM AkhiA sI kuraiza de kAfarAM ne tuhADe nAla lar3ana laI ika fauja jamAM kItI he tusIM usa toM Daro iha suNa ke suhAbAM dA ImAna hora vI vaddha giA ate uhanAM ne kihA hasabUnalAha vA niamala vakIla bhAva ki sADe laI allAha hI batherA he ate uha sabha toM vadhIA kaMma savArana vAlA he| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 4563)

translations.translation: ate uha allAha de inAma ate usa dIAM miharAM sadakA uha (jaMga viccoM) ghara parata Ae uhanAM nUM koI nukasAna nahIM hoiA uhanAM ne allAha dI maraz2I dI pAlaNA kItI, allAha DADhA faz2ala faramAuNa vAlA he|
iha tAM zaitAna hI he jihar3A ApaNe sAthIAM (kAfirAM) toM (mominAM) nUM DarAuMdA he| (he musalamAno!) so tusIM uhanAM kAfirAM toM nA Daro (sagoM) maithoM Daro je tusIM (sacce) momina ho|

(he muhaMmada!) jihar3e loka kufara vica agge vaddha rahe hana uhanAM dIAM saragaramIAM tuhA` ciMtA vica nA pA deNa, iha allAha dA kujjha vI vigAr3a nahIM sakade| allAha dA irAdA iha he ki uhanAM (kAfirAM) laI Aqhirata vica koI hissA nA rakkhe, uhanAM laI tAM (naraka dA) karar3A az2Aba he|
kufara nUM ImAna de badale qharIdaNa vAle kade vI allAha dA kujjha vI nahIM vigAr3a sakade ate uhanAM laI dukhadAI az2Aba he|

kAfira loka sADe (allAha) valloM (saMsAra vica) dittI hoI Dhilla nUM ApaNe hakka vica caMgA nA samajhaNa| iha Dhilla tAM asIM isa laI dittI he ki uha ApaNe pApAM vica hora vAdhA kara laiNa| ihanAM (kAfirAM) laI hI z2alIla karana vAlA az2Aba he|

(he masamino!) jisa hAla vica ajja tusIM ho allAha ImAna vAliAM nUM isa hAla vica kade vI nahIM rahiNa devegA, jadoM taka ki uha pavittara lokAM nUM apavittara lokAM toM vakkharA nA kara deve ate nA hI allAha dA iha tarIkA he ki tuhAnUM parokha toM jANU karAve, para allAha ApaNe rasUlAM viccoM jisa nUM cAhuMdA he (g2aiba dI jANakArI deNa laI) cuNa laiMdA he| isa laI tusIM allAha ate usa de rasUlAM utte ImAna rakkho jekara tusIM (sacce) ImAna vAle ho! allAha toM Daro fera tuhAnUM bahuta vaDDA badalA milegA|

jinhAM lokAM nUM allAha ne ApaNe faz2alAM nAla navAz2iA hoiA he phera uha isa vica kaMjUsI karade hana uha ApaNI isa kaMjUsI nUM ApaNe laI vadhIA nA samajhaNa sagoM iha (kaMjUsI) uhanAM laI bahuta hI bhair3I siddha hovegI| chetI hI kiAmata vAle dina iha (kaMjUsI nAla ikatarra kItI hoI mAyA) uhanAM de gala dA tauka (hAra) baNa jAvegI|[20] akAza te dharatI (dI hara cIz2a) dA vArasa allAha hI he ate jo kujjha tusIM kara rahe ho usa toM allAha (bhalI bhAMta) jANU he|
translations.footnotes: [20] isa Aita vica z2akAta nA deNa vAliAM laI karar3I citAvanI he| hadIsa anusAra jisa viakatI nUM allAha daulata baqhaze ate uha z2akAta adA nA kare tAM kiAmata dihAr3e usa dI daulata ika gaMje sappa jisa dIAM akkhAM ’te do kAle nizAna hoNage dI zakala baNa ke usa de gala dA hAra baNa jAvegI ate usa dIAM doveM bAchAM phAr3a ke AkhegA ki mainUM pucchadAM nahIM maiM terI daulata hAM maiM terA qhaz2AnA hAM, phera Apa ne iho Aita par3hI| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 4565)

translations.translation: allAha ne uhanAM lokAM dA kathana vI suNiA he jo Akhade hana ki allAha tAM fakIra he ate asIM dhanavAna hAM| uhanAM de isa kathana nUM asIM likkha chaDDAMge ate uha vI (likhiA hoiA he) jo uha nabIAM nUM nA-hakkA katala karade rahe hana| asIM (allAha) ihanAM (kAfirAM) nUM AkhAMge ki huNa sAr3aNa vAle az2Aba (naraka dI agga) dA savAda lavo|
ate (uhanAM nUM kihA jAvegA) ki iha sabha tuhADe hatthAM dI kamAI dA badalA he| allAha ApaNe baMdiAM utte koI vI z2ulama nahIM karadA|

iha uha loka hana jihar3e kahiMde hana ki allAha valloM sAnUM hukama hoiA he ki tusIM kise rasUla nUM udoM taka nA maMno jadoM taka ki uha (rasUla) sADe sAhamaNe ajihI kurabAnI nA kare jisa nUM g2aiboM A ke agga khA jAve| (he nabI!) tusIM Akha dio ki (he kAfiro!) je tusIM sacce ho tAM maithoM pahilAM tuhADe kola jihar3e vI rasUla Ae jihar3e hora bahuta sAre sapazaTa moajaz2iAM (camatakArAM) nAla iha (nizAnI) vI liAe sana jo tusIM kahi rahe ho, phera tusIM uhanAM (rasUlAM)nUM kiuM katala kItA sI? (javAba dio) je tusIM sacce ho?

(he muhaMmada!) je iha loka tuhAnUM nahIM maMnade (tAM kI hoiA) tuhAthoM pahilAM vI bahuta sAre uhanAM rasUlAM nUM jhuThalA cukke hana jihar3e sapazaTa nizAnIAM, sahIfe (choTIAM choTIAM pothIAM) ate cAnaNa failAuNa vAlIAM kitAbAM lai ke Ae sana|

(he loko!) aMta nUM hara jIva ne mauta dA suAda cakhaNA he (bhAva mara jANA he) kiAmata vAle dina tuhAnUM (ApaNe kIte kaMmAM dA) pUrA-pUrA badalA dittA jAvegA| hAM! jihar3e viakatI nUM agga toM bacA liA jAve ate savaraga vica dAqhala kara dittA jAve uhIo viakatI asala vica kAmayAba hovegA| saMsArika jIvana tAM kevala ika bhulekhA hI he (asala jIvana praloka dA jIvana he)|

(he musalamAno!) tuhADe mAla ate tuhADIAM jAnAM rAhIM tuhAnUM avazza az2amAiA jAvegA| tusIM uhanAM lokAM toM jinhAM nUM tuhAthoM pahilAM kitAba dittI gaI ate uhanAM lokAM toM, jihar3e muzarika hana, z2arUra hI dukhadAI gallAM suNoge, je tusIM sabara karo te parahez2agArI vAlA vatIrA apaNAoge tAM iha bahuta vaDDI himmata dA kaMma he|

jadoM allAha ne ahale kitAba (yahUdI te IsAIAM) toM iha vacana liA sI ki tusIM uhanAM (kitAbAM de hukamAM) nUM sAre lokAM de sAhamaNe lAz2amI biAna karoge ate isa de (hukamAM nUM) lukA ke nahIM rakkhoge para uhanAM ne isa bacana nUM piTTha picche suTTa chaDDiA ate isa (kitAba) nUM bahuta hI thor3he mulla ’te (bhAva saMsArika lAbha laI) veca suTTiA he, ihanAM dA iha vapAra kiMnA bhair3A ghATe vAlA he|

iha loka ApaNIAM karatUtAM ’te bahuta qhuza hana ate cAhuMde hana ki jihar3e kaMma uhanAM ne kIte vI nahIM uhanAM dI vI prazaMsA kItI jAve| tusIM uhanAM lokAM nUM (naraka de) az2Aba toM surakkhiata nA samajho uhanAM laI tAM bar3I hI daradanAka saz2A he|
akAza te dharatI dI bAdazAhata allAha laI he ate hara cIz2a allAha de vassa vica he|
akAza te dharatI nUM paidA karana vica ate rAta te dina de AuNa jANa vica akalamaMda lokAM laI (allAha nUM saMmajhaNa laI) batherIAM nizAnIAM hana|

jihar3e (neka loka) khar3e, baiThe ate leTade hoe (bhAva hara hAla vica) allAha nUM yAda rakkhade hana ate akAza te dharatI dI baNatara ’te vicAra karade hana ate Akhade hana ki he sADe pAlaNahAra! tUM iha sabha kujjha viaratha nahIM baNAiA, tUM pAka he, basa tUM sAnUM naraka dI agga de az2Aba toM bacA lai|
he sADe pAlaNahAra! tUM jisa nUM vI naraka vica suTTiA, hakIkata vica usa nUM tUM z2alIla kItA he ate (Aqhirata vica) z2AlamAM dA koI vI sahAI nahIM hovegA|

he sADe pAlaNahAra! bezakka asIM suNiA ki munAdI karana vAlA uccI avAz2a nAla (lokAM nUM) ImAna valla sadda rihA he ki he loko! ApaNe rabba ’te ImAna le Ao| so asIM usa dI galla maMnada hoe) ImAna lai Ae| he rabbA! huNa tUM sADe gunAhAM nUM muAfa kara de ate sADIAM burAIAM nUM sAthoM dUra karade ate jadoM sADI mauta Ave tAM asIM neka lokAM de nAla hoIe|

he sADe pAlaNahAra! sAnUM uha cIz2a (savaraga) baqhaza de jisa dA vAadA taiMne sADe nAla ApaNe rasUlAM rAhIM kItA he ate sAnUM kiAmata vAle dina z2alIla nA karIM| bezakka tUM ApaNe vAade toM phirana vAlA nahIM|

uhanAM de rabba ne uhanAM dI duA nUM kabUla kara liA (ate AkhiA ki) tuhADe viccoM kise dA vI neka amala, bhAveM uha puraza hove jAM isatarI, aiveM hI barabAda nahIM karAMgA| tusIM sAre Apasa vica ikko hI ho, isa laI uha loka jinhAM ne hijarata kItI ate ApaNe gharAM viccoM kaDDha ditte gae ate jinhAM nUM mere rasate callaNa kArana takalIfA dittIAM gaIAM| jinhAM ne rabba laI lar3AI lar3I ate mAre gae, maiM z2arUra hI uhanAM dIAM burAIAM uhanAM toM dUra kara davegAM ate uhanAM nUM uhanAM jaMnatAM vica dAkhila karAgAM jitthe uha sadA rahiNage| jisa de heTha nahirAM vagga rahIAM hana, iha uhanAM dA badalA allAha valloM he ate allAha kola hI sabha toM vadhIA badalA he|
he nabI! rabba de inakArIAM dI saMsAra vica calata phirata (qhuzahAlI) tuhAnUM dhokhe vica nA pA deve|
iha tAM bahuta hI thor3hA lAbha he (isa saMsArika jIvana toM bAada) uhanAM dA TikANA naraka hI he ate uha bahuta hI burI jaghA he|

praMtU jihar3e loka (saMsAra vica) ApaNe rabba toM Darade rahe uhanAM laI (Aqhirata vica) savaragAM hana jinhAM de heTha nahirAM vagadIAM hana jitthe uha sadA rahiNage, iha allAha valloM uhanAM (neka lokAM) laI Ao bhagata he ate neka lokAM laI jo allAha kola he uha bahuta hI vadhIA he|

bezakka! kitAba vAliAM (yahUdIAM te IsAIAM) viccoM kujjha ajihe vI hana jihar3e allAha ’te ImAna rakhade hana ate tuhADe utte (he muhaMmada!) jihar3A (.kuraAna) nAz2ala hoiA he ate uhanAM laI jo (tauraita te iMjIla) nAz2ala kItA giA he usa ’te vI (ImAna rakkhade hana), allAha toM Darade hana ate allAha dIAM AitAM (.kuraAna) nUM thor3he jihe (saMsarAki lAbha) mulla ’te veca nahIM suTTade, uhanAM dA badalA uhanAM de rabba de kola he ate allAha bahuta chetI hisAba laiNa vAlA he|
he ImAna vAlio! (musIbatAM vele) sabara toM kaMma lavo (lar3AI sameM) DaTe raho, hakka sacca dI sevA laI saragarama raho tAM jo tusIM (ApaNe TIce nUM prApata karana vica) safala ho sako|

he loko! ApaNe usa pAlaNahAra toM Daro jisa ne tuhAnUM sabha nUM ika jAna (haz2arata Adama) toM paidA kItA te use (jAna) toM uhadA jor3A (patanI havvA nUM) baNAiA ate uhanAM dovAM toM bahuta sAre marada te auratAM (dunIAM vica) khilAra ditte| usa allAha toM Daro jisa dA vAsatA pAke tusIM ika dUje koloM (rizate) maMgade ho, ate rizate nAte tor3aNa toM baco|[1] bezakka allAha tuhADI nigarAnI kara rihA he|
translations.footnotes: [1] rizate tor3aNA bahuta vaDDA gunAha he| nabI karIma sa: dA faramAna he ki rizate tor3aNa vAlA jaMnata vica nahIM jAvegA| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 5984)

translations.translation: yatImAM de mAla (jihar3e tuhADe kola hana) uhanAM nUM vApasa de dio ate (uhanAM de) vadhIA mAla nUM (ApaNe) bhair3e mAla nAla nA badalo| tusIM uhanAM de mAla ApaNe mAla nAla ralA malA ke nA khAo| bezakka iha bahuta vaDDA pApa he|

je tuhAnUM Dara hove ki tusIM yatIma lar3akIAM nAla (nikAha karake) inasAfa nahIM kara sakoge tAM jihar3IAM isatarIAM tuhAnUM pasaMda hoNa tusIM uhanAM viccoM do-do, tiMna-tiMna ate cAra-cAra (isatarIAM nAla nikAha) kara sakade ho, para je tuhAnUM isa galla dA Dara he ki tusIM uhanAM nAla niA nahIM kara sakade tAM ikka hI aurata nAla nikAha karo jAM uhanAM golIAM nUM patanI baNA lao jo tuhADe kabaz2e ’ca AIAM hana| tuhADe laI iho ucita he| iMja karake tusIM nA inasAfI toM baca jAvoge|
patanIAM nUM uhanAM de mahira qhuzI-qhuzI adA karo,[2] hAM je uha Ape ApaNI icchA nAla tuhAnUM mahira dA kujjha hissA muAfa kara deNa tAM tusIM usa nUM zauka nAla khA sakade ho|
translations.footnotes: [2] mahira aurata dA uha hakka he jisa nUM nA deNA saqhata gunAha he nabI karIma sa: ne faramAiA ki allAha taAlA ne tuhADe laI mAvAM dI nA-faramAnI, dhIAM nUM jiuMdA gaDDa deNA ApaNe ’te kise dA hakka hove usa nUM nA adA karanA ate dUjiAM toM ApaNA hakka maMgaNA harAma kara dittA he ate Apa sa: ne bekAra gallAM karana, ate bahute savAla karana, ate mAla barabAda karana nUM nA pasaMda kItA he| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 2408)

translations.translation: jisa mAla nUM allAha ne tuhADe laI jIvana guz2Arana dA ika sAdhana baNAiA he usa mAla nUM be-samajha lokAM de havAle nA karo| hAM! uhanAM (be-akalAM) nUM usa mAla ’coM khANa pANa karAo te kappar3A lattA pavAo ate uhanAM nAla narama subhAa nAla gallabAta karo|

tusIM yatImAM dI (sUjha-bUjha dI) parakha karade raho, itthoM taka ki uha nikAha dI umara nUM pujja jANa| phera je tusIM uhanAM vica samajhadArI te yogatA pAo tAM uhanAM de mAla uhanAM de havAle kara dio| tusIM uhanAM dI daulata nUM lor3a toM vaddha ate chetI-chetI isa karake nA khAo ki uha vaDDe ho ke tuhAthoM ApaNA hakka maMgaNage| je (saraprasata) amIra hove tAM usa nUM cAhIdA he ki anAthAM de mAla khANa toM baco, para je uha garIba he tAM lor3a anusAra khA sakadA he| jadoM tusIM uhanAM (anAthAM) de mAla uhanAM de havAle karo tAM isa ’te kise he gavAha baNA lavo| ate allAha hisAba laiNa laI Apa hI batherA he|
mAtA pitA te sAka-saMbaMdhI de chaDDe hoe mAla vica maradAM dA vI hissA he te auratAM dA vI (hissA he) mAla bhAveM ghaTTa hove jAM vaddha hove iha de hisse (allAha valloM) niyata kIte gae hana|
je vaMDa vele rizatedAra, yatIma ate muthAja A jANa tAM tusIM usa (virAsata de) mAla viccoM uhanAM nUM vI kujjha de devo ate uhanAM nAla naramI nAla bolo|

lokAM nUM isa galla toM DaranA cAhIdA he ki je uha ApaNe picche (choTe-choTe) bevasa bacce chaDDa jANa tAM uhanAM nUM ApaNe bacciAM pratI kiMnI ciMtA hovegI| so uhanAM nUM rabba toM Darade hoe ThIka te sahI galla kahiNI cAhIdI he|
jihar3e loka yatImAM dA mAla z2ulama nAla khAMde hana uha ApaNe DhiDDa agga nAla hI bharade hana ate uha chetI hI (kiAmata vAle dina) naraka dI agga vica suTe jANage|

allAha tuhAnUM tuhADI saMtAna bAre hukama diMdA he ki puttara dA hissA do dhIAM de barAbara he| jekara kevala dhIAM do jAM do toM vaddha hoNa tAM uhanAM nUM virase dA do tihAI hissA milegA ate je ika hI (dhI) hove tAM usa laI addhA virasA he| je mritaka de saMtAna he tAM usa de mAtA pitA viccoM hara ika nUM virase dA chevAM hissA milegA ate je saMtAna nA hove ate mA bApa hI vArisa hoNa tAM usa dI mAM dA tIjA hissA he| je mritaka de kaI bharA hoNa tAM phera usa dI mAM dA chevAM hissA varAsata vica hovegA| iha sAre hissiAM dI vaMDa mritaka dI vasIata pUrI karana ate usa de sira jihar3A karaz2A hove usa nUM utArana magaroM hovegI| tuhADe mAM bApa hoNa jAM tuhADI saMtAna hove tuhAnUM nahIM patA ki ihanAM viccoM koNa tuhAnUM lAbha pahuMcA sakadA he| iha sAre hisse allAha valloM niyata kIte hoe hana| bezakka allAha sArIAM hakIkatAM ate sArIAM hikamatAM dA jANana vAlA he|

je tuhADIAM patanIAM be-aulAda hoNa tAM uhanAM de chaDDe hoe mAla viccoM tuhADA (patI dA) addhA hissA hovegA je usa dI saMtAna he tAM uhanAM de chaDDe hoe mAla viccoM tuhADA cothA hissA hovegA| iha vaMDa uhanAM patanIAM dI vasIata pUrI karana ate karaz2AM adA karana toM bAada hI hovegI| je tuhADI (maradAM dI) saMtAna nahIM tAM tuhADe valloM chaDDe hoe mAla ’coM tuhADI patanIAM dA cauthA hissA he je tuhADI aulAda he tAM tuhADe chaDDe hoe mAla ’coM uhanAM (tuhADIAM patanIAM) dA aTThavAM hissA he iha vaMDa vI tuhADe valloM kItI hoI vasIata dI pUratI ate tuhADA karaz2a adA karana uparaMta hovegI| jekara uha viakatI jisa dA virasA vaMDiA jA rihA he nA koI usadA puttara he ate nA hI usa dA pio (jiodAM) he jAM iMja hI koI aurata hove je usa dA ika bharA jAM ika bhaiNa hove tAM ihanAM dovAM viccoM hareka dA chevAM hissA hovegA, je uha vaddha giNatI vica hana tAM uha sAre ika tihAI de bhAgIdAra hoNage, iha (vaMDa) usa (marana vAle dI) vasIata ’te amala hoNa toM bAada jAM usa de z2iMme karaz2e dI adAegI toM bAada hovegI, para isa toM kise nUM koI hAnI nahI hoNI cAhIdI| iha hukama allAha valloM he ate allAha hI jANana vAlA sahiNazIla he|

iha (varAsata dIAM vaMDAM) allAha dIAM niyata kItIAM hoIAM hana ate jihar3A viakatI allAha ate usa de rasUla (muhaMmada sa:) dI tAbedArI karegA usa nUM allAha savaragAM vica dAqhala karegA jinhAM de heTha nahirAM vagadIAM hana, jinhAM vica uha (AgiAkArI loka) sadA rahiNage ate iho vaDDI kAmayAbI he|

jo viakatI allAha ate usa de rasUla dI nA-faramAnI karegA ate usa (allAha) dIAM haddAM dI ulaMghaNA karegA, usa (nA-faramAna) nUM (allAha) naraka vica suTTa devegA jitthe uha hamezAM laI rahiNage ajihe lokAM laI hI z2alIla karana vAlA az2Aba he|

ate tuhADIAM isatarIAM (patanIAM) viccoMM jihar3IAM badakArI vAle kaMma (z2anA) kara baiThaNa uhanAM utte ApaNe viccoM hI cAra purazAM dI gavAhI lao, je iha cAro gavAhI deNa tAM uhanAM auratAM nUM gharAM vica baMda (kaida) kara dio, itthoM taka ki unhAM dI mota A jAve jAM allAha uhanAM laI koI hora rAha kaDDha deve|

tuhADe ’coM jihar3e vI do puraza badakArI (samaliMgatA) karana uhanAM nUM saz2A dio je uha taubA karake ApaNA sudhAra kara laiNa tAM uhanAM nUM muAfa kara dio| bezakka allAha hI taubA nUM kabUla karana vAlA he te rahima faramAuNa vAlA he|

allAha kevala uhanAM lokAM dI hI taubA kabUla karadA he jihar3e nAdAnI (aNajANapune) vica koI gunAha kara baiThade hana para chetI hI (usa gunAha toM) taubA kara laiNa tAM allAha uhanAM dI taubA kabUla karadA he| allAha (sabha dilAM dI) jANakArI rakkhaNa vAlA he ate hikamata vAlA he|

uhanAM lokAM dI taubA kabUla nahIM huMdI jihar3e bhair3e kaMma karade rahiMde hana itthoM tIka ki jadoM uhanAM viccoM kise dI mauta dA velA A pujjadA he usa sameM AkhadA he ki “huNa maiM taubA karadA hAM” ise tarhAM uhanAM dI taubA vI kabUla nahIM huMdI jihar3e kAfira huMde hoe hI mara jANa| iho uha loka hana jinhAM laI asAM dukhadAI az2Aba tiAra kara chaDDiA he|

he ImAna vAlio! tuhADe laI iha jAiz2a nahIM ki tusIM z2ora z2abaradasatI (vidhavA) isatarIAM de vArasa baNa baiTho (huNa uha az2Ada he jitthe cAhe nikAha karavA sakadI he) ate nA hI uhanAM nUM isa laI (talAka deNa magaroM) roka ke rakkho ki jo tusIM uhanAM nUM mahira dittA hoiA he usa viccoM kujjha vApasa lai lavo [3] hAM je uha koI sapazaTa badakArI te be-hiAI de kaMma kara baiThaNa tAM uhanAM nUM rokaNA jAiz2a he| tusIM uhanAM (ApaNIAM patanIAM) nAla sucajje DhaMga nAla jIvana guz2Aro je tusIM uhanAM nUM nA pasaMda karo tAM ho sakadA he ki tuhAnUM ika cIz2a pasaMda nA hove para allAha ne use vica koI bhalAI rakkha chaDDI hove|
translations.footnotes: [3] isa toM bhAva mahira he, isa vica hara uha cIz2a he, jihar3I patI valloM patanI nUM nikAha de badale dittI jAMdI he (sonA cAMdI mAla daulata Adi) lokAM vica Ama karake 32/- rupae zaraI mahira dA rivAja he| jada ki iha sabha g2alata gallAM hana| mahira lar3ake dI vittI yogatA anusAra hoNA cAhIdA he, nA deNa de irAde nAla vadha toM vadha mahira niyata karanA ThIka nahIM ate nA hI lar3ake dI hiMmata toM vaddha ke mahira hoNA cAhIdA he ate isa nUM deNA vI z2arUrI he|

translations.translation: je tusIM ika patanI dI thAM dUjI patanI liAuNA cAhuMde ho tAM bhAveM tusIM uhanAM (chaDDaNa vAlIAM patanIAM) viccoM kise nUM qhaz2AnAM vI de rakkhiA he tAM vI usa viccoM kujjha vI vApasa nA lavo| kI tusIM usa ’te ilaz2Ama lA ke ate khullhA pApa karade hoe vApasa lavoge?
tusIM (ditte hoe) mahira viccoM kiddAM vApasa lavoge jadoM ki tusIM ika dUje nAla sarIrika milaNa kara cukke ho ate uha auratAM tuhAthoM pakkA praNa lai cukkIAM hana (bhAva nikAha kItA he)|

uhanAM isatarIAM nAla nikAha nA karo jinhAM (auratAM) nAla tuhADe pio nikAha kara cakke hana para jo pahilAM ho cukkA so ho cukkA| bezakka iha ika azalIla kaMma he ate nA pasaMdIdA te bhair3A ravAja he|

tuhADe ’te harAma kItIAM gaIAM hana (bhAva jinhAM nAla tusIM nikAha nahIM kara sakade) tuhADIAM (sakIAM te materIAM) mAvAM, tuhADIAM dhIAM (potI te dohatI sameta), bhaiNAM (sakI mAM jAM bApa valloM), bhUA, mAsIAM, bhatIjIAM, bhANajIAM, tuhADIAM uha mAvAM jinhAM dA tusIM duddha pItA he ate tuhADIAM duddha vica sAMjhIvAla bhaiNAM, tuhADIAM sassAM ate tuhADIAM patanIAM dIAM dhIAM, jihar3IAM tuhADI godI vica palIAM hana, uhanAM auratAM dIAM dhIAM jinhAM nAla tusIM (patI patanI vAlA) mela milApa kara cukke ho, para je tusIM uhanAM nAla patI patanI vAMga milApa nahIM sI kItA (kevala nikAha hI hoiA he) tAM phera tuhADe ’te koI doza nahIM tuhADe laI jAiz2a he (tusIM nikAha kara sakade ho) ate tuhADe vIraja toM paidA hoe puttarAM dIAM patanIAM ate do sakIAM bhaiNAM nUM iko vele ikaTThA rakkhaNA (vI harAma he) hAM jo vI (ihanAM hukamAM toM) pahilAM ho cukkiA so ho cukkiA| allAha baqhazaNahAra te rahima faramAuNa vAlA he|

tuhADe laI vivAhita auratAM vI harAma hana praMtU jihar3IAM auratAM jaMga vica tuhADe kabaz2e vica A jANa uha jAiz2a hana| allAha ne ihanAM hidAitAM nUM tuhADe laI likkha chaDDiA he| ihanAM isatarIAM toM chuTTa bAkI sArIAM auratAM tuhADe laI halAla (jAiz2a) hana| tusIM ApaNe mAla (mahira) de ke uhanAM nAla nikAha kara sakade ho| tuhADA irAdA badakArI laI nahIM hoNA cAhIdA| isa laI jinhAM nAla tusIM nikAha karo uhanAM nUM uhanAM dA niyata kItA hoiA mahira adA karo| mahira niyata hoNa toM magaroM jekara ApasI raz2AmaMdI nAla isa vica (ghaTTa jAM vaddha) niyata kara lavo tAM tuhADe ’te koI doza nahIM| bezakka allAha jANana vAlA, siANA te dAnA he|

je tuhADe viccoM koI viakatI Az2Ada musalamAna isatarI nAla nikAha karana dI samarathA nA rakkhadA hove tAM uha musalamAna bAMdIAM nAla, jinhAM de tusIM Apa mAlika ho, nikAha kara sakadA he| allAha tuhADe ImAna dI hAlata nUM bhalI-bhAMta jANadA he| tusIM sAre ika (Adama dI aulAda) ho, isa laI bAMdIAM de mAlikAM toM ijAz2ata lai ke uhanAM nAla nikAha kara lavo ate ravAja anusAra uhanAM (bAMdIAM) de mahira uhanAM nUM devoM| uha (bAMdIAM) neka te bhalIAM hoNa badakArI karana vAlIAM nA hoNa ate nA hI corI chupe yArIAM lAuNa, jadoM uha bAMdIAM (tuhADe) nikAha vica A jANa je phera vI uha badakArI karana tAM uhanAM dI saz2AM Az2Ada isatarIAM dI saz2A toM addhI (bhAva 50 kor3e) hovegI|[4] bAMdIAM (golIAM) nAla nikAha karana dI ijAz2ata tuhADe viccoM kevala uhanAM lokAM nUM hI he jinhAM nUM gunAha bharI rAha tura paiNa dA Dara he| je tusIM sabara kara sako tAM iha tuhADe laI vadhere caMgA he ate allAha bar3A hI baqhazaNahAra te rahimatAM vAlA he|
translations.footnotes: [4] g2ulAma marada jAM aurata bhAveM uha vivAhita hana jAM nahIM je uhanAM viccoM koI z2anAM karegA tAM uhanAM nUM paMjAha kor3hiAM dI saz2A dittI jAvegI ate uhanAM laI rajama (patthara mArana) dI saz2A lAgU nahIM hovegI|

translations.translation: allAha iha cAhuMdA he ki sAre hukamAM nUM visathAra nAla biAna kare ate tuhAnUM tuhAthoM pahilAM de neka lokAM dI rAha ’te calAve, uha tuhADe valla dhiAna deNA cAhuMdA he| allAha jANanahAra te siANA he|
allAha cAhuMdA he ki tuhADI taubA nUM kabUla kare, praMtU jihar3e lokI ApaNIAM icchAvAM de picche lagge hoe hana uha cAhuMde hana ki tusIM hakka toM dUra ho jAo|
allAha tuhADe (gunAhAM de) bhAra nUM (muAfI de ke) halakA karanA cAhuMdA he| manukkha nUM bahuta hI kamaz2ora paidA kItA giA he|

he ImAna vAlio! tusIM ika dUje dA mAla nA-jAiz2a DhaMga nAla nA khAo, sagoM ApasI raz2AmaMdI nAla laiNa-deNa karo ate ana-hakkA ApaNe Apa nUM katala (AtamA hattiA) nA karo,[5] bezakka allAha tuhADe ’te bahuta miharabAna he|
translations.footnotes:
[5] Atama hattiA dI hadIsa anusAra karar3I saz2A he| jisa viakatI ne isalAma toM chuTTa kise hora dharama dI jANa bujha ke jhUThI kasama khAdhI tAM uha ajihA he jiveM uha kahiMdA he je usa ne kihA ki je uha galla iMja nA hovo tAM maiM yahUdI hAM tAM uha hakIkata vica yahUdI hI he je uha ApaNI galla vica jhUThA he ate jisa viakatI ne ApaNe Apa nUM tez2a hathiAra nAla mAra liA tAM use hathiAra nAla naraka vica az2Aba huMdA rahegA| nabI karIma sa: dA faramAna he ika viakatI z2aqhamI ho giA usa ne taMga A ke Atama hattiA kara laI tAM allAha ne faramAiA ki mere baMde ne marana vica chetI kItI bhAva uha sabara nahIM kara sakiA ki maiM usa dI jAna kaDDhadA ate usa dI mauta haMdI sagoM usa ne qhudakuzI (Atama hattiA) kara laI maiM usa laI jaMnata nUM harAma kara dittA he| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 1363-1364)
* Apa sa: ne faramAiA ki jo viakatI ApaNA galA ghuTTa ke ApaNe Apa nUM mAradA he uha sadA laI naraka vica ApaNA galA ghuTTadA rahegA ate jihar3A koI ApaNe Apa nUM kise hathiAra dIAM saTTAM nAla katala karegA, uha naraka vica ApaNe Apa nUM sadA saTTAM mAradA rahegA| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 1365)

translations.translation: jihar3A viakatI dhakke nAla te z2ulama rAhIM ajihe (nA-faramAnI vAle) kaMma karegA asIM usa nUM chetI hI naraka dI agga vica suTTa devAMge ate iMja karanA allAha laI bahuta hI saukhA he|

jekara tusIM uhanAM vaDDe gunAhAM toM bacade rahoge jinhAM toM tuhAnUM rokiA giA he tAM asIM tuhADe choTe-choTe gunAhAM nUM tuhAthoM dUra kara devAMge [6] ate tuhAnUM iz2z2ata mAna vAlI thAM (savaraga) vica dAqhala karAMge|
translations.footnotes: [6] isa Aita vica gunAhe kabIrA (mahAM pApa) toM bacana dI hidAita kItI gaI he| vekho sUrata Ale-imarAna, hAzIA Aita 130\\ 3

translations.translation: tusIM uhanAM cIz2AM dI kAmanA nA karo jinhAM kArana allAha ne tuhADe viccoM kise nUM kise de mukAbale vica vadhere dittA hoiA he| jo purazAM ne kamAiA he usa kamAI vica uhanAM dA hissA he (bhAva uhI hakkadAra hana) ate auratAM dA hakka usa kamAI vica he jo uhanAM ne kamAiA he| tusIM allAha toM hI usa de faz2alAM laI duAvAM maMgade raho| bezakka allAha hara (viakatI dI lor3a dIAM) cIz2AM nUM jANana vAlA he|

mAtA pitA jAM ner3ale rizatedAra jo vI mAla chaDDa jANa usa virase vica asIM (allAha ne rizate anusAra) hareka nUM vArasa baNAiA he| jinhAM nAla tusIM ikarAra kItA hoiA he, uhanAM nUM uhanAM dA hissA dio| bezakka allAha hara galla dA gavAha he|

maradAM nUM auratAM ’te hukama calAuNa dA isa laI adhIkAra he ki allAha ne uhanAM viccoM ika nUM dUje de mukAbale agge rakkhiA he| uha isa laI ki uha (marada) ApaNe mAla viccoM uhanAM ’te qharaca karade hana| jo patanIAM neka te AgiAkArI huMdIAM hana uha ApaNe patI de piTTha picche allAha dI nigarAnI heTha uhanAM dI (hara pakkho) rAkhI karadIAM hana| ate jinhAM patanIAM dI nA-faramAnI jAM sarakazI dA tuhAnU Dara hove tusIM uhanAM nUM samajhAo (je nA samajhaNa tAM) uhanAM dA paiNA soNA vakkha kara dio (je phera vI nA samajhaNa) uhanAM nUM halakI saz2A devo| (praMtU mUMha ’te nA mAro) je uha AgiAkArI baNa jANa tAM uhanAM nUM taMga karana de bahAne nA labbho| bezakka allAha vaDDI vaDiAI vAlA te sarava-ucca he|

jekara tuhAnUM (rizatedArAM nUM) patI patanI de ApasI saMbaMdhA vica kise aNabaNa hoNa dA Dara hove tAM ika munasifa (paMca) patI valloM te ika munasifa patanI de rizatedArAM valloM niyata karo, je uha doveM sulAha karavAuNA cAhuMde hana tAM allAha dovAM (patI-patanI) dA milApa karA devegA| bezakka allAha (hara prakAra dA) giAna rakkhaNa vAlA te (hAlAta toM) bA-qhabara he|

tusIM sAre allAha dI ibAdata karo ate usa de nAla kise hora nUM zarIka nA baNAo, mAM bApa nAla nekI vAlA varatAo karo, rizatedArAM, yatImAM, muthAjAM, ner3e de sAthI (dosatAM), guAMDI ate opare guvAMDI, ner3e de sAthI, rAhIM-musAfara ate jihar3e tuhADe g2ulAma te bAMdIAM (ate gharelU nokara) hana uhanAM sabha nAla nekI karo| bezakka allAha seqhI khora ate ghamaMDI nUM pasaMda nahIM karadA|

uha loka vI allAha nUM nahIM bhAuMde jihar3e loka Apa vI kaMjUsI karade hana te dUjiAM nUM vI kaMjUsI karana laI Akhade hana, jo kujjha allAha ne uhanAM nUM ApaNe faz2alAM (mAla dolata) nAla navAz2iA hoiA he usa nUM lako laiMde hana| asIM uhanAM kAfirAM (nA-zukare) laI z2alIla karana vAlA az2Aba tiAra kara rakkhiA he |[7]
translations.footnotes: [7] nabI karIma sa: dA faramAna he ki koI vI ajihA dina nahIM jadoM do farizate dharatI ’te uttara ke iha duA nA karade hoNa ki he allAha! tere rAha vica qharaca karana vAle nUM usa dA badalA de ate dUjA duA karadA he ki he allAha! kaMjUsI karana vAle dA mAla barabAda kara| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 1442)

translations.translation: uha loka vI allAha nUM nA-pasaMda hana jihar3e loka ApaNA mAla loka-vikhAve laI qharaca karade hana ate uha allAha ate kiAmata vAle dina utte ImAna nahIM rakkhade| uhanAM dA sAthI zaitAna he ate iha sabha toM bhair3A sAthI he|

bhalA uhanAM lokAM dA kI vigar3a jAMdA, je uha allAha ate kiAmata de dina utte ImAna lai AuMde? ate jo mAla allAha ne uhanAM nUM dittA he, usa vico qharaca karade alAhha uhanAM lokAM nUM caMgI tarhAM jANadA he|
bezakka allAha kise ’te vI bhorA bhara z2ulama nahIM karadA [8] ate je kise ne koI ika nekI kItI hove tAM usa nUM dUNA kara diMdA he ate ApaNe valloM vizeza badalA pradAna karadA he|
translations.footnotes: [8] bhAva hara viakatI nUM use kaMma dA badalA milegA jihar3A usa ne kItA hovegA jiveM ika hadIsa toM sapazaTa huMdA he| haz2arata abU-saIda ra:a: dassade hana ki nabI karIma sa: dI sevA vica kujjha loka hAz2ara hoe ate pucchiA, he allAha de rasUla! kI kiAmata dihAr3e asIM ApaNe rabba nUM vekhAMge? nabI sa: ne faramAiA hAM! bezakka vekhoge| kI tuhAnUM dupahira vele jadoM akAza dI rozanI sAfa huMdI he baddala nA hoNa tAM kI sUraja vekhaNa vica koI takalIfa huMdI he? uhanAM ne kihA ki nahIM, phera nabI karIma sa: ne faramAiA ki caudavIM dI rAta nUM jadoM akAza dI rauzanI sAfa hove, baddala nA hoNa tAM kI caMna vekhaNa vica koI takalIfa haMdI he? tAM uhanAM ne kihA nahIM, phera nabI sa: ne faramAiA ise tarhAM tuhAnUM kiAmata de dina ApaNe allAha nUM vekhaNa vica vI koI ar3IkA nahIM laggegA jiveM sUraja jAM caMna de vekhaNa vica nahIM huMdI| fera faramAiA ki kiAmata de dina ika hoke lAuNa vAlA bulAvegA ki he loko! jihar3A jisa dI pUjA karadA sI use de nAla calA jAve| phera allAha toM chuTTa dUje izaTAM nUM pUjaNa vAliAM viccoM koI nahIM rahegA| uha sAre ApaNe izaTAM nAla naraka vica cale jANage| = = allAha nUM pUjaNa vAle hI rahi jANage ihanAM vica caMge mAr3e sabha tarhAM de musalamAna hoNage ate ahale kitAba de kujjha loka rahi jANage| ahale kitAba vica pahilAM yahUdIAM nUM bulAiA jAvegA uhanAM toM pucchiA jAvegA ki tusIM kisa cIz2a dI ibAdata karade sI? uha javAba deNage ki asIM haz2arata uz2aira jo ki allAha de puttara sI uhanAM dI pUjA karade sI, tAM uhanAM nUM kihA jAvegA ki tusIM jhUTha bolade ho kiuM jo nA tAM allAha dI koI patanI he ate nA hI koI puttara he, phera uhanAM nUM puchiA jAvegA ki huNa tusIM kI cAhuMde ho? tAM uha AkhaNage ki he pAlaNahAra! sADA piAsa nAla burA hAla he sAnUM kujjha pINa laI dittA jAve tAM uhanAM nUM izArA kItA jAvegA ki usa ghATa ’te jA ke piAsa bujhA lavoM jadoM ki uha asala vica agga valla dhakke jANage ate uha agga iMja dikhAI devegI jisa tarhAM mArUthala jisa nUM dupahira vele dUra toM vekhiA jAve tAM pANI vAMga laggadA he ate jisa dA kujjha bhAga hI kujjha nUM kucala rihA hove tAM uha usa agga vica hI gira jANage| yahUdIAM toM bAada IsAIAM nUM bulAiA jAvegA ate uhanAM nUM puchiੱA jAvegA ki tusIM kisa dI pUjA karade sI? tAM uha AkhaNage ki haz2arata IsA dI joki allAha de puttara sI tAM uhanAM nUM kihA jAvegA ki tusIM jhUTha bolade ho allAha taAlA dI koI patanI he hI nahIM| phera uhanAM toM pucchiA jAvegA ki tusIM kI cAhaMde ho? tAM uha vI uhIo kahiNage jo yahUdIAM ne kihA sI ate uha vI aiveM hI naraka vica suTTe jANage huNa maidAna vica kevala uhIo loka rahi jANage jihar3e kevala rabba dI hI ibAdata kariA karade sana| ihanAM vica caMge mAr3e sAre hI hoNage usa sameM allAha ika zakala vica pragaTa hovegA jihar3I usa pahilI zakala vAMga hovegI jihar3I uha pahilAM vekha cukke sana uhanAM nUM kihA jAvegA ki tusIM kisa dI uDIka kara rahe ho? hara TolA ApaNe izaTa nAla calA jAvegA jisa dI uha ibAdata karade sana tAM uha AkhaNage ki saMsAra vica asIM ihanAM kurAhe pae lokAM toM alagga rahe asIM ihanAM dA sAtha nahIM dittA asIM tAM ApaNe sacce izaTa dI uDIka kara rahe hAM jisa dI asIM ibAdata kariA karade sana| usa sameM pAlaNahArA faramAegA maiM hI tuhADA rabba hAM tAM uha iMja tiMna vAra AkhaNage ki asIM allAha de nAla kise nUM zarIka nahIM baNAuMde| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 4581)

translations.translation: usa sameM uhanAM (kAfirAM) dA hAla kI hovegA? jadoM hareka ummata viccoM ika gavAha liAvAMge ate isa ummata utte tuhAnUM (muhaMmada sa:) nUM gavAha baNAvAMge|

usa dina (kiAmata vele) (rabba de) inakArI ate rasUla de nA-faramAna iha icchA karanage ki kAza! uhanAM nUM dharatI de barAbara hI paddhara kara dittA jAMdA (bhAva puccha-giccha nA huMdI) ate uha (usa dina) allAha toM koI vI galla lukA nahIM sakaNage|

he ImAna vAlio! jadoM tusIM naze dI hAlata vica hovo tAM namAz2a de ner3e vI nA jAo jadoM taka ki tusIM ApaNI (kahI hoI) galla nU nA samajho (namAz2a nA par3ho) ate nA hI nA pAkI dI hAlata vica (namAz2a par3ho), jadoM tIka ki tusIM izanAna (g2usala) nA kara lao| hAM! je tusIM rasate (safara) vica hovoM, g2usala karanA saMbhava nA hove, tAM galla vakkharI he| jekara tusIM bImAra ho jAM safara vica ho jAM tuhADe viccoM koI TaTTI pizAba karake AiA hove jAM tusIM ApaNIAM (patanIAM) nAla zarIraka mela milApa kItA hove ate tuhAnUM (g2usala laI) pANI nA mile tAM pAka miTTI nAla tiyAmuma kara lao ate isa (miTTI ’te hattha mAra ke miTTI libar3e hatthAM) nUM ApaNe mUMha te hatthAM utte phera liA karo|[9] bezakka allAha bhullAM hoNa te naramI karana vAlA te baqhazaNahAra he|
translations.footnotes: [9] namAz2a adA karana laI vaz2U karanA z2arUrI he para je pANI nA mile jAM koI bImAra hove tAM miTTI toM tayammuma karake namAz2a par3hI jA sakadI he usa dA tarIkA he ki ika vAra hatthAM nUM dharatI ’te jAM kise pAka miTTI de ror3e ’te mAro ate doveM hatthAM nUM ika dUje ’te fero phera ApaNe cihare ’te phera lavo nabI karIma sa: ne faramAiA ki dovAM hathelIAM ate cihare laI hatthAM nUM ika vAra hI miTTI ’te mAranA he| (sunana abU-dAUda, hadIsa: 327)

translations.translation: kI tusIM uhanAM lokAM nUM nahIM vekhiA jinhAM nUM rabbI kitAba dA thor3hA jihA bhAga dittA giA sI? uha loka gumarAhI de qharIdAra hana ate iha vI cAhuMde hana ki tusIM vI siddhI rAha toM bhaTaka jAo|
allAha tuhADe duzamanAM nUM bhalI-bhAMta jANadA he, ate allAha dA sAtha hoNA ate usa dI madada hI (mominAM laI) batherI he|

yahUdIAM viccoM kujjha loka uha vI hana jihar3e zabadAM nUM uhanAM de asala TikANe (bhAva arathAM) toM badala diMde hana| uha ApaNIAM jIbhAM nUM tor3a maror3a ke sacce dharama (isalAma) viruddha kaTAqha karade hoe nabI sa: nUM Akhade hana ki “asIM suNa liA he para asIM maMnade nahIM” ate Akhade hana “suNo ki tusIM isa yoga nahIM ho ki tuhAthoM suNiA jAve” ate Apa jI (bhAva nabI sa:) nUM saMbodhana karade hoe Akhade hana ‘rAinA’[10] (bhAva he sADe caravAhe!) je uha iha Akhade ki “asIM suNiA te asIM pAlaNA vI kItI” ate Akhade ki “sADI benatI suNo te sADe valla dhiAna dio” tAM iha kahiNA uhanAM laI vadhere ucita sI| kiuM jo allAha ne uhanAM dI avagiAkI kArana uhanAM ’te fiTakAra pAI he, isa laI chuTTa kujjha ika lokAM toM uha ImAna nahIM liAuMde|
translations.footnotes: [10] rAinA dA aratha sADe valla dhiAna deNA he jadoM koI galla samajha vica nA Ave tAM usa sameM isa zabada dI varatoM karake bolaNa vAle dA dhiAna ApaNe valla karanA huMdA he| para yahUdI IrakhA kArana isa zabada nUM vigAr3a ke varatoM vica liAuMde sana, jisa kArana isa de aratha hI badala jAMde sI, jiveM uha rAinA zabada nUM vigAr3a ke rAInA Akhade sI jisa dA aratha he, he sADe caravAhe| jo ki bevakUfa dI thAM boliA jAMdA he isa zabada dI thAM musalamAnAM nUM unaz2uranA zabada dI varatoM karana dI hidAita dittI gaI|

translations.translation: he ahile kitAba! jo vI asIM (.kuraAna) nAz2ila kItA he usa ’te ImAna liAo uha usa dI vI puzaTI karadA he jo tuhADe kola mojUda he| tusIM isa (.kuraAna) ’te ImAna lai Aou[11] isa toM pahilAM ki asIM (allAha) tuhADe cihare vigAr3a daIe ate uhanAM ` pi=ThAM va=la phera daIe jAM ihanAM ’te iMja lAanatAM bhejIe jiveM ki asIM ‘sabata vAliAM’ ’te lAanatAM bhejIAM sana| yAda ra=kho ki allAha dA hukama aTala huMdA ru|
translations.footnotes: [11] iha Aita yahUdIAM te IsAIAM laI ika citAvanI sAmAna he isa vica uhanAM laI iha lAz2amI he ki uha haz2arata muhaMmada sa: dI rasAlata ate kuraAna te ImAna dI sikkhiAvAM utte ImAna lai AuNa phera uhanAM dA ImAna kabUla kItA jAvegA nahIM tAM radda ho jAvegA| vekho sUrata Ale-imarAna, Aita 85, 116 /3

translations.translation: bezakka allAha ziraka (rabba nAla sAMjhI) karana vAliAM nUM kade nahIM baqhazadA, isa (gunAha) toM chuTTa jisa nUM vI cAhuMdA he baqhaza diMdA he| jisa ne vI allAha de nAla kise hora nUM zarIka baNAiA usa ne bahuta hI vaDDA jhUTha ghar3hiA ate bahuta vaDDA gunAha kItA|[12]
translations.footnotes: [12] nabI karIma sa: dA faramAna ru ki jisa nUM sabha toM ghaTa saz2A dittI jAvegI, usa toM allAha pucchegA, “je tere kola dharatI de barAbara mAla huMdA tAM kI tUM usa nUM ApaNI jAna baqhazavAuNa laI badale vica de diMdA? ” tAM uha kahegA, “hAM! iho merI icchA he|” phera allAha faramAegA, “maiM tAM isa toM saukhI galla dI tethoM maMga kItI sI, jada tUM Adama dI piTTha vica hI sI ki tUM mere nAla kise nUM zarIka nA baNAI, para tUM nahIM maMniA ate ziraka karana utte ar3iA rihA| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 3334)

translations.translation: (he nabI!) kI tusIM usa nUM nahIM vekhiA jihar3A ApaNI pavittaratA dI Apa hI prazaMsA karadA he? jada ki allAha jisa nUM cAhuMdA he usa viakatI (de mana) nUM pavittara karadA he (kiAmata dihAr3e) kise ’te vI ratA z2ulama nahIM kItA jAvegA|
vekho tAM sahI iha (yahUdI) loka allAha utte kiveM jhUThIAM gallAM mar3ha rahe hana, ihanAM dIAM iho (harakatAM) sapazaTa rUpa vica uhanAM nUM pApI siddha karana laI batherIAM hana|

kI tusIM uhanAM (yahUdIAM) nUM nahIM vekhiA jinhAM nUM kitAba de giAna dA kujjha hissA dittA giA sI? (huNa uhanAM dA iha hAla he ki) uha loka butAM ate tAg2Uta [13] (zaitAnAM) utte bharosA rakkhade hana ate kAfirAM bAre Akhade hana ki iha loka tAM ImAna vAliAM toM kIte vaddha siddhe rasate utte hana|
translations.footnotes: [13] tAg2Uta toM bhAva jhUThe izaTa hana| bhAva hara uha cIz2a, chuTTa allAha toM jisa dI ibAdata kItI jAve jAM bharosA kItA jAve jAM madada maMgI jAve, uha tAg2Uta he, para saMsArika kaMmAM vica kise dI madada karanA isa vica zAmila nahIM, kiuM jo bhalAI de kaMmAM vica sahiyoga deNA ate bure kaMmAM vica sAtha nA deNA zarIata dA hukama he| vekho hAzIA sUrata ala-bakaraha, Aita 257 \\2

translations.translation: iho uha loka hana jinhAM nUM allAha ne fiTakAriA he ate jisa kise nUM allAha hI fiTakAra deve phira tusIM usa dA koI vI sahAI nahIM vekhoge|
kI rAja sattA vica uhanAM (de jhUThe izaTAM) dA koI hissA he? (je iMja huMdA) tAM iha kise nUM ika kANI koDI vI nA diMde|

kI iha lokAM toM isa laI IrakhA rakkhade hana ki allAha ne ApaNe phaz2alAM nAla unAM nUM nivAz2iA hoiA he? so asIM tAM ibarAhIma dI saMtAna nUM kitAba (tauraita, iMjIla) dittI te sUjha-bUjha pradAna kItI ate bahuta vaDDA rAja pATa vI baqhaziA sI|
phera uhanAM viccoM kujjha lokAM ne tAM (kitAba de hukamAM) nUM maMniA ate kujjha (kahiNA maMNana toM) ruka gae| uhanAM laI naraka dI bhar3akadI hoI agga hI batherI he |[14]
translations.footnotes: [14] allAha taAlA dIAM nAz2ila kItIAM hoIAM kitAbAM utte ImAna liAuNA ImAna dI muDhalI zarata he| vekho sUrata Ale-imarAna, hAzIA Aita 85/3

translations.translation: jinhAM lokAM ne sADIAM (rabba dIAM) AitAM (AdezA) dA inakAra kItA uhanAM nUM chetI hI asIM (naraka dI) agga vica suTAMge jadoM (agga vica) uhanAM de sarIra dIAM camar3IAM sar3ha jANagIAM tAM asIM uhanAM dI camar3I nUM dUjI camar3I nAla badala devAMge tAM jo uha az2Aba dA suAda laiMde rahiNa| bezakka allAha DhADI samarathA rakkhadA he ate hikamata vAlA he|

ate jihar3e loka ImAna liAe ate uhanAM ne neka te bhale kaMma vI kIte asAM uhanAM nUM chetI hI uhanAM savaragAM vica lai jAvAMge, jinhAM de heTha nahirAM vagadIAM hana, jitthe uha sadA laI rahiNage| utthe uhanAM laI pavittara patanIAM hoNagIAM| asIM uhanAM (patanIAM)nUM vI saMghaNI chAM vica lai jAvAMge| [15]
translations.footnotes: [15] nabI karIma sa: ne faramAiA, jaMnata vica ika ajihA daraqhata vI he jisa dI chAiA vica je savAra caladA rahe tAM sau sAlA taka callaNa ’te vI usa dI chAiA qhatama nahIM hovegI| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 3251)

translations.translation: allAha tuhAnUM hukama diMdA he ki amAnatAM nUM uhanAM de hakkadArAM de havAle karo ate jadoM (lokAM vicAle) faisalA karo tAM inasAfa vAlA faisalA karo| uha galla bahuta hI vadhIA he jisa dI nasIhata allAha tuhAnUM kara rihA he| bezakka allAha tuhADIAM sArIAM gallAM suNadA he ate sAre kaMma vekha rihA he|

he ImAna vAlio! tusIM allAha ate usa de rasUla de hukamAM dI pAlaNA karo ate tuhADe viccoM jihar3e (allAha ate rasUla haz2arata muhaMmada sa: de AgiAkArI) hAkama hana uhanAM dI AgiA dI pAlaNA karo| phera jekara tuhADA kise galla ’te Apasa vica koI matabheda ho jAve tAM usa nUM (faisale laI) allAha te usa de rasUla valla lai jAo, jekara tusIM sacca-mucca allAha ate kiAmata de dina utte ImAna rakhade ho, matabheda dUra karana dA iho vadhIA tarIkA he ate siTTe pakkhoM vI bahuta hI vadhIA he|

(he nabI!) kI tusIM uhanAM lokAM nUM nahIM vekhiA jinhAM dA dAavA tAM iho he ki jo vI tuhADe ’te utAriA giA (.kuraAna) he ate jo tuhAthoM pahilAM (akAzI kitAbAM) utArIAM gaIAM hana sADA uhanAM sabha ’te ImAna he, praMtU cAhuMde iha hana ki ApaNe faisale zaitAna de celiAM toM karavAuNa jadoM ki uhanAM nUM hukama dittA giA sI ki ajihe zaitAnAM (rabba de bAg2IAM) nUM maMNana toM inakAra karana, jada ki zaitAna tAM iho cAhuMdA he ki ihanAM (mominAM) nUM siddhe rAha toM haTA ke dUra lai jAve|[16]
translations.footnotes: [16] iha te isa toM bAada vAlI Aita uhanAM lokAM de saMbaMdha vica he jihar3e ApaNe mAmale muhaMmada sa: dI adAlata vica nahIM laike jAMde sana, sagoM yahUdIAM jAM kuraiza de saradArAM kola laike jAMde sana| so isa dA hukama Ama he ajja isa vica uha sAre loka zAmila hana jihar3e kuraAna te sunnata nUM chaDDa ke ApaNe faisale dUjiAM toM karavAuMde hana|

translations.translation: jadoM ihanAM nUM kihA jAMdA ki allAha valloM utAre hoe.kuraAna valla ate rasUla (muhaMmada sa: de AdezAM) valla Ao tAM tusIM vekhoge ki iha munAfika tuhADe valla AuNa toM kaMnI katarAuMde hana|

phera usa sameM kI hAla huMdA he jadoM ihanAM de ApaNe hatthIM saher3I hoI musIbata ihanAM ’te A paiMdI he? tAM phera tuhADe kola A ke (allAha dIAM kasamAM khAMde hoe) Akhade hana ki rabba dI suMha sADA irAdA tAM kevala bhalAI te ApasI mela-jola karavAuNA sI|

iha uha loka hana ki jinhAM de dilAM de bheta allAha bhalI-bhAMta jANadA he ki ihanAM de dilAM vica kI he? (isa laI he nabI!) tusIM ihanAM dIAM gallAM valla dhiAna nA dio ate ihanAM nUM ajihIAM nasIhatAM karo jihar3IAM ihanAM de dilAM nUM prabhAvita karana|

asIM hareka rasUla nUM kevala ise laI bhejiA ki allAha de hukamAM anusAra uhanAM dI tAbedArI kItI jAve| jadoM ihanAM lokAM ne ApaNIAM jAnAM ’te z2ulama kItA sI je uha tuhADe kola A jAMde ate allAha toM ApaNe gunAhAM dI muAfI maMgade ate rasUla vI uhanAM laI muAfI laI benatI karadA tAM iha loka allAha nUM muAfa karana vAlA ate bahuta hI miharabAnI karana vAlA vekhade|

(he nabI!) kasama he tuhADe pAlaNahAra dI! iha loka udoM taka momina nahIM ho sakade jadoM taka ki ApaNe Apo vicAle matabhedAM vica tuhAnUM hI hAkama nahIM maMna laiMde, phera jo vI faisalA tusIM karo usa laI ApaNe dila vica kise prakAra dI koI taMgI mahisUsa nA karana, sagoM khir3e matthe mana toM kabUla karana|

jekara asIM uhanAM laI (banI isarAIla vAMga) faraz2a kara diMde ki ApaNe Apa nUM katala kara dio jAM ApaNe gharAM toM nikala jAo, tAM ihanAM viccoM bahuta hI ghaTTa loka kahiNA maMnade| jekara uha uhIo kaMma karade jisa laI uhanAM nUM nasIhata dittI jAMdI he tAM iha uhanAM laI vadhere caMgI galla sI ate (dharama vica) drir3atA dA kArana huMdA|
je uha ajihA karade tAM uhanAM nUM ApaNe valloM bahuta vaDDA badalA (dunIAM te Aqhirata dI bhalAI) diMde|
ate lAz2amana uhanAM nUM siddhe rAha tora diMde|

ate jihar3e lokI allAha ate (usa de) rasUla (sa:) dI tAbedArI karanage uha (kiAmata vAle dina) uhanAM lokAM nAla hoNage jinhAM nUM allAha ne inAma baqhaze hana, jiveM nabI, saciAre, zahIda ate suhaNe amalAM vAle loka hana, (jaMnata vica) iho sabha toM vadhIA ika dUje de sAthI hoNage|
iha faz2ala (miharAM) allAha valloM hana| saccAI nUM jANana laI allAha dA giAna hI batherA he|
he momino! tusIM (ApaNe bacAo dA sAmAna bhAva hathiAra) cukkIM rakkho, fera tusIM bhAveM aDDa-aDDa dasatiAM vica bhAveM ikaTThe ho ke (jihAda laI) nikkalo|

tuhADe viccoM lAz2amana kujjha uha vI hana jihar3e rabba dI rAha nikkalaNa vica TAla maTola karade hana phera je tuhADe ’te koI musIbata AuMdI he tAM Akhade hana ki allAha ne sADe ’te bar3I mihara kItI he ki asIM (lar3AI vica) uhanAM nAla nahIM sI|

phera je tuhAnUM allAha valloM koI mihara kripA (lar3AI vica jitta) mila jAve tAM iMja laggadA he jiveM tuhADe te usa vicAle koI mela milApa (rizatA) huMdA hI nahIM te Akhade hana ki “kAza mai vI uhanAM (mominAM nAla lar3AI vica) zAmala huMdA tAM maiM vI safalatA prApata karadA”|

uha loka jihar3e praloka de badale saMsArika jIvana nUM veca cukke hana uhanAM nUM allAha dI rAha vica lar3aNA (jihAda karanA) cAhIdA he ate jihar3A allAha dI rAha vica lar3adA hoiA mAriA jAve (zahIda ho jAve) jAM jitta prApata kare usa nUM asIM chetI hI vaDDA badalA devAMge|

(he musalamAno!) tuhAnUM kI ho giA he ki tusIM allAha dI rAha vica uhanAM kamaz2ora te bevasa maradAM, auratAM ate choTe-choTe bacciAM laI nahIM lar3ade? jo benatIAM kara rahe hana ki he sADe rabbA! sAnUM ihanAM z2AlamAM dI basatI viccoM kaDDha lai ate sADe laI ApaNe valloM koI himAitI te sahAika baNA ke bheja|

jihar3e loka ImAna rakkhade hana uha allAha dI rAha vica lar3ade hana ate jinhAM ne kufara kItA he uha tAg2Uta[17] (zaitAna) dI rAha vica lar3ade hana| isa laI tusIM (ImAna vAlio) zaitAna de himAitIAM nAla jaMga karo, vizavAsa rakkho ki zaitAna dIAM cAlAM bahuta hI kamaz2ora hana|
translations.footnotes: [17] vekho sUrata Ale-imarAna, hAzIA Aita 51/3

translations.translation: (he nabI!) kI tusIM uhanAM lokAM nUM nahIM vekhiA jinhAM nUM hukama dittA giA sI ki ApaNe hattha (lar3AI toM) rokIM rakkho, namAz2AM par3hade raho ate z2akAta adA karo| phera jadoM uhanAM nUM lar3AI dA hukama dittA giA tAM usa vele uhanAM viccoM ika TolI kAfirAM toM iMja DaraNa lagga paI jiddAM allAha toM DaradI hovo, sagoM usa toM vI kujjha vaddha bhai-bhIta sI ate kahiNa lagge ki “he rabba! sADe utte jihAda karanA faraz2a kiੳM.kItA he? kioM nA sAnUM thor3hI hora jiuNa dI mohalata dittI nUM” (he nabI!) ihanAM nUM Akha dio ki “saMsArika lAbha tAM bahuta hI thor3hA he ate rabba toM Darana vAliAM laI tAM praloka hI vadhere caMgI he ate (usa dina) tuhADe utte ika dhAge barAbara (bhAva bhorA bhara) vI z2ulama nahIM kItA jAvegA|”

(rahi gaI mauta) tusIM jitthe kIte vI hovoge ੳੱ.the hI mauta tuhAnUM nappa lavegI bhAveM tusIM kiMne vI maz2abUta kiilaAM vica kiuM nA hovo| je uhanAM nUM koI lAbha huMdA he tAM Akhade hana ki iha allAha valloM he praMtU je koI hAnI huMdI he tAM kahiMde hana ki (he nabI!) iha tuhADe kArana he (isa laI tusIM) ihanAM (munAfikAM) he kahi dio ki iha sabha kujjha (ghATA-vAdhA) allAha valloM hI he| ihanAM lokAM nUM kI ho giA he ki koI galla samajhade hI nahIM?

he loko! tuhAnUM jihar3I vI bhalAI prApata huMdI he uha sabha allAha valloM hI he ate jihar3I burAI palle paiMdI he uha tuhADIAM ApaNIAM karanIAM kArana he| (he nabI!) asIM tuhAnUM sAre hI lokAM laI rasUla baNA ke ghalliA he ate isa laI allAha dI gavAhI kAfI he|

jisa ne vI rasUla (haz2arata muhaMmada sa:) dI tAbedArI kItI usa ne allAha dI tAbedArI[18] kItI jihar3A (nabI dI tAbedArI toM) mukkha mor3egA (tAM uha mor3a lave) (he nabI) asIM tuhAnUM koI pahiredAra baNA ke tAM nahIM ghalliA|
translations.footnotes: [18] abU-hurairA ra:a: dassade hana ki nabI karIma sa: ne faramAiA jisa ne merI atAata (AgiAkArI) kItI usa ne allAha dI AgiAkArI kItI jisa ne merI nA-faramAnI kItI usa ne allAha dI nA-faramAnI kItI aiveM hI jisa ne mere valloM niyata kIte hAkama dI atAata kItI usa ne merI atAata kItI ate jisa ne usa dI nA-faramaranI kItI, usa ne merI nA-faramAnI kItI| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 7137)

translations.translation: iha (munAfika) kahiMde hana, ki sADA kaMma tAM faramAMbaradArI karanA he, praMtU jadoM tuhADe koloM (he nabI!) uTTha AuMde hana tAM ihanAM viccoM hI ika TolA rAta nUM ikaTThiAM ho ke tuhADIAM kahIAM hoIAM gallAM de viruddha salAha mazavare karadA he| uhanAM dIAM ihanAM rAta dIAM sAz2izAM nUM allAha likkha rihA he| so tusIM uhanAM dI paravAha nA karo ate allAha utte bharosA rakkho, allAha hI sAre kAraja savAraNa vAlA he|
kI iha (munAfika te kAfira).kuraAna ’te soca vicAra nahIM karade? jekara iha allAha toM chuTTa kise hora valloM huMdA tAM isa vica bahuta kujjha matabheda vekhaNa nUM milade|

jadoM ihanAM (munAfikAM) lokAM nUM koI amana zAMtI jAM Dara khaufa (nukasAna) vAlIM qhabara miladI he iha usa nUM phailA diMde hana jadoM ki je iha loka (ise qhabara nUM) rasUla jAM ApaNe viccoM hI kise z2iMmevArAM tIka pahuMcA diMde jihar3e usa de ThIka-ThAka natIje tIka pahuMcaNa dI yogatA rakkhade hana tAM usa dI asalIata patA cala jAMdI ate jekara allAha dA faz2ala ate usa dIAM miharAM tuhADe ’te nA huMdIAM tAM tuhADe viccoM kujjha ika lokAM toM chuTTa sAre hI zaitAna de picche lagga jAMde|

so (he nabI!) tusIM allAha dI rAha vica (z2Alama te kAfirAM virrudha) lar3ade raho, tuhAnUM ApaNI z2Ata toM chuTTa kise hora laI z2iMmevAra nahIM baNAiA giA| hAM! ImAna vAliAM nUM lar3aNa laI avazza prerita karo, ho sakadA he ki allAha kAfirAM nUM jaMga toM roka deve| allAha lar3AI vica vI saqhata he ate saz2A deNa vica vI saqhata he|

jihar3A vI koI bhalAI jAM neka kaMmAM dI sifAraza karegA usa nUM usa viccoM hissA milegA ate jihar3A burAI te mAr3e kaMmAM dI sifAraza karegA usa laI use vica hissA he ate allAha hareka cIz2a ’te ApaNI pakar3a rakkhadA he|
ate jadoM koI tuhAnUM salAma kare tAM usa nUM vadhIA DhaMga nAla javAba dio jAM (ghaTTo-ghaTTa) use tarhAM de zabadAM nUM duharA devo|[19] bezakka allAha hareka galla dA hisAba laiNa vAlA he|
translations.footnotes: [19] hadIsa vica he ki nabI karIma sa: ne faramAiA “allAha ne Adama nUM usa dI zakala vica paidA kItA uhanAM dA kadda saTTha hattha sI|” jadoM allAha ne uhanAM nUM paidA kara dittA tAM AkhiA uha farizatiAM dI ika TolI baiThI he, jAke uhanAM nUM salAma karo ate suNo jo uha kahiMde hana, phera uhIo tere ate terI aulAda dA salAma hovegA tAM haz2arata Adama ne farizatiAM nUM kihA “assalAmu alaikuma” tAM uhanAM ne javAba dittA “assalAmu alaikama varahamatullAha”| iMja uhanAM ne zabada “rahamatullAha” vadhA ditte| nabI karIma sa: ne faramAiA jihar3A vI jaMnata vica jAvegA tAM uha haz2arata Adama varagA saTTha hattha laMmA hovegA ate Adama toM bAada lokAM dA kadda choTA huMdA giA ate iha silasilA aje vI jArI he| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 6227)

translations.translation: allAha uha he jisa toM chuTTa hora koI vI izaTa nahIM| uha tuhAnUM sabha nUM kiAmata vAle dina jamAM karegA jisa de AuNa vica koI zakka nahIM| allAha toM vaddha saccA koNa he?

(he musalamAno!) tuhAnUM kI ho giA he ki munAfikAM bAre tuhADe vicakAra do garoha baNa gae hana? uhanAM (munAfikAM) nUM tAM allAha ne uhanAM dIAM ApaNIA hI karatUtAM kArana puTThA kara chaDDiA he| kI tusIM iha cAhuMde ho ki allAha valloM kurAhe pae hoiAM nUM tusIM siddhe rAha pA dio? para jisa nUM allAha ne hI rAhoM kurAhe pA dittA hove tusIM usa laI koI rasatA nahIM labbha sakade|

ihanAM (munafikAM) dI cAhata tAM iha he ki jiveM uha Apa kAfira hana use tarhAM tusIM vI kufara karana lagga jAo tAM jo tusIM ate uha sabha iko barAbara ho jANa| so jadoM taka iha allAha dI rAha vica hijarata nahIM karade, tusIM ihanAM viccoM kise nUM vI ApaNA mittara nA baNAo, phera jekara uha isa (hijarata) toM mUMha mor3ade hana tAM phera jitthe vI uha tuhADe hattha laggaNa utthe hI uhanAM nUM katala kara dio| qhabaradAra! ihanAM viccoM kise nUM vI ApaNA dosata te sahAI nA baNAo|

kevala uhanAM lokAM nUM isa hukama toM chUTa he jihar3e usa kauma nAla saMbaMdha rakkhade hoNa, jinhAM nAla tuhADI saMdhI ho cukkI he jAM tuhADe kola isa hAlata vica AuNa ki lar3AI toM taMga A cukke hana, uha tuhADe nAla vI lar3aNa toM bacade hana ate ApaNI kauma nAla vIM lar3aNa toM bacade hana| jekara allAha cAhuMdA tAM ihanAM kAfirAM nUM tuhADe ’te bhArU kara diMdA ate phera uha lAz2amana tuhADe nAla jaMga karade, isa laI je iha munAfika loka tuhAthoM kaMnI khANa ate lar3AI karana toM bacaNa ate tuhADe valla sulAha te zAMtI da hattha vadhAuNa tAM allAha ne tuhADe laI uhanAM munAfikAM nAla lar3aNa dI koI rAha nahIM chaDDI|

tuhAnUM kujjha ajihe (munAfika) vI milaNage jihar3e cAhuMde hana ki tuhADe nAla vI zAMtI nAla rahiNa ate ApaNI kauma nAla vI amana nAla rahiNa| praMtU jadoM fasAda karana dA maukA miladA he tAM usa vica kudda paiMde hana| je iha loka tuhADe TAkare toM nahIM rukade ate nA hI tuhADe nAla koI sulAha dI pezakaza karana te nA hI (lar3AI toM) ApaNe hattha rokaNa tAM uha jitthe vI tuhAnUM milaNa uhanAM nUM phar3o ate katala kara dio| iha uha loka hana jinhAM utte (hattha cukkaNa laI) asIM tuhAnUM khullI chUTa dittI he|

kise vI momina laI iha jAiz2a nahIM ki uha dUje momina dA katala kare praMtU je g2alatI jAM bhulekhe vica ho jAve (tAM vakkharI galla he)| je koI viakatI kise musalamAna nUM g2alatI nAla katala kara deve tAM isa laI ika musalamAna g2ulAma Az2Ada karanA ate mritaka de vArasAM nUM katala karana dA fiidayA (aratha-daMDa) deNA lAz2amI he, hAM je vArasa muAfa kara deNa tAM galla vakkharI he| je katala hoNa vAlA viakatI tuhADI duzamana kauma viccoM he, praMtU he uha musalamAna, tAM kevala ika musalAmana g2ulAma nUM Az2Ada karanA z2arUrI he, jekara katala usa kauma de viakatI dA hoiA he jisa nAla tuhADI saMdhI hove tAM (usa de vArasAM nUM) aratha daMDa deNA lAz2amI he ate ika musalamAna g2ulAma nUM Az2Ada karanA vI z2arUrI he phera jisa nUM g2ulAma nA mile usa de z2iMme do mahIniAM de lagAtAra roz2e rakkhaNA z2arUrI he (iha sabha kujjha) allAha toM ApaNe gunAha baqhazavAuNa laI hI he ate allAha (sabha kujjha) jANana vAlA ate dAnAI te sUjha-bUjha vAlA he|

jihar3A vI kise musalamAna nUM jANa bujjha ke katala karadA he usa dI saz2A naraka he, jitthe uha sadA laI rahegA, usa utte allAha dA g2az2aba (karopa) te usa dI lAanata hovegI| allAha ne usa laI vaDDA karar3A az2Aba tiAra kara chaDDiA he|[20]
translations.footnotes: [20] nA-hakkA katala de saMbaMdha vica hadIsa vica dassiA giA he haz2arata abadullA bina umara ra:a: dassade hana ki nabI karIma sa: ne faramAiA “musalamAna dIna de muAmale vica usa sameM taka zAMtamaI tarIke anusAra amala karadA he jadoM taka ki uha nA-hakkA katala nA kare|” (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 6862)

translations.translation: he ImAna vAlio! jadoM tusIM allAha dI rAha vica (lar3aNa laI) jA rahe ho tAM mittara te vairI vica faraka kara liA karo, je tuhAnUM koI salAma kare tAM usa nUM iha nA kaho ki tUM tAM ImAna vAlA hI nahIM| je tusIM saMsArika lAbha cAhuMde ho tAM allAha kola tuhADe laI batherIAM g2anImatAM de mAla hana| pahilAM tusIM vI (he musalAmano!) ajihI sathitI vica phase rahi cukke ho| phera allAha ne tuhADe utte ahisAna kItA (tusIM ImAna lai Ae) isa laI tusIM jAMca parakha toM kaMma liA karo| bezakka allAha tuhADe sAre amalAM nUM bhalI-bhAMta jANadA he|

ApaNI dhana dolata te ApaNIAM jAnAM nAla rabba de rAha vica lar3aNa vAle momina ate binAM kise kArana baiTha rahe momina, ika barAbara nahIM ho sakade| allAha ne ApaNe mAlAM te jAnAM nAla lar3aNa vAliAM dA darajA baiThe rahiNa vAliAM nAloM uccA rakkhiA he| bhAveM ki allAha ne hareka (momina) nAla bhalAI dA vAadA kItA hoiA he praMtU jihAda karana vAliAM nUM picche baiThaNa vAliAM nAloM kIte vadhere darajA dittA giA he|
allAha valloM uhanAM laI vaDDe maratabe, baqhazIza te miharAM hana| ate allAha vaDDA baqhazaNahAra te rahima vAlA he|

jihar3e (musalamAna) loka kAfirAM vica rahiMde hoe ApaNe Apa ’te z2ulama karade hana, jadoM farizate uhanAM dI rUha kaDDhade hana tAM pucchade hana ki tusIM itthe kisa hAla vica rahiMde sI? uha uttara diMde hana ki asIM dharatI utte bahuta hI kamaz2ora sAM| (bhAva kujjha nahIM sI kara sakade) farizate Akhade hana, kI allAha dI dharatI vizAla nahIM sI? ki tusIM utthe toM hijarata kara jAMde| iho loka hana, jinhAM dA TikANA naraka he ate uha bahuta hI bhair3A TikANA he|
hAM jihar3e puraza, isatarIAM ate bacce jihar3e vAsatava vica hI bevasa hana, nA hI uhanAM kola nikkalaNa dA koI sAdhana he ate nA hI uhanAM nUM kise rasate dA patA he|
ho sakadA he ki allAha uhanAM (bevasa lokAM) nUM muAfa kara deve| allAha muAfa karana vAlA te vaDDA baqhazaNahAra he|

jihar3A vI allAha dI rAha vica ApaNA ghara bAra chaDDegA usa nUM dharatI ’te rahiNa laI batherIAM thAvAM hana ate (guz2ara vasana laI) pUrI khullha milegI ate je koI ApaNe gharoM hijarata karake allAha ate rasUla valla nikaliA hove phera usa nUM rAha vica hI mauta A jAve tAM usa dA badalA deNA allAha de z2iMme he ate allAha bar3A hI baqhazaNahAra ate miharAM vAlA he|

jadoM tusIM dharatI ’te safara kara rahe hovo tAM tuhADe ’te namAz2AM nUM kasara (saMkhepa) kara laiNa vica koI haraja nahIM, je tuhA` iha Dara hove ki duzamana tuhAnUM taMga karanage tAM vI (kasara) kara sakade ho| bezakka kAfira tAM tuhADe khullhe duzamana hana|

(he nabI!) jadoM tusIM ihanAM (musalamAnAM) vicAle hovo ate (jaMga dI hAlata vica) uhanAM nUM namAz2a par3hAuNa laI khar3he hovo tAM uhanAM dA ika jatthA tuhADe nAla ApaNe hathiArAM sane jamAata nAla A khar3he phera jadoM uha jatthA sijadA kara lave tAM uha tuhADe picche calA jAve phera uha dUjA jatthA jisa ne namAz2a nahIM par3hI uha A jAve ate tuhADe nAla namAz2a adA kare ate ApaNe bacAo laI hathiArAM nUM phar3I rakkhaNa| kAfira tAM iha cAhuMde hana ki jadoM vI tusIM ApaNe hathiArAM te ApaNe sAmAna toM beqhabara hovo tAM uha tuhADe ’te hallA bola deNa| je tuhAnUM bAriza kArana koI takalIfa hove jAM tusIM bImAra ho tAM hatthiAra ika pAse rakkhaNa vica koI gunAha nahIM| para isa hAlata vica vI sAvadhAna raho| allAha ne inakArIAM laI z2alIla karana vAlA az2Aba tiAra kItA hoiA he|

phera jadoM tusIM namAz2a par3ha lavo tAM uTThade, baiThade ate leTe (bhAva hara sameM) allAha nUM yAda karade raho| jadoM tuhAnUM zAMtI mila jAve tAM pUrI namAz2a par3ho| bezakka namAz2a ImAna vAliAM laI sameM dI pAbaMdI nAla faraz2a kItI gaI he|

tusIM ihanAM (duzamanAM) dA picchA karana vica kamaz2orI nA vikhAo, je tuhAnUM kazaTa huMde hana tAM ihanAM nUM vI tuhADI tarhAM kazaTa huMdA he| tusAM allAha toM jisa cIz2a dIAM AsAM rakkhade ho uha AsAM uhanAM (duzamanAM) nUM nahIM| allAha bahuta dAnAI vAlA ate hikamata vAlA he|
