(he nabI!) asIM tuhADe valla hakka de nAla isa kitAba (.kuraAna) nUM utAriA he tAM ki jihar3I siddhI rAha allAha ne tuhAnUM vikhAI he tusIM usa de anusAra hI lokAM vicAle faisale karo ate vizavAsaghAtI lokAM de himAitI nA baNo|
allAha toM qhimA dI benatI[21] karo, bezakka allAha baqhazaNa vAlA te miharAM karana vAlA he|
translations.footnotes: [21] isa Aita de anusAra nabI karIma sa: allAha toM isatag2afAra karade rahiMde sana| haz2arata abU-hurairA ra:a: toM patA laggadA he ki “maiM nabI karIma sa: nUM faramAuMde hoe suNiA he ki allAha dI kasama maiM tAM nita sattara vAra toM vI vaddha allAha toM isatag2afAra ate usa de haz2Ura taubA karadA hAM|” (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 6307)

translations.translation: tusIM uhanAM valloM nA jhagar3o jihar3e ApaNe Apa nAla hI qhiAnata (vizavAsa-ghAta) karade hana, allAha vizavAsa-ghAtI lokAM nUM ukkA hI pasaMda nahIM karadA|

iha (vizavAsa-ghAtI) loka lokAM toM tAM ApaNIAM karatUtAM lukA sakade hana praMtU allAha toM nahIM lukA sakade, uha usa sameM vI uhanAM nAla huMdA he jadoM uha rAtAM nUM luka luka ke ajihe salAha-mazavare karade hana jihar3e allAha nUM pasaMda nahIM| uhanAM dIAM sArIAM karatUtAM nUM usa ne ghere vica lai rakkhiA he|

tusIM lokAM ne saMsArika jIvana vica tAM ihanAM aparAdhIAM valloM jhagar3A kara liA praMtU allAha de agge kiAmata vAle dina uhanAM dI himAita koNa karegA? ate uha kauNa he jihar3A uhanAM dA vakIla hovegA?
jihar3A viakatI koI mAr3e kaMma kare jAM ApaNe Apa utte hI z2ulama kara baiThe, para phera uha allAha toM muAfI laI benatI kare, tAM uha allAha nUM baqhazaNahAra te miharabAna hI pAvegA|
jo koI viakatI gunAha karadA he tAM iha use laI musIbata baNegA| allAha (sAre kIte hoe kaMmAM nUM) jANana vAlA he ate dAnA-siANA he|
ate jisa viakatI ne koI gunAha jAM g2alatI karake usa dA doza kise hora be-gunAha utte thopa dittA usa ne bahuta vaDDI tuhamata ate khullhe pApAM dA bhAra ApaNe sira lai liA|

je (he nabI!) tuhADe utte rabba dI kripA te mihara nA huMdI tAM uhanAM (vizavAsaghAtI) lokAM viccoM ika Tole ne tAM tuhAnUM bhulekhe vica phasA deNa dA faisalA kara hI liA sI| asala vica tAM iha ApaNe Apa nUM hI bhulekhe vica pA rahe hana| iha tuhADA kujjha vI nahIM vigAr3a sakade| allAha ne tuhADe ’te kitAba (.kuraAna) te hikamata (siANapa) utArI he ate tuhAnUM uha sabha kujjha sikhAiA he jisa dA tuhAnUM giAna nahIM sI| allAha dIAM tuhADe utte vaDDIAM miharAM hana|

uhanAM (vizavAsaghAtI) lokAM de Ama karake vadhere mazavariAM (jo tuhAnUM diMde hana) vica koI bhalAI nahIM huMdI, para je koI kise nUM qhairAta (puMna-dAna) jAM nekI de kaMmAM laI jAM lokAM vica sulAha-safAI karavAuNa laI hukama diMdA he (tAM iha vadhIA galla he) ate jihar3A viakatI kevala allAha nUM qhuza karana laI iha sAre kaMmAM karadA he, usa nUM asIM bahuta vaDDA badalA devAMge|

ate jihar3e viakatI utte siddhA rAha sapazaTa ho giA hove phera vI uha rasUla de viruddha kaMma kare ate ImAna vAliAM de rasate nUM chaDDa ke dUjI rAha dI pairavI kare tAM usa nUM asIM (allAha) use valla tora devAMge jisa valla uha jANA cAhuMdA he ate asIM usa nUM naraka vica suTTa devAMge jo ki rahiNa laI sabha toM vaddha bhair3A TikANA he|

bezakka allAha usa de nAla ziraka karana vAle nUM kade vI muAfa nahIM karadA, isa toM chuTTa jisa nUM vI cAhe muAfa kara diMdA he ate jisa ne allAha (dIAM sifatAM) nAla kise nUM zarIka (sAMjhIvAla) ThahirAiA uha gumarAhI vica bahuta dUra nikkala giA|
iha (muzarika) allAha nUM chaDDa ke kevala devIAM nUM hI (ApaNI madada laI) bulAuMde hana| asala vica iha bAgI zaitAna nUM hI pUjade hana|
allAha ne usa (zaitAna) nUM fiTakAriA he ate usa ne kihA hoiA he ki he rabA! maiM tere baMdiAM viccoM ika niyata hissA lai ke rahAMgA|

ate uhanAM nUM kurAhe pAuMdA rahAMgA ate uhanAM nUM (kAmayAbI) dIAM jhUThIAM AsAM divAuMdA rahAMgA ate uhanAM nUM hukama devAMgA tAM uha (butAM de car3hAve laI) jAnavarAM de kaMna cIranage ate uhanAM nUM hukama devAMgA tAM uha rabbI baNatara vica adalA badalI karanage| (he loko! kaMna khola ke suNa lao) ki jihar3A koI viakatI allAha nUM chaDDa ke zaitAna nUM ApaNA mittara baNAvegA uha sapazaTa rUpa vica ghATe vica jAvegA|
iha (zaitAna ziraka karana vAliAM nAla) jhUThe vAade karadA he ate uhanAM nUM AsAM duAuMdA he| (yAda rakho) ki zaitAna de sAre vAade kevala dhokhe hI hana, chala-kapaTa toM chuTTa hora kujjha nahIM|
ihanAM lokAM dA AqharI TikANA naraka he, jitthoM uhanAM nUM koI chuTakArA nahIM milegA|

ate jihar3e loka (rabba, rasUla,.kuraAna, farizatiAM ate Aqhirata utte) ImAna liAuNage, bhale te neka kaMma karaNage asIM uhanAM nUM savaragAM vica dAqhala karAMge, jinhAM de heTha nahirAM vagadIAM hana jitthe iha sadA rahiNage| iha (mominAM nAla) allAha dA vAadA he, jihar3A saccA he| uha kauNa he jihar3A ApaNI galla vica allAha toM vaddha ke saccA hove?

AqhIra nA tuhADI (muzarikAM dI) kAmanAvAM ’te nirabhara karadA he ate nA hI kitAba vAliAM dIAM kAmanAvAM utte he| jihar3A vI burAI karegA usa nUM saz2A avazza milegI ate uha allAha toM chuTTa koI mittara te sahAI nA labbha sakegA|
jihar3A vI neka kaMma karegA, bhAveM uha puraza he jAM isatarI para he ImAna vAlA tAM ajihe loka avazza hI savaragAM vica jANage, ate bhorA bhara vI uhanAM dA hakka nahIM mAriA jAvegA|

dharama pakkho usa viakatI nAloM caMgA koNa hovegA jisa ne ApaNA sIsa allAha de hukamAM agge jhukA dittA te uha neka vI hove, ika cita ho ke ibarAhIma de dIna dI pairavI kare jo ki hakka dA pujArI sI? ibarAhIma nUM allAha ne ApaNA vizeza mittara baNAiA sI|
akAzAM te dharatI vica jo kujjha hUM sabha allAha dA hI he ate allAha ne hara cIz2a nUM ApaNe ghere vica lai rakkhiA he|

(he nabI!) lokI tuhAthoM (yatIma) lar3akIAM pratI pucchade hana| tusIM Akha dio ki ihanAM bAre tAM allAha Apa hI (inasApha karana dA) hukama de rihA he ate.kuraAna dIAM uha AitAM vI (cete karavAuMdIAM hana ki) jihar3IAM yatIma lar3akIAM bAre tuhAnUM par3ha ke suNAIAM jAMdIAM hana ki jinhAM dA niyata hakka tusIM nahIM diMde ate tusIM uhanAM nUM ApaNe nikAha vica liAuNA cAhuMde ho, ate ajihe bacciAM de bAre vI jihar3e kujjha vI z2ora nahIM rakkhade, (tuhAnUM hukama diMdA he ki) tusIM yatImAM nAla inasAfa karo ate tusIM jihar3I vI nekI karade ho bezakka allAha usa dA giAna rakkhadA he|

je kise isatarI nUM ApaNe patI toM lar3AI jhagar3e jAM bhair3e varatAo (talAka) dA Dara hove, je doveM (patI patanI) Apasa vica kise vI tarhAM dI sulAha kara laiNa tAM isa vica koI gunAha nahIM sagoM sulAha safAI tAM vadhere caMgI he| allAha ne manukkhI mana vica kaMjUsI pA chaDDI he| je tusIM loka ahisAna bhAva sohaNA varatAvA karo ate parahez2agArI toM kaMma lavo tAM tusIM jo vI kara rahe ho usa nUM allAha caMgI tarhAM jANadA he|

tuhAthoM iha kade nahIM ho sakegA ki tusIM ApaNIAM sArIAM patanIAM nAla iko jihA vivahAra (inasAfa) kara sako bhAveM tusIM isa laI kiMnI hI cAhata ate koziza kara lavo (tusIM nahIM kara sakade) isa laI (allAha hukama diMdA he ki) ika patanI valla hI iMnA ullara nA ho jAo ki dUjI patanI nUM ukkA hI addha vicAle lamakadA chaDDa dio, jekara tusIM ApaNA iha vatIrA ThIka kara lavo ate allAha toM Darade raho tAM allAha vI (bhullAM nUM) muAfa karana vAlA ate rahima faramAuNa vAlA he|
para je patI patanI ika dUje toM (talAka rAhIM) judA ho hI jANa tAM allAha ApaNI vizAla kudarata nAla hareka nUM dUje dI muthAjI toM beparavAha kara devegA| allAha vaDDA samAI vAlA ate dAnA siANA he|

akAzAM te dharatI vica jo kujjha he hara cIz2a dA mAlika allAha hI he| asIM uhanAM lokAM nUM jinhAM nUM tuhAthoM pahilAM kitAbAM dittIAM sana, ate (he musalamAno!) tuhA` vI iho hukama dittA he ki allAha toM Darade raho, je tusIM hukama nahIM maMnoge tAM tusIM iha galla yAda rakkho ki jo vI akAza vica he ate jo vI dharatI vica he uha sabha allAha dA hI he| allAha (tuhADe hukama maMNana jAM nA maMNana toM) beparavAha he ate hara prakAra dI prazaMsA use laI he|
akAzAM ate dharatI dA mAlika allAha he ate kaMma suArana vAlA vI allAha hI he|
(he loko!) je uha (allAha) cAhe tAM uha tuhAnUM sabha nUM parAM haTA ke tuhADI thAM dUjiAM nUM lai Ave| allAha iMja karana dI pUrI kudarata rakkhadA he|

jihar3A viakatI kevala dunIAM dI bhalAI cAhuMdA he tAM usa nUM isa galla dA patA hoNA cAhIdA he ki allAha de kola tAM dunIAM ate Aqhirata (doveM thAvAM) dI bhalAI he| allAha (tuhADIAM sArIAM gallAM nUM) suNana vAlA ate (tuhADe hara kaMma nUM) vekhaNa vAlA he|

he ImAna vAlio! inasAfa utte maz2abUtI nAla DaTa jAo ate allAha laI saccI gavAhI deNa vAle baNa jAo bhAveM uha tuhADe ApaNe viraddha hove jAM tuhADe ApaNe mAM bApa jAM rizatedArAM de viruddha hove|[22] mAmale nAla saMbaMdhata dhira bhAveM amIra hove jAM g2arIba, doveM hAlatAM vica tuhAthoM vaddha allAha uhanAM dA zubha-ciMtaka he| isa laI tusIM ApaNIAM icchAvAM de picche lagga ke inasAfa dA pallA nA chaDDo| jekara tusIM (inasAfa karana sameM) gola mola galla kItI jAM ApaNe Apa nUM gavAhI deNa toM bacAiA tAM yAda rakkho ki jo kujjha tusIM karade ho allAha usatoM pUrI tarhAM jANU he|
translations.footnotes: [22] isa Aita vica saccI g2avAhI deNa laI nasIhata kItI gaI he kiuM jo jhUThI gavAhI vaDDe gunAhAM vica giNI jAMdI he Apa sa: toM jadoM gunAhe kabIrA bhAva mahA pApAM bAre pucchiA giA tAM Apa sa: ne faramAiA (1) allAha de saMga kise dUje nUM vI ibAdata vica zarIka karanA (2) mApiAM dI nA-faramAnI karanA (3) nA-hakkA katala karanA (4) jhUThI gavAhI deNA! (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 2653)

translations.translation: he ImAna vAlio! allAha ate usa de rasUla (muhaMmada sa:) ate usa kitAba (.kuraAna) utte, jihar3I usa ne ApaNe rasUla ’te nAz2ila kItI he ate uhanAM kitAbAM (tauraita, z2abUra, iMjIla) ’te, jo usa ne isa.kuraAna toM pahilAM nAz2ila kItIAM hana, ImAna lai Ao| jihar3A viakatI allAha, usa de farizate, usa dIAM kitAbAM, usa de rasUlAM ate kiAmata de dina toM inakAra karegA, uha gumarAhI vica bhaTakadA hoiA bahuta dUra nikkala giA|

jinhAM lokAM ne ImAna lai AuNa magaroM inakAra kItA phera ImAna lai Ae phera inakAra kItA ate kufara vica vadhade hI cale gae, allAha uhanAM nUM vI muAfa nahIM karegA ate nA hI uhanAM nUM kade siddhA rAha vikhAvegA|
he nabI! munAfikAM nUM qhabaradAra kara dio ki uhanAM laI duqhadAI az2Aba he|
jihar3e loka musalamAnAM nUM chaDDa ke kAfirAM nUM ApaNA dosata baNAuMde hana, uha dassaNa, kI uha uhanAM kola iz2z2ata laI jAMde hana? yAda rakkho ki iz2z2ata tAM sArI dI sArI allAha laI he|

allAha tuhADe laI ApaNI kitAba (.kuraAna) vica iha hukama utAra cukkiA he ki jadoM tusIM kise thAM allAha dIAM AitAM (hukamAM) toM inakAra karade ate makhaula karade vekho tAM tusIM usa sabhA vica nA baiTho, jadoM taka ki uha loka dUjIAM gallAM vica nA lagga jANa| (je tusIM iMja nA kItA) tAM tusIM vI usa sameM uhanAM varage hI ho jAoge| bezakka allAha ika dina sAre munAfikAM ate kAfirAM nUM naraka vica jamAM karana vAlA he|

iha (munAfika) loka tuhADe aMjAma dI uDIka karade rahiMde hana, phera jekara tuhAnUM allAha kAmayAbI de deve tAM iha kahiMde hana “kI asIM tuhADe nAla nahIM sAM?” je kAfirAM dA pallA bhArI ho jAve tAM uhanAM nUM Akhade hana “kI asIM tuhADe ’te bhArU hoNa vAle nahIM sAM? kI asIM tuhAnUM musalamAnAM de hatthoM nahIM bacAiA?” kiAmata vAle dina allAha uhanAM munAfikAM vicAle faisalA kara devegA| allAha kAfirAM nUM ImAna vAliAM viruddha (bhArU) hoNa dA koI vI rAha nahIM devegA

bezakka munAfika allAha nAla dhokhA karade hana jada ki allAha ne hI ihanAM (munAfikAM) nUM dhokhe vica pA chaDDiA he| jadoM iha namAz2a laI khar3he huMde hana tAM bar3I hI bedilI te loka vikhAve laI khar3he huMde hana ate allAha nUM tAM bahuta hI ghaTTa yAda karade hana|
iha kufara ate ImAna vicAle DAvAMDola hana, nA pUre isa pAse ate nA hI pUre usa pAse ate allAha jisa nUM gumarAhI vica pA deve tusIM usa laI hora koI rAha nahIM labbha sakade|
he ImAna vAlio! mominAM nUM chaDDa ke kAfirAM nUM apaNA dosata nA baNAo| kI tusIM cAhuMde ho ki allAha nUM ApaNe viruddha sapazaTa dalIla de dio?
munAfika tAM z2arUra hI naraka de sabha toM heThale daraje vica jANage[23] ate tusIM utthe uhanAM dA koI vI sahAI nA vekhoge|
translations.footnotes:
[23] isa vica dassiA giA he ki isa vica munAfikAM vAlIAM sifatAM toM baca ke raho| hadIsa vica iha qhUbIAM dassIAM gaIAM hana| nabI karIma sa: dA faramAna he ki cAra gallAM jisa kise vica hoNagIAM uha pa=kA munAfika ru jisa kise vica uhanAM cArAM vi=coM ika auauguNa pAiA jAvegA| usa vica ika auauguNa nifAka dA vI ru| jadoM taka ki uha usa nUM chaDDa nA deve uha gallAM jAM auauguNa iha hana: (1) jadoM usa de kola koI amAnata rakkhI jAve tAM usa vica qhiAnata kare| (2) jadoM bole tAM jhUTha bole| (3) jada vAadA kare tAM usa nUM pUrA nA kare| (4) jadoM jhagar3A kare tAM gAlAM kaDDhe| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 34)
* allAha de rasUla sa: ne iha vI faramAiA ru ki kiAmata dihAr3e tusIM allAha de kola usa viakatI nUM sabha toM vaddha bhair3e lokAM vica vekhoge jihar3e do mUMhe hana bhAva kujjha lokAM kola tAM ika mUMha laike jAMde hana ate dUjiAM kola dUjA mUMha laike jAMde hana (bhAva vakkha vakkha gallAM karade hana)| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 6058)

translations.translation: hAM! jihar3e (ihanAM vicco) taubA kara laiNa ate ApaNe vatIre dA sudhAra kara laiNa ate allAha de lar3a lagga jANa ate dharama nUM allAha vAsate qhAlasa kara laiNa, ajihe loka hI mominAM de sAthI hoNage| allAha mominAM nUM chetI hI bahuta vaDDA badalA devegA|

je tusIM usa dA zukara adA karade raho ate ImAna vAle baNa ke raho phera allAha tuhAnUM saz2A de ke kI karegA? allAha (tuhADI) bahuta kadara karana vAlA he ate (tuhADe sAre amalAM te icchAvAM dA) giAna rakkhaNa vAlA he|

kise dI burAI nUM uccI avAz2a nAla biAna (bhAva caracA) karana nUM allAha pasaMda nahIM karadA, hAM je kise ’te z2ulama hoiA he (usa nUM ijAz2ata he) ate allAha hara galla nUM caMgI tarhAM suNadA ate jANadA he|

je tusIM kise nekI de kaMma nUM bhAveM khullhe Ama karo jAM luka chupa ke karo jAM kise valloM kItI hoI vadhIkI nUM muAfa kara devo tAM allAha vI bahuta vaDDA baqhazaNahAra he ate hara tarhAM dI samarathA rakkhadA he|

jihar3e lokI allAha ate usa de paig2aMbarAM dA inakAra karade hana ate cAhuMde hana ki uha allAha ate usa de rasUlAM vicakAra vitakarA karana, uha iha kahiMde hana “kujjha nabIAM utte tAM sADA ImAna he ate kujjha ’te nahIM” ate cAhuMde hana ki kufara ate ImAna de vicakAra ika rasatA kaDDhIe|
sacca jANo ki iha sAre loka asalI kAfira hana ate kAfirAM laI asIM z2alIla karana vAlI saz2A tiAra kItI hoI he|

ate jihar3e loka allAha ate usa de sAre paig2aMbarAM utte ImAna lai AuNage ate uhanAM vicakAra koI vitakarA nahIM karade iha uha hana jinhAM nUM allAha chetI hI sohaNA badalA devegA| allAha bar3A hI baqhazaNahAra ate vaDDIAM rahimatAM vAlA he|

(he nabI!) tuhAthoM iha kitAba vAle (yahUdI te IsAI) iha maMga karade hana ki tusIM ihanAM kola koI akAzoM kitAba lai ke Ao, jada ki mUsA toM tAM ihanAM ne isa toM vI vaDDI maMga kItI sI ki sA` ailAnIA (khullhama-khullhA) allAha nUM vikhA dio| basa uhanAM dIAM z2AlamAnAM karatUtAM kArana uhanAM utte acanaceta bijalI A DigI, jada ki uhanAM kola sapazaTa dalIlAM (mUsAM de rasUla hoNa dIAM) A cukkIAM sana phera vI uhanAM ne vacche nUM ApaNA pUjaNahAra baNA liA, praMtU asIM iha vI muAfa kara dittA ate mUsA nUM sapazaTa rUpa vica uhanAM utte bhArU kara dittA|

ate (hukamAM dI pAlaNA karana dA) ikarAra laiNa laI asIM uhanAM (de sirAM) utte tUra pahAr3a jhukA dittA ate uhanAM nUM hukama dittA ki zahira de bUhe vica dI jhukade hoe [24] paraveza karo| ate asIM uhanAM nUM iha vI kihA ki hafate vAle dina (bhAva zanicaravAra) koI vadhIkI nA karanA ate isa galla laI uhanAM toM pakkA bacana liA sI|
translations.footnotes: [24] haz2arata abU-hurairA dassade hana ki nabI karIma sa: dA faramAna he, banI isarAIla nUM hukama dittA giA sI ki zahira de bUhiAM vica sijadA karade hoe ate hittAtuna (sADI taubA kabUla kara) kahiMde hoe dAqhila hoNa, para uhanAM ne hukama badala dittA, sijade dI thAM ghisar3ade hoe ate hubatAtuna fI zAarAha (saTTe vica dANA) kahiMde hoe zahira vica dAqhala hoe| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 3403)

translations.translation: fera asIM uhanAM ’te isa laI lAanatAM bhejIAM kiuM jo uhanAM ne ApaNe bacanAM nUM tor3hiA, allAha de hukamAM dI ulaMghanA kItI ate allAha de nabIAM nUM nA-hakkA katala karade rahe ate uhanAM ne iha vI AkhiA “sADe dilAM utte tAM g2ilAfa car3he hoe hana” (bhAva sADe dila mahifUz2a hana)| jadoM ki uhanAM de inakAra kArana allAha ne uhanAM de dilAM utte mohara lA chaDDI he, so uhanAM viccoM bahuta hI thor3he loka ImAna liAuNage|
iha sabha lAanatAM uhanAM utte (IsA nUM) rasUla maMNana toM inakAra ate haz2arata marIama utte tuhamatAM (jhUThe ilaz2Ama) lAuNa kArana sI|

ate uhanAM de isa kathana kArana vI lAanata sI ki asIM allAha de rasUla marIama de puttara masIha IsA nUM katala kara dittA he, jada ki vAsatava vica nA tAM uhanAM ne usa (IsA)nUM katala kItA ate nA hI usa nUM sUlI ’te cAr3hiA sagoM sArA mAmalA uhanAM laI zakkI baNA dittA giA| sacca jANo ki uhanAM nUM isa galla dA koI giAna nahIM, iha tAM sAre aTakalAM utte hI cala rahe hana| iha galla yakInI he ki uhanAM ne usa (IsA nUM ) katala nahIM sI kItA|
sagoM allAha ne usa (IsA a:sa:) nUM ApaNe valla (akAza ’te) cukka liA| allAha bar3A hI z2orAvara ate pUrI dAnAI vAlA he|
kitAba vAliAM viccoM ika vI ajihA nahIM hovegA jihar3A IsA utte ApaNe marana toM pahilAM pahilAM ImAna nA lai Ave[25] ate kiAmata vAle dina uha uhanAM utte gavAha hovegA|
translations.footnotes: [25] isa Aita vica haz2arata IsA dI Amada valla izArA he jo ki kiAmata de ner3e akAza toM hovegI ise saMbaMdha vica ika hadIsa Ale-imarAna sUrata dI Aita 55 de hAzIe vica dittI gaI he jisa vica iha vI he ki haz2arata IsA jaz2iA laiNA baMda kara deNage| jaz2iA toM bhAva uha Taikasa he jihar3A isalAmI hakUmatAM vica vasaNa vAle g2aira musalamAM toM sarakAra laiMdI he, jihar3e isalAma dI thAM dUje dharamAM ’te kAima rahiMde hana| isa de badale vica isalAmI hakUmata uhanAM de jAna mAla dI rAkhI karadI he| haz2arata IsA jaz2iA nahIM laiNage sagoM dIna isalAma nUM kabUla karana dI maMga karanage ate uhanAM kola isalAma kabUla karana toM ilAvA koI rAha nahIM hoNI|

translations.translation: jihar3e loka yahUdI hana uhanAM de z2ulama kArana ate uhanAM valloM vadhere lokAM nUM allAha dI rAha toM rokaNa kArana asIM kujjha pAka cIz2AM nUM uhanAM laI harAma kara chaDDiA jihar3IAM pahilAM uhanAM laI halAla sana|

ate ika kArana iha vI sI ki uha viAja laiMde sI jisa toM uhanAM nUM rokiA giA sI ate lokAM dA mAla nA-hakkA (dhakke nAla) khANa kArana vI sI| uhanAM viccoM jihar3e kAfira hana uhanAM laI asIM dukhadAI az2Aba tiAra kara chaDDiA he|

praMtU jihar3e uhanAM viccoM pakkA giAna rakkhade hana ate ImAna vAle hana ate jo Apa valla (.kuraAna) utAriA giA he usa ’te ImAna rakkhade hana ate usa utte vI jo tuhAthoM pahilAM nAz2ila kItA giA he, namAz2AM nUM kAima karade hana, z2akAta diMde hana, allAha utte ate kiAmata vAle dina utte ImAna rakkhade hana, iha uha loka hana jinhAM nUM asIM chetI hI bahuta vaDDA badalA devAMge|

(he nabI!) bezakka asIM tuhADe valla use prakAra vahI[26] (rabbI paig2Ama) bhejiA he jiveM nUha ate isa toM bAada vAle nabIAM valla (vahI) bhejI sI ate iho vahI ibarAhIma, isamAIla, isahAka, yAkUba ate uhanAM dI saMtAna valla ate IsA, ayyUba, yUnusa, hArUna ate sulemAna valla bhejI sI| asIM dAUda nUM z2abUra (akAzI kitAba) baqhazI sI|
translations.footnotes: [26] allAha de rasUla sa:nUM pucchiA giA ki tuhADe utte vahI kiveM nAz2ila huMdI he, tAM Apa sa: ne faramAiA “vahI kade tAM mere ’te ghaMTI dI AvAz2a vAMga nAz2ila haMdI he| vahI nAz2ila hoNa sameM mere dila ’te bahuta bojha huMdA he ate jo kujjha vahI vica kihA jAMdA he tAM maiM usa nUM yAda kara laiMdA hAM|” haz2arata AizA faramAuMdIAM hana ki maine saqhata saradIAM vica nabI sa: ’te vahI nAz2ila huMde hoe vekhI he, jadoM vahI dA silasilA qhatama ho jAMdA tAM Apa sa: de matthe ’te pasInA A jAMdA| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 2)

translations.translation: tuhAthoM pahilAM asIM kiMne hI rasUla bheje jinhAM dI galla asIM tuhAnUM pahilAM hI suNA cukke hAM, ate kaI rasUlAM dIAM gallAM tuhAnUM suNAIAM vI nahIM| asIM mUsA nAla vizeza kara ke kalAma kItA|

asIM lokAM nUM qhuzaqhabarIAM suNAuNa vAle ate rabba de az2Aba toM DarAuNa vAle rasUla bheje tAM jo lokAM kola rasUlAM toM bAada allAha de sira koI Aropa lAuNa dA bahAnA nA rahe (ki sADe kola tAM DarAuNa vAlA koI AiA hI nahIM) allAha vaDDA z2orAvara ate hikamata vAlA he|

jo allAha valloM tuhADe laI (.kuraAna) utAriA he usa dI gavAhI tAM allAha Apa hI de rihA he ki isa kuraAna nUM usa ne ApaNe giAna nAla utAriA nUM ate isa dI gavAhI farizate vI diMde hana, jada ki gavAhI tAM allAha dI hI batherI he|
jinhAM lokAM ne (.kuraAna ate rasUlAM toM) inakAra kItA ate lokAM nUM allAha dI rAha callaNa toM rokiA, bezakka uha gumarAhI vica bahuta dUra nikala gae hana|

jinhAM lokAM ne allAha ate rasUla dA inakAra kItA ate uhanAM nAla vadhIkIAM vI kItIAM fera allAha nUM iha zobhA nahIM diMdA ki uha ihanAM nUM baqhaza deve ate nA hI iha zobhA diMdA he ki uhanAM nUM siddhI rAha vikhAve|
chuTTa naraka vica jANa toM uhanAM laI koI hora rAha nahIM jisa vica uha sadA laI rahiNage ate iha kaMma allAha laI bahuta hI AsAna he|

he loko! tuhADe kola tuhADe rabba valloM hakka (.kuraAna) lai ke rasUla A giA he, so tusIM usa ’te ImAna lai Ao, ise vica tuhADe laI bhalAI he| je tusIM ImAna nahIM liAuMge tAM jo vI akAzAM ate dharatI vica he uhanAM sabha dA mAlika allAha he ate allAha hI jANanahAra ate sUjha-bUjha vAlA he|

he kitAba vAlio (yahUdI te IsAIo)! ApaNe dharama dIAM haddAM toM nA laMgho (bhAva jo allAha ne Adeza ditte hana, uhanAM nUM hI maMno) ate allAha de saMbaMdha vica sacAੱI toM chuTTa hora kujjha vI nA kaho| bezakka marIama dA puttara IsA tAM kevala allAha dA rasUla he ate (usa dA janama) usa (allAha de) ika bola (hukama duArA hoiA) he jisa nUM usa ne marIama valla ghalliA, uha usa valloM ika rUha he| so tusIM allAha ate usa de rasUla utte ImAna liAo ate iha nA kaho ki izaTa tiMna hana, iha galla kahiNa toM bAz2a A jAo ise vica hI tuhADI bhalAI he| pUjaNayoga tAM kevala allAha hI he ate isa galla toM pAka he ki usa de koI auaulAda vI hove|[27] sabha kujjha use laI he jihar3A AsAmAnAM ate dharatI vica he ate sAre kaMmAM nUM sire cAr3haNa laI allAha hI batherA he|
translations.footnotes: [27] nabI karIma sa: ne faramAiA jisa kise ne vI isa dI gavAhI dittI ki allAha toM chuTTa koI izaTa nahIM, uha ika hI he, usa dA koI sAMjhI nahIM ate bezakka haz2arata muhaMmada sa: allAha de baMde ate usa de rasUla hana, ate isa galla dI gavAhI vI dittI ki bezakka haz2arata IsA vI allAha de baMde ate usa de rasUla ate usa dA kalamA hana jihar3A ki usa ne haz2arata marIama valla ghalliA sI ate use valloM paidA kItI hoI ika rUha hana ate jaMnata te naraka dA hoNA hakka he tAM allAha taAlA usa nUM jaMnata vica dAqhala kara devegA bhAveM usa de amala kiho jahi vI hoNa (cAhe saz2A toM bAada jaMnata vica jAve jAM pahilAM, jANA tAM ika momina ne jaMnata vica lAz2amI he)| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 3435)

translations.translation: allAha dA baMdA hoNa vica nA tAM masIha (IsA) dI koI heThI he ate nA hI allAha de ner3ale farizatiAM dI hI koI heThI he, para jihar3A koI allAha dI baMdagI karana vica ApaNI heThI samajhadA he ate ghamaMDa vI karadA he tAM allAha chetI hI uhanAM sabha nUM ApaNe kola ikaTThA karegA|

isa laI jo vI loka ImAna liAe ate caMge kaMma karanage uhanAM nUM isa dA pUrA-pUrA badalA dittA jAvegA ate ApaNIAM miharAM sadake isa vica hora vI vAdhA karegA ate jinhAM lokAM ne baMdagI karana nUM ApaNI heThI samajhI ate ghamaMDa kItA uhanAM nUM daradanAka az2Aba dittA jAvegA ate uhanAM laI allAha toM chuTTa hora koI vI himAitI ate sahAI nA hovegA|

isa laI jo vI loka ImAna liAe ate caMge kaMma karanage uhanAM nUM isa dA pUrA-pUrA badalA dittA jAvegA ate ApaNIAM miharAM sadake isa vica hora vI vAdhA karegA ate jinhAM lokAM ne baMdagI karana nUM ApaNI heThI samajhI ate ghamaMDa kItA uhanAM nUM daradanAka az2Aba dittA jAvegA ate uhanAM laI allAha toM chuTTa hora koI vI himAitI ate sahAI nA hovegA|

so jihar3e loka allAha utte ImAna lai Ae ate isa (.kuraAna dIAM hidAitAM) nUM maz2abUtI nAla phar3a liA uhanAM nUM uha chetI hI ApaNI rahimatAM ate miharAM nAla navAz2egA ate uhanAM nUM ApaNe valla AuNa vAlA siddhA rasatA vI vikhAvegA|

(he nabI!) lokI tuhAthoM (kalAlA de saMbaMdha vica) fatavA pucchade hana| tusIM Akha dio ki allAha tuhAnUM kalAlA bAre dassadA he ki je koI viakatI mara jAve ate usa dI aulAda (bhAva pratakkha vArisa) nA hove te usa dI ika hI bhaiNa hove tAM usa bhaiNa nUM usa de bharA de chaDDe hoe mAla dA addhA hissA milegA ate je bhaiNa be-aulAda mare tAM usadA bharA usa dA vArasa hovegA| je bhaiNA do jAM do toM vaddha hoNa tAM uhanAM nUM uhanAM de bharAM de chaDDe hoe mAla dA do tihAI hissA milegA| je kaI bharA, bhaiNa, puraza te auratAM vArasa hoNa tAM marada dA hissA do auratAM de barAbara hovegA| allAha tuhADe laI ApaNe AdezAM nUM sapazaTa karake biAna karadA he tAM jo tusIM kurAhe nA pai jAo| allAha hara cIz2a nUM bhalI-bhAMta jANadA he|

he ImAna vAlio! ApaNe bacanAM nUM nibhAo| tuhADe laI sAre caukhure pazU halAla (jAiz2a) kIte gae hana, chuTTa uhanAM toM jihar3e tuhA` (agge calla ke) dasse jANage| para jadoM tusIM iharAma (hajja dA vizeza vasatara) dI hAlata vica hovo tAM zikAra nUM ApaNe laI jAiz2a nA samajho| bezakka allAha jo cAhuMdA ru use dA hukama diMdA he|

he ImAna vAlio! allAha dIAM nizAnIAM dA nirAdara nA karo ate nA adaba vAle mahIniAM dA ate nA hI harama (bhAva qhAnA-kAabA) vica kurabAna hoNa vAle jAnavara dA, jinhAM de gale vica kurabAnI de paTe pae hoe hana ate nA kAabe valla jANa vAle uhanAM lokAM nUM taMga karo jihar3e allAha de ghara (qhAnA-kAabA) valla ApaNe rabba de faz2ala ate usa dI raz2A dI bhAla vica jA rahe hana| hAM! jadoM tusIM iharAma utAra dio tAM zikAra kara sakade ho| jinhAM lokAM ne tuhA` masajide harAma (satikArayoga masajida bhAva qhAnA-kAabA) toM rokiA sI uhanAM dI duzamanI tuhAnUM isa galla laI nA ubhAre ki tusIM uhanAM nAla vadhIkI karo| tusIM nekI ate parahez2agArI (bhAva burAIAM toM bacaNa) vica ika dUje dI sahAitA karade raho, praMtU gunAha ate vadhIkI de kaMmA vica sahiyogI nA baNo| allAha toM Darade raho, bezakka allAha (gunAhAM te vadhIkI karana vAliAM nUM) karar3I saz2A deNa vAlA he|

(he musalamAno!) tuhADe laI, muradAra, khUna, sUra dA mAsa ate uha jAnavara jisa nUM z2ibaha (bhAva kurabAna) karana lagge rabba toM chuTTa hora kise dA nAM liA giA hove, jihar3A jAnavara galA ghuTa ke mara jAve jAM saTTa khA ke mara jAve jAM uccI thAM toM gira ke mara jAve jAM koI jAnavara siMga laggaNa nAla mara jAve ate jisa pazU nUM kise dariMde ne pAr3a khAiA hove, chuTTa usa toM jisa nUM tusIM jiuMdA vekha ke halAla kara liA hove ate uha jAnavara jihar3A kise asathAna[1] ’te kurabAna kItA giA hove, harAma (nA jAiz2a) kItA giA he| tuhADe laI iha vI nA-jAiz2a he ki tusIM kAniAM nAla ApaNI kisamata mAlUma karo, iha sAre kaMma gunAha de hana| ajja uha loka nirAza ho gae hana jinhAM ne tuhADe dIna dA inakAra kItA he, so tusIM uhanAM toM nA Daro sagoM methoM hI Daro| ajja maine (allAha ne) tuhADe laI tuhADA dIna (dharama) nUM mukammala kara dittA he ate tuhADe utte ApaNI niamata pUrI utAra chaDDI he ate tuhADe laI isalAma nUM dharama vajoM pasaMda kItA he| jihar3A koI bhukkha toM hAloM-behAla ho jAve jadoM ki usa dI rucI gunAha valla nA hove (ate uha koI harAma cIz2a khA lave tAM ajihe musalamAna laI) bezakka allAha vaDDA baqhazaNahAra ate rahima faramAuNa vAlA he|
translations.footnotes: [1] thAna toM bhAva uha thAM jihar3I buttA de ner3e butAM nU qhuza karana laI jAnavarAM nU z2ibaha (bheMTa) karana laI huMdI he|

translations.translation: (he nabI!) lokIM tuhAthoM pucchade hana ki (rabba valloM) uhanAM laI kI kujjha halAla (jAiz2a) kItA giA he, tusIM Akha dio! ki sArIAM hI pAka cIz2AM tuhADe laI halAla kItIAM gaIAM hana ate jihar3e jAnavarAM nUM tusIM zikAra karana laI sikhalAI de rakkhI he bhAva tusIM ApaNe zikArI jAnavarAM nUM uha kujjha sikhAuMde ho jisa dA giAna rabba ne tuhAnUM dittA hoiA he so jihar3e vI zikAra nUM uha tuhADe laI phar3I rakkhaNa tAM usa zikAra kIte hoe jAnavara nUM allAha dA nAM par3hake z2ibaha karo phera usa viccoM khAo| allAha toM Darade rihA karo| bezakka allAha chetI hI hisAba laiNa vAlA he|

sArIAM pAka cIz2AM ajja toM tuhADe laI halAla kara dittIAM gaIAM hana ate ahale kitAba dA bhojana (yahUdI ate IsAIAM de hatthoM allAha de nAM ’te z2ibaha kItA giA jAnavara) tuhADe laI jAIz2a ru ate tuhADA bhojana uhanAM laI jAIz2a he| tuhADe laI pAka pavittara ImAna vAlIAM isatarIAM ate uhanAM dIAM pAka-pavittara isatarIAM vI halAla hana (bhAva nikAha kara sakade ho) jihanAM nUM tuhAthoM pahilAM kitAba dittI gaI sI, para iha usa sameM he jadoM tusIM uhanAM de mahira adA karake uhanAM nUM nikAha dI kaida vica lai Ao, nA badakArI karana vAle baNo ate nA hI gupata saMbaMdha rakkho| jihar3A koI ImAna toM hI inakAra karegA tAM usa dA sArA kItA karAiA barabAda hovegA ate uha paraloka vikhe ghATA sahiNa vAliAM viccoM hovegA|

he ImAna vAlio! jadoM tusIM namAz2a (de irAde nAla) uTTho tAM tuhAnUM cAhIdA he ki ApaNe cihare nUM dhovo ate hatthAM nUM sane kuhanIAM dho lavo[2] ApaNe sira utte (hattha gille karake) phero ate ApaNe pairAM nUM giTe sane dhovo| je tusIM nApAkI dI hAlata vica hovo tAM izanAna kara lavo hAM! je tusIM bimAra jAM saphara vica hovo jAM tuhADe viccoM koI viakatI nita-roz2a dIAM lor3AM (bhAva TaTTI-pizAba Adi) pUrIAM karake AiA hove jAM tusIM patanIAM nAla saMbhoga kItA hove ate tuhAnUM pANI nA mile tAM tusIM pAka miTTI nAla tayammuma kara[3] lao phera usa (miTTI nAla libar3e hatthAM) nUM ApaNe cihare ate hatthAM utte phera liA karo| allAha nahIM cAhuMdA ki tuhAnUM aukhiAI vica pAve, sagoM uha tAM tuhAnUM pAka rakkhaNA cAhuMdA he ate tuhADe utte ApaNI niamatAM pUrIAM kara deNA cAhuMdA he, tAM jo tusIM usa dA dhaMnavAda karo|
translations.footnotes: [2] isa Aita vica vaz2U karana dA hukama he| kiAmata dihAr3e ummate muhaMmadIyA dI vizezatA hovegI ki usa de vaz2U vAle sarIra de aMga camakaNageM jiveM ki nabI karIma (sa:) ne faramAiA, jadoM merI ummata de loka kiAmata dihAr3e bulAe jANage tAM vaz2U kArana uhanAM de matthe, hattha, paira camakade hoNage| je tuhADe ’coM koI ApaNI camaka vadhAuNa dI hiMmata rakkhadA hove tAM uha z2arUra vadhAe bhAva caMgI tarhAM te vaddha toM vaddha vaz2U kare| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 136) [3] tayammuma karana dA tarIkA ApaNe dovAM hatthAM nUM kise pAka miTTI jAM sAfa dharatI ’te mAro phera dovAM hatthAM toM miTTI jhAr3ha ke ika hattha dI hathelI dUje hattha dI piTTha ’te phero ate phara ApaNe cihare ’te malo, iMja ika vAra hI karanA he| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 347)

translations.translation: (he momino!) tuhADe utte jo vI allAha valloM niamata nAz2ila hoI he usa nUM cete rakkho ate isa bacana nUM vI yAda rakkho jo tusIM usa (allAha) nAla kItA he, jadoM tusIM (ikarAra vajoM) kihA sI ki asIM ihanAM hukamAM nUM suNiA ate isa nUM savIkAra kItA he| so allAha toM Darade raho bezakka allAha dilAM (vica luke) bhetAM nUM caMgI tarhAM jANadA he|

he ImAna vAlio! tusIM allAha laI hakka sacca utte khar3haNa vAle ate inasAfa dI gavAhI deNa vAle baNa jAo| kise kauma dI duzamanI tuhAnUM isa galla ’te nA ubhAre ki tusIM inasAfa hI nA kara sakoM| inasAfa toM kaMma liA karo iho parahez2agArI de vaddha ner3e he ate allAha toM Darade raho, sacca jANo ki allAha tuhADe sAre kaMmAM dI jANakArI rakkhadA he|
allAha ne uhanAM lokAM nAla jihar3e ImAna liAe hana ate uhanAM ne kaMma vI bhale hI kIte iha vAadA kItA he ki uhanAM laI baqhaziza he ate bhale kaMmAM dA bahuta vaDDA badalA he|
ate jinhAM lokAM ne kufara kItA ate sADe hukamAM nUM jhuThalAiA, uha sAre loka naraka vica jANa vAle hana|

he ImAna vAlio! allAha ne tuhADe utte jihar3I niamata (rabbI madada) nAz2ila kItI sI usa nUM cete rakkho jadoM ika kauma ne tuhADe utte hattha pAuNa dI koziza kItI sI tAM allAha ne uhanAM de hatthAM nUM tuhADe taka pahuMcaNa toM roka dittA sI| allAha toM Darade raho ate mominAM nUM allAha utte hI bharosA karanA cAhIdA he|

bezakka allAha ne banI isarAIla toM pakkA bacana liA sI ate asIM uhanAM viccoM bArAM saradAra niyukata kIte sana| ate allAha ne uhanAM nUM AkhiA sI ki maiM tuhADe aMga-saMga hI hAM| je tusIM namAz2a kAima rakkhoge ate z2akAta diMde rahoge ate mere rasUlAM nUM maMnoge ate uhanAM dI sahAitA karade rahoge ate allAha nUM sohaNA karaz2A dioge (bhAva rabba dI rAha vica qharaca karoge) tAM maiM tuhADIAM burAIAM tuhAthoM dUra kara devAMgA ate tuhAnUM uhanAM savaragAM vica lai ke jAvAMgA jinhAM de heTha nahirAM vagadIAM hana, je kise ne phera vI kufara kItA tAM asalo uha siddhe rasate toM bhaTaka giA|

so uhanAM de ApaNe hI kIte bacanAM nUM bhaMga karana kArana[4] asIM uhanAM (banI isarAIla) utte lAanatAM bhejIAM ate uhanAM de dila kaThora kara ditte (ki uha sidhe rAha tura hI nA sakaNa)| uha rabba de kalAma dI rUpa rekhA badala diMde hana ate jo vI uhanAM nUM hidAitAM kItIAM gaIAM sana uhanAM dA ika vaDDA hissA uhanAM ne bhulA dittA he| (he nabI!) uhanAM vica kujjha lokAM nUM chaDDa ke dUjiAM valloM herA-pherI karana dI sUcanA Ama karake tuhAnUM miladI rahiMdI he| so tusIM uhanAM nUM khimA baqhazo ate uhanAM dIAM karatUtAM toM aNa dekhI kara dio| bezakka allAha upakAra karana vAliAM nUM pasaMda karadA he|
translations.footnotes: [4] yahUdIAM nUM tauraita rAhIM hukama dittA giA sI ki jadoM vI muhaMmada (sa:) sArI manukkhatA laI allAha valloM nabI baNA ke bheje jANa tAM tusIM sAre muhaMmada (sa:) dI pairavI karanI he para uhanAM ne iha bacana tor3a dittA|

translations.translation: jihar3e ApaNe Apa nUM nasarAnI (isAI) AkhavAuMde hana, asIM uhanAM toM vI hukamAM dI pAlaNA karana dA bacana [5] liA sI, praMtU jisa galla laI uhanAM toM bacana liA giA sI usa dA ika vaDDA bhAga uhanAM ne bhulA dittA| so phera asIM vI uhanAM vicAle kiAmata taka laI duzamaNI te IrakhA pA chaDDI ate uha jo vI karade hana allAha uhanAM nUM chetI hI uhanAM dIAM karatUtAM toM jANU kara devegA|
translations.footnotes: [5] IsAIAM nUM vI iMjIla vica hukama dittA giA sI ki jadoM haz2arata muhaMmada (sa:) pUrI manukkhI nasala laI nabI baNa ke AuNa tAM tusIM sAre usa ’te ImAna liAuNA he ate Apa (sa:) dI pairavI karanA he|

translations.translation: he ahale kitAba (yahUdI ate IsAIo)! tuhADe kola sADA rasUla (haz2arata muhaMmada sa:) A giA he, uha tuhAnUM allAha dIAM kitAbAM (tauraita ate iMjIla) dIAM bahuta sArIAM gallAM sapazaTa kara rihA he jinhAM nUM tusIM lukA rahe sI ate vadherIAM gallAM toM aNa-dekhI kara rihA he| bezakka tuhADe kola allAha valloM cAnaNa ate (sacca, jhUTha nUM) sapazaTa karana vAlI kitAba (pavittara.kuraAna) A gaI he|

isa.kuraAna rAhIM allAha uhanAM lokAM nUM, jihar3e rabba dI raz2A de cAhavAna hana, siddhe rAha dI agavAI karadA he ate ApaNI AgiA nAla hI uhanAM nUM haneriAM ’coM kaDDha ke rozanI valla lai ke jAMdA he ate uhanAM nUM siddhe rAha valla lai ke jAMdA he|

bezakka uha loka rabba de inakArI ho gae jinhAM ne kihA ki bezakka allAha tAM uhI masIha, marIama dA puttara he| (he nabI!) jekara allAha marIama de puttara masIha nUM ate usa dI mAtA nUM ate dharatI utte vasana vAle sAre hI lokAM nUM halAka kara deve, tAM kauNa he jihar3A allAha nUM isa galla toM rokaNa dA adhikAra rakkhadA he? akAza ate dharatI ate ihanAM dovAM de vicAle jo kujjha vI he uhanAM sabha dA mAlika allAha hI he uha jo vI cAhuMdA he paidA karadA he ate hareka cIz2a allAha de vassa vica he|

yahUdI ate IsAI Akhade hana ki asIM allAha de puttara ate usa de lADale hAM| (tusIM he nabI!) uhanAM toM puccho ki je iha galla he tAM phera uha tuhADe pApAM dI saz2A kiuM diMdA he? nahIM sagoM tusIM vI usa (allAha) dI racanA viccoM ika manukkhI racanA ho, uha jisa nUM cAhuMdA he baqhaza diMdA he ate jisa nUM cAhuMdA ru saz2A de diMdA he| akAza ate dharatI ate ihanAM de vicAle dI hareka cIz2a dA mAlika allAha hI he ate tusIM sabha ne use valla mur3a ke jANA he|

he kitAba vAlio! tuhADe kola sADA rasUla (haz2arata muhaMmada) A giA he, jihar3A rasUlAM de kAfI dera magaroM aiA he jo tuhADe laI sADIAM gallAM (sikkhiAvAM) nUM visathAra pUravaka biAna karadA he tAM jo tusIM iha nA kahi sako ki sADe kola tAM koI savaraga dIAM qhuzaqhabarIAM suNAuNa vAlA te (naraka toM) DarAuNa vAlA koI AiA hI nahIM sI| so huNa qhuzaqhabarIAM deNa vAlA ate DarAuNa vAlA A giA he|[6] allAha hara cIz2a utte pUrI kudarata rakkhadA he|
translations.footnotes: [6] isa laI sAre manukkhAM laI iha lAz2ama he ki uha muhaMmada (sa:) dI nabuvvata te rasAlata ’te ImAna laike AuNa| nabI (sa:) ne faramAiA ki merI ate methoM pahilAM hoe nabIAM dI udAharana iMja ru jiveM kise ne koI bahuta hI qhUbasUrata imArata usArI para usa de ika koNe vica ika iTTa dI jaghA chaDDa dittI lokIM isa de Ale-duAle ghuMmade ate isa dI qhUbasUratI te rurAnI dA pragaTAvA karade ate Akhade ki kAza isa thAM vI iTTa lagga jAMdI faramAiA ki uha iTTa maiM hAM ate maiM sAre aMbIAM de aqhIra viccoM hAM| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 3535)

translations.translation: yAda karo jadoM mUsA ne ApaNI kauma nUM AkhiA sI ki he merI kauma! allAha de usa ahisAna nUM yAda karo, jihar3A usa ne tuhADe utte kItA he, jadoM ki usa ne tuhADe viccoM paig2aMbara baNAe, tuhAnUM hakUmatAM vI baqhazIAM ate tuhAnUM uha kujjha dittA jo saMsAra vica hora kise nUM nahIM sI dittA|
he merI kauma! isa pavittara dharatI (phalasatIna) vica dAqhala ho jAo jihar3I allAha ne tuhADe nAM likkha chaDDI he| tusIM (jihAda toM) piTTha nA phera laiNa, (nahIM tAM) tusIM ghATe vica rahoge|

uhanAM ne javAba dittA ki he mUsA! utthe tAM vadhere hI zakatIzAlI loka rahiMde hana uha jadoM taka utthioM nikala nahIM jAMde, asIM utthe ukkA hI nahIM jAvAMge, hAM! je uha utthioM nikala jANa phera asIM (qhuzI nAla) dAqhala hovAMge|

uhanAM viccoM do viakatI, jo rabba toM DaraNa vAliAM viccoM sana ate jinhAM utte rabba dI mihara sI, uha bole, tusIM uhanAM de mukAbale laI bUhe taka tAM pahuMco, jadoM tusIM bUhe vica dAqhala hovoge tAM lAz2amana tusIM hI bhArU rahoge| je tusIM sacce momina ho tAM tuhAnUM allAha utte hI bharosA karanA cAhIdA he|
uha AkhaNa lagge ki he mUsA! jadoM taka uha utthe hana udoM taka asIM usa dharatI vica nahIM dAqhala hovAMge, so tUM te terA rabba, doveM hI jAo te uhanAM nAla lar3o, asIM tAM itthe hI baiThe hAM|
mUsA ne AkhiA ki he rabbA! mainUM tAM chuTTa ApaNe Apa toM ate ApaNe bharA (hArUna) toM hora kise ’te koI z2ora nahIM, so tUM sAnUM isa avagiAkArI kauma toM aDDa karade|

allAha ne faramAiA ki huNa ihanAM laI iha pavittara dharatI cAlI sAlAM tIka harAma kara dittI gaI| huNa iha iddhara-uddhara bhaTake hoe phirade rahiNage so tusIM ihanAM nA-faramAna lokAM dI ciMtA nA karo|

(he nabI!) tusIM ihanAM (nA-faramAnAM) nUM Adama de puttarAM (hAbIla te kAbIla) dA kissA vI ThIka-ThIka suNA dio| jadoM uhanAM dovAM ne (rabba de haz2Ura) ika kurabAnI peza kItI tAM ihanAM viccoM ika (hAbIla) dI kurabAnI kabUla ho gaI ate dUje (kAbIla) dI kabUla nA hoI tAM uha (IrakhA vica A ke) kahiNa laggA ki maiM tAM tainUM mAra devAMgA[7] tAM usa ne (jisa dI kurabAnI kabUla hoI sI) kihA ki allAha tAM usa toM Darana vAliAM dI hI kurabAnI kabUla karadA he|
translations.footnotes:
[7] nA-hakkA katala de saMbaMdha vica allAha de rasUla (sa:) dA faramAna he ki jadoM vI saMsAra vica kise nUM nA-hakkA katala kItA jAMdA he tAM usa de katala karana de gunAha dA ika hissA haz2arata Adama de puttara kAbIla nUM jAMdA he kiuM jo pahilA nA-hakkA katala karana dI rasama use toM zurU hoI sI| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 3335)
* dUjI hadIsa vica faramAiA ki maithoM bAada tusIM ika dUje nUM nA-hakkA katala karake kAfira nA baNa jANA| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 6868)

translations.translation: je tUM mainUM katala karana de irAde nAla mere utte hattha cukkegAM maiM phera vI tainUM katala karana laI ApaNA hattha nahIM cukkAMgA| bezakka maiM tAM allAha toM, jo sAre saMsAra dA pAlaNahAra he, DaradA hAM|
maiM cAhuMdA hAM ki tUM merA gunAha ate ApaNA gunAha, doveM ApaNe sira lai laveM ate narakIAM vica jA raleM| z2AlamAM dA iho badalA he|
iMja usa de jI ne usa nUM ApaNe bharA nUM katala karana laI tiAra kara liA, so usa ne katala kara dittA, jisa nAla uha ghATA uThAuNa vAliAM vica jA raliA|

(jadoM usa nUM lAza dI ciMtA hoI) phera allAha ne utthe ika kAM bhejiA, jo ApaNe paMjiAM nAla dharatI nUM puTTa rihA sI, tAM jo usa nUM vikhAe ki uha ApaNe bharA dI lotha (lAza) nUM kiveM lukAve| phera uha (kAbIla) kahiNa laggiA ki afasosa maiM tAM isa kAM varagA vI nA ho sakiA ki ApaNe bharA dI lotha nUM dafanA diMdA| so uha pachatAuNa vAliAM viccoM ho giA|

ise kArana asIM, isarAIlIAM laI likhata jArI kara dittI sI ki jihar3A viakatI kise nUM katala karegA, binAM isa galla toM ki usa ne kise dA katala kItA hove jAM dharatI utte phitanA fasAda failAuNa vAlA hove tAM iMja samajho ki usa ne sAre hI lokAM nUM (bhAva manukkhatA nUM) hI katala kara dittA hove [8] ate jihar3A viakatI kise dI jAna (nUM ana-hakkA katala hoNa toM) bacA lave, iMja samajhe ki usa ne sAre hI lokAM dI jAna bacAI he| ihanAM kola sADe bahuta sAre paig2aMbara sapazaTa dalIlAM lai ke Ae, praMtU phera vI vadhere loka dharatI utte ajihe hana, jihar3e haddoM nikala jAMde hana|
translations.footnotes: [8] gunAhe kabIrA (mahAM pApa) de bAre nabI karIma (sa:) ne faramAiA ki uha iha hana, allAha dA zarIka baNAuNA, kise nUM nA-hakkA katala karanA, mApiAM dI nA-faramAnI karanA, jhUTha bolaNA, jAM jhUThI gavAhI deNA| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 6871)

translations.translation: jihar3e loka allAha ate usa de rasUla nAla jaMga karade hana (bhAva AdezAM de inakArI hana) ate dharatI utte vigAr3a paidA karade hana, uhanAM dI saz2A iho he ki uhanAM nUM katala kara dittA jAve jAM fAMsI de dittI jAve jAM virodhI dizAvAM toM uhanAM de hattha paira vaDDa suTTe jANa jAM uhanAM nUM deza-nikAlA de dittA jAve, iha tAM uhanAM dI saMsArika rusavAI he praMtU Aqhirata vica uhanAM laI bahuta vaDDI (naraka dI) saz2A he|
para hAM! jihar3e loka tuhADe kAbU pAuNa toM pahilAM pahilAM taubA kara laiNa, uhanAM nUM khimA kara dio| tusIM bharosA rakkho ki allAha bahuta vaDDA baqhazaNahAra te atiaMta rahima karana vAlA he|
he ImAna vAlio! allAha toM Darade raho ate usa dI ner3atA prApata karana de jatana karo ate usa dI rAha vica jihAda (saMgharaza) karo tAM jo tuhADA bhalA ho sake|

bezakka jihanAM lokAM ne (rabba de ika hoNa dA) inakAra kItA he je uhanAM kola uha sabha kujjha hove jihar3A dharatI utte he ate iMnA hI hora hove tAM vI (uhanAM dI saz2A de badale vica) kabUliA nahIM jAvegA| uhanAM laI tAM bahuta hI karar3A az2Aba he|
uha naraka dI agga viccoM nikalaNA cAhuMNage, praMtU usa viccoM kade vI nikala nahIM sakaNage| uhanAM laI tAM sadIvI az2Aba he|
tusIM corI karana vAle puraza te corI karana vAlI isatarI dA hattha vaDDa dio| iha allAha valloM usa aparAdha dI sikkhiAvAna saz2A he, jihar3A uhanAM ne kItA he| allAha z2orAvara te dAnAI vAlA he|
phera jihar3A viakatI aparAdha karana magaroM taubA kara lave ate ApaNe Apa nUM suAra lave tAM allAha usa dI taubA savIkAra karadA he| allAha vaDDA hI baqhazaNahAra ate rahima karana vAlA he|

kI tusIM nahIM jANade ki dharatI ate akAza dI pAtazAhI kevala allAha laI hI he, uha jisa nUM cAhe (mAr3e kaMmAM dI) saz2A deve ate jisa nUM cAhe muAfa kara deve| allAha hara tarhAM dI kudarata rakkhadA he|

he rasUla! tusIM uhanAM lokAM laI duqhI nA hovo, jihar3e inakAra karana vica kAhalI karade hana, ihanAM (yahUdIAM) viccoM kujjha tAM uha loka hana, jihar3e ApaNe mUMhoM Akhade hana ki asIM ImAna liAe hAM, jada ki uha diloM ImAna nahIM liAe| uhanAM lokAM viccoM hI kujjha yahUdI hana, uha jhUThIAM gallAM suNana de AdI hana te dUjI kauma dI kaMnasoI karana vAle hana| uha ajihe tuhADe kola (tAbedArI laI) nahIM Ae| uha (tauraita de) zabadAM de ThIka aratha siddha hoNa magaroM uhanAM nUM badala diMde hana| uha lokAM nUM Akhade hana ki je tuhAnUM (muhaMmada sa: valloM tauraita anusAra) hukama dittA jAve tAM maMna lavo, je hukama nA dittA jAve tAM uhanAM toM aDDa raho| (he nabI!) jisa nUM allAha hI fitane (az2amAiza) vica pA deNA cAhave tAM tuhAnUM isa saMbaMdha vica kujjha vI adhikAra nahIM (ki uha ImAna vAle baNa jANa)| jihanAM de bAre allAha ne hI nahIM cAhiA ki uhanAM de mana pAka hoNa, uhanAM laI saMsAra vica rusavAI he ate Aqhirata vica vI uhanAM laI karar3I saz2A he|

iha (munAfaka) loka jhUThIAM gallAM suNana vAle ate harAma mAla khANa vAle hana, je iha tuhADe kole AuNa tAM (he nabI!) tuhAnUM iha adhIkAra he, bhAveM ihanAM vicakAra faisalA kara dio, bhAveM TAla dio| jekara tusIM ihanAM dA faisalA karana toM nA kara deo tAM vI iha tuhAnUM kujjha vI hAnI nahIM pahuMcA sakade, je tusIM faisalA karo tAM hakka-inasAfa de nAla faisalA karo| allAha inasAfa karana vAliAM nAla muhabbata karadA he|

rurAnI vAlI galla he ki uha tuhAthoM kiveM faisalA karavAuMde hana, jada ki uhanAM kola tauraita (mojUda) he, jisa vica allAha valloM ditte hukama likhe hoe hana phera vI uha ihanAM hukamAM toM mUMha mor3a rahe hana| asala galla he ki iha ImAna vAle he hI nahIM|

asIM tauraita nAz2ila kItI jisa vica hidAita ate nUra he| yahUdIAM viccoM allAha dI tAbedArI karana vAle sAre hI rasUla, allAha vAle ate giAnI loka isa kitAba anusAra hI faisalA karade sana| ise laI uha allAha dI isa kitAba de rAkhe baNAe gae ate uha sAre hI isa galla de gavAha sana| so (he yahUdIo!) tusIM lokAM toM nA Daro ate kevala merA Dara hI dila vica rakkho, merIAM AitAM (hukamAM) nUM thor3he jihe mulla ’te nA veco, jihar3e lokI allAha de utAre hoe (kAnUM na) anusAra faisalA nahIM karade, uhIo kAfira hana|[9]
translations.footnotes: [9] kufara de do daraje hana kufare akabara (vaDDA gunAha) te kufare asag2ara (choTA gunAha)| kufare akabara vica jhuThalAuNA, ghamaMDa karanA, nifAka Adi zAmala hana ate kufare asag2ara toM bhAva allAha dIAM niamatAM dI nA-zukarI karanA he|

translations.translation: asIM uhanAM yahUdIAM laI tauraita vica hukama likha dittA sI ki bezakka jAna de badale jAna,[10] akkha de badale akkha, nakka de badale nakka, kaMna de badale kaMna, daMda de badale daMda ate sAre vizeza jaqhamA dA vI barAbara dA badalA he, phera jihar3A viakatI muAfa kara deve (badalA nA lave) usa laI hI badale toM chuTakArA he ate jihar3e loka allAha valloM nAz2ila kIte hoe hukamAM anusAra faisalA nahIM karade, uhIo z2Alama hana|
translations.footnotes: [10] zarIata dA hukama he ki kasAsa toM binAM kise nUM katala nahIM kItA jANA cAhIdA| nabI karIma (sa:) ne faramAiA, jihar3A musalamAna isa galla dI gavAhI diMdA he ki allAha toM chuTTa koI izaTa nahIM ate maiM (muhaMmada sa:) allAha dA rasUla hAM tAM usa dA katala karanA tiMna hAlatAM toM chuTTa jAiz2a nahIM (1) jAna de badale vica jAna (2) je koI vivAhata viakatI z2anAM kare tAM usa nUM pattharA nAla mAriA jAvegA (3) je koI isalAma toM fira jAve ate musalamAnAM dI jamAata nUM chaDDa deve tAM usa dI saz2A vI katala hI he| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 6878)

translations.translation: ate asIM ihanAM paig2aMbarAM magaroM marIama de puttara IsA nUM bhejiA [11] jihar3A ApaNe toM pahilAM AI kitAba bhAva tauraita dI puzaTI karana vAlA sI| asIM usa (IsA) nUM iMjIla dittI, jisa vica (siddhA rAha vekhaNa laI) rozanI ate hidAita sI ate uha ApaNe toM pahilAM nAz2ala hoI kitAba (tauraita) dI puzaTI karana vAlI sI ate burAIAM toM bacaNa vAliAM laI hidAita te nasIhata nAla bharI hoI sI|
translations.footnotes:
[11] haz2arata IsA toM bAada haz2arata muhaMmada (sa:) nUM nabI baNAiA giA| allAha de rasUla (sa:) ne faramAiA, maiM ibane marIama nAla sabha toM vaddha ner3e dA sabaMdha rakkhadA hAM ate sAre paig2aMbara mere alAtI bhAI hana, mere ate ibane marIama vicAle koI nabI nahIM| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 3442)
* alAtI bhAI toM bhAva he ki jinhAM dA bApa ika hove ate mAvAM vakkha vakkha hoNa bhAva ki sAre nabIAM dA dIna ika hI sI para tarIke (zarIatAM) vakkha vakkha sI paraMtU zarIate muhaMmadIyA toM bAada sArIAM zarIatAM radda ho gaIAM ate huNa dIna vI ika he ate zarIata vI ika| (ahasanula-biAna)

translations.translation: ate iMjIla vAliAM nUM cAhIdA he ki allAha ne jo vI iMjIla vica hukama nAz2ala kIte hana usa de anusAra hI faisale karana ate jihar3e loka allAha valloM nAz2ala kIte hoe hukamAM anusAra faisale nahIM karade, uha fAsika (ulaMghANAkArI) hana|

(he nabI!) asIM tuhADe utte iha kitAba (.kuraAna) saccAI ate hakka nAla nAz2ila kItI he, iha usa kitAba dI puzaTI karadI he, jihar3I isa toM pahilAM [12] (nAz2ila hoI) sI ate usa dI rAkhI karadI he| so tusIM uhanAM (yahUdI ate IsAIAM) de ApasI jhagar3hiAM vica allAha valloM utArI hoI kitAba (.kuraAna) anusAra hI faisale karo| tusIM isa saccAI (.kuraAna) dI aNadekhI karade hoe uhanAM dIAM icchAvAM de picche nA laggo| asIM tuhADe viccoM hareka laI ika kA`na ate kaMma karana dA ika DhaMga niyata kItA he| je allAha cAhuMdA tAM tuhAnUM sAriAM nUM ika hI ummata baNA diMdA praMtU uha tAM cAhuMdA ru ki isa kitAba rAhIM tuhAnUM parakhe so tusIM nekIAM vica ika dUje toM agAMha vadho| tusIM sAriAM ne jANA use rabba kola hI he phera uha tuhAnUM uhanAM gallAM dI hakIkata dassa devegA, jihanAM vica tusIM matabheda karade rahiMde sAM|
translations.footnotes: [12].kuraAna pahilAM AIAM sArIAM kitAbAM dI rAkhI karadA he uhanAM kitAbAM vica jo vI rabbI bANI he,.kuraAna usa dI puzaTI karadA he ate jo uhanAM kitAbA vica raddo-badala kara dittA he, usa nUM jhuThalAuMdA he|

translations.translation: (he nabI!) tusIM ihanAM lokAM de mAmaliAM vica rabba valloM tuhADe utte utArI kitAba (.kuraAna) anusAra hI faisale karo| ihanAM dIAM icchAvAM dI pAlaNA nA karo ate ihanAM toM sAvadhAna raho, kite iha tuhAnUM kise ajihe hukama toM iddhara-uddhara nA kara deNa jihar3A allAha ne tuhADe ’te utAriA he je uha mUMha mor3ade hana tAM sacca jANo ki allAha vI iho cAhuMdA he ki ihanAM nUM ihanAM de kujjha gunAhAM dI saz2A (saMsAra vica) mila jAve ate bahute loka tAM ihanAM viccoM ulaMghaNAkArI hI hana|
kI iha loka jahAlata bhariA faisalA cAhuMde hana?[13] jihar3I kauma allAha utte vizavAsa rakkhadI he, usa laI allAha toM vadhIA faisalA koNa kara sakadA he?
translations.footnotes: [13] hadIsa anusAra tiMna tarhAM de viakatI allAha nUM saqhata nApasaMda hana (1) jihar3A qhAnA-kAabA vica gunAha kare (2) jihar3A musalamAna haMde hoe vI jahAlata vAlIAM rasamAM ravAjAM nUM ApaNAe (3) kise dA nA-hakkA katala karana laI usa dA picchA kare| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 6882)

translations.translation: he ImAna vAlio! tusIM yahUdIAM ate IsAIAM nUM ApaNA mittara nA baNAo iha tAM Apasa vica hI ika dUje de mittara hana| tuhADe viccoM jihar3A vI koI ihanAM nAla dosatI karegA, uha ihanAM viccoM hI giiNaA jAvegA| bezakka allAha z2AlamAM nUM kade vI hidAita nahIM diMdA|

phera tusIM uhanAM lokAM nUM vekhade ho jihanAM de dilAM vica (chala kappaTa dI) bImArI he| uha bhajja bhajja ke uhanAM yahUdIAM vica jA ghusade hana ate uhanAM nUM kahiMde hana ki sAnUM Dara laggadA he iMja nA hove ki asIM kise musIbata vica hI phasa jAIe| ho sakadA he ki allAha tuhAnUM (musalamAnAM nUM) jitta hI de deve jAM ApaNe valloM koI hora (bhalAI dI) galla z2Ahira kara deve tAM phera iha loka ApaNe dila vica lukAIAM hoIAM gallAM utte pachatAuNage|

usa vele ImAna liAuNa vAle AkhaNage, kI iha uha loka hana, jihar3e allAha de nAM utte vaDDIAM-vaDDIAM sahUMAM khA ke vizavAsa dilAuMde sana ki uha tuhADe nAla hI hana? ihanAM de sAre amala viaratha gae ate iha ghATA khANa vAliAM viccoM ho gae|

he ImAna vAlio! tuhADe viccoM jihar3A vI koI ApaNe dIna toM phira jAvegA tAM allAha chetI hI ajihe lokAM nUM liAvegA ki uha uhanAM nAla muhabbata karadA hovegA ate uha vI allAha nAla mahubbata karade hoNage| uha mominAM pratI naramI karana vAle ate kAfirAM laI bahuta hI saqhata hoNage| uha allAha dI rAha vica jihAda karanage ate kise maMdA-caMgA AkhaNa vAle dI paravAha nahIM karaNage| iha allAha dIAM miharAM hana, jisa nUM cAhuMdA he diMdA he, allAha asImita sAdhanAM dA mAlika he ate sabha kujjha jANadA he|

(he musalamAno!) tuhADe dosata tAM kevala allAha ate usa de rasUla (haz2arata muhaMmada) hana ate uha sAre hI ImAna vAle hana jihar3e namAz2AM par3hade hana ate z2akAta diMde hana ate uha (allAha de hara hukama agge) jhukaNa vAle hana|
ate jo vI viakatI allAha, usa de rasUla nAla ate uhanAM lokAM nAla jihar3e ImAna liAe hana, dosatI karegA[14] (iho allAha dI TolI he)| baizakka allAha dI TolI hI bhArU rahiNa vAlI he|
translations.footnotes: [14] hadIsa anusAra allAha ate usa de rasUla dI muhabbata ImAna de suAda dA kAranahe allAha de rasUla (sa:) ne faramAiA ki jisa kise vica iha tiMna AdatAM hoNagIAM uha ImAnI suAda avazza hI cakhegA, (1) allAha ate usa de rasUla usa nUM sabha toM vaddha mahibUba hoNa (2) kise nAla mittaratA kevala allAha laI hI kare, (3) mur3a kAfira hoNA iMja nApasaMda hove jiveM agga vica suTTa dittA giA| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 16)

translations.translation: he ImAna vAlio! uhanAM nUM ApaNA mittara nA baNAo jinhAM ne tuhADe dharama (isalAma) nUM hAsA-maqhola baNA chaDDiA he, bhAveM uha uhanAM viccoM hoNa jihanAM nUM tuhAthoM pahilAM kitAbAM (tauraita, iMjIla) dittIAM gaIAM hana jAM kAfira hoNa, je tusIM momina ho tAM kevala allAha toM hI Daro|
jadoM tusIM uhanAM nUM namAz2a laI bulAuMde ho [15] tAM uha iha dA makhaula uDAuMde hana ate kheDa-tamAzA baNA laiMde hana, iha isa laI karade hana ki uhanAM nUM akala hI nahIM|
translations.footnotes: [15] namAz2a laI balAuNa dA tarIkA nabI (sa:) ne az2Ana duArA dassiA he| kujjha suhAbA nUM supaniAM vica az2Ana de zabada dasse gae ate Apa (sa:) ne uhanAM nUM pasaMda kItA| haz2arata abbAsa ra:a: toM patA laggadA he ki namAz2a de ailAna laI lokAM ne agga bAlaNa jAM nAkUsa (bhAva uccI AvAz2a dA sAz2a) bajAuNa dI rAe dittI, jo yahUdIAM ate IsAIAM dA tarIkA sI tada haz2arata balAla ra:a: nUM kihA giA ki az2Ana vica kalame (bola) do vAra ate akAmata laI ika-ika vAra kahiNa (akAmata usa sameM kahI jAMdI he jadoM lokIM namAz2a laI tiAra ho jAMde hana)| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 603)

translations.translation: so (he nabI!) tusIM Akho ki he kitAba vAlio! kI tusIM sADe nAla isa laI vaira rakkhade ho ki asIM allAha ate usa valloM ghallI gaI kitAba (.kuraAna) ate sAthoM pahilAM nAz2ila hoIAM kitAbAM utte ImAna rakkhade hAM| bezakka tuhADe viccoM bahute loka tAM nA-faramAna hana|

(he nabI!) kahi dio! kI maiM tuhAnUM usa viakatI bAre nA dassAM jihar3A badale pakkhoM allAha dIAM naz2arAM vica usa (nA-faramAna) toM vI vaddha bhair3A he? iha viakatI uha he jisa utte allAha ne lAanatAM pAIAM hana ate usa ’te ApaNA g2az2aba (karopa) nAz2ila kItA he| ihanAM viccoM kujjha nUM bAMdara ate sUra baNA chaDDiA| ate jisa viakatI ne zaitAna dI baMdagI kItI uhI loka sabha toM vaddha bhair3I zreNI vica hana ate iho hana jihar3e sabbha toM vaddha siddhI rAha toM bhaTake hoe hana|

jadoM uha tuhADe kola AuMde hana tAM kahiMde hana ki asIM ImAna liAe, jada ki uhanAM dA hAla iha he ki uha kufara de nAla hI (ImAna vica) dAqhala hoe sI ate use de nAla hI nikala gae| iha jo vI lukA rahe hana allAha uha sabha jANadA he|
tusIM vekhoge ki ihanAM viccoM bahute loka gunAha, vadhIkI ate harAma khANa vica chetI karade hana, uha bahuta hI bure kaMma hana jo uha karade hana|

ihanAM nUM ihanAM de allAha vAle te dharama-giAnI gunAha dIAM gallAM kahiNa toM te harAma cIz2AM khANa toM kiuM nahIM rokade? bezakka bahuta hI bhair3I racanA he jo uha ApaNe laI tiAra kara rahe hana|

yahUdI Akhade hana ki allAha de hattha bajjhe hoe hana? (jada ki) hattha tAM ihanAM de hI[16] bajjhe hoe hana ate ihanAM dI isa bakavAsa kArana hI ihanAM utte lAanatAM kItIAM gaIAM hana, sagoM allAha de hattha tAM khullhe hana, jiveM cAhuMdA he qharaca karadA he| hakIkata iha he ki jo vI tuhADe rabba valloM utAriA jAMdA he iha ihanAM (kAfira) viccoM batheriAM dI sarakazI ate kufara vica vAdhe dA kArana baNadA he| ate asIM kiAmata taka laI ihanAM vicAle IrakhA te vaira virodha pA chaDDiAM he| jadoM vI uha lar3AI dI agga bhar3akAuNA cAhuMde hana tAM allAha usa nUM bujhA diMdA he| iha dharatI utte vigAr3a paidA karana laI bhajje-naTThe phirade hana jada ki allAha fasAdIAM nUM pasaMda nahIM karadA|
translations.footnotes: [16].kuraAna vica jihar3IAM vI allAha dIAM sifatAM biAna hoIAM hana, jiveM ciharA, akkha, hattha, piMDalI, ANA, phar3aNA Adi biAna hoiA he jAM jihar3IAM sifatAM hadIsa toM siddha hana, jiveM uttaranA, hassaNA Adi, tAM ihanAM ’te ImAna rakkhaNA z2arUrI he ate ihanAM sifatAM dA hakkadAra vI allAha hI he kiujo allAha dA irazAda he, usa allAha jihI koI cIz2a nahIM| (sUrata aza-zUrA 11/42) ate usa de barAbara dA koI nahIM| (sUrata ala-aqhalAsa 4/112)

translations.translation: je iha ahale kitAba ImAna liAuMde ate dilAM vica rabba dA Dara rakkhade tAM asIM (allAha) ihanAM dIAM sArIAM burAIAM nUM muAfa kara diMde ate ihanAM nUM niamatAM bharIAM jannatAM vica lai jAMde|

je iha loka tauraita, iMjIla ate allAha valloM bhejIAM dUjIAM kitAbAM de hukamAM dI ThIka-ThIka pAlaNA karade tAM iha loka ApaNe upparoM (akAzoM) ate heThoM (dharatI viccoM) vI roz2IAM prApata karade| ika dhar3A ihanAM viccoM vicakAra vAlI bhAva siddhI rAha ’te he,[17] para ihanAM dI bahugiNatI bahuta hI bhair3e kaMma kara rahI he|
translations.footnotes: [17] jiveM abadullA bina salAma ra:a: Adi sana haz2arata anasa ra:a: toM patA laggadA he ki jadoM abadullA bina salAma (yahUdI vidavAna) nUM patA laggiA ki nabI karIma (sa:) madIne padhAra rahe hana tAM uha nabI (sa:) toM kujjha gallAM pucchaNa laI hAz2ara hoiA ate kihA ki maiM tuhAthoM tiMna gallAM pucchaNA cAhuMdA hAM jinhAM nUM nabI toM chuTTa hora koI nahIM jANadA (1) kiAmAta hoNa dI pahilI nizAnI kihar3I he?(2) jaMnatI sabha toM pahilAM kI khANage (3) isa dA kI kArana he ki kade baccA bApa varagAM huMdA he kade mAM varagA? nabI (sa:) ne faramAiA ki jibarAIla ne iha gallAM huNe mainUM dassIAM hana abadullA bina salAma ne AkhiA iha jibarAIla tAM farizatiAM vica yahUdIAM dA vairI he Apa (sa:) ne faramAiA (1) kiAmata dI pahilI nizAnI agga he jihar3I lokAM nUM pUraba dizA toM pacchama valla laike jAvegI (2) jaMnatIAM dA pahilAM bhojana macchI dI kalejI dA vAdhU hisA hovegA (3) jadoM marada dA vIraja aurata de vIraja ’te bhArU ho jAve tAM baccA bApa dI zakala dA ate jadoM aurata dA vIraja marada de vIraja ’te bhArU ho jAve tAM baccA mAM dI zakala ’te huMdA he iha suNa ke abadullA bina salAma ne kihA ki maiM gavAhI diMdA hAM ki chuTTa allAha toM hora koI pUjaNahAra nahIM ate tusIM allAha de rasUla ho ate iha vI AkhiA ki he allAha de rasUla! yahUdI kauma ilaz2AmabAz2I ’ca mAhira he, tusIM uhanAM nUM mere bAre isalAma vica AuNa toM pahilAM dA hAla puccho| yahUdI kauma de kujjha baMde nabI (sa:) dI sevA vica hAz2ara hoe tAM Apa (sa:) ne uhanAM toM pucchiA tuhADe viccoM abadullA bina salAma kiho jihA viakatI he? uhanAM ne javAba vica kihA, uha sADe viccoM ika bhalA AdamI he ate bhale AdamI dA hI puttara he, uha sADe vica vadhIA mAnayoga viakatI he ate mAnayoga viakatI dA hI puttara he| isa ’te nabI karIma (sa:) ne pucchiA ki je abadullA bina salAma isalAma kabUla kara lave tAM tuhADI kI rAe he yahUdI bole allAha usa nUM isalAma toM bacAe| Apa (sa:) ne uhanAM toM phera iho savAla kItA tAM uhanAM ne phera uhIo javAba dittA abadullA bina salAma jihar3e luke hoe sI uhanAM kola Ake kahiNa lagge “azahAdo-allA-ilAhA-ilalla-lAha vA-azahAdo-annA-muhaMmadu-rasUlullAha”| yahUdI iha suNa ke AkhaNa lagge ki abadullA bina salAma sADe viccoM sabha toM mAr3A viakatI he ate mAr3e AdamI dA hI puttara he ate usa nUM caMgA mAr3A AkhaNa lagga pae| usa sameM abadullA bina salAma ne kihA ki he allAha de rasUla! mainUM isa galla dA hI Dara sI| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 3938)

translations.translation: he rasUla! jo kujjha vI Apa jI valla tuhADe rabba valloM ghallhiA giA he usa nUM lokAM taka pahuMcA devo je tusIM ajihA nA kItA tAM tusIM allAha de paig2aMbara hoNa dA hakka adA nahIM kItA| allAha tuhAnUM lokAM dIAM zarAratAM toM bacAuNa vAlA he| bezakka allAha kAfirAM nUM sedha nahIM diMdA|

(he nabI!) tusIM kahi dio! he ahale kitAba! tusIM asalI dharama utte kade vI kAima nahIM rahi sakade jada taka ki tusIM tauraita, iMjIla ate ApaNe rabba valloM utArIAM hoIAM dUjIAM kitAbAM de AdezAM dI pAlaNA nahIM karoge| hakIkata iha he jo kujjha tuhADe valla tuhADe rabba ne utAriA he, iha ihanAM (ahale kitAba) de bahute lokAM dI sarakazI te kufara vica vAdhe dA kArana baNiA he, so tusIM kAfirAM de hAla utte dukhI nA hovo|

bezakka jihar3e loka vI ImAna liAe bhAMveM uha yahUdI, sAbI te nasarAnI hana, ihanAM viccoM jihar3A vI allAha ate kiAmata utte ImAna rakkhegA ate neka kaMma vI karegA, uhanAM nUM (kiAmata dihAr3e) nA koI Dara hovegA ate nA hI uhanAM nUM koI dukkha hovegA|

asIM isarAIla dI saMtAna toM rabbI hukamAM dI pAlaNA karana dA pakkA vAadA liA sI ate uhanAM valla kaI rasUla bheje sI, para jadoM kade uha rasUla uhanAM kola uha cIz2a laike Ae, jihanAM nUM uha nApasaMda karade sana, tAM kujjha nabIAM nUM uhanAM ne jhuThalAiA ate kaIAM nUM uha katala hI kara diMde sana|

ate uha iMja samajhade sI ki uhanAM dI koI pakar3a nahIM hovegI, so uha aMnhe-bole ho gae| phera allAha uhanAM utte miharabAna ho giA bhAva muAfa kara dittA| phera vI uhanAM dI bahu-giNatI aMnhI te bolI hI baNI rahI| allAha caMgI tarhAM vekhaNa vAlA ru jo uha karade hana|

bezakka uhanAM lokAM ne kufara kItA jinhAM dA kahiNA sI ki bezakka allAha tAM marIama dA puttara masIha hI he| jadoM ki masIha ne iha kihA sI ki he banI isarAIla! tusIM allAha dI hI ibAdata karo, jihar3A merA te tuhADA rabba he| jihar3A viakatI allAha nAla kise hora nUM sAMjhI baNAuMdA he usa laI allAha ne jaMnata harAma kara chaDDI he te usa dA TikANA naraka he| jitthe gunAhagArAM dI madada karana vAlA koI nahIM hovegA|[18]
translations.footnotes: [18] vekho sUrata ala-bakaraha, hAzIA Aita 165 /2

translations.translation: uha loka vI kAfira ho gae jinhAM ne kihA sI ki allAha tiMnAM (bhAva marIama, IsA te allAha) viccoM ika he| jada ki ika izaTa toM chuTTa hora koI izaTa nahIM| je kara iha loka ApaNI isa galla toM bAz2a nA Ae tAM ihanAM vica jihar3e kufara ’te ar3e rahiNage uhanAM nUM dukhadAI az2Aba milegA|
phera kI iha loka allAha agge taubA nahIM karade ate usa toM khimA nahIM maMgade? allAha tAM bahuta hI vaDDA baqhazaNahAra ate bahuta hI miharabAna he|[19]
translations.footnotes: [19] allAha taubA karana vAle toM kiMnA qhuza haMdA he isa dA patA ika hadIsa toM laggadA he ki allAha de rasUla (sa:) ne faramAiA allAha ApaNe baMde dI taubA karana ’te isa toM kIte vaddha qhuza huMdA he ki jisa dA UMTha jaMgala vica kho jAve fera acaNaceta usa nUM mila jAve| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 6309)

translations.translation: masIha ibane marIama ika paig2aMbara hoNa toM chuTTa kujjha vI nahIM sI| ihanAM toM pahilAM vI vadhere paig2aMbara ho guz2are hana| ihanAM (IsA) dI mAtA (marIama) ika saccI-succI aurata sI, uha doveM (mAM-puttara) bhojana kariA karade sana| vekho asIM ihanAM sAhamaNe kiddAM nizAnIAM (manukkha hoNa dIAM) biAna karade hAM, phera vI vekho ki uha kiddhara puTThe phire jAMde hana|

(he nabI!) tusIM Akha dio! tusIM loka allAha nUM chaDDa ke jinhAM dI ibAdata karade ho uha nA tAM tuhADe laI koI nukasAna ate nA hI koI lAbha deNa dA adhikAra rakkhade hana| allAha hI sabha kujjha suNana vAlA ate jANana vAlA he|

Akha dio! ki he ahale kitAba! ApaNe dIna vica aNa-hakkA vAdhA nA karo ate uhanAM lokAM dIAM icchAvAM de picche nA laggo jihar3e pahilAM toM hI bhaTake hoe hana, uhanAM ne batheriAM nUM kurAhe pAiA he, uha siddhI rAha toM bhaTake hoe hana|
banI isarAIla viccoM jihar3e kAfira baNa gae uhanAM utte dAUda ate IsA dI z2ubAna toM lAanata kItI gaI, iha sabha isa laI hoiA kiuM jo uhanAM ne nA-faramAnI kItI ate haddoM Tappa jAMde sana|
uha ika dUje nUM bhair3e kaMmAM toM rokade nahIM sI, kiuM jo uhanAM ne uha kaMma qhuda vI kItA huMdA sI jo vI uha karade sana, bezakka uha bahuta hI burA karade sana|

tusIM ihanAM vica bahute lokAM nUM vekhoge ki uha uhanAM lokAM nAla dosatIAM karade hana jo kufara karade sana| jo vI uhanAM de manAM ne agge (paraloka laI) bhejiA he, uha bahuta hI burA he, allAha ihanAM toM narAz2a he, huNa uha sadA (naraka de) az2Aba vica hI rahiNage|

je iMja huMdA ki uha allAha ate usa de rasUla ’te ImAna liAuMde ate jo vI usa ’te utAriA giA he, usa ’te ImAna rakhade tAM iha kade vI kAfirAM nAla dosatIAM nA karade| para ihanAM viccoM bahute loka tAM ulaMghaNAkArI hana|

(he nabI!) bezakka tusIM ImAna vAliAM dA sabha toM vaDDA duzamana yahUdIAM nUM ate muzarikAM [20] nUM vekhoge ate ImAna vAliAM nAla mittaratA vica sabha toM vaddha ner3atA tusIM uhanAM ’ca vekhoge jihar3e ApaNe Apa nUM nasArA (IsAI) kahiMde hana| iha isa laI ki ihanAM ’ca kujjha dharama-giAnI te ibAdata guz2Ara hana ate kujjha saMsAra-tiAgI vI hana ate uha ghamaMDa vI nahIM karade|
translations.footnotes: [20] muzarika toM bhAva kaI butA nUM maMNana vAlA, butapUjaka ate allAha de ika hoNa te usa de rasUla muhaMmada (sa:) ’te ImAna nA rakkhaNa vAle|

translations.translation: jadoM uha (nasArA) rasUla valla utariA hoiA kalAma (.kuraAna) suNade hana tAM tusIM vekhoge ki uhanAM dIAM akkhAM viccoM atharU vagaNa lagga jAMde hana| isa dA kArana iha he ki uhanAM ne hakka nUM pachANa liA he| uha kahiMde hana ki he sADe rabba! asIM ImAna liAe so huNa tUM sADA nAM vI (hakka dI) gavAhI deNa vAliAM vica likha lai|

(ate kahiMde hana ki) huNa sADe kola kihar3A bahAnA he ki asIM allAha ’te ate jihar3A hakka (.kuraAna) sADe kola pahuMciA he usa ’te ImAna nA liAe ate sA` isa galla dI vI Asa rakkhaNI cAhIdI he ki sADA rabba sAnUM neka lokAM vica zAmala karegA|
ise kathana sadakA allAha uhanAM nUM ajihe bAg2a devegA jisa de heTha nahirAM vagadIAM hoNagIAM ate uha uhanAM vica sadA laI rahiNage ate neka lokAM dA iho badalA he|
ate jihar3e loka kufara karade rahe ate sADIAM AitAM nUM jhuThalAuMde rahe, uhIo narakI hana|

he ImAna vAlio! allAha ne jihar3IAM pavittara cIz2AM tuhADe laI halAla (jAiz2a) kItIAM hana, tusIM uhanAM nUM harAma (nA-jAiz2a) nA Akho ate haddoM nA Tappo| bezakka allAha haddAM TappaNa vAliAM nUM nApasaMda karadA he|
allAha ne tuhAnUM jo halAla te pAka riz2aka (roz2I) dittA he usa viccoM khAo ate allAha toM Daro jisa utte tusIM ImAna rakkhade ho|

allAha tuhADIAM binAM soce samajhe khAdIAM hoIAM kasamAM laI tuhADI pakar3ha nahIM karegA para uhanAM kasamAM ’teu[21] avazza puccha-giccha karegA jihar3IAM tusIM (soca samajha ke) pakkIAM kItIAM hana| (pakkIAM kasamAM bhaMga karana ’te) dasa muthAjAM nUM bhojana karAuNA he jihA tusIM ApaNe parivAra nUM khuAMde ho jAM uhanAM nUM kappar3A deNA jAM ika garadana bhAva g2ulAma Az2Ada karanA he| phera jihar3A ihanAM viccoM kujjha vI karana dI himmata nA rakkhadA hove tAM uha tiMna dina de roz2e (lagAtAra) rakkhe| iha tuhADIAM uhanAM kasamAM dA kuffArA (bhAva pApa nUM DhakaNa dA sAdhana) ru jihanAM nUM tusIM tor3a baiThade ho| tusIM ApaNIAM kasamAM dI rAkhI karo| allAha tuhAnUM sAre Adeza khola khola ke dassadA he tAM jo tusIM zukara adA karo|
translations.footnotes: [21] bhAva kasamAM soca samajha ke hI khANIAM cAhIdIAM hana, je kasama khA laiNa toM bAada usa de siTTe bhair3e hoNa dA qhatarA hove tAM kasama nUM tor3a deNA cAhIdA he| nabI karIma (sa:) ne faramAiA ki asIM (ummate muhaMmadiA) isa dunIAM vica sabha toM AkhIra vica Ae para kiAmata vAle dina sabha toM agge hovAMge Apa (sa:) ne faramAiA kasama allAha dI tuhADI viccoM koI vI ajihI kasama nUM pUrA karana dI z2idda nA kare jisa toM ghara-parivAra nUM koI hAnI haMdI hove, uha viakatI allAha dIAM naz2arAM vica aparAdhI he, usa nUM cAhIdA he ki uha kasama tor3a deve ate allAha de hukama anusAra kuffArA adA kare| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 6624, 6625)

translations.translation: he ImAna vAlio! bezakka zarAba, jUA, asathAna te fAlagirI de tIra, iha sAre gaMde kaMma hana ate zaitAnI kaMmAM viccoM hana so ihanAM toM baco,[22] tAhIoM tusIM safala hovoge|
translations.footnotes: [22] isa toM patA lagadA he ki zaitAnI kaMmAM nUM halAla karana dI koziza karanA bahuta hI ghaTIAM kaMma he iMja uha halAla nahIM hoNagIAM sagoM harAma hI rahiNagIAM| ika hadIsa vica allAha de rasUla (sa:) dA faramAna he, merI ummata vica kujjha lokI ajihe avazza hoNage jihar3e z2anA, rezama, zarAba, gANa-bajANa de sAmAna nUM halAla samajhaNage ate pahAr3AM vica kujjha uha loka vI rahiMde hoNage ki zAma vele uhanAM dA caravAhA uhanAM de pazUAM nUM uhanAM kola laike AegA ate ApaNI lor3a pratI savAla karegA para uha usa nUM AkhaNage ki sADe kola kalla nUM AI para rAta nUM hI uhanAM utte pahAr3a Dega dittA jAvegA ate uha barabAda ho jANage ate jihar3e uhanAM ’coM baca jANage uhanAM nUM bAMdara te sUra baNA dittA jAvegA jo kiAmata taka ੲaiveM hI rahiNage| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 5590)

translations.translation: zaitAna tAM iha cAhuMdA he ki zarAba te jUe duArA tuhADe vicAle vaira-virodha pA deve ate allAha dI yAda ate namAz2a toM tuhAnUM parAM rakkhe| kI tusIM ihanAM zaitAnI kaMmAM toM bAz2a nahIM Auge|

tusIM allAha ate rasUla dI AgiAkArI karade raho ate saMbhala ke raho| je tusIM hakka sacca toM phira jAo tAM iha jANa lao ki sADe rasUla de z2iMmeM tAM kevala (rabbI Adeza) kholha-kholha ke pahuMcAuNA he|

jihar3e loka ImAna liAe te neka kaMma karana lagga pae, pahilAM uhanAM ne jo kujjha vI (harAma) khAiA piA he usa laI koI gunAha (bhAva saz2A) nahIM, para agge laI burAIAM toM bacaNa, ImAna ’te kAima rahiNa te bhale kaMma karana, phera je uha burAIAM toM bace hI rahiNa ate ImAna utte DaTe rahiNa, phera uha rabba toM Darade hoe nekI karana tAM allAha nekI karana vAliAM nUM pasaMda karadA he|

he ImAna vAlio! allAha tuhADI parakha usa zikAra duArA karegA, jinhAM taka tuhADe hattha ate tuhADe nez2e bhAva hathiAra pahuMca sakade hana tAM jo allAha nUM patA lagga jAve ki koNa he jihar3A usa toM binAM vekhe DaradA he, (ihanAM hidAitAM toM bAada) jihar3A vI viakatI haddoM TappegA, usa laI daradanAka az2Aba he|

he ImAna vAlio! jadoM tusIM iharAma dI hAlata vica hovo tAM zikAra nA karo, je tuhADe vica koI jANa bujjha ke zikAra karegA tAM zikAra kIte hoe jAnavara de barAbara ika jAnavara pazUAM viccoM fidiyA deNA hovegA jisa dA faisalA tuhADe viccoM do munasifa vAle karanage| iha (fidiyA) kurabAnI karana laI kAabe pahuMcAiA jAvegA jAM isa dA kuffArA kujjha muthAjAM nUM bhojana karavAuNA he jAM isa de barAbara roz2e rakkhaNA he| (iha sabha isa laI he) tAM jo uha ApaNe kIte kaMmAM dA suAda vekhaNa| allAha ne pahilAM hoe gunAhAM nUM muAfa kara dittA he ate je koI viakatI mur3a ajihI harakata karegA tAM allAha usa toM badalA lavegA| allAha z2abaradasata ate badalA laiNa vAlA he|

tuhADe laI samuMdara dA zikAra ate usa dA khANA halAla (jAiz2a) kItA giA he, iha tuhADe laI vI he ate musAfarAM de lAbha (bhAva sahUlata) laI he| tusIM iharAma dI hAlata vica qhuzakI dA (bhAva dharatI utte) zikAra karanA tuhADe laI harAma kIta giA he| tusIM allAha toM Darade raho jisa de kola tusIM sAre ikaTThe kIte jAvoge|

qhAnA-kAabA jihar3A satikAra vAlA ghara ru allAha ne isa nUM lokAM de Thahirana dA ika sAdhana baNAiA he| huramata bhAva Adara vAle (cAra mahIne) ate harama vAlI kurabAnI ate paTe vAle jAnavarAM nUM vI satikAra dittA he| iha sabha isa laI ki tusIM jANa lao ki bezakka allAha hI akAzAM ate dharatI vica jo vI he, uhanAM sabha dA giAna rakkhadA he| bezakka allAha sArIAM cIz2AM dA jANana vAlA he|
jANa lao! allAha saqhata saz2A deNa vAlA he ate atiaMta baqhazaNahAra te rahima faramAuNa vAlA vI allAha hI he|
rasUlAM de z2iMme tAM allAha dA paig2Ama (lokAM takka) pujjadA karanA he| allAha uha sabha kujjha jANadA he, jo tusIM vikhAvA karade ho ate jo tusIM gupata rakkhade ho|

(he nabI!) tusIM Akha dio! ki pAka te nApAka ika sAmAna nahIM ho sakade bhAveM nApAka lokAM dI bahugiNatI tuhAnUM kiMnI hI prabhAvita kiuM nA karadI hove| so he akala vAlio! tusIM allAha toM hI Daro tAM jo tusIM safala ho sako|

he ImAna vAlio! tusIM (muhaMmada sa: toM) ajihIAM gallAM nA puccho ki je uha tuhADe ’te sapazaTa ho jANa tAM tuhAnUM burIAM laggaNa, je tusIM.kuraAna de nAz2ala hoNa sameM ihanAM (gupata gallAM) de saMbaMdha vica pucchoge tAM tuhADe ’te sapazaTa kara dittIAM jANagIAM| pahilAM de pucche gae savAlAM nUM allAha ne muAfa kara ditA he| allAha vaDDA baqhazaNahAra ate sahiNa karana vAlA he|
ajihIAM gallAM tuhAthoM pahilAM dUje lokAM ne vI pucchiAM sana ate uhanAM gallAM kArana hI uha kAfira ho gae|
allAha ne nA kise nUM bahIrA niyata kItA he, nA sAibA, nA vasIlA, nA hI hAma| para iha kAfira allAha utte jhUThe Aropa lagAuMde hana| jada ki uhanAM viccoM bahute mUrakha hana|

jadoM uhanAM nUM kihA jAMdA he ki Ao usa cIz2a (.kuraAna) valla jo allAha ne nAz2ila kItA he ate rasUla valla Ao tAM Akhade hana ki sADe laI tAM uhIo tarIkA batherA he jisa utte asIM ApaNe bApa-dAdiAM (bhAva baz2uragAM) nUM vekhiA he bhAveM uhanAM de pio dAdA kujjha vI nA jANade hoNa ate nA hI hidAita vAle hoNa (phera vI ihanAM dI hI pairavI karanage?)|

he ImAna vAlio! tusIM ApaNI ciMtA avaza karo, je tusIM siddhI rAha ’te calla rahe ho tAM jihar3A viakatI kurAhe piA hoiA he uha tuhADA kujjha vI vigAr3a nahIM sakadA| tusIM sAriAM ne allAha valla hI parataNA he, phera uha tuhAnUM dassa devegA ki tusIM kI karade rahe ho?

he ImAna vAlio! jadoM tuhADe viccoM kise dI mauta dA velA AuNa lagge (tAM vasIata karana vele) tuhADe vicAle koI gavAha hoNA cAhIdA he| so vasIata karade sameM ApaNe (rizatedArAM) viccoM do niAkArIAM nUM gavAha baNA lao| je tusIM kidhare safara ’ca hovoM ate (rAha vica hI) tuhA` mauta A jAve tAM bigAnIAM viccoM do gavAha ThIka hana| je tuhA` (beinasAfI dA) zakka ho jAve tAM ihanAM dohAM gavAhAM nUM namAz2a magaroM masIta vica roka lavo je uha allAha dI suMha khA ke AkhaNa ki asIM isa gavAhI de badale kujjha vI nahIM lai rahe ate je koI sAka saMbaMdhI vI hove tAM vI asIM usa dA pakkha pUrana vAle nahIM ate asIM allAha dI gavAhI nUM gupata nahIM rakkhAMge| je asIM ajihA kItA tAM asIM vI pApIAM vica giNe jAvAMge|

phera je patA laga jAve ki uhanAM dohAM ne (jhUThI gavAhI deNa dA) pApa kItA he tAM uhanAM dI thAM do hora gavAha uhanAM lokAM viccoM lavo, jihanAM dA hakka mAriA jA rihA he ate mritaka de vI vaddha ner3e hoNa, je uha doveM allAha dI suMha khA ke AkhaNa ki sADI gavAhI pahile dohAM gavAhAM toM vadhere saccI he, asIM koI vadhIkI nahIM kItI, je asIM ajihA karIe tAM z2AlamAM vica giNe jAvAMge|

isa tarhAM Asa kItI jA sakadI he ki uha saccI gavAhI deNage jAM ghaTTo-ghaTTa isa galla toM DaraNage ki uhanAM (vArasAM) dIAM sahuMAM magaroM uhanAM dIAM sahuMAM vI radda nA kara dittIAM jANagIAM| so tusIM allAha toM Daro ate suNo! ki allAha nA-faramAnAM nUM hidAita nahIM diMdA|

usa dina dI ciMtA karo jadoM allAha sAre paig2aMbarAM nUM jamAM karegA phera uhanAM nUM AkhegA ki tuhAnUM (tuhADI kauma ne) kI javAba dittA sI? uha (paig2aMbara) AkhaNage ki sAnUM kujjha vI nahIM patA, tUM hI chupIAM hoIAM gallAM dA bhetI he|

jadoM allAha faramAegA ki he IsA bina marIama! tUM ApaNe te ApaNI mAM utte hoI merI usa niamata nUM yAda kara jadoM maiM terI madada pavittara rUha (jibarAIla) rAhIM kItI sI| tUM mAM dI godI vica vI (bhAva jaMmade hI) te siANI umara vica vI lokAM nAla gallAM karadA sI| maiM tainUM kitAba, DUMghI siANapa, tauraita te iMjIla dI sikkhiA vI dittI| jadoM tUM mere hukama nAla gAre nAla paMchIAM vAMga mUrata baNAuMdA sI, phera tUM usa vica phUMka mAradA sI tAM uha mere hukama nAla ika paMchI baNa jAMdA sI| mere hukama nAla hI tUM jamAMdarU aMnhe te phulavaharI vAle viakatI nUM savasatha kara diMdA sI ate mere hukama nAla hI tUM muradiAM nUM (kabarAM viccoM jiuMdA) kaDDhadA sI| jadoM maiM tenUM banI isarAIla toM bacAiA sI, udoM tUM uhanAM kola merIAM khullhIAM nizAnIAM lai ke AiA sI, phera ihanAM viccoM, jihanAM ne inakAra kItA sI, uhanAM ne kihA sI ki iha tAM nirA jAdU he, hora kujjha vI nahIM|
jadoM maiM havArIAM nUM hukama dittA sI ki tusIM mere ate mere rasUla ’te ImAna liAo, udoM uhanAM ne kihA sI ki asIM ImAna liAe, tusIM gavAha raho ki asIM pUre AgiAkArI hAM|

uha samAM vI yAda karo jadoM havArIAM (bhAva IsA de sahAikAM) ne kihA sI ki he marIama de puttara IsA! kI tuhADA rabba iha kara sakadA he ki sADe laI bhojana dA thAla bheje? tAM uhanAM (IsA) ne kihA ki allAha toM Dara, je tusIM ImAna vAle ho|
uha bole, asIM cAhuMde hAM ki asIM usa viccoM khAIe tAM jo sADe dilAM dI tasallI ho jAve ate asIM iha jANa laIe ki tusIM sADe nAla sacca boliA he ate asIM gavAhI deNa vAliAM viccoM ho jAIe|

IsA bina marIama ne duA kItI ki he allAha! he sADe pAlaNahAra! sADe laI akAza toM bhojana dA thAla bheja tAM jo uha sADe agaliAM-pichaliAM laI Ida (qhuzI) dA avasara ho jAve uha tere valloM vizeza nizAnI hove| tUM sAnUM riz2aka baqhaza, kiuM jo tUM hI sAriAM toM vadhIA riz2aka deNa vAlA he|
allAha ne kihA ki maiM uha bhojana tuhADe laI utArAMgA, je phera vI tuhADe viccoM koI inakAra karegA, tAM maiM usa nUM ajihI saz2A devAMgA ki uha saz2A dunIAM jahAna vica kise hora nUM nahIM devAMgA|

uha samAM vI yAda rakkho, jadoM allAha AkhegA ki he marIama de puttara IsA! kI tUM ihanAM nUM kihA sI ki mainUM ate merI mAM nUM allAha nUM chaDDa ke izaTa baNAo? tAM uha AkhegA ki tUM pAka he, mainUM kise prakAra vI iha zobhA nahIM diMdA ki maiM ajihI galla kahAM jisa dA mainUM koI vI adhikAra nahIM, je maiM iha galla kahI hovegI tAM tuhAnUM patA hI hovegI, tUM tAM mere dila dIAM gallAM vI jANadA he, para maiM tere dila dIAM gallAM nahIM jANadA| tUM sArIAM g2aiba dIAM gallAM dA jANana vAlA he|

maiM uhanAM nUM chuTTa usa toM jisa dA tUM mainUM hukama dittA sI, kujjha vI nahIM kihA ki tusIM allAha dI baMdagI karo, jihar3A merA vI rabba he ate tuhADA vI rabba he| maiM jadoM taka ihanAM vica rihA ihanAM dI rAkhI kItI jadoM tUM mainUM cukka liA phera tUM hI ihanAM dI rAkhI karana vAlA sI| tUM hI hara cIz2a dI rAkhI karana vAlA he|
je tUM ihanAM nUM saz2A deveMgA tAM iha tere baMde hana, je tUM ihanAM nUM muAfa kara deveM, tAM bezakka tUM vaDDA z2orAvara te hikamata vAlA he|[23]
translations.footnotes: [23] nabI (sa:) vI kiAmata dihAr3e iho zabada bolaNage jiveM hadIsa vica he allAha de rasUla (sa:) ne faramAiA kiAmata dihAr3e tuhAnUM jamAM kItA jAvegA kujjha lokAM nUM khabbe pAse naraka valla lijAiA jAvegA, maiM usa sameM uhIo kahAgAM jo allAha de neka baMde haz2arata IsA ne AkhiA sI| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 4626)

translations.translation: allAha AkhegA ki iha (kiAmata) uha dina he ki sacca bolaNa vAliAM nUM uhanAM dA sacca bolaNA lAbhadAika siddha hovegA| uhanAM nUM isa sacca de badale vica bAg2a milaNage jinhAM heTha nahirAM vagadIAM hoNagIAM, jisa vica uha sadA rahiNage| allAha uhanAM toM rAz2I hovegA ate uha allAha toM rAz2I hoNage| iho asalI kAmayAbI he|
akAzAM te dharatI ate ihanAM vicAle dI hara cIz2a utte allAha dI hI hakUmata he ate hareka cIz2a use de kAbU vica he|
sArIAM tArIfAM usa allAha laI jisa ne akAzAM te dharatI nUM sAjiA he, haneriAM nUM ate rauzanI (nUra) nUM baNAiA, phera vI kAfira loka (horAM nUM) ApaNe pAlaNahAra de barAbara darajA diMde hana|

uha (allAha) uhIo ru jisa ne tuhAnUM (manukkhAM nUM) miTTI toM paidA kItA he, phera usa ne (tuhADe laI) ika samAM (mauta) dA nizacita kItA ate usa de kola (kiAmata dA) samAM vI nizacita kItA hoiA he| (vizeza kiAmata dA samAM allAha nUM hI patA he) tusIM phera vI zakka karade ho|
ate uhIo allAha akAzAM vica vI he te dharatI vica vI uhIo he| uha tuhADIAM gupata gallAM nUM vI ate tuhADe z2Ahira (vikhAve) nUM vI jANadA he ate uha sabha uha vI jANadA he jo tusIM karade ho|
ate ihanAM kola ihanAM de rabba dIAM nizAnIAM viccoM koI vI nizAnI ajihI nahIM AI jisa toM ihanAM ne mUMha nA mor3hiA hove|

jadoM uhanAM kola hakka (.kuraAna) A giA tAM uhanAM ne isa nUM vI jhuThalAiA| so chetI hI uhanAM (inakArIAM) nUM (usa dI mattahatA dA) patA lagga jAvegA jisa cIz2a nAla iha loka makhaula kariA karade sana|[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] uhanAM sAriAM nUM allAha dA az2Aba milegA kiuM jo haz2arata muhaMmada (sa:) dI nabuvvata te risAlata utte ImAna liAuNA sAre manukkhAM laI z2arUrI he| vekho sUrata Ale-imarAna, hAzIA Aita 85 /3

translations.translation: kI uhanAM ne nahIM vekhiA ki ihanAM toM pahilAM asIM kiMnIAM hI kaumAM nUM halAka kara cukke hAM jinhAM nUM asIM dharatI utte iMnA zakatIzAlI baNAiA sI ki tuhAnUM tAM uha zakatI dittI hI nahIM| asIM uhanAM utte akAza toM mosalAdhAra bAriza kItI ate nahirAM baNAIAM jihar3IAM uhanAM de gharAM heTha vagadIAM sana| phera asIM uhanAM de pApAM kArana uhanAM nUM halAka kara dittA ate uhanAM dI thAM dUjIAM kaumAM paidA kItIAM|

(he nabI!) je asIM kAg2az2a ’te likhI hoI koI kitAba tuhADe utte nAz2ila kara diMde, phera iha (makke de kAfira) loka isa nUM ApaNe hatthIM chU ke vI vekha laiMde tAM vI iha kAfira z2arUra iho Akhade ki iha tAM paratakkha jAdU hI he|

iha loka tAM iha vI kahiMde hana ki isa nabI utte koI farizatA kiuM nahIM utAriA giA| (he nabI!) je asIM koI farizatA vI bheja diMde tAM sArA kissA hI qhatama ho giA huMdA| phera ihanAM nUM koI Dhilla vI nA miladI|
je asIM isa (nabI nUM) farizatA baNA ke utArade tAM vI uha manukkhI rUpa vica hI AuMdA| ise prakAra dA zakka iha phera vI karade jisa vica iha huNa phase hoe hana|

he nabI! tuhAthoM pahilAM jihar3e vI paig2aMbara hoe hana, uhanAM dA vI makhaula kItA giA sI| phera ihanAM viccoM jihar3e lokAM ne makhaula kItA sI, uhanAM nUM usa az2Aba ne A gheriA, jisa dA uha makhaula uDAiA karade sana|
(he nabI!) tusIM Akha dio ki ratA dharatI utte ghuMma phira ke vekho ki (rabba de) inakArIAM dA kiho jihA aMta hoiA sI|

ihanAM toM puccho! ki jo kujjha vI akAzAM te dharatI vica maujUda he uhanAM sabha dA mAlika kauNa he? tusIM kaho ki sabha dA mAlika allAha hI he| allAha ne (ApaNI maqhalUka utte) miharabAnI[2] karanA ApaNe laI lAz2ama kara liA he| uha kiAmata dihAr3e tuhAnUM sAriAM nUM z2arUra hI ikaTThA karegA, jisa de AuNa vica koI zakka nahIM| jinhAM lokAM ne ApaNe Apa nUM ghATe vica rakkhiA he uha ImAna nahIM liAuNage|
