translations.footnotes: [2] kiuM jo uha atiaMta rahima vAlA he| usa dI rahimata dA koI aMta nahIM| hadIsa vica he ki allAha ne ApaNI rahimata de 100 bhAga kIte ate uhanAM ’coM 99 hisse ApaNe kola rakkha hoe hana ate kevala ika bhAga dharatI ’te utAriA he, isa ika bhAga kArana hI maqhalUka ika dUje ’te rahima karadI he| itthoM taka ki ghor3I vI ApaNe khura nUM ApaNe bacce nAla laggaNa nahIM diMdI tAM jo usa nUM koI takalIfa nA hove| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 6000)

translations.translation: rAta (de haneriAM) ate dina (de ujAle) vica jo kujha maujUda he, uha sabha allAha dA hI he| uha sabha kujjha suNadA te bhalI-bhAMta jANadA he|

(he nabI!) tusIM Akha dio, kI maiM usa allAha toM chuTTa kise hora nUM apaNA izaTa baNA lavAM? uhIo akAzAM te dharatI dA paidA karana vAlA he, uha (sabha nUM) khANa nUM diMdA he ate usa nUM koI khANa nUM nahIM diMdA| so tusIM Akha dio ki mainUM iha hukama hoiA he ki sabha toM pahilAM maiM isalAma kabUla karAM ate muzarikAM vica zAmila nA hovAM|
(he nabI!) tusIM Akho ki je maiM apaNe rabba dA kahiNA nAM maMniA tAM maiM ika vaDDe (kiAmata de) dina de az2Aba bhogaNa toM DaradA hAM|
jisa viakatI toM usa dina (naraka dA) az2Aba haTA dittA jAvegA, usa utte allAha dA bahuta hI vaDDA rahima hovegA| iho asalI kAmayAbI he|

je tuhAnUM allAha valloM koI dukha-takalIfa Ave tAM usa dA dUra karana vAlA vI allAha toM chuTTa hora koI nahIM| je allAha tuhAnUM kise bhalAI nAla nivAz2e tAM (uhIo de sakadA he kiuM jo) uha hara cIz2a ’te kudarata rakkhaNa vAlA he|
uhIo ApaNe baMdiAM utte pUrana adhikAra rakkhadA he ate uhIo vaDDIAM hikamatAM vAlA ate sArIAM qhabarAM rakkhaNa vAlA he|

(he nabI!) tusIM ihanAM toM puccho ki gavAhI vajoM sabha toM vaDDI cIz2a kihar3I he? tusIM Akho ki mere te tuhADe vicakAra allAha hI gavAha he ate mere valla iha vahI (.kuraAna) (jibarAIla nAM de farizate duArA) bhejI gaI he tAM jo maiM isa.kuraAna duArA tuhAnUM ate jisa taka vI iha (.kuraAna) pahuMce, uhanAM sabha nUM (rabba de az2Aba toM) DarAvAM| kI tusIM vAsatava vica vI iha gavAhI devoge ki allAha de nAla dUje vI izaTa hana? (he nabI!) tusIM Akha dio ki maiM iha gavAhI kade vI nahIM diMdA ate iha vI Akha dio ki kevala uhIo ikko ika (allAha hI) izaTa he ate maiM uhanAM toM barI hAM jihar3e zarIka tusIM baNA rahe ho|

jinhAM lokAM nUM asIM kitAba (tauraita te iMjIla) dittI uha isa (.kuraAna te rasUla nUM) iMjha pachANade hana jiveM ApaNe puttarAM nUM pachANade hana| jinhAM ne ApaNe Apa nUM ghATe vica pA chaDDiA he, uha ImAna nahIM liAuNage|[3]
translations.footnotes: [3] vekho sUrata Ale-imarAna, hAzIA Aita 85 /3

translations.translation: usa viakatI toM vaDDA z2Alama kauNa hovegA, jihar3A allAha ’te jhUTha thApe jAM allAha dIAM AitAM (nizAnIAM) nUM jhUThA Akhe? ajihe z2Alama kade vI safala nahIM hoNage|
uha samAM vI yAda karo jadoM asIM sAriAM nUM (ika thAM) ikaTThA karAMge, phera asIM muzarikAM nUM kahAMge ki tuhADe uha zarIka kitthe hana, jinhAM nUM tusIM allAha dA sAMjhI vicArade sI|
isa (puccha-giccha) ’te isa toM chuTTa hora kujjha vI bahAnA nahIM hovegA, ki uha iho AkhaNage ki he allAha! sAnUM sADe pAlaNahAra dI suMha ki asIM ukkA hI muzarika nahIM sI|
vekhaNA ki uha kiveM ApaNIAM jAnAM utte jhUTha ghar3haNage ate jinhAM nUM uha izaTa baNAuMde sI uha sabha alopa ho jANage|

ihanAM (makke de kAfirAM) viccoM kujjha uha vI hana jihar3e kaMna lA ke tuhADIAM gallAM suNade hana, jada ki asIM uhanAM de dilAM ’te par3ade pA chaDDe hana tAM jo uha samajha hI nA sakaNa ate uhanAM de kaMnAM vica DATa pA rakkhI he, jekara uha loka dalIlAM (nizAnIAM) vekha laiNa tAM vI uha ImAna nahIM liAuNage| jadoM iha lokI tuhADe kola AuMde hana tAM tuhADe nAla mallo-mallI bahisAM karade hana| iha lokI jihar3e kAfira hana, uha kahiMde hana ki iha (.kuraAna) tAM kujjha vI nahIM kevala be-dalIla gallAM hana, jihar3IAM pahilAM toM callIAM A rahIAM hana|
iha (kAfira) dUjiAM nUM vI isa (.kuraAna) toM rokade hana ate Apa vI isa toM dUra rahiMde hana| iha loka ApaNe Apa nUM hI tabAha kara rahe hana ate ihanAM nUM isa dA patA vI nahIM|

je tusIM ihanAM kAfirAM nUM usa vele vekho jadoM iha naraka vica khar3he kIte jANage, phera AkhaNage, kAza! je sAnUM ika vAra mur3a saMsAra vica vApasa bhejiA jAve tAM phera asIM ApaNe rabba dIAM nizAnIAM nUM kade vI jhUThA nahIM kahAMge ate asIM vI ImAna vAliAM viccoM hovAMge|

nahIM, sagoM ihanAM dIAM uha karatUtAM ajja pragaTa ho cukkIAM hana, jinhAM nUM uha pahilAM (saMsAra vica) lakoiA karade sana| je uhanAM nUM saMsAra vica mur3a bheja dittA jAve, phera vI uha uhIo kaMma karanage jinhAM toM uhanAM nUM rokiA giA sI| bezakka uha tAM ukkA hI jhUThe hana|
ate iha (kAfira) tAM iha vI kahiMde hana ki jIvana tAM kevala saMsArika jIvana hI he, asIM mur3a jiUMde nahIM kIte jAvAMge|

(he nabI!) je tusIM ihanAM nUM usa sameM vekhoM jadoM iha ApaNe pAlaNahAra de sAhamaNe khar3e kIte jANage, tada uha (allAha) faramAegA, kI iha (mur3a jIuNA) hakka nahIM he? tAM uha AkhaNage ki kiuM nahIM iho hakka he, ApaNe rabba dI suMha| allAha faramAegA ki huNa tusIM az2Aba dA suAda lavo kiuM jo tusIM kufara karade sI|

bezakka uhI loka ghATe vica rahe jinhAM ne allAha nAla mulAkAta hoNa nUM jhuThalAiA|[4] para jadoM kiAmata dI ghar3I acaNaceta uhanAM kola A jAvegI, phera AkhaNage ki afasosa! isa saMbaMdha vica sAthoM vaDDI bhulla ho gaI ate uha ApaNI piTThAM utte (pApAM dA) bhAra cukkI phiranage| caMgI tarhAM suNa lao! ki bahuta hI bhair3A he uha bhAra jo uha (kiAmata dihAr3e) cukkaNage|
translations.footnotes: [4] hadIsa anusAra allAha de rasUla ne faramAiA, jihar3A viakatI allAha nUM milaNA pasaMda karadA he tAM allAha vI usa nUM milaNA pasaMda karadA he ate je koI allAha nUM milaNA pasaMda nahIM karadA tAM allAha vI usa nUM milaNA pasaMda nahIM karadA| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 6508)

translations.translation: saMsArika jIvana tAM sivAe kheDa-tamAze toM hora kujjha vI nahIM jada ki Aqhirata dA jIvana burAIAM toM bacaNa vAliAM laI vadhIA thAM[5] he| kI tusIM soca vicAra nahIM karoge?
translations.footnotes: [5] bhAva parahez2agAra, neka ate sacce loka jihar3e allAha toM bahute Darade hana ate ihanAM sAre gunAhAM toM ate bhair3e kaMmAM toM bace rahiMde hana jinhAM toM usa ne manhA kItA he iha loka allAha toM bahuta muhabbata karade hana ate uha sAre neka kaMma karade hana jinhAM nUM karana dA usa ne hukama dittA he|

translations.translation: (he nabI!) asIM caMgI tarhAM jANade hAM ki tuhAnUM ihanAM (kAfirAM) dIAM gallAM toM dukha huMdA he| iha lokI tuhAnUM jhUThA nahIM kahiMde, sagoM iha z2Alima tAM allAha dIAM AitAM dA inakAra karade hana|

(he nabI!) tuhAthoM pahilAM vI kaI paig2aMbarAM nUM jhuThalAiA jA cukkiA he| para uhanAM ne jhuThalAuNa ate tasIhe deNa utte sabara kItA sI itthoM taka ki uhanAM nUM sADI (allAha dI) madada A pahuMcI| allAha dIAM gallAM (faisaliAM) nUM koI vI badalaNa vAlA nahIM he ate tuhADe kola kujjha paig2aMbarAM dIAM kujjha-kujjha qhabarAM pahuMca vI cukkIAM hana|

(he nabI!) je ihanAM kAfirAM dA hakka toM mUMha mor3aNA tuhAthoM sahiNa nahIM huMdA tAM je tusIM kara sakade ho tAM dharatI vica koI suraMga jAM akAza vica jANa laI koI paur3I labbha lao, phera tusIM uhanAM kola koI nizAnI lai Ao (je tusIM kara sakade ho tAM kara vikhAo) je allAha cAhuMdA tAM ihanAM sAriAM nUM siddhe rasate utte ikaTThiAM kara diMdA| so tusIM nAdAnAM viccoM nA hovo (bhAva allAha de faisaliAM utte hI sabara karo)|

uhIo lokI saccAI (nasIhata) kabUla karade hana jihar3e suNade hana| jitthoM taka muradiAM (kAfirAM) dA saMbaMdha he, allAha uhanAM nUM jiuMdiAM karake uThAvegA, phera uha sAre allAha valla hI liAe jANage|

iha kAfira loka kahiMde hana ki isa (muhaMmada sa:) utte koI vaDI nizAnI kiuM nahIM utArI gaI? (he nabI!) tusIM kahi dio ki bezakka allAha isa dI samarathA rakkhadA he ki uha koI vaDDI nizAnI nAz2ila kare, para bahute lokAM nUM isa dA giAna nahIM|

dharatI ’te callaNa vAlA koI jAnavara ate doveM khaMbAM nAla uDDaNa vAlA koI vI paMchI ajihA nahIM jihar3A tuhADe (manukkhAM) vAMga vakkharI ummata nA hove| asIM kitAba (.kuraAna) vica koI cIz2a (binAM caracA kIte) nahIM chaDDI| phera uha sAre ApaNe rabba de haz2Ura ikattarata kIte jANage|

jihar3e lokI sADIAM AitAM (.kuraAna) nUM jhuThalAuMde hana, uha gumarAhI de haneriAM kArana bole te guMge ho gae hana| allAha jisa nUM cAhave gumarAha kara diMdA he ate jisa nUM cAhave siddhI rAha taura diMdA he|

(he nabI!) tusIM (ihanAM kAfirAM nUM) puccho ki jekara tuhADe utte allAha dA koI az2Aba A jAve jAM tuhADe ’te kiAmata hI A jAve tAM kI tusIM allAha nUM chaDDa ke kise hora nUM (ApaNI sahAitA laI) pukAroge? je tusIM sacce ho (tAM javAba dio)|

sagoM tusIM kevala use (allAha) nUM hI (madada laI) saddoge| je uha cAhegA tAM tuhADI usa takalIfa nUM dUra kara devegA, jisa laI tusIM usa nUM aradAsa karoge| phera tusIM uhanAM sabha nUM bhulla jAvoge, jinhAM nUM tusIM (rabba dA) zarIka baNAuMde sI|
he nabI! asIM tuhAthoM pahilIAM ummatAM valla vI paig2aMbara bheje| phera asIM uhanAM (ummatAM) nUM kaThanAIAM te bimArIAM sahita nappa liA tAM jo uha nimaratA pUravaka sADe sAhamaNe niMva jANa|
jadoM uhanAM kola sADA (cetAvanI bhariA) az2Aba AiA tAM uhanAM ne nimaratA kiuM nahIM dhArI? sagoM uhanAM de mana kaThora ho gae ate uhanAM de amalAM vica zaitAna ne khicca paidA kara dittI|

phera jadoM uhanAM ne usa nasIhata nUM hI bhulA chaDDiA jihar3I uhanAM nUM kItI gaI sI tAM asIM hareka tarhAM (dI qhuzahAlI) de bUhe uhanAM laI khola ditte, itthoM taka ki jadoM uhanAM cIz2AM ’te, jihar3IAM uhanAM nUM dittIAM gaIAM sana, zeqhIAM mArana lagga pae tAM asIM acAnaka hI uhanAM nUM (az2Aba vica) phar3a liA| phera uha hareka (bhalAI toM) nirAza ho gae|
isa tarhAM usa kauma dI jar3a vaDDa dittI gaI jisa ne z2ulama kamAiA sI| sArIAM tArIfAM usa allAha laI hana jihar3A sAre jahAnAM dA pAlaNahAra he|

(he nabI!) tusIM puccho ki ratA iha tAM dasso ki je allAha tuhADI suNana zakatI ate tuhADI vekhaNa zakatI khoha lave ate tuhADe dilAM utte moharAM lA deve tAM allAha toM chuTTa hora kihar3A izaTa he jihar3A iha sabha tuhAnUM vApasa liA deve? tusIM vekho tAM sahI ki asIM dalIlAM nUM kiddAM vakho-vakkha pakkha toM peza kara rahe hAM, iha phera vI mUMha mor3I jAMde hana|
(he nabI!) tusIM kaho ki iha tAM dasso ki je tuhADe utte rabba dA az2Aba acAnaka jAM ailAnIAM A jAve tAM kI z2AlimAM toM chuTTa hora vI halAka kIte jANage? (ukkA hI nahIM|)

asIM koI vI ajihA rasUla nahIM bhejiA jihar3A (jaMnata dIAM) qhuzaqhabarIAM deNa vAlA ate (naraka toM) DarAuNa vAlA nA hove| phera jihar3A koI ImAna liAe ate ApaNe (amalAM dA) sudhAra kara lave tAM (kiAmata dihAr3e) uhanAM lokAM nUM nA koI Dara-bhau hovegA ate nA hI uha udAsa hoNage|
jihar3e vI loka sADIAM AitAM (nizAnIAM) nUM jhuThalAuMde hana uhanAM nUM az2Aba pahuMcegA, kiuM jo uha nA-faramAnIAM karade sana|

(he nabI!) tusIM Akha dio ki nA tAM maiM tuhAnUM iha kahiMdA hAM ki mere kola allAha de qhaz2Ane hana te nA hI maiM g2aiba (parokha) nUM jANadA hAM ate nA maiM tuhA` iha kahiMdA hAM ki maiM farizatA hAM, maiM tAM kevala jo mere valla vahI (rabbI paig2Ama) AuMdI he usa dI pairavI karadA hAM| tusIM puccho, kI aMnhA te sujAkhA doveM ika barAbara ho sakade hana? kI tusIM soca vicAra nahIM karade?

(he nabI!) tusIM isa (.kuraAna) rAhIM uhanAM lokAM nUM DarAo jihar3e isa galla toM Darade hana ki ApaNe rabba dI haz2UrI vica isa hAlata vica ikaTThe kIte jANage, jitthe usa (allAha) toM chuTTa uhanAM dA nA koI yAra-mittara hovegA ate nA hI koI sifArazI hovegA| ho sakadA he ki (ise Dara kArana) uha burAIAM toM bacaNa vAle baNa jANa|

he nabI! uhanAM lokAM nUM ApaNe toM dUra nA karo jihar3e savere-zAma ApaNe pAlaNahAra dI ibAdata karade hana, kevala use dI raz2A cAhuMde hana| uhanAM de hisAba dA tuhADe ’te koI bhAra nahIM ate tuhADe hisAba dA bojha bhAra uhanAM ’te nahIM| je tusIM uhanAM nUM ApaNe toM dUra karoMge tAM tusIM vI z2AlamAM vica giNe jAoge|

isa tarhAM asIM kaIAM nUM kaIAM rAhIM az2amAiza vica pAuMde hAM tAM jo iha (makke de saradAra) AkhaNa, kI iha uha loka hana jinhAM utte sADe viccoM allAha ne faz2ala kItA he?hAM, kI iha galla (sacca) nahIM ki allAha zukaraguz2Ara baMdiAM nUM (ihanAM kAfirAM) toM vaddha jANadA he

(he nabI!) jadoM uha loka tuhADe kola AuNa jihar3e sADIAM AitAM utte ImAna rakkhade hana tAM uhanAM nUM Akho ki tuhADe ’te salamAtI hove, tuhADe rabba ne miharAM karanIAM ApaNe z2iMme lai rakkhIAM hana| je tuhADe viccoM koI viakatI nAdAnI nAla koI bhair3A kaMma kara baiThe, phera usa toM taubA karake ApaNA sudhAra kara lave tAM allAha bahuta hI vaDDA baqhazaNahAra te miharAM vAlA he|
ise tarhAM asIM AitAM (hukamAM) dI viAkhiA karade rahiMde hAM tAM jo aparAdhIAM laI (naraka vica jANa vAlI rAha) sapazaTa ho jAve|

(he nabI!) tusIM Akha dio ki mainUM isa galla toM rokiA giA he ki maiM vI usa dI ibAdata karAM jinhAM dI tusIM (allAha nUM chaDDa ke) ibAdata karade ho| tusIM Akho ki maiM tuhADIAM icchAvAM dI pairavI nahIM karAMgA kiuM jo iMja tAM maiM kurAhe pai jAvAMgA ate siddhI rAha ’te callaNa vAliAM viccoM nA rahAMgA|

(he nabI!) tusIM Akha dio ki maiM ApaNe rabba valloM ika sapazaTa dalIla ’te kAima hAM ate tusIM usa dalIla nUM jhuThalA rahe ho, jisa cIz2a (bhAva az2Aba) dI tusIM chetI kara rahe ho usa de faisale dA adhikAra allAha nUM hI he| uhIo hakka biAna karadA he ate sabha toM caMgA faisalA karana vAlA vI uhIo he|

(he nabI!) tusIM Akha dio ki je mere vassa vica uha cIz2a huMdI jisa laI tusIM kAhalI karade ho, tAM mere ate tuhADe vicAle kadoM dA faisalA ho giA huMdA| z2AlamAM nUM tAM allAha caMgI tarhAM jANadA he|

g2aiba (parokha) dIAM kuMjIAM tAM allAha kola hI hana, uhanAM nUM usa toM chuTTa koI nahIM jANadA| jala te thala vica jo vI he uha sabha jANadA he| koI vI rukkha toM girana vAlA pattA ajihA nahIM jisa dA usa nUM giAna nA hove| dharatI de haneriAM vica koI dANA ajihA nahIM jisa nUM uha nA jANadA hove| gillI, sukkI koI cIz2a ajihI nahIM jihar3I khallhI kitAba (lauhe-mahifUja) vica nA likhI hove|

ate uhIo (allAha) he jihar3A rAta nUM (sauMde hoe) tuhADIAM rUhAM nUM kabaz2a kara laiMdA he| jo tusIM dina vica karade ho usa nUM jANadA he, phera dUje dina uha tuhAnUM jagAuMdA he, tAM jo tusIM ApaNe jIvana dA nizacita samAM pUrA kara lavo| tusIM sabha ne use valla jANA he, phera uha allAha tuhAnUM dassegA jo tusIM (saMsAra vica) karade sI|

uhIo (allAha) ApaNe baMdiAM utte hara pakkhoM bhArU he ate tuhADI nigarAnI laI (farizatiAM nU) bhejadA he,[6] itthoM tIka ki jadoM tuhADe viccoM kise dI mauta dA samAM AuMdA he, usa dI rUha sADe bheje hoe farizate kabaz2a karade hana| uha kujjha vI g2alatI nahIM karade|
translations.footnotes: [6] isa toM bhAva uha farizate hana jihar3e manuੱqha de caMge jAM bhair3e amala likhade hana| hadIsa anusAra nabI karIma (sa:) nUM allAha ne faramAiA ki allAha ne caMge jAM bhair3e sAre kaMma likhe hoe hana| phera uhanAM dI viAkhiA faramAI, jihar3A viakatI ika neka kaMma karana dA irAdA karegA para uha nahIM kara sakegA tAM usa de hakka vica ika nekI likhI jAvegI| ate jihar3A ika neka kaMma karana dA irAdA kare ate usa nUM pUrA vI kare tAM allAha usa laI dassa toM laike satta so guNA sagoM usa toM vI vaddha savAba likhegA| je koI burA kaMma karana dA irAdA kare para uha nA kare tAM allAha usa de hakka vica ika nekI dA savAba likhegA| para je uha viakatI koI bure kaMma dA irAdA kare ate usa nUM kare vI tAM allAha usa de hakka vica ika burAI likhegA| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 6491) haz2arata abU-hurairA faramAuMde hana ki nabI karIma (sa:) ne faramAiA ki rAta te dina de farizate vArI vArI AuMde hana ate fajara te asara vele jamhAM ho jAMde hana| rAta vAle farizate jadoM savera nUM allAha de darabAra vica hAz2ara haMde hana tAM uha uhanAM toM pucchadA he hAlAM ki uha caMgI tarhAM jANadA he ki tusIM mere baMdiAM nUM kisa hAlata vica chaDDa ke Ae ho? farizate javAba diMde hana he allAha! asIM uhanAM nUM chaDDa ke Ae hAM ki uha namAz2a par3ha rahe sI ate jadoM uhanAM de kola gae sI tAM vI uha namAz2a par3ha rahe sI| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 3223)

translations.translation: phera uha sAre ApaNe sacce mAlika valla paratAe jANage| caMgIM tarhAM suNa lavo ki faisaliAM dA sArA adhikAra allAha nUM hI prApata he ate uha hisAba laiNa vica bahuta hI chetI karadA he|

(he nabI!) tusIM ihanAM nUM puccho ki uha kauNa he jihar3A tuhAnUM thala (dharatI) ate jala (dariAvAM) de haneriAM de qhatariAM toM bacAuMdA he? tusIM use nUM miMnatAM tarale pA ke ate haulI-haulI aradAsAM karade ho ki je uha sAnUM ihanAM (musIbatAM) toM bacA lave tAM asIM z2arUra hI dhaMnavAdI hovAMge|
tusIM Akha dio ki allAha hI tuhAnUM isa (musIbata) toM ate hara takalIfa toM mukata karadA he, phera vI tusIM usa de nAla ziraka karana lagga jAMde ho!

(he nabI!) tusIM kaho ki iha galla dI vI use nUM kudarata he ki tuhADe utte koI az2Aba uparoM (akAzo) ੳtAra deve jAM tuhADe pairAM heThoM (dharatIoM) kaDDha liAve jAM tuhAnUM vakkha-vakkha ToliAM vica vaMDa ke ika dUje dI zakatI dA suAda cakhAve| tusIM vekho tAM sahI ki asIM kiveM vakkho-vakkha DhaMga nAla dalIlAM diMde hAM tAM jo uha (inakArI) samajha sakaNa|
ate tuhADI kauma isa (.kuraAna) nUM jhuThalAuMdI he jada ki uha hakka he| tusIM kahi dio ki maiM tuhADe utte koI nigarAna nahIM hAM|
hareka qhabara de pragaTa hoNa dA ika samAM nizacita he ate tuhAnUM chetI hI patA lagga jAvegA (jadoM kiAmata AvegI)|

(he nabI!) jadoM tusIM vekho ki iha (kAfira) loka sADIAM AitAM (AdezA) dI niMdA karade hana tAM ihanAM lokAM toM dUra haTTa jAo| jadoM taka ki uha dUjIAM gallAM vica nA rujha jANa| je zaitAna tuhAnUM iha galla bhulA vI deve tAM yAda AuNa ’te ihanAM z2AlamAM nAla nA baiTho|

jihar3e lokI parahez2agAra hana uhanAM ’te uhanAM (kAfirAM) de lekhe ’coM kise galla dI koI z2iMmevArI nahIM, para nasIhata karanA uhanAM dA faraz2a he| ho sakadA he ki uha (kAfira) vI (rabba toM) Darana vAle baNa jANa|

(he nabI!) ajihe lokAM dA khahir3A chaDDo dio jinhAM ne ApaNe dharama nUM kheDa-tamAzA baNA chaDDiA he ate saMsArika jIvana ne uhanAM nUM dhokhe vica pA chaDDiA he (ki jIvana tAM basa iho he)| tusIM isa.kuraAna duArA nasIhata karade raho tAM jo koI viakatI ApaNIAM hI karatUtAM kArana rAhIM barabAda nA ho jAve| phera chuTTa allAha toM nA tAM usa dA koI sahAI hovegA ate nA hI sifArazI hovegA| je uha dunIAM bhara dIAM saMbhava cIz2AM vI (ApaNe bacAo de) badale vica de deNa tAM vI usa toM kujjha nahIM liA jAvegA| iha uha loka hana jinhAM nUM uhanAM de karamAM kArana halAka kItA giA he ate jihar3A uha kufara karade rahe usa kArana uhanAM nUM naraka vica ubaladA hoiA pANI pINa laI milegA ate daradanAka saz2A milegI|

(he nabI!) tusIM Akha dio! kI asIM allAha nUM chaDDa ke uhanAM nUM pukArIe jo nA sAnUM koI lAbha de sakade hana te nA hI hAnI? kI asIM allAha dI hidAita toM bAada vI puTThe turIe? jAM asIM usa viakatI vAMga ho jAIe jisa nUM jaMgala vica zaitAna ne rAha toM berAha kara dittA hove ate uha rurAna parezAna bhaTakadA phiradA hove, usa de kujjha sAthI vI hoNa jihar3e usa nUM ThIka rasate valla bulA rahe hoNa ki sADe nAla A jA (iho siddhI rAha he)| (he nabI!) tusIM kaho ki hakIkata iho he ki siddhI rAha uhIo he jihar3I qhAsa allAha valla hI jAMdI hove ate sAnUM iha vI hukama hoiA he ki asIM kulla jahAna de pAlaNahAra dI adhInagI iqhatiAra karIe|
ate iha vI (hukama hoiA he) ki namAz2AM dI pAbaMdI karIe ate use allAha toM hI DarIe he jisa de kola sabha ne ikaThiAM hoNA he|

uhIo he jisa ne akAzAM te dharatI nUM hakka sacca nAla paidA kItA he ate jisa dina allAha AkhegA ki ‘ho jA’ basa uha (kiAmata) ho jAvegI| usa dA kahiNA hI sacca he| (kiAmata dihAr3e sArI hakUmata allAha dI hI hovegI) jadoM sUra (narasiMghA) vica phUMka mArI jAvegI| uha gupata gallAM dA vI ate pragaTa hoNa vAlIAM sArIAM gallAM dA jANanahAra he ate uhIo hikamatAM vAlA ate pUrI jANakArI rakkhaNa vAlA he|

uha samAM vI yAda rakkhaNa yoga he jadoM ibarAhIma ne ApaNe pitA Az2ara nUM kihA sI, kI tusIM butAM nUM izaTa baNAuMde ho? maiM tuhAnUM ate tuhADI sArI barAdarI nUM gumarAhI vica piA vekha rihA hAM|[7]
translations.footnotes: [7] haz2arata ibarAhIma de pitA ApaNI kauma vAMga kurAhe pae hoe sI so dUje muzarikAM vAMga uha vI naraka vica jANage jiveM hadIsa vica he ki allAha de rasUla (sa:) ne faramAiA, hazara vAle dina ibarAhIma ApaNe pitA Az2ara nUM jinhAM dA ciharA miTTI ghaTTe nAla lukiA hovegA, ibarAhIma uhanAM nUM kahiNage kI maiM ne tuhAnUM nahIM kihA sI ki nA-faramAnI nA karanA tAM Az2ara AkhegA ki ajja maiM terI nA-faramAnI nahIM karAMgA| ibarAhIma ApaNe rabba nUM benatI karanage ki he rabba! tainUM mere nAla vAadA kItA sI ki tUM hazara vAle dina mainUM z2alIla nahIM hoNa deveMgA isa toM vaddha ke merI rusavAI kI hovegI ki mere pitA z2alIla hove ate terI rahimata toM vAMjhA rahi jAve| isa ’te allAha faramAegA maiMne kAfirAM laI maMnata nUM harAma kara chaDDiA he, phera faramAegA he ibarAhIma! ApaNe pairAM de heTha vekha ibarAhIma vekhaNage ki gaMdagI nAla bhariA hoiA ika bijjU he jisa nUM lattA toM phar3hiA jAvegA ate naraka vica suTTa dittA jAvegA| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 3350)

translations.translation: asIM ibarAhIma nUM akAzAM te dharatI dIAM sArIAM cIz2AM isa laI vikhAuMde sI tAM jo uha pUrana vizavAsa karana vAliAM viccoM ho jAve|

jadoM rAta dA hanerA uhanAM utte chA giA tAM usa (ibarAhIma) ne ika tArA vekhiA ate AkhiA ki iho merA rabba he, para jadoM uha Dubba giA tAM AkhiA ki maiM DubbaNa vAliAM nAla muhabbata nahIM rakkhadA|

phera jadoM caMna nUM camakadA dekhiA tAM kihA ki iha merA rabba he| praMtU jadoM uha vI Dubba giA tAM Apa ne kihA ki je mainUM mere rabba ne hidAita nA baqhazI tAM maiM vI kurAhe paiNa vAliAM viccoM ho jAvAMgA|

phera jadoM usa ne sUraja nUM lizakAre mAradA hoiA vekhiA tAM AkhiA ki iha merA rabba he, iha tAM sAriAM toM vaDDA he| jadoM uha vI Dubba giA tAM Apa (ibarAhIma) ne AkhiA ki he merI kauma! bezakka maiM tuhADIAM uhanAM sArIAM cIz2AM toM bez2Ara hAM jinhAM nUM tusIM rabba dA sAMjhI baNAiA hoiA he|
maiM ne ApaNA mUMha usa hasatI valla hI kara liA he jisa ne akAzAM nUM ate dharatI nUM sAjiA he| maiM use (allAha) dA parasatAra hAM ate ziraka karana vAliAM viccoM nahIM hAM|

jadoM uha dI kauma usa nAla jhagar3ana laggI tAM usa ne kauma nUM AkhiA, kI tusIM allAha de mAmale vica mere nAla jhagar3ade ho? jada ki use (allAha) ne mainUM hidAita baqhazI he| maiM uhanAM toM nahIM DaradA jinhAM nUM tusIM allAha dA zarIka baNAiA he| hAM! je merA rabba hI kujjha cAhe tAM uha kara sakadA he| mere rabba de giAna de ghere vica hara cIz2a he| kI tusIM phera vI nahIM vicAra karade?

maiM uhanAM (izaTAM) toM kiveM DarAM jinhAM nUM tusIM (rabba dA) zarIka baNAiA he, jada ki tusIM isa galla toM nahIM Darade ki tusIM uhanAM nUM allAha dA zarIka baNAiA he jinhAM laI usa ne koI dalIla nahIM utArI? so ihanAM dohAM (muzarika te momina) dhar3hiAM viccoM kauNa vadhere nizaciMta hoNa dA adhikAra rakkhadA he, je tusIM jANade ho (tAM dasso)?
jihar3e loka ImAna liAe ate uhanAM ne ApaNe ImAna nUM z2ulama (ziraka) nAla nahIM laber3hiA uhanAM laI hI amana he ate siddhe rAha ’te vI iho calla rahe hana|

iha sADI (allAha dI) dalIla sI jihar3I asIM ibarAhIma nUM usa dI kauma dA mukAbalA karana laI baqhazI sI| asIM jisa nUM vI cAhuMde hAM usa de maratabe ucce kara diMde hAM| bezakka (he nabI!) tuhADA rabba bahuta hI hikamata te giAna vAlA he|

asIM usa (ibarAhIma) nUM isahAka (puttara) dittA ate yAkUba (potarA) dittA ate asIM sabha nUM hidAita (bhAva nabUvvata) baqhazI| isa toM pahilAM asIM nUha nUM hidAita baqhazI sI ate usa dI aulAda viccoM dAUda, sulaimAna, ayUbba, yUsufa, mUsA te hArUna nUM vI hidAita baqhazI sI, nekI karana vAliAM nUM asIM iMja hI caMgA badalA diA karade hAM|
ise tarhAM z2akarIA, yAhayyA, IsA ate ilayAsa nUM vI hidAita baqhazI, iha sAre hI neka lokAM (nabIAM) viccoM sana|
(use de vaMza viccoM asIM) isamAIla, ala-yasAa, yUnusa ate lUta nUM vI hidAita (nabUvvata) baqhazI ate ihanAM sAriAM nUM samUha saMsAra vAsIAM utte vaDiAI baqhazI|
isa de nAla hI uhanAM de pio dAdiAM, uhanAM dI aulAda ate uhanAM de bharAvAM viccoM kujjha nUM asIM (ApaNI sevA laI) cuNa liA ate siddhe rAha valla uhanAM dI agavAI kItI|

iha allAha dI hidAita hI he, uha ApaNe baMdiAM viccoM jisa nUM cAhuMdA he isa valla agavAI karadA he| je kIte uha loka vI ziraka karade tAM jo vI uha nekI karade uha sArI kItI kattarI ajAIM callI jAMdI|

iha uha loka hana jinhAM nUM asIM kitAba, hikamata ate nabuvatta rAhIM nivAz2iA sI| je iha loka isa (rabbI hidAita) dA inakAra karade hana tAM asIM isa (niamata) dI saMbhAla laI ika ajihI kauma tiAra kara rakkhI he jihar3I ihanAM (hidAitAM) dA inakAra karana vAlI nahIM hovegI|

iho uha loka hana jinhAM dI hidAita allAha valloM hoI sI| so (he muhaMmada sa:!) tusIM vI uhanAM de hI rAha ’te Turo ate Akha dio! ki maiM tuhAthoM isa kaMma (hidAita deNa) dA koI badalA nahIM cAhuMdA| iha tAM sAre jahAna vAliAM laI ika nasIhata he|

ihanAM lokAM (kAfirAM) ne allAha dI uha kadara nahIM kItI jisa dA uha hakkadAra sI, jadoM uhanAM ne iha kihA ki allAha ne kise manukkha utte koI vI cIz2a (.kuraAna) nAz2ila nahIM kItI| (he muhaMmada!) tusIM ihanAM toM iha puccho ki uha kitAba kisa ne nAz2ila kItI sI jisa nUM mUsA liAe sI jihar3I sAre lokAM laI ika nUra ate hidAita sI| jisa (dIAM hidAitAM) nUM tusIM (ApaNI icchA anusAra) vakkhare-vakkhare patariAM utte nakala karade rahe ho| ihanAM viccoM kujjha hukamAM nUM sAhamaNe liAuMde ho ate kujjha nUM lukA laiMde ho (usa kitAba tauraita rAhIM) tuhAnUM uha giAna dittA giA jihar3A nA tuhADe kola sI ate nA hI tuhADe pio dAdiAM nUM hI sI| so (he nabI!) tusIM Akha dio ki uha (tauraita dA giAna) allAha ne hI utAriA sI| phera ihanAM nUM (ihanAM de hAla ’te) chaDDa dio, uha ApaNIAM dalIla bAz2IAM vica kheDade rahiNa|

iha kitAba (.kuraAna) nUM asIM utAriA he, jihar3I bahuta hI barakatAM vAlI he ate ApaNe toM pahilIAM (kitAbAM) dI puzaTI karadI he| tAM jo tusIM isa duArA makke vAliAM nUM ate Ale-duAle de lokAM nUM DarAo| jihar3e lokI Aqhirata utte vizavAsa rakkhade hana ajihe loka hI isa (.kuraAna) utte ImAna rakkhade hana ate ApaNIAM namAz2AM dI rakhavAlI karade hana|

usa viakatI toM vaddha z2Alama kauNa hovegA jihar3A allAha utte jhUThI Uja lAve jAM iha kahe ki mere utte vI vahI nAz2ila kItI gaI he, jadoM ki usa kola rabba valloM koI vI vahI nAz2ila nahIM hoI jAM jihar3A viakatI iha kahe ki jiho jihA kalAma allAha ne utAriA he maiM vI ise prakAra dA liA sakadA hAM| jadoM tusIM ihanAM z2AlamAM nUM mauta dIAM saqhatIAM vica girafatAra vekhoge ate farizate iha kahiMde hoe ApaNe hattha vadhA rahe hoNage ki kaDDho ApaNIAM jAnAM, ajja tuhAnUM z2alIla karana vAlI saz2A dittI jAvegI[8] kiuM jo tusIM allAha ’te UjAM lAke aNa-hakkIAM gallAM ghar3hade sI ate usa dIAM AitAM toM takabbara (ghamaMDa vica A ke inakAra) karade sI|
translations.footnotes: [8] isa toM az2Abe kabara hoNA siddha huMdA he jihar3A hakka sacca ’te AdhArita he| ise tarhAM sUrata momina dI 45, 46 Aita toM vI isa dA sabUta miladA he| jisa vica Ale-firaauauna de az2Aba dI galla kItI gaI he| allAha dA faramAna he ate Ale firaauauna nUM bahuta hI bhair3A daradanAka az2Aba ghere vica lai lavegA| jisa de sAhamaNe savere-zAma uha liAe jANage ate jisa dina kiAmata kAima hovegI tAM hukama dittA jAvegA ki firaauauna de sAthIAM nUM karar3e az2Aba vica suTTa dio iha Aita kabara de az2Aba dI khullhI dalIla he| ika dUjI hadIsa vica isa nUM visathAra nAla dassiA giA he ki nabI karIma (sa:) ne faramAiA, jadoM momina nUM dafana karana toM bAada kabara vica biThAiA jAMdA he tAM usa de kola ika farizatA AuMdA he phera uha gavAhI diMdA he ki allAha toM chuTTa hora koI izaTa nahIM ate muhaMmada (sa:) allAha de rasUla hana ate.kuraAna dI iha Aita allAha ImAna vAliAM nUM pakkI galla duArA dunIAM te Aqhirata vica paira jamAI rakkhadA he| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa:1369) haz2arata anasa toM patA laggadA he ki nabI karIma (sa:) ne faramAiA ki lokI murade nUM dafana karake jadoM vApasa AuMde hana tAM uha uhanAM de pairAM dI AvAz2a suNadA he phera do farizate AuMde hana ate usa murade nUM biThA ke pucchade hana ki muhaMmada (sa:) de pratI tUM dunIAM vica kI kihA karadA sI tAM uha javAba vica kahegA, maiM gavAhI diMdA hAM ki iha allAha de baMde ate usa de rasUla hana phera usa nUM kihA jAvegA ki ratA naraka vica ApaNI uha thAM vekha jisa nUM badala ke allAha ne terA TikANA jaMnata vica baNA dittA he| phera nabI (sa:) ne faramAiA, uha marana vAlA doveM TikANiAM nUM vekhegA para jihar3A kAfira hovegA uha farizatiAM nUM kahegA maiM isa viakatI (muhaMmada sa:) bAre kujjha nahIM jANadA jo kujjha lokI kahiMde sI maiMne vI uhI kahi dittA usa nUM kihA jAvegA ki nA tUM jANadA sI, ate nA hI.kuraAna toM hidAita laI, phera usa de cihare ’te iMnI z2ora nAla thaur3e nAla saTTa mArI jAvegI ki uha cIkAM mAregA jisa nUM manukkhAM te jiMnAM toM chuTTa dUra ner3e dI sArI maqhalUka suNegI| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 1338)

translations.translation: ajja tusIM sADe kola use tarhAM ikalle-ikalle Ae ho jiveM asIM tuhAnUM pahilI vAra ikallA paidA kItA sI| jo kujjha asIM tuhAnUM (mAla aulAda Adi) dittA sI usa nUM ApaNe picche chaDDa Ae ho| ajja asIM tuhADe nAla tuhADe uhanAM sifArazIAM nUM nahIM vekhade jinhAM bAre tusIM dAavA karade sI ki uha (tuhADI baMdagI vica) allAha de zarIka hana| ajja tuhADe sAre ApasI saMparaka TaTTa gae hana| ajja uha sAre tuhAthoM khussa gae jinhAM nUM tusIM ApaNA izaTa samajhade sI|

bezakka allAha hI dANe ate guThalI nUM fAr3aNa vAlA he| uha jAnadAra nUM bejAna vicoM ate bejAna nUM jAnadAra viccoM kaDDhadA he| iha he allAha, sAre kaMma karana vAlA, so tusIM kiddhara bhaTake phira rahe ho|

uha savera dA cAnaNa (rAta viccoM) kaDDhadA he| use ne rAta nUM ArAma dA sAdhana baNAiA, sUraja te caMna nUM sameM dA ika hisAba rakkhaNa dA sAdhana baNAiA| iha sabha gallAM use z2orAvara te jANanahAra de nizacita kIte hoe anumAna hana|

ate uhIo he jisa ne tuhADe laI tAre baNAe tAM jo tusIM ihanAM duArA jala te thala[9] de haneriAM vica rasatA labha sako| bezakka asIM sArIAM AitAM (nizAnIAM) giAna rakkhaNa vAliAM laI visathAra nAla biAna kara dittIAM hana|
translations.footnotes: [9]haz2arata katAdAha faramAuMde hana ki tAre baNAuNa de tiMna lAbha hana (1) akAzI dunIAM nUM sajAuNA (2) ihanAM duArA zaitAnAM nUM mAra ke bhajAuNA (3) ihanAM duArA musAfarAM nUM rAta de sameM ApaNI rAha dA patA lagAuNA ihanAM toM ilAvA je koI isa Aita dA koI hora aratha kaDDhadA he tAM uha g2alatI ’te he ate ApaNI mihanata nUM barabAda kara rihA he ate ajihI cIz2AM dI bhAla karadA he jisa duArA uha ApaNe Apa nUM kaThanAI vica pA rihA he| jihar3IAM usa de giAna toM bAhara hana| (sahI buqhArI)

translations.translation: uhIo he jisa ne tuhAnUM ika jAna toM paidA kItA phera hareka laI ika thAM rahiNa vAlI (bhAva Aqhirata) he ate dUjI thAM amAnata vajoM (bhAva saMsAra) he| bezakka asIM sArIAM dalIlAM khola khola ke biAna karade hAM, uhanAM lokAM laI, jihar3e sUjha-bUjha rakkhade hana|

uhIo he jisa ne akAza toM pANI barasAiA, usa duArA asIM hara prakAra dI paidAvAra ugAI, phera ise nAla harIAM bharIAM khetIAM ugAIAM jinhAM toM uppara thalle dANe kaDDhade hAM ate khajUra de daraqhatAM toM phalAM de gucche de gucche paidA kIte jihar3e bhAra kArana jhuka jAMde hana| aMgUra, z2aitUna te anAra de bAg2a lAe jinhAM de phala ika dUje nAla ralade-milade hana, para hareka dI vizezatA vakkho-vakkha he| jadoM iha daraqhata phala deNa laggade hana phera uhanAM de phala deNa ate pakkaNa dI hAlata valla dhiAna dio| ihanAM vica dalIlAM hana uhanAM lokAM laI jihar3e ImAna rakkhade hana|

para phera vI lokAM ne jiMnAM nUM allAha dA zarIka baNA rakkhiA he jadoM ki ihanAM sAriAM nUM allAha ne hI paidA kItA he ate ihanAM lokAM ne binAM giAna toM allAha laI puttara te dhIAM thApa dittIAM hana|[10] uha (allAha) pAka he, uhanAM sArIAM gallAM toM uccA he jihar3IAM uha karade hana|
translations.footnotes: [10] allAha faramAuMdA he ki Adama dI aulAda ne mainUM jhuThalAiA jada ki usa nUM iha hakka nahIM sI ate uha mainUM gAlAM diMdA he jada ki iha vI usa nUM hakka nahIM pahuMcadA Adama dI aulAda dA mainUM jhuThalAuNA iha he ki uha duAvAM karadA he ki maiM usa nUM mur3a jiUMdA karana vica samaratha nahIM, jiveM maiM usa nUM pahilAM paidA kItA sI ate usa dIAM gAlAM iha hana ki uha kahiMdA he ki mere aulAda he jada ki maiM ihanAM gallAM toM pAka hAM| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 4482)

translations.translation: uha akAzAM te dharatI dA racaNahAra he| usa de aulAda kiveM ho sakadI he jada ki usa dI koI patanI hI nahIM? uhIo hara cIz2a nUM paidA karana vAlA nUM ate uha hara cIz2a nUM bhalI-bhAMta jANadA he|
iha allAha tuhADA rabba he| isa toM chuTTa hora koI ibAdata de yoga nahIM he| uha hara cIz2a dA paidA karana vAlA he, tusIM use dI ibAdata karo ate uhIo hara cIz2a dA nigarAna he|
usa taka kise dIAM naz2arAM nahIM pahuMca sakadIAM, para uha (sabha dIAM naz2arAM takka) pahuMca rakhadA he| uha bahuta barIkI nAla hara galla dI qhabara rakkhadA he|

bezakka tuhADe kola tuhADe rabba valloM khullhIAM dalIlAM A cukkIAM hana| jihar3A sUjha-bUjha toM kaMma lavegA usa dA ApaNA hI lAbha he, para jihar3A (akaloM) aMnhA baNiA rihA usa dA ApaNA hI nukasAna he| (he muhaMmada!) tusIM Akha dio ki maiM tuhADe utte nigarAnI karana vAlA nahIM| (maiM tAM tuhAnUM qhabaradAra karana laI AiA hAM)|

ise prakAra asIM ApaNIAM AitAM ghar3I-mur3I vakkho-vakkha DhaMga nAla biAna karade hAM tAM jo kAfira AkhaNa ki tusIM (he muhaMmada sa:!) kise toM par3ha ke Ae ho ate jihar3e loka giAnavAna hana asIM uhanAM utte (saccAI) pragaTa kara daIe|
(he nabI!) tusIM ise vahI dI pAlaNA karade raho jihar3I tuhADe valla tuhADe rabba valloM AI he| usa toM chuTTa hora koI ibAdata de yoga nahIM| muzarikAM valla ukkA hI dhiAna nA devo|
je allAha cAhuMdA tAM iha ziraka nA karade ate asIM tuhAnUM ihanAM dI nigarAnI karana laI nahIM bhejiA ate nA hI tusIM ihanAM de z2iMmevAra ho|

(he musalamAno!) muzarika loka allAha nUM chaDDa ke jinhAM dI pUjA karade hana, tusIM uhanAM nUM burA bhalA nA Akho kiuM jo jahAlata dIAM haddAM Tappade hoe iha loka vI allAha dI zAna vica g2usatAkhIAM karanage| asIM isa prakAra hara ummata (dharama vAliAM) laI uhanAM de karamAM vica khicca paidA kara chaDDI he| uhanAM ne parata ke AuNA tAM ApaNe rabba valla hI he, phera uha uhanAM nUM dassegA ki uha (saMsAra vica) kI karade sI?

uhanAM lokAM ne pakkIAM kasamAM allAha de nAM dIAM khAdIAM ki je uhanAM kola koI nizAnI (nabI hoNa dI) A jAve tAM uha z2arUra hI ImAna liAuNage| (he nabI!) tusIM Akho ki nizAnIAM tAM sArIAM allAha de kabaz2e vica hana, tuhAnUM iha galla kauNa samajhAve ki jadoM uha nizAnI A jAvegI iha loka phera vI ImAna nahIM liAuNage|

asIM use tarhAM ihanAM de dilAM nUM ate ihanAM dIAM naz2arAM nUM phera diAMge jisa tarhAM iha pahilI vAra isa (.kuraAna) ’te ImAna nahIM liAe sana| asIM ihanAM dI sarakazI vica hI ihanAM nUM bhaTakaNa laI chaDDa devAMge|

jekara asIM (allAha) ihanAM valla (kAfirAM dI maMga ’te) farizate bheja diMde ate ihanAM nAla murade gallAM karana laga jAMde ate asIM uha sArIAM nizAnIAM (jo uha maMga karade hana) uhanAM dIAM akkhAM de sAhamaNe jamAM kara diMde tAM vI iha loka ImAna nahIM liAuNage| hAM! je allAha hI cAhave tAM vakkharI galla he| para ihanAM vica bahute loka tAM nA-samajhI dIAM gallAM karade hana|

ise tarhAM asIM hara nabI de duzamana manukkhAM te jiMnAM viccoM baNAe, jihar3e ika dUje de kaMnAM vica sohaNIAM jApaNa vAlIAM gallAM pAuMde rahiMde hana, tAM jo usa nUM dhokhe vica rakkhiA jA sake| (he nabI!) je allAha cAhuMdA tAM iha ajihA nA karade| so tusIM ihanAM lokAM nUM ate jo iha buhatAna lagA rahe hana usa nUM (uhanAM de hAla ’te) chaDDa dio|

tAM jo jihar3e loka Aqhirata utte ImAna nahIM liAuMde uhanAM de mana usa jhUTha valla jhuka jANa ate uha isa jhUTha nUM pasaMda karade rahiNa ate jihar3e bhair3e kaMma uha kara rahe hana uha karade rahiNa|

(he nabI!) Akho, kI maiM allAha toM chuTTa kise hora hAkama dI bhAla karAM? hAlAM ki uhIo he jisa ne iha kitAba visathAra nAla tuhADe valla bhejI| jinhAM lokAM nUM asIM kitAba dittI he uha isa galla nUM yakIna nAla jANade hana ki iha tuhADe rabba valloM hakka sacca nAla nAz2ila hoI he, so tusIM zakka karana vAliAM viccoM nA ho jAIo|
tuhADe rabba dA kalAma saccAI te inasAfa pakkhoM mukkamala he ate isa dIAM gallAM nUM koI badalaNa vAlA nahIM| uha bhalI-bhAMta suNana vAlA te jANana vAlA he|
je tusIM (he nabI!) dharatI ’te vasana vAlI bahugiNatI de Akhe laggoge tAM uha tuhAnUM rAho be-rAha kara devegI| uha tAM kevala bharamAM utte calade hana ate qhiAlI gallAM hI karade hana|

(hakIkata iha he) ki tuhADA rabba usa viakatI nUM caMgI tarhAM jANadA he jihar3A usa dI rAha toM berAha ho jAMdA he ate uha hidAita vAle lokAM nUM vI jANadA he (jihar3e usa dI rAha ’te hI calade hana|)
so tusIM usa (jAnavara) dA mAsa khAo jisa utte allAha dA nAM (z2ibaha karana sameM) liA giA hove| je tusIM usa de hukamAM nUM maMnade ho|

kI kArana he ki tusIM usa jAnavara dA (mAsa) nahIM khAMde jisa ’te allAha dA nAM liA giA he| hAlAM ki allAha ne uhanAM sAre jAnavarAM dI jANakArI de rakhI he jihar3e tuhADe laI harAma hana, para je saqhata majabUrI dI galla hove tAM uha (harAma) vI halAla (jAiz2a) he ate iha vI galla lAz2amI he ki lokAM dI bahugiNatI ApaNIAM icchAvAM kArana binAM kise dalIla toM dUjiAM nUM gumarAha karade hana| isa vica koI zakka nahIM ki allAha haddA TappaNa vAliAM nUM caMgI tarhAM jANadA he|
tusIM qhulle gunAhAM toM vI baco ate lukaveM gunAhAM toM vI baco| bezakka jihar3e lokI gunAha kara rahe hana uhanAM nUM uhanAM de karamAM dA badalA z2arUra milegA|

ajihe jAnavara nA khAo jinhAM utte (z2ibaha karade hoe) allAha dA nAM nahIM liA giA, iha kaMma nA-faramAnI vAlA he ate zaitAna ApaNe sAthIAM de manAM vica zaMkA pAuMdA he tAM jo iha tuhADe nAla jhagar3aNa| (he nabI!) je tusIM ihanAM lokAM dI pairavI karoge tAM tusIM vI muzarika baNa jAoge|[11]
translations.footnotes: [11] isa toM bhAva uha aMnhI pairavI he jisa vica laggaNa toM bAada inasAna hakka ate dalIlAM nUM nahIM vekhadA sagoM ApaNe baz2uragAM nUM ate uhanAM dIAM gallAM nUM hI sahI samajhadA he ise nUM ziraka kihA jAMdA he| hadIsa he ki haz2arata adI bina hAtama (ra:a:) allAha de rasUla (sa:) kola Ae tAM uhanAM de gale vica sone dI salIba sI| Apa (sa:) ne uhanAM nUM kihA, he adI! isa buta nUM sunUMTa dio ate phera Apa (sa:) sUrata bagaata dI iha Aita suNAI ki uhanAM yahUdI te IsAIAM ne ApaNe vidavAnAM te duravezAM nUM ApaNA rabba baNA liA sI| Apa (sa:) ne faramAiA ki bezakka uha uhanAM nUM pUjade nahIM sI para uhanAM de vidavAna jisa nUM halAla kahi diMde uha halAla samajhade sI ate jisa cIz2a nUM harAma kahiMde sI usa nUM harAma samajhade sI| bhAva aMnhI pairavI ate AsathA nUM nabI (sa:) ne ApaNe dhAramika AgUAM dI ibAdata kihA he| (jAame tiramaz2I, hadIsa: 3095)

translations.translation: uha viakatI jihar3A pahilAM muradA (bhAva ImAna toM khAlI) sI phera asIM usa nUM (ImAna baqhaza ke) jiUMdA kara dittA ate usa nUM ajihA nUra (ImAna) dittA jisa dI rauzanI vica lokAM vicAle turadA phiradA he, kI uha usa viakatI vAMga ho sakadA he jihar3A haneriAM vica phasiA hoiA he ate ihanAM viccoM nikkala vI nahIM sakadA? ise prakAra kAfirAM laI uhanAM dIAM karatUtAM vica khicca paidA kara dittI gaI hai|

ise tarhAM asIM hareka basatI vica usa de vaDDe-vaDDe aparAdhIAM nUM usa basatI vica ApaNe chala-kapaTa dA jAla failAuNa laI chaDDiA hoiA he| asala vica uha ApaNe kapaTa de jAla vica Apa hI phasade hana para uhanAM nUM isa dI samajha hI nahIM|

jadoM uhanAM kola koI Aita (nizAnI) AuMdI he tAM iha kahiMde hana ki asIM ukkA hI ImAna nahIM liAuMde jadoM tIka sAnUM vI ajihI cIz2a nA dittI jAve jihar3I rasUlAM nUM dittI gaI he| iha galla tAM allAha hI jANadA he ki ApaNI paig2aMbarI dA kaMma kisa toM lave| chetI hI uha aparAdhI loka allAha kola jA ke z2alIla hoNage ate uhanAM dIAM cAlAM de badale vica jo uha karade sana karar3I saz2A milegI|

so jisa viakatI nUM allAha ne rAha ’te pAuNA huMdA hai usa dA sInA (dila) isalAma laI kholha diMdA hai[12] ate jisa nUM berAha karanA huMdA hai usa de sIne nUM taMga kara diMdA hai| jiveM koI akAza valla car3hadA hove (bhAva dama ghuTaNa kArana mara rihA hove)| isa tarhAM allAha ImAna nA liAuNa vAliAM utte (gumarAhI dI) gaMdagI suTTa diMdA hai|
translations.footnotes: [12] ise galla nUM hadIsa vica kihA giA hai ki allAha de rasUla ne faramAiA ki jisa kise nAla allAha bhalAI karanA cAhuMdA hai usa nUM.kuraAna te sunnata dI samajha baqhaza diMdA hai| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 71)

translations.translation: iho tere rabba dA siddhA rAha he| nasIhata laiNa vAliAM laI asIM ihanAM (.kuraAna dIAM) AitAM nUM kholha-kholha ke biAna karade hAM|
uhanAM (ImAna liAuNa vAle) lokAM laI uhanAM de rabba de kola salAmatI vAlA ghara (savaraga) he| allAha nUM uhanAM nAla uhanAM de neka kaMmAM kArana muhabbata he|

jisa dina uha uhanAM sAriAM nUM ikaTThA karegA ate AkhegA ki he jiMno! tusIM manukkhAM viccoM kaIAM nUM kurAhe pAiA sI ate manukkhAM ’coM uhanAM (jiMnAM) de mittara AkhaNage he sADe rabbA! asIM ika dUje toM lAbha khaTTiA sI| ajja asIM usa sameM nUM pahuMca gae hAM jihar3A tusIM sADe laI nizacita kItA sI| huNa allAha faramAegA ki tuhADA sAriAM dA TikANA naraka he, jitthe tusIM sadA rahoge, hAM je allAha nUM hI (tuhADI rihAI) manaz2Ura hove tAM galla vakkharI he| bezakka tuhADA rabba vaDDIAM hikamatAM vAlA ate giAna vAlA he|
isa prakAra asIM (Aqhirata vica) kujjha z2AlamAM nUM dUje (z2AlamAM) dA sAthI baNAvAge iha sabha uhanAM dIAM karatUtAM kArana hI hovegA|

he jiMno te manukkhAM dI TolIo! kI tuhADe kola tuhADe hI viccoM paig2aMbara nahIM Ae sana jo tuhAnUM mere Adeza suNAuMde sana ate tuhAnUM isa (kiAmata de) dina dI milaNI toM DarAuMde sana? uha AkhaNage ki asIM isa galla nUM maMnade hAM| uhanAM nUM saMsArika jIvana ne bhulekhe vica pA rakkhiA sI| iha loka Apa ApaNe viruddha gavAhI deNage ki uha inakArI sana|
iha rasUla isa laI bheje gae ki tuhADA rabba kise vI basatI nU z2ulama kArana udoM taka halAka nahIM karadA jadoM taka usa de vasanIka hakIkata toM aNajAna hana|
hara ika nU uhanAM de karamAM anusAra (Aqhirata vica) daraje milaNage ate tuhADA rabba uhanAM de amalAM toM beqhabara nahIM he|

ate tuhADA rabba kise dA muthAja nahIM sagoM miharAM karadA he| je uha cAhave tAM tuhAnUM sabha nUM cukka lave (bhAva qhatama kara deve) ate tuhAthoM bAada jisa nUM cAhe tuhADA uttara-adhikArI baNA deve jiveM usa ne tuhAnUM dUjI kauma dI nasala viccoM paidA kItA he|
jisa cIz2a kiAmata dA tuhADe nAla vAadA kItA jA rihA he uha lAz2amI AuNa vAlI zaia heai| tusIM (allAha nUM) Ajiz2a bhAva bevasa nahIM kara sakade|

(he nabI!) tusIM kahi dio ki he merI kauma! tusIM ApaNA kaMma karade raho maiM ApaNA kaMma kara rihA hAM| tuhAnUM chetI hI patA lagga jAvegA ki isa Aqhirata dA aMta kisa laI caMgA hai| iha galla sacca hai ki z2AlamAM nUM kade vI kAmayAbI nahIM miladI|

allAha ne jo vI khetI ate pazUAM de rUpa vica paidA kItA hai ihanAM lokAM ne ApaNe gumAna anusAra uhanAM viccoM kujjha hissA allAha laI nizacita kItA hai ate Akhade hana ki iha allAha laI hai ate iha sADe izaTAM laI hai, phira jihar3A hissA uhanAM de izaTAM dA huMdA hai uha tAM allAha kola nahIM pujjadA para jihar3A allAha dA hissA huMdA hai uha uhanAM de izaTAM nUM mila jAMdA hai| kiMnI beinasAfI de faisale karade hana!

ise tarhAM bahuta sAre muzarikAM laI uhanAM dI saMtAna dA katala karanA uhanAM de zarIkAM ne sohaNA baNA chaDDiA hai tAM jo uhanAM nUM barabAda kara deNa ate uhanAM de dharama nUM zakka-zubaha vica pA deNa| je allAha nUM manaz2Ura huMdA tAM iha iMja nA karade| so tusIM (he nabI!) ihanAM nUM ate inhAM de jhUTha nUM uhanAM de hAla ’te chaDDa dio|

uha iha vI vicAra rakkhade hana ki iha DaMgara-pazU ate khetIAM (nUM khANA) manhA hai, ihanAM nUM kevala uhIo khA sakadA hai jisa nUM asIM cAhIe| phera kujjha jAnavara hana jinhAM utte savArI karanI harAma kara dittI gaI hai ate kujjha jAnavara ajihe hana jinhAM utte (z2ibaha karade hoe) allAha dA nAM nahIM laiMde| iha sabha uhanAM ne allAha de nAM ’te jhUTha ghar3hiA hai ate uha chetI hI uhanAM nUM isa jhUTha ghar3haNa dI saz2A devegA|

uha (muzarika) Akhade hana ki jihar3I cIz2a ihanAM harAma (kIte hoe) jAnavarAM de garabha vica hai, uha qhAsa sADe maradAM laI hai ate auratAM laI harAma hai| je uha muradA baccA hove tAM doveM usa de khANa vica sAre barAbara hana| chetI hI allAha ihanAM nUM ihanAM dIAM mana ghar3ata gallAM dA badalA devegA| bezakka uha hikamata vAlA ate sArIAM gallAM dI qhabara rakkhadA hai|

z2arUra hI uha loka ghATe vica hana jihar3e ApaNI aulAda nUM mUrakhatA ate agiAnatA kArana katala kara diMde hana ate jihar3A riz2aka allAha ne uhanAM nUM (khANa-pINa laI) baqhaziA hai, allAha utte jhUTha mar3ha ke usa nUM harAma baNA laiMde hana| bezakka iha lokI gumarAhI vica jA pae ate huNa uha siddhe rasate nahIM AuNage|

ate uhIo hai jisa ne chapparAM ’te cAr3he hoe ate binAM chapparAM ’te cAr3he bAg2a paidA kIte| khajUrAM te (dUje phalAM dIAM) fasalAM ugAIAM, ihanAM de phalAM dA suAda vakkho-vakkha huMdA hai| z2aitUna te anAra paidA kIte jihar3e vekhaNa vica ralade-milade huMde hana te suAda vica vakkhare| jadoM ihanAM (rukkhAM) ’te phala AuNa tAM tusIM ihanAM de phala khAo| ihanAM phalAM dI vADhI sameM allAha dA hakka adA karo| faz2Ula qharacI nA karo, bezakka allAha faz2Ula qharacI (lor3a toM vaddha qharaca) karana vAliAM nUM pasaMda nahIM karadA|
use ne bhAra dI DhoA-DhuAI laI choTe kadda de jAnavara paidA kIte| allAha ne tuhAnUM jihar3A riz2aka baqhaziA hai usa viccoM khAo ate zaitAna dI pairavI nA karo, kiuM jo uha tuhADA vairI hai|

iha aTTha prakAra de nara te madIna hana, do bheDa dI nasaloM ate do bakarI dI nasala viccoM| (he nabI!) tusIM ihanAM toM puccho, kI dovAM de nara harAma kIte hana jAM madIna jAM uha bacce jihar3e doveM (nasalAM) de madIna de DhiDDAM vica hana? je tusIM sacce ho tAM mainUM zuddha giAna sahita dasso|

do nasalAM UMTha dIAM ate do hI gaU dIAM hana|[13] (he nabI!) ratA pUccho, kI allAha ne dovAM de nara harAma kIte hana jAM dovAM de madIna jAM uha bacce jihar3e dovAM madIna de DhiDDAM vica hana? kI usa sameM tusIM hAz2ara sI jadoM allAha tuhAnUM hukama de rihA sI? isa toM vaDDA z2Alama kauauNa hovagA jihar3A allAha de sira binAM kise dalIla toM jhUTha mar3he tAM jo lokAM nUM iha binAM giAna toM gumarAha kara sake| bezakka z2AlamAM nUM allAha siddhI rAha nahIM vikhAuMdA|
translations.footnotes: [13] iha narIna te mAdA pazU jinhAM nUM manukkha khAMdA hai ate isa toM bojha DhohA DhoAI dA kaMma vI laiMdA hai allAha dIAM nizAnIAM viccoM hana bhAveM ki iha manukkhAM vAMga bola nahIM sakade para je allAha cAhave tAM ihanAM nUM bolaNa dI zakatI vI de sakadA hai, jiveM hadIsa viccoM kujjha ghaTanAvAM dI caracA vI kItI gaI hai| nabI (sa:) ne faramAiA, ika caravAhA bakarIAM carA rihA sI ki ika bhair3IAM ika bakarI lai ke bhajja giA, jadoM caravAhe ne bhair3Ie dA picchA kItA tAM bhair3Ie ne caravAhe nUM kihA ki kiAmata de ner3e ihanAM bakarIAM dI rAqhI jaMgalI jAnavarAM toM kauNa karegA jada ki maitoM chuTTa usa dina hora koI caravAhA nahIM hovegA| nabI (sa:) ne iha vI faramAiA ki ika viakatI ika baila ’te sAmAna laddI jA rihA sI, baila ne usa valla mur3a ke vekhiA ate kihA ki mainUM sAmAna DhohaNa laI paidA nahIM kItA giA mainUM tAM khetI bAr3I laI paidA kItA giA hai loka rurAna ho ke bole ‘subahAnalAhha’, jAnavara vI gallAM karade hana! nabI (sa:) ne faramAiA, maiM so isa ’te ImAna liAiA hAM ate abU-bakara te umara vI isa galla ’te ImAna liAe hana| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 3663)

translations.translation: (he nabI!) tusIM kaho ki jo vI vahI (rabbI Adeza) mere valla AI hai maiM isa viccoM kujjha vI ajihA nahIM vekhadA jo kise khANa vAle laI, jovI usa nUM khAe, harAma hove para hAM! muradAra, vagadA qhUna, sUra dA mAsa kiuM jo iha nA-pAka hana (isa laI iha harAma hana) jAM uha jAnavara jisa ’te z2ibaha karade sameM chuTTa allAha toM kise hora dA nAM liA giA hove| phera je koI viakatI (bhukkha toM) majabUra ho jAve para uha nA-faramAna te (zarIata dIAM) sImAvAM TappaNa vAlA nA hove (je ajihA viakatI harAma khA lave) tAM bezakka tuhADA rabba ati baqhazaNahAra te rahima vAlA hai|

yahUdIAM laI asIM sAre hI nauhAM vAle jAnavara harAma kIte sI ate gaU te bakarIAM dI carabI vI uhanAM laI harAma kItA sI, chuTTa usa carabI toM jihar3I uhanAM dIAM piTThAM jAM AMtar3IAM jAM haDDI nAla ciMbar3I rahi jAve| asIM uhanAM nUM iha saz2A uhanAM dIAM nA-faramAnIAM kArana dittI sI|
(he nabI!) je iha tuhAnUM jhUThA kahiNa tAM tusIM ihanAM nUM Akho ki tuhADA rabba bahuta hI khullhI-DullhI rahimata vAlA hai ate usa dA az2Aba aparAdhIAM toM TaliA nahIM karadA|

chetI hI iha muzarika AkhaNage ki je allAha nUM manaz2Ura huMdA tAM nA asIM ziraka karade ate nA hI sADe bApa dAdA ate nA hI asIM kise cIz2a nUM harAma kahiMde| ise prakAra jihar3e lokI ihanAM toM pahilAM bIta cukke hana uhanAM ne vI (nabIAM nUM) jhuThalAiA sI itthoM taka ki uhanAM ne sADe az2Aba dA suAda lai liA| tusIM kaho ki tuhADe kola je koI dalIla hai tAM sADe sAhamaNe hAz2ara karo| tusIM loka kevala qhiAlI gallAM ’te calla rahe ho ate tusIM bilakula hI betukIAM gallAM toM kaMma laiMde ho|
(he nabI!) tusIM Akho ki saccI dalIla tAM allAha dI hI hai phira je uha cAhuMdA tAM tuhAnUM sAriAM nUM siddhe rasate pA diMdAM|

(he nabI!) tusIM ihanAM nUM Akho ki tusIM ApaNe uhanAM gavAhAM nUM lai Ao jihar3e isa galla dI gavAhI deNa ki allAha ne ihanAM cIz2AM nUM harAma kItA hai| je uha gavAhI deNa tAM vI tusIM gavAhI nA dio ate nA hI ajihe jhUThe vicArAM vAle lokAM dI pairavI karo, jihar3e sADIAM AitAM dA inakAra karade hana, nA hI Aqhirata ’te ImAna rakkhade hana ate dUjiAM nUM ApaNe rabba dA bhAIbhAla baNAuMde hana|

(he nabI!) tusIM (muzarikAM te kAfirAM nUM) Akho ki Ao maiM tuhAnUM uha cIz2AM par3ha ke suNAvAM jinhAM nUM tuhADe rabba ne tuhADe laI harAma kItA hai uha iha hai ki usa de nAla kise cIz2a nUM zarIka nA karo, mAM-bApa nAla ihasAna (vadhIA varatAo) karo, g2arIbI toM Darade hoe ApaNI aulAda nUM katala nA karo, asIM tuhAnUM vI ate uhanAM (bacciAM) nUM vI riz2aka diMde hAM, azalIlatA de ner3e vI nA jAo, bhAveM uha gupata hai jAM khullhe Ama hai, jisa dA katala karanA allAha ne harAma kItA hai usa nUM katala nA karo chuTTa usa toM jisadA katala karanA hakka hove| iha uha galAM hana jinhAM dA hukama tuhAnUM dittA jAMdA hai tAM jo tusIM sUjha bUjha toM kaMma lavoM|

yatIma de mAla de ner3e vI nAM jAo para ajihe tarIke nAla jAo jihar3A sabha toM vadhIA hai, itthoM taka ki uha ApaNI javAnI dI umara nUM pujja jANa| nApa-tola vica inasAfa karo| asIM kise viakatI utte usa dI samarathA toM vaddha z2iMmevAra nahIM pAuMde| jadoM koI vI galla (faisalA) karo tAM inasAfa dA hI karo bhAveM uha (mAmalA tuhADe) sake-saMbaMdhI dA hove| allAha nAla kIte vacanAM nUM pUrA karo| ihanAM (gallAM) dA allAha ne tuhAnUM karana laI hukama dittA hai tAM jo tusIM yAda rakkho|

(ate iha vI hukama dittA hai) ki iha (dIna isalAma) merI rAha hai jihar3A siddhA hai, so tusIM ise rAha ’te callo ate dUjIAM rAhAM ’te nA turo, uha rAhAM tuhAnUM allAha toM judA kara deNagIAM| allAha ne tuhAnUM isa dA Adeza dittA hai tAM jo tusIM burAIAM toM baca sako|

asIM mUsA nUM kitAba (tauraita) isa laI dittI sI ki caMge karama karana vAliAM utte merIAM niamatAM pUrIAM hoNa ate hara galla dI visathAra nAla caracA karana laI iha hidAita ate rahimatAM dA sAdhana hai| tAM jo uha loka ApaNe rabba nAla mulAkAta dA yakIna kara laiNa|
ate iha (.kuraAna) ika ucca koTI dI kitAba hai jisa nUM asIM nAz2ila kItA hai| iha barakatAM vAlI hai| so tusIM ise dI pairavI karo ate parahez2agAra baNo tAM jo tuhADe ’te miharAM kItIAM jANa|
tAM jo tusIM iha nA kahi sakoM ki kitAba tAM sAthoM pahile do firakiAM (yahUdI te IsAI) utte hI utArI gaI sI ate asIM tAM uhanAM de par3haNa par3hAuNa toM beqhabara sI|

jAM tusIM (iha nA kaho) ki je sADe utte koI kitAba nAz2ila hoI huMdI tAM asIM ihanAM toM vI kite vaddha siddhe rasate ’te huMde| so huNa tuhADe kola tuhADe rabba valloM ika khullI kitAba A gaI hai jihar3I rAhanumAI dA sAdhana hai ate rahimata vI hai| usa viakatI toM vadhake z2Alama kauNa hovegA jihar3A allAha dIAM AitAM toM mUMha mor3adA hai? asIM chetI hI ihanAM lokAM nUM az2Aba dI zakala vica saz2A devAMge kiuM jo uha hakka toM mUMha mor3ade sana|

kI iha loka isa galla dI uDIka vica hana ki ihanAM kola farizate AuNa jAM tuhADA rabba Ave jAM tuhADe rabba valloM koI nizAnI Ave? jisa dina tuhADe rabba valloM koI vaDDI nizAnI A jAvegI tAM kise vI ajihe viakatI dA ImAna usa de kaMma nahIM AvegA jihar3A isa (nizAnI AuNa toM) pahilAM ImAna nahIM rakkhadA sI,[14] jAM usa ne ApaNe ImAna vica rahiMde hoe koI neka amala nA kItA hove| (he nabI!) tusIM Akho ki tusIM vI (rabbI phaisale dI) uDIka karo asIM vI uDIka karade hAM|
translations.footnotes: [14] isa toM bhAva kiAmata ner3e pragaTa hoNa vAlIAM nizAnIAM viccoM ika vaDDI nizAnI hai jisa de pragaTa hoNa toM bAada ImAna te taubA dA bUhA baMda ho jAvegA phera kise dA ImAna liAuNa jAM taubA karanA koI lAbha nahIM devegA| so hadIsa vica hai ki allAha de rasUla (sa:) ne faramAiA, kiAmata usa vele taka nahIM AvegI jadoM taka sUraja pacchama toM nA nikale ate jadoM loka isa nUM pacchama toM nikaladA hoiA vekhaNage tAM usa sameM jihar3A vI koI dharatI ’te hovegA ImAna liAvegA para usa sameM kise viakatI dA ImAna liAuNA je uha pahilAM ImAna nahIM liAiA hovegA usa nUM koI lAbha nahIM devegA| (sahI buqhArI hadIsa: 4635) ika dUjI hadIsa vica allAha de rasUla (sa:) dA irazAda hai ki jadoM tiMna nizAnIAM pragaTa ho jANa tAM usa sameM kise viakatI dA ImAna lai AuNA, je uha pahilAM ImAna vAlA nahIM sI, koI lAbha nahIM devegA (1) sUraja dA pacchama dizA toM nikalaNA (2) bhucAla dA AuNA) (3) dharatI ’coM jAnavara dA nikalaNA (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 150) rasUla (sa:) ne faramAiA, koI vI nabI ajihA nahIM hoiA jisa ne ApaNI ummata nUM jhUThe kAne dajjAla toM nA DarAIAM hove sAvadhAna raho uha kAnA hovegA tuhADA rabba kAnA nahIM usa dIAM doveM akkhAM de vicakAra kAfira liikhaA hovegA| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 7131)

translations.translation: jinhAM lokAM ne ApaNe dIna nUM aDDa-aDDa kara rakkhiA hai ate dhar3hiAM vica vaMDe hoe hana| he nabI! tuhADA uhanAM nAla koI saMbaMdha nahIM, uhanAM dA mAmalA allAha de havAle hai[15] phera uha uhanAM nUM dassegA jihar3e kaMma uha kariA karade sana|
translations.footnotes: [15] isa Aita vica dhar3e baMdI ate dIna vica navIAM navIAM gallAM (bidaAta) ghar3aNa dI nikhedI kItI gaI hai| nabI (sa:) dA isa Aita de saMbaMdha vica kahiNA hai ki iha uha loka hana jinhAM ne dIna vica navIAM navIAM gallAM ghar3IAM ate jihar3e ApaNIAM icchAvAM de picche lagge rahiMde hana allAha uhanAM dI duA nUM kabUla nahIM karadA| (tafasIre kuratabI 150/7) nabI (sa:) ne faramAiA yahUdI 71 dhar3hiA vica jAM 72 dhar3hiA vica vaMDe gae sana ate iha ummata 73 dhar3hiAM vica vaMDI jAvegI ate sAre naraka vica jANage chuTTa ika dhar3e toM iha jaMnatI dhar3A hovegA jihar3A mere ate mere sahAbA (sAthIAM) dI pairavI karegA|

translations.translation: jihar3A viakatI allAha de haz2Ura ika nekI lai ke hAz2ara hovegA usa nUM usa dA dasa guNA badalA milegA| jihar3A ika burAI karegA usa nUM usa de barAbara saz2A milegI| [16] kise ’te koI z2ulama nahIM kItA jAvegA|
translations.footnotes: [16] isa vica allAha de usa fajalo karama dA biAna hai jisa dA pragaTAvA nekI ate burAI dA badalA deNa sameM hovegA| vekho sUrata ala-anAma, hAzIA Aita 61/6

translations.translation: (he nabI!) tusIM Akho ki bezakka mere rabba ne mai` siddhI rAha valla callaNa dI hidAita dittI hai jo ki uccIAM kadarAM vAlA dIna hai, jihar3A ika rabba dI baMdagI karana vAle ibarAhIma dA dIna hai ate uha muzarikAM viccoM nahIM sI|
(he nabI!) tusIM Akha dio ki merI namAz2a, merI kurabAnI, merA jInA te merA maranA, iha sabha allAha vAsate hI hai jihar3A sArI sarizaTI dA mAlika hai|
usa dA koI sAMjhI nahIM ate mainUM ise dA hukama hoiA hai ate sabha toM pahilAM maiM (usa de hukamAM nUM) maMNana vAlA hAM|

(he nabI!) tusIM kaho, kI maiM allAha nUM chaDDa ke kise hora nUM rabba baNAuNa laI bhAladA phirAM, jada ki uha hara cIz2a dA mAlika hai| koI vI viakatI ajihA (gunAha) nahIM kamAuMdA jisa dA bojha-bhAra use ’te nA hove| koI vI bhAra cukkaNa vAlA kise dUje dA bhAra nahIM cukkegA| tusIM sabha ne ApaNe rabba de kola hI jANA hai, phera uha tuhAnUM dassegA jisa cIz2a vica tusIM matabheda rakkhade sI|

ate uhIo ru jisa ne dharatI ’te tuhAnUM ika dUje dA uttara-adhikArI baNAiA ate tuhADe viccoM kaIAM nUM ucce daraje baqhaze tAM jo uha uhanAM niamatAM duArA tuhADI parakha kare jihar3IAM usa ne tuhAnUM baqhazIAM hana| tuhADA rabba saz2A deNa vica bahuta tez2a hai ate bezakka uha ati baqhazaNahAra te rahima karana vAlA hai|
alafi, lAma, mIma, suAda|

(he nabI!) iha kitAba (.kuraAna) tuhADe (muhaMmada sa:) valla ghallI gaI hai (tAM jo) tusIM isa duArA lokAM nUM rabba de az2Aba toM DarAo| so tuhADe mana vaci (kise vI prakAra dI) koI taMgI (ghuTaNa) nahIM hoNI cAhIdI jada ki iha.kuraAna ImAna liAuNa vAliAM laI ika nasIhata hai|

(he ImAna vAlio!) tusIM loka ise (.kuraAna) dI pAlaNA karo jahir3A tuhADe rabba valloM tuhADe valla nAz2ali kItA gaAi hai ate tusIM (allAha nUM chaDDa ke) horAM (izaTAM) dI tAbedArI nA karo| tusIM loka tAM bahuta hI ghaTTa nasIhata maMnade ho|
batherIAM hI basatIAM ajahiIAM hana jinhAM nUM asIM barabAda kItA hai ate uhanAM utte sADA az2Aba usa vele AiA jadoM uha rAta nUM sutte pae hoe sI jAM dupahira sameM, jadoM uha ArAma kara rahe sana|
so jadoM uhanAM ’te sADA az2Aba AiA tAM usa sameM uhanAM de mUMhAM toM chuTTa isa toM hora kujjha nahIM nikkaliA ki z2Alama tAM asIM Apa hI sAM|
phera asIM uhanAM lokAM toM hareka savAla pucchAMge jinhAM valla rasUla bheje gae sana ate asIM paig2aMbarAM toM vI pucchAMge|
phera asIM (sabha kujjha) ApaNe gaAina de AdhArati uhanAM de sAhamaNe (uhanAM tIAM karatUtAM) baAina karAMge, asIM (dunIAM ’coM) alopa nahIM sI|
usa dani (kaAimata dahiAr3e) amalAM dA tola hakka anusAra hI hovegA phera jasi dA palar3hA (neka amalAM dA) bhArI hovegA uhIo kAmayAba hovegA|[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] isa Aita vica amalAM de bhAra dI galla kItI gaI hai bhAva kiAmata dihAr3e manukkhAM de amalAM nUM toliA jAvegA sUrata aMbIAM dI Aita vica.kuraAna faramAuMdA hai ki kiAmata de dina allAha lokAM de amalAM nUM ika inasAfa de paimAne duArA tolegA| hadIsa vica vI amalAM nUM tolaNa dI caracA kItI gaI hai jiveM nabI karIma (sa:) ne faramAiA ki do kalame allAha nUM bahuta hI pasaMda hana jihar3e z2ubAna laI bahuta halake ate tolaNa vica bahuta bhAra rakkhade hana uha hana subahAnallA hI vAbI hamadI hI subahA-nallAhila-az2Ima bhAva allAha pAka hai ApaNIAM sArIAM qhUbIAM sane allAha pAka hai ate uccI vaDiAI vAlA hai| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 7563) bhAva ki maiM allAha nUM uhanAM sArIAM gallAM toM pAka samajhadA hAM jihar3IAM usa dI zAna de viruddha hana ate maiM allAha nUM uhanAM sArIAM gallAM toM bahuta uccA samajhadA hAM jihar3IAM usa nAla jor3IAM jAMdIAM hana, maiM tAM usa dI prasaMzA ate vaDiAI biAna karadA hAM|

translations.translation: jinhAM (de neka amalAM) dA palar3A halakA hovegA, iha uha loka hoNage jinhAM ne apaNA Apa nUM ghATe vaci pAiA hovegA kauiM jo uha merIAM AitAM nAla z2ulama karade sana|
narisaMdeha, asAM tuhAnUM dharatI ’te rahaNi dA adhakiAra dittA ate tuhADe laI isa vaci (hara prakAra dI) jIvana samaggarI paidA kItI, para tusIM loka bahuta hI ghaTTa zukara adA karade ho|

asIM hI tuhAnUM paidA kItA phera tuhADIAM zakalAM baNAIAM| phera asIM farazitaAiM nUM AkhaAi ki Adama nUM sajidA karo, so chuTTa ibalIsa toM sAraAiM ne sajidA kara dittA, uha sajidA karana vAlaAiM vaci zAmali nahIM hoiA|

allAha ne ibalIsa toM pucchaAi ki tainUM kise galla ne sajidA karana toM roka ke rakkhaAi jada ki maiM tainUM hukama dittA sI| uha (ibalIsa) AkhaNa laggA ki maiM isa (Adama) toM caMgerA hAM kiuM jo tUM mainUM agga toM paidA kItA hai ate isa (Adama) nUM miTTI toM baNAiA hai|
allAha ne kihA ki tUM akAza toM heTha uttara jA, tainUM koI hakka nahIM ki tUM itthe rahiMde hoe ghamaMDa kareM, so itthoM nakila, tUM tAM z2alIla lokAM viccoM hI hai|
usa (ibalIsa) ne (allAha nUM) kihA ki tUM mainUM usa dina tIka laI mohalata de jadoM lokI kabarAM viccoM (jiuMde) uThAe jANage|
allAha ne kahiA ki tainUM mohalata dittI jAMdI hai|

usa (zaitAna jAM ibalIsa) ne kihA ki kiuM jo tUM isa (Adama) de kArana mainUM gumarAha kItA he tAM maiM vI ihanAM (Adama dI aulAda) nUM gumarAha karana laI tere valla AuMdI siddhI rAha ’te ghAta vaci baiThAMgA|
maiM ihanAM de agiੱoM vI te picchioM vI sajjioM vI te khabbioM vI ihanAM nUM gumarAha karana laI AvAMgA tUM ihanAM viccoM bahutiAM nUM dhaMnavAdI nahIM vekheMgA|
allAha ne AkhaAi! jA itthoM nikala jA, tUM z2alIla te dhuttakAriA hoiA hai| jihar3A vI viakatI ihanAM viccoM terA kahiNA maMnegA maiM z2arUra hI tuhADe sAriAM nAla naraka nUM bhara devAMgA|
AkhaAi ki he Adama! tUM ate terI patanI jaMnata vicca raho, jitthio maraz2I khAo para isa daraੱqhata de ner3e vI nahIM jANA, nahIM tAM tusIM doveM z2AlamAM vica giNe jAoge|

phera zaitAna ne uhanAM dovAM (Adama te usa dI patanI) nUM bahikAuNa laI uhanAM de dilAM vica vasavasA (bhair3e vicAra) dA dittA tAM jo jahir3IAM gupata iMdarIAM ihanAM toM kajjIAM hoIAM sana, uhanAM sAhamaNe khola deve| zaitAna AkhaNa laggA ki tuhADe rabba ne tuhAnUM (isa vizeza daraqhata dA phala khANa toM) isa laI rokiA hai ki kIte tusIM doveM farizate nA baNa jAo jAM sadA laI hI jIvita rahiNa vAliAM viccoM nA ho jAo|
usa ne uhanAM dovAM de sAhamaNe suMha khAdI ki sacca jANoM maiM tuhADA zubha ciMtaka hAM|

iMja zaitAna ne dhokhA deke uhanAM dovAM nUM bahikAiA| jadoM uhanAM dovAM ne daraqhata (dA phala) khAdA tAM dovAM de gupata aMga ika dUje de agge bepar3adA ho gae ate phera uha doveM ApaNe Apa nUM jaMnata de pattiAM nAla DhakaNa lagga pae| uhanAM de rabba ne uhanAM nUM AvAz2a dittI, kI maiM tuhAnUUM isa daraqhata (de ner3e jANa) toM manhA nahIM kItA sI ate iha nahIM kihA sI ki zaitAna tuhADA khullA duzamana hai?

dovAM ne kihA ki he sADe rabba! asIM ApaNe Apa nAla z2ulama kItA hai| je tUM sAnUM muAfa nahIM kareMgA ate sADe ’te rahima nahIM kareMgA tAM asIM ghATe vica rahiNa vAliAM viMcoM ho jAvAMge (bhAva barabAda ho jAvAMge)|

allAha ne kihA ki tusIM itthoM (akAza toM) uttara jAo, tusIM doveM (zaitAna te manukkha) ika dUje de vairI ho| huNa tusIM dharatI ’te hI rahiNA-vasaNA hai ate ika (nizacita) sameM tIka (jIvana dA) lAbha prApata karanA hai|
faramAiA ki tusIM (usa dharatI ’te hI) jIvana batIta karanA hai ate utthe hI maranA hai ate (kiAmata dihAr3e) tusIM use viccoM hI kaDDhe jAoge|

he Adama dI saMtAna! asIM tuhADe laI libAsa utAriA hai jo tuhADe gupata aMgAM nUM chupAuMdA hai ate sajAvaTa dA sAdhana vI hai ate sabha toM vadhIA libAsa parahez2agArI vAlA libAsa hai|[2] iha (libAsa) allAha dIAM nizAnIAM viccoM hai tAM jo lokI sikkhiA prApata karana|
translations.footnotes: [2] kihA jAMdA hai ki isalAma toM pahilAM jahAlata de sameM araba de buta pUjaka naMge ho ke kAabA de cakkara lagAiA karade sI para jadoM isalAma bhArU ho giA ate makkA jitta liA giA tAM ihanAM buta pUjakAM ate muzarikAM dA dAqhalA makke vikhe baMda kara dittA giA ate naMge ho ke cakkara lagAuNa dA vI aMta kara dittA giA|

translations.translation: he Adama dI aulAda! katie zaitAna tuhAnUM phera kise az2amAiza vica nA pA deve| jiveM ki usa ne tuhADe mAM bApa (Adama te usa dI patanI havvA) nUM jaMnata ’coM bAhara kaDhavAiA sI, jadoM uhanAM dovAM dA libAsa uhanAM toM luhA dittA sI, tAM jo uhanAM de gupata aMga pragaTa kare bezakka uha te usa dA kabIlA tuhAnUM usa thAM toM vekhadA hai jitthio tusIM uhanAM nUM nahIM vekha sakade ihanAM zaitAnAM nUM asIM uhanAM dA dosata baNA dittA hai jihar3e ImAna nahIM liAuMde|

iha loka jadoM koI azalIla harakatAM karade hana tAM Akhade hana ki asIM ApaNe bApa dAdiAM nUM iho karade vekhiA hai ate sAnUM vI allAha ne iho karana dA hukama dittA hai| (he nabI!) kahi dio ki allAha azalIla gallAM dI sikkhiA nahIM diMdA| kI tusIM allAha de z2iMme uha gallAM mar3hade ho jinhAM nUM tusIM jANade hI nahIM?

(he nabI!) tusIM Akha dio ki mere rabba ne saccAI te inasAfa dA hukama dittA hai ate hukama dittA hai ki tusIM namAz2a vele ApaNA mUMha siddhA (qhAnA-kAabA valla) rakkho| baMdagI nUM use laI qhAlasa karade hoe use nUM (madada laI) saddo| jiveM usa ne tuhAnUM pahaliAM paidA kItA use tarhAM mur3ha surajIta kIte jAoge|

kujjha lokAM nUM allAha ne hidAita dittI hai ate kujjha nUM gumarAhI ciMbar3a gaI hai| ihanAM lokAM ne allAha nUM chaDDa ke zaitAnAM nUM ApaNA mittara baNA liA hai ate iha samajhade hana ki uha siddhI rAha ’te hana|

he Adama dI aulAda! hareka ibAdata de mauke ’te ApaNI sajAvaTa nAla saje raho|[3] khAo pio para lor3a toM vaddha qharaca nA karo| bezakka uha binAM lor3a qharaca karana vAliA nUM pasaMda nahIM karadA|
translations.footnotes: [3] bhAva namAz2a par3hade hoe kappar3e pAuNA z2arUrI hai satara toM bhAva hai ki marada ApaNe moDhiAM utte kappar3e pAve ate dhuMnI toM goDiA taka ApaNA sarIra kappar3e nAla DhakaNA namAz2a par3haNa laI z2arUrI hai jada ki auaurata chuTTa usa de cihare toM pUrA sarIra Dhakka ke rakkhegI vidavAnA anusAra iha galla vadhere caMgI hai jekara auauratAM ApaNe hatthAM nUM kappar3e nAla jAM dasatAne nAla Dhakka ke rakhe ate ApaNe pairAM nUM jAM tAM laMme libAsa duArA jAM jarAbAM nAla Dhake, iha rAe abU-dAUda dI hadIsa: 639, 640 ’te AdhArita hai| ● haz2arata AizA pharamAuMdI hai ki jadoM nabI (sa:) phajara dI namAz2a adA karade sI tAM kujha musalamAna auauratAM cadarAM laike namAz2a vica zAmila huMdIAM sana ate uha namAz2a ApaNe gharAM nUM mur3a jAMdIAM sana| binAM isa toM ki uhanAM nUM koI pachANa sake| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 372)

translations.translation: (he nabI!) ihanAM nUM Akho jihar3IAM sajAvaTa te khANa pINa dIAM pavittara cIz2AM allAha ne ApaNe baMdiAM laI paidA kItIAM hana uhanAM nUM kise ne harAma kItA hai? tusIM kahi dio ki iha sArIAM (pavittara cIz2AM) saMsAra vaci vI uhanAM laI hana jahir3e ImAna laAie jada ki kiAmata dihAr3e iha vizeza mominAM laI hI hoNagiAM| isa tarhAM asIM ApaNe AdezAM nUM uhanAM laI kholha-kholha ke biAna karade hAM jihar3e giAna rakkhade hana|

(he nabI!) tusIM Akha dio ki mere rabba ne behiyAI vAlIAM (bhAva azalIla) gallAM bhAveM uha z2Ahira hoNa jAM gupata, pApa te aNa hakkA z2ulama nUM harAma kItA hai ate iha vI (harAma kItA) ki tusIM binAM kise dalIla toM kise nUM allAha dA zarIka baNAo ate allAha de saMbaMdha vicca uha gallAM Akho jisa dA tuhAnUM ukkA hI giAna nahIM (harAma hana)|
hareka (kauma) laI ika samAM niyata hai so jadoM usa dA niyata samAM AvegA tAM uha (kauma) usa (sameM) toM (bacaNa laI) ika pala laI vI agge-picche nahIM hovegI|

he Adama dI aulAda! je tuhADe viccoM hI tuhADe kola paig2aMbara AuNa jihar3e tuhAnUM merIAM AitAM suNAuNa tAM jihar3A viakatI burAiAM toM bacegA ate ApaNA sudhAra karegA tAM (kiAmata dihAr3e) usa nUM nA koI Dara hovegA ate nA hI koI ciMtA hovegI|
jihar3e loka mere ihanAM hukamAM nUM jhuThalAuNage ate sarakazI karanage uha loka naraka vica jANage, jitthe uha sadA laI rahiNage|

so usa toM vaDDA z2Alama kauNa hovegA jihar3A allAha ’te hI jhUTha lAve jAM usa dIAM nizAnIAM nUUM hI jhUThA kahe| jo kujjha usa de mukaddara vica likhiA hoiA hai uha usa nUM mila jAvegA, jadoM uhanAM (z2AlamAM) kola sADe farizate uhanAM dI jAna kaDDhaNa laI AuNage tAM pucchaNage ki jinhAM nUM tusIM rabba nUM chaDDa ke pUjade sI ajja uha kitthe hana? tAM javAba deNage ki uha sAthoM khussa gae ate uha ApaNe viruddha gavAhI deNage ki bezakka uhIo (saccAI de) inakArI sI|

(allAha hukama de ke) kahegA ki tusIM vI use naraka vica cale jAo jisa vica tuhAthoM pahilAM bIta cukke manukkhAM te jiMnAM de Tole jA cukke hana| uha ika dUje nUM fiTakArAM pAuNage itthoM taka ki jadoM uha sAre utthe jamhAM ho jANage tAM ika TolA dUje Tole nUM AkhegA ki he sADe rabba! ihanAM lokAM ne hI sAnUM kurAhe pAiA sI isa laI tUM ihanAM nUM agga dA dUNA az2Aba de| allAha AkhegA ki tuhADe sAriAM laI dUNA az2Aba hai, para tusIM jANade nahIM|
uhanAM dA pahilA TolA dUje Tole nUM AkhegA (ki je iha galla hai tAM) phera tuhAnUM sADe toM koI vizezatA prApata nahIM so tusIM vI ApaNI kamAI anusAra az2Aba dA suAda lavo|

jinhAM lokAM ne sADIAM AitAM (hukamAM) nUM jhuThalAiA ate uhanAM toM sarakazI kItI, uhanAM laI akAza de bUhe nahIM kholhe jANage| uha lokI udoM taka jaMnata vica nahIM jANage jadoM taka UMTha sUI de nakke vica dI laMgha nahIM jAMdA (jihar3A saMbhava nahIM )| asIM aparAdhIAM nUM ajihA hI badalA diA karade hAM|
uhanAM laI naraka vica agga dA vichauNA hovegA ate uhanAM dA oDhaNA vI uhIo hovegA, asIM z2AlamA nUM ajihA hI badalA diA karade hAM|

jihar3e loka ImAna liAe ate uhanAM ne neka kaMma vI kIte ate asIM (allAha) kise viakatI nUM usa dI samarathA toM vaddha takalIfa nahIM diMde| uhIo loka jaMnata vica jANage ate sadA use vica hI rahiNage|

je uhanAM (jaMnatIAM) de dilAM vica (ika dUje de viruddha) koI maila hovegI asIM usa nUM kaDDha suTTAMge| uhanAM de heTha nahirAM vagadIAM hoNagIAM ate uha loka AkhaNage ki allAha dA zukara hai ki usa ne sAnUM siddhI rAha vikhAiA, asIM Apa siddhI rAha nahIM sI pai sakade, je allAha sAnUM rAhe nA pAuMdA| bezakka sADe rabba de paig2aMbara saccIAM gallAM laike Ae sana ate uhanAM nUM AvAz2a dittI jAvegI ki iha hai uha jaMnata jisa de vArasa tusIM uhanAM amalAM kArana baNAe gae ho jo tusIM (saMsAra vica) karade sAM|

jaMnata vAle narakIAM nUM kahiNage ki(rabba ne) sADe nAla jihar3A vAadA kItA sI asIM tAM usa nUM saccA hI vekhiA hai| kI tusIM vI jihar3A tuhADe rabba ne tuhADe nAla vAadA kItA sI usa nUM saccA vekhiA hai? uha (narakI) AkhaNage ki‘hAM’ phera ika pukArana vAlA pukAregA ki z2AlamAM ’te allAha dI fiTakAra hove|
jihar3e lokI allAha de rasate toM lokAM nUM rokade sana ate isa vica koI viMga-valla labbhade sana ate uha Aqhirata de vI inakArI sana| (uhanAM ’te allAha dI phiTakAra hai)

uhanAM dovAM (narakIAM te jaMnatIAM) vicakAra ika oTa hovegI ate ArAfa[4] (uccAIAM) ’te kujjha hora loka hoNage iha hareka (jaMnatI te narakI) nUM uhanAM de lacchaNA toM pachANa laiNage| uha jaMnatIAM nUM pukArade hoe AkhaNage ki assalAmA alaikuma (tuhADe ’te salAmatI hove) iha ArAfa vAle jaMnata vica dAqhala tAM nahIM hoe hoNage, hAM! AsavaMda hoNage|
translations.footnotes: [4] ArAfa jaMnata te naraka vicAle dI thAM nUM kihA jAMdA hai| (taphasIra-e-kuratabI: 211/7)

translations.translation: jadoM uhanAM (ArAfa vAliAM dIAM) naz2arAM narakIAM valla jANagIAM phera AkhaNage ki he sADe rabbA! sAnUM ihanAM z2AlamAM de saMga nA rakkhIM|

ArAfa vAle kujjha (narakadhArI) lokAM nUM uhanAM de lacchaNA toM pachANa ke AvAz2a deNage ki nA ajja tuhADe jatthe ne ate nA hI tuhADI (jIvana samaggarI) ne tuhAnUM koI lAbha dittA hai jisa ’te tusIM ghamaMDa karade sAM|

kI iha uhIo lokI hana jinhAM bAre tusIM kasamAM khA khA ke kihA karade sI ki allAha ihanAM ’te kade vI ApaNIAM miharAM nahIM karegA (jada ki ihanAM nUM tAM hukama ho giA hai ki tusIM jaMnata vica dAqhala ho jAo| aja nA tuhADe laI koI Dara hai ate nA hI koI ciMtA hai|

ate narakI jaMnatIAM nUM pukAra ke AkhaNage ki sADe ’te thor3hA pANI hI pA dio jAM jihar3A riz2aka allAha ne tuhAnUM de chaDDiA hai usa viccoM kujjha sAnUM vI de dio| jaMnatI AkhaNage ki allAha ne doveM cIz2AM kAfirAM laI harAma kara rakkhiA hai|

jinhAM ne saMsAra vica ApaNe dharama nUM kheDa-tamAzA baNA rakkhiA sI ate jinhAM nUM saMsArika jIvana ne dhokhe vica pAiA hoiA sI ajja asIM (allAha) uhanAM nUM use tarhAM bhula jAvAMge jiveM ki uhanAM ne isa kiAmata) dihAr3e dI milaNI nUM bhulA chaDDiA sI ate sADIAM AitAM (rabbI kalAma) dA inakAra karade sana|

ate asIM ihanAM lokAM kola ika ajihI kitAba (rasUla rAhIM) pahuMcAI hai jisa vica asIM ApaNe giAna te adhArita bahuta hI visathAra nAla (hara galla) biAna kItA hai| jada ki iha uhanAM lokAM laI hidAita te rahimata hai jihar3e ImAna liAe hana|

ihanAM lokAM nUM hora kise galla dI uDIka nahIM kevala isa (saMsAra) de aMta dI uDIka kara rahe hana| jisa dina isa (saMsAra) dA aMta AvegA tAM jihar3e loka isa nUM bhullI baiThe sana uha AkhaNage ki bezakka sADe rabba de paig2aMbara hakka lai ke Ae sana| kI sADA koI sifArazI hai ki uha sADI laI (rabba de kola) sifAraza kare? jAM sAnUM mur3a saMsAra vica bheje tAM jo asIM ihanAM kaMmAM dI thAM dUje kaMma karIe jo asIM pahilAM kariA karade sI| bezakka ihanAM lokAM ne ApaNe Apa nUM ghATe vica pA liA ate jihar3IAM gallAM uha baNAuMde sana ajja uha sArIAM guAcIAM gaIAM|

bezakka terA rabba uha allAha hI hai jisa ne che dinAM vica sAre akAzAM te dharatI nUM paidA kItA phera uha araza (rAja sighAsana) ’te jA baiThiA| uha (allAha) dani nUM rAta nAla iMja Dhakka diMdA hai ki uha rAta chetI hI dina de picche callI AuMdI hai| usa ne sUraja, caMna, ate tAriAM nUM paidA kItA ki uha sAre usa (allAha de) hukama adhIna hana| qhabaradAra raho! paidA karanA te hukama deNA use nUM hI zobhA diMdA hai| allAha, sAre jahAnAM dA pAlaNahAra ate bahuta hI barakatAM vAlA hai|
tusIM ApaNe pAlaNahAra toM gir3agir3AuMde hoe ate hole hole duAvAM kariA karo| bezakka uha (allAha) haddoM TappaNa vAliAM nUM pasaMda nahIM karadA|

dharatI vica jada ki isa nUM suAriA jA cukkiA hai, vigAr3a nA paidA karo ate Darade hoe te (baqhaziza dIAM) AsAM rakkhade hoe use nUM hI pukAro| bezakka allAha dIAM miharAM sohaNe carittara vAliAM de vadhere ner3e hana|

ate uha (allAha) hI hai jihar3A ApaNI rahimata (dI bAraza) toM pahilAM qhuzaqhabarIAM deNa vAlIAM havAvAM nUM bhejadA hai| jadoM uha havAvAM bhArI (pANI vAle) baddalAM nUM cukadIAM hana tAM asIM ihanAM baddalAM nUM kise nirajIva (baMjara) dharatI valla taura diMde hAM| phera asIM ihanAM baddalAM toM pANI varAuMde hAM, phera isa pANI toM hara prakAra de phala (dharatI viccoM) kaDDhade hAM| ise tarhAM asAM muradiAM nUM (dharatI viccoM) kaDDha ke khar3A kara devAMge tAM jo tusIM sikkhiA grahiNa karo|

jihar3I dharatI caMgI (upajAU) huMdI hai usa dI upaja tAM allAha de hukama nAla batherI nikaladI hai ate jihar3A dharatI kharAba huMdI hai usa dI upaja bahuta hI nikaMmI huMdI hai| isa tarhAM asIM kholha-kholha ke ApaNIAM dalIlAM biAna karade hAM uhanAM lokAM laI jihar3e zukara adA karade hana|

asIM nUha nUM usa dI kauma valla (paig2aMbara baNAke) bhejiA| uhanAM ne AkhiA ki he merI kauma! tusIM allAha dI hI ibAdata karo usa toM chuTTa hora koI tuhADA izaTa nahIM, maiM tuhADe ’te ika vaDDe dina (kiAmata) de az2Aba AuNa toM DaradA hAM|
usa (nUha) dI kauma de kujjha saradArAM ne AkhiA| bezakka asIM tAM tainUM sapazaTa taura ’te kurAhe piA hoiA vekha rahe hAM|
uhanAM(nUha) ne AkhiA ki he merI kauma! maiM ukkA hI gumarAhI ’te nahIM, maiM tAM saMsAra de pAlaNahAra dA rasUla hAM|
maiM tuhAnUM ApaNe rabba de paig2Ama pahuMcAuMdA hAM ate tuhADI bhalAI cAhuMdA hAM, maiM allAha valloM uhanAM gallAM dI qhabara rakkhadA hAM jinhAM dI qhabara tuhAnUM nahIM|

kI tuhAnUM isa galla dI hairAnI huMdI hai ki tuhADe pAlaNahAra valloM tuhADe kola ika ajihe baMde rAhIM nasIhata AI hai jihar3A tuhADe hI viccoM hai ki uha tuhAnUM (allAha dI saz2A) toM DarAe ate tusIM Dara jAvo tAM jo tuhADe ’te rahima kItA jAve|

phera uhanAM ne usa (nUha) nUM jhuThalAiA ate asIM (allAha ne) usa nUM ate usa de (ImAna liAuNa vAle) sAthIAM nUM ika ber3I vica chuTakArA dittA ate jinhAM lokAM ne sADIAM AitAM (rabbI AdezAM) nUM jhuThalAiA sI uhanAM nUM asIM Doba dittA| bezakka uha lokI (kufara vica) aMnhe ho rahe sana|

asIM Ada kauma valla uhanAM de hI bharA hUda nUM (nabI baNA ke) bhejiA| usa ne AkhiA ki he merI kauma! tusIM allAha dI hI ibAdata karo usa toM chuTTa tuhADA koI izaTa nahIM| kI tusIM (allAha toM) nahIM Darade?
usa dI kauma de kAfira saradArAM ne kihA ki asIM tAM tainUM mUrakhatA vica fasiA hoiA vekha rahe hAM ate asIM tAM tainUM jhUThe lokAM viccoM samajhade hAM|
usa (hUda) ne AkhiA ki he merI kauma! maiM koI mUrakha nahIM hAM, maiM tAM sAre jahAnAM de pAlaNahAra valloM bhejiA hoiA paig2aMbara hAM|
tuhAnUM ApaNe rabba dA paig2Ama pahuMcAuMdA hAM, maiM tuhADA saccA zubha-ciMtaka hAM|

kI tuhAnUM isa galla dI hairAnI hai ki tuhADe pAlaNahAra valloM tuhADe valla ika ajihe viakatI rAhIM nasIhata pujjI hai jihar3A tuhADe viccoM hI hai tAM jo uha tuhAnUM (rabba de az2Aba toM) DarAe| tusIM iha galla vI yAda rakkho ki allAha ne tuhAnUM nUha dI kauma toM bAada dharatI dA jAnazIna baNAiA ate tuhAnUM vadhere rizaTa-puzzaTa kItA, so tusIM allAha dIAM niamatAM nUM yAda karo tAM jo tusIM saphalatA pAo|

uhanAM (hUda dI kauma) ne AkhaAi, kI tUM sADe kola isa laI AiA hai ki asIM basa ika allAha dI hI ibAdata karIe ate jinhAM nUM sADe bApa dAdA pUjade Ae hana uhanAM nUM tiAga daIe? jihar3e az2Aba dI dhamakI tUM diMdA hai uha lai A, je tUM saccA hai|

usa (hUda) ne AkhiA kihuNa tuhADe utte allAha dA az2Aba AuNa vAlA hI hai| kI tusIM mere nAla uhanAM nAvAM laI jhagar3ade ho jinhAM nUM tusIM ate tuhADe pio dAdiAM ne (ApaNe izaTa) ghar3ha lae hana? ihanAM de izaTa hoNa dI allAha ne koI dalIla nahIM bhejI, so tusIM (az2Aba dI) uDIka karo maiM vI tuhADe nAla uDIka kara rihA hAM|
aMta asIM ApaNI mihara nAla usa (hUda) nUM ate usa de sAthIAM nUM bacA liA ate uhanAM lokAM dI jar3ha vaDDha suTTI jihar3e sADIAM AitAM dA inakAra karade sI ate uha ImAna liAuNa vAle vI nahIM sI|

asIM samUda valla uhanAM de hI bharA sAleha nUM (nabI baNAke) bhejiA| usa ne kihA ki he merI kauma! tusIM allAha dI hI ibAdata karo, usa toM chuTTa tuhADA koI izaTa nahIM, tuhADe kola tuhADe pAlaNahAra valloM ika sapazaTa dalIla A cukkI hai| iha allAha dI UMThaNI tuhADe laI ika vizeza nizAnI hai so tusIM isa nUM chaDDa dio ki allAha dI dharatI ’te cugadI-caradI phire ate isa nUM kise bure irAde nAla hattha nahIM lAuNA, nahIM tAM tuhAnUM daradanAka az2Aba A nappegA|

tusIM usa vele nUM yAda karo jadoM allAha ne tuhAnUM Ada toM magaroM (dharatI dA) jAna-nazIna baNAiA sI ate tuhAnUM dharatI utte vasaNa dA TikANA dittA| tusIM isa dI narama miTTI toM mahalla usArade ho ate pahAr3AM nUM kaTTa ke ghara baNAuMde ho| so allAha dIAM niamatAM nUM yAda rakkho ate dharatI vica fasAda nA failAo|

usa dI kauma de ghamaMDI saradArAM ne uhanAM dI kauma de kamaz2ora varaga de lokAM nUM jahir3e ImAna liAe sana pucchiA, kI tuhAnUM isa galla dA vizavAsa hai ki sAleha ApaNe rabba valloM bhejiA hoiA (paig2aMbara) heai? uhanAM ne AkhiA bezakka sAnUM isa ’te pUrA yakIna hai jo vI sunehA usa nUM deke bhejiA hai|
uha haMkAre hoe loka AkhaNa lagge ki jisa galla ’te tusIM yakIna rakkhade ho asIM tAM usa dA inakAra karade hAM|

so uhanAM ne UThaNI dIAM TaMgAM vaDDha suTTIAM ate ApaNe pAlaNahAra de hukamAM toM sarakazI kItI ate AkhaNa lagge ki he sAleha! jisa (az2Aba) dI tUM sAnUM citAvanI de rihA hai, je tUM paig2aMbarAM viccoM hai tAM uha az2Aba lai A|
phera uhanAM nUM ika bhucAla ne A nappiA, uha ApaNe gharAM vica mUdhe mUMha pae rahigae|

use vele uha (sAleha) ne uhanAM toM mUMha phera liA ate AkhaNa laggA ki he merI kauma! maiM tAM tuhAnUM ApaNe pAlaNahAra dA hukama pahuMcA dittA ate tuhAnUM nasIhata kItI sI, para tusIM loka nasIhata karana vAliAM nUM pasaMda nahIM sI karade|
asIM lUta nUM bhejiA, jadoM usa ne ApaNI kauma nUM kihA ki tusIM uha azalIla kaMma karade ho jisa nUM saMsAra vica tuhAthoM pahilAM kise ne vI nahIM sI kItA|
tusIM isatarIAM nUM chaDDa ke maradAM toM ApaNI kAma vAsanA pUrI karade ho, tusIM tAM haddoM Tappa gae ho|
para usa dI kauma ne uttara vica kihA ki ihanAM lokAM nU ApaNI basatI viccoM kaDDha dio, iha loka bahuta hI pAkabAz2a baNade hana|
aqhIra asIM usa (lUta) nUM ate usa de ghara vAliAM nUM, chuTTa usa dI patanI, az2Aba toM bacA liA| usa dI (patanI) picche rahiNa (halAka hoNa) vAliAM vica jA ralI|
ate asIM uhanAM (lUta dI kauma) ’te pattharAM dA mIMha barasAiA| vekho tAM sahI uhanAM mujaramAM dA aMta kiho jihA hoiA!

asIM madayana vAliAM valla uhanAM de bharA zuaiba nUM bhejiA, usa ne kihA ki he merI kauma! tusIM allAha dI hI ibAdata karo usa toM chuTTa tuhADA koI izaTa nahIM, tuhADe kola tuhADe rabba valloM ika sapazaTa dalIla A cukkI hai so tusIM nApa te tola pUrA karo ate lokAM nUM uhanAM dIAM cIz2AM ghaTTa karake nA dio ate dharatI de sudhAra magaroM usa vica vigAr3a nA phailAo ise vica hI tuhADI bhalAI hai, je tusIM sacce ImAna vAle ho|

tusIM lokAM nUM (kurAhe pAuNa laI) rasatiAM vica nA baiTho| tusIM hara usa viakatI nUM DarAuMde ho ate allAha de rasate vica callaNa toM rokade ho, jihar3A usa ’te ImAna liAuMdA hai jada ki tusIM use rAha vica viMga-valla labbhade ho| (he momino!) yAda karo jadoM tusIM bahuta hI thor3he sI, phera allAha ne tuhADe vica vAdhA kara dittA ate iha vI vekho ki fisAdIAM dA aMta kiho jihA hoiA sI?

je tuhADe vica kujjha loka usa rabbI Adeza ’te, jisa nAla mainUM (zuaiba nUM) bhejiA giA hai, ImAna liAe ate kujjha ImAna nA liAe tAM ratA tusIM dhIraja rakkho itthoM taka ki allAha sADe vicAle koI faisalA kara deve ate uha (allAha) sabha toM[5] vadhIA faisalA karana vAlA hai|
