translations.footnotes: [5] iha faisalA saMsAra vica vI ho sakadA hai para Aqhirata vica faisalA hoNA lAz2amI hai utthe hareka toM usa de kaMmAM bAre puccha-giccha hovegI ate usa dI rauzanI vica faisale kIte jANage jiveM hadIsa vica nabI (sa:) ne faramAiA hai ki tuhADe viccoM hareka viakatI z2iMmevAra hai ate usa toM usa de adhIna lokAM bAre pucchiA jAvegA, rAjA toM usa dI parajA pratI pucchiA jAvegA auaurata ApaNe patI de ghara ate usa de bacciA dI raqhavAlI karana laI hai usa toM uhanAM bAre puccha-giccha hovegI| tuhADe viccoM hara viakatI z2iMmevAra hai ate usa toM usa de adhIna lokAM bAre pucchiA jAvegA| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 7138) ● ika hadIsa vica rasUla (sa:) ne faramAiA jihar3A koI viqhAve laI koI neka kaMma karadA hai tAM allAha kiAmata vAle dina usa dI niyata nUM lokAM sAhamaNe z2Ahira karegA jihar3A koI lokAM nAla saqhatI karegA tAM kiAmata vAle dina allAha uhanAM ’te saqhatI karegA (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 7152) ika viakatI ne allAha de rasUla (sa:) nUM AkhiA ki he allAha de rasUla! kiAmata kadoM AvegI? tAM rasUla (sa:) ne pucchiA ki taine usa kiAmata laI kI tiArI kItI hai? tAM uha viakatI zaramiMdA hoiA ate Dara giA ate kihA ki he allAha de rasUla! maiMne isa laI bahute roz2e, qhairAta te namAz2A tAM nahIM par3hIAM para maiM allAha ate usa de rasUla nAla muhabbata karadAM hAM iha suNa ke nabI (sa:) ne AkhiA ki tUM use dA hI sAthI hovegA jisa nAla tUM muhabbata karadA hai (sahI buqhArI hadIsa: 7153) abUz2ara ra:a: faramAuMde hana ika vAra maiM nabI (sa:) dI sevA vica hAz2ara hoiA tAM Apa (sa:) ne faramAiA usa allAha dI kasama jisa de kabaz2e vica merI jAna hai jihar3A koI UMTha, gaU, bakarIAM rakkhadA hoiA vI z2akAta adA nahIM karadA tAM kiAmata dihAr3e uhanAM jAnavarAM nUM liAiA jAvegA jada ki uha pahilAM toM bahuta vaddha moTe hoNage uha usa viakatI nUM pairA heTha dabbaNage ate sIMgAM nAla mAraNage ate iMja huMdA rahegA ate iha saz2A usa sameM taka miladI rahegI jadoM taka sAre lokAM dA faisalA nahIM ho jAvegA| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 1460)

translations.translation: usa dI kauma de ghamaMDI saradArAM ne kihA ki he zuaiba! asIM tainUM ate jihar3e tere nAla ImAna liAuNa vAle hana uhanAM sabha nUM ApaNI basatI ’coM kaDDha devAMge jAM tusIM sADe dharama vica mur3a Aoge| zuaiba ne kihA, kI asIM tuhADe usa dharama valla parata AIe bhAveM ki usa toM asIM ghiranA hI karade hoIe|

je asIM tuhADe dharama vica A jAvAMge phera tAM asIM allAha utte bahuta hI jhUThIAM gallAM jor3aNa vAle ho jAvAMge jada ki allAha sAnUM (tuhADe isa dharama) toM chuTakArA de cukkiA hai| sAnUM iha zobhA nahIM diMdA ki asIM usa dharama vica mur3a AIe| hAM, je sADA rabba hI iha cAhave tAM galla vkharrI hai| sADe rabba dA giAna hara cIz2a nUM ApaNe ghere vica rakkhadA hai, asIM allAha ’te hI bharosA rakhade hAM ate use toM duA karade hAM, he sADe pAlaNahAra! tUM sADe te sADI kauma vicAle hakka anusAra faisalA karade ate tUM hI sabha toM vadhIA faisalA karana vAlA hai|
usa dI kauma de kufara karana vAle saradArAM ne AkhiA ki he loko! je tusIM zuaiba dI rAha Turoge tAM bezakka tusIM bhArI ghATe vica rahoge|
phera uhanAM nUM ika bhucAla ne A far3hiA ate uha ApaNe gharAM vica mUdhe mUMha pae rahe gae|
jinhAM lokAM ne zuaiba nUM jhuThalAiA sI uhanAM dI iha hAlata ho gaI sI jiveM ihanAM gharAM vica uha kade vase hI nahIM sI| jinhAM ne zuaiba nUM jhuThalAiA sI uhIo ghATe vica rahi gae|

phera zuaiba ne uhanAM toM mUMha phera ke AkhaAi ki he merI kauma! maiM tuhAnUM ApaNe pAlaNahAra (rabba) de sAre paig2Ama pahuMcA ditte ate tuhADI bhalAI cAhI phera bhalA maiM inakArIAM utte kiuMafasosa karAM?
asIM jadoM vI kise basatI (kauma) valla koI paig2aMbara bhejiA tAM utthoM de vasanIkAM nUM pahiloM taMgI te takalIfAM vica phasAiA tAM jo uha adhInagI dhArana kara laiNa|

phera asIM uhanAM dI maMdahAlI nUM qhuzahAlI vica badala dittA itthoM taka ki uha bahuta vaddha fula gae ate AkhaNa lagge ki sADe baz2uragAM ’te vI caMge-mAr3e dina Ae sana| aqhIra asIM uhanAM qhuzahAla lokAM nUM acAnaka hI A nappiA ate uhanAM nUM qhabara taka nA ho sakI|

je uhanAM basatIAM vAle ImAna liAuMde ate parahez2agArI ikhatiAra karade tAM asIM (allAha) uhanAM ’te akAzAM ate dharatI dIAM barakatAM de bUhe khola diMde para uhanAM (sacce dharama nUM) jhUTha jANiA phera asIM uhanAM de (bhair3e) amalAM de badale uhanAM nUM phar3a liA|
kI phera vI ihanAM basatIAM vAle isa galla toM nizacita ho gae hana ki ihanAM ’te sADA az2Aba rAta nUM sutte piAM A jAve?
jAM basatIAM vAle isa galla toM nahIM Darade ki ihanAM ’te sADA az2Aba dina car3he Ave jadoM uha kheDa tamAziAM vica masata hoNa|
kI uha allAha de dAa toM beparavAha ho gae hana? so allAha de dAa toM chuTTa usa toM, jisa dI barabAdI hI A gaI hove, hora koI be-paravAha nahIM huMdA|

kI uhanAM lokAM nUM, jihar3e dharatI ’te pahilAM bIta cukke vasanIkAM dI barabAdI toM magaroM isa de vArasa baNe hana iha (az2Aba dI galla) aje sapazaTa nahIM hoI| jekara asIM (allAha) cAhIe tAM ihanAM de juramAM kArana ihanAM nUM halAka kara daIe ate ihanAM de manAM utte asIM moharAM lagA daIe phera uha kujjha vI suNa nahIM sakaNage|

(he nabI!) iha uha basatIAM hana jinhAM dIAM qhabarAM asIM tuhAnUM suNA rahe hAM| bezakka uhanAM de rasUla uhanAM kola khullhIAM nizAnIAM lai ke Ae para jisa cIz2a nUM uha pahilAM jhuThalA cukke sI usa ’te ImAna liAuNa vAle nahIM sI| allAha iMja hI kAfariAM de dilAM ’te moharAM lA diMdA hai|
asIM ihanAM viccoM bahutiAM nUM pratiggiA dI pAlaNA karade hoe nahIM vakhaAi, sagoM bahutiAM nUM (hukamAM) dI ulaMghaNA karade hoe nahIM vekhiA|

phera ihanAM (nabIAM) toM bAada asIM mUsA nUM ApaNIAM nizAnIAM de nAla firaauna ate usa de darabArIAM kola bhejiA para uhanAM ne uhanAM nizAnIAM nUM (saccA) nahIM maMniA, phera vekho uhanAM fasAdIAM dA aMta kiho jihA hoiA sI?
(firaauna de darabAra vica jA ke) mUsA ne AkhiA ki he firaauna! maiM kulla jahAnAM de pAlaNahAra valloM (bhejiA hoiA) paig2aMbara hAM|

mere laI iha z2arUrI hai ki maiM allAha valloM hakka sacca toM binAM hora kujjha vI nA AkhAM| maiM tere valla tere rabba valloM (rasUla hoNa dIAM) khullhIAM nizAMnIAM lai ke AiA hAM, so tUM banI-isarAIla nUM mere nAla bheja de|
firaauna ne kihA ki je tUM koI nizAMnI lai ke AiA hai tAM usa nUM vikhA, je tUM saccA hai|
so Apa jI (mUsA) ne ApaNA asA (lAThI) nUM (dharatI ’te) suTTiA, uha use vele ika ajagara vikhAI deNa lagga piA|
phera usa (mUsA) ne ApaNA hattha kuccha viccoM bAhara kaDDhiA tAM uha vekhaNa vAliAM laI camakadA hoiA safaida (hattha) sI|
firaauna dI kauma de saradArAM ne AkhiA ki bezakka iha viakatI tAM ika mAhira jAdUgara hai|
(firaauna ne AkhiA ki) iha cAhuMdA hai ki tuhAnUM (firaauna te usa de sAthIAM nUM) tuhADe deza vicoM bAhara kaDDha deve tuhADA kI vicAra hai?
(firaauna de pucchaNa ’te darabArIAM ne) kihA ki tusIM isa (mUsA) nUM ate isa de bharA (hArUna) nUM thor3hA samAM de dio ate zahira vica harakAre bheja dio|
tAM jo uha sAre hI mAhira jAdUgarAM nUM tuhADe kola hAz2ara karana|
jadoM jAdUgara firaauna kola hAz2ara hoe ate kahiNa lagge ki jekara asIM (mUsA ’te) bhArU rahe tAM kI sAnUM koI vaDDA badalA (inAma) milegA?
(firaauna ne) kihA, hAM! tusIM mere nikaTavaratI lokAM viccoM ho jAoge|
(jAdUgarAM ne) kihA ki he mUsA! pahilAM tusIM (jAdU) vikhAoge jAM pahilAM asIM vikhAIe|

(mUsA) ne AkhiA ki pahilAM tusIM hI karo| phera jadoM uhanAM (jAdUgarAM) ne (ApaNIAM rassIAM te lAThIAM) suTTIAM tAM lokAM dIAM naz2arAM ’te jAdU ho giA ate uhanAM nUM (lAThIAM te rassIAM toM sappa baNA ke) DarA dittA, uha bahuta vaDDA jAdU liAe sana|

ate phera asIM mUsA nUM hukama dittA ki tUM vI ApaNA asA (soTI ihanAM sappAM) agge suTTade| jadoM usa ne suTTiA tAM uha (asA) vekhade hI vekhade (ajagara baNa ke uhanAM sappAM nUUM) nigalaNa lagga piA, jo uha jAdUgara ghar3a ke liAe sana|
aMta saccAI siddha ho gaI ate uhanAM ne jo kujjha vI (jAdU) kItA sI uha sabha malIAMmeTa ho giA|
jAdUgarAM ne utthe hI hAra maMna laI ate hINe ho ke (maidAna toM) parA haTTa gae|
ate sAre jAdUgara sijade vica Diga pae|
AkhaNa lagge ki asIM tAM sAre jahAnAM de rabba ’te ImAna liAe hAM|
jihar3A mUsA te hArUna dA vI rabba hai|

firaauna ne kihA ki tusIM binAM merI AgiA toM isa mUsA ’te ImAna liAe ho, bezakka iha ika cAla hai jihar3I tusIM isa zahira vica rala mila ke racI hai tAM jo tusIM isa zahira de vasanIkAM nUM itthoM bAhara kaDDha dio! chetI hI tuhAnUM isa de siTTe dA patA lagga jAvegA|
maiM tuhADe (jAdUgarAM de) ika pAse de hattha ate dUje pAse de pairAM nUM vaDhavA devAMgA ate tuhAnUM sAriAM nUM fAMsI ’te laTakavA devAMgA|
uhanAM (jAdUgarAM ne) javAba vica kihA ki bezakka (phAMsI magaroM) asIM ApaNe mAlika valla hI parata ke jAvAMge|

(he firaauna!) tUM sAnUM isa laI saz2A de rihA hai ki asIM apaNe rabba dIAM nizAnIAM ’te ImAna liAe hAM jadoM ki uha sADe sAhamaNe A gaIAM hana| he rabbA! sAnUM sabara de ate sAnUM isa hAlata vica mauta daIM ki asIM musalamAna hoIe|

firaauna dI kauma de saradArAM ne kihA, kI tusIM mUsA ate usa de sAthIAM nUM aiveM hI chaDDa dioge tAM jo uha dharatI utte fasAda karana ate uha tuhAnUM ate tuhADe izaTAM nUM chaDDa deNa? firaauna ne kihA ki asIM uhanAM de jaMmade muMDiAM nUM katala kara devAMge ate uhanAM dIAM dhIAM nUM (jiudIAM) chaDDa devAMge| bezakka asIM uhanAM ’te hara pakkhoM bhArU hAM|

mUsA ne ApaNI kauma nUM kihA ki tusIM allAha toM madada maMgo ate dhIraja toM kaMma lavo| bezakka dharatI tAM allAha dI hI hai, uha ApaNe baMdiAM ’coM jisa nUM cAhuMdA hai usa dA vArasa baNA diMdA hai, vadhIA aMta tAM parahez2agArAM dA hI hai|

usa dI kauma ne mUsA nUM kihA ki tuhADe AuNa toM pahilAM vI ate tuhAthoM bAada vica vI sAnUM tasIhe ditte gae| mUsA ne kihA ki Asa hai tuhADA rabba chetI hI tuhADe vairI nUM mAra mukAvegA ate tuhAnUM dharatI (deza) dA vArasa baNA devegA ate phera vekhegA ki tusIM kI karade ho?
phera asIM firaaunIAM nUM kAla te phalAM dI upaja de ghATe vica phasAIM rakkhiA tAM jo uha sikkhiA laiNa|

jadoM uhanAM ’te qhuzahAlI A jAMdI tAM Akhade ki iha tAM sADe laI hoNA hI sI je uhanAM nUM kise bhair3I hAlata dA sAhamaNA karanA paiMdA tAM usa laI mUsA ate uhanAM de sAthIAM nUM be-bhAga dassade| yAda rakkho ihanAM dI bebhAgI (badazuganI) tAM allAha de kola hai para ihanAM vica kiMne hI loka jANade hI nahIM|
ate uha kahiMde sI ki(he mUsA!) tUM sADe sAhamaNe bhAveM koI vI nizAnI, sADe ’te jAdU karana laI, lai A tAM vI asIM terI galla nahIM maMNanI|

phera asIM uhanAM firaaunIAM ’te tUfAna bhejiA, ate TiDDI dala, susarIAM, DaDDU ate qhUna de az2Aba bheje| iha sArIAM nizAnIAM aDDa-aDDa karake vikhAIAM, phera vI uha ghamaMDa karade rahe| uha loka aparAdhI hI sana|

jadoM uhanAM ’te koI az2Aba A jAMdA tAM Akhade ki he mUsA! tasIM sADe laI ApaNe rabba toM duA karo jisa (dI gabUlI) dA usa ne tuhADe nAla vAadA kItA hoiA hai| je tusIM sAthoM isa az2Aba nUM haTA dio tAM asIM z2arUra hI tuhADe utte ImAna liAvAMge ate banI-isarAIla nUM tuhADe nAla bheja devAMge|
phera jadoM asIM uhanAM taka pahuMcaNa vAlA az2Aba ika niyata sameM laI haTA diMde tAM uha use sameM ApaNe vacanAM toM phira jAMde|
phera asIM uhanAM toM badalA liA bhAva uhanAM nUM dariA vica Doba dittA uha isa laI ki uha sADIAM nizAnIAM nUM jhuThalAuMde sI ate uhanAM dI ukkA hI paravAha nahIM sI karade|

asIM uhanAM lokAM nUM jihar3e kamaz2ora samajhe jAMde sana, isa dharatI de pUraba pacchama taka dA vArasa baNA dittA jisa vica asIM barakatAM rakkhIAM sana ate tuhADe rabba dA saccA vAadA banI-isarAIla de hakka vica uhanAM de dhIraja toM kaMma laiNa kArana pUrA hoiA| asAM firaauna ate usa dI kauma valloM baNAIAM hoIAM cIz2AM (bhAva kAraqhAne Adi) ate jihar3IAM uha uccIAM-uccIAM (mahilAM dIAM) imAratAM usArade sI uhanAM sabha nUM malIA meTa kara dittA|

jadoM asIM banI isarAIla nUM samuMdaroM pAra laMghA dittA tAM uha ajihI kauma de koloM dI ho ke laMghe jihar3I ApaNe butAM dI pUjA kara rahe sI| uha AkhaNa lagge ki he mUsA! sADe laI vI ika ajihA izaTa baNA dio jiveM ihanAM de izaTa hana| usa (mUsA) ne kihA ki tusIM loka tAM nire jAhala ho|
iha lokI jihar3e kaMma vica rujhe hoe hana iha sabha tAM nazaTa hoNa vAlA hai ate jo vI iha kara rahe hana uha ukkA hI g2alata hai|
mUsA ne AkhiA! kI maiM allAha nUM chaDDa ke tuhADe laI kise hora izaTa dI bhAla karAM? jadoM ki usa ne tuhAnUM sAre jahAnAM vAliAM utte vaDiAI baqhazI hai|

(he banI-isarAIla!) uha velA vI yAda karo jadoM asIM tuhAnUM firaaunIAM toM chuTakArA duAiA sI| uha tuhAnUM karar3e az2Aba diMde sI, tuhADe puttarAM nUM katala kara suTTade sI ate tuhADIAM isatarIAM (dhIAM) nUM jiuMdIAM rahaNi diMde sI, isa vica tuhADe pAlaNahAra valloM vaDDI bhArI az2amAiza sI|

asIM mUsA toM tUra pahAr3a ’te tIha rAtAM bitAuNa dA vacana liA ate magaroM dasa dina hora vadhA ditte| so uhanAM de pAlaNahAra dA (kohe-tUra ’te mUsA nUM) milaNa dA samAM pUre cAlI rAtAM dA ho giA| (jANa toM pahilAM) mUsA ne ApaNe bharA hArUna nUM kihA ki tUM mere magaroM merI kauma dI jAnazInI karIM ate ihanAM dA sudhAra karadA rahIM ate vigar3e hoe lokAM de rasate nA turIM|

jadoM mUsA sADe (allAha de) nizacita kIte hoe sameM (tUra pahAr3a) ’te pahuMciA, ate rabba ne uha de nAla vAratAlApa kItI tAM uha (mUsA) ne benatI kItI ki he mere pAlaNahAra! mainUM (ika jhalaka) vikhA ki maiM tere darazana kara sakAM| faramAiA ki tUM mainUM nahIM vekha sakadA| tUM usa pahAr3a valla vekha je uha ApaNI thAM ’te rahiMdA hai tAM tUM vI mainUM vekha sakeMgA| so jadoM uha de rabba ne pahAr3a ’te apaNA prakAzana kItA (bhAva jalavA vikhAiA) tAM usa (pahAr3a) nUM cUra cUra kara dittA ate mUsA behoza ho ke Diga piA|[6] jadoM hoza AiA tAM benatI kItI ki bezakka (he allAha!) tUM pAka hai, maiM tere haz2Ura taubA karadA hAM ate maiM sAriAM toM pahilAM ImAna liAuNa vAlA hAM|
translations.footnotes: [6] tibarI de dassaNa anusAra pahAr3a ’te allAha dA pragaTAvA bahuta hI thor3A jihA hoiA sI nabI (sa:) ne ise Aita nUM par3hiA ate faramAiA pahAr3a ’te allAha ne manukkha dI choTI uMgalI de barAbara pragaTAvA kItA sI| (tibarI 72/9 ate musanada ahimada 209/3)

translations.translation: faramAiA ki he mUsA! maiMne sAre lokAM viccoM paig2aMbarI karana laI ate vAratAlApa laI tainUM cuNiA hai| so jo (paig2aMbarI) maiM tainUM diMdA hAM, usa nUM lai ate merA zukara adA kara|

asIM mUsA nUM jIvana de hareka khetara bAre nasIhatAM ate hara cIz2a dI viAkhiA taqhatIAM ’te likha dittIAM ate kihA ki ihanAM (hidAitAM) nUM caMgI tarhAM sAMbha ate ApaNI kauma nUM hukama de ki ihanAM caMgIAM gallAM dI hI pAlaNA karana| maiM bahuta chetI hI uhanAM lokAM dA TikANA tainUM vikhAvAMgA jihar3e nA-faramAna hana|

maiM (chetI hI) ajihe lokAM nUM ApaNe hukamAM toM dUra hI rakkhAMgA jihar3e saMsAra vica takabbara (vaDiAI) karade hana jisa dA uhanAM nUM koI hakka nahIM| je uha sArIAM nizAnIAM vI vekha laiNa tAM vI uha ImAna nahIM liAuNage| je koI hidAita vAlI rAha vekha laiNa tAM usa rAha nUM nahIM apaNAuMde, hAM! je gumarAhI vAlA rAha vekha laiNa tAM usa rAha nUM apaNAuMde hana| iha sabha isa laI hai kiuM jo uhanAM ne sADIAM AitAM (AdezAM) nUM jhuThalAiA ate ihanAM toM besurata rahe|
uha lokI jinhAM ne sADIAM AitAM nUM ate kiAmata de AuNa nUM vI jhuThalAiA, uhanAM de sAre hI kaMma viaratha ho gae, uhanAM nUM uhIo badalA dittA jAvegA jo uha (saMsAra vica) karade sana|

mUsA dI kauma ne uha de (kohe-tUra ’te) jANa magaroM ApaNe gahiNiAM dA ika vacchA baNA liA jihar3A ika dhar3a sI, jisa viccoM gaU dI avAz2a nikaladI sI| kI uhanAM ne iha nahIM vekhiA ki nA tAM uha (vacchA) uhanAM nAla koI galla hI karadA hai nA hI uhanAM nUM koI rAha darasAuMdA hai? phera vI uhanAM ne usa nUM izaTa baNA liA hai ate uha bahuta z2Alama sana|

jadoM uha ApaNe kIte utte pachatAe ate patA calliA ki hakIkatana uha loka kurAhe pae gae sI tAM AkhaNa lagge ki he sADe rabba! je sADe ’te rahima nA kItA ate sADIAM g2alatIAM nUM muAfa nA kItA tAM asIM barabAda ho jAvAMge|

jadoM mUsA (kohe tUra toM) vApasa ApaNI kauma valla AiA tAM gusse te dukha bharI hAlata vica (hArUna nUM) kihA ki tUM maitho magaroM bahuta hI bhair3I jAnazInI kItI hai| tUM ApaNe rabba de hukama toM pahilAM hI mUMha mor3aNa vica chetI kItI ate (hidAita vAlIAM) taqhatIAM ika pAse suTTa dittIAM| jadoM (mUsA) ApaNe bharA (hArUna) dA sira phar3a ke ApaNe valla ghasITaNa laggiA tAM hArUna ne kihA ki he mere mAM jAi bharA! ihanAM lokAM ne mainUM kamaz2ora samajhiA, ner3e sI ki uha mainUM katala hI kara diMde, so tUM duzamanAM nUM mere ’te nA hasA ate mainUM ihanAM z2AlamAM vica zAmala nA kara|
mUsA ne kihA ki he mere rabba! merIAM te mere bharA (hArUna) dIAM g2alatIAM nUM muAfa kara ate sAnUM ApaNIAM miharAM baqhaza de, tUM sAre hI rahima karana vAliAM toM vaddha rahima karana vAlA hai|
bezakka jinhAM ne gaU dI pUjA kItI uhanAM utte chetI hI uhanAM de rabba valloM kahira AvegA ate uha isa saMsAra vica vI hINe hoNage| asIM jhUTha ghar3haNa vAliAM nUM ajihI hI saz2A diA karade hAM|
jinhAM lokAM ne gunAha kIte ate phera usa toM bAada taubA kItI ate ImAna vI liAe tAM tuhADA rabba isa taubA toM bAada sAre gunAha muAfa kara deNa vAlA hai ate miharAM karana vAlA hai|
jadoM mUsA dA roha DhaliA tAM uhanAM ne uhanAM taqhatIAM nUM cukkiA jinhAM vica uhanAM lokAM laI hidAitAM te miharAM sI jihar3e ApaNe rabba toM Darade sI|

mUsA ne sattara AdamI ApaNI kauma viccoM cuNe tAM jo sADe valloM nizacita sameM (kohe-tUra) ’te pahuMcaNa| jadoM uhanAM nUM bhucAla ne A nappiA tAM mUsA AkhaNa laggiA ki he mere mAlika! je tUM iho karanA sI tAM isa toM pahilAM hI ihanAM nUM ate mainUM halAka kara diMdA| kI tUM sADe viccoM kujjha mUrakhAM dIAM harakatAM kArana sAriAM nUM hI halAka kara deveMgA? iha tAM tere valloM ika prIkhiA sI| ajihIAM az2amAizAM duArA tUM jisa nUM vI cAheM gumarAhI vica pA deveM ate jisa nUM cAheM hidAita ’te kAima rakkheM| tUM hI tAM sADe kaMma savArana vAlA hai| so tUM sADe ’te baqhazizAM ate rahimatAM pharamA ate tUM sAriAM toM vaddha muAfIAM deNa vAlA hai|

ate tUM sADe laI isa dunIAM vica vI bhalAI likha de ate Aqhirata dI vI bhalAI likha de| bezakka asIM tere valla hI paratade hAM| allAha ne faramAiA ki maiM usa nUM ApaNA az2Aba diMdA hAM jisa ’te cAhuMdA hAM ate merI rahimata ne hareka cIz2a nUM ghere vica liA hoiA hai| maiM chetI hI isa rahimata nUM uhanAM de nAM z2arUra likha devAMgA jihar3e allAha toM Darade hana, z2akAta diMde hana ate sADIAM AitAM utte ImAna liAuMde hana|

jihar3e lokI ajihe ummI paig2aMbara (be-par3e likhe nabI) dI tAbedArI karade hana, jisa de bAre uha tauraita te iMjIla vica likhiA hoiA vekhade hAM,[7] uha (nabI) uhanAM nUM nekIAM dA hukama diMdA hai ate burAIAM toM rokadA hai, pAka cIz2AM nUM halAla (jAiz2a) karadA hai ate nA-pAka cIz2AM nUM harAma karadA hai ate uhanAM lokAM dA bhAra utAradA hai jihar3e uhanAM utte ladde hoe sana| so jihar3e loka isa nabI (muhaMmada sa.) ’te ImAna liAe, usa dA satikAra ate usa dI madada karade hana ate usa nUra (.kuraAna) dI pairavI karade hana jihar3A usa de nAla hI bhejiA giA hai, ajihe lokI hI pUrI tarhAM kAmayAba huMde hana|
translations.footnotes: [7] tauraita ate iMjIla vica uhanAM de asala zabada qhatama karana toM bAada vI muhaMmada (sa:) dI nabUvatta pratI bahuta hI sapazaTa bhavizavANIAM maujUda hana jiveM asatasanA 18:18-21, 21:21, z2abUra 118:22, 23, yasae hAM 42:1-131 habakUka 3:3:4 iMjIla matI 21:42 ate inaz2Ila yuhanAM 14:12-17-26-27, 16:7:14) dUjI thAM allAha ne faramAiA ki he ahale kitAba! ImAna liAo usa.kuraAna ’te jihar3A asIM utAriA hai ate usa kitAba dI puzaTI vI karadA hai jihar3I tuhADe kola kitAba hai isa toM pahilAM ki asIM lokAM de cihare vigAr3a ke picche kara daIe jAM iMja uhanAM ’te lAanatAM bhejIe jiddAM asIM asahAbe sabata ’te lAanata kItI sI ate cete rakkho ki allAha dA hukama lAgU ho ke rahiMdA hai| (sUrata nisA 47/4) (sUrata ala-hadIda 28/57)

translations.translation: (he muhaMmada sa:!) kahidio ki he loko! maiM tuhADe sAriAM laI paig2aMbara baNA ke usa allAha valloM bhejiA giA hAM jisadI hakUmata sAre akAzAM ate dharatI vica hai| usa toM chuTTa hora koI vI ibAdata dI yogatA nahIM rakkhadA uhI jIvana diMdA hai ate uhIo mauta diMdA hai| so allAha ’te ImAna liAo ate usa de paig2aMbara ummI nabI ’te vI ImAna liAo jo ki allAha ate usa de hukamAM utte ImAna rakkhadA hai| tusIM use (paig2aMbara) dI hI pairavI karo tAM jo tusIM hidAita pA sakoM|
mUsA dI kauma vica ika dhar3A ajihA vI sI jihar3A hakka anusAra agavAI karadA hai ate use anusAra inasAfa vI karadA hai|

asIM uhanAM (banI-isarAIla) nUM bArAM parivArAM vica vaMDa ke aDDa-aDDa garoha baNA ditte| jadoM mUsA dI kauma ne usa toM pANI maMgiA tAM asIM mUsA nUM hukama dittA ki ApaNA asA (soTI) usa patthara utte mAra, usa viccoM use vele bArAM cazame phuTa vage ate hareka ne ApaNI pANI pINa dI thAM niradhArata kara laI| asIM uhanAM utte baddalAM dI chAM kItI ate uhanAM (de khANa) laI mano-salavA dA prabaMda kItA tAM jo pAka cIz2AM khANa jihar3IAM asIM tuhAnUM dittIAM hana| isa toM magaroM (je AgiA dA pAlaNa nahIM kItA) tAM uhanAM ne sADe ’te z2ulama nahIM kItA sagoM uha tAM ApaNe Apa nAla hI z2ulama karade rahe|

ate jadoM uhanAM nUM kihA giA ki tusIM isa basatI vica jA vaso ate jo tusIM pasaMda karade ho khAo ate z2ubAna toM hitAttuna Akhade jANA (ki taubA hai) ate zahira de bUhe vica jhukade hoe dAqhala hoNA, phera asIM tuhADIAM sArIAM g2alatIAM nUM muAfa kara diAMgA ate jihar3e lokI neka kaMma karanage uhanAM nUM hora batherA kujjha devAMge|
para uhanAM z2AlamAM ne usa galla nUM hI badala dittA jihar3I uhanAM nUM AkhI gaI sI| ise kArana asIM uhanAM utte ika akAzoM az2Aba bhejiA kiuM jo uha z2ulama karade sana|

tusIM (he muhaMmada!) ihanAM (yahUdIAM) lokAM toM usa basatI (IlA) bAre puccho jihar3I dariA de kaMDe AbAda sI jadoM ki uha sabbata (sanicaravAra) vAle dina haddoM Tappa jAMde sI| sabata vAle dina tAM macchIAM uhanAM nUM vikhAI diMdIAM sana jadoM sabata vAlA dina nA huMdA tAM uhanAM de sAhamaNe nA AuMdIAM| asIM uhanAM dI isa prakAra parakha karade sI kiuM jo uha kahiNA nahIM sI maMnade|

jadoM uhanAM (mUsA) dI ika (neka) jamAata ne kihA ki tusIM ajihe lokAM nUM kiuM nasIhatAM karade ho jinhAM nUM allAha ukkA hI halAka karanA cAhuMdA hai jAM uhanAM nUM karar3I saz2A deNa vAlA hai? uhanAM (mUsA) ne javAba dittA, isa laI (hidAita karadAM hAM) ki tuhADe rabba de haz2Ura uz2ara (hujjata) peza kara sakAM ate iha vI ho sakadA hai ki uha Dara jANa|

so jadoM uha sabha (nasIhatAM) bhulla gae jihar3IAM uhanAM nUM samajhAIAM jAMdIAM sI phera asIM uhanAM nUM (az2Aba toM) bacA liA jihar3e bhair3IAM gallAM toM rokiA karade sI para uha lokI, jihar3e z2ulama karade sI, uhanAM nUM ika karar3e az2Aba vica phar3a liA, isa laI ki uha nA-faramAnIAM kariA karade sI|
jadoM jisa kaMma toM uhanAM nUM rokiA sI, usa vica haddoM Tappa gae tAM asIM uhanAM nUM Akha dittA ki tusIM z2alIla bAMdara baNa jAo|[8]
translations.footnotes: [8] isa toM patA laggadA hai ki allAha dI nA-faramAnI dunIAM te Aqhirata doveM thAM z2alIla ate rusavAI dA kArana baNadI hai ate allAha dI nA-faramAnI toM bacaNa vAle nUM jaMnata dI z2amAnata dittI gaI hai jiveM sahala bina sAada ra:a: toM patA laggadA hai ki rasUla (sa:) ne faramAiA jihar3A viakatI mainUM isa dI rAkhI karana dI z2amAnata de deve jihar3I jabAr3hiAM de vicakAra hai bhAva (mUMha te z2ubAna) ate usa dI jihar3I cIz2a do lattA de vicakAra hai (bhAva gupata aMga) tAM maiM usa nUM jaMnata dI z2amAnata diMdA hAM (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 6474) bhAva jihar3A koI cug2alI, jhUTha ate ghaTIAM gallAM toM ApaNI z2ubAna nUM ate harAma cIz2AM de khANa pINa toM ApaNe mUMha nUM ate z2anA, badakArI de gunAhAM toM ApaNe Apa nUM bacA ke rakhegA tAM uha jaMnatI hai|

translations.translation: (he nabI! uha velA vI yAda rakkhaNA cAhIdA hai) jadoM tuhADe rabba ne iha citAvanI dittI sI ki uha ihanAM (yahUdIAM) utte kiAmata taka ika ajihA viakatI z2arUra hI thopadA rahegA, jihar3A uhanAM nUM saqhata takalIfAM diMdA rahegA| bezakka tuhADA rabba chetI hI saz2A deNa vAlA hai| uha bahuta vaDDA baqhazaNahAra ate rahimatAM vAlA hai|

asIM saMsAra vica uhanAM nUM vakkha-vakkha dhar3hiAM vica vaMDa dittA| kujjha uhanAM viccoM neka sI ate kujjha usa de ulaTa (bhair3e) sI| asIM uhanAM nUM caMge mAr3e hAlatAM duArAM parakhade rahe ki ho sakadA hai ki uha (ApaNIAM harakatAM toM) bAz2a A jANa|

phera uhanAM toM bAada ayoga loka uhanAM de jAnazIna hoe jihar3e kitAba (tauraita) de vArasa baNe uha dunIAM de tuccha lAbha saiMtade hana ate Akhade hana ki sADI baqhaziza z2arUra hovegI| jada ki uhanAM dA hAla iha hai ki je uhIo saMsArika samaggarI uhanAM kola mur3a AjAve tAM usa nUM vI lai laiNage| kI uhanAM toM isa kitAba tauraita vica pratiggiA nahIM laI gaI sI ki uha allAha bAre chuTTa hakka bAta toM hora koI galla nahIM jor3aNage jada ki uhanAM ne isa kitAba vica jo vI sI usa nUM par3ha liA hai| Aqhirata vAlA ghara uhanAM lokAM laI vadhIA hai jihar3e rabba dA Dara rakkhade hana| kI tusIM kujjha vI nahIM samajhade?
jihar3e lokI kitAba (de hukamAM) dI pAbaMdI karade hana ate namAz2a nUM kAima karade hana asIM (allAha) ajihe neka lokAM dA badalA ajAIM nahIM karade|

uha samAM vI z2ikara yoga hai jadoM asAM (uhanAM de sirAM utte) pahAr3a nUM iMja khar3A kara dittA sI jiveM uha ika chatara hoe ate uha samajhade sI ki iha pahAr3a uhanAM utte DigiA hI DigiA hai ate asIM kihA sI ki jihar3I kitAba (tauraita) asIM tuhAnUM dittI hai usa nUM drir3atA nAla phar3o ate jihar3e isa vica Adeza hana uhanAM dI pAlaNA karo, Asa hai ki tusIM rabba toM Darana vAle baNa jAoge|

jadoM tuhADe rabba ne Adama de puttarAM dIAM piTThAM viccoM usa dI aulAda nUM kaDDhiA sI ate uhanAM nUM uhanAM dIAM jAnAM utte gavAha baNAiA sI, kI maiM tuhADA rabba nahIM hAM? sabha ne uttara dittA sI ki kiuM nahIM! asIM sAre isa galla dI puzaTI karade hAM (iha isa laI pucchiA sI) tAM jo kiAmata dihAr3e tusIM iha nA kahisako ki sAnUM tAM patA hI nahIM sI|
jAM tusIM iha kaho ki sAthoM pahilAM ziraka sADe baz2uragAM ne kItA sI ate asIM tAM uhanAM dI nasala viccoM hAM| kI tUM sAnUM uhanAM kurAhe pae lokAM de amalAM kArana halAka karadA hai?
asIM ise prakAra sAfa-sAfa AitAM biAna karade hAM tAM jo uha (ApaNIAM harakatAM toM) bAz2a A jANa|

(he nabI!) ihanAM lokAM nUM usa viakatI dA vI hAla suNAo jisa nUM asIM AitAM dA giAna dittA sI para uha uhanAM dI pAbaMdI toM nassa giA, sagoM zaitAna de picche lagga giA| so uha kurAhe pae lokAM viccoM ho giA|

je asIM cAhuMde tAM ihanAM AitAM duArA hI usa dA darajA bulaMda kara diMde para uha dunIAM valla hI jhuka giA ate ApaNI mana dIAM icchAvAM dI pairavI karana lagga piA| so usa dI hAlata kutte vAMga ho gaI ki je tusIM usa ’te hamalA karo tAM vI happha jAMdA hai te je usa nUM chaDDa dio tAM vI happhaNa laggadA hai| iho hAlata uhanAM lokAM dI hai jinhAM ne sADIAM AitAM dA inakAra kItA, so tusIM (he nabI!) uhanAM (yahUdIAM) nUM iha kissA biAna karo, ho sakadA hai uha kujjha socaNa|
uhanAM dI vI hAlata burI hai jihar3e sADIAM AitAM nUM jhuThalAuMde hana ate iMja uha ApaNA hI nukasAna karade hana|
jisa nUM allAha hidAita diMdA hai hidAita use nUM hI miladI hai ate jisa nUM uha gumarAha kara deve uhIo ghATe vica rahiNa vAlA hai|

asIM kiMne hI jiMna te manukkha naraka laI paidA kIte hana, uhanAM dIAM akalAM tAM hana para uhanAM toM hakka nUM samajhade nahIM ate uhanAM dIAM akkhAM tAM hana jinhAM toM vekhade nahIM ate uhanAM de kaMna tAM hana jinhAM toM suNade nahIM| iha lokI jAnavarAM vAMga hana sagoM uhanAM toM vI vaddha gumarAha hana, iho lokI besurata hana|

sAre hI sohaNe nAM allAha de laI hana so tusIM usa nUM[9] ihanAM nAvAM nAla hI saddo| ajihe lokAM nAla saMbaMdha vI nA rakkhe jihar3e usa de nAvAM vica viMga-valla pAuMde hana| ihanAM lokAM nUM ihanAM de kIte dI saz2A chetI hI milegI|
translations.footnotes: [9] allAha de ninAnaveM nAM hana| haz2arata abU-hurairA dassade hana ki allAha de rasUla (sa:) ne faramAiA allAha de ninAnaveM nAM hana jihar3A vI ihanAM nUM yAda kara lavegA, jaMnata vica jAvegA ate allAha vitara (TAka) hai ate vitara nUM pasaMda karadA hai| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 6410)

translations.translation: sADI maqhalUka vica ika garoha ajahiA vI hai jahir3A hakka anusAra rAha darasAuMdA hai ate use anusAra faisale karadA hai|
jihar3e loka sADIAM AitAM nUM jhuThalAuMde hana asIM z2arUra hI uhanAM nUM haulI-haulI ApaNI pakar3a vica iMja laI jAMde hana ki uhanAM nUM patA vI nA cale|
ate maiM ihanAM (inakArIAM) nUM mohalata diMdA hAM, bezakka merI tadabIra bahuta hI maz2abUta huMdI hai|

kI uhanAM (makke de) lokAM ne isa galla ’te ukkA hI vicAra nahIM kItA ki uhanAM de sAthI (muhaMmada sa:) nUM ratA vI pAgalapaNa nahIM, uha tAM kevala (allAha de az2Aba toM) sAfa-sAfa DarAuNa vAlA hai|

kI uhanAM ne akAza te dharatI dI pAtazAhI ate dUjIAM cIz2AM nUM jihar3IAM allAha ne paidA kItIAM hana, nahIM vekhiA ate isa galla laI vicAra nahIM kItA ki ho sakadA hai ki uhanAM dI mauta ner3e hI A laggI hove? phera isa.kuraAna toM bAada kihar3I galla utte iha loka ImAna liAuMge?
jisa nUM allAha kurAhe pA deve usa nUM koI rAha ’te nahIM pA sakadA ate allAha uhanAM nUM uhanAM dI gumarAhI vica hI bhaTakadA hoiA chaDDa diMdA hai|

(he nabI sa.!) iha (kAfira) loka tuhAthoM kiAmata de bAre pucchade hana ki iha kadoM hovegI? tusIM Akha dio ki isa dA giAna tAM kevala mere rabba de kola hI hai| isa de sameM ’te isa nUM sivAe allAha toM hora koI z2Ahira nahIM karegA, uha (samAM) akAzAM te dharatI vica bahuta vaDDI (ghaTanA) hovegI| uha tuhADe ’te acAnaka hI A jAvegI| uha (kAfira) (he nabI!) tuhAthoM isa tarhAM pucchade hana jiveM tusIM isa dI jANakArI lai cukke ho| tusIM Akha dio ki isa dA giAna tAM allAha de kola hI hai para bathere lokI nahIM jANade|

(he nabI!) tusIM kahi dio ki maiM Apa vI ApaNI z2Ata laI kise lAbha jAM hAnI dA adhikAra nahIM rakkhadA, para hAM! unnAM hI (adhikAra) rakkhadA hAM jiMnAM allAha deNA cAhe| jekara maiM g2aiba dIAM gallAM jANadA huMdA tAM maiM kiMne hI lAbha prApata kara laiMdA ate nA hI mainUM kade koI nukasAna huMdA| maiM tAM kevala (naraka dI agga toM) DarAuNa vAlA ate (jaMnata dIAM) qhuzaqhabarIAM suNAuNa vAlA hAM (uha vI uhanAM nUM) jihar3e ImAna rakkhade hana|

uha allAha hI tAM hai ki jisa ne tuhAnUM (sAre lokAM nUM) ika jAna toM paidA kItA ate phera use (ika toM hI) usa dA jor3A baNAiA tAM jo uha ApaNe jor3e (patanI) toM zAMtI lai sake| phera jadoM patI ne patanI nAla (sarIrika) ner3atA kItI tAM usa (patanI) nUM holA jihA (garabha) Thahira giA usa hamala nUM lai ke uha turadI phiradI rahI, jadoM uha garabha nAla bhArI ho gaI tAM doveM patI patanI (ApaNe rabba toM) duA karana lagge ki (he allAha!) je taine sAnUM savasatha aulAda dittI tAM asIM tere dhaMnavAdI hovAge|
jadoM uhanAM nUM sahI salAmata aulAda baqhaza dittI tAM uha doveM (isa bacce dI dAta vica) horAM nUM zarIka karana lagga pae jadoM ki allAha uhanAM de ziraka toM bahuta uccA hai|
kI uha ajihAM nUM (allAha dA) zarIka jApade hana jihar3e kise vI cIz2a nUM paidA nahIM kara sakade? sagoM uha vI paidA kIte gae hana|
uha (jhUThe izaTa) uhanAM dI kise tarhAM dI vI madada nahIM kara sakade, uha tAM ApaNI vI madada nahIM kara sakade|
je tusIM uhanAM nUM hidAita valla saddo tAM tuhADe kahiNa ’te nahIM callaNage| bhAveM tusIM uhanAM nUM pukAro jAM cuppa raho, tuhADe laI doveM barAbara hana|

he muzariko! tusIM allAha nUM chaDDa ke jinhAM dI vI ibAdata karade ho uha vI tuhADe vAMga baMde hI hana| jadoM tusIM uhanAM nUM pukArade ho, uhanAM nUM cAhIdA hai ki tuhADI pukAra dA javAba deNa, je tusIM sacce ho|

kI uhanAM de paira hana jinhAM toM uha calade hana, kI uhanAM de hattha hana jinhAM toM uha kise cIz2a nUM phar3ade hana jAM uhanAM dIAM akkhAM hana jinhAM toM uha vekhade hana jAM uhanAM de kaMna hana jinhAM toM uha suNade hana| tusIM (he nabI!) ihanAM nUM Akho ki tusIM sAre ApaNe thApe hoe zarIkAM nUM (madada laI) bulA lavo phera mere viruddha dAo kheDo, mainUM kujjha vI Dhillha nA dio| (phera vekhoM ki uha merA kI vigAr3ade hana)
bezakka merA madadagAra allAha hai jisa ne iha kitAba (.kuraAna) nAz2ila kItI hai uhIo neka baMdiAM dI madada karadA hai|
tusIM jinhAM lokAM dI ibAdata allAha nUM chaDDa ke karade ho uha tuhADI kujjha vI madada nahIM kara sakade nA hI uha ApaNI madada kara sakade hana|
je tusIM uhanAM nUM hidAita valla pukAro tAM suNa nahIM sakade (he nabI!) tusIM uhanAM nUM iMja vekhade ho jiveM uha tuhAnUM vekha rahe hana jada ki uha kujjha vI nahIM vekhade|
(he nabI!) tusIM (ihanAM makke vAliAM nAla) naramI te khimA dI nItI ApaNAo, caMge kaMmAM dI sikkhiA dio ate jAhalAM toM dUra raho|
je tuhAnUM koI vicAra zaitAna valloM Ave tAM allAha toM zarana maMgo, bezakka uhIo bhalI-bhAMta suNana vAlA ate jANana vAlA hai|
jihar3e lokI rabba toM Darana vAle hana jadoM vI uhanAM nUM zaitAna valloM koI bhair3A vicAra AuMdA hai tAM uha jhaTTa cukkaMne ho jAMde hana tAM uhanAM dI akkhAM khulha jAMdIAM hana|
uhanAM (muzarikAM) dA bharA zaitAna uhanAM nUM kurAhe valla dhUhIM laI jAMdA hai ate isa vica koI kasara nahIM chaDDadA|

jadoM tusIM (he nabI!) ihanAM de sAhamaNe koI muajaz2A (nizAnI jAM camatakAra) peza nahIM karade tAM Akhade hana ki tusIM ApaNe laI muajaz2A kiuM nahIM liAe?[10] tusIM Akha dafo ki maiM tAM kevala use vahI dI pairavI karadA hAM jihar3I mere rabba ne mere valla bhejI hai| iha (.kuraAna) bahuta vaDDI dalIla hai tuhADe rabba valloM, ate rahimata hai uhanAM lokAM laI jihar3e ImAna rakkhade hana|
translations.footnotes: [10] ika vAra nabI (sa:) ne makke vAliAM nUM uhanAM de maMga karana ’te ika ahima muajaz2A vikhAiA| anasa bina mAlika toM patA laggadA hai nabI (sa:) ne makke vAliAM ne kise nizAnI dI maMga kItI tAM Apa ne uhanAM nUM caMna de ToTe huMde vikhAiA (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 3637) paraMtU isa dA koI vI lAbha nA hoiA ise laI allAha kAfirAM dI maMga karana ’te muajaz2e nahIM vikhAuMdA sagoM usa sameM muajaz2e pragaTa karadA hai jadoM allAha cAhuMdA hai|

translations.translation: (he momino!) jadoM.kuraAna par3hiA jAve tAM usa nUM kaMna lA ke (dhiAna nAla) suNo ate cuppa raho| Asa hai ki tuhADe ’te rahimatAM hoNagIAM|
he nabI! ApaNe pAlaNahAra nUM ApaNe dila vica nimaratA sahita, Darade hoe, haulI haulI savere zAma yAda karo[11] ate g2afalata vaci (beparavAha) pae lokAM vaci nA ho jANA|
translations.footnotes: [11] kiuM jo allAha nUM cete rakkhaNa nAla hI mana nUM zAMtI miladI hai|

translations.translation: jihar3e farizate tuhADe rabba de naz2adIka hana uha usa dI ibAdata toM takabbara (ghamaMDa) nahIM karade ate usa dI pAkI biAna karade hana ate use nUM sijadA karade hana|

(he nabI!) iha loka tuhAthoM mAle-g2anImata (jaMga vica prApata hoNa vAle dhana-padArathAM) de saMbaMdha vica pucchade hana| tusIM Akha dio ki iha mAle-g2anImata allAha ate usa de rasUla (muhaMmada sa:) dA hai| so tusIM allAha toM Daro ate Apo vicAle saMbaMdhAM nUM sudhAro| allAha ate usa de rasUla dI AgiA dA pAlaNa karo je tusIM (sacce) ImAna vAle ho|

(sacce) ImAna vAle tAM uha loka hana ki jadoM uha allAha dA z2ikara suNade hana tAM uhanAM de dila kaMba jAMde hana ate jadoM uhanAM nUM allAha dIAM AitAM suNAIAM jAMdIAM hana tAM uha AitAM uhanAM de ImAna vica hora vAdhA kara diMdIAM hana| uhanAM dA bharosA ApaNe pAlaNahAra ’te hI hai|
jihar3e loka namAz2AM dI pAbaMdI karade hana ate jo vI riz2aka (dhana-padAratha) asIM uhanAM nUM de chaDDiA hai usa viccoM (allAha de rAha vica) qharaca karade hana|
ajihe loka hI sacce ImAna vAle hana| uhanAM laI uhanAM de rabba de kola vaDDe ucce daraje hana ate (bhullAM dI) muAfI te iz2z2ata vAlI roz2I hai|

(he nabI! yAda karo jadoM badara dI jaMga sameM) tuhADe rabba ne tuhAnUM hakka sacca nAla gharoM (madIne toM) toriA sI| bezakka usa sameM musalamAnAM dI hI ika TolI isa nikalaNa nUM pasaMda nahIM sI karadI|

uha usa hakka de mAmale ’ca isa de sapazaTa hoNa toM bAada vI tuhADe nAla jhagar3a rahe sana| uha iMja samajhade sana ki jiveM uhanhAM nUM mauta valla dhakkiA jA rihA hove ate uha (mauta nUM) vekha rahe hoNa|

(he ImAna vAlio! yAda karo) jadoM allAha tuhADe nAla (kAfirAM dIAM) dovAM TolIAM viccoM ika de milaNa dA vAadA kara rihA sI ki iha bezaka tuhADe laI hai, para tusIM iha cAhuMde sI ki binAM hathiAroM TolI (tajAratI kAfalA) hI tuhADe hattha Ave jada ki allAha iha cAhuMdA sI ki uha ApaNe faramAnAM duArA hakka nUM sacca siddha kara vikhAve ate kAfirAM dI jar3ha vaDDa suTTe|
tAM jo hakka hakka hoke rahe ate kUr3a kUr3a hoke rahe, bhAveM aparAdhI isa nUM kiMnA hI nApasaMda karade hoNa|

(he momino! usa sameM nUM yAda karo) jadoM tusIM ApaNe rabba toM benatIAM kara rahe sI, phera allAha ne tuhADI (benatI) suNa laI (ate kihA ki) bezakka maiM uppara-thalle AuNa vAle ika haz2Ara farizatiAM nAla tuhADI sahAitA karAMgA|
isa (sUcanA) nUM allAha ne qhuzaqhabarI baNA dittA tAM jo isa nAla tuhADe dila saMtuzaTa ho jANa| madada tAM allAha valloM hI huMdI hai, nirasaMdeha, allAha vaDDA z2orAvara te siANA hai|

ratA usa vele nUM vI yAda karo jadoM usa (allAha) ne ApaNe valloM tuhAnUM amana zAMtI deNa laI tuhADe ’te uMgha utArI ate tuhADe ’te akAza toM pANI (mIMha) barasAiA, tAM jo isa pANI (mIMha) rAhIM tuhAnUM pavittara kara deve ate zaitAna dI pAI hoI (bhair3e vicArAM dI) gaMdagI toM tuhAnUM chuTakArA deve ate tuhADe dilAM nUM maz2abUta kare (bhAva himmata hausalA deve) ate tAM jo tuhADe paira jamA deve|

(he nabI! usa sameM nUM yAda karo) jadoM tuhADA rabba farizatiAM valla vahI ghalla rihA sI ki bezakka maiM tuhADe aMga-saMga hAM, tusIM ImAna vAliAM nUM pakke pairIM rakkho, maiM chetI hI ihanAM kAfirAM de dilAM vica tuhADA roaba pA devAMgA, so tusIM uhanAM dIAM dhoNAM ’te vAra karo ate ate uhanAM de jor3a-jor3a ’te saTTa mAro|
iha (saz2A) isa laI hai ki uhanAM (kAfirAM) ne allAha ate usa de rasUla dA virodha kItA sI, jihar3A koI allAha ate usa de rasUla dA virodhI hovegA, usa nUM allAha karar3I saz2A deNa vAlA hai|
so (he kAfiro!) tusIM isa (saz2A) dA suAda vekho| (cete rakkho ki) kAfirAM laI naraka de az2Aba dA prabaMdha kItA hoiA hai|
he ImAna vAlio! jadoM tuhADA TAkarA kAfirAM dI sainA nAla ho jAve tAM tusIM uhanAM toM piTTha nA vikhAo|

jihar3A viakatI uhanAM (kAfirAM) nUM usa sameM piTTha vikhAke nassegA, chuTTa usa toM ki jaMgI cAla vajoM ajihA kare jAM ApaNI kise TolI valla bacAo laI Ave, tAM uha allAha de karodha vica phassa jAvegA| usa dA TikANA naraka hovegA ate uha bahuta hI bhair3I parataNa vAlI thAM hai|

(he momino!) tusIM uhanAM kAfirAM) nUM katala nahIM kItA, sagoM uhanAM nUM allAha ne hI katala kItA hai| (he nabI!) jihar3I (miTTI dI muTThI) uhanAM (kAfirAM) ’te suTTI sI, uha tusIM nahIM suTTI sI sagoM allAha ne hI suTTI sI, tAM jo uha ApaNe valloM musalamAnAM nUM vadhIA inAma (jitta) nAla nivAz2e| bezakka allAha suNana vAlA ate bhalI-bhAMta jANana vAlA hai|
(dUjI galla iha vI hai) ki allAha hI kAfirAM dIAM cAlAM nUM kamaz2ora karana vAlA hai|

(kAfirAM nUM Akha dio) jo tusIM faisalA cAhuMde sI tAM uha faisalA tuhADe sAhamaNe (tuhADI hAra de rUpa vica) A giA hai| je tusIM huNa vI (ApaNIAM harakatAM toM) bAz2a A jAo tAM iha tuhADe laI vadhIA galla hai| je tusIM phera mur3a (pahilAM vAMga) hI karoge tAM asIM vI tuhAnUM use tarhAM (daMDita) karAMgA| ate tuhADI jatthebaMdI, bhAveM uha kiMnI hI vaDDI kiuM nA hove, tuhADe kujjha vI kaMma nahIM AvegI bezakka allAha ImAna vAliAM dA sAthI hai|
he ImAna vAlio! allAha dA ate usa de rasUla dA kahiNA maMno ate usa toM mUMha nA mor3o, jadoM ki tusIM (hukamAM nUM) suNa rahe ho|
ate tusIM uhanAM lokAM vAMga nA ho jANA jihar3e kahiMde tAM iha hana ki asIM suNa liA, para uha suNade kujjha vI nahIM sI|

bezakka allAha dIAM naz2arAM vica dharatI utte callaNa-phirana vAliAM viccoM sabha toM vaddha bhair3e uha loka hana jihar3e (kaMna te z2ubAna rakkhade hoe vI) bole te gUMge hana, jihar3e kujjha vI nahIM samajhade|
je allAha uhanAM vica kujjha vI bhalAI vekhadA hai tAM uhanAM nUM z2arUra hI suNana dA bala bakkhaza diMdA| je uha uhanAM nUM suNana dA bala de vI diMdA tAM vI uha mUMha mor3a ke bhajja jAMde|

he ImAna vAlio! tusIM allAha ate usa de rasUla de AgiAkArI baNo[1] jadoM ki uha (rasUla) tuhAnUM usa (hukama) valla bulAuMdA hai jihar3A tuhAnUM (rUhAnI) jIvana baqhazadA hai ate tusIM iha vI jANa lavo ki bezakka allAha baMde te usa de mana vicakAra ika oTa baNa jAMdA hai ate iha vI ki tusIM sAriAM ne allAha de kola hI ikaTThA hoNA hai|
translations.footnotes: [1] isa Aita vica allAha ate usa de rasUla (sa:) de hukamAM dI pairavI karana de lAbha dasse gae hana bhAva jihar3A saccA musalamAna huMdA hai usa nUM hamezagI vAlA jIvana nasIba huMdA hai ate saccA momina uha hai jo allAha ate rasUla (sa:) dA AgiAkArI huMdA hai ate sAre kaMma.kuraAna te sunatta de anusAra hI karadA hai| jihar3A allAha dI rAha vica jihAda laI nikaladA hai je uha zahIda ho jAve tAM usa nUM mauta nahIM sagoM jaMnata vica sadIvI jIvana hai isa de ulaTa binAM ImAna toM ika viakatI murade vAMga huMdA hai ate naraka vica sadA laI rahegA|

translations.translation: ate tusIM fitane (bipatA) toM baco jihar3A tuhADe viccoM kevala uhanAM lokAM nUM hI nahIM gheregA sagoM isa de ghere vica sAre vI phasa sakade hana ate iha vI yAda rakkho ki allAha karar3I saz2A deNa vAlA hai|

usa vele nUM yAda karo jadoM tusIM dharatI utte thor3hI giNatI vica sI ate tuhAnUM nirabala samajhiA jAMdA sI| tuhAnUM ise galla dI ciMtA laggI rahiMdI sI ki lokI tuhAnUM kIte miTA hI nA deNa| so allAha ne tuhAnUM rahiNa laI ThikANA dittA ate ApaNI sahAitA nAla tuhADe hattha takar3e kIte ate tuhAnUM pAkIz2A cIz2AM dittIAM tAM jo tusIM usa de dhaMnavAdI baNo|
he ImAna vAlio! tusIM allAha ate usa de rasUla nAla qhiAnata (dhokhA) nA karo[2] ate nA hI tusIM ApaNIAM amAnatAM vica qhiAnatAM karo, jada ki tusIM jANade ho|
translations.footnotes: [2] vekho sUrata Ale-imarAna, hAzIA Aita 164/3|

translations.translation: ate tusIM iha galla vI yAda rakkho ki bezaka tuhADe dhana padAratha te tuhADIAM aulAdAM asala vica tuhADe laI phitanA (az2amAiza) hana ate (iha vI yAda rakkho) ki allAha kola deNa laI bahuta hI vadhIA badalA hai|

he ImAna vAlio! je tusIM allAha toM Darade rahoge tAM uha tuhADe laI hakka sacca nUM parakhaNa laI ika kasauTI upalabadha kara devegA ate tuhADIAM burAIAM tuhAthoM dUra kara devegA ate tuhAnUM baqhaza devegA, allAha vaDDe faz2alAM vAlA hai|

(he nabI!) yAda karo jadoM kAfira loka Apa jI bAre soca rahe sI ki uha tuhAnUM baMdI baNA laiNa jAM katala kara deNa jAM Apa jI nUM (makke toM) deza nikAlA deNa| uha (kAfira) ApaNIAM cAlAM calla rahe sI ate allAha ApaNIAM cAlAM calla rihA sI ate sabha toM vadhIA cAlAM callaNa vAlA tAM allAha hI hai|

jadoM uhanAM (kAfirAM) de sAhamaNe sADIAM AitAM par3hIAM jAMdIAM hana tAM uha Akhade hana ki asIM suNa liA je asIM cAhIe tAM isa tarhAM dA kalAma asIM vI kahi sakade hAM, iha tAM bIta cukke lokAM de kisse hana|

jadoM uhanAM (kAfirAM) ne kihA ki he allAha! je iha.kuraAna asaloM tere valloM hI hai (tAM isa dI nikhedI karana ’te) jAM tAM sADe ’te akAza toM patthara varasA de jAM sADe ’te koI dukha bhariA az2Aba lai A|

(he nabI!) allAha ajihA nahIM ki ihanAM nUM az2Aba deve, jada ki tusIM ihanAM vica maujUda hana ate je uha ApaNIAM bhullAM dI khimAM laI benatIAM karade hana tAM vI allAha uhanAM nUM az2Aba nahIM devegA|

para huNa uha kihar3I ajihI galla hai ki allAha uhanAM nUM saz2A nA deve jada ki uha lokAM nUM masajide-harAma (qhAnA-kAabA) toM rokade hana jada ki uha isa de matavallI (prabaMdhaka) vI nahIM| isa de matavallI tAM neka parahez2agAra loka hI hana| para ihanAM viccoM bahute loka tAM isa galla dI hakIkata nUM nahIM jANade|
qhAnA-kAabA de kola ihanAM (muzarikAM) dI namAz2a sITIAM te tAlIAM bajAuNa toM chuTTa hora kujjha vI nahIM sI| so huNa (he kAfiro!) tusIM az2Aba dA suAda lavo, usa kufara kArana jo tusIM karade sI|

bezakka iha kAfira loka ApaNA mAla isa laI qharaca kara rahe hana tAM jo lokAM nUM allAha dI rAha toM rokiA jAve| hAlAM iha ApaNA mAla (iMja hI) hora qharaca karanage, phera uha (qharaciA hoiA) mAla ihanAM de pachatAve dA kArana ho jAvegA| phera iha adhIna ho jANage ate jinhAM lokAM ne kufara kItA hai (kiAmata dihAr3e) naraka valla jamAM karake liAiA jAvegA|

(iha isa laI hovegA) tAM jo allAha apavittara (kAfira) lokAM nUM pavittara (ImAna vAle) lokAM toM vakharA kara deve| ate nA-pAka (lokAM) nUM ika dUje de uppara thalle rakkha ke sabha nUM ika thAM ikaTThA karake uhanAM sabha nUM naraka vica suTTa deve| ajihe loka hI ghATe vica rahiNa vAle hana|

(he muhaMmada sa:!) tusIM ihanAM kAfirAM nUM dassa dio ki je iha loka (ApaNIAM harakatAM toM) bAz2a A jANa tAM ihanAM de uha sAre hI gunAha, jihar3e ho cukke hana, sabha muAfa kara ditte jANage| je mur3a uhIo karanage tAM pahilIAM kaumAM nAla jo ho cukkiA hai ihanAM nAla vI uhIo hovegA|

(he momino!) tusIM kAfirAM nAla itthoM taka lar3o ki fitanA (ziraka) bAkI nA rahe ate (hara thAM) dIna saMpUrana rUpa vica allAha dA hI ho jAve| phera je iha (kAfira) bAz2a A jANa tAM bezakka allAha uhanAM de karamAM nUM caMgI tarhAM vekha rihA hai|
je uha mUMha mor3anage tAM visavAza rakkho ki allAha tuhADe sAre kaMma savArana vAlA hai ate uha bahuta hI vadhIA kaMma savArana vAlA te sahAI hai|[3]
translations.footnotes: [3] dIna allAha laI hoNa toM kaI vidavAnA anusAra iha usa sameM hovegA jadoM haz2arata IsA dharatI ’te uttaraNage tAM usa sameM uha isalAma toM chuTTa kise dharama nUM savIkAra nahIM karanage|

translations.translation: (he musalamAno!) tuhAnUM patA hoNA cAhuMdA hai ki tusIM jo vI mAle-g2anImata (jaMga viccoM vairIAM dA mAla) prApata karoge usa viccoM paMjavAM hissA allAha dA ate usa de rasUla dA ate (uha de) rizatedArAM, yatImAM, masakInAM ate musAfarAM dA hai| je tusIM allAha ’te usa cIz2a (rabbI madada) utte ImAna liAe ho jihar3I madada asAM faisale (bhAva badara dI jaMga) vAle dina utArI sI, jadoM doveM faujAM bhir3a rahIAM sana (tAM tusIM isa vaMDa nUM vI maMno) allAha hara cIz2a dI kudarata rakkhadA hai|

usa vele nUM yAda karo jadoM tusIM (musalamAna) ghATI (badara de maidAna) de urale pAse sI ate uha (kAfira) ghATI de parale pAse sI ate (kuraiza dA tajAratI) kAfalA tuhADe heTha (bahare-kulaz2uma de taTa valla) sI| je tusIM doveM dhirAM pahilAM toM hI Apasa vica lar3aNa dA irAdA karade tAM lAz2amana hI usa sameM tuhADe vicakAra matabheda ho jAMde, para doveM musalamAna te kAfirAM de Tole AhamaNe sAhamaNe A gae tAM jo allAha usa kaMma nUM pUrA kara deve jihar3A hoNa vAlA sI| ki jihar3A (jaMga vica) mare uha vI dalIla nAla hI mare ate jiUMdA rahe uha vI dalIla nAla hI jiUMdA rahe| bezakka allAha sabha kujjha suNana vAlA ate jANana vAlA hai|

(he nabI!) uha velA vI yAda karo jadoM allAha ne tuhAnUM supane vica uhanAM (kAfirAM) dI giNatI ghaTTa karake vikhAI sI, je uha uhanAM dI giNatI vaddha vikhA diMdA tAM tusIM z2arUra hI himmata hAra jAMde ate isa (jaMga) de mAmale vica matabheda karana lagga jAMde (ki lar3Ie jAM nA) para allAha ne tuhAnUM isa toM bacA liA| bezakka uha dilAM dIAM gallAM toM jANU hai|

(he musalamAno! yAda karo) jadoM usa (allAha) ne TAkare de sameM uhanAM (kAfirAM) nUM tuhADIAM naz2arAM vica bahuta hI ghaTTa giNatI vica vikhAiA sI ate tuhAnUM uhanAM (kAfirAM) dIAM naz2arAM vica ghaTTa karake vikhAiA tAM jo usa (allAha) ne jihar3A kaMma karanA hai usa nUM aMta taka pahuMcA deve ate allAha valla hI sAre kaMma paratAe jAMde hana|
he ImAna vAlio! jadoM tuhADA TAkarA kise virodhI dhira nAla ho jAve tAM DaTe raho ate allAha nUM vaddha toM vaddha yAda karo tAM jo tuhAnUM safalatA prApata ho sako|

(he momino!) allAha ate usa de rasUla dI AgiA dI pAlaNA karade raho| Apo vicAle jhagar3A nA karo, nahIM tAM tusIM kamaz2ora ho jAvoge ate tuhADI havA ukkhar3a jAvegI so tusIM dhIraja toM kaMma lavo| allAha dhIraja nAla kaMma karana vAliAM dA hI sAthI hai|

tusIM uhanAM lokAM vAMga nA ho jANA jihar3e ghamaMDa karade hoe ate lokAM nUM ApaNI vaDiAI vikhAuMde hoe gharAM toM (lar3AI laI) nikale (lokAM nUM) allAha de rasate callaNa toM rokade sana, jo kujjha uha kara rahe hana allAha ne uha sabha (giAna de) ghere vica liA hoiA hai|

yAda karo, jadoM zaitAna uhanAM (kAfirAM) dIAM karatUtAM nUM sohaNIAM karake vikhA rihA sI ate kahi rihA sI ki ajja tuhADe ’te koI vI jitta prApata nahIM kara sakadA, maiM Apa tuhADA himAitI hAM, para jadoM doveM faujAM dA sAhamaNA hoiA tAM uha (zaitAna) pichale pairIM mur3a giA ate AkhaNa laggiA ki merA te tuhADA koI sAtha nahIM| bezakka maiM uha (farizate) vekha rihA hAM jo tusIM nahIM vekha rahe| maiM allAha toM DaradA hAM allAha saqhata az2Aba deNa vAlA hai|

jada ki munAfika ate uha loka, jinhAM de dilAM vica (ghamaMDa dA) roga sI, iha kahi rahe sana ki ihanAM (musalamAnAM) nUM tAM ihanAM de dIna (isalAma) ne dhokhe vica pA rakkhiA hai ate jihar3A vI koI allAha utte bharosAM karegA (uhIo safala hovegA)| bezakka z2orAvara te hikamatAM vAlA (allAha) hai|

(he nabI!) kAza tusIM vekhade jadoM farizate kAfirAM dIAM rUhAM kabaz2e vica karade hana, uha uhanAM de mUMhAM te piTThAM ’te mArade hana ate Akhade hana ki huNa tusIM naraka dI agga vica sar3aNa vAlA az2Aba bhogo|
iha (az2Aba) uhanAM kaMmAM dA badalA hai jihar3e tusIM ApaNe hatthIM pahilAM hI agge bheja cukke ho ate iha vI jANa lavo ki bezakka allAha ApaNe baMdiAM ’te z2ulama karana vAlA nahIM|

ihanAM (makke vAliAM) dA vatIrA vI uhanAM vAMga hI hai jihar3A ihanAM toM pahilAM firaaunIAM ate uhanAM toM pahilAM bIta cukke lokAM dA sI| uhanAM ne allAha dIAM AitAM (AdezAM) dA inakAra kItA tAM allAha ne uhanAM de gunAhAM kArana uhanAM nUM phar3a liA| bezakka allAha bahuta hI zakatIzAlI ate karar3A az2Aba deNa vAlA hai|

iha isa laI hoiA ki allAha iMja nahIM ki uha kise kauma nUM koI niamata baqhaze phera usa nUM udoM taka nahIM badaladA jadoM tIka ki uha (kauma) Ape ApaNe dilAM dI hAlata nUM nahIM badaladI| bezakka allAha suNana vAlA te jANana vAlA hai|

ihanAM makke de kAfirAM dIAM karatUtAM vI firaaunIAM ate uhanAM toM pahilAM bIta cukke lokAM vAMga hI hana uhanAM ne ApaNe rabba dIAM AitAM (hukamAM)nUM jhuThalAiA tAM asAM vI uhanAM de aparAdhAM kArana uhanAM nUM halAka kara dittA ate asIM firaaunIAM nUM (samuMdara vica) Dabo dittA iha sAre hI z2Alama sana|
dharatI ’te callaNa vAle sAre prANIAM ’coM allAha dIAM naz2arAM vica sabha toM vaddha bhair3A uha hai jihar3A kufara karadA[4] hai, phera uha ImAna vI nahIM liAuMdA|
translations.footnotes: [4] bhAva jihar3e ApaNe rabba (allAha) ’te ImAna nahIM rakkhade usa dI ika hoNa dA inakAra karade hana ate usa toM chuTTa horAM dI pUjA karade hana usa de paig2aMbarAM dA inakAra karade hana ate allAha dI vahI ’te ImAna rakkhade hana|

translations.translation: (he nabI!) uha jinhAM nAla tuhADI saMdhI hoI hai| phera vI uha hara vAra ApaNI saMdhI nUM tor3a diMde hana, uha allAha toM ratA vI nahIM Darade|

so jadoM tusIM uhanAM nUM lar3AI (de maidAna) vica vekho tAM uhanAM nUM ajihI mAra-mAro ki uhanAM (kAfirAM) de pichale loka (bhAva sahAI) vI nassa jANa| ho sakadA hai ki uha sikkhiA grahiNa kara laiNa|
je tuhAnUM kise kauma valloM vizavAsaghAta dA Dara hove tAM barAbarI dI hAlata vica A ke (bhAva ailAnIAM) saMdhI nUM uhanAM de mUMha ’te mAro| allAha vizavAsa ghAtIAM nUM pasaMda nahIM karadA|
kAfira iha nA-samajhaNa ki uha bacca gae, hakIkata iha hai ki uha (kAfira) kade vI (ApaNIAM cAlAM nAla rabba nUM) bevasa nahIM kara sakade|

(he momino!) tusIM ihanAM (ApaNe vairIAM) de mukAbale laI samarathA anusAra vaddha toM vaddha zakatIzAlI baNo ate ApaNe ghor3hiAM (bhAva savArIAM Adi) nUM vI (sadA) tiAra rakkho tAM jo tusIM allAha de vairIAM nUM ate ApaNe vairIAM nUM ihanAM (kAfirAM) toM chuTTa horAM (vairIAM) nUM vI bhai bhIta kara sako, jinhAM nUM tusIM nahIM jANade, para allAha uhanAM nUM caMgI tarhAM jANadA hai| jo kujjha vI tusIM allAha dI rAha vica jAna mAla qharaca karoge (allAha usa dA) tuhAnUM pUrA-pUrA badalA devegA bezakka tuhADA hakka nahIM rakkhiA jAvegA|
(he nabI!) je uha kAfira sulAha valla jhukaNa tAM tusIM vI sulAha valla jhuko ate allAha ’te hI bharosA rakkho, hakIkata vica uhIo sabha kujjha suNana vAlA te jANana vAlA hai|
je uha tuhADe nAla dhokhA karade hana tAM bezaka tuhADe laI allAha hI batherA hai| (he nabI!) uhIo hai jisa ne ApaNI sahAitA ate mominAM rAhIM tuhADI himAita kItI|

ihanAM (musalamAnAM) de manAM vica mahubbata vI use (allAha) ne hI pAI hai| (he nabI!) je tusIM saMsAra de sAre qhaz2Ane vI qharaca kara diMde tAM vI tusIM ihanAM lokAM de manAM vica muhabbata nahIM sI pA sakade| iha mahubbata tAM (ihanAM vica) allAha ne hI pAI hai| uhIo z2orAvara te hikamatAM (sUjha-bUjha) vAlA hai|
he nabI! tuhADe laI tAM allAha hI batherA hai ate uhanAM laI vI jihar3e mominAM viccoM tuhADI pairavI karade hana|

he nabI! ImAna vAliAM nUM(allAha de vairIAM nAla) yuddha (jihAda) karana laI prerita karo| je tuhADe viccoM vIha loka vI DaTaNa vAle hana tAM uha do sau kAfirAM ’te bhArU rahiNage, je tuhADe ika sau hoNage tAM ika haz2Ara kAfirAM ’te bhArU hoNage, isa laI kiuM jo (kAfira tAM) besamajha loka hana|

huNa allAha ne tuhADA bhAra haulA kara dittA hai| uha caMgI tarhAM jANadA hai ki tuhADe aMdara aje kamaz2orI hai, so je tuhADe vica ika sau (momina) dhIraja rakkhaNa vAle hoNage tAM allAha dI kripA nAla do sau (kAfirAM) ’te bhArU hoNage| je tuhADe viccoM ika haz2Ara DaTaNa vAle hoNage tAM uha allAha de hukama nAla do haz2Ara ’te bhArU hoNage| allAha sabara karana vAliAM de nAla hai|

kise nabI laI iha ucita nahIM ki usa de kola kaidI hoNa jadoM tIka ki uha dharatI ’te vairIAM nUM caMgI tarhAM kucala nA deve| (he musalamAno!) tusIM tAM saMsArika lAbha (mAle-g2anImata) cAhuMde ho ate allAha tuhADI Aqhirata cAhuMdA hai| allAha z2orAvara te hikamata (dAnAI) vAlA hai|
je pahilAM toM hI allAha valloM (tuhADI jita) nA likhI huMdI tAM jo (fidiA) tusIM lokAM ne (badara de kaidIAM toM) liA hai, usa de badale vica tuhAnUM karar3I saz2A dittI jAMdI|
so, huNa jo vI halAla te pAka mAle-g2anImata tuhAnUM miliA hai usa nUM khAo ate allAha toM Darade raho, bezakka allAha hI (bhullAM dA) baqhazaNahAra te rahima karana vAlA hai|

he nabI! tuhADe kabaz2e vica Ae hoe kaidIAM nUM Akho ki je allAha tuhADe dilAM dI neka niyyatI vekhegA tAM jo kujjha vI tuhAthoM (fidiA) liA giA hai usa toM kIte vadhIA tuhAnUM hora devegA, nAla hI tuhADe gunAha vI muAfa karegA| allAha hI baqhazaNahAra te miharAM vAlA hai|

(he nabI!) je uha tuhADe nAla qhiAnata (dhokhA) karanA cAhuMde hana tAM isa toM pahilAM uha allAha nAla vI dhokhA kara cukke hana ate usa ne uhanAM nUM tuhADe kAbU vica kara dittA hai| allAha sabha kujjha jANadA hai te sUjha-bUjha vAlA hai|

jihar3e loka ImAna liAe ate hijarata kItI ate ApaNe mAlAM te jAnAM nAla allAha dI rAha vica jihAda kItA ate jihar3e lokAM ne uhanAM nUM panAha dittI ate uhanAM dI madada kItI uha sabha Apasa vica ika dUje de dosata hana| jihar3e ImAna tAM lai Ae hana para hijarata nahIM kItI uhanAM nAla tuhADA koI dosatAnA nahIM jadoM tIka ki uha hijarata nA kara laiNa| hAM! je uha dIna de mAmale vica tuhADI koI sahAitA cAhuMde hana tAM uhanAM dI madada karanA tuhADe laI z2arUrI hai, chuTTa uhanAM de mukAbale vica jinhAM nAla tuhADI saMdhI ho cukkI hai, tusIM jo vI karade ho allAha caMgI tarhAM vekhadA hai|
kAfira Apasa vica ika dUje de dosata hana[5] (he momino) je tusIM vI iMja hI (kAfirAM vAMga) mittaratA nA kItI tAM dharatI utte bahuta vaDDA vigAr3a ho jAvegA|
translations.footnotes: [5] tafasIra tibarI vica biAna kItA giA hai ki isa Aita dI sabha toM vadhIA tafasIra viAkhaNa iha hai je tusIM uha kujjha nahIM karoge jihar3A maiMne tuhAnUM hukama dittA hai bhAva tusIM dunIAM bhara de musalamAna allAha de dIna nUM bhArU ate jitaNa laI ika juTTa ho ke ika dUje de hAmI ate sahAI nahIM baNoge tAM dunIAM vica fitanA fasAda faila jAvegA ate ika hI sameM vica kaI qhalIfA (hukamarAna) dA hoNA vI fitanA hI hai jiveM ika hadIsa vica jo ki sahI musalima dI hai, arAfAha valloM biAna kItI gaI hai, uha kahiMde hana ki maiMne nabI karIma (sa:) nUM iha faramAuMde suNiA hai ki jadoM tusIM sAre musalamAna ika qhalIfA dI agavAI vica jamAM ho jAvoge ate koI viakatI tuhADe vicakAra fitanA phailA ke tuhAnUM aDDa-aDDa vaMDaNA cAhave tAM ajihe viakatI dI garadana vaDDa dio (sahI musalima, hadIsa: 1852) ika dUjI hadIsa vica nabI karIma (sa:) ne faramAiA je dunIAM de musalamAna do qhalIfiAM (hAkamAM) ’te baiata bhAva kabUla kara laiNa tAM ihanAM vica jisa de hattha ’te pahilAM baiata kItI jAve uhIo qhalIfA vajoM bAkI rahegA jada ki dUje nUM katala kara dittA jAvegA| (sahI musalima, hadIsa: 1853) ●.kuraAna te hadIsa dIAM ihanAM dalIlAM toM iho patA caladA hai ki iha kAnUMnI faraz2a hai ki ika sameM vica sArI isalAmI dunIAM laI ika toM vaddha qhalIfA nahIM hoNA cAhIdA nahIM tAM musalamAnAM vica ika vaDDA fitanA paidA ho jAvegA jisa de siTTe bahuta hI qhataranAka hoNage|

translations.translation: jihar3e loka ImAna liAe, hijarata kItI ate allAha dI rAha vica jihAda vI kItA ate jinhAM ne uhanAM nUM zarana dittI ate uhanAM madada vI kItI asala vicca sacce momina tAM iho hana| ihanAM laI baqhaziza hai ate iz2z2ata vAlI roz2I hai|

ate jihar3e loka (hijarata toM) bAada ImAna liAe, phera uhanAM ne hijarata vI kItI ate tuhADe nAla milake jihAda vI kItA, uha loka vI tuhADe viccoM hI hana| para allAha dI kitAba (.kuraAna) anusAra qhUna de rizate ika dUje dA vadhere hakka rakkhade hana| bezakka allAha hara cIz2a dA jANana vAlA hai|
(he musalamAno!) jinhAM muzarikAM nAla tusIM saMdhI kara rakkhI hai, allAha te usa de rasUla (haz2arata muhaMmada sa:) valloM uhanAM nUM korA javAba hai|

so (he muzariko!) tusIM loka deza (makke) vica cAra mahIne taka Tura phira lavo ate iha jANa lao ki tusIM allAha nUM bevasa nahIM kara sakade ate iha vI (cete rakkho) ki allAha kAfirAM nUM z2alIla karana vAlA hai|

allAha te uhade rasUla valloM lokAM nUM vaDDe hajja de dina sUcita kItA jAMdA hai ki allAha ate usa de rasUla dI muzarikAM pratI koI z2iMmevArI nahIM, para je tusIM loka huNa vI taubA kara lavo tAM iho tuhADe hakka vica caMgI galla hai| je tusIM saccAI toM mUMha mor3ade ho tAM qhabaradAra raho ki tusIM allAha nUM harA nahIM sakade| (he nabI!) tusIM kAfirAM nUM dukhadAI az2Aba dI qhabara suNA dio|

para (he musalamAno!) uhanAM muzarikAM toM jinhAM nAla tuhADA samajhautA ho cukkiA hai ate uhanAM ne tuhADA sAtha nibhAuNa vica koI kasara vI nahIM chaDDI ate nA hI tuhADe viruddha kise dI madada kItI hai tAM tusIM uhanAM de nAla samajhaute dI mithI hoI muddata pUrI karo| allAha parahez2agArAM nUM pasaMda karadA hai|

jadoM harAma (varaje hoe) mahIne laMgha jANa tAM tusIM muzarikAM nUM jitthe vI vekho uhanAM nUM katala kara dio, uhanAM nUM phar3o ate uhanAM dA gherAo karo, uhanAM dI ghAta vica hareka ghATI vica jAo,[1] hAM! je uha taubA kara laiNa te namAz2a de pAbaMdha ho jANa ate z2akAta deNa lagga jANa tAM (he musalamAno!) tusIM uhanAM nUM chaDDa dio| bezakka allAha miharAM karana vAlA te baqhazaNahAra hai|
translations.footnotes: [1] vekho sUrata ala-bakaraha, hAzIA Aita 119/2

translations.translation: (he nabI!) je muzarikAM viccoM koI vI viakatI tuhAthoM zarana maMge tAM usa nUM zarana vica lai lao jadoM uha allAha dA kalAma (.kuraAna) suNa lave tAM phera usa (muzarika) nUM usa de surakkhiata TikANe ’te pahuMcA dio| iMja isa laI (karanA) hai kiuM jo iha loka giAna nahIM rakkhade|

bhalAM muzarikAM laI allAha ate usa de rasUla dIAM naz2arAM vica koI saMdhI-samajhautA kiveM rahi sakadA hai, chuTTa uhanAM toM jinhAM nAla tusIM masajide-harAma (qhAnA-kAabA) lAge samajhautA kItA sI| jada uha loka tuhADe nAla samajhautA nibhAuNa, tusIM vI uhanAM nAla saMdhI nibhAo| allAha Dara-bhau maMNana vAliAM nUM pasaMda karadA hai|[2]
translations.footnotes: [2] vekho sUrata ala-bakaraha, hAzIA Aita 2/2

translations.translation: (he nabI! ihanAM muzarikAM nAla saMdhI kiveM ho sakadI hai) jada ki uhanAM dA hAla tAM iha hai ki je uha tuhADe ’te bhArU ho jANa tAM nA tAM uha tuhADe mAmale vica kise rizate-nAte dI paravAha karana nAM hI ApaNe kise saMdhI samajhaute dI| uha ApaNIAM gallAM nAla hI tuhAnUM qhuza karana vica lagge hoe hana, para dila toM inakAra karade hana| ihanAM viccoM bahute nA-faramAna hana|

uhanAM (muzarikAM) ne allAha dIAM AitAM (AdezAM) nUM bahuta hI thor3hI kImata ’te veca suTTiA hai ate dUje lokAM nUM vI usa (allAha) dI rAha toM rokade hana| bahuta hI bhair3IAM karatUtAM hana, jo uha kara rahe hana|
uha (muzarika) tAM kise musalamAna de mAmale vica nA tAM kise rizatedArI dI paravAha karade hana ate nA hI kise samajhaute dA lihAz2a rakkhade hana| iha loka tAM haddAM TappaNa vAle hana|

je huNa vI iha taubA kara laiNa, namAz2a dI pAbaMdI karana ate z2akAta adA karade rahiNa tAM iha tuhADe dInI bharA hana| asIM (allAha) tAM ApaNIAM AitAM (AdezAM) dA giAna rakkhaNa vAliAM laI kholha-kholha ke biAna kara rahe hAM|

je uha samajhaute karana magaroM apaNIAM kasamAM tor3a deNa ate tuhADe dIna utte hamale karana tAM tusIM vI uhanAM kufara de saradArAM nAla bhir3a jAo, uhanAM dIAM kasamAM dA kujjha vI bharosA nahIM ho sakadA zAida uha (ApaNIAM harakatAM toM) bAz2a A jANa|

(he musalamAno!) kI tusIM uhanAM (kAfirAM) nAla nahIM lar3oMge jinhAM ne ApaNIAM kasamAM nUM tor3hiA ate paig2aMbara (mahuMmada sa:) nUM (makke zahira toM) deza nikAlA deNa dA irAdA kItA ate uhanAM ne hI pahilAM tuhADe nAla lar3AI araMbha kItI? kI tusIM uhanAM toM Darade ho? je tusIM ImAna vAle ho tAM tusIM allAha toM hI Daro uhIo isa dA vadha hakka rakkhadA hai|

tusIM uhanAM nAla jaMga karo allAha uhanAM nUM tuhADe hatthoM az2Aba (saz2A) duAvegA, uhanAM nUM z2alIla te rusavA karegA, tuhAnUM uhanAM ’te jita pradAna karegAM ate mominAM de hiradiAM nUM zAMta karegA|
ate uha uhanAM de manAM viccoM karodha nUM dUra karegA| allAha jisa valla vI cAhuMdA hai ApaNIAM miharAM sahita dhiAna diMdA hai| allAha sabha kujjha jANana vAlA te hikamata vAlA hai|

(he muzariko te kAfiro!) kI tusIM iha samajhade ho ki tusIM aiveM hI chaDDa ditte jAoge jada ki allAha ne iha tAM ajihe taka vekhiA hI nahIM ki tuhADe viccoM kauNa loka hana, jinhAM ne usa de rAha vica jihAda (saghaMraza) kItA ate allAha te usa de rasUla ate mominAM toM chuTTa hora kise nUM dosata nahIM baNAiA| allAha uha sabha jANadA hai jo tusIM kara rahe ho|

muzarikAM nUM iha zobhA nahIM diMdA ki uha allAha dIAM masItAM nUM AbAda karana, jadoM ki uha Apa hI ApaNe kufara dI gavAhI de rahe hana| uhanAM de sAre kIte kaMma (sevA) ajAIM gae, uha sadA laI naraka vica rahiNage|

allAha dIAM masItAM dI abAdakArI (prabaMdhakI) tAM kevala uhIo karade hana jihar3e allAha ate kiAmata dihAr3e ’te ImAna rakkhade hana, namAz2AM dI pAbaMdI karade hana, z2akAta adA karade hana, chuTTa allAha toM hora kise toM Darade nahIM| Asa hai ki iho lokI sidhe rAha ’te hana|

kI tuhADIAM naz2arAM vica hAjIAM nUM pANI piAuNA ate masajide-harAma (qhAnA-kAabA) nUM AbAda karanA usa viakatI de kaMma de barAbara hai, jihar3A allAha ’te ate Aqhirata ’te ImAna liAe ate allAha dI rAha vica jihAda (saMgharaza) kare| allAha dIAM naz2arAM vica iha doveM ika sAmAna nahIM ho sakade ate nA hI allAha z2AlamAM nUM hidAita diMdA hai|

jihar3e lokI ImAna liAe, ghara-bAra chaDDiA ate allAha dI rAha vica ApaNe mAlAM te jAnAM sahita jihAda kItA, allAha de naz2adIka uhanAM lokAM de bahuta hI ucce maratabe hana ate uhIo ApaNIAM murAdAM pAuNage|[3]
translations.footnotes: [3] allAha de rasUla (sa:) dA faramAna hai jihar3A allAha te usa de rasUla (sa:) ’te ImAna liAe namAz2a kAima kare ramaz2Ana de roz2e rakkhe tAM allAha ne iha galla ApaNe ’te lAz2amI kara laI hai ki usa nUM jaMnata vica dAqhala kare bhAveM ki usa ne jihAda kItA hove jAM usI thAM baiThe rahe jitthe uha jaMmIAM sI lokAM ne pucchiA ki he allAha de rasUla! kI iha qhuzaqhabarI asIM lokAM nUM suNA daIe? tAM Apa ne faramAiA jaMnata de so daraje hana jihar3e allAha dI rAha vica jihAda karana vAliAM laI tiArA kIte gae hana hara do darajiAM vica iMnI dUrI hai jiMnA akAza te dharatI de vicAle dI dUrI so jadoM tusIM rabba toM jaMnata maMgo tAM phiradausa dA savAla karo kiuM jo iha jaMnata dA vicAle dA bhAga hai ate sabha toM vadhIA hai kahiNa vAle dA iha vI vicAra hai ki Apa ne iha vI faramAiA isa phiradausa de utte rahimAna dA araza hai ate jaMnata dIAM nahirAM use toM hI nikaladIAM hana (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 2790) zahAdata dI icchA rakkhaNA vI ika momina dI vizezatA hai| abU-hurairA dA kahiNA hai ki rasUla (sa:) dA faramAna hai ki kasama hai usa hasatI dI jisa de hattha vica merI jAna hai je kujjha ImAna vAliAM nUM iha galla nA-pasaMda nA huMdI ki uha mere picche rahi jANa ate uhanAM kola savArIAM vI nahIM ki jinhAM ’te maiM uhanAM nUM savAra kara davAM tAM maiM kise (jaMga) vica picche nA rahiMdA jihar3e allAha dI rAha vica jihAda laI nikalade hana| kasama hai usa z2Ata dI jisa de kAbU vica merI jAna hai merI tAM iho cAhata hai ki maiM allAha dI rAha vica mAriA jAvAM phera jioMdA kItA jAvA phera katala kItA jAvA phera jiUMdA kItA jAvAM phera katala kItA jAvAM phera jiUMdA kItA jAvAM te phera katala kItA jAvAM phera jiuMdA| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 2797)

translations.translation: uhanAM dA rabba uhanAM nUM ApaNI mihara, raz2A ate ajihe bAg2AM dI qhuzaqhabarI diMdA hai jitthe uhanAM laI sadIvI niamatAM hoNagIAM|
jinhAM vica uha sadA rahiNage bezakka allAha kola (sevAvAM dA) badalA deNa laI batherA kujjha hai|

he ImAna vAlio! je tuhADe pio te bharA ImAna toM vaddha kufara nUM pasaMda karade hana tAM tusIM uhanAM nUM kade vI ApaNA mittara nA baNAo| tuhADe viccoM jihar3A vI ihanAM nAla muhabbata karegA, uhIo asalI z2Alama hovegA|

(he muhaMmada sa:!) tusIM Akha dio ki jekara tuhADe pitA te tuhADe puttara te tuhADe bharA te tuhADIAM patanIAM te tuhADe parivAra te tuhADe kamAe hoe uha dhana padAratha ate kArobAra jinhAM de maMdA paiNa toM tusIM Darade ho ate tuhADIAM uha havelIAM jinhAM nUM tusIM pasaMda karade ho jekara iha sabha tuhAnUM allAha ate usa de rasUla toM ate usa dI rAha vica jihAda toM vaddha piAre hana tAM tusIM uDIka karo ki allAha ApaNA hukama (az2Aba dA) bhaija deve|[4] allAha jhUThiAM nUM hidAita nahIM diMdA|
translations.footnotes: [4] isa Aita vica jihAda toM bacaNa vAliAM laI citAvaNI hai allAha dI rAha vica jihAda karana nUM isalAma vica vizeza mahattava kItA jAMdA hai ate isa nUM isalAma dA sikhara kihA giA hai| jihAda karana ’te hI isalAma dA vajUda kAima huMdA hai jihAda nA karana toM isalAma qhatama ho jAMdA hai ate musalamAna rusavAI te z2alAlata ’te tura paiMde hana ate AdaramAna toM vAMjhe ho jAMde hana| jihar3A koI sacce diloM jihAda karana dI cAhata nahIM rakkhadA tAM uha vI jhUThe hoNa dIAM nizAnIAM vica ika nizAnI nAla mAradA hai bhAva usa nUM jhUTha dI hAlata vica hI mauta AuMdI hai| (sahI musalima, hadIsa: 1910)

translations.translation: (he musalamAno!) bezakka allAha ne pahilAM bathere avasarAM ’te tuhADI sahAitA kItI hai ate hunaina (dI lar3AI) vAle dina vI (sahAitA kItI sI), jadoM tuhAnUM ApaNI bahu giNatI ’te ghamaMDa sI paraMtU uha tuhADe kise kaMma nahIM AI sagoM dharatI ApaNI vizAlatA ’te huMde hoe vI tuhADe ’te taMga ho gaI sI ate tusIM piTTha vikhA ke naTTha Ae sI|

phera allAha ne ApaNe valloM ApaNe nabI ate mominAM ’te ApaNI tasakIna (tasallI) utArI ate uha lazakara bheje, jinhAM nUM tusIM vekhiA hI nahIM ate kAfirAM nUM pUrI saz2A dittI| ihanAM kAfirAM dA iho badalA hai|
isa (saz2A) toM bAada allAha jisa ’te cAhavegA use valla dhiAna devegA (bhAva khimA kara devegA)| allAha hI baqhaziza te miharabAnIAM karana vAlA hai|

he ImAna vAlio! nirasaMdeha, muzarika apavittara hana[5] uha isa sAla (bhAva nauM hijarI) toM bAada masajide-harAma (qhAnA-kAabA) de ner3e vI nA AuNa| je tuhAnUM Dara hai ki (ihanAM de nA AuNa kArana) tuhADA hattha taMga ho jAvegA, je allAha cAhegA tAM uha ApaNe faz2alAM rAhIM tuhAnUM dhanavAna baNA devegA| bezakka vaDDA jANanahAra te sUjha-bUjha vAlA hai|
translations.footnotes: [5] muzarikAM dI nA-pAkI jAM gaMdagI doM tarhAM dI hai ika sarIrika ate dUjI ruhAnI gaMdagI, rUhAnI gaMdagI iha hai ki uha allAha ate usa de rasUla (sa:) ’te ImAna nahIM rakkhadA ate sarIra dI gaMdagI iha hai ki uha safAI dA dhiAna nahIM rakkhadA, pizAba, TaTTI, vIraja Adi nikalaNa ’te muzarika jAM kAfira nA-pAka huMde hana|

translations.translation: uhanAM nAla jaMga lar3o jihar3e allAha te kiAmata dihAr3e nUM nahIM maMnade jihar3e allAha te usa de rasUla valloM harAma kItIAM hoIAM cIz2AM nUM harAma nahIM maMnade ate nA hI sacce dharama (isalAma) nUM kabUla karade hana| jihar3e ahale kitAba (yahUdIAM te IsAIAM) viccoM hana uhanAM nAla lar3o, itthoM tIka ki uha z2alIla ho ke ApaNe hatthIM jaz2iA (rakkhiA kara) deNa lagga jANa|[6]
translations.footnotes: [6] jaz2iA ika ajihA Taikasa hai jihar3A ajihe g2aira musalamAnAM toM liA jAMdA hai jihar3e musalamAnAM dI hakUmata vica surakkhiata jIvana guz2Arade hana|

translations.translation: yahUdI Akhade hana ki uz2aira (nAM dA nabI) allAha dA puttara hai ate nasarAnI (IsAI) Akhade hana ki masIha (IsA) allAha dA puttara [7] hai| iha kevala ihanAM de mUMha (bhAva kahiNa) dIAM gallAM hana| iha uhanAM inakArIAM dI rIso-rIsa gallAM karade hana jihar3e ihanAM toM pahilAM bIta cukke hana| rabba dI mAra hove ihanAM ’te, iha bhaTake hoe kitthe TurI phirade hana|
translations.footnotes: [7] jada ki allAha de koI aulAda nahIM, uha ihanAM gallAM toM pAka hai|

translations.translation: ihanAM ne allAha nUM chaDDa ke ApaNe dhAramika giAnIAM te berAgIAM nUM ate marIama de puttara masIha (IsA) nUM ApaNA rabba baNA liA hai (bhAva jo uha AkhaNa uhIo rabbI kalAma hai) jada ki ihanAM nUM kevala ika allAha dI ibAdata karana dA hukama dittA giA sI, jisa toM binAM hora koI izaTa nahIM|[8] uha hara prakAra de ziraka toM pAka hai, jihar3A uha karade hana|
translations.footnotes: [8] haz2arata adI bina hAtima ne nabI karIma (sa:) toM iha Aita suNI tAM Apa (sa:) ne faramAiA ki uha loka uhanAM dI ibAdata nahIM karade sI para jadoM unhAM de dhAramika gurU kise cIz2a nUM halAla kahiMde sI tAM iha vI usa nUM halAla samajhade sI ate jisa nUM uha harAma kahiMde sI usa nUM iha vI harAma samajhade sI| (jAmaa tiramaz2I, hadIsa: 3095)

translations.translation: uha tAM iho cAhuMde hana ki allAha de nUra (isalAma) nUM ApaNe mUMhAM (dIAM phUkAM) nAla hI bujhA deNa, jada ki allAha ApaNe nUra nUM pUrA karaka rahegA| bhAveM kAfirAM nUM kiMnAM hI burA kiuM nA lagge|
usa ne ApaNe rasUla (muhaMmada sa:) nUM hidAita ate saccA dIna deke bhejiA hai tAM jo usa nUM sAre dharamAM ’te g2Aliba kara deve, bhAveM muzarikAM nUM kiMnA hI burA lagge|

he ImAna vAlio! ihanAM kitAba vAliAM de dharama giAnI te saMsAra tiAgI sAdhU-saMtAM dI bahu-giNatI lokAM dA mAla nA-hakkA hI khA jAMde hana ate allAha dI rAha toM (lokAM nUM) rokade hana| jihar3e lokI sonA cAMdI jor3a-jor3a ke rakhade hana ate allAha dI rAha vica qharaca nahIM karade, uhanAM nUM daradanAka az2Aba dI qhabara suNA dio|

ika dina usa jamhAM kIte mAla nUM naraka dI agga vica pighalAiA jAvegA phera use nAla uhanAM de matthe, vakhIAM ate piTThAM nUM dAgiA jAvegA| (ate kihA jAvegA ki) iha hai uha (daulata) jisa nUM tusIM ApaNe laI jor3hiA karade sI| huNa tusIM ApaNe usa (qhaz2Ane) dA suAda lavo jihar3A tusIM jor3ade rahiMde sI|[9]
translations.footnotes: [9] vekho sUrata Ale-imarAna, hAzIA Aita 180/3

translations.translation: bezakka allAha dI kitAba vica mahIniAM dI giNatI bArhAM hI hai ate iha usa vele toM hai jadoM toM akAza te dharatI nUM usa ne paidA kItA hai| ihanAM viccoM cAra mahIne adaba (satikAra) de hana, iho hisAba ThIka hai| tusIM ihanAM mahIniAM vica ApaNIAM jAnAM ’te z2ulama nAM karo ate tusIM sAre (musalamAna) milake muzarikAM nAla lar3o jiveM uha sAre tuhADe nAla (milake) lar3ade hana [10] ate iha galla vI cete rakkho ki allAha parahez2agArAM dA hI sAthI hai|
translations.footnotes: [10] vekho sUrata ala-bakaraha, hAzIA Aita 193/2

translations.translation: nirasaMdeha, kise mahIne nUM agge-picche kara deNA kufara vica vAdhA karanA hai, ise kArana kAfirAM nUM kurAhe pAiA jAMdA hai| uha (muzarika) ika sAla laI kise (mahIne) nUM jAiz2a (halAla) baNA laiMde hana ate dUje sAla use nUM harAma (lar3AI toM varajita kItA hoiA) baNA laiMde hana, tAM jo uhanAM mahIniAM dI giNatI pUrI kara laiNa jinhAM nUM allAha ne harAma ghozita kItA hoiA hai, iMja usa nUM halAla baNA laiMde hana jisa nUM allAha ne harAma kItA hai| uhanAM nUM uhanAM de bhair3e kaMma vI bhale vikhAI diMde hana| allAha kAfirAM dI rAhanumAI nahIM karadA|

he ImAna vAlio! tuhAnUM kI ho giA hai ki jadoM tuhAnUM kihA jAMdA hai ki allAha dI rAha vica nikalo tAM tusIM dharatI nAla cimabar3e rahiMde ho|[11] kI tusIM Aqhirata nUM chaDDa ke dunIAM de hI lAlacI baNa gae ho| suNo! saMsArika jIvana dA lAbha Aqhirata de mukAbale vica kujjha vI nahIM|
translations.footnotes: [11] allAha dI rAha vica jihAda karana dI bahuta vaDDI mahattatA hai| ithoM tIka ki zahIda duniA vica mur3a AuNa dI icchAM karegA tAM jo uha mur3a zahAdata maratabe nUM pahuMca sake| allAha de rasUla (sa:) ne faramAiA ki koI vI ajihA viakatI nahIM jisa nUM marana magaroM allAha koloM vadhIA badalA mile phera vI uha duniA vica mur3a AuNA pasaMda kare bhAveM ki usa nUM duniAM vicca jo kuja vI hai usa nUM uha sabha kujha de dittA jAve chuTTa zahIda toM ki uha zahAdata dI vaDiAI dekha ke cAhegA ki uha mur3a saMsAra vica jAve ate mur3a zahIda hove| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 2795)

translations.translation: je tusIM (lar3aNa laI) nahIM nikaloge tAM allAha tuhAnUM daradanAka az2Aba devegA ate tuhADI thAM kise hora kauma nUM lai AvegA| tusIM usa dA kujjha vI vigAr3a nahIM sakoge jada ki allAha hara prakAra dI samarathA rakkhadA hai|

je tusIM uhanAM (muhaMmada sa:) dI madada nA kItI (tAM kujjha paravAha nahIM) kiuM jo usa dI madada tAM allAha ne usa vele vI kItI sI jadoM usa nUM kAfirAM valloM (makke ’coM) deza nikAlA dittA giA sI| jadoM uha (muhaMmada sa:) do viccoM dUjA sI jadoM uha doveM (sora nAM dI) guphA vica sI, jadoM uha ApaNe dUje sAthI (abU-bakara) nUM Akha rahe sI ki Dara nA bezakka allAha sADe aMga maMga hai| phera allAha ne uhanAM utte ApaNe valloM tasallI bhejI ate uhanAM faujAM rAhIM uhanAM dovAM dI madada kItI jinhAM nUM tusIM vekhiA hI nahIM| usa (allAha) ne kAfirAM dI galla nUM nIvAM kara dittA ate galla (kalamAM) tAM allAha dI hI uccI hai| allAha vaDDA z2orAvAra te hikamatAM vAlA hai|

(he musalamAno!) bhAveM tusIM hole (nihatthA) ho jAM bhAre (hathiAra-baMda) hovo, ApaNI jAna te mAla nAla allAha dI rAha vica jihAda karana laI nikalo iha tuhADe laI caMgA hai, je tusIM giAna rakkhade ho|

(he nabI!) je lAbha milaNa vica chetI huMdI ate saphara vI AsAna huMdA tAM iha (munAfika) lAz2amI tuhADe picche ho jAMde para iha paiMDA ihanAM nUM vaDDA hI aukhA vikhAI deNa lagga piA huNa iha lokI allAha dIAM kasamAM khA khA ke AkhaNage ki je sADe vica tAkata huMdI tAM asIM z2arUra hI tuhADe nAla (jaMga laI) nikalade| iha jhUThIAM kasamAM khA ke ApaNe Apa nUM hI halAka kara rahe hana| ihanAM de jhUTha dI pUrI jANakArI allAha rakkhadA hai|

he nabI! allAha ne tuhAnUM muAfa kara dittA tusIM ihanAM (munAfikAM) nUM (jaMga vica nA jANa dI) chUTa kiuM dittI? (je tusIM chUTa nA diMde) tAM tuhADe sAhamaNe sacce loka vI A jAMde ate tusIM jhUThe lokAM nUM vI jANa jAMde|

(he nabI!) jihar3e loka allAha ate Aqhirata de dihAr3e ’te (sacce manoM) ImAna rakhade hana, uha tuhAthoM uha apaNe dhana nAla te ApaNIAM jAnAM nAla jihAda karana toM chUTa nahIM maMgade| allAha parahez2agArA nUM caMgI tarhAM jANadA hai|

iha (nA lar3aNa dI) AgiA tAM tuhAthoM kevala uhIo maMgade hana, jinhAM nUM nA tAM allAha ’te ImAna hai nA Aqhirata de dina ’te vizavAsa hai, unhAM de dila zaMkA vica phase hoe hana, uha ApaNe zakka vica hI DAvAM-Dola hana|

je uhanAM dI icchA jihAda laI nikalaNa dI huMdI tAM uha isa laI kujjha tAM sAmAna tiAra rakkhade, para allAha nUM uhanAM dA nikalaNA pasaMda hI nahIM sI, isa laI uhanAM nUM susata kara dittA ate uhanAM nUM Akha dittA ki tusIM baiThaNa vAliAM nAla hI baiThe raho|

je iha (munAfika) tuhADe nAla nikala vI jAMde tAM vI tuhADIAM parezAnIAM vica vAdhA hI karade| uha tuhADe vicAle fitanA fasAda phailAuNa laI bhajja-naTTha karade, tuhADe vicAle ihanAM de jAsUsa vI hana| allAha ihanAM z2AlamAM nUM caMgI tarhAM jANadA hai|

(he nabI!) isa toM pahilAM vI iha (munAfika) lokI fitanA phailAuNa de jatana karade rahe hana ate tuAhADe kaMmAM nUM asafala baNAuNa vica lagge rahe, itthoM taka ki hakka A giA ate allAha dA hukama bhArU ho giA jada ki uha (hakka nUM) nA-pasaMda karade sana|

ihanAM viccoM koI tuhAnUM kahiMdA hai ki mainUM chuTTI de dio, mainUM az2amAiza (bipatA) vica nA pAo, qhabaradAra uha tAM az2amAiza vica phasa cukke hana ate bezakka naraka ihanAM kAfirAM nUM gherana vAlI hai|

(he nabI!) je tuhAnUM koI lAbha huMdA hai tAM ihanAM nUM dukkha huMdA hai, je koI bipatA AuMdI hai tAM Akhade hana ki asIM tAM pahilAM hI ApaNe pratI surakkhiata nItI ApaNAI sI| iMja uha prasaMna-cita hoke paratade hana|
(he nabI!) Akha dio! ki sAnUM tAM kevala uhIo musIbata pahuMcegI jo allAha ne sADe laI likha chaDDI hai| uhIo sADA kAraja sAdhaka hai| mominAM nUM use ’te hI bharosA karanA cAhIdA hai|

(he nabI!) Akha dio! he munAfiko! ki tusIM sADe hakka vica likhiA hoIAM do bhalAIAM viccoM kise ika (jita jA zahAdata) dI uDIka kara rahe ho ate asIM tuhADe hakka vica isa galla dI uDIka vica hAM ki allAha tuhAnUM ApaNe kola toM az2Aba deve jAM sADe hatthoM az2Aba duAve| caMgA tAM huNa tusIM vI uDIka karo tuhADe nAla asIM vI uDIka karade hAM|
(he nabI!) Akha dio! he munAphiko! tusIM bhAveM cAhuMde hoe qharaca karo jAM nA cAhuMde hoe, tuhAthoM ukkA hI savIkAra nahIM kItA jAvegA, tusIM tAM jhUThe loka ho|

ihanAM de qharaca kIte hoe mAla nUM nA kabUla karana dA isa toM chuTTa hora koI kArana nahIM ki iha allAha ate usa de rasUla de inakArI hana ate ApaNIAM namAz2AM laI vI jako-jakI AuMde hana[12] ate rabba dI rAha vica vI nA cAhuMde hoe qharaca karade hana|
translations.footnotes: [12] isa toM patA calapA hai ki namAz2a vica susatI karanA munAfikAM dA kaMma hai| allAha de rasUla (sa:) ne faramAiA ki fajara te izA dI namAz2a munAfikAM utte sabha toM bhArI huMdI hai| para je uhanAM nUM isa galla dA giAna ho jAve ki ihanAM dovAM namAz2AM dA kiMnAM vaDDA badalA hai tAM uha z2arUra masItAM vica AuNage bhAve uhanAM nUM riMgar3ade hoe hI kiuM nA AuNA pave| allAha de rasUla (sa:) ne iha vI faramAiA ki maiM muaz2z2ana nUM akAmata dA hukama davAM ate phera uha akAmata kahe ate maiM kise dUje viakatI nUM hukama davAM ki uha lokAM dI imAmata karavAe, phera maiM agga lai ke uhanAM lokAM de gharAM nUM agga lA davAM jihar3e ApaNe gharoM namAz2a laI nahIM nikale| uhanAM nUM maiM sane uhanAM de ghara de jalA davAM| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 657)

translations.translation: so tuhAnUM ihanAM dI daulata te saMtAna kise dhokhe vica nA pA deve| allAha tAM iho cAhuMdA hai ki ise (dhana te aulAda) rAhIM ihanAM nUM saMsArika jIvana vica hI saz2A de deve ate kufara dI hAlata vica hI ihanAM dI mauta hove|
iha allAha dIAM kasamAM khA khA ke kahiMde hana ki asIM tuhADe viccoM hI hAM, jada ki uha ukkA hI tuhADe viccoM nahIM, sagoM iha tAM tuhAthoM Darade hana|
je uhanAM nUM koI zarana asathAna jAM koI khoha jAM koI sira chapAuNa dI thAM mila jAve tAM iha sabha kujjha chaDDa ke use valla nasse jANage|

(he nabI!) ihanAM vica uha vI hana jihar3e sadakiAM dI vaMDa pratI tuhADe utte itarAz2a karade hana, jekara ihanAM nUM isa (mAla) viccoM kujjha mila jAve tAM qhuza huMde hana je nA mile tAM vigar3aNa lagga jAMde hana|

kiMnA caMgA huMdA ki allAha te usa de rasUla ne uhanAM nUM jo kujjha vI dittA sI use ’te hI rAz2I rahiMde ate Akhade ki sADe laI allAha hI batherA hai, chetI hI allAha te usa dA rasUla sAnUM ApaNe faz2alAM nAla nivAz2egA| asIM tAM allAha toM hI AsAM rakkhaNa vAle hAM|

iha sadakA (z2akAta) tAM kevala fakIrAM (g2arIbAM) laI, masakInAM[13] laI, sadakA vasUla karana vAle karamacArIAM laI, uhanAM lokAM dI diladArI laI jinhAM de dila jor3ana dI cAha hove, g2ulAmI toM garadanAM chuDavAuNa laI, karaz2adArAM nUM karaz2a toM bacAuNa laI, allAha dI rAha vica ate musAfarAM dI sahAitA laI hai| iha (vaMDa) allAha valloM faraz2a kItI gaI hai allAha sabha kujjha jANana vAlA te siANA hai|
translations.footnotes: [13] vekho sUrata ala-bakaraha, hAzIA Aita 273, 83/2

translations.translation: ihanAM (munAfikAM) vicca uha vI hana jihar3e nabI (sa:) nUM takalIfAM diMde hana ate Akhade hana ki kaMnAM dA kaccA hai (he nabI!) tusIM Akho ki uha kaMna tuhADe bhale dI hI galla suNade hana| uha allAha ’te ImAna rakkhadA hai ate musalamAnAM dIAM gallAM dA vizavAsa karadA hai ate tuhADe viccoM jo vI ImAna vAlA hai, iha (rasUla) uhanAM laI rahimata hai| jihar3e lokI allAha de rasUla nUM takalIfAM diMde hana uhanAM laI dukhadAI az2Aba hai|
(he momino!) iha loka kevala tuhAnUM qhuza karana laI tuhADe sAhamaNe allAha dIAM suMhAM khAMde hana je iha momina huMde tAM allAha ate usa de rasUla nUM qhuza karana dA vaddha hakka baNadA sI|
kI iha nahIM jANade ki jihar3A vI allAha ate usa de rasUla dA virodha karegA usa laI naraka dI agga hai jisa vica uha sadA rahiNage, iho asalI z2alAlata hai|

munAfikAM nUM hara vele iho Dara laggiA rahiMdA hai ki musalamAnAM utte koI sUrata ajihI nA uttara Ave jihar3I uhanAM (musalamAnAM) nUM ihanAM (munAfikAM) de mana dIAM gallAM dassa deve| (he nabI!) Akha dio! ki tusIM makhaula karade raho, bezakka allAha uha sabha pragaTa karana vAlA hai jisa galla toM tusIM Darade ho|

je tusIM uhanAM toM puccho tAM jhaTa Akha deNage ki asIM tAM Apo vica hAsA-makhaula te dila-lagI karade sI| (he nabI!) Akha dio! (he munAfiko) kI allAha usa dIAM AitAM ate usa dA rasUla hI tuhADe makhaula karana laI rahi gae hana?
tusIM bahAne nA baNAo tusIM tAM ImAna liAuNa magaroM vI kufara kItA hai| je asIM tuhADe viccoM kujjha lokAM nUM muAfa vI kara daIe tAM kujjha nUM tAM uhanAM de juramAM dI saz2A devAMge hI|
