sAre hI munAfika marada ate manAfika auratAM ika dUje nAla samAnatA rakkhade hana, uha burAI karana dA hukama diMde hana ate bhale kaMmAM toM rokade hana ate ApaNIAM muTThIAM baMda rakkhade hana (bhAva qharaca nahIM karade) iha loka allAha nUM bhulla gae tAM allAha ne vI uhanAM nUM bhulA dittA hai, asala vica munAfika loka hI jhUThe te bhair3IAM harakatAM karade hana|

allAha ihanAM munAfika maradAM ate munAfika auratAM nAla ate kAfirAM nAla naraka dI agga dA vAadA kara cukkiA hai, jitthe iha sadA rahiNage| uhIo (nakara) ihanAM laI batherI hai| ihanAM ’te allAha ne lAanata kItI hai ate sadIvI az2Aba vI ihanAM laI hai|

(he munAfiko!) tusIM uhanAM lokAM vAMga ho jihar3e tuhAthoM pahilAM hoe sana, uha tuhAthoM kIte vaddha zakatIzAlI sI ate daulata te aulAda pakkhoM vI vAdhU sI| uha saMsAra viccoM ApaNA baNadA hissA lai gae tusIM vI ApaNA hissA khA haMDhA liA| tusIM vI uhanAM vAMga hI bekAra de vAda-vivAda vica ulajhe rahe| uhanAM de kIte karama saMsAra vica vI te Aqhirata vica vI ajAIM gae| iho loka ghATe vica rahiNa vAle hana|

kI ihanAM nUM ApaNe toM pahilAM de lokAM dIAM qhabarAM nahIM pahuMcIAM jiveM kauma nUha, Ada, samUda, ibarAhIma ate ahile madIna te uha basatIAM jinhAM nUM uppara thalle kara dittA giA sI? ihanAM de kola ihanAM de paig2aMbara dalIlAM lai ke Ae (para iha nahIM maMne)| allAha ajihA nahIM ki ihanAM ’te z2ulama karadA, sagoM ihanAM ne Apa hI ApaNe ’te z2ulama kIte sI|

momina marada te momina auratAM Apasa vica ika dUje de sAthI hana| uha bhalAIAM, nekIAM dA hukama diMde hana ate burAIAM toM rokade hana, namAz2AM dI pAbaMdI karade hana, z2akAta adA karade hana, allAha ate usa de rasUla muhaMmada (sa:) dIAM gallAM nUM maMnade hana| iha uha loka hana jinhAM ’te allAha bahuta chetI rahima karegA| bezakka allAha z2orAvara ate hikamata vAlA hai|

ihanAM ImAna vAle maradAM te auratAM nAla allAha ne uhanAM bAg2AM dA vAadA kItA hai jinhAM de heTha nahirAM vagadIAM hoNagIAM, uha utthe hI sadA rahiNage| ihanAM (sadA bahAra bAg2AM) vica pavitara mahila hana, para allAha dI raz2A hI sabha toM vaDDI te ahima cIz2a hai iho z2abaradasata kAmayAbI hai|
he nabI! kAfirAM te munAfikAM nAla jihAda (jaMga) karo, ihanAM nAla karar3AI vAlA varatAo karo| ihanAM dI asalI thAM naraka hai, jihar3I sabha toM vaddha bhair3I thAM hai|

iha allAha dIAM suMhAM khA-khA ke Akhade hana ki uhanAM ne koI galla nahIM kahI, hAlAM ki uhanAM ne z2arUra hI kufara vAle bhair3e zabada Akhe hana| ate iha loka isalAma kabUla karana toM magaroM kAfira ho gae ate uhanAM ne uha kujjha karana dA irAdA vI kItA jisa nUM uha kara nahIM sake| uhanAM dA sArA karopa isa galla dA sI ki allAha ne ate usa de rasUla ne ApaNe faz2alAM nAla uhanAM (musalamAnAM) nUM rajA kiuM dittA? jekara iha huNa vI taubA kara laiNa tAM ihanAM laI vadhIA galla hai, je iha mUMha mor3aNage tAM allAha ihanAM nUM saMsAra vica vI te Aqhirata vica vI dukha bhariA az2Aba devegA ate dharatI ’te uhanAM dA koI vI hamAitI te sahAI nA hovegA|

ihanAM vica uha vI hana jinhAM ne allAha nAla bacana kIte sI ki je allAha sAnUM ApaNe faz2alAM te miharAM nAla nivAz2e tAM asIM z2arUra hI sadakA qhairAta devAMge ate asIM vI neka lokAM viccoM hovAMge|
para jadoM allAha ne uhanAM nUM ApaNIAM miharAM nAla nivAz2iA tAM iha kaMjUsI karana laga pae| uhanAM ne hakka toM mUMha mor3a liA ate ApaNe vacanAM toM phira gae|

so ihanAM (karatUtAM) vajoM allAha ne uhanAM de dilAM vica nifAka (dogalApaNa) pA ke odoM taka saz2A dittI jadoM taka allAha nAla uhanAM dI milaNI nA ho jAve| kiuM jo uhanAM ne allAha nAla kIte vacanAM de ulaTa kItA hai ate uha jhUTha vI bolade sana|
kI uha nahIM jANade ki allAha uhanAM de mana dIAM lukIAM hoIAM gallAM ate uhanAM dIAM kAnA-phUsIAM nUM caMgI tarhAM jANadA hai? allAha sArIAM hI gupata gallAM nUM jANadA hai|

jihar3e loka uhanAM musalamAnAM nUM mihaNe diMde hana jihar3e dila khola ke qhairAta karade hana ate uha (g2arIba) loka jinhAM kola mihanata maz2adUrI chuTTa kujjha nahIM (thor3hI qhairAta deNa kArana uhanAM dA makhaula uDAuMde hana tAM (kiAmata dihAr3e) allAha vI uhanAM dA makhaula uDAvegA ate uhanAM laI daradanAka az2Aba hai|

(he nabI!) tusIM ihanAM (munAfikAM) laI bhAveM muAfI dI duA karo jAM nA karo (ika barAbara hai) je tusIM sattara vAra vI ihanAM laI muAfI dI benatI karo tAM vI allAha ihanAM nUM muAfa nahIM karegA| iha isa laI kiuM jo ihanAM ne allAha te usa de rasUla nAla kufara kItA hai| ajihe jhUThe lokAM nUM allAha hidAita nahIM diMdA|

jihar3e lokAM nUM picche rahi jANa dI chUTa de dittI gaI sI uha allAha de rasUla (sa:) de (jaMga vica) jANa magaroM ApaNe baiThe rahiNa ’te hI qhuza hana, uhanAM ne allAha dI rAha vica ApaNIAM jAnAM te mAlAM nAla jihAda karanA pasaMda nahIM kItA ate uhanAM ne (dUjiAM nUM vI) kihA ki ajihI saqhata garamI vica (jaMga laI) nA nikalo| (he nabI!) tusIM ihanAM nUM Akha dio ki naraka dI agga tAM (isa garamI toM kIte vaddha garama hai| kAza je uha samajhadAra huMde|
ihanAM nUM tAM cAhIdA hai ki iha bahuta hI ghaTTa hassaNa ate vaddha roNa kiuM jo uhanAM nUM uhanAM dIAM karatUtAM dA badalA milanA hai, jo uha kamAuMde sana|

(he nabI!) je allAha ihanAM (munAfikAM) vicAle tuhAnUM phera mur3a lai Ave ate je bhavikkha vica uhanAM ’coM koI TolI jihAda vica jANa laI tuhAthoM AgiA maMge tAM tusIM kahi dio ki tusIM mere saMga (jihAda laI) kade vI nahIM calla sakade ate nA hI mere nAla rala ke duzamanAM nAla lar3a sakade ho, tusIM tAM pahilAM baiThe rahiNa nUM pasaMda kItA hai so huNa vI tusIM picche rahiNa vAliAM nAla hI baiThe raho|

(he nabI!) je ihanAM (munAfikAM) viccoM koI mara jAve tAM tusIM uhanAM laI kade vI janAz2e dI namAz2a nahIM par3haNI ate nA hI usa dI kabara ’te (duA laI) khar3A hoNA hai| kiuM jo iha allAha ate usa de rasUla de inakArI hana ate marana vele vI uha jhUThe sI|

(he nabI!) tuhAnUM ihanAM dI dhana-daulata te aulAda kise dhokhe vica nA pA deve| allAha dI icchA iho hai ki ihanAM (kAfirAM) nUM ihanAM dIAM cIz2AM (mAla te aulAda) rAhIM (ise saMsAra vica) saz2A dittI jAve ate uhanAM de prANa kufara dI hAlata vica hI nikalaNa|

jadoM vI koI sUrata allAha ’te ImAna liAuNa dI ate usa de rasUla nAla mila ke jihAda karana dI uttaradI hai tAM ihanAM viccoM amIra loka tuhAnUM (jihAda toM chUTa laiNa laI) benatIAM karade hana ate kahiMde hana ki sAnUM tAM (gharAM ’ca) baiThaNa vAliAM nAla hI rahiNa dio|
ihanAM lokAM ne picche rahiNa vAlIAM z2anAnIAM nAla rahiNA pasaMda kItA hai ate allAha ne uhanAM de dilAM ’te mohara lA chaDDI hai, para uha iha samajhade hI nahIM|
paraMtU rasUla ate uhanAM de ImAna vAle sAthIAM ne ApaNIAM jAnAM te dhana padArathAM nAla jihAda kItA hai, sArIAM bhalAIAM ihanAM lokAM laI hana, iho safalatA prApata karana vAle hana|
ihanAM laI allAha ne uhanAM bAg2AM nUM tiAra kItA hai jinhAM heTha nahirAM vagadIAM hana| utthe hI uha sadA rahiNage, iho sabha toM vaDDI kAmayAbI hai|

baddUAM viccoM batheriAM ne bahAne ghar3he ki uhanAM (jaMga toM)nUM chuTTI dittI jAve tAM jo uha baiThe rahiNa| iha uha loka hana jinhAM ne allAha ate usa de rasUla nUM jhUTha boliA sI| iha jiMne vI kAfira hana ihanAM sabha nUM dukhadAI mAra pavegI|

kamaz2orAM, rogIAM ate buDDhiAM laI ate uhanAM laI jinhAM de palle qharaca karana nUM kujjha vI nahIM, uhanAM laI isa hAlata vica picche rahiNa vica kujha vI haraja nahIM, je uha allAha te usa de rasUla de zubha ciMtaka baNa ke rahiNa,[14] ajihe neka lokAM laI jihAda vica nA jANa ’te koI doza nahIM| allAha vaDDA baqhazaNahAra te miharAM vAlA hai|
translations.footnotes: [14] nabI (sa:) ne faramAiA ki dIna vica qhaira qhvAhI iqhalAsa te sacAI dA nAM hai ate iha allAha de laI ate usa de rasUla laI ate sameM de imAmAM laI ate Ama lokAM laI hai| (sahI musalima, hadIsa: 55) ● allAha de laI bhalAI dI cAhata rakhaNA iha hai ki usa de agge jhukiA jAve usa de hukamAM dI pAlaNA kItI jAve, usa de kalame nUM car3adI kalAM vica rakkhaNa laI jihAda kItA jAve| usa nAla muhabbata kItI jAve use toM DariA jAve| allAha de rasUla nAla bhalAI iha hai ki usa dI madada kItI jAve ate usa dI sunaMta dI pAlaNA kItI jAve| musalamAna hAkamAM dI bhalAI cAhuNA iha hai ki uhanAM dI sahAitA kItI jAve ki uha musalamAnAM dI sahI agavAI kara sakaNa| Ama musalamAnAM dI bhalAI cAhuNA iha hai ki uhanAM nUM nekI dA hukama dittA jAve ate burAI toM rokiA jAve ate uhanAM nAla naramAI ate muhabbata vAlA vivahAra hove|

translations.translation: hAM uhanAM laI vI (nA jANadA) koI doza nahIM jihar3e tuhADe valla isa laI Ae sI ki tusIM uhanAM laI kise savArI dA prabaMdha kara dio tAM tusIM Akhade ho ki maiM tuhADe laI kise savArI dA prabaMdha nahIM kara sakadA tAM uha aphasosa karade hoe ApaNIAM akkhAM vica haMjhU laike mur3a gae ki uhanAM kola (allAha dI rAha vica) qharaca karana laI kujjha vI nahIM|

(he nabI!) dozI tAM uha loka hana jihar3e daulatamaMda huMde hoe vI tuhAthoM (jaMga vica nA jANa) dI AgiA (chuTTI) maMgade hana ate iha gharAM vica z2anAnIAM nAla baiThaNA pasaMda karade hana|[15] ihanAM de dilAM ’te allAha ne moharAM lA chaDDIAM hana jisa nUM uha jANade vI nahIM|
translations.footnotes: [15] isa vica munAfikAM dA jihAda toM bacana dI caracA kItI gaI hai jisa toM patA caladA hai ki jihAda vica sahI arathAM vica uhIo hissA lai sakadA hai jisa nUM duniA dI cAhata nA hove| haz2arata abU-hurairA dA kahiNA hai ki maine nabI (sa:) nUM iha faramAuMde suniA ki ika nabI jihAda laI nikale tAM uhanAM ne ApaNI kauma nUM AkhiA ke mere nAla uha viakatI nA jAve jisa ne huNe huNe kise z2anAnI nAla viAha karavAiA hai ate uha aje taka ApaNI patanI nAla zarIrika saMbaMdha nahIM baNA sakiA ate uha iha saMbaMdha baNAuNA cAhuMdA hai| nA hI uha viakatI jAve jisa ne ghara baNAiA hai para aje usa dI chatta nahIM pAI| nA hI uha viakatI jAve jisa ne gabbhaNa uMThanIAM te bakarIAM qharIdIAM hana ate uha uhanAM de bacce jamaNNa dI Asa vica hai, phera uha jihAda vica cale gae| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 3124)

translations.translation: (he nabI!) jadoM tusIM ihanAM kola (jaMga) toM mur3a Auge, phera iha (munAfika) loka tuhADe haz2Ura bahAne peza karanage (he nabI!) tusIM Akha dio ki bahAne nA baNAo, asIM tuhADe ’te kade vI vizavAsa nahIM karAMge| allAha sAnUM tuhADe bAre sabha dasa cukkiA hai ate agge laI vI allAha te usa dA rasUla tuhADIAM karatUtAM vekha laiNage, tusIM use valla parate jAoge jihar3A gupata ate z2Ahira hara cIz2a jANana vAlA hai phera uha tuhAnUM dassa devegA jo tusIM (saMsAra vica) karade sI|

jadoM tusIM uhanAM de kola mur3a Avoge, phera huNa uha (munAfika) tuhADe sAhamaNe allAha dIAM kasamAM khA jANage tAM jo tusIM uhanAM nUM muAfa kara dio, so tusIM uhanAM toM aNadekhI hI karo| bezakka uha loka bahuta hI nA-pAka hana[16] ate uhanAM dA TikANA naraka hai, iha saz2A uhanAM dIAM karatUtAM kArana hai, jo uha karade sana|
translations.footnotes: [16] vekho sUrata ala-taubA, hAzIA Aita 28/9

translations.translation: uha tuhADe sAhamaNe isa laI kasamAM khANage tAM jo tusIM uhanAM toM rAz2I ho jAo| je tusIM (he nabI!) unhAM toM rAz2I ho vI jAo tAM allAha tAM ajihe lokAM toM rAz2I nahIM hovegA jihar3e nA-faramAna hana|

dehAtI loka inakAra te nifAka (doraMgI) vica vadhere karar3e hana, ihanAM dA iMja hoNA subhAvika hai kiuM jo ihanAM nUM uhanAM hukamAM dA giAna hI nahIM jihar3e allAha ne ApaNe rasUla ’te nAz2ila kIte hana| allAha bahuta hI giAna vAlA hai ate hikamata vAlA (sUjhavANa) hai|

ihanAM dehAtIAM viccoM kujjha ajihe vI hana ki uha jo vI allAha dI rAha vica qharaca karade hana usa nUM tAvAna (juramAnA) samajhade hana ate tuhADe musalamAnAM laI bure sameM laI uDIka vANa rahiNade hana jada ki burA sameM tAM ihanAM ’te hI AuNa vAlA hai| allAha hara galla suNana vAlA te jANana vAlA hai|

kujjha dehAtI ajihe vI hana jihar3e allAha ate kiAmata dihAr3e ’te vizavAsa rakhade hana ate jo vI qharaca karade hana usa nUM allAha de ner3e hoNa dA sAdhana samajhade hana ate rasUla dIAM duAvAM dA sAdhana samajhade hana| ihanAM dA (allAha dI rAha vica qharaca karanA z2arUra hI ner3atA dA sAdhana baNegA ate uhanAM nUM allAha z2arUra hI ApaNI rahimata vica dAqhala karegA| allAha baqhazaNahAra te miharAM vAlA hai|

(isalAma) kabUla karana vica pahila karana vAle mahAjara ate anasAra (sahAI) ate uha loka jinhAM ne neka dilI nAla uhanAM (allAha te rasUla) dI pairavI kItI, allAha uhanAM sabha toM rAz2I hoiA ate uha vI sAre usa (allAha) toM rAz2I ho gae| allAha ne uhanAM laI uha bAg2a tiAra kIte hoe hana, jinhAM de heTha nahirAM vaga rahIAM hana| utthe hI uha sadA rahiNage, iho asalI kAmayAbI hai|

tuhADe Ale-duAle jihar3e dehAtI (baddU) hana ihanAM viccoM kujjha munAfika hana ate kujjha madIne de vasanIka vI ApaNe nifAka (dogalepaNa) ’te ar3e hoe hana| (he nabI!) tusIM uhanAM nUM nahIM jANade, asIM uhanAM nUM jANade hAM, asIM chetI hI uhanAM nUM doharI saz2A diAMge, phera uha bahuta hI vaDDe az2Aba valla paratAe jANage|

kujjha ajihe vI hana jihar3e ApaNIAM g2alatIAM nUM savIkAra karade hana uhanAM ne rale mile kaMma kIte sI kujjha caMge vI te kujjha mAr3e vI| Asa hai ki allAha uhanAM dI taubA kabUla karegA|[17] bezakka allAha baqhazaNahAra ate miharAM vAlA hai|
translations.footnotes: [17] isa hadIsa vica isa Aita dI viAkhiA iMja kItI gaI hai ki allAha de rasUla ne faramAiA ika rAta mere kola do farizate Ae ate mainUM jagA ke ajihe zahira vala lai gae jihar3A sone ate cAMdI dIAM iTTAM nAla usAriA hoiA sI| utthe sAnUM ajihe loka mile jinhAM de addhe zarIra disaNa vica suhaNe lagade sI ate addhe bher3e| farizatiAM ne uhanAM nUM kihA ki isa nahira vica dAqhila ho jAo so uha usa vica dAqhila ho gae jadoM uha vApisa Ae tAM uhanAM dI badasUratI qhatama ho cukkI sI ate uha bahuta hI sohaNe baNa gae sI| farizatiAM ne mainUM AkhiA ki iha bAg2e adana hai ate iho tuhADA nivAsa sathAna hai| phera uhanAM farizatiA ne kihA ki iha loka jinhAM de addhe zarIra sohaNe sI ate addhe bher3e sI iha ajihe loka sI jihar3e caMge ate mAr3e donA tarhAM de kaMma karade sI para allAha ne uhanAM nUM muAfa kara dittA| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa 4674)

translations.translation: (he nabI!) tusIM uhanAM de mAlAM viccoM sadakA lavo ate (isa duArA) uhanAM nUM pavittara karo ate nekI dI rAha vica uhanAM nUM vadhAo ate uhanAM laI duA vI karo| nirasaMdeha, tuhADI kItI hoI duA uhanAM laI mana dI zAMtI dA sAdhana hai| allAha caMgI tarhAM suNadA te jANadA hai|
kI iha nahIM jANade ki allAha hI ApaNe baMdiAM dI duA kabUla karadA hai ate uhIo sadake (puna-dAna) kabUla karadA hai| bezakka allAha hI taubA nUM kabUla karana vAlA ate rahima karana vAlA hai|

(he nabI!) tusIM Akha dio! ki tusIM amalAM karade raho| tuhADe amalAM nUM allAha Apa hI vekha lavegA ate usa dA rasUla ’te ImAna vAle vI vekha laiNage ate tusIM z2arUra hI use valla paratAe jAoge, jihar3A sArIAM hI lukkIAM ate khullhIAM hoIAM gallAM nUM jANadA hai| so uha tuhAnUM tuhADA sArA kItA kariA dassa devegA|

ate kujjha uha loka hana jinhAM dA mAmalA ajihe allAha de hukama ’te AuNa taka picche pA dittA hai| uha jAM tAM uhanAM nUM saz2A devegA jAM uhanAM dI taubA kabUla kara levegA| allAha bhalI-bhAMta jANana vAlA te sUjhavAna hai|

kujjha loka uha vI hana jinhAM ne isa laI masIta baNavAI sI tAM jo (musalamAnAM nUM) nukasAna pahuMcAuNa, kufara nUM vadhAuNa ate musalamAnAM vica phuTTa pAuNa ate usa viakatI laI ghAta dA prabaMdha karana jihar3A isa toM pahilAM allAha ate usa de rasUla de viruddha lar3a cukkiA hai| uha kasamAM khA khA ke AkhaNage ki sADA irAdA tAM bhalAI karanA sI| allAha gavAhI diMdA hai ki bezakka uha ukkA hI jhUThe hana|

(he nabI!) tusIM usa masIta (bhAva masajide z2arrAra) vica kade vI khar3e nA hoNA| hAM! jisa masIta dI nIMha pahile hI dina toM takave ’te (bhAva neka niyyatI) nAla rakkhI gaI hove, uhI (masIta) isa yoga hai ki usa vica tusIM (namAz2a laI) khar3e hovo, isa vica ajihe loka vI hana jihar3e pAka rahiNA pasaMda karade hana| allAha vI pAka rahiNa vAliAM nUM hI pasaMda karadA hai|

kI uha viakatI vadhIA hai jisa ne ApaNI imArata dI nIMha allAha de Dara-bhai ate usa dI raz2A laI rakkhI hove jAM uha viakatI jisa ne ApaNI imArata dI nIMha kise dariA de kaMDe ’te rakkhI hove, jihar3I DiggaNa vAlI hove, phira uha usa nUM laike naraka dI agga vica Diga jAve| allAha ajihe z2AlamAM nUM samajha nahIM diMdA|
uhanAM dI usArI hoI imArata sadA laI uhanAM de manAM vica (kaMDA baNake) cubadI rahegI, je uhanAM de dila hI ToTe-ToTe ho jANa tAM galla hai| allAha sabha kujjha jANana vAlA te sUjhavAna hai|

bezakka allAha ne musalamAnAM toM uhanAM dIAM jAnAM ate mAlAM nUM jaMnata de badale qharIda liA hai| uhI lokI allAha dI rAha vica lar3ade hana, uha katala karade vI hana te katala huMde vI hana| isa laI (jaMnata dA) vAadA kItA giA hai, jihar3A tauraita iMjIla te.kuraAna viccoM hai| allAha toM vaddha ke ApaNe vAade nUM pUrA karana vAlA kauNa hai| so (he musalamAno!) jihar3A tusIM allAha nAla saudA kItA hai isa laI qhuzIAM manAo te iho vaDDI safalatA hai|[18]
translations.footnotes: [18] isa vicca jahAdI muhattatA dassI gaI hai allAha de rasUla ne faramAiA jihar3A viakatI allAha dI rAha vica jahAda karadA hai ate allAha dI rAha vica jahAda ate usa de kalame dI puzaTI karana utte usa nUM gharoM kaDiA giA tAM allAha usa dA z2Amana baNa jAMdA hai phera jAM tAM usa nUM jaMnata vica dAqhila karegA jAM caMgA badalA ate mAle g2anImata deke usa de nivAsa sathAna takka pahuMcA devegA jithe uha AiA sI| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa 3123) ● ise tarhAM jihar3A koI jihAda nahIM karadA tAM usa de laI karar3I cetAvanI hai| nabI (sa:) ne faramAiA ki jihar3A koI jihAda nahIM karadA tAM allAha usa utte z2illata bhArU kara diMdA hai| ate uha z2illata usa toM haTAI nahIM jAvegI| ithoM takka ki tusIM ApaNe dIna isalAma valla mur3a Au| (abU dAUda, hadIsa 3462)

translations.translation: iha loka taubA karana vAle, ibAdata karana vAle, rabba dI prasaMzA karana vAle, roz2AM rakkhaNa vAle, caMgIAM gallAM dI sikkhiA deNa vAle, burIAM gallAM toM rokaNa vAle ate allAha dIAM haddA dI rAkhI karana vAle hana| (he nabI!) ajihe mominAM nUM (jaMnatAM dIAM) qhuzaqhabarIAM suNA dio|

nabI ate dUje musalamAnAM laI iha galla jAiz2a nahIM ki muzarikAM laI rabba toM baqhaziza dI duA karana bhAveM uha uhanAM de sake-saMbaMdhI hI kiuM nA hoNa jada ki iha galla sapazaTa ho cukkI hai ki uha lokI narakI hana|

rahI galla ibarAhIma dA ApaNe pitA laI khimA dI duA maMgaNa dI uha tAM kevala ika vacana sI jihar3A (ibarAhIma) ne usa nAla kara liA sI| jadoM usa ne ’te iha galla zapazzaTa ho gaI ki uha tAM allAha dA duzamana hai tAM uha (ibarAhIma ApaNe pitA toM) abAz2Ara ho giA|[19] hakIkata iho hai ki ibarAhIma bahuta hI kaumala hirade vAlA te bahuta hI sahiNazIla viakatI sI|
translations.footnotes: [19] vekho sUrata ala-anAma, hAzIA Aita 74/6

translations.translation: allAha ajihA nahIM karadA ki kise kauma nUM hidAita deNa toM bAada gumarAha kara deve jadoM taka ki uhanAM nUM uha sArIAM gallAM nUM sapazaTa rUpa vica dassa nA deve jinhAM toM bacaNA cAhIdA hai|[20] bezakka allAha hareka cIz2a nUM caMgI tarhAM jANadA hai|
translations.footnotes: [20] isa toM AlamAM ne iha siddha kItA hai ki sapazaTa dalIla toM kise musalamAna nUM kAfira nahIM kahiNA cAhIdA|

translations.translation: bezakka allAha hI dharatI te akAzAM dA mAlika hai, uhIo jIvana te mauta diMdA hai ate allAha toM chuTTa tuhADA hora koI nA sAthI hai nA hI madadagAra hai|

allAha ne nabI (sa:) dA ate unhAM muhAjarAM te anasArAM (sahAika) dA vizeza dhiAna rakkhiA hai, kiuM jo uhanAM ne bar3e aukhe sameM nabI dA sAtha dittA, bhAveM ki bAada vica uhanAM viccoM ika TolI de dila Dola rahe sana, para allAha ne phera vI uhanAM ’te kripA kItI| bezakka uha uhanAM ’te bahuta hI miharabAna te rahima faramAuNa vAlA hai|

allAha ne uhanAM tiMnAM nUM vI muAfa kara dittA jinhAM dA mAmalA rabbI hukamAM dI uDIka vica picche pA dittA giA sI, itthoM taka ki dharatI ApaNI sArI vizAlatA hoNa de bAvajUda uhanAM laI taMga ho gaI sI (bhAva choTI ho gaI sI) ate uhanAM de prANa vI uhanAM ’te bhAra baNe hoe sI ate uhanAM ne iha samajha liA sI ki huNa allAha toM bacaNa laI chuTTa usa dI miharAM toM koI zarana-asathAna nahIM| allAha ne uhanAM valla dhiAna dittA tAM jo agge laI taubA kara sakaNa| bezakka allAha bahuta taubA kabUla karana vAlA te rahima karana vAlA hai|
he ImAna vAlio! allAha toM Daro ate sacce lokAM dA hI sAtha dio|[21]
translations.footnotes: [21] allAha de nabI ne faramAiA ki bezakka saccAI nekI valla hidAita karadI hai ate nekI jaMnata vala laike jAMdI hai ate AdamI sacca boladA rahiMdA hai| ithoM takka ki saciAdA baNa jAMdA hai ate jhUTha gunAha valla laike jAMdA hai ate naraka valla pahuMcA diMdA hai| jihar3A viakatI jhUTha boladA rahiMdA hai uha allAha kola jhUThA likha ditA jAMdA hai| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa 6094)

translations.translation: madIne de vasanIka te Ale-duAle de badUAM nUM iha ukkA hI zobhadA nahIM sI ki uha (jihAda vica) allAha de rasUla toM picche rahi jANa ate nA hI iha (zobhadA hai) ki ApaNI jAnAM nUM nabI dI jAna toM vaddha piArIAM samajhaNa| iha isa laI ki iha uha (loka) hana jihar3e allAha dI rAha vica bhukkhe piAse te thakeveM sahiNa karade hana ate ajihe rAhAM nUM pairAM nAla puTTade hana jihar3e sacca de inakArIAM nUM bahuta hI bhair3I jApadI hai ate vairIAM toM jihar3I vI safalatA prApata karade hana usa de badale uhanAM laI neka karama likhe jAMde hana| bezakka allAha kola paraupakArIAM dA sevA phala mAriA nahIM jAMdA|

ate jo vI thor3hA jAM bahutA qharaca karade hana ate uha jihar3I vI ghATI (lar3ade hoe) pAra karade hana uha sabha kujjha uhanAM de nAM likha dittA jAMdA hai tAM jo allAha uhanAM nUM uhanAM de kaMmAM dA vadhIA badalA deve|[22]
translations.footnotes: [22] isa vicca allAha de faz2alAM dI caracA kItI gaI hai jo uha nekI dA badalA diMde sameM iqhatiAra karadA hai ki hara neka kaMma karana ’te dasa toM lai ke sata so guNA takka savAba miladA hai ate je uha koI burA kaMma karadA hai tAM ika hI guNA giNiA jAMdA hai ate ho sakadA hai ki allAha usa nUM mAfa kara deve| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa 41)

translations.translation: ate mominAM nUM nahIM cAhIdA ki uha sAre de sAre (jaMga laI) Tura paiNa| uhanAM de hara kabIle viccoM ika TolI dIna dI sUjha-bUjha prApata karana laI kiuM nahIM nikale| jadoM iha loka ApaNI kauma de kola AuNa tAM uhanAM nUM sAvadhAna karana tAM ate ApaNe picche rahiNa vAliAM nUM rabba toM DarAuNa|
he ImAna vAlio! tusIM uhanAM kAfirAM nAla lar3o jihar3e tuhADe Ale-duAle hana ate cAhIdA hai ki uha tuhADe vica karar3AI vekhaNa| sacca maMno ki allAha parahez2agAra lokAM dA hI sAthI hai|

jadoM vI koI sUrata uttaradI hai tAM ihanAM munAfikAM vica kujjha loka makhaula vajoM musalamAnAM toM) pucchade ki isa sUrata ne kisa de ImAna vica vAdhA kItA hai? jihar3e tAM ImAna vAle hana hareka sUrata ne uhanAM de ImAna vica vAdhA kItA hai ate uha isa toM qhuza vI hana|
para jinhAM de manAM vica kappaTa dA roga hai hara uttarana vAlI sUrata uhanAM de manAM dI gaMdagI vica vAdhA kara diMdI hai ate uha kufara dI hAlata vica hI mara jANage|
kI iha (kAfira) loka nahIM vekhade ki sAla vica ika jAM do vAra uhanAM dI parakha kItI jAMdI hai| phera vI nA iha taubA karade hana tAM nA hI koI nasIhata grahiNa karade hana|

jadoM koI sUrata nAz2ila huMdI hai tAM iha akkhAM-akkhAM vica hI ika dUje nUM vekhade hana ki uhanAM nUM koI vekhadA tAM nahIM phera malakkar3e jihe Tura paiMde hana| allAha ne ihanAM de dilAM nUM (saccAI) toM phera dittA hai kiuM jo iha besamajha hana|

(he loko!) tuhADe kola ika ajihA paig2aMbara A giA hai jihar3A tuhADe hI viccoM hai, jihar3A tuhAnUM hANa vica vekhake bar3A dukhI huMdA hai, usa nUM tuhADI bhalAI dI vadhere lAlasA hai ate ImAna vAliAM laI ati kaumala citta te rahima faramAuNa vAlA hai|

(he nabI!) je phera vI uha tuhAthoM mUMha mor3aNa tAM tusIM kahi dio ki mere laI tAM merA allAha hI batherA hai isa toM chuTTa hora koI izaTa nahIM| maiMne usa ’te hI bharosA kItA hai ate uhIo mahAna rAja-ziMghAsana dA mAlika hai
alifa, lAma, rA| iha AitAM (Adeza) hikamata (DugghI siANapa) vAlI kitAba (.kuraAna) dIAM hana|

kI iha (makke de) lokAM nUM isa galla dI hairAnI hai ki asIM uhanAM viccoM hI ika viakatI (haz2arata muhaMmada) kola ApaNI vahI bhejI[1] ki uha sAre lokAM nUM (rabba de az2Aba toM) DarAve ate jihar3e ImAna lai AuNa uhanAM nUM (savaragAM dIAM) qhuzaqhabarIAM suNAve| bezakka uhanAM de rabba kola uhanAM laI hakka-sacca (nUM maMnaNa vAliAM) dA uccA maratabA hai, para kAfira Akhade hana ki iha viakatI (muhaMmada sa:) tAM ika jAdUgara hai|
translations.footnotes: [1] vekho sUrata ana-nisA, hAzIA Aita 163/4

translations.translation: hakIkata iha hai ki tuhADA sabhanAM dA pAlaNahAra uha allAha hI hai jisa ne akAza te dharatI nUM che dinAM vica sAjiA ’te phera araza ’te virAjamAna ho giA| uhIo hara prakAra dI hidAita dA prabaMdha karadA hai usa dI AgiA toM binAM koI usa de kola sifAraza nahIM kara sakadA| uhI tAM allAha tuhADA pAlaNahAra hai| so tusIM sAre use dI ibAdata karo| kI tusIM kujjha vI nasIhata prApata nahIM karade?

tusIM sabha ne use (allAha) valla hI parataNA hai| allAha dA iho vAadA hai jo saccA hai| bezakka pahilAM vI uhIo paidA karadA hai phera dubArA (marana magaroM) vI uhIo jiUMdA karegA tAM jo jihar3e loka (allAha ’te ate usa de rasUla ’te) ImAna lai Ae uhanAM nUM uhanAM valloM kIte neka kaMmAM dA inasAfa anusAra badalA dittA jAve ate jinhAM ne kufara (inakAra) kItA hai, uhanAM nUM naraka vica pINa laI ubbaladA pANI milegA ate karar3A az2Aba hovegA| iha sabha (saz2AvAM) uhanAM de kufara kArana hovegA|

uhIo hai jisa ne sUraja nUM camakadAra baNAiA ate caMna nUM nUra dittA ate isa (caMna de ghaTaNa vadhaNa) dIAM maMz2ilAM nizacita kItIAM tAM jo tusIM loka varhiAM dI giNatI (te mitIAM) dA hisAba kara sako| allAha ne iha sabha hakka nAla sAjiA hai| uha (allAha) ApaNIAM nizAnIAM nUM visathAra nAla uhanAM laI peza kara rihA hai, jihar3e samajha bUjha rakkhade hana|

bezakka rAta ate dina de agge-picche AuNa vica ate allAha ne jo kujjha vI akAzAM te dharatI vica paidA kItA hai, usa vica uhanAM lokAM laI (rabba nUM maMNana laI) dalIlAM hana jihar3e burAIAM toM bacaNA cAhuMde hana|
jinhAM lokAM nUM sADe nAla milaNa dI Asa nahIM uha saMsArika jIvana utte hI rAz2I hana ate isa vica hI saMtuzaTa hana ate sADIAM AitAM (hukamAM) toM aNagahilIAM karade hana|
ajihe lokAM dA TikANA naraka hai, uhanAM burAIAM de badale vica jihar3IAM uha karade sana|

jihar3e loka (rabba ate rasUlAM ’te) ImAna liAe ate uhanAM ne caMge kaMma vI kIte uhanAM dA rabba uhanAM de ImAna kArana uhanAM nUM niamatAM bhare bAg2AM vica pahuMcA devegA jinhAM de heTha nahirAM vaga rahIAM hoNagIAM|

isa (jaMnata) vica uha pukAraNage, he allAha! tUM (hara aiba) toM pAka hai| uhanAM dI duA salAmatI vAlI hovegI ate aMta vica iho AkhaNage ki sArIAM tArIfAM usa allAha laI hana jihar3A sArI srizaTI dA rabba hai|

jekara allAha lokAM nUM burAI (az2Aba) deNa vica vI chetI karadA, jiveM uha (saMsArika) lAbha laI chetI karade hana, tAM uhanAM dA nizacita samAM kadoM dA pUrA ho giA huMdA| so asIM uhanAM lokAM nUM jinhAM nUM sADe kola AuNa dA vizavAsa nahIM, uhanAM de hAla ’te hI chaDDa diMde hAM tAM jo ApaNI sarakazI vica bhaTakade phirade rahiNa|

jadoM manukkha nUM koI takalIfa musIbata (bipatA) pahuMcadI hai tAM uha sAnUM khar3e, baiThe ate piA piA benatIAM karadA hai| jadoM asIM (allAha) usa dI takalIfa (bipatA) nUM dUra kara diMde hAM tAM uha iMja ho jAMdA hai jiveM usa nUM takalIfa hoNa ’te kade sAnUM saddiA hI nahIM sI| isa tarhAM haddoM TappaNa vAliAM de (bhair3e) amalAM nUM uhanAM laI sohaNA jApadA baNA dittA giA hai|

(he loko!) asIM tuhAthoM pahilAM kaIAM kaumAM nUM halAka kara cukke hAM, kiuM jo uha rasUlAM nAla z2ulama karade sI| jada ki uha paig2aMbara uhanAM kola (rabba valloM nabI hoNa dIAM) nizAnIAM vI lai ke Ae para uha phera vI ImAna nahIM liAe asIM ise tarhAM z2AlamAM nUM saz2A diA karade hAM|
phera uhanAM magaroM asIM tuhAnUM dharatI dA qhalIfA (jAna-nazIna) baNAiA tAM jo asIM vekhIe ki tusIM kI karade ho?

ate jadoM uhanAM de sAhamaNe sADIAM sapazaTa (.kuraAna dIAM) AitAM par3hIAM jAMdIAM hana tAM uha lokI jinhAM nUM (marana magaroM) sADe nAla milaNa dI Asa nahIM uha Akhade hana ki isa.kuraAna nUM chaDDa ke koI hora.kuraAna liAo jAM isa vica kujjha badalAo karo| (he muhaMmada sa:!) tusIM Akha dio ki mainUM iha adhikAra nahIM ki maiM isa (.kuraAna) vica ApaNe valloM koI tabadIlI kara sakAM, maiM tAM usa (.kuraAna) dI pairavI karadA hAM jihar3I vahI mere valla bhejI jAMdI hai| je maiM (bhAva muhaMmada:) ApaNe rabba dI nA-faramAnI karAMgA tAM mainUM usa vaDDe (kiAmata) dihAr3e de az2Aba toM Dara laggadA hai|

(he nabI!) tusIM Akho ki je allAha dI icchA iho huMdI tAM nA maiM tuhAnUM iha (.kuraAna) par3ha ke suNAuMdA ate nA hI allAha tuhAnUM isa bAre koI jANakArI diMdA| maiM tAM (isa.kuraAna suNAuNa toM pahilAM vI) tuhADe vica ika umara bitA cukkiA hAM| kI tusIM akala toM kaMma nahIM laiMde?
usa viakatI toM vaDDA z2Alama hora kauNa hovegA jihar3A allAha ’te jhUTha ghar3e jAM usa dIAM AitAM (.kuraAna) nUM jhUTha dasse? bezakka aparAdhIAM nUM kade vI safalatA nahIM miladI|

ate iha (muzarika) allAha nUM chaDDa ke uhanAM dI pUjA karade hana jihar3e nA ihanAM nUM koI hAnI pahuMcA sakade hana te nA hI koI lAbha puhaMcA sakaNa, ate Akhade iha hana ki iha (sADe izaTa) allAha kola sADI ziphAraza karanage| (he nabI!) tusIM kahi dio, kI tusIM allAha nUM uha gallAM dasa rahe ho jinhAM nUM uha nA akAzAM vica jANadA hai te nA hI dharatI vica? uha (allAha) pAka te uccA hai, uhanAM toM jinhAM nUM usa dA zarIka baNAuMde hana|

pahilAM sAre hI lokI ika hI ummata (garoha) sI[2] phera ihanAM vica matabheda ho gae| je tuhADe rabba valloM pahilAM hI ika galla nizacita nA kItI huMdI tAM jinhAM gallAM vica (bhAva ika rabba dI hoMda vica, rasUlAM vica te kiAmata de dihAr3e vica) iha matabbheda kara rahe hana, usa dA faisalA kadoM dA ho giA huMdA|
translations.footnotes: [2] hara viakatI hidAita utte paidA huMdA hai| bhAva sAre hI ika ummata hana, jiveM hadIsa toM siddha huMdA hai ki nabI (sa:) ne pharamAiA ki hara baccA phitarata (prakitI) utte paidA huMdA hai, phira usa de mApe usa nUM yahUdI, nasarAnI jAM majUsI baNA diMde hana| jiveM ika jAnavara sahI salAmata baccA jaNadA hai, kI tusIM usa de kaMna vaDDe hoe vekhade ho? (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa:1385)

translations.translation: iha kAfira loka Akhade hana ki isa (muhaMmada sa:) ’te rabba valloM (nabI hoNa dI) koI nizAnI kiuM nahIM utArI gaI? tAM (he nabI!) tusIM Akha dio ki g2aiba (parokha) dA giAna tAM kevala allAha nUM hI hai, so tusIM vI uDIka karo maiM vI uDIka karadA hAM|

jadoM asIM uhanAM (kAfirAM) nUM kise bipatA magaroM ApaNI mihara dA suAda cakhAuMde hAM tAM uha jhaTTa sADIAM AitAM (hukamAM) pratI cAlabAz2IAM zurU kara diMde hana|[3] (he nabI!) uhanAM nUM Akho ki allAha tuhAthoM kIte vaddha cAlAM callaNa vica tez2a hai| bezakka sADe farizate tuhADIAM sArIAM cAlabAz2IAM nUM likha rahe hana|
translations.footnotes: [3] vekho sUrata ala-anAma, hAzIA Aita 66/6

translations.translation: uha allAha hI hai jihar3A tuhAnUM thala te jala vica toradA hai itthoM taka ki jadoM tusIM kizatIAM vica huMde ho ate uha ber3IAM lokAM nUM havAM de anukUla laike caladIAM hana ate tAM usa vele ihanAM (havAvAM) toM sAre loka qhuza huMde hana| para acaNaceta uhanAM utte ika tez2a havA dA jhakkhar3a AuMdA hai ate hara pAsioM uhanAM ’te lahirAM dIAM caper3AM paiNa laggadIAM hana ate iha samajhade hana ki huNa asIM (tUphAna vica) phasa gae, usa sameM sAre hI savAra kevala te kevala allAha nUM hI benatIAM karade hana ki je tUM sA` isa bipatA toM bacA laveM tAM asIM tere zukara guz2Ara baMde baNake rahAMge|[4]
translations.footnotes: [4] vekho sUrata banI isarAIla, hAzIA Aita 67/17

translations.translation: jadoM uha (allAha) uhanAM nUM bacA laiMdA hai tAM phera uhIo loka dharatI utte aNahakkI sarakazI karana lagga jAMde hana| he loko! tuhADI iha sarakazI tuhADe ApaNe hI viruddha hai, tusIM saMsArika jIvana dA AnaMda mANo ate tusIM sADe valla hI parata ke AuNA hai usa sameM asIM dassAMge ki tusIM kI karade sI|

saMsArika jIvana dI misAla tAM mIMha vAMga hai, jisa nUM asIM akAza toM barasAiA jisa toM dharatI dI paidAvAra hoI jisa nUM manukkha te pazU khAMde hana| jadoM dharatI ApaNI bahAra te AI ate fasalAM tiAra khalotIAM sana ate dharatI de mAlikAM ne samajhiA ki huNa uha isa (fasala toM lAbha uThAuNa) de samaratha hana tAM sADA hukama (az2Aba dA) rAtI jAM dine acaNaceta A giA ate asIM usa nUM iU nazaTa kara dittA jiveM kulla utthe kujjha hai hI nahIM sI| asIM ApaNIAM AitAM (nizAnIAM) nUM ise tarhAM kholha-kholha ke biAna karade hAM, uhanAM lokAM laI jihar3e sUjha-bUjha rakkhade hana|
allAha salAmatI vAle ghara (bhAva jaMnata) valla tuhAnUM bulAuMdA hai ate jisa nUM vI cAhuMdA hai siddhe rAha pA diMdA hai|

jinhAM ne nekIAM kItIAM hana uhanAM laI bhalAI hI bhalAI hai te (dIdAre IlAhI varage) hora vI vadhere inAma hana| uhanAM de cihariAM ’te koI kAlakha te rusavAI nahIM hovegI| iho loka jaMnatI hana jitthe uha sadA laI rahiNageM|

ate jinhAM ne bhair3e kaMma kIte uhanAM nUM burAI dA badalA use burAI de barAbara hI milegA ate hINatA uhanAM ’te chAI hoI hovegI| uhanAM nUM allAha de az2Aba toM bacAuNa vAlA koI nahIM hovegA| iMja laggegA jiveM uhanAM de cihariAM ’te rAta de kAle par3ade pae hoe hoNa| iho loka narakI hana jitthe uha sadA laI rahiNage|

uha dina jadoM asIM sAriAM nUM ikaTThA karAMge phera muzarikAM nUM kahAMge ki tusIM te tuhADe zarIka ApaNI-ApaNI thAM ’te Thahiro phera asIM uhanAM vicAle judAI pA diAMge ate uhanAM de zarIka AkhaNage ki tusIM sADI ibAdata nahIM sI karade|
iha vI AkhaNage ki sADe te tuhADe vicAle allAha dI gavAhI hI batherI hai| asIM (izaTa) tAM tuhADI ibAdata toM ukkA hI beqhabara hAM|

usa vele hara viakatI ApaNe (saMsAra vica) kIte hoe kaMmAM dI jAMca kara lavegA ate iha sAre hI loka allAha valla, jihar3A sabha dA asalI mAlika hai, paratAe jANage ate jo kujjha vI uha (rabba te rasUla utte) jhUTha ghar3hiA karade sI, usa sabha alopa ho jANage|

he nabI! tusIM Akho ki uha kauNa hai jihar3A tuhAnUM akAza te dharatI ’coM roz2I diMdA hai? jAM uha kauNa hai jihar3A akkhAM te kaMnAM dA mAlika hai? ate uha kauNa hai jihar3A jAnadArAM ’coM bejAna ate bejAnAM ’coM jAnadAra nUM kaDDhadA hai? uha kauNa hai jihar3A sAre kaMmAM dI biUMta baNAuMdA hai? uha (kAfira) z2arUra hI iho AkhaNage ki allAha| tAM (he nabI!) ihanAM nUM Akho ki phera tusIM (allAha toM) Darade kiuM nahIM?
so iho allAha hai jihar3A tuhADA saccA mAlika hai| isa saccAI magaroM chuTTa gumarAhI toM hora kI rahi giA hai? phera tusIM kiddhara phirI jAMde hai?
(he nabI!) ise tarhAM tuhADe rabba dI iha galla ki nA-faramAna loka ImAna nahIM liAuNage sAre hI jhUThe lokAM pratI sacca sAbita ho gaI hai|

(he nabI!) tusIM iha puccho kI tuhADe thApe hoe zarIkAM viccoM kauNa hai jihar3A pahilI vAra racanA kare ate mur3a dubArA use dI racanA kare? tusIM Akha dio ki pahilI vAra vI allAha hI racanA karadA hai, mur3a dubArA vI uhIo racanA karegA| tusIM kihar3e puTThe rAha ture firade ho?

(he nabI!) tusIM (ihanAM muzarikAM toM) puccho, kI tuhADe zarIkAM viccoM koI hai jihar3A hakka sacca dI hidAita diMdA hove? Akha dio ki allAha hakka dI hidAita diMdAM hai| phera kI uha jihar3A hakka dI hidAita diMdA hai uha isa galla dA adhikAra rakkhadA hai ki usa dI pairavI kItI jAve? jAM uha (hakkadAra)hai jihar3A Apa hI rAhoM bhuliA hove? sagoM use nUM hakka dI nasIhata kItI jAve| tuhAnUM kI ho giA hai tusIM kiho jihe (g2alata) faisale karade ho?

ate uhanAM kAfirAM viccoM bahute tAM gumAna (aTakala paccU qhiAla) de hI picche lagge rahiMde hana| jada ki gumAna hakIkata de mukAbale kujjha vI lAbhadAika nahIM| bezakka allAha uha sabha caMgI tarhAM jANadA hai jo kujjha uha kara rahe hana|

iha.kuraAna ajihA nahIM ki allAha dI (vahI) toM binAM hI (ApaNe koloM) ghar3ha liA hove, sagoM iha tAM (uhanAM kitAbAM dI) puzaTI karadA hai jihar3IAM isa toM pahilAM (rabba valloM) utArIAM jA cukkIAM hana ate uhanAM sArIAM kitAbAM dI visathAra pUravaka jANakArI deNa vAlI kitAba hai| isa vica koI zakka nahIM ki iha (.kuraAna) sAre jahAnAM de rabba valloM hai|[5]
translations.footnotes: [5] isa toM bhAva kuraAna hai| ika hadIsa vica nabI (sa:) ne isa kuraAna nUM ApaNA sabha toM vaDDA moajaz2A AkhiA hai, pharamAiA ki hara nabI nUM ajihe moajaz2e ditte gae jinhAM kArana lokAM nUM ImAna nasIba hoiA ate mainUM jihar3A moajaz2A baqhaziA giA hai uha rabbI vahI hai, jo allAha ne mere utte utArI hai| so mainUM Asa hai ki kiAmata dihAr3e mere pairokAra sabha toM vaddha hoNage| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 7274)

translations.translation: kI iha (kAfira) loka Akhade hana ki paig2aMbara ne isa (.kuraAna) nUM ghar3ha liA hai? (he muhaMmada sa:!) Akho ki ratA tusIM ajihI ika sUrata hI baNA liAo ate jinhAM (izaTAM) nUM, chuTTa allAha toM, madada laI bulA sakade ho bulA lao, je tusIM sacce ho|

sagoM uhanAM ne usa cIz2a (.kuraAna) nUM jhuThalAiA hai jisa nUM iha ApaNe giAna de ghere vica nahIM liA sakade, ate aje taka jisa dI hakIkata vI ihanAM de sAhamaNe pragaTa nahIM hoI| jihar3e ihanAM (kAfirAM) toM pahilAM lokI hoe sana, ise prakAra uhanAM ne vI (rabbI kitAbAM nUM) jhuThalAiA sI| so vekha lavo, uhanAM z2AlamAM dA aMta kiho jihA hoiA sI|
he nabI! ihanAM lokAM viccoM kujjha tAM ajihe hana jihar3e (isa.kuraAna utte) ImAna liAuNage ate kujjha ajihe hana jihar3e ImAna nahIM liAuNage| tuhADA rabba fasAdIAM nUM caMgA tarhAM jANadA hai|
(he nabI!) jekara uha tuhAnUM jhuThalAuNa tAM unhAM nUM Akho ki merA amala (karanI) mere laI hai, tuhADA amala tuhADe laI hai| tusIM mere amalAM toM barI ho te maiM tuhADe amalAM toM barI hAM|
ihanAM viccoM kujjha ajihe vI hana jihar3e tuhADIAM gallAM dhiAna nAla suNade hana kI tusIM (he muhaMmada sa:!) boliAM nUM suNA sakade ho bhAveM uhanAM nUM akala hI nA hove?
ate ihanAM viccoM kujjha uha vI hana jihar3e tuhADe valla vekha rahe hana| kI tusIM aMniAM nUM rAha vikhA sakade ho? bhAveM uhanAM nUM vikhAI vI nA diMdA hove|
bezakka allAha lokAM ’te z2ulama nahIM karadA lokI tAM ApaNe ’te Apa hI z2ulama karade hana|

uhanAM nUM uha velA vI cete karavAo jadoM allAha ihanAM sabha nUM (ApaNe haz2Ura) ikaTThA karegA (tAM iha samajhaNage) ki jiveM uha saMsAra vica dina dIAM kujjha ghar3IAM toM vaddha nahIM rahe hoNage ate Apasa vica ika dUje nUM pachANa laiNage| hakIkata vica uhIo loka, jinhAM ne allAha dI milaNI nUM jhUTha samajhiA, ghATe vica rahiNage ate uha iha hidAita pAuNa vAle nahIM sI|

jisa (az2Aba) dA vAadA asIM (ihanAM kAfirAM nAla) kara rahe hAM, (he muhaMmada) je asIM usa viccoM thor3hA jihA az2Aba tuhADe jiUMde jI tuhAnUM vikhA dAIe jAM usa toM pahilAM tuhAnUM uThA laIe hara hAla vica uhanAM ne sADe valla hI parataNA hai| allAha uhanAM dIAM sArIAM karatUtAM dA gavAha hai|

hara ummata (kauma) dA ika rasUla hai, jadoM usa (kauma) dA rasUla A jAMdA hai tAM uhanAM dA faisalA (uhanAM de karamAM anusAra) inasAfa nAla kItA jAMdA hai uhanAM nAla kise prakAra dA dhakkA nahIM kItA jAMdA|
iha (kAfira) loka Akhade hana ki iha (az2Aba dA) vAadA kadoM pUrA hovegA? je tusIM sacce ho? (tAM dasso)|

(he nabI!) tusIM kahi dio ki mere hattha vica kise tarhAM dA lAbha jAM hAnI pahuMcAuNa dA adhikAra nahIM| uhIo huMdA hai jo allAha dI icchA huMdI hai| hara ummata laI ika samAM (dharatI utte vasaNa dA) niyata hai jadoM uhanAM dA niyata samAM A jAMdA hai tAM ika ghar3I vI agge-picche nahIM ho sakadI|
(he nabI!) tusIM puccho ki je tuhADe ’te allAha dA az2Aba acanaceta rAtIM jAM dinIM A jAve tAM tusIM kI karoge? kihar3I cIz2a hai jisa laI aparAdhI loka chetI kara rahe hana?
kI jadoM uha (az2Aba) tuhADe ’te A paegA tusIM phera ImAna liAuMge? (usa sameM kihA jAvegA, kI ImAna huNa liAe ho?) jada ki isa (az2Aba) laI tusIM chetI kara rahe sI|
z2AlamAM nUM AkhiA jAvegA ki huNa sadA laI az2Aba dA suAda lavo tuhAnUM tuhADe uhanAM karamAM dA badalA dittA jAvegA jo tusIM (saMsAra vica) karade sI|

(he nabI!) iha z2Alama tuhAthoM pucchade hana, kI az2Aba dA AuNA sacca hai? tusIM Akha dio ki hAM! (sacca hai) kasama hai mere pAlaNahAra dI ki ihadA AuNA sacca hai ate tusIM kise tarhAM vI allAha nUM bevasa nahIM kara sakade|

jekara hara z2Alama viakatI de kola (sAre) saMsAra dA mAla hove tAM uha naraka de az2Aba toM bacaNa laI sabha kujjha fidiA (chuDavAI vajoM) vica de deve|[6] jadoM iha (aparAdhI) az2Aba nUM vekhaNage tAM uha ApaNe diloM vI te z2AharoM vI zaramiMdagI dA pragaTAvA karanage| ate uhanAM dA faisalA iMnasAfa nAla hovegA, kise prakAra dI vadhIkI nahIM hovegI|
translations.footnotes: [6] vekho sUrata Ale-imarAna, hAzIA Aita 91/3

translations.translation: (he loko!) qhabaradAra jiMnIAM vI cIz2AM akAzAM te dharatI vica hana, unhAM sabha dA mAlika allAha hI hai| yAda rakkho ki allAha dA vAadA saccA hai, para iha galla bahuta hI ghaTTa loka jANade hana|
uhIo jIvana diMdA hai te uhIo mauta diMdA hai ate tusIM sabha ne use (allAha) valloM parataNA hai|

he loko! tuhADe kola tuhADe rabba valloM nasIhata dI kitAba A gaI hai| jo vI tuhADe manAM vica (gussAM, lAlaca, IrakhA, kaMjUsI havasa, nafarata Adi) de roga hana, iha uhanAM sabha dA ilAja hai ate ImAna vAliAM laI hidAita te rahimata hai|

(he nabI!) tusIM kahi dio ki iha.kuraAna allAha de phaz2ala ate usa dI rahimata nAla nAz2ila hoiA hai so lokAM nUM cAhIdA hai ki uha qhuza hoNa, iha uhanAM sArIAM cIz2AM toM bahuta hI vadhIA hai jihar3IAM uha (saMsArika jIvana laI) ikaTThIAM kara rahe hana|

(he nabI!) tusIM (ihanAM kAfirAM nUM) puccho ki allAha ne tuhADe laI jihar3A riz2aka bhejiA sI, tusIM usa vica kujjha nUM harAma (nA-jAiz2a) ate kujjha nUM halAla (jAiz2a) kara liA| kI allAha ne tuhAnUM isa dI AgiA dittI sI jAM allAha ’te ilaz2Ama lagA rahe ho|

jihar3e loka allAha utte jhUTha mar3ade hana uhanAM dA kiAmata pratI kI vicAra hai? hakIkata iha hai ki allAha dA lokAM utte bahuta vaDDA faz2ala hai| para phera vI bahute loka ajihe hana jihar3e dhaMnavAda nahIM karade|

(he nabI!) jisa hAla vica vI tusIM huMde ho ate allAha valloM nAz2ila kIte hoe.kuraAna vica jo vI tusIM lokAM nUM suNAuMde ho, ate he loka! tusIM jo vI karade ho usa sameM asIM tuhAnUM vekha rahe huMde hAM| nA hI dharatI viccoM, nA hI akAza viccoM, nA hI koI cIz2a choTI, nA hI vaDDI, koI cIz2a allAha toM lukI hoI hai, para iha sabha ika khullhI (sapazzaTa) kitAba vica (visathAra nAla) daraja hai|
yAda rakkho ki allAha de piAriAM nUM (loka praloka vica) nA koI Dara bhaia hovegA ate nA hI nirAza hoNage|[7]
translations.footnotes: [7] isa vica allAha de neka baMdiAM dA hAla biA kItA giA hai, jada ki allAha de nA faramAnAM dA hAla isa toM ulaTa hovegA| jiveM ki ika hadIsa vica allAha de rasUla (sa:) ne faramAiA ki jadoM janAz2A tiAra ho jAMdA hai ate AdamI usa nUM moDhiAM ’te cukka laiMde hana, tAM jekara uha marana vAlA neka huMdA hai tAM AkhadA hai ki mainUM chetI chetI lai callo ate je burA huMdA hai tAM kahiMdA hai ki hAe merI bhair3I kisamata! tusIM mainUM kitthe lijA rahe ho, usa dI AvAz2a nUM inasAnAM toM chuTTa hara koI suNadA hai| jekara inasAna isa nUM suNa lave tAM uha behoza ho jAve| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 1314)

translations.translation: iha lokI uha hana jihar3e ImAna liAe ate allAha toM Darade rahe|
ihanAM laI saMsArika jIvana vica vI ate Aqhirata de jIvana vica vI qhuzIAM hI qhuzIAM hana|[8] allAha de kathaNA vica kujjha vI badalAo nahIM ho sakadA, iho sabha toM vaDDI kAmayAbI hai|
translations.footnotes: [8] haz2arata abU-hurairA dassade hana ki maiM nabI karIma (sa:) nUM iha faramAuMde hoe suNiA ki nabuvvata vica chuTTa qhuzaqhabarIAM toM hora kujjha vI nahIM rihA| lokAM ne araz2a kItI ki qhuzaqhabarIAM toM kI bhA hai? tAM Apa (sa:) ne faramAiA ki sacce de caMge supane jihar3e qhuzaqhabarIAM deNa| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa 6990) ● ika dUjI hadIsa vica faramAiA ki momina dA supanA nabuvvata de chiAlI hissiAM vicoM ika hissA huMdA hai| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 6988)

translations.translation: (he nabI!) tusIM ihanAM (kAfirAM) dIAM gallAM toM dukhI nA hove| bezakka sArIAM iz2z2atAM allAha laI hI de hattha vica hana, uha sabha kujjha suNana te jANana vAlA hai|

cete rakkho, jo kujjha vI akAzAM vica hai ate jo vI dharatI vica hai iha sabha allAha dA hI hai| jihar3e lokI allAha nUM chaDDa ke dUje izaTAM nUM (madada laI) pukArade hana uha (kise izaTa dI) pairavI nahIM karade, sagoM nire vahimAM bharamAM dI pairavI kara rahe hana ate kevala qhiAlI gallAM hI karade hana|

uhIo (allAha) hai jisane tuhADe laI rAta baNAI tAM jo tusIM ArAma kara sakoM ate (roz2I kamAuNa laI) dina nUM prakAzamaI baNAiA, bezakka isa vica uhanAM laI batherIAM nizAnIAM hana jihar3e (paig2aMbarAM dIAM gallAM nUM dhiAna nAla) suNade hana|

uha (muzarika) Akhade hana ki allAha ne puttara baNA liA hai, jada ki uha (aulAda toM) pAka hai ate (hara lor3a toM) beparavAha hai|[9] akAzAM te dharatI vica jo vI hai sabha use laI hai| tuhADe kola isa galla dI vI koI dalIla nahIM (ki rabba de aulAda hai) kI tusIM allAha de bAre uha gallAM Akhade ho jisa dA tuhAnUM giAna vI nahIM?
translations.footnotes: [9] vekho sUrata ala-bakaraha, hAzIA Aita 116/2

translations.translation: (he nabI!) tusIM Akha dio ki jihar3e lokI allAha ’te doza lagA rahe hana, uha kAmayAba nahIM hoNage|
saMsAra vica tAM thor3hA jihA lAbha uThAuNA hai phera uhanAM ne sADe kola hI AuNA hai, phera asIM uhanAM nUM uhanAM de kufara de badale vica karar3e az2Aba dA suAda cakhAvAMge|

(he nabI!) tusIM ihanAM (inakArIAM) nUM nUha dA kissA suNAu jadoM uhanAM (nUha) ne ApaNI kauma nUM kihA sI ki he merI kauma! je tuhAnUM merA (tuhADe vicAle) rahiNA ate allAha dIAM AitAM rAhIM nasIhatAM (karanIAM) bhAra mahisUsa huMdA hai (tAM iha tuhADI icchA hai) para merA bharosA tAM allAha ’te hI hai| so tusIM te tuhADe zarIka mila ke mere viruddha faisalA kara lavo, ate tuhADA iha faisalA kise toM gupata nA rahe, phera mere viruddha ApaNe faisale anusAra jatana karo ate mainUM ukkA hI mohalata nA dio|
je tusIM saccAI toM mUMha mor3a vI lao para maiM tuhAthoM kise badale dI maMga nahIM karadA| merA badalA tAM allAha de hI z2iMme hai ate mai` iha hukama hoiA hai ki maiM AgiAkArIAM viccoM hovAM|

so uhanAM lokAM ne nUha nUM jhuThalAiA tAM asIM usa nUM ate jihar3e usa nUha dI ber3I vica savAra sana uhanAM sabha nUM bacA liA ate uhanAM nUM dharatI dA jAnazIna baNAiA ate jinhAM ne sADIAM AitAM nUM jhuThalAiA sI asIM uhanAM nUM Doba dittA| so vekho (uhanAM lokAM dA) aMta kiho jihA hoiA, jinhAM nUM qhabaradAra kItA giA sI|

phera asIM (nUha) toM bAada anekAM hI rasUlAM nUM uhanAM dI ApaNI ApaNI kauma valla ghalliA, uha sAre (rasUla) rauzana dalIlAM laike Ae, phera vI iMja nA hoiA ki uha isa (hidAita) ’te ImAna lai AuMde jisa nUM pahilAM hI jhuThalA cukke sana| isa prakAra allAha haddoM TappaNa vAliAM de dilAM ’te ThappA lA diMdA hai| (phera uha samajhade hI nahIM)|
ihanAM toM bAada asIM mUsA te hArUna nUM(rasUla baNA ke) firaauna te usa (dI kauma) de saradArAM valla ApaNIAM nizAnIAM de ke bhejiAM para uhanAM ne ghamaMDa kItA| uha loka aparAdhI sana|
jadoM uhanAM (firaaunIAM) kola sADe valloM hakka pujja giA tAM AkhaNa lagge ki iha tAM jAdU hai|
mUsA ne AkhiA, kI tusIM hakka pratI iha kahiMde ho, jada ki uha hakka tuhADe kola A giA hai, kI iha jAdU hai? jada ki jAdUgara kade vI kAmayAba nahIM hoiA karade|

uha (firaaunI) AkhaNa laggA, kI tusIM (mUsA te hArUna) sADe kola isa laI Ae ho ki sAnUM usa rAhoM haTA dio jisa ’te asIM ApaNe pio dAde (baz2uragAM) nUM vekhiA sI ate tuhAnUM dovAM nUM saMsAra vica saradArI mila jAve? jada ki asIM tuhAnUM dovAM nUM (rabba dA rasUla) nahIM maMnade|
firaauna ne hukama dittA ki mere kola sAre hI mAhira jAdUgarAM nUM hAz2ara karo|
jadoM jAdUgara A gae tAM mUsA ne uhanAM (jAdUgarAM)nUM kihA ki jo tusIM (jAdU laI) suTTaNA cAhuMde ho usa nUM suTTo|
jadoM uhanAM (jAdagUrAM) ne suTTiA tAM mUsA ne kihA ki iha jo vI tusIM liAe ho iha jAdU hai allAha isa nUM huNe nakAra devegA| allAha fasAdIAM de kaMmAM nUM safala hoNa nahIM diMdA|
ate allAha saccAI nUM ApaNe faramAnAM rAhIM sacca siddha karadA hai bhAveM aparAdhIAM nUM kiMnA hI nA-pasaMda kiuM nA hove|

so mUsA utte usa dI kauma (firaaunIAM) viccoM thor3he hI lokI ImAna liAe, uha vI firaauna ate ApaNe adhikArIAM toM Darade Darade ki iMja nA hove ki uha uhanAM nUM tasIhe deNa| hakIkata iho hai ki firaauna usa deza misara vica sarakaza baNiA hoiA sI, bezakka uha haddoM TappiA hoiA sI|
mUsA ne kihA ki he merI kauma! je tusIM allAha ’te ImAna liAe ho tAM use ’te bharosA rakkho je tusIM AgiAkArI ho|
uhanAM (ImAna vAliAM) ne kihA ki asIM allAha ’te hI bharosA kItA hai| he sADe mAlika! tUM sAnUM ihanAM z2AlamAM de hatthoM az2amAiza vica nA pAIM|
ate tUM sAnUM ApaNIAM miharAM sadake kAfirAM toM chuTakArA de|

asIM mUsA ate usa de bharA (hArUna) kola vahI bhejI ki tusIM doveM ApaNe laI misara vica hI ghara baNAo ate tusIM ihanAM gharAM nUM hI masItAM baNA lao, namAz2a dI pAbaMdI karo ate mominAM nUM savaraga dIAM qhuzaqhabarIAM suNA dio|

mUsA ne benatI kItI ki he sADe rabbA! tUM firaauna te usa (dI kauma) de saradArAM nUM saMsArika jIvana vica kiMnIAM hI sohaNIAM cIz2AM te dhana-daulata nAla nivAz2iA hai tAM jo uha tere rAha toM (lokAM nUM) gumarAha karana| he rabbA! uhanAM de mAlAM (dhana padArathAM) nUM nazaTa karade ate uhanAM de dilAM nUM kaThora kara de, iha ImAna nahIM liAuNage jadoM taka ki daradanAka az2Aba nA vekha laiNa|
allAha ne kihA ki tuhADe dovAM dI duA kabUla kara laI gaI hai, so tusIM saccAI dI rAha ’te drir3a raho tusIM uhanAM dI rAha utte nahIM callaNA jinhAM nUM giAna hI nahIM|

asIM banI-isarAIla nUM (bhAva haz2arata mUsA de sAthIAM nUM) dariA toM pAra laMghA dittA ate usa de picche firaauna te usa dI fauja ne z2ulama karana de irAde nAla uhanAM dA picchA kItA| itthe taka ki jadoM firaauna DUbaNa laggiA tAM kahiNa laggA ki maiM vI usa (allAha) ’te ImAna liAMdA hai jisa utte banI-isarAIla ImAna liAe hana, usa (allAha) toM chuTTa hora koI izaTa nahIM ate maiM musalamAnAM viccoM hI hAM|
allAha valloM javAba AiA, kI huNa ImAna liAiA hai? pahilAM tAM sarakazI karadA sI ate fasAdIAM viccoM sI|

so ajja asIM terI lAza nUM samuMdara ’coM kaDDha ke surakkhiata rakkhAMge tAM jo tUM AuNa vAlIAM pIr3hIAM laI sikkhiA dAI ciMna baNa jAveM| bezakka bathere loka hana jihar3e sADIAM nizAnIAM toM besurata hana|

asIM banI-isarAIla nUM rahiNa laI bahuta hI vadhIA TikANA dittA ate khANa laI pavittara cIz2AM dittIAM uhanAM vica koI matabheda vI nahIM sI, itthoM taka ki uhanAM kola (rabbI) giAna A giA| (he nabI!) bezakka terA rabba uhanAM vicakAra kiAmata vAle dina uhanAM sArIAM gallAM dA faisalA kara devegA jisa vica uha matabheda karade sana|

jekara tusIM (he nabI!) isa (.kuraAna) pratI kise zakka vica hovoM jihar3A asIM tuhADe utte nAz2ila kItA hai tAM tusIM uhanAM lokAM toM puccha lavo jihar3e tuhAthoM pahilIAM kitAbA (tauraita, iMjIla) nUM par3hade hana ki bezakka tuhADe kola tuhADe rabba valloM hakka A giA hai| so tusIM kade vI zakka karana vAliAM viccoM nA ho jANA|[10]
translations.footnotes: [10] vekho sUrata ala-ArAfa, hAzIA Aita 157/7

translations.translation: ate nA hI uhanAM lokAM viccoM hoio jinhAM ne allAha dIAM AitAM nUM jhuThalAiA, nahIM tAM tusIM vI ghATA khANa vAliAM viccoM ho jAuge|
bezakka jinhAM lokAM pratI tuhADe rabba valloM (az2Aba dA) hukama ho cukkiA hai uha ImAna nahIM liAuNage|
bhAveM uhanAM kola sArIAM hI nizAnIAM kiuM nA A jANa, jadoM tIka ki dukhadAI az2Aba nUM nA vekha laiNa (uha ImAna nahIM liAuMge)|

so koI vI basatI (kauma) ajIhI nahIM jihar3I az2Aba toM pahilAM ImAna liAI hove, tAM jo ImAna liAuNa usa laI lAbhadAika huMdA, chuTTa yUnusa dI kauma toM, jadoM uha (yUnusa dI kauma az2Aba nUM vekha ke) ImAna liAI tAM asIM usa toM saMsArika jIvana vica z2alIla karana vAlA az2Aba TAla dittA ate usa nUM ika vizeza sameM laI jIvana dA lAbha uThAuNa laI mohalata dittI|
je tuhADA rabba cAhuMdA tAM dharatI de sAre hI vAsI ImAna liAuMde| (he muhaMmada!) kI tusIM lokAM nUM majabUra karoMge ki uha ImAna vAle baNa jANa?
jadoM ki kise vI viakatI laI saMbhava nahIM ki uha allAha de hukama toM binAM ImAna lai Ave| uha (allAha) uhanAM lokAM utte (vicArAM dI) gaMdagI pA diMdA hai jihar3e akala toM kaMma nahIM laiMde|
(he nabI!) tusIM Akho ki jo kujjha vI akAzAM te dharatI vica hai usa nUM akkhAM khola ke vekho| jihar3e loka ImAna nahIM liAuMde uhanAM laI iha nizAnIAM te citAvaNIAM lAhevaMda nahIM ho sakadIAM|

huNa iha loka vI uhanAM bIta cukke bhair3e dinAM dI uDIka kara rahe hana jihar3e ihanAM toM pahilAM lokAM utte bIta cukke hana (he nabI!) Akha dio! ki caMgA tusIM vI uDIka karo maiM vI tuhADe nAla uDIka karana vAliAM viccoM hAM|
asIM (allAha) ApaNe paig2aMbarAM nUM ate ImAna vAliAM nUM (az2Aba toM) bacA laiMde hAM| iha sADI z2iMmevArI hai ki asIM ImAna vAliAM nUM (az2Aba toM) bacAIe|

(he nabI sa:!) tusIM Akha dio ki he loko! jekara tusIM mere dharama saMbaMdhI kise zakka vicca ho tAM suNo ki maiM uhanAM izaTAM dI pUjA nahIM karadA jinhAM dI pUjA tusIM allAha nUM chaDDa ke karade ho, hAM! maiM tAM usa allAha dI ibAdata karadA hAM jihar3A tuhADe prANa kaDhadA hai ate mainUM iha hukama hoiA hai ki maiM ImAna liAuNa vAliAM nAla rala jAvAM|
ate iha vI (hukama hoiA hai) ki maiM ika citta ho ke ApaNI dizA isalAma valla siddhI rakkhAM ate kade vI muzarikAM vica nA ralA|

tusIM allAha nUM chaDDa ke uhanAM nUM nA saddo jo nA tAM tuhAnUM koI lAbha pahuMcA sakade hana ate nA hI koI nukasAna pahuMcA sakade hana| je tusIM ajihA karoge tAM tusIM usa sameM z2AlamAM vica ho jAvoge|[11]
translations.footnotes: [11] vekho sUrata ala-bakaraha, hAzIA Aita 165/2

translations.translation: jekara allAha tuhAnUM koI takalIfa deve tAM chuTTa usa (allAha) toM hora koI isa (bipatA)nUM dUra karana vAlA nahIM ate je uha (allAha) tuhADe hakka vica kise bhalAI dA irAdA kare tAM usa de faz2alAM nUM rokana vAlA vI koI nahIM| uha ApaNe baMdiAM viccoM jisa nUM cAhuMdA hai ApaNe faz2aloM nivAz2adA hai| uha vaDDA baqhazaNahAra te miharAM faramAuNa vAlA hai|

(he muhaMmada sa:!) tusIM Akha dio ki he loko! tuhADe kole tuhADe rabba valloM hakka saccA A giA hai| so huNa jihar3A koI siddhe rasate A jAve tAM bezakka uha ApaNe laI hI siddhe rAha ’te AvegA ate jihar3A viakatI kurAhe pavegA tAM uha ApaNe laI hI kurAhe pavegA maiM tuhADA vakIla nahIM hAM|

he muhaMmada sa:! tuhADe valla jihar3I vahI bhejI jAMdI hai tusIM usa dI hI pairavI karo ate (kaThanAIAM AuNa ’te) sabara toM kaMma lavo itthoM taka ki allAha koI faisalA kara deve ate uhIo sabha toM vadhIA faisalA karana vAlA hai|

alifa, lAma, rA| iha uha kitAba hai jisa dIAM AitAM pakkIAM (aTalla) kara rakkhIAM hana, visathAra nAla varaNana kItIAM gaIAM hana, bahuta hI DUMghI siANapa te jANanahAra hasatI valloM (nAz2ila hoIAM) hana|
tusIM allAha toM chuTTa hora kise dI ibAdata nA karo| maiM (muhaMmada) tuhADe laI use (hasatI) valloM DarAuNa laI te qhuzaqhabarI deNa AiA hAM|

ate iha vI dassAM ki tusIM ApaNe gunAhAM dI baqhaziza laI ApaNe rabba toM aradAsa karo| phera use valla parata Ao, uha (allAha) tuhAnUM ika nizacita sameM laI jIvana samaggarI devegA ate hara vaddha (neka) amala karana vAle nUM vadhere badalA devegA je tusIM isa (rabba) toM mUMha mor3ade rahe tAM maiM tuhADe bAre ika vaDDe dina (kiAmata) de az2Aba toM DaradA hAM|
tusIM sAriAM ne mur3a allAha kola hI jANA hai ate uha hara zaia ’te pUrI kudarata rakkhadA hai|

vekho iha loka ApaNIAM hikkAM nUM duharA karade hana tAM jo allAha toM luka jANa| yAda rakkho ki jadoM uha libAsa pAuMde hana usa sameM vI allAha jANadA hai, jo uha gupata rakkhade hana ate z2Ahira karade hana, uha vI allAha jANadA hai| bezakka uha tAM dilAM de bheta vI jANadA hai|

dharatI ’te turana firana vAle hara jIva dI roz2I allAha de z2iMme hai uha uhanAM dI rahiNa dI thAM ate uhanAM de dabbana (bhAva marana dI) dI thAM vI jANadA hai| sArA kujjha ika sapazaTa kitAba (lauhe-mahafUz2a) vica daraja hai|

allAha uhIo hai jisa ne akAzAM te dharatI nUM chehAM dinAM vica paidA kItA ate (usa sameM) usa dA taqhata pANI ’te sI [1] tAM jo tuhAnUM parakhe ki tuhADe viccoM kihar3A caMge kaMma karadA hai| (he nabI!) je tusIM AkhoM ki tusIM marana magaroM mur3a jIvata kIte jAvoge tAM kAfira z2arUra iho javAba deNage ki iha tAM sAfa jAdUgarI hai|
translations.footnotes: [1]|| isa dI puzaTI hadIsa toM vI huMdI hai, allAha de rasUla ne pharamAiA ki allAha de sajjA hattha bhariA hoiA hai dina rAta dA qharaca vI usa nUM haulA nahIM karadA| kI tusIM nahIM vekhiA jadoM toM z2amIna te asamAna sAje hana usa isa viccoM kiMnA qharaca kara cukkiA hai| para jo kujha usa de hattha vica hai usa vica vI koI kamI nahIM hoI ate usa dA araza pANI utte thA ate usa de dUje hatha vica vI baqhazizAM jAM jAnA dA kaDDhaNA hai ate uha kujha lokAM nUM vaDiAI diMdA hai ate kujha nUM hINA karadA hai| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 7419)

translations.translation: je asIM ihanAM (kAfirAM) toM az2Aba nUM ika vizeza muddata taka laI TAla daੱIe tAM iha (kAfira) z2arUra Akhade ki az2Aba nUM kihar3I cIz2a ne rokiA hoiA hai| suNo jisa dina uha (az2Aba) ihanAM kola AvegA phera ihanAM toM TalegA nahIM, jisa dA iha makhaula kariA karade sI uhIo ihanAM nUM ghera lavegA|
je asIM manukkha nUM ApaNI kise niamata toM nivAz2ade hAM phera magaroM usa niamata toM vAMjhiAM kara daIe tAM uha (manukkha) bahuta hI nirAza ate bahuta hI nAzukarA baNa jAMdA hai|

je asIM (allAha) usa nUM bipatA deNa magaroM ApaNIAM niamatAM dA suAda cakhAuMde hAM tAM uha AkhaNa laggadA hai ki huNa merIAM parezAnIAM dUra ho gaIAM| bezakka uha (usa sameM) zekhIAM mArana lagga jAMdA hai te ghamaMDa vI karadA hai|
para jihar3e loka dhIraja rakkhade hana ate neka kaMma karade hana uhanAM laI hI baqhaziza hai ate bahuta hI vaDDA badalA vI hai|

(he muhaMmada sa:!) ho sakadA hai ki tusIM isa vahI de kujjha bhAga nUM jihar3I tuhADe valla nAz2ila kItI gaI hai (varaNana karana toM) chaDDa dio| tuhADA dila taMgI mahisUsa kara rihA hove| ki iha kAfira AkhaNage ki tuhADe ’te koI qhaz2AnA kiuM nahIM utariA giA jAM ihanAM (muhaMmada sa:) de saMga koI farizatA kiuM nahIM AiA (he nabI!) suNa lavo ki tusIM tAM kevala (allAha de az2Aba toM) DarAuNa vAle ho allAha hara cIz2a dI nigarAnI kara rihA hai|

kI uha (kAfira) Akhade hana ki isa ne iha.kuraAna Apa hI ghar3ha liA hai? (he nabI! kAfirAM nUM) Akha dio ki phera tusIM vI ihanAM varagIAM dassa AitAM ghar3a vikhAo ate chuTTa allAha toM (ApaNI madada laI) jisa nUM bulA sakade ho bulA lavo, je tusIM ApaNI galla vica sacce ho|

phera je uha kAfira tuhAnUM koI javAba nA deNa tAM jANa lao ki iha (.kuraAna) allAha de giAna anusAra hI utAriA giA hai ate allAha toM chuTTa hora koI izaTa nahIM| (he loko!) kI tusIM (iha sabha jANana toM bAada) musalamAna baNade ho?
jihar3e lokI saMsArika jIvana te isa dI qhUbasUratI cAhuMde hana asIM uhanAM de karamAM dA badalA ise saMsAra vica hI de chaDDade hAM ate uhanAM dA hakka nahIM mAriA jAMdA|

iho uha loka hana jinhAM laI Aqhirata vica chuTTa agga toM hora kujjha vI nahIM, jo kujjha uhanAM ne saMsAra vica kamAI kItI sI uha sabha barabAda ho gaI ate jo vI uha amala karade rahe uha vI ajAIM gae|

kI bhalAM uha viakatI (.kuraana dA inakAra kara sakadA hai? ) jihar3A ApaNe rabba valloM baqhazI hoI dalIla ’te kAima hove ate isa de nAla allAha valloM ika gavAha (vajoM.kuraAna) vI hove, jada ki isa toM pahilAM mUsA dI kitAba (tauraita) vI mAraga darazana te miharAM de rUpa vica rahI hai| iho uha loka hana jihar3e isa (.kuraAna) ’te ImAna rakkhade hana ate ihanAM sAre manukkhI dhar3hiAM viccoM jo vI isa (.kuraAna) dA inakArI hovegA usa dA TikANA agga hai|[2] (he nabI sa:!) tusIM kise prakAra de zakka-zubahe vica nahIM paiNA| iha.kuraAna tuhADe pAlaNahAra valloM hakka (’te AdhArita) hai para vadhere loka nahIM maMnade|
translations.footnotes: [2] vekho sUrata Ale-imarAna, hAzIA Aita 85/3

translations.translation: usa viakatI toM vadhake z2Alama kauNa hovegA jihar3A allAha ’te hI jhUTha jar3e? iha sAre loka allAha de haz2Ura peza kIte jANage ate (farizate) gavAhI deNage ki iha uha loka hana jinhAM ne ApaNe rabba ’te jhUTha jar3hiA sI| suNa lao| allAha dI phiTakAra z2AlamAM laI hai|[3]
translations.footnotes: [3] isa dI puzaTI iha hadIsa karadI hai jisa nUM safavAna bina muharrara dassiA hai ki abadullA bina umara (ra:a:) tavAfa kara rahe sI ki ika viakatI AiA te AkhaNa laggA, kI tusIM nabI (sa:) de bAre kujha suNiA hai? ibane-umara (ra:a:) ne AkhiA ki maine nabI karIma (sa:) toM iha suNiA hai ki momina nUM allAha de ner3e liAMdA jAvegA| hazzAma dA kahiNA hai ki momina ApaNe rabba de innA ner3e ho jAvegA ki allAha usa utte ApaNA paTTa rakkha devegA ate usa toM usa de gunAhAM dI puzaTI karAvAegA (allAha usa nUM AkhegA) kI tainUM ApaNA phalAnA gunAha yAda hai? uha momina do bAra AkhegA ki maiM jANadA hAM he mere rabba maiM jANadA hAM| usa sameM allAha AkhegA ki maine saMsAra vica tere gunAhAM utte par3adA pAiA sI ate ajja maiM uhanAM nUM tere laI mAfa karadA hAM| phira isa dI nekIAM dA rajisaTara baMda kara dittA jAvegA| ate dUje lokA dA jAM kAfirAM dA hAla iha hovegA ki guvAhAM de sAmaNe khulamma khallA AkhiA jAvegA ki iha uha loka hana jinhAM ne ApaNe rabba utte jhUTha mar3hiA sI| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 4685)

translations.translation: jihar3e lokAM nUM allAha dI rAha toM rokade hana ate isa (rAha) vica viMga-vala labbhade hana iho Aqhirata de inakArI hana|

uha loka dharatI utte allAha nUM bevasa karana vAle nahIM sana ate nA hI chuTTa allAha toM uhanAM dA koI himAitI sI, uhanAM laI doguNA az2Aba hovegA kiuM jo nA hI uha (hakka) suNa sakade sI ate nA hI usa nUM vekhaNA cAhuMde sI|
iho uha loka hana jinhAM ne ApaNe Apa nUM ghATe vica pAiA hai ate uha sabha uhanAM toM guAca giA jihar3A uhanAM ne ghar3a rakkhiA sI|
bezakka Aqhirata vica ghATe vica rahiNa vAle iho loka hoNage|
bezakka jihar3e loka ImAna liAe te bhale kaMma vI kIte ate ApaNe pAlaNahAra de haz2Ura jhukade vI rahe uhIo savaragAM vica jANa vAle hana jitthe uha sadA laI rahiNage|

iha doveM dhirAM dI misAla iMja hai jiveM ika dhira aMnhA te bolA hove, dUjA vekhaNa te suNana vAlA hove| kI iha doveM dhirAM iko barAbara ho sakade hana? kI tusIM phera vI nasIhata prApata nahIM karade?
bezakka asIM nUha nUM usa dI kauma valla (paig2aMbara baNAke) bhejiA ate usa ne kihA ki maiM tuhAnUM sapazaTa citAvaNI de rihA hAM|
ki tusIM allAha toM chuTTa kise hora dI ibAdata nA karo| maiM tAM tuhADe ’te daradanAka dina (bhAva kiAmata) de az2Aba AuNa toM DaradA hAM|

usa (nUha) dI kauma de vaDeriAM ne kihA ki asIM tAM tainUM ApaNe vAMga hI ika manukkha vekhade hAM ate iha vI vekhade hAM ki kevala uhanAM lokAM ne hI binAM soce samajhe terI pairavI kItI hai jihar3e sADI kauma de nIca, dalita te bhair3I soca vAle loka hana, asIM iha vI vekha rahe hAM ki tuhAnUM sADe ’te kise tarhAM dI koI vaDiAI vI nahIM, asIM tAM tuhAnUM jhUThA samajhade hAM|

(nUha ne) kihA ki he merI kauma vAlio! mainUM dasso ki je maiM ApaNe rabba valloM kise dalIla ’te hovAM ate usa ne mainUM ApaNe valloM kise mihara toM (bhAva rasUla baNA ke) nivAz2iA hove phera uha mihara tuhAnUM (aMniAM nUM) vikhAI nA diMdI hove tAM kI asIM tuhAnUM isa nUM maMNana laI majabUra kara sakade hAM, jada ki tusIM isa nUM pasaMda nahIM karade|

(nUha ne kihA) ki he merI kauma vAlIo! maiM tuhAthoM isa (citAvanI deNa) laI koI dhaMna nahIM maMgadA| merA badalA tAM allAha de kola hI hai| maiM ImAna vAliAM nUM (bhAveM uha dalita hI hana) ApaNe koloM parAM karana vAlA nahIM| bezakka uhanAM dI milaNI ApaNe rabba nAla hoNI hai para maiM vekhadA hAM ki tusIM agiAnatA toM kaMma lai rahe ho|
he merI kauma de loko! je maiM ihanAM (maMNana vAliAM) nUM dhikkAra vI davAM tAM kauNa mainUM allAha de az2Aba toM bacAvegA? kI tusIM kujjha vI sikkhiA nahIM laiMde?

(nUha ne kihA) ki maiM tuhAnUM iha nahIM kahiMdA ki mere kola allAha de qhaz2Ane hana ate nA hI maiM g2aiba dA giAna rakkhadA hAM, nA maiM iha kahiMdA hAM ki maiM farizatA hAM nA hI merA iha kahiNA hai ki jinhAM nUM tuhADIAM akkhAM nIca samajha rahIAM hana, uhanAM nUM allAha koI bhalAI nahIM baqhazegA| uhanAM de mana vica jo hai usa nUM allAha caMgI tarhAM jANadA hai| je maiM koI ajihI galla kahAMgAM tAM merI giNatI vI z2AlamAM vica hovegI|
(kauma ne) AkhiA ki he nUha! tUM sADe nAla jhagar3A kara liA ate sADe nAla vadhere jhagar3A kara cukkiAM haiM| jisa az2Aba toM sAnUM tUM DarA rihA haiM uha lai A, je tUM saccA haiM|
(nUha ne) kihA ki bezakka allAha hI uha (az2Aba) tuhADe ’te liAvegA, je uha cAhave| phera tusIM usa nUM roka vI nahIM sakade|

tuhAnUM merIAM nasIhatAM kujjha vI lAbha nahIM de sakadIAM bhAveM maiM tuhADI kiMnI hI bhalAI cAhavAM jadoM ki allAha dI icchA tuhAnUM kurAhe pAuNA dI hove| uhIo tuhADA rabba (pAlaNahAra) hai ate usa valla tusIM (sAriAM ne) parata ke jANA hai|

kI uha kAfira Akhade hana ki isa (.kuraAna) nUM usa ne Apa hI ghar3ha liA hai? (he nabI!) javAba dio ki je maine ApaNe mana toM isa nUM ghar3ha liA hai tAM isa dA doza mere ’te hai ate maiM uhanAM sAre aparAdhAM toM barI hAM jo tusIM kara rahe ho|
nUha valla vahI bhejI gaI ki terI kauma viccoM jihar3e loka pahilAM ImAna liA cukke hana uhanAM toM chuTTa hora koI ImAna nahIM liAvegA, so tUM uhanAM dIAM karatUtAM ’te dukhI nA ho|
tUM sADIAM akkhAM de sAhamaNe sADI vahI anusAra ika ber3I baNA ate uhanAM z2AlamAM de saMbaMdha vica sADe nAla koI galla nA kara| bezakka uhanAM nUM Doba dittA jAvegA|

jadoM uha (nUha) ber3I baNAuNa laggiA te uhanAM dI kauma de AgU jadoM usa (nUha) de kola dI laMghade tAM uha usa dA makhaula karade| nUha ne kihA ki je (ajja) tusIM sADA makhaula uDAuMde ho bezakka (ika dina) asIM vI tuhADe ’te hassAMge, jiddAM tusIM sADe ’te (ajja) hassa rahe ho|
tuhAnUM bahuta chetI hI patA calla jAvegA ki kisa viakatI ’te ajihA az2Aba AvegA jihar3A uha nUM (saMsAra vica) z2alIla kara devegA ate (Aqhirata vica) sadA laI saz2A hovegI|

jadoM sADA (az2Aba dA) hukama A giA te (dharatI ’coM pANI dA) taMdUra ubbalaNa lagga piA phera asIM nUha nUM AkhiA ki isa ber3I vica hara prakAra de (jAnavarAM de) jor3e bhAva (do jAnavara) ika nara te ika madIna savAra kara lai ate ApaNe parivAra nUM, chuTTa usa (tuhADI patanI te puttara) toM, jinhAM bAre pahilAM galla ho cukkI hai, sane sAre ImAna vAliAM nUM savAra kara lai| usa (nUha) ’te bahuta hI ghaTTa giNatI vica ImAna liAe sI|

nUha ne kihA ki sAre (ImAna vAle) isa ber3I vica savAra ho jAo isa dA callaNA te ThahiraNA allAha de hukama nAla hI hai| hakIkata vica merA pAlaNahAra vaDDA baqhazaNahAra te rahima faramAuNa vAlA hai|

uha (ber3I) uhanAM (ImAna vAliAM) nUM pahAr3a vAMga (uccIAM-uccIAM) challAM vica laIM jA rAhIM sI| nUha ne ApaNe puttara nUM pukAriA jihar3A ki sabha toM alagga khalagga sI ki he puttara! sADe nAla (tUM vI) savAra ho jA kAfirAM nAla nA rahi|

uha (puttara) boliA, maiM tAM huNe kise pahAr3a dI zarana laiੲ lavAgAM uha mainUM pANI toM bacA lavegA| nUha ne AkhiA ki ajja allAha de hukama (az2Aba) toM bacAuNa vAlA koI nahIM kevala uhIo bacaNage jinhAM ’te allAha dI mihara hovegI|[4] use sameM uhanAM dohAM (pio puttara) vicAle ika chala A gaI tAM uha (puttara vI) DUbaNa vAliAM vica jA raliA|
translations.footnotes: [4] allAha de rasUla ne faramAiA ki jadoM vI koI qhalIfA niyukata kItA jAMdA hai tAM usa de do salAhakAra huMde hana ika usa nUM nekI dA hukama diMdA hai ate usa de laI prerita karadA hai jadoM ki dUjA usa nUM burAI dA hukama diMdA hai ate use laI prerita karadA hai para gunAhAM toM uhIo baciA rahiMdA hai jisa nUM allAha bacAve| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 6611)

translations.translation: AkhiA ki he dharatI! tUM ApaNe pANI nUM nigala jA ate he akAza! tUM rukka so use sameM dharatI vica pANI samA giA ate uhanAM kAfirAM dA niber3A kara dittA giA ate ber3I jodI (nAM dI pahAr3I) ’te jA TikI ate Akha dittA giA ki z2Alama kauma laI (rabba dI rahimata toM) dUrI hai|
nUha ne ApaNe pAlaNahAra nUM benatI kItI ki mere rabbA merA puttara tAM mere parivAra viccoM hI hai ate bezakka terA vAadA vI saccA hai ate tUM sAriAM toM caMgerA faisalA karana vAlA haiM|

AkhiA ki he nUha! uha (terA puttara) tere parivAra viccoM nahIM hai| usa dIAM karatUtAM tAM bahuta hI bhair3IAM hana| tUM maithoM usa cIz2a dA savAla nA kara jisa dA tuhAnUM giAna nahIM| maiM tainUM nasIhata karadA hAM ki tUM jAhalAM vica nA ralIM|

(nUha) ne kihA ki he mere pAlaNahAra! maiM terI zarana vica AuNA hAM isa galla toM ki maiM tuhAthoM uha cIz2a maMgA jisa dA mainUM ukkA hI giAna nahIM| je tUM mainUM nahIM baqhazegA ate mere ’te miharAM nahIM karegA tAM maiM ghATe vica rahiNa vAliAM vica ho jAvAMgA|

(jadoM tUphAna dA z2ora jAMdA rihA phera) AkhiA giA ki he nUha! tUM sADe valloM uhanAM barakatAM te salAmatI nAla (ber3I viccoM) uttara jA jihar3IAM (barakatAM) tere ’te ate tere nAla dIAM jamAatAM utte nAz2ila kItIAM gaIAM hana| hora vI kujjha jamAatAM (ummatAM) hoNagIAM jinhAM nUM asIM saMsAra vica z2arUra hI lAbha pacAvAMge para phera uhanAM nUM sADe valloM bar3A hI karar3A az2Aba AvegA|

(he nabI!) iha sArIAM g2aiba (parokha) dIAM qhabarAM hana jihar3IAM asIM tuhADe valla vahI karade hAM| ihanAM qhabarAM nUM isa toM pahilAM nA hI tusIM jANade sI ate nA hI tuhADI kauma (makke vAle) jANade sI| so tusIM (ihanAM de inakAra karana ’te) dhIraja toM kaMma lavo| aMta bhalA uhanAM lokAM dA hI hai jihar3e parahez2agAra hana|[5]
translations.footnotes: [5] vekho sUrata ala-bakaraha, hAzIA Aita 2/2

translations.translation: asIM Ada kauma valla uhanAM de bharA hUda nUM bhejiA| usa (hUda) ne kihA ki he merI kauma! tusIM allAha hI dI ibAdata karo, usa toM chuTTa tuhADA hora koI izaTa nahIM, tusIM tAM nirA jhUTha ghar3haNa vAle ho|
he merI kauma! maiM tuhAthoM isa (sikkhiA deNa) dA koI badalA nahIM maMgadA merA badalA tAM usa de z2iMme hai jisa ne mainUM paiedA kItA hai| kI tusIM phera vI akala toM kaMma nahIM laiMde?

(ate kihA ki) he merI kauma! tusIM ApaNe rabba (pAlaNahAra) toM ApaNe gunAhAM dI muAfI maMgo ate usa de haz2Ura taubA karo uha (allAha) tuhADe laI akAza toM (rahimatAM bhare) baddala bhejegA ate tuhADI varatamAna zakatI vica hora vadhere vAdhA karegA| so tusIM aparAdhI baNa ke (hakka toM) mUMha nA mor3o|

kauma ne javAba vica kihA ki he hUda! tUM sADe kola (ApaNe nabI hoNa dI) koI dalIla tAM liAiA nahIM, asIM kevala tere AkhaNa ’te ApaNe izaTAM nUM nahIM chaDDaNa vAle ate nA hI asIM tere utte ImAna liAuNa vAle hAM|

sagoM asIM tAM iho samajhade hAM ki sADe kise izaTa ne terI akala mAra chaDDI hai| hUda ne AkhiA ki maiM tAM allAha nUM gavAha baNAuMdA hAM ate tusIM vI gavAha raho ki maiM tAM chuTTa allAha toM ihanAM sabha (izaTAM) toM abAz2Ara hAM jinhAM nUM tusIM rabba dA sAMjhI baNAuMde ho|
chuTTa allAha toM tusIM sAre rala mila ke mainUM hANa pahuMcauNa dIAM yojanAvAM baNA lao, phera mainUM ukkA hI mohalata nA daIo|

bezakka! merA bharosA tAM allAha ’te hI hai jihar3A merA vI te tuhADA sabha dA pAlaNahAra hai| (dharatI utte) callaNa vAlA koI vI (prANI) ajihA nahIM jisa nUM usa ne bodI toM nA phar3a rakkhiA hove| nirasaMdeha, merA pAlaNahAra siddhI rAha ’te hai|

hAM je tusIM (hakka toM) mUMha mor3oge tAM maiM tuhAnUM uha sunehAM de cukkiA hAM jihar3A tuhADe valla de ke mainUM bhejiA giA sI| merA rabba ika hora kauma nUM tuhADA jAnazIna baNA devegA ate tusIM usa (rabba) dA kujjha vI vigAr3a nahIM sakoge| vAsatava vica merA rabba hI hara cIz2a dI nigarAnI karadA hai|
jadoM sADA az2Aba A giA tAM asAM hUda te usa de ImAna vAle (AgiAkArI) sAthIAM nUM ApaNI qhAsa miharAM sadake (kurAhe paiNa toM) bacA liA ate asIM uhanAM sabha nUM karar3e az2Aba toM bacA liA|

ate vekho iha kaume-Ada sI, jisa ne ApaNe rabba dIAM AitAM (hukamAM) dA inakAra ate allAha de rasUlAM dI nA-faramAnI kItI sI ate hareka sarakaza (rabba de bAg2I) te (saccAI nAla) vaira rakkhaNa vAle dA kahiNA maMniAM|
uhanAM de picche isa saMsAra dI vI ate kiAmata dihAr3e dI vI lAanata laggI rahegI| vekho Ada dI kauma ne ApaNe rabba dA inakAra kItA| suNoM! hUda dI kauma Ada utte lAanata hai|

asIM samUda (dI kauma) valla uhanAM de bharA sAleha nUM (nabI baNAke) bhejiA uhanAM ne ApaNI kauma nUM AkhiA ki tusIM sAre allAha dI ibAdata karo, usa toM chuTTa tuhADA hora koI izaTa nahIM| use ne tuhAnUM dharatI (miTTI) toM paidA kItA ate use ne isa dharatI utte tuhAnUM vasAiA hai| use toM hI ApaNe gunAhAM dI muAfI maMgo ate use valla parata Ao! bezakka merA rabba tuhADe ner3e hI hai te duAvAM nUM kabUlaNa vAlA hai|

uhanAM (kaume-samUda) ne AkhiA ki he sAleha! isa toM pahilAM tUM sADIAM AsAM dA keMdara sI, kI tUM sAnUM uhanAM izaTAM dI ibAdata toM rokadA hai jinhAM dI ibAdata sADe pio dAde karade sana| jisa cIz2a (ika rabba) valla tUM sAnUM bulA rihA hai sAnUM tAM usa de pratI zaMkA hai jo sADI dubidhA dA kArana hai|

usa (sAleha) ne kihA ki he merI kauma vAlio! ratA dasso tAM sahI je maiM ApaNe rabba valla kise (Thosa) dalIla ’te hovAM ate usa ne mainUM (vizeza) mihara (bhAva nabuvvata) baqhazI hove phera je maiM usa dI nA-faramAnI karAM tAM allAha de az2Aba toM mainUM kauNa bacAvegA? tusIM tAM mere nukasAna vica vAdhA kara rahe ho|

(sAleha ne kihA ki) he merI kauma! iha vekho iha UThaNI tuhADe laI allAha dI nizAnI (vajoM) hai| so tusIM isa nUM rabba dI dharatI ’te caraNa-cugaNa laI chaDDa dio, tusIM isa nAla bure irAde nAla ratA vI cher3a chAr3a nA karIo, nahIM tAM tuhAnUM chetI hI az2Aba A nappegA|

para uhanAM ne uhadIAM TaMgAM vaDDa suTTIAM| isa ’te sAleha ne citAvaNI dittI ki caMgA huNa tusIM ApaNe ApaNe gharAM vica tiMna tiMna dina hora rasa vasa lao| (tuhADe ’te az2Aba AuNa vAlA hai) iha ajihA vAadA hai jihar3A jhUThA siddha nahIM hovegA|

jadoM sADA hukama (az2Aba) A giA tAM phera asIM sAleha ate usa de ImAna liAuNa vAliAM nUM ApaNI miharAM sadake az2Aba toM bacA liA ate usa (kiAmata dihAr3e de az2Aba) toM vI bacA liA| bezakka terA rabba hI asala vica sarava zakatImAna te z2orAvara hai|
ate z2AlamAM nUM ika kar3AkedAra dhamAke ne nappa liA phera tAM uha ApaNe gharAM vica ulaTe mUMha Dige rahi gae|
(usa basatI vica iMja laggadA sI) jiveM ki uha utthe kade vase hI nahIM sI sAvadhAna raho| ki bezakka kaume-samUda ne ApaNe rabba nAla kufara kItA, ihanAM samUdIAM ’te fiTakAra hai|

nirasaMdeha! sADe bheje hoe (farizate) ibarAhIma kola qhuzaqhabarI laike Ae te AkhiA ki tuhADe ’te salAma hove| uhanAM (ibarAhIma) ne vI javAba vica salAma kihA ate binAM derI kIte bhujjA hoiA vacchA (uhanAM laI) liAe|

jadoM vekhiA ki uhanAM (farizatiAM) de hattha usa (bhojana) valla vadha hI nahIM rahe tAM (ibarAhIma) uhanAM nUM ajanabI samajha ke mana hI mana vica uhanAM toM bhai-bhIta ho giA| (iha vekha) uhanAM (farizatiAM) ne kihA ki sAthoM nA Daro asIM tAM lUta dI kauma valla ghalle gae hAM|

uhanAM (ibarAhIma) dI patanI (bIbI sArA) jihar3I utthe hI khar3I sI (ibarAhIma dI bhaia bhIta hAlata vekha ke) hassaNa laggI tAM asIM (uhanAM farizatiAM rAhIM) usa nUM isahAka ate isahAka magaroM yAkUba (nUM nabI baNAuNa) dI qhuzaqhabarI suNAI|
(ibarAhIma dI patanI sArA) AkhaNa laggI ki (hAi lohar3A) mere aulAda kiveM hovegI jadoM ki maiM buDDhI ho gaI hAM ate merA patI vI bahuta buDDhA hai| iha tAM bahuta hI hairAnI dI galla hai|

(farizatiAM ne) kihA, kI tUM allAha de hukama ’te hairAna ho rahI hai? he isa ghara vAlio! tuhADe ’te allAha dIAM rahimatAM ate usa dIAM barakatAM nAz2ila hoNa bezakka allAha atiaMta zalAghA yoga te uccIAM zAnAM vAlAM hai|
jadoM usa (ibarAhIma) dA Dara dUra ho giA ate usa nUM qhuzaqhabarI vI mila gaI tAM uha sADe nAla lUta dI kauma bAre jhagar3aNa lagga piA|
asala vica ibarAhIma bahuta hI sahinazIla te kaumala hirade vAlA ate sADe (allAha valla) hI jhukaNa vAlA viakatI sI|
(farizatiAM ne) AkhiA ki ibarAhIma tusIM iha vicAra chaDDa dio tuhADe rabba dA hukama (az2Aba deNa dA) A giA hai| ihanAM (kaume-lUta) ’te ika nA-TalaNa vAlA az2Aba z2arUra hI AuNa vAlA hai|

jadoM sADe bheje hoe (farizata) lUta de kola pahuMce tAM uha (lUta) uhanAM de AuNa nAla bahuta hI dukhI hoiA ate dilo taMga hoiA (bhAva ghabarAiA) ate AkhaNa lagiA ki ajja tAM bahuta hI karar3A dina hai|

usa dI kauma de loka (mahimAnAM nUM vekha) nassade hoe usa (lUta) kola Ae jihar3e ki pahilAM toM hI azalIlatA bhare kaMma karade sana| usa (lUta) ne kihA ki he merI kauma de loko! iha merI (kauma dIAM) dhIAM hana (ihanAM nAla nikAha kara lavo) iha tuhADe laI atiaMta pavittara hana| so tusIM allAha toM Daro ate mere mahimAnAM de sAhamaNe mainUM z2alIla nA karo, kI tuhADe viccoM ika vI bhalA viakatI nahIM|
(kauma ne) kihA ki tUM tAM caMgI tarhAM jANadA hai ki terI (kauma dIAM) dhIAM nAla sAnUM koI sarokAra nahIM| tUM tAM sADI asalI icchA toM bhalI-bhAMta jANU hai|
(lUta ne) kihA ki kAza maiM tuhADe nAla mukAbalA karana dI tAkata rakkhadA jAM merA koI z2orAvara himAitI huMdA|

farizatiAM ne AkhiA ki he lUta! asIM tere pAlaNahAra valloM bheje hoe hAM, iha loka tuhADe ’te hatha nahIM pA sakade| tUM ApaNe ghara vAliAM nUM laike rAta nUM kise vele nikala jA, tuhADe vicoM koI vI picche mur3a ke nA vekhe, terI patanI toM chuTTa (sAre cale jAo) kiuM jo usa nUM vI uhIo (az2Aba) pahuMcaNa vAlA hai jihar3A uhanAM sAriAM (z2AlamAM) nUM pahuMcegA| bezakka ihanAM dA vAadA (az2Aba deNa dA) savere dA samAM hai| kI savera dA samAM ner3e nahIM A laggiA? [6]
translations.footnotes: [6] vekho sUrata ala-kamara, hAzIA Aita 39,33/54

translations.translation: jadoM sADA hukama (bhAva az2Aba) A giA tAM asAM usa basatI nUM upparo-thalle kara dittA ate uhanAM ’te khiMgharAM dA tAbar3a-tor3a mIMha barasAiA|
hara patthara ’te tere rabba dI nizAnI laggI hoI sI ate uha basatI ihanAM z2AlamAM toM (bhAva makke toM) kujjha vI dUra nahIM sI|

asIM madayana vAliAM valloM uhanAM de hI ika bharA zuaiba nUM ghalliA usa ne kihA ki he merI kauma! tusIM allAha dI ibAdata karo, usa toM chuTTa tuhADA hora koI izaTa nahIM ate nApa tola vica ghATa nA pAiA karo| ajja maiM tuhAnUM bahuta qhuzahAla vekha rihA hAM| para maiM usa dina toM DaradA hAM jadoM tuhAnUM az2Aba vAlA dina ghere vica lai lavegA|
(zuaiba ne AkhiA) he mere kauma! tusIM nApa te tola inasAfa nAla kariA karo ate lokAM nUM uhanAM dIAM cIz2AM ghaTA ke nA dio ate tusIM isa dharatI ’te fasAdI baNa ke nA ghUmmoM|
je tusIM sacce momina ho tAM allAha valloM dittI hoI jAiz2a baccata (naphA) hI tuhADe laI vadhIA hai| maiM (bhAva zuaiba) tuhADe utte koI pahiredAra nahIM hAM|

(kauma ne) javAba dittA ki he zuaiba! kI terI namAz2a (dharama) tainUM iho sikhAuMdI hai ki asIM ApaNe pio dAdiAM de izaTAM nUM chaDDa daੱIe jAM ApaNe mAlAM vica uha nA karIe jo asIM karanA cAhIe? basa tUM hI tAM ika narama subhAo vAlA te samajhadAra viakatI hai?

zuaiba ne kihA ki he merI kauma! ki je meM ApaNe rabba valloM ika sapazaTa dalIla ’te hovAM ate use ne hI mainUM ApaNe valloM vadhIA roz2I vI dittI hove phera maiM usa dI nA-faramAnI kiveM karAM| maiM iha vI nahIM cAhuMdA ki maiM tuhADI virodhatA karAM ki maiM uhI kaMma Apa karAM jisa toM maiM tuhAnUM rokadA hAM| maiM chuTTa tuhADe sudhAra toM hora kujjha nahIM cAhuMdA ate isa dI yogatA deNA chuTTa allAha dI madada toM, saMbhava nahIM| use ’te merA bharosA hai ate use valla maiM jhukadA hAM|

he merI kauma vAlio! merI virodhatA kite tuhAnUM uhanAM az2AbAM dA hakkadAra nA baNA deve jihar3e kaume-nUha, kaume-hUda te kaume-sAleha nUM pahuMce sana ate kaume-lUta dI basatI tAM tuhAthoM bahutI dUra vI nahIM|
tusIM ApaNe rabba toM muAfI maMgo te use valla parata Ao, bezakka merA rabba atiaMta miharAM ate muhabbata karana vAlA hai|

(kauma ne) kihA ki he zuaiba! terIAM bahutIAM gallAM tAM sADI samajha vica hI nahIM AuMdIAM| asIM tAM tainUM ApaNe vicAle bahuta hI nirabala viakatI samajhade hAM| je sAnUM tere kabIle dA qhiAla nA huMdA tAM asIM tainUM pattharAM nAla mAra suTTade tUM sADe ’te kise pakkhoM vI bhArU nahIM|

(zuaiba ne) kihA ki he mere kauma de vIro! kI tuhADe laI mere kabIle de loka allAha toM vI vaddha Adara vAle hana? tusIM usa (rabba) nUM ukkA hI piTTha picche suTTa dittA hai| jo vI tusIM kara rahe ho uhanAM sabha nUM mere rabba ne ApaNe giAna de ghere vica liA hoiA hai|

ate AkhiA ki he kauma vAlio! huNa tusIM ApaNI thAM ’te (bhAva icchA anusAra) kaMma karade raho maiM vI ApaNA kaMma kara rihA hAM, tuhAnUM chetI hI patA calla jAvegA ki hINatA bhariA az2Aba kisa ’te AuMdA hai te kauNa jhUThA hai| tusIM vI (az2Aba nUM) uDIko ate tahADe nAla maiM vI uDIkadA hAM|

jadoM sADA hukama (az2Aba dA) AiA tAM asIM zuaiba nUM ate usa de ImAna vAle sAthIAM nUM ApaNI vizeza miharAM sadake najAta baqhazI ate z2AlamAM nUM ika kar3akadAra caMgiAr3a ne A nappiA, jisa kArana uha ApaNe gharAM vica muddhe mUMha Dige pae rahe gae|
iMja laggadA sI ki jiveM uhanAM gharAM vica kade koI vasiA rasiA hI nahIM sI| madayyana vAliAM ’te vI fiTakAra paI jiveM samUda ’te fiTakAra paI sI|
asIM mUsA nUM ApaNIAM nizAnIAM te rauzana dalIlAM de ke (firaauna de darabAra vica) bhejiA sI|
firaauna te usa de darabArIAM valla rauzana dalIlAM AIAM phera vI uhanAM lokAM ne firaauna de hukamAM dI pairavI kItI jada ki firaauna dA koI vI hukama saccAI ’te AdhArita nahIM sI|
uha (firaauna) kiAmata dihAr3e ApaNI kauma dA AgU baNake agge-agge hovegA, phera uhanAM nUM naraka vica suTTa dittA jAvegA| uha tAM bahuta hI bhair3I thAM hai jitthe uhanAM nUM pahuMcAiA jAvegA|
uhanAM lokAM ’te tAM isa saMsAra vica vI fiTakAra pai gaI sI ate kiAmata dihAr3e vI pavegI| kiMnA bhair3A hai uha inAma jihar3A uhanAM nUM dittA jAvegA|
he nabI! iha kujjha barabAda hoIAM basatIAM dIAM qhabarAM hana jo asIM tuhAnUM suNA rahe hAM ihanAM vica kujjha tAM maujUda hana ate kujjha malIAMmeTa ho cukkIAM hana|

asIM uhanAM (basatIAM) ’te koI z2ulama nahIM sI kItA sagoM uhanAM ne ApaNe Apa ’te hI z2ulama kItA sI ate uhanAM de (jhUThe) izaTAM ne uhanAM nUM koI lAbha nahIM pahuMcAiA jinhAM nUM uha allAha nUM chaDDa ke (madada laI) pukAra de sana| jadoM tuhADe rabba dA hukama (az2Aba dA) AiA tAM uhanAM dI barabAdI vica vAdhA hI hoiA|
(he nabI!) tere rabba dI pakar3a ajihI hai ki jadoM uha kise basatI de z2AlamAM nUM phar3adA hai tAM usa dI pakar3a bahuta hI dukhadAI te karar3I huMdI hai|[7]
