translations.footnotes: [7] allAha de rasUla ne faramAiA ki allAha taAlA z2Alima (muzarika aparAdhI Adi) nUM Dhilla diMdA rahiMdA hai| para jadoM usa nUM phar3adA hai tAM usa nUM chaDadA nahIM| abu mUsA Akhade hana ki isa toM bAada nabI (sa:) ne iho Aita talAvata kItI|(sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 4686)

translations.translation: bezakka isa vica uhanAM lokAM laI (sikkhiAdAika) nizAnI hai jihar3e kiAmata de az2Aba toM Darade hana| uha dihAr3A kiAmata dA hovegA jadoM sAre loka ikaTTha kIte jANage ate jadoM sAre loka rabba de haz2Ura peza kIte jANage| (uha kiAmata dA dihAr3A hovegA)
asIM jihar3I derI kara rahe hAM uha ika mithe sameM laI hai (bhAva kiAmata dA samAM mithiA hoiA hai)
jadoM uha dina AvegA tAM koI vI viakatI allAha dI AgiA toM binAM koI galla nahIM kara sakegA phera ihanAM viccoM hI koI be-bhAga hovegA ate koI bhAgAM vAlA hovegA|
jihar3e bebhAga hoNage uha (naraka dI) agga vica jANage jitthe uha sadA roNa piTTaNa dI hAlata vica hI rahiNage|

uha usa naraka vica udoM tIka rahiNage jadoM tIka akAza te dharatI rahiNage sivAe isa toM ki terA rabba kujjha hora cAhave| (bhAva naraka toM chuTakArA deNA cAhave) terA rabba jo vI cAhuMdA hai karadA hai|

para jihar3e bhAgAM vAle hoNage uha savaraga vica hoNage jitthe uha sadA laI rahiNage jadoM taka akAza te dharatI bAkI rahiNage para huMdA uha hai jo tere rabba cAhuMdA hai, usa dIAM baqhazizAM dA koI aMta nahIM|

so (he nabI!) tusIM uhanAM izaTAM saMbaMdhI kise saMdeha vica nA raho jinhAM dI iha loka baMdagI kara rahe hana| ihanAM lokAM dI pUjA pATha tAM use tarhAM dI hai jisa tarhAM pahilAM uhanAM de pio dAdA pUjA karade sana| bezakka asIM (allAha) uhanAM nUM uhanAM dI saz2AM dA hissA pUrA diAMge, isa viccoM kaTautI nahIM kItI jAvegI|

bezakka asIM mUsA nUM kitAba (tauraita) baqhazI paraMtU usa vica matabheda kIte gae| jekara tere rabba valloM pahilAM toM hI iha galla nizacita nA kara dittI gaI huMdI tAM uhanAM vicAle faisalA ho giA huMdA| iha sacca hai ki uha loka usa saMbaMdhI zakka vica hana te ise kArana uha duvidhA vica phase hoe hana|
bezakka terA rabba z2arUra hI uhanAM de amalAM dA pUrA-pUrA badalA devegA| bezakka uha (kAfira) jo vI kara rahe hana uha (allAha) uhanAM toM jANU hai|

so (he nabI!) jiveM tuhAnUM hukama dittA giA hai tusIM usa ’te kAima raho ate uha loka vI jihar3e tuhADe valla parata Ae hana| qhabaradAra! haddoM agge nA vadhaNA (bhAva vadhIkI nahIM karanA) allAha tuhADIAM sArIAM harakatAM nUM vekha rihA hai|

(he nabI!) tusIM uhanAM lokAM valla nA jhuko jinhAM ne z2ulama kItA,[8] nahIM tAM tuhAnUM vI (naraka dI) agga ciMbar3a jAvegI ate chuTTa allAha toM tuhADA hora koI sahAI nA hovegA ate nA hI tuhADI madada kItI jAvegI|
translations.footnotes: [8] bhAva uhanAM lokAM nAla dosatI nA rakkho jihar3e loka dIna vica biddatAM dA AraMbha karade hana ate ziraka karake ApaNe utte z2ulama karade hana|

translations.translation: (he muhaMmada sa:!) tusIM dina de doveM siriAM ’te namAz2a kAima rakkho ate rAta dIAM ghar3IAM vica vI (namAz2a par3ho) bezakka nekIAM burAIAM nUM dUra kara diMdIAM hana| iha nasIhata allAha dA z2ikara (simarana) karana vAliAM laI hai|
(he nabI!) tusIM sabara toM kaMma lavo, bezakka allAha nekIAM karana vAliAM dA ajara ajAIM nahIM karadA|

tuhAthoM pahilAM bIta cukkIAM ummatAM vica ajihe bhale loka kiuM nahIM hoe jihar3e lokAM nUM dharatI ’te fasAda failAuNa toM rokade| uhanAM viccoM bahuta hI ghaTTa loka ajihe sana jinhAM nUM asIM (az2Aba toM) bacAiA ate jinhAM lokAM ne z2ulama kItA uha aiza-ArAma vAlIAM cIz2AM de picche lagge rahe, uha sAre aparAdhI hana|
(he nabI!) tuhADA rabba ajihA nahIM ki uha basatIAM nUM (aNa hakkA) z2ulama te az2Aba nAla barabAda kare, jada ki utthe de vasanIka (samAja dA) sudhAra karana vAle hoNa|
je tuhADA rabba cAhuMdA tAM sAre hI lokAM nUM ika hI ummata (samudAe) baNA diMdA| para uha (kAfira) sadA matabheda karade hI rahiNage|

sivAe uhanAM toM jinhAM ’te tere raba dI mihara hai ihanAM nUM tAM paidA hI isa laI kItA giA hai (ki ihanAM dI az2amAIza hove) ate tuhADe rabba dI iha galla vI pUrI hovegI ki maiM naraka nUM jiMnAM te manukkhAM nAla bharAMgAM|

(he nabI!) asIM rasUlAM de kissiAM viccoM tuhAnUM uha kissA suNAuMde hAM jisa rAhIM asIM tuhADe dila nUM hausale vica rakkhIe| isa (kisse) rAhIM tuhADe kola hakka A giA hai ate mominAM laI nasIhata te yAda rakkhaNa vAlIAM gallAM hana|
(he nabI!) ImAna nA liAuNa vAliAM nUM Akha dio ki tusIM ApaNI thAM karama karo baizakka asIM vI karama kara rahe hAM|
tusIM vI (rabbI faisaliAM dI) uDIka karo bezakka asIM vI uDIka karade hAM|

akAza te dharatI dA g2aiba (gupata giAna) allAha laI hI (vizeza) hai| sAre mAmale (kaMma) vI use valla paratAe jAMde hana| so tusIM use dI ibAdata karo ate use ’te bharosA karo, tusIM je vI karade ho usa toM allAha beqhabara nahIM|
alifa, lAma, rA| iha (sapazaTa AitAM) vAlI kitAba hai|
bezakka asIM isa (.kuraAna) nUM arabI (bhAzA) vica utAriA hai tAM jo tusIM samajha sako|
he nabI! asIM tuhAnUM bahuta hI vadhIA kissA suNAuMde hAM, jihar3A asIM vahI duArA nAz2ila kItA hai, isa toM pahilAM tusIM aNajANa lokAM viccoM sI|
iha usa sameM dI galla hai jadoM yUsufa ne ApaNe pitA nUM dassiA sI ki he pitA jI! maiMne (supane vica) vekhiA hai ki giArAM tAre, sUraja te caMna mainUM sijadA kara rahe hana|

usa (pitA, yAkUba) ne AkhiA ki he mere piAre puttara! ApaNe isa supane nUM ApaNe bharAvAM (jihar3e ki giArAM sana) nUM nA suNAIM, nahIM tAM uha tere nAla (IrakhA vica Ake makkArI bharIAM) cAlAM callaNage| bezakka zaitAna tAM manukkha dA khullhA duzamana hai|

(ise supane vAMga hI) terA rabba tainUM (jIvana vica) mAna sammAna devegA ate tainUM samassiAvAM dA halla karanA vI sikhAvegA ate tere utte ate yAkUba de gharAne utte ApaNI niamata (nabI baNAuNa dI) use prakAra pUrI karegA, jiveM isa toM pahilAM tere pio dAdA (ibarAhIma te isahAka utte nabI baNA ke) ahisAna kara cukkA hai| nirasaMdeha, terA rabba bahuta vaDDe giAna ate DUMghI sUjha-bUjha vAlA hai|
bezakka yUsufa te usa de bharAvAM de kisse vica pUcchaNa vAliAM laI batherIAM nizAnIAM hana|

jadoM uhanAM (bharAvAM) ne Apo vica (galla bAta karade hoe) AkhiA ki yUsufa te usa dA (sakA) bharA (binayamIna) sADe pio (yAkUba) nUM sAthoM vaddha piAre hana, jada ki asIM (dasoM bharA) ika jatthA hAM (iMja karake) sADA pio g2alatI kara rihA hai|
(ika bharA ne sujhAu dittA) ki tusIM yUsufa nUM mAra hI dio jAM usa nUM kise vIrAne vica suTTa Ao tAM jo tuhADe pio dA ciharA (dhiAna) tuhADe laI (vizeza) ho jAve, magaroM tusIM neka baNa jANA|

uhanAM bharAvAM viccoM ika ne kihA ki tusIM yUsufa nUM katala nA karo, sagoM usa nUM kise aMne khUha vica suTTa dio, koI AuMdA jAMdA viakatI usa nUM kaDDha ke lai jAvegA| je tusIM kujha karanA hai tAM iMja karo|
so uhanAM ne kihA ki pitA jI, tuhAnUM kI ho giA hai ki tusIM sADe utte yUsufa bAre bharosA nahIM karade jada ki asIM sAre usa de zubha-ciMtaka hAM|
tusIM bhalaki usa (yUsufa) nUM sADe nAla bhejaNA ki asIM rajja ke (phala) khAvAMge te kheDAM-kuddAMge, asIM usa dI rAkhI karAMge|

(yAkUba ne) AkhiA ki bezakka mainUM tAM isa galla dA g2ama hai ki tusIM usa nUM (mere koloM) lai jAo ate mainUM Dara lagadA hai ki usa nUM koI bher3IAM khA jAve te tuhAnUM usa dI koI qhabara vI nA hove|
uhanAM (bharAvAM) ne AkhiA ki je sADe varage zakatIzAlI jatthe de huMde hoe vI koI bhair3IA khA jAve tAM phera asIM tAM ukkA hI nikaMme hoe|

yAkUba dI AgiA deNa magaroM jadoM uha usa (yUsufa) nUM lai gae ate sabha ne milake iha matA pakkA kara liA ki isa nUM khUha vica suTTa deIe, tada asIM yUsufa valla vahI ghallI ki ika samAM ajihA AvegA ki tUM ihanAM (bharAvAM) nUM ihanAM dI karanI z2arUra cete karAegA, ki uha kujjha jANade hI nahIM hoNage|
(yUsufa nUM khUha vica suTTa ke) uha sAre bharA rAta nUM ApaNe pitA kola roMde hoe Ae|

ate AkhaNage lagge ki pitA jI asIM tAM Apo vica daur3a bhajAI de mukAbale vica lagge hoe sI ate yUsufa nUM asIM ApaNe sAmAna kola chaDDa dittA sI ki ika bher3IAM usa (yUsufa) nUM khA giA| tusIM sADI galla ’te vizavAsa tAM nahIM karanA para asIM sacce hAM|

uha (bharA) yUsufa de kur3ate nUM jhUTha mUTha de qhUna nAla bhara liAe sI| pitA (yAkUba) ne AkhiA ki (hakIkata iha nahIM) sagoM tuhADe manAM ne hI tuhADe laI ika (bhair3I) galla nUM sajA dittA hai| huNa tAM sabara hI bihatara hai, ise de laI maiM allAha to hI madada cAhuMdA hAM, jo tusIM dassa rahe ho|

ika kAfalA AiA ate uhanAM ne ApaNe mAsakI nUM pANI laiNa laI bhejiA| jadoM usa ne ApaNA Dola (khUha vica) lamakAiA, (uha vekhade hI) AkhaNa laggiA ki kiMnI qhuzI dI galla hai ki (qhUha vica tAM) ika bAlaka hai| uhanAM (kAfale vAliAM) ne usa bAlaka nUM pUMjI (vapAraka mAla) samajhade hoe lukA liA, jadoM ki uha jo vI kara rahe sI usa toM allAha bhalI-bhAMta jANU sI|
ate uhanAM (kAfale vAliAM) ne usa bAlaka (yUsufa) nUM bahuta hI thor3he mulla ’te bhAva kujjha ku damar3hIAM vaTTe veca suTTiA, uha (kAfale vAle) tAM usa (yUsufa) toM be-dhiAne hI sana|

jisa viakatI ne usa (yUsufa) nUM kAfale vAliAM toM misara deza vica kharIdiA sI usa ne ApaNI patanI nUM AkhiA ki isa (bAlaka) dA dhiAna rakkhIM, ho sakadA hai ki iha sADe laI lAhevaMda siddha hove jAM iha nUM asIM ApaNA puttara hI baNA laIe| iMja asIM yUsufa nUM misara dI dharatI ’te rahiNa laI thAM dittI tAM jo usa nUM gallAM dI tahi taka pahuMcaNA (bhAva supane dI tAbIra) sikhAIe| allAha ApaNe hara kaMma karana vica samaratha hai, para phera vI bathere lokI (allAha de giAna nUM) nahIM jANade|
jadoM uha (yUsufa) javAna ho giA tAM asIM usa nUM hukama (niranAM zakatI) te (rabbI) giAna (nabuvatta) baqhazI, asIM ise tarhAM nekIAM karana vAliAM nUM badalA diA karade hAM|

jisa isatarI de ghara uha (yUsufa) rahiMdA sI, uha usa nUM bharamAuNa laggI ate ika dina bUhe baMda karake kahiNa laggI ki “A jA”| (yUsufa ne) kihA, allAha dI panAha, maiM iha kaMma nahIM karAMgA, uha (terA patI) merA mAlika hai, usa ne mainUM bahuta vadhIA TikANA dittA hai| bezakka z2Alama (dhokhe bAz2a) lokAM nUM bhalAI nahIM miladI|

usa isatarI ne yUsufa nAla (badakArI karana dA) irAdA kara liA ate uha vI usa (badakArI) dA irAdA kara hI laiMdA je ApaNe rabba dIAM nizAnIAM nA vekha laiMdA| iha sabha isa kArana hoiA tAM jo asIM usa (yUsufa) toM (hara tarhAM dI) burAI te be-hiAI (azalIlatA) dUra kara daIe| bezaka uha sADe ’coMNaveM baMdiAM (nabIAM) viccoM sI|

(ika dina) uha doveM (isatarI te yUsufa) bUhe valla nasse ate usa (isatarI) ne usa (yUsufa) dA kur3atA picchioM (khicca ke) pATa dittA ate bUhe kola hI isatarI dA patI dohAM nUM mila giA| tAM uha (isatarI ApaNe patI nUM) AkhaNa laggI, kI saz2A hai usa viakatI dI jihar3A viakatI terI patanI nAla burAI dA irAdA kare? (patI ne kihA) usa dI saz2A tAM iho hai ki usa nUM kaida kara liA jAve jAM koI hora karar3I saz2A dittI jAve|

(yUsufa ne) kihA ki iho (tuhADI patanI) mainUM bharamA rahI sI nA ki maiM| use isatarI de gharAne viccoM ika viakatI ne gavAhI dittI ki je isa yUsufa dA kur3atA muharioM pATiA hai tAM isatarI saccI hai ate iha (yUsufa) jhUThA|
je isa yUsufa dA kur3atA picchioM pATiA hoiA hai tAM aurata jhUThI hai te uha yUsufa saccA|
jadoM az2Iz2a (patI ne) vekhiA ki usa yUsufa dA kur3atA tAM picchioM pATiA hoiA hai tAM usa ne kihA ki iha sabha isatarIAM de tirIAM-carittara hana, bezakka tere carittara vI bahuta qhataranAka hana|
(patI ne kihA ki) he yUsufa! isa galla toM aNadekhI kara ate (he aurata!) tUM ApaNIAM karatUtAM dI (yUsufa toM) muAfI maMga, bezakka tUM hI dozI hai|

usa zahira dIAM z2anAnIAM vica gallAM hoNa lagga paIAM ki az2Iz2a dI patanI ApaNe g2ulAma nUM hI ApaNI icchA pUratI laI bharamAuNa vica laggI hoI hai| usa dA mana usa (yUsufa) dI mahubbata vica fidA ho giA hai| bezakka asIM usa nUM sapazaTa gumarAhI vica vekha rahe hAM|

jadoM usa (az2Iz2a dI patanI) ne uhanAM (z2anAnIAM) dIAM makkArI bharIAM gallAM suNIAM tAM usa ne (sArIAM z2anAnIAM) nUM saddA bhejiA ate uhanAM (z2anAnIAM) laI gAo takIAM vAlI majalisa sajAI ate hareka nUM (phala kaTTaNa laI) ika-ika churI phar3A dittI| ate (phera yUsufa nUM) kihA ki ihanAM de sAhamaNe nikala A| jadoM uhanAM z2anAnIAM ne usa nUM vekhiA tAM vekha ke rurAna ho gaIAM ate ApaNe hattha vaDA baiThIAM ate AkhaNa laggIAM ki allAha dI panAha! iha manukkha nahIM iha tAM koI bahuta hI baz2uraga farizatA hai|

(usa sameM az2Iz2a dI patanI ne) AkhiA, iho uha viakatI hai jisa laI tusIM mainUM tAane-mihane diMdIAM sI| maine hI isa nUM bharamAuNa dI koziza kItI sI para iha baca nikaliA, huNa je isa ne mere hukama anusAra nA kItA tAM isa nUM z2arUra hI kaida kItA jAvegA ate uha bahuta hI hINA hovegA|

(yUsufa ne) kihA ki he mere rabbA! jisa galla laI iha z2anAnIAM mainUM bulA rahIAM hana usa toM tAM mainUM jela hI pasaMda hai| je taine mainUM ihanAM dIAM cAlAM toM nA bacAiA tAM merA jhukAo vI ihanAM z2anAnIAM valla ho jAvegA, phera maiM ukkA hI jAhalAM viccoM ho jAvAMgA|
usa de rabba ne usa (yUsufa) dI duA kabUla kara laI ate usa nUM z2anAnIAM dIAM cAlAM toM bacA liA| bezakka uhIo suNana vAlA te jANakAra hai|
yUsufa dI pavittaratA dIAM sArIAM nizAnIAM vekhaNa toM bAada uhanAM lokAM ne iho ThIka samajhiA ki kujjha sameM laI isa (yUsufa)nUM kaida vica hI rakkhiA jAve|

uha (yUsufa) de nAla hI do hora viakatI vI kaida khAne vica dAqhala hoe| uhanAM viccoM ika ne (yUsufa nUM) kihA ki maine ApaNe Apa nUM supane vica zarAba kaDDhade hoe vekhiA haiai ate dUje ne kihA ki maine supane vica ApaNe sira ’te roTIAM cukkIAM hoIAM hana, jinhAM nUM paMchI khA rahe hana| tusIM sAnUM ihanAM supaniAM dI tAabIra bhAva aratha samajhAo, tusIM sAnUM ika neka viakatI vikhAI de rahe ho|

(yUsufa ne) kihA ki jihar3A bhojana tuhAnUM itthoM miliA karadA hai usa de AuNa toM pahilAM-pahilAM maiM tuhAnUM ihanAM dI tAabIra (aratha) dassa devAMgA| iha (sUjha-bUjha) dIAM gallAM usa giAna viccoM hana jihar3IAM mere rabba ne mainUM sikhAIAM hana| maiMne uhanAM lokAM dA dharama (tarIkA) chaDDiA hoiA hai jihar3e allAha ’te ImAna nahIM rakkhade ate Aqhirata de vI inakArI hana|

maiM tAM ApaNe pio dAdA ibarAhIma, isahAka te yAkUba de dharama dI pairavI karadAM hAM| sADe laI jAiz2a nahIM ki asIM allAha de nAla kise hora nUM zarIka baNAIe| sADe ’te ate sAre hI dUje lokAM ’te allAha dA iha vizeza faz2ala hai, paraMtU bathere loka nA-zukarI karade hana|[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] vekho sUrata ala-bakaraha, hAzIA Aita 135/2

translations.translation: he mere jela de sAthIo! (ratA dasso) kI kaI vakkhare-vakkhare izaTa caMge hana jAM ikko ika allAha jihar3A sabha toM vaddha z2orAvara hai|

isa allAha toM chuTTa tusIM jinhAM dI vI ibAdata karade ho uha kevala nAM (de hI izaTa) hana| jihar3e tusIM te tuhADe baz2uragAM ne Apa rakkha chaDDe hana| allAha ne uhanAM laI koI dalIla (ibAdata karana dI) nahIM utArI| allAha toM chuTTa hora koI hAkama nahIM hai, use dA hukama hai ki tusIM sAre use dI ibAdata karo, iho saccA dharama hai, para bathere lokI nahIM jANade|

(yUsufa ne supane saMbaMdhI dassade hoe kihA ki) he mere jela de sAthIo! tuhADe viccoM ika tAM ApaNe mAlika nUM zarAba piAegA ate dUjA sUlI ’te cAr3hiA jAvegA ate paMchI usa de sira (dA mAsa) noca noca ke khANage| usa mAmale (supane) dA niber3A kara dittA, jisa bAre tusIM methoM puccha rahe sI|

ate jisa bAre (yUsufa dA) vicAra sI ki uhanAM dohAM viccoM ika nUM chaDDa dittA jAvegA, usa nUM kihA ki ApaNe mAlika nUM mere bAre dassaNA| para zaitAna ne usa nUM ApaNe (bAdazAha) kola yUsufa dI galla karana toM bhulA dittA ate (yUsufa) kaI varhe jela vica hI rihA|

(ika dina) bAdazAha ne AkhiA ki maiM supane vica satta moTIAM tAz2IAM gaUAM vekhadA hAM jinhAM nUM satta kamaz2ora sukkIAM gaUAM khA rahIAM hana| ate vekhadA hAM ki anAja dIAM satta ballIAM tAM harIAM bharIAM hana ate satta sukkIAM hana| he darabArIo! mainUM isa supane dI tAabIra (aratha) dasso, je tusIM supaniAM dA aratha dassa sakade ho|
uhanAM (darabArIAM) ne kihA ki iha tAM qhiAlI gallAM bhAva prezAna karana vAle supane hana ate ajihe supaniAM dI tAabIra (bhAva aratha) asIM nahIM jANade|

uhanAM dohAM kaidIAM viccoM jihar3A rihA hoiA sI, usa nUM bar3I dera magaroM (yUsufa) yAda AiA te AkhaNa laggA ki (he bAdazAha!) maiM tuhAnUM isa supane dI tAabIra dassAMge, basa tusIM mainUM (yUsufa) de kola jANa dio|

(usa ne jela vica jA ke) AkhiA ki he sacca bolaNa vAle yUsufa! tusIM sAnUM isa supane dI tAabIra dasso ki satta moTIAM tAz2IAM gaUAM hana jinhAM nUM satta dubalIAM-patalIAM gaUAM khA rahIAM hana| ate satta harIAM-bharIAM ballIAM ate satta hI dUjIAM ukkA hI qhuzaka sukIAM hoIAM ballIAM hana, (mainUM isa dI tAabIra dasso tAM jo) maiM lokAM kola (isa dI tAabIra lai ke jAvAM tAM jo uha vI tuhAnUM jANa laiNa|
(yUsufa ne) kihA ki tusIM satta sAla lagAtAra khetI karoge, so tusIM jihar3I vI fasala kaTTo usa nUM ballIAM vica hI rahiNa dio, jihar3A tusIM khANA hai uha thor3hA jihA lai lavo|
phera satta sAla bahuta hI karar3e AuNage, usa sameM usa (anAja) nUM khA liA jAvegA jihar3A tusIM uhanAM laI jaqhIrA (bhaMDAra) kItA hovegA, kevala uha bacegA jihar3A tusIM bacA ke rakkhiA hoiA sI|
isa toM magaroM ika sAla ajihA AvegA ki isa vica lokAM laI varakhA hovegI ate isa vica uha rasa nicor3aNage|

bAdazAha ne kihA, usa (kaidI) nUM mere kola lai Ao| jadoM rAjadUta usa (yUsufa) kola pahuMciA tAM usa (yUsufa) ne kihA ki ApaNe bAdazAha de kola jAo te usa toM puccho ki jinhAM auratAM ne ApaNe hattha vaDhA lae sI, usa dI hakIkata kI hai? uhanAM z2anAnIAM dIAM cAlAM nUM merA pAlaNahAra caMgI tarhAM jANadA hai|

(bAdazAha ne) isatarIAM nUM pacchiA ki jadoM tusIM yUsufa nUM bharamAuNa dI koziza kara rahIAM sI usa sameM dI hakIkata kI hai? uhanAM (z2anAnIAM) ne uttara dittA ki allAha dI panAha! asIM tAM yUsufa vica koI vI burAI nahIM vekhI| (iha suNa ke) az2Iz2a dI patanI vI AkhaNa laggI ki huNa tAM sacca nittara ke A giA hai, maiM hI usa nUM bharamAiA sI, jada ki uha sacciAM viccoM hI hai|

yUsufa ne kihA ki maiM iha galla isa laI sapazaTa kItI hai ki uha (az2Iz2a) jANa lave ki maiMne usa de piTTha picchioM koI vI vizavAsaghAta nahIM sI kItA, ate iha vI ki allAha dhokhA deNa vAliAM dIAM cAlAM nUM safala nahIM hoNa diMdA|[2]
translations.footnotes: [2] khiAnata bada ahidI ate dagAbAz2I mahAM pApa hai| hadIsa vica isa saMbaMdhI citAvanI AI hai| allAha de rasUla (sa:) ne faramAiA ki hara gaddAra de laI kiAmata de dihAr3e ika jhaMDA gaDiA jAvegA ate ailAna kItA jAvegA ki iha phalAM bina phalAM dI g2addArI hai| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 6177)

translations.translation: yUsufa ne AkhiA ki maiM ApaNe mana nUM pavittara siddha karanA nahIM cAhuMdA jada ki mana tAM burAI valla hI preradA hai| merA pAlaNahAra hI jisa ’te miharAM kare (ohIo burAIAM toM bacadA hai)| bezakka merA rabba bar3A hI baqhazaNahAra te miharabAna hai|

bAdazAha ne AkhiA ki uha nUM (bhAva yUsufa nUM) mere kola liAo tAM jo maiM usa nUM ApaNe laI vizeza kara lavAM, jadoM usa (bAdazAha) ne yUsufa nAla galla kItI tAM kahiNa laggiA ki ajja toM tusIM sADe ucca maratabe vAle te bharosemaMda AdamI ho|
(yUsufa ne) kihA ki tusIM mainUM deza de qhaz2Ane (anAja de bhaMDAra) utte niyukata kara dio, maiM usa dI rAkhI karana vAlA vI hAM ate (usa dI varatoM toM) bhalI-bhAMta jANU hAM|

isa prakAra asIM yUsufa nUM(misara dI) dharatI utte (sattA baqhazI) ki uha jitthe cAhe utthe hI rahe| asIM jisa nUM vI cAhuMde hAM ApaNIAM miharAM baqhazade hAM ate asIM neka lokAM dA badalA ajAIM nahIM karade|
ate Aqhirata dA badalA uhanAM lokAM laI vadhere caMgA hai, jihar3e ImAna liAe ate rabba toM Darade hoe burAIAM toM bacade rahe|
jadoM yUsufa de bharA anAja laiNa laI (misara vikhe) gae tAM usa (yusUfa) ne uhanAM bharAvAM nUM pachANa liA ate uhanAM ne usa nUM nA pachANiA|

jadoM uhanAM dA sAmAna tiAra kara ditA giA phera usa (yUsufa ne) kihA ki tusIM mere kola usa bharA nUM vI nAla lai Ao, jihar3A tuhADe pitA toM hI hai| kI tusIM iha nahIM vekhiA ki maiM pUrA tola ke diMdA hAM ate maiM caMgI mez2abAnI karana vAlA hAM?
je tusIM usa nUM mere kola nA liAe tAM mere valloM tuhAnUM koI tola (aMna-dANe dA) nahIM milegA, sagoM tusIM mere ner3e vI nA DhukaNA|
uhanAM (bharAvAM ne) kihA ki caMgA asIM usa de pitA nUM isa laI manAuNa dI pUrI koziza karAMge|

(yUsufa ne) ApaNe sevAdArAM nUM AkhiA ki ihanAM dI pUMjI (rupiA-paisA) ihanAM de sAmAna dIAM borIAM vica rakkha dio, jadoM uha parata ke ApaNe parivAra vica jANa tAM (pUMjI nUM) pachANa laiNa| ho sakadA hai ki uha phira mur3a (mere kola) AuNa|

jadoM iha (bharAM) ApaNe pitA kola parata Ae tAM AkhaNa lagge ki pitA jI! agge toM sAnUM anAja deNa toM inakAra kara dittA giA hai| huNa tusIM sADe nAla sADe bharA (binayamIna) nUM bhejo tAM jo asIM borIAM bharake anAja liAIe, asIM isa dI rakkhiA karAMge|

(pitA) yAkUba ne kihA, kI maiM isa bAre tuhADe ’te uho jihA bharosA karAM, jiveM isa toM pahilAM ihade bharA (yUsufa) bAre tuhADe ’te kItA sI? basa allAha hI sabha toM vadhIA rakhavAlA hai ate uhIo sabha toM vaddha rahima karana vAlA hai|

jadoM uhanAM ne ApaNA sAmAna kholiA tAM ApaNI pUMjI maujUda pAI jihar3I uhanAM nUM vApasa kara dittI gaI sI AkhaNa lagge ki pitA jI! sAnUM hora kI cAhIdA hai? vekho sADI pUMjI vI sAnUM vApasa kara chaDDI hai| asIM ApaNe parivAra laI anAja lai ke AvAMge ate ApaNe bharA dI rAkhI vI karAMge| asIM ika UMTha de bhAra jiMnA anAja liAvAMge, iMnA anAja tAM sAnUM bahuta asAnI nAla mila jAvegA|

(yAkUba ne) kihA ki maiM tAM kade vI usa nUM tuhADe nAla nahIM bhejAMgA jadoM tIka tusIM allAha nUM gavAha baNA ke mainUM pakkA vacana nA de dio ki tusIM isa nUM mere kola paratA ke liAoMge, chuTTa isa toM ki tusIM sAre (kise musIbata vica) ghira jAo| jadoM uhanAM sabha ne vacana de dittA tAM uhanAM ne kihA ki asIM jo kujjha vI Akhade hAM allAha usa ’te nigarAna hai|

ate usa (yAkUba) ne kihA ki he mere puttaro! tusIM sAre ika hI bUhe toM (zahira vica) praveza nahIM karana, sagoM vakkho-vakkha bUhiAM vica dI jANA| maiM allAha valloM AuNa vAlI kise vI cIz2a (musIbata) nUM TAla nahIM sakadA| hukama tAM kevala allAha dA hI caladA hai| merA use ’te pUrA bharosA hai ate hara bharosA karana vAle nUM use (ika allAha) ’te hI bharosA karanA cAhIdA hai|

uha ApaNe pitA dIAM hidAitAM anusAra (zahira vica) dAqhala hoe ate iha hidAitAM allAha dI maraz2I toM uhanAM nUM nahIM sI bacA sakadIAM, para yAkUba de mana vica ika icchA sI, so uhane pUrI kara laI| asala vica uha sADe valloM dittI hoI sikkhiA nAla hI giAnavAna sI, para bathere lokI iha nahIM jANade|[3]
translations.footnotes: [3] disaNa vAle sAdhaNAM dI varatoM karanA bhAveM ki tavakkala de viruddha nahIM hai para allAha utte hI vizavAsa rakkhaNa sabha toM vaDDA karama hai| hadIsa vica isa dI vaDDI mahattatA AI hai| jiveM ki hadIsa vica hai ki merI ummata de sattara haz2Ara viakatI binA hisAba toM jaMnata vica jANage ate iha uha loka hana jihar3e nA tAM dama karavAuMde hana ate nA hI bada zuganI laiMde hana sagoM allAha dI z2Ata utte hI bharosA rakhade hana| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 6472)

translations.translation: jadoM uha sAre (bharA) yUsufa kola pahuMca gae tAM usa (yUsufa) ne ApaNe sake bharA (binayamIna) nUM ApaNe kola biThA liA ate AkhiA ki maiM terA bharA (yUsufa) hAM, iha jo vI karade rahe hana huNa tUM usa dI ciMtA nA kara|

jadoM usa ne (yUsufa ne) uhanAM bharAvAM dA sAmAna tiAra karavA dittA tAM ApaNe bharA de sAmAna vica ika piAlA rakkha dittA, phera ika ailAna karana vAle ne AvAz2a dittI ki he kAfale vAlio! tusIM tAM cora ho|
uhanAM ne parata ke pucchiA ki tuhADI kihar3I cIz2a guAcI hai?

(Avaz2a deNa vAle ne) kihA ki asIM bAdazAha dA piAlA guAciA vekha rahe hAM| jihar3A koI usa nUM liA ke devegA usa laI ika UMTha de bhAra jiMnA (anAja) inAma niyata hai| maiM isa galla dI z2amAnata diMdA hAM|
uhanAM (bharAvAM) ne AkhiA ki allAha dI kasama tusIM tAM bhalI-bhAMta jANade ho ki asIM itthe fasAda phailAuNa nahIM Ae ate nA hI asIM cora hAM|
sarakArI karamacArIAM ne uhanAM nUM pucchiA, caMgA cora dI saz2A kI hovegI je tusIM jhUThe siddha ho gae|
javAba vica kihA ki uhadI saz2A tAM iho hai ki jisa de sAmAna vica (tola) nikale uhIo badale vica rakkhiA jAve, asIM tAM z2AlamAM (corAM) nUM iho saz2A diMde hai|

so yUsufa ne ApaNe bharA (binayamIna) de sAmAna dI talAzI toM pahilAM uhanAM dI talAzI laiNI zurU kara dittI| phera usa piAle nUM ApaNe bharA de sAmAna viccoM kaDDhiA| isa tarhAM asIM yUsufa dI sahAitA laI iha tadabIra kItI, kiuM jo isa (misara de) bAdazAha de kAnUMna anusAra iha (yUsufa) ApaNe bharA nUM nahIM sI rakkha sakadA, chuTTa isa toM ki allAha iho cAhuMdA sI| asAM jisa de vI cAhuMde hAM usa de daraje ucce kara diMde hAM| hara giAna rakkhaNa vAle toM vaddha giAna rakkhaNa vAlA (allAha) baiThA hai|

uhanAM (bharAvAM) ne AkhiA ki je iha (binayamIna) ne corI kItI hai (tAM koI hairAnI nahIM) ihadA bharA (yUsufa) vI pahilAM corIAM kara cukkiA hai| yUsufa ne isa galla nUM mana vica hI lukA liA ate ihanAM de sAhamaNe sapazaTa nahIM hoNa dittA (ki uhIo yUsufa hai ate mana vica) AkhiA ki tusIM ghaTIA daraje de loka ho| jo tusIM biAna kara rahe ho usa nUM allAha bhalI-bhAMta jANadA hai|

uhanAM bharAvAM ne AkhiA ki he misara de hAkama! isa dA pitA bahuta hI birada hai| tusIM iha de badale vica sADe viccoM kise nUM rakkha lavo, asIM vekhade hAM ki tusIM bahuta hI ahisAna karana vAle viakatI ho|

(yUsufa ne) kihA, asIM jisa de koloM ApaNI (guAcI) hoI cIz2a prApata kItI hai usa nUM chaDDa ke dUje nUM kaida karana toM allAha dI panAha maMgade hAM| iMja tAM asIM nA-inasAfI karana vAliAM viccoM ho jAvAMge|

jadoM uha (bharA) usa (yUsufa) toM nirAza ho gae tAM aDDa baiTha ke salAhAM karana lagge (kI huNa kI karIe) ihanAM viccoM jihar3A sabha toM vaDDA sI usa ne AkhiA, kI tuhAnUM patA nahIM ki tuhADe pitA ne tuhAthoM allAha dI kasama ’te pakkA vacana liA sI| isa toM pahilAM yUsufa de mAmale vica tusIM g2alatI kara cukke ho| huNa maiM tAM itthoM jAvAMgA nahIM jadoM tIka mere pitA jI mainUM (ghara AuNa dI) AgiA nA deNa jAM allAha hI mere mAmale vica koI faisalA kara deve, uhIo vadhIA faisalA karana vAlA hai|
so tusIM ApaNe pitA jI kola jAo ate kaho ki pitA jI! tuhADe sAhibaz2Ade ne corI kItI hai, asIM tAM uhIo AkhiA hai jo asIM jANade hAM| hAM! sAnUM g2aiba (parokha) dA giAna nahIM hai|
tusIM usa basatI de lokAM toM puccha-giccha kara lao jitthe asIM gae sI, usa kAfale toM vI puccha lavo jisa nAla asIM Ae hAM, asIM bilakula sacca bolade hAM|

(yAkUba ne) kihA ki (hakIkata iha nahIM) tuhADe laI tuhADe mana ne ika jhUTha galla nUM baNA saMvAra liA hai| basa huNa sabara karanA hI bihatara hai| ho sakAda hai ki allAha uhanAM sabha (dohAM bharAvAM) nUM mere nAla liA malAve uhIo giAnavAna te hikamatAM vAlA hai|
iha kahi ke (pitA ne) uhanAM toM mUMha mor3a liA ate AkhiA ki hAe yUsufa! usa dIAM akkhAM (yUsufa de) g2ama vica (ro ro ke) ciTTIAM ho gaIAM sana ate (g2ama nAla usa dA dila) bhariA hoiA sI|
puttarAM ne kihA, allAha dI kasama! tusIM tAM basa yUsufa nUM hI yAda karade rahiMde ho, itthoM tIka ki tusIM jAM tAM roga lagA baiThoge jAM prANa tiAga dioge|
uhanAM (yAkUba) ne AkhiA ki maiM tAM ApaNIAM parezAnIAM ate dukhar3iAM dI fariAda allAha kole hI karadA hAM| maiM allAha valloM uha kujjha jANadA hAM jo tusIM nahIM jANade|
he mere puttaro! jAo! te yUsufa ate usa de bharA dI caMgI tarhAM bhAla karo| allAha dIAM miharAM toM be-Asa nA hovo| allAha dIAM miharAM toM kAfira hI nirAza huMde hana|

jadoM uha sAre bharA yUsufa kola pahuMce tAM AkhaNa lagge ki he az2Iz2a (hAkama)! sAnUM te sADe parivAra nUM bahuta hI dukha pahuMciA hai| asIM tuccha jihI pUMjI lai ke Ae hAM, tusIM sAnUM pUrA anAja (bhAva sADA baNadA hissA) de dio ate sAnUM puMna-dAna (qhairAta) vI dio| allAha puMna-dAna karana vAliAM nUM caMgA badalA diMdA hai|
yUsufa ne AkhiA, kI tusIM jANade vI ho ki tusIM yUsufa ate usa de bharA nAla nAdAnI vica kI kItA sI, jadoM tusIM nAdAna sI?

uha (bharA) bole, kI tUM hI yUsufa hai? kihA hAM! maiM hI yUsufa hAM ate iha merA bharA hai, allAha ne sADe ’te mihara kItI hai| bezakka jihar3A vI viakatI parahez2agArI te sabara karadA hai tAM allAha kise nekI karana vAliAM dA badalA ajAIM nahIM karadA|
uhanAM (bharAvAM) ne AkhiA, allAha dI kasama! allAha ne tuhAnUM sADe ’te vaDiAI baqhazI hai ate iha vI sacca hai ki asIM hI dozI sAM|
(yUsufa ne) javAba dittA ki ajja tuhADe sira koI doza nahIM allAha tuhAnUM khimA kare, uha sabha toM vadhere miharabAna hai|[4]
translations.footnotes: [4] allAha dI miharAM dA aMdAz2A isa hadIsa toM kItA jA sakadA hai jisa vica rasUla (sa:) ne pharamAiA ki jadoM allAha ne rahimata nUM paidA kItA sI tAM usa de sau hisse kIte sI isa vicoM 99 hisse ApaNe kola rakkha lae ate usa dA ika hissA ApaNI makhalUka laI bheja ditA| je kAfira iha jANa laiNa ki allAha kola kiMnI rahimata hai tAM uha kadI vI jaMnata toM beAsa nahIM hoNage ate je momina iha jANa lave ki allAha kola kiMnA az2Aba hai tAM uha kadI vI naraka toM be-Dara nahIM rahegA| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 6469)

translations.translation: tusIM iha kur3atA mere pitA de mUMha ’te lijA ke pA dio, uha vekhaNa lagga jANage ate tusIM ApaNe pUre parivAra nUM mere kola lai Ao|
jadoM uha (bharAvAM dA) kAfalA (misara toM) TuriA tAM uhanAM de pitA (yAkUba) ne AkhiA ki mainUM tAM yUsufa dI qhuzabU A rahI hai, je tusIM iha nA-samajho ki maiM saThiA giA hAM|
uha bharA AkhaNa lagge ki kasama rabba dI tusIM tAM uhIo purANe sudAa vica pae hoe ho|

jadoM qhuzaqhabarI deNa vAle ne A ke uhanAM (yAkUba) de mUMha ’te uha (yUsufa valloM dittA giA) kur3atA pAiA, use sameM uhanAM dI akkhAM dI jota parata AI| (yAkUba ne) kihA ki maiM tuhAnUM kahiMdA nahIM sI ki maiM allAha valloM uha gallAM jANadA hAM jihar3IAM tusIM nahIM jANade|
uhanAM (putarAM) ne AkhiA ki pitA jI! tusIM sADe gunAhAM dI baqhaziza laI (rabba koloM) duA karo, asIM sacca muca dozI hAM|
(yAkUba ne) kihA ki caMgA maiM ApaNe rabba toM tuhADe laI chetI hI baqhaziza dI duA karAMgA, uha tAM bahuta hI baqhazaNahAra ate ati miharAM karana vAlA hai|

jadoM pUrA parivAra yUsufa de kola pahuMca giA tAM yUsufa ne ApaNe mAM-pio nUM ApaNe nAla thAM dittI ate kihA ki tusIM sAre misara vica A vaso, je allAha nUM manaz2Ura hoiA tAM tusIM sAre amana zAMtI nAla rahoge|

usa (yUsUfa) ne ApaNe mAM-pio nUM taqhata ’te uccA karake biThAiA ate sAre (giArAM bharA) usa de agge jhuka gae tadda yUsufa ne kihA ki pitA jI! iha mere pahile supane dI tAabIra hai, mere rabba ne usa nUM sacca kara vikhAiA| usa ne mere utte bahuta vaDDA ahisAna kItA hai, mainUM jela viccoM bAhara kaDDhiA ate tuhAnUM (piMDa viccoM) itthe (misara vica) liAiA jada ki zaitAna ne mere te mere bharAvAM vicAle vigAr3a pA dittA sI| merA rabba jo vI cAhuMdA hai usa laI vadhIA upparAle karadA hai, bezakka uha hara galla jANana vAlA te hikamatAM vAlA hai|

(yUsufa ne duA karade hoe kihA ki) he mere pAlaNahAra! taine hI mainUM sattA baqhazI hai ate mainUM supaniAM dI tAabIra sikhAI hai| he akAza te dharatI de sirajaNahAra! tUM hI loka-paraloka vica mere kaMma savArana vAlA hai| tUM merA aMta isalAma ’te hI karIM ate (paraloka vica) merA sAtha neka lokAM nAla hove|

(he muhaMmada sa:!) iha porakha (g2aiba) dIAM kujjha qhabarAM hana jihar3IAM asIM (allAha) tuhADe valla vahI kara rahe hAM| tusIM uhanAM (yUsufa de bharAvAM) de saMga nahIM sI jadoM uhanAM ne ApaNI ika galla ’te sahimatI pragaTAI sI ate uha (yUsufa de viruddha) cAlAM calla rahe sI|
(he nabI sa:!) tusIM bhAveM kiMnAM vI cAho para vadhere loka ImAna liAuNa vAle nahIM|
jada ki tusIM uhanAM toM koI badalA vI nahIM bhAlade| iha (.kuraAna) sArI dunIAM de lokAM laI nasIhata hai|
akAza te dharatI vica batherIAM ajihIAM nizAnIAM hana jinhAM kola dI iha kAfira mUMha mor3a ke laMgha jAMde hana, para ratA vI dhiAna nahIM diMde|
ihanAM lokAM vica bathere loka allAha ’te ImAna rakkhade hoe vI muzarika hI huMde hana (bhAva rabba de pUjA vI karade hana ate nAla hora izaTAM dI vI)|
kI uhanAM muzirakAM nUM isa galla dA koI Dara nahIM ki uhanAM kola allAha de az2AbAM viccoM koI vI az2Aba A jAve jAM uhanAM ’te acaNaceta kiAmata A jAve ate uhanAM nUM qhabara vI nA hove|

(he nabI sa:!) Akha dio ki iho merI rAha hai maiM tuhAnUM allAha valla balAuMdA hAM| maiM ate uha loka jihar3e mere pairokAra hana pUre vizavAsa te sUjha-bUjha ’te khar3he hAM| allAha pAka hai ate maiM muzarikAM viccoM nahIM|

(he nabI!) tuhAthoM pahilAM asIM jiMne vI rasUla ghalle uha sAre hI marada sI jinhAM valla asIM ApaNI vahI bhejade sI ate uha basatIAM vica rahiNa vAle sana| kI uhanAM lokAM ne dharatI ’te ghuMma-phira ke nahIM vekhiA ki uhanAM toM pahilAM (inakArIAM) dA kI hAla hoiA sI? Aqhirata dA ghara hI parahez2agAra lokAM laI vadhIA ghara? | kI tusIM loka phera vI nahIM samajhade|

jadoM rasUla (ApaNI kauma toM) nirAza ho gae ate uha loka vI samajhaNa lagga pae ki uhanAM nUM hakIkata de viruddha qhabara dittI gaI hai tAM usa vele sADI madada uhanAM (rasUlAM) nUM A pahuMcI| phera (az2Aba toM) bacAo use dA hoiA jisa nUM asIM cAhiA para aparAdhI kauma toM az2Aba TaliA nahIM karadA|

bezakka ihanAM kissiAM vica samajha-bUjha rakkhaNa vAliAM laI vaDDIAM sikkhiAvAM hana| iha (.kuraAna) koI ghar3hI hoI galla nahIM, sagoM ApaNe toM pahilIAM kitAbAM (z2abUra, tauraita ate iMjIla) dI puzaTI karadI hai ate hara galla dA viAkhaNa vI hai ate ImAna vAliAM laI (rabbI) hidAita te rahimata hai|[5]
translations.footnotes: [5] bhAva kuraAna nUM samajhanA ate usa rAhIM hidAita prApata karanA allAha valoM ika inAma hai| jiveM hadIsa vica hai ki je allAha kise nAla bhalAI karanA cAhuMdA hai tAM usa nUM dIna dI samajha baqhaza diMdA hai ate faramAiA ki maiM vaMDaNa vAlA hAM ate baqhazaNahAra allAha hai ate iha vI yAda rakkho ki sacce musalamAna isalAma de akIdA-e-tauhIda dI saqhatI nAla pairavI karanage| uhanAM de virodhI uhanAM nUM koI hAnI nahIM pahuMcA sakaNage| ithoM tIka ki allAha de hukama bhAva kiAmata A jAvegI| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 71)

translations.translation: alifa, lAma, rA| (he nabI!) iha (rabbI) kitAba (.kuraAna) dIAM AitAM (Adeza) hana jo tuhADe rabba valloM tuhADe ’te utArIAM gaIAM hana| uha hakka sacca (’te AdhArita) hana, para vadhere lokI phera vI ImAna nahIM liAuMde|

allAha uha z2Ata hai jisa ne thaMmhAM toM binAM uhanAM akAzAM nUM uccA sathApita kItA, jihar3e (akAza) tuhAnUM vikhAI diMde hana| phera uha ApaNI rAja gaddI ’te virAjamAna ho giA ate sUraja te caMna nUM kaMma ’te lAiA| hareka ApaNe niyata sameM tIka laI calla rihA hai| uhI hara kaMma dA prabaMdha karadA hai ate ApaNIAM nizAnIAM visathAra nAla varaNana kara rihA hai tAM jo tusIM ApaNe rabba dI milaNI ’te vizavAsa kara lavo|

uhI (allAha) hai jisa ne dharatI nUM (pharaza vAMga) vichAiA hai ate isa vica pahAr3a te nahirAM nUM baNAiA ate isa vica bhAMta-bhAMta de phalAM de do-do jor3e baNAe| uha dina nUM rAta nAla DhakkadA hai| bezakka isa vica uhanAM lokAM laI batherIAM nizAnIAM hana, jihar3e soca vicAra karade hana|

dharatI vica ika dUje nAla laggade khatte hana, aMgUrAM de bAg2a, khetIAM ate khajUrAM de rukkha hana, jiMnhA dIAM jar3hAM Apasa vica milIAM hoIAM hana ate aDDo-aDDa vI hana, ihanAM sAriAM nUM ika hI pANI siMjadA hai| asIM kujjha phalAM nUM suAda vica dUje phalAM nAloM caMgerA baNA diMde hAM| bezakka ihanAM cIz2AM vica uhanAM lokAM laI nizAnIAM hana, jihar3e akala-samajha rakkhade hana|

je tusIM acaraja karanA hI hai tAM acarajayoga tAM uhanAM (kAfirAM) dA iha kahiNA hai ki jadoM asIM (mara ke) miTTI ho jAvAMge tAM kI sAnUM naveM siiraoM paidA kItA jAvegA? iho uha loka hana jihar3e ApaNe rabba de inakArI hana ate iho hana jinhAM dIAM garadanAM vica (kiAmata dihAr3e) paTe pae hoNage ate iho naraka vica jANa vAle hana, jitthe uha sadA laI rahiNage|

(he nabI!) uha loka tuhAthoM bhalAI (rabba dI mihara) toM pahilAM burAI (rabbI az2Aba) cAhuMde hana, hAlAM ki ihanAM toM pahilAM (az2Aba dIAM sikkhiAdAika) misAlAM guz2ara cukkIAM hana ate bezakka tuhADA rabba lokAM valloM vadhIkIAM hoNa de bAvajUda uhanAM nUM baqhazaNa vAlA hai| (hakIkata iha vI hai ki) bezakka tuhADA rabba karar3I saz2A deNa vAlA hai|

kAfira loka kahiMde hana ki isa (muhaMmada sa:) ’te isa de rabba valloM (nabI hoNa dI) koI nizAnI kiuM nahIM utArI gaI? (he nabI!) tusIM tAM kevala (rabbI az2Aba toM) DarAuNa vAle ho| (kiuM jo) hareka kauma laI (rabba valloM) ika mAraga darazaka huMdA hai|
hara madIna jo vI ApaNe garabha vica cukkI phiradI hai, allAha usa nUM jANadA hai ate garabhAM dA ghaTaNA-vadhaNA vI (jANadA hai)| usa de kola hara cIz2a laI ika parimANa nizacita hai|
uha g2aiba (parokha) te z2Ahira (paratakkha) dA jANana vAlA hai| uha mahAna te saravaucca hai|
tuhADe viccoM bhAveM koI haulI-haulI gallAM kare jAM uccI-uccI, ate bhAveM koI rAta de haneriAM vica lukiA hove jAM dina de cAnaNe vica calla rihA hove, allAha laI sabha ika samAna hai|

usa (manukkha) laI vArI-vArI AuNa vAle farizate hana jihar3e usa de agge-picche lagge hoe hana allAha de hukama nAla usa dI dekha-bhAla karade hana|[1] allAha kise kauma dI hAlata udoM taka nahIM badaladA jadoM tIka uha ApaNe mana dI avasathA nUM nahIM badaladI| jadoM allAha kise kauma nAla burAI (az2Aba) dA irAdA karadA hai tAM phera usa nUM TAlaNa vAlA koI nahIM ate uhanAM laI usa (allAha) toM chuTTa koI kAraja sAdhaka vI nahIM|
translations.footnotes: [1] vekho sUrata ala-anAma, hAzIA Aita 61/6

translations.translation: (allAha) uhIo hai jihar3A tuhAnUM DarAuNa laI ate AsAM jagAuNa laI bijalIAM (dI lizaka) vikhAuMdA hai ate (pANI nAla) ladde hoe baddala uThAuMdA hai|

baddalAM dI kar3aka [2] usa dI usatata de nAla usa dI tasabIha (pAkI biAna) karadI hai ate farizate vI uhade Dara-qhaufa toM (kaMbade hoe) uhadI tasabIha karade hana| uhI (akAzoM) kar3akadIAM bijalIAM bhejadA hai ate jisa (thAM) ’te vI cAhuMdA hai Dega diMdA hai jada ki uha (kAfira) allAha bAre jhagar3a rahe huMde hana,vAsatava vica usa dI cAla z2abaradasata huMdI hai|
translations.footnotes: [2] kujjha.kuraAna de viAkhAkArAM dA kahiNA hai ki ala-rAada ika farizate dA nAM hai, jihar3A baddalAM laI rakkha chaDDiA hai, uha allAha de hukamAM anusAra baddalAM nUM ika thAM toM dUjI thAM lai ke jAMdA hai ate allAha dI pavittaratA te vaDiAI dA simarana karadA rahiMdA hai| (tafasIra ala-kuratabI 296/9)

translations.translation: use (allAha) nUM (hara lor3a laI) pukArana dA hakka baNadA hai| jihar3e loka usa nUM chaDDa ke horA izaTAM nUM pukArade hana uha uhanAM de kise vI galla dA uttara nahIM de sakade| jiveM koI viakatI ApaNe dohAM hatthAM nUM pANI valla pasAra ke benatI kare ki pANI usa de mUMha tIka pujja jAve jadoM ki uha (pANI) usa de mUMha tIka pujaNa jogA nahIM| (ise tarhAM) inakArIAM dIAM jiMnIAM vI aradAsAM hana uha sArIAM gumarAhI vAlIAM hana|
allAha nUM hI dharatI te akAzAM dIAM sArIAM cIz2AM, cAhuMdIAM te nA cAhuMdIAM, sijadA karadIAM hana ate uhanAM cIz2AM de parachAveM vI saMjha-savere (uhade agge jhukade hana)|

(he nabI!) tusIM ihanAM toM puccho ki akAzAM te dharatI dA rabba (sirajanahAra) kauNa hai? tusIM Akha dio ki allAha hai! phira ihanAM nUM Akho, kI tusIM allAha toM chuTTa uha himAitI baNAe hoe hana jihar3e ApaNI z2Ata laI vI lAbha-hANa dA adhikAra nahIM rakkhade| puccha kI aMnhA te sujAkhA ika samAna ho sakadA hai? jAM kI hanerA te cAnaNa ika barAbara ho sakadA hai? jinhAM nUM tusIM allAha dA zarIka baNAiA hai kI uhanAM ne vI allAha vAMga kise nUM sAjiA hai? jisa kArana rabba valloM sAjiA hoiA (kulla jahAna) uhanAM laI zakka-zubAha vAlA ho giA hai? (he nabI!) Akha dio ki kevala allAha hI sArIAM cIz2AM dA qhAlika (sirajanahAra) hai| uha ikko-ika hai te sabhanAM ’te bhArU hai|

use (allAha) ne akAza toM pANI nAz2ala kItA ate ApaNI-ApaNI samAI anusAra nadI nAle (usa pANI nUM lai ke) vagaNa laga pae, phera jadoM har3ha AiA tAM utte jhagga A gaI| ise prakAra dI jhagga uhanAM dhAtAM toM vI uThadI hai jinhAM nUM gihaNe jAM dUje samAna baNAuNa laI agga vica DhAliA jAMdA hai| isa prakAra allAha sacca te jhUTha dI udAharana diMdA hai| so jihar3I jhagga hai uha sukka ke uDDa jAMdI hai para jihar3I cIz2a lokAM nUM lAbha deNa vAlI hai, uha dharatI ’te rahi jAMdI hai|[3] allAha iMja hI udahAraNAM diMdA hai (tAM jo samajhaNa vica AsAnI hove)|
translations.footnotes: [3] jiveM saccAI hai| vekho sUrata ala-taubA, hAzIA Aita 119/9

translations.translation: jinhAM lokAM ne ApaNe pAlaNahAra dA hukama maMniA, uhanAM laI bhalAI hai ate jinhAM ne usa dA hukama nahIM maMniAM, jekara uhanAM kola uha sabha kujjha hove jo dharatI ’te hai ate unnAM hI hora hove tAM uha sabha kujjha (kiAmata dihAr3e) fidiA (chuDavAI vajoM) deNa laI tiAra ho jANage| [4] iho uha loka hana jinhAM toM karar3AI vAlA hisAba liA jAvegA ate unhAM dA TikANA naraka hai ate uha bahuta hI bhair3A TikANA hai|
translations.footnotes: [4] vekho sUrata Ale-imarAna, hAzIA Aita 91/3

translations.translation: (he nabI!) uha viakatI jihar3A iha giAna rakkhadA hai ki tuhADe rabba ne jo vI tuhADe ’te (.kuraAna) utAriA hai uhIo hakka hai, kI uha viakatI aMnhiAM vAMga ho sakadA hai? sikkhiA tAM uhIo prApata kara sakade hana jihar3e sUjha-bUjha vAle hana|
uha (loka sUjhavAna hana) jihar3e allAha nUM ditte vacanAM nUM pUrA karade hana ate pakke vAadiAM nUM tor3ade nahIM|

ate jinhAM saMbaMdhAM nUM allAha ne jor3ana dA hukama dittA hai uhanAM (rizatiAM) nUM uha jor3IM rakkhade hana, uha ApaNe pAlaNahAra toM Darade hana ate (kiAmata dihAr3e) karar3AI vAlI puccha-giccha dA bhaia vI rakkhade hana|

jo ApaNe rabba dI raz2A prApata karana laI sabara toM kaMma laiMde hana, namAz2AM nUM kAima karade hana ate jo vI asIM uhanAM nUM (mAla daulata) de rakkhiA hai usa nUM gupata rUpa vica vI te khullhe-Ama vI qharaca karade hana ate burAI nUM caMgiAI nAla parAM karade hana, uhanAM sUjhavAna lokAM laI hI paraloka dA vadhIA ghara hai|

uhanAM laI uha sadIvI bAg2a hana, jinhAM vica uha Apa vI praveza karanage ate uhanAM de pio, dAde, uhanAM dIAM patanIAM te uhanAM dI saMtAna viccoM jihar3e neka hoNage uha sabha praveza karanage te farizate (jaMnata) de hara bUhe toM (suvAgata laI) uhanAM kola AuNage|
(uha farizate) AkhaNage ki tuhADe ’te salAmatI hove, isa laI ki tusIM (saMsAra vica) sabara toM kaMma liA| so (isa kArana) tuhADe laI bahuta hI sohaNA Aqhirata dA ghara hai|

jihar3e lokI allAha nAla kIte hoe pakke vacanAM nUM tor3a diMde hana ate jinhAM saMbaMdhAM nUM jor3ana laI allAha ne hukama dittA hai usa nUM tor3ade hana ate dharatI utte fasAda phailAuMde hana,[5] uhanAM laI lAanatAM hana ate uhanAM laI paraloka vica vaDDA bhair3A TikANA hai|
translations.footnotes: [5] vekho sUrata ala-bakaraha, hAzIA Aita 27/2

translations.translation: allAha jisa nUM cAhuMdA hai khullhA-DullhA te jisa nUMcAhuMdA hai giNavAM miNavAM riz2aka diMdA hai| iha (kAfira) loka tAM saMsArika jIvana ’te hI qhuza hana jadoM ki iha saMsAra jIvana Aqhirata (paraloka) de mukAbale vica ika nA-mAtara cIz2a hai|

kAfira Akhade hana ki isa (muhaMmada sa:) de rabba valloM koI nizAnI (nabI hoNa dI) kiuM nahIM utArI gaI? (he nabI! kAfirAM nUM) Akho ki allAha jisa nUM cAhuMdA hai kurAhe pA diMdA hai ate jihar3A usa valla parata AuMdA hai, usa nUM siddhI rAha darasAuMdA hai|
jihar3e lokI ImAna liAe uhanAM de hiradiAM nUM allAha de simarana nAla hI zAMtI prApata huMdI hai| (he loko!) cete rakkho ki allAha dA simarana karana nAla hI manAM nUM zAMtI prApata huMdI hai|[6]
translations.footnotes: [6] allAha dA simarana karana ate usa dI pavittaratA te vaDiAI dI caracA karana de saMbaMdha vica allAha de rasUla (sa:) ne faramAiA, usa viakatI dI udAharana, jihar3A ApaNe rabba dA simarana karadA hai, usa viakatI de mukAbale vica jihar3A simarana nahIM karadA, iMja hai jiveM moe de mukAbale vica jiUMdA viakatI| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 6407) ● allAha de rasUla ne faramAiA, jihar3A vI koI dina vica so vAra “subahAnallAhI vabI hamadIhI” AkhegA, usa de sAre choTe gunAha muAfa kara ditte jANage, bhAveM uha samuMdara dI jhagga jinne hI kiuM nA hoNa| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 6405) ● ika dUjI hadIsa vica hai, jihar3A viakatI dina vica sau vAra “lA ilAhA ilalla lAho vAhadAhU lA zarIkalAhU lahUla malaku valA hula hamadU vAhUvA alA kullI zaia ina kadIra” (bhAva allAha toM chuTTa hora koI izaTa nahIM, uha ikallA hI hai, usa dA koI sAMjhI nahIM, pAtazAhI use laI hai ate sArIAM tArIfAM vI use laI hana ate hareka cIz2a use de kabaz2e vica hai|) AkhegA, tAM usa nUM dasa g2ulAma Az2Ada karana jinnA savAba milegA ate usa de khAte vica sau nekIAM likha dittIAM jAMdIAM hana ate usa de khAte viccoM dasa burAIAM nUM miTA dittA jAMdA hai, ate usa dA iha amala usa nUM zaitAna dIAM zarAratAM toM surakkhiata rakkhadA hai ate koI vI viakatI usa dina use viakatI toM vaddha ke neka kaMma karana vAlA nahIM hovegA, chuTTa usa toM jiMnhe iha karama usa toM vaddha kItA hove| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 6403)

translations.translation: jihar3e loka ImAna liAe ate (uhanAM ne) neka kaMma vI kIte uhanAM laI bhalAI hI bhalAI hai ate rahiNa laI bahuta hI vadhIA TikANA (jaMnata) hai|

(jiveM pahilAM rasUla bheje sana| use tarhAM asIM (he muhaMmada sa:!) tuhAnUM vI ika ajihI ummata vica rasUla baNA ke bhejiA hai jisa toM pahilAM batherIAM ummatAM bIta cukkIAM hana, tAM jo tusIM vI ihanAM nUM uha (saMdeza) suNAo jihar3I vahI asIM tuhADe valla ghallI hai| uha rahimAna (bhAva allAha) dA inakAra karade hana| (he nabI!) tusIM Akha dio ki uhIo (rahimAna) merA rabba hai, usa toM chuTTa hora koI izaTa nahIM, use ’te merA (aTuTTa) vizavAsa hai ate merA parataNA vI use valla hai|

je bhalAM koI ajihA਼kuraAna huMdA jisa duArA pahAr3a tore jAMde jAM dharatI de ToTe-ToTe kara ditte jAMde jAM muradiAM nAla gallAM karavAIAM jAMdIAM (tAM vI iha loka ImAna nA liAMde) sagoM (imAna liAuNa jAM nA liAuNa dA) sArA adhikAra hI allAha de hattha vica hai| kI ImAna vAliAM dA isa galla ’te dila nahIM ThukadA ki je allAha cAhuMdA tAM sAre lokAM nUM (binAM kise prakAra dA camatakAra vikhAe) siddhe rAha pA diMdA? kAfirAM nUM tAM uhanAM dIAM karatUtAM kArana koI nA koI bipatA paI hI rahegI jAM uhanAM de gharAM de ner3e-ter3e (koI musIbata) uttaradI rahegI| itthoM taka ki allAha dA vAadA (mominAM dI safalatA dA jAM kiAmata dihAr3e dA) pUrA ho jAve| allAha ApaNe vacanAM viraddha kujjha nahIM karadA|

(he nabI!) tuhAthoM pahilAM vI paig2aMbarAM dA makhaula uDAiA jAMdA rihA hai para allAha ne kAfirAM nUM Dhilla de chaDDI sI, aMta uhanAM nUM nappa liA, phera vekha lao ki merA az2Aba kiMnA karar3A sI|

bhalAM uha allAha, jihar3A hareka jIva de kIte kaMmAM dI nigarAnI kara rihA hai ate jihar3e lokAM ne allAha de zarIka baNAe hoe hana, (kI uha allAha de barAbara ho sakade hana? ) (he nabI!) kahi dio ki uhanAM de nAM tAM lavo? kI tusIM allAha nUM uha gallAM dassa rahe ho, jisa nUM uha ApaNI dharatI ’te nahIM jANadA? sagoM jhUThe gumAnAM ’te hI tusIM allAha dA zarIka baNAuMde ho| asala galla iha hai ki kufara karana vAliAM laI uhanAM dIAM cAlabAz2IAM nUM (uhanAM dIAM karatUtAM nUM) sajA-saMvAra dittA giA hai ate uhanAM nUM siddhe rAha toM roka dittA giA| jisa nUM allAha kurAhe pA deve usa nUM siddhe rAha pAuNa vAlAM koI vI nahIM|
ihanAM kAfirAM laI saMsArika jIvana vica vI az2Aba hai ate Aqhirata (paraloka) dA az2Aba tAM bahuta hI karar3A hai| ihanAM nUM allAha de g2az2aba (gusse) toM bacAuNa vAlA koI vI nahIM|

usa savaraga dI vizezatA, jisa dA vacana (burAIAM toM) parahez2a karana vAle lokAM nAla kItA giA hai, iha hai ki usa de heTha nahirAM vagadIAM hana usa de phala sadA laI hana (bhAva mosamI nahIM) ate uhanAM dA parachAvAM amukka hai| iha hai aMta parahez2agArAM dA ate kAfirAM dA aMta naraka dI agga hai|

(he nabI!) jinhAM nUM asIM pahilAM kitAba dittI sI, uha isa kitAba (.kuraAna) toM jihar3I tuhADe ’te utArI hai, qhuza huMde hana ate kujjha dUje dhar3e.kuraAna dIAM kujjha gallAM toM inakAra karade hana| (he muhaMmada sa:!) tusIM Akha dio ki mainUM tAM kevala iho hukama dittA giA hai ki maiM allAha dI ibAdata karAM ate isa de nAla kise nUM sAMjhI nA baNAvAM| maiM use valla (sabha nUM) bulAuMdA hai ate use valla maiM parataNA hai|

isa prakAra (bhAva pahilIAM kitAbAM vAMga) asIM isa (.kuraAna) nUM arabI bhAzA vica hukamanAmA baNAke utAriA hai| (he nabI!) je tusIM isa de huMdiAM ihanAM (kAfirAM) dI icchAvAM dI pairavI kItI, jada ki tuhADe kola (rabbI) giAna A cukkiA hai tAM allAha de mukAbale tuhAnUM nA tAM koI himAitI milegA ate nA hI koI (allAha dI saz2A toM) bacAuNa vAlA hovegA|

(he muhaMmada sa:!) bezakka asIM tuhAthoM pahilAM vI bathere paig2aMbara bheja cukke hAM ate asIM uhanAM sabha nUM bIvI bacciAM vAlA baNAiA sI| kise vI rasUla toM iha saMbhava nahIM ki binAM allAha dI AgiA toM koI nizAnI (muajaz2A) Apa liA vikhAve| hareka vacana de pUrA hoNa dA samAM liikhaA hoiA hai|
allAha jo cAhe (likhiA hoiA) miTA diMdA hai ate jisa nUM cAhe kAima rakkhadA hai| mUla kitAba tAM use kola hai|[7]
translations.footnotes: [7] ika vAra haz2arata umara ra:a: qhAnA-kAabA de Ale-duAle cakkara laggA rahe sI ate roMde hoe kahi rahe sI ki he allAha! je tUM merA nAM neka lokAM vica likha chaDDiA hai, tAM mainUM uhanAM nAla hI rakkhIM, je tUM mainUM bhair3e lokAM dI sUcI vica rakkha chaDDiA hai tAM usa nUM neka ate baqhaze hoe lokAM nAla badala de| tUM jo cAheM miTA sakadA hai, ੳmmala-kitAba (sArIAM akAzI kitAbAM dI mAM) tere kola hI hai| (tafasIra ala-kuratabI 330/9)

translations.translation: (he nabI!) jisa (az2Aba) dA vAadA asIM ihanAM (kAfirAM) nAla kItA hoiA hai, usa dA kujjha hissA bhAveM asIM tuhAnUM vikhA daIe jAM (usa toM pahilAM hI) tuhADA akAla calANA ho jAve (hara hAla vica) tuhADe z2iMme tAM kevala (rabbI paig2Ama) pahuMcAuNA hai| hisAba laiNa dA kaMma sADe z2iMme hai|

kI uha loka nahIM vekhade ki asIM (kAfirAM laI) dharatI nUM hara pAsioM ghaTAuMde jA rahe hAM (bhAva isalAma phaila rihA hai) allAha jo hukama diMdA hai, koI vI usa nUM radda karana vAlA nahIM| uha chetI hI hisAba laiNa vAlA hai|

ihanAM inakArIAM toM pahilAM vI bIta cukke lokAM ne ApaNIAM cAlabAz2IAM (makkArIAM) vica koI kasara nahIM chaDDI sI para sArIAM kaMma AuNa vAlIAM cAlAM allAha dIAM hI hana| jihar3A viakatI jo vI kamAI kara rihA hai uha sabha allAha dI jANakArI vica hai| kAfirAM nUM huNe patA lagga jAvegA ki paraloka dA ghara kinhAM laI hai|

(he muhaMmada sa:!) iha kAfira Akhade hana ki tusIM allAha de paig2aMbara nahIM ho| tusIM Akha dio ki mere te tuhADe vicAle gavAhI deNa laI allAha hI batherA hai ate uha vI (gavAha hai) jisa kola (AsamAnI) kitAba dA giAna hai|

alifa, lAma, rA| (he nabI!) iha ucca koTI dI kitAba (.kuraAna) asIM tuhADe valla utArI hai, tAM jo tusIM lokAM nUM haneriAM ’coM kaDDha ke rauzanI valla, uhanAM de rabba dI AgiA nAla te use rabba dI rAha valla, lai Ao| jihar3A atiaMta z2orAvara ate salAhiA hoiA hai|
(bhAva) usa allAha valla jisa dA uha sabha kujjha hai, jihar3A akAzAM te dharatI vica hai, para inakArIAM laI karar3A vinAzakArI az2Aba hai|

jihar3e (loka) paraloka de jIvana nAloM saMsArika jIvana nUM hI pasaMda karade hana ate lokAM nUM allAha de rAhoM rokade hana ate isa vica viMga-vala labhade hana, ajihe loka gumarAhI vica bahuta dUra nikala gae|

asIM hareka paig2aMbara nUM use dI ApaNI kaumI bhAzA (mAM-bolI) vica bolaNa vAlA bhejiA hai, tAM jo (rabbI paig2Ama nUM) uhanAM de sAhamaNe caMgI tarhAM viAkhiA kare| phera allAha jisa nUM cAhe kurAhe pA diMdA hai ate jisa nUM cAhave (siddhI) rAha vikhA diMdA hai| uhIo z2orAvara ate hikamata (sUjha-bUjha) vAlA hai|

bezakka asIM mUsA nUM ApaNIAM nizAnIAM deke bhejiA ki uha ApaNI kauma (banI-isarAIla) nUM haneriAM ’coM kaDDha ke cAnaNa valla liAve ate uhanAM nUM allAha valloM baqhaze gae yAdagAra dinAM nUM cete karAve| bezakka ihanAM (ghaTanAvAM) vica hareka dhIraja toM kaMma laiNa vAle ’te dhaMnavAda karana vAle viakatI laI (sikkhiAdAI) nizAnIAM hana|

(yAda karo) jadoM mUsA ne ApaNI kauma nUM kihA sI ki allAha de uhanAM ahisAnAM nUM yAda karo jihar3e usa ne tuhADe ’te kIte hana| usa ne tuhAnUM firaaunIAM toM bacAiA sI jadoM uha tuhAnUM karar3e tasIhe diMde sI, tuhADe puttarAM nUM mAra suTTade sI ate tuhADIAM dhIAM nUM jiuMdIAM rakkha chaDDade sI| isa vica tuhADe rabba valloM tuhADI bar3I vaDDI az2amAiza sI|
yAda karo jadoM tuhADe rabba ne tuhAnUM qhabaradAra kItA sI ki je tusIM dhaMnavAdI baNoge tAM maiM tuhAnUM hora vaddha inAma baqhazAMgA, je tusIM nAzukarI karoge tAM merI saz2A vI karar3I hai|
mUsA ne (ApaNI kauma nUM) AkhiA ki je tusIM inakAra karoge ate isa dharatI de sAre vasanIka vI kAfira baNa jANa tAM bezakka allAha (ihanAM gallAM toM) be-paravAha hai ate zalAghAyoga (iho) hai|

(he makke vAlio!) kI tuhAnUM tuhAthoM pahilAM de lokAM, (bhAva) nUha, Ada te samUda dI kauma ate ihanAM toM magaroM hoIAM kaumAM dIAM qhabarAM nahIM pujjIAM, jinhAM nUM kevala allAha hI jANadA hai? jadoM uhanAM (kaumAM) kola uhanAM de rasUla (khullhIAM) nizAnIAM lai ke Ae tAM uhanAM ne (rurAnI nAla) mUMha vica ApaNe hattha lai lae ate AkhiA ki jihar3A (sunehA) tuhAnUM de ke bhejiA giA hai asIM usa nUM nahIM maMnade ate jisa cIz2a valla tusIM sAnUM bulA rahe ho usa vica vI sAnUM duvidhA zaMkA hai|

uhanAM de rasUlAM ne uhanAM nUM AkhiA, kI tuhAnUM allAha bAre saMdeha hai jihar3A akAzAM te dharatI dA baNAuNa vAlA hai? uha tuhAnUM (isa kArana ApaNe valla) bulA rihA hai tAM jo tuhADe gunAhAM nUM baqhaza deve ate ika niyata sameM taka tuhAnUM (saMsAra vica rahiNa dI) mohalata deve| uhanAM ne AkhiA ki tusIM (bhAva rasUla) tAM sADe hI varage manukkha ho, tusIM tAM cAhuMde ho ki asIM uhanAM izaTAM dI ibAdata toM ruka jAIe jinhAM dI ibAdata sADe pio-dAde (bhAva baz2uraga) karade sana| caMgA, (je tusIM sacce ho tAM) sADe kola koI sapazaTa dalIla peza karo|

uhanAM de paig2aMbarAM ne uhanAM nUM kihA ki iha tAM sacca hai ki asIM tuhADe varage hI manukkha hAM, para allAha ApaNe baMdiAM viccoM jisa nUM cAhuMdA hai, ApaNIAM miharAM (paig2aMbarI) nAla nivAz2adA hai| sAnUM iha adhikAra nahIM ki allAha dI AgiA toM binAM asIM tuhAnUM koI muajaz2A (rabbI camatakAra) vikhA sakIe| ImAna vAliAM nUM tAM kevala allAha utte hI bharosA rakkhaNA cAhIdA hai|

(paig2aMbarAM ne AkhiA ki) uha kihar3A kArana hai ki asIM allAha ’te bharosA nA karIe jada ki uha sAnUUM ApaNIAM (siddhIAM) rAhAM vikhA cukkiA hai? jihar3e vI tasIhe tusIM sA` de rahe ho, asIM (bhAva rasUla) uhanAM ’te sabara karAMge| bharosA karana vAliAM nUM tAM iho zobhA diMdA hai|

kAfirAM ne ApaNe rasUlAM nUM AkhiA ki asIM tuhAnUM deza nikAlA de diAMge jAM tusIM sADe dharama vica mur3a Ao| udoM hI uhanAM (rasUlAM) de rabba ne uhanAM valla vahI (saMdeza) bhejI ki asIM ihanAM z2AlamAM nUM z2arUra hI barabAda kara diAMge|

ate ihanAM (inakArIAM) toM magaroM asIM tuhAnUM (rasUlAM nUM ate uhanAM de AgiAkArIAM nUM) dharatI ’te vasebA diAMge| iha inAma uhanAM laI hai jihar3e merI haz2UrI vica (kiAmata dI puccha-giccha laI) khar3e hoNa toM Darade hana ate merIAM citAvanIAM toM bhaia-bhIta rahiMde hana|
uhanAM (inakArIAM) ne faisalA (az2Aba) maMgiA sI ate (ise faisale kArana) sAre hI bAg2I te Akar3aNa vAle nA-murAda ho gae|
isa toM agge (inakArIAM laI) naraka hai jitthe uhanAM nUM pIpa vAlA pANI pINa laI dittA jAvegA|

jisa nUM uha (pApI) ghuTTa-ghuTTa karake pINage phera vI uha galla toM thalle nahIM laMghA sakanage| hara pAsioM mauta uhanAM valla vadhegI, para uha maranage nahIM, kiuM jo uhanAM de agge ati karar3A az2Aba hovegA|

jinhAM lokAM ne ApaNe rabba dA inakAra kItA hai uhanAM de karamAM dI misAla usa suhAa vAMga hai jisa nUM tez2a hanerI vAle dina dI havA ne uDA dittA hove| (ise prakAra kiAmata dihAr3e) jo vI uhanAM (kAfirAM) ne (saMsAra vica) kamAiA hai, uha usa viccoM kise ’te vI koI adhikAra nahIM rakkhade hoNage| iha parale daraje dI gumarAhI hai|

kI tusIM nahIM vekhiA ki allAha ne akAza te dharatI dI racanA hakka-sacca nAla kItI hai je uha (allAha) cAhe tAM tuhAnUM sAriAM nUM (saMsAra viccoM) lai jAve ate (tuhADI thAM) ika navIM maqhalUka (racanAM) lai Ave|
ate allAha laI iha kaMma karanA kujjha vI aukhA nahIM|

sAre hI loka (kiAmata dihAr3e) allAha de haz2Ura khar3e hoNage, phera kamaz2ora loka (saMsAra vica) ghamaMDa karana vAle (AgUAM) nUM kahiNage ki asIM tAM tuhADe hI adhIna sI, kI tusIM sAthoM allAha dA thor3hA jihA az2Aba dUra kara sakade ho? uha (AgU) AkhaNage ki je allAha sAnUM hidAita diMdA tAM asIM z2arUra tuhAnUM hidAita diMde| huNa bhAveM asIM roIe bhAveM sahiNa karIe, sADe laI ika samAna hai| sADe laI bhajjaNa laI koI thAM nahIM|

jadoM (karamAM dA) faisalA ho cukkegA tAM zaitAna kahegA ki allAha ne tAM tuhADe nAla saccA vAadA kItA sI ate jihar3e vAade maiMne tuhADe nAla kIte sI, uhanAM ’coM koI vI pUrA nahIM kItA| merA tuhADe ’te koI z2ora nahIM sI (ki mere Akhe laggo)| maiMne tuhAnUM (ApaNe valla) bulAiA ate tusIM merI galla maMnI so mainUM doza nA dio sagoM ApaNe Apa dI hI niMdA karo| itthe nA hI maiM tuhADIAM benatIAM maMNana vAlA hAM ate nA hI tusIM merI benatIAM nUM paravAna kara sakade ho| maiM (zaitAna) tAM iha vI maMNana nUM tiAra nahIM ki tusIM mainUM isa (kiAmata) toM pahilAM rabba dA zarIka maMnade sI| bezakka z2AlamAM laI daradanAka az2Aba hai|

jihar3e lokI ImAna liAe ate neka kaMma vI kIte uha uhanAM savaragAM vica praveza karanage jinhAM de heTha nahirAM vagadIAM hoNagIAM, jitthe uha ApaNe rabba dI AgiA nAla sadA laI rahiNage te utthe uhanAM dA savAgata “salAma” nAla hovegA|[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] vekho sUrata ala-nisA, hAzIA Aita 86/4

translations.translation: (he nabI!) kI tusIM nahIM vekhiA ki allAha ne pavittara kalameM (isalAma) dI udAharana kiveM dittI hai ki uha ika pAkIz2A daraqhata vAMga hai, jisa dIAM jar3hAM maz2abUta hana ate usa dIAM TahiNIAM akAza vica hana|
uha ApaNe rabba de hukama nAla hara vele phala diMdA hai| allAha iha udAharaNAM isa laI diMdA hai, tAM jo lokIM sikkhiA prApata kara sakaNa|

apavittara bola bhAva (ziraka te kufara) dI udAharana ika bhair3e kisama de daraqhata vAMga hai jihar3A dharatI de uttoM puTTa liA jAve| (bhAva usa dIAM jar3hAM DUMghIAM nahIM huMdIAM) uha TikAo nahIM huMdA|
allAha ImAna vAliAM nUM ihanAM Thosa gallAM (pavittara kalameM) rAhIM loka-paraloka vica drir3hatA baqhazadA hai|[2] allAha z2AlamAM nUM kurAhe pAuMdA hai ate allAha jo vI cAhuMdA hai karadA hai|
translations.footnotes: [2] bhAva marana magaroM jadoM farizate uhanAM toM kabarAM vica tiMna savAla karanage| 1਼ terA rabba koNa hai| 2਼ terA dIna kihar3A hai| 3਼ tusIM isa manukkha muhaMmada (sa:) de saMbaMdha vica, jisa nUM tuhADe vala bhejiA giA sI, kI Akhade sI? ImAna vAle isa de sahI uttara deNage ki allAha merA rabba hai, merA dIna isalAma hai ate iha muhaMmada (sa:) allAha de rasUla hana| jihar3e sADe kola khuliAM nizAnIAM liAe hana ate sADA ihanAM utte ImAna hai jada ki gunAhagAra jihaDe muhaMmada (sa:) ’te ImAna nahIM rakhadde uha ihanAM savAlA dA sahI uttara nahIM de sakaNage| (vekho sUrata ala-anAma, hAzIA Aita 93/6 ate sUrata Ale-imarAna, hAzIA Aita 85/3)

translations.translation: (he nabI sa:!) kI tusIM uhanAM nUM nahIM vekhiA jinhAM ne allAha dI niamata (ImAna) nUM kufara nAla badala liA ate ApaNI kauma nUM vI barabAdI de ghara vica dhakka dittA|
bhAva uha sAre usa naraka vica jANage ate jihar3A bahuta hI bhair3A TikANA hai|

uhanAM ne allAha de zarIka baNA rakkhe hana tAM jo lokAM nUM uhade (allAha de) rAhoM kurAhe pA deNa| (he nabI!) tusIM Akha dio ki (dunIAM dA) lAbha uThA lao, aMta tuhADA TikANA tAM naraka dI agga hI hai|

(he nabI!) mere ImAna vAle baMdiAM nUM Akha dio ki namAz2a kAima karana ate jo vI asIM uhanAM nUM baqhaziA hai, usa viccoM kujjha nA kujjha lukAvAM jAM ailAnIAM (rabba dI rAha vica) qharaca karana| isa toM pahilAM ki uha (kiAmata dA) dihAr3A Ave, jisa vica nA koI saudebAz2I hovegI ate nA hI dosatI kaMma AvegI|

allAha uha hai jisa ne akAzAM nUM te dharatI nUM paidA kItA ate akAza toM pANI nAz2ila kItA, phera use (pANI) rAhIM tuhADe riz2aka vajoM tarhAM-tarhAM de phala paidA kIte ate kizatIAM (ber3IAM) nUM tuhADe vassa vica kara chaDDiA hai tAM jo samuMdarAM vica uha de hukama nAla callaNa ate dariAvAM nUM tuhADe vassa vica kItA hoiA hai|
(usI allAha ne) sUraja te caMna nUM tuhADI sevA ’te lAiA jo ki lagAtAra calla rahe hana ate rAta te dina nUM vI tuhADI sevA ’te lA rakkhiA hai|

ate tuhAnUM hara uha cIz2a baqhazI hai jo tusIM usa toM maMgI| je tusIM allAha dIAM niamatAM dI giNatI karanA cAho tAM uhanAM nUM giNa nahIM sakade| bezakka manukkha bahuta hI beinasAfa te nAzukarA hai|
he nabI! iha vI yAda karo ki jadoM ibarAhIma ne aradAsa kItI sI ki he mere mAlika! isa zahira (makke) nUM amana zAMtI vAlA zahira baNA de ate mainUM ate merI saMtAna nUM mUratI pUjA toM bacA lai|

(ate kihA ki) he meriA rabbA! ihanAM (mUratIAM) ne bahuta sAre lokAM nUM kurAhe pAiA hai, so jihar3A vI (merI saMtAna viccoM) merI pairavI karegA, uhIo merA hai ate jihar3A merI nA-faramAnI karegA tAM bezakka tUM baqhazaNahAra te miharabAna hai|

he sADe rabbA! bezakka maiM ne ApaNe parivAra dA ika bhAga tere pavittara ghara (qhAnA- kAabA) de lAge ika rohI biAbAna vica liA vasAiA hai|[3] he sADe rabbA! (iha maiM isa laI kItA hai) ki uha (utthe) namAz2a kAima karana, isa laI tUM vI kujjha lokAM de dilAM nUM isa vica rahiNa dA icchuka baNA de ate ihanAM nUM hara tarhAM de phalAM duArA riz2aka de, tAM jo iha (tere) dhaMnavAdI hoNa|
translations.footnotes: [3] isa vica usa ghaTanA dI caracA kItI gaI hai jadoM haz2arata ibarAhIma ne allAha de hukama nAla ApaNI patanI sane ApaNe duddha pIMde bacce isamAIla nUM ika virAne vica chaDDa Ae sI| ika visathArapUravaka hadIsa dI caracA karade hoe ibane abbAsa faramAuMde hana ki jadoM haz2arata ibarAhIma ne isamAIla ate uhanAM dI mAtA jihar3I aje isamAIla nUM ApaNA duddha piAuMdI sI qhAnA kAabA de ner3e z2amaz2ama de kola AbAda kItA ate uhanAM donAM de kola ika thaile vica qhajUrAM ate mazaka vica pANI rakkha dittA usa sameM usa makke vica koI manukkhI AbAdI nahIM sI ate nA hI pANI sI| jadoM haz2arata ibarAhIma unhAM dohAM nUM chaDDa ke mur3ana lagge tAM isamAIla dI mAtA ne unhAM nUM AkhiA ki he ibarAhIma tusIM sAnUM ika aisI basatI vica chaDDa ke jA rahe ho jitthe nA koI manukkha hai ate nA hI koI hora cIz2a| ibarAhIma ne javAba dittA ki allAha ne mainUM iho hukama dittA hai| jadoM iha qhajUrAM te pANI mukka giA tAM bIbI hAjarA pANI dI bhAla vica safA te maravA vica becenI nAla cakkara lAuNa lagga paIAM tAM jo pANI Adi mila sake| aMta allAha de hukama nAla ika farizate ne usa thAM ApaNI aDDI jAM paira mAriA jisa toM z2amaz2ama dA somA phuTTa piA| ise pANI kArana utthe ika kabIlA vI AbAda hoiA ate ise kabIle dI do lar3akIAM nAla ika toM bAada dUjI nAla haz2arata isamAIla ne vivAha kItA| kujha sameM bAada haz2arata ibarAhIma unhAM dI qhabara laiNa laI Ae phera doveM pio puttara ne qhAnA kAabA dI usArI zurU kItI| haz2arata isamAIla patthara cukka ke liAuMde sI ate haz2arata ibarAhIma usArI karade sI| ate doveM allAha toM iha aradAsa karade sI ki he sADe rabbA sADI iha sevA kabUla kara bezakka tUM hI sunaNa vAlA te jAnaNa vAlA hai| (sUrata ala-bakaraha: 127/2) allAha de rasUla ne faramAiA ki donoM ibarAhIma ate isamAIla allAha de ghara dI usArI karade rahe ate usa de Ale duAle tavAfa karade hoe ihI duA karade sI| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 3364)

translations.translation: he mere mAlika! bezakka tUM caMgI tarhAM jANadA hai jo asIM (dilAM vica) lukAuMde hAM ate jo pragaTa karade hAM| dharatI te akAza dI koI vI vasatU allAha toM lukI hoI nahIM|
ibarAhIma ne AkhiA ki zukara hai usa mAlika dA jisa ne mainUM isa buDhApe vica isamAIla (puttara) te isahAka (potarA) baqhaze| bezakka merA pAlaNahAra duAvAM nUM suNana vAlA hai|
ibarAhIma ne duA kItI ki he mere allAha! mainUM te merI saMtAna nUM namAz2a kAima karana vAlA baNA| he sADe rabba! merI duA nUM kabUla kara lai|
he mere pAlaNahAra! jisa dina lekhA-jokhA hovegA usa dina mainUM, mere mAM-pio nUM ate sAre mominAM nUM vI baqhaza devIM|
(he nabI!) tusIM iha nA samajho ki allAha uhanAM z2AlamAM de z2ulama toM aceta hai| uha tAM uhanAM (kAfirAM) nUM usa (kiAmata) dihAr3e taka mohalata devegA jisa dina akkhAM faTIAM rahi jANagIAM|

(usa dina) uha (kAfira) ApaNe sira (mUMha) utAMha cukkI (hazara de maidAna valla) nasse jA rahe hoNage, uhanAM dIAM naz2arAM ApaNe valla vI nahIM jANagIAM ate uhanAM de dila (dahizata nAla) uDDe jA rahe hoNage|

(he nabI sa:!) lokAM nUM usa (kiAmata dihAr3e) toM sAvadhAna kara dio jadoM uhanAM nUM az2Aba A gheregA ate z2Alama loka AkhaNage ki he sADe rabbA! sAnUM thor3hI jihI mohalata hora de dio, tAM jo asIM tere sadde nUM savIkAra karIe ate tere rasUlAM de hukamAM dI pAlaNA karIe| (allAha AkhegA) kI tusIM isa toM pahilAM suMhAM khA khA ke Akhade nahIM sI ki asIM tAM saMsAra toM kade jANA hI nahIM?

tusIM uhanAM lokAM dIAM basatIAM vica rahiMde vassade sI, jinhAM ne Apo ApaNe ’te z2ulama kItA sI ate tuhAnUM iha vI patA sI ki asIM uhanAM nAla kiho jihA varatAo kItA sI| asIM tAM tuhADe samajhAuNa laI batherIAM udAharaNAM vI dittIAM sI|
uha ApaNIAM cAlAM calla cukke ate allAha uhanAM dIAM sArIAM cAlAM nUM allAha jANadA hai uhanAM dIAM cAlAM ajihIAM vI nahIM sI ki (uhanAM cAlAM nAla) pahAr3a hI hila jAMde|
(he muhaMmada sa:!) tusIM ukkA hI iha vicAra nA karo ki allAha ApaNe paig2aMbarAM nUM ditte vacanAM toM phira jAvegA| allAha bahuta hI z2orAvara te badalA laiNa vAlA hai|
jisa dina iha dharatI dUjI dharatI nAla badala dittI jAvegI ate akAza vI (badala dittA jAvegA) sAre loka allAha de haz2Ura peza kIte jANage, jihar3A ikko-ikka te z2orAvara hai|
tusIM (he nabI!) usa dina sAre aparAdhIAM nUM saMgalAM nAla jakar3e hoe vekhoge|
uhanAM (pApIAM) de kappar3e lukka de hoNage ate agga dIAM lATAM nAla uhanAM de mUMha Dhake hoNage|
(iha sabha isa laI hovegA) tAM jo allAha hara prANI nUM usa dI kamAI dA badalA deve| bezakka allAha nUM hisAba laiNa vica kujjha vI dera nahIM lagadI|

iha (.kuraAna) sAre lokAM laI (rabbI) paig2Ama hai, tAM jo isa rAhIM lokAM nUM qhabaradAra kItA jAve ate uha jANa laiNa ki allAha hI ikko ika izaTa hai ate jihar3e akala vAle hana, uha nasIhata prApata kara laiNa|
alifa, lAma, rA| iha rabbI kitAba te sapazaTa.kuraAna dIAM AitAM hana|
ika samAM uha vI hovegA jadoM kAfira cAhuNage ki kAza uha musalamAna huMde|[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] vekho sUrata Ale-imarAna, hAzIA Aita 85/3

translations.translation: (he nabI!) ihanAM (dI ciMtA) chaDDa dio! iha khANa pINa te AnaMda mANana| jhUThIAM AsAM ne ihanAM nUM bhulekhe vica pA chaDDiA hai| iha chetI hI (hakIkata) jANa laiNage|
asIM jisa basatI nUM vI barabAda kItA hai, usa (dI barabAdI) laI ika vizeza mohalata niyata kItI sI|
koI vI kauma nA ApaNe nizacita sameM toM pahilAM halAka ho sakadI hai te nA hI usa toM magaroM baca sakadI hai|
uhanAM (inakArIAM) ne AkhiA ki he uha viakatI! (bhAva muhaMmada sa:) jisa ’te iha z2ikara (.kuraAna) utAriA giA hai, tUM tAM z2arUra hI sudAI hai|
je tUM saccA hai tAM sADe sAhamaNe farizate kiuM nahIM lai AuMdA|
(allAha ne AkhiA) farizatiAM nUM tAM asIM hakka (bhAva az2Aba) nAla hI (dharatI ’te) utArade hana ate phera usa sameM uhanAM (kAfirAM) nUM mohalata nahIM dittI jAMdI|
bezakka asIM hI isa z2ikara (.kuraAna) de utArana vAle hAM ate asIM hI isa de rakhavAle hAM| [2]
translations.footnotes: [2] iha kuraAna dI iha Aita manukkhAM laI ika caNotI hai ate hareka laI iha z2arUrI hai ki uha kuraAna de moajaz2iAM utte imAna liAve| iha ika hakIkata hai ki aje taka kuraAna de kise ika zabada vica vI koI tabadIlI nahIM hoI| bhAveM ki kAfirAM ne ate isa kitAba de inakArIAM ne isa vica tabadIlI karana dIAM vadherIAM hI kozizA kItIAM para uha sArIAM hI asaphala hoIAM| jiveM ki isa Aita vica faramAiA giA hai ki asIM hI isa dI hifAz2ata karAMge| allAha dI kasama use allAha ne isa dI hifAz2ata kItI hai jada ki dUjIAM AsamAnI kitAbAM vica kaI prakAra dIAM tabadIlIAM ho cukkIAM hana|

translations.translation: (he nabI!) tuhAthoM pahilAM vI asIM kaI ummatAM vica ApaNe rasUla bheja cukke hAM|
uhanAM kola jihar3A vI rasUla AiA, uha usa nAla makhaula karade sI|
isa tarhAM asIM AparAdhIAM de dilAM vica (rasUlAM dA) makhaula uDAuNA racA-basA diMde hAM|
uha (kAfira) isa.kuraAna ’te ImAna nahIM liAuMde, iho rIta pahilAM toM calI A rahI hai|
jekara asIM uhanAM laI akAza dA ika bUhA kholha daIe ate uha (inakArI) utthe car3ha vI jANa|
phera vI uha iho kahiNage ki sADIAM naz2arAM tAM baMnha dittIAM gaIAM hana, sagoM sADe ’te jAdU kara dittA giA hai|
asAM akAza vica buraja baNAe ate vekhaNa vAliAM laI isa nUM (tAriAM nAla) sajA dittA|[3]
translations.footnotes: [3] vekho sUrata ala-anAma, hAzIA Aita 97/6

translations.translation: ate asIM isa (akAza) nUM hareka phiTakAre hoe zaitAna toM surakkhiata rakkhiA|
hAM! jihar3A koI corI chupe suNana dI koziza kare, tAM usa dA picchA dahakadA hoiA aMgiArA karadA hai
ate dharatI nUM asIM pasAriA ate isa vica pahAr3a gar3ha ditte ate isa (dharatI) vica asIM hareka cIz2a napI-tulI mAtarA vica ugAI hai|
ate ise (dharatI) vica asAM tuhADe laI roz2IAM rakkha chaDDIAM hana ate uhanAM laI vI jinhAM nUM roz2I deNa vAle (dAtA) tusIM nahIM|
sArIAM cIz2AM de bhaMDAra sADe kola hI hana ate asIM hara cIz2a nUM ika nizacita mAtarA vica utArade hAM|
asIM hI (pANI nAla) bojhala havAvAM nUM bhejade hAM phera akAza toM pANI varhAuMde hAM ate tuhAnUM piAuMde hAM, isa (pANI dI) daulata de bhaMDArI tusIM nahIM (asIM hAM)|
bezakka asIM hI jIvana ate mauta diMde hAM ate aMta asIM hI (sArIAM cIz2AM) de vArasa hAM|[4]
translations.footnotes: [4] jadoM manukkha mara jAMdA hai tAM usa de amalAM dA silasilA vI qhatama ho jAMdA hai chuTTa tiMna amalAM toM: 1਼ sadakAe jArIA bhAva uha kaMma karanA jihar3A usa toM bAada vI lokAM de kaMma Ave jiveM yatImaqhAnA, pANI de laI khUha dI usArI, vidiaka saMsathA dI usArI| 2਼ ajihA ilama jisa toM loka lAbha uThAuNa| 3਼ neka saMtAna jihar3I allAta toM ApaNe mApiAM laI baqhaziza dI duA kare| (sahI musalima, hadIsa: 1631)

translations.translation: asIM uhanAM sAre lokAM nUM jANade hAM jihar3e tuhAthoM pahilAM bIta cukke hana ate jihar3e picchoM AuNa vAle hana, uhanAM dI vI jANakArI hai|
(he nabI!) bezakka tuhADA pAlaNahAra ihanAM sabha nUM ikaTThA karegA| uha vaDDA sUjhavAna te giAna rakkhaNa vAlA hai|
asIM manukkha nUM galI sar3hI miTTI de sukke hoe gAre toM paidA kItA hai|
ate usa toM pahilAM jiMnAM nUM asIM agga dI lATa toM paidA kItA sI|
(he nabI! yAda karo!) jadoM tuhADe rabba ne farizatiAM nUM AkhiA sI ki maiM galI-sar3I khaNakhaNa karadI hoI miTTI toM ika manukkha dI racanA karana vAlA hAM
jadoM maiM usa (manukkha) nUM pUrI tarhAM baNA lavAM ate usa vica ApaNI rUha (AtamA) toM kujjha phUMka diAM tAM tusIM sAre usa de agge sijade vica Diga jANA|
sAre hI farizate sijade vica jhuka gae|
chuTTa ibalIsa toM, usa ne sijadA karana vAliAM dA sAtha deNa toM sAfa inakAra kara ditta
pucchiA, he ibalIsa! tainUM kI hoiA, ki tUM sijadA karana vAliAM dI saMgata nahIM kItI?
usa (ibalIsa) ne kihA, maiM uha nahIM hAM jihar3A usa manukkha nUM sijadA kare jisa nUM tUM galI-sar3I khaNakadI hoI miTTI toM paidA kItA hai|
kihA, caMgA! huNa tUM itthoM (farizatiAM dI saMgata viccoM) nikala jA, huNa tUM phiTakAriA hoiA hai|
ate tere ’te merI iha phiTakAra badale vAle dina (bhAva kiAmata dihAr3e) tIka rahegI
(ibalIsa ne) kihA ki he mere mAlika! mainUM usa dina tIka mohalata de de jadoM ki sAre manukkha mur3a surajIta kIte jANage|
faramAiA ki caMgA tainUM mohalata de dittI gaI
ika nizacita sameM tIka (bhAva kiAmata takka) laI (iha mohalata hai)|

usa (ibalIsa bhAva zaitAna) ne AkhiA ki he mere rabbA! jiveM taine mainUM kurAhe pAiA hai mainUM vI kasama hai ki maiM vI dharatI utte uhanAM (lokAM) laI (saMsArika samaggarI nUM) manamohaNA baNA diAMgA, iMja ihanAM sabha (manukkhAM) nUM gumarAha karAMgA|
chuTTa tere uhanAM baMdiAM toM jihar3e tUM uhanAM viccoM cuNa lae hana|
faramAiA, iho (mere hukamAM dI pAlaNA hI) siddhA rAha hai, jihar3A mere taka pahuMcadA hai
bezakka mere neka baMdiAM ’te terA koI z2ora nahIM| terA z2ora kevala uhanAM kurAhe pae lokAM ’te hI callegA jihar3e tere picche laggaNage|
ate uhanAM sabha laI naraka dA vAadA hai|
usa (naraka) de satta bUhe hana ate hara bUhe laI uhanAM (gumarAhAM) viccoM ika vizeza bhAga vaMDiA hoiA hai|
jada ki parahez2agAra loka savaraga vica bAg2AM te jharaniAM vica hoNage|
uhanAM nUM kihA jAvegA ki salAmatI te amana nAla isa (savaraga) vica dAqhala ho jAo|

ate jo vI uhanAM (neka lokAM) de manAM vica (kise laI kujjha vI) vaira-virodha hovegA usa nUM asIM kaDDha diAMge| uha Apo vica bharA-bharA baNa ke ika dUje de AhamaNo-sAhamaNe taqhatAM utte baiThe hoNage|
nA hI utthe uhanAM nUM koI takalIfa hovegI ate nA hI utthioM kade kaDDhe jANage|
(he nabI!) mere baMdiAM nUM dassa dio ki maiM ati baqhazaNahAra ate ati miharabAna hAM|
bezakka merI saz2A (az2Aba) vI atiaMta dukhadAI hai|
(he nabI!) ihanAM lokAM nUM ratA ibarAhIma de mahimAnAM dA kissA suNAo|
jadoM uha (mahimAna) usa (ibarAhIma) de kola pahuMce tAM uhanAM ne salAma kItA tAM usa ne (ibarAhIma) ne kihA ki sAnUM tAM tuhAthoM Dara laggadA hai|
uhanAM (mahimAnAM) ne kihA ki Daro nA, asIM tainUM ika giAnavAna puttara dI qhuzaqhabarI suNAuMde hAM|
(ibarAhIma ne) kihA ki isa buDhApe vica mainUM qhuzaqhabarI de rahe ho, iha qhuzaqhabarI tusIM kiveM de rahe ho?
uhanAM (mahimAnAM) ne kihA ki asIM tuhAnUM ika saccI qhuzaqhabarI de rahe hAM, tUM nirAza nA ho?
ibarAhIma ne kihA ki ApaNe rabba dI rahimata toM kurAhIe hI nirAza huMde hana|
ibarAhIma ne pucchiA ki he (rabba valloM) bheje hoe farizatio! tuhADe AuNa dA udeza kI hai?
uhanAM ne kihA ki asIM ika pApI kauma valla bheje gae hana|
chuTTa lUta de ghara vAliAM toM, asIM uhanAM sabha (ImAna vAliAM) nUMma (az2Aba toM) bacA lavAMge|
sivAe usa (lUta) dI patanI toM jisa laI asIM mitthiA hoiA hai ki uha picche rahi jANa vAliAM viccoM hovegI|
jadoM bheje hoe (farizate) lUta de ghara pahuMce|
tAM uhanAM (lUta) ne kihA ki tusIM loka tAM ajanabI laggade ho|
uhanAM (farizatiAM) ne kihA, (nahIM) asIM tAM tere kola uha (az2Aba) lai ke Ae hAM jisa de AuNa vica iha loka zakka karade sana|
asIM tere kola saccAI laike Ae hAM ate bezakka asIM hAM vI sacce|

huNa tUM ApaNe parivAra sane rAta rahiMde gharoM nikala jA ate tusIM inhAM (ImAna vAliAM) de picche hI rahiNA ate tuhADe viccoM koI pichAMha mur3a ke nA vekhe| tuhAnUM jitthe jANa laI hukama dittA jA rihA hai utthe hI cale jANA|
ate asIM uhanAM (kaume-lUta) laI iho faisalA kItA ki saverA hoNa taka ihanAM lokAM dI jar3ha vaDDa suTTI jAvegI|
ate zahira (saddUma) de vAsI (farizatiAM nUM sohaNe muMDiAM de rUpa vica) vekha ke qhuzIAM maNAuMde hoe (lUta de ghara) Ae|
usa (lUta) ne kihA ki bezakka iha loka mere mahimAna hana tusIM mainUM apamAnita nA karo|
allAha toM Daro ate mainUM hINA nA karo|
uha (zahira vAsI) bole ki kI asIM tuhAnUM dunIAM bhara dI ThekedArI toM manhAM nahIM sI kItA?
usa (lUta) ne kihA ki je tusIM karanA hI hai tAM iha merIAM (kauma dIAM) dhIAM maujUda hana tusIM ihanAM nAla nikAha kara lao|
(he muhaMmada!) terI jAna dI kasama, bezakka uha (kaume-lUta) ApaNI masatI vica kurAhe pae hoe sana|
aMta sUraja nikalade hI uhanAM nUM ika caMgiAr3a ne A nappiA|
ate asIM isa zahira nUM uppara-thalle kara suTTiA ate ihanAM lokAM ’te khiMgharAM vAle pattharAM dA mIMha varhA dittA|
bezakka isa (ghaTanA) vica sikkhiA laiNa vAliAM laI kaI nizAnIAM hana|
ate bezakka uha basatI usa (makke dI) rAha ’te sathita hai|
bezakka isa (ghaTanA) vica ImAna vAliAM laI vaDDIAM nizAnIAM hana|
bezakka aikA basatI vAle (zuaiba dI kauma) vI z2Alama sI|
uhanAM toM vI asIM (zuaiba nUM jhuThalAuNa dA) badalA liA, iha doveM zahira (kaume-lUta te kaume-zuaiba dI basatIAM) mukkha rAha ’te sathita hana|
ate hijara vAliAM (bhAva kaume-samUda) ne vI rasUlAM nUM jhuThalAiA|
asIM usa (sAleha) nUM ApaNe valloM nizAnIAM vI baqhazIAM, para uha (hijara vAle) uhanAM toM mUMha mor3ade rahe|
iha lokI pahAr3AM nUM ghar3ha-ghar3ha ke ghara baNAuMde sana, kise toM Darade nahIM sI|
aMta uhanAM (kaume-hijara) nUM savera huMde hI ika z2oradAra caMgiAr3a ne A nappiA|
uhanAM dI koI vI kamAI uhanAM de kise kaMma nA AI|

asIM akAza te dharatI ate ihanAM vicakAra dIAM sArIAM cIz2AM nUM saccAI nAla hI paidA kItA hai| kiAmata dihAr3A lAz2amI AvegA| so (he nabI!) tusIM sucajje DhaMga nAla kAfirAM dIAM vadhIkIAM nUM akkhAM uhale karade raho|
bezakka tuhADA rabba hI sabha dA paidA karana vAlA ate giAnavAna hai|
bezakka asIM tuhAnUM (he nabI sa:!) mur3a-mur3a duharAuNa vAliAM satta AitAM (sUrata fAtihA) ate vaDDe marAtabe vAlA਼kuraAna vI baqhaziA hai|[5]
translations.footnotes: [5] vokha sUrata ala-fAtihA, hAzIA Aita 2/1

translations.translation: he nabI! tusIM kade vI uhanAM cIz2AM valla nA takko jihar3IAM (jIvana samaggarIAM) asIM vakkha-vakkha lokAM nUM de chaDDIAM hana ate nA hI ihanAM laI ciMtita hovo, sagoM mominAM laI ApaNIAM muhabbata bharIAM bAhAM nUM jhukAIM rakkho|
ate Akha dio ki maiM tAM khullhama-khullhA DarAuNa vAlA hAM|
ajihe az2Aba dI citAvanI asIM fuTTa pAuNa vAle lokAM valla bhejI sI|
jinhAM ne ApaNe.kuraAna (bhAva tauraita) de ToTe-ToTe kara chaDDe sI|
kasama hai tere rabba dI! asIM ihanAM sAriAM toM z2arUra hI puccha-giccha karAMge|
uhanAM kaMmAM bAre jo uha karade sana|
(he nabI!) tuhAnUM jo vI hukama dittA jA rihA hai usa nUM kholha-kholha ke suNA dio ate muzarikAM dI ratA paravAha nA karo|
tuhADe valloM asIM uhanAM makhaula karana vAliAM laI bathere hAM|
jihar3e lokI allAha de nAla-nAla dUje izaTa baNAuMde hana, uhanAM nUM chetI hI (hakIkata dA) patA laga jAvegA|
(he nabI!) asIM (allAha) caMgI tarhAM jANade hAM ki jo kujjha uha kahiMde hana, usa nAla tuhADA mana kur3hadA hai
tusIM ApaNe pAlaNahAra dI usatata nAla usadI tasabIha karo ate sijade karana vAliAM dI saMgata karo|[6]
translations.footnotes: [6] isa toM bhAva jamAata nAla namAz2a par3hanA hai jiveM nabI (sa:) de sameM huMdA sI| ibane abbAsa faramAuMde hana ki allAha de rasUla (sa:) de sameM jadoM loka faraz2a namAz2a adA kara cukkade tAM uccI AvAz2a nAla allAha dA z2ikara (allAho-akabara, asatag2aphirullAha, asatag2aphirullAha, asatag2aphirullAha) kariA karade sI| jadoM maiM iha z2ikara suNadA tAM maiM samajha jAMdA ki iha lokI faraz2a namAz2a toM vehale ho cukke hana| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 841)

translations.translation: ate ApaNe rabba dI ibAdata karade raho, itthoM tIka ki tuhADe kola aTalla cIz2a (bhAva mauta) A jAve|[7]
translations.footnotes: [7] nabI karIma (sa:) ne faramAiA ki je tuhADe vicoM kise nUM koI bipatA A jAve tAM uha` mauta dI icchA nahIM karanI cAhIdI| je mauta dI icchA toM chuTTa hora koI rAha nA mile tAM usa nUM iha kahiNA cAhIdA hai ki he allAha mainUM usa sameM takka jiUMdA rakkha jadoM takka jiuNA mere laI lAbhadAika hai ate mauta usa sameM de jadoM merI mauta vica merI bhalAI hove (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 5671)

translations.translation: allAha dA hukama (az2Aba dA) A giA hai, huNa usa laI tusIM tabAI nA pAo| uha pAka hai ate uhanAM sabha toM ucca darajA hai, jinhAM nUM uha loka (allAha dA) sAMjhI dassade hana|

uha ApaNe jisa baMde kola cAhuMdA hai ApaNe hukama rAhIM vahI (rabbI sunehA) de ke farizatiAM nUM bhejadA hai tAM jo tuhAnUM (lokAM nUM) isa galla toM suceta kara deNa ki chuTTa maithoM hora koI izaTa nahIM| so tusIM maithoM hI Daro|
use ne akAza te dharatI nUM hakka nAla sAjiA hai| uha (allAha) uhanAM toM bahuta uccA hai jinhAM nUM uha (allAha dA) zarIka baNAuMde hana|
use (allAha) ne manukkha nUM vIraja toM paidA kItA para acaNaceta uha jhagar3AlU baNa giA|
usa ne pazU paidA kIte, ihanAM vica tuhADe laI ThaMDa toM bacAo (dA sAdhana) hai ate hora vI kaI lAbha hana, ihanAM viccoM kujjha (pazUAM) nUM tusIM khAMde vI ho|
ihanAM (pazUAM) viccoM tuhADe laI ronakAM vI hana jadoM tusIM ihanAM nUM zAma vele carA ke liAMde ho ate savera nUM carana lai jAMde ho|

ate uha (pazU) tuhADe laI bhAra Dho-Dho ke uhanAM zahirAM (thAvAM) tIka lai jAMde hana jitthe tusIM binAM jAnator3a mihanata toM nahIM pujja sakade| vAsatava vica tuhADA rabba atiaMta naramI karana vAlA te miharabAna hai|

ghor3e, khaccara te khote (use ne) paidA kIte tAM jo tusIM uhanAM ’te savAra hovo| uha tuhADe laI sajAvaTa dA sAdhana vI hana| uha hora vI anekAM cIz2AM paidA karadA hai jinhAM dA tuhAnUM patA vI nahIM|
siddhI rAha allAha kola pahuMcadI hai te kujjha rAha viMge-TeDe vI hana| je allAha cAhuMdA tAM tuhAnUM sabha nUM siddhe rAha pA diMdA|
uhIo hai jisa ne akAza toM tuhADe laI pANI utAriA, use nUM pItA jAMdA hai ate use toM daraqhata uggade hana jinhAM toM tusIM ApaNe jAnavarAM nUM carAMde ho|
use (pANI) toM uha (allAha) tuhADI khetI ugAuMdA hai, z2aitUna, khajUra, aMgUra ate hora kaI prakAra de phala (ugAuMdA hai)| bezakka soca vicAra karana vAliAM laI ihanAM vica bahuta vaDDI nizAnI hai|
use ne tuhADe laI rAta te dina nUM kaMma lA chaDDiA hai| sUraja, caMna ate tAre vI use de hukama dI pAlaNA karade hana| bezakka isa vica sUjha-bUjha rakkhaNa vAliAM laI kiMnIAM hI nizAnIAM hana|
ate hora vI anekAM raMga-baraMgIAM cIz2AM usa ne tuhADe laI dharatI vica paidA kItIAM hana| sikkhiA grahiNa karana vAliAM laI isa vica anekAM hI nizAnIAM hana|

use allAha ne tuhADe adhIna samuMdara kara chaDDe hana tAM jo tusIM usa (samuMdara) viccoM tAz2A (macchI dA) mAsa khAo ate isa viccoM ApaNe ziMgAra laI gihaNe (hIre mautI) kaDDhoM, jo tusIM pahiniA karade ho| tusIM (ise vica) pANI nUM cIradIAM hoIAM kizatIAM vI caladIAM hoIAM vekhade ho, tAM jo tusIM samuMdara viccoM allAha dA faz2ala (riz2aka) talAza karo ate tusIM usa de dhaMnavAdI hovo|
ate usa (allAha) ne dharatI vica pahAr3a gaDDa ditte tAM jo uha (dharatI) sane tuhADe Dhilaka nA jAve| nahirAM ate rasate baNAe tAM jo tusIM ApaNIAM thAvAM (maMz2ilAM) ’te pahuMca sako|
hora vI kaI nizAnIAM (rAha labbhaNa laI) rakkha chaDDIAM hana| tAriAM rAhIM vI lokI rAha labbha laiMde hana|
bhalA jihar3A (allAha sabha kujjha) paidA karadA hai, kI uha usa jihA ho sakadA hai jihar3A (kujjha vI) paidA nahIM karadA? kI tusIM kujjha vI nahIM socade?
je tusIM allAha dIAM niamatAM dI giNatI karanA cAho tAM giNa nahIM sakade| bezakka allAha baqhazaNahAra te miharabAna hai|
jo vI tusIM gupata rakkhade ho jAM pragaTa (vikhAvA) karade ho allAha sabha jANadA hai|
jinhAM nUM iha (muzarika loka) allAha nUM chaDDa ke pukArade hana uha kise vI cIz2a nUM paidA nahIM kara sakade, jada ki uha sAre (allAha duArA) paidA kIte gae hana|[1]
