translations.footnotes: [1] bhAva ika toM vaddha izaTAM nUM maMNana vAle mUratI pUjaka ate allAha dA ika hoNa toM inakAra karana vAle jihar3e allAha de nAla-nAla dUjiAM dI vI pUjA karade hana ate allAha dA zarIka baNAuMde hana uha sabha (paidA kItIAM hoiA) (maqhalUka) hana ate maqhalUka kiveM pUjana yoga ho sakadA hai?

translations.translation: iha sAre (akala pakkhoM) murade hana jiUMde nahIM, uhanAM nUM tAM iha vI nahIM patA ki uha kadoM (mur3a) uThAe jANage|
tuhADA sabha dA kevala ika hI izaTa hai, para jihar3e lokI Aqhirata ’te ImAna nahIM rakkhade uhanAM de mana (ikko-ika izaTa dA) inakAra karade hana| uha sAre hI ghamaMDI hana|
bezakka allAha hara usa cIz2a nUM jisa nUM tusIM gupata rakkhade ho ate jisa nUM pragaTa karade ho, caMgI tarhAM jANadA hai| bezakka uha ghamaMDIAM nUM ukkA hI pasaMda nahIM karadA|
jadoM uhanAM (kAfirAM) toM pucchiA jAMdA hai ki tuhADe rabba (iz2aTa) ne kI cIz2a utArI hai? tAM (makke vAle) Akhade hana ki iha tAM pahile sameM de kisse kahANIAM hana|

kiAmata dihAr3e iha loka jitthe ApaNe (pApAM dA) bojha cukkaNage utthe hI uhanAM dA vI bojha cukkaNage, jinhAM nUM uha binAM giAna gumarAha karade hana| vekho uha kiMnAM bhair3A bojha cukka rahe hana|

bezakka uha loka ApaNIAM cAlAM calla cukke jihar3e ihanAM toM pahilAM bIta cukke, para allAha ne uhanAM dIAM makkArI bharIAM cAlAM dI imArata jar3o ukhAr3a suTTI, so uhanAM de utte use (makkArI) dI chatta A DiggI| uhanAM ’te hara pAsioM az2Aba AiA hai jidharoM uha soca vI nahIM sI sakade|

kiAmata dihAr3e allAha ihanAM nUM hINA karegA ate pucchegA ki mere uha zarIka kitthe hana jinhAM laI tusIM (ImAna vAliAM nAla) jhagar3hiA karade sI| uha loka jinhAM nUM (kuraAna dA) giAna dittA giA sI uha AkhaNage ki ajja kAfirAM laI rusavAI te maMdabhAgI hai|

unhAM dI rUha farizate isa hAla vica kaDDhade hana ki uha (kufara jAM ziraka rAhIM) ApaNe Apa ’te z2ulama kara rahe huMde hana tAM ate uha (kAfira) iha kahiMde hoe sira jhukA diMde hana ki asIM tAM koI bhair3A kaMma nahIM sI karade| (farizate Akhade hana) kiuM nahIM sI karade! allAha sabha jANadA hai, jo tusIM karade sI|
huNa tusIM naraka de bUhiAM vica dAqhala ho jAo ate sadA ise vica hI raho| so ghamaMDIAM laI kiMnAM bhair3A TikANA hai|

jadoM rabba dA Dara maMNana vAliAM nUM pucchiA jAMdA hai ki tuhADe rabba ne kI utAriA hai? tAM Akhade hana ki qhaira hI qhaira (sabha toM vadhIA cIz2a utArI hai)| jinhAM lokAM ne bhalAI kItI uhanAM laI isa dunIAM vica vI bhalAI hai ate Aqhirata dA ghara tAM lAz2amI hI vadhIA hovegA| kiMnAM caMgA ghara hai, rabba toM Darana vAliAM dA|

(bhAva) sadIvI nivAsa laI bAg2a hana jinhAM vica uha (neka loka) dAqhala hoNage| uhanAM de heTha nahirAM vaga rahIAM hoNagIAM, jo vI uha icchA karanage uha utthe uhIo prApata karanage| parahez2agArAM nUM allAha iMja hI vadhIA badalA diMdA hai|

jinhAM de prANa farizate pavittaratA (bhAva ImAna) dI hAlata vica kaDDhade hana (uhanAM nUM farizate) Akhade hana ki tuhADe laI salAmatI hI salAmatI hai| tusIM savaraga vica praveza kara jAo, ApaNe uhanAM (neka) kaMmAM de badale jo tusIM karade sI|

kI iha (kAfira) isa galla dI uDIka kara rahe hana ki ihanAM kola (ihanAM dI jAna kaDDhaNa laI) farizate AuNa jAM (az2Aba laI) tuhADe rabba dA hukama A jAve| iMja hI uhanAM lokAM ne vI kItA sI jihar3e ihanAM toM pahilAM sI| allAha ne uhanAM ’te koI z2ulama nahIM sI kItA, sagoM uha tAM ApaNIAM jAnAM utte hI z2ulama karade sana|
so uhanAM (inakArIAM) nUM uhanAM dIAM bhair3IAM karatUtAM de bhair3e badale mila gae ate jisa (az2Aba) dA uha makhaula uDAiA karade sI, use ne uhanAM nUM ghera liA|

muzarikAM ne AkhiA ki je allAha cAhuMdA tAM nA hI asIM te nA hI sADe bApa dAdA usa (allAha) toM chuTTa kise hora dI ibAdata karade ate nA uha (allAha) de hukama toM binAM kise cIz2a nUM harAma samajhade| iho vatIrA ihanAM toM pahilAM de lokAM dA vI rihA hai| so rasUlAM de z2iMme sapazaTa rUpa vica paig2Ama pahuMcAuNA hai|

asIM hara ummata vica ika rasUla (iha dassaNa laI) bhejiA ki kevala ika allAha dI hI baMdagI karo ate tAg2Uta [2] toM baco| phera ihanAM viccoM kujjha lokAM nUM tAM allAha ne hidAita baqhaza dittI ate kujjha ’te gumarAhI chA gaI| so tusIM Apa hI dharatI ’te ghuMma-phira ke vekha lavo ki (paig2aMbarAM nUM) jhuThalAuNa vAliAM dA aMta kiho jihA hoiA sI|
translations.footnotes: [2] tAg2Uta laI vekho sUrata ala-bakaraha, hAzIA Aita 257/2

translations.translation: (he nabI sa:!) bhAveM tusIM ihanAM lokAM dI hidAita laI kiMne hI cAhavAna hovo, [3] para jisa nUM allAha kurAhe pA deve phera usa laI hidAita nahIM ate nA hI uhanAM dA koI sahAI huMdA hai|
translations.footnotes: [3] hadIsa vica Apa (sa:) dI isa icchA te koziza nUM iMja biAna kItA giA hai ki allAha de rasUla (sa:) ne faramAiA merI ate lokAM dI udAharana aiveM hai jiveM kise ne agga bAlI hove jadoM agga ne ApaNe Ale-duAle nUM rauzana kara dittA tAM pataMge jihar3e agga vica girade hana usa vica girana lagga pae tAM uha AdamI uhanAM pataMgiA nUM girana toM rokadA hai para uha pataMge AdamI ’te bhArU hoke agga vica girade rahiMde hana| nabI (sa:) faramAiA, iMja hI maiM vI tuhAnUM tuhADe lakkAM toM phar3a ke agga toM roka rihA hAM para tusIM ho ki agga vica girana laI z2ida kara rahe ho| (sahI baqhArI, hadIsa: 6483)

translations.translation: uha lokI allAha dIAM pakkIAM suMhAM khA ke Akhade hana ki allAha muradiAM nUM mur3a jIuMdA nahIM karegA| he nabI! Akha dio, kiuM nahIM (karegA)? iha usa dA saccA vAadA hai| para vadhere loka isa nUM jANade vI nahIM|
ajihA hoNA isa laI z2arUrI hai ki lokI jisa cIz2a (kiAmata) vica matabheda rakkhade sana usa nUM allAha sapazaTa kara deve ate kAfirAM nUM patA lagga jAve ki uhI jhUThe sana|
jadoM asIM kise cIz2a (nUM hoMda vica liAuNa) dA irAdA kara laIe tAM usa laI sADA kahiNA iho huMdA hai ki ‘ho jA’ tAM uha ho jAMdA hai|

jinhAM lokAM ne z2ulama sahiNa magaroM allAha dI rAha vica hijarata kItI (bhAva ghara-bAra chaDDe) tAM asIM uhanAM nUM saMsAra vica vI vadhIA TikANA baqhazAMge ate Aqhirata (paraloka) dA savAba (badalA) tAM bahuta hI vaDDA hai| kAza! ki lokI isa toM jANU huMde|
iha uha loka hana jinhAM ne sabara toM kaMma liA ate uha ApaNe pAlaNahAra ’te bharosA karade hana|
(he nabI!) tuhAthoM pahilAM vI asIM puraza hI (nabI) bheje sana| asIM uhanAM valla vahI (rabbI saMdeza) bhejade sI| je tusIM nahIM jANade tAM jihar3e giAna rakkhade hana uhanAM nUM puccha lavo|

(asAM uhanAM nabIAM nUM) khullhIAM dalIlAM te kitAbAM de ke ghallhiA sI ate asIM huNa tuhADe utte (he nabI!) iha z2ikara (bhAva.kuraAna) utAriA hai tAM jo tusIM lokAM de sAhamaNe, jo uhanAM laI utAriA giA hai, usa nUM kholha-kholha ke (visathAra nAla) biAna karo tAM jo uha soca vicAra kara sakaNa|

(paig2aMbarAM viruddha) bhair3IAM cAlAM callaNa vAle kI isa galloM niDara ho gae hana ki allAha uhanAM nUM dharatI vica dhaMsA deve jAM uhanAM ’te ajihe pAsioM az2Aba A jAve, jidharoM uha soca vI nahIM sakade|
jAM uhanAM nUM turade-phiradiAM hI nappa lave| phera uha allAha nUM bevasa karana vAle nahIM|
jAM uhanAM (kAfirAM) nUM Dara-qhaufa dI avasathA vica phar3a lave| saccI galla tAM iha hai ki tuhADA rabba bahuta hI narama subhAa vAlA te miharabAna hai|

kI iha loka allAha dIAM sAjIAM hoIAM cIz2AM nUM nahIM vekhade ki uhanAM de parachAveM kiveM sajje-khabbe jhukade hana? allAha dI haz2UrI vica sijadA karade hana ate usa de agge uha sAre hI nimANe hana?
dharatI te akAza de sAre hI jIva-jaMtU te sAre farizate allAha de agge sIsa jhukAuMde hana ate uha takabbara (ghamaMDa) nahIM karade|
ate jihar3A rabba uhanAM sabha de uppara hai usa toM Darade rahiMde hana ate jo vI hukama miladA hai usa dI pAlaNA karade hana|
allAha dA faramAna hai ki do izaTa nA baNAo, izaTa tAM ikallA uhIo (allAha) hai,[4] so tusIM sAre maithoM hI Daro|
translations.footnotes: [4] vekho sUrata ana-nisA, hAzIA Aita 171/4

translations.translation: akAzAM te dharatI vica jo kujjha vI hai, uha sabha use dA hI hai ate use (de hukamAM) dI pAlaNA sadIvI hai| kI tusIM usa allAha nUM chaDDa ke horA toM Darade ho?
tuhADe kola jihar3IAM vI niamatAM hana, uha sabha allAha va$loM hI baqhazIAM hoIAM hana| jadoM vI tuhAnUM koI bipatA A paiMdI hai tAM tusIM use nUM hI benatIAM karade ho|
ate jiveM hI uha tuhADI bipatA nUM dUra karadA hai, phera tuhADe viccoM kujjha loka allAha de nAla dUjiAM nUM (bipatA dUra karana vica) zarIka karana lagga jAMde hana|
ate sADIAM dittIAM hoIAM niamatAM dI nA-zukarI karana lagga jAMde hana, caMgA jinnA lAbha uThAuNA hai uThA lavo, tuhAnUM chetI hI patA lagga jAvegA (jo tusIM karade sI)|

asIM ihanAM (muzarikAM) nUM jo vI riz2aka baqhaziA hai, iha usa viccoM uhanAM (jhUThe izaTAM) dA hissA nizacita karade hana jinhAM nUM iha jANade vI nahIM| allAha dI suMha! tuhADe isa jhUTha ghar3hana dA tuhAthoM z2arUra hI puccha-giccha kItI jAvegI|
iha (kAfira) allAha laI tAM dhIAM ThahirAuMde hana, jada ki allAha (aulAda toM) pAka hai| ate ApaNe laI uha jo uha icchA karana (bhAva puttara)|

jadoM ihanAM vica kise nUM dhI hoNa dI qhuzaqhabarI dittI jAMdI hai tAM dukha te afasosa kArana usa de mUMha ’te kAlasa chA jAMdI hai (bhAva murajhA jAMdA hai) ate uha dila hI dila vica ghuTaNa mahisUsa karadA hai|

isa (mAr3I) qhabara kArana, jisa dI usa nUM qhuzaqhabarI suNAI gaI sI, lokAM toM lukadA phiradA hai, (socadA hai) kI maiM apamAnita hoNa de bAvajUda isa nUM jiUMdA rakkhAM jAM dharatI vica (jiUMdA hI) dabba devAM?[5] vekho! uha allAha bAre kiMnA bhair3A faisalA kara rahe hana (ki usa de dhIAM hoNa)|
translations.footnotes: [5] iha saMketa usa sameM valla hai jadoM jaMmadIAM kur3IAM nUM jiUMde hI dharatI vica dabba deNa dI rasama sI jisa nUM isalAma ne A ke rokiA|

translations.translation: jihar3e loka Aqhirata ’te vizavAsa nahIM rakkhade uhanAM laI bahuta hI bhair3I misAla hai| jada ki allAha laI tAM bahuta hI uccIAM misAlAM hana| uha bahuta hI z2orAvara ate hikamatAM (dAnAI) vAlA hai|

je allAha lokAM valloM kIte z2ulamAM (pApAM) ’te turaMta hI phar3a laiMdA tAM dharatI ’te callaNa vAlA ika vI prANI nUM nA chaDDadA| para uha (allAha) tAM uhanAM sabha nUM ika nizacita sameM tIka laI Dhilla diMdA hai, phera jadoM uhanAM dA nizacata samAM A pahuMcadA hai tAM usa toM ika ghar3I bhara vI agge-picche nahIM ho sakade|

iha (muzarika) allAha laI uha cIz2a pasaMda karade hana jisa toM uha Apa ghiranA karade hana ate uhanAM dIAM z2ubAnAM jhUTha kahiMdIAM hana ki bezakka ihanAM laI hI (Aqhirata vica) bhalAI hai| asala vica ihanAM laI agga hai ate uha isa naraka vica sabha toM pahilAM bheje jANage|

allAha dI kasama! asIM tuhAthoM pahilIAM ummatAM valla vI paig2aMbara bheje sI paraMtU zaitAna ne uhanAM (inakArIAM) dIAM bhair3IAM karatUtAM nUM vekhaNa vica sohaNA baNA chaDDiA hai| ajja vI uhI (zaitAna) uhanAM dA dosata hai ate uhanAM laI dukhadAI saz2A hai|

(he nabI!) asIM tuhADe ’te kitAba (.kuraAna) kevala isa laI utArI hai tAM jo tusIM uhanAM ’te uhanAM sArIAM gallAM nUM sapazaTa kara dio, jinhAM vica iha matabheda karade hana ate iha (.kuraAna) ImAna vAliAM laI hidAita te rahimata hai|
allAha ne akAza toM pANI barasAiA ate isa nAla marI hoI dharatI nUM mur3a surajIta kara dittA| bezakka isa vica uhanAM lokAM laI nizAnIAM hana, jihar3e (dhiAna nAla) suNade hana|

bezakka tuhADe laI (pAlatU) jAnavarAM vica vI ika sikkhiA hai| uhanAM jAnavarAM de DhiDDAM ’coM gohe ate lahU de vicAlioM jihar3A qhAlasa duddha nikkaladA hai, asIM tuhAnUM piAuMde hAM, jihar3A pINa vAliAM laI atiaMta suAdalA hai|
khajUra te aMgUra uha phala hana jinhAM toM tusIM nazIlIAM cIz2AM (zarAba) te pAka roz2I vI prApata karade ho| jihar3e lokI akala rakkhade hana uhanAM laI isa vica bahuta nizAnIAM hana|
tuhADe rabba ne madhU mukhI valla iha hukama ghallhiA ki tUM pahAr3AM ’te, daraqhatAM ’te ate uhanAM chapparAM ’te jinhAM ’te lokI velAM cAr3hade hana, ApaNA ghara (chattA) baNA|

(hukama hoiA) hara prakAra de phalAM (te phullAM) dA rasa cUsa, phera ApaNe pAlaNahAra dIAM paddhara rAhAM ’te turadI rahi| usa (makkhI) de DhiDDoM raMga-baraMgA ika zarabata (zahada) nikaladA hai, jisa vica lokAM laI zifA (bhAva bImArIAM dA ilAja) hai| soca vicAra karana vAliAM laI isa vica ika vaDDI nizAnI hai|

allAha ne tuhAnUM sabha nUM paidA kItA hai phera uhIo tuhAnUM mauta devegA ate tuhADe viccoM koI nakaMmI umara (buDhApe) nUM pahuMcA dittA jAMdA hai tAM jo uha jANana magaroM phera kujjha nA jANe| bezakka allAha hI (pUrana) giAna ate (hara tarhAM dI) samarathA rakkhadA hai|

allAha ne tuhADe viccoM kaIAM nUM kaIAM ’te riz2aka deNa vica vaDiAI baqhazI hai, phera jinhAM nUM vaDiAI de rakkhI hai uha ApaNe riz2aka viccoM ApaNe adhIna g2ulAmAM nUM nahIM diMde tAM jo uha isa riz2aka vica barAbara nA ho jANa| kI iha loka allAha dIAM niamatAM de inakArI hana? [6]
translations.footnotes: [6] allAha ne iha udAharana uhanAM muzarikAM de saMbaMdha vica dittI hai jihar3e jhUThe izaTAM nUM rabba de sAMjhI baNAuMde sI ki uha Apa isa galla ’te sahimata nahIM hoNage ki uhanAM dI jAidAda vica uhanAM de g2ulAma bhAgI baNa jANa, phera iha lokI allAha dI ibAdata vica dUje izaTAM nUM sAMjhI baNAuNa vica sahimata kiuM nahIM huMde|

translations.translation: allAha ne tuhADe laI tuhADe viccoM hI patanIAM baNAIAM ate use ne tuhADIAM patanIAM toM tuhADe putta-pote baNAe ate tuhADe khANa laI pAka riz2aka dittA| kI phera vI uha loka jhUTha nUM hI (sacca) maMNanage ate allAha valloM baqhazIAM hoIAM niamatAM dI nA - zukarI karanage?
uha allAha nUM chaDDa ke uhanAM dI baMdagI karade hana jinhAM nUM akAza te dharatI ’coM uhanAM nUM kujjha vI riz2aka deNa dA koI vI adhikAra nahIM ate nA hI uha (isa dI) samarathA rakhade hana|
so tusIM allAha laI udahAraNAM nA ghar3ho, allAha caMgI tarhAM jANadA hai tusIM nahIM jANade|

allAha ika udAharana diMdA hai ki ika g2ulAma hai jisa ’te dUje dA adhikAra hai jihar3A Apa koI vI adhikAra nahIM rakkhadA ate ika uha viakatI hai jisa nUM asIM ApaNe koloM sohaNI roz2I de rakkhI hai jisa viccoM uha luka-chupa ke ate ailAnIA qharaca karadA hai, kI uha doveM barAbara ho sakade hana? allAha laI hI hara prakAra dI vaDiAI hai, para ihanAM viccoM bathere loka isa galla nUM nahIM jANade|

allAha do viakatIAM dI ika hora misAla diMdA hai ki ihanAM viccoM ika gUMgA hai| uha kise kaMma de yoga nahIM sagoM ApaNe mAlika ’te bhAra baNiA hoiA hai, uha usa nUM jitthe vI bheje koI bhaddarakArI nahIM| kI uha usa viakatI de barAbara ho sakadA hai, jihar3A hakka inasAfa dA hukama diMdA hai ate hove vI siddhI rAha ’te?

akAzAM te dharatI de gupata tatthAM dA giAna kevala allAha kola hI hai ate kiAmata dA AuNA tAM iMja hai jiveM akkha jhamaka jAve sagoM isa toM vI kujjha ghaTa| bezakka allAha hara cIz2a ’te kudarata rakkhadA hai|
allAha ne tuhAnUM tuhADIAM mAvAM de garabhAM ’coM isa hAla vica paidA kItA ki tusIM kujjha vI nahIM sI jANade| use ne tuhADe kaMna, akkhAM te dila baNAe tAM jo tusIM zukaraguz2Ara hovo|

kI iha loka paMchIAM nUM nahIM vekhade jihar3e akAza maMDala vica rabbI hukama nAla baddhe hoੲ hana| allAha toM chuTTa hora koI ihanAM nUM thaMmaNa vAlA nahIM| bezakka isa vica ImAna liAuNa vAliAM laI vaDDIAM nizAnIAM hana|

allAha ne tuhADe laI tuhADe gharAM nUM vassaNa dI thAM baNAI ate use ne tuhADe laI jAnavarAM dIAM khallAM toM ajihe ghara baNAe jihar3e tuhAnUM safara vica vI te ThahiraNa de sameM vI hole jApade hana ate uhanAM (jAnavarAM dIAM) unnAM, jattAM te khallAM toM tusIM hora vI batherIAM gharelU cIz2AM baNAuMde ho, jihar3IAM jIvana de nizacita sameM tIka tuhAnUM lAbha diMdIAM hana|

allAha ne hI tuhADe laI ApaNIAM baNAIAM hoIAM cIz2AM toM parachAveM baNAe ate tuhADe lukaNa chippaNa laI pahAr3AM vica khohAM (gArAM) baNAIAM ate tuhADe laI ajihe kur3ate baNAe jihar3e tuhAnUM garamIM toM bacAuMde hana ate ajihe kur3ate (bhAva z2arrA-bakatara) baNAe jihar3e yuddha vica tuhADI rakkhiA karade hana| ise tarhAM uha tuhADe ’te ApaNIAM niamatAM dI pUratI karadA hai| tAM jo tusIM AgiAkArI baNa jAo|
(he nabI!) je phera vI uha (rabba toM) mUMha mor3ade hana (tAM mor3a laiNa) tAM tuhADe z2iMme tAM kevala sapazaTa rUpa vica (rabbI Adeza) pahuMcANA hI hai|
uha allAha dIAM niamatAM nUM pachANade hana phera vI uhanAM dA inakAra kara rahe hana| sagoM ihanAM viccoM bahu-giNatI nA-zukariAM dI hai|

jadoM (kiAmata) dihAr3e asIM hara ummata (samUdAe) viccoM ika gavAha (vajoM rasUla) khar3hA karAMge, phera nA tAM kAfirAM nUM (bolaNa dI) AgiA dittI jAvegI ate nA hI uhanAM toM taubA karana dI maMga kItI jAvegA|
jadoM uha z2Alama loka az2Aba vekha laiNage phera nA tAM uhanAM dI saz2A nUM haulA kItA jAvegA te nA hI kise tarhAM dI Dhillha hI dittI jAvegI|

jadoM muzarika loka ApaNe thApe hoe zarIkAM nUM vekhaNage tAM AkhaNage ki he sADe rabbA! iho sADe (Apa ghar3e hoe tere) zarIka hana jinhAM nUM asIM tainUM chaDDa ke pukAriA karade sI| tada uha (zarIka) uhanAM (muzarikAM) dI galla uhanAM de mUMha ’te mAranage te AkhaNage ki tusIM tAM ukkA hI jhUTha bolade ho|
usa dina uha allAha de haz2Ura ApaNI faramAMbaradArI (nimaratA sahita) peza karanage| ate uha sAre (jhUThe zarIka) jihar3e uha (saMsAra vica) ghar3hiA karade sana, uha sAre visara jANage|
jinhAM ne inakAra kItA ate allAha de rAha toM lokAM nUM rokiA asIM uhanAM nUM az2Aba hI az2Aba diAMge kiuM jo uha fasAdI sana|

(he nabI! yAda karo) jisa (kiAmata) dihAr3e asIM hara ummata viccoM uhanAM laI ika gavAha khar3A karAMge ate tuhAnUM uhanAM sabha utte gavAha baNAvAMge| asIM tuhADe ’te hara cIz2a kholha ke biAna karana vAlI iha kitAba utArI hai, jihar3I musalamAnAM laI hidAita, rahimata te qhuzaqhabarI hai|

bezakka allAha niAM, upakAra te sAka saMbaMdhIAM nUM (sahAitA) deNa dA hukama diMdA hai[7] ate burAI, azalIlatA, z2ulama ate vadhIkI toM rokadA hai| uha (allAha) tuhAnUM nasIhata karadA hai, tAM jo tusIM sikkhiA prApata kara sakoM|
translations.footnotes: [7] rizatedArI de vI daraje hana sabha toM pahilAM mAMpe phera aulAda, phera bhAI bhaiNa phera cAce phUpphI phera mAmA te mAsar3a phera dUje rizatedAra|

translations.translation: allAha nAla kIte vacanAM nUM pUrA karo ate jadoM tusIM Apo vica praNa karo ate kasamAM nUM pakkIAM karana magaroM nA tor3o| jada ki tusIM allAha nUM ApaNe ’te gavAha baNA cukke ho| jo vI tusIM karade ho allAha usa nUM bhalI-bhAMta jANadA hai|

tusIM usa aurata vAMga nA ho jAo jisa ne ApaNA sUta mihanata nAla kattiA ate phera Ape usa nUM tAra-tAra kara chaDDiA, so tusIM ApaNIAM kasamAM nUM ika dUje nUM dhokhA deNa dA sAdhana nA baNAo| tAM jo ika dhar3A dUje dhar3e ’te bhArU ho jAve| jada ki allAha ihanAM (kasamAM) rAhIM tuhAnUM parakha rihA hai ate kiAmata dihAr3e z2arUra hI uha uhanAM sArIAM gallAM nUM sapazaTa kara devegA, jinhAM vica tusIM matabheda karade sana|

je allAha cAhuMdA tAM tuhAnUM sabha nUM ika hI ummata (garUha) baNA diMdA para uha jisa nUM cAhuMdA hai kurAhe pAuMdA hai ate jisa nUM cAhuMdA hai hidAita baqhaza diMdA hai| tusIM jo vI kara rahe ho usa pratI z2arUra hI puccha-giccha hovegI|

tusIM ApaNIAM kasamAM nUM Apo vica ika dUje nUM dhokhA deNa dA sAdhana nA baNAo ki isalAma ’te kise dA paira jaMma jANa magaroM tilaka jAve phera tuhAnUM (saMsAra vica) karar3I saz2A bhugatanI pavegI ate paraloka vica tuhADe laI karar3I saz2A hovegI| kiuM jo tusIM (usa nUM) rAha toM rokiA sI|
tusIM allAha nAla kItIAM saMdhIAM nUM tuccha jihe (saMsArika) lAbha laI nA veco| bezakka jo (badalA) allAha kola hai uhIo vadhIA hai, je tusIM samajho|

jo kujjha vI tuhADe kola hai uha sabha muka jANa vAlA hai ate jo allAha kola hai uhI sadA bAkI rahiNa vAlA hai| sabara karana vAliAM nUM asIM (allAha) uhanAM de bhale karamAM dA bahuta hI vadhIA badalA diAMge|[8]
translations.footnotes: [8] vekho sUrata ala-taubA, hAzIA Aita 121/9

translations.translation: jo vI viakatI neka karama karegA, puraza hove jAM isatarI, para hove ImAna vAlA tAM asIM usa nUM bahuta hI pAkIz2A jIvana batIta karAvAMge ate (paraloka vica) uhanAM de neka karamAM dA vadhIA badalA vI uhanAM nUM z2arUra devAMge|
(he musalamAno!) jadoM tusIM.kuraAna par3haNa laggo tAM phiTakAre hoe zaitAna toM bacaNa laI allAha dI zarana maMga liA karo|
ImAna vAliAM ’te ate ApaNe rabba ’te bharosA karana vAliAM ’te usa (zaitAna) dA ukkA hI vasa nahIM caladA|
hAM usa (zaitAna) dA vassa tAM uhanAM ’te hI caladA hai jihar3e usa nUM ApaNA saraprasata baNAuMde hana ate allAha dA zarIka baNAuMde hana|

jadoM asIM ika Aita dI thAM dUjI Aita utArade hAM jadoM ki allAha jo vI utAradA hai usa nUM bhalI-bhAMta jANadA hai, phera uha (kAfira) Akhade hana ki (he muhaMmada!) iha sabha tUM hI ghar3hadA hai| asala vica ihanAM viccoM vadhere kujjha jANade hI nahIM|

(he nabI!) Akha dio ki isa (.kuraAna) nUM pavittara rUha (jibarAIla) ne tuhADe rabba valloM hakka-sacca nAla utAriA giA hai, tAM jo allAha ImAna vAliAM de pairAM nUM jamAIM rakkhe, isa vica AgiAkArIAM laI rAha-numAI ate qhuzaqhabarI hai|

asIM caMgI tarhAM jANade hAM jo iha kAfira Akhade hana ki isa (muhaMmada sa:) nUM tAM ika viakatI (.kuraAna) sikhAuMdA hai, jada ki uha viakatI jisa valla iha saMketa karade hana, ajamI hai (bhAva usa dI bolI arabI nahIM)| jada ki iha.kuraAna tAM TheTha arabI vica hai|
jihar3e lokI allAha dIAM AitAM (AdezAM) nUM nahIM maMnade, uhanAM nUM allAha hidAita nahIM diMdA ate uhanAM laI karar3A az2Aba hai|
jhUTha tAM uhIo loka ghar3hade hana jinhAM nUM allAha dIAM AitAM ’te ImAna nahIM, asala vica jhUThe tAM iho loka hana|

jihar3A viakatI ApaNe ImAna liAuNa magaroM vI allAha nAla kufara kare, chuTTa usa toM jisa nUM majabUra kItA jAve para usa dA mana ImAna ’te saMtuzaTa sI, paraMtU jihar3e lokI khullhe dila toM kufara karade hana, tAM uhanAM ’te allAha dA karopa hai ate uhanAM laI bahuta vaDDA az2Aba hai|
iha isa laI ki uhanAM ne paraloka (Aqhirata) dI thAM saMsArika jIvana nUM vadhere pasaMda kItA hai, allAha vI kAfirAM nUM siddhI rAha nahIM vikhAuMdA|
iha uha loka hana, jinhAM de dilAM (bhAva akalAM) ’te, kaMnAM ’te ate akkhAM ’te allAha ne mohara lA chaDDI hai ate iha gafalata vica pae hoe hana|
kujjha vI zakka nahIM ki iho loka Aqhirata vica ghATe vica rahiNage|

(he nabI!) bezakka tuhADA rabba uhanAM lokAM laI ati miharabAna hai jinhAM ne az2amAiza vica paiNa magaroM hijarata kItI, phera jihAda (saMgharaza) kItA ate dhIraja toM kaMma liA| bezakka tuhADA rabba ihanAM az2amAizAM toM bAada lokAM laI baqhazaNahAra te miharabAna hai|

jadoM hareka prANI ApaNe Apa nUM bacAuNa laI lar3adA jhagar3adA hovegA ate hara viakatI nUM usa de kIte karamAM dA pUrA-pUrA badalA dittA jAvegA ate usa dina lokAM nAla bhorA bhara vI z2ulama nahIM hovegA|

allAha ika basatI dI udAharana diMdA hai, jihar3I amana-caina nAla rahi rahI sI| usa dA riz2aka usa de kola hara thAM toM buhalatA nAla pahuMca rihA sI phera usa (de vasanIkAM) ne allAha dIAM niamatAM dI nA-zukarI kItI[9] tAM allAha ne uhanAM dIAM karatUtAM kArana uhanAM ’te bhukkha te Dara dI musIbata pA chaDDI hai|
translations.footnotes: [9] baMdiAM dI nA-zukarI karanA bahuta vaDDA jurama hai isa dI udAharana ika hadIsa vica dassI gaI hai, allAha de rasUla (sa:) ne faramAiA mainUM naraka vikhAI gaI maiMne vekhiA ki usa vica bahu giNatI auratAM dI hI sI jihar3IAM nA-zukarI karadIAM sI, pucchiA giA, kI uha allAha dI nA-zukarI karadIAM sana? Apa (sa:) ne faramAiA, uha ApaNe patIAM dI nA-zukarI karadIAM hana| je koI patI uhanAM de nAla vadhIA varatAo karadA hai, usa dI vI nA-zukarI karadIAM hana| je tUM kise aurata nAla ika laMme sameM taka ahisAna karadA rahe phera uha tere vica koI vI ajihI galla vekhe jisa nUM uha nA-pasaMda karadI hove tAM kahiNa laggadI hai, maiMne tethoM koI vI bhalAI nahIM pAI| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 29)

translations.translation: uhanAM kola uhanAM viccoM hI ika rasUla AiA para uhanAM ne usa nUM jhuThalAiA, so uhanAM nUM az2Aba ne A dabbaiA, asala vica uha z2Alama hI sana|
jo vI halAla te pAkIz2A roz2I tuhAnUM allAha ne dittI hoI hai usa nUM khAo|[10] je tusIM use dI baMdagI karade ho tAM allAha dIAM niamatAM dA zukara adA karo|
translations.footnotes: [10] isa vica uha pazU vI zAmala hana jinhAM nUM allAha ne tuhADe laI halAla baNAiA hai ate ihanAM nUM isalAmI tarIke anusAra z2ibaha kItA jAMdA hai|

translations.translation: tuhADe laI kevala muradAra, qhUna, sUra dA mAsa ate jisa cIz2a ’te allAha toM chuTTa kise hora dA nAM liA giA hove, harAma kItA hai| je koI viakatI bhukkha toM majabUra ho jAve, jada ki uha rabba dA bAg2I nA hove te nA uha Apa cAhuMdA hove ate nA hI haddoM TappaNa vAlA hove tAM allAha uhanAM bevasa lokAM dIAM bhullAM laI baqhazaNahAra te rahima karana vAlA hai|

kise vI cIz2a nUM ApaNI z2ubAna toM aiveM hI jhUTha nA kahi diA karo ki iha halAla hai ate iha harAma, iha kahi ke allAha ’te jhUTha nA lAo| yAda rakkho ki allAha ’te jhUTha lAuNa vAlA safalatA toM vAMjhA hI rahiMdA hai|
ihanAM (gallAM) dA lAbha bahuta thor3hA huMdA hai para ihanAM dA az2Aba bar3A hI karar3A huMdA hai|
yahUdIAM laI asIM jo kujjha harAma kItA sI uha asIM tuhAnUM pahilAM hI dassa cukke hAM, asIM uhanAM ’te koI z2ulama nahIM sI kItA, sagoM uhanAM ne Apo hI ApaNe ’te z2ulama kItA sI|
jihar3A vI koI agiAnatA kArana bhair3e kaMma karadA hai para (giAna AuNa ’te) taubA kara lave ate ApaNA sudhAra vI kara lave tAM tuhADA pAlaNahAra uhanAM laI ati baqhazaNahAra ate miharabAna hai|
hakIkata iho hai ki ibarAhIma tAM Apa hI ika ummata sI (bhAva sArIAM umattAM dA AgU sI), allAha dA AgiAkArI te ika muqhalisa baMdA sI, uha ziraka karana vAliAM viccoM nahIM sI|
uha allAha dIAM niamatAM dA zukara karana vAlA sI, allAha ne usa nUM vizeza ApaNe laI cuNa liA sI ate usa nUM siddhI rAha vI vikhAI sI|[11]
translations.footnotes: [11] ibArahIma nA tAM yahUdI sI ate nA IsAI sagoM uha tAM ika saccA musalamAna sI ate uha muzarikAM viccoM vI nahIM sI| (Ale-imarAna 67/3)

translations.translation: asIM usa nUM saMsAra vica vI bhalAI dittI ate uha Aqhirata vica vI neka lokAM vica hI hovegA|
(he nabI!) asIM tuhADe valla vahI (rabbI bANI) bhejI ki tusIM ika cita hoke millate-ibarAhIma dI pairavI karo, jisa dA rukha kevala allAha valla hI sI, uha muzarikAM viccoM nahIM sana|[12]
translations.footnotes: [12] vekho sUrata ala-bakaraha, hAzIA Aita 135/2

translations.translation: ‘sabata’ vAle dina dI mahattatA tAM kevala uhanAM lokAM laI nizacita kItI gaI sI, jinhAM ne isa vica matabheda kItA sI| bezakka tuhADA rabba uhanAM vicAle kiAmata dihAr3e niber3A kara devegA|

he nabI! lokAM nUM ApaNe rabba de rasate valla samajhadArI ate sohaNe upadezAM rAhIM bulAo ate uhanAM nAla vadhIA te sohaNe DhaMga (bhAva dalIla) nAla bahisa karo| tuhADA rabba ApaNI rAha toM bhaTake hoe lokAM nUM caMgI tarhAM jANadA hai ate uha siddhI rAha pae hoe lokAM nUM vI jANadA hai|
je tusIM badalA laiNA vI hove tAM unnA hI badalA lao jiMnI tuhADe nAla vadhIkI kItI gaI hai,[13] para je tusIM sabara kara lavo tAM sabara karana vAliAM laI iho vadhIA galla hai|
translations.footnotes: [13] badalA laiNa dIAM kaI zakalAM hana jiveM umme-maAvIA hiMdA ra:a: ne allAha de rasUla nUM benatI kItI ki abU-sufiyAna ra:a: ika kaMjUsa viakatI hai, je usa nUM binAM dasse usa de mAla ’coM qharaca kara lavAM, tAM kI gunAha hovegA? Apa (sa:) ne faramAiA tUM ate tere bacce ApaNe guz2Are laI vadhIA tarIke nAla binAM koI phAlatU qharace toM lai sakade ho| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 2) ● rasUla (sa:) toM pucchiA giA, jadoM tusIM sAnUM bAhara bhejade ho tAM kade iMja vI haMdA hai ki asIM ajihe lokAM kola jA ke Thahirade hAM jihar3e sADI mahimAnadArI nahIM karade, tAM isa saMbaMdha vica tuhADA kI vicAra hai? Apa (sa:) ne faramAiA je tusIM kise aisI thAM ruko ate uha tuhADI isa tarhAM mahimAnadArI karana jiddAM uhanAM nUM karanI cAhIdI hai tAM uhanAM dI mahimAnadArI kabUla kara laiNI cAhIdI hai je uha iMja nA karana tAM uhanAM toM ApaNA mahimAnadArI dA hakka prApata karo| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 2461)

translations.translation: so he nabI! tusIM sabara toM kaMma lavo, para binAM allAha dI madada toM tusIM sabara vI kara nahIM kara sakade| tusIM ihanAM (inakArIAM) dI ciMtA nA karo ate jo vI iha cAlAM kheDa rahe hana, ihanAM toM dila choTA nA karo|
sacca jANoM ki allAha parahez2agAra (rabba toM Darana vAle) ate neka kaMma karana vAliAM de aMga-saMga hI hai|[14]
translations.footnotes: [14] jinnI kise ne vadhIkI kItI hove unnA hI badalA laiNA cAhIdA hai| nekI te parahez2agArI rabba dI miharAM rAhIM prApata huMdI hai ate binAM allAha dI rahimata toM kise dI mukatI dI Asa nahIM kItI jA sakadI, itthe taka ki nabIAM dI vI nahIM| jiveM ki hadIsa vica hai ki allAha de rasUla (sa:) ne faramAiA, tuhADe viccoM kise de vI karama usa nUM naraka dI agga toM bacA nahIM sakaNage| lokAM ne pucchiA ki he nabI! kI tuhADe vI? Apa ne faramAiA, hAM! mainUM vI nahIM, para je allAha mainUM ApaNIAM miharAM vicca chupA lave| so tusIM qhAlisa ate vicAle vAlI rAha ApaNAuMde hoe neka karama karade raho, bhAva tusIM siddhI te vicAle vAlI rAha dI nItI ApaNAo, savere-zAma ate rAta de AqhirI hisse vica allAha dI ibAdata karo ate sadA vicakAra vAlI rAha apaNAo, itthoM taka ki tusIM ApaNI icchA anusAra jaMnata vica jA pahuMco| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 6463)

translations.translation: pAka z2Ata hai uha (allAha) jihar3A ApaNe baMde (muhaMmada sa:) nUM rAta de ika hisse vica hI satikArayoga masIta (qhAnA-kAabA) toM masajide- akasA (yarozalama vikhe baitula-mukaddasa) taka lai giA, jisa de Ale-duAle asIM barakatAM rakkhIAM hana, tAM jo asIM usa (muhaMmada) nUM ApaNIAM kujjha nizAnIAM vikhAIe|[1] bezakka uhIo (allAha) sabha kujjha suNana vAlA te vekhaNa vAlA hai|
translations.footnotes: [1] isa sUrata vica allAha ne isarA, bhAva qhAnA-kAabA toM baitula mukaddasa takka muhaMmada (sa:) nUM ika rAta de kujjha hisse vica lai jANa dI caracA kItI hai ate miarAja bhAva akAzAM de uppara laike jANa dI caracA sUrata najama 53 vica kItI gaI hai| iha miarAja dI pUrI yAtarA allAha dA vaDDamullA muajaz2A (camatakAra) hai| muajaz2A usa nUM kihA jAMdA hai jihar3A kevala allAha dI kudarata valloM hI pragaTa haMdA hai, nabI dI kujjha vI icchA isa vica ukkA hI nahIM huMdI| isa laI isa ghaTanA nUM rUhAnI saira jAM supanA AkhaNA ukkA hI g2alata hai| Apa (sa:) nUM miarAja jAgaNa dI hAlata vica hI karAI gaI sI| iha supanA Adi nahIM sI je iMja huMdA tAM kAfirAM nUM isa nUM jhuThalAuNa dI kI lor3a paI sI? para kAfirAM ne isa nUM jhuThalAiA ate nabI (sa:) nUM uhanAM de tIkhe savAlA nUM baradAzata karanA piA| je iha supaNA haMdA tAM nabI (sa:) AsAnI nAla iha kahi ke picchA chur3A sakade sI ki maiM tAM ApaNA supanA dassa rihA hAM tusIM maithoM iha savAla kiuM kara rahe ho? para Apa (sa:) ne iha nahIM kihA sagoM javAba deNa vica ar3IkA lagga rihA sI jisa karake allAha ne betula mukaddasa nUM hI Apa jI de sAhamaNe kara dittA| jiveM hadIsa vica hai jadoM kuraiza ne mainUM jhuThalAiA tAM maiM hatIma (ika thAM dA nAM) vica khar3hA ho giA tAM allAha ne baitula mukaddasa mere agge kara dittA maiM uhanAM kuraizIAM nUM usa dI nizAnIAM dassaNIAM zurU kara dittIAM jadoM maiM usa de valla vekha rihA sI| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 3886)

translations.translation: asIM mUsA nUM kitAba (tauraita) dittI sI ate usa nUM banI-isarAIla laI mAraga darazaka baNAiA ate kihA sI ki tusIM chuTTa maithoM hora kise nUM ApaNA vakIla (kAraja-sAdhaka) nA ThahirAo|
(he loko!) tusIM sAre hI uhanAM lokAM dI nasala ’coM ho jinhAM nUM asIM nUha de nAla (ber3I ’te) savAra kItA sI| bezakka uha (nUha, allAha dA) dhaMnavAdI baMdA sI|
asIM banI-isarAIla nUM uhanAM dI kitAba (tauraita) vica sAfa-sAfa suceta kara dittA sI ki tusIM dharatI ’te do vArI fasAda karoge te vaDDI sarakazI karoge|

jadoM dovAM vAadiAM viccoM pahile vAade dA samAM AiA tAM (he banI isarAIlIo!) asIM tuhADe ’te bahuta hI lar3AkU baMde bheje uha zahirAM vica fasAda phailAuNa laI hara pAse phaila gae| iha ika vacana sI jihar3A pUrA hoNA hI sI|
phera asIM uhanAM (lar3AkUAM) ’te tuhAnUM jitta de ke tuhADe dina phera ditte ate dhaMna daulata ate aulAda nAla tuhADI madada kItI ate tuhADI saMkhiA vica vI vAdhA kItA|

je tusIM bhalAI karoge tAM ApaNe laI hI karoge je burAI karoge tAM uha vI ApaNe laI hI hovegI phera jadoM dUje vAade dA samAM AiA (tAM ika dUjI kauma tuhADe ’te bhArU ho gaI), tAM jo uha (mAra mAra ke) tuhADe cihariAM nUM vigAr3a suTTaNa ate masIta (baitula mukaddasa) vica dAqhala ho jANa, jiveM isa vica pahilI vAra dAqhala hoe sana, tAM jo jisa ’te vI unhAM dA z2aura calle, usa nUM ukkA hI barabAda kara deNa|
ho sakadA hai ki tuhADA rabba tuhADe ’te rahima kare| hAM! je tusIM phera uhIo cajja karana lagga pae tAM asIM vI pahilAM vAMga hI karAMge| asIM naraka nUM ika kaida qhAnA baNA chaDDiA hai|

hakIkata vica iha.kuraAna uha rAha vikhAuMdA hai jihar3A bahuta hI siddhA hai ate unhAM ImAna vAliAM nUM jihar3e neka kaMma karade hana, isa galla dI qhuzaqhabarI diMdA hai ki uhanAM laI bahuta hI vaDDA ajara (badalA) hai|
ate jihar3e loka Aqhirata ’te yakIna nahIM rakkhade uhanAM laI daradanAka az2Aba tiAra kItA giA hai|
manukkha (ApaNe laI) burAI dI duAvAM isa tarhAM maMgadA hai jiveM usa dI bhalAI dI duA hove| manukkha (subhA vajoM) bahuta hI kAhalA hai|

asIM rAta te dina nUM (kudarata dIAM) do nizAnIAM vajoM baNAiA hai, rAta dI nizAnI (caMna) nUM tAM asIM be-nUra kara dittA te dina dI nizAnI (sUraja) nUM ruzanA ditA tAM jo tusIM ApaNe rabba dA faz2ala (roTI roz2I) dI bhAla kara sako ate isa laI vI ki varhiAM (’te mahIniAM) dA hisAba jANa sako| asIM hareka cIz2a dI caMgI tarhAM viAkhiA kItI hai|
asIM hareka manukkha dI karama-patarI nUM usa dI garadana vica pA chaDDiA hai ate kiAmata dihAr3e asIM usa de sAhamaNe ika kitAba peza karAMge[2] jisa nUM uha ApaNe sAhamaNe khullhI vekhegA|
translations.footnotes: [2] iha karama uha hoNage jihar3e manukkha saMsAra vica karake giA hai caMge jAM bhair3e doveM tarhAM de karama manukkha agge rakkhe jANage ate uhanAM dI rauzanI vica usa de jaMnata jAM naraka vica jANa dA faisalA kItA jAvegA| so isa laI z2arUrI ho jAMdA hai ki manukkha saMsAra vica vaddha toM vaddha caMge karama kare nabI (sa:) ne faramAiA: 1਼ nitta roja paMja vele dIAM namAz2AM uhanAM de samAM hoNa ’te adA karanIAM| 2਼ mApiAM nAla nekI vAlA varatAo ate uhanAM dI AgiA dA pAlaNa karanA| 3਼ allAha dI rAha vica jihAda karanA, nekI vAle karama hana| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 7534)

translations.translation: AkhiA jAvegA ki tUM Apa hI ApaNI (karamAM vAlI) kitAba par3ha lai, ajja tUM Apa hI ApaNA hisAba laiNa laI batherA hai|

jihar3A koI siddhI rAha prApata karadA hai tAM usa dA lAbha use nUM hI huMdA hai ate jihar3A rAhoM bhaTTaka jAve tAM uha ApaNe Apa nUM hI kurAhe pAuMdA hai| (kiAmata dihAr3e) koI bhAra cukkaNa vAlA kise dUjI dA bhAra nahIM cukkegA| asIM usa sameM taka kise (kauma) nUM az2Aba nahIM diMde jadoM taka koI rasUla nA bheja daIe|

jadoM asIM kise basatI nUM barabAda karanA cAhuMde hAM tAM utthe de qhuzahAla lokAM nUM Adeza diMde hAM ate uha usa basatI vica (khullhe taura ’te) nA-faramAnIAM karana lagga paiMde hana ate iMja usa (basatI vAliAM) ’te az2Aba dA AuNA Dhukka jAMdA hai ate phera asIM usa (basatI) nUM ujAr3a ke rakkha diMde hAM|
asAM nUha toM magaroM kiMnIAM hI kaumAM halAka kItIAM hana| (he nabI) terA rabba ApaNe baMdiAM de aparAdhAM toM bhalI-bhAMta jANU hai, uha sabha kujjha vekhaNa vAlA hai|

jihar3A koI chetI milaNa vAlA (saMsAra) cAhuMdA hai tAM asIM ise saMsAra vica jisa de laI cAhuMde hAM ate jinnA cAhuMde hAM chetI hI baqhaza diMde hAM, phera usa laI naraka vica jANA lAz2amI ho jAMdA hai uha isa vica rusavAI nAla dhakke khAMdA hoiA dAqhala hovegA|
ate jihar3A Aqhirata cAhuMdA hai ate usa de laI pUre jatana vI karadA hai jada ki uha ImAna vAlA vI hai, iho uha loka hana jinhAM de jatanAM dI kadara kItI jAvegI|

(he nabI! saMsAra vica) asIM hareka nUM tere rabba dIAM baqhazizAM nAla nivAz2ade hAM, uhanAM (inakArIAM) nUM vI (nivAz2ade hAM) ate uhanAM (ImAna vAliAM) nUM vI| tere rabba dIAM baqhazizAM nUM koI roka nahIM sakadA|
vekho asIM ihanAM viccoM ika nUM dUje ’te kiddAM vaDiAI de chaDDI hai ate praloka tAM darajiAM vica hora vI vadhI hoI hai ate uha vaDiAI deNa vica vI kaI guNA vadhI hoI hai|
(he nabI!) tusIM allAha de nAla koI hora izaTa nA baNAo nahIM tAM tusIM vI bhaMDhe hoe te beAsarA hoke baiThe rahi jAoge|

tuhADA rabba hukama de cukiA hai ki tusIM usa (allAha) toM chuTTa kise hora dI baMdagI nA karo ate mApiAM nAla sohaNA vihAra karo| je tuhADe sAhamaNe ihanAM dovAM (mAM-pio) viccoM ika jAM doveM biradha-avasathA vica pahuMca jANa tAM uhanAM de agge ufa taka nA karo (bhAva sI taka nA vaTTo) ate nA hI uhanAM nUM (uttara vica) jhir3akIAM dio sagoM uhanAM nAla naramAI (bhAva satikAra) nAla hI galla bAta karo|

miharAM te nimaratA sahita uhanAM de sAmhaNe ApaNe moDhiAM nUM jhukA ke rakkho ate duA kariA karo ki he mere rabbA! ihanAM (mere mAM-bApa) ’te miharAM faramA jisa tarhAM (mihara muhabbata nAla) unhAM ne bacapaNa vica merI paravariza kItI hai |
jo kujjha vI tuhADe dilAM vica hai tuhADA rabba caMgI tarhAM jANadA hai| je tusIM neka baNa gae ho tAM uha ApaNe valla parata AuNa vAliAM laI ati baqhazaNahAra hai|
rizatedArAM, masakInAM ate musAfirAM [3] dA hakka adA karo ate phaz2Ula qharacI nAla ApaNA mAla nA uDAo| [4]
translations.footnotes: [3] isa vica sohaNe varatAve dI sikkhiA dittI gaI hai| (vekho sUrata ala-bakaraha, hAzIA Aita 83/2) [4] bhAva qharaca karade hoe vicakAra vAlI rAha nUM hI apaNAuNA cAhIdA hai bhAva nA hI phAlatU qharaca karanA cAhIdA hai ate nA hI kaMjUsI karanI cAhIdI hai ate nA hI allAha ate rasUla dI virodhatA vica qharaca karanA cAhIdA hai|

translations.translation: faz2Ula (lor3a toM vaddha) qharaca karana vAle zaitAna de bharA hana ate zaitAna ApaNe rabba dA nA-zukarA hai|
je tuhAnUM uhanAM (lor3avaMdAM de savAlAM) toM isa karake kaMnI katarAuNI pave ki hAle tusIM Apa hI allAha dI miharAM dI bhAla kara rahe ho (bhAva kujha de nahIM sakade) tAM naramAI nAla javAba dio|
nA hI tusIM ApaNA hattha garadana nAla baMnhIM rakkho (ki kaMjUsI karo) ate nA hI usa nUM ukkA hI khullhA chaDDa dio (ki phaz2Ula qharacI hove) ki bhaMDI karavA ke te bebasa hoke baiThe rahi jAo|

bezakka terA rabba jisa laI cAhuMdA hai usa laI khullhI-DullhI roz2I diMdA hai ate (je cAhe) taMga vI kara diMdA hai| bezakka uha ApaNe baMdiAM (de hAlAM) toM bhalI-bhAMta jANU hai ate caMgI tarhAM vekha rihA hai|
tusIM g2arIbI de Dara toM ApaNI aulAda dI hattiA nA karo, asIM uhanAM nUM vI riz2aka diMde hAM ate tuhAnUM vI| bezakka uhanAM (aulAda) dA katala mahA pApa hai|
(qhabaradAra) z2anA de ner3e vI nA jAo, bezakka iha bahuta hI vaDDI azalIlatA hai ate bhair3I rAha hai|

tusIM usa jAna nUM, chuTTa hakka toM, katala nA karo jisa nUM allAha ne harAma kItA hai| jihar3A viakatI niradoza mAriA jAvegA asIM usa de vArasAM nUM (badalA laiNa dA) hakka dittA hai| so uha katala dA badalA laiNa vica haddoM nA Tappe| hAM! (badalA laiNa vica) usa dI madada kItI gaI hai|

tusIM yatIma de mAla de ner3e vI nA jAo (bhAva usa viccoM qharaca nA karo) para sucajje DhaMga nAla (qharaca karo) itthoM tIka ki uha (yatIma) ApaNI javAnI nUM pujja jAve| kIte hoe vacanAM nUM nibhAo, kiuM jo vacanAM saMbaMdhI pucchiA jAvegA|
jadoM miNana laggo tAM miNatI pUrI karo ate siddhI takkar3I nAla pUrA tolo (bhAva DaMDI nA mAro) iMja karanA hI ThIka hai ate siTTe pakkhoM vI iho ThIka hai|
jisa galla dA tuhAnUM giAna hI nA hove usa de picche nA pavo (bhAva Toha vica nA laggo) kiuM jo kaMna akkha ate dila ihanAM sabha toM (kiAmata dihAr3e) puccha-giccha hovegI|
dharatI ’te Akar3a ke nA turo| tUM nA tAM dharatI nUM (ApaNI cAla nAla) pAr3a sakadA haiM ate nA hI (Akar3a nAla) pahAr3AM dIAM uccAIAM nUM pujja sakadA haiM|
iha sAre kaMma ate ihanAM dIAM burAIAM tuhADe rabba nUM saqhata nA-pasaMda hana|

iha uha siANapa dIAM gallAM hana, jihar3IAM tuhADe rabba ne tuhADe valla vahI rAhIM nAz2ila kItIAM hana| allAha toM chuTTa hora kise nUM izaTa nA baNAo nahIM tAM tuhADI bhaMDI karake te hareka bhalAI toM vAMjhA karake naraka vica suTTa dittA jAvegA|
kI tuhADe rabba ne tuhAnUM puttarAM laI cuNa liA hai ate ApaNe laI farizatiAM viccoM dhIAM baNA laIAM hana| bezakka tusIM bahuta hI bhair3IAM gallAM kahiMde ho|
asIM tAM izakuraAna vica hara pakkhoM (hakIkatAM dI) caracA kItI hai tAM jo lokI sikkhiA prApata karana, para iha cIz2a uhanAM (kAfirAM) dI nafarata vica vAdhA karadI hai|
(he nabI!) Akha dio ki je usa (allAha) de nAla hora vI izaTa huMde jiveM ki iha (muzarika loka) Akhade hana tAM uha araza de mAlika (bhAva allAha) taka pahuMcaNa vAlI rAha dI z2arUra hI bhAla karade|
jo uha muzarika Akhade hana allAha uhanAM (sArIAM gallAM toM) pAka hai, sagoM uhanAM toM bahuta uccA hai|

sattAM akAza, dharatI ate jo vI ihanAM vicakAra vasatUAM hana uha sabha use (allAha) dI vaDiAI biAna kara rahIAM hana| koI vI ajihI vasatU nahIM jihar3I usatata nAla usa dI tasabIha nA karadI hove para tusIM uhanAM dI tasabIha nUM samajha nahIM sakade vAsatava vica uha bahuta hI sahiNazIla te baqhazaNahAra hai|
(he muhaMmada!) jadoM tusIM.kuraAna par3hade ho tAM asIM tuhADe ate uhanAM vicakAra jihar3e Aqhirata ’te vizavAsa nahIM rakkhade, ika barIka jihA par3adA tAna diMde hana|[5]
translations.footnotes: [5] saIda bina jabIra ra:a: dA kahiNA hai ki jadoM sUrata lahaba uttarI tAM abU-lahaba dI patanI nabI (sa:) kola AI jadoM ki utthe abU-bakara (ra:a:) vI baiThe hoe sI abU-bakara ne Apa (sa:) nUM kihA ki (he nabI!) tusIM parAM ho jAo uha abu lahaba dI patanI kIte tuhADe nAla koI ajihI galla nA kare jisa toM tuhAnUM takalIfa hove uha bhair3I z2ubAna vAlI z2anAnI hai| nabI (sa:) ne faramAiA mere ate usa de vicAle par3adA pA dittA jAvegA jada uha Apa (sa:) nUM vekha nA sakI usa ne abU-bakara nUM AkhiA ki tuhADe sAthI ne sADI bez2atI kItI hai abU-bakara ne AkhiA ki allAha dI suMha uha zeara nahIM kahiMdA usa ne pucchiA ki tUM isa dI puzaTI karadA hai? phera uha uthioM callI gaI| abU-bakara ne araz2a kItA he allAha de rasUla! kI usa ne tuhAnUM nahIM vekhiA? nabI (sa:) ne faramAiA, nahIM| uha de jANa taka ika farizatA mere te usa de vicAle khar3hA sI ate usa ne mainUM ApaNI oTa vica liA hoiA sI| (tafasIra kuratabI 269/10 musanada abU-yAalI 54/1)

translations.translation: uhanAM de manAM ’te asIM ajihe g2alAfa cAr3ha diMde hAM ki uha kujjha vI nA-samajha sakaNa [6] ate uhanAM de kaMnA ’te DATa lA diMde hAM (ki uha suNa nA sakaNa)| jadoM tusIM.kuraAna vica ApaNe ikkoM rabba dI caracA karade ho tAM uha ghriNA nAla piTTha phera ke bhajja jAMde hana|
translations.footnotes: [6] isa toM bhAva miarAja dI ghaTanA hai jisa dI visathAra nAla caracA sUrata najama de AraMbha vica AvegI|

translations.translation: he nabI asIM caMgI tarhAM jANade hAM ki uha (kAfira).kuraAna kiuM suNade hana| asIM iha vI jANade hAM jadoM uha kaMna lA ke tuhADIAM gallAM suNade hana ate jadoM uha (tuhADe virodha) kAnAphUsIAM karade hana ate jadoM uha z2Alama (lokAM) nUM Akhade hana ki tusIM isa viakatI de picche nA laggo, usa utte tAM jAdU kItA hoiA hai
(he muhaMmada!) vekho tAM uha tuhADe laI kiho jahIAM misAlAM de rahe hana| uha tAM bhaTake hoe loka hana, huNa siddhe rAha turanAM uhanAM de vassa vica nahIM|
uha kahiMde hana ki jadoM asIM haDDIAM ate cUrA-cUrA ho jAvAMge tAM kI naveM sirioM paidA karake phera khar3e kIte jAvAMge?
(he nabI!) tusIM Akho ki bhAveM tusIM patthara baNa jAo jA lohA (mur3a paidA kIte) jAvoge|

jAM hora koI ajihI cIz2a jihar3I tuhADI soca anusAra bahuta hI karar3I hove (tAM vI mur3a paidA kIte jAoge)| je uha pucchaNa ki uha kauNa hai jihar3A sAnUM mur3a surajIta karegA tAM javAba dio ki uhIo allAha (mur3a paidA karegA) jisa ne tuhAnUM pahilI vAra paidA kItA| phera uha sira hilA hilA ke pucchaNage ki iha kadoM hovegA? tusIM (he nabI!) Akha dio ki acaraja nahIM ki uha velA ner3e hI A laggiA hove|

jisa dihAr3e uha (allAha) tuhAnUM saddegA tAM tusIM usadIAM tArIfAM karade hoe (kabarAM ’coM) nikkala turoMge ate tusIM iho samajhoge ki tuhADA (kabarAM vica) ThahiranA bahuta hI thor3he sameM laI sI|
(he nabI!) mere baMdiAM nUM Akha dio ki uha sohaNIAM gallAM hI mUMhoM AkhiA karana| bezakka zaitAna uhanAM vicAle fasAda karavAuMdA hai, asala vica zaitAna manukkha dA khullhA vairI hai|
tuhADA rabba tuhAnUM caMgI tarhAM jANadA hai je uha cAhe tAM tuhADe ’te rahima kare jAM je uha cAhe tAM tuhAnUM az2Aba deve| (he nabI!) asIM tuhAnUM ihanAM lokAM ’te holadAra baNA ke nahIM bhejiA|
akAzAM te dharatI vica jo vI hai tuhADA rabba uhanAM sabha nUM caMgI tarhAM jANadA hai| asAM kaI paig2aMbarAM nUM kaIAM nAloM vaddha vaDiAI baqhazI hai jiveM dAUda nUM asIM z2abUra baqhazI|

(he nabI!) Akha dio ki unhAM nUM madada laI bulA lao jinhAM nUM tusIM usa (allAha) toM chuTTa izaTa samajhade ho| nA tAM uha tuhADe kise kazaTa nUM dUra karana dA adhikAra rakkhade hana ate nA hI badalaNa dA|

jinhAM (izaTAM) nUM iha pukArade hana uha tAM Apa hI ApaNe rabba taka pahuMca prApata karana laI sAdhana bhAla rahe hana ki ihanAM viccoM kauNa rabba de vadhere ner3e ho sakadA hai| uha usa dI miharAM dI Asa rakkhade hana ate usa de az2Aba toM Darade hana| he nabI tuhADe rabba dA az2Aba Darana yoga hI hai|
koI vI basatI ajihI nahIM jisa nUM asIM kiAmata toM pahilAM halAka nA kara daIe jAM usa nUM karar3A az2Aba (daMDa) nA daIe| iho kitAba (lauhe-mahafUz2a) vica likhiA hoiA hai|

asAM nUM nizAnIAM bhejaNa toM kevala isa galla ne roka rakkhiA hai ki pahile lokAM ne unhAM (allAha dIAM) nizAnIAM nUM jhuThalAiA sI| nizAnI vajoM asIM samUda dI kauma nUM (nasIhata prApata karana laI) ika UThaNI dittI| para uhanAM ne usa (UThaNI) ’te z2ulama kItA (bhAva mAra suTTiA) asIM tAM kevala DarAuNa laI hI nizAnIAM bhejade hAM|

(he nabI!) ratA yAda karo jadoM asIM tuhAnUM kihA sI ki tuhADe rabba ne sAre hI lokAM nUM ghera rakkhiA hai| asIM tuhAnUM (miarAja sameM) jo kujha vikhAiA sI usa nUM lokAM laI ika az2amAiza baNA ke rakkha chaDDiA ate usa rukkha (z2akUmma) nUM vI jisa ’te.kuraAna vica lAanata kItI gaI hai| asIM ihanAM inakArIAM nUM DarA rahe hAM, para ihanAM dI sarakazI vica vAdhA hI huMdA jA rihA hai|

jadoM asIM farizatiAM nUM AkhiA sI ki Adama nUM sijadA karo tAM ibalIsa (zaitAna) toM chuTTa sAriAM ne (sijadA) kItA| para usa (zaitAna) ne kihA, kI maiM usa (Adama) nUM sijadA karAM jisa nUM tUM miTTI toM sAjiA hai?

(zaitAna) allAha hai kahiNa laggA, vekha! usa nUM jisa nUM tUM mere utte iz2z2ata dittI hai, je tUM kiAmata dihAr3e tIka mainUM Dhillha deveM tAM thor3he jihe lokAM toM chuTTa maiM isa dI pUrI nasala dIAM jar3hAM puTTa suTTAMgA|
allAha ne faramAiA jAM (tainUM chUTa hai) jihar3A vI ihanAM viccoM terI pairavI karegA tAM bezakka tuhADI sabha dI saz2A naraka hai| iho uhanAM (de karamAM) dA ThIka badalA hovegA|

ihanAM viccoM jinhAM ’te vI terA vasa calla sakadA hai uhanAM nUM ApaNI AvAz2a (gallAM) nAla phisalA lai| uhanAM ’te ApaNe savAra te piAde cAr3ha liA ate mAla te aulAda vica ihanAM dA sAMjhI baNa jA ate ihanAM nAla (jhUThe) vAade kara jada ki zaitAna de sAre vAade jhUThe huMde hana|
para mere (sacce) baMdiAM ’te terA kujjha vI vassa nahIM callegA ate terA rabba (neka baMdiAM de) kaMma savArana laI batherA hai|
tuhADA rabba tAM uha hai jihar3A samuMdarAM vica tuhADIAM ber3IAM toradA hai tAM jo tusIM usa (rabba) dA faz2ala (roz2I) bhAla sako| uha tuhADe ’te atiaMta miharabAna hai|

jadoM samuMdara vica tuhAnUM koI bhIr3a A paiMdI hai tAM allAha nUM chaDDa ke jinhAM nUM tusIM (madada laI) pukAriA karade ho uhanAM sAriAM nUM bhulla jAMde ho|[7] jadoM uha tuhAnUM qhuzakI (bhAva dharatI) valla bacA liAuMdA hai phera tusIM usa toM mUMha mor3a laiMde ho| manukkha bar3A hI nA-zukarA|
translations.footnotes: [7] makke dI jita hoNa ’te akaramAM bina abI jahila rasUla (sa:) toM Dara ke bhajja giA ate habazA jANa vAlI ber3I vica savAra ho giA udoM hI ber3I tUfAna vica phasa gaI ber3I de savAra lokI ika dUje nUM AkhaNa lagge ki allAha toM chuTTa tuhAnUM kauNa bacA sakadA hai? so tusIM sAre manoM aradAsa karo akaramAM ne ApaNe mana vica kihA ki allAha dI suMha je samuMdara vica allAha toM chuTTa hora koI lAbha nahIM pahuMcA sakadA tAM phera dharatI ’te vI usa toM chuTTa koI lAbha nahIM de sakadA| he allAha! maiM tere haz2Ura iha praNa karadA hAM ki je tenai mainUM bacA liA tAM maiM siddhA allAha de rasUla kola jAvAMgA ate uhanAM de hattha vica ApaNA hattha de devAMgA ate uha lAz2amana mere nAla miharabAnI te muhabbata vAlA varatAo karanage jadoM uha baca ke samuMdara toM bAhara AiA tAM akaramAM siddhA nabI (sa:) kola AiA ate ApaNI ghaTanA suNAI ate isalAma dharama nUM savIkAra karake ika pakkA saccA musalamAna baNa giA| (tafasIra ibane kasIra, sUrata banI-isarAIla 67/17)

translations.translation: kI tusIM isa galla toM beDara ho gae ho ki uha (rabba) tuhAnUM sukkI thAM (bhAva dharatI vica) dhasA deve jAM tuhADe ’te patharAo karana vAlI hanerI bheja deve, usa vele tusIM ApaNe laI koI vI kAraja sAdhaka nahIM pAuge|

kI tuhAnUM isa dI koI vI ciMtA nahIM ki uha (allAha) tuhAnUM phera samuMdara de safara ’te lai jAve ate tuhADe ’te tez2a havAvAM de jhakkhar3a bheja deve ate tuhADI nA-zukarI kArana tuhAnUM Doba deve| phera tusIM ajihA koI vI nA pAoge jihar3A sAthoM puccha-giccha kara sake|

nirasaMdeha, asIM hI Adama dI saMtAna nUM Adara-mAna baqhaziA ate ihanAM nUM jala-thala laI savArIAM baqhazIAM ate ihanAM nUM pAkIz2A cIz2AM viccoM roz2IAM baqhazIAM ate ihanAM nUM ApaNI asaMkha jIa-jaMtU ’te, jinhAM nUM asIM paidA kItA hai, vaDiAI baqhazI|

jisa dihAr3e asAM sAre lokAM nUM sane uhanAM de AgU bulAvAMga, usa dina jinhAM dI karama patarI sajje hatthAM vica phar3AI jAvegI uha tAM ApaNA ciTThA (qhuza hoke) par3haNage ate uhanAM nAla bhorAbhara vI vitakarA nahIM hovegA|
ate jihar3A koI saMsAra vica aMnhA baNa ke rihA uha Aqhirata vica vI aMnhA ate rAhoM bhaTakiA hoiA hovegA|

(he nabI!) iha (makke de kAfira) loka tuhAnUM usa vahI (rabbI sunehe) toM thir3akA deNA cAhuMde hana jihar3I tuhADe ’te utArI hai ate cAhuMde hana ki tusIM isa (vahI) toM chuTTa kujjha hora vI sADe nAM toM ghar3ha lavo (je tusIM unhAM dI galla maMna laiMde) tada iha lokI tuhAnUM ApaNA mittara baNA laiMde|
(he nabI!) je asIM tuhAnUM drir3atA nA baqhazI huMdI tAM tusIM uhanAM (kAfirAM) valla thor3hA bahuta ulAra ho hI jAMde|
(he nabI! je iMja huMdA) phera asIM tuhAnUM jIvana vica vI te marana toM bAada vI doharA az2Aba diMde| phera tuhAnUM sADe mukAbale koI vI sahAika nA miladA|

iha loka isa (makke) dI dharatI toM tuhADe paira (makke toM) ukhAr3a deNA cAhuMde hana tAM jo tusIM itthoM nikala jAo (je bhalA ajihA ho vI jAve) tAM tuhADe picchoM iha vI kujjha dera hI Tika sakaNage|
uhanAM rasUlAM de dasatUra vAMga, jihar3e (he nabI!) asIM tuhAthoM pahilAM bheje sana, (iha vI halAka ho jAMde) tusIM sADe dasatUra (nItI) vica koI badalAo nahIM vekhoge|
sUraja DhalaNa toM laike rAta de hanere taka namAz2a kAima karo ate fajara dI namAz2a vI (kAima karo)| bezakka fajara dI namAz2a vele farizatiAM dI hAz2arI dA samAM huMdA hai|[8]
translations.footnotes: [8] isa dA aratha hadIsa vica biAna kItA giA hai ki usa sameM rAta te dina de farizate hAz2ara huMde hana ate ikaTThe huMde hana| so allAha de rasUla dA faramAna hai ki jamAata nAla namAz2a par3haNa dA savAba ikalle viakatI dI namAz2a toM paccI guNA vaddha hai rAta te dina de farizate fajara vele ikaTThe huMde hana| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 648)

translations.translation: (he nabI!) rAta de kujjha hisse vica vI tusIM isa.kuraAna nUM tahajjada dI namAz2a vica par3ho| iha (tahajjada) vizezakara tuhADe laI hai| Asa hai ki tuhADA rabba tuhAnUM mukAme mahimUda [9] ’te liA khar3A karegA|
translations.footnotes: [9] makAme-mahamUda kiAmata dihAr3e nabI (sa:) nUM baqhaziA jAvegA jisa ’te barAjamAna ho ke Apa (sa:) zafAata (sifAraza) karanage jiveM ki hadIsa vica hai| ibane-umara dA kahiNA hai ki kiAmata vAle dina lokI ApaNe goDiAM de bhAra pae hoNage ate hareka ummata ApaNe nabI de picche turI AogI ate lokI AkhaNage he phalAne! allAha toM sADI zifAata (sifAraza) kara dio| itthoM taka ki sifAraza karana dA adhikAra nabI (sa:) nUM de dittA jAvegA ate uha uhIo dihAr3A hovegA jadoM allAha nabI (sa:) nUM makAme-mahamUda ’te barAjamAna karegA| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 4718) ● dUjI hadIsa vica nabI (sa:) ne faramAiA jihar3A viakatI az2Ana suNana toM bAada duA par3hugA usa nUM kiAmata vAle dina mere sifAraza nasIba hovegI duA hai: “he allAha! isa pUrana dAavata ate isa namAz2a de mAlika jihar3e huNe kAima hoNa vAlI hai muhaMmada (sa:) nUM vasIlA ate faz2Ilata baqhaza de ate ihanAM nUM mukAme mahamUda ’te barAjamAna kara jisa dA tUM ihanAM nAla vAadA kItA hoiA hai|” (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 4719) ● savaraga vica vasIlA nAM dI sabha toM uccI thAM hai jihar3I nabI (sa:) nUM vizeza kara baqhazI jAvegI| alafaz2Ilata AdaramAna dA ika vizeza darajA hai jihar3A nabI (sa:) nUM sArI maqhalUka laI baqhaziA jAvegA|

translations.translation: (he nabI!) Akho ki he mere rabbA! mainUM jitthe vI tUM lai jAveM, saccAI de nAla hI lai ke jAIM ate jitthioM vI kaDDhIM, sacAI nAla hI kaDDhIM ate ApaNe valloM rAja sattA nUM merA sahAika baNA|
(he nabI!) ailAna kara dio ki sacca (bhAva isalAma) A giA te jhUTha (bhAva kufara) dA aMta ho giA, jhUTha tAM qhatama hoNa laI hI hai|
ate asIM jihar3A.kuraAna nAz2ila kara rahe hAM, isa vica ImAna vAliAM laI tAM zifA (rogAM dA ilAja) ate rahimata hai, para uha z2AlamAM de ghATe vica hI vAdhA karadA hai|
jadoM asIM manukkha nUM niamatAM nAla nivAz2ade hAM tAM uha mUMha mor3a laiMdA hai te piTTha phera laiMdA hai, jadoM usa nUM koI bhIr3a paiMdI hai tAM (rabba dIAM miharAM toM) nirAza ho jAMdA hai|
(he nabI!) tusIM Akha dio ki hara viakatI ApaNe tarIke anusAra hI kaMma karadA hai| huNa iha galla ki kauNa siddhe rAha ’te hai tuhADA rabba hI jANadA hai|
(he nabI!) iha loka tuhAthoM rUha (AtamA) bAre pucchade hana| tusIM kahi dio ki iha rUha mere rabba de hukama hai ate tuhAnUM tAM bahuta hI thor3hA giAna dittA giA hai|
(he nabI!) je asIM cAhIe tAM jihar3I vahI (rabbI saMdeza) tuhADe valla ghallI gaI hai uha tuhAthoM khoha laIe phera tusIM sADe mukAbale vica kise toM vI sahAitA nahIM labha sakoge|
chuTTa tuhADe rabba dIAM miharAM toM (koI sahAI nahIM) nirasaMdeha, tuhADe ’te usa dA bahuta hI vaDDA faz2ala hai|
(he nabI!) Akha dio jekara sAre hI manukkha te jiMna rala ke vI isa.kuraAna jihI koI cIz2a liAuNA cAhaNa tAM nahIM liA sakade bhAveM uha ika dUje de sahAika hI kiuM nA baNa jANa|
asIM izakuraAna vica (lokAM nUM samajhAuNa laI) hara misAla nUM vAra vAra biAna kItA hai| phera vI vadhere loka nA zukarI kare binAM nahIM rahi sakade|
uhanAM (kAfirAM) ne kihA ki asIM tere utte (he muhaMmada sa:!) udoM tIka ImAna nahIM liAvAMge jadoM tIka ki tUM sADe laI dharatI viccoM koI somA nA vagA deveM|
jAM tere ApaNe laI khajUrA jAM aMgUra dA bAg2a hove phera tUM usa vicAle (jaghA jaghA) nahirAM vagA deveM|
jAM tUM sADe ’te akAza nUM ToTe-ToTe kara ke (az2Aba vajoM) Dega deveM, jiveM ki tUM kihA karadA hai| jAM tUM (ApaNI puzaTI laI) allAha ate farizatiAM nUM sADe sAhamaNe lai A|

jAM tere rahiNa laI sone dA koI ghara hove jAM tUM akAza ’te car3ha jAveM ate asIM tere asamAna ’te car3haNa dA udoM tIka vizavAsa nahIM karAMge jadoM tIka tUM uthioM sADe laI koI kitAba nA utAra liAvoM jisa nUM asIM par3ha vekhIe| (he nabI!) tusIM Akho ki merA pAlaNahAra pAka hai, maiM tAM kevala ika manukkha hAM jisa nUM paig2aMbara baNAiA giA hai|
lokAM kola hidAita AuNa toM bAada vI uhanAM nUM ImAna liAuNa toM kevala ise cIz2a ne roka rakkhiA sI ki uha kahiMde sana, kI allAha ne manukkha nUM rasUla baNAiA hai?
(he nabI!) tusIM kahi dio ki je dharatI ’te farizate nizaciMta ho ke turade-phirade huMde tAM vI asIM akAzoM uhanAM laI kise farizate nUM hI rasUla baNA ke bhejade|

(he nabI!) Akha dio ki mere ate tuhADe vicakAra allAha dI gavAhI batherI hai (ki maiMne tuhAnUM rabbI paig2Ama ghalla dittA hai) uha (allAha) ApaNe baMdiAM toM bhalI-bhAMta jANU hai ate sabha kujjha vekhaNa vAlA hai|

allAha jisa nUM rAha pAve uhIo siddhI rAha prApata karadA hai ate jisa nUM uhIo kurAhe pA deve tAM chuTTa usa (allAha) dI sahAitA toM usa nUM koI hora sahAika nahIM mila sakadA| ajihe (kurAhe pae) lokAM nUM asIM kiAmata dihAr3e mUdhe mUMha [10] ghasITa liAvAMge, ate aMnhe-guMge te bole karake kabarAM ’coM uThAvAMge| uhanAM dA TikANA naraka hovegA| jadoM uha (agga) ThaMDI hoNa laggegI asIM usa (agga) nUM hora sulhagA devAMge|
translations.footnotes: [10] haz2arata anasa dA kahiNA hai ki ika viakatI ne pucchiA ki he allAha de nabI sa:! kI kiAmata vAle dina kAfira nUM usa de mUMha de bala bhAva ulaTA karake calAiA jAvegA? nabI (sa:) ne faramAiA, jisa hasatI ne saMsAra vica isa nUM do pairAM nAla toriA hai kI uha kiAmata vAle dina usa nUM mUMha de bala torana dI kudarata nahIM rakkhadA? katAdAha ra:a: ne faramAiA “sADe rabba dI iz2z2ata te jalAla dI suMha kiuM nahIM? (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 4760)

translations.translation: iha uhanAM dI saz2A hai, kiuM jo uhanAM ne sADIAM AitAM dA inakAra kItA ate kihA ki jadoM asIM haDDIAM ate cUrA-cUrA ho jAvAMge tAM kI asIM naveM sirioM uThAe jAvAMge?

kI uhanAM ne isa galla valla jhAta nahIM mArI ki jisa allAha ne akAza te dharatI nUM paidA kItA hai uha uhanAM jiihaAM nUM paidA karana dI pUrI samarathA rakkhadA hai? allAha ne hI uhanAM laI ika ajihA samAM niyata kItA hai jisa vica kise prakAra dA koI zakka nahIM, para z2Alama loka inakAra kare binAM rahi hI nahIM sakade|

(he nabI!) Akha dio ki je kIte mere rabba dIAM miharAM de bhaMDAra tuhADe kabaz2e vica huMde tAM tusIM vI usa nUM qharaca ho jANa de Dara toM rokI rakkhade| vAsatava vica manukkha bahuta hI taMga dilA hai|

asIM mUsA nUM nau sapazaTa moajaz2e (rabbI camatakAra) baqhaze, tusIM Apa vI (he nabI!) banI-isarAIla toM puccha lavo ki jadoM uha (mUsA) uhanAM kola AiA tAM firaauna ne usa nUM kihA ki he mUsA! maiM samajhadA hAM ki tUM z2arUra ika jAdU dA mAriA AdamI hai|

(mUsA) ne kihA ki tUM bhalIbhAMta jANa cukiA hai ki iha sArIAM nizAnIAM akAzAM te dharatI de rabba ne hI vekhaNa te samajhaNa de maMtava laI nAz2ila kItIAM hana ate he firaauna! maiM tainUM ika zAmata dA mAriA viakatI samajhadA hAM|
aMta firaauna ne pakkA vicAra baNA liA ki uhanAM (mUsA te banI-isarAIla) nUM dharatIoM ukhAr3a suTTe| asIM usa (firaauna) nUM ate usa de sAthIAM nUM (samaMdara vica) Doba dittA|
(isa toM magaroM) asIM banI-isarAIla nUM kihA ki isa dharatI ’te raso-vaso, hAM! jadoM Aqhirata de vAade dA samAM AvegA tAM asIM tuhAnUM sabha nUM ikaTThA karake liAvAMge|

asIM isa (kuraAna) nUM hakka sacca nAla utAriA hai ate hakka sacca nAla hI AiA hai| (he nabI!) asIM tuhAnUM (jaMnata dIAM) qhuzaqhabarIAM suNAuNa vAlA ate (rabba de az2Aba toM) DarAuNa vAlA (rasUla) baNA ke bhejiA hai|[11]
translations.footnotes: [11] vekho sUrata Ale-imarAna, hAzIA Aita 85/3 ate sUrata ana-nisA, hAzIA Aita 80/4

translations.translation: asIM.kuraAna nUM thor3hA-thor3hA karake isa laI nAz2ila kItA hai tAM jo tusIM isa nUM Thahira-Thahika ke (lor3a anusAra) lokAM nUM suNA sakoM ate asAM isa nUM lar3IvAra utAriA hai|

Akha dio ki tusIM isa ’te ImAna liAo jAM nA liAo, para jinhAM nUM isa toM pahilAM (rabbI kitAbAM dA) giAna dittA giA sI, uhanAM kola jadoM vI isa nUM par3hiA jAMdA hai tAM uha mUMha de bhAra sijade vica Diga paiMde hana|
ate Akhade hana ki sADA pAlaNahAra (hara aiba toM) pAka hai ate sADe rabba dA vAadA nirasaMdeha, pUrA hoke rahegA|
uha vilakade hoe mUMha de bhAra sijade vica Diga paiMde hana ate iha (.kuraAna) uhanAM dI nimaratA te Dara vica hora vI vAdhA karadA hai|

(he nabI!) Akha dio ki tusIM allAha nUM allAha kahi ke saddo jAM rahimAna Akho, tusIM jisa nAM nAla vI usa nUM saddo sAre hI sohaNe nAM use laI hana| ApaNI namAz2a nA tAM bahutIM uccI AvAz2a nAla par3ho te nA hI bahutI haulI AvAz2a nAla par3ho sagoM dohAM de vicakAralI rAha apaNAo|

ate iha vI Akho! ki sArIAM tArIfAM te zukarAne usa allAha laI hana jisa ne (ApaNe laI) koI aulAda nahIM baNAI ate nA hI rAja sattA vica usa dA koI sAMjhI hai| nA hI uha nirabala te bevasa hai ki usa nUM kise sahAika dI lor3a hai| tusIM use allAha dI vaDiAI, uha vI ucca koTI dI vaDiAI, biAna karo|
hara prakAra dIAM tArIfAM (te zukarAne) usa allAha nUM hI zobhA diMde hana jisa ne ApaNe baMde (muhaMmada sa:) ’te kitAba (.kuraAna) utArI ate jisa vica koI vI viMga-valla nahIM

sagoM ThIka te siddhIAM gallAM AkhaNa vAlI kitAba utArI tAM jo uha (lokAM nUM) usa (allAha) valloM karar3e az2Aba toM qhabaradAra kare ate neka kaMma karana vAle ImAna vAliAM nUM (jaMnata dIAM) qhuzaqhabarIAM suNAve ki bezaka uhanAM laI bahuta hI caMgA badalA hai|
jisa (savaraga vica) uha sadA rahiNage|
ate uhanAM lokAM nUM vI DarAe jihar3e Akhade hana ki allAha aulAda rakkhadA hai|

(asala vica) nA tAM ihanAM nUM isa dA koI giAna hai ate nA hI uhanAM de pio dAdiAM nUM sI| bahuta hI bhair3I galla hai jihar3I uhanAM de mUMhoM nikala rahI hai| uha tAM nirA hI jhUTha baka rahe hana (ki allAha de aulAda hai)|
(he nabI!) je iha kAfira isa.kuraAna ’te ImAna nahIM liAMde tAM ho sakadA hai ki tusIM ihanAM dI ciMtA vica ApaNI jAna nUM hI halAka kara baiTho|
isa dharatI te jo kujjha vI hai usa nUM asIM dharatI dI sajAvaTa baNAiA hai tAM jo asIM ihanAM lokAM nUM parakhIe ki ihanAM viccoM kauNa neka amala karana vAlA hai|
(ika samAM uha vI AvegA) ki isa (dharatI) ’te jo kujjha vI hai asIM usa nUM ika rar3A maidAna baNA deNa vAle hAM|
(he loko!) kI tusIM g2Ara (guphA) vAle te katabe (zilAlekha) vAliAM nUM sADIAM nizAnIAM viccoM koI ajIba (aNahoNI) nizAnI samajhade ho?

jadoM uhanAM naujavAnAM ne (ApaNe ImAna nUM kAfira bAdazAha toM mahafUz2a rakkhaNa laI) guphA vica jA ke zarana laI tAM uhanAM ne duA kItI sI ki he sADe mAlika! ApaNe valloM sAnUM miharAM nAla nivAz2a de ate sADe mAamale vica sADI agavAI kara|
phera asIM use guphA vica kaI sAlAM laI uhanAM de kaMnAM ’te par3adA pA chaDDiA (ki uha kujjha nA suNa sakaNa te sutte rahiNa)|
phera asIM uhanAM (naujavAnAM) nUM (nIMda toM) uThAiA tAM jo asIM iha patA karIe ki doveM dhirAM ’coM kisa ne ApaNI Thahirana dI muddata nUM yAda rakkhiA hai|
(he nabI!) asIM uhanAM (guphA vAliAM) dA asala kissA tuhAnUM suNAuMde hAM| uha kujjha naujavAna sana jihar3e ApaNe rabba ’te ImAna liAe sI ate asIM uhanAM nUM hidAita vica unnatI baqhaza sI|

asIM uhanAM de dilAM nUM drir3atA baqhazI jadoM uha (bAdazAha de darabAra viccoM) iha kahiMde hoe uTTha khar3e hoe ki sADA mAlika tAM uhIo hai jihar3A akAza te dharatI dA mAlika hai, iha nahIM ho sakadA ki asIM usa nUM chaDDa ke kise hora nUM izaTa kahie? jekara asIM ajihA kujjha kihA tAM asIM bahuta hI z2ulama te vadhIkI vAlI galla kahI|

iha hai sADI kauma jisa ne usa (allAha)nUM chuDDa ke hora izaTa baNA rakkhe hana| ihanAM de izaTa hoNa dI iha loka koI khullhI dalIla kiuM nahIM liAuMde? allAha ’te jhUTha jor3aNa vAliAM toM vaddha z2Alama hora kauNa hovegA|

(uhanAM naujavAnAM viccoM hI ika ne kihA ki) jadoM tusIM uhanAM toM ate allAha toM chuTa unhAM de dUje izaTAM toM lAMbhe ho cukke ho tAM kise guphA vica jA baiTho, tuhADA rabba tuhADe ’te ApaNIAM miharAM dI chAM kara devegA ate tuhADe kaMmAM vica AsAnIAM paidA kara deve gA|

tusIM vekhade ki jadoM sUraja car3hadA tAM uhanAM dI guphA de sajje pAse jhuka jAMdA ate DubaNa de sameM uhanAM de khabbe pAsioM baca ke nikala jAMdA ate uha (naujavAna) usa guphA dI khullhI thAM te sutte pae hana| iha allAha dIAM nizAnIAM viccoM ika nizAnI hai| allAha jisa nUM rAha vikhAve uhIo siddhI rAha paiMdA hai| jisa nUM uha kurAhe pA deve usa laI tusIM koI himAitI te rAha dassaNa vAlA nahIM labbha sakade|

tusIM samajhade ho ki uha jAga rahe hana jada ki uha tAM sutte pae hana| asIM (allAha) Apa hI uhanAM nUM sajje khabbe pAse duAuMde hAM ate uhanAM dA kuttA vI (guphA dI) cauMkhaTa ’te ApaNe paira phailAIM baiThA hoiA hai| jekara tusIM jhAtI mAra ke uhanAM nUM vekha laiMde tAM (Darade hoe) pichale pairIM nassa jAMde ate uhanAM nUM vekha ke dahizata baiTha jAMdI|

ise hAlata vica asIM uhanAM nUM nIMda toM uThAiA tAM jo uha Apasa vica puccha-giccha karana| uhanAM viccoM ika ne kihA ki tusIM kiMnI dera isa hAlata vica sutte rahe? uhanAM ne uttara dittA ki asIM ika dina jAM ika dina toM vI ghaTTa isa hAlata vica rahe hovAMge| phera AkhaNa lagge ki tusIM jinnI dera iMja rahe isa dA asala giAna tAM tuhADe allAha nUM hI hai| so huNa tusIM ApaNe viccoM ika viakatI nUM iha cAMdI (dA sikkA) de ke basatI vica bhejo| uha caMgI tarhAM dekha-bhAla kara lave ki zahira vica kihar3A bhojana vadhere pAkIz2A hai, use viccoM tuhADe laI vI bhojana liAve| usa nUM cAhIdA hai ki (suceta ho ke) naramAI nAla galla kare, tuhADe bAre ukkA hI kise nUM patA nA lagge|

je kite uhanAM (basatI vAliAM) nUM tuhADI qhabara ho gaI tAM uha patthara mAra-mAra ke tuhAnUM mAra deNage jAM tuhAnUM mur3a ApaNe dharama vica lai AuNage, phera tusIM kade vI safalatA prApata nahIM kara sakoMge|

ise prakAra asIM uhanAM lokAM de hAloM Ama lokAM nUM jANU karavAiA hai tAM jo uha samajha jANa laiNa ki allAha dA vAadA (ApaNe neka baMdiAM dI) madada karana dA saccA hai ate kiAmata de AuNa vica vI koI zakka nahIM| jadoM uha (basatI vAle) ihanAM de mAmale vica Apo vica jhagar3a rahe sana tAM uha AkhaNa lagge ki (uhanAM dI guphA ’te) ika bhavana baNA dio, uhanAM de bAre tAM uhanAM dA rabba hI jANadA hai| jihar3e loka mAmale dI agavAI kara rahe sana, uha AkhaNa lagge ki asIM ihanAM ’te ika pUjA-sathAna baNAvAMge|

kujjha loka tAM AkhaNage ki uha (guphA vAle) tiMna sana ate cauthA uhanAM dA kuttA sI, kujjha AkhaNage ki uha paMja sana te chevAM uhanAM dA kuttA sI| (iha sabha) hanere vica tIra calAuNA hai| kujjha loka (iha vI) AkhaNage ki uha sata sana ate aThavAM uhanAM dA kuttA sI| (he nabI!) tusIM Akha dio ki merA mAlika hI (uhanAM dI ThIka giNatI) nUM jANadA hai jada ki ThIka giNatI tAM bahuta hI ghaTTa loka jANade hana| so tusIM isa saMbaMdha vica sarasarI galla karo ate koI vAda-vivAda vAlI galla nA karo ate nA tusIM uhanAM de bAre kise toM kujjha puccho|
kise vI kaMma bAre kade vI iha nA kaho ki maiM iha kaMma bhalake karAMgA|

(sagoM AkhiA karo) hAM, je allAha cAhe (phera hI kara sakade ho) je tusIM (inazA allAha kahiNA) bhula jAvo tAM jhaTTa ApaNe rabba nUM yAda karo ate Akho ki Asa hai ki merA rabba isa mAmale vica hidAita te bhalAI vala merI agavAI karegA|
uha loka guphA vica tiMna sau sAla toM nau sAla vaddha (bhAva 309 sAla) rahe|

(he nabI!) tusIM Akha dio ki uhanAM de rahiNa dA ThIka samAM tAM allAha hI jANadA hai| akAzAM te dharatI dA gupata giAna kevala use nUM hI hai| uha kiMnA vadhIA vekhaNa te suNana vAlA hai| allAha toM chuTTa uhanAM dA koI sahAI nahIM ate allAha ApaNI sattA vica kise nUM bhAIvAla nahIM baNAuMdA|

(he nabI!) tuhADe valla tuhADe rabba valloM jihar3I kitAba vahI kItI gaI hai tusIM usa nUM par3hade rihA karo| isa (.kuraAna) dIAM gallAM nUM koI badalaNa vAlA nahIM ate nA hI tuhAnUM usa (allAha) toM chuTTa koI zarana sathAna mila sakadA hai|

(he nabI!) tusIM ApaNe Apa nUM uhanAM lokAM dI saMgata vica rakkho jihar3e savere-zAma ApaNe pAlaNahAra nUM pukArade hana ate usa de cihare dA dIdAra (bhAva usa dI raz2A) cAhuMde hana so tuhADIAM naz2arAM uhanAM toM parAM nahIM haTaNIAM cAhIdIAM ki uha vI saMsArika jIvana dI ThATha-bATha dIAM ichukka baNa jANa| usa de picche kade vI nA laggo jisa de mana nUM asIM ApaNI yAda toM bhulA rakhiA hai ate uha ApaNIAM icchAvAM de picche tura piA, phera usa dA mAmalA haddoM TappiA hoiA hai|

uhanAM nUM Akha dio ki hakka tuhADe rabba valloM A giA hai| huNa jihar3A cAhe ImAna lai Ae ate jihar3A cAhe kufara (inakAra) kare| bezakka z2AlamAM (inakArIAM) laI asIM ika ajihI agga tiAra kara rakkhI hai, jisa dIAM lATAM ne uhanAM nUM ghere vica lai laiNA hai, (je uha pANI laI) benatI karanage tAM ajihe pANI nAla suNI jAvegI jihar3A paMghare hoe tela dI gAda varagA hovegA, uha uhanAM de cihariAM nUM bhuNa devegA| kiMnI bhair3I pINa vAlI cIz2a hai ate kiMnA bhair3A vizarAma ghara (naraka) hai|
para jihar3e ImAna liAuNa te phera neka karama karana tAM asIM kise vI neka karama karana vAle dA badalA ajAIM nahIM guAuMde (bhAva hakka nahIM mArade)|

uhanAM lokAM laI sadIvI bAg2a (jaMnatAM) hana jinhAM de heTha nahirAM vagadIAM hoNagIAM, utthe uhanAM nUM sone de kar3e puvAe jANAMge ate hare raMga de barIka te moTe rezamI libAsa pahiNanage| utthe uha takkhatAM utte gAve lAIM baiThe hoNage| kiMnA vadhIA badalA hai ate kiMnA vadhIA vizarAma ghara (jaMnata) hai|

(he nabI!) ihanAM lokAM nUM uhanAM do viakatIAM dI udAharana vI suNA dio, unhAM jinhAM viccoM ika nUM asAM aMgUrAM de do bAg2a ditte sI ate uhanAM duAle khajUrAM de rukkhAM dI vAr3a lAI sI ate uhanAM (doveM bAg2AM) de vicAle khetI ugA chaDDI sI|
doveM bAg2AM ne phala deNa vica kise tarhAM dI koI kasara nahIM chaDDI sI ate uhanAM dovAM bAg2AM de vicakAra asIM ika nahira vagA dittI sI|
jadoM usa nUM phalAM (dI upaja pUrI) mila gaI tAM uha ApaNe mittara nUM gallAM karade hoe AkhaNa laggA ki maiM taithoM vadhere mAladAra hAM ate jatthe pakkhoM vI tethoM vaddha Adara-mAna vAlA hAM|
ate (iho Akhade hoe) jadoM uha ApaNe bAg2a vica dAqhala hoiA jada ki uha ApaNI AtamA nAla z2ulama kara rihA sI| usa ne AkhiA ki maiM nahIM samajhadA ki iha bAg2a kade nazaTa hovegA|
ate AkhiA ki nA hI maiM samajhadA hAM ki kiAmata kAima hovegI| je bhalAM mainUM ApaNe rabba valla paratAiA vI giA tAM z2arUra maiM ihanAM bAg2AM toM vI vadhIA thAM prApata karAMgA|

usa de momina sAthI ne usa nUM gallAM gallAM vica pucchiA, kI tUM usa (rabba) dA inakAra karadA hai jisa ne tainUM miTTI toM paidA kItA, te phera vIraja toM sAjiA te phera ika pUrA AdamI baNA khar3hA kItA?
jadoM ki merA tAM iha vizavAsa hai ki uhIo allAha merA rabba hai te maiM ApaNe rabba (pAlaNahAra) de nAla kise nUM vI zarIka (sAMjhI) nahIM baNAuMdA|

(ate kihA) jadoM tUM ApaNe bAg2a vica dAqhala ho rihA sI tAM “mAzA allAha lA kuvattA ilAੱ bilAhha” [1] (bhAva jo allAha cAhuMdA hai uhIo huMdA hai, allAha toM chuTTa hora koI vI zakatI nahIM) kiuM nA kihA| je ajja tUM mainUM mAla te saMtAna pakkhoM ghaTTa vekha rihA hai|
translations.footnotes: [1] “mAzA allAha lA kuva-vatA illA billAha” khairo barakata ate burI naz2ara toM bacAuNa vAlI duA hai isa de nAla hI “lA haulA valA kuvattA illA bilAha” bhAva allAha toM chuTTa koI vI gunAhAM toM parAM rakkhaNa ate nA hI usa toM chuTTa koI nekI karana dI himmata diMdAM hai| iha vadhIA bola hana ihanAM dI mahattatA hadIsa vica biAna kItI gaI hai| jiveM haz2arata abU-mUsA azaarI ra:a: dassade hana ki allAha de rasUla (sa:) ika hI pahAr3I ’te car3aNa lagge tAM ika viakatI usa dI coTI ’te pahuMca giA ate AkhaNa laggA ki ‘lA ilAhA illalAha vallA ho akabara’| usa vele nabI (sa:) ApaNe khaccara ’te savAra sI, Apa (sa:) ne faramAiA ki tUM kise bole nUM nahIM pukAra rihA| phera faramAiA “he mUsA! jAM he abadullA! kI maiM tuhAnUM jaMnata de khaz2AniAM viccoM ika bola nA dassAM? maiMne araz2a kItI kiuM nahIM z2arUra dasso, Apa (sa:) ne faramAiA lA haulA valAM kuva-vatA illA billAha”| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 6409)

translations.translation: ho sakadA hai ki merA rabba mainUM tere isa bAg2a toM vI vadhIA (bAg2a) de deve ate jAM tere isa bAg2a ’te koI akAzoM az2Aba bheje ki uha (terA bAg2a) ika rar3A maidAna baNa ke rahi jAve|
jAM isa dA pANI DuMgiAI (bhAva dharatI) vica uttara jAve phera iha galla tere vassa dI nahIM ki tUM (pANI nUM) labbha sake (bhAva kaDDha liAveM)|

so usa (nA-zukare) de phalAM nUM (az2Aba ne) ghera liA (bhAva nazaTa ho gae) uha ApaNI lagAI hoI lAgata nUM barabAda huMdA vekha hattha maladA rahi giA, jada ki uha ApaNe (bAg2a) chapparAM ’te puTThA DiggiA piA sI ate uha Akha rihA sI ki kAza! maiM ApaNe rabba de nAla kise nUM zarIka nA karadA|
usa dI sahAitA laI koI ajihA jatthA nahIM sI jihar3A allAha (de az2Aba) toM usa dA bacAo karadA ate nA hI uha Apa isa (bipatA) dA sAthoM badalA lai sakadA sI|
(isa toM siddha huMdA hai ki) kaMma baNAuNa dA sArA adhikAra allAha sacce dA hI hai| uhIo loka-praloka vica vadhIA badalA deNa vAlA hai|

(he nabI!) ihanAM nUM saMsArika jIvana dI udahArana dio ki jiveM mIMha dA pANI hai, jisa nUM asAM akAzoM barasAiA, jisa toM dharatI dI upaja bahuta vadhIA hoI, phera uhIo upaja cUrA-cUrA (bhAva bhusA) baNA ke rahi gaI jisa nUM havAvAM uDAIM phiradIAM hana| bezakka allAha hareka kaMma karana dI kudarata rakkhadA hai|

iha mAla (dhana padAratha) te aulAda tAM saMsarika jIvana dIAM sajAvaTAM hana, jada ki tuhADe rabba dIAM naz2arAM vica bAkI rahiNa vAlIAM nekIAM hI siTTe pakkhoM bihatara hana ate caMgIAM AsAM takkaNa laI vI iho vadhIA hana|

jisa dina asIM pahAr3AM nUM torAMge ate tusIM dharatI nUM ukkA hI rar3A maidAna vekhoMge ate asIM sAre hI lokAM nUM ikaTThA karAMge ki uhanAM viccoM koI vI (binA puccha giccha toM chaDDiA nahIM jAvegA|

ate uha sAre katArAM baMnI tuhADe rabba de haz2Ura peza kIte jANage| (kihA jAvegA ki) tusIM sAre loka sADe kola use prakAra Ae ho jiveM asIM tuhAnUM pahilI vAra paidA kItA sI para tusIM tAM iho samajhade rahe ki asIM tuhADe laI vAade (bhAva kiamAta) dA koI vI samAM nizacita nahIM sI kItA|

(kiAmata diAr3e) hareka dI karama-patarI usa de sAhamaNe dhara dittI jAvegI| (he muhaMmada!) phera tusIM vekhoge ki aparAdhI usa dI likhata nUM par3ha ke Dare sahime pae hoNage ate AkhaNage ki hAe sADe phuTTe bhAga! iha kiho jahI karama-patarI hai jisa ne koI vI choTA vaDDA amala binAM likhe nahIM chaDDiA ate isane tAM sabha kujjha hI giNa rakkhiA hai| jo vI uhanAM ne karama (karatUtAM) kIte sana unhAM sabha nUM (usa kitAba vica) maujUda pAuNage ate tuhADA rabba kise nAla bhorA bhara vI z2ulama nahIM karegA|

(yAda karo) jadoM asIM farizatiAM nUM hukama dittA ki Adama de agge sIsa jhukAo tAM chuTTa ibalIsa toM sabha ne sIsa jhukA ditte| uha (ibalIsa) jiMnAM viccoM sI| so usa ne ApaNe rabba dI nA-faramAnI kItI| (he loko!) kI tusIM phera vI mainUM chaDDa ke usa nUM ate usadI aulAda nUM ApaNA mittara baNA rahe ho, jadoM ki uha tuhADA vairI hai| z2AlamAM dA bahuta hI bhair3A TikANA (naraka) hai|

maiM uhanAM (ibalIsa te usa dI aulAda) nUM akAzAM te dharatI nUM sirajaNa sameM gavAha nahIM baNAiA sI ate nA hI usa sameM, jadoM uhanAM nUM paidA kItA giA sI| maiM kurAhe pAuNa vAliAM nUM ApaNA sahAI baNAuNa vAlA vI nahIM|

(usa dina toM Daro) jisa dina uha (allAha) AkhegA ki tusIM jinhAM nUM merA zarIka samajhade sI uhanAM nUM (ApaNI madada laI) balAo| iha uhanAM nUM bulAuNage para uha koI vI javAba nahIM deNage ate asIM uhanAM (z2AlamAM) vicAle barabAdI dI ika khAI baNA devAMge|
ate pApI (naraka dI) agga nUM vekha ke samajha laiNage ki uha ise (khAI) vica suTTe jANage ate usa toM bacaNa laI uhanAM nUM koI hora thAM nahIM labbhegI|
asIM isa.kuraAna vicoM hara hara prakAra dIAM udAharaNAM lokAM (nUM samajhAuNa) laI biAna kara dittIAM hana para manukkha sabha toM vaddha jhagar3AlU hai|

lokAM de kola hidAita A jANa toM bAada vI uhanAM nUM ImAna liAuNa toM te ApaNe rabba toM muAfI maMgaNa toM kevala isa galla ne roka rakkhiA hai ki uha cAhuMde hana ki pahilIAM kaumAM nAla jihar3A kujha bIta cukkiA hai (bhAva az2Aba) uha kujjha ihanAM nAla vI vApare jAM ihanAM de sAhamaNe vI uhIo az2Aba Ave|

asIM rasUlAM nUM kevala isa laI bhejade hAM ki uha (lokAM nUM savaragAM dIAM) qhuzaqhabarIAM suNAuNa ate (naraka de az2Aba toM) DarAuNa, para kAfira loka jhUTha de hathiAra nAla jhagar3ade hana tAM jo isa de nAla sacca nUM saTTa mArI jAve, uhanAM ne sADIAM AitAM (AdezAM) nUM ate jisa cIz2a (az2Aba) toM DarAiA jAMdA hai, uhanAM ne use dA hI makhaula baNA liA|

usa toM vaddha z2Alama kauNa hai jisa nUM usa de rabba dIAM aitAM (.kuraAna) rAhIM nasIhata kItI jAve, uha phera vI mUMha mor3a lave ate jo vI usa de hatthAM ne agge bhejiA hai uha usa nUM bhula jAve| bezakka asIM uhanAM de dilAM ’te par3adA pA chaDiA hai ki usa (.kuraAna) nUM nA-samajhaNa ate uhanAM de kaMnAM vica DATa pA ditte hana (ki uha suNa nA sakaNa)| (he muhaMmada sa:!) bhAveM tusIM uhanAM nUM kiMnA hI hidAita valla saddo para uha iha phera vI hidAita nahIM pAuNage

tuhADA rabba atiaMta baqhazaNahAra te rahimatAM vAlA hai| je uha uhanAM (pApIAM) dIAM karatUtAM utte phar3aNA cAhe tAM uhanAM nUM tAM bahuta hI chetI az2Aba A jAve| para uhanAM nAla (kiAmata de) vAade dA samAM niyata kItA hoiA hai| uha isa (dihAr3e) toM bacaNa laI koI vI zarana asathAna nahIM pAuNage|
iha hana uha basatIAM jinhAM nUM asIM udoM halAka kItA sI jadoM uhanAM ne attiAcAra kIte sI, asAM uhanAM dI barabAdI laI ika samAM niyata kara rakkhiA sI|

(he nabI! yAda karo) jadoM mUsA ne ApaNe sAthI (yuzUa bina nUna) nUM AkhiA sI ki maiM tAM udoM taka turadA hI ravAgAM jadoM tIka ki do dariAvAM de saMgama [2] ’te nA pahuMca jAvAM, bhAveM mainUM sAlAM sAla hI kiuM nA turanA pave|
translations.footnotes: [2] isa saMbaMdha vica dassiA giA sI ki ise thAM haz2arata mUsA ate haz2arata khiz2ara (a:) dI milaNI hoI sI| visathAra nAla vekhaNa laI vekho sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 4725

translations.translation: jadoM uha doveM dariAvAM de saMgama ’te pahuMce utthe uha ApaNI macchI bhula gae ate uha (macchI) dariA vica dI ika suraMga vAMga rAha baNA ke calI gaI|
jadoM uha doveM uthioM agge ture tAM mUsA ne ApaNe sAthI nUM AkhiA ki liA sADA nAzatA! asIM tAM isa safara toM burI tarhAM thakka gae hAM|

usa (sAthI) ne AkhiA, kI tusIM vekhiA sI jadoM asIM ika caTTAna lAge ruke sAM, tAM maiM utthe hI macchI nUM bhulla AiA te zaitAna ne mainUM bhulA dittA ki mainUM tuhAnUM isa dI qhabara diMdA, uha (macchI) tAM bar3e hI ajIba DhaMga nAla dariA vica rasatA baNA ke calI gaI|
mUsA ne AkhiA, iho thAM tAM asIM cAhuMde sI| phera uha ApaNe pairAM de nizAna vekhade hoe (use thAM) mur3a Ae|
utthe uhanAM ne sADe baMdiAM viccoM ika baMdA (qhiz2ara nUM) vekhiA, jisa nUM asIM ApaNe valoM miharAM nAla nivAz2iA sI ate usa nUM ApaNe valloM ika vizeza giAna vI baqhaziA|
mUsA ne usa (qhiz2ara) nUM pucchiA, kI maiM tuhADe saMga rahi sakadA hAM ki tusIM mainUM vI usa giAna viccoM sikhAo jihar3I bhalAI (hikamata) tuhAnUM sikhAI gaI hai?
usa (qhiz2ara) ne AkhiA ki tusIM mere saMga (rahi ke) sabara nahIM kara sakade|
ate jisa cIz2a dA tuhAnUM giAna hI nA hove usa ’te sabara ho vI kiveM sakadA hai?
mUsA ne kihA ki “iMzA allAha” (rabba ne cAhiA), tusIM mainUM sabara karana vAliAM viccoM pAoge ate maiM kise vI galla vica tuhADI nA-faramAnI nahIM karAMge|

usa (qhiz2ara) ne kihA ki caMgA je tusIM mere nAla callaNa laI z2idda karade ho tAM yAda rakkho ki kise vI cIz2a pratI maithoM nA pucchaNA jadoM tIka maiM Apa hI usa bAre tuhADe nAla koI caracA nA karAM|

phera uha doveM (mUsA te qhiz2ara) tura pae, itthoM taka ki uha ika kizatI ’te savAra ho gae tAM usa (qhiz2ara) ne kizatI de taqhate tor3a ditte (bhAva cheka kara dittA)| mUsA ne kihA, kI tusIM isa nUM isa laI tor3a rahe ho tAM jo kizatI de savAra Dubba jANa? iha tAM tusIM ika bhiAnaka kaMma kItA hai|
usa (qhiz2ara) ne kihA ki maiM tAM pahilAM hI kahiMdA sI ki tusIM (mUsA) mere nAla (rahi ke) sabara nahIM kara sakade|
(mUsA ne) kihA ki merI bhulla cukka ’te merI pakar3a [3] nA karo ate mere bAre iMnI karar3AI toM kaMma nA lao|
translations.footnotes: [3] isa toM patA laggadA hai ki bhulla cukka muAfa hai| allAha dA faramAna hai ki je tusIM bhulla cukka nAla koI g2alatI kara jAo tAM tuhADe ’te koI doza nahIM| (vekho sUrata ala-ahaz2Aba, hAzIA Aita 5/33)| ise tarhAM dilAM vica paidA hoNa vAle vasavase vI muAfa hana| nabI (sa:) nUM faramAiA “mere ummatIAM de dilAM vica jihar3e vasavase te vicAra AuMde hana allAha ne uhanAM nUM muAfa kara dittA hai”| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 6664)

translations.translation: phera uha doveM tura pae itthoM taka ki uhanAM nUM ika bAlaka miilaA usa (qhiz2ara) ne usa nUM mAra dittA mUsA ne kihA ki tusIM tAM ika niradoza nUM binAM kise kArana mAra suTTiA| tusIM tAM bahuta hI bhair3A kaMma kItA hai|
uha (qhiz2ara) kahiNa laggiA ki maiM ne tuhAnUM kihA nahIM sI ki tusIM mere saMga rahi ke sabara nahIM kara sakade|
(mUsA ne) kihA ki je isa toM bAada maiM tuhAthoM koI savAla karAM tAM bezakka tusIM mainUM ApaNe saMga nA rakkhaNA, huNa tuhAnUM mere valloM pUrI chUTa mila gaI hai|

phera uha doveM ika basatI vica pahuMce ate uhanAM toM bhojana maMgiA para basatI vAliAM ne uhanAM dI mahimAnadArI karana toM inakAra kara dittA| uhanAM dovAM ne utthe (basatI vica) ika kaMdha vekhI jihar3I DigaNa vAlI sI| usa (qhiz2ara) ne usa kaMdha nUM siddhA kara dittA| mUsA ne AkhiA ki je tusIM cAhuMde tAM isa dI maz2adUrI lai sakade sI|
usa (qhiz2ara) ne kihA ki basa huNa tere te mere vicakAra judAI hai| huNa maiM tuhAnUM uhanAM gallAM dI hakIkata vI dassa devAM jinhAM bAre tusIM sabara nahIM sI kara sake|

uha kizatI tAM kujjha uhanAM masakInAM dI sI jihar3e dariA vica mihanata maz2adUrI karade sana| maiM ne usa (kizatI) vica iha soca ke tor3a phor3a kItI sI kiuM jo usa (dariA) toM agge ika bAdazAha sI jihar3A hareka kizatI nUM ApaNe kabaz2e vica kara laiMdA sI|
ate jihar3A uha bAlaka sI tAM usa de mAtA pitA momina sana| asIM isa galla toM Dara gae ki uha ApaNI sarakazI te kufara kArana uhanAM nUM gunAha karana ’te majabUra karegA|
so asIM cAhiA ki uhanAM dA rabba isa (sarakaza bAlaka) de badale vica uhanAM nUM ajihI aulAda deve jihar3I usa nAloM carittara pakkhoM vI caMgA hove ate piAra-muhabbata vica vI ner3atA rakkhadA hove|

jihar3I uha kaMdha sI uha usa basatI de do yatIma bAlakAM dI sI, jisa de heTha uhanAM dA ika qhaz2AnA (dabbiA hoiA) sI uhanAM dA pio ika neka purakha sI| so tere rabba ne cAhiA ki uha doveM bacce ApaNI javAnI nUM pahuMcaNa ate tere rabba dI miharAM sadake ApaNA qhaz2AnA kaDDha laiNa| iha sabha maiMne ApaNI soca nAla nahIM sI kItA| iha hai hakIkata uhanAM gallAM dI jinhAM ’te tusIM sabara nahIM kara sake|
(he nabI!) iha (makke de) loka tuhAthoM z2ula-karanaina bAre pucchade hana| tusIM kahi dio ki chetI hI maiM tuhADe sAhamaNe isa dI caracA karAMge|
bezakka asIM usa nUM dharatI dI rAja sattA baqhazI ate usa nUM hara prakAra de sAdhanAM toM vI nivAz2iA sI|
uha ika muhima ’te tura piA|
