itthoM tIka ki uha sUraja DUbaNa vAlI thAM pahuMca giA usa ne vekhiA ki uha (sUraja) kAle pANI vica Duba rihA hai ate utthe ika kauauma vekhI| asIM AkhiA ki he z2ula kuranaina! tainUM adhikAra hai ki bhAveM tUM ihanAM nUM daMDita kara bhAveM vadhIA vivahAra kara|
usa (z2ulakaranaina) ne AkhiA ki jihar3e z2Alama hana asIM uhanAM nUM chetI hI saz2A devAMge| phera uha ApaNe rabba valla paratAe jANage jitthe uha usa nUM karar3I saz2A devegA|
ate jihar3A koI ImAna liAve te amala vI neka kare, uhanAM laI allAha kola sohaNA badalA hai ate asIM vI ApaNe kaMmAM laI uhanAM nUM sukhAle Adeza diAMge|
phera uha ika dUjI muhima de picche tura piA|
itthoM tIka ki uha sUraja car3hana dI sImA ’te pahuMca giA usa ne vekhiA ki uha (sUraja) ika ajihI kauma ’te nikala rihA hai jisa laI asIM sUraja te lokAM vicakAra koI par3adA nahIM rakkhiA|
hakIkata iho hai ate jo kujjha vI usa de kola sI uha sabha sADe vithAra pUravaka giAna de ghere vica hai|
phera uha ika hora muhima de picche tura piA|
jadoM uha do dIvArAM de (bhAva pahAr3AM de) vicAle pujjiA tAM usa nUM utthe ika kauma vekhI jihar3I koI vI gallabAta samajhaNa vica asamaratha laggadI sI|

uha (kauma) AkhaNa laggI ki he z2ula karanaina! yAjUja mAjUja [4] isa dharatI ’te fasAda macAuMde rahiMde hana| kI asIM tere laI kujjha dhaMna ikaTThA kara laIe tAM jo tUM sADe te uhanAM vicAle ika kaMdha usAra deveM?
translations.footnotes: [4] isa vica yAjUja mAjUja dI caracA kItI gaI hai iha allAha dI sAjI hoI ika maqhalUka hai jihar3I isa sameM ika kaMdha dI oTa vica kaida hai, kiAmata de ner3e jadoM allAha cAhegA usa kaMdha vica galI kara devegA ate iha bAhara A jANage ate fasAda failAuNage| haz2arata z2ainaba binata jahhaza (ra:a:) dassade hana ki ika dina allAha de rasUla (sa:) ghabarAe hoe uhanAM kola Ae ate AkhaNa lagge ki allAha toM chuTTa hora kise nUM vI iha adhikAra nahIM ki usa dI ibAdata kItI jAve| jisa cIz2a vicca araba dI barabAdI hai uha uhanAM de ner3e A laggI hai| ajja yAjUja mAjUja dI kaMdha vica innA magaurA ho giA hai ate Apa (sa:) ne ApaNe aMgUThe ate zahAdata vAlI bhAva aMgUThe de nAla dI uMgalI dA gherA baNA ke dassiA| haz2arata z2ainaba (jo ki Apa sa: dI patanI sI) dassadIAM hana ki maiMne pucchiA ki he allAha de rasUla! kI asIM barabAda ho jAvAMge jada ki sADe vicAle neka loka vI hana? Apa (sa:) ne faramAiA “hAM jadoM burAI bahutI hI vaddha jAvegI” bhAva z2anAkArI, harAmI bacce ate hara tarhAM dI azalIlatA vica vAdhA ho jAvegA| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 7135)

translations.translation: usa (z2ulakaranaina) ne kihA ki mere rabba ne jo mainUM dhaMna de rakkhiA hai uha batherA hai, tusIM kevala zarIrika zakatI pakkhoM merI sahAitA karo, phera maiM tuhADe te uhanAM vicAle ika maz2abUta baMnha baNA diAMgA|

basa tusIM mainUM lohe dIAM caddarAM liA dio| jadoM uhanAM ne doveM pahAr3AM de vicakAralA khappA (cadarAM rAhIM) barAbara kara dittA tAM kihA ki huNa isa vica agga sulaghAo| jadoM usa ne usa (lohe dI caddarAM) nUM agga vAMga baNA dittA tAM AkhiA ki huNa isa ’te pAuNa laI paMgheriA hoiA tAMbA liAo|
huNa uha (yAjUja-mAjUja) isa (kaMdha) ’te car3haNa dI hiMmata nahIM sI rakkhade ate nA hI isa vica saMnha lA sakade sI|

z2ulakaranaina ne AkhiA ki iha sabha mere rabba dI mihara hai| hAM, jadoM mere rabba dA vAadA (kiAmata dihAr3e dA) A jAvegA tAM uha isa (kaMdha) nUM paddhara kara devegA ate mere rabba dA vAadA saccA hai|
usa dina (kiAmata dihAr3e) asIM ihanAM nUM ika dUje vica gaDDa maDDa hoNa laI chaDDa diAMge| phera sUra (narasiMghA) vajAiA jAvegA ate asIM ihanAM sAriAM (manukkhAM) nUM ikaTThA karAMge|
usa dina asIM naraka nUM kAfirAM de hai-barU liAvAMge|
(uhanAM kAfirAM de rU-barU) jinhAM dIAM akkhAM merI yAda toM par3ade vica sana ate nA hI uha (hakka) suNana dI samarathA rakkhade sI|
kI kAfira iha samajhade hana ki uha mainUM chaDDa ke mere baMdiAM nUM ApaNA himAitI baNA laiNage?[5] beza$ka asIM kAfirAM dI sevA laI naraka tiAra kara rakkhI hai|
translations.footnotes: [5] ika tAM isa dA aratha iha hai ki allAha nUM chaDDa ke uhade baMdiAM nUM ApaNIAM lor3AM nUM pUrIAM karana vAlA samajhaNA ate dUjA bhAva iha hai ki dIna vica isa nUM jAiz2a samajha liA giA jisa nUM uhanAM ne halAla kihA use nUM halAla ate jisa nUM harAma kihA giA usa nUM harAma samajha liA giA, jiveM allAha ne sUrata taubA (31/9) vica faramAiA hai ki ihanAM yahUdI te IsAIAM ne ApaNe AlamAM te AgUAM nUM ApaNA rabba baNA liA hai| lokI uhanAM lokAM dI pairavI karade hana jinhAM nUM allAha de hukamAM toM binAM ApaNIAM icchAvAM de anusAra harAma halAla baNA liA hai ate marIama de puttara masIha nUM vI uhanAM ne ApaNA rabba baNA liA jada ki uhanAM dovAM nUM tauraita ate iMjIla vica ika sacce izaTa toM chuTTa hora kise dI upAsanA dA hukama nahIM dittA giA sI| uha allAha jisa toM chuTTa hora koI izaTa nahIM uha uhanAM dIAM muzarikAnAM gallAM toM pAka hai|

translations.translation: he nabI! ihanAM nUMAkho, kI asIM tuhAnUM dassIe ki karamAM pakkhoM sabha toM vaddha ghATe vica rahiNa vAle kauNa hana?
(uha ghATe vica hana) jinhAM dIAM kozizAM saMsArika jIvana vica hI barabAda ho gaIAM jada ki uha samajhade hana ki uha sAre kaMma bhalAI te nekI vAle kara rahe hana| [6]
translations.footnotes: [6] isa Aita vica uhanAM lokAM dI caracA kItI gaI hai jihar3e ApaNe mana toM gallAM ghar3ha laiMde hana ate ApaNI samajha vica uhanAM nUM ThIka samajhade hana, jiveM bidaatI Adi para allAha ne faramAiA “uhanAM de sAre kIte hoe karama barabAda hana” neka kaMmAM dI savIkiratI laI do gallAM dA hoNA ati z2arUrI hai ika tAM iha ki uha kevala allAha nUM qhuza karana laI hI kIte jANa nA ki loka vikhAve laI dUjI galla ki uha sAre kaMma allAha de rasUla (sa:) de tarIke anusAra hoNa| ise laI bidaata de saMbaMdha vica allAha de rasUla (sa:) dA faramAna hai “jisa ne vI sADe dIna vica koI navI galla (bidaata) ghar3I jisa dI dalIla dIna vica nA hove tAM uha maradUda (barabAda) hai”| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 2697)

translations.translation: iha uha loka hana jinhAM ne ApaNe rabba dIAM AitAM (nizAnIAM) dA ate usa dI milaNI dA inakAra kItA, ise kArana uhanAM de sAre karama barabAda ho gae| so kiAmata dihAr3e asIM uhanAM (de karamAM) nUM tolaNa dA koI prabaMdha nahIM karAMge|
iho naraka uhanAM dI saz2A hai, kiuM jo uhanAM ne kufara kItA sI ate merIAM AitAM (nizAnIAM) te mere rasUlAM dA makhaula karade sana|
jihar3e loka ImAna liAe te uhanAM ne neka karama vI kIte uhanAM dI mahimAnadArI (bhAva sevA) laI jaMnatu-ula-firadausa (ucca koTI) dA bAg2a hai|
uha uhanAM vica sadA rahiNage jitthio uha jaghA badalaNA pasaMda nahIM karanage|

(he nabI!) Akha dio! je mere rabba dIAM gallAM (sifatAM likhaNa laI) samuMdara (dA pANI) rauzanAI (siAhI) baNa jAve tAM mere rabba dIAM gallAM qhatama hoNa toM pahilAM samuMdara qhatama ho jAvegA bhAveM asIM isa de barAbara ika hora (samuMdara) madada laI le AIe|

(he nabI!) Akha dio! maiM tAM tuhADe varagAM hI ika manukkha hAM, mere valla vahI (rabbI paig2Ama) AuMdI hai ki tuhADA izaTa kevala ika izaTa hai, phera jihar3A viakatI rabba nAla milaNa dI Asa rakkhadA hai usa nUM cAhIdA hai ki neka amala kare ate ApaNe rabba dI baMdagI vica kise hora nUM zarIka nA kare|
kAfa, hA, yA, aina, sAdda|
(he nabI!) iha tuhADe rabba dI usa miharabAnI dI caracA hai jihar3I usa ne ApaNe baMde z2ikarIA ’te kItI sI|
jadoM usa (z2ikarIA) ne ApaNe rabba nUM malakar3e jihe pukAriA sI|

(z2ikarIA ne benatI kItI) ki he mere pAlaNahAra! bezakka merIAM haDDIAM kamaz2ora ho gaIAM hana ate sira buDhApe kArana (bhAva safaida vAlAM nAla) bhar3aka uThiA hai| he mere rabbA! maiM kade vI tethoM duA maMga ke nA-murAda nahIM rihA|
mai` ApaNe picchoM ApaNe vArasAM dI ciMtA hai (ki uha kurAhe nA pai jANa) merI patanI vI vAMjha hai tUM mainUM ApaNe kola toM ika vArasa dI baqhaziza kara|
jihar3A merA vI vArasa hove ate yAkUba dI nasala dA vI vArasa hove| (he mere rabbA!) tUM usa nUM ika mana bhAuMdA viakatI baNA|
(allAha ne duA suNa ke) faramAiA ki he z2ikarIA! asIM tuhAnUM ika puttara dI qhuzaqhabarI diMde hAM jisa dA nAM yAhayA hai asIM isa toM pahilAM isa nAM dA koI viakatI paidA nahIM kItA|
(z2ikarIA) AkhaNa laggA ki he mere mAlika! mere ghara puttara kiveM hovegA jada ki merI patanI vAMjha hai ate maiM Apa buDhApe de sikhara ’te pahuMca giA hAM|
farizate ne AkhiA ki iMja hI hovegA| tere pAlaNahAra dA iha vI faramAna hai ki mere laI tAM iMja karanA bahuta hI AsAna hai| isa toM jada ki tUM kujjha vI nahIM sI, maiM tai` paidA kara cukkiA hAM|

(z2ikarIA ne) AkhiA ki mere pAlaNahAra! mere laI koI nizAnI nizacita karade| faramAiA, tere laI nizAnI iha hai ki tUM savasatha huMde hoe vI lagAtAra tiMna rAtAM (dina-rAta) lokAM nAla galla bAta nahIM kara sakeMgA|
so uha (z2ikarIA) ApaNe hujarioM (kamare ’coM) nikala ke ApaNI kauma de sAhamaNe AiA te usa ne izAriAM nAla (binA bole) kihA ki tusIM savera toM zAma taka (bhAva hara vele rabba dI) pAkI biAna karo|

(jadoM yAhayA javAna ho giA tAM rabba ne usa nUM ApaNA nabI ghozita karade hoe) allAha ne faramAiA ki he yAhayA! (merI) kitAba (tauraita) nUM z2ora nAla phar3a lai| asIM usa nUM choTI umara (bacapaNa) vica hI niraNA-zakatI nAla nivAz2iA sI|
ate ApaNe valloM usa (yAhayA) nUM nimaratA te pavittaratA baqhazI| uha ika parahez2agAra (rabba dI nArAz2agI toM Darana vAlA) viakatI sI|
uha ApaNe mApiA nAla bhalAI karana vAlA sI uha sarakaza te nA-faramAna nahIM sI|
usa (yAhayA) ’te salAma, jisa dina uha paidA hoiA, jisa dina uha akAla calANA karegA ate jisa dina uha mur3a jiUMdA karake uThAiA jAvegA|
isa kitAba vica marIama dA vI z2ikara hai, jadoM uha ApaNe lokAM toM vakkha hoke pUraba valla ghara vica jA baiThI|
ate uhanAM lokAM toM par3adA kara liA phera asIM allAha ne usa (marIama) kola ApaNI rUha (jibarAIla) nUM bhejiA, uha (jibarAIla) usa (marIama) de sAhamaNe pUre manukkha de rUpa vica pragaTa hoiA|
iha vekha ke marIama AkhaNa laggI ki maiM taithoM rahimAna dI panAha maMgadI hAM je tUM ratA vI usa toM Darana vAlA hai|
usa (jibarAIla) ne uttara vica kihA ki maiM tAM tere rabba valloM hI bhejiA hoiA hAM tAM jo tainUM rabbI hukama nAla ika pavittara bAlaka baqhazAM|
(marIama) AkhaNa laggI ki mere baccA kiveM ho sakadA hai? mainUM tAM kise purakha ne hattha taka nahIM lAiA ate nA hI maiM badakAra hAM|

farizate (jibarAIla) ne AkhiA ki iMja hI hovegA tere rabba dA pharamAna hai ki iMja karanA mere laI bahuta hI AsAna hai| asIM usa bAlaka nUM lokAM laI ika nizAnI baNA devAMge ate ApaNe valloM ika vizeza rahimata baNA devAMge ate iha kaMma hoNA nizacita hai|
aMta uha (marIama) garabhapatI ho gaI ate uha usa (garabha) nUM lai ke ika dUra sathAna ’te calI gaI|[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] isa hakIkata nUM dUjI thAM iMja biAna kItA giA hai “uha pAka te pavittara z2anAnI jisa ne ApaNI iz2z2ata dI rAkhI kItI| asIM usa vica ApaNe valloM jAna (rUha) pA dittI ate usa nUM ate usa de puttara nUM dunIAM vAliAM laI nizAnI baNA dittA” (aMbIAM 91/21)|

translations.translation: phera parasUta dIAM pIr3AM ne usa nUM khajUra de daraqhata heTha pahuMcA dittA| AkhaNa laggI ki kAza! maiM isa (bAlaka de jaMmaNa) toM pahilAM hI mara jAMdI ate lokI mainUM bhula jAMde|
udoM hI farizate ne usa de heThoM avAz2a mAra ke AkhiA ki ciMtA nA kara tere rabba ne tere pairAM heTha ika somA vagA dittA hai|
ate khajUra de tane nUM halUNA mAra, iha tere agge (khAna laI) tAz2IAM te pakkIAM hoIAM khajUrAM jhAr3a devegA|

so huNa tUM khA pI ate (bacce nUM vekha ke) ApaNIAM akkhAM ThaMDhIAM kara, je tainUM koI viakatI vikhAI deve tAM uha nUM Akha daIM ki maiM rahimAna laI roz2e dI sukkha sukkhI hai so ajja maiM kise nAla vI galla nahIM karAMgI|
jadoM uha (marIama) ApaNe bacce nUM lai ke ApaNI kauma valla AI tAM uha kahiNa lagge ki he marIama! iha tAM tUM ghora pApa kItA hai|
(kauma ne AkhiA ki) he hArUna dI bhaiNa! nA hI terA pio bhair3A viakatI sI ate nA hI terI mAM koI badakAra aurata sI|
marIama ne ApaNe bacce valla izArA kItA (jo puchaNA hai isa toM paccho ki isa toM puccho)| uha loka kahiNa lagge ki bhalAM godI vAle bacce nAla asIM kiddA gallAM kara sakade hAM|[2]
translations.footnotes: [2] vekho sUrata Ale-imarAna, hAzIA Aita 46/3

translations.translation: para baccA bola piA ki maiM allAha dA baMdA hAM usa ne mainUM kitAba (iMjIla) baqhazI hai ate mainUM paig2aMbara baNAiA hai|
usa (allAha) ne mainUM barakatAM vAlA baNAiA hai, maiM jitthe vI hovAM ate jadoM tIka maiM jiUMdA rahAM, usa ne mainUM namAz2a ate z2akAta deNa dA hukama dittA hai|
ate usa ne mainUM ApaNI mAtA dA sevAdAra baNAiA hai| usa (allAha) ne mainUM z2ora z2abaradasatI karana vAlA ate maMdabhAgA nahIM baNAiA|
salAma hai mere utte jadoM maiM janamiA ate jisa dina maiM marAMgA ate jadoM maiM mur3a jiUMdA karake khar3A kItA jAvAMgA|
iha hai IsA puttara marIama (dI hakIkata), iho hakka sacca vAlI galla hai, jisa vica lokI zakka kara rahe hana|

allAha nUM iha zobhA nahIM diMdA ki usa de koI saMtAna hove, uha tAM ika pAka z2Ata hai| uha jadoM kise kaMma de karana dA faisalA kara laiMdA hai tAM AkhadA hai ki ho jA tAM uha jhaTTa ho jAMdA hai|[3]
translations.footnotes: [3] vekho sUrata ala-bakaraha, hAzIA Aita 116/2

translations.translation: (IsA ne AkhiA) bezakka allAha hI merA ate tuhADA rabba hai, so tusIM sAre use dI baMdagI karo, iho siddhA rAha hai|
para phera vakkha-vakkha dhar3e Apo vicAle matabheda karana lagga pae, [4] so uhanAM laI barabAdI hai jinhAM ne vaDDe dihAr3e (bhAva kiAmata) dI pezI dA inakAra kItA|
translations.footnotes: [4] vekho sUrata Ale-imarAna, hAzIA Aita 103/3

translations.translation: uha loka kiMnAM vadhIA vekhaNa vAle te suNana vAle hoNage jadoM (kiAmata dihAr3e) uha kAfira sADe kola AuNage para ajja de dina tAM iha z2Alama loka sapazaTa kurAhe pae hoe hana|

(he nabI!) tusIM ihanAM (kAfirAM) nUM usa dukha bhare dina toM DarAo jadoM sAre mAmaliAM dA naber3A kara dittA jAvegA para ajja (saMsAra vica) iha lokI bhulekhe vica hana [5] uha ImAna nahIM liAuNage|
translations.footnotes: [5] jadoM kiAmata dI ghaTanA vAparegI tAM inakArIAM dIAM akkhAM khulhIAM rahi jANagIAM ate afasosa karanage para huNa isa dI bharapAI nahIM ho sakadI kiuM je utthe jihar3A vI koI ArAma te qhuzI vica hovegA uha sadA laI hovegA ate jihar3A az2Aba vica fasiA hovegA uha vI sadA laI hovegA| ika hadIsa vica allAha de rasUla (sa:) ne faramAiA “kiAmata dihAr3e mauta nUM ika citakabare miMDhe dI zakala vica liAiA jAvegA ate phera ika AvAz2a deNa vAlI AvAz2a devegA ki he jaMnatIo! jadoM uha garadana cukka ke vekhaNage ki uhanAM nUM kihA jAvegA kI tusIM isa nUM jANade ho? tAM uha AkhaNage ki hAM! jANade hAM iha tAM mauta hai kiuM jo isa nUM sAre hI vekha cukke hana| phera dubArA pucchiA jAvegA he narakIo! uha vI garadana cukkaNage tAM uhanAM nUM vI pucchiA jAvegA ki kI tusIM isa nUM jANade ho? uha kahiNage ki hAM! iha tAM mauta hai kiuM jo usa sameM taka sAre hI usa nUM vekha cukke hoNage| phera isa mIDhe nUM z2ibaha kItA jAvegA ate manAdI karana vAlA AkhegA ki he savaraga vAlio! tusIM sadA laI isa vica rahoge huNa tuhAnUM mauta nahIM AvegI ate he naraka vAlio! tusIM sadA ise vica rahoge huNa tuhAnUM mauta nahIM AvegI phera isa toM bAada rasUla (sa:) ne ise Aita dA pATha kItA| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 4730)

translations.translation: aMta nUM asAM hI dharatI de ate sAre dharatI vAliAM de vArasa hovAMge ate sAre hI lokI sADe valla hI paratAe jANage|
(he nabI!) ise kitAba (.kuraAna) viccoM ibarAhIma dA vI kissA biAna karo, bezakka uha (ibarAhIma) ika saccA nabI sI|
jadoM usa ne ApaNe pitA nUM kihA ki he mere pitA jI! tusIM inhAM (devI devatiAM) nUM kiuM pUjade ho jo nA kujjha suNana, nA hI vekhaNa te nA hI tuhADe kise kaMma AuNa?
mere piAre pitA jI bezakka mere kola (mere rabba valoM) ajihA giAna AiA hai jihar3A tuhADe kola nahIM hai so tusIM merI maMno maiM tuhAnUM siddhI rAha darasAvAMgA|
pitA jI, tusIM zaitAna dI baMdagI nA karo| bezakka zaitAna tAM rahimAna (bhAva allAha) dA nA-faramAna hai|
pitA jI mainUM Dara hai ki tuhADe utte rahimAna valloM koI az2Aba nA A jAve phera tusIM zaitAna de sAthI baNa jAo|
(pitA) Az2ara ne AkhiA ki he ibarAhIma! kI taiM mere izaTAM toM mUMha phera liA hai? je tUM bAz2a nA AiA tAM maiM patthara mAra-mAra ke tainUM mAra diAMgA jAM tUM sadA laI maithoM dUra caliA jA|
(ibarAhIma ne) kihA ki caMgA tusIM salAmata raho, maiM chetI hI tuhADI baqhaziza laI ApaNe rabba toM duA karAMgA bezakka uha mere ’te ati miharabAna hai|

maiM tAM tuhAnUM vI chaDadA hAM ate uhanAM nUM vI chaDDadA hAM jinhAM nUM tusIM rabba nUUM chaDDa ke pukArade ho| maiM tAM kevala ApaNe rabba nUM hI (ApaNI madada laI) pukAradA hAM| mainUM Asa hai ki maiM ApaNe rabba nUM pukAra ke nA-murAda nahIM rahAMgA|

jadoM uha (ibarAhIma) uhanAM (basatI vAliAM) toM ate jinhAM nUM uha allAha nUM chaDDa ke pUjade sI, aDDa ho giA, phera asIM usa nUM isahAka (puttara) ate yAkUba (potarA) jihI aulAda baqhazI ate asIM unhAM sabha nUM nabI baNAiA|
asAM uhanAM nUM ApaNI mihara nAla nivAz2iA ate uhanAM laI saccAI de bolAM nUM ucAI (prasiddhI) baqhazI|[6]
translations.footnotes: [6] vekho sUrata ala-bakaraha, hAzIA Aita 135/2 ate sUrata ana-nahala, hAzIA Aita 121/16

translations.translation: (he nabI sa:!) isa kitAba (.kuraAna) viccoM mUsA dA vI kissA biAna karo, uha ’coMNavAM rasUla (nabI) sI|
asIM usa (mUsA) nUM tUra (pahAr3a) de sajje pAsioM AvAz2a dittI ate bheta bharIAM gallAM karana laI ner3e kara liA|
ate ApaNI vizeza kripA karade hoe usa de bharA (hArUna) nUM vI nabI baNAiA|
isa kitAba (.kuraAna) viccoM isamAIla dI vI caracA karo uha vAade dA pakkA sI rasUla te nabI sI|
uha (isamAIla) ApaNe ghara vAliAM nUM namAz2a te z2akAta dA hukama diA karadA sI| bezakka uha ApaNe rabba dA mana-bhAuMdA baMdA sI|
isa kitAba (.kuraAna) vica idarIsa dI vI caracA karo uha ika saccA nabI sI|
ate asIM usa (idarIsa) nUM ika uccA sathAna baqhaziA sI|

iha uha paig2aMbara hana jinhAM nUM allAha ne inAma nAla nivAz2iA, jo ki Adama dI saMtAna viccoM sana ate uhanAM lokAM dI nasala viccoM sana jinhAM nUM asIM nUha de saMga kizatI ’te savAra kItA sI ate ibarAhIma te isarAIla (bhAva yAkUba) de vaMza viccoM sana| jinhAM lokAM nUM asIM ApaNe valloM hidAita baqhazI ate (paig2aMbarI laI) cuNa liA, jadoM uhanAM de sAhamaNe rahimAna dIAM AitAM (.kuraAna) dI par3hAI kItI jAMdI sI tAM uha roMde hoe sijade vica Diga paiMde sana|[7]
translations.footnotes: [7].kuraAna par3haNa vAlA jadoM iha Aita par3he tAM kibalA valla mUMha karake allAha de haz2Ura sijadA kare jisa vica duAvAM par3he jinhAM dA aratha hai ki he allAha! mere laI ApaNe kola toM isa.kuraAna nUM par3haNa dA savAba likha de ate badala vica mainUM gunAhAM toM pAka kara ate mere valloM isa par3hAI nUM ApaNe kola jamAM kara lai ate mere valloM isa de par3haNa nUM kabUla kara jiveM tUM apaNe baMde dAUda a:sa de par3haNa nUM kabUla kItA sI| (ibane mAjA, hadIsa: 1053, jAmaae tiramaz2I, hadIsa: 3424, 579)

translations.translation: phera uhanAM toM bAada kujjha ajihe ayoga jAnazIna baNe ki uha namAz2AM nUM ajAIM karade rahe ate apaNIAM icchAvAM de picche hI lagge rahe| [8] chetI hI uhanAM nUM halAkata te gumarAhI dA phala bhugataNA pavegA|
translations.footnotes: [8] jiveM zarAba Adi dA nazA karanA, jhUThI gavAhI deNA, harAma khANA, z2anA karanA, lokAM de hakka mAranA, corI, cuggalI Adi karanA, jhUThe alaz2Ama, nA-hakkA katala Adi karanA zAmala hana|

translations.translation: para jihar3e loka taubA kara laiNa ate ImAna liAuNa ate neka amala vI karana, ajihe loka hI jaMnata vica jANage ate uhanAM dA bhorA bhara vI hakka nahIM mAriA jAvegA|[9]
translations.footnotes: [9] vekho sUrata ala-taubA, hAzIA Aita 121/9

translations.translation: iha jaMnatAM sadIvI hana jinhAM dA vAadA rahimAna ne ApaNe AgiAkArI baMdiA nAla aNa-DiThiAM hI kItA hoiA hai| nirasaMdeha, usa (rabba) dA iha vAadA pUrA ho ke rahegA|
uha loka utthe (jaMnata vica) chuTTa salAma toM, koI behUdA gallAM nahIM suNanage| utthe uhanAM laI savere-zAma riz2aka hovegA|
iha uha savaraga hai jisa dA vArasa asIM ApaNe baMdiAM viccoM uhanAM nUM baNAuMde hAM jihar3e parahez2agAra huMde hana|

(he nabI!) asIM (bhAva farizate) tuhADe rabba dI AgiA nAla hI (dharatI ’te) uttarade hAM, jo sADe agge hai te jo sADe picche hai ate jo uhanAM de vicakAra hai uha sabha use dA hai ate tuhADA rabba bhulaNa vAlA nahIM|
akAzAM te dharatI dA ate jo vI ihanAM de vicakAra hai, sabha dA mAlika uhIo hai| so tusIM use dI ibAdata karo te uese dI ibAdata ’te kAima raho| kI tusIM usa jihA koI nAM hora vI jANade hai?[10]
translations.footnotes: [10] vekho sUrata Ale-imarAna, hAzIA Aita 73/3

translations.translation: manukkha AkhadA hai ki jadoM maiM mara jAvAMgA tAM kI maiM mur3a (kabarAM ’coM) jiUMdA kaDDhiA jAvAMgA?
kI iha manukkha iha vI nahIM jANadA ki asIM isa nUM isa toM pahilAM paidA kara cukke hAM jadoM ki uha kujjha vI nahIM sI|
tere rabba dI suMha asIM z2arUra hI ihanAM (kAfirAM) nUM zaitAnAM de nAla ikaTThA karAMge phera asIM z2arUra hI ihanAM nUM naraka de Ale-duAle goDiAM de bhAra hAz2ara karAMge|
phera asIM hareka dhar3e viccoM usa nUM khicca ke vakkha kara devAMge, jihar3A ihanAM viccoM rahimAna de viruddha sarakazI vica vadhere saqhata sI|
phera asIM uhanAM nUM vI caMgI tarhAM jANade hAM jihar3e naraka vica jANa dA vadhere hakka rakkhade hana|
tuhADe (kAfirAM) ’coM koI vI ajihA nahIM jihar3A naraka taka nA pahuMce,[11] jisa nUM pUrA karanA tuhADe rabba dI z2iMmevArI hai ate iha ho ke rahiNA hai|
translations.footnotes: [11] isa Aita dA viAkhaNa hadIsa dIAM kitAbAM vica iMja kItA giA hai, ki naraka de utte ika pula baNAiA jAvegA jisa toM hareka viakatI nUM laMghaNA pavegA momina tAM ApaNe karamAM anusAra chetI jAM derI nAla laMgha hI jANage kujjha tAM uhanAM viccoM akkha jhamakade hI kujjha bijalI jAM havAM dI tarhAM, kujjha paMchIAM vAMga ate kujjha ghor3hiAM ate dUjIAM savArIAM vAMga laMgha jANage aiveM hI kujjha ThIka-ThAka kujjha jaqhamI pula pAra kara hI laiMNage kujjha naraka vica gira jANage para kujjha sameM bAada sifAraza duArA uhanAM nUM kaDDha liA jAvegA para kAfira usa pula nUM pAra nahIM kara sakaNage uha sAre naraka vica Diga jANage isa galla dI puzaTI isa hadIsa toM vI huMdI hai ki “jisa de tiMna bacce bAlaga hoNa toM pahilAM hI mara jANa uhanAM nUM agga nahIM chUegI para iha kasama halAla laI hai”| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 1251, sahI musalima, hadIsa: 2632) ● iha uhIo kasama hai jisa nUM ise Aita vica ‘AqhirI pakkA faisalA’ kihA giA hai bhAva isa dA virada naraka toM pula sarAta uttoM laMghaNa takka hI hovegA| (ahasanula biAna)

translations.translation: phera asIM parahez2agArAM nUM tAM bacA lavAMge ate z2AlamAM nUM use naraka vica goDe bhAra Digge pae chaDDa diAMge|

jadoM uhanAM de sAhamaNe sADIAM sapazaTa AitAM par3hIAM jAMdIAM hana tAM kAfira musalamAnAM nUM Akhade hana ki dasso sADe dohAM dhar3hiAM viccoM kihar3e dhar3e dA darajA uccA hai ate kisa dIAM sabhAvAM vadhere zAnadAra hana|
jada ki ihanAM toM pahilAM asIM kaI kaumAM nUM halAka kara cukke hAM jihar3IAM dhana padAratha pakkhoM vI ate prasiddhI te ThATha-bATha vica vI ihanAM toM kite vAdhU sana|

Akha dio ki jihar3A viakatI kurAhe pai jAMdA hai tAM rahimAna (allAha) vI usa nUM khullhI Dhilla de chaDDadA hai itthoM tIka ki uha uhanAM cIz2AM nUM vekha laiMdA hai jisa dA uhanAM nAla vAadA kItA giA hai| usa sameM uhanAM nUM patA laggegA ki kauNa bhair3e hAlAM vica hai ate kisa dA jatthA lAo-lazakara pakkhoM kamaz2ora hai|

ate hidAita vAlI rAha turana vAle lokAM dI hidAita vica allAha vAdhA karadA rahiMdA hai| nekIAM hI bAkI rahiNa vAlIAM hana jihar3IAM badale te siTTe pakkhoM tere rabba dIAM naz2arAM vica bahuta hI vadhIA hana|
kI tusIM usa viakatI nUM vI vekhiA jisa ne sADIAM AitAM (hukamAM) dA inakAra kItA ate kihA ki mainUM tAM dhaMna te saMtAna lAz2amI milegI|
kI uha g2aiba (parokha) nUM jANadA hai jAM rahimAna toM koI vacana lai chaDDiA hai|
kade vI nahIM! jo vI iha kahi rihA hai asIM usa nUM z2arUra likha rakkhAMge ate usa de az2Aba vica hora vAdhA kara devAMge|
jinhAM cIz2AM dI (iha inakArI) galla karadA hai (bhAva dhana-daulata, aulAda, lAo lazaka Adi) uhanAM sabhanA de asIM hI vArasa hAM| iha tAM ikallA hI sADe kola AvegA|
uhanAM ne allAha nUM chaDDa dUjiAM nUM izaTa baNA liA hai tAM jo uha uhanAM dI (kiAmata dihAr3e) madada kara sakaNa|
para iMja hovegA nahIM, uha (izaTa) tAM uhanAM lokAM valloM kItI gaI baMdagI dA inakAra karanage sagoM uhanAM de virodhI baNa jANage|
kI tusIM nahIM vekhiA ki asAM kAfirAM utte zaitAnAM nUM chaDDa rakkhiA hai jihar3e ihanAM nUM (gunAhAM laI) prerita karade hana|
tusIM uhanAM laI (az2Aba pakkhoM) chetI nA karo, asIM tAM basa ihanAM de dina giNa rahe hAM|
jisa dina asIM parahez2agArAM nUM rahimAna (allAha) kola mahimAnAM vajoM ikaTThA karAMge|
ate pApIAM nUM piAsa dI hAlata vica naraka valla dhakade hoe lai jAvAMge|
(usa vele) kise nUM vI sifAraza karana dA adhikAra nahIM hovegA, chuTTa usa toM jisa ne rahimAna toM (sifAraza karana dA) vacana liA hovegA|
iha (kAfira) Akhade hana ki rahimAna de vI aulAda hai|
tusIM bahuta hI bhair3e te saqhata zabada bola rahe ho te gunAha taka A pahuMce ho|
ner3e hai ki tuhADe isa kathaNI kArana akAza phaTa jAve, dharatI ToTe-ToTe ho jAve te pahAr3a cUrA-cUrA ho ke Digga paiNa|
iha galla ki uhanAM ne rahimAna (allAha) laI saMtAna hoNa dA dAavA kItA hai|
iha galla rahimAna nUM zobhA nahIM diMdI ki usa de aulAda hove|
akAza te dharatI vicakAra jo kujjha vI hai sAre de sAre rahimAna de sevaka baNa ke hI (kiamAta dihAr3e) hAz2ara hoNage|
ihanAM sAriAM nUM usa (allAha) ne gheriA hoiA hai ate sabha nUM giNa rakkhiA hai|
iha sAre kiamAta dihAr3e usa (allAha) de haz2Ura ikallA ikallA hAz2ara hoNage|
bezakka jihar3e ImAna liAe te neka amala kIte, uhanAM laI rahimAna dilAM vica muhabbata paidA kara devegA|[12]
translations.footnotes: [12] dharatI ’te lokAM de dilAM vica ate akAza vica farizatiAM de dilAM vica neka lokAM laI muhabbata paidA kara devegA ika hadIsa vica allAha de rasUla (sa:) ne faramAiA jadoM allAha kise viakatI nAla muhabbata karadA hai tAM uha jihabarAIla a:sa nUM bulA ke kahiMdA hai ki allAha phalAne viakatI nAla muhabbata karadA hai so tUM vI usa nAla muhabbata kara jadoM jibarAIla usa viakatI nAla muhabbata karana lagga jAMdA hai tAM phera jibarAIla akAza vAliAM vica ailAna karadA hai ki allAha phalAne viakatI nAla muhabbata karadA hai tusIM vI usa nAla muhabbata karo iMja sAre akAza vAle vI uhade nAla muhabbata karana laga jAMde hana phera dharatI toM vasana vAliAM de dilAM vica usa dI muhabbata rakkha dittI jAMdI hai iMja uha dharatI ’te vI allAha de neka baMdiAM dA mahabUba baNA jAMdA hai| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 6040)

translations.translation: (he nabI!) bezakka asIM isa (.kuraAna) nUM tuhADI bhAzA (arabI) vica bahuta hI sarala kara dittA hai tAM jo tusIM isa rAhIM parahez2agArAM nUM jaMnata dIAM qhuzaqhabarIAM suNA dio ate jhagar3AlU (kAfira te muzarika) lokAM nUM (naraka toM) DarA dio|[13]
translations.footnotes: [13] jhagar3AlU uha kauma hai, jihar3I allAha de ika hoNa ate usa rasUla (sa:) dI rasAlata ’te ImAna nahIM rakkhade|

translations.translation: asIM (makke vAliAM) toM pahilAM vI kiMnIAM hI kaumAM dA saravanAza kara cukke hAM| kI tusIM uhanAM dA nAM-theha vI vekhade ho? jAM uhanAM dI koI bhiNaka vI kIte suNAI diMdI hai?
tA, hA|
(he nabI!) asIM iha.kuraAna tuhADe ’te isa karake nahIM utAriA ki tusIM aukhe ho jAvo|
sagoM iha tAM hara usa viakatI laI ika nasIhata hai jihar3A usa (allAha) toM DaradA hai|
ate isa (.kuraAna) dA utAranA usa z2Ata valloM hai jisa ne dharatI nUM ate ucce akAza nUM baNAiA hai|
uha rahimAna hai, jihar3A araza de rAja siMghAsana ’te virAjamAna hai|
akAzAM te dharatI vica jo vI hai, jo uhanAM de vicAle hai ate jo dharatI de thalle hai, sabha use (rahimAna) dA hai|
bhAve tusIM uccI AvAz2a nAla galla karo para uha hara bheta nUM sagoM uha tAM usa toM vI gupata gallAM nUM jANadA hai|
allAha uhIo hai jisa toM chuTTa hora koI izaTa nahIM ate sAre hI sohaNe nAM use de hana|[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] vekho sUrata ala-ArAfa, hAzIA Aita 180/7

translations.translation: (he nabI!) kI tusIM mUsA dA kissA jANade ho?

jadoM uhanAM ne (tuvA ghATI vica) agga nUM vekha ke ApaNe ghara vAliAM nUM kihA sI ki ratA Thahiro maiMne agga vekhI hai, zAida maiM tuhADe laI usa viccoM ika addhA aMgiArA lai AvAM jAM agga kola koI agavAI karana vAlA hove|
jadoM mUsA agga de kola pahuMciA tAM AvAz2a AI ki he mUsA!
maiM hI terA pAlaNahAra hAM| tUM ApaNIAM jUtIAM utAra de, kiuM jo tUM ika pavittara ghATI tuvA vica (khar3hA) hai|
ate maiMne tainUM (paig2aMbarI vajoM) cuNa liA hai, huNa jihar3I vI vahI (saMdeza) Ave, usa nUM dhiAna nAla suNIM|
nirasaMdeha! maiM hI allAha hAM, maithoM chuTTa hora koI izaTa nahIM, so tUM merI hI ibAdata kara ate mainUM yAda rakkhaNa laI namAz2a kAima rakkha|
bezakka kiAmata dA velA AuNa vAlA hai jisa dA samAM maiM gupata rakkhaNA cAhuMdA hAM tAM jo hareka viakatI nUM (usa dIAM caMgIAM jAM mAr3IAM) kozizAM dA badalA dittA jAve|

so huNa usa (kiAmata dihAr3e) dI ciMtA karana toM tuhAnUM koI ajihA viakatI roka nA deve jihar3A usa (dina) nUM Apa hI maMnadA nA hove ate ApaNIAM icchAvAM de picche hI laggiA hove, nahIM tAM (he mUsA!) tUuM vI barabAda ho jAveMgA|[2]
translations.footnotes: [2] vekho vekho sUrata marIama, hAzIA Aita 59/19

translations.translation: he mUsA! tere sajje hattha vica kI hai?
(mUsA ne) uttara dittA ki iha merI lAThI hai, jisa nAla maiM sahArA laiMdA hAM ate maiM ApaNIAM bakarIAM laI patte jhAr3adA hAM ate mainUM isa toM hora vI kaI lAbha hana|
kihA ki he mUsA! isa (lAThI) nUM suTTa de|
suTTade hI uha (lAThI) sappa baNake nassaNa lagga paI|
faramAiA ki isa sappa nUM phar3a lai, Dara nA| asIM isa nUM pahilAM vAMga hI (lAThI) baNA diAMge|
apaNA sajjA hattha kuccha vica lai, uha (hattha) binAM kise roga toM lizakAre mAradA hoiA safaida baNake nikalegA| iha dUjI nizAnI hai|
(iha sabha isa laI hai tAM jo) asIM tuhAnUM ApaNIAM vaDDIAM-vaDDIAM nizAnIAM vikhAIe|
(allAha ne kihA he mUsA!) tUM firaauna valla jA, kiuM jo uha sarakaza (bAg2I) ho giA hai|
(mUsA ne kihA ki he mere mAlika! tUM merA sInA kholade (bhAva mainUM hausalA de)|
ate mere kaMma nUM mere laI sukhAlA karade|
ate merI z2ubAna dIAM gaMDhAM kholha de|
tAM jo lokI merI galla nUM caMgI tarhAM samajha sakaNa|
ate mere parivAra ’coM merA ika vaz2Ira (sahAika) baNA de|
bhAva mere bharA hArUna nUM (merA sAthI baNA)|
tUM usa duArA merI piTTha nUM maz2abUta karade|
ate usa nUM merA bhAI vAla baNA de|
tAM jo asIM doveM vaddha toM vaddha terI tasabIha karIe|
ate vaddha toM vaddha tainUM yAda karIe|
bezakka tUM sAnUM caMgI tarhAM vekhadA hai|
(allAha ne) faramAiA, he mUsA! maiM terIAM sArIAM maMgAM kabUla karadA hAM|
asIM tere ’te ika vAra pahilAM vI upakAra kara cukkA hAM|
jadoM asIM terI mAM nUM ilahAma (rabbI izArA) kItA sI jisa dI caracA huNa vahI rAhIM kItI jA rahI hai|

ki tUM isa (mUsA) nUM ika saMdUka vica baMda karake dariA vica chaDDa de, phera dariA isa (saMdUka) nUM kaMDe ’te liA chaDDegA ate isa nUM merA ate isa (mUsA) dA vairI kaDDha lavegA| maiMne ApaNe valloM usa (firaauna) de mana vica tere laI ika vizeza prama pA dittA tAM jo merI dekha rekha heTha terI paravariza hove|

jadoM terI (mUsA) dI bhaiNa (saMdUka de nAla-nAla) turI jA rahI sI (ate firaauna nUM) kahi rahI sI, kI maiM tuhAnUM usa (isatarI) dA patA dassAM, jihar3I isa (bacce) dI dekha-bhAla kara sakadI hai? iMja asIM tainUM terI mAM kola pahuMcA dittA tAM jo usa dIAM akkhAM ThaMDhIAM rahiNa ate uha dukhI nA hove| phera taiMne ika viakatI nUM (mukkA mAra ke) mAra dittA sI| asIM tainUM usa bipatA viccoM vI kaDDhiA| bhAva asIM tainUM caMgI tarhAM parakhiA| phera tUM kaI sAla madIana de lokAM vica guz2Are| phera he mUsA! mukaddarAM nAla tUM itthe A giA|
ate maiMne vizeza ApaNe (paig2aMbara baNAuNa) laI tainUM cuNa liA hai |[3]
translations.footnotes: [3] bhAva maine tuhAnUM ApaNI vahI ate rasAlata laI cunna liA hai jAM maine tuhAnUM ApaNe laI paidA kItA hai jAM maine tuhAnUM darir3a baNAiA hai jAM tuhAnUM sikhAiA tAM jo tusIM mere baMdiAM nUM caMge kaMma karana dA hukama ate mAr3e kaMma karana toM rokana dA hukama pahuMcA dio| (tafasIra ala-kuratabI: 198/11)

translations.translation: huNa tUM te terA bharA (hArUna) mere valloM dittIAM nizAnIAM laike (firaauna de kola) jAo| qhabaradAra merI yAda vica kise tarhAM dI susatI nA karIo|
tusIM doveM firaauna kola jAo kiuM jo uha bAg2I ho giA hai|
usa nUM naramAI nAla samajhANA, ho sakadA hai ki uha samajha jAve jAM Dara jAve|
dovAM (mUsA te hArUna) ne kihA ki he sADe mAlika! sAnUM Dara hai ki uha sADe nAla koI dhakkA nA kare jAM hora bAg2I nA ho jAve|
(allAha ne) faramAiA ki tusIM ukkA hI nA Daro| maiM tuhADe aMga-saMga hAM, maiM sabha kujjha suNadA ate vekhadA vI hAM|

so tusIM (mUsA te hArUna) uha de kola jAo te Akho ki asIM tere pAlaNahAra valloM bheje hoe paig2aMbara hAM, tUM sADe nAla banI irAIla nUM bheja de uhanAM nUM dukhI nA kara| asIM tAM tere kola tere rabba dI nizAnI laike Ae hAM ate jihar3A (rabbI) hidaitAM nUM kabUla karegA usa laI salAmatI hai|
sADe valla vahI AI hai ki jihar3A vI (rabbI hukamAM nUM) jhuThalAegA, usa laI az2Aba hai|
(firaauna ne) kihA ki he mUsA! tuhADA rabba kauNa hai?
mUsA ne kihA ki sADA rabba uha hai jisa ne hareka zaia nUM usa dI vizeza zakala sUrata baqhazI phera rAha vI vikhAI|
usa (firaauna) ne kihA ki caMgA iha dasso ki pahile (inakArI) lokAM dA kI baNegA?
uttara dittA ki isa dA giAna tAM mere rabba de kola ika kitAba (lauhe-mahafUz2a) vica liikhaA hoiA hai| nAM tAM merA rabba koI g2alatI karadA hai ate nA hI uha toM koI bhula huMdI hai|
use (rabba) ne tuhADe laI dharatI nUM vichAiA ate isa (dharatI) vica tuhADe turana-phirana laI rAha baNAe ate akAzoM pANI barasAiA phera usa rahIM bhAMta-bhAMta dI banasapatI kaDDhI|
tusIM Apa vI khAo ate apaNe pazUAM nUM vI carAo| bezakka (rabba dI zakatI nUM samajhaNa laI) isa vica buddhIvAnAM laI anekAM nizAnIAM hana|
asIM ise (miTTI) viccoM tuhAnUM paidA kItA hai ate phera ise vica tuhAnUM mur3a paratA devAMge ate mur3a tuhAnUM ise viccoM dobArA kaDDhAMge|
asAM usa (firaauna) nUM ApaNIAM sArIAM nizAnIAM vikhAIAM, paraMtU phera vI uha jhuThalAuMdA rihA ate maMniA hI nahIM|
(firaauna) AkhaNa laggA ki he mUsA! kI tUM isa laI sADe kola AiA hai ki tUM ApaNe jAdU de z2ora nAla sAnUM sADe deza ’coM bAhara kaDDha deveM|

caMgA asIM vI tere TAkare te ajihA hI jAdU liAvAMge, tUM sADe ate ApaNe vicakAra (jAdU dA mukAbalA hoNa dA) ika samAM nizacita kara lai, nA asIM isa ikarAra toM phirAMge te nA hI tUM, ate iha mukAbalA khullhe maidAna vica hovegA|
mUsA ne AkhiA ki tiohAra vAle dina dA vAadA (nizacita) hai ate dina car3he lokI jamAM ho jANage|
firaauna vApasa (mahila vica) calA giA ate ApaNe sAre hathakaMDe ikaTThe karake mukAbale laI mur3a (maidAna vica) A giA|
mUsA ne (jAdUgarAM nUM) AkhiA ki tusIM allAha utte jhUTha nA mar3ho, nahIM tAM uha tuhAnUM az2Aba nAla barabAda kara devegA, (qhabaradAra raho ki) jisa ne vI jhUTha ghar3hiA uha asafala hI hoiA hai|
(iha suNa ke) uhanAM (jAdUgarAM) vicAle matabheda hoNa lagiA ate haulI-haulI Apo vica salAha mazavare karana lagge|

aMta vica firaauna te usa de darabArIAM ne kihA ki iha doveM (mUsA te hArUna) jAdUgara hI hana ate uhanAM dI icchA iho hai ki ApaNe jAdU de z2ora nAla tuhAnUM sAriAM nUM tuhADe deza vicoM kaDDha deNa ate tuhADe isa Adaraza jIvana praNAlI nUM barabAda kara deNa|
so tusIM ApaNe sAre upAvAM nUM jamAM kara lavo ate ikajuTTa hoke Ao, ajja jihar3A bhArU rahegA uhIo bAz2I jitta jAvegA|
(jAdUgara) AkhaNa lagge ki he mUsA! tUM pahilAM (jAdU) suTTegA jAM asIM hI pahilAM suTTIe|

mUsA ne kihA ki nahIM tusIM hI pahila karo! (jadoM jAdU laI jAdUgarAM ne rassIAM te soTIAM suTIAM tAM) mUsA nUM iMja mahisUsa hoNa lagga piA ki jiveM uhanAM (jAdUgarAM) dIAM rassIAM te soTIAM jAdU de kArana nassa bhajja rahIAM hana|
(iha vekha ke) mUsA ApaNe mana hI mana vica Dara mahisUsa karana lagiA|
tAM asIM faramAiA ki ukkA nA Dara, tUM hI bhArU rahegA|

ate tere sajje hattha vica jo (lAThI) hai usa nUM suTTa de, uhanAM (jAdUgarAM) ne jo vI kArIgarI (karatabba) vikhAI hai uha uhanAM sabha nUM nigala jAvegI| uhanAM ne jo vI baNAiA hai uha sabha jAdUgarI dA sAMga hai ate jAdUgara kade vI safala nahIM ho sakadA bhAveM kitio vI Ave|

(jiveM hI) mUsA ne ApaNI soTI suTTI, soTI ika ajagara baNa gaI ate jAdUgarAM valloM suTTIAM hoiA soTIAM de baNe hoe sappAM nUM khA gaI, jadoM jAdUgarAM ne iha vekhiA tAM sAre jAdUgara sijade vica Diga pae ate kahiNa lagge ki asIM mUsA te hArUna de rabba ’te ImAna liAe hAM|

firaauna ne (gusse vica) AkhiA ki maithoM pucche binAM hI tusIM usa (allAha) ’te ImAna lai Ae? asala vica iha (mUsA) tuhADA gUru hai jisa toM tusIM jAdU sikkhade ho| maiM tuhADA ika pAse dA hattha ate dUje pAse dA paira vaDhA diAMgA ate tuhAnUM sAriAM nUM khajUra de poriAM ’te sUlI ’te cAr3hAMgA ate phera tuhAnUM patA lagga jAvegA ki sADe dohAM (allAha te firaauna) viccoM kisa dI saz2A vadhere karar3I te sadIvI hai|

uhanAM (jAdUgarAM) ne javAba vica kihA ki iha galla asaMbhava hai ki uhanAM dalIlAM de agge jihar3IAM sADe sAhamaNe A cukkIAM hana ate usa allAha dI z2Ata de mukAbale vica jisa ne sAnUM paidA kItA hai, asIM tainUM (firaauna nUM) pahila deie| huNa jo vI tUM karanA cAhuMdA hai kara lai| tUM jo vI hukama calA sakadA hai uha kevala ise jIvana taka hI sImata hai|

asIM (jAdUgara) isa laI ApaNe pAlaNahAra ’te ImAna liAe hAM ki uha sADIAM g2alatIAM nUM muAfa kara devegA ate (vizeza kara) iha jAdUgarI, jisa laI tUM sAnUM majabUra kItA hai| allAha hI vadhIA (badalA deNa vAlA) hai ate uhIo sadA rahiNa vAlA hai|
asala vica jo vI viakatI aparAdhI baNa ke allAha de haz2Ura peza hovegA usa laI naraka hai jitthe nA tAM uha mara sakegA te nA hI jI sakegA|
ate jihar3A vI ImAna dI hAlata vica hAz2ara hovegA ate usa ne amala vI neka kIte hoNage usa laI ucce-ucce marAtabe hoNage|
bhAva rahiNa laI sadA bahAra bAg2a hoNage, jinhAM heTha nahirAM vagadIAM hoNagIAM, jitthe uha (neka loka) hamezA laI rahiNage| iho inAma hai hara usa viakatI dA jihar3A (gunAhAM toM) pAka hovegA|

asAM mUsA valla paig2Ama bhejiA ki tUM rAtoM rAta mere baMdiAM nUM itthoM lai ke nikala jA ate uhanAM laI dariA vica (soTI mAra ke) sukkA rAha baNA| phera nAM tAM tainUM kise valloM picchA karana dI ciMtA hovegI te nA hI (DubaNNa dA) koI Dara hovegA|
firaauna ne ApaNIAM faujAM laike uhanAM (mUsA ate sAthIAM) dA picchA kItA tAM dariA de pANI ne uhanAM nUM ghera liA jiveM ki usa dA hakka baNadA sI|
firaauna ne ApaNI kauma nUM kurAhe hI pAiA sI, siddhe rAha nahIM sI pAiA|

(allAha ne faramAiA) he banI-isarAIla! asIM tuhAnUM tuhADe vairIAM toM mukata karavAiA ate asIM tuhAnUM tUra pahAr3a de sajje pAse tauraita deNa dA vAadA kItA sI ate tuhADe laI akAza toM mana te salavA vI utAriA sI|[4]
translations.footnotes: [4] vekho sUrata ala-bakaraha, hAzIA Aita 57/2

translations.translation: jihar3IAM vI pAka cIz2AM asIM tuhAnUM baqhazIAM hana uhanAM vicoM hI khAiA karo ate isa toM agge nA vadho, nahIM tAM tuhADe ’te merA g2az2aba (karopa) nAz2ila hovegA ate jisa utte vI merA g2az2aba A jAve uha barabAda ho jAMdA hai|
ate jihar3e (allAha dI nA-faramAnI toM) taubA karana, phera ImAna liAuNa te neka kaMma vI karana ate phera siddhI rAha ’te hI rahiNa| bezaka maiM ati aMta baqhazanahAra hAM|
(jadoM mUsA hArUna te banI-isarAIlIAM nUM chaDDa ke rabba nUM milaNa laI tUra pahAr3a ’te Ae tAM allAha ne pucchiA ki) mUsA tUM ApaNI kauma toM agge callaNa vica chetI kiuM kItI?
(mUsA ne) kihA ki uha loka vI mere picche-picche A rahe hana ate he rabba! maiMne tere valla AuNa vica chetI isa laI kItI ki tUM qhuza ho jAve|
(allAha ne) faramAiA ki asIM tere picchoM terI kauma nUM ika az2amAiza vica pA dittA hai, uhanAM nUM sAmarI ne kurAhe pA dittA hai|

phera mUsA atiaMta gusse ate dukhI hoke ApaNI kauma valla paratiA ate AkhaNa laggA ki he merI kauma vAlio! kI tuhADe rabba ne tuhADe nAla neka vAadA nahIM sI kItA? kI tuhAnUM merI judAI dA samAM laMmA lagga rihA sI jAM tusIM iha cAhuMde ho ki tuhADe ’te tuhADe pAlaNahAra dA karopa nAz2ila hove? tusIM mere nAla kIte hoe vacanAM toM phira gae (ki asIM tuhADA kahiNA maMnAge tusIM sAnUM firaauna toM bacAo)|

uhanAM (banI-isarAIlIAM) ne uttara vica kihA ki asIM tuhADe nAla vacanAM dI ulaMghaNA ApaNI maraz2I nAla nahIM kItI, sAthoM firaauna dI kauma de gahiiNaAM dA bhAra cukavAiA giA sI| asIM uhanAM nUM (agga vica) suTTa dittA sI ate iMja hI sAmarI ne vI gahiNe (agga vica) suTTa ditte sI|

phera usa (sAmarI) ne uhanAM (banI-isarAIlIAM) laI gahiniAM dA ika vacche dA dhar3ha baNA dittA jisa viccoM (gaU dI) AvAz2a nikaladI sI ate phera uha loka AkhaNa lagge ki tuhADA izaTa ate mUsA dA izaTa iho hai, uha mUsA tAM (sAnUM) bhula giA hai|
kI iha (kurAhe pae hoe) loka iha nahIM sI vekhade ki iha (vacchA) uhanAM dI kise galla dA javAba nahIM de sakadA ate nA hI uhanAM laI lAbha hAnI dA koI adhikAra rakkhadA hai|

jada ki hArUna ne uhanAM nUM pahilAM hI Akha dittA sI ki he merI kauma! isa (vacche) de kArana tAM tuhADI az2amAiza kItI gaI hai, tuhADA asalI pAlaNahAra tAM rahimAna hI hai so tusIM sAre mere picche laggo ate merI hI galla maMno|
paraMtU uhanAM ne uttara dittA ki mUsA de mur3a AuNa taka tAM asIM ise (vacche) dI hI pUjA karAMge|
phera mUsA ne hArUna nUM kihA ki he hArUna! uhanAM nUM kurAhe paiMde vekha ke tainUM kisa galla ne roka rakkhiA sI?
tUM mere picche (tUra pahAr3a ’te) nahIM AiA kI tUM vI mere hukamAM dI ulaMghanAM karana lagga piA?

kihA (hArUna ne) ki he mere mAM-jAiA! tUM merI dAr3I nA phar3a ate mere sira de vAlAM nUM nA khicca maiM tAM isa galla toM DaradA sI ki tusIM Ake iha nA Akho ki tUM banI-isarAIla vica phuTa pA dittI hai, merI galla dA dhiAna nahIM rakkhiA|
pucchiA (mUsA ne) ki he sAmarI! terA mAmalA kI hai?

usa (sAmarI) ne kihA ki maiM ika uha cIz2a vekhI hai jihar3I ihanAM lokAM ne nahIM sI vekhI| maiMne jibarAIla de ghor3e de pairAM dI miTTI ’coM ika muTTha cukka laI te usa nUM (agga vica) suTTa dittA| mere mana ne mainUM iho sujhAiA sI|

(mUsA ne) kihA ki caMgA tUM jA, huNa sArI umara terI iho saz2A hai ki tUM (lokAM nUM) AkhiA kareMgA ki mainUM nA chUNA ate tere laI (Aqhirata dI saz2A dA) ika hora vI vAadA hai jihar3A TalaNa vAlA nahIM| phera tUM ApaNe isa izaTa nUM vI vekha laIM jisa dI tUM pUjA karadA sI, asIM isa nUM (agga vica) sAr3a diAMge ate cUrA-cUrA karake dariA vica suTTa diAMge|
hakIkata iha hai ki tuhADA sabha dA izaTa kevala ika allAha hai, usa toM chuTTa hora koI vI pUjaNa yoga nahIM ate usa dA giAna hareka cIz2a ’te bhArU hai|
isa prakAra (he muhaMmada sa:!) asIM tuhADe sAhamaNe pichale vApare hoe hAlAta rakkha rahe hAM ate asIM ApaNe koloM tuhAnUM ika nasIhata (.kuraAna) baqhaza cukke hAM|
jihar3A vI isa (nasIhata) toM mUMha mor3egA uha kiAmata vAle dina ApaNe (pApAM dA) bhAra Apa hI cukkegA|[5]
translations.footnotes: [5] vekho sUrata Ale-imarAna, hAzIA Aita 85/3

translations.translation: uha (pApI) use (bipatA) vica sadA laI (phase) rahiMNage ate kiAmata dihAr3e iha (pApAM dA) bhAra uhanAM laI bar3A hI dukhadAI hovegA|
jisa dina bigula (narasiMghA) bajAiA jAvege, usa dina asIM sAre aparAdhIAM nUM ikaTThA karAMge jinhAM dIAM akkhAM nIlIAM (pIlIAM) ho rahIAM hoNagIAM|
uha (pApI) Apasa vica haulI-haulI gallAM karanage ki asIM tAM (saMsAra vica) kevala dasa dina hI rahe sI|
uha jo kahi rahe hana asIM usa dI saccAI nUM jANade hAM, uhanAM (pApIAM) viccoM jihar3A sUjhavANa hovegA uha kahegA ki tusIM tAM kevala (saMsAra vica) ika dina hI rahe sI|
(he nabI!) uha (kAfira) tuhAthoM pahAr3AM bAre pucchade hana, tusIM Akho ki kiAmata dihAr3e uhanAM nUM merA mAlika (dhUr3a baNA ke) ur3A devegA|
ate dharatI nUM rar3A maidAna baNA devegA|
jisa vica nA tAM koI mor3a hovegA te nA hI koI uccAI hovegI|

usa dina sAre lokI bulAuNa vAle (farizate) de picche-picche turanage jisa de sAhamaNe koI Akar3a nahIM vikhA sakegA ate rahimAna de agge sArIAM AvAz2AM daba jANagIAM| ika sarasarAhaTa toM chuTTa hora kujjha vI suNAI nahIM devegA|
usa (kiAmata vAle) dina koI vI sifAraza kaMma nahIM AvegI para uha kaMma AvegI jisa nUM rahimAna (sifAraza karana dI) AgiA deve ate usa dI galla nUM pasaMda vI kare|
jo kujjha vI uhanAM lokAM dA agalA pichalA hAla hai usa nUM uha (allAha) jANadA hai| lokAM dA giAna usa (allAha de giAna) ’te bhArU nahIM ho sakadA|
sAre lokAM de cihare (sIsa) usa sadA jIvita ate sadA kAima rahiNa vAle (allAha) de agge jhuke hoe hoNage, uha barabAda ho jAvegA jisa ne ApaNe sira ’te z2ulama (bhAva ziraka) dA bhAra cukka liA|
ate jihar3A bhale kaMma kare ate hove vI ImAna vAlA tAM usa nUM nA tAM vadhIkI hoNa dA Dara hovegA ate nA hI kise hakka marana dA Dara hovegA|

ise kArana asIM tere ’te (he nabI!) arabI.kuraAna utAriA hai ate isa vica tarhAM-tarhAM nAla citAvanIAM suNAIAM gaIAM hana tAM jo lokI burAIAM toM baca jANa jAM uhanAM de mana vica nasIhata (grahiNa karana vAle) lacchaNa paidA hoNa|

so allAha uccIAM zAnA vAlA saccA pAtazAha hai (he muhaMmada sa:!) tusIM.kuraAna par3haNa vica kAhalI nA kariA karo jadoM taka ki tuhADe valla nAz2ila kItI jA rahI vahI pUrI nA ho jAve| hAM! iha duA kariA karo ki he mere mAlika! mere giAna vica vAdhA kara|
isa toM pahilAM asIM Adama toM ika vAadA liA sI (ki zaitAna dIAM gallAM vica nahIM AuNA zaitAna terA vairI hai) paraMtU uha bhula giA asIM usa vica drir3atA nahIM vekhI|
jadoM asIM farizatiAM nUM kihA ki Adama de agge sijadA karo tAM chuTTa ibalIsa toM uhanAM sabha ne sijadA kItA, para usa (ibalIsa) ne inakAra kara dittA|
phera asIM kihA ki he Adama! iha (zaitAna) terA vI ate terI patanI dA vI vairI hai, kite iha tuhAnUM dovAM nUM jaMnata ’coM nA kaDDhavA deve ate tusIM kise musIbata vica phassa jAo|
itthe (jaMnata vica) tuhAnUM iha suvidhA hai ki nA bhukkhe rahoge te nA hI naMge|
ate nA hI itthe piAse rahoge ate nA hI dhuppa laggegI|
para zaitAna ne usa (Adama) nUM phusalAiA ate kahiNa laggA ki he Adama! kI maiM tuhAnUM sadIvI jIvana te nA-qhatama hoNa vAlI pAtazAhI deNa vAle daraqhata bAre nA dassAM?

aMta uhanAM dovAM (Adama te havvA) ne usa daraqhata dA phala khA liA| (siTTe vajoM) uhanAM dovAM dIAM zaramagAhAM (gupata aMga) uhanAM ’te sapazaTa ho gae ate ApaNe Apa nUM jaMnata de pattiA nAla DhakaNa lagga paI| Adama ne ApaNe rabba dI nA-faramAnI kItI, so uha siddhe rAha toM bhaTaka giA|
phera usa nUM usa de rabba ne navAz2iA, usa dI taubA kabUla kItI ate usa nUM hidAita vAlI rAha vikhAI|

faramAiA ki tusIM doveM (Adama te zaitAna) itthoM (akAza toM dharatI ’te) ikaTThe uttara jAo, (ajja toM) tusIM ika dUje de vairI ho| huNa jadoM mere valloM tuhAnUM (kitAba te nabIAM duArA) koI hidAita pahuMce tAM jihar3A merI hidAita dI pairavI karegA uha (siddhI rAha toM) nahIM bhaTakegA, nA hI usa nUM koI kaThanAI hovegI|
ate jo vI merI yAda toM mUMha mor3egA usa dA jIvana aukhiAI vAlA hovegA, kiAmata dihAr3e asIM usa nUM aMnhA karake uThAvAMge|
uha AkhegA ki he rabbA! taine mainUM aMnhA kiuM baNAiA hai jadoM ki maiM tAM (saMsara vica) sujAkhA sI|
(rabba) AkhegA ki iMja hI hoNA sI (saMsAra vica) tUM merIAM AitAM (hukamAM) nUM bhula giA sI tAM ajja (kiAmata dihAr3e) tainUM bhulA dittA giA hai|

hara usa viakatI nUM jihar3A haddAM TappaNa vAlA hai ate nA hI uha rabba dIAM AitAM te imAna rakkhadA hai, asIM usa nUM iMja hI saz2A diAMge ate nirasaMdeha, paraloka dA az2Aba (saz2A) bahuta hI karar3A ate sadIvI hai|

kI uhanAM lokAM ne isa galla toM vI koI sikkhiA nahIM laI ki asIM uhanAM toM pahilAM kiMnIAM hI basatIAM tabAha kara cukke hAM jitthe ajja iha turade-phirade hana| sUjhavAna viakatIAM laI ihanAM vica anekAM nizAnIAM hana|

je tere rabba valloM pahilAM hI (az2Aba nA bhejaNa dI) galla nizacita nA kItI huMdI ate (kiAmata laI) ika samAM niyata nA kItA huMdA tAM (he nabI sa:!) uhanAM nUM use sameM (jadoM tuhADA inakAra kara rahe sI) az2Aba A cimar3adA|

so (he nabI sa:!) tusIM uhanAM (kAfirAM) dIAM gallAM ’te sabara karo, sUraja nikalaNa toM pahilAM ate isa de DobaNa toM pahilAM ate rAta dIAM ghar3IAM vica vI ate dina dIAM haddAM (qhatama te zurU hoNa) ’te vI tusIM ApaNe rabba dI tasabIha karade raho, ho sakadA hai ki (jo isa de badale vica rabba tuhAnUM safalatA baqhaze ate tusIM rAz2I (saMtuzaTa) ho jAo|

(he nabI sa:!) tusIM akkha cukka ke vI uhanAM cIz2AM valla nA vekhaNA jihar3IAM asIM uhanAM viccoM vakkho-vakkha lokAM nUM saMsArika jIvana dI ThATha bATha laI dittIAM hoIAM hana, tAM jo asIM uhanAM nUM ihanAM cIz2AM rAhIM parakhIe| tere pAlaNahAra dA dittA hoiA riz2aka hI sabba toM vadhIA ate sadA rahiNa vAlA hai|

(he nabI sa:!) ApaNe ghara vAliAM nUM namAz2a laI prerita karo ate Apa vI usa de pAbaMda raho| asIM (allAha) tuhAthoM koI roz2I nahIM maMgade sagoM asIM tAM Apa hI tuhAnUM roz2I deNa vAle hAM, aMta vica safalatA parahez2agArAM nUM hI milegI|

ate (kAfira) kahiNa lagge ki iha nabI (muhaMmada sa:) sADe kola ApaNe pAlaNahAra valloM koI (nabI hoNa dI) nizAnI kiuM nahIM liAiA? kI uhanAM (kAfirAM) kola pahilIAM kitAbAM (tauraita, z2abUra, iMjIla) vica sapazaTa dalIlAM nahIM A cukkIAM|

je asIM isa (nabI) toM pahilAM hI uhanAM (kAfirAM) nUM kise az2Aba vica halAka kara diMde tAM iha loka lAz2amana iho kahiMde ki he sADe mAlika! tUM sADe kola ApaNA paig2aMbara kiuM nahIM bhejiA tAM jo asIM terIAM AitAM (hukamAM) dI pAlaNA karade isa toM pahilAM ki asIM (inakArI) z2alIla te rusavA huMde|

(he nabI sa:!) tusIM Akha dio ki hareka viakatI uDIka vica hai (ki kauNa bhArU rahegA) so tusIM vI uDIko chetI hI tuhAnUM patA lagga jAvegA ki siddhe rAha ’te turana vAle kauNa hana ate kihar3e hidAita prApata kara cukke hana?
lokAM toM (uhanAM de karamAM de) hisAba laiNA dA velA (bhAva kiAmata dA) ner3e A giA hai phera vI uha beparavAhI nAla isa toM mUMha mor3e phirade hana|
jadoM uhanAM kola uhanAM de rabba valloM koI vI navIM nasIhata AuMdI hai uha usa nUM kheDade hoe (makhaula vica hI) suNade hana|

uhanAM de dila ukkA hI beparavAha hana| uhanAM z2AlamAM ne haulI-haulI Apo vicAle kAnAphUsIAM karade hoe (ImAna vAliAM nUM) kihA ki iha (muhaMmada sa:) tuhADe varagA hI ika manukkha hai, phera kI tusIM akkhIM vekhade hoe jAdU vica phasade ho?
(rasUla ne kihA) ki merA rabba akAza te dharatI vica vAparana vAlIAM sArIAM gallAM nUM jANadA hai| uha sabha suNadA te jANadA hai|

sagoM iha (kAfira) tAM iha vI Akhade hana ki iha (.kuraAna) tAM khiMDe-puMDe supane hana| sagoM isa (muhaMmada) ne ApaNe mana toM jhUTha ghar3ha liA hai| iha tAM ika kavI hai nahIM tAM isa nUM sADe kola (nabI hoNa dI) koI ajihI nizAnI liAuNI cAhIdI sI jiveM ki pahilAM rasUla (sane nizAnIAM) bheje gae sana|
ihanAM toM pahilAM jiMnIAM vI basatIAM asIM ujAr3IAM uha ImAna toM qhAlI sana, kI huNa iha (makke vAle) vI ImAna liAuNage?

(he muhaMmada!) tuhAthoM pahilAM asIM jinne vI paig2aMbara bheje uha sAre hI manukkha sana, uhanAM valla asIM vahI (rabbI sunehA) bhejiA karade sI, jekara tusIM nahIM jANade tAM kitAba vAliAM (IsAI ate yahUdIAM toM) puccha lao|
asIM uhanAM (paig2abaMrAM de) ajihe sarIra nahIM baNAe sI ki uha khAMde nA hoNa ate nA hI uha sadA jIvita rahiNa vAle sana|

asIM uhanAM (paig2aMbarAM) nAla jihar3e vI vAade kIte sana unhAM sAriAM nUM sacca kara vikhAiA, asIM uhanAM (paig2aMbarAM) nUM ate hora jinhAM nUM asIM cAhiA (az2Aba toM) bacA liA, paraMtU haddA TappaNa vAliAM nUM nazaTa kara suTTiA|
(he loko!) bezakka asIM tuhADe valla uha kitAba nAz2ila kItI hai jisa vica tuhADI hI caracA hai, kI tusIM phera vI nahIM samajhade?
ate kiMnIAM hI basatIAM asIM nazaTa kara suTTIAM jihar3IAM z2ulama karadIAM sana ate uhanAM de picchioM kise dUjI kauma nUM uThAiA (bhAva paidA kara dittA)|
jadoM uhanAM (kaumAM) ne sADe az2Aba de AuNa nUM mahisUsa kItA tAM usa thAM tUM nassaNa lagge|
(uhanAM nassaNa vAliAM nUM kihA giA ki) huNa nasso nA, jAo ApaNe uhanAM hI gharAM vica jitthe tuhAnUM hara tarhAM dIAM suvidhAvAM prApata sana tAM jo tuhAthoM (tuhADA hAla cAla tAM) puccha liA jAve|
(kAfira) AkhaNa lagge ki asIM tAM barabAda ho gae, bezakka asIM hI z2Alama sAM|
iha iho Akhade rahe itthoM tIka ki asIM uhanAM nUM jar3ha toM vaDDI hoI fasala vAMga ate bujhI hoI agga (suAha) baNA dittA|
asIM akAza ate dharatI ate uhanAM vicakAra dIAM cIz2AM nUM kheDade hoe bhAva binAM soce samajhe viaratha nahIM baNAiA|[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] ki akAza te dharatI dI racanA manukkhAM laI kudarata dIAM nizAnIAM hana ki isa toM uha sikkhiA grahaNa karana ate iha jANa laiNa ki srizaTI dA racaNahAra kevala ika allAha hI hai ate Usa toM chuTa hora koI izaTa nahIM|

translations.translation: je asIM kheDaNA hI cAhuMde te kevala iho kujjha asIM karanA huMdA tAM isa nUM ApaNe kola hI rakkhade|

sagoM asIM tAM jhUTha utte hakka dI saTTa mArade hAM ate (uha sacca usa jhUTha dA) sira kucala diMdA hai ate phera uha (jhUTha) usa sameM nikhaTTa ho jAMdA hai| (he z2Alamo!) jihar3IAM gallAM tusIM baNAuMde ho uhIo tuhADI barabAdI dA kArana baNIAM hana|
akAzAM ate dharatI vica jo vI hai, sabha use (allAha) dA hI hai ate jihar3e (farizate) usa de kola hana uha usa dI ibAdata karana toM nA tAM sarakazI karade hana ate nA hI uha thakkade hana|
uha (farizate) binAM kise vighana toM dina- rAta (bhAva hara vele) usa (allAha) dI tasabIha karade hana|
kI uhanAM (muzarikAM) de dharatI vAle izaTa kise (muradA viakatI) nUM jiUMdA kara sakade hana|

je isa (saMsAra) vica allAha toM chuTTa hora vI izaTa huMde tAM iha dovAM (akAza te dharatI) dI vivasathA bigar3a jAMdI| so allAha, arazAM dA mAlika, uhanAM gallAM toM pAka hai jihar3IAM iha (muzarika) karade hana|
uha (allAha) ApaNe kaMmAM laI kise nUM uttaradAI nahIM, jada ki sAre hI (allAha de sAhamaNe) uttaradAI hana|

kI uhanAM lokAM ne (rabba nUM chaDDa ke) hora izaTa baNA rakkhe hana? (he nabI!) uhanAM (muzarikAM) nUM Akho ki koI dalIla tAM liAo jadoM ki mere kola iha kitAba (.kuraAna) vI maujUda hai jisa vica mere sAthIAM laI nasIhata hai ate maithoM pahile lokAM laI vI nasIhata sI| hakIkata iha hai ki ihanAM vica bahute ajihe hana jihar3e hakka (saccAI) nUM nahIM jANade, iho kArana iha (hakka toM) mUMha mor3e hoe hana|
tuhAthoM pahilAM vI (he nabI!) asIM jihar3e vI rasUla bheje uhanAM valla iho vahI (rabbI sunehA) ghallI gaI sI ki chuTTa maithoM hora koI izaTa nahIM, so tusIM sAre merI hI ibAdata karo|

iha (muzarika) Akhade hana ki rahimAna (allAha) saMtAna vAlA hai jada ki usa dI z2Ata tAM (aulAda hoNa toM) pAka hai, sagoM uha (farizate jinhAM nUM saMtAna Akhade hana) sAre hI usa (allAha) de satikArayoga baMde hana|
uha kise vI galla vica vaddha ke nahIM bolade sagoM usa de AgiAkArI baMde hana|

uha (allAha) uhanAM (farizatiAM) de jo agge hai usa nUM vI jANadA hai ate jo uhanAM de picche hai usa nUM vI jANadA hai| uha (farizate) kevala usa dI sifAraza karanage jinhAM toM allAha qhuza hovegA| uha (farizate) tAM usa (allAha) de bhaia toM kaMbade rahiMde hana|
uhanAM viccoM je koI (farizatA) iha kahi deve ki allAha toM chuTTa maiM vI izaTa hAM tAM asIM usa nUM naraka dI saz2A diAMge| asIM z2AlamAM nUM iMja hI saz2A diA karade hAM|

kI kAfirAM ne nahIM vekhiA (bhAva JicAra nahIM kItA ki bezakka akAza te dharatI ika dUje nAla jUr3e hoe sana phera asIM ihanAM dovAM nUM vakkho vakkha kara dittA | asAM hareka jIvata cIz2a nUM pANI toM baNAiA hai, kI uha phera vI ImAna nahIM liAuNage|
asIM dharatI vica pahAr3AM nUM jamA dittA tAM jo uha lokAM de bhAra nAla jhuka nA jANa| asIM isa vica khullhe khullhe rAha baNA ditte tAM jo uha (loka) rAha labha laiNa|
ate asIM akAza nUM ika surakkhiata chatta baNA dittA, paraMtU iha (kAfira) ihanAM nizAnIAM valla dhiAna hI nahIM diMde|
uha uhIo hai jisa ne rAta, dina, sUraja ate caMna nUM paidA kItA, iha sAre ApaNe ApaNe maMDala vica turade-phirade hana|
(he nabI sa:!) tuhAthoM pahilAM vI kise vI manukkha nUM asIM sadIvI z2iMdagI nahIM dittI| je tusIM mara gae tAM kI iha loka sadA jiUMde rahiNage?
mauta dA suAda tAM hareka jIva ne cakhaNA hI hai| asIM tuhAnUM parakhaNa laI caMge te mAr3e hAlAta vica rakkhade hAM, aMta tusIM sabha ne AuNA sADe valla hI hai|

iha inakArI jadoM vI tuhAnUM (he muhaMmada!) vekhade hana tAM tuhADA makhaula karade hana ate Akhade hana, kI iha uhIo hai jihar3A tuhADe izaTAM dI caracA (nikhedI) karadA hai? jada ki sacca iha hai ki iha (kAfira) hI rahimAna de z2ikara toM inakAra karade hana|
manukkha janama toM hI kAhalA hai| maiM chetI hI tuhAnUM ApaNIAM nizAnIAM vikhAvAMgA, tusIM mere nAla (az2Aba laI) iMnI kAhalI nA karo|
kAfira Akhade hana ki je tusIM (he nabI!) ApaNI galla vica) sacce ho tAM dasso ki iha (az2Aba AuNa dA) vAadA kadoM pUrA hovegA|

kAza! iha inakArI jANade huMde ki usa sameM (jadoM az2Aba AvegA) iha kAfira nA tAM ApaNe cihariAM toM nA hI ApaNIAM piTThAM toM (naraka dI) agga nUM parAM kara sakaNage ate nA hI (kise pAsioM) uhanAM dI sahAitA kItI jAvegI|
acaNaceta uhanAM utte vAade vAlI ghar3I (kiAmata) A jAvegI ate iha rurAna parezAna ho jANage, phera nA tAM uha usa (ghar3I) nUM TAla sakaNage ate nA hI uhanAM nUM ratA bhara chUTa dittI jAvegI|
(he muhaMmada sa:!) tuhAthoM pahilAM vI paig2aMbarAM nAla makhaula hoe sana, aMta uhanAM khillI karana vAliAM nUM use (az2Aba) ne A gheriA jisa dA uha makhaula kariA karade sana|
(uhanAM inakArIAM nUM) kaho ki dina-rAta rahimAna de (az2Aba toM) tuhADI surakkhiA kauNa karadA hai? asala galla iha hai ki iha ApaNe rabba dI yAda toM mUMha mor3IM phirade hana|
kI chuTTa sAthoM uhanAM de hora izaTa ajihe hana jihar3e uhanAM nUM (az2Aba toM) bacA sakaNa? uha nA tAM ApaNI sahAitA Apa kara sakade hana ate nA hI sADe az2Aba toM surakkhiata hana|

sagoM uhanAM (kAfirAM) nUM ate uhanAM de bApa dAdiAM nUM asIM hI jIvana guz2Arana laI samaggarI dittI, itthoM tIka ki uhanAM ’te ika laMmA samAM laMgha giA| kI tusIM iha nahIM vekhade ki asIM dharatI nUM usa dIAM anekAM dizAvAM toM (kAfirAM dI tAkata) ghaTAuMde jAMde hAM? kI phera vI iho bhArU rahiNage?
he nabI! Akha dio ki maiM tAM tuhAnUM vahI (rabbI Adeza) duArA (usa de az2Aba toM) qhabaradAra kara rihA hAM, paraMtU bole loka nahIM suNade, jada ki uhanAM nUM sAvadhAna kItA jA rihA hai|
je uhanAM nUM (he nabI!) tere rabba dA az2Aba ratA chUha jAve tAM kahiNage ki asIM tAM barabAda ho gae, (ikarAra karanage ki) asIM z2Alama hAM|

kiAmata dihAr3e asIM ThIka-ThIka tolaNa vAlI takkar3I lokAM vicakAra liA rakkhAMge phera kise nAla koI z2ulama nahIM hovegA| je ika rAI de dAne barAbara vI kise ne koI amala (kaMma) kItA hovegA asIM usa nUM usa de sAhamaNe liAvAMge| hisAba karana laI asIM hI batherA hai|

(ate.kuraAna toM pahilAM) asIM mUsA ate hArUna nUM furakAna (hakka ate jhUTha vicakAra faisalA karana vAlI te siddhI rAha vikhAuNa vAlI) ate cAnaNa pAuNa vAlI ate (burAIAM toM) parahez2a karana vAliAM nUM nasIhata karana vAlI kitAba (tauraita) baqhaza cukke hAM|
(ate iha kuraAna unhAM laI hai) jihar3e loka binA vekhe ApaNe rabba toM Darade hana ate kiAmata toM vI Dare rahiMde hana|
iha (.kuraAna) barakatAM vAlA z2ikara hai, jisa nUM asIM hI nAz2ila kItA hai| kI tusIM phera vI isa nUM nahIM maMnade? [2]
translations.footnotes: [2] vekho sUrata yUnusa, hAzIA Aita 37/10 ate sUrata Ale-imarAna, hAzIA Aita 85/3

translations.translation: bezakka usa (tauraita) toM vI pahilAM asIM ibarAhIma nUM sUjha-bUjha baqhazI sI ate asIM usa (ibarAhIma) nUM caMgI tarhAM jANade sI|
jadoM usa (ibarAhIma) ne ApaNe pitA nUM ate ApaNI kauma nUM AkhiA sI ki iha mUratIAM jinhAM dI tusIM majAvarI (dekha bhAla) karade ho kI hana?
uhanAM (sabha ne) kihA ki asIM ApaNe pio dAdiAM (bhAva baz2uragAM) nUM ihanAM (mUratIAM) dI hI pUjA karade vekhiA hai|
(ibarAhIma ne) kihA, phera tAM tusIM vI kurAhe pae hoe ho ate tuhADe baz2uraga vI sapazaTa rUpa vica kurAhe pae hoe sana|
(kauma ne) kihA, kI tusIM sADe sAhamaNe sacca bola rahe ho jAM makhaula kara rahe ho?

ibarAhIma ne faramAiA, asala galla iha hai ki tuhADA sAriAM dA pAlaNahAra tAM uhIo hai jihar3A akAzAM ate dharatI dA mAlika hai ate jisa ne uhanAM nUM sAjiA hai| maiM tuhADe sAhamaNe isa dI gavAhI diMdA hAM|
(ibarAhIma ne mana vica kihA ki) allAha dI kasama! tuhADe jANa magaroM maiM tuhADe ihanAM butAM nAla nibar3AMgA|
(jadoM sAre cale gae tAM) phera usa (ibarAhIma) ne sArIAM (mUratIAM) de ToTe-ToTe kara ditte, kevala ika vaDDe buta nUM bAkI rahiNa dittA tAM jo (jadoM A ke vekhaNa tAM) use buta valla parataNa|
(jadoM uhanAM nUM butAM bAre patA lagiA tAM) pucchaNa lagge ki sADe izaTAM dA iha hAla kisa ne kItA hai? (jisa ne vI iha kItA hai) bezuka uha z2AlamAM viccoM hI hai|
(kujjha loka Apasa vica) kahiNa lagge ki asIM ika naujavAna nUM ihanAM (izaTAM) pratI caracA karade hoe suNiA sI usa nUM ibarAhIma kihA jAMdA hai|
sAriAM ne kihA ki tusI usa nUM lokAM de sAhamaNe phar3a liAo tAM jo sAre usa nUM vekha laiNa|
(jadoM ibarAhIma nUM lokAM sAhamaNe liAMdA giA tAM kauma de saradAra) AkhaNa lagge, kI tene hI sADe izaTAM dA iha hAla kItA hai?
tAM ibarAhIma ne kihA ki iha kaMma tAM uhanAM (mUratIAM) de vaDDe (buta) dA hai, puccha lavo je iha bola sakadA hai|
(iha suNake) uha sabha ApaNe Apa vica isa galla nUM maMNana lagge (ki iha buta tAM kujjha bola vI nahIM sakade ate (mana hI mana vica) kahiNa lagge ki z2Alama tAM tusIM Apa hI ho|
phera uhanAM dI matta puTThI ho gaI (te AkhaNa lagge) iha tAM tUM vI jANadA hai ki iha bolade nahIM|
(ibarAhIma ne) kihA, kI tusIM allAha nUM chaDDa ke uhanAM dI pUjA karade ho jo nA tuhAnUM kujjha lAbha de sakade hana nA hI hAnI?
afasosa hai tuhAte (bhAva tuhADIAM akalAM) utte ate uhanAM utte jinhAM dI pUjA tusIM allAha nUM chaDDa ke karade ho| kI tuhAnUM kujjha vI akala nahIM?
(Apasa vica) kahiNa lagge ki je tusIM ApaNe izaTAM dI madada karanI hI hai tAM ibarAhIma nUM agga vica suTTa dio|
(jadoM ibarAhIma nUM agga vica suTa dittA giA tAM) asIM hukama dittA ki he agga! tUM ThaMDI ho jA ate ibarAhIma laI salAmatI vAlI baNa jA|
uhanAM ne ibarAhIma nAla burA karanA cAhiA para asIM uhanAM nUM hI ghATe vica pA dittA (asafala kara dittA)|
asIM usa (ibarAhIma) nUM ate lUta nUM surakkhiata bacA ke usa dharatI (mulaka zAma) valla lai gae, jitthe asIM dunIAM jahAna laI barakatAM rakkhIAM sana|
asIM usa (ibarAhIma) nUM isahAka (jihA puttara) ate yAkUba (jihA potarA) inAma vica dittA ate hareka nUM asIM neka kaMma karana vAlA baNAiA|

ate asIM uhanAM (isahAka te yAkUba) nUM AgU (nabI) baNAiA tAM jo sADe AdezAM anusAra lokAM dI agavAI karana ate asIM uhanAM (nabIAM) valla bhale kaMma karana, namAz2a kAima rakkhaNa ate z2akAta adA karana dA hukama vahI rAhIM bhejiA ate uha sAre hI sADe ibAdata guz2Ara baMde sana|
asIM lUta nUM vI dAnAI (paig2aMbarI) ate giAna baqhaziA ate asIM usa nUM usa basatI viccoM kaDDhiA jitthe de lokI azalIla kaMmAM vica rujjhe hoe sana| uha bahuta hI bhair3e ate avagiAkArI loka sana|
asIM usa (lUta) nUM ApaNIAM miharAM vica dAqhala kara liA bezakka uha neka lokAM viccoM sI|

ate (he nabI!) nUha nUM yAda karo jadoM usa ne uhanAM (sAre nabIAM) toM pahilAM sAnUM duA kItI sI ate asIM uha dI duA kabUla kItI| so asIM usa (nUha) nUM ate usa de sAthIAM nUM ika vaDDe saMkaTa viccoM kaDDhiA|

ate asIM uhanAM (nUha te usa de sAthIAM) dI himAita uhanAM lokAM de mukAbale vica kItI sI, jihar3e sADIAM AitAM (nizAnIAM) nUM jhuThalA rahe sana| nirasaMdeha, uha bahuta hI bhair3e loka sana, so asIM uhanAM sabha nUM Doba dittA|

(he nabI sa:!) dAUda ate (usa de puttara) sulemAna nUM yAda karo jadoM uha doveM ika kheta (dI malakIyata) dA faisalA kara rahe sana, jisa vica rAta vele kise dIAM bakarIAM cara-curA gaIAM sana| asIM uhanAM de faisale sameM maujUda sI|

asIM sulemAna nUM ThIka (faisalA) sujhA dittA ate asIM hareka nUM siANapa te giAna baqhaziA| asIM dAUda de adhIna pahAr3AM te paMchiAM nUM kara dittA| uha (sAre) tasabIha karade sana| iha sabha karana vAle asIM Apa hI sAM|
asIM usa (dAUda) nUM tuhADe laI z2irhA-bakatara (jaMgI libAsa) baNAuMNa dI kalA sikhAI, tAM jo lar3AI sameM ika dUje de hamale toM bacAe| kI tusIM dhaMnavAdI baNoge?
asIM hI sulemAna de adhIna tez2a havAM nUM kItA, uha usa de hukama nAla usa dharatI valla vagadI sI jitthe asIM barakatAM de rakkhIAM sana| asIM hareka cIz2a dA bhalI-bhAMta giAna rakkhade hAM|

ise prakAra asIM bahuta sAre zaitAna vI usa (sulaimAna) de adhIna kIte hoe sI jihar3e usa de hukama nAla (samuMdara vica) gote mArade sI ate hora vI kaI kaMma karade sI, asIM hI uhanAM dI rAkhI karade sI|
(he nabI sa:!) ayyUba (nabI) nUM yAda karo jadoM usa ne ApaNe rabba nUM aradAsa kItI sI ki mainUM bImArI cimmar3a gaI hai ate tUM hI sabha toM vaddha rahima karana vAlA hai (mainUM bImArI toM bacA)|

asIM (usa dI aradAsa kabUla kara laI ate jihar3A usa nUM roga sI uha dUra kara dittA ate usa nUM aulAda baqhazI, sagoM ApaNIAM miharAM sadake hora vI bahuta kujjha dittA tAM jo neka loka nasIhata prApata karana|
ate isamAIla, idarIsa te z2avila kifala nUM yAda karo, iha sAre (nabI) sabara karana vAle sana|
ate asIM uhanAM sAre (nabIAM) nUM ApaNI miharAM vica lai liA| nirasaMdeha, uha sAre hI neka loka sana|

ate macchI vAle (yUnusa) nUM yAda karo jadoM uha (kauma toM) vigar3a ke calA giA ate samajhadA sI ki asIM usa nUM phar3a nahIM sakade| aMta usa ne sAnUM haneriAM vica (bhAva macchI de peTa viccoM) aradAsAM kItIAM ki taithoM (allAha toM) chuTTa hora koI izaTa nahIM, tUM pAka hai, asala vica maiM hI z2AlamAM viccoM ho giA hAM|
asIM usa (yUnusa) dI aradAsa manaz2Ura kara laI ate usa nUM kazaTa (macchI de peTa) toM chuTakArA dilAiA| ImAna vAliAM nUM asIM ise tarhAM bacAuMde rahiMde hAM|
yAda karo z2ikarIA nUM jadoM usa ne ApaNe rabba nUM duA kItI sI ki he mere rabbA! mainUM ikalliAM nA chaDDIM, tUM hI sabha toM vaDDA vArasa (rakkhavAlA) hai|

asIM usa (z2ikarIA) dI duA kabUla kara laI ate usa nUM yAhayA (nAM dA puttara) baqhaziA| asIM usa dI patanI nUM isa (aulAda) de yoga baNA dittA| iha doveM (z2ikarIA te usa dI patanI) bhale kaMma karana vica chetI karade sana ate sAnUM AsAM nAla ate Darade hoe pukArade sana ate sADe agge nimaratA sahita jhukade sana|

ate usa pAka pavittara isatarI nUM yAda karo jisa ne ApaNI iz2z2ata AbarU dI rAkhI kItI sI| asIM usa (pavittara z2anAnI marIama) vica ApaNI rUha phUMkI ate usa nUM ate usa de puttara (IsA) nUM kulla jahAna laI ika nizAnI baNA dittA|
he loko! bezakka iha tuhADa dharama (isalAma) ika hI dharama hai ate maiM tuhADA pAlaNahAra hAM, so tusIM merI hI baMdagI karo|
ate jinhAM lokAM ne ApaNe dharama vica phuTTAM pAIAM hana uhanAM sabha ne AuNA tAM mere hI kola hai|
so jihar3A vI koI neka amala karegA, para hove uha ImAna vAlA, usa de kaMmAM dI nA-kadarI nahIM hovegI, asIM tAM uhanAM de sAre kaMmAM nUM likha rahe hAM|
ate jisa basatI asAM halAka kara daIe uha de vasanIka kade mur3a parata ke (saMsAra vica) nahIM AuNage|
itthoM tIka ki yAjUja mAjUja khola ditte jANage ate uha hara uMcAI toM bhajade hoe nikkala AuNage|[3]
translations.footnotes: [3] vekho sUrata ala-kahafa, hAzIA Aita 94/18

translations.translation: ate saccA vacana bhAva kiAmata dA samAM vI ner3e A laggegA, tada kAfirAM dIAM akkhAM (acaraja nAla)khullhIAM dIAM khullhIAM rahi jANagIAM (ate AkhaNage ki) afasosa sADe mAr3e bhAga asIM isa dina nUM bhulle baiThe sI, asIM hI z2Alama sAM|
(he kAfiro! suNo!) tusIM rabba nUM chaDDa ke jinhAM dI baMdagI karade ho uha sAre naraka dA bAlaNa baNake rahiNage ate tusIM sAre usa vica jAvoge| [4]
translations.footnotes: [4] jadoM allAha ne iha irazAda faramAiA tAM muzarIkIna-e-kuraiza bahuta qhuza hoe ate AkhaNa lagge ki asIM tAM doz2akha vica ApaNe IzaTAM nAla hovAMge| jiveM nakara vica buta ApaNe pujArIAM nAla hoNage| so marIama dA puttara IsA ate uz2aira (a:) naraka vica ApaNe pUjArIAM nAla hoNage, isa tarhAM dUje loka vI| so allAha ne isa samassiA dA halla ate muzarikAM de dAve dI nakhedI laI kuraAna dI Aita 101/21 nAz2ila faramAI ki bezakka jinhAM lokAM laI sADe valloM pahilAM toM hI nekI mukaddara baNa cukkI hai uha z2arUra hI naraka toM dUra rakkhe jANage|

translations.translation: jekara iha asalI izaTa huMde tAM usa naraka vica kiuM jAMde? jada ki iha sAre isa (naraka) vica sadA laI rahiNage|
utthe iha sAre kUkAM mAraNage, para utthe uhanAM nUM suNana vAlA koI nahIM hovegA|[5]
translations.footnotes: [5] jadoM haz2arata ibane masaUda ne iha Aita talAvata kItI ate AkhiA ki jadoM uha loka jinhAM de mukaddara vica naraka likhI jA cukkI hai ki uha sadA hI utthe rahiNage ate naraka vica suTTa ditte jANage tAM ihanAM viccoM hara ika nUM vakkha vakkha agga de saMdUka vica suTTa dittA jAvegA ate uha dekha nA sakaNage ki usa doM chuTTa kise hora nUM vI naraka dI saz2A dittI gaI hai| phera ibane masaUda ne iha Aita talAvata kItI| (ibane kasIra, ata-tibarI, ala-kuratabI)

translations.translation: paraMtU uha loka jinhAM laI pahilAM hI asIM nekI dA faisalA kara cukke hAM uha sAre naraka toM dUra hI rahiNage|
uha usa (naraka) dI bir3aka vI nahIM suNanage ate sadA laI ApaNIAM mana bhAuMdIAM niamatAM (jaMnata) vica rahiNage|
uha atiaMta ghabarAhaTa vAlA velA vI uhanAM nUM g2amag2Ina nahIM karegA ate farizate uhanAM nUM iha Akhade hoe milaNage ki iho tuhADA uha velA hai jisa dA vAadA tuhADe nAla kItA giA sI|

usa (kiAmata vAle) dina asIM akAza nUM likhe hoe kAgaz2a vAMga valeTa ke rakkha diAMge| jiveM asIM srizaTI nUM pahilI vAra paidA kItA sI iMja hI mur3a phera (paidA) karAMge| iha sADe valloM vAadA hai ate asIM isa nUM z2arUra hI pUrA karAMge|
z2abUra vica asIM nasIhatAM magaroM iha likha cukke hAM ki dharatI de vArasa mere neka baMde hI hoNage|
sADI baMdagI karana vAliAM laI tAM isa vica ika ahima paig2Ama hai|
(he muhaMmada sa:!) asIM tuhAnUM sAre jahAna vAliAM laI rahimata baNA ke bhejiA hai|
he nabI! tusIM Akha dio ki mere kola tAM kevala iho vahI AuMdI hai ki tuhADA sAriAM dA izaTa ika (allAha) hI hai| kI tusIM musalamAna ho?

je phera vI iha loka mUMha mor3a laiNa tAM Akha dio ki maiMne tAM tuhAnUM khullhI citAvanI de chaDDI hai| mainUM ukkA hI giAna nahIM ki jisa galla (kiAmata) dA tuhADe nAla vAadA kItA jA rihA hai, kI uha dUra hai jAM ner3e?
bezakka allAha sapazaTa ate khullhIAM gallAM nUM vI jANadA hai ate jo tusIM gupata rakkhade ho usa nUM vI jANadA hai|
mainUM isa dA kujjha vI giAna nahIM, ho sakadA hai ki iha (az2Aba vica derI) tuhAnUM parakhaNa laI ate ika mithe sameM laI tuhAnUM (jIvana dA) AnaMda mAnaNa laI hovee|
(nabI ne kihA) he mere rabba! inasAfa nAla faisalA kara| sADA rabba sADe laI atiaMta mihabAna hai| (he kAfiro!) jihar3IAM gallAM tusIM karade ho uhanAM laI uhI madada maMgaNa de yoga hai|
he loko! ApaNe rabba toM Daro| nirasaMdeha, kiAmata dA bhucAla bahuta hI vaDDI (DarAuNa vAlI) cIz2a hai|

jisa dina tusIM vekhoge ki hara duddha piAuNa vAlI ApaNe duddha pIMde bacce nUM bhulla jAvegI ate garabhavatIAM garabhapAta ho jANagIAM ate tusIM lokAM nUM naze vica madahoza vekhoge jadoM ki uha naze vica nahIM hoNage, paraMtU allAha dA az2Aba bar3A hI karar3A hovegA|
kujjha lokI uha vI hana jihar3e allAha bAre binAM giAna toM bahisAM (vAda-vivAda) karade hana ate hara bAg2I zaitAna de picche laga jAMde hana|
ajihe lokAM laI likha dittA giA hai ki je koI uhanAM lokAM dA sAtha devegA uha (zaitAna) usa nUM gumarAha kara devegA ate usa nUM agga de az2Aba (naraka) valla lai jAvegA|

he loko! je tuhAnUM marana magaroM mur3a jIvita hoNa bAre koI zakka hai tAM tuhAnUM patA hoNA cAhIdA hai ki bezakka asIM (AraMbha vica) tuhAnUM miTTI toM sAjiA hai phera vIraja toM, phera jamme hoe qhUna toM, phera mAsa dI boTI [1] toM jihar3A rUpamAna vI huMdI hai te rUpahINa vI (iha asIM isa laI dassa rahe hAM) tAM jo asIM tuhADe ’te (ApaNI kudarata) sapazaTa kara daIe| asIM jisa (vIraja) nUM vI cAhIe ika mithe hoe sameM laI garabhAM vica rakkhade hAM phera tuhAnUM ika bacce de rUpa vica kaDDha liAuMde hAM tAM jo tusIM ApaNI javAnI nUM pujjo| tuhADe viccoM kujjha nUM (buDhApe toM pahilAM hI) vApasa bulA liA jAMdA hai ate kujjha ati bhair3I umara (buDhApe) valla phera ditte jAMde hana ki uha jANade hoe vI kujjha nahIM jANade huMde| (ise prakAra) tusIM vekhade ho ki dharatI baMjara te sukkI paI hai| phera jadoM asIM usa (dharatI) ’te mIMha barasAuMde hAM tAM uha upajAU ho jAMdI ru ate usa vica hareka tarhAM dI sohaNI disaNa vAlI banasapatI kaDDhI jAMdI hai|
translations.footnotes: [1] hadIsa toM vI isa dI puzaTI huMdI hai| allAha de rasUla ne faramAiA ki tuhADe viccoM hara viakatI ApaNI mAM de garabha vica pahilAM 40 dina takka viraja de rUpa vica rahiMdA hai phera uha 40 dina takka jamme hoe qhUna dA rUpa lai liMdA hai| phera uha 40 dina takka gozata dA lothar3A baNa ke rahiMdA hai phera allAha usa vala ika farizatA bhejadA hai ki uha usa de laI cAra gallAM likha deve so uha usa de karama, usa dI mauta dA samAM, usa dA riz2aka ate iha ki uha bhAgAMvAlA hai jAM maMdabhAgA likha diMdA hai| phera usa de sarIra vica AtamAM pAI jAMdI hai, ise laI koI AdamI narakIAM jihe kaMma karadA rahiMdA hai ithoM takka ki usa de ate naraka vicAle ika hattha jiMnhI dUrI rahi jAMdI hai| para usa de mukaddara vica likhiA hoiA bhArU ho jAMdA hai ate uha jaMnatIAM varage kaMma karake jaMnata vica caliA jAMdA hai| iMja hI ika viakatI jaMnatI jihe kaMma karadA rahiMdA hai ki usa de ate jaMnata vicAle ika hattha dI dUrI rahi jAMdI hai para usa utte mukaddara bhArU ho jAMdA hai ate uha narakIAM jihe kaMma karana gala jAMdA ate naraka vica caliA jAMdA hai| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 3332)

translations.translation: (iha sabha) isa laI varaNana kItA jA rihA hai (tAM jo tusIM jANa lao) ki bezakka allAha hI hakka (sati) hai, bezakka uhI muradiAM nUM jiUMdA karadA hai ate uha hareka zaia utte kudarata rakkhadA hai|
nirasaMdeha, kiAmata AuNa vAlI hai, isa de AuNa vica koI zakka nahIM ate allAha kabarAM vAliAM (bhAva muradiAM) nUM z2arUra uThAvegA|
kujjha loka uha vI hana jihar3e allAha pratI binAM kise giAna, binAM kise hidAita ate binAM rAha vikhAuNa vAlI kitAba toM vAda-vivAda karade hana|

jihar3A ghamaMDa [2] vica A ke hakka dI aNa-dekhI kare tAM jo (lokAM nUM) allAha dI rAha toM kurAhe pAve, usa nUM isa dunIAM vica vI rusavAI milegI ate kiAmata vAle dina asIM usa nUM naraka vica jalaNa dA suAda cakhAvAMge|
translations.footnotes: [2] isa toM bhAva takabarra jAM ghamaMDa dA pragaTAvA karanA hai jo ki allAha nUM nA pasaMda hai| hadIsa vica nabI (sa:) ne faramAiA ki jisa viakatI de dila vica ratA bhara vI vaDiAI hovegI uha jaMnata vica nahIM jAvegA| ika sahAbI ne pucchiA ki ika viakatI cAhuMdA hai ki usa dA libAsa te jutte vadhIA hoNa tAM kI iha vI takabbara hai| Apa (sa:) ne faramAiA ki allAha sohaNA hai ate sohaNIAM cIz2AM nUM hI pasaMda karadA hai| takabbara tAM iha hai ki AdamI hakka sacca toM kannI katarAve ate dUjiAM nUM hINA samajhe| (sahI musalima, hadIsa: 91)

translations.translation: (kihA jAvegA ki) iha (az2Aba) usa (dIAM karatUtAM) de badale vica hai, jihar3A usa ne ApaNe hatthIM agge bhejiA hai| sacca jANoM ki allAha ApaNe baMdiAM utte z2ulama karana vAlA nahIM|

kujjha ajihe vI loka hana jihar3e (zakka de) kaMDe ’te rahi ke allAha dI baMdagI karade hana, je koI lAbha mila giA tAM saMtuzaTa ho jAMde hana, je koI musIbata A jAve tAM use sameM (isalAma toM) mUMha mor3a laiMde hana| uhanAM dA dunIAM vica vI ate Aqhirata vica vI ghATA hovegA| iho asalI ghATA hai|
uha allAha nUM chaDDa ke uhanAM nUM (madada laI) pukAradA hai, jihar3A nA usa nUM lAbha de sakaNa ate nA hI nukasAna kara sakaNa| iho asalI gumarAhI hai|
uha use nUM (ApaNIAM lor3AM laI) pukAradA hai, jisa dA nukasAna usa de lAbha nAloM bahutA ner3e hai| usa dA sAIM bahuta hI bhair3A hai| bezakka ajihA sAthI bahuta hI bhair3A hai|
bezakka allAha ImAna liAuNa vAle lokAM nUM ate neka kaMma karana vAliAM nUM uhanAM jaMnatAM vica dAqhala karegA jinhAM heTha nahirAM vagadIAM hoNagIAM| bezakka allAha jo cAhuMdA hai uhIo karadA hai|

jihar3A koI iha socadA hai ki allAha usa rasUla dI madada loka praloka vica nahIM karegA usa nUM cAhIdA hai ki uha (ika rassA ApaNe gale vica pA lave ate) akAza vica car3ha jAve te usa rassI nUM kaTTa deve, phera vekhe kI usadA iha upAa usa de gusse nUM dUra karadA hai?
asIM kuraAna dIAM AitAM nUM sapazaTa karake utAriA hai jisa nUM allAha cAhave use nUM hidAita nasIba huMdI hai|

bezakka jihar3e lokI ImAna liAe, jAM jihar3e yahUdI, sAbI (adharamI), IsAI, majUsI (agga pUjaNa vAle) jAM muzarika baNa gae (bhAva uha koI vI hove) bezakka allAha uhanAM sabhanAM vicAle kiAmata dihAr3e faisalA kara devegA| allAha tAM hara hara cIz2a dA gavAha hai|[3]
translations.footnotes: [3] vekho sUrata ala-bakaraha, hAzIA Aita 62/2

translations.translation: kI tusIM nahIM vekhade ki allAha de agge hI sabha dharatI vAle ate akAza vAle sIsa jhukAuMde hana ate usa de nAla hI sUraja, caMna tAre, pahAr3a, rukkha ate jAnavara ate bathere manukkha vI sIsa jhukAuMde hana| uhanAM vica uha vI hana jinhAM laI az2Aba dA hoNA taia ho cukkiA hai| jisa nUM rabba hI z2alIla kara deve usa nUM koI iz2z2ata deNa vAlA nahIM, allAha jo cAhuMdA hai uhIo karadA hai|
iha do dhira (kAfirAM te mominAM de) hana, jihar3e ApaNe rabba bAre jhagar3a rahe hana| kAfirAM laI tAM agga de vasatara kaTTe jANage ate uhanAM de sirAM ’te ubbaladA hoiA pANI DolhiA jAvegA|
jisa nAla uhanAM de DhiDAM de aMdaroM sabha kujjha gala jAvegA ate uhanAM dI camar3I vI gala jAvegI|
uhanAM (narakIAM) nUM mArana laI lohe de thaur3he hoNage|
jadoM uha utthioM (naraka vica) ghabarA ke nikkalaNa dI koziza karanage, mur3a utthe hI dhakka ditte jANage ate kihA jAvegA ki huNa lavo sAr3aNa vAle az2Aba dA suAda|

bezakka ImAna vAliAM nUM ate neka kaMma karana vAliAM nUM allAha uhanAM savaragAM vica dAqhala karegA jinhAM heTha nahirAM vagadIAM hoNagIAM, jitthe uhanAM nUM sone de kaMgaNa pahiNAe jANage ate utthe uhanAM dA libAsa rezama dA hovegA|
saMsAra vica uhanAM lokAM nUM pavittara gallAM (kalamA-e-tauhIda kabUlana) dI hidAita baqhazI gaI ate salAhe hoe allAha dA rAha vikhAiA giA|

jinhAM lokAM ne (rabbI hidAita dA) inakAra kItA, uha lokAM nUM allAha dI rAha toM ate pAka masIta (qhAnA-kAabA) toM rokade hana, jisa nUM asIM sAre jahAna de lokAM laI baNAiA hai| utthe (makke) de vasanIka hoNa jAM bAharo AuNa hoNa, uhanAM sabha dA adhikAra ika barAbara hai| jihar3A vI utthe (qhAnA-kAabA) vikhe z2ulama karana de irAde nAla koI bhair3e kaMma karegA asIM usa nUM daradanAka az2Aba dA suAda cakhAvAMge|

ate (yAda karo) jadoM asIM ibarAhIma laI kAabe dI thAM nUM niyata kItA sI, (ate hukama dittA sI ki) mere nAla kise nUM zarIka nahIM karanA ate mere ghara (qhAnA-kAabA) nUM tavAfa (parikramA) karana laI, namAz2a, rukUa te sijadA karana vAliAM laI pavittara rakkhaNA|
(ate Adeza dittA) ki lokAM vica hajja karana laI munAdI kara dio, lokI tere kola (dUra-dUra toM) paidala vI AuNage ate kamaz2ora UThAM ’te savAra ho ke vI AuNage|[4]
translations.footnotes: [4] isa vica hajja karana dA hukama dittA giA hai| hajja dI atiaMta mahattatA hai jiveM ki ika hadIsa vica allAha de rasUla ne faramAiA ki jisa ne vI allAha de laI usa de ghara qhAnA kAabA dA hajja kItA nA tAM usa ne ApaNI patanI nAla sarIrika saMbaMdha baNAe nA koI hora pApa kItA tAM uha usa bacce vAMga pavittara hai jisa ne huNe huNe janama liA hove| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 1819)

translations.translation: tAM jo uha ApaNe (loka-paraloka dA) lAbha prApata karana laI (khAnA kAabA vica) hAz2ara hoNa ate nizacita dinAM vica uhanAM pazUAM te z2ibaha karade sameM allAha dA nAM laiNa jihar3e allAha ne unhAM nUM ditte hana| phera tusIM Apa vI uhanAM (pazUAM) dA mAsa khAo ate hareka bhukkhe phakIra nUM vI khavAo|

phera (kurabAnI karana magaroM) ApaNe maila kucaila nUM dUra karo (bhAva vAlAM nUM ate nohAM nUM kaTavAo) ate ApaNIAM sukkhaNA pUrIAM karo ate allAha de sabha toM purANe ghara (qhAnA-kAabA) dA tavAfa karo|[5]
translations.footnotes: [5] vekho sUrata ala-mAidA, hAzIA Aita 32/5

translations.translation: iha (hukama) uhanAM laI ru jihar3e allAha dIAM niyata kItIAM hoIAM pAbaMdIAM dA satikAra karade hana, uhanAM laI uhanAM de rabba kola vadhIA badalA hai| tuhADe laI cAra pairAM vAle pazU jAiz2a (halAla) kara ditte, chuTTa uhanAM toM jinhAM bAre tuhAnUM dassiA jA cukkiA hai| so tusIM mUratIAM dI gaMdagI toM baco ate jhUThIAM gallAM toM parahez2a karo|

allAha de laI ika ho jAo usa de saMga kise nUM sAMjhI nA baNAo| jihar3A koI allAha nAla kise nUM zarIka karegA, iMja samajho jiveM uha akAza toM Diga piA hove, phera usa nUM bhAveM paMchI jhapaTA mAra ke lai jANa jAM havA kise dUra thAM lijA suTTe|
iha hukama usa laI hai jihar3A allAha dIAM mithIAM hoIAM nizAnIAM dA Adara karadA hai| bezakka isa dA saMbaMdha dilAM dI pAkIz2agI nAla jur3hiA hoiA hai|

tuhADe laI ihanAM (pazUAM) vica ika qhAsa sameM laI lAbha hai (bhAva uhanAM toM duddha, savArI dA lAbha ate unna Adi lai sakade ho) ate uhanAM nUM z2ibaha (kurabAnI) karana dI thAM use purAtaNa ghara (qhAnA kAabA) de kola hai|

asIM hara ummata laI kurabAnI karana de tarIke mukarrara kIte hana ki uhanAM cAra pairAM vAle jAnavarAM utte, jihar3e jAnavara allAha ne hI uhanAM nUM baqhaze hoe hana, (z2ibaha karade sameM) allAha dA nAM liA jAve| tuhADA sabha dA ika hI izaTa hai tusIM use de AgiAkArI baNo| (he nabI!) tusIM nimaratA dhArana karana vAliAM nUM (rabba dI raz2A dI) qhuzaqhabarI suNA dio|

jadoM rabba dI caracA kItI jAMdI hai tAM uhanAM de dila kaMba jAMde hana| jadoM uhanAM nUM koI musIbata AuMdI hai usa ’te sabara karade hana, namAz2AM kAima karade hana ate jo vI asIM uhanAM nUM (dhaMna-daulata) baqhaziA hai, usa viccoM qharaca karade hana|

kurabAnI de UThAM nUM asIM tuhADe laI allAha dIAM nizAnIAM vajoM niyata kItA hai| isa vica tuhADe laI (kaI) lAbha hana| so uhanAM (UThAM) nUM (kurabAnI karade sameM) khar3A karake uhanAM ’te allAha dA nA lavo, phera jadoM uha dharatI ’te Tika jANa tAM tusIM uhanAM dA mITa Apa vI khAo ate masakInAM, nA-maMgaNa vAliAM ate maMgaNa vAliAM nUM vI khuvAo| isa tarhAM asIM (allAha ne pazUAM nUM) tuhADe adhIna kara chaDDiA hai tAM jo tusIM (rabba dA) zukara karoM|
