allAha kola nA tAM uhanAM kurabAnI de jAnavarAM dA mAsa (gozata) pahuMcadA hai ate nA hI qhUna, usa kola tAM tuhADI parahez2agArI pahuMcadI hai| isa laI allAha ne uhanAM (kurabAnI vAle) jAnavarAM nUM tuhADe adhIna kara chaDDiA hai tAM jo tusIM allAha dI vaDiAI biAna karo ki usa ne tuhAnUM hidAita dittI hai| (he nabI!) neka amala karana vAliAM nUM (jaMnata) dI qhuzaqhabarI suNA dio|
bezakka allAha ImAna vAliAM dA (vairIAM toM) bacAo karadA hai| allAha kise vI qhAina (herA-pherI) karana vAle nUM ate nA-zukare nUM pasaMda nahIM karadA|

jinhAM musalamAnAM nAla kAfirAM valloM lar3AI kItI jAMdI hai uhanAM nUM (jaMga karana dI) chUTa dittI jAMdI hai kiuM jo uhanAM utte z2ulama ho rihA hai| bezakka allAha uhanAM dI sahAitA karana dI samarathA rakkhadA hai|

iha uha loka hana jinhAM nUM uhanAM de gharoM aNa-hakkA kaDDhiA giA kevala iha kahiNa ’te ki sADA mAlika allAha hai| je allAha ika (z2Alama) nUM dUje z2Alima rAhIM (sattA toM) parAM nA karadA tAM dharama sathAna giraje masItAM ate yahUdIAM de dharama sathAna ate uha sArIAM masItAM vI DhAha dittIAM jAMdIAM jinhAM vica allAha dA simarana vaddha toM vaddha kItA jAMdA hai| jihar3A vI usa (de dIna isalAma) dI madada karegA, allAha z2arUra hI usadI madada karegA| bezakka allAha atiaMta z2orAvara hai|

iha uha loka hana ki je asIM uhanAM nUM dharatI utte sattA baqhaza daIe tAM uha namAz2a kAima karanage,[6] z2akAta deNage ate bhale kaMmAM dA hai kama deNage te bhair3e kaMmAM toM rokaNage| sAre hI kaMmAM dA badalA allAha de adhikAra vica hai|
translations.footnotes: [6] namAz2a kAima karana toM bhAva iha hai ki namAz2a hara musalamAna marada hove jAM auaurata utte faraz2a hai ki uha dina vica paMja namAz2AM niyata sameM anusAra adA kare| nabI (sa:) ne faramaiA ki jadoM tuhADe bacce satta sAla de ho jANa tAM unhAM nUM namAz2a par3haNa laI hukama dio ate jadoM dassa sAla de ho jANa tAM namAz2a nA par3hana utte unhAM nUM saz2A dio| (abu dAUda, hadIsa: 495) ● nabI (sa:) ne iha vI faramAiA ki namAz2a isa tarhAM par3ho jisa tarhAM tusIM mainUM namAz2a par3hade hoe vekhade ho| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 7246

translations.translation: (he muhaMmada sa:!) je iha loka tuhAnUM (rabba dA rasUla) nahIM maMnade tAM isa toM pahilAM nUha dI kauma ate Ada te samUda dI kauma ne vI ApaNe ApaNe nabIAM nUM jhuThalAiA hai|
ate ibarAhIma ate lUta dI kauma ne vI iMja hI kItA sI|

ate madayana dI kauma ate mUsA dI kauma vI (ApaNe nabIAM nUM) jhuThalA cukkI hai| pahilAM tAM maiMne kAfirAM nUM kujjha sameM laI chUTa dittI hai phera uhanAM nUM phar3a liA so (vekhaNA) ki merA az2Aba kiho jihA sI|

kaI basatIAM ajihIAM hana jinhAM nUM asIM halAka kara dittA kiuM jo uha z2ulama karadIAM sana| ajja uhanAM (de gharAM dIAM) chattA DigIAM paIAM hana ate kiMne hI khUha beAbada pae hana ate kiMne hI maz2abUta mahila ujjar3e pae hana|

kI iha (kAfira) loka dharatI utte ghuMme-phire nahIM ki uhanAM de dila (dimAg2a) huMde jinhAM rAhIM uha samajhade jAM kaMnAM toM hI iha (kisse) suNa laiMde| asala galla iha hai ki kevala akkhAM toM hI koI aMnhA nahIM huMdA sagoM uha dila vI aMne ho jAMde hana jihar3e sInIAM vica hana|

ate (he nabI! iha z2Alama loka) tuhAthoM az2Aba vica chetI dI maMga kara rahe hana| allAha kade vI ApaNe vacana nahIM badaladA (bhAva az2Aba Ake rahegA)| hAM! iha galla vakkharI hai ki tuhADe rabba kola ika dina hI tuhADI giNatI de ika haz2Ara sAla varagA haiai|
kiMnIAM hI (z2Alama) basatIAM nUM asAM Dhilla dittI jadoM ki uha z2Alama sana| phera asAM uhanAM nUM phar3a liA| AuNA tAM mur3a mere hI kola hai|
(he muhaMmada sa:!) Akha dio! ki maiM tAM tuhAnUM khullhama-khullhA (rabba de az2Aba toM) DarAuNa vAlA hAM|
so jo loka ImAna liAe te neka kaMma karade hana, uhanAM laI baqhaziza ate mAna sammAna vAlI roz2I hai|
jihar3e lokI sAnUM bevasa karana laI sADIAM nizAnIAM dI heThI karana vica lagge rahiMde hana (bhAva hukamAM dI ulaMghaNA karade hana), uhI narakI hana|

(he nabI!) asIM tuhAthoM pahilAM jo vI paig2aMbara te nabI bheje ate jadoM vI uha (rabbI kalAma dI) talAvata karade (bhAva par3hade) tAM zaitAna ApaNe valloM koI nA koI vighana pA diMdA, para allAha zaitAna valloM pAe hoe vighana nUM miTA diMdA| iMja allAha ApaNI kahI hoI galla nUM pakkI karadA hai, kiuM jo allAha hikamatAM vAlA hai, hara prakAra dI qhabara rakkhadA hai|

iha isa laI huMdA hai tAM jo zaitAna valloM pAI jANa vAlI qharAbI nUM allAha uhanAM lokAM nUM az2amAuNa dA sAdhana baNA sake, jinhAM de manAM vica (kufara dA) roga hai ate jinhAM de mana khoTe hana, uhIo z2Alama loka (hakka de) virodha vica kAfI agge jA cukke hana|

tAM jo jinhAM lokAM nUM giAna dittA giA sI uha jANa laiNa ki iha (nabI te.kuraAna) rabba valloM hakka ’te AdhArita hai| je uha ImAna liAuNa tAM uhanAM de dila isa (hakka) valla jhuka jANage| bezakka allAha ImAna vAliAM nUM siddhI rAha valla sedha diMdA hai|
kAfira isa vahI (.kuraAna) vica sadA zakka karade rahiNage itthoM taka ki acaNaceta uhanAM ’te kiAmata A khar3I hovegI jAM ika manahUsa dihAr3e dA az2Aba A jAvegA|
usa dina pAtazAhI kevala allAha dI hI hovegI uhIo uhanAM de (karamAM dA) faisale karegA, ImAna te neka kaMma karana vAliAM nUM niamatAM bharIAM jaMnatAM milaNagIAM|
ate jinhAM ne kufara kItA ate sADIAM AitAM (.kuraAna) nUM jhUTha samajhiA, uhanAM laI z2alIla karana vAlA az2Aba hai|

jinhAM lokAM ne allAha dI rAha vica ApaNA ghara bAra chaDDiA, uhanAM nUM katala vI kItA giA jAM mara gae, uhanAM nUM allAha bahuta hI vadhIA roz2I deNa vAlA hai| bezakka allAha sabha toM vadhIA riz2aka deNa vAlA hai|
allAha (uhanAM nUM) ajihI thAM z2arUra hI dAqhala karegA jisa toM uha rAz2I (saMtuzaTa) ho jANage bezakka allAha sahiNazIlatA bhariA giAna rakkhadA hai (bhAva saz2A deNa vica chetI nahIM karadA)|

ThIka galla iha hai ki jekara koI viakatI unnA hI badalA lave jinnA usa nAla dhakkA hoiA hai (tAM ThIka hai) para je vadhIkI kare tAM allAha Apa hI (usa maz2alUma) dI madada karegA| bezakka allAha muAfa karana vAlA te baqhazaNahAra hai|
allAha rAta nUM dina vica ate dina nUM rAta vica dAqhala karadA hai| allAha sabha kujjha vekhadA te suNadA hai|
bezakka allAha hI hakka hai ate isa toM chuTTa jisa nUM vI uha (madada laI) pukArade hana uha sabha jhUThe hana, bezakka allAha hI sabha toM vaddha vaDiAI vAlA hai|
kI tusIM nahIM vekhade ki allAha akAza toM (baMjara dharatI ’te) pANI barasAuMdA hai, isa rAhIM dharatI harI bharI ho uThadI hai, bezakka allAha hara galla nUM barIkI nAla jANadA hai|
akAzAM ate dharatI vica jo kujjha vI hai sabha use dA hI hai ate bezakka allAha uhanAM sArIAM cIz2AM toM beparavAha te salAhiA hoiA hai|

kI tusIM nahIM vekhade ki allAha ne dharatI dIAM sArIAM cIz2AM tuhADe adhIna kara chaDDIAM hana, kazatIAM use de hukama nAla pANI vica caladIAM hana, akAza nUM vI use ne sAMbhiA hoiA hai ki uha dharatI utte usa dI AgiA binAM nA Digge| bezakka allAha lokAM nAla miharabAnIAM sadake naramIAM karadA hai|
ate tuhAnUM jIvana vI use ne baqhaziA hai ate uhI tuhAnUM mauta devegA, phera tuhAnUM (kiAmata dihAr3e) mur3a jIvita karegA| para manukkha (rabba de ahisAnA dI) nA-zukarI karadA hai|

hara ummata laI asIM ibAdata karana dA ika vizeza tarIkA niradhArata kItA hai ate uha sAre usa ’te amala karade hana| so (he nabI!) uhanAM (kAfirAM) nUM uhanAM gallAM vica tuhADe nAla jhagar3aNA nahIM cAhIdA, tusIM lokAM nUM ApaNe rabba valla bulAo, bezakka tusIM siddhI rAha utte ho|
je phera vI iha kAfira tuhADe nAla ulajhade hana tAM (he nabI!) tusIM kahi dio ki allAha tuhADIAM karatUtAM toM bhalI-bhAMta jANU hai|
bezakka kiAmata dihAr3e allAha uhanAM sArIAM gallAM dAM nipaTArA kara devegA, jihar3IAM gallAM vica tusIM mata bheda kara rahe hana|

kI tusIM (he nabI!) nahIM jANade ki akAzAM te dharatI dI hara ika cIz2a allAha de giAna vica hai ate iha sabha kujjha ika likhI hoI kitAba vica daraja hai| iha kaMma allAha laI tAM bahuta hI AsAna hai|
iha (muzarika) allAha nUM chaDDa ke uhanAM dI pUjA karade hana jisa de laI koI rabbI dalIla nahIM ate nA hI uhanAM nUM isa dA koI giAna hai| z2AlamAM dA koI vI madadagAra nahIM|

jadoM uhanAM (kAfirAM) de sAhamaNe sADe kalAma (.kuraAna) dIAM AitAM dI talAvata kItI jAMdI hai (bhAva par3hIAM jAMdIAM hana) tAM tusIM kAfirAM de cihariAM nUM vigar3ade hoe vekhoge ate iMja laggadA hai ki huNe uha sADIAM AitAM (rabbI kalAma.kuraAna) suNAuNa vAliAM utte hamalA kara deNage| he nabI! uhanAM nUM Akha dio ki maiM tuhAnUM isa toM vI bhair3I qhabara diMdA hai ki uha ika agga hai jisa dA vAadA allAha ne kAfirAM nAla kItA hoiA hai, jihar3I ki sabha toM vaddha bhair3I thAM hai|

he loko! (tuhAnUM samajhAuNa laI) ika udahArana dittI jA rahI hai so tusIM dhiAna nAla suNo| allAha nUM chaDDa ke jinhAM (izaTAM) nUM tusIM (madada laI) pukAra de ho uha ika makkhI vI paidA nahIM kara sakade bhAveM ki uha sAre hI ikaTThe ho jANa| je uhanAM (izaTAM jiveM mUratIAM, kabarAM) toM makkhI koI cIz2a khoha ke lai jAve tAM iha usa toM khoha nahIM sakade| kiMnAM bodA hai uhanAM toM sahAitA maMgaNa vAlA ate kiMnAM bodA hai uha (izaTa), jisa toM madada maMgI jAMdI hai|
uhanAM (muzarikAM) ne allAha dI kadara hI nahIM kItI (jiveM ki usa dA hakka baNadA sI)| jada ki allAha tAM bahuta hI z2abaradasata tAkata rakkhadA hai|
allAha kujjha farizatiAM viccoM ate kujjha manukkhAM viccoM vI ApaNA paig2Ama pacAuNa vAle cuNa laiMdA hai bezakka allAha sabha kujjha vekhadA ate suNadA hai|
uha sabha jANadA hai jo uhanAM de agge hai ate jo uhanAM de picche hai ate sAre kaMma allAha valla hI paratAe jAMde hana|
he momino! (ApaNe rabba de agge hI) jhuko ate sijadA karo ate ApaNe pAlaNahAra dI hI baMdagI karo ate bhale kaMma karade raho tAM jo tuhAnUM safalatA prApata ho sake|

ate tusIM allAha dI rAha vica (jI jAna nAla) jihAda karo jiveM ki jihAda karana dA hakka hai| usa ne tuhAnUM ApaNe dIna (dI sevA) laI cuNa liA hai ate usa ne dIna vica tuhADe laI koI aokhiAI nahIM rakkhI|[7] ApaNe pio ibarAhIma de dIna dI pairavI karo| allAha ne pahilAM vI tuhADA nAM musalima (AgiAkArI) rakkhiA sI ate isa.kuraAna vica vI tuhADA iho nAM hai, tAM jo rasUla tuhADe laI tuhADe utte gavAha hove ate tusIM lokAM utte gavAha hove| so tusIM namAz2a kAima karo, z2akAta adA karo ate allAha (de hukamAM) nUM maz2abUtI nAla phar3IM rakkhio| uhIo tuhADA kAraja sAdhaka hai, ate sabha toM vadhIA kAraja sAdhaka vI uhIo hai ate sabha toM vadhIA sahAika vI uhIo hai|
translations.footnotes: [7] bhAva dIna bahuta hI AsAna hai| nabI (sa:) ne faramAiA ki allAha dA pasaMdIdA dIna uha hai jihar3A siddhA ate AsAna hai| Apa (sa:) ne iha vI faramAiA ki bezakka dIna isalAma bahuta AsAna hai jihar3A koI isa dIna vica saqhatI karegA tAM uha dIna usa laI bhArI ho jAvegA| so tusIM vicakAralI rAha ikhatiAra karo ate caMge amalAM nAla allAha de ner3e ho jAo ate caMge badale dI ummIda rakhade hoe jo tuhAnUM dittA jAve usa te qhuza ho jA ate savere zAma ate rAta de AqharI hisse vica ibAdata karake madada prApata karo| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 39)

translations.translation: bezakka uha ImAna vAle (Aqhirata vica) z2arUra kAmayAba hoNage|
jihar3e ApaNIAM namAz2AM vica Ajaz2I (nimaratA) dhArana karade hana|
jihar3e viaratha gallAM toM dUra rahiMde hana|
jihar3e z2akAta adA karade hana|
jihar3e ApaNe gupata aMgAM dI rAkhI karade hana|
chuTTa ApaNIAM patanIAM toM jAM uhanAM isatarIAM toM jinhAM de uha mAlika hana, phera uhanAM de z2iMme koI gunAha nahIM|
jihar3A viakatI isa toM chuTTa kise hora DhaMga (nAla ApaNI kAmavAsanA pUrI karana) dI icchA rakkhadA hai ajihe loka hI haddoM TappaNa vAle hana|
jihar3e ApaNIAM amAnatAM ate ApaNe vacanAM dI rAkhI karade hana|
jihar3e ApaNIAM namAz2AM dI dekha bhAla karade hana|
iha (sifatAM rakkhaNa vAle hI jaMnata de) vArasa hoNage|
uha usa jaMnate-phiradausa de vArasa hoNage jitthe uha sadA rahiNage|
asAM manukkha nUM miTTI de sata toM paidA kItA|
phera asIM usa nUM ika surakkhiata thAM (mAM de garabha vica) vIraja baNA ke rakkha dittA|

phera asIM use vIraja nUM jaMmiA hoiA qhUna (buttha) baNAiA phera jamme hoe qhUna nUM lothar3A baNAiA, phera isa lothar3e toM haDDIAM baNAIAM, phera haDDIAM ’te mAsa car3hAiA phera usa vica (rUha phUMka ke) ika hora hI rUpa baNA dittA| uha allAha vaDIAM barakatAM vAlA hai jihar3A sabha toM vadhIA racanAhAra hai|[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] vekho sUrata ala-hajja, hAziA Aita 5/22

translations.translation: phera isa (paidA hoNa) toM picchoM tusIM (sAre ika dina) z2arUra hI mara jANa vAle ho|
phera tusIM sAre (mare hoe) loka kiAmata vAle dina mur3a uThAe jAoge|
asIM tuhADe utte sata akAza baNAe| asIM ApaNI baNAIAM hoIAM vasatUAM toM kujjha vI beqhabara nahIM|
asIM ika vizeza mAtarA vica akAzoM pANI utAriA, phera usa (pANI) nUM dharatI vica roka chaDDiA| ate asIM isa nUM alopa vI kara sakade hAM|
ise pANI rAhIM asIM tuhADe laI khajUrAM ate aMgUrAM de bAg2a ugAe, uhanAM vica tuhADe laI bahuta sAre suAdale phala hana, uhanAM viccoM kujjha (phalAM nUM) tusIM khAMde ho|
uha (z2aitUna dA) rukkha jihar3A sInA de pahAr3AM vica paidA huMdA hai, uha khANa vAliAM laI tela te sAlaNa laike ugadA hai|

bezakka tuhADe laI pazUAM vica vI ika sikkhiA hai| jo uhanAM de DhiDDAM vica hai asIM tuhAnUM uha duddha piAuMde hAM| uhanAM pazUAM vica tuhADe laI anekAM hI lAbha hana, uhanAM viccoM kaIAM nUM tusIM khAMde vI ho|
uhanAM (pazUAM) utte ate ber3IAM utte tusIM loka savAra vI huMde ho|

bezakka asIM nUha nUM use dI kauma valla (rasUla baNA ke) bhejiA| uhanAM ne kihA ki he merI kauma! allAha dI baMdagI karo, isa toM chuTTa tuhADA hora koI izaTa nahIM| kI tusIM (allAha toM) nahIM Darade?

usa dI kauma de saradAra, jinhAM ne kufara kItA sI, (kauma nUM) AkhaNa lagge ki iha (nUha) tAM tuhADe jihA hI ika viakatI hai, iha tAM tuhADe utte saradArI karanA cAhuMdA hai| je allAha cAhuMdA tAM kise farizate nUM (nabI baNA ke) bhejadA| asIM tAM ajihI (tauhIda dI) galla ApaNe pio dAde de sameM toM kade suNI hI nahIM|
(ate AkhiA) iha ika manukkha hI tAM hai jisa nUM sudA ho giA hai, tusIM kujjha sameM laI uDIka kara lao (ho sakadA hai ki ThIka ho jAve)|
nUha ne kihA ki he rabbA! tUM merI sahAitA kara, uhanAM ne mainUM jhuThalAiA hai|

asIM usa (nUha) valla ika vahI (paig2Ama) bhejI ki tUM sADI dekha rekha vica sADI vahI (Adeza) anusAra ika ber3I tiAra kara| jadoM sADA hukama A jAve ate taMdUra ubbala pave (bhAva dharatI vica pANI har3a vAMga nikala Ave) tAM tUM hareka bhAMta de jAnavarAM dA ika-ika (nara-madIna dA) jor3A ate ApaNe parivAra nUM isa ber3I vica savAra kara lai| paraMtU usa nUM savAra nahIM karanA, jisa de saMbaMdha vica asIM pahilAM hI faisalA de cukke hAM (bhAva nUha dI patanI jihar3I kAfirAM dA sAtha de rahI sI)| jinhAM ne z2ulama kItA hai, uhanAM bAre mere nAla koI galla nahIM karanI| uha tAM sAre hI Doba ditte jANage|
(ate AkhiA) jadoM tUM (nUha) ate tere sAthI ber3I utte savAra ho jANa tAM kahiNA ki sArIAM tArIfAM te zukarAne usa allAha laI hI hana jisa ne sAnUM z2AlamAM toM mukata karavAiA|
ate kahiNA ki he mere mAlika! mainUM barakatAM vAlI thAM utAra ate tUMhIo sabha toM vadhIA (thAM) utArana vAlA hai|
isa kisse vica vaDDIAM nizAnIAM hana| bezakka asIM hI (lokAM dI) parIkhiA laiNa vAle hAM|
phera asIM uhanAM (nUha dI kauma) magaroM ika hora ummata (kauma) nUM paidA kItA|

asIM uhanAM viccoM hI uhanAM valla ika rasUla ghalliA (iha kahiNa laI) ki tusIM sAre allAha dI hI ibAdata karo, isa toM chuTTa tuhADA hora koI izaTa nahIM| tusIM (rabba de az2Aba toM) kiuM nahIM Darade?

kauma de uha saradAra, jinhAM ne (rasUla) maMNana toM nA kara dittI sI ate paraloka dI mulAkAta nUM jhUTha Akhade sI, uhanAM nUM asIM saMsArika jIvana dI qhuzahAlI vI de chaDDI sI, (kauma nUM AkhaNa lagge) ki iha rasUla tAM tuhADe varagA hI ika manukkha hai| jo tusIM khAMde ho uhanAM cIz2AM nUM iha vI khAMdA hai ate jihar3A pANI tusIM pIMde ho uhIo iha pIMdA hai|
je tusIM ApaNe jihe manukkha de Akhe lagga gae tAM bezakka isa sameM tusIM ghATe vica rahoge|
kI iha rasUla tuhAnUM iha vacana diMdA hai ki jadoM tusIM mara jAoge ate miTTI te haDDIAM ho ke rahi jAoge tAM phera (kabarAM viccoM kaDDha ke) mur3a jIvita kIte jAoge?
jihar3A vacana tuhAnUM dittA jA rihA hai uha pUrA hoNA asaMbhava hai|
iho sADA saMsArika jIvana (hI tAM sabha kujjha) hai, jitthe asIM marade te jiUMde rahiMde hAM ate sAnUM mur3a uThAiA nahIM jAvegA|
uha ika manukkha hI tAM hai jisa ne (allAha) ’te jhUTha jar3a dittA hai, asIM tAM isa dIAM gallAM nUM maMNana vAle nahIM|
nabI ne duA kItI ki he mere rabbA! uhanAM ne mainUM jhuThalAiA hai, so huNa tUM merI madada kara|
allAha ne faramAiA ki iha (kAfira) chetI hI (ApaNIAM karatUtAM laI) pachatAuNage|
aMta baNade hakka anusAra ika tez2a cIka ne uhanAM nUM A nappiA ate asIM uhanAM nUM kUr3A-kacarA baNA ke suTTa dittA| so z2AlamAM laI lAanata hai|
uhanAM toM magaroM asIM hora vI kaI ummatAM (kaumAM) nUM paidA kItA|
nA koI ummata ApaNe mithe sameM toM agge laMgha sakadI hai (bhAva jiUMdI rahi sakadI hai) ate nA hI uha picche rahi sakadI hai (bhAva mara sakadI hai)|

asIM nAlo-nAla rasUla bhejade rahe hAM, jada vI kise ummata kola uhanAM dA rasUla AiA tAM usa (ummata) ne usa nUM jhuThalAiA| asIM ika toM bAada dUjI ummata nUM halAka karade gae ate uha (kaumAM) kevala kahANI baNa ke rahi gaIAM| uhanAM lokAM laI phiTakAra hai jihar3e ImAna nahIM liAuMde|
asIM mUsA ate usa de bharA hArUna nUM ApaNIAM nizAnIAM ate khullhIAM dalIlAM deke bhejiA|
asAM firaauna ate usa de saradArAM valla (mUsA te hArUna nUM) bhejiA, para uhanAM ne haMkAra kItA, uha sarakaza (bAg2I) loka sI|
uha (firaauna ate usa de sAthI) kahiNa lagge ki kI asIM ApaNe hI varage do viakatIAM ’te ImAna liAIe? jadoM ki uhanAM dI kauma sADI g2ulAma hai|
basa phera uhanAM (firaaunIAM) ne uhanAM nUM (rasUla) maMNana toM inakAra kara dittA ate uha vI tabAha hoNa vAliAM viccoM ho gae|
asIM mUsA nUM kitAba (tauraita) vI dittI sI, tAM jo uha loka siddhe rAha utte A jANa|
asIM marIama de puttara (IsA) nUM ate usa dI mAM (marIama) nUM (kudarata dI) ika nizAnI baNAiA ate uhanAM dovAM (mAM ate puttara) nUM uccI pAka thAM ’te ThahirAiA, jitthe cazame vagade sI|
allAha ne faramAiA ki he paig2aMbaro! pAka cIz2AM khAo ate neka kaMma karo, tusIM jo vI kara rahe ho maiM usa toM bhalI-bhAMta jANU hAM|
ate tuhADe sAre (rasUlAM) dI ika hI ummata bhAva dharama hai ate maiM hI tuhADe sabha dA rabba hAM, so maiMtho hI Daro|
kujjha sameM bAada uhanAM ne ApaNe dIna nUM Apo vicAle ToTe-ToTe kara chaDDiA| hara dhar3hA usa vica masata hai jihar3A usa de kola hai|[2]
translations.footnotes: [2] vekho sUrata Ale-imarAna, hAziA Aita 103/3

translations.translation: basa (he nabI!) tusIM vI kujjha sameM laI uhanAM nUM masatI vica rahiNa dio|
kI uha iha samajhade hana ki jihar3A vI asIM unhAM de mAla ate aulAda vica vAdhA kara rahe hAM|
tAM kI asIM uhanAM laI bhalAIAM karana vica chetI kara rahe hAM? iMja nahIM, sagoM iha loka (hakIkata nUM) samajhade hI nahIM|
jihar3e loka ApaNe rabba de gusse toM Darade hana|
ate jihar3e ApaNe rabba dIAM AitAM (.kuraAna) nUM maMnade hana|
ate jihar3e ApaNe rabba nAla kise nUM zarIka nahIM karade|
ate jihar3e (rabba dI rAha vica) jo vI baNadA saradA hai diMde hana uhanAM de dila kaMbade hana ki jANA tAM uhanAM ne ApaNe rabba valla hI hai| [3]
translations.footnotes: [3] allAha de rasUla ne faramAiA ki uha loka jihar3e roz2A rakkhade hana, namAz2a par3hade hana ate z2akAta vI diMde hana uha isa galla toM Dare rahiMde hana ki kIte allAha unhAM de amalAM nUM kabUla hI nA kare| iho loka bhalAIAM karana vica chetI karade hana| (tiramaz2I zarIfa, hadIsa: 3175)

translations.translation: iha uha hana jihar3e nekIAM karana vica chetI karade ate bhalAIAM valla ika dUje toM agge jANa vAle hana|

asIM kise viakatI nUM usa dI himmata toM vaddha (karama karana dI) takalIfa nahIM diMde ate sADe kola ika ajihI kitAba (karamapatarI) hai jo (hareka dA hAla) iMna-biMna dassa devegI| so kise nAla vI koI dhakkA nahIM hovegA|
jada ki uhanAM (kAfirAM) de dila isa (.kuraAna) toM beparavAha hana ate (isa beparavAhI) toM chuTTa hora vI vadhere (bhair3e) kaMma hana jinhAM nUM uha karana vAle hana|
itthoM tIka ki jadoM asIM uhanAM de khAMde pIMde lokAM nUM az2Aba vica phar3AMge phera uha usa sameM roNa pITaNNage|
(uhanAM nUM kihA jAvegA ki) ajja hAe duhAI nA karo, sADe valloM tuhAnUM kujjha vI madada nahIM pahuMcegI|
(kihA jAvegA ki) jadoM sADIAM AitAM tuhADe sAhamaNe par3hIAM jAMdIAM sana tAM tusIM pichale pairIM naTTha jAMde sI|
ghamaMDa karade sI ate isa (.kuraAna) nUM kissA kahANI kahiMde hoe bakavAsa karade sI|
kI uhanAM (kAfirAM) ne kade isa (.kuraAna) ’te soca vicAra kItA hI nahIM? jAM uhanAM kola uha cIz2a A gaI hai jihar3I uhanAM de pio dAdiAM kola nahIM sI AI?
jAM uhanAM ne ApaNe paig2aMbara (muhaMmada sa:) nUM pachANiA hI nahIM isa laI usa de inakArI ho rahe hana|
iha kAfira Akhade hana ki iha (muhaMmada) tAM pAgala hai jada ki uha tAM uhanAM de kola hakka lai ke AiA hai ate uhanAM viccoM bahute tAM hakka nUM nA-pasaMda karade hAM|

je hakka (dharama) hI uhanAM dIAM icchAvA de adhIna ho jAve tAM dharatI, akAza ate uhanAM vicAle dI hareka cIz2a uthala-puthala ho jAve| sacca tAM iha hai ki asIM uhanAM laI nasIhata (bhAva.kuraAna) liAe hAM, para uha ApaNI hI nasIhata toM mUMha mor3ade hana|
(he nabI!) kI tusIM uhanAM toM koI badalA cAhuMde ho, badalA tAM tuhADe rabba valloM hI vadhIA milegA ate uhIo sabha toM vadhIA rAz2ika (badalA deNa vAlA) hai|
(he paig2aMbara muhaMmada sa:!) tusIM tAM uhanAM siddhI rAha valla bulA rahe ho|
praMtU jihar3e lokI Aqhirata ’te vizavAsa nahIM rakkhade uha siddhI rAha toM mUha mor3a laiMde hana|
je asIM uhanAM (inakArIAM) utte miharAM karIe ate uhanAM dIAM takalIfAM dUra kara daIe phera vI uha ApaNI sarakazI ’te ar3e rahiNage ate bhaTake phiranage|
jadoM asIM uhanAM nUM az2Aba de ghere vica phar3hiA sI phera vI iha loka ApaNe pAlaNahAra agge nahIM jhukke ate nA hI nimaratA dhArana kItI|
itthoM tIka ki jadoM asIM uhanAM laI karar3e az2Aba dA bUhA khola dittA tAM use sameM uha nirAza ho gae|
uha allAha hI hai jisa ne tuhAnUM kaMna, akkhAM ate dila dIAM zakatIAM baqhazIAM, para tusIM loka bahuta hI ghaTTa dhaMnavAdI huMde ho|
ate use ne tuhAnUM dharatI ’te phailAiA hai ate use valla tusIM sAre ikaTThe kIte jAvoge|
ate iha (allAha) uhIo hai jihar3A jIvana diMdA hai ate mauta diMdA hai ate rAta te dina dA ulaTa phera use ne hI paidA kItA hai| kI tusIM phera vI nahIM samajhade?
sagoM uhanAM lokAM ne vI uhIo galla AkhI jihar3I uhanAM toM pahilAM de lokAM ne AkhIAM sana|
ki jadoM asIM mara ke miTTI ate haDDI ho jAvAMge, kI phera vI sAnUM (jiUMdA karake) uThAiA jAvegA?
sAthoM vI ate sAthoM pahilAM ate sADe pio dAdiAM toM vI pahilAM toM iho (mur3a jIvita hoNa dA) vAadA huMdA A rihA hai, iha kujjha vI nahIM, iha tAM kevala pahile lokAM de kisse kahANIAM hana|
(he nabI!) tusIM uhanAM toM puccho ki dharatI ate isa dIAM kulla cIz2AM kisa dIAM hana? je tusIM jANade ho tAM dasso?
iha AkhaNage ki iha sabha allAha dI hI (malakIata) hai| tusIM Akho ki phera tusIM nasIhata grahiNa kiuM nahIM karade?
tusIM uhanAM (inakArIAM) toM iha vI puccho ki satto akAzAM dA ate vaDDe arazA dA mAlika kauNa hai?
uha javAba vica AkhaNage ki allAha hI (mAlika) hai| puccho ki phera tusIM (usa toM) Darade kiuM nahIM|

(he muhaMmada!) uhanAM nUM puccho ki uhanAM sArIAM cIz2AM dI pAtazAhI kisa de hattha vica hai jihar3A zarana vI diMdA hai ate jisa varagI zarana koI hora de vI nahIM sakadA| je tusIM jANade ho tAM dasso?
iha sabha iho AkhaNage ki (pAtazAhI dA mAlika) allAha hI hai| uhanAM nUM puccho phera tusIM kisa pAse toM dhokhA khA rahe ho?
asIM uhanAM kola hakka liAe hAM asala vica iho jhUThe hana|

allAha ne kise nUM ApaNI aulAda nahIM baNAiA te nA hI usa varagA koI hora izaTa hai, je koI huMdA tAM hara izaTa ApaNI sAjI hoI cIz2a nUM lai jAMdA ate (isa de laI) hareka dUje ’te car3hAI kara diMdA| allAha uhanAM gallAM toM pAka hai jo uha biAna karade hana|
uha g2aiba (parokha) te hAz2ara (mojUda) dA jANana vAlA hai, uha uhanAM nAloM bahuta uccerA hai jinhAM nUM iha usadI barAbarI diMde hana|
(he nabI!) Akho ki he merA rabbA! je tUM mere huMde uha (az2Aba) vikhAveM jisa dA uhanAM nUM vAadA dittA giA hai|
tAM he meriA rabbA! tUM mainUM uhanAM z2AlamAM vica nA ralAIM|
(he nabI!) nirasaMdeha, uhanAM nAla asIM jihar3e vAadA karade hAM tAM asAM isa galla dI vI kuradarata rakhade hAM ki usa nUM tuhAnUM kara vikhAIe|
(he nabI!) burAI nUM sabha toM vadhIA DhaMga nAla dUra karo| jo kujjha vI iha biAna kara rahe hana, asIM uhanAM sabha nUM caMgI tarhAM jANade hAM|
so tusIM (he nabI!) duA karo ki he mere rabbA! maiM zaitAnAM dIAM ukasAhaTAM toM bacaNa laI terI zarana bhAladA hAM|
ate he mere rabbA! maiM isa galla toM vI terI zarana cAhuMdA hAM ki uha (zaitAna) mere kola AuNa|
praMtU jadoM uhanAM (kAfirAM) viccoM kise nUM mauta AuMdI hai tAM AkhadA hai ki he pAlaNahAra! mainUM vApasa (saMsAra vica) bheja de|

tAM jo maiM ApaNI chaDDI hoI dunIAM vica neka te bhale kaMma kara lavAM| para iMja ukkA hI nahIM hovegA iha tAM kevala ika kahiNa dI galla hai jo uha kahi rihA hai| uhanAM (marana vAliAM) de picche ika par3adA hai jihar3A mur3a jIvita karana vAle dina (kiAmata) taka rahegA|
jadoM bigala bajA dittA jAvegA phera nA tAM koI rizatedArIAM hI rahiNagIAM ate nA hI ika dUje dA (hAla cAla) pucchiA jAvegA|
jinhAM de karamAM de tola bhArI hoNage uhIo safala hoNage|
ate jinhAM dA tola halakA hovegA iha uha hoNage jinhAM ne ApaNA nukasAna Apa hI kItA hovegA ate uha sadA laI naraka vica jANage|
uhanAM de cihariAM nUM agga sAr3egI ate uhanAM dIAM zakalAM bhair3IAM ho jANagIAM|
uhanAM nUM pUcchiA jAvegA, kI merIAM AitAM tuhAnUM nahIM suNAIAM jAMdIAM sI? phera tusIM uhanAM nUM jhuThalA diA karade sI|
(inakArI) javAba vica AkhaNage ki he sADe rabbA! sADI mAr3I kisamata sADe ’te bhArU ho gaI sI, bezakka asIM rAhoM bhaTaka gae sI|
he sADe rabbA! sAnUM isa thAM (naraka) toM bAhara kaDDha (te saMsAra vica bheja), je asIM phera vI (kufara) karIe phera asIM z2Alama hovAMge|
allAha faramAegA ki huNa ise (naraka) vica pae raho ate mere nAla kalAma nA karo|

mere (neka) baMdiAM dI ika jamAata sI, jihar3I iho kihA karadI sI ki he sADe mAlika! asIM ImAna liAe hAM, tUM sAnUM baqhaza de ate sADe utte rahima faramA| tUM sabha toM vaddha miharAM karana vAlA hai|
para tusIM (kAfiro) uhanAM (ImAna vAliAM) dA makhaula karade rahe itthoM tIka ki tusIM mainUM vI bhulA dittA tusIM uhanAM utte hasiA karade sI|
ajja maiMne uhanAM (mominAM) nUM uhanAM de sabara dA badalA (jaMnata) de dittA hai ate uha ApaNI safalatA nUM pahuMcage|
allAha pucchegA ki tusIM dharatI ’te kiMne sAla rahe sI|
uha kahiNage ki ika dina jAM ika dina toM vI ghaTTa (dharatI) utte rahe sI, giNatIkArAM koloM puccha lavo|
allAha faramAegA, phera tAM tusIM utthe (dharatI utte) bahuta hI ghaTTa rahe ho| kAza! tusIM (iha galla saMsAra vica hI) jANa laiMde|
kI tusIM isa qhiAla vica sI ki asIM tuhAnUM aiveM bekAra hI paidA kItA hai ate iha vI ki tusIM sADe valla parate nahIM jAoge?
jada ki allAha dI pAtazAhI hakka hai ate uha sabha toM uccA hai, isa toM chuTTa hora koI izaTa nahIM, uhIo ucce arazAM dA mAlika hai|

jihar3A vI koI allAha de nAla-nAla kise dUje izaTa nUM (madada laI) pukAradA hai, jisa laI usa de kola dalIla vI nahIM, usa dI puccha-giccha karanA rabba de z2iMme hai| bezakka kAfira loka kade vI safala nahIM ho sakade|
he nabI! (duAvAM karade hoe) Akho ki he mere pAlaNahAra! tUM mainUM baqhaza de ate (mere hAla utte) rahima kara, tUM sabha toM vaddha miharAM karana vAlA hai|

iha uha sUrata hai jisa nUM asIM nAz2ila kItA hai ate isa de hukamAM dI pAlaNA karanA (hara momina laI) faraz2a kItA hai ate isa vica asIM sAfa-sAfa AitAM (hidAitAM) utArIAM hana tAM jo tusIM sikkhiA grahiNa kara sako|

z2AnIAM aurata (vibhacAraNa) te z2AnI marada (vibhacArI), uhanAM dohAM viccoM hareka nUM so-so kor3e mAro|[1] je tuhADA allAha te Aqhirata de dihAr3e ’te ImAna hai tAM allAha de dharama (tarIke) ’te amala karade hoe tuhAnUM uhanAM dohAM (z2AnI marada te aurata) ’te ukkA hI tarasa nahIM AuNA cAhIdA| uhanAM nUM saz2A diMde sameM musalamanAM dI ika bhIr3a z2arUra maujUda hoNI cAhIdI hai (tAM jo lokI nasIhata prApata kara sakaNa)|
translations.footnotes: [1] iha saz2A ajihe badakAra marada jAM aurata laI hai jihar3I vivAhita nahIM hai isa de nAla hI Apa (sa:) ne ajihe lokAM laI deza nikAle dI saz2A vI vadhAI hai| jiveM sahI buqhArI hadIsa 6833 vica isa dI viAkhiA kItI gaI hai|

translations.translation: z2AnI puraza dA chuTTa z2AnI jAM muzarika aurata toM hora kise (neka aurata) nAla nikAha nahIM hoNA cAhIdA ate z2AnI aurata dA chuTTa z2AnI marada jAM muzarika marada toM hora (kise neka marada) nAla nikAha nahIM hoNA cAhIdA ate ImAna vAliAM nUM isa toM roka (bhAva harAma kara) dittA giA hai|

jihar3e loka pavittara auratAM utte z2anA dI tuhammata lAuNa phera uha cAra gavAha peza nA kara sakaNa tAM tusIM uhanAM nUM assI kor3e mAro ate uhanAM dI gavAhI kade vI kabUla nA karo, iha tAM jhUThe (nA-faramAna) loka hana|
hAM jihar3e loka isa (kukarama) picchoM taubA kara laiNa ate ApaNe Apa nUM sudhAra laiNa tAM bezakka allAha baqhazaNahAra te rahima karana vAlA |

jihar3e loka ApaNIAM patanIAM utte tuhamatAM (doza) lAuNa ate uhanAM kola ApaNe Apa toM chuTTa hora koI gavAha nA hove tAM ajihI sathitI vica uhanAM viccoM ika viakatI (patI) dI gavAhI iha hai ki uha cAra vAra allAha dI suMha cukka ke Akhe ki uha saccA hai|
ate paMjavI vAra Akhe ki je uha jhUThA hove tAM usa ’te allAha dI fiTakAra hove|
ate aurata saz2A toM iMja baca sakadI hai ki uha cAra vAra allAha dI suMha cukka ke Akhe ki usa dA patI jhUTha boladA hai|
ate paMjavI vAra kahe ki usa utte allAha dA g2az2aba (az2Aba) hove, je usa dA patI saccA hove|
je tuhADe utte allAha dI kripA te usa dIAM miharAM nA huMdIAM (tAM bahuta aukhiAI huMdI) allAha taubA kabUla karana vAlA ate hikamata vAlA hai|

jihar3e lokAM ne (ummata dI mAM haz2arata AizA utte) iha bahutAna (Uja) ghar3hiA sI,[2] uha tuhADe (musalamAnAM) viccoM hI ika TolA hai, (he muhaMmada!) tusIM isa nUM ApaNe laI bhair3A nA-samajho sagoM iha tAM tuhADe hakka vica caMgA hI hai| jisa ne jinnAM (isa ghaTanA vica) bhAga liA, usa ne unnA hI gunAha khaTTiA hai| jisa ne vI isa gunAha dA bhAra cukkiA, usa laI vaDDA az2Aba hai|
translations.footnotes: [2] isa vica usa bahutAna dI galla kItI gaI hai jihar3A nabI (sa:) dI patanI bIbI AizA para munAfikAM valloM ghar3hiA giA sI| iha ghaTanA kisA-e-ifaka de nAM nAla prasiddha hai| jisa dI viAkhiA sahI buqhArI dI hadIsa 4750 vica kItI hai| sUrata nUra dI 11 toM 20 takka dIAM AitAM vica allAha taAlA ne haz2arata AizA nUM isa bahutAna toM barI kara dittA sI|

translations.translation: jadoM tusIM iha (jhUTha) suNiA sI tAM momina maradAM te momina auratAM ne ApaNe mana vica neka gumAna (vicAra) kiuM nahIM kItA ate kiuM nahIM AkhiA ki iha tAM khullama khallA jhUTha (Uja) hai|
uha (isa tuhamata nUM siddha karana laI) cAra gavAha kiuM nahIM liAe? jadoM koI gavAha hI nahIM tAM allAha dIAM naz2arAM vica uhIo jhUThe hana|
(he musalamAno!) je tuhADe ’te dunIAM te Aqhirata vica allAha dIAM miharAM te rahimatAM nA huMdIAM tAM jinhAM gallAM vica tusIM jA pae sI, uhanAM de badale vica tuhAnUM ika vaDDA az2Aba A nappadA|

tusIM ApaNIAM z2ubAnA rAhIM isa jhUTha dI caracA kara rahe sI ate tusIM ApaNe mUMhoM uha gallAM kahi rahe sI jisa dA tuhAnUM vI koI thahu-patA nahIM sI| tusIM tAM isa nUM sadhArana samajhade sI jada ki allAha laI tAM iha bahuta vaDDI galla sI|
(he musalamAno!) tusIM ajihI galla suNade sAre hI iha kiuM nA AkhiA ki sAnUM ajihI jhUThI galla mUMhoM kaDhaNI zobhA nahIM diMdI| he allAha! tUM pAka hai, iha tAM bahuta vaDDA buhatAna hai|
allAha tuhAnUM nasIhata karadA hai ki phera kade vI ajihA kaMma nA karanA je tusIM sacce momina ho|
allAha tuhADe laI ApaNIAM AitAM (Adeza) biAna kara rihA hai ate allAha hI vaDDA jANakAra te hikamatAM vAlA hai|
jihar3e vI loka musalamAnAM vica azalIlatA phailAuNA cAhuMde hana, uhanAM laI dunIAM te Aqhirata vica dukhAM bhariA az2Aba hai| allAha sabha kujha jANadA hai jada ki tusIM kujjha vI nahIM jANade|
je allAha dIAM miharAM te rahimatAM tuhADe utte nA huMdIAM (tAM allAha bahutAna lAuNa vAliAM nUM use sameM saz2A de diMdA) para allAha vaDDA naramI vAlA te miharabAna hai|

he ImAna vAlio! zaitAna dI pairavI nA karo, jihar3A vI usa de picche callegA tAM uha (zaitAna) usa nUM behiyAI (azalIlatAM) ate bure kaMmAM dA hI hukama devegA| jekara tuhADe utte allAha dI kripA te mihara nA huMdI tAM tuhADe viccoM koI vI pAka sAfa nA huMdA| allAha jisa nUM cAhuMdA hai pAka kara diMdA hai ate allAha sabha kujjha suNana vAlA te jANana vAlA hai|

tuhADe viccoM jihar3e vI loka mAla pakkhoM sarade-pujjade hana uhanAM nUM ApaNe sake-saMbaMdhIAM nUM, muthAjAM nUM ate rabba dI rAha vica ghara-bAra chaDDaNa vAliAM (muhAjarAM) nUM sahAitA nA deNa dI kasama nahIM khANI cAhIdI, sagoM muAfa kara deNA ate bhulla jANA cAhIdA hai| kI tusIM nahIM cAhuMde ki allAha tuhADIAM bhullAM nUM muAfa kare? allAha muAfa karana vAlA te miharabAna hai|
jihar3e loka pavittara te bholI-bhAlIAM ImAna vAlIAM auratAM ’te tuhamatAM lAuMde hana uhanAM utte loka-paraloka vica fiTakAra pAI gaI hai ate uhanAM laI vaDDA takar3A az2Aba hai|
jadoM uhanAM dIAM ApaNIAM z2ubAnAM te uhanAM de hattha paira uhanAM de viruddha uhanAM dIAM karatUtAM dI gavAhI deNage jo uha (saMsAra vica) kariA karade sI|
usa dina allAha uhanAM (pApIAM) nUM hakka te inasAfa nAla (baNadA) badalA devegA ate uhanAM nUM patA lagga jAvegA ki allAha hI saccA hai ate uhIo sacca nUM sapazaTa karana vAlA hai|

nA-pAka auratAM nA-pAka maradAM laI hana ate nA-pAka marada nA-pAka auratAM laI hana ate pAka auratAM pAka maradAM laI ate pAka marada pAka auratAM de yoga hana| iha (pAka) loka uhanAM gallAM toM niralepa hana, jihar3IAM gallAM (gaMdI soca vAle) loka Akhade hana| uhanAM (neka lokAM) laI baqhaziza ate iz2z2ata vAlA riz2aka |

he ImAna vAlIo! ApaNe gharAM toM chuTTa parAe gharAM vica udoM taka nA var3o jadoM taka ki tusIM AgiA nA lai lavo ate (jadoM AgiA mila jAve tAM) ghara vAliAM nUM salAma karo| iho tuhADe laI vadhIA galla hai| Asa hai ki tusIM dhiAna rakkhoMge|

je utthe (parAe ghara) tuhAnUM koI nA mile tAM binAM AgiA toM aMdara nA var3o, ate je tuhAnUM vApasa jANa laI AkhiA jAve tAM vApasa mur3a jAo, tuhADe laI iho vadhIA galla hai| tusIM jo vI kara rahe ho allAha usa nUM bhalI-bhAMta jANadA hai|

hAM tuhADe laI ajihe gharAM vica jANa vica koI haraja nahIM, jitthe kise dA nivAsa sathAna nA hove (bhAva sAMjhI jaghA hove) jAM jitthe tuhADe lAbha dI koI cIz2a hove (jiveM hoTala, sarAM jAM kArobArI thAvAM)| tusIM jo vI z2Ahara karade ho ate jo tuhADe (dilAM vica) lukiA hoiA hai uha sabha allAha nUM patA hai|

(he nabI!) tusIM musalamAna maradAM nUM Akho ki uha ApaNIAM naz2arAM nIvIAM rakkhaNa ate ApaNe gupata aMgAM dI hifAz2ata karana, iho uhanAM laI vadhIA galla | jo kujjha vI uha karade hana uha sabha allAha jANadA |

ate musalamAna auratAM nUM Akho ki uha (vI) ApaNIAM naz2arAM nUM nIvIAM karake rakkhaNa ate ApaNI iz2z2ata AbarU (gupata aMgAM) dI hifAz2ata karana, ApaNI qhUbasUratI nUM pragaTa nA hoNa deNa [3] (bhAva libAsa zarIra nUM chapAuNa vAlA pAuNa) chuTTa usa toM jihar3A Apa hI vikhAI diMdA hai (jiveM hattha te ciharA) ate ApaNe sIniAM utte ApaNIAM (vaDDI) caddara dI bukkala mArI rakkhaNa| ApaNe baNAo-ziMgAra (mekaappa) nUM chuTTa ApaNe patI, ApaNe pitA jAM sauharA jAM ApaNe puttara jAM ApaNe patI de (pahile) puttara jAM ApaNe bharA jAM ApaNe bhatIje jAM bhANaje jAM ApaNIAM sahelIAM jAM g2ulAma jAM ajihe naukara jihar3e kise prakAra dI vAsanA nA rakkhade hoNa jAM choTe bacce jihar3e z2anAnIAM dIAM gupata gallAM toM anajANa hoNa, kise hora agge iz2ahAra nA karana, pragaTa nA hoNa deNa ate nA hI dharatI utte dabba dabba ke pairAM nUM mArade hoe callaNa jisa toM uhanAM dA lukiA hoiA banAo ziMgAra dA patA lagge (jiveM gahiNiAM dI avAz2a jAM zarIra dA hilanA Adi)| he musalamAno! tusIM sAre (auratAM te puraza) allAha de haz2Ura taubA karo tAM jo tusIM safalatA prApata kara sako|
translations.footnotes: [3] haz2arata AizA faramAMdIAM hana ki jadoM iha Aita nAz2ila hoI tAM auratAM ne ApaNIAM caddarAM nUM donAM siiraA toM pAr3a ke ApaNe uppara lai laIAM| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 4759)

translations.translation: tuhADe viccoM jihar3e vI puraza te isatarIAM de nikAha nahIM hoe uhanAM de nikAha kara dio ate ApaNe neka Acarana vAle g2ulAma muMDe kur3IAM de vI (nikAha kara dio)| jekara uha g2arIba vI hoNa tAM allAha ApaNe faz2alAM nAla uhanAM nUM amIra baNA devegA| allAha vaDDIAM guMjAizAM vAlA te (hareka de hAla dA) jANanahAra hai|

jihar3e loka nikAha karavAuNa dI himmata nahIM rakkhade, uhanAM nUM cAhIdA hai ki ApaNe Apa nUM pAka rakkhaNa itthoM tIka ki allAha uhanAM nUM ApaNe faz2ala nAla amIra baNA deve| je tuhADe g2ulAma (gole) Az2Ada hoNa laI likhata-par3hata karanA cAhuNa ate je tusIM uhanAM vica koI bhalAI vekho tAM uhanAM nUM likha dio (bhAva Az2Ada kara dio)| allAha ne jihar3A mAla tuhAnUM dittA hai, usa viccoM uhanAM (g2ulAmAM) nUM vI dio| je tuhADIAM golIAM (g2ulAma auratAM) pavittara rahiNA cAhuMdIAM hana tAM tusIM uhanAM nUM saMsArika lAbha laI badakArI karana laI majabUra nA karo, jihar3A vI uhanAM nUM majabUra karegA tAM allAha uhanAM dI majabUrI picchoM vI uhanAM laI vaDDA baqhazaNahAra te miharabAna hai|

bezakka asIM tuhADe (musalamAnAM) laI sapazaTa te sAfa-sAfa darasAuNa vAliAM AitAM (hidAitAM) utArIAM hana ate kujjha uhanAM lokAM de hAlAta hana jo tuhAthoM pahilAM bIta cukke hana| jo burAIAM toM bacaNA cAhuMde hana, ihanAM vica unhAM laI sikkhiAvAM hana|

allAha akAzAM te dharatI dA nUra (hidAita dA sAdhana) hai, usa de nUra dI misAla iMja hai ki jiveM ika AlA hove jisa vica ika carAg2a rakkhiA hove ate iha carAg2a kise fAnUsa vica hove ate fAnUsa isa tarhAM hove jiveM lizakadA hoiA tArA ate uha carAg2a ika barakatAM vAle rukkha z2aitUna (de tela) nAla bAliA giA hove, jisa dI rauzanI nA pUraba valla hai te nA hI pacchama valla| jisa dA tela ApaNe Apa hI bala paiMdA hove, bhAveM usa nUM agga nA vI laggI hove| uha nUra ’te nUra hai| allAha ApaNe nUra (hidAita) valla jisa dI cAhuMdA hai agavAI karadA hai| allAha lokAM nUM (samajhAuNa laI) iha udAharana diMdA hai| allAha hara cIz2a nUM caMgI tarhAM jANadA hai|

(isa nUra toM lAbha uThAuNa vAle) uhanAM gharAM (masItAM) vica milade hana, jinhAM nUM uccA rakkhaNa dA ate uhanAM vica allAha dA nAM japaNa dA allAha ne hukama dittA hai| utthe uha loka rahiMde hana jihar3e savere-zAma (hara vele) allAha dI tasabIha karade hana|[4]
translations.footnotes: [4] ika hadIsa vica allAha de rasUla ne faramAiA ki jadoM tusIM musIta vica dAqhila hovoM tAM baiThaNa toM pahilAM do rakAta namAz2a par3ha laiNI cAhIdI hai| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 444)

translations.translation: ajihe loka jinhAM nUM kArobAra ate qharIda-veca allAha dI yAda ate namAz2a kAima karana ate z2akAta deNa toM bhulA nahIM diMdI, uha usa dihAr3e toM Darade hana, jadoM dila ate akkhAM ulaTA dittIAM jANagIAM|

(uha neka amala isa Asa vica karade hana) tAM jo allAha uhanAM nUM uhanAM de kIte karamAM dA vadhIA badalA deve ate ApaNe faz2ala (kripA) toM kujjha hora vadhA ke deve| allAha jisa nUM vI cAhe behisAba riz2aka nAla nivAz2adA hai|

ate kAfirAM de kaMmAM dI udAharana ika rar3e maidAna vica camakadI hoI reta dI hai| ika piAsA viakatI dUra toM isa (reta) nUM pANI samajhadA rihA paraMtU jadoM usa de ner3e pahuMcadA hai tAM utthe (pINa nUM) kujjha vI nahIM miladA,[5] hAM! allAha nUM z2arUra ApaNe kola vekhadA hai jihar3A usa (kAfira) dA pUrA-pUrA lekhA-jokhA karadA hai| allAha hisAba laiNa vica chetI karana vAlA hai|
translations.footnotes: [5] bhAva kAfira de amala usa piAse viakatI vAMga hana jihar3A ‘sarAba’ vAMga hai jadoM kAfira allAha nUM milegA tAM uha iha vicAregA ki allAha usa nUM ApaNe valoM usa de neka amalAM dA caMgA badalA devegA| para ‘sarAba’ vAMga usa kujha vI nahIM milegA ate usa nUM naraka vica suTTa dittA jAvegA|

translations.translation: jAM kAfirAM de amalAM dI udAharana uhanAM haneriAM vAMga hai jisa nUM ika lahira (pANI dI challa) Dhakka lave isa de uppara ika lahira hora hove, phera uppara toM baddala chA jAve bhAva uppara thalle hanerA hI hanerA vI hove, jadoM uha ApaNA hattha kaDDhe tAM usa nUM vI nA vekha sake| asala galla iha hai ki jisa nUM allAha hI nUra (hidAita) toM nA nivAz2e usa laI (kise pAsioM) koI vI nUra nahIM|

kI tusIM vekhade nahIM ki akAza ate dharatI de vicakAra dI hareka cIz2a, khaMbha pasArIM uDDade hoe paMkha-pakherU allAha dI tasabIha vica rujhe hoe hana| hareka ApaNI namAz2a te tasabIha nUM jANadA hai ate uha jo vI karade hana allAha usa toM bhalI-bhAMta jANU hai|
ate akAzAM te dharatI dA mAlika uhIo allAha hai ate use allAha valla hI (sabha ne) parataNA hai|

kI tusIM nahIM vekhade ki allAha hI baddalAM nUM toradA hai, phera uhanAM nUM ika dUje nAla milAuMdA hai, phera uhanAM nUM uppara thalle kara diMdA hai, phera tusIM vekhade ho ki uhanAM baddalAM viccoM varakhA nikaladI hai| iMja lagadA hai jiveM uhIo akAza toM bhAva ole de pahAr3AM viccoM gar3e barasAuMdA hai| phera uhanAM nUM jitthe cAhuMdA hai Dega diMdA hai ate jitthioM cAhe mor3a laiMdA hai| baddalAM toM nikalaNa vAlI bijalI dI lizaka ajihI huMdI hai ki jiveM akkhAM dI rauzanI hI callI jAve|
allAha hI rAta te dina dA ulaTa phera karadA rahiMdA hai| vekhaNa vAliAM laI tAM isa vica grahiNa karana laI sikkhiAvAM hana|

allAha ne dharatI ’te turana vAle hara jIva-jaMtU nUM pANI toM hI paidA kItA hai uhanAM viccoM koI tAM ApaNe DhiDa parane rir3adA hai kujjha do pairAM ’te turadA hai ate koI cAra pairAM ’te turadA hai| (bhAva) allAha jiveM cAhave uveM paidA karadA hai| nirasaMdeha, allAha hara prakAra dI samarathA rakkhadA hai|
bezakka asAM rauzana rAha vikhAuNa vAliAM ’te sapazaTa AitAM (sikkhiAvAM) uttArIAM hana, para siddhI rAha jisa nUM allAha cAhave, usa nUM vikhAuMdA hai|

ate uha (pakhaMDI) loka Akhade hana ki asIM allAha ate usa de rasUla utte ImAna liAe ate tAbedArI kabUla karade hAM, para magaroM uhanAM viccoM ika dhar3hA mUMha phera laiMdA hai, ajihe loka ImAna vAle nahIM|

jadoM uhanAM nUM isa galla laI bulAiA jAMdA hai ki allAha ate usa dA rasUla (muhaMmada sa:) uhanAM de kise ApasI jhagar3e dA faisalA karana tAM acaNaceta uhanAM viccoM ika dhira mUMha mor3a laiMdI hai|
hAM je faisalA uhanAM de hakka vica hove tAM AgiAkArI baNake A jAMde hana|

kI uhanAM de dilAM vica koI bImArI hai jAM iha kise saMdeha vica hana jAM uhanAM nUM isa galla dA Dara hai ki allAha ate usa dA rasUla uhanAM nAla dhakkA karanage| jada ki iha loka tAM Apa hI z2Alima hana|

ImAna vAliAM dA hAla tAM iha hai ki jadoM uhanAM nUM allAha te usa de rasUla valla saddiA jAMdA hai tAM jo rasUla uhanAM de kise jhagar3e dA faisalA kare tAM uha Akhade hana ki asIM suNiA ate savIkAra vI kItA| ajihe (AgiAkArI) loka hI safalatA prApata karana vAle hana|

jihar3e vI allAha ate usa de rasUla (muhaMmada sa:) dI tAbedArI karanage, allAha dA Dara-qhaufa (manAM vica) rakkhaNage ate usa de hukamAM dI ulaMghanA toM bacaNage uhIo (paraloka vica) kAmayAba hoNage|

iha (munAfika) allAha de nAM dIAM pakkIAM kasamAM cukka-cukka ke Akhade hana ki (he nabI!) je tusIM hukama dio tAM asIM avaza jihAda laI nikalAMge| (he nabI!) uhanAM nUM Akho ki kasamAM nA khAo, tuhADI AgiAkArI dA patA hai, jo vI tusIM (pAkhaMDa) kara rahe ho allAha nUM sabha patA hai|

(he nabI!) uhanAM nUM kahi dio ki allAha de hukamAM dI pAlaNA karo te usa de rasUla (muhaMmada sa:) dI tAbedArI karo, para je tusIM mUMha mor3ade ho (tAM tuhADI icchA) rasUla de z2iMme tAM uhI hai jihar3e kaMma dA usa ’te bhAra rakkhiA giA hai| tuhADe utte jisa kaMma dA bhAra pAiA giA hai usa de z2iMmevAra tusIM ho| hidAhita tAM usa sameM hI milegI jadoM rasUla dI tAbedArI karoge| rasUla de z2iMme tAM kevala (allAha de hukamAM nUUM lokAM tIka visathAra nAla) pahuMcANA hai|

allAha ne tuhADe viccoM uhanAM lokAM nUM vacana dittA hai, jihar3e ImAna liAe hana ate neka kaMma karade hana, ki uhanAM nUM z2arUra hI isa dharatI dI hakUmata milegI, jiveM ki usa ne ihanAM toM pahile lokAM nUM qhalIfA (hAkama) baNAiA sI| uhanAM laI isa dharama (isalAma) nUM pakkIAM nIhAM ’te jamAM devegA jisa nUM allAha ne uhanAM laI pasaMda kItA hai ate uhanAM de Dara-qhaufa nUM amana zAMtI vica badala devegA| basa uha merI baMdagI karanage ate mere saMga kise nUM (baMdagI vica) zarIka nahIM karanage| je koI isa toM bAada vI nA-zukarI kare, phera uha fAsika (jhUThe loka) hana|
tusIM namAz2a nUM kAima rakkho, z2akAta adA karo ate rasUla dI tAbedArI karo tAM jo tuhADe ’te miharAM huMdIAM rahiNa|

(he nabI sa:!) kAfirAM bAre ApaNe mana vica kade vI iha qhiAla nahIM liAuNA ki uha (inakArI) loka dharatI ’te allAha nUM Ajiz2a (bevasa) kara deNage| uhanAM dA asalI TikANA tAM naraka hai, jihar3I bahuta hI bhair3I thAM hai|

he ImAna vAlio! tuhADe ApaNe g2ulAma, golIAM ate uhanAM nUM vI jihar3e aje bAlig2a nahIM hoe tiMna samiAM vica, fajara dI namAz2a toM pahilAM, dupahira vele jadoM ki tusIM kappar3e lAha ke rakkha diMde ho ate izA dI namAz2a magaroM AgiA lai ke tuhADe kola AiA karana| iha tiMno sameM tuhADe laI par3ade de sameM hana| ihanAM samiAM toM chuTTa (je AuNa) tAM nA tuhADe laI nA uhanAM laI koI haraja vAlI galla hai| tusIM sAre Apasa vica ika dUje kola ghar3I-mur3I AuNa jANa vAle ho| isa tarhAM allAha tuhADe laI ApaNe AdezAM nUM sapazaTa karadA hai| allAha pUrana giAna vAlA te hikamatAM vAlA (yukatImAna) hai|

ise prakAra jadoM tuhADe ApaNe bacce vI bAlaga ho jANa tAM jiveM uhanAM de siANe AgiA laike AuMde hana uhanAM nUM vI AgiA laike hI AuNA cAhIdA hai| isa tarhAM allAha ApaNI AitAM (hukama) tuhADe agge biAna karadA hai| allAha hI jANanahAra te hikamatAM vAlA hai|

jihar3IAM isatarIAM bridha ho jANa, viAha dI Asa nA rakkhadIAM hoNa, jekara uha ApaNe (par3ade vAle) kappar3e (caddarAM, burakA Adi) utAra deNa tAM koI gunAha nahIM zarata iha hai ki uha ApaNe hAra ziMgAra dA pragaTAvA karana vAlIAM nA hoNa, je iha (bridha auratAM) ihanAM gallAM toM bacca ke rahiNa tAM uhanAM laI vadhere caMgA hai| allAha sabha kujjha suNadA te jANadA hai|

nA hI kise aMnhe laI jAM laMgar3e laI jAM bImAra laI ate nA hI tuhADe laI koI haraja dI galla nahIM ki bhAveM tusIM ApaNe gharAM vica khAo jA ApaNe pitA de gharoM jAM apANI mAtA de gharoM jAM ApaNe bharAvAM de gharoM jAM bhaiNa de gharoM jAM cAce tAe de gharoM jAM ApaNI bhUA jAM mAme jAM mAsI de gharoM jAM uhanAM gharAM viccoM jinhAM dIAM kuMjIAM tuhADe kola hana jAM apaNe mitarAM de gharoM khAo| tuhADe laI isa vica vI koI haraja nahIM bhAveM rala milake (iko bhAMDe vica) khAo jAM aDDa-aDDa khAo| jadoM tusIM ApaNe gharAM vica jAo tAM ApaNe ghara vAliAM nUM salAma kara liA karo, iha allAha valloM nAz2ila kItI hoI qhairo-barakata (bhalAI) dI duA hai| iMja hI allAha tuhADe samajhaNa laI ApaNIAM AitAM (Adeza) kholha-kholha ke biAna kara rihA hai|

ImAna vAle loka tAM uha hana jihar3e allAha ate usa de rasUla ’te ImAna liAe ate jadoM uha kise samUhika kAraja vica rasUla (sa:) de sAtha huMde hana tAM binAM tuhADI AgiA toM uthiੱoM nahIM jAMde| (he nabI!) jihar3e loka tuhAthoM ijAz2ata maMgade hana iho uha loka hana jihar3e allAha ate rasUla utte ImAna liA cukke hana| so jadoM uha (ImAna vAle) tuhAthoM kise kaMma laI AgiA maMgaNa tAM tusIM uhanAM viccoM jisa nUM cAho AgiA de dio ate uhanAM laI allAha toM baqhaziza dIAM duA maMgiA karo| bezakka allAha baqhazaNahAra hai te miharabAna hai|

(he musalamAno!) tusIM rasUla sa: de bulAve nUM Apo vica ika dUje de bulAve vAMga nA samajha baiTho| allAha uhanAM nUM caMgI tarhAM jANadA hai jihar3e tuhADe viccoM akkha bacA ke khisaka jAMde hana| so jihar3e lokI rasUla de hukamAM dI ulaMghaNA karade hana, uhanAM nUM DaranA cAhIdA hai ki uha kise az2amAiza vica nA phasa jANa jAM uhanAM utte koI daradanAka az2Aba nA A jAve|

qhabaradAra! akAza te dharatI vica jo vI hai uha sabha allAha dA hai| jisa rAha ’te tusIM calla rahe ho uha usa nUM caMgI tarhAM jANadA hai| jisa dina uha usa valla paratAe jANage usa dina uha (allAha) uhanAM de kIte kaMmAM bAre dassegA| allAha hara zaia nUM caMgI tarhAM jANadA hai|
uha z2Ata bahuta hI barakatAM vAlI hai jisa ne ApaNe baMde (muhaMmada) ’te furakAna (.kuraAna) utAriA tAM jo uha sAre lokAM nUM (kiAmata de az2Aba toM) DarAuNa vAlA baNe|

akAzAM te dharatI dI pAtazAhI use (allAha) dI hai| nA hI uha (allAha) ApaNe laI koI puttara rakkhadA hai ate nA hI pAtazAhI vica usa dA koI bhAIvAla hai| usa ne hareka cIz2a nUM paidA kItA te phera ika niyata sameM laI uhanAM dI takadIra baNAI|

uhanAM (muzarikAM) ne allAha nUM chaDDa hora jihar3e izaTa baNA rakkhe hana uha (kise vI cIz2a dI sirajaNA) nahIM kara sakade sagoM uha tAM Apa sAje gae hana| iha tAM Apa ApaNe laI kise nafA-nukasAna karana dA adhikAra nahIM rakkhade ate nA hI jIvana te mauta dA, ate nA hI mur3a jI uThaNA uhanAM de vassa vica hai|

ate kAfira ne kihA ki iha (.kuraAna) tAM nirA jhUTha hai jisa nUM isa (muhaMmada) ne Apa hI ghar3ha liA hai jisa de (ghar3haNa) vica horAM ne vI isa dI madada kItI hai| he nabI! (iha kahi ke) uhanAM ne bahuta hI vaDDe z2ulama ate jhUTha dA aparAdha kItA hai|
(uhanAM ne) iha vI kihA ki iha tAM pichale lokAM de kisse hana, jinhAM nUM usa ne ApaNe laI likhavAe hana| basa uhIo savere-zAma usa de sAhamaNe par3he jAMde hana|
(he nabI!) Akha dio ki isa (.kuraAna) nUM tAM usa ne utAriA hai jihar3A akAza te dharatI dIAM gupata gallAM nUM jANadA hai| bezakka uha vaDDA baqhazaNahAra te rahima faramAuNa vAlA hai|

uhanAM (kAfirAM) ne kihA ki iha kiho jihA rasUla hai jihar3A bhojana vI karadA hai ate baz2ArAM vica turadA phiradA vI hai? isa de saMga koI farizatA kiuM nahIM bhejiA giA ki uha vI isa dA sAthI baNa ke (inakArIAM ate sarakazAM nUM) DarAuMdA|

jAM isa laI koI qhaz2AnA hI utAriA huMdA jAM isa dA koI bAg2a hI huMdA jisa viccoM iha (phala) khAMdA| uhanAM z2AlamAM ne (ImAna liAuNa vAliAM nUM kihA) ki tusIM ajihe AdamI de picche lagga Ture ho jisa ’te jAdU kItA hoiA hai|
(he muhaMmada sa:!) vekho tAM sahi ki iha (kAfira) loka tuhADe pratI kiho jahIAM gallAM baNA rahe hana| uha kurAhe pae hoe ho, huNa uha kise tarhAM vI siddhe rAha nahIM A sakade|

uha (allAha) dI z2Ata vaDDIAM barakatAM vAlI hai| je uha cAhave tAM tuhADe laI ihanAM toM vadhIA cIz2AM baNA deve bhAva ajihe bAg2a baNA deve jinhAM de heTha nahirAM vaga rahIAM hoNa ate tuhAnUM kaI mahila vI de deve|
para uhanAM ne kiAmata nUM jhuThalAiA hai ate asIM usa viakatI laI, jihar3A kiAmata nUM jhuThalAe, bhar3akadI hoI agga tiAra kItI hoI hai|
jadoM uha (naraka dI agga) uhanAM (inakArIAM) nUM dUra toM vekhegI tAM iha lokI usa (agga) dIAM gusse bharIAM te joza mAradIAM AvAz2AM suNa laiNage|
jadoM uha z2aMjIrAM nAla kase hoe usa (naraka) dI kise bhIr3I thAM vica suTTe jANage tAM utthe ApaNI mauta nUM hI hAMkAM mAraNage|
(uhanAM kAfirAM nUM kihA jAvegA) ki ajja ika mauta nA bulAo sagoM kaI sArIAM mautAM nUM pukAro|

(he nabI!) tusIM (uhanAM kAfirAM toM) puccho ki kI iha (naraka) vadhIA hai jAM uha sadA rahiNa vAlI jaMnata jisa dA vAadA parahez2agArAM (neka lokAM) nUM dittA giA hai? uha uhanAM de neka kaMmAM dA badalA hovegA ate uhanAM de rahiNa dA asalI TikANA hai|
isa (jaMnata vica) uhanAM laI uhIo hovegA jisa dI iha (neka loka) icchA karanage| utthe uha sadA rahiNage| iha tuhADe rabba z2iMme uha vAadA hai jihar3A pUrA hoke rahiNA hai|

jisa dina allAha uhanAM (muzarikAM) nUM ate uhanAM izaTAM nUM, jinhAM nUM uha allAha nUM chaDDa ke pUjade sI uhanAM sabha nUM ikaTThA karegA ate (ihanAM toM) pucchegA, kI mere inhAM baMdiAM nUM tusIM kurAhe pAiA sI jAM iha Apa hI kurAhe pae gae sI?

uha (izaTa) uttara deNage ki terI z2Ata pAka hai, sADI iha majAla nahIM sI ki asIM tethoM chuTTa horAM nUM ApaNA (kAraja sAdhaka) baNAuMde| asala galla iha hai ki tUM uhanAM nUM ate uhanAM de pio dAdiAM nUM hara prakAra dI jIvana samaggarI baqhazI, para uha terIAM nasIhatAM nUM bhulA baiThe, phera tAM uhanAM lokAM ne barabAda hoNA hI sI|

(allAha kAfirAM nUM AkhegA ki) uhanAM (izaTAM) ne tAM tuhADIAM sArIAM gallAM dI nikhedI kItI hai| huNa nA tAM tusIM az2Aba nUM TAla sakade ho ate nA hI (kise toM) koI madada lai sakade ho| tuhADe (kAfirAM) viccoM jihar3A vI z2ulama (ziraka) karegA hai asIM usa nUM karar3A az2Aba devAMge|[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] isa Aita toM patA laggadA hai ki ika allAha toM chuTTa hora kise dI ibAdata jAiz2a nahIM, jihar3e kise hora dI ibAdata karegA tAM uha allAha de az2Aba dA hakkadAra hovegA nahIM tAM allAha iMnA miharabAna hai ki uha ApaNe baMdiAM nUM az2Aba deNA pasaMda hI nahIM karadA| ika hadIsa vica hai ki allAha de rasUla (sa:) ne faramAiA “he maAz2a! kI tUM jANadA hai ki allAha dA baMdiAM utte kI hakka hai? maAz2a ne kihA ki allAha ate usa dA rasUla vaddha jANadA hai” Apa (sa:) ne faramAiA ki uha hakka iha hai ki uha usa dI ibAdata karana ate usa de nAla kise hora nUM zarIka nA baNAuNa| phera Apa (sa:) ne faramAiA kI tUM jANadA hai ki baMdiAM dA allAha utte kI hakka hai? haz2arata maAz2a ra:a ne benatI kItI ki allAha ate usa dA rasUla hI vaddha jANade hana “nabI karIma (sa:) ne faramAiA, uha iha hai ki uhanAM baMdiAM nUM az2Aba nA deve| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 7373)

translations.translation: (he nabI!) asIM tuhAthoM pahilAM jiMne vI paig2aMbara bheje sana, uha vI sAre de sAre bhojana karade sana ate baz2ArAM vica turade-phirade sana ate asIM tuhAnUM ika dUje laI parakhaNa dA sAdhana baNAiA hai| kI tusIM (uhanAM kAfirAM dIAM karatUtAM ’te) dhIraja toM kaMma lavoMge? (he nabI! terA rabba sabha kujjha vekhadA hai)|

jihar3e loka sADe nAla (bhAva rabba nAla) milaNa dI Asa nahIM rakkhade uha Akhade hana ki sADe laI farizate kiuM nahIM utAre jAM asIM ApaNe rabba nUM (akkhIM) vekha laiMde (phera ImAna lai AuMde)| uhanAM lokAM ne ApaNe Apa nUM bahuta vaDDA samajha rakkhiA hai ate ise kArana uha sarakazI vI karade hana|
jisa dina iha loka farizatiAM nUM vekha laiNage usa dina uhanAM pApIAM laI koI qhuzI vAlI galla nahIM hovegI| ate uha (farizate) AkhaNage ki tuhADe laI jaMnata harAma kara dittI gaI hai|
ate uhanAM (pApIAM) ne jihar3e vI (vekhaNa vica neka) amala kIte hoNage jadoM asIM uhanAM valla dhiAna diAMge tAM uhanAM nUM dhUr3a vAMga uDA diAMge|
usa (kiAmata) dihAr3e jaMnatIAM laI Thahirana dI vadhIA thAM hovegI ate vadhIA ArAmagAha vica hoNage|
jisa dina akAza baddalAM sameta phaTTa jAvegA ate farizatiAM dIAM DArAM dIAM DArAM (dharatI ’te) utArIAM jANagIAM|
usa dina saccI pAtazAhI kevala rahimAna dI hI hovegI ate uha dina kAfirAM laI bahuta bhArI hovegA|
usa dina hara z2Alama viakatI ApaNe hatthAM nUM bhAva uMgalAM nUM daMdI vaDDegA ate AkhegA ki kAza! rasUla de nAla maiM vI (dIna dI siddhI) rAha phar3I huMdI|[2]
translations.footnotes: [2] isa toM patA laggadA hai ki muhaMmada (sa:) dI rasAlata ’te ImAna rakkhaNA z2arUrI hai, jiveM hadIsa vica vI hai ki muhaMmada (sa:) dI rasAlata utte ImAna nA liAuNa vAlA narakI hai| (sahI musalima, hadIsa: 153)

translations.translation: hAe mere mAr3e bhAga! kAza! maiM phalANe nUM ApaNA mittara nA baNAuMdA|
bezakka usa (mittara) ne hI mainUM gumarAhI vica pAIAM sI jada ki z2ikara (.kuraAna) mere kola A cukkA sI| zaitAna tAM manukkha nUM bipatA vica phasA ke be-sahArA chaDDa deNa vAlA hai|
ate rasUla (kiAmata dihAr3e) AkhegA ki he mere mAlika! merI kauma ne isa.kuraAna nUM piTTha picche suTTa rakkhiA sI|
(he nabI!) asIM tAM ise prakAra hareka nabI dA vairI aparAdhIAM viccoM baNAiA hai ate tuhADA rabba agavAI ate madada karana laI batherA hA|

ate kAfira kahiMde hana ki isa (muhaMmada) utte saMpUran2akuraAna ikko vArI kiuM nahIM utAriA giA? (he nabI!) ajihA isa laI kItA hai tAM jo tuhADA dila maz2abUta rakkhIe (bhAva yAda rakkhaNA te amala karanA AsAna hove)| asIM isa.kuraAna nUM (vizeza krama nAla) Thahira-Thahira ke hI par3ha ke suNAiA hai|
je iha (kAfira) tuhADe kola koI vI udAharana (jAM vicittara prazana) lai ke AuNa tAM asIM (use vele) saccAI ’te AdhArita DhukavAM javAba ate sucajje DhaMga nAla usa dA viAkhaNa dassa diMde hAM|
jihar3e lokI ikaThe karake mUdhe mUMha naraka valla dhakke jANage uhanAM dA TikANA bahuta hI bhair3A hai ate uha ukkA hI bhair3e rAha vAle hana|[3]
translations.footnotes: [3] vekho sUrata banI-isarAIla, hAzIA Aita 97/17

translations.translation: bezakka asIM mUsA nUM kitAba (tauraita) baqhazI ate usa de bharA hArUna nUM usa dA sahAika baNAiA|
asIM uhanAM nUM hukama dittA ki tusIM doveM usa kauma valla jAo jisa ne sADIAM AitAM (hukamAM) nUM jhuThalAiA hai| phera asIM uhanAM lokAM nUM maliAmeTa kara suTTiA|

ate nUha dI kauma ne vI jadoM rasUlAM nUM jhUThA kihA tAM asIM uhanAM sabha nUM Doba dittA ate saMsAra de sAre lokAM laI ika sikkhiAdAika nizAnI baNA dittA| asIM z2AlamAM laI daradanAka az2Aba tiAra kara rakkhiA hai|
Ada, samUda te khUha vAle ate ihanAM de vicakAra dIAM hora bahuta sArIAM kaumAM nUM vI asIM halAka kara cukke hAM|
asIM uhanAM sabha kaumAM nUM (picche barabAda hoNa vAliAM dIAM) udAharaNAM peza kItIAM (tAM jo samajha jANa) aqhIra hareka nUM barabAda karake malIAMmeTa kara dittA|

iha (makke de) loka usa basatI de ner3hio hI laMghade hana jitthe bar3I bhair3I (pattharAM dI) bAriza hoI sI| kI iha phera vI usa nUM nahIM vekhade? saccI galla tAM iha hai ki uhanAM nUM marana magaroM mur3a surajIta hoNa dI Asa hI nahIM|
he nabI! jadoM uha tuhAnUM vekhade hana tAM tuhADA makhaula karade hana (ate kahiMde hana), kI iha iho viakatI hai jisa nUM allAha ne ApaNA rasUla baNA ke bhejiA hai?

iha kAfira tAM iha vI kahiMde hana ki je asIM isa (kufara) ’te ar3e nA rahiMde tAM isa (nabI sa:) ne tAM sAnUM sADe izaTAM toM bahakA deNa vica koI kasara nahIM chaDDI sI| paraMtU jadoM iha az2AbAM nUM vekhaNage tAM uhanAM nUM chetI hI patA lagga jAvegA ki kauNa rAhoM bhaTakiA hoiA hai?
kI tusIM (he nabI!) usa nUM nahIM vekhiA jisa ne ApaNIAM icchAvAM nUM ApaNA izaTa baNA rakkhiA hai? kI tusIM ajihe viakatI dI (siddhe rAha callaNa dI) z2iMmevArI lai sakade ho?
kI tusIM isa qhiAla vica ho ki uhanAM lokAM viccoM bahute loka suNade jAM samajhade hana? iha tAM pazUAM samAna hana sagoM uhanAM toM vI gae guz2are hana|

(he muhaMmada!) kI tusIM nahIM vekhiA ki tuhADe rabba ne parachAveM nUM kiveM phailAiA hai? jekara uha cAhuMdA tAM usa nUM sathira hI kara diMdA| phera asAM sUraja nUM usa (parachAveM) dA AgU baNAiA| (bhAva je sUraja nA huMdA tAM parachAvAM vI nA huMdA)|
phera asIM isa (sUraja) nUM haulI-haulI ApaNe valla sameTa liA (bhAva sUraja nUM Doba dittA)|
ate uhI (allAha) hai jisa ne rAta nUM tuhADe laI par3adA baNAiA ate nIMdara nUM arAma sakUna dA sAdhana baNAiA ate dina nUM uTha khar3e hoNa dA (bhAva jAgaNa dA) velA baNAiA|
ate uhI (allAha) hai jihar3A ApaNI miharAM vAle mIMha toM pahilAM havAvAM nUM qhuzaqhabarI deNa vAlIAM baNA ke bhejadA hai ate akAza toM pavittara pANI vI asIM hI utAriA hai|
tAM jo isa (mIMha) rAhIM muradA ilAke (baMjara dharatI) nUM jiUMdA (upajAU) kara daIe ate asIM isa (pANI) nUM ApaNI maqhalUka (srizaTI) viccoM bahuta sAre jAnavarAM ate manukkhAM nUM piAIe|
ate bezakka asIM isa (mIMha) nUM mur3a-mur3a uhanAM de sAhamaNe liAuMde bhAva barasAuMde hAM tAM jo uha sikkhiA prApata kara sakaNa para phera vI bahute loka nA-zukarI karade hana|
jekara asIM cAhuMde tAM hareka basatI vica (naraka toM) ika DarAuNa vAlA (nabI) bhejade|
so (he nabI!) tusIM kAfirAM de Akhe nAM laggo ate isa.kuraAna (dIAM sikkhiAvAM) rAhIM uhanAM (kAfirAM) viruddha jihAda (saMgharaza) karo|

ate uhI (allAha) hai jisa ne do samuMdarAM nUM milA rakkhiA hai| ika pANI mIThA te piAsa bujhAuMdA hai ate dUjA khArA te kaur3A hai ate uhanAM dovAM vicakAra ika par3hadA hai, jisa ne uhanAM nUM gaDa-maDa hoNa toM roka rakkhiA hai|
ate (allAha) uhI hai jisa ne pANI (bhAva vIraja) toM manukkha nUM paidA kItA phera usa nUM parivAra vAlA ate sahuriAM vAlA baNAiA| bezakka tuhADA rabba hara kaMma karana dI kudarata rakkhadA hai|
iha (kAfira) loka allAha nUM chaDDa ke uhanAM dI pUjA karade hana jo nA tAM uhanAM nUM koI lAbha hI de sakade hana te nA hI koI hAnI| kAfira tAM ApaNe rabba de viruddha (zaitAna dA) sahAI hai|
(he muhaMmada!) asAM tAM tuhAnUM (savaragAM dIAM) qhuzaqhabarIAM ate (az2Aba) toM DarAuNa vAlA baNA ke bhejiA hai|

(he nabI! uhanAM kAfirAM nUM) Akho ki maiM isa kaMma laI (.kuraAnI sikkhiAvAM pahuMcAuNa laI) tuhAthoM koI badalA nahIM maMgadA| so jo vI cAhaveM (ihanAM sikkhiAvAM nUM maMnadA hoiA) ApaNe rabba valla jA sakadA hai|

so tusIM usa sadA jIvita rahiNa vAle (allAha) ’te bharosA rakkho jisa nUM kade mauta nahIM AvegI ate usa dI mahimA nAla usa dI tasabIha karo| uha (rabba) ApaNe baMdiAM de gunAhAM toM sabha toM vaddha jANU hai|

(allAha) uha z2Ata hai jisa ne akAzAM ate dharatI ate uhanAM de vicakAra dIAM sArIAM cIz2AM nUM che dinAM vica paidA kItA phera araza (akAza) ’te virAjamAna hoiA| uhI rahimAna hai, tusIM usa dI zAna kise jANana vAle toM puccho|

jadoM uhanAM (kAfirAM) nUM kihA jAMdA hai ki rahimAna nUM sijadA karo tAM pucchade hana ki rahimAna kauNa hai? kI asIM usa nUM sijadA karIe jisa dA hukama tusIM (muhaMmada sa:) sAnUM de rahe ho? isa galla ne tAM uhanAM dI ghiranAM vica vadhere vAdhA kItA hai|
uha vaDDIAM barakatAM vAlA hai jisa ne akAza vica buraja baNAe ate use vica carAg2a (sUraja) ate rauzana caMna baNAiA|
use ne ika dUje de picche AuNa vAle rAta te dina baNAe| iha sabha usa viakatI nUM samajhAuNa laI hai jihar3A sikkhiA prApata karanA cAhuMdA hai jAM dhaMnavAdI hoNA cAhuMdA hai|

rahimAna de (sacce) baMde uha hana jihar3e dharatI ’te naramAI nAla turade hana| jadoM jAhila loka uhanAM nAla (betukIAM) gallAM karana laggade hana tAM uha (ulajhade nahIM) basa kahiMde hana ki tuhAnUM merA salAma|
ate jihar3e ApaNe rabba de haz2Ura sijade te kiyAma karade (bhAva namAz2AM par3hade) hoe rAtAM guz2Arade hana|[4]
translations.footnotes: [4] bhAva faraz2AM de nAlo-nAla nafalAM dI adAigI karana vAle vI ihanAM vAMga hoNage farajAM dI adAigI vI koI choTI jihe galla nahIM uha sabha vI isa vica zAmala hana|

translations.translation: ate jihar3e iha duAvAM karade hana ki he sADe rabbA! naraka dA az2Aba sAthoM parAM hI rakkhio kiuM jo usa dA az2Aba sadA laI ciMbar3aNa vAlA hai|
nirasaMdeha, uha (naraka) tAM vaDDI bhair3I Thahirana ate rahiNa vAlI thAM hai|
uha loka qharaca karade sameM nA tAM phAlatU (lor3a toM vadha) qharaca karade hana ate nA hI kaMjUsI toM kaMma laiMde hana, sagoM uhanAM dovAM de vicAle vAlI rAha apaNAuMde hana|

uha allAha de nAlo-nAla kise hora izaTa nUM (madada laI) nahIM pukArade ate kise vI ajihe viakatI nUM katala nahIM karade, jisa nUM mAranA allAha ne harAma kItA hai ate nA hI uha z2anAkhorI karade hana| jihar3A vI koI iha kaMma karegA, usa de pApAM dI saz2A use nUM milegI|
kiAmata vAle dina usa dA az2Aba dugganA kara dittA jAvegA ate uha usa vica sadA apamAnita ho ke rahegA|
para jinhAM ne taubA kara laI ate ImAna liAe ate neka kaMma kIte ajihe lokAM dIAM burAIAM nUM allAha nekIAM vica badala devegA| allAha (miharAM sadake) baqhazaNahAra te miharabAna hai|[5]
translations.footnotes: [5] allAha de rasUla (sa:) ne faramAiA “bezakka isalAma pichale sAre gunAhAM nUM qhatama kara diMdA hai iMja hI allAha laI hijarata ate allAha de ghara dA hajja vI” (sahI musalima, hadIsa: 121) haz2arata ibane abbAsa rAhIM patA laggadA hai ki kujjha muzarika jinhAM ne bahuta katala ate z2anA kIte sI| nabI karIma (sa:) dI sevA vikhe hAz2ira hoe ate uhanAM ne kihA ki tusIM jo vI Akhade ho ate jihar3e dharama valla bulAuMde ho uha bahuta hI vadhIA hai para tusIM sAnUM iha tAM dasso ki asAM jihar3e bhair3e kaMma kIte hoe hana uhanAM dA koI kaffArA (bacAo) vI hai?isa ’te •kuraAna dI iha Aita nAz2ila hoI ki jihar3e allAha de nAla kise dUje izaTa nUM nahIM pukArade ate jisa manukkhI jAna nUM harAma kItA hai usa nUM nA-hakkA katala nahIM karade ate nA hI uha z2anA karade hana ate jihar3A koI ajihe kaMma karegA usa nUM gunAha dA badalA milegA para jisa ne taubA kara laI usa nUM saz2A nahIM ate sUrata ala z2umara dI iha Aita vI nAz2ila hoI, “he rasUla! tusIM sADe valloM Akha dio ki he mere baMdio! jinhAM ne vI pApa karake ApaNIAM jAnAM nAla vadhIkI kItI hai, uha allAha dIAM miharAM toM be-Asa nA hoNa”| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 4810, sahI musalima, hadIsa: 122)

translations.translation: ate jihar3A koI taubA kare ate neka kaMma vI kare, bezakka uhI taubA karadA hai jiveM taubA karana dA hakka hai|
ate jihar3e lokI jhUThI gavAhI nahIM diMde ate jadoM kise bhair3I thAM toM uhanAM dA laMghaNA huMdA hai tAM uha zarAfata nAla guz2ara jAMde hana|
jadoM uhanAM nUM uhanAM de raba de kalAma (•kuraAna) dIAM AitAM suNAIAM jAMdIAM hana tAM uha uhanAM utte aMnhe te bole baNa ke nahIM rahi jAMde (sagoM dhiAna nAla suNade hana)|
ate duA karade hana ki he sADe pAlaNahAra! tUM sADIAM patanIAM ate aulAda valloM sADIAM akkhAM nUM ThaMDIAM rakkha ate sAnUM parahez2agAra lokAM dA AgU baNA|

iho uha loka hana jinhAM nUM uhanAM de sabara (bhAva ImAna ’te jaMme rahiNa) de badale savaraga vica uccIAM-uccIAM thAvAM (mahilAM de rUpa vica) dittIAM jANagIAM ate utthe duA-salAma nAla uhanAM dA savAgata hovegA|
uha sadA (utthe hI rahiNage ate uha (jaMnata) bahuta hI vadhIA nivAsa sathAna hai|

(he nabI!) Akha dio ki (he kAfiro!) jekara tusIM rabba toM aradAsAM jAM benatIAM nahIM karade tAM rabba nUM vI tuhADI koI paravAha nahIM| tusIM tAM (hakka) dA inakAra kara hI cukke ho, huNa chetI hI tuhAnUM usa dA az2Aba AuNa vAlA hai|
tA, sIna, mIma|
iha rauzana kitAba dIAM AitAM hana|
(he nabI!) zAida isa ciMtA vica ki uha (makke de) loka ImAna nahIM liAuMde, tusIM ApaNe Apa nUM halAka hI nA kara dio|
je asIM cAhIe tAM akAza toM koI ajihI nizAnI utAra sakade hAM jisa agge uhanAM dIAM garadanAM nIvIAM ho jANa|
jadoM vI (uhanAM lokAM kola) rahimAna valloM koI navIM nasIhata AuMdI hai tAM uha usa toM mUMha mor3a laiMde hana|
uhanAM lokAM ne isa (.kuraAna) nUM jhuThalAiA hai, huNa chetI hI uhanAM nUM patA lagga jAvegA (ki uha kI hai) jisa dI iha khillI ur3AuMde hana|
kI uhanAM ne dharatI valla (gauha nAla) nahIM vekhiA ki asIM isa vica kiMnIAM vadhIA-vadhIA cIz2AM ugAIAM hana|
bezakka isa vica (allAha dI) nizAnI hai (para phera vI) uhanAM viccoM bahute loka nahIM maMnade (ImAna nahIM liAuMde)|
(he muhaMmada!) bezakka terA rabba DADhA z2orAvara ate rahima faramAuNa vAlA hai|
(ate usa vele nUM yAda karo) jadoM tuhADe rabba ne mUsA nUM AvAz2a dittI sI ki z2Alama kauma valla jA|
bhAva firaauna dI kauma kola (jA) kI uha raba toM Darade nahIM?
mUsA ne kihA ki mere rabbA! maiM isa galla toM DaradA hAM ki uha mainUM jhuThalA deNage|
merA dama ghuTa rihA hai te nA hI maithoM caMgI tarhAM boliA jAMdA hai| tUM hArUna nUM hukama de ki uha mere nAla firaauna kola jAve|
mere sira uhanAM valloM ika aparAdha dA doza vI hai, mainUM Dara hai ki kite mainUM uha katala hI nA kara deNa|
allAha ne AkhiA ki ukkA nahIM (ghabarAuNA), tusIM doveM (mUsA te hArUna) merIAM nizAnIAM lai ke jAo| asAM tuhADe aMga-saMga sabha kujjha suNade hAM|
so tusIM firaauna kola jAo ate Akho ki asIM sAre jahAnAM de rabba de rasUla hAM|
(ate Akho ki) banI-isarAIla nUM sADe nAla jANa (laI az2Ada kara) de
firaauna ne (mUsA nUM) kihA kI asIM tainUM nikke huMde ApaNe vicAle pAliA-posiA nahIM sI? ate tUM ApaNI umara de kaI varhe sADe vica nahIM sI laMghAe?
phera tUM uha kaMma kara giA (bhAva ika baMde nUM katala kItA) jihar3A tUM karanA sI| tUM tAM ika nA-zukarA viakatI hai|
mUsA ne uttara dittA ki maithoM uha (katala) usa sameM hoiA sI, jadoM maiM rAha bhulle hoe lokAM viccoM sI|
ate maiM tuhADe Dara kArana tuhADe koloM nassa giA sI, phera mere rabba ne mainUM Adeza te giAna nAla baqhaziA ate mainUM paig2aMbarAM vica zAmala kara liA|
kI mere utte terA iho ahisAna hai, jisa nUM tUM jatA rihA hai? (jada ki) banI-isarAIla (merI kauma) nUM tUM g2ulAma baNA chaDDiA hai|
firaauna ne kihA ki sAre jahAnAM dA pAlaNahAra kI (cIz2a) hai?
mUsA ne uttara vica kihA ki uha akAza te dharatI vicAle hareka cIz2a dA mAlika hai, jekara tusIM vizavAsa karana vAle ho tAM kara lao)|
firaauna ne ApaNe Ale-duAle baiThe lokAM nUM kihA ki kI tusIM suNa rahe ho (mUsA kI kahi rihA hai)?
(mUsA ne hora) kihA ki uha terA vI rabba hai ate tere pio dAdiAM toM vI pahiilaAM dA rabba hai|
(firaauna ne) darabArIAM nUM kihA ki iha paig2aMbara jihar3A tuhADe valla bhejiA giA hai iha tAM jhallA laggadA hai|
(mUsA ne) kihA ki (he firaauna!) uhIo pUraba te pacchama dA ate uhanAM vicAle sArIAM vasatUAM dA mAlika hai (samajho) je tusIM akala vAle ho|
usa (firaauna) ne (mUsA nUM) dhamakAuMde hoe kihA ki je tUM maithoM chuTTa kise hora nUM izaTa baNAiA tAM maiM tainUM kaidIAM vica zAmala kara diAMgA|
(mUsA) ne kihA ki je maiM tere sAhamaNe (ApaNe rasUla hoNa dI) koI sapazaTa nizAnI lai AvAM, kI phera vI (kaida karoge)?
kihA (firaauna ne) ki je tUM saccA hai tAM mainUM usa (nizAnI) nUM vikhA|
mUsA ne (use vele dharatI ’te) ApaNI lAThI suTTa dittI jihar3I acaNaceta ika sappa de rUpa vica A gaI|
ate jadoM ApaNA hattha (bag2aloM) kaDDhiA tAM darazakAM nUM uha use vele lizakAre mAradA hoiA vikhAI deNa lagga piA|
firaauna ApaNe Ale-duAle baiThe saradArAM nUM kahiNa laggiA ki iha tAM koI bahuta vaDDA jAdUgara hai|
uha ApaNe jAdU de z2ora nAla tuhAnUM tuhADI dharatI (desa) ’coM kaDDha deNA cAhuMdA hai, huNa dasso mainUM kI hukama hai?
uhanAM sabha ne kihA ki tusIM isa (mUsA) nUM ate isa de bharA (hArUna) nUM roke rakkho ate sAre zahirAM vica harakAre bheja dio|
jihar3e tuhADe kola mAhira jAdUgarAM nUM liAuNa|
phera ika nizacita dina sAre hI jAdUgara ikaTThA kIte gae|
ate Ama lokAM nUM vI kihA giA ki tusIM sAre vI AIo|
tAM jo je jAdUgara kAmayAba ho jANa tAM asIM uhanAM dI pairavIM karIe|
jAdUgarAM ne firaauna nUM AkhiA ki je asIM jitta gae tAM sAnUM inAma kI milegA?
kihA (firaauna ne) hAM! ajihI hAlata vica tusIM mere qhAsa darabArIAM viccoM hovoMge|
uhanAM (jAdUgarAM) ne mUsA nUM kihA ki karo jo tusIM karanA hai|
uhanAM (jAdUgarAM) ne ApaNIAM rassIAM te soTIAM (jAdU laI) dharatI ’te suTTa dittIAM ate AkhaNa lagge ki firaauna dI iz2z2ata dI kasama asIM hI kAmayAba hovAMge|
huNa (mUsA ne vI ApaNI soTI maidAna vica suTTI jisa ne use vele uhanAM (jAdUgarAM) de jhUThe karatabAM nUM nigalaNA zurU kara dittA|
iha vekhade hI jAdUgara bekAbU hoke sijade vica Diga pae|
ate uhanAM ne sAfa kahi dittA ki asIM tAM jihar3A sAre hI jahAnAM dA rabba hai usa ’te ImAna liAe hAM|
bhAva uha rabba jisa nUM mUsA te hArUna maMnade hana|

firaauna boliA ki maithoM pucchaNa toM pahilAM hI tusIM usa (mUsA de rabba) ’te ImAna liAe lAz2amana uha tuhADA gurU hai, jisa ne tuhAnUM jAdU sikhAiA hai| so tuhAnUM huNe patA lagga jAvegA, maiM tuhADe hattha-paira ulaTe dAo toM vaDavA devAMgA ate tuhAnUM sAriAM nUM fAMsI ’te cAr3ha devAMgA|
uhanAM (jAdUgarAM) ne kihA ki ciMtA vAlI koI galla nahIM, asIM tAM ApaNe pAlaNahAra kola hI jANA hai|
kiuM jo (terI kauma viccoM)sabha toM pahilAM asIM ImAna liAuNa vAle hAM, so sAnUM Asa hai ki sADA rabba sADIAM g2alatIAM nUM muAfa karegA|
asIM mUsA valla vahI bhejI ki rAto-rAta mere baMdiAM nUM itthoM laike nikkala jA, tuhADA picchA kItA jAvegA|
firaauna ne zahirAM vica harakAre bheja ditte|
iha (dassaNa laI) ki iha (ImAna liAuNa vAle) tAM bahuta hI thor3he loka hana|
uhanAM (ImAna liAuNa vAliAM) ne sAnUM DADhA g2ussA cAr3hiA hai|
asIM hI vaDDI giNatI vica hAM, uhanAM toM sAvadhAna rahiNa vAle hAM|
aMta asIM uhanAM (firaaunIAM) nUM bAg2AM te cazamiAM viccoM kaDDhiA|
ate qhaz2AniAM toM te uhanAM de suhaNe nivAsa-sathAna ’coM (vI kaDDhiA)|
isa prakAra (firaauna nAla) hoiA, (dUje pAse) asAM uhanAM dIAM sArIAM cIz2AM dA vArasa banI-isarAIla nUM baNA dittA|
(firaaunIAM ne) sUraja nikalade hI uhanAM dA picchA kItA|
jadoM doveM dhirAM ne ika dUje nUM vekha liA tAM mUsA de sAthIAM ne kihA ki asIM tAM phar3e jAvAMge|
mUsA ne kihA ki ukkA nahIM, vizavAsa karo ki merA rabba mere nAla hai, jihar3A mainUM lAz2amI (bacaNa dI) rAha vikhAvegA|
asIM mUsA valla vahI (saMdeza) bhejI ki samuMdara utte ApaNI soTI mAra, uha use vele pATa giA ate pANI dA hareka bhAga ika pahAr3a vAMga ho giA|
ate asIM dUje dhar3e (firaaunIAM) nUM (samuMdara de) ner3e lai Ae|
ate mUsA nUM ate usa de sAthIAM nUM bacA liA|
ate dUje (firaaunI) sAre Doba ditte|
bezakka isa (ghaTanA) vica bahuta vaDDI sikkhiA hai, phera vI bahute lokI ImAna nahIM liAuMde|
bezakka tuhADA pAlaNahAra bahuta hI z2orAvara ate miharabAna hai|
(he nabI!) uhanAM nUM ibarAhIma dA kissA vI suNAo|
jadoM usa ne ApaNe pitA te ApaNI kauma toM pucchiA sI ki tusIM kI pUjade ho?
uhanAM ne javAba vica kihA ki asIM butAM nUM pUjade hAM ate uhanAM de hI pujArI rahAMge|
ibarAhIma ne kihA ki jadoM tusIM uhanAM nUM pukArade ho tAM kI iha suNade vI hana?
jAM tuhAnUM koI nafA jAM nukasAna vI pahuMcA sakade hana?
uhanAM ne kihA ki asIM tAM ApaNe baz2uragAM nUM iMja hI karade vekhiA hai|
ibarAhIma ne kihA, jinhAM nUM tusIM pUjade ho, kI tusIM uhanAM nUM vekhiA vI hai?
(ate kihA ki) tusIM ate tuhADe pio-dAdA jinhAM nUM pUjade ho|
chuTTa sAre jahAnAM de pAlaNahAra toM, uha (sAre izaTa) mere vairI hana|
jisa ne mainUM paidA kItA hai uhIo merI agavAI karadA hai|
uhIo mainUM khuAuMdA-piAuMdA hai|
jadoM maiM bImAra huMdA hAM tAM uhIo mainUM savasatha karadA hai|
uhIo mainUM mauta devegA phera mainUM mur3a jiUMde karegA|
uhIo hai jisa toM maiM Asa karadA hAM ki badale vAle dina mere gunAhAM nUM muAfa kara devegA|
he mere rabbA! mainUM hikamata (sUjha-bUjha) dI dAta baqhaza ate mainUM neka lokAM vica zAmala kara lai|
ate merI caracA AuNa vAle lokAM vica vI bAkI rave|
mainUM niamatAM vAlI jaMnatAM dA vArisa baNA|
mere pitA nUM baqhaza de uha gumarAha lokAM viccoM sI|
jadoM (sAre) lokI mur3a jiUMde kIte jANage (usa dina) mainUM z2alIla nA karIM|
jisa dina mAla te aulAda kise kaMma nahIM AvegI|
chuTTa usa toM ki koI viakatI niramala-citta laike allAha de haz2Ura peza hove|
ate jaMnata parahez2agArAM de ner3e kara dittI jAvegI|
ate gumarAha lokAM laI naraka pragaTa kItI jAvegI|
ate uhanAM toM pucchiA jAvegA ki jinhAM dI pUjA tusIM karade sI uha kitthe hanaੱ?
kI allAha toM chuTTa (izaTa) tuhADI sahAitA kara sakade hana? jAM uha (tuhADI saz2A) dA badalA lai sakade hana?
phira uha sAre kurAhe pae loka naraka vica muddhe mUMha suTTe jANage|
ate ibalIsa (zaitAna) de sAre de sAre lazakara vI (suTTe jANage)|
utthe uha Apo vica lar3ade jhagar3ade hoe ApaNe IzaTAM nUM AkhaNage|
ki allAha dI suMha asIM tAM sapazaTa kurAhIe sAM|
jadoM asIM tuhAnUMsAre jahAnAM de rabba barAbara samajha baiThe sI
sAnUM tAM uhanAM aparAdhIAM ne gumarAha kItA sI|
huNa sADA koI vI sifArazI nahIM|
ate nA hI koI saccA dosata hai|
kAza ki sADI ika vAra phera saMsAra vica vApasI ho jAve tAM jo asIM vI mominAM viccoM ho jAIe|
bezakka isa vica bahuta hI vaDDI nizAnI hai, phera vI uhanAM viccoM bahute loka ImAna liAuNa vAle nahIM|
bezakka tuhADA rabba hI z2orAvAra te miharabAna hai|
nUha dI kauma ne vI nabIAM dA inakAra kItA|
jadoM uhanAM de hI ika bharA nUha ne kihA, kI tusIM rabba toM Darade nahIM?
bezakka maiM allAha valloM tuhADe laI ika amAnatadAra rasUla hAM|
so tusIM allAha toM Daro ate merI tAbedArI karo|
maiM tuhAthoM isa (dharama pracAra) laI koI badalA nahIM cAhuMdA, merA badalA tAM sAre jahAnAM de rabba de z2iMme hai|
so tusIM allAha toM Daro ate merI pairavI karo|
(kauma ne) kihA ki kI asIM tere ’te ImAna liAIe? terI tAbedArI tAM nIca loka hI karanage|
nUha ne kihA ki maiM nahIM jANadA ki pahilAM iha loka kI karade rahe hana?
usa dA hisAba laiNA mere rabba z2iMme hai, kiMnA caMgA hove je tuhAnUM akala-samajha hove|
maiM ImAna vAliAM nUM dhakke nahIM devAMgAM|
maiM tAM sapazaTa rUpa vica DarAuNa vAlA hAM|
uhanAM ne kihA ki he nUha! je tUM bAz2a nA AiA tAM asIM tainUM patthara mAra-mAra ke mAra diAMge|
(nUha ne) kihA ki he mere rabbA! merI kauma ne mai` maMNana toM nA kara dittI hai|
huNa tUM mere ate uhanAM vicakAra faisalA karade ate mainUM ate mere ImAna vAle sAthIAM nUM bacA lai|
so asIM usa (nUha) nUM ate usa de (momina) sAthIAM nUUM bharI hoI kisatI vica (savAra karake) bacA liA|
usa toM magaroM bAkI sAre hI lokAM nUM asIM Doba dittA|
bezakka isa ghaTanA vica bahuta vaDDI sikkhiA hai para phera vI uhanAM viccoM bahute loka ImAna nahIM liAe|
bezakka tuhADA pAlaNahAra uhIo hai jihar3A sabha toM vaddha z2orAvara te miharAM karana vAlA hai|
AdIAM ne vI rasUlAM nUM jhuThalAiA sI|
jadoM uhanAM de hI bharA hUda ne kihA sI, kI tusIM (rabba de az2Aba toM) Darade nahIM?
maiM tuhADe laI amAnatadAra paig2aMbara hAM|
so tusIM rabba toM Daro ate mere Akhe laggo|
maiM isa (agavAI) laI tuhAthoM kujjha badalA nahIM cAhuMdA, merA badalA tAM sAre jahAnAM de pAlaNahAra de z2iMme hai|
kI tusIM hareka uccI thAM ’te viaratha kheDa vajoM yAdagArAM baNA rahe ho|
tusIM maz2abUta mahila usArade ho, zAida tusIM sadA itthe (saMsAra vica) hI rahoge|
jadoM tusIM kise ’te hattha pAuMde ho tAM bahuta hI saqhatI ate z2ulama nAla pAuMde ho|
allAha toM Daro ate merI (hUda dI) pairavI karo|
tusIM usa (hasatI) toM Daro jisa ne tuhADI uhanAM cIz2AM duArA madada kItI jinhAM nUM tusIM jANade ho|
usa (rabba) ne tuhADI sahAitA mAla daulata te aulAda nAla kItI|
bAg2AM te cazamiAM (nahirAM) duArA kItI|
maiM tAM tuhADe laI usa vaDDe (kiAmata) dihAr3e toM DaradA hAM|
uhanAM (kauma) ne kihA ki he hUda! tUM sAnUM samajhA jAM nA samajhA, sADe laI ikko galla hai|
iha tAM pahile sameM de lokAM dIAM gallAM hana|
sAnUM kade koI az2Aba nahIM dittA jAvegA|

uhanAM ne usa (hUda) nUM (rabba dA rasUla maMNana toM) inakAra kara dittA sI| so asIM uhanAM nUM tabAha kara dittA| bezakka isa vica (samajhaNa vAliAM laI) nizAnIAM hana, para uhanAM viccoM vadhere uha hana jihar3e ImAna nahIM liAuMde
bezakka tuhADA rabba uhIo hai jihar3A z2orAvara te miharabAna hai|
samUdIAM ne vI paig2aMbarAM nUM maMNana toM inakAra kara dittA|
uhanAM (samUdIAM) de bharA sAleha ne uhanAM nUM kihA ki tusIM allAha toM kiuM nahIM Darade?
maiM tuhADe valla allAha dA ika amAnatadAra paig2aMbara hAM|
tusIM allAha toM Daro ate mere Akhe laggo|
maiM isa de laI tuhAthoM koI ujarata nahIM bhAladA, merI ujarata (badalA) tAM mere pAlaNahAra de z2iMme hai|
kI uhanAM cIz2AM nAla tuhAnUM amana zAMtI nAla nizaciMta hoke (saMsAra vica) rahiNa laI chaDDa dittA jAvegA?
bhAva ihanAM bAg2AM te cazamiAM vica (nahirAM Adi)|
iha kheta ate khajUra de bAg2AM vica jinhAM de gucche rasa bhare hana|
tusIM pahAr3AM nUM kaTTa-kaTTa ke vaDDe mANa nAla uhanAM vica bhavana usArade ho|
so tusIM allAha toM Daro ate merI tAbedArI karo|
tusIM rabba valloM niyata kItIAM haddAM nUM TappaNa vAliAM de Akhe nA laggo
uha (bAg2I) hana, jihar3e dharatI ’te fasAda phailAuMde hana, sudhAra nahIM karade|
uhanAM ne kihA ki (he sAleha!) tUM tAM uhanAM viccoM hai jinhAM ’te jAdU kItA giA hai|
tUM tAM sADe varagA hI ika manukkha hai, je tUM saccA hai tAM koI moajaz2A (rabbI camatakAra) liA?
sAleha ne kihA ki iha UThaNI (nizAnI) hai| ika nizacita dina pANI pINa dI vArI isa dI hai ate ika dina tuhADI hai|
isa nUM bhair3e irAde nAla hattha nahIM lAuNA, nahIM tAM ika vaDDe dihAr3e dA az2Aba tuhAnUM A nappegA|
(isa citAvanI toM bAada vI) uhanAM (samUdIAM) ne usa (UThaNI) dIAM khuccAM vaDDa suTTIAM| phera uha pachatAuNa lagge|
ate uhanAM nUM az2Aba ne A jhapphiA, bezakka isa (ghaTaNA) vica ika sikkhiA hai| uhanAM viccoM vadhere ImAna liAuNa vAle nahIM sAM|
bezakka tuhADA rabba uha hai jihar3A DADhA z2orAvara te rahima faramAuNa vAlA hai|
lUta dI kauma ne nabIAM nUM jhuThalAiA|
jadoM uhanAM nUM uhanAM de bharA lUta ne AkhiA, kI tusIM allAha toM nahIM Darade?
maiM tuhADe valla ika amAnatadAra rasUla (baNake AiA) hAM|
so tusIM allAha toM Daro ate merA kahiNA maMno|
maiM (isa nasIhata laI) tuhAthoM koI badalA (ujarata) nahIM maMgadA merA badalA tAM allAha de z2iMme hai|
kI tusIM (kAma vAsanA de laI) dunIAM viccoM purazA kola jAMde ho?
ate ApaNIAM patanIAM nUM chaDDa diMde ho jinhAM nUM allAha ne tuhADe laI paidA kItA hai| tusIM tAM haddAM TappaNa vAle ho|
uhanAM ne uttara vica kihA ki he lUta! je tUM bAz2a nA AiA tAM tUM (basatI viccoM) bAhara kaDDha dittA jAvegA|
lUta ne AkhiA, bezakka maiM tuhADIAM (azalIla) harakatAM dA kaTTar3a virodhI hAM|
lUta ne duA kItI ki he mere rabbA! tUM mainUM ate mere parivAra nUM uhanAM bhair3e karamAM toM chuTakArA de|
ate iMja asIM usa (lUta) nUM ate usa de sAthIAM nUM bacA liA|
chuTTa usa buDDhI aurata (lUta dI patanI) toM jihar3I picche rahi jANa vAliAM viccoM sI|
phira asIM bAkI rahiMde lokAM nUM halAka (barabAda) kara dittA|
asIM uhanAM utte (pattharAM dA) mIMha barasAiA| uha bahuta hI bhair3A mIMha sI, jihar3e DarAe hoe lokAM ’te barasiA sI|
bezakka isa ghaTaNA vica vI ika (sikkhiAdAika) nizAnI hai| uhanAM viccoM vI vadhere loka ImAna nahIM liAe sAM|
bezakka terA rabba hI (hara pakkho) bhArU hai ate miharabAna hai|
‘aike’ vAliAM ne vI rasUlAM nUM jhuThalAiA|
jadoM uhanAM nUM zuaiba ne kihA, kI tusIM (rabba toM) nahIM Darade?
maiM tuhADe laI (rabba valloM) bhejiA hoiA ika amAnatadAra rasUla hAM|
so tusIM allAha toM Daro ate merI AgiA dA pAlaNa karo|
(iha sikkhiA deNa laI) maiM tuhAthoM koI badalA nahIM cAhuMdA, merA badalA tAM sAre jahAnAM de pAlaNahAra de kola hI hai|
miNatI pUrI bhara ke dio ate dUjiAM dA nukasAna karana vAle nA baNo|
ate siddhI takkar3I nAla tolo (bhAva DaMDI nA mAro)|
lokAM nUM uhanAM dIAM cIz2AM ghaTTa nA dio ate dharatI ’te fasAda nA macAuMde phiro|
usa rabba toM Daro jisa ne tuhAnUM ate tuhAthoM pahilI maqhalUka nUM paidA kItA hai|
uhanAM ne kihA ki tUM tAM uhanAM viccoM hai jinhAM ’te jAdU kara dittA jAMdA hai|
tUM tAM sADe varagA hI ika manukkha hai, asIM tAM tainUM jhUTha bolaNa vAliAM viccoM hI samajhade hAM|
je tUM saccA hai tAM sADe utte akAza dA koI Tukar3A Dega de|
zuaiba ne kihA ki merA rabba caMgI tarhAM jANadA hai jo tusIM kara rahe ho|
so jadoM uhanAM ne uha (zuaiba) nUM jhuThalAiA (chetI hI) uhanAM nUM (baddalAM de) parachAveM vAle dihAr3e de az2Aba ne A nappiA, uha bahuta hI bhArI dina dA az2Aba sI|
isa ghaTanA vica vaDDIAM nizAnIAM hana, uhanAM viccoM bahute loka ImAna liAuNa vAle nahIM sana|
