bezakka tuhADA pAlaNahAra hI bhArU te miharabAnIAM vAlA hai|
ate nirasaMdeha, iha (.kuraAna) sAre hI jahAnAM de pAlaNahAra valloM bhejiA giA hai|
isa nUM ika amAnatadAra rUha (jibarAIla) lai ke AiA hai|
(he muhaMmada!) asIM isa (.kuraAna)nUM tuhADe dila utte nAz2ila kItA hai tAM jo tusIM vI DarAuNa vAle (paig2aMbarAM) viccoM ho jAo|
iha.kuraAna sapazaTa te TheTha arabI bhAzA vica hai|
bezakka izakuraAna dI caracA pahilIAM asamAnI kitAbAM vica vI kItI gaI hai|
kI uhanAM (kAfirAM) laI iho nizAnI kAfI nahIM ki.kuraAna de hakka hoNa nUM tAM banI-isarAIla de vidavAna vI jANade hana| [1]

translations.translation: jekara asIM isa.kuraAna nUM kise ajamI (gaira arabI viakatI) utte nAz2ila kara diMde|
ate uha uhanAM (arabI lokAM) de sAhamaNe isa (.kuraAna) nUM par3hadA tAM uha vI ImAna nA liAuMde|
isa tarhAM asAM gunAhagArAM de dilAM vica isa (.kuraAna) nUM jhuThalAuNA pakkA kara dittA hai|
uha jadoM taka darada bhare az2Aba nahIM vekha laiMde, ImAna nahIM liAuNage|
so uha az2Aba uhanAM utte acaNaceta AvegA ate uhanAM nUM isa dA patA vI nahIM laggegA|
phera uha AkhaNage, kI sAnUM kujjha sameM laI mohalata mila sakadI hai? (tAM jo asIM ImAna liAIe)
kI uha sADe az2Aba laI kAhalI pA rahe hana?
ratA tusIM vekho! je bhalAM asIM uhanAM (aparAdhIAM) nUM hora kaI varhe saMsAra dA lAbha laiNa (laI mohalata) de diMde|
phira uhanAM (kAfirAM) utte uha az2Aba A jAMdA jisa toM DarAe jA rahe hana|
tAM vI jisa jIvana samaggarI dA uha AnaMda lai rahe hana uha uhanAM de kise kaMma nA AuMdI|
asIM jihar3I vI basatI nUM halAka kItA hai tAM (pahilAM) usa vica DarAuNa vAle bheje|
lokAM nUM samajhAuNa laI (DarAuNa vAle bheje)| asIM kise ’te koI z2ulama (vadhIkI) karana vAle nahIM|
isa.kuraAna nUM zaitAna laike nahIM uttare|
nA hI uha isa yoga hana te nA hI uha samarathA rakkhade hana|
uha tAM isa (.kuraAna) nUM suNana toM vI dUra rakkhe gae hana|
so tusIM (he muhaMmada sa:!) allAha de nAla kise hora izaTa nUM nA pukAro nahIM tAM tusIM vI saz2A bhogaNa vAliAM viccoM ho jAoge|
tusIM ApaNe sake-saMbaMdhIAM nUM DarAo|[2]
translations.footnotes: [2] haz2arata ibane abbAsa ra:a dA kahiNA hai ki jadoM.kuraAna karIma dI iha Aita nAz2ila hoI tAM allAha de rasUla (sa:) Ae ate safA pahAr3a ’te car3ha gae ate uccIM avAz2a nAla ailAna karana lagga pae ki loko sAvadhAna ho jAo| makke de loka AkhaNa lagge ki iha kauNa hai? phera uha nabI karIma (sa:) de kola jamA ho gae, tAM Apa (sa:) ne faramAiA “je maiM tuhAnUM iha dassAM ki vairIAM de savAra isa pahAr3a toM nikala ke tuhADe ’te hamalA karana vAle hana tAM kI tusIM sacca maMnoge? lokAM ne kihA sAne tuhAnUM kade vI jhUTha bolade nahIM vekhiA, iho kArana sI ki makke vAle Apa jI nUM ‘amIna’ te ‘sAdika’ Akhade sana| nabI karIma (sa:) ne faramAiA, tAM phera maiM tuhAnUM usa az2Aba toM DarAuNa vAlA hAM jihar3e tuhADe sAhamaNe maujUda hai| iha suNa ke abU lahaba AkhaNa laggA, tUM barabAda ho jAveM, kI tUM sAnUM ise laI jamhAM kItA sI? phira abU lahaba mur3a turiA ise saMbaMdha vica sUrata lahaba nAz2ila hoI sI| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 4971)

translations.translation: ImAna vAliAM viccoM jihar3e tuhADI pairavI karana, uhanAM nAla ati nimaratA dA vihAra karo|
je uha tuhADe AdezAM dI pAlaNA nahIM karade tAM tusIM vI ailAna kara dio ki maiM tuhADe uhanAM sAre kaMmAM dI z2iMmevArI toM, jihar3e kaMma tusIM kara rahe ho, Az2Ada hAM|
(he muhaMmada sa:!) tusIM ApaNA bharosA use z2orAvara miharabAna ’te rakkho|
jihar3A tuhAnUM vekhadA hai jadoM tusIM (namAz2a laI) khar3e huMde ho|
ate uha sijadA karana vAliAM vicakAra tuhADA uThaNA baiThaNA vI vekhadA hai|
uha (allAha) hara galla suNana vAlA ate jANana vAlA hai|
kI maiM (allAha) tuhAnUM dassAM ki zaitAna kisa ’te utariA karade hana|
uha zaitAna hareka jhUTha ghar3aNa vAle pApI ’te utariA karade hana|
jihar3e (zaitAnAM valla) kaMna lAIM rakkhade hana, uhanAM viccoM bahute jhUThe huMde hana|
kavIAM picche tAM kurAhIe hI laggade hana|
kI tusIM nahIM vekhiA ki uha (kavI) hareka qhiAlI ghATI vica TakkarAM mArade phirade hana?
ate uha ajihIAM gallAM kahiMde hana jo uha Apa nahIM karade|

chuTTa uhanAM (kavIAM) toM jihar3e ImAna liAe ate caMge kaMma kIte ate allAha nUM vI vaddha toM vaddha yAda kItA ate jadoM uhanAM ’te z2ulama hoiA tAM uhanAM ne usa dA badalA (kalama te hathiAra) rAhIM liA| z2Alama chetI hI jANa laiNage ki kisa (dukhadAI) parataNa vAlI thAM uha parataNage|
tA, sIna| iha.kuraAna ate cAnaNa vikhAuNa vAlI kitAba dIAM AitAM hana|
(iha.kuraAna) hidAita ate qhuzaqhabarI hai uhanAM ImAna vAliAM laI|
jihar3e (ImAna vAle) namAz2AM kAima karade hana ate z2akAta adA karade hana ate Aqhirata utte pUrA vizavAsa rakkhade hana|
jihar3e lokI kiAmata vAparana ’te ImAna nahIM rakkhade, asIM uhanAM dIAM karatUtAM nUM uhanAM laI zobhAvAna baNA diMde hAM, so uha bhaTake phirade hana|
iho uha loka hana jinhAM laI karar3IAM saz2AvAM hana ate Aqhirata vica vI uha sabha toM vaddha ghATe vica rahiNage|
(he nabI!) nirasaMdeha, tuhAnUM ika hakIma (yukatImAna) te jANanahAra (allAha) valloM iha਼kuraAna sikhAiA jA rihA hai|

(usa vele dI galla suNAo) jadoM mUsA ne ApaNI patanI nUM kihA sI ki maiM ne agga vekhI hai| maiM huNe utthoM tuhADe laI koI qhabara jAM koI agga dA baladA hoiA aMgiArA liAuMdA hAM tAM jo tusIM seka sako|
jadoM (mUsA) usa agga kola pahuMciA tAM AvAz2a AI ki barakatAM vAlA hai uha (allAha) jihar3A isa agga (nUra) vica hai ate jo isa de Ale-duAle hai ate allAha pAka hai jo ki sAre jahAnAM dA mAlika hai|
he mUsA! bezakka maiM hI allAha hAM! jo ki DADhA z2orAvara te yukatImAna hai|

(allAha ne kihA ki) tUM ApaNI soTI suTTa de| jadoM (mUsA ne soTI suTTI tAM) vekhiA ki uha tAM iMja hila rahI hai jiveM koI sappa hove tAM uha piTTha phera ke nassiA pichhAM mur3a ke vI nahIM vekhiA| (allAha ne faramAiA) he mUsA! DaraNA nahIM, merI haz2UrI vica paig2aMbara DariA nahIM karade|
para jinhe z2ulama kItA phera usa ne burAI toM magaroM (bhair3e amalAM nUM) badala ke nekI kItI tAM (ajihe viakatI laI) nirasaMdeha, maiM baqhazaNahAra te miharabAna hAM|

(he mUsA!) ApaNA hattha ApaNe galAveM vica pA, uha safaida te lizakadA hoiA be-aiba nikalegA| iha (do nizAnIAM) uhanAM no nizAnIAM (rabbI camatakArAM) viccoM hana (jinhAM de nAla) tuhAnUM firaauna te usa dI kauma valla bhejiA giA hai| bezakka uha nA-faramAna loka hana|
jadoM uhanAM (firaaunIAM) kola sapazaTa muajaz2e (rabbI camatakAra) pahuMce tAM uha kahiNa lagge ki iha tAM khullhA jAdU hai|
uhanAM (firaaunIAM) ne z2ulama te haMkAra nAla uhanAM (nizAnIAM) dA inakAra kItA jadoM ki uhanAM de dilAM ne maMna liA sI| phera vekho uhanAM inakArIAM dA aMta kiho jihA hoiA sI|

bezakka asIM dAUda te sulemAna nUM (vizeza) giAna baqhaziA ate uhanAM dovAM ne kihA ki sArIAM tArIfAM te zukarAne use allAha laI hana jisa ne sAnUM ApaNe bahuta sAre ImAna vAle baMdiAM utte vaDiAI baqhazI|

ate asIM dAUda dA vArasa sulemAna nUM baNAiA te usa ne AkhiA ki he loko! sAnUM (rabba ne) paMchIAM dIAM bolIAM sikhAIAM hana ate sAnUM hora bahuta kujjha baqhaziA hoiA hai| bezakka iha sabha sapazaTa rUpa vica (allAha dI) kripAlatA hai|
sulemAna de haz2Ura jiMnAM, manukkhAM ate paMchIAM de dala ikattara kIte gae, uhanAM sabha dIAM vakkha-vakkha TolIAM baNAIAM gaIAM sana|

(ika vAra) jadoM uha (sulemAna te usa dIAM faujAM) kIr3IAM dI ghATI vica dI laMgha rahe sI tAM ika kIr3I ne kihA ki he kIr3Io! ApaNI ApaNI khuDDAM vica jA var3o, kite iMja nA hove ki (bedhiAnI vica) sulemAna ate usa dIAM faujAM tuhAnUM latAr3a suTTaNa ate uhanAM nUM isa dI qhabara vI nA hove|

isa (kIr3I) dI iha galla suNa ke sulemAna musakar3IM hassa piA ate AkhaNa laggA ki he mere mAlika! tUM mainUM iha bala baqhaza ki maiM tere uhanAM sArIAM niamatAM dA zukara adA karadA rahAM, jihar3IAM vI taine mainUM ate mere mAM-pio nUM baqhazIAM hana| isa galla laI vI (duAM maMgadA hAM) ki maiM ajihe bhale kaMma karAM jihar3e tUM pasaMda kare ate ApaNI mihara sadakA ApaNe neka baMdiAM vica zAmila kara lai|
(ika vAra) jadoM uha (sulaimAna) ne paMchIAM dI jAMca-par3hatAla kItI tAM AkhaNa laggA, kI galla hai ki maiM huda huda (cakkIrAhe) nUM nahIM vekha rihA, kI uha kite g2Aiba ho giA hai?
maiM usa nUM karar3I saz2A diAMgA jAM usa nUM z2ibaha kara diAMgA (bhAva mAra diAMgA) jAM mere sAhamaNe koI Thosa dalIla peza kare|
bahutI dera nahIM sI hoI ki uha (huda huda) A giA ate kihA ki maiM uha jANakArI lai ke AiA hAM jisadA tuhAnUM kujjha vI patA nahIM, maiM sabA (deza) bAre ika saccI sUcanA tuhADe kola lai ke AiA hAM|
maiM vekhiA ki utthe ika isatarI rAja kara rahI hai jisa nUM hara prakAra dIAM (lor3IMdIAM) cIz2AM baqhazIAM gaIAM hana ate usa dA taqhata (siMghAsana) bahuta hI zAnadAra hai|

maiM vekhiA ki uha te usa dI kauma rabba nUM chaDDa ke sUraja nUM pUjadI hai ate zaitAna ne uhanAM de ihanAM kaMmAM nUM uhanAM laI sohaNe kara vikhAiA hai ate uhanAM nUM siddhe rAha toM roka dittA hai| huNa uha hidAita valla nahIM AuMde|

ki uha usa allAha nUM sijadA karana jihar3A akAzAM te dharatI dIAM sArIAM lukIAM hoiA cIz2AM nUM bAhara kaDDhadA hai ate tusIM jo vI (lokAM toM) lukAuMde ho ate vikhAuMde ho uha (allAha) sabha jANadA hai|
allAha toM chuTTa hora koI vI baMdagI de yoga nahIM, uhIo vaDiAI vAle araza dA mAlika hai|
(sulemAna ne huda huda nUM) kihA ki asIM huNe vekhAMge ki tUM sacca kihA hai jAM jhUThiAM viccoM hai|
merI isa ciTThI nUM lai jA te uhanAM valla ghalla A, phera uhanAM toM parAM haTTa ke vekha ki uha kI kahiMde hana|
(jadoM sabA dI rANI bilakIsa ne ciTThI vekhI tAM) uha kahiNa laggI ki he darabArIo! mere kola ika bahuta hI mahattava pUrana ciTThI AI hai|
nirasaMdeha, iha (ciTThI) sulemAna (bAdazAha) valloM AI hai ate isa dA AraMbha atiaMta miharabAna allAha de nAM nAla kItA giA hai|
(usa vica likhiA hai) ki tUM mere mukAbale vica sarakazI nA kara ate musalamAna (faramAMbaradAra) baNake mere kola hAz2ira hovo|
usa (rANI) ne kihA ki he mere darabArIo! tusIM mainUM isa muAmale vica salAha dio, maiM koI vI faisalA tuhAthoM binAM nahIM karadI|
uhanAM (afasarAM) ne (salAha diMde) kihA ki asIM zakatIzAlI ate yodhe hAM, agge faisalA karana de sAre adhikAra tuhADe hattha vica hana| tusIM vekho ki tusIM sAnUM kI hukama deNA hai|
usa (rANI) ne kihA ki jadoM bAdazAha kise deza vica A ghusade hana tAM usa nUM ujAr3a diMde hana ate usa de patavaMte sajjanAM dA nirAdara karade hana (laggadA hai) iha lokI vI iMja hI karanage|
maiM uhanAM valla ika sugAta bhejadI hAM, phera vekhadI hAM ki mere dUta kI javAba laike AuMde hana|

jadoM dUta sulemAna kola pahuMciA tAM Apa jI ne pucchiA, kI tusIM daulata nAla merI sahAitA karanA cAhuMde ho? mainUM allAha ne jo baqhaziA hai, uha usa toM kite vadhere hai jo usa ne tuhAnUM dittA hoiA hai| so tuhADI sugAta tuhAnUM hI mubAraka hove|

(he dUta!) jA parata jA ApaNe bhejaNa vAle valla| asIM uhanAM de utte ajihIAM faujAM laike AvAMge jisa dA mukAbalA karana dI himmata uhanAM kola nahIM hovegI ate asIM uhanAM nUM z2alIla karake uthiੱoM bAhara kaDDha diAMge, ki uha hINe hoke rahi jANage|
sulemAna ne AkhiA, he darabArIo! tuhADe viccoM koI ajihA ru jihar3A uhanAM lokAM de AgiAkArI baNake mere kola AuNa toM pahilAM pahilAM usa (rANI) dA taqhata mere kola lai Ave|

jiMnAM viccoM ika takar3e jiMna ne kihA ki isa toM pahilAM ki tusIM isa thAM toM uTThoM, maiM usa (taqhata) nUM tuhADe kola lai AvAMgA| bezakka maiM isa dI tAkata rakkhadA hAM ate maiM amAnatadAra vI hAM|

jisa (viakatI) kola kitAba dA giAna sI uha boliA ki maiM usa (taqhata) nUM tuhADI akkha jhamakaNa toM pahilAM tuhADe kola lai AvAMgA| jadoM sulemAna ne usa taqhata nUM ApaNe kola rakkhiA hoiA vekhiA tAM AkhiA, iha sabha mere rabba dI kripAlatA hai, tAM jo uha mainUM parakhe, kI maiM usa dA zukara adA karadA hAM jAM nA-zukarA hAM? jihar3A vI koI zukara (dhaMnavAda) karadA hai uha ApaNe hI laI zukara adA karadA hai jihar3A koI nA-zukarI karadA hai (cete rahe ki) bezakka merA rabba ihanAM gallAM toM vaDDA be-paravAha hai ate miharabAna hai|
(sulemAna ne) hukama dittA ki tusIM isa taqhata (siMghAsana) vica kujjha phera badala kara dio tAM jo patA lagga jAve ki uha hakIkata nUM samajhadI hai jAM uhanAM viccoM hai jihar3e nA-samajha hana|

phera jadoM uha (rANI) sulemAna de darabAra vica A gaI tAM usa nUM pucchiA giA, kI tuhADA siMghAsana vI ajihA hI hai? usa ne kihA ki iMja samajho ki iha uhIo hai ate sAnUM isa toM pahilAM hI (tuhADe nabI hoNa dA) giAna ho cukkiA sI ate asIM AgiAkArI (musalamAna) baNa gae sAM|
usa (rANI) nUM (allAha dI baMdagI toM) isa (sUraja dI pUjA) ne roka rakkhiA sI, jisa dI uha allAha nUM chaDDa ke ibAdata karadI sI, kiuM jo uha kAfira kauma viccoM sI|

rANI nUM kihA giA ki mahila aMdara praveza karo| jadoM usa ne (mahila dA faraza) vekhiA tAM uha samajhI ki iha (tAlAba dA) pANI hai ate usa ne ApaNIAM piMDalIAM naMgIAM kara laIAM (bhAva mUharIAM utAMha cukka laIAM)| sulemAna ne faramAiA, iha tAM zIze toM baNiA hoiA mahila hai| (rANI) AkhaNa laggI ki he mere pAlaNahAra! bezakka (huNa takka sUraja dI pUjA karake) maine ApaNe Apa ’te z2ulama hI kItA sI ate huNa maiM sulemAna nAla mila ke sArI srizaTI de mAlika dI AgiAkArI kabUla karadI hAM|
asIM samUda (kauma) valla uhanAM de bharA sAleha nUM (iha paig2Ama deke) bhejiA ki tusIM sAre allAha dI baMdagI karo, praMtU uha do guTa (kAfirAM te momina) baNake Apasa vica hI jhagar3ana lagga pae|

sAleha ne faramAiA, he merI kauma! tusIM bhalAI toM pahilAM burAI bhAva az2Aba laI (duAvAM maMgaNa vica) chetI kiuM kara rahe ho? tusIM allAha toM muAfI kiuM nahIM maMga laiMde tAM jo tuhADe ’te rahima kItA jAve|

uha (kaume-samUda) AkhaNa lagge ki asIM tAM tuhAnUM ate tuhADe sAthIAM nUM be-bhAga samajhade hAM| sAleha ne AkhiA ki be-bhAgI (bada-zagunI) tAM allAha de hattha vica hai, sagoM tuhADI tAM parakha ho rahI hai|
usa zahira vica no saradAra sI jihar3e dharatI ’te fasAda failAuMde sI, uha koI vI sudhAra dI galla nahIM sI karade|

uhanAM (nau saradArAM) ne Apo vica AkhiA, allAha dIAM kasamAM khAo ki asIM rAta nUM hI sAleha ate usa de ghara vAliAM ’te hamalA karAMge ate usa de vArasAM nUM Akha diAMge ki asIM tAM usa de ghara vAliAM de hamale de sameM maujUda hI nahIM sI, asIM sacca Akhade hAM|
uhanAM (fasAdIAM) ne ika cAla callI ate asIM vI ika cAla callI ate uhanAM nUM usa dI qhabara taka nA hoI|
phera tusIM vekho ki uhanAM dIAM cAlAM dA aMta kI hoiA? asIM uhanAM nUM ate uhanAM dI kauma nUM (sane nau saradArAM de) malIAMmeTa kara dittA|
iha hana uhanAM de qhAlI ghara jihar3e uhanAM de z2ulamAM kArana ujar3e pae hana| jihar3e lokI giAna rakkhade hana uhanAM laI isa vica sikkhiAdAika nizAnIAM hana|
asIM uhanAM nUM, jihar3e ImAna liAe sI te allAha toM Darade sI, az2Aba toM bacA liA sI|
(yAda karo) jadoM lUta ne ApaNI kauma nUM kihA ki kI tusIM akkhIM vekhade hoe vI azalIla kaMma karade ho?
kI tusIM auratAM nUM chaDDa ke kAma vAsanAM dI pUratI laI maradAM kola jAMde ho? tusIM tAM jAhalAM vAle kaMma karade ho|

Usa dI kauma de kola uhanAM gallAM dA chuTTa isa toM koI vI javAba nahIM sI ki uhanAM ne kihA ki lUta ate isa de ghara vAliAM nUM ApaNI basatI ’coM hI kaDDha dio, iha tAM vaDDe neka-pAkabAz2a baNade hana|
phera asIM usa (lUta) nUM ate usa de ghara vAliAM nUM, chuTTa usa dI patanI, sabha nUM bacA liA| asIM iha mittha liA sI ki uha picche rahi jANa vAliAM viccoM hovegI|
asAM uhanAM z2AlamAM utte pattharAM dA mIMha barasAiA| bahuta hI bhair3A mIMha sI jihar3A DarAe hoe lokAM ’te barasAiA giA|

(he muhaMmada sa:!) tusIM Akha dio ki sArIAM tArIfAM te zukarAne allAha laI hana| usa de uhanAM baMdiAM ’te salAma hove jinhAM nUM usa ne (paig2aMbarI laI) cuNa liA hai| kI allAha caMgerA hai jAM uha (izaTa) jinhAM nUM iha lokI (rabba dA) zarIka thApa rahe hana? [1]
translations.footnotes: [1] isa Aita rAhIM ziraka toM DarAiA jA rihA hai, kiuM jo ziraka allAha dI muhabbata de ulaTa hai, jada ki ika momina de dila vica sabha toM vaddha muhabbata allAha ate usa de rasUla dI hoNI cAhIdI hai| ziraka muAfI yoga vI nahIM je koI viakatI ziraka karade karade hI mara jAve tAM uha sadA laI narakI hai|

translations.translation: (kI iha jhUThe izaTa caMgere hana) jAM uha (allAha) jisa ne akAza te dharatI nUM sAjiA te tuhADe laI akAza toM mIMha barasAiA? phera isa (mIMha) toM asIM ramaNIka bAg2a ugAe jinhAM bAg2AM de daraqhatAM nUM tusIM kade vI ugA nahIM sI sakade| kI allAha de nAla koI hora vI izaTa hai? (jo iha sabha kujjha kara sakadA hove)| iho loka hana jihar3e thApe hoe izaTAM nUM allAha de barAbara khar3hA karade hana|

uha (allAha hai) jisa ne dharatI nUM Thahirana (vasana) de yoga baNAiA ate use (dhatarI) vica nahirAM vagAIAM ate isa laI (ki dharatI nA hille) pahAr3a baNA ditte ate do samuMdarAM de vicakAra par3adiAM dI roka lagA dittI| kI usa allAha de nAla koI hora vI izaTa (ihanAM kaMmAM dA karana vAlA) hai?uhanAM vica vadhere hana jihar3e iha galla nahIM jANade|

kI uha jhUThe izaTa caMge hana jAM uha allAha caMgA hai jihar3A bevasa (majabUra) dI duA kabUladA hai, usa dI pukAra nUM suNa ke usa dIAM muzakalAM, takalIfAM nUM dUra karadA hai| uha tuhAnUM dharatI dA AdhikArI baNAuMdA hai? kI allAha de nAla koI hora vI izaTa hai? tusIM tAM bahuta hI ghaTTa soca vicAra karade ho|

kI buta caMge hana jAM ki uha jihar3A tuhAnUM jala ate thala de haneriAM viccoM rAha vikhAuMdA hai ate jihar3A ApaNIAM rahimatAM toM pahilAM hI (bAriza dIAM) qhuzaqhabarIAM deNa vAlIAM havAvAM nUM bhejadA hai| kI allAha de nAla koI hora vI (izaTa) hai? allAha tAM uhanAM sabha (izaTAM toM) bahuta uccA hai jinhAM nUM uha (rabba dA) zarIka thApade hana|

kI thApe izaTa vadhIA hana jAM uha allAha jihar3A muDDhoM maqhalUka dI racanAM racAuMdA hai (usa de marana magaroM) phera mur3a racAvegA ate jihar3A tuhAnUM akAza te dharatI viccoM roz2IAM diMdA hai? kI allAha toM chuTTa koI hora vI izaTa hai? (he muhaMmada!) uhanAM muzarikAM nUM Akho ki je tusIM sacce ho (ki allAha dA hora sAMjhI hai) tAM koI dalIla liAo|

(he nabI!) Akha dio ki chuTTa allAha toM akAzAM vica rahiNa vAle (bhAva farizate) ate dharatI ’te rahiNa vAliAM (manukkha te jiMnAM) viccoM koI vI g2aiba dA giAna nahIM rakkhadA, iha (thApe hoe izaTa) tAM iha vI nahIM jANade ki uhanAM nUM mur3a jiUMdA kadoM kItA jAvegA|
sagoM Aqhirata dI jANakArI nUM iha guAca (bhulA) baiThe hana, iha isa (Aqhirata) valloM zakka vica hana sagoM iha tAM (Aqhirata pakkhoM) aMnhe ho gae hana|
kAfira pucchade hana ki kI jadoM asIM ate sADe pio-dAde miTTI ho jAvAMge tAM kI asIM mur3a (dharatI viccoM) kaDDhe jAvAMge?
bezakka sAnUM vI ate sAthoM pahilAM sADe bApa-dAdiAM nUM vI iho gallAM kahIAM gaIAM hana| para iha tAM kevala pahile lokAM de kisse kahANIAM hana|
(he nabI!) Akha dio ki dharatI ’te tura phira ke vekho ki pApIAM dA aMta kiho jihA hoiA sI|
(he muhaMmada sa:!) tusIM uhanAM (kAfarAM) dI hAlata ’te dukhI nA hovo ate nA hI uhanAM dIAM cAlAM ’te dila choTA karo|
iha (kAfira) Akhade hana ki iha (kiAmata dA) vAadA kadoM pUrA hovegA? je tusIM sa?ce ho tAM (isa dA samAM) dasso|
uhanAM nUM kaho ki jisa galla laI tusIM chetI kara rahe ho ho sakadA hai ki usa dA kujjha hissA tuhADe ner3e hI A DhukkA hove|
ate bezakka tuhADA pAlaNahAra sAre lokAM ’te hI faz2ala (miharAM) karana vAlA hai para phera vI bahute lokI tAM nA-zukarI hI karade hana|
bezakka tuhADA rabba uhanAM gallAM nUM vI jANadA hai jinhAM nUM uhanAM de dila lako rahe hana ate jo vikhA rahe hana (sabha jANadA hai)|
akAzAM te dharatI dI koI vI gupata cIz2a ajihI nahIM jihar3I sapazaTa kitAba (lauhe-mahafUz2a) vica nA likhI hove|
bezakka iha਼kuraAna banI-isarAIla nUM uhanAM gallAM dI asalIata biAna karadA hai jinhAM vica iha matabheda kara rahe hana|
nirasaMdeha, iha (.kuraAna) ImAna vAliAM laI hidAita ate rahimata?|
bezakka he nabI! tuhADA rabba uhanAM (kAfirAM) vicakAra ApaNe hukama anusAra faisale kara devegAM uha z2orAvara ate sabha kujjha jANana vAlA hai|
so (he nabI!) tusIM allAha ’te bharosA rakkho, bezakka tusIM hI sacce te siddhe rAha ’te ho|
tusIM nA tAM (ApaNI galla) muradiAM nUM suNA sakade ho ate nA hI uhanAM boliAM nUM ApaNI avAz2a suNA sakade ho, jada ki uha piTTha pherI nasse jA rahe hana|

ate nA hI aMnhiAM nUM uhanAM dI gumarAhI toM bacA ke siddhe rahA pA sakade ho| tusIM tAM kevala uhanAM nUM hI suNA sakade ho, jihar3e sADIAM AitAM (.kuraAna) ’te ImAna liAe hana, phera uhIo AgiAkArI baNa jAMde hana|

jadoM uhanAM (inakArIAM) ’te az2Aba liAuNa dI sADI galla pUrI hoNa dA samAM A jAvegAM tAM asIM dharatI viccoM uhanAM laI ika jAnavara [2] kaDDhAMge jihar3A uhanAM nAla gallAM karegA| bezakka iha loka tAM sADIAM AitAM (nizAnIAM) dA vizavAsa nahIM sI karade|
translations.footnotes: [2] vekho sUrata ala-anAma, hAzIA Aita 158/6

translations.translation: ate usa vele (bhAva kiAmata dihAr3e) asIM hara ummata (samudAi) viccoM usa TolI nUM ghera ke liAvAMge jihar3I sADIAM AitAM (hukamAM) nUM savIkAra nahIM sI karadI| phera uhanAM sabha dI darajA baMdI (bhAva vakkha-vakkha) kara dittI jAvegI|

jadoM sAre (hazara de maidAna vica) A jANage tAM allAha pucchegA, kI tusIM binAM giAna de ghere vica liAe merIAM (AitAM) dA inakAra nahIM sI kItA? (je nahIM phera tAM iha dasso) ki (saMsAra vica tusIM kI kujjha karade sI)|
uhanAM (inakArIAM) de z2ulamAM kArana uhanAM utte (az2Aba dI) puzaTI ho jAvegA ate uha kujjha bolaNa joge vI nahIM rahiNage|
kI uha nahIM vekhade ki asIM rAta nUM baNAiA hai ki uha usa vica ArAma kara sakaNa ate dina nUM vekhaNa vAlA baNAiA| bezakka isa vica uhanAM lokAM laI bahuta nizAnIAM hana jihar3e ImAna liAuMde hana|

jisa dina sUra (bigala) bajAiA jAvegA tAM sAre de sAre akAzAM vAle ate dharatI vAle ghabarA jANage para (uha nahIM ghabarAuMge) chuTTa uhanAM toM jinhAM nUM allAha cAhave ate sAre hI hINe hoke nimaratA sahita usa (rabba) de haz2Ura peza hoNage|

tusIM pahAr3AM nUM ApaNI thAM ’te gaDDe hoe samajhade ho para (kiAmata dihAr3e) uha vI baddalAM vAMga ur3ade hoNage, iho allAha dI kArIgarI hai, usa ne hareka cIz2a nUM drir3a te maz2abUta baNAiA| tusIM jo vI karade ho usa toM (allAha) jANU hai|
jihar3A viakatI nekI laike AvegA usa nUM vadhIA badalA milegA ate uha usa dina dI ghabarAhaTa toM nizaciMta hovegA|
para jihar3e lokI burAIAM laike AuNage uhanAM nUM mUddhe mUMha agga vica suTTiA jAvegA (ate kihA jAvegA) ki tuhAnUM usa dA hI badalA dittA jAvegA jo amala tusIM (saMsAra vica) karade sI|

(he nabI! tusIM kahi dio ki) mainUM tAM(rabba valloM) iho hukama hoiA hai ki maiM isa nagara (makke)de rabba dI baMdagI karAM jisa ne isa nUM huramata vAlA (satikAra yoga) baNAiA hai,[3] jihar3A hareka cIz2a dA mAlika hai ate mainUM iha vI hukama hoiA hai ki maiM musalamAnAM (AgiAkArIAM) viccoM hovAM|
translations.footnotes: [3] isa toM bhAva makkA zahira vica nabI karIma (sa:) ne phatiha makke de dina faramAiA “allAha ne isa zahira nUM harama (amana dA zahira) ghozita kItA hai isa dIAM kaMDedAra jhAr3IAM nA kaTTIAM jANa nA utthe zikAra dA picchA kItA jAve je utthe koI cIz2a girI paI hove usa nUM nA cukkiA jAve| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 1587 ate vokho hAzIA sUrata bakarA 191/2)

translations.translation: (ate hukama hoiA hai) ki.kuraAna dI talAvata karAM (bhAva par3ha par3ha ke suNAuMdA ravAM) jihar3A koI (.kuraAna suNa ke) siddhe rAha ’te A jAvegA uha ApaNe bhale laI hI hidAita pAvegA ate jihar3A kurAhe pai giA tAM usa nUM Akha dio ki maiM tAM kevala sAvadhAna karana vAliAM viccoM hAM|

(he nabI!) uhanAM (kAfirAM) nUM kaho ki sArIAM tArIfAM allAha laI hI hana uha tuhAnUM chetI hI ApaNIAM (hoMda dIAM) nizAnIAM vikhAvegA jinhAM nUM tusIM Apa hI pachANa lavoge ate jo kujjha tusIM karade ho usa toM tuhADA rabba beqhabara nahIM hai|
tA, sIna, mIma|
iha rauzana kitAba (.kuraAna) dIAM AitAM hana|
he nabI! asIM tuhAnUM mUsA te hArUna dA hAla ThIka-ThAka suNAuMde hAM, iha kissA uhanAM lokAM (de lAbha) laI hai jihar3e ImAna rakkhade hana|

firaauna ne dharatI (misara) utte sarakazI (bagAvata) phailA rakkhI sI ate misara de lokAM nUM kaI dhar3hiAM vica vaMDa suTTiA sI| uhanAM viccoM ika dhar3e (banI-isarAIla) nUM kamaz2ora samajha ke dabA ke rakkhadA sI| uha uhanAM de puttarAM nUM mAra suTTadA sI ate dhIAM nUM jiuMdIAM rakhadA sI| asala vica uha fasAdIAM viccoM hI sI|
asIM cAhuMde sI ki asIM uhanAM lokAM ’te ahisAna karIe, jinhAM nUM dharatI utte kamaz2ora (be-vasa) samajha ke dabA ke rakkhiA giA sI, uhanAM nUM AgU ate uhanAM nUM hI (misara dA) vArasa baNA daIe|

ate iha vI icchA sI ki asIM uhanAM (kamaz2ora lokAM) nUM (falasatIna dI dharatI dI) prabhUsattA baqhazIe ate firaauna, hAmAna ate uhanAM dIAM faujAM nUM (uhanAM kamaz2ora lokAM de hatthoM) uha (bhavizavANI sacca kara) vikhA daIe jisa toM uha Dara rahe sI|

asIM mUsA dI mAM nUM izArA kItA ki tUM isa (mUsA) nUM duddha piAuMdI rahi ate je isa valloM koI ciMtA hove (ki firaauna de baMde isa nUM mAra nA deNa) tAM tUM isa (mUsA) nUM dariA vica ror3ha daIM, nA kise tarhAM dA koI Dara qhaupha rakkhaNA te nA hI koI ciMtA Adi karanA| asIM (allAha) isa (mUsA) nUM tere kola mor3a liAvAMge ate isa nUM ApaNe paig2aMbarAM vica zAmala karAMge|

so firaauna de ghara vAliAM ne usa (mUsA) nUM (dariA ’coM) kaDDha liA tAM jo iha (mUsA ika dina) uhanAM (firaaunIAM) dA duzamana siddha hove ate uhanAM dI ciMtA dA kArana baNe| bezakka firaauna, hAmAna ate uhanAM dIAM faujAM (sAthI) aparAdhI sana|

(firaauna ne jadoM usa bacce nUM katala karanA cAhiA tAM) firaauna dI patanI ne kihA iha baccA tAM tuhADe te mere laI akkhAM dI ThaMDhaka hai, isa nUM nA mAro, ho sakadA hai ki iha sADe laI lAhevaMda siddha hove jAM asIM isa nUM ApaNA puttara hI baNA laIe| (asala galla tAM iha hai ki) uha isa de siTTe toM aNajANa sI uhanAM nUM kujjha vI samajha nahIM sI (ki uha kisa nUM puttara baNA rahe hana)|

uddhara mUsA dI mAM dA dila becaina sI, je asIM usa nUM hausalA nA duAuMde tAM ho sakadA sI ki uha isa bheda nUM hI khola diMdI| (iha hausalA isa laI dittA giA sI) tAM jo uha (sADe vacanAM utte) bharosA karana vAliAM viccoM ho jAve|

mUsA dI mAM ne usa (mUsA) dI bhaiNa nUM kihA ki tUM isa de picche-picche jA ate uha (bhaiNa) usa (mUsA) nUM dUra toM hI vekhade hoe picche-picche jA rahI sI jada ki firaaunIAM nUM isa dA kujjha patA vI nahIM sI|

asIM (mUsA te mUsA dI bhaiNa de firaauna de darabAra vica pahuMcaNa toM) pahilAM hI mUsA utte dAIAM dA duddha harAma kara (bhAva duddha cuMghaNa toM roka) dittA sI| mUsA dI bhaiNa ne (firaauna dI patanI nUM) kihA, kI maiM tuhAnUM uha ghara dassAM jihar3A isa bacce dA pAlaNa pozaNa kare ate isa bacce de zubha ciMtaka vI hoNa|

iMja asIM usa bacce (mUsA) nUM usa dI mAM kola mor3a liAMdA tAM jo usa dIAM akkhAM ThaMDIAM rahiNa ate kise prakAra dI koI ciMtA nA hove ate iha vI jANa lave ki bezakka allAha dA vAadA saccA huMdA hai, para vadhere lokI iha galla nahIM jANade|

jadoM mUsA ApaNI bhara javAnI nUM pujja giA ate samajha bUjha vAlA ho giA phera asIM usa (mUsA) nUM hikamata (samajhadArI) te giAna baqhaziA| asIM nekI karana vAliAM nUM iMja hI badalA diA karadA hAM|

(ika dina mUsA) usa zahira vica ajihe vele dAqhala hoiA jadoM zahira nivAsI beqhabarI vica sana| utthe usa (mUsA ne) do AdamIAM nUM lar3ade vekhiA| (uhanAM vica) ika tAM usa (mUsA) dI kauma viccoM sI ate dUjA usa dI vairI kauma viccoM sI| jihar3A (mUsA) dI kauma viccoM sI usa ne usa de viruddha, jo usa dI kauma dA vairI sI, usa (mUsA) toM sahAitA maMgI| jisa toM mUsA ne usa de ika mukkA jar3ha dittA jisa kArana uha mara giA| mUsA (nUM isa dA pachatAvA hoiA ate) AkhaNa laggA ki iha tAM zaitAnI kaMma hai, bezakka uha zaitAna (manukkha dA) khullA duzamana hai ate kurAhe pAuMdA hai|

(mUsA ne muAfI maMgade hoe) kihA ki he mere mAlika! maine ApaNe Apa nAla z2ulama kItA hai, so tUM mainUM khimA kara de| allAha ne usa nUM muAfa kara dittA| uha ApaNIAM miharAM sadake baqhazaNahAra hai|
(mUsA) ne AkhiA ki he mere rabbA! jiddAM tUM mere ’te upakAra kItA hai huNa maiM kade vI kise aparAdhI dI madada nahIM karAMgA|

phera mUsA ne zahira vica Darade Darade ate iddhara uddhara dekhade hoe savera kItI| acaNaceta usa ne vekhiA ki jisa viakatI ne kalla usa (mUsA) toM sahAitA maMgI sI (ajja phera usa nUM) madada laI kahi rihA hai| mUsA ne usa nUM kihA ki isa vica koI zakka nahIM ki tUM tAM vigar3hiA hoiA AdamI hai|

jadoM (mUsA ne) ApaNe ate usa viakatI nUM phar3aNA cAhiA, jihar3A uhanAM dohAM dA vairI sI tAM uha (isarAIlI) AkhaNa laggA ki he mUsA! jiveM tUM kalla ika viakatI nUM katala kItA sI, kI tUM use prakAra mainUM vI mAranA cAhuMdA hai? tUM tAM iha cAhuMNA hai ki isa deza vica jabara de z2ulama karadA phireM, tUM nahIM cAhuMdA ki koI sudhAra hove|

(use vele) zahira de parale sirio bhajjadA hoiA ika viakatI AiA ate AkhaNa laggA ki he mUsA! (misara) de saradAra tere viruddha salAhAM kara rahe hana, bassa tUM (chetI toM chetI) itthoM nikala jA maiM tere zubha ciMtakAM viccoM hAM|
(iha suNade hI) mUsA usa zahira ’coM Darade sahimade Ale-duAle vekhade hoe nikkala turiA ate AkhaNa laggiA ki he mere pAlaNahAra! mainUM z2AlamAM dI kauma toM surakkhiata rakkha|
jadoM uha (mUsA) ne madayana valla calla piA tAM kahiNa laggA ki Asa hai ki merA rabba mainUM siddhI rAha dI hidAita devegA|

jadoM uha madayana de pANI (khUha) ’te appar3hiA tAM utthe usa ne lokAM dI ika bhIr3a vekhI, uha ApaNe pazUAM nUM pANI piA rahe sana| utthe hI usa ne do auratAM dekhIAM jihar3IAM (ApaNe pazUAM nUM) rokIM vakkharIAM khar3hIAM sana| mUsA ne uhanAM toM pucchiA, kI galla tusIM pANI nahIM piA rahIAM? uha bolIAM ki jadoM taka iha Ajar3I itthoM (pANI piA ke) mur3a nahIM jAMde asIM pANI nahIM piA sakadIAM, sADe pitA jI bahuta bridha ho cukke hana|
iha suNa ke mUsA ne uhanAM de pazUAM nUM pANI piA dittA, phera ika chAM vAlI thAM jA ke bahi giA te AkhiA ki he mere rabbA! tUM jihar3I vI nekI mere valla utAradA hai, maiM usa dA muthAja hAM|

(kujjha cira magaroM) uhanAM dovAM auratAM viccoM ika aurata zaramAuMdI lajjAuMdI hoI usa kola AI te kahiNa laggI ki tuhAnUM mere pitA jI ne bulAiA hai tAM ki jihar3A tusIM (pazUAM nUM) pANI piAiA hai usa dI maz2adUrI deNa| jadoM uha usa (pitA) de kola pujjiA ate uhanAM nUM ApaNI kahANI suNAI tAM uha kahiNa laggiA ki huNa koI DaraNa dI lor3a nahIM, tusIM z2Alama kauma toM najAta pA cukke ho|

uhanAM dovAM (auratAM) viccoM ika (aurata) ne kihA ki pitA jI, isa viakatI (mUsA) nUM maz2adUrI laI rakkha lao, maz2adUrI laI sAriAM toM caMgA uhIo huMdA hai jihar3A tAkatavAra ate amAnatadAra vI hove|

usa (aurata de pitA ne mUsA nUM) kihA ki maiM ApaNIAM dhIAM viccoM ika nUM tere nikAha vica deNA cAhuMdA hAM para isa zarata ’te ki tusIM aTTha sAla (mahira vajoM) merI naukarI karoge, hAM! je dasa sAla taka karo tAM iha tuhADI icchA hai maiM tuhADe ’te saqhatI karanA nahIM cAhuMdA| je allAha nUM iha manaz2Ura hoiA tAM tusIM mainUM ika bhalA AdamI hI vekhoge|

(mUsA ne) kihA ki isa galla dI (saMdhI) mere te tuhADe vicAle hai, maiM ihanAM dovAM muddatAM viccoM jihar3I vI cAhavAM pUrI karAMgA, phera mere nAla koI vadhIkI nahIM hoNI cAhIdI, asIM jo saMdhI kara rahe hAM allAha usa dA nigarAna hai|

jadoM mUsA ne uha muddata pUrI kara laI ate ApaNI patanI nUM laike TuriA tAM tUra pahAr3a valla usa ne ika agga vekhI, usa ne ApaNI patanI nUM kihA ki tUM itthe hI Thahira maiMne agga vekhI hai, ho sakadA hai ki maiM utthioM koI qhabara lai AvAM jAM agga dA aMgiArA hI lai AvAM tAM jo tusIM seka sako|
jadoM uha (mUsA usa tUra pahAr3a) kola pahuMciA tAM usa nUM barakatAM vAlI dharatI de sajje kaMDhe ika rukkha ’coM AvAz2a AI ki he mUsA! maiM hI allAha hAM, sAre jahAnAM dA pAlaNahAra hAM|

(ate iha vI kihA ki) tUM ApaNA asA (lAThI) suTTa de, (suTTaNa magaroM) jadoM usa (lAThI) nUM vekhiA tAM uha sappa vAMga valla khA rahI sI tAM uha (mUsA) piTTha mor3a ke nassiA te picche mur3a ke vI nahIM vekhiA| asIM kihA ki he mUsA! agge A te nA Dara, bezakka tUM hara tarhAM nAla surakkhiata hai|

(ate kihA ki) ApaNe hattha nUM ApaNe galAMveM vica pA, uha binAM kise aiba toM camakadA hoiA nikalegA| ate Dara bhaia toM bacaNa laI ApaNIAM bAvAM nUM mIca lai| iha doveM muajaz2e (bevasa karana vAle rabbI camatakAra) tere rabba valloM firaauna ate usa de darabArIAM valla bheje gae hana| bezakka uha sAre hI nA-faramAna loka hana|
mUsA ne kihA ki he mere mAlika! maiM tAM uhanAM dA ika AdamI katala kara cukkiA hAM, so mainUM Dara hai ki uha mainUM mAra deNage|

merA bharA hArUna maithoM vadhIA bulArA hai, tUM usa nUM merA sahAI baNA ke mere nAla bheja de tAM jo uha mainUM saccA samajhaNa, mainUM tAM Dara hai ki uha sAre (firaauna te usa de sAthI) mainUM jhuThalA deNage|

allAha ne kihA ki asIM tere bharA (hArUna) rAhIM tere hattha maz2abUta kara devAMge ate tuhAnUM ajihA pratApa baqhazAMge ki uha (firaaunI) tuhADe taka pahuMca vI nahIM sakaNage| sADIAM nizAnIAM (muajaz2e) lai ke firaauna de darabAra vica jAo| tusIM doveM ate tuhADe pairokAra hI bhArU rahiNage|

jadoM mUsA uhanAM (firaaunIAM) de kola sADe valloM ditte hoe sapazaTa muajaz2e (rabbI camatakAra) laike pahuMciA tAM uha (firaaunI) kahiNa lagge ki iha tAM ghar3hiA ghar3hAiA jAdU hai| asIM tAM ApaNe pio dAdiAM toM iha gallAM (ki allAha hI ikko-ika izaTa hai) kade nahIM suNIAM|

ate mUsA ne (javAba vica) kihA, merA rabba usa nUM caMgI tarhAM jANadA hai, jihar3A usa valloM hidAita laike AuMdA hai ate (usa nUM vI) jisa dA aMta caMgA hovegA| saccI galla tAM iha hai ki z2Alama kade safalatA nahIM pAuMde|

firaauna ne kihA ki he darabArIo! maiM tAM tuhADe laI chuTTa ApaNe Apa toM hora kise izaTa nUM nahIM jANadA| he hAmAna! tUM gAre dIAM iTTAM nUM pakavA ke mere laI ika uccA mahila tAM baNavA tAM jo (isa ’te car3ha ke) mUsA de izaTa nUM vekha sakAM, maiM tAM isa galla nUM (ki rabba akAza ’te ru) jhUTha samajhadA hAM|
isa (firaauna) ne ate isa dIAM faujAM ne (misara dI) dharatI ’te nA-hakkA takabbara (ghamaMDa) kItA ate samajhade sI ki uhanAM nUM sADe valla paratAiA nahIM jAvegA|
aMta asIM usa (firaauna) nUM ate usa dIAM faujAM nUM phar3hiA ate dariA vica suTTa dittA huNa vekho uhanAM pApIAM dA aMta kiho jihA hoiA sI|
ate asIM uhanAM nUM naraka valla saddA deNa vAle AgU baNA dittA ate kiamAta vAle dina uhanAM dI kujjha vI sahAitA nahIM kItI jAvegI|
asIM isa saMsAra vica vI uhanAM (kAfirAM) de picche phiTakAra lA dittI ate kiAmata dihAr3e vI uha bhair3e hAlAM vica hoNage|

pahilIAM ummatAM (nasalAM) nUM halAka karana magaroM asIM (rabba ne) mUsA nUM ajihI kitAba (tauraita) baqhazI jihar3I lokAM laI dAnAI, hidAita ate rahimata baNa ke AI sI, zAida ki uha (isa toM) nasIhata grahiNa kara sakaNa|
(he muhaMmada!) jadoM asIM mUsA nUM vizeza hukama (zarIata) laI vahI ghallI sI tAM (usa sameM) tusIM (tUra de) pacchama valla nahIM sI ate nA hI tusIM isa (ghaTanA) de gavAha ho|

para isa toM picchoM asIM kaIAM nasalAM nUM paidA kItA ate uhanAM ’te ika laMmA samAM bIta cukkA hai| tusIM (muhaMmada sa:) madayana de rahiNa vAle nahIM sI ki uhanAM de sAhamaNe sADIAM AitAM (.kuraAna) nUM par3hade, asalIata iha hai ki sAre rasUlAM nUM bhejaNa vAle asIM hI hAM|

ate tusIM tUra (pahAr3a) kola nahIM sI jadoM asIM (mUsA nUM) avAz2a de ke bulAiA sI| para iha vahI (rabbI bANI) tere rabba valloM ika rahimata hai| tAM jo tusIM uhanAM lokAM nUM (naraka toM) sAvadhAna karo jinhAM kola tuhAthoM pahilAM koI DarAuNa vAlA nahIM AiA| zAida ki uha nasIhata grahiNa kara laiNa|

je iha galla nA huMdI ki lokAM dIAM ApaNIAM karatUtAM kArana uhanAM utte koI musIbata A jAMdI tAM uha iho Akhade ki he sADe rabbA! tUM sADe valla koI paig2aMbara kiuM nahIM bhejiA tAM jo asIM terIAM AitAM (hukama) dI pAlaNA karade ate ImAna vAliAM viccoM ho jAMde (tAM asIM rasUla nA bhejade)|

phera jadoM sADe valloM uhanAM (makke vAliAM) kola hakka (.kuraAna) A giA tAM kahiNa lagge ki uhIo camatakAra tuhAnUM kiuM nahIM ditte gae jiveM mUsA nUM ditte gae sI? (rabba pucchadA hai ki iha dasso) kI uhanAM lokAM ne uhanAM (camatakArAM) nUM maMNana toM inakAra nahIM sI kItA jihar3e isa toM pahilAM mUsA nUM ditte gae sana? kahiMde hana ki doveM (tauraita te.kuraAna) jAdU hana, jo ika dUje dI madada karade hana| asIM kise nUM vI nahIM maMnade|

(he muhaMmada sa:!) uhanAM nUM kahi dio! je tusIM (ApaNIAM dalIlAM vica) sacce ho tAM tusIM vI allAha koloM koI ajihI kitAba lai Ao jihar3I uhanAM dovAM (.kuraAna te tauraita) toM vaddha ke hidAita vAlI hove, maiM use dI pairavI karAgAM|

je phera vI iha (makke vAle) tuhADIAM gallAM nUM nahIM maMnade tAM tusIM samajha lao ki iha tAM kevala ApaNIAM icchAvAM dI hI pairavI kara rahe hana| isa toM vaddha ke z2Alima koNa hovegA jihar3A binAM rabbI hidAita toM ApaNIAM icchAvAM de picche hI laggiA rahe? bezakka allAha z2Alama lokAM nUM hidAita nahIM diMdA|
nirasaMdeha, asIM lokAM dI hidAita laI lar3I vAra ApaNIAM gallAM (bhAva kuraAna) nAz2ila karade rahe hAM tAM jo uha nasIhata hAsala kara sakaNa|
jihanAM lokAM nUM asIM isa (.kuraAna) toM pahilAM kitAba dittI sI uha isa (.kuraAna) ’te vI ImAna rakkhade hana|

jadoM isa (.kuraAna) nUM uhanAM sAhamaNe par3hiA jAMdA hai tAM uha kahiMde hana ki asIM isa ’te ImAna liAe hAM, bezakka iha sADe rabba valloM hakka hai, asIM tAM isa toM pahilAM hI musalamAna sAM [1] (kiuM jo asIM pahilIAM AsamAnI kitAbAM nUM sacca maMnade hAM)|
translations.footnotes: [1] vekho sUrata ala-mAidA, hAzIA Aita 66/5

translations.translation: uhanAM lokAM nUM uhanAM de (ImAna liAuNa dA) dUharA badalA dittA jAvegA, kiuM jo uhanAM ne (allAha dI rAha vica) sabara toM kaMma liA [2] ate burAI nUM bhalAI nAla parAM karade hana ate jo kujjha vI asIM uhanAM nUM (dhaMna daulata) dittA hoiA hai usa viccoM (rabbI hukamAM anusAra) qharaca karade hana|
translations.footnotes: [2] isa toM bhAva uha loka hana jihar3e hara tarhAM de hAlAda vica paig2aMbarAM ate rabbI kitAbAM utte ImAna liAe ate ApaNe ImAna utte jame rahe| uha pahile nabI utte ImAna liAe usa magaroM dUjA nabI A giA tAM usa te ImAna liAe uhanhAM utte doharA ajara hai| sahI buqhArI hadIsa 5083 vica nabI (sa:) ne faramAiA hai ki jihar3e viakatI ApaNe paig2aMbara utte ImAna liAiA te phera mere utte ImAna liAiA usa nUM dUrA savAba milegA|

translations.translation: jadoM uha bhair3IAM gallAM (muzarikAM, kAfirAM valloM) suNade hana tAM usa toM mUMha mor3a laiMde hana ate Akhade hana ki sADe karama sADe laI ate tuhADe karama tuhADe laI hana| tuhAnUM sADA salAma hai, asIM jAhalAM nAla ulajhaNA nahIM cAhuMde|
he nabI! tusIM jisa nUM cAho hidAita nahIM de sakade, sagoM jisa nUM allAha cAhuMdA hai usa nUM hidAita diMdA hai| uha hidAita kabUla karana vAliAM nUM caMgI tarhAM jANadA hai|

uha (makke de muzarika) Akhade hana ki je asIM tuhADI hidAita anusAra pairavIM karAgAM tAM asIM ApaNI dharatI (makke) viccoM kaDDha ditte jAvAMge| (allAha pucchadA hai) kI asIM uhanAM nUM amana zAMtI vAlI thAM ‘harama’ vica nivAsa sathAna nahIM dittA, jisa valla hara tarhAM de phala riz2aka vajoM sADe vala liAe jAMde hana, [3]para (afasosa) uhanAM viccoM vadhere (loka) kujjha vI nahIM jANade|
translations.footnotes: [3] iha makke dI uha vizezatA jisa nUM lakkhAM hAjI ate umarA karana vAle loka hara sAla vekhade hana ki makke vica paidAvAra nA haMde hoe vI hara tarhAM dA phala bar3I AsAnI nAla mila jAMdA hai| vekho sUrata ana-namala, hAzIA Aita 91/27, vekho sUrata ala-bakaraha, hAzIA Aita 191/2

translations.translation: asIM kiMnIAM hI basatIAM nUM tabAha kara cukke hAM jihar3IAM ApaNI aratha vivasathA ’te ghamaMDa karadIAM sana| iha hana uhanAM de (ujjar3e hoe) ghara jihar3e uhanAM magaroM bahuta hI ghaTTa AbAda hoe hana (bhAva khaMDara baNa gae) aqhIra asIM hI uhanAM sabha de vArasa hAM|

(he muhaMmada!) terA rabba kise vI basatI nUM udoM taka halAka nahIM karadA jadoM tIka utthe dI kise vaDDI basatI vica ApaNA koI paig2aMbara nahIM bhejadA, uha uhanAM (basatI vAliAM) nUM sADIAM AitAM (hukama) suNAuMdA hai ate asIM uhanAM basatIAM nUM udoM taka halAka nahIM karade jadoM taka utthe de vasanIka z2ulama karana nahIM lagga jAMde|

ate tuhAnUM jo vI dittA hoiA hai uha tAM kevala saMsArika jIvana dI samaggarI hai ate usa dA suhapaNa hai, para jo kujjha allAha de kola hai uha bahuta hI vadhIA hai ate laMme sameM laI hai| kI tusIM akala nahIM rakkhade?

kI uha viakatI jisa nAla asIM neka vAadA kItA hove, jisa nUM uha prApata karana vAlA hai, kade usa viakatI vAMga ho sakadA hai jisa nUM asIM saMsArika jIvana dI samaggarI de chaDDI hove ate aMta kiAmata vAle dina saz2A laI peza hoNa vAliAM viccoM hove|
ate jisa dina allAha uhanAM nUM AvAz2a mAregA ate pucchegA ki tusIM jinhAM nUM ApaNe gumAnAM vica merA zarIka baNAuMde sI uha (ajja) kitthe hana?

uha loka jinhAM laI (az2Aba dA) hukama ho cukkiA hovegA, uha AkhaNage ki he sADe pAlaNahAra! iho uha loka hana, jinhAM nUM asIM kurAhe pAiA sI| asIM ihanAM nUM isa tarhAM kurAhe pAiA, jiddAM asIM Apa bhaTake phirade sI| asIM tere haz2Ura ailAna karade hAM ki uha sADI baMdagI nahIM sI karade|

ate kihA jAvegA ki tusIM ApaNe zarIkAM nUM bulAo, uha (muzarika) uhanAM nUM bulAuNage para uha (zarIka) uhanAM nUM koI uttara nahIM deNage ate uha sAre (muzarika te zarIka) az2Aba nUM vekhaNage| kiMnAM caMgA huMdA je iha (muzarika te kAfira) siddhe rAha ture huMde|
jisa (kiAmata vAle) dina allAha valloM uhanAM nUM pucchiA javegA ki (jadoM rasUla tuhAnUM rabbI paig2Ama suNAuMde sI tAM) tusIM rasUlAM nUM kI uttara dittA sI?
phera tAM usa dina uhanAM nUM kise galla dI qhabara nahIM hovegI ate uha ika dUje toM koI savAla taka nA kara sakaNa ge|
hAM jihar3A viakatI (saMsAra vica hI) taubA karake ImAna lai Ave ate neka kaMma kare uha Asa kara sakadA hai ki uha safalatA pAuNa vAle lokAM viccoM hovegA|

(he nabI!) tuhADA rabba jo cAhuMdA hai paidA karadA hai ate jisa nUM cAhuMdA hai (ApaNe kAraja laI) pasaMda kara laiMdA hai| uhanAM lokAM de hattha vica kujjha vI nahIM| pavittaratA sArI dI sArI allAha laI hai, uha uhanAM toM bahuta ucerA hai jinhAM nUM lokI zarIka baNAuMde hana|
ate tuhADA rabba jANadA hai jo uhanAM de manAM vica lukiA hoiA hai ate jo uha pragaTa kara rahe hana|
uhI allAha hai usa toM chuTTa hora koI baMdagI de yoga nahIM| saMsAra vica vI ate Aqhirata vica vI sArIAM tArIfA use laI hana, use dA hukama caladA hai aMta use valla tusIM sAre paratAe jAoge|

(he nabI!) uhanAM toM puccho ki je allAha tuhADe ’te kiAmata tIka laI rAta hI pAIM rakkhe tAM allAha toM chuTTa hora kauNa izaTa hai, jihar3A tuhADe laI dina dI rauzanI lai ke Ave? kI tusIM suNade nahIM?

uhanAM nUM puccho ki je allAha tuhADe ’te kiAmata tIka sadA laI dina hI kaDDhIM rakkhe (rAta Ave hI nA) tAM allAha toM chuTTa koI izaTa ajihA hai jihar3A tuhADe laI rAta lai Ave ki tusIM ArAma kara sakoM? kI tusIM vekhade nahIM?

usa ne ApaNI rahimata sadake tuhADe laI rAta te dina baNAe, tAM jo tusIM isa (rAta) ArAma kara sakoM ate tAM jo (dina vica) usa dA phaz2ala (riz2aka) labbha sakoM| (iha sabha vekha ke) ho sakadA hai ki tusIM dhaMnavAda karoM|
ate jisa dina allAha uhanAM (muzarikAM) nUM pucchegA ki uha (izaTa) kitthe hana jinhAM nUM tusIM merA sAMjhI qhiAla karade sI|

ate asIM hara ummata (kauma) viccoM ika-ika gavAha kaDDha liAvAMge phera asIM AkhAMge ki tusIM (merA zarIka baNAuNa laI) koI dalIla peza karo| usa sameM uhanAM nUM patA lagga jAvegA ki bezakka saccI gala tAM allAha hI dI hai ate uhanAM toM uha sabha guAca jAvegA, jo jhUTha uha ghar3ade sI|

bezakka kArUna vI mUsA dI kauma viccoM hI sI, para uha uhanAM ’te z2ulama karadA sI| asIM usa nUM iMne qhaz2Ane de rakkhe sI ki usa dIAM kuMjIAM dA bhAra kaI kaI tAkatavara lokAM nUM vI thakA diMdIAM sI| ika vAra usa dI kauma ne kihA ki tUM ghamaMDa nA kara, allAha ghamaMDI lokAM nUM pasaMda nahIM karadA|

ate jo (daulata) allAha ne tainUM dittI hoI hai tUM usa nAla Aqhirata dA ghara baNAuNa dI vI ciMtA kara ate dunIAM viccoM vI ApaNA hissA laiNA nA bhullIM ate jisa tarhAM allAha ne tere ’te ahisAna kItA hai, tUM vI (lokAM ’te) ahisAna kara ate dharatI ’te vigAr3a paidA nA kara| bezakka allAha fasAdIAM nUM pasaMda nahIM karadA|

kArUna ne uttara vica kihA ki iha sabha kujjha (mAladaulata) mainUM merI akala-samajha kArana hI dittA giA hai| kI uha nahIM jANadA ki bezakka allAha isa toM pahilAM bahuta sAre ajihe lokAM nUM nazaTa kara cukkiA hai jo isa toM kite vaddha z2orAvara sI ate bahuta vaDDe dhanavAna sI? gunAhagArAM (pApIAM) toM uhanAM de aparAdhAM pratI nahIM pucchiA jAMdA|

jadoM uha (kArUna) ApaNI kauma de sAhamaNe pUrI sajja-dhajja nAla nikaliA tAM saMsArika jIvana de matavAle kahiNa lagge ki kAza! sAnUM vI kise prakAra uha mila jAMdA jo (dhaMna-daulata) kArUna nUM dittA giA hai| bezakka uha tAM kisamata dA dhaMnI hai|

para jinhAM nUM giAna dittA giA sI uhanAM ne kihA ki afasosa tuhADIAM akalAM ’te, usa viakatI laI allAha valloM caMgA badalA hai jihar3A allAha ’te ImAna liAiA te neka amala kIte| iha galla sabara karana vAliAM nUM hI sikhAI jAMdI hai|

so asIM usa (kArUna) nUM sane usa de mahila de dharatI vica dhasA dittA ate phera usa laI (usa de hAmIAM dI) koI TolI ajihI nahIM sI jihar3I allAha de mukAbale vica usa dI madada karadI ate nA hI uha Apa badalA lai sakiA|[4]
translations.footnotes: [4] iha ru uha aMta jihar3A takabbara karana vAliAM dA huMdA hai| hadIsa vica hai ki vaDiAI ate haMkAra nAla pajAmA, paiMTa, zalavAra jAM cAdarA dharatI utte ghasITa ke calaNNa vAlA bhair3e aMjAma huMdA hai| ise laI nabI (sa:) ne faramAiA ki kiAmata de dihAr3e usa viakatI vala nahIM vekhegA jihar3A ghamaMDa vica Ake pajAmA jAM zalavAra ghasITa ke caladA hai| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 5788)

translations.translation: ate jihar3e lokI kalla tIka usa vAMga amIra baNana dI icchA rakkhade sI, uha savera nUM uTha ke kahiNa lagge, hAe afasosa (sADI bhulla utte)! allAha ApaNe baMdiA viccoM jisa nUM cAhuMdA hai khullhI roz2I diMdA hai ate (cAhe tAM) taMga vI kara diMdA hai| je allAha sADe ’te ApaNI kripA nA karadA tAM sAnUM vI dhusA diMdA| kI tusIM nahIM jANade ki nA-zukare kade safala nahIM huMde?
uha Aqhirata dA ghara(savaraga) asIM uhanAM lokAM nUM hI baqhazAMge jihar3e dharatI ’te nA vaDiAI cAhuMde hana te nA hI fasAda| rabba toM Darana vAliAM dA hI vadhIA aMta hovegA|[5]
translations.footnotes: [5] vekho sUrata ala-hajja, hAzIA Aita 9/22

translations.translation: jihar3A koI (kiAmata dihAr3e) nekI liAvegA usa nUM usa (nekI) toM vadhIA badalA milegA jihar3A koI burAI liAvegA tAM bhair3IAM karatUtAM karana vAle nUM uhI badalA milegA, jo uha karama karade sana|

(he nabI!) jisa allAha ne tuhADe ’te iha (.kuraAna) nAz2ila kItA hai lAz2amana uha tuhAnUM vadhIA aMta taka pahuMcAuNa vAlA hai| Akha dio ki merA rabba caMgI tarhAM jANadA hai ki kauNa hidAita de nAla (allAha kola) AiA hai te kauNa gumarAhI nAla AiA hai|

(he nabI!) tusIM tAM kade sociA vI nahIM sI ki Apa valla iha kitAba (.kuraAna) nAz2ila kItI jAvegI| ihatAM tuhADe rabba dIAM miharAM sadake hI uttariA hai| so huNa tusIM kade vI kAfirAM dA sahAika nahIM baNo| (bhAva koI kaMma jAM galla ajihI nA karo jisa toM uhanAM nUM kise prakAra dA lAbha hove)|

ate uha (kAfira) tuhAnUM allAha dIAM AitAM (.kuraAna) de pracAra toM nA roka deNa jada ki iha tuhADe utte hI utArIAM gaIAM hana| tusIM (uhanAM nUM) ApaNe rabba valla balAuMde raho ate kade vI ziraka karana vAliAM viccoM nA hoNA|

tusIM allAha de nAla kise hora nUM izaTa nA Akho| allAha toM chuTTa hora koI vI izaTa nahIM| hara cIz2a dA aMta hoNa vAlA hai sivAe usa (allAha) dI hasatI toM, use dA hukama caladA hai ate tusIM sAre use valla paratAe jAvoge|
alifa, lAma, mIma|
kI lokAM ne iha samajha liA hai ki uha kevala iMnA AkhaNa nAla hI chaDDa ditte jANage ki “asIM ImAna liAe” ate uhanAM nUM parakkhiA nahIM jAvegA|
asIM uhanAM lokAM nUM vI parakkhiA hai jihar3e ihanAM toM pahilAM bIta cukke hana| so allAha uhanAM lokAM nUM z2arUra khola devegA jihar3e sacca bolade hana ate uhanAM nUM vI jihar3e jhUThe hana|
kI jihar3e lokI burAIAM kara rahe hana uhanAM ne iha samajha rakkhiA hai ki uha sAthoM baca ke nikkala jANage? bahuta hI burA hai jo uha faisalA karade hana (bhAva soca rakkhade hana)

jihar3A viakatI allAha nUM milaNa dI Asa rakkhadA hai (usa nUM patA hai ki) allAha dA vAadA (kiAmata dA) z2arUra AuNa vAlA hai| uha (allAha) sabha kujjha ApaNe giAna nAla suNana vAlA te jANana vAlA hai|
jihar3A viakatI jihAda (saMgharaza) karadA hai, uha apaNe hI bhale laI jihAda karadA hai jada ki allAha dunIAM-jahAna de lokAM toM beparavAha hai|

jihar3e ImAna liAe ate (rabba de hukamAM anusAra) caMge kaMma kIte asIM uhanAM toM uhanAM dIAM sArIAM burAIAM nUM dUra (bhAva muAfa) kara diAMge ate uhanAM nUM (caMge kaMmAM) dA bahuta hI vadhIA badalA diAMge|

asIM hareka viakatI nUM ApaNe mAtA pitA nAla vadhIA varatAo karana dI nasIhata kItI hai, hAM! je uha tere utte z2ora pAuNa ki tUM mere nAla uhanAM (izaTAM) nUM zarIka baNA jisa nUM tUM jANadA vI nahIM tAM uhanAM dA kahiNA nA maMnI| tusIM sabha ne AuNA tAM mere kola hI hai, phera maiM tuhAnUM dassAMgA jo tusIM kariA karade sI|
jihar3e loka ImAna liAe te uhanAM ne neka karama kIte, asIM uhanAM nUM neka lokAM nAla (jaMnata vica) dAqhala karAgA|

lokAM vica hI kujjha ajihe vI hana jihar3e kahiMde hana ki asIM ImAna liAe| para jadoM uhanAM nUM allAha dI rAha calade satAiA jAMdA hai tAM uha lokAM valloM satAe jANa nUM allAha valloM ditte az2Aba vAMga samajhade hana| jekara tuhADe rabba valloM koI madada A jAve tAM AkhaNage, bezakka asIM tAM (he ImAna vAlio!) tuhADe nAla sAM| kI jo kujjha vI saMsAra de lokAM de manAM vica ru usa dA giAna allAha nUM nahIM hai?
allAha uhanAM nUM z2arUra pragaTa karegA jihar3e (sacce diloM) ImAna liAe ate uha munAfikAM (dogale lokAM) nUM vI pragaTa karegA|

kAfirAM ne musalamAnAM nUM kihA ki tusIM sADI rAha ’te callo tuhADe pApAM dA bojha asIM cukka lavAMge, jada ki uha (kAfira) uhanAM de gunAhAM dA kujjha vI bojha cukkaNa vAle nahIM| uha tAM korA jhUTha bolade hana|

hAM uha ApaNe pApAM dA bhAra ate ApaNe bhAra de nAla hora vI kaI bhAra cukkaNage| jo vI jhUTha uha ApaNe koloM ghar3hade hana, kiAmata dihAr3e uhanAM de saMbaMdha vica uhanAM toM z2arUra pucchiA jAvegA|

bezakka asIM nUha nUM usa dI kauma valla bhejiA ate uhanAM vicAle uha paMjAha ghaTTa ika haz2Ara (950) sAla taka rihA (jadoM kauma ne nUha nUM jhuThalAiA)| phera uhanAM nUM tUfAna ne isa hAla vica A gheriA jadoM ki uha z2ulama kara rahe sana|
phera asIM usa (nUha) nUM ate ber3I vAliAM nUM (tUfAna toM) bacA liA ate iMja asIM (isa ghaTanA nUM) sAre jahAna de lokAM laI ika ucca koTI dI (sikkhiAdAika) nizAnI baNA chaDDiA|
ate (asAM) ibarAhIma nUM (rasUla baNA ke) bhejiA, jadoM usa ne ApaNI kauma nUM kihA ki tusIM allAha dI baMdagI karo ate use toM Daro, je tusIM akala rakkhade ho iho tuhADe laI vadhIA galla hai|

(ate kihA ki) tusIM tAM allAha nUM chaDDa ke butAM dI pUjA karade ho ate jhUTha ghar3hade ho| bezakka tusIM allAha nUM chaDDa ke jinhAM nUM vI pUjade ho uha tuhAnUM roz2I deNa dA adhikAra nahIM rakkhade| so tusIM allAha toM hI roz2I maMgo ate use dI ibAdata karo ate use dA dhaMnavAda karo| tusIM (marana magaroM) use valla paratAe jAoge|

(he loko!) je tusIM (mere rasUla nUM) jhuThalAoge (tAM koI navIM galla nahIM) tuhAthoM pahilIAM kaumAM ne vI (rasUlAM nUM) jhuThalAiA hai| rasUla dA kaMma tAM kevala (rabba de hukamAM nUM) sapazaTa rUpa vica pucA deNA hI hai|

kI uhanAM (inakArIAM) ne kade vekhiA hI nahIM ki allAha maqhalUka nUM kisa tarhAM pahilI vAra paidA karadA hai ate uha (kiAmata vele) isa nUM mur3a duharAvegA| iha karanA tAM allAha laI bahuta hI saukhA hai|

(he nabI! inakArIAM nUM) Akho ki ratA dharatI utte tura phira ke vekho ki usa (allAha) ne kisa tarhAM pahilI vAra maqhalUka dI racanAM racAI phera allAha hI isa nUM dUjI vAra racAegA| allAha hara kaMma karana dI samarathA rakkhadA hai|
uha jisa nUM cAhave az2Aba (pApAM dI saz2A) deve te jisa ’te cAhe kripA kare (muAfa kare), jANA tusAM sabha ne use valla hI hai|
tusIM nA tAM (allAha nUM) dharatI ’te bevasa kara sakade ho te nA hI akAza vica, ate nA hI allAha toM chuTTa tuhADA koI dosata hai te nA koI sahAI|
jihar3e loka allAha dIAM AitAM (.kuraAna) ate usa de nAla milaNI (Aqhirata) dA inakAra karade hana uha merIAM miharAM toM nirAza ho cukke hana ate uhanAM laI daradanAka az2Aba hai|

uha (ibarAhIma) dI kauma dA javAba isa toM chuTTa hora kujjha nahIM sI ki uha AkhaNa lagge ki isa (ibarAhIma) nUM katala kara dio jAM sAr3a dio| (kauma ne sAr3aNA cAhiA) para allAha ne usa nUM agga toM bacA liA| bezakka isa (ghaTanA) vica ImAna vAliAM laI nizAnIAM hana|[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] vekho sUrata Ale-imarAna, hAzIA Aita 173/3

translations.translation: ate ibarAhIma ne kihA ki tusIM allAha nUM chaDDa ke jihar3e vI butAM nUM pUjade ho, iha dA kArana tAM kevala tuhADe saMsArika prema hai, para kiAmata vAle dihAr3e tusIM ika dUje de inakArI ho jAoMge te tusIM ika dUje ’te phiTakArAM pAoMge| tuhADA sabha dA TikANA (naraka dI) agga hovegI, jitthe tuhADA koI vI sahAI nahIM hovegA|

phera ibarAhIma utte lUta ImAna liAiA te ibarAhIma ne AkhiA ki maiM ApaNe pAlaNahAra valla hijarata karana vAlA hAM (bhAva sabha kujjha chaDDa ke use dA lar3a phar3AMgAM) uha bahuta hI z2abaradasata hikamatAM vAlA hai|

ate asIM usa (ibarAhIma) nUM isahAka te yAkUba (puttara te potare) ditte ate use de vaMza viccoM paig2aMbarI te (akAzI) kitAbAM de chaDDIAM| asIM uhanAM nUM saMsAra vica vI badalA bhAva mAna dittA ate paraloka vica uha neka te bhale lokAM viccoM hI hoNage|
ate asAM lUta nUM (paig2aMbara baNA ke) bhejiA, jadoM usa ne apaNI kauma nUM kihA ki tusIM tAM uha azalIla harakatAM karade ho jisa nUM tuhAthoM pahilAM saMsAra vica kise ne vI nahIM sI kItA|

kI tusIM purazAM de kola (kAmavAsanA dI pUratI laI) jAMde ho? (luTTAM khohAM karana laI) rasate baMda karade ho ate ApaNIAM majalisAM vica bhair3IAM (azalIla) harakatAM karade ho? ihanAM gallAM de uttara vica usa (lUta dI) kauma ne isa toM chuTTa hora kujjha nahIM kihA ki je tUM ApaNI galla vica saccA hai tAM (sADe laI) allAha valloM az2Aba lai A|
usa (lUta) ne kihA ki he meriA rabbA! isa fasAdI kauma de TAkare ’te merI madada kara|
jadoM sADe dUta (farizate) ibarAhIma kola qhuzaqhabarI laike pahuMce tAM uhanAM ne kihA ki asIM isa basatI (saddUma) nUM barabAda karana vAle hAM| bezakka isa de vasanIka tAM z2Alama hana|

(ibarAhIma ne) kihA ki utthe tAM lUta vI rahiMdA hai| farizate kahiNa lagge ki utthe jo vI hai asIM usa nUM caMgI tarhAM jANade hAM, asIM lUta ate usa de parivAra nUM, chuTTa usa dI patanI, sabha nUM surakkhiata rakkhAMge, usa dI aurata picche rahi jANa vAliAM viccoM hovegI (bhAva jinhAM nUM sajA milaNI hai)|

jadoM sADe valloM bheje hoe (farizate) lUta de kola pahuMce tAM uha AuNa dA kArana suNa ke) bahuta dukhI hoiA ate mana hI mana vica taMgI mahisUsa hoI tAM farizatiAM ne usa nUM AkhiA ki tusIM ukkA hI nA Daro te nA koI ciMtA karo, asIM tuhAnUM te tere ghara vAliAM nUM bacA lavAMge, chuTTa terI patanI toM, uha picche rahi jANa vAliAM nAla hovegI|
(farizatiAM ne kihA ki) asIM isa basatI vAliAM utte uhanAM dI nA-faramAnI kArana akAzoM az2Aba nAz2ila karana vAle hAM|
bezakka asIM isa basatI nUM uhanAM lokAM laI ika khullhI nizAnI vajoM chaDDa rakkhiA hai, jihar3e akala rakkhade hana|

ate madayana valla asIM uhanAM de bharA zuaiba nUM bhejiA| usa ne ApaNI kauma nUM AkhiA ki he merI kauma vAlio! tusIM allAha dI baMdagI karo, kiAmata dihAr3e ’te vizavAsa rakkho ate dharatI ’te vadhIkIAM nA karade phiro|
phera vI uha nahIM maMne| aMta ika bhUcAla ne uhanAM nUM A phar3iA ate uha ApaNe gharAM vica muddhe mUMha pae rahi gae|

asIM AdIAM te samUdIAM nUM vI halAka kItA| tusIM uhanAM de (ujjar3e hoe) nivAsa sathAna vekha sakade ho| zaitAna ne uhanAM dIAM karatUtAM nUM uhanAM laI sohaNA kara vikhAiA ate uhanAM nUM (siddhe rAha toM roka dittA jada ki uha sUjha-bUjha vAle sana)|

kArUna, firaauna te hAmAna nUM vI halAka kara dittA giA| bezakka uhanAM kola vI mUsA sapazaTa nizAnIAM lai ke AiA sI, para uhanAM ne dharatI ’te ApaNI vaDiAI vikhAI jada ki uha az2Aba toM baca ke jANa vAle nahIM sI|

ate asIM sabha nUM uhanAM de gunAhAM kArana phar3a liA, uhanAM vica koI tAM uha sI jinhAM ’te asIM patharAo karana vAlI tez2a havA bhejI ate uhanAM vica uha vI sI jinhAM nUM ika vaDDe dhamAke ne A nappiA ate uhanAM vica uha vI sI jinhAM nUM dharatI vica dhasA dittA ate uhanAM vica uha vI sI jinhAM nUM asIM Doba dittA| allAha ne uhanAM ’te z2ulama nahIM kItA, sagoM uha Ape ApaNe ’te z2ulama karade rahe sana|

jinhAM lokAM ne allAha nUM chaDDa ke horAM nUM ApaNA kArajasAdhaka baNAiA hai uhanAM dI misAla tAM makkar3I vAMga hai, uha vI ika ghara baNAuMdI hai, jada ki sAre gharAM viccoM sabha toM bodA ghara makkar3I dA hI huMdA hai| kAza! iha (muzarika vI) jANa laiMde|
allAha uhanAM sabha cIz2AM nUM jANadA hai jinhAM nUM usa (allAha) nUM chaDDa ke (ApaNI madada laI) pukArade hana [2] ate uha z2abaradasata te hikamatAM vAlA hai|
translations.footnotes: [2] vekho sUrata ala-bakaraha, hAzIA Aita 165/2

translations.translation: asIM iha misAlAM lokAM nUM samajhAuNa laI biAna kara rahe hAM para ihanAM nUM kevala (allAha dA) giAna rakkhaNa vAle hI samajhade hana|
allAha ne akAzAM te dharatI nUM sacca de adhAra ’te hI paidA kItA hai| nirasaMdeha, ImAna vAliAM laI isa vica vaDDIAM nizAnIAM hana|

(he muhaMmada!) jihar3I kitAba (.kuraAna) tuhADe valla vahI kItI gaI hai, tusIM usa nUM par3ho ate namAz2a nUM kAima karo| bezakka namAz2a azalIlatAM ate burAIAM toM rokadI hai| nirasaMdeha, allAha dA z2ikara hI sabha toM vaDDI cIz2a hai| jo vI tusIM kara rahe ho usa toM allAha qhabaradAra hai|

(he muhaMmada!) tusIM kitAba vAliAM (IsAI te yahUdIAM) nAla sucajje DhaMga nAla vAda-vivAda karo| paraMtU jihar3e uhanAM viccoM z2Alama hana uhanAM nUUM sapazaTa zabadAM vica Akha dio ki sADA tAM isa kitAba (.kuraAna) ’te vI ImAna hai ate uhanAM ’te vI jihar3IAM tuhADe vala (iMjIla te tauraita) utArIAM gaIAM sana| sADA te tuhADA izaTa ika hI hai ate asIM sAre use de AgiAkArI hAM|

(he nabI! pahile nabIAM vAMga) asAM tuhADe valla vI iha kitAba (.kuraAna) nAz2ila kItI hai| isa kitAba te uhIo ImAna liAuMde hana jinhAM nUM asIM (isa toM pahilAM) kitAba dittI sI ate uhanAM (makke vAliAM) viccoM vI kujjha loka isa (.kuraAna) ’te ImAna liAuMde hana| sADIAM AitAM (AdezAM) dA inakAra kevala kAfira hI karade hana|

(he nabI!) isa (.kuraAna) toM pahilAM tusIM vI koI vI kitAba nahIM par3hade sI ate nA hI ApaNe hatthIM koI kitAba likhade sI| (je ajihA huMdA tAM) iha jhUTha de pujArI zakka kara sakade sI (ki iha tuhADI ApaNI likhI hoI kitAba hai)|

sagoM iha਼kuraAna dIAM sapazaTa AitAM hana jihar3IAM uhanAM lokAM de sIniAM vica surakkhiata hana jinhAM nUM (rabbI) giAna baqhaziA hoiA hai, jada ki z2Alama loka hI sADIAM AitAM dA inakAra karade hana|

(z2AlamAM ne) kihA ki isa (muhaMmada) ’te isa de rabba valloM koI muajaz2A (bevasa karana vAlA camatakAra) kiuM nahIM utAriA giA? (he nabI!) tusIM Akho ki sAre muajaz2e tAM allAha de kola hI hana (jisa nUM cAhe deve, cAhe nA deve)| maiM tAM kevala khullhama-khullhA (naraka de az2Aba toM) DarAuNa vAlA hAM|

kI ihanAM(kAfirAM) laI iha(.kuraAna dI nizAnI) kAfI nahIM ki asIM tuhADe (muhaMmada)’te iha kitAba utArI hai jihar3I ihanAM (kAfirAM nUM suceta karana) laI par3hI jAMdI hai| [3] bezakka isa vica uhanAM lokAM laI rahimatAM (vI) hana ate nasIhatAM vI hana, jihar3e ImAna rakkhade hana (bhAva sacca samajhade hana)|
translations.footnotes: [3] je kuraAna pAka nUM soca vicAra karade hoe par3hiA jAve tAM manukkha nUM isa dA lAbha huMdA hai ate allAha taAlA vI ise tarhAM kuraAna par3hana vAla toM qhuza huMdA hai| hadIsa vica hai ki allAha taAlA kise galla utte iMnAM dhiAna nahIM diMdA jiMnAM paig2aMbara dI sohaNI te uccI avAz2a nAla kuraAna par3hana te qhuza huMdA hai| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 5024) ● ika dUjI hadIsa vica allAha de rasUla ne faramaiA ki IrakhA kevala do AdamIAM te kItI jA sakadI hai ika uha jisa nUM allAha ne kuraAna de giAna nAla navAz2iA hai ate dUjA uha jihar3A dina rAta isa dI talAvata vica rujhiA rahiMdA hai ki usa dI talAvata suNa ke usa dA gavAMDI IrakhA kare ki kAza! mainUM vI iMja hI kuraAna yAda huMdA tAM maiM vI ise tarhAM.kuraAna par3hadA| dUjA uha viakatI jisa nUM allAha ne dhana baqhaziA hove ate usa nUM caMge kaMmA laI qharaca karadA hove| isa ’te koI viakatI iha kahi sakadA hai ki kAza mainUM vI ajihI dolata mila jAMdI tAM maiM vI usa nUM caMge kaMmAM vica qharaca karadA (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 5026)

translations.translation: (he nabI!) uhanAM (inakArIAM) nUM Akha dio ki merA ate tuhADe vicakAra allAha dI gavAhI hI batherI hai| uha akAzAM te dharatI dI hara cIz2a nUM jANadA hai| jihar3e lokI jhUTha nUM maMNana vAle hana ate allAha de nAla kufara karana vAle hana uhI vaDDe ghATe vica rahiNa vAle hana|

(he nabI) iha (inakArI) tuhAthoM az2Aba maMgaNa vica kAhalI karade hana| jekara (mere valloM) isa dA samAM niyata nA kItA huMdA tAM iha az2Aba uhanAM nUM z2arUra A cabbhadA| iha vI galla pakkI hai ki iha az2Aba (bhAva kiAmata) uhanAM utte acAnaka beqhabarI vica hI AvegA|
iha (z2Alama) tohAthoM az2Aba laI chetI kara rahe hana jada ki naraka ne kAfirAM nUM gheriA hoiA hai|
usa dina uhanAM de upparo (akAzoM) te pairAM de thallioM (dharatI ’coM) az2Aba uhanAM nUM Dhaka lavegA ate allAha AkhegA ki huNa lavo savAda ApaNIAM karatUtAM dA jihar3IAM tusIM karade sI|
(allAha faramAuMdA hai ki) he mere ImAna vAle baMdio! merI dharatI bahuta vizAla hai (je iha kAfira tuhAnUM taMga karade hana tAM itthoM nikala jAo) so tusIM merI hI baMdagI karo|[4]
translations.footnotes: [4] ika hadIsa vica allAha de rasUla ne faramAiA ki he maAz2a! ki tUM jANadA hai ki allAha dA baMdiAM utte kI hakka hai? tAM haz2arata maAz2a ne AkhiA ki maiM nahIM jANadA| tAM Apa ne faramAiA ki allAha dA hakka baMdiAM utte iha hai ki uha kevala use dI IbAdata karana ate usa dI ibAdata vica kise nUM sAMjhI nA baNAuNa| phera Apa (sa:) ne faramaiA ki kI tUM jANadA hai ki baMdiAM dA hakka allAha utte kI hai| jadda ki uha ziraka nA karade hoNa? uha iha hai ki allAha unhAM nUM az2Aba deve| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa 6267)

translations.translation: hara prANI ne mauta dA suAda laiNA hai, aMta tusIM sAre mere valla hI mur3a Aoge|

(tuhADe viccoM) jihar3e loka ImAna liAe ate uhanAM ne neka kaMma kIte, asIM uhanAM nUM z2arUra hI jaMnata dIAM uccIAM thAvAM vica rakkhAMge, jisa de heTha nahirAM vagadIAM hoNagIAM uha uhanAM vica sadA laI rahiNage| bhale karama karana vAliAM dA badalA bahuta hI caMgA hai|
jihar3e loka sabara toM kaMma laiMde hana, uhI ApaNe rabba utte bharosA rakkhade hana (ki sabara dA badalA milegA)| [5]
translations.footnotes: [5] vekho sUrata yusUfa, hAzIA Aita 67/12

translations.translation: dharatI ’te callaNa vAle kiMne hI jIva-jaMtU ajihe hana jihar3e ApaNA riz2aka ApaNe nAla cukkI nahIM phirade| allAha uhanAM (sAriAM) nUM vI ate tuhAnUM vI roz2I diMdA hai| uha bhalI-bhAMta suNana vAlA te jANana vAlA hai|

je tusIM uhanAM (kAfirAM) toM iha puccho ki dharatI te akAza dA baNAuNa vAlA kauNa hai? sUraja te caMna nUM tuhADI sevA laI kisa ne lagA rakhiA hai tAM uhanAM dA javAba iho hovegA ki ‘allAha ne’ (iha sabha jANade hoe) phera tusIM kiddhara bhaTake phirade ho!
allAha ApaNe baMdiAM viccoM jisa nUM cAhuMdA hai roz2I vica khullha diMdA hai ate jisa nUM cAhuMdA hai taMga roz2I diMdA hai| bezakka allAha hara cIz2a nUM caMgI tarhAM jANadA hai|

je tusIM uhanAM (kAfirAM) toM iha puccho ki akAza toM pANI utAra ke moI dharatI nUM mur3a jiUMdA (upajAU) kauNa karadA hai? tAM uha AkhaNage “allAha” Akho sArI zobhA allAha laI hai paraMtU uhanAM viccoM vadhere be-akala hana (jihar3e phera vI nahIM samajhade)|
iha saMsArika jIvana ika kheDa tamAze toM chuTTa hora kujjha vI nahIM| bezakka Aqhirata dA jIvana hI asalI jIvana hai| kAza! iha loka jANade huMde|[6]
translations.footnotes: [6] jaMnata vAliAM dA sathAna kI hovegA ate unhAM nUM kI kujha milegA? ika hadIsa vica dassiA giA hai ki jaMnata vica dAqhila hoNa vAle pahilI TolI dIAM sUratAM caudavIM de caMna vAMga camaka rahIAM hoNagIAM| uha thukka, sIMDa, TaTTI pazAba Adi toM mukata hoNage| unhAM de pAMDe sone de ate kaMghIAM cAMdI dIAM hoNagIAM| aMgIThIAM vica oda dI qhuzabU vAlI lakar3I varatI jAvegI unhAM de pasIne viccoM muzaka dI qhuzabU AvegI| hareka dIAM do do patanIAM hoNagIAM| jinhAM dI qhUbasUratI ate naz2Akata iMnI hovegI ki unhAM dI piMDalI dA guddA vI bAharoM disadA hovegA| ApasI virodha ate mattabheda toM pAka hoNage savere zAma allAha dI tasabiha karanage| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa 3245)

translations.translation: jadoM uha (muzarika loka) ber3I ’te savAra huMde hana (jadoM tUfAna vica phasa jAMde hana) tAM uha nirola allAha de dharama dI pAlaNA karade hoe usa nUM hI (madada laI) pukArade hana| phera jadoM uha uhanAM nUM (bacA ke) thala valla liAuMdA hAM tAM uha ziraka karana lagga paiMde hana|[7]
translations.footnotes: [7] vekho sUrata banI isarAI, hAzIA Aita 67/17

translations.translation: (asIM uhanAM nUM isa laI bacAuMde hana) tAM jo uha sADIAM dittIAM hoIAM niamatAM dI nA-zukarI karana ate jIvana dA AnaMda laiMde rahiNa, phera chetI hI uha usa dA aMta jANa laiNage|

kI uha nahIM vekhade ki asIM harama (qhAnA-kAabA) nUM amana vAlI thAM baNAiA hai, jada ki (isa toM pahilAM) usa de Ale-duAle de lokAM nUM luTTa liA jAMdA sI| kI uha jhUThIAM gallAM ’te ImAna liAuMde hana ate allAha dIAM niamatAM dI nA-zukarI karade hana?

usa viakatI toM vaDDA z2Alama kihar3A hovegA jihar3A allAha ’te jhUTha jar3he| jadoM ki hakka sacca usa de sAhamaNe khullha ke A giA tAM usa ne usa nUM jhuThalA dittA| kI ajihe kAfirAM dA TikANA naraka nahIM hovegA?
jihar3e lokI sADI rAha vica jihAda (saMgharaza) karade hana asIM uhanAM nUM ApaNIAM rAhAM z2arUra vikhAMvAge| bezakka allAha neka kaMma karana vAliAM dA sAtha diMdA hai|
alifa, lAma, mIma|
rUmI (IrAna) toM hAra gae|
ner3e dI dharatI (zAma te phalasatIna) vica uha (rUmI) ApaNI isa hAra magaroM chetI hI (IrAna utte) jitta prApata karanage|

kujjha ku varhiAM vica hI uha jitta jANage| pahilAM vI (jitta-hAra dA) adhikAra allAha dA hI sI ate magaroM vI allAha dA hI hai| usa dina (jadoM rUmI jittaNage) musalamAna vI (uhanAM dI jitta utte) qhuzIAM mANanage|
(iha jitta) allAha dI madada nAla hovegI, uha jisa dI cAhave madada karadA hai, uha DADhA z2orAvara te miharabAna hai|
iha allAha dA vacana hai (ki rUma dI jitta hovegI) ate allAha kade vI ApaNe vacanAM dI ulaMghaNA nahIM karadA| para vadhere loka nahIM jANade|
uha loka tAM kevala saMsArika jIvana de disade pakkha nUM hI jANade hana ate paraloka toM tAM ukkA hI beqhabara hana|

kI uhanAM (beqhabara) lokAM ne ApaNe manAM ’ca soca vicAra nahIM kItA ki allAha ne akAzAM te dharatI nUM ate uhanAM de vicAle dIAM sArIAM cIz2AM nUM hakka-sacca nAla te ika mithe hoe sameM laI paidA kItA hai? ate nirasaMdeha, vadhere loka ApaNe rabba dI milaNI (kiAmata) toM hI inakAra karade hana|

kI uha (inakArI) dharatI ’te ture phire nahIM? phera uha vekhade ki uhanAM toM pahilAM bIta cukke lokAM dA kiho jihA aMta hoiA sI? uha uhanAM nAloM vadhere zakatIzAlI sana ate uhanAM ne dharatI nUM ihanAM toM vaddha vAhiA-bIjIA sI ate isa nUM AbAda kItA sI jinnA ihanAM ne (araba nUM) AbAda kItA hai| uhanAM kola vI uhanAM de paig2aMbara khullhIAM nizAnIAM (rasUla hoNa dIAM) lai ke Ae sI (para uhanAM ne rasUlAM dA inakAra kItA)| phera iMja vI nahIM sI ki allAha (binA pApa kIte) uhanAM utte z2ulama karadA jada ki uha ApaNe utte Apa hI z2ulama karade sana|
phera jinhAM lokAM ne bhair3e kaMma kIte sI uhanAM dA aMta bahuta hI bhair3A hoiA kiuM jo uha allAha dIAM AitAM (hukamAM) dA inakAra karade sana ate uhanAM dA makhaula (vI) uDAiA karade sana|
(yAda rakkho ki) allAha hI sArI sazriTI nUM pahilI vAra paidA karadA hai, phera uhI usa nUM mur3a paidA karegA, phera use valla tuhAnUM paratAiA jAvegA|
jisa dina kiAmata kAima hovegI tAM usa dina aparAdhI saqhata nirAza hoNage|
ate uhanAM de zarIkAM (izaTAM) viccoM ika vI uhanAM dA sifArazI nahIM baNegA ate uha ApaNe zarIkAM (izaTAM) toM (Apa vI) inakArI ho jANage|
ate jadoM kiAmata dA velA AvegA usa dina lokI (momina te kAfira) vakkhare vakkhare ho jANage|
phera jihar3e loka ImAna liAe te uhanAM ne neka kaMma vI kIte, uha jaMnata vica hassade-tusade rakkhe jANage|
jinhAM lokAM ne (allAha dA) inakAra kItA hai ate sADIAM AitAM (nizAnIAM) te paraloka dI milaNI nUM jhuThalAiA hai, uha sAre loka (naraka de) az2Aba vica hAz2ara rakkhe jANage|
so (he momino!) tusIM allAha dI pAkI dA guNagANa karo jadoM tuhADI zAma hove ate jadoM savera hove|
akAza te dharatI vica use dI usatata ho rahI hai, so tusIM vI use dI tasabIha tIje pahira te z2ohara vele (dupahira vele) kariA karo|

uhIo jiuMdiAM nUM muradiAM viccoM ate muradiAM nUM jiuMdiAM viccoM kaDDhadA hai ate uhIo dharatI nUM usa dI mauta (baMjara) hoNa magaroM jiUMdA (upajAU) karadA hai| ise prakAra tusIM vI (kabarAM viccoM) kaDDhe jAvoge|
iha usa (allAha) dIAM nizAnIAM viccoM hai ki usa ne tuhAnUM miTTI toM paidA kItA, phera huNa tusIM manukkha ho jihar3e hara pAse phaila rahe ho|

use dI nizAnIAM viccoM (iha vI) hai ki usa ne tuhADe toM hI (tuhADIAM) patanIAM paidA kItIAM tAM jo tusIM uhanAM koloM sukha zAMtI prApata kara sako| usa ne tuhADe vicAle muhabbata te hamadaradI paidA kara dittI| jihar3e lokI soca vicAra karana vAle hana uhanAM laI isa vica mahattavapUraNa nizAnIAM hana|
usa dIAM nizAnIAM viccoM akAza te dharatI dI racanA ate tuhADIAM bolIAM te raMgAM dA vakkha-vakkha hoNA vI hai| jANakArAM laI isa vica batherIAM nizAnIAM hana|
tuhADA rAta te dina vele sauNA ate usa de phaz2alAM (roz2I) dI bhAla karanA vI usa dIAM nizAnIAM viccoM hai| jihar3e lokI (dhiAna nAla) suNade hana uhanAM laI vI batherIAM nizAnIAM hana|

iha vI usa dIAM nizAnIAM viccoM hI hai ki uha tuhAnUM DarAuNa laI ate AsavaMda karana laI bijalI dI lizaka vikhAuMdA hai ate akAza toM mIMha varhAuMdA hai, jisa toM marI hoI dharatI jiUMdI ho jAMdI hai| akala vAliAM laI isa vica vI batherIAM nizAnIAM hana|

use (rabba) dI ika nizAnI iha vI hai ki akAza te dharatI use de hukama nAla kAima hana| jadoM uha tuhAnUM dharatI (kabarAM) viccoM saddegA phera tusIM sAre dharatI viccoM kevala ika sadde ’te hI bAhara nikkala Aoge|
jo kujjha vI akAzAM te dharatI vica hai uha sabha usa dI malakIata hai ate sAre use de AgiAkArI hana|

uhI (allAha) hai jihar3A sazriTI nUM pahilI vAra paidA karadA hai uhIo phera usa nUM mur3a paidA karegA ate iha karanA usa laI tAM iha bahuta hI saukhA hai akAzAM te dharatI vica use (rabba) dI zAna sabha toM uccI hai ate uhI z2abaradasata te hikamatAM vAlA hai|

(he loko!) usa ne tuhADe (samajhAuNa) laI tuhADe viccoM hI ika udAharana dittI hai ki jo asIM tuhAnUM riz2aka dittA hai, kI usa vica tuhADe g2ulAmAM (adhIna lokAM) viccoM vI koI sAMjhI ho sakadA hai? kI tusIM ate uha iko barAbara ho? kI tusIM (ApaNe mAla ’coM qharaca karade hoe) uhanAM toM isa tarhAM Darade ho jiveM ApaNe sAMjhIAM toM Darade ho? isa tarhAM asIM samajha rakkhaNa vAliAM laI ApaNIAM nizAnIAM kholha-kholha ke biAna karade hAM|
para iha z2Alama binAM soce samajhe ApaNIAM icchAvAM de picche lagge rahe| jisanUM allAha hI kurAhe pA deve phera usa nUM rAha kauNa vikhA sakadA hai? uhanAM dA tAM koI vI sahAI nahIM hovegA|

(he nabI!) tusIM ikAgaratA nAla ApaNA mUMha (allAha de) dIna isalAma valla siddhA rakkho| kAima ho jAo usa fitarata (subhAo) utte jisa utte allAha ne manukkha nUM paidA kItA hai| (bhAva musalamAna hI paidA kItA hai) allAha dI baNAI hoI baNatara nUM badaliA nahIM jA sakadA| iho siddhA te saccA dharama (dIna) hai, para vadhere loka nahIM jANade|[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] vekho sUrata yUnusa, hAzIA Aita 19/10

translations.translation: (he loko!) use (allAha) valla jhukade hoe dIna ’te kAima raho ate tusIM use toM Darade raho ate namAz2a kAima rakkho ate tusIM muzarikAM viccoM nA ho jAo|
(uhanAM varage vI nA ho jAo) jinhAM ne ApaNe dharama nUM ToTe-ToTe kara chaDDiA ate dhar3hiAM vica vaMDe gae, hareka dhar3e kola jo hai uha use vica masata hai|

jadoM lokAM ’te koI bipatA AuMdI hai tAM uha (madada laI) ApaNe rabba valla mur3a AuMde hana te use toM duAvAM maMgade hana phera jadoM uha ApaNe valloM uhanAM nUM ApaNIAM miharAM dA suAda cakhAuMdA hai (bhAva bipatA dUra kara diMdA hai)| tAM uhanAM viccoM kaI loka ApaNe rabba nAla ziraka karana lagga jAMde|

(iha asIM isa laI karade hAM) tAM jo uha usa cIz2a (niamata) dI nA-zukarI karana laga jANa jo asIM uhanAM nUM baqhazI hai| (caMgA) tusIM maujAM mAra lao, chetI hI tuhAnUM patA lagga jAvegA (ki hakIkata kI hai? )|
kI asIM uhanAM ’te koI ajihI dalIla utArI hai ki uha uhanAM de ziraka nUM jAiz2a karadI hove|

jadoM asIM lokAM nUM ApaNIAM miharAM dA suAda cakhAuMde hAM tAM uha qhuza ho jAMde hana ate jadoM uhanAM de ApaNe hatthIM agge bhejIAM hoIAM karatUtAM kArana koI musIbata A jAve tAM jhaTTa (rabba dIAM miharAM toM) be-Asa ho jAMde hana|
kI uhanAM ne nahIM vekhiA ki bezakka allAha jisa nUM cAhe roz2I vica farAqhI (khullha) jAM taMgI diMdA hai? isa vica uhanAM lokAM laI anekAM nizAnIAM hana jihar3e ImAna rakkhade hana|

tusIM (ApaNe mAla ’coM) ApaNe sAka-saMbaMdhIAM nUM, masakInAM nUM ate musAfarAM nUM uhanAM dA baNadA hakka adA karo| jihar3e lokI allAha de darazana karanA cAhuMde hana uhanAM laI iMja karanA bahuta caMgA hai, ajihe loka hI kAmayAba hoNage|

(he loko!) tusIM jihar3A (dhaMna) sUda ’te diMde ho tAM jo uha lokAM de mAla vica rala ke vadhadA rahe, uha allAha dIAM naz2arAM vica nahIM vadhadA| tusIM allAha de darazana karana laI jihar3A kujjha z2akAta vica diMde ho ajihe loka hI ApaNe mAla nUM (allAha dIAM naz2arAM vica) kaI guNA vadhAuNa vAle hana|

allAha hI uha z2Ata hai jisa ne tuhAnUM paidA kItA phera (khANa pINa nUM) riz2aka dittA phera uha tuhAnUM mauta devegA phera uha tuhAnUM jiUMdA karegA| kI tuhADe (mithe hoe) zarIkAM viccoM vI koI ajihA hai jihar3A iha kujjha kara sakadA hove? allAha uhanAM de thApe hoe zarIkAM toM pAka pavittara hai te kite uccA hai|
thala te jala vica lokAM dIAM bhair3IAM karatUtAM kArana vigAr3a phaila giA hai, ise laI fasAdIAM nUM uhanAM dIAM karatUtAM dA suAda cakhAuMdA hai, zAida ki uha hidAita valla parata AuNa|
(he nabI!) tusIM uhanAM (z2AlamAM) nUM Akho ki dharatI ’te tura phira ke vekho ki pahile lokAM dA kiho jihA aMjAma (aMta) hoiA sI| uhanAM vica bahute tAM muzarika hI sana|
so tusIM ApaNI dizA usa sacce te siddhe dharama (isalAma) vala rakkho, isa toM pahilAM ki uha dina Ave jihar3A allAha valloM nahIM TalegA| usa dihAr3e uha (momina te kAfira) aDDo-aDDa ho jANage|
jisa ne kufara kItA hovegA usa nUM usa dI saz2A milegI ate jinhAM ne neka kaMma kIte hoNage uha ApaNe laI (safalatA vAlI) rAha paddhara kara rahe hoNage|
tAM jo allAha uhanAM lokAM nUM, jinhAM ne ImAna liAuNa magaroM neka kaMma kIte hana, ApaNe faz2ala (kripA) nAla jaz2A (vadhIA badalA) deve| bezakka uha kAfirAM nUM pasaMda nahIM karadA|

ate uha dIAM nizAnIAM viccoM iha vI hai ki uha qhuzaqhabarIAM deNa vAlIAM havAvAM nUM bhejadA hai tAM jo uha tuhAnUM ApaNIAM miharAM dA AnaMda deve| usa de hukama nAla hI (pANI vica) ber3IAM calladIAM hana tAM jo (samuMdarAM vica) tusIM usa de faz2ala dI bhAla karo tAM jo tusIM usa dA dhaMnavAda kara sakoM|

(he muhaMmada sa:!) asIM tuhAthoM pahilAM vI ApaNe kaI paig2aMbarAM nUM uhanAM dIAM hI kaumAM valla bheje sana| uha (rasUla) uhanAM kola sapazaTa dalIlAM vI liAe sana| (jadoM uha kaumAM nahIM maMnIAM) phera asIM gunAhagArAM toM (ApaNe az2Aba rAhIM) badalA liA| sADe laI tAM mominAM dI madada karanA lAz2amI hai|

allAha uha z2Ata ru jihar3A havAvAM nUM bhejadA hai phera uha baddalAM nUM cukkadIAM hana phera allAha ApaNI icchA anusAra uhanAM (baddalAM) nUM akAza vica phailA diMdA hai ate uhanAM (baddalAM) nUM Tukar3IAM vica vaMDa diMdA hai phera tusIM vekhade ho ki uhanAM (baddalAM) viccoM (pANI dIAM) buMdAM nikaladIAM hana ate jinhAM baMdiAM ’te allAha cAhuMdA hai, uhanAM utte mIMha barasAuMdA hai| usa sameM uha loka qhuza ho jAMde hana|
nirasaMdeha, isa mIMha de AuNa toM pahilAM tAM uha loka be-Asa ho rahe sana|

so tusIM allAha dIAM miharAM dI nizAnIAM vekho ki uha marI hoI (ujAr3a) dharatI nUM kiddAM jiUMdA (upajAU) karadA hai| bezakka uhI (allAha) muradiAM nUM jiUMdA karana vAlA hai ate uha hara kaMma karana dI samarathA rakkhadA hai|
ate jekara asIM havAvAM de jhakkhar3a calA daIe ate iha ApaNI fasala nUM pIlI (murajhAI) hoI vekhaNa tAM uha nA-zukarIAM karana lagga jAMde hana|
bezakka (he nabI!) tusIM muradiAM nUM (be-samajhAM nUM) nahIM suNA sakade ate nA hI boliAM nUM ApaNI galla suNA sakade ho| jada ki uha piTTha phera ke mur3a gae hoNa|
ate nA hI tusIM aMnhe lokAM nUM kurAhioM kaDDha ke siddhe rAha liA sakade ho| tusIM tAM kevala uhanAM nUM hI suNA sakade ho jihar3e sADIAM AitAM ’te ImAna rakkhade hana| basa uhIo AgiAkArI hana|

allAha uha z2Ata hai jisa ne tuhAnUM kamaz2orI dI hAlata vica paidA kItA, phera isa kamaz2orI (bacapaNa) toM magaroM tAkata (javAnI) dittI, phera isa tAkata (javAnI) magaroM kamaz2orI te buDhApA dittA| uha jiveM cAhe paidA karadA hai| uha sabha kujjha jANana vAlA ate hara tarhAM dI samarathA rakkhadA hai|
jisa dina kiAmata AvegI aparAdhI kasamAM khANage ki uha (saMsAra vica) chuTTa ika pala toM nahIM Thahire| isa tarhAM iha (saMsArika jIvana vica) kurAhe pae rahe|

ate jinhAM lokAM nUM ImAna ate giAna dittA giA hai uha AkhaNage ki tusIM tAM (he aparAdhIo!) jiveM ki allAha dI kitAba (lauha-e-mahifUz2a) vica hai kiAmata taka (saMsAra vica) rahe sI| ajja iha dina mur3a AuNa dA hai| para tusIM tAM isa nUM maMnade hI nahIM sI|
usa dina uhanAM z2AlamAM dA koI vI bahAnA uhanAM de kaMma nahIM AvegA ate nA hI uhanAM nUM taubA karana dA avasara dittA jAvegA|
bezakka asIM isa.kuraAna vica lokAM sAhamaNe hara tarhAM dIAM udAharaNAM (visathAra nAla) biAna kara dittIAM hana| phera vI kAfira tAM basa iho AkhaNage ki tusIM tAM nire jhUThe ho|
isa tarhAM allAha be-samajha lokAM de dilAM ’te moharAM lA chaDDadA hai|

so (he nabI!) tusIM dhIraja rakkho| bezakka allAha dA vacana saccA hai| uha (kAfira) loka, jihar3e lokI (allAha dI kitAba.kuraAna) ’te yakIna nahIM rakkhade, uha tuhAnUM holA (be-sabarA) nA kara deNa|
alifa, lAma, mIma|
iha hikamata vAlI kitAba (•kuraAna) dIAM AitAM hana|
jisa vica neka kaMma karana vAliAM laI hidAita te rahimata hai|[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] vekho sUrata ala-taubA, hAzIA Aita 120/9

translations.translation: (bhAva) jihar3e lokI namAz2AM nUM kAima karade hana te z2akAta diMde hana ate paraloka utte pakkA vizavAsa rakkhade hana|
iho uha loka hana jihar3e ApaNe rabba valloM hidAita ’te hana ate iho loka safalatA prApata karana vAle hana|

ate kujjha loka ajihe vI hana jihar3e mana paracAU bANI (gANa, bajANa, kheDAM, kisse kahANIAM Adi) mulla lai ke AuMde hana tAM jo uha binAM kise giAna toM lokAM nUM rabba dI rAha toM bhaTakA deNa ate isa (rAha ’te saddaNa vAle) dA makhaula uDAuNa,[2] ajihe lokAM laI hI (paraloka vicca) hINatA bhariA az2Aba hovegA|
translations.footnotes: [2] vekho sUrata ala-mAidA, hAzIA Aita 90/5

translations.translation: jadoM usa (makhaula uDAuNa vAle) nUM sADIAM AitAM suNAIAM jAMdIAM hana tAM uha haMkAra nAla isa tarhAM mUMha phera laiMdA hai jiveM ki usa ne kujjha suNiA hI nahIM jiveM ki usa de kaMnAM vica DATa piA hove| (he muhaMmada sa:!) tusIM usa nUM ika dukhadAI az2Aba dI qhabara suNA dio| [3]
translations.footnotes: [3] vekho sUrata ala-hajja, hAzIA Aita 9/22

translations.translation: jihar3e loka ImAna liAe ate uhanAM ne kaMma vI neka kIte, uhanAM laI niamatAM bhare bAg2a (jaMnatAM) hana|
jitthe uha (neka loka) sadA rahiNage| iha allAha dA saccA vAadA hai (jihar3A pUrA hovegA)| uha (rabba) DADhA z2orAvara te yukatImAna hai|

use (allAha) ne akAza nUM binAM thaMmAM toM sAjiA hai, tusIM isa (akAza) nUM vekha hI rahe ho| usa ne dharatI vica pahAr3AM nUM gar3a dittA tAM jo uha (dharatI) tuhAnUM lai ke ulAra nA ho jAve| (use ne) hara prakAra de jAnavara dharatI vica khilAra ditte ate asIM akAza toM pANI barasAiA ate dharatI vicca hara prakAra dIAM vadhIA-vadhIA cIz2AM ugA dittIAM|

iha sabha racanAM allAha dI hai| huNa ratA mainUM vikhAo ki ihanAM dUjiAM izaTAM ne isa (allAha dI racanA) toM chuTTa kI sAjiA hai? (kujjha vI nahIM) sagoM iha z2Alama loka tAM sapazaTa rUpa vica kurAhe pae hoe hana|

nirasaMdeha, asIM lukamAna nUM dAnAI baqhazI sI ki uha allAha dA zukara adA kare| hara zukara karana vAlA ApaNe nijI lAbha laI hI zukara karadA hai ate jihar3A nA-zukarI karadA hai tAM vAsatava vica allAha (usa dI nA-zukarI toM)beparavAha hai ate sArIAM qhUbIAM dA mAlika hai |

(yAda karo) jadoM lukamAna ne ApaNe puttara nUM nasIhata karadiAM hoiA kihA sI ki he mere puttara! tUM allAha de nAla (usa dI sifatAM vica ate baMdagI vica) kise nUM zarIka nA baNAIM, bezakka ziraka karanA mahAM pApa hai|[4]
translations.footnotes: [4] vekho sUrata ana-namala, hAzIA Aita 59/27 ate vekho sUrata ala-bakaraha, hAzIA Aita 22/2

translations.translation: asAM manukkha nUM usa de mApiAM pratI vadhIA toM vadhIA vihAra karana dA hukama dittA hai| usa dI mAM ne kiMnIAM kamaz2orIAM (dukkha) sahi ke usa nUM ApaNe garabha vica rakkhiA ate do sAla usadI duddha chur3AI vica lagga gae sI so tUM merA te ApaNe mAM-pio dA dhaMnavAda kara, mere valla hI (tusIM sabha ne) parata ke AuNA hai|

para je uha doveM (mAM-pio) tere utte dabAo pAuNa ki tUM kise ajihe nUM (sifatAM te pUjA vica) merA sAMjhI baNA jisa dA tainUM kujjha vI giAna nahIM tAM uhanAM dI galla kade vI nA maMnI, hAM! dunIAM vica uhanAM nAla sucajjA varatAo karadA rahIM ate usa viakatI de picche laggIM, jihar3A mere vala mur3adA hai (bhAva jhukadA hai)| phera tuhADA sabha dA parataNA tAM mere valla hI hai| tusIM jo vI karade ho, maiM tuhAnUM dassa diAMgA|

(lukamAna ne AkhiA) he mere puttara! bezakka je koI cIz2a rAI de dANe de barAbara vI hove, phera uha bhAveM kise caTAna jAM akAzAM jAM dharatI vica kIte vI hove, allAha usa nUM (kiAmata dihAr3e) z2arUra kaDDha liAvegA| bezakka allAha vaDDA sUkhamadarazI te qhabaradAra hai|
he mere puttara! tUM namAz2a kAima kara te nekI dA hukama de, burAI toM varajadA rahi ate jo vI musIbata Ave usa ’te sabara kara| bezakka iha (sabara karanA) hiMmata vAle kaMmAM viccoM hai|
