tUM lokAM nAla mUMha phera ke galla nA kara te nA hI dharatI utte Akar3a ke tura, kiuM jo kise vI ghamaMDI te zekhI khore nUM allAha pasaMda nahIM karadA|
tUM ApaNI cAla vicakAralI rakkha (bhAva nA hI tez2a te nA hI haulI tura) ate ApaNI AvAz2a ratA nIvIM rakkha, bezakka sArIAM AvAz2AM nAloM vadhere bhair3I AvAz2a khote dI huMdI hai|

kI tusIM nahIM vekhade ki allAha ne akAza te dharatI dI hareka cIz2a nUM tuhADe vassa vica kara chaDDiA hai ate ApaNIAM sArIAM disaNa vAlIAM ate gupata niamatAM tuhADe utte pUrIAM kara dittIAM hana| kujjha lokI uha hana jihar3e binAM kise giAna jAM hidAita jAM binAM kise cAnaNa vikhAuNa vAlI kitAba toM rabba saMbaMdhI bahisAM karade hana|

jadoM uhanAM (muzarikAM) nUM kihA jAMdA ki jo allAha ne utArI hai usa (•kuraAna) dI hI pAlaNA karo tAM Akhade hana ki asIM tAM uhIo karAMgA jo asIM ApaNe pio dAdiAM (baz2uragAM) nUM karade vekhiA hai| (uhanAM nUM pucho ki) bhAveM zaitAna uhanAM nUM naraka valla hI bulAuMdA hove, kI phera vI? (use cIz2a dI pAlaNA karoge?)

jihar3A viakatI pAlaNA karade hoe ApaNA ciharA allAha valla jhukA deve jada ki uha neka kaMma karana vAlA vI hove, vAsatava vica usa ne ika bharoseyoga AsarA phar3a liA hai| sAre mAmaliAM dA niber3A allAha de kola hI hoNA hai|

(he nabI!) jihar3A (rabbI hidAitAM dA) inakAra karadA hai, usa de inakAra toM tusIM dukhI nA hovo| aMta uhanAM ne parata ke AuNA tAM sADe valla hI hai| phera asIM uhanAM nUM dassAMge ki uha saMsAra vica kI kujjha karade sI| nirasaMdeha, allAha dilAM de bhetAM nUM caMgI tarhAM jANadA hai|
asIM uhanAM (inakArIAM) isa saMsAra vica thor3hA jihA lAbha diMde hAM, phera asIM uhanAM nUM ika karar3e az2Aba valla dhUha lai jAvAMge|

je tusIM ihanAM nUM puccho ki akAza te dharatI dI racanAM kisa ne kItI hai tAM uha z2arUra AkhaNage ki allAha ne| (he nabI!) tusIM Akho ki sArIAM tArIfAM allAha nUM hI zobhadIAM hana para uhanAM viccoM vadhere loka (iha galla) jANade hI nahIM|
akAzAM te dharatI vica jo vI hai uha sabha allAha dA hI hai| bezakka allAha (ApaNI prazaMsA toM) beparavAha hai, te Apo Apa salAhiA hoiA hai|

je dharatI de (sAre) rukkhAM dIAM kalamAM baNa jANa ate sAre samuMdarAM (de pANI) dI siAhI baNa jAve ate uhanAM de nAla hI satta samuMdara hora siAhI jaTAuNa phera vI allAha dIAM gallAM (likhaNoM) qhatama nahIM hoNagIAM| bezakka allAha DADhA z2orAvara te hikamata vAlA (dAnAI te sUjha-bUjha) vAlA hai|
tuhAnUM sabha nUM paidA karanA ate mur3a surajIta karanA (allAha laI) tAM iMja hai jiveM kise ika jI nUM paidA karanA| bezakka allAha sabha kujjha suNana te vekhaNa vAlA hai|

kI tusIM nahIM vekhade ki allAha rAta nUM dina vica te dina nUM rAta vica dAqhila karadA hai? sUraja te caMna nUM use ne kaMma ’te lA rakkhiA hai te hareka (allAha valloM) niradhArita sameM taka caladA rahegA| bezakka allAha hara usa kaMma toM, jo vI tusIM karade ho, bhalI-bhAMta jANU hai|

iha sabha isa laI (dassiA jAMdA hai) hai ki allAha hI hakka hai ate bezakka usa (allAha)nUM chaDDa ke jinhAM (izaTAM) nUM iha (kAfira) pukArade hana uha sabha jhUThe hana| bezakka allAha hI uccIAM zAnAM vAlA te sabha toM vaDDA hai|

kI tusIM isa ’te vicAra nahIM karade ki bezakka samuMdarAM vica ber3IAM allAha dI miharabAnIAM nAla hI caladIAM hana tAM jo uha tuhAnUM ApaNI (kudarata dIAM) nizAnIAM vikhAve| nirasaMdeha, isa vica hara sabara te zukara karana vAle laI nizAnIAM hana|

jadoM samuMdara dIAM challAM chatarhAM vAMga uhanAM utte chA jAMdIAM hana tAM phera uha (ber3I cAlaka) qhAlisa ImAna rakkhadA hoiA allAha nUM hI pukAradA hai| phera jadoM uha (allAha) usa nUM bacA ke thala taka pahuMcA diMdA hai tAM uhanAM vica kujjha hI loka ApaNe vacanAM ’te kAima rahiMde hana| sADIAM AitAM (nizAnIAM) dA inakAra kevala uhIo karadA hai, jihar3A ditte vacanAM nUM tor3aNa vAlA te nA-zukarA hai|[5]
translations.footnotes: [5] vekho sUrata banI isarAIla, hAzIA Aita 67/17

translations.translation: (he loko!) ApaNe rabba (dI karopI) toM Daro ate usa dina toM Daro jadoM koI pio ApaNe saMtAna de kise kaMma nahIM AvegA ate nA hI saMtAna ApaNe pio de kujjha kaMma AvegI| bezakka allAha dA vAadA (kiAmata AuNa dA) saccA hai| so iha saMsArika jIvana tuhAnUM kise dhokhe vica nA pA deve ate nA dhokhebAz2a (zaitAna) tuhAnUM allAha pratI kise dhokhe vica pA deve|

bezakka kiAmata dA giAna allAha de kola hI hai| uhI barakhA varhAuMdA hai ate uhIo jANadA hai ki mAvAM de garabhAM vica kI (pala rihA) hai? koI nahIM jANadA ki kalla uha kI karana vAlA hai te nA kise nUM iha patA hai ki kisa dharatI utte usa nUM mauta AvegI| (jANa lavo ki) bezakka allAha hI sArA kujjha jANadA hai te hara cIz2a dI qhabara rakhadA hai|
alifa, lAma, mIma|
nirasaMdeha, iha kitAba (•kuraAna) sAre jaga de pAlaNahAra valloM utArI gaI hai|

kI uha (makke de kAfira) Akhade hana ki isa (•kuraAna) nUM nabI ne Ape hI ghar3ha liA hai? (nahIM) sagoM (he nabI!) iha tAM tuhADe rabba valloM hakka sacca (’te AdhArita) hai tAM jo tusIM uhanAM (lokAM) nUM (rabba dI saz2A toM) sAvadhAna karo jinhAM kola tuhAthoM pahilAM koI vI sAvadhAna karana vAlA nahIM AiA, zAida uha siddhe rAha pai jANa|

allAha uha jisane akAza te dharatI nUM ate jo kujjha vI ihanAM de vicAle hai, che dinAM vica sAjiA hai| phera uha araza de siMghAsana utte virAjamAna hoiA| usa toM chuTTa nA koI tuhADA sahAI hai ate nA hI sifArazI| kI tusIM phera vI nasIhata grihaNa nahIM karade?

uha akAza toM lai ke dharatI taka (bhAva saMsAra) de sAre mAmaliAM dA saMcAlana karadA hai ate ika dina, jihar3A tuhADe ika haz2Ara sAla de barAbara hai, uha mAmalA usa kola (akAza ’te car3ha) jAMdA hai|
uha (allAha) tuhADIAM guppata te khullhIAM gallAM dA jANana vAlA hai| uha DADhA z2orAvara te ati rahima faramAuNa vAlA hai|
jisa ne harake cIz2a nUM sohaNe DhaMga nAla sAjiA ate manukkha dI racanA miTTI toM AraMbha kItA|
phera usa (manukkha bhAva Adama) dI nasala ika tuccha jihe pANI de nacor3a (vIraja) toM calAI|
phera usa (de aMgAM) nUM ThIka kItA ate usa vica ApaNI rUha phUMkI (bhAva jAna pA dittI)| use (allAha) ne tuhADe kaMna, akkhAM te dila baNAe, para tusIM bahuta hI ghaTTa dhaMnavAdI huMde ho|

ate uhanAM (kAfira) lokAM ne kihA ki jadoM asIM miTTI vica rala-mila jAvAMge tAM kI asIM navIM jIvanI vica pragaTa hovAMge? (nahIM) he nabI! sagoM uha tAM ApaNe pAlaNahAra de milaNa toM hI inakAra karade hana|
(he nabI!) tusIM uhanAM (inakArIAM) nUM kahi dio ki mauta dA farizatA (iz2arAIla) tuhADI jAna kaDDhegA jihar3A tuhADe ’te niyukata kItA hoiA hai, phera tusIM sAre ApaNe rabba vala hI paratAe jAvoge|

he nabI! kAza! tusIM vI vekhade jadoM pApI ApaNe rabba agge nIvIM pAIM khar3e hoNage| uha AkhaNage ki he sADe rabbA! asIM isa (kiAmata dihAr3e) nUM vekha liA ate suNa vI liA, huNa tUM sAnUM mur3a (dharatI ’te) bheja de huNa asIM bhale kaMma karAMge, sAnUM yakIna ho giA hai (ki tere nabI dIAM gallAM saccIAM sana)|

jekara asIM (allAha) cAhuMde tAM hareka viakatI nUM siddhA rAha darasAuMde para mere laI iha galla sacca sAbata ho gaI (jihar3I maiM AkhI sI) ki maiM naraka nUM manukkhAM te jiMnAM nAla z2arUra hI bhara devAMgA|

so (he inakArIo!) huNa tusIM az2Aba dA suAda lavo isa laI ki tusIM isa dina dI milaNI (kiAmata) nUM bhulA beThe sI, so ajja asAM vI tuhAnUM bhulA chaDDiA hai ate jo bure kaMma tusIM karade sI uhanAM kArana tusIM sadIvI saz2A dA suAda lavo|

sADIAM AitAM (hukamAM) nUM tAM uhIo sacca maMnade hana ki jadoM uhanAM nUM ihanAM AitAM rAhIM nasIhata kItI jAMdI hai tAM uha sijade vica Diga paiMde hana (bhAva AgiA dI pAlaNa karade hana) ate ApaNe rabba de prasaMzAM de nAlo-nAla usa dI pavittaratA vI biAna karade hana| uha jhukaNa vica ghamaMDa nahIM karade|[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] vekho sUrata ala-hajja, hAzIA Aita 9/22

translations.translation: uhanAM dIAM piThAM ApaNe bisatariAM toM aDDa rahiMdIAM hana [2] (bhAva uha rAtAM nUM sauMde nahIM sagoM) ate ApaNe rabba toM Darade hoe ate (miharAM dIAM) AsAM rakkhade hoe (rAta vele muAfI laI) benatIAM karade hana ate jo kujjha vI asIM uhanAM nUM (dhaMna daulata) dittA hoiA hai usa nUM uha (rabba de hukamAM anusAra hI) qharaca karade hana|
translations.footnotes: [2] ika hadIsa vica ru ki allAha de neka baMde rAta de AqharI tihAI hisse vica namAz2a par3hade hana, Apa (sa:) ne iha Aita tilAvata faramAI ki unhAM dIAM piTThAM bisatariAM toM aDDa rahiMdIAM hana| (jAme tiramaz2I, hadIsa: 2616)

translations.translation: koI vI (ImAna ’te neka karama karana vAlA) viakatI nahIM jANadA ki usa de karamAM de badale usa dIAM akkhAM ThaMDIAM karana laI (rabba ne) kI kujjha luko ke rakkhiA hoiA hai|
kI momina vI fAsika (jhUThe) vAMga ho sakadA hai? iha doveM ika samAna nahIM ho sakade|
para jihar3e loka ImAna liAe ate uhanAM ne karama vI caMge hI kIte uhanAM de rahiNa laI bAg2a hana, iha mahimAnadArI (Ao bhagata) uhanAM karamAM de badale vica hai jihar3e uha kariA karade sana|

para jinhAM lokAM ne nA-faramAnI kItI uhanAM dA TikANA naraka hai, jadoM vI uha usa viccoM bAhara AuNA cAhuNage use vica dhakela ditte jANage ate kihA jAvegA ki (rabba te usa de rasUla nUMGa) jhuThalAuNa de badale vica agaddA suAda lavo|
asIM (allAha) z2arUra hI uhanAM (kAfirAM) nUM usa vaDDe (naraka de) az2Aba toM pahilAM (saMsAra vica) choTe nikke az2AbAM dA suAda devegAM tAM jo uha (rabba valla) parata AuNa|
usa viakatI toM vaDDA aparAdhI kauNa hai jisa nUM usa de rabba dIAM AitAM (•kuraAna) nAla nasIhata kItI gaI hove phera vI usa ne mUMha mor3a liA| z2arUra hI asIM aparAdhIAM toM badalA laiNa vAle hAM|

bezakka asIM mUsA nUM vI kitAba (tauraita) baqhazI, so (he nabI!) tusIM isa kitAba (•kuraAna) nUM allAha valloM milaNa utte zakka nA karo| asIM isa (tauraita) banI-isarAIla laI hidAita (dA sAdhana) baNAiA|
jadoM uhanAM ne dhIraja toM kaMma liA tAM asIM uhanAM laI kujjha ajihe AgU baNAe jihar3e sADe hukamAM anusAra agavAI karade sana ate uha sADIAM AitAM (upadezAM) ’te vizavAsa karade sana|
nirasaMdeha, tuhADA rabba kiAmata dihAr3e uhanAM vicAle faisalA karegA jisa vica uha matabheda karade sana|

kI ajihe tIka uhanAM ’te sapazaTa nahIM hoiA ki asIM uhanAM toM pahilAM kiMnIAM hI ummatAM (kaumAM) nUM, jinhA de gharAM vica ajja uha turade-phirade hana, halAka kara cukke hAM, bezakka isa vica samajhaNa laI vaDDIAM nizAnIAM hana| kI uha phera vI suNade samajhade nahIM?

kI uha nahIM vekhade ki bezakka asIM hI pANI nUM bahA ke baMjara dharatI valla lai jAMde hAM, phera asIM usa (pANI) rAhIM fasalAM ugAuMde hAM, jisa nUM uhanAM de pazU te uha Apa vI khAMde hana| kI uha soca vicAra nahIM karade?
uha inakArI pucchade hana ki je tusIM sacce ho tAM dasso ki iha (amalAM) dA niber3A kadoM hovegA?
(he nabI!) tusIM Akha dio ki faisale vAle dina (bhAva kiAmata dihAr3e) ihanAM kAfirAM nUM uhanAM dA ImAna liAuNA kujjha vI lAbha nahIM devegA te nA hI uhanAM nUM koI Dhilla dittI jAvegI|
so tusIM (he nabI!) uhanAM toM mUMha phera lavo (bhAva uhanAM de hAla ’te chaDDa dio) ate uDIka karo, bezakka uha (inakArI) vI (allAha de phaisale dI) uDIka kara rahe hana|
he nabI! (muhaMmada sa:) allAha toM hI Darade raho ate kAfirAM te munAfikAM de Akhe nA laggo| bezakka allAha vaDDA jANanahAra te hikamata vAlA (yukatImAna) hai|
ate usa vahI (rabbI hidAita) dI pairavI karo jo tuhADe rabba valloM tuhADe utte nAz2ila kItI jAMdI hai, bezakka allAha tuhADe sAre kaMmAM dI qhabara rakkhadA hai|
tusIM allAha utte hI bharosA rakkho ate kaMma savArana laI allAha hI batherA hai|

allAha ne kise viakatI de sIne vica do dila nahIM rakkhe| tusIM ApaNIAM jinhAM patanIAM nUM mAM kahi baiThade ho allAha ne uhanAM nUM nA hI tuhADI (sakI) mAM baNAiA hai ate nA hI tuhADe laI le pAlakAM (mUMha-bole beTe) nUM tuhADA (sakA) puttara baNAiA hai| iha tAM tuhADe ApaNe mUMhAM dIAM gallAM hana| jada ki allAha tuhAnUM hakka-sacca galla hI AkhadA hai ate uhIo siddhI rAha darasAuMdA hai|

pAlakAM nUM uhanAM de (asalI) bApAM de nAM lai ke pukAro, allAha dI naz2ara vica iho inasAfa vAlI galla hai| phera je tuhAnUM uhanAM de asalI pio dA patA hI nA hove (ki ੳhanAM dA pio kauNa hai) tAM uha tuhADe dharama-bharA te tahADe mittara hana| je isa mAmale vica tuhAthoM koI bhulla-cukka ho jAve tAM tuhADe sira koI doza nahIM, hAM! doza usa galla dA hai jihar3A tusIM ApaNe mano irAdA karade ho| allAha vaDDA baqhazanahAra te miharAM vAlA hai|

bezakka nabI tAM ImAna vAliAM laI uhanAM de ApaNe Apa toM vI kite vaddha hakka rakkhadA hai[1] ate nabI dIAM patanIAM ImAna vAliAM dIAM mAvAM hana ate allAha dI kitAba (.kuraAna) anusAra dUje mominAM ate muhAjarAM nAloM, rizatedAra (varAsata dA) vadhere hakkadAra hana| je tusIM ApaNe mittarAM nAla bhalAI karanA cAhuMde ho (tAM kara sakade ho) iha hukama rabbI kitAba (.kuraAna) vica likhiA hoiA hai|
translations.footnotes: [1] isa toM bhAva hai ki mominAM nUM satikArayoga muhaMmada (sa:) de nAla ApaNIAM jAnA toM vI vaddha muhabbata hoNI cAhIdI hai| ika hadIsa vica hai ki nabI (sa:) ne haz2arata umara dA hattha phar3iA hoiA sI ki haz2arata umara ne araz2a kItI ki he rasUla (sa:) tusIM mainUM hara cIz2a toM vadhake piAre ho chuTTa merI ApaNI jAna toM| Apa (sa:) ne faramAiA ki kasama hai mainUM usa z2Ata dI jisa de kabaz2e vica merI jAna hai ki tuhADA ImAna usa sameM takka makkamalla nahIM ho sakadA jadoM takka tusI mainUUM ApaNI jAnAM toM vI vaddha muhabbata nahIM karoMge| iha suNa ke haz2arata umara ne kihA ki je iMja hai tAM allAha dI kasama huNa tusIM mainUM merI jAna toM vI vaddha ke piAre ho| iha suNa ke Apa (sa:) ne faramaiA ki he umara! huNa tUM momina hai| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 6232)

translations.translation: (he nabI! yAda karo) jadoM asIM sAre nabIAM toM (rabbI paig2Ama lokAM taka pahuMcAuNa dA) praNa liA sI| tuhAthoM (bhAva muhaMmada sa: toM) vI ate nUha, ibarAhIma, mUsA te marIama de puttara IsA [2] toM (vI iho praNa liA sI) ate asIM sabha toM pakkA praNa lai cukke hAM|
translations.footnotes: [2] allAha ne bahuta bar3I saMkhiA vica paig2aMbara te nabI bheje hana para.kuraAna pAka vica laga-bhaga 25 nabIAM de nAvAM dI hI caracA kItI gaI hai| inhAM vicca ucca koTI de paMja paig2aMbara hI hana| 1਼ muhaMmada (sa:) 2਼ haz2arata nUha 3਼ haz2arata ibarAhIma 4਼ haz2arata mUsA 5਼ haz2arata IsA|

translations.translation: tAM jo (allAha) sacce lokAM (paig2aMbara) toM uhanAM (lokAM de praNa) dI saccAI bAre (kiAmata dihAr3e) puccha-giccha kare| usa ne kAfirAM laI dukhadAI az2Aba (naraka dI agga Adi) tiAra kara rakkhiA hai|

(he ImAna vAlio!) allAha ne jo tuhADe ’te upakAra kItA hai usa nUM cete rakkho ki jadoM tuhADe utte (kAfirAM dIAM) faujAM car3hAI kara rahIAM sana, phera asIM uhanAM (faujAM) ’te ika hanerI bhejI te (farizatiAM dIAM) ajihIAM faujAM bhejIAM jinhAM nUM tusIM vekhiA vI nahIM| jo kujjha vI tusIM karade ho allAha sabha vekhadA hai|

(yAda karo) jadoM vairI utale te heThale pAsioM tuhADe ’te car3ha Ae ate (bhai-bhIta ho ke) tuhADIAM akkhAM patharA gaIAM, kAlaje mUMha nUM AuNa lagga pae ate tusIM allAha bAre tarhAM-tarhAM de (bhair3e) gumAna karana lagga pae sI|
usa vele mominAM dI parakha hoI sI ate uhanAM nUM burI tarhAM halUNiA giA|
jadoM munAfika (do gale) ate uha loka jinhAM de manAM vica (kufara dA) roga sI uha Akha rahe sana ki allAha te usa de rasUla (muhaMmada sa:) ne tAM sADe nAla chala-kapaTa vAle jhUThe vAade kIte sI|

jadoM uhanAM (munAfikAM) de ika dhar3e ne AkhiA ki he yasaraba (madInA) vAlio! ajja tuhADe laI (makke dIAM faujAM de sAmhaNe) Thahirana dA koI maukA nahIM, pichAMha parata callo| ate uhanAM viccoM hI ika hora TolI iha kahi ke nabI (sa:) toM chuTTI maMga rahI sI ki sADe ghara surakkhiata nahIM hana jada ki uhanAM nUM kise tarhAM dA koI qhatarA nahIM sI| asala vica uha tAM kevala (jaMga toM) bhajjaNA cAhuMde sana|

je kite isa (madIne) de kinAriAM toM uhanAM (munAfikAM) utte (kAfirAM dIAM) faujAM aMdara A var3IAM huMdIAM ate phera uhanAM nUM upaddara macAuNa laI saddA dittA jAMdA tAM iha use vele usa nUM pravAna kara laiMde ate uhanAM nUM isa (upaddara vica) ralaNoM zAida hI koI saMkoca hoNA sI|
nirasaMdeha, isa toM pahilAM ihanAM (munAfikAM) ne allAha nAla praNa kItA sI ki uha (jaMga toM) piTTha nahIM pheranage| uhanAM ne jihar3A vAadA allAha nAla kItA hai usa dI puccha-giccha tAM hovegI|

(he nabI!) Akho ki tusIM mauta toM jAM katala hoNa de Dara toM bhAveM kiMnAM hI nasso, iha nassaNA tuhADe laI kujjha vI lAhevaMda siddha nahIM hovegA| (isa bhajjaNa magaroM) tusIM ApaNe jIvana dA bahuta hI ghaTTa lAbha uThAoge|

(he nabI!) uhanAM (Darapoka) lokAM nUM puccho ki kauNa hai jo tuhAnUM allAha (de az2Aba) toM bacA sake je uha tuhAnUM koI hAnI pahuMcAuNA cAhave jAM tuhADe ’te koI miharabAnI karanA cAhave tAM kauNa roka sakadA hai? ate uha loka chuTTa allAha toM ApaNA koI vI sahAI te himAitI nahIM pAuNage|

bezakka allAha tuhADe viccoM uhanAM sabha nUM jANadA hai jihar3e jihAda vica ar3Ike lAuMde hana ate uhanAM nUM vI (jANadA hai) jihar3e ApaNe bharAvAM nUM kahiMde hana ki sADe kola A jAo (jihAda nA karo) ate uha Apa vI jaMga vica bahuta hI ghaTTa hissA laiMde hana|

he nabI isa (jaMga dI) hAlata vica uha (munAfika) tuhADA sAtha deNa vica bahuta hI kaMjUsa (sUma) hana| jadoM Dara qhaupha (jaMga) dA velA A jAve tAM tusIM uhanAM nUM vekhade ho ki uha iMja akkhAM (de Dele) ghuMmA ghuMmA ke tuhADe vala dekhade hana jiveM ki uha viakatI vekhadA hai jisa utte mauta dI behozI chA jAve, para jadoM qhatarA Tala jAMdA hai tAM mAle g2anImata de lobhI baNa ke tuhADe sAmhaNe (yodhe baNa ke) tez2a tez2a (kaiMcIAM vAMga) z2ubAnAM calAuMNa laga jAMde hana| asaloM iha loka ukkA hI ImAna nahIM liAe, ise laI allAha ne uhanAM de sAre karama nazaTa kara dite hana ate ajihA karanA allAha laI bahuta hI saukhA hai|

uha samajhade hana ki ajiha taka vairI dIAM faujAM vApasa nahIM gaIAM (jada ki jA cukkIAM hana) ate je faujAM A car3haNa tAM uhanAM dI mana dI icchA iho huMdI hai ki uha jaMgalAM vica rahiNa vAle baddUAM nAla jA ke rahiNa laga jANa ate utthioM hI tuhADI qhaira-qhairIyata pucchade rahiMde| (he nabI!) jekara uha loka tuhADe saMga huMde tAM vI uha nA-mAtara lar3ade|

bezakka tuhADe laI allAha de rasUla (haz2arata muhaMmada sa:) dI zaqhasIata ika uttama namUnA hai (ate iha namUnA) hara usa viakatI laI hai jihar3A allAha ate kiAmata dihAr3e dI Asa rakkhadA hai ate allAha nUM vadhere yAda karadA hai|

(dUje pAse) jadoM ImAna vAliAM ne (kAfirAM dIAM) faujAM nUM vekhiA tAM bola pae ki iha uhIo cIz2a hai jisa dA vAadA sADe nAla allAha ate usa de rasUla (muhaMmada sa:) ne kItA sI ate allAha te usa de rasUla dA AkhaNA sacca sI| isa (ghaTanA) ne uhanAM de ImAna te faramAMbaradArI vica hora vAdhA kara dittA|

mominAM viccoM kujjha ajihe loka vI hana jinhAM ne jo vI allAha nAla praNa kItA sI, usa nUM sacca kara vikhAiA|[3]so kujjha ne tAM ApaNe vacanAM nUM pUrA kara dittA (bhAva zahIda ho gae) ate kujjha uhanAM viccoM (zahIda hoNa dI) uDIka vica hana ate uhanAM ne ApaNe vihAra vica koI badalAo nahIM kItA|
translations.footnotes: [3] iha Aita unhAM sahAbIAM de bAre nAz2ala hoI hai jinhAM ne badara dI jaMga vica johara dikhAe ate inhAM vica hI uha vI sahAbI hana jihar3e badara dI jaMga vica bhAga nahIM lai sake para unhAM ne iha vacana vI liA sI ki jadoM vI koI hora jaMga hovegI usa vica bhAga jarUra laiNage|

translations.translation: (iha isa laI hoiA hai) tAM jo allAha sacce lokAM nUM uhanAM dI saccAI dA badalA deve ate je cAhe tAM munAfikAM nUM saz2A deve jAM uhanAM dI taubA nUM kabUla kara lave| allAha bahuta hI baqhazaNahAra te miharabAna hai|

(ahaz2Aba dI jaMga vica) allAha ne kAfirAM nUM (nA-murAdI de) gusse nAla vApasa mor3a dittA, uha (jaMga vica) kujjha vI lAbha prApata nahIM kara sake ate isa lar3AI vica mominAM laI allAha hI batherA ho giA| allAha vaDDA z2orAvara te zakatIzAlI hai|

ate ahale kitAba (yahUdIAM) viccoM jinhAM ne kAfirAM dI madada kItI sI allAha uhanAM dIAM gar3hIAM toM uhanAM nUM kaDDha liAiA| uhanAM de dilAM vica (musalamAnAM dA) ajihA roaba pA dittA ki ajja tusIM uhanAM (banUkurez2A de munAfikAM) de ika dhar3e nUM katala kara rahe ho ate dUje nUM kaidI baNA rahe ho|

ate iMja allAha ne tuhAnUM uhanAM dI dharatI, gharAM ate mAlAM dA vArasa baNA dittA ate usa dharatI dA vI (vArasa baNAiA) jisa nUM tusIM ApaNe pairA heTha latAr3hiA vI nahIM (bhAva jitthe aje tusIM gae vI nahIM) allAha tAM hareka kaMma karana dI samarathA rakkhadA hai|

he nabI! ApaNIAM patanIAM nUM Akha dio ki je tusIM saMsArika jIvana ate usa dI zobhA cAhuMdIAM ho tAM Ao! maiM tuhAnUM kujjha de duA de sohaNe DhaMga nAla taura diAM[4] (bhAva tuhAnUM talAka de diAM)|
translations.footnotes: [4] isa Aita vica usa ghaTanA dI caracA kItI gaI ru jadoM nabI (sa:) dIAM patanIAM ne Apa jI toM kujha vaddha qharace laI maMga kItI sI jisa nUM Apa jI ne nA pasaMda faramAiA sI ate kujha sameM laI unhAM patanIAM toM aDDa rahiNa lagga pae sI| jisa karake allAha taAlA ne iha Aita nAz2ila faramAI ki tusIM jinhAM patanIAM nUM talAka deNA cAhuMde ho de sakade ho| tAM Apa ne ApaNIAM patanIAM nUM talAka laiNa dA adhikAra de dittA| para kise vI patanI ne Apa toM talAka nahIM laI|

translations.translation: ate je tusIM allAha te usa de rasUla ate Aqhirata (paraloka) dA ghara cAhuMdIAM ho tAM jANa lao ki tuhADe viccoM neka kaMma karana vAlIAM laI tAM allAha ne bahuta hI vaDDA badalA tiAra kara chaDDiA hai|
he nabI dI patanIo! tuhADe viccoM jihar3I vI koI pratakkha azalIla kaMma karegI usa nUM dUharA az2Aba dittA jAvegA ate allAha laI iha karanA bahuta hI saukhA kaMma hai|

ate tuhADe viccoM jihar3I vI koI allAha te usa de rasUla dI AgiA dA pAlaNa te neka kaMma karegI asIM usa nUM ajara (badalA) vI dUharA hI diAMge ate usa laI asIM mAna mariAdA vAlI roz2I tiAra kara rakkhI hai|

he nabI dI patanIo! tusIM sAdhArana auratAM vAMga nahIM ho, je tusIM rabba toM Darana vAlIAM ho tAM (kise vI gaira mahirama nAla) dabavIM z2ubAna (naramI) nAla galla bAta nA karo ki uha viakatI jisa de mana vica (kAma vAsanA dA) roga hai uha kise lobha vica jA Dige, sagoM sAfa te sapazaTa (zabadAM vica) galla karo|

tusIM ApaNe gharAM vica TikIAM baiThIAM rihA karo ate purANe jahAlata de sameM (bhAva਼ kuraAnI sikkhiAvAM AuNa toM pahilAM) vAMga ApaNe husana dA pragaTAvA nA karadIAM phiro| ate namAz2AM kAima karo te z2akAta adA karo ate allAha te usa de rasUla dI AgiA dI pAlaNA karo| (he ahale baita!) allAha tAM iho cAhuMdA hai ki uha tuhAthoM hara prakAra dI burAI dUra kara deve ate tuhAnUM caMgI tarhAM pavittara kara deve|
ate tuhADe gharAM vica jihar3IAM vI allAha dIAM AitAM (.kuraAnI Adeza) ate hikamatAM (rasUla dIAM gallAM) suNAIAM jAMdIAM hana uhanAM nUM yAda rakkho| bezakka allAha sUkhamadarazI te bA-qhabara hai|

nirasaMdeha, musalamAna marada te auratAM, momina marada te auratAM, AgiAkArI marada te auratAM (kahiNI te karanI vica), sacce marada te auratAM, (muzakalAM AuNa ’te) sabara karana vAle marada te auratAM, allAha de agge jhukaNa vAle marada te auratAM, sadakA (punna-dAna) karana vAle marada te auratAM, roz2e rakkhaNa vAle marada te auratAM, gupata aMgAM dI rAkhI karana vAle marada te isatarIAM, allAha dA vaddha toM vaddha simarana karana vAle marada te auratAM, ihanAM sabha laI allAha ne bahuta hI vaDDA baqhaziza te ucca daraje dA badalA deNa dA prabaMdha kItA hoiA hai|

ate kise vI momina marada jAM aurata nUM iha hakka nahIM ki jadoM allAha te usa dA rasUla kise mAmale dA faisalA kara deve tAM phera usa nUM ApaNe usa mAmale vica faisalA karana dA koI adhikAra (bAkI) nahIM| jihar3A vI koI allAha ate usa de rasUla dI avaggiA karegA uha sapazaTa kurAhe jA piA|

(he nabI!) usa vele nUM yAda karo jadoM tusIM usa viakatI (z2aida bina hArisa) nUM Akha rahe sI, jisa ’te allAha ne ate tusIM vI upakAra kItA sI ki tUM ApaNI patanI (z2ainaba) nUM ApaNe kola hI rakkha (talAka nA de) ate allAha toM Dara| usa sameM tusIM ApaNe mana vica uha galla lukA chaDDI sI jisa nUM allAha kholaNA cAhuMdA sI| tusIM lokAM toM Dara rahe sI jada ki allAha hI vadhere hakka rakkhadA hai ki use toM hI DariA jAve, jadoM z2aida ne usa aurata (patanI) toM ApaNI lor3a pUrI kara laI (bhAva patanI toM dila bhara giA te talAka de dittI) phera asIM usa (talAkI hoI z2ainaba) nUM tuhADe nikAha vica de dittA, tAM jo musalamAnAM laI ApaNe le-pAlakAM dIAM patanIAM (nAla nikAha) de mAmale vica koI taMgI nA rahe jada ki uha (le-pAlaka) uhanAM toM ApaNI lor3AM pUrIAM kara cukke hoNa| allAha dA hara hukama sAkAra ho ke hI rahiNA hai|

ate nabI laI usa kaMma karana vica koI haraja nahIM jihar3A allAha ne usa laI pharaz2a kara dittA hai| iho allAha dA dasatUra uhanAM (paig2aMbarAM) laI vI rihA hai jihar3e pahilAM ho cukke hana| allAha de Adeza ika aTala faisalA huMdA hai|
uha sAre paig2aMbara jihar3e allAha dA paig2Ama (lokAM takka) pahuMcAde sana uha use (allAha) toM hI Darade sana hora kise toM nahIM sI Darade| lekhA-jokhA laiNa laI tAM allAha hI kAfI hai|

(he loko! suNo ki) muhaMmada (sa:) tuhADe lokAM viccoM kise de vI pitA nahIM para uha allAha de rasUla ate sAre nabIAM de samApaka hana[5] (bhAva AqharI nabI hana) ate allAha (sArIAM gallAM toM) caMgI tarhAM jANU hai|
translations.footnotes: [5] qhatama-e-nabuvatta toM bhAva hai ki huNa rasAlate muhaMmadIA utte ImAna liAe binAM mukatI nahIM| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 335, 3535, 3455)

translations.translation: he ImAna vAlio! allAha nUM vaddha toM vaddha yAda kariA karo|
savere vI te zAma nUM vI (bhAva hara vele) use (allAha) dI tasabIha karo|

uhIo hai jihar3A tuhADe utte ApaNIAM miharAM bhejadA hai ate usa de farizate vI (tuhADe laI duAvAM karade hana) tAM jo uha (allAha) tuhAnUM (kufara de) haneriAM viccoM kaDDha ke (ImAna de) cAnaNa valla lai Ave ate allAha ImAna vAliAM laI bahuta hI miharabAna hai|
jisa dina uha (ImAna vAle) allAha nUM milaNage tAM uhanAM laI duA hovegI (ki tuhADe ’te) salAma hove, uhanAM laI Adara-mAna vAlA badalA (savaraga) tiAra kara chaDDiA hai|
he nabI! nirasaMdeha asIM hI tuhAnUM gavAhI deNa vAlA, (savaragAM dIAM) qhuzaqhabarI suNAuNa vAlA ate (rabba dI pakar3a toM) DarAuNa vAlA (rasUla) baNA ke bhejiA hai|
allAha dI AgiA nAla (lokAM nUM) use (rabba) valla bulAuNa vAlA ate (siddhA rAha vikhAuNa vAlA) ika rauzanI dA carAg2a[6] (cAnaNa munArA) baNA ke bhejiA hai|
translations.footnotes: [6] vekho sUrata Ale-imarAna, hAzIA Aita 164/3

translations.translation: ate ImAna vAliAM nUM iha qhuzaqhabarI de dio ki uhanAM laI rabba valloM bahuta vaDDI kripAlatA hai|
(he nabI!) kAfirAM te munAfikAM dA ukkA hI kahiNA nA maMno, uhanAM valloM dittI hoI takalIfa dI paravAha nA karo| allAha ’te hI bharosA rakkho ate sAre kaMma savArana vAlA allAha hI batherA hai|

(he ImAna vAlio!) jadoM tusIM momina auratAM nAla nikAha karo je hattha lAuNa toM pahilAM hI uhanAM nUM talAka de dio tAM tuhADe valloM uhanAM ’te koI iddata pUrI karanA z2arUrI nahIM ki tusIM usa (iddata) de dinAM dI giNatI karo, sagoM tusIM uhanAM nUM kujjha nA kujjha (mAla) de ke sohaNe DhaMga nAla vidA karo|

(he nabI!) asAM tuhADe laI tuhADIAM uha patanIAM halAla (jAiz2a) kara dittIAM jinhAM de mahira tusIM adA kara cukke ho ate uha dAsIAM vI jAiz2a hana jihar3IAM tuhADI malakIyata vica hana, jihanAM nUM allAha ne tuhAnUM mAle-g2anImata vajoM dittIAM hana| tuhADe cAce, bhUA, mAme ate mAsI dIAM dhIAM, jinhAM ne tuhADe nAla hijarata kItI hai ate uha ImAna vAlIAM z2anAnIAM vI halAla hana jinhAM ne ApaNe Apa nUM nabI laI hibA kara dittA hove ate je nabI vI usa nAla nikAha karanA cAhuMdA hove tAM usa nUM nikAha vica lai Ave| para iha chUTa kevala tuhADe laI hai, dUje mominAM laI nahIM| jihar3e hukama asIM uhanAM (sAdhArana musalamAna) dIAM patanIAM ate dAsIAM bAre ditte hoe hana asIM bhalI-bhAMta jANade hAM| (tuhADe laI patanIAM dI vizeza chUTa isa laI hai ki) tuhAnUM kise tarhAM dI taMgI nA hove| allAha vaDDA baqhazaNahAra te rahima karana vAlA hai|

(he nabI!) tusIM ApaNIAM patanIAM viccoM jisa nUM vI cAho ApaNe toM aDDa rakkho te jisa nUM cAho ApaNe kola rakkho| jinhAM nUM tusIM aDDa rakkhiA hoiA hai je tusIM uhanAM nUM vI ApaNe kola bulA lavo tAM vI tuhADe sira koI doza nahIM| isa galla toM vadhere Asa kItI jA sakadI hai ki uhanAM dIAM akkhAM (Apa jI nUM vekha ke) ThaMDIAM rahiNagIAM, uha dukhI nahIM hoNagIAM ate tusIM uhanAM nUM jo vI dioge uha sabha usa toM qhuza hoNagIAM| tuhADe dilAM vica jo vI (bhalAI) uhanAM laI hai, allAha usa nUM caMgI tarhAM jANadA hai| allAha sahinazIlatA nAla hara galla jANadA hai|

ihanAM patanIAM toM bAada tuhADe laI hora auratAM (nikAha laI) jAiz2a nahIM ate nA iha (jAiz2a) hai ki tusIM ihanAM patanIAM dI thAM horAM patanIAM nAla nikAha karo, bhAveM uha tuhAnUM kiMnIAM hI sohaNIAM kiuM nA laggadIAM hoNa, para hAM uhanAM dAsIAM dI chUTa hai jihar3IAM tuhADI malakIyata vica hana| allAha hareka galla dI nigarAnI karadA hai|

(he ImAna vAlio!) tusIM nabI (sa:) de gharAM vica binAM AgiA nA var3hiA karo, hAM! je tuhAnUM saddiA jAve (tada jAo) para utthe jAke bhojana tiAra hoNa dI uDIka vica nA baiTho raho, hAM! je tuhAnUM bhojana laI saddiA jAve, usa sameM jAo| jadoM bhojana kara cukko tAM khilara jAo, utthe hI gallAM vica nA rujjhe raho| nabI (sa:) nUM tuhADIAM iha harakatAM dukkha diMdIAM hana| para uha (kujjha kahiNo) saMgadA hai, jada ki allAha saccI galla AkhaNo nahIM saMgadA| (he musalamAno!) jadoM tusIM nabI (sa:) dIAM patanIAM toM kujjha maMgaNA hove (jAM pucchaNA hove) tAM par3ade dI oTa karake maMgo| tuhADe mana laI vI ate uhanAM de manAM dI pavittaratA laI iho vadhere ucita hai| iha galla tuhADe laI ucita nahIM ki tusIM allAha de paig2aMbara nUM kise tarhAM dA dukkha pahuMcAo ate nA hI iha jAiz2a hai ki tusIM uhanAM de (akAla calANe) magaroM uhanAM dIAM patanIAM nAla nikAha karo| allAha dI naz2ara vica iha bahuta hI vaDDA pApa hai|
tusIM kise galla nUM pragaTa karo jAM chupAo allAha hara galla toM jANU hai|

uhanAM (z2anAnIAM) laI ApaNe pio (sane dAdA, nAnA, soharA), puttara, bharA, bhatIje, bhAMje ate ApaNe varagIAM momina auauratAM ate ApaNe adhIna kaMma karana vAle (nauaukarAM) de sAhamaNe AuNa vica koI haraja nahIM| (he auaurato!) tusIM allAha toM DaradIAM raho, bezakka allAha tuhADe hareka kaMma dA gavAha hai|
bezakka allAha ate usa de farizate nabI (muhaMmada sa:) utte rahimatAM bhejade hana, he ImAna vAlio! tusIM vI uhanAM ’te darUda te salAma bhejade rihA karo|

nirasaMdeha, jihar3e loka vI allAha te usa de rasUla (muhaMmada sa:) nUM kise vI tarhAM dA dukkha diMde hana uhanAM utte loka te paraloka vica allAha dIAM fiTakArAM hana ate uhanAM lokAM laI z2alIla karana vAlA az2Aba tiAra kara chaDDiA hai|
jihar3e lokI momina purazAM te z2anAnIAM nUM binAM kise kasUra toM satAuMde hana, nirasaMdeha, uha ApaNe sirAM utte ika vaDA bahutAna (Uja) ate pratakkha pApAM dA bojha cukkI phirade hana|

he nabI (sa:)! ApaNIAM patanIAM, dhIAM te momina auratAM nUM Akho ki (jadoM gharoM bAhara jANa tAM) uha ApaNe utte ika vaDDI caddara lai liA karana, iMja uhanAM dI bar3I chetI pachANa ho jAiA karegI [7] (ki uha neka bIbIAM hana) phera uhanAM nUM koI taMga nahIM karegA| allAha ApaNIAM miharAM sadake baqhazaNahAra hai|
translations.footnotes: [7] vekho sUrata ana-nUra, hAzIA Aita 31/24

translations.translation: je munAfika ate uha jinhAM de manAM vica khoTa hai ate uha jihar3e madIne vica baiThiAM afavAhAM phailAuMde hana, je uha ApaNIAM harakatAM toM bAz2a nA Ae tAM asIM tuhAnUM z2arUra hI uhanAM de viruddha ika nA ika dina khar3A karAMge, phera tAM uha tuhADe nAla (he nabI!) isa zahira (madIne) vikhe thor3he hI sameM laI rahi sakaNage|
uha (hara pAsioM) phiTakAre hoe hana, jitthe vI uha vikhAI deNage phar3e jANage ate burI tarhAM mAra ditte jANage|
jihar3e loka pahilAM bIta cukke hana uhanAM laI vI allAha dA iho dasatUra sI| tusIM rabba de dasatUra vica kade koI adalA badalI nahIM vekhoge|
(he nabI!) lokI tuhAthoM kiAmata bAre pucchade hana, tusIM Akho ki isa dA giAna tAM allAha nUM hI hai| tuhAnUM kI patA hai ki uha ner3e hI hove?
bezakka allAha ne kAfirAM ’te lAanatAM pAIAM hana ate uhanAM laI bhar3akadI hoI agga tiAra kara rakkhI hai|
uha isa (naraka) vica sadA laI rahiNage, utthe nA tAM uhanAM dA koI himAitI hovegA te nA hI koI sahAI hovegA|
usa dina uhanAM (kAfirAM) de cihare agga vica ulaTAe palaTAe jANage tAM uha AkhaNage ki kAza! asIM allAha ate usa de rasUla (de hukamAM) dI pAlaNA karade|
ate AkhaNage ki he sADe rabbA! asIM tAM ApaNe saradArAM te vaDDiAM dI hI pAlaNA kItI ate unhAM ne hI sAnUM siddhe rAhoM bhaTakA dittA|
(rabba nUM benatI) karade hoe uha (inakArI) AkhaNage ki sADe rabba tUM sADe uhanAM (saradArAM) nUM duggaNA az2Aba de ate uhanAM ’te vadha toM vadha lAanatAM bheja|

he ImAna vAlio! tusIM uhanAM lokAM vAMga nA ho jANA jinhAM ne mUsA nUM satAiA sI| jihar3IAM gallAM uha (mUsA) bAre karade sI allAha ne uhanAM sabha toM (mUsA nUM) barI kara dittA| uha (mUsA) tAM rabba dIAM naz2arAM vica ucce marAtabe vAlA sI|
he ImAna vAlio! tusIM (kevala) allAha toM hI Daro ate siddhIAM te saccIAM gallAM kariA karo|

(iMja karana nAla) uha (allAha) tuhADe sAre kaMmAM nUM suAra devegA ate tuhADe gunAhAM nUM muAfa kara devegA ate jihar3A vI koI allAha ate usa de rasUla de hukamAM dI pAlaNA karegA, bezakka usa ne hI asalI kAmayAbI prApata kara laI hai|

asIM isa amAnata (kuraAnI Adeza) nUM cukkaNa laI akAzAM te dharatI nUM kihA para uha isa nUM cukaNNa laI tiAra nA hoe sagoM Dara gae para manukkha ne cukka liA| bezakka uha bahuta hI z2Alama te be-samajha hai|

asIM iha amAnata[8] (manukkhAM toM isa laI cukavAI) ki allAha munAfika maradAM te auratAM nUM ate muzarika maradAM te auratAM nUM saz2A deve ate momina maradAM te momina auratAM utte rahima kare| allAha atiaMta baqhazaNahAra te miharAM karana vAlA hai|
translations.footnotes: [8] ithe amAnata toM bhAva uha adhikAra te chUTa hai jisa nUM allAha ne manukkha nUM usa dI baMdagI karana de saMbaMdha vica ditte sI| kiuMjo manukkha de subhAo vica tez2I hai so usa ne binAM soce samajhe isa z2iMmevArI nUM cukkaNa laI hAmI bhara laI jada ki dharatI, akAza ate pahAr3a varage zakatIzAlI cIz2AM ne rabba dI isa pezakaza nUM kabUla karana toM inakAra kara dittA|

translations.translation: sArIAM hI tArIfAM (te zukarAne) usa allAha laI jisa dA uha sabha kujjha hai jihar3A akAzAM te dharatI vica hai| paraloka vica vI use dI hI tArIfa hovegI| uha hikamatAM (sUjha-bUjha) nAla hara galla dI qhabara rakkhadA hai|

jo kujjha vI dharatI vica jAMdA hai ate jo usa viccoM nikkaladA hai, jo vI akAza toM utaradA hai ate jo usa vica car3hadA hai, uha (allAha) sabha jANadA hai| uha vaDDA miharabAna te baqhazaNahAra hai|

kAfira kahiMde hana ki sADe ’te kiAmata nahIM AvegI| (he nabI!) tusIM Akha dio ki mainUM g2aiba (parokha) de jANanahAra mere rabba dI suMha! uha (kiAmata) tuhADe ’te z2arUra hI A ke rahegI| akAzAM te dharatI vica ratA barAbara vI koI cIz2a usa toM lukI hoI nahIM rahi sakadI| nA kiNake toM vaDDI te nA usa toM nikkI, koI cIz2a ajihI nahIM jihar3I khullhI kitAba (lauhe-mahafUz2a) vica daraja nA hove|

(kiAmata isa laI hovegI) tAM jo uha (allAha) uhanAM lokAM nUM vadhIA badalA deve jihar3e ImAna liAe ate uhanAM ne neka kaMma vI kIte| iho uha (kAmayAba) loka hana jinhAM laI baqhaziza ate Adara-mAna vAlI roz2I hai|
para jinhAM lokAM ne sADIAM AitAM (hukamAM) dI heThI karana dI koziza kItI, uhanAM lokAM laI bahuta hI bhair3A dukhadAI az2Aba hai|

jinhAM lokAM nUM (rabbI) giAna baqhaziA giA, uha jANade hana ki jo vI Apa jI (sa:) valla Apa de rabba valloM (.kuraAna) nAz2ila hoiA hai, uhIo hakka hai ate allAha guNavAdI lokAM dI agavAI karadA hai|

ate kAfirAM ne (ika dUje nUM) kihA, kI asIM tuhAnUM ika ajihe viakatI bAre dassIe jihar3A tuhAnUM iha sUcanA de rihA hai ki jadoM tusIM kiNakA-kiNakA kara ditte jAoge, phera tusIM naveM siiraoM paidA kIte jAoge?

kI usa (muhaMmada) ne allAha ’te jhUTha lAiA hai? jAM uha (muhaMmada sa:) sudAI ho giA hai? (ukkA nahIM!) sagoM jihar3e loka Aqhirata (paraloka) utte ImAna nahIM rakkhade uha az2Aba ate gumarAhI vica dUra takka cale gae hana|

kI uhanAM ne ApaNe aggioM te picchioM akAza te dharatI nUM nahIM vekhiA? je asIM cAhIe tAM uhanAM nUM dharatI vica dhusA daIe jAM uhanAM ’te akAza de kujjha ToTe Dega daIe| bezakka isa vica hara usa viakatI laI ika nizAnI hai jihar3A rabba valla jhukaNa vAlA hai|

bezakka asIM hI dAUda nUM ApaNe valloM vaDiAI baqhazI sI| (asAM hukama dittA ki) he pahAr3o! usa (dAUda) de saMga (merI) tasabIha kariA karo ate iho hukama paMchIAM nUM vI sI ate asIM usa laI lohe nUM narama kara dittA|

(hidAita dittI) ki isa lohe toM khullhe Dulle z2arrA-bakatara (saMjoAM te hathiAra) baNAo te isa de jor3AM vica ThIka aMtara rakkho| tusIM sAre neka kaMmAM laI hI (isa dI varatoM) kariA karo| maiM tuhADe sAre hI kaMmAM nUM vekha rihA hai|

asIM sulemAna de adhIna havA nUM kara dittA| savere vele usa dA callaNA ika mahIne dI rAha taka ate saMjha vele usa dA callaNA ika mahIne dI rAha taka sI| asIM usa (sulaimAna) laI pighale hoe tAMbe dA cazamA vaghA dittA ate usa de adhIna kujjha ajihe jiMna kara chaDDe sI jihar3e usa de agge usa de rabba de hukama nAla kaMma karade sana ate uhanAM (jiMnAM) viccoM jisa ne vI sADe hukama dI ulaMghaNA kItI asIM usa nUM dahakadI hoI agga dA suAda cakhAuMde hAM|

sulemAna jo cAhuMdA sI usa laI jiMna uhIo baNA diMde, jiveM zAnadAra bhavana, tasavIrAM, vaDDe-vaDDe hauz2AM varage parAMta ate ApaNI thAM toM nA hillaNa vAlIAM cUlhiAM utte paIAM degAM| he dAUda dI saMtAna! (ihanAM ahisAnAM laI) dhaMnavAda vajoM neka kaMma karo| mere baMdiAM vica dhaMnavAda karana vAle bahuta hI thor3he hana|

phera jadoM asIM uhanAM (sulaimAna) laI mauta dA hukama lAgU kara dittA tAM isa dI sUcanA jiMnAM nUM deNa vAlA kevala uha siUMka vAlA kIr3A sI, jihar3A uhanAM (sulaimAna) dI lAThI nUM khA rihA sI| jadoM uha (sulaimAna) Diga pae, usa vele jiMnAM ne jANiA ki jekara uha (jiMna) parokha de jANakAra huMde tAM uha hINatA bhare kazaTa vica phase nA rahiMde|

sabA (kauma) laI usa dI ApaNI basatI vica ika vaDDI (rabba dI) nizAnI maujUda sI| isa (basatI) de sajje te khabbe pAse do bAg2a sana| asIM uhanAM (basatI vAliAM) nUM hukama dittA ki tusIM ApaNe rabba dI baqhazI hoI roz2I khAo ate usa dA dhaMnavAda karo| iha pavittara basatI hai ate tuhADA rabba vaDDA baqhazaNahAra hai|

para jadoM uhanAM (basatIAM vAliAM) ne (zukara adA karana toM) mUMha mor3a liA tAM asIM uhanAM ’te baMnha-tor3a har3ha bheja dittA ate uhanAM de (hare bhare) bAg2AM de ditte badale asIM uhanAM nUM do ajihe bAg2a de ditte jinhAM de phala be-suAde kaur3e-kusaile, jhAU vAle te kujjha berIAM vAle rukkha sana|
iha saz2A asIM uhanAM nUM uhanAM dI nA-zukarI dI dittA sI| asIM nA-zukariAM nUM hI saz2A diMde hAM|

asIM uhanAM (sabA vAliAM) de ate uhanAM (sulemAna dI basatI) de vicakAra jinhA basatIAM vica asIM barakatAM vI rakkhIAM sana, kujjha basatIAM nAlo-nAla rasate vica AbAda kara rakkhIAM sana ate uhanAM basatIAM vica callaNa vAliAM laI asIM maMz2ilAM (par3A) niyata kara dittIAM sana| (asIM kihA) tusIM ihanAM vica dina-rAta nizaciMta hoke safara karo|

para uhanAM (sabA dI basatI vAliAM) ne benatI kItI ki he sADe rabbA! sADI yAtarA vica dUrIAM (bhAva deza dIAM sarahadAM) vadhA de| (iha kahi ke) uhanAM ne ApaNe Apa ’te hI z2ulama kItA sI, so asIM uhanAM nUM kisse-kahANIAM baNA chaDDiA ate uhanAM nUM (purANe kissiAM vAMga) tittara-bittara kara dittA (bhAva az2Aba de chaDDiA)| bezakka hareka sabara te zukara karana vAle viakatI laI isa (kisse) vica mahattavapUrana sikkhiAvAM hana|
ate ibalIsa (zaitAna) ne uhanAM de mAmale vica ApaNI soca nUM sacca siddha kara vikhAiA, mominAM de ika dhar3e toM chuTTa, sAre de sAre loka usa de adhIna ho gae|

isa (zaitAna) dA uhanAM (mominAM) ’te koI z2ora nahIM sI, para (iha sabha) isa laI kItA sI ki asIM iha jANa laIe ki kauNa paraloka ’te ImAna rakkhadA hai ate uhanAM lokAM viccoM kauNa isa vica zakka karadA hai| tuhADA rabba hareka cIz2a dI dekhabhAla karadA hai|

(he nabI!) Akha dio ki uhanAM nUM saddo jinhAM nUM tusIM allAha toM chuTTa ApaNA izaTa samajhade ho| uha akAzAM te dharatI vica ratA barAbara vI adhikAra nahIM rakkhade ate nA hI mAlakI vica koI hissedArI hai ate nA hI ihanAM viccoM koI (sazriTI de baNAuNa vica) allAha dA sahAI hai|

usa de haz2Ura kevala usa viakatI dI hI sifAraza lAhevaMda ho sakadI hai jisa nUM allAha AgiA devegA| jadoM uhanAM de dilAM dI ghabarAhaTa dUra kara dittI jAMdI hai tAM phera pucchade hana ki tuhADe rabba ne kI kihA hai? uha uttara vica Akhade hana ki hakka (sacca) kihA hai| uha (allAha) atiaMta mahAna te saravaucca hai|
uhanAM toM puccho ki tuhAnUM akAzAM te dharatI viccoM roz2I kauNa diMdA hai? Akho ‘allAha’| ate iha vI puccho ki kauNa siddhI rAha ’te hai, asIM jAM tusIM? jAM kauNa sapazaTa kurAhe piA hoiA hai?
Akha dio ki sADe kIte hoe aparAdhAM bAre tuhAthoM pucchiA nahIM jAvegA ate nA hI tuhADe kaMmAM bAre sAthoM kujjha pucchiA jAvegA|
uhanAM nUM dassa dio ki sAnUM sabha nUM sADA rabba ikaTThA karegA phera uha sADe vicAle hakka (inasAfa) nAla faisalA kara devegA| uhIo vadhIA faisalA karana vAlA te dAnAI vAlA hai|

Akho ki caMgA mainUM vI tAM uhanAM izaTAM nUM vikhAo jinhAM nUM tusIM allAha dA sAMjhI baNA ke usa (allAha) de nAla ralA malA ditA hai, jada ki usa dA sAMjhI koI vI nahIM ho sakadA, sagoM uhIo allAha z2orAvara te hikamata vAlA hai|
(he muhaMmada) asAM tuhAnUM sAre hI lokAM laI (savaraga dIAM) qhuzaqhabarIAM suNAuNa vAlA ate (naraka toM) DarAuNa vAlA baNA ke bhejiA hai para lokAM dI bahugiNatI agiAnIAM dI hai|[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] vekho sUrata ala-bakaraha, hAzIA Aita 252/2

translations.translation: (he nabI!) uha lokI tuhAthoM pucchade hana ki (kiAmata dA) vAadA kadoM pUrA hovegA? (je tusIM sacce ho tAM dasso?)
(he nabI!) uhanAM nUM kaho ki tuhADe laI ika ajihe vAadA dA dina niyata hai jisa toM tusIM ika ghar3hI vI nA pichAMha rahi sakade ho ate nA hI agAMha vadha sakade ho|

ate kAfira Akhade hana ki asIM isa.kuraAna ’te ImAna nahIM liAvAMge ate nA hI isa toM pahilIAM kitAbAM ’te (ImAna hai)| (he nabI!) kAza! je tusIM uhanAM z2AlamAM nUM usa sameM vekho jadoM uha ApaNe rabba de haz2Ura khalote ika dUje ’te Aropa lA rahe hoNage| jihar3e lokI saMsAra vica kamaz2ora samajhe jAMde sI uha vaDiAI mArana vAliAM nUM AkhaNage ki je tusIM nA huMde tAM asIM vI ImAna vAle huMde|
uha ghamaMDI loka (samAja de) kamaz2ora lokAM nUM AkhaNage, kI asIM tuhAnUM usa hidAita (.kuraAna) toM rokiA sI jihar3I tuhADe kola A cukkI sI? nahIM! tusIM tAM Ape hI aparAdhI sI?

(javAba vica) uha kamaz2ora loka uhanAM ghamaMDIAM nUM AkhaNage ki nahIM, sagoM tuhADIAM dina-rAta dIAM cAlAM ne hI sAnUM (ImAna liAuNa toM) roka rakkhiA sI| tusIM sAnUM allAha nAla kufara karana laI ate usa de nAla sAMjhI baNAuNa laI hukama diMde sI| jadoM uha (kamaz2ora loka) az2Aba vekhaNage tAM uha pachatAve nUM ApaNe dilAM vica gupata rakkhaNa dI koziza karanage ate (jinhAM ne ghamaMDa vica Ake) inakAra kItA sI asIM uhanAM de galiAM vica tauka (paTe) pA diAMge, uhanAM nUM uhanAM de kIte karamAM dA badalA dittA jAvegA|
ate asIM jisa basatI vica koI sAvadhAna karana vAlA (nabI) bhejiA, utthe de khAMde pIMde lokAM ne iho kihA ki jisa cIz2a nUM tusIM laike Ae ho asIM usa dA inakAra karade hAM|
ate uhanAM (ghamaMDIAM) ne iha vI kihA ki asIM tuhAthoM vadhere dhaMna daulata te saMtAna de mAlika hAM ate nA hI sAnUM az2Aba dittA jAvegA|
he nabI (sa:)! Akha dio ki merA mAlika jisa laI cAhuMdA hai usa laI riz2aka vica vAdhA kara diMdA hai ate kise de riz2aka nUM ghaTA vI diMdA hai, para bahute loka isa nUM nahIM samajhade|

tuhADe mAla te aulAda ajihe nahIM jihar3e tuhAnUM sADe ner3e kara deNa| hAM! ner3e uha hana jihar3e ImAna lai AuNa te neka kaMma karana, uhanAM laI uhanAM de karamAM dA dUNA badalA hai ate uha nizaciMta hoke uccIAM-uccIAM thAvAM ’te rahiNage|
ate jihar3e loka sAnUM be-basa karana laI sADIAM AitAM (hukamAM) nUM jhuThalAuNa vica lagge rahiMde hana uhI loka az2Aba laI hAz2ara kIte jANage|

(he nabI!) Akha dio ki merA pAlaNahAra ApaNe baMdiAM viccoM jisa laI cAhe riz2aka vica vAdhA kara diMdA hai ate jisa laI cAhave riz2aka taMga kara diMdA hai| tusIM jo vI allAha dI rAha vica qharaca karoge allAha usa dA badalA devegA ate uhIo tAM hai jihar3A sabha toM vadhIA roz2I deNa vAlA hai|
ate jisa (kiAmata vAle) dina uha sAriAM nUM ikaTThA karegA ate farizatiAM nUM pucchegA, kI iha lokI tuhADI baMdagI karade sana?

uha (farizate) AkhaNage ki terI z2Ata (hara aiba toM) pAka hai, chuTTa tere toM sADA koI kaMma savArana vAlA nahIM, jada ki iha (kAfira) tAM jiMnAM dI baMdagI karade sI, uhanAM viccoM bahutiAM dA tAM uhanAM ’te hI ImAna sI|
so ajja (kiAmata dihAr3e) tuhADe ’coM nA koI kise nUM lAbha pahuMcA sakadA hai ate nA hI hAnI ate asIM z2AlamAM nUM kahAMge ki isa agga dA suAda lavo jisa nUM tusIM jhuThalAuMde sI|[2]
translations.footnotes: [2] vekho sUrata ala-kahafa, hAzIA Aita 102/18

translations.translation: jadoM uhanAM (kAfirAM) nUM sADIAM sapazaTa AitAM (.kuraAna dIAM) suNAIAM jAMdIAM hana tAM uha Akhade hana ki iha (muhaMmada sa:) tAM uha viakatI hai jihar3A tuhAnUM tuhADe bApa dAdA (baz2uragAM) de izaTAM dI ibAdata toM rokadA hai ate uha iha vI Akhade hana ki iha (.kuraAna) tAM ghar3hiA ghar3hAiA jhUTha hai| jada ki hakka uhanAM kAfirAM kola A cukkiA hai, phera vI kAfira iho Akhade rahe ki uha tAM sapazaTa rUpa vica ika jAdU hai|
asIM uhanAM (makke de kAfirAM) nUM koI kitAba nahIM dittI ki uha usa nUM par3hade ate nA hI uhanAM de kola (he muhaMmada) tuhAthoM pahilAM koI qhabaradAra karana vAlA hI ghalliA sI|

ihanAM (makke vAliAM) toM pahilAM de lokAM ne vI hakka nUM jhuThalAiA sI jada ki iha uhanAM de dasaveM hisse nUM vI nahIM pahuMcade jihar3A asIM uhanAM nUM (jIvana samaggarI) dittA sI| phera vI uhanAM ne mere rasUlAM nUM jhuThalAiA, phera vekho uhanAM ’te mere az2Aba kiho jihA hoiA sI?

(he nabI!) Akha dio ki maiM tAM tuhAnUM ika hI galla dI nasIhata karadA hAM ki tusIM allAha vAsate, ikalle-ikalle jAM do-do mila ke (ika pAse) khar3he ho jAo te ratA soca-vicAra tAM karo (ki hakIkata kI hai) tuhADe isa sAthI (muhaMmada sa:) vica koI vI dIvAnagI vAlI galla nahIM, uha tAM tuhAnUM ika vaDDe az2Aba (kiAmata dihAr3e de) AuNa toM pahilAM DarAuNa vAlA hai|
(he nabI!) Akha dio ki je maiM tuhAthoM koI badalA (ihanAM citAvanIAM deNa dA) maMgAM tAM uha tuhAnUM hI mubAraka, merA badalA tAM allAha de hI z2iMme hai ate uha hara galla dI qhabara rakkhadA hai|
Akho ki bezaka merA rabba hI mere utte hakka utAradA hai ate hara prakAra de gupata giAna dA jANanahAra hai|
(he nabI!) Akha dio ki hakka (isalAma) A giA, bAtila (kUr3a, kufara) nA tAM pahilAM kade chAiA hai ate nA hI huNa chAvegA|

(iha vI) Akha dio ki je maiM kurAhe pai jAvAM tAM mere isa kurAhe paiNa dA doza merA hI hai, je maiM siddhI rAha ’te hAM tAM isa dA kArana uha vahI (paig2Ama) hai jisa nUM merA pAlaNahAra mere valla ghalladA hai, bezakka uha (allAha) suNana vAlA hai ate (baMde de) bahuta hI ner3e hai|
(he nabI!) kAza je tusIM (usa sameM) ihanAM kAfirAM nUM vekho jadoM uha ghabarAe hoe hoNage ate (utthioM) uha baca nA sakaNage ate uha ner3e toM hI phar3e jANage|
usa sameM iha (kAfira) AkhaNage ki huNa asIM ImAna liAe hAM, para iMnI dUra toM ImAna dI prApatI kiveM saMbhava hai?
jada ki isa (kiAmata) toM pahilAM (saMsAra vica) uha isa de inakArI sana ate dUra toM hI binAM vekhe hI (qhiAlI tIra) suTTade rahe|

(kiAmata dihAr3e) uhanAM de ate uhanAM dIAM icchAvAM vicAle oTa kara dittI jAvegI| jiveM ki inhAM toM pahilAM uhanAM varagiAM nAla kItA giA sI| bezakka uha duvidhA vica pAuNa vAlI azaMkA vica phase hoe sana|

sArIAM tArIfAM usa allAha laI hana jihar3A ki akAzAM te dharatI dA paidA karana vAlA hai ate do-do tiMna tiMna cAra cAra parAM vAle farizatiAM rAhIM ApaNe sunehe pahuMcAuNa vAlA hai| uha ApaNI racanA vica jiveM cAhave vAdhA karadA hai| allAha hara cIz2a dI samarathA rakkhadA hai|

allAha lokAM laI ApaNIAM rahimatAM de jihar3e bUhe khola diMdA hai usa nUM koI baMda nahIM kara sakadA ate jisa nUM uha baMda kara diMdA hai usa nUM koI khola nahIM sakadA ate uhIo zakatIzAlI te hikamata vAlA (sUjha-bUjha dAnAI vAlA) hai|

he loko! allAha valloM jo tuhADe utte upakAra kIte gae hana uhanAM nUM yAda rakkho| kI allAha toM chuTTa koI hora racanAhAra hai jihar3A tuhAnUM akAza te dharatI toM riz2aka diMdA hove? chuTTa usa (allAha) toM koI vI hora (saccA) izaTa nahIM, tusIM kidharoM dhokhA khA rahe ho?

(he nabI!) je iha (kAfira) tuhAnUM jhuThalA rahe hana (tAM koI navIM galla nahIM) tuhAthoM pahilAM vI bahuta sAre paig2aMbara jhuThalAe jA cukke hana, aMta uha sAre mAmale (nipaTAre laI) allAha kola hI jANage|
he loko! bezakka allAha dA vAadA saccA hai, so iha saMsArika jIvana tuhAnUM dhokhe vica nA pAIM rakkhe ate nA hI uha vaDDA dhokhebAz2a (zaitAna) tuhAnUM (allAha bAre kise) dhokhe vica pA deve|
bezakka zaitAna tuhADA vairI hai, so tusIM vI usa nUM ApaNA vairI samajho| uha (zaitAna) tAM apaNe pairokArAM nUM ApaNe rasate valla isa laI bulAuMdA hai tAM jo uha naraka vAle baNa jANa|
jihar3e loka kAfira (ika rabba de inakArI) ho gae uhanAM laI karar3I saz2A hai ate jihar3e lokI ImAna liAe ate uhanAM ne neka kaMma vI kIte uhanAM laI baqhaziza te bahuta vaDDA badalA hai|

kI uha viakatI (hidAita vAlA ho sakadA hai) jisa laI usa de bhair3e karamAM nUM sohaNA baNA dittA giA hove ate uha uhanAM nUM caMgA samajhadA hove| bezakka allAha jisa nUM cAhuMdA hai gumarAha kara diMdA hai te jisa nUM cAhuMdA hai siddhe rAha pAuMdA hai| so (he nabI!) tusIM uhanAM dI ciMtA vica kite ApaNI jiMda nUM hI nA guAca beTho| uha jo vI kara rahe hana allAha bhalI-bhAMta jANU hai|

ate allAha hI uhanAM havAvAM nUM bhejadA hai jihar3IAM baddalAM nUM cukkadIAM hana, phera asIM uhanAM baddalAM nUM muradA (baMjara) dharatI valla bhejade hAM ate ihanAM (baddalAM) rAhIM use dharatI nUM usa dI mauta (ujAr3a) toM magaroM jiUMdA (upajAU) kara diMde hAM| ise prakAra (tusIM sabha ne vI kiAmata dihAr3e) mur3a jiUMdA hoNA hai|

jo viakatI mAna-sanamAna cAhuMdA hai (tAM usa nUM patA hoNA cAhIdA hai ki) Adara satikAra tAM sArA dA sArA allAha laI hI hai, sAre pavittara zabada use valla car3hade hana ate neka karama uhanAM (zabadAM) utAMha cukka lai jAMde hana| jihar3e loka bhair3IAM cAlAM calade hana uhanAM laI karar3A az2Aba hai ate uhanAM dIAM sArIAM cAlAM Ape nazaTa ho jANagIAM|

(loko) allAha ne hI tuhAnUM miTTI toM paidA kItA phera vIraja toM (paidA kItA) phera tuhADe jor3e (patI patanI) baNAe ate jihar3I vI isatarI garabhavatI huMdI hai te baccA jaNadI hai, allAha nUM usa dA giAna huMdA hai ate je kise dI AyU vica vAdhA kItA jAMdA hai jAM kise dI AyU ghaTAI jAMdI hai tAM iha sArIAM gallAM ika kitAba (lauhe-mahafUz2a) vica likhIAM hoIAM hana| bezakka allAha laI iha sabha karanA bahuta hI saukhA hai|

ate do dariAvAM vica ika dA pANI miTThA hai, pINa vica suAdI hai ate dUjA khArA hai ate kaur3A hai| (he loko!) tusIM uhanAM dohAM dariAvAM viccoM tAz2A mAsa (macchIAM Adi) khAMde ho ate gahaNIAM dI samaggarI (mautI hIre) kaDDhade ho, jinhAM nUM tusIM pahiNade ho| tusIM (dariAvAM vica) pANI nUM cIradIAM hoIAM vaDDIAM-vaDDIAM ber3IAM turadIAM vekhade ho tAM jo tusIM allAha dI kripAlatA (roz2I) uhanAM (dariAvAM) viccoM labbho ate tusIM usa de dhaMnavAdI hovo|

uha (allAha) rAta nUM dina vica ate dina nUM rAta vica dAqhila karadA hai ate sUraja te caMna nUM use ne kaMma lA rakkhiA hai| hareka ApaNe niyata sameM tIka laI calla rihA hai| uhIo allAha tuhADA sabha dA pAlaNahAra hai, pAtazAhI use dI hai| jinhAM nUM tusIM usa allAha nUM chaDDa ke benatIAM karade ho uha tAM khajUra de chilake jinnA vI adhikAra nahIM rakhade|

je tusIM uhanAM (jhUThe izaTAM)nUM saddo tAM uha tuhADIAM benatIAM nahIM suNade, je bhalA suNa vI laiNa tAM uha (tuhADI benatIAM dA) javAba nahIM de sakade, sagoM kiAmata vele uha tuhADe isa ziraka dA inakAra kara deNage|[1] allAha varage jANakAra toM chuTTa tuhAnUM koI vI (uhanAM muzarikAM de hAla dI sUcanA) nahIM devegA|
translations.footnotes: [1] vekho sUrata ala-bakaraha, hAzIA Aita 165/2

translations.translation: he loko! tusIM hI allAha de muthAja ho jada ki allAha tAM hara cIz2a toM beparavAha hai te sabha sifatAM use laI hana|
je uha cAhe tAM tuhAnUM qhatama karake (tuhADI thAM) ika navI maqhalUka paidA kara deve|
ate iMja karanA allAha laI koI aukhA kaMma nahIM|

yAda rakho ki (kiAmata dihAr3e) koI vI viakatI kise dUje de (gunAhAM dA) bhAra nahIM cukkegA ate je koI (ApaNe gunAhAM de) bhAra toM laddiA hoiA viakatI ApaNA bhAra vaMDAuNa laI kise nUM saddegA tAM usa de bhAra viccoM kujjha vI cukka nahIM sakegA, bhAveM uha koI sakA-saMbaMdhI hI kiuM nA hove| (he nabI!) tusIM kevala uhanAM nUM hI sAvadhAna kara sakade ho jihar3e lokI ApaNe rabba toM binAM vekhe hI Darade hana ate namAz2AM dI pAbaMdI karade hana| jihar3A vI koI (gunAhAM toM) pAka bhAva baca ke rahiMdA hai uha ApaNe laI hI pavittaratA dhArana karadA hai, kiuM jo parataNA tAM sAriAM ne allAha valla hI hai|
aMnhA te sujAkhA ikko jihe nahIM huMde|
nA hI hanere te cAnaNa ika samAna hana|
te nA hI dhuppa te chAM ika barAbara hai|

nA hI jiUMde te murade ika samAna ho sakade hana| bezakka allAha jisa nUM cAhuMdA hai (use nUM caMgIAM gallAM) suNavAuMdA hai ate (he nabI!) tusIM uhanAM lokAM nUM nahIM suNA sakade jihar3e kabarAM vica hana|
(he muhaMmada sa:!) tusIM tAM kevala (naraka toM) sAvadhAna karana vAle ho|
bezakka asIM hI tuhAnUM hakka (kuraAna) nAla qhuzaqhabarIAM suNAuNa vAlA te DarAuNa vAlA baNA ke bhejiA hai te koI vI ajihI ummata nahIM hoI jisa vica koI DarAuMNa vAlA nA AiA hove|

(he muhaMmada!) je iha (makke de) loka tuhAnUM jhuThalAuMde hana tAM uhanAM lokAM ne vI tAM (paig2aMbarAM nUM) jhuThalAiA sI jihar3e ihanAM nUM pahilAM bIta cukke hana, jada ki uhanAM de kola uhanAM de rasUla khullhIAM nizAnIAM te cAnhaNa vikhAuNa vAlIAM kitAbAM lai ke Ae sana|
phera asIM uhanAM sAre kAfirAM nUM (az2Aba vica) phar3a liA, phera vekho merA az2Aba kiho jihA sI|

kI tusIM (he loko!) vekhade nahIM ki bezakka allAha ne akAza toM pANI barasAiA, phera asIM use rAhIM bhAMta-bhAMta raMgAM de phala ugAe ate pahAr3AM vica vI lAla te ciTTIAM ghATIAM hana| uhanAM de vakkho-vakkha raMga hana ate kAle siAha vI hana|

ise prakAra manukkhAM, jAnavarAM te pazUAM de raMga vI vakkho-vakkha huMde hana| so allAha toM usa de baMdiAM viccoM uhIo Darade hana, jihar3e giAna rakkhade hana| bezakka allAha z2orAvara te baqhazaNahAra hai|

jihar3e lokI allAha dI kitAba (.kuraAna) dA pATha karade hana ate namAz2AM dI pAbaMdI karade hana ate jo vI asIM uhanAM nUM (mAla) dittA hai usa viccoM gupata rUpa vica jAM (lor3a paiNa ’te) ailAnIA qharaca karade hana, uha loka ajihe vaNaja-vapAra de AsavaMda hana, jisa vica koI ghATA vI nahIM|

(uha iha vapAra isa laI karade hana) tAM jo allAha uhanAM nUM unhAM dI mihanata dA pUrA-pUrA badalA deve ate ApaNI kripA nAla uhanAM nUM hora vI vadherA baqhaze| bezakka uha (allAha) vaDDA baqhazaNahAra te (parahez2agArAM dA) kadaradAna hai|

(he nabI!) asAM jihar3I kitAba (.kuraAna) tuhADe valla vahI rAhIM bhejI hai, uha bilakula sacca hai| jada ki iha ApaNe toM pahilAM dIAM kitAbAM dI vI puzaTI karana vAlI hai| bezakka allAha ApaNe baMdiAM dI pUrI qhabara rakkhadA hai ate hareka cIz2a ’te naz2ara rakkhaNa vAlA hai|

asIM uhanAM lokAM nUM kitAba dA vArasa baNAiA, jinhAM nUM asIM ApaNe baMdiAM viccoM (ucita samajhiA) cuNa liA, phera uhanAM lokAM viccoM kujjha tAM ApaNe Apa ’te hI z2ulama karana lagga pae (bhAva allAha de hukamAM dI ulaMghanA karana laga pae) ate kujjha uhanAM viccoM vicakAralI rAha (kujjha hukamAM dI AgiAkArI te kujjha hukamAM dI ulaMghaNA dI nItI) apaNAI ate kujjha uhanAM viccoM allAha dI kripA nAla nekIAM vica vadhade gae, iho sabha toM vaDDI kripAlatA hai|
jinhAM bAg2AM vica uha praveza karanage uha sadIvIM hana utthe uhanAM nUM sone de kaMgaNAM te motIAM nAla ziMgAriA jAvegA ate utthe uhanAM de vasatara rezama de hoNage|
ate uha AkhaNage ki allAha dA (lakkha-lakkha) zukara hai jisa ne sAthoM (naraka dI) ciMtA dUra kItI| bezakka sADA pAlaNahAra bahuta hI vaDDA baqhazaNahAra hai ate (nekIAM dI) kadara karanA vAlA hai|
ate AkhaNage ki (dhaMnavAda usa dA) jisa ne ApaNI miharabarAnIAM nAla sAnUM sadIvI nivAsa sathAna dittA jitthe sAnUM nA tAM koI kazzaTa hai ate nA hI koI thakevAM|

jinhAM ne (paig2aMbarAM dIAM gallAM dA) inakAra kItA sI uhanAM laI naraka dI agga hovegI phera nA uhanAM nUM mauta AvegI ki mara hI jANa ate nA hI naraka de az2Aba vica koI kaTotI kItI jAvegI| asIM kAfirAM nUM isa prakAra hI saz2A diMde hAM|

ate uha (kAfira) usa (naraka) viccoM cIkAM mAra-mAra ke AkhaNage ki he sADe rabbA! sAnUM itthoM kaDDha lai, (huNa) asIM caMge kaMma karAMge nA ki uha jihar3e kaMma asIM pahilAM kariA karade sI| (allAha pucchegA) kI asIM tuhAnUM iMnI umara nahIM dittI sI ki jisa vica je koI kujjha sikkhiA prApata karanA cAhuMdA tAM uha kara sakadA sI? ate tuhADe kola ika citAvanI deNa vAlA (paig2aMbara) vI AiA sI| huNa tusIM (agga dA) suAda lavo| z2AlamAM dA itthe koI vI sahAika nahIM|
bezakka akAzAM te dharatI dIAM gupata gallAM nUM allAha hI jANadA hai ate dilAM vica chuppe hoe bhetAM nUM vI uhIo jANadA hai|

uhI (allAha) hai jisa ne tuhAnUM dharatI dA vArisa baNAiA, so jo koI kufara (nA-zukarI) karegA usa de kufara dA doza use ’te hI hovegA ate kAfirAM (inakArIAM) laI uhanAM dA kufara (inakAra) uhanAM de rabba de (gusse) nUM vadhAuNa dA kArana baNadA hai ate kAfirAM laI uhanAM dA kufara uhanAM de nukasAna vica vAdhA karadA hai|[2]
translations.footnotes: [2] vekho sUrata Ale-imarAna, hAzIA Aita 85/3

translations.translation: (he nabI! muzarikAM nUM) Akho, caMgA tusIM ApaNe jihar3e izaTa deva nUM, allAha nUM chaDDa ke (madada laI), pukArade ho ratA mainUM vI vikhAo ki uhanAM ne dharatI ’te kihar3I racanA racAI hai jAM akAza vica uhanAM dI kihar3I sAMjha hai? jAM asIM ihanAM (muzarikAM) nUM koI likhata de chaDDI hai jisa de AdhAra ’te uha khar3he hana? nahIM kujjha vI tAM nahIM, sagoM iha z2Alama ika dUje nUM kevala lAre ate dhokhe daIM jA rahe hana| [3]
translations.footnotes: [3] haz2arata abU-hurairA dasadde hana ki allAha de rasUla ne faramAiA ki kiAmata de dina allAha z2amIna nUUM ApaNI muTThI vica lai lavegA ate AsamAnAM nUM muTThI vAMga ApaNe sajje hattha vica valeTa lavegA phera faramAegA ki maiM bAdazAha hAM dharatI de bAdazAha kitthe hana| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 4812)

translations.translation: hakIkata iha hai ki allAha ne hI akAzAM te dharatI nUM phar3hiA hoiA hai ki uha doveM ApaNI thAM toM siraka nA jANa| je uha siraka jANa phera uhanAM nUM hora koI thamhaNa vAlA vI nahIM| bezakka uha vaDDA sahiNazIla te baqhazaNahAra hai|

ate uhanAM (makke de) kAfirAM ne allAha dIAM pakkIAM suMhAM khA ke kihA sI ki je uhanAM kola koI DarAuNa vAlA (paig2aMbara) AvegA tAM uha horAM kaumAM toM kite vaddha ke hidAhitAM kabUla karana vAle hoNage, praMtU jadoM uhanAM kola DarAuNa vAlA (paig2aMbara) A giA tAM usa de AuNa nAla uhanAM vica hakka pratI nafarata vica vAdhA hoNa lagga piA|

nafarata dA kArana iha sI ki uha ApaNe Apa nUM dharatI utte vaDDA samajhade sana ate (hakka de viruddha) bhair3IAM cAlAM vI calade sana| jadoM ki bhair3IAM cAlAM tAM ApaNe calAuNa vAle nUM hI A gheradIAM hana| huNa iha loka usa (az2Aba) dI uDIka kara rahe hana jihar3A pahilIAM kaumAM nAla allAha dI mariAdA rahI hai| so tusIM (he nabI!) kade vI allAha dI mariAdA nUM badaladA hoiA nahIM vekhoge ate nA hI tusIM allAha dI mariAdA nUM TaladA vekhoge|

kI uha (makke de) loka dharatI utte ture phire nahIM, jisa toM uhanAM nUM patA laggadA ki jihar3e lokI uhanAM toM pahilAM bIta cukke hana, uhanAM dA aMta kiho jihA hoiA sI jada ki uha uhanAM toM kite vaddha zakatIzAlI sI| allAha ajihA nahIM ki koI cIz2a usa nUM akAzAM vica te dharatI vica bevasa kara deve| uha sabha kujjha jANadA hai ate hareka prakAra dI samarathA rakkhadA hai|

ate je allAha lokAM nUM uhanAM dIAM karatUtAM kArana phar3aNa lagga jAMdA hai tAM isa (dharatI) dI piTTha utte turana-phirana vAlA koI vI prANI (usa de az2Aba toM) nA baca sakadA, para uha (allAha) ne uhanAM sabha nUM ika niyata sameM laI Dhilla dittI hoI hai, jadoM uhanAM dA samAM A jAvegA (uhanAM nUM saz2A devegA)| bezakka allAha ApaNe baMdiAM nU caMgI tarhAM vekha rihA hai|
yA, sIna|
kasama hai hikamata bhare.kuraAna dI|
nirasaMdeha, tusIM (he muhaMmada!) paig2aMbarAM viccoM hI ho|
ate siddhe rAha ’te ho|
iha (.kuraAna) z2orAvara te miharAM vAle (allAha) valloM utAriA giA hai|
tAM jo tusIM uhanAM lokAM nUM (kiAmata toM) DarAvo jinhAM de pio dAdiAM nUM DarAiA nahIM giA sI, ise kArana uha vI (nakara toM) beparavAha hana|
nirasaMdeha, uhanAM dI bahu giNatI allAha de faisale (bhAva az2Aba) dI bhAgI baNa cukkI hai, so iha ImAna nahIM liAuNage|
asAM uhanAM de galAM vica saMgala pA chaDDe hana, jihar3e uhanAM dIAM ThoDIAM tIka hana isa laI uha sira cukkIM khar3he hana|

ate asIM uhanAM de agge (nafarata dI) ika kaMdha khar3hI kara chaDDI hai ate ika kaMdha uhanAM de picche, jisa nAla asIM uhanAM dIAM akkhAM nUM Dhakka dittA hai, huNa uha (hakka sacca) vekha nahIM sakade|
(he nabI!) tusIM bhAveM uhanAM nUM DarAo jAM nA DarAo, uhanAM laI ika barAbara hai| uha ImAna nahIM liAuNage|

(he nabI!) tusIM tAM kevala use viakatI nUM hI DarA sakade ho jihar3A nasIhata (.kuraAna) dI pairavI kare te binAM vekhe rahimAna toM Dare, so tusIM usa viakatI nUM baqhaziza te mAna-sanamAna vAle badale (bhAva jaMnata) dIAM qhuzaqhabarIAM suNA dio|

nirasaMdeha, asIM hI muradiAM nUM (mur3a) jiUMdA karAMge ate jihar3e karama uha agge (paraloka laI) bheja cukke hana, uhanAM sabha nUM asIM likha rahe hAM ate jihar3e (caMge jAM mAr3e) ciMnha uha picche chaDDa Ae hana, uha vI daraja karade hAM| asIM uhanAM sabha nUM ika sapazaTa kitAba vica likha rakkhiA hai|
(he nabI!) tusIM ihanAM (inakArIAM) laI ika basatI dI udAharana dA ullekha karo, jadoM ki usa basatI vica paig2aMbara Ae sana|

jadoM asIM uhanAM (basatI vAliAM) kola do (paig2aMbarAM) nUM bhejiA, para uhanAM ne uhanAM dovAM nUM jhuThalAiA, phera asIM tIjA paig2aMbara uhanAM dovAM dI sahAitA laI bhejiA, so uhanAM (tiMnAM) ne kihA ki asIM tuhADe valla (rabba valloM) ghalle gae (rasUla) hAM|
uhanAM (basatI vAliAM) ne kihA ki tusIM tAM sADe hI varage ika manukkha ho ate rahimAna (rabba) ne tuhADe utte koI vI cIz2a (bhAva paig2aMbarI) nahIM utArI, tusIM tAM nirA hI jhUTha bolade ho|
uhanAM (paig2aMbarAM) ne kihA ki sADA pAlaNahAra jANadA hai ki bezakka asIM tuhADe valla hI bheje gae hAM|
sADe z2iMme tAM kevala sapazaTa rUpa vica (rabbI sunehA) pahuMcAuNA hai|

uha (basatI vAle) AkhaNa lagge ki asIM tAM tuhAnUM manahUsa (be-bhAga) samajhade hAM, je tusIM bAz2a nA Ae tAM asIM tuhAnUM patthara mAra-mAra ke mAra suTTAMge ate sADe valloM tuhAnUM karar3I saz2A milegI|

uhanAM (paig2aMbarAM) ne kihA ki tuhADI nahUsata tuhADe nAla hI jur3I hoI hai| kI tusIM isa nasIhata nUM nahUsata samajhade ho jihar3I tuhAnUM kItI jAMdI hai| (ukkA hI nahIM sagoM) tusIM haddoM TappaNa vAle loka ho|
inhAM kola ika viakatI, basatI de parale siirao, nassadA hoiA AiA ate AkhaNa laggA ki he merI kauma! tusIM ihanAM (paig2aMbarAM) dI pairavI karo|
tusIM ihanAM lokAM dI pairavI karo jihar3e tuhAthoM (nasIhatAM karana dA) koI badalA vI nahIM maMgade ate iha loka siddhe rAha ’te vI hana|
ate mainUM kI hoiA hai ki maiM usa z2Ata dI ibAdata nA karAM, jisa ne mainUM paidA kI? tA hai ate tusIM sAre (marana magaroM) use valla paratAe jAvoge|

kI maiM usa (allAha) nUM chaDDa dUjiAM nUM izaTa baNA lavAM? je rahimAna mainUM koI hAnI pacAuNA cAhave tAM nA uhanAM (izaTAM) dI sifAraza mere kujha kaMma AvegI ate nA hI uha mainUM (az2Aba toM) chuDavA sakade hana|
iMja tAM maiM sapazaTa rUpa vica gumarAhI vica phasa jAvAMgA|
(uhI viakatI ne kihA ki) maiM tAM tuhADe sabha de pAlaNahAra ’te ImAna lai AiA hAM (iha suNa ke kauma ne usa nUM mAra dittA)|
(rabba valloM usa viakatI nUM) kihA giA ki savaraga vica praveza kara jA| uha (viakatI AkhaNa laggiA ki) kAza merI kauma nUM vI giAna ho jAMdA|
ki mere mAlika ne mainUM baqhaza dittA hai ate usa ne mainUM patavaMte lokAM vica zAmila kara liA hai|
usa (viakatI de katala) magaroM asIM usa dI kauma ’te akAzoM koI fauja (saz2A deNa laI) nahIM utArI ate nA hI asIM isa prakAra bhejiA karade hAM|
uha tAM kevala ika (dila dahalAuNa vAlI) cIka sI (jisa nUM suNa ke) acaNaceta uha sAre lokI bujha ke rahi gae (bhAva mara gae)|
hAe afasosa baMdiAM de hAla ’te, jihar3A vI rasUla uhanAM kola AiA, uha usa dA makhaula hI uDAuMde rahe|
kI uhanAM ne nahIM vekhiA ki uhanAM toM pahilAM asIM kiMnIAM kaumAM nUM barabAda kara cukke hAM? bezakka uha uhanAM kola mur3a ke nahIM AuNagIAM|
ate sAre de sAre loka sADI haz2UrI vica hAz2ara kIte jANage|

(jihar3e lokI mur3a jIvana nUM nahIM maMneda) uhanAM laI muradA (bhAva baMjara) dharatI ika nizAnI hai, jisa nUM asIM jiUMdA (upajAU) kara dittA ate isa viccoM anAja kaDDhiA, phera isa viccoM iha khAMde hana|
ate asIM isa (dharatI) viccoM khajUra ate aMgUrAM de bAg2a paidA kIte ate isa (dharatI) viccoM nahirAM vI vagAIAM|
tAM jo (lokI) isa de phala khANa ate ihanAM phalAM nUM ihanAM (inakArIAM) de hatthAM ne nahIM baNAiA (iha sabha jANade hoe vI) uha loka dhaMnavAda kiuM nahIM karade|

pAka hai uha z2Ata jisa ne hara cIz2a de jor3e paidA kIte, uhanAM cIz2AM de vI jinhAM nUM dharatI ugAuMdI hai ata ihanAM (manukkhAM) de vI ate uhanAM de vI (jor3e baNAe) jinhAM nUM iha jANade vI nahIM|
ate ihanAM lokAM laI rAta vI ika nizAnI hai| asIM isa viccoM dina nUM kaDDhade hAM tAM uha (dina) hanere vica Dubba jAMdA hai|
ate sUraja ApaNe niyata TikANe pahuMcaNa laI caladA rahiMdA hai, iha (niyata cAlAM) dA hisAba vaDDe z2orAvara te jANanahAra valloM hai|
ate caMna dIAM (aThAI) maMz2ilAM (cAlAM) asIM niyata kara rakkhIAM hana, itthoM taka ki (mahIne de akhIra vica) uha mur3a khajUra dI ika purANI TeDhI TahiNI vAMga ho jAMdA hai|
nA hI sUraja de vassa vica hai ki uha caMna nUM phar3a lave ate nA hI rAta toM pahilAM dina A sakadA hai ate hareka (sUraja, caMna, tAre Adi) ApaNe niyata ghere vica teradA phiradA hai|
uhanAM (rabba de inakArIAM) laI ika nizAnI iha vI hai ki asIM uhanAM dI nasala nUM (nUha dI) bharI hoI kizatI vica savAra kItA|
ate asIM uhanAM laI ajihIAM kaI cIz2AM hora vI paidA kItIAM jinhAM ’te uha savAra huMde hana|
jekara asIM cAhIe tAM uhanAM nUM Doba daIe, phera nA tAM koI uhanAM dIAM aradAsAM suNana vAlA hovegA ate nA hI uhanAM nUM bacAiA jA sakegA|
praMtU (uhanAM dA bacAo) sADI miharAM ’te nirabhara hai ate ika qhAsa sameM taka (bhAva marana takka) uhanAM nUM jIvana dA lAbha de rahe hAM|

jadoM uhanAM nUM kihA jAMdA hai ki usa az2Aba toM Daro jihar3A tuhADe sAhamaNe (saMsAra vica) hai ate jihar3A tuhADe picche (paraloka vica) hai tAM jo tuhADe ’te rahima kItA jAve (tAM uha kaMnI katarAuMde hana)|
ate uhanAM de rabba dIAM nizAnIAM viccoM jihar3I vI nizAnI uhanAM kola AuMdI hai tAM usa toM mUMha phera laiMde hana|

jadoM uhanAM nUM kihA jAMdA hai ki jo allAha ne tuhAnUM dittA hai usa (mAla) viccoM qharaca karo, tAM uha kAfira ImAna vAliAM nUM kahiMde hana, kI asIM ihanAM nUM khavAIe? je allAha cAhuMdA tAM ihanAM nUM Apa hI khuA diMdA| tusIM tAM kurAhe pae hoe ho|
iha (kAfira) Akhade hana ki iha (kiAmata AuNa dA) vacana kadoM pUrA hovegA, (he nabI!) je tusIM sacce ho tAM dasso|
(he nabI!) uha tAM ika karar3I jihI cIka dI uDIka kara rahe hana ate uha uhanAM nUM (acaNaceta) A nappegI ate usa sameM uha Apasa vica jhagar3a rahe hoNage|
(usa sameM) nA tAM uha koI vasIata kara sakaNage ate nA hI ApaNe parivAra valla A sakaNage|
ate jadoM sUra (bigala) bajAiA jAvegA tAM ika dama uha sAre ApaNIAM kabarAM viccoM nikala ke ApaNe mAlika valla nassaNage|

AkhaNage ki hAe sADe mAr3e bhAga! sAnUM sADe nIMdara sathAna toM kisa ne jagA dittA? (uttara vica kihA jAvegA) ki iha uhIo (kiAmata) hai, jisa dA vacana rahimAna ne kItA sI ate paig2aMbarAM ne sacca hI AkhiA sI|
uha tAM kevala ika karar3I (DarAuNa vAlI) cIka hovegI, phera uha sAre de sAre sADe haz2Ura peza kara ditte jANage|
ajja kise viakatI ’te koI z2ulama (nA-inasAfI) nahIM hovegA, tuhAnUM kevala uhanAM kaMmAM dA hI badalA dittA jAvegA jo tusIM karade sI|
bezakka savaragAM vAle ajja aizo-ArAma vica rujhe hoNage|
uha te uhanAM dIAM patanIAM chAvAM heTha siMghAsaNAM utte gAve lAIM baiThIAM hoNagIAM|
uhanAM laI utthe hara prakAra de phala hoNage ate jo vI uha icchA karaNage uhanAM nUM uhIo milegA|
ate atiaMta miharAM vAle rabba valloM uhanAM nUM salAma kihA jAvegA|
(ate pApIAM nUM kihA jAvegA ki) he pApIo! ajja tusIM (neka lokAM toM) aDDa ho jAo|
he Adama dI aulAda! kI maiMne tuhAnUM iha hidAita nahIM sI dittI ki tusIM zaitAna dI baMdagI nA karIo, uha tAM tuhADA khullhA vairI hai|
sagoM merI hI ibAdata karanA, iho siddhI rAha hai|[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] vekho sUrata ala-bakaraha, hAzIA Aita 22/2

translations.translation: bezaka usa (zaitAna ne tAM tuhADe viccoM kaIAM nUM kurAhe pA dittA hai| kI tuhAnUM kujjha vI akala nahIM?
(vekho) iho uha naraka hai jisa dA tuhADe nAla vAadA kItA giA sI|
ajja isa vica praveza kara jAo| kiuM jo tusIM kufara kariA karade sI|

ajja (kiAmata dihAr3e) asIM uhanAM (kAfirAM) de mUMhAM ’te moharAM lA devAMge ate uhanAM de hattha sADe nAla (bhAva allAha nAla) gallAM karanage ate uhanAM de paira uhanAM de kaMmAM dI gavAhIAM deNage jo uha (saMsAra vica) karade sana|
je asIM cAhIe tAM asIM uhanAM (kAfirAM) nUM akkhAM toM aMnhA kara daIe phera uha (rAha labbhaNa laI) nassade, praMtU uhanAM nUM vikhAI kiveM devegA?
je asIM cAhuMde tAM ise thAM uhanAM dIAM zakalAM nUM vigAr3a diMde phera uha nA hI agge jA sakaNage ate nA hI picche mur3a sakaNage|[2]
translations.footnotes: [2] vekho sUrata Ale-imarAna, hAzIA Aita 91/3

translations.translation: jisa viakatI nUM asIM vaDDI umara (bhAva buDhApA) diMde hAM, tAM usa nUM paidA hoNa vAlI sathitI (bhAva bacapaNa) valla ulaTA diMde hAM| kI uha phera vI nahIM samajhade?
asIM isa (muhaMmada sa:) nUM kavitA kahiNI nahIM sikhAI ate nA hI isa nUM zobhadA hai| iha (rabbI bANI) tAM kevala ika nasIhata te khullhe rUpa vica.kuraAna hai|
tAM jo uha (nabI) usa nUM (.kuraAna rAhIM) rabba de az2Aba toM sAvadhAna kare jihar3A jiUMdA hai (bhAva jisa dI akala nahIM marI) ate kAfirAM laI (az2Aba deNa dI) hujjata pUrI ho jAve|
kI uha (kAfira) nahIM vekhade ki asIM ApaNe hatthIM baNAIAM hoIAM cIz2AM viccoM uhanAM laI pazU paidA kIte jinhAM de uha mAlika baNa gae hana|

uhanAM (pazUAM) nUM asIM uhanAM de adhIna kara chaDDiA hai, so ihanAM viccoM kujjha pazUAM (ghor3A, gadhA UMTha Adi) dI tAM uha savArI karade hana ate uhanAM viccoM kujjha (pazUAM) nUM uha khAMde hana (jiveM bakarI, bhaiDa, UMTha, gaU, maisa) Adi|
uhanAM laI uhanAM pazUAM vica hora vI kaI tarhAM de lAbha hana, (jiveM camar3I, vAla, unna Adi) ate pINa laI (duddha) hai| kI uha phera vI (rabba dA) zukara adA nahIM karade?
ate uhanAM (kAfirAM) ne allAha nUM chaDDa horAM nUM izaTa baNA liA hai tAM jo uhanAM dI madada kara sakaNa|
jadoM ki uha (izaTAM) uhanAM dI madada nahIM kara sakade sagoM iha (muzarika) tAM ulaTe uhanAM (butAM) dI madada karana laI hara vele hAz2ira rahiMde hana|
so (he nabI!) tusIM ihanAM (kAfirAM) dIAM gallAM toM dukhI nA hovo, asIM uhanAM (kAfirAM) dIAM khullhIAM te lukIAM hoIAM sArIAM gallAM dI jANakArI rakkhade hAM|
kI manukkha iha vI nahIM jANadA ki asIM usa nUM vIraja toM paidA kItA hai?phera uha (siANA hoNa ’te sADe mukAbale vica) ika dama jhagar3AlU baNa giA|
ate isa (jhagar3AlU manukkha) ne sADe laI udAharana biAna kItI ate ApaNI sirajaNA nUM bhulla giA| AkhaNa laggA ki uhanAM galIAM-sar3IAM haDDIAM nUM kauNa jiUMdA kara sakadA hai|
(he nabI!) tusIM kaho ki uhanAM (galIAM sar3IAM haDDIAM) nUM uhI (allAha) jiUMdA karegA, jinhe uhanAM nUM pahilI vAra paidA kItA hai ate uha hara tarhAM de paidA karana nUM caMgI tarhAM jANadA hai|
uhIo (allAha mur3a paidA karegA) jisa ne tuhADe laI hare bhare rukkha toM agga (bAlaNa laI lakkar3a) baNAI jisa toM tusIM acaNaceta agga bAla laiMde ho|

uhI (allAha mur3a paidA karegA) jisa ne akAzAM te dharatI nUM paidA kItA| kI uha uhanAM varagiAM nUM (mur3a) paidA karana dI samarathA nahIM rakkhadA? nirasaMdeha, samarathA rakkhadA hai, uhIo tAM paidA karana vAlA te giAna rakkhaNa vAlA hai|
jadoM uha (allAha) kujjha karanA cAhuMdA hai tAM usa dA kevala innA hI kahiNA batherA huMdA hai ki ‘ho jA’ tAM uha (kaMma) ho jAMdA hai|
pAka hai uha allAha jisa de hattha vica hara cIz2a dI saMpUrana sattA hai ate tusIM sAre use valla paratAe jAvoge|
kasama hai (rabba de haz2Ura) katArAM baMnI khar3he (farizatiAM dI)|
kasama hai (kiAmata dihAr3e aparAdhIAM nUM) jhir3akIAM deNa vAle (farizatiAM dI)|
phera kasama uhanAM dI jihar3e.kuraAna par3hade hana|
nirasaMdeha, tuhADA sabha dA izaTa ikko ikka (allAha) hai|
uhI akAzAM te dharatI dA ate uhanAM dovAM vicakAra sArIAM cIz2AM dA mAlika hai ate sArIAM pUrabI dizAvAM dA vI mAlika hai|
asIM saMsArika akAza nUM tAriAM te sohappaNa nAla sajAiA hai|[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] vekho sUrata ala-anAma, hAzIA Aita 97/6

translations.translation: ate hareka sarakaza zaitAna toM usa nUM surakkhiata rakkhaNa dA prabaMdha kItA hai|
tAM jo uha (zaitAna) saravaucca (rabbI) darabAra dIAM gallAM nA suNa sakaNa, sagoM hara pAsioM uhanAM ’te zahAba (tAre) suTTe jAMde hana|
(iha tAre) uhanAM nUM naThAuNa laI suTTe jAMde hana ate uhanAM laI sadIvI az2Aba hai|
para je koI (zaitAna) utthioM ika addha galla suNa ke nassa vI jAve tAM uha dA picchA ika dahakadA hoiA aMgiArA karadA hai|

(he nabI!) ihanAM (kAfirAM) toM puccho, kI uhanAM nUM paidA karanA vadhere aukhA hai jAM jo asIM paidA kara cukke hAM? bezakka asIM ihanAM (manukkhAM nUM) ika lesadAra cIkaNI miTTI toM paidA kItA hai|
(he nabI!) tusIM tAM (paraloka de inakAra karana ’te) rurAna huMde ho, jada ki uha isa dA makhaula karade hana|
jadoM uhanAM nUM samajhAiA jAMdA hai tAM vI nahIM samajhade|
ate jadoM kise nizAnI nUM vekhade hana tAM makhaula karade hana|
ate Akhade hana ki iha tAM khullhama-khullhA ika jAdU hai|
(pucchade hana) ki jadoM asIM mara jAvAMge ate miTTI te haDDI ho jAvAMge tAM kI asIM mur3a jiUMde kIte jAvAMge?
kI sAthoM pahilAM mare hoe pio dAde vI (jiUMde kIte jANage)?
tusIM (he nabI!) Akho ki ‘hAM’ ate (use vele) tusIM (loka) z2alIla vI hovoge|
uha (kiAmata dihAr3e oThANA) tAM ika jhir3akI vAMga hai ate acaNaceta uha (jiUMde ho ke) vekhaNage|
ate AkhaNage, hAe sADe mAr3e bhAga! iha tAM badalA milaNa vAlA dina hai|
(uhanAM nUM kihA jAvegA ki) iha phaisaliAM dA velA hai, jisa nUM tusIM jhuThalAiA karade sI|
(he farizatio!) uhanAM lokAM nUM ikaTThA karo jinhAM ne z2ulama (ziraka) kItA sI phera uhanAM de sAthIAM nUM ate uhanAM (izaTa) nUM vI ikaTThA karo, jinhAM dI uha (kAfira) pUjA karade sana|
ate (jihar3e) allAha nUM chaDDa horAM dI pUjA karade sana, uhanAM sabha nUM naraka dI rAha vikhAo|
uhanAM (z2AlamAM) nUM roko, bezakka uhanAM toM puccha-giccha kItI jAvegI|
(kihA jAvegA) tuhAnU kI ho giA ki tusIM ika dUje dI sahAitA nahIM kara rahe?
sagoM ajja tAM (sAre hI) AgiAkArI baNa gae|
uha (inakArI) ika dUje valla vekhaNage ate vAda vivAda karanage|
pairokAra AkhaNage, bezakka tusIM (sAnUM kurAhe pAuNa laI) sADe kola sajje pAsioM AiA karade sI|
uha (izaTa) AkhaNage ki nahIM, sagoM tusIM Apa hI ImAna liAuNa vAle nahIM sI|
ate tuhADe ’te sADA kujjha vI z2ora nahIM sI, tusIM tAM Ape hI sarakaza sI|
huNa tAM sADe ’te sADe rabba dA iha kahiNA sacca siddha ho giA hai ki bezakka asIM (sAre hI az2Aba dA) suAda cakhaNa vAle hAM|
so asIM tuhAnUM rAhoM bhaTakAiA te asIM Apa vI bhaTake hoe sI|
usa dina uha sAre az2Aba vica bhAIvAla hoNage|
asIM aparAdhIAM nAla iMja hI kariA karade hAM|
iha uha loka hana ki jadoM uhanAM nUM kihA jAMdA sI ki allAha toM chuTTa hora koI izaTa nahIM tAM uha haMkAra karade sana|[2]
translations.footnotes: [2] vekho sUrata ala-hajja, hAzIA Aita 9/22

translations.translation: ate kahiMde sana, kI asIM ApaNe izaTAM nUM ika sudAI kavI de kahiNe ’te chaDDa daIe?
jada ki uha (muhaMmada) tAM hakka (saccA dIna) lai ke AiA hai ate isa ne sAre rasUlAM dI puzaTI kItI hai|
bezakka huNa tusIM daradanAka az2Aba dA suAda cakhoge|
huNa tuhAnUM tuhADe karamAM dA badalA dittA jAvegA jo tusIM (saMsAra vica) karade sI|
praMtU allAha de ’coMNaveM baMde (az2Aba toM) surakkhiata rahiNage|
uhanAM laI jANiA-pachANiA riz2aka hai|
(bhAva) jaMnata de suAdale phala hoNage ate uha jaMnata vAsI satikArayoga hoNage|
niamatAM vAlI savaraga vica rakkhiA jAvegA|
ika dUje de sAhamaNe taqhatAM ’te baiThe hoNage|
uhanAM laI vagade cazamiAM toM pavittara zarAba dA daura calla rihA hovegA|
(uha zarAba) vekhaNa vica safeda (sAfa-sutharI) hovegI ate pINa vAliAM laI suAdalI hovegI|
nA usa de pINa nAla sira cakarAvegA ate nA hI matta mArI jAvegI|
ate uhanAM (jaMnatIAM) de kola naz2arAM nUM nIvIAM rakkhaNa vAlIAM te vaDDIAM-vaDDIAM (sohaNIAM) akkhAM vAlIAM (hUrAM) hoNagIAM|
jiveM uha akkhAM (zutara murag2a de) AMDe hoNa, jihar3e par3adiAM vica lukAe hoe hana|
uha (jaMnatI) ika dUje valla rukkha karake (ika dUje dA hAla) pucchaNage|
uhanAM (jaMnatIAM) viccoM ika AkhegA ki (saMsAra vica) merA ika sAthI sI|
jihar3A (mainUM) kihA karadA sI ki kI tUM vI (kiAmata de AuNa dI) puzaTI karana vAliAM viccoM hai?
kI jadoM asIM mara jAvAMge te haDDIAM ho jAvAMge tAM kI sAnUM (mur3a jiUMdA karake karamAM anusAra) badalA dittA jAvegA?
uha (jaMnatI sAthIAM nUM) AkhegA ki je tUM (usa inakArI nUM) vekhaNA cAhuMdA hai tAM (naraka vica) jhAtI mAra ke vekha le|
jadoM uha jhAtI mAregA tAM usa nUM naraka de vicAle (jaladA hoiA) vekhegA|
jaMnatI usa nUM AkhegA ki allAha dI suMha, tUM tAM mainUM vI barabAda karanA cAhuMdA sI|
je mere rabba dI mere ’te kripA nA huMdI tAM ajja maiM vI naraka vica ihanAM aparAdhIAM vAMga hAz2ara kItA giA huMdA|
(jaMnatI AkhegA) kI maiM tainUM nahIM sI kahiMdA ki huNa asIM nahIM marAMge?
(hAM koI mauta nahIM) chuTTa pahilI (saMsArika) mauta toM ate nA hI sAnUM (praloka vica) koI az2Aba dittA jAvegA|
nirasaMdeha, iho sabha toM vaDDI kAmayAbI hai|
amala karana vAliAM nUM ajihI safalatA laI hI amala karane cAhIde hana|
kI iha (jaMnata dI) mahimAnadArI caMgI hai jAM (naraka vica) thohara dA rakkha?
jisa nUM asIM z2AlamAM laI prIkhiA baNA chaDDiA hai|
iha uha rukkha hai jihar3A naraka de heTha toM nikaladA hai|
usa de phala zaitAna de sirAM vAMga hana|
uhanAM rukkhAM (de phalAM) viccoM hI (narakadhArI) khANage ate ApaNe DhiDDa bharanage|
phera uhanAM nUM khauladA hoiA pANI pINa nUM milegA|
(khANa pINa magaroM) uhanAM dI vApasI mur3a bhar3akadI agga valla hovegI|
iha uha loka hana jinhAM ne ApaNe pio dAdiAM nUM kurAhe piA hoiA vekhiA|
ate uhanAM dI hI pairavI karana laI uhanAM de picche naTThe cale gae|
bezakka uhanAM toM pahilAM vI vadhere loka kurAhe pai cukke hana|
ate asIM uhanAM vica (naraka toM) DarAuNa vAle (paig2aMbara) vI bheje sana|
huNa tUM vekha, jinhAM nUM DaraiA giA sI (praMtU nA Dare) uhanAM dA aMta kiho jihA hoiA|
(usa bhair3e aMta toM) koI nahIM bacegA, chuTa allAha de cuNaveM te qhAlasa baMdiAM toM|
ate (isa toM pahilAM ApaNI kauma toM nirAza ho ke) sAnUM nUha ne pukAriA sI, vekho ki asIM kiMnA sohaNA uttara deNa vAle hAM|
asIM usa (nUha) nUM ate usa de ghara vAliAM nUM vaDDI musIbata toM bacA liA|
ate usa dI aulAda nUM bAkI rahiNa vAlA baNAiA|
magaroM AuNa vAlIAM nasalAM laI asIM usa dI prazaMsA te carace nUM bAkI rakkhiA|
sAre jahAnAM vica nUha ’te salAmatI hove|
bezakka nekI karana vAliAM nUM asIM ise prakAra (caMgA) badalA diMde hAM|
uha (nUha) sADe ImAnadAra baMdiAM viccoM sI|
asIM dUjiAM (nUha de dazamaNAM) nUM Doba dittA|
bezakka ibarAhIma vI nUha dI TolI viccoM sI|
jadoM uha (ibarAhIma) ApaNe rabba de haz2Ura niramala hiradA lai ke AiA|
usa ne ApaNe pitA te ApaNI kauma nUM kihA, tusIM kisa cIz2a dI pUjA karade ho?
kI tusIM allAha nUM chaDDa ke (ApaNe hatthIM) ghar3he hoe izaTa cAhuMde ho?
sAre jahAnAM de pAlaNahAra bAre tuhADA kI vicAra hai?
phera usa ne ika naz2ara tAriAM valla vekhiA (bhAva socaNa laggA)|
ate (ApaNe ghara vAliAM nUM) kihA ki maiM tAM bImAra hAM|
isa toM uha usa (ibarAhIma) nUM ghara chaDDa ke (mele vica) cale gae|
phera uha (ibarAhIma) uhanAM de izaTAM kola giA ate pucchaNa laggA, tusIM (ApaNe agge pae bhoga nUM) khAMde kiuM nahIM?
tuhAnUM kI hoiA ki tusIM bolade vI nahIM?
phera tAM uha (ibarAhIma) uhanAM nUM sajje hattha (zakatI) nAla mAra-mAra ke tor3aNa lagga piA|
(phera jadoM muzarika melA vekha de ghara Ae ate butAM dA hAla vekhiA tAM) uha loka nassade hoe usa valla Ae|
usa (ibarAhIma) ne AkhiA, kI tusIM uhanAM nUM pUjade ho jinhAM nUM tusAM Apa hI ghar3hiA hai?
jada ki tuhAnUM vI allAha ne sAjiA hai ate tuhADIAM baNAIAM hoIAM cIz2AM nUM vI usa (allAha) ne hI paidA kItA hai|
uha (muzarika) AkhaNa lagge ki isa (ibarAhIma) laI ika bhaTThI baNAo ate usa vica agga bAlo te usa dagadI hoI agga vica usa nUM suTTa dio|
uha loka tAM ibarAhIma de viruddha cAla calaNA cAhuMde sI praMtU asIM (agga nUM gulaz2Ara baNA ke) uhanAM (muzarikAM) nUM hI hINA kara vikhAiA|
ate usa (ibarAhIma) ne (ApaNI kauma dA vatIrA vekha ke) kihA ki maiM tAM ApaNe rabba valla jAMdA hai, uhIo maiM nUM rAha vikhAvegA|
(ibarAhIma ne duA kItI ki) he mere rabbA! mainUM ika puttara dI dAta baqhaza, jihar3A neka lokAM viccoM hove|
asIM usa nUM ika sahinazIla puttara dI qhuzaqhabarI dittI|

jadoM uha (puttara) ApaNI naTThaNa bhajjaNa dI umara nUM pahuMciA tAM usa (pitA) ne (puttara) nUM AkhiA ki he mere puttara! maiMne ika supanA vekhiA hai ki maiM tainUM z2ibaha (allAha dI rAha vica kurabAna) kara rihA hAM, huNa tUM dassa terA kI vicAra hai? puttara boliA ki pitA jI, jo vI (rabba valloM) tuhAnUM hukama hoiA hai usa nUM pUrA karo, je allAha ne cAhiA tAM tusIM mainUM sabara karana vAliAM ’coM hI pAuge|
aqhIra jadoM dovAM (pio puttara) ne (rabba de) hukama agge ApaNe sIsa jhukA ditte ate ibarAhIma ne usa (puttara) nUM pAse bhAra (dharatI ’te) pA dittA|
phera asIM (allAha ne usa dA irAdA vekha ke) AvAz2a dittI ki he ibarAhIma!
bezakka tUM ApaNA supanA saccA kara ke vikhA dittA| asIM nekI karana vAliAM nUM ajihA hI badalA diMde hAM|
asala vica iha ika sapazaTa parIkhiA sI|
