ate asIM isa (isamAIla) de badale vica ika vaDDA jAnavara z2ibaha (kurabAnI) karana laI baqhaza dittA|
ate isa dI zubha caracA asIM magaroM AuNa vAliAM (nasalAM) laI bAkI rakkhI|
ibarAhIma ’te salAmatI hove|
asIM neka lokAM nUM ise prakAra vadhIA badalA diA karade hAM|
bezakka uha (ibarAhIma) sADe momina baMdiAM viccoM sI|
ate asIM usa (ibarAhIma) nUM isahAka (puttara) dI qhuzaqhabarI dittI, jihar3A neka lokAM viccoM ika nabI hovegA|
asIM usa (ibarAhIma) ate isahAka ’te barakatAM nAz2ila kItIAM ate uhanAM dI aulAda viccoM kujjha tAM nekI karana vAle hana ate kujjha ApaNe Apa utte z2ulama karana vAle hana|
bezakka asAM mUsA te hArUna ’te vI upakAra kItA|
asIM uhanAM dovAM nUM ate uhanAM dI kauma nUM ika vaDDI kaThinAI toM mukatI dittI|
ate asIM uhanAM dI sahAitA kItI ate uhIo bhArU rahe|
ate asIM uhanAM dovAM (mUsA te hArUna) nUM ika sapazaTa kitAba (tauraita) dittI|
ate uhanAM dovAM nUM siddhe rAha dI sikkhiA dittI|
ate asIM uhanAM dovAM (mUsA te hArUna) dI zubha caracA nUM picchioM AuNa vAliAM laI bAkI rakkhiA|
mUsA te hArUna utte salAma hove|
asIM neka lokAM nUM ise prakAra badalA diA karade hAM|
nirasaMdeha, uha sADe momina baMdiAM viccoM sana|
bezakka iliAsa vI paig2aMbarAM viccoM hI sI|
jadoM usa (iliAsa) ne ApaNI kauma nUM kihA ki kI tusIM (allAha toM) nahIM Darade?
kI tusIM boala (nAM de buta) nUM pukArade ho? ate sabha toM vadhIA racanAhAra nUM chaDDa diMde ho|
bhAva allAha nUM chaDDa diMde ho jihar3A tuhADA te tuhADe pio dAdiAM dA rabba hai|
para uhanAM (kauma) ne usa (iliAsa) nUM jhuThalAiA, huNa uha sAre z2arUra hI (saz2A laI) hAz2ara kIte jANage|
rabba de neka baMdiAM toM chuTTa (saz2A toM koI nahIM baca sakegA)|
asIM iliAsa dI) zubha caracA magaroM AuNa vAliAM laI bAkI rakkha chaDDI hai|
ilayAsIna (iliAsa) ’te salAmatI hove|
nekI karana vAliAM nUM asIM iMja hI badalA diA karade hAM|
bezakka uha (iliAsa) sADe momina baMdiAM viccoM hI sI|
nirasaMdeha, lUta vI paig2aMbarAM viccoM hI sI|
asIM usa (lUta) nUM te usa de ghara vAliAM nUM (az2Aba toM) bacA liA|
chuTTa usa buDDhI (lUta dI patanI) toM jihar3I picche rahi jANa vAliAM viccoM sI (bhAva jinhAM nUM az2Aba AuNA sI)|
phera asIM bAkI sAriAM nUM halAka (tabAha) kara dittA|
nirasaMdeha, tusIM savera nUM uhanAM (nAza kItIAM hoIAM) basatIAM viccoM dI laMghade ho|
ate rAta nUM vI laMghade ho| kI tusIM phera vI nahIM samajhade?
bezakka yUnusa vI nabIAM viccoM sI|
jadoM uha (yUnusa kauma toM nirAza ho ke) ika bharI hoI ber3I valla nassa turiA sI|
jadoM (ber3I dA bojha ghaTAuNa laI ber3I vAliAM ne) paracIAM pAIAM tAM uha (yUnusa) phasa giA (bhAva yUnusa dI hI paracI nikkalI)|
(jadoM usa ne samuMdara vica chAla mArI) tada hI macchI ne usa nUM nigala liA jada ki uha ApaNI niMdA Apa hI kara rihA sI|
jekara uha rabba dI pAkI biAna karana vAliAM viccoM nA huMdA|
tAM uha lokAM de mur3a jiUMdA uThAuNa jANa vAle dina (kiAmata) takka use macchI de DhiDDa vica hI rahiMdA|
phera asIM usa (yUnusa) nUM (macchI de DhiDDa viccoM kaDDha ke) ika rar3e maidAna vicasuTTa dittA| usa vele uha asuvasatha sI|
ate asIM usa (yUnusa) utte (kaddU dA) ika veladAra rukkha ugA dittA|
phera asIM usa (yUnusa) nUM ika lakkha lokAM valla (rabbI paig2Ama de ke) bhejiA, uha loka isa giNatI toM kujjha vaddha hI hoNage|
so uha sAre ImAna liAe ate asAM uhanAM nUM ika niyata sameM tIka (saMsAra dA) lAbha uThAuNa dA avasara pradAna kItA|
ihanAM (muzarikAM) toM puccho, kI tuhADe rabba laI dhIAM ate uhanAM (lokAM) laI puttara hana?
kI uha usa sameM hAz2ara sana jadoM asIM farizatiAM nUM isatarIAM baNAiA sI?
(qhabaradAra) iha loka ApaNe valloM jhUTha ghar3ha rahe hana|
ki allAha dI saMtAna hai| bezakka uha sAre jhUThe hana|
kI uha (allAha) puttarAM dI thAM dhIAM nUM pasaMda karadA hai?
tuhAnUM kI ho giA hai? tusIM kiho jihIAM gallAM karade ho?
kI tusIM kujjha vI nahIM socade?
jAM tuhADe kola koI sapazaTa dalIla hai?
jAM tusIM ApaNI kitAba lai Ao, je tusIM sacce ho|
uhanAM (muzarikAM) ne allAha ate jiMnAM de vicAle ika saMbaMdha baNA chaDDiA hai, jada ki jiMnAM nUM isa galla dA giAna hai ki uha (rabba agge) z2arUra hI hAz2ara kIte jANage|
allAha uhanAM sArIAM gallAM toM pAka hai jihar3IAM uha (muzarika) usa de bAre karade hana|
allAha de neka baMde (ajihIAM gallAM toM) bace hoe hana|
he muzariko! bezakka tusIM ate uha, jinhAM dI tusIM baMdagI karade ho|
tusIM sAre mila ke vI (neka baMdiAM nUM) allAha de viruddha bahakA nahIM sakade|
chuTTa usa toM jihar3A naraka vica jANa vAlA hai|
(farizate Akhade hana ki) sADe viccoM hareka dI z2iMmevArI niyata hai|
asIM tAM allAha de haz2Ura katAra baMnI khar3he rahiNa vAle hAM|
bezakka asIM allAha dI tasabIha (zalAghA) karana vAle hAM|
ate uha (inakArI) loka kihA karade sana|
ki je sADe kola sAthoM pahilAM de lokAM (de az2Aba) dI caracA kItI huMdI|
tAM asIM vI allAha de ’coMNave baMde huMde|
jadoM paig2aMbara.kuraAna lai ke AiA tAM uhanAM ne usa (.kuraAna dA) inakAra kara dittA| uha chetI hI jANa laiNage (ki uha kI karade sana?)|
asala vica asIM pahilAM hI ApaNe uhanAM baMdiAM nUM, jihar3e paig2aMbara hana, vacana de cukke hAM|
ki z2arUra hI uhanAM dI sahAitA kItI jAvegI|
ate bezakka sADIAM (allAha dIAM) faujAM hI bhArU rahiNagIAM|
so he nabI! tusIM kujjha sameM laI uhanAM (kAfirAM) toM mUMha mor3a lavo (bhAva dhiAna nA dio)|
ate uhanAM nUM vekhade raho (ki uhanAM ’te az2Aba AuNa vAlA hai) phera chetI hI uha vI vekha laiNage|
kI uha sADe az2Aba laI kAhalI kara rahe hana?
praMtU jadoM uha (az2Aba) uhanAM de vihar3e uttaregA tAM DarAe gae lokAM laI uha savera bahuta hI bhair3I hovegI|
(he nabI!) tusIM kujjha sameM laI ihanAM dI ciMtA chaDDa dio|
kevala uhanAM nUM vekhade raho ate uha vI chetI hI vekha laiNage|
tuhADA rabba, jihar3A iz2z2atAM dA mAlika hai, uhanAM sArIAM gallAM toM pAka hai jihar3IAM uha muzarika biAna karade hana|
samUha paig2aMbarAM ’te salAma hove|
ate sArIAM tArIfAM (te zukarAne) allAha laI hana jihar3A sAre jahAnAM dA pAlaNahAra hai|
suAda| suMha hai nasIhatAM bhare.kuraAna dI|
para inakArI tAM ghamaMDa vica ate (.kuraAna dI) virodhatA vica phase hoe hana|

ihanAM (kAfirAM) toM pahilAM vI asIM kiMnIAM hI ummatAM (kaumAM) nUM (az2Aba rAhIM) halAka kara cukke hAM| (jadoM az2Aba A giA) tAM uhanAM ne (madada laI) sAnUM hI saddiA, jada ki uha samAM (az2Aba toM) chuTakAre dA nahIM sI|
ate uhanAM lokAM nUM isa galla utte rurAnI sI ki ika DarAuNa vAlA Apa uhanAM viccoM hI A giA ate kAfira AkhaNa lagge ki iha tAM ika jAdUgara hai ate vaDDA jhUThA hai|
kI isa ne sAre izaTAM nUM ika hI izaTa baNA dittA hai? iha tAM bahuta hI ajIba galla hai|

ate (makke de) saradAra iha kahiMde hoe (muhaMmada sa: dI sabhA viccoM) uTTha ture ki callo ate ApaNe izaTAM dI ibAdata ’te hI DaTe raho| bezakka iha galla kise nijI udeza nUM lai ke AkhI jA rahI hai|
asIM tAM iha galla pahilIAM kaumAM toM vI nahIM suNI, iha tAM kevala ghar3hI hoI ika galla hai|
kI sADe viccoM ise ’te hI z2ikara (.kuraAna) uttariA hai? asala vica iha loka mere z2ikara (.kuraAna) utte zakka kara rahe hana, kiuM jo aje uhanAM ne mere az2Aba dA suAda nahIM cakkhiA|
(he nabI!) kI ihanAM (kAfirAM) kola tere (usa) rabba dIAM rahimatAM de qhaz2Ane hana, jihar3A ki vaDDA z2orAvara te saqhI dAtA hai?
jAM kI iha akAza te dharatI ate uhanAM de vicakAra hareka cIz2a de mAlika hana? (je iMja hai) tAM ihanAM nUM cAhIdA hai ki (vahI nUM rokaNa laI) rassiAM rAhIM akAza ’te car3ha jANa|
iha tAM (do vaDDe-vaDDe) hAre hoe jatthiAM viccoM ika nikkA jihA jatthA hai, jihar3A mAta khAvegA|
ihanAM toM pahilAM nUha ate Ada dI kauma ate mekhAM vAle firaauna ne (paig2aMbarAM nUM) jhuThalAiA sI|
ate samUda ate lUta dI kauma ne ate aikA vAliAM ne vI (hakka nUM) jhuThalAiA sI| iha sabha vaDDe-vaDDe (zakatIzAlI) jatthe sana|
ihanAM viccoM hareka ne paig2aMbarAM nUM jhuThalAiA, so uhanAM utte mere az2Aba dA faisalA lAgU ho giA|
iha (kAfira) loka vI kevala ika DarAuNa vAlI cIka dI uDIka kara rahe hana jisa vica koI derI nahIM|
uha inakArI (makhaula vica) Akhade hana ki he sADiA rabbA! sAnUM sADI saz2A dA hissA hisAba vAle dina (bhAva kiAmata) toM pahilAM chetI hI de de|

(he nabI!) tusIM ihanAM (kAfirAM) dIAM gallAM utte jo iha kahi rahe hana, dhIraja toM kaMma lao ate sADe baMde dAUda nUM yAda karo jo z2orAvara, zakatIzAlI ate hareka mAmale vica (rabba valla) parataNa vAlA sI|
asIM pahAr3AM nUM usa de adhIna kara chaDDiA sI ate uha usa de nAla saMjha-savere (allAha dI) tasabIha (pAkI) biAna kariA karade sana|
ate paMchI vI (tasabIha karana laI) ikaTThe ho AuMde ate uha sAre usa (dAUda) de AgiAkArI sana|
ate asIM usa dI hakUmata nUM maz2abUta kara dittA ate usa nUM hikamata (dAnAI, sUjha-bUjha) baqhazI ate faisalAkuna galla AkhaNa dI yogatA vI dittI sI|
(he muhaMmada!) kI tuhAnUM jhagar3ana vAliAM dI qhabara hai, jadoM uha kaMdha Tappa ke (dAUda de) kamare vica A gae sana?

jadoM uha dAUda de kola pahuMce tAM uha (dAUda) uhanAM toM Dara giA| tAM uhanAM (AuNa vAliAM) ne AkhiA ki tusIM sAthoM Daro nA asIM doveM ika dUje nAla jhagar3a pae hAM, asIM ika dUje nAla vadhIkI kItI hai, so tusIM sADe vicAle hakka anusAra faisalA kara dio ate beinasAfI nA hove ate inasAfa valla hI sADI agavAI karo|

(ika boliA ki) iha merA bharA hai isa de kole nar3hinaveM duMbIAM hana, jadoM ki mere kola ika hI duMbI hai| iha AkhadA hai ki uha ika duMbI vI mere havAle karade ate gallIM bAtIM mainUM dabA laiMdA hai|

dAUda ne (binA dUje dhira dI galla suNe ate binA kise gavAhI toM faisalA) faramAiA ki terI ika duMbI nUM ApaNIAM duMbIAM nAla jor3aNa dI galla karake bezakka isa ne tere nAla vadhIkI kItI hai| Ama karake sAjhIMdAra ika dUje nAla dhakkA karade hana, chuTTa uhanAM toM jihar3e (rabba ’te) ImAna rakkhade hana ate bhale kaMma karade hana, ajihe lokI tAM bahuta hI thor3he hana| dAUda samajha giA ki asIM (isa faisale rAhIM) usa nUM az2amAiA hai| phera tAM usa (dAUda) ne ApaNe rabba toM baqhaziza dI duA maMgI ate rukUa vica jhuka giA ate (rabba valla) parata AiA|
asIM (rabba ne) usa dI iha bhulla baqhaza dittI| bezakka usa laI sADe kola nikaTavaratI sathAna te sohaNA TikANA (bhAva jaMnata) hai|

asIM kihA ki he dAUda! asIM tuhAnUM dharatI ’te qhalIfA (rabbI hAkama) baNAiA hai, so tUM lokAM vicakAra inasAfa anusAra faisale kara ate ApaNI icchA de picche nA lagga| iha (mana dI icchA) tainUM allAha de rasate toM haTA devegI| jihar3e loka allAha dI rAha toM bhaTaka jAMde hana uhanAM laI karar3A az2Aba hai isa laI ki uhanAM ne hisAba hoNa vAle dina (kiAmata) nUM bhulA dittA hai|

asIM akAza te dharatI nUM ate jo ihanAM de vicAle hai, viaratha nahIM sAjiA, iha tAM vicAra uhanAM lokAM dA hai jihar3e rabba dA inakAra karade hana ate jihar3e inakArI hana uhanAM laI naraka dI agga rAhIM barabAdI hai|

kI asIM ImAna liAuNa vAle te bhale kaMma karana vAliAM nUM uhanAM lokAM de barAbara kara diAMge jihar3e dharatI ’te vigAr3a pAuNa vAle hana? jAM asIM muttakIna (burAIAM toM bacaNa vAliAM) nAla badakArAM varagA (salUka) karAMge|

iha (.kuraAna) barakatAM vAlI kitAba hai jisa nUM asIM tuhADe valla (he muhaMmada!) isa laI utArI hai tAM jo lokI isa dIAM AitAM (AdezAM) ’te soca vicAra karana ate akala vAle isa toM nasIhata grahiNa karana|
asIM dAUda nUM sulemAna jihA puttara baqhaziA, jihar3A bahuta hI neka baMdA sI ate uha bahulatA nAla (rabba valla) parataNa vAlA sI|
jadoM zAma vele usa (sulaimAna) de agge tez2a bhajjaNa vAle asIla ghor3e hAz2ara kIte gae| (jisa kArana namAz2a dA samAM bIta giA)
(yAda AuNa ’te) usa ne AkhiA ki maine ApaNe rabba dI yAda nUM isa mAla (ghor3hiAM) dI muhabbata ’te pahila dittI, itthoM taka ki sUraja akkhAM toM uhale ho giA|
sulemAna ne hukama dittA ki ihanAM ghor3hiAM nU mere kola liAo| phera uhanAM dIAM piMnIAM te garadanAM ’te hattha pherana laggA| (bhAva vaDaNa lagga piA)
nirasaMdeha, asIM sulemAna nUM az2amAiA ate asIM usa dI kurasI utte ika bejAna dhar3a rakkha dittA| phera usa (sulaimAna) ne rabba valla dhiAna dittA|
usa ne kihA ki he mere rabba! mainUM baqhaza de ate mainUM uha pAtazAhI baqhaza jihar3I mere picchoM kise nUM nA phabe| bezakka tUM hI sabha toM vaDDA dAtA hai|
phera asIM havA nUM usa de adhIna kara dittA, uha (havA) usa de hukama anusAra jiddhara uha cAhuMdA sI, naramI nAla vagadI sI|
zaitAnAM (jiMnAM) nUM vI, jihar3e bhavana usArade sI ate (samuMdarAM vica) gote lagAuMde sI, usa de adhIna kara chaDDe sana|
ate hora (jiMna) jihar3e saMgalAM nAla jakar3e hoe sana| (uha vI adhIna sI)|
(he sulaimAna!) iha hai sADe valloM baqhaziza, so huNa tUM bhAveM kise ’te ahisAna kara jAM nA kara, isa dI koI puccha-giccha nahIM|
bezakka usa laI sADe kola nikaTavaratI ate vadhIA TikANA hai|
ate (he muhaMmada!) ratA sADe baMde ayyUba dI vI caracA karo, jadoM usa ne ApaNe rabba nUM aradAsa kItI sI ki mainUM zaitAna ne dukkha te (bImArI de) az2Aba vica pA suTTiA hai|
asAM kihA ki ApaNA paira dharatI ’te (dabba ke) mAra (ke pANI kaDDho), iha ThaMDA pANI izanAna laI te pINa laI hai|
asIM usa (ayyUba) nUM usa dA pUrA parivAra de dittA sagoM ApaNe valloM mihara vajoM unne hI hora baqhaza ditte| (ihanAM gallAM vica) akala vAliAM laI nasIhatAM hana|

asIM Adeza dittA ki ApaNe hattha vica so tIlhIAM dA ika muTThA (bhAva jhAr3U) phar3a ate (ApaNI kasama nUM pUrA karana laI) usa de nAla ApaNI patanI nUM mAra, ApaNI kasama nUM nA tor3a|[1] (saccI galla tAM uha hai ki) asIM usa (ayyUba) nUM sabara karana vAlA pAiA| (uha) bahuta hI neka baMdA sI ate (rabba valla) mur3a AuNa vAlA sI|
translations.footnotes: [1] haz2arata ayUba dI patanI bimArI de dinAM vica unhAM dI sevA kariA karadI sI| ika vAra kise galla te nArAz2a hoke haz2arata ayUba ne usa nUM 100 kaurar3e mArana dI kasama khA laI, so allAha ne unhAM nUM hukama ditA ki 100 jhAr3U dIAM siMkhAM laike ika vAra usa nUM mAro terI kasama pUrI ho jAvegI|

translations.translation: sADe baMde ibarAhIma, isahAka te yAkUba dI vI caracA karo, jihar3e kArajazakatI rakkhaNa vAle sUjhavAna loka sana|
asIM uhanAM nUM ika vizeza guNa, paraloka dI yAda, kArana cuNa liA sI|
uha sAre sADe laI (rabba laI) ’coMNaveM neka lokAM viccoM sana|
isamAIla, ala-yAsaA te z2ula-kifala dI vI caracA karo, iha sAre neka lokAM viccoM sana|
iha (.kuraAna) ika nasIhata hai ate (sacca jANa ki) muttakIna (burAIAM toM bacaNa vAliAM) laI bahuta hI vadhIA thAM (savaraga) hai|
sadIvI rahiNa vAle bAg2a hana jinhAM de bUhe uhanAM (neka lokAM) laI khullhe hoNage|
jitthe uha bar3e ArAma nAla DhAsaNe lAIM baiThe hoNage ate tarhAM-tarhAM de phalAM dIAM te pINa vAlIAM cIz2AM dIAM faramAizAM karaNage|
uhanAM de kola naz2arAM nUM nIvIAM rakkhaNa vAlIAM te hANa-paravANa dIAM patanIAM hoNagIAM|
(AkhiA jAvegA ki) iha hai uha vAadA, jihar3A tuhADe (neka lokAM) nAla hisAba vAle dina laI kItA jAMdA sI|
bezakka iha riz2aka sADe valloM vizeza baqhaziza hai, jihar3A kade vI mukkegA nahIM|
iha tAM hai (neka lokAM) dA badalA, praMtU bAg2IAM laI bahuta hI (bhair3A) TikANA hai|
bhAva naraka hai jisa vica uha (inakArI) jANage, uha bahuta hI bhair3A nivAsa-sathAna hai|
iha khauladA hoiA pANI te pIpa hai, huNa uha isa dA suAda cakhaNa|
ise prakAra dIAM hora kaI tarhAM dIAM dUjIAM saz2AvAM vI hoNagIAM|

kihA jAvegA iha tuhADe pairokArAM dA jatthA hai jihar3A tuhADe nAla (naraka vica) ghusadA jA rihA hai| ihanAM laI koI qhuzI jAM koI khullha nahIM hovegI sagoM iha tAM naraka dI agga vica jANa vAle hana|

uha (sarakazI karana vAle) AkhaNage ki sagoM tusIM hI isa yoga ho ki tuhADe laI koI qhuzI jA koI khullha nahIM bhAva koI Ao-bhagata nahIM| tusIM hI isa (naraka) nUM sADe sAhamaNe liAe ho, iha bahuta hI bhair3A nivAsa-sathAna hai|
uha AkhaNage ki he sADe rabbA jihar3A vI koI sADe sAhamaNe iha aMta liAiA hai usa laI naraka dI saz2A (az2Aba) dUNI karade|
uha (narakI) AkhaNage, kI galla hai ki ajja sAnUM uha lokI vikhAI nahIM diMde, jinhAM nUM asIM bhair3hiAM vica giNade sAM?
kI asIM aiMve hI (saMsAra vica) uhanAM dA makhaula karade sI jAM sADIAM akkhAM hI uhanAM toM phira gaIAM hana?
iha galla saccI hai ki narakIAM vica ApasI jhagar3A z2arUra hovegA|
(he muhaMmada) tusIM kahi dio ki maiM tAM kevala citAvanI deNa vAlA hAM ate chuTTa allAha z2orAvara toM hora koI pUjaNahAra nahIM|
jihar3A ki akAzAM te dharatI dA ate jo kujjha vI uhanAM de vicAle hai uhanAM sabha dA mAlika hai| uha z2orAvara te baqhazaNahAra hai|
(he nabI!) tusIM Akha dio ki iha ika vaDDI qhabara hai|
jisa nUM suNa ke tusIM mUMha pherana vAle ho|
(he nabI!) uhanAM nUM Akha dio ki mainUM sabha toM ucce darabAra (vAle farizatiAM) dA kujjha vI giAna nahIM jadoM uha (manukkhI sirajana ’te rabba nAla) jhagar3a rahe sI|
mere valla tAM kevala vahI ghallI jAMdI hai ate maiM tAM sapazaTa rUpa vica (naraka dI agga toM) qhabaradAra karana vAlA hAM|
(yAda karo) jadoM tuhADe pAlaNahAra ne farizatiAM nUM kihA ki maiM miTTI toM ika manukkha nUM paidA karana vAlA hAM|
jadoM maiM isa (manukkha) nUM ThIka-ThAka kara lavAM ate usa vica ApaNI rUha pA devAM tAM tusIM sAre usa de agge sijade vica Diga paiNA|
(isa Adeza anusAra) sAre farizatiAM ne ikaTThA ho ke sijadA kItA|
chuTTa ibalIsa toM, usa ne ghamaMDa kItA, iMja uha inakArIAM viccoM ho giA|

pucchiA ki he ibalIsa! tainUM kihar3I galla ne isa (manukkha) nUM sijadA karana toM rokiA, jisa nUM maiMne ApaNe hatthIM sAjiA hai? kI tUM ghamaMDI ho giA jAM terA darajA (uhanAM farizatiAM nAloM) uccA hai? [2]
translations.footnotes: [2] vekho sUrata Ale-imarAna, hAzIA Aita 73/3

translations.translation: usa (ibalIsa) ne uttara dittA ki maiM isa (Adama) toM caMgA hAM, tusAM mainUM agga toM paidA kItA hai jada ki isa (manukkha) nUM miTTI toM baNAiA hai|
allAha valloM hukama hoiA ki tUM aithoM nikala jA tUM tAM maradUda (dhikkAriA hoiA) hai|
ate kiamAta taka laI tere utte merI fiTakAra hai|
(ibalIsa bhAva zaitAna ne) AkhiA ki he mere rabbA! tAM phera mainUM usa dina taka dI mohalata de, jadoM loka mur3a (kabarAM ’coM) uThAe jANage|
faramAiA ki bezakka tUM vI mohalata dittI jANa vAle lokAM viccoM ho giA|
usa dina taka (mohalata) hai jisa dA samAM mere valloM mithiA hoiA hai|
(zaitAna ne) kihA ki mainUM terI iz2z2ata dI kasama! maiM uhanAM sabha (manukkhAM) nUM (rabba de rasatioM) lAz2amI kurAhe pAvAMgA|
chuTTa uhanAM toM jihar3e uhanAM viccoM tere coMNaveM te pasaMda de baMde hana|
faramAiA ki saccI galla tAM iho hai ate maiM sacca hI kihA karadA hAM|
ki maiM tere ate terA kahiNA maMNana vAliAM nAla naraka nUM z2arUra bhara devAMgAM|
(he nabI!) Akha dio ki maiM tuhAthoM (rabbI sunehA pacAuNa dA) koI badalA nahIM maMgadA ate nA hI maiM koI baNAvaTI kaMma karana vAliAM viccoM hAM|
iha (.kuraAna) tAM sAre jahAnAM laI ika nasIhata hai|
ate tusIM isa dI saccAI nUM kujjha dera magaroM (bhAva kiAmata vele z2arUra hI) jANa lavoge|
iha kitAba (.kuraAna) usa allAha valloM (hakka sacca nAla) utArI gaI hai jihar3A z2orAvara ate hikamata (dAnAI) vAlA hai|
bezakka asIM isa kitAba (.kuraAna) nUM tuhADe valla (he muhaMmada sa:) hakka nAla nAz2ila kItI hai| so tusIM allAha laI ApaNI baMdagI nUM nirola karade hoe use dI hI ibAdata karo|

huziAra raho! baMdagI nirola allAha laI hI hai ate jinhAM lokAM ne usa (allAha) toM chuTTa horAM nUM ApaNA saraparasata baNA rakkhiA hai, (uha Akhade hana) ki asIM tAM uhanAM dI ibAdata isa laI karade hAM ki uha sAnUM allAha de vaddha ner3e kara deNage| allAha z2arUra hI uhanAM vicAle uhanAM sArIAM gallAM dA niber3A kara devegA jinhAM vica uha mattabheda karade hana| bezakka allAha jhUThiAM ate nA-zukariAM nUM siddhI rAha nahIM vikhAuMdA|

jekara allAha dI icchA (ApaNe laI) puttara dhApaNa dI huMdI tAM ApaNI racAI racanA viccoM jisa nUM cAhuMdA cuNa laiMdA, jada ki allAha tAM ihanAM gallAM toM pAka hai[1] uha allAha ikko-ika hai ate zakatIzAlI hai|
translations.footnotes: [1] vekho sUrata ala-bakaraha, hAzIA Aita 116/2

translations.translation: usa ne akAzAM te dharatI nUM hakka nAla sAjiA| uha rAta nUM dina vica ate dina nUM rAta vica valeTadA hai| use ne sUraja ate caMna nUM kaMma lA rakkhiA hai, hareka ika niyata sameM tIka calla rihA hai| sacca jANo, ki uha z2orAvara te baqhazaNahAra hai|

use (allAha) ne tuhAnUM sabha nUM ika hI jAna (bhAva Adama) toM paidA kItA hai, phera usa ne use toM usa dA jor3A (patanI havvA nUM) baNAiA ate use ne tuhADe laI aTTha prakAra de mavezI (nara te madIna) utAre| uha tuhAnUM tuhADIAM mAvAM de DhiDDAM vica hI ika baNatara toM magaroM dUjI baNatara vica paidA karadA hai jo ki tiMna tarhAM de hanere par3adiAM (bhAva garava) de aMdara hai, iha hai allAha, jihar3A tuhADA rabba hai, pAtazAhI use dI hai, usa toM chuTTa hora koI izaTa nahIM, phera tusIM kitthe bhaTake phirade ho? tusIM kidharoM phere jA rahe hana?

je tusIM kufara (bhAva nA-zukarI) karoge tAM iha vI yAda rakkho ki allAha vI tuhAthoM beparavAha hai, para uha ApaNe baMdiAM laI nA-zukarI (kufara) karana nUM pasaMda nahIM karadA| je tusIM zukara adA karoge tAM uha usa nUM tuhADe laI pasaMda karadA hai| ate (kiAmata dihAr3e) koI bhAra cukkaNa vAlA kise dUje dA bhAra nahIM cukkegA| jANA tusIM sAriAM ne rabba valla hI hai, phera uha tuhAnUM dassa devegA ki tusIM (saMsAra vica) kI karade rahe ho? uha tAM dilAM dA hAla taka jANadA hai|

jadoM manukkha nUM koI kazaTa pahuMcadA hai tAM uha ApaNe rabba nUM (madada laI) pukAradA hai| phera jadoM uha usa nUM ApaNe valloM koI niamata baqhazadA hai (jAM parezAnI nUM dUra kara diMdA hai) tAM uha uhanAM duAvAM nUM bhulla jAMdA hai jihar3IAM uha pahilAM kariA karadA sI, sagoM allAha de zarIka baNAuNa lagga jAMdA hai tAM jo horAM nUM vI usa de rAhoM (lokAM nUM) dUra kare| (he nabI!) tusIM usa nUM Akha dio ki tUM ApaNe isa kufara (nA-zukarI) dA kujjha dera laI (saMsArika) lAbha uThA lai| nirasaMdeha, tUM narakIAM viccoM hai|

kI (muzarika vadhIA hai jAM) uha viakatI jihar3A rAta dIAM ghar3hIAM vica sijadA karadA hove ate khar3A-khar3A (allAha dI) ibAdata karadA hai, jada ki uha paraloka toM DaradA hai ate ApaNe rabba dI rahimata dI Asa vI rakkhadA hai? (he nabI!) ihanAM toM puccho, kI giAnI ate agiAnI ikko barAbara ho sakade hana? bezakka akala vAle hI nasIhata grahiNa karade hana|

Akha dio ki he mere ImAna liAuNa vAle baMdio! ApaNe rabba toM Daro| jinhAM ne isa saMsAra vica bhale kaMma kIte uhanAM laI bhalAI hai ate (bhale kaMma karana laI) allAha dI dharatI vizAla hai| sabara karana vAliAM nUM uhanAM dA badalA binAM hisAba dittA jAvegA|
(he nabI!) Akho ki mainUM (rabba valloM) hukama hoiA hai ki maiM allAha laI baMdagI nUM nirola karade hoe use dI ibAdata karAM|
ate mainUM hukama dittA giA hai ki maiM pahilAM musalamAna (AgiAkArI) baNa jAvAM|
Akha dio ki je maiM ApaNe rabba dI nA-faramAnI karAM tAM bezakka mainUM vaDDe dina bhAva kiAmata de az2Aba toM Dara laggadA hai|
Akha dio ki maiM allAha laI ApaNI baMdagI nUM qhAlasa karade hoe use dI ibAdata karadA hAM|

(he muzariko tuhAnUM chUTa hai) tusIM usa (allAha) nUM chaDDa ke jisa dI cAhe ibAdata karo| (he nabI!) Akha dio, bezakka asalI ghATe vica tAM uha loka hana jinhAM ne ApaNe Apa nUM ate ApaNe parivArAM nUM kiAmata vAle dina ghATe vica rakkhiA| yAda rakkho ki iho asalI ghATA hai|

uhanAM (ghATe vAliAM) laI uhanAM de utte vI agga dIAM chatarIAM hoNagIAM ate uhanAM de heTha vI agga dIAM chatarIAM hoNagIAM| iho uha (az2Aba) hai jisa toM allAha ApaNe baMdiAM nUM DarA rihA hai (ate AkhadA hai ki) he mere baMdio! basa tusIM maiMtho hI Darade raho|

jihar3e loka tAgUta [2] dI pairavI karana toM bace rahe ate uhanAM ne allAha de hukamAM valla hI dhiAna dittA, uhanAM lokAM laI qhuzaqhabarIAM hana| so (he nabI!) tusIM mere neka baMdiAM nUM (jaMnata dI) qhuzaqhabarI suNA dio|
translations.footnotes: [2] vekho sUrata ala-bakaraha, hAzIA Aita 257/2

translations.translation: jihar3e loka dhiAna nAla galla suNade hana phera uha vadhIA (neka) galla dI pAlaNA karade hana, allAha valloM uhanAM nUM hI hidAita miladI hai ate iho loka akala vAle hana|
(he nabI!) bhalA jisa viakatI ’te az2Aba dA faisalA Dhukka cukkiA hove tAM kI tusIM usa nUM agga (naraka) toM chur3avA laoMge?

para uha loka jihar3e ApaNe rabba toM Dara gae uhanAM laI (jaMnata vica) ’cobAre hana uhanAM de uppara hora vI ’cobAre baNe hoe hana jada ki uhanAM de heTha nahirAM vaga rahIAM hana| (neka lokAM nAla) iha allAha dA vacana hai ate allAha kade vI ApaNe vacanAM toM phiradA nahIM|

kI tusIM nahIM vekhiA ki bezakka allAha ne akAza toM pANI utAriA phera usa nUM dharatI de cazamiAM vica dAqhala kItA phera uha usa (pANI rAhIM) khetIAM (fasalAM) kaDDhadA hai jada ki uhanAM fasalAM de anekAM hI raMga huMde hana, phera uha fasala pakka ke sukka jAMdI hai phera tusIM usa nUM pIlIAM paiMdIAM vekhade ho, phera uha usa nUM cUrA-cUrA (bhAva tUr3I) kara diMdA hai| bezakka isa vica akalamaMdA laI bahuta vaDDI nasIhata vAlI galla hai|

kI uha viakatI (kaThora dila kAfirAM vAMga ho sakadA hai) jisa dA sInA allAha ne isalAma (kabUlaNa) laI khola dittA hai ate uha ApaNe rabba valloM nUra ’te hai? so unhAM laI barabAdI hai, jinhAM de dila allAha dI yAda de mAmale vica saqhata hana| (hAM!) uhIo loka khullhama-khullhA rAhoM bhaTake hoe hana|

allAha ne sabha toM uttama kalAma (.kuraAna) utAriA hai jihar3A ajihI kitAba vica hai, jisa dIAM AitAM (aMza) raladIAM miladIAM ate vAra-vAra duharAIAM jANa vAlIAM hana| jisa nUM suNa ke uhanAM lokAM de roMgaTe (rUAM-rUAM) khar3e ho jAMde hana, jihar3e ApaNe rabba dA Dara rakkhade hana, uhanAM de sarIra te dila narama ho ke allAha dI yAda valla jhukka jAMde hana| iho (.kuraAna) allAha dI hidAita hai| uha jisa nUM cAhuMdA hai, isa (.kuraAna) rAhIM hidAita diMdA hai ate jisa nUM allAha hI rAhoM bhaTakA deve usa nUM rAha dassaNa vAlA koI nahIM|

kI uha viakatI (jaMnatI de samAna ho sakadA hai) jihar3A kiAmata dihAr3e ApaNe cihare rAhIM (bhAva DhAla baNA ke) az2Aba toM bacaNa de jatana karadA hai? ate z2AlamAM nUM kihA jAvegA ki tusIM ajja usa kamAI dA suAda lavo jo tusIM karade sI|
jihar3e loka uhanAM toM pahilAM sana uhanAM ne vI (sacce dharama isalAma nUM) jhuThalAiA sI phera uhanAM ’te utthioM az2Aba AiA jitthoM uha soca vI nahIM sakade sI|
so allAha ne uhanAM nUM saMsArika jIvana vica hI rusavAI dA suAda cakhA dittA ate paraloka dA az2Aba tAM bahuta hI vaDDA hai, kAza ki uha (inakArI) vI jANade huMde|
nirasaMdeha, asIM izakuraAna vica hara prakAra dIAM udAharaNAM biAna kItIAM hana tAM jo uha sikkhiA grahiNa kara laiNa|
.kuraAna arabI bhAzA vica hai, isa vica koI viMga-valla nahIM, tAM jo uha suNa ke Dara jANa|

allAha ika viakatI (bhAva g2ulAma) dI udAharana diMdA hai jisa de kaI mattabheda rakkhaNa vAle mAlika hana ate dUjA viakatI uha hai jihar3A kevala ika dA hI g2ulAma hai| kI uhanAM dovAM dI hAlata ika samAna ho sakadI hai? (ukkA hI nahIM) sArIAM tArIfAM allAha laI hI hana praMtU uhanAM viccoM bahute loka iha galla nahIM jANade|
(he nabI!) hakIkata iha hai ki tusIM vI maranA hai ate uha sAre vI marana vAle hana|
phera tusIM sAre kiAmata dihAr3e ApaNe rabba de haz2Ura jhagar3A karoge|
phera usa viakatI toM vaDDA z2Alima kauNa hovegA jihar3A allAha ’te jhUTha jar3e, jadoM usa de kola saccAI A jAve tAM usa nUM jhuThalAve? (kI kAfirAM laI naraka TikANA nahIM hovegA?)
jihar3A viakatI saccAI (saccA dharama) lai ke AiA te jinhAM ne usa dI puzaTI kItI, uhI loka muttakI (burAIAM toM bacaNa vAle) hana|
uhanAM laI uhanAM de rabba kola uha sabha kujjha hai, jo uha icchA karanage| neka lokAM laI iho badalA hai|
tAM jo allAha uhanAM toM uha burAIAM parAM kara deve jihar3IAM unhAM ne kItIAM hana ate uhanAM nUM uhanAM de (karamAM anusAra caMgA) badalA deve jo uha karade rahiMde sI|[3]
translations.footnotes: [3] vekho sUrata ata-taubA, hAzIA Aita 121/9

translations.translation: kI allAha ApaNe (neka) baMdiAM laI kAfI nahIM hai? iha loka (kAfira) tuhAnUM (he nabI!) allAha toM chuTTa horanAM (izaTAM toM) DarA rahe hana| jada ki jisa nUM allAha rAhoM bhaTakA deve usa nUM siddhI rAha darasAuNa vAlA vI koI nahIM|
ate jisa nUM allAha hidAita deve usa nUM koI vI rAho nahIM bhaTakA sakadA kI allAha zakatIzAlI te (ApaNe duzamanAM toM) badalA laiNa vAlA nahIM?

(he nabI!) je tusIM uhanAM toM iha puccho ki akAza te dharatI nUM kisa ne racAiA hai? tAM uha kahiNage ki allAha ne| (iha vI puccho ki) jihanAM nUM tusIM allAha nUM chaDDa ke (madada laI) pukArade ho, ratA dasso, uha kI karade hana? puccho! jekara allAha mainUM koI takalIfa pahuMcAuNA cAve tAM kI uha (tuhADe jhUThe izaTa) mainU usa dI pahuMcAI hoI takalIfa toM dUra kara sakade hana? jAM jekara uha mere utte koI mihara karanA cAve tAM kI uha usa dI mihara nUM roka sakade hana? (he nabI!) tusIM Akha dio ki mere laI tAM allAha hI batherA hai, bharosA karana vAle tAM use (allAha) ’te hI bharosA karade hana|[4]
translations.footnotes: [4] vekho sUrata yUsufa, hAzIA Aita 67/12

translations.translation: (he nabI!) kaho ki he merI kauma! tusIM ApaNI thAM ’te bhAva samajha anusAra karama karade raho, maiM ApaNA kaMma karadA rahAMgA| chetI hI tusIM (hakIkata nUM) jANa laoge (ki kauNa saccA hai)|
ki saMsAra vica hINatA bhariA az2Aba kisa utte AvegA ate sadA rahiNa vAlA (paraloka dA) az2Aba kisa ’te uttaradA hai|

(he nabI!) bezakka asIM tuhADe ’te saccAI ’te AdhArita iha kitAba (.kuraAna) sAre lokAM (dI hidAita) laI nAz2ila faramAI hai| so huNa jihar3A vI siddhe rAha ApaNAvegA, ApaNe hI bhale laI ApaNAvegA ate jihar3A rAhoM bhaTaka jAve, usa dI gumarAhI dA doza use laI hai, tusIM uhanAM de z2iMmevAra nahIM|[5]
translations.footnotes: [5] vekho sUrata Ale-imarAna, hAzIA Aita 85/3

translations.translation: allAha hI marana sameM prANa kaDDhadA hai ate jinhAM nUM hAlAM mauta nahIM, uhanAM dI rUha (jAna) nUM usa dI nIMdara vele kaDDhadA hai, phera uha usa (rUha) nUM roka laiMdA hai jisa laI usa ne mauta dA faisalA kItA huMdA hai ate dUjiAM (rUhAM) nUM ika niyata sameM laI vApasa bheja diMdA hai| bezakka soca vicAra karana vAliAM laI isa vica batherIAM nizAnIAM hana|

kI uhanAM (muzarikAM) ne allAha toM chuTTa horAM nUM sifArazI baNA rakkhiA hai? (he nabI!) tusIM kahi dio ki bhAveM uha (sifArazI) kujjha vI adhikAra nahIM rakkhade ate nA hI uhanAM nUM (kise prakAra dI) akala-samajha hai| (kI phera vI uha sifArazI hana?)
(he nabI!) tusIM Akha dio ki sArIAM sifArazAM use (allAha) de adhikAra vica hana| akAzAM te dharatI utte use dA rAja hai, tusIM sAre (marana magaroM) use valla paratAe jAvoge|

jadoM ikko ikka allAha dI caracA kItI jAMdI hai tAM uhanAM de dila sar3aNa lagga jAMde hana jihar3e paraloka ’te vizavAsa nahIM rakkhade, jadoM isa (allAha) toM chuTTa horanAM (izaTAM) dI caracA kItI jAMdI hai tAM uha bahuta qhuza huMde hana|[6]
translations.footnotes: [6] vekho sUrata ala-bakaraha, hAzIA Aita 165/2

translations.translation: (he nabI!) tusIM Akho ki he allAha! akAzAM te dharatI de racanAhAra! gupata te pragaTa de jANanahAra! tUM hI (kiAmata dihAr3e) ApaNe baMdiAM de uhanAM mAmaliAM vicAle faisalA karegA jinhAM vica uha matabheda kariA karade sI|

jekara uhanAM z2AlamAM de kole uha sabha kujjha hove jihar3A dharatI utte (dhana-daulata) hai ate iMnA hI hora hove tAM vI uha bhair3e az2Aba toM bacaNa laI sArA kujjha chuDavAI vajoM deNa laI tiAra ho jANage| uhanAM de sAhamaNe allAha valloM uha (az2Aba) pragaTa hovegA jisa dA uhanAM nUM citta-cetA vI nahIM sI| [7]
translations.footnotes: [7] vekho sUrata Ale-imarAna, hAzIA Aita 91/3

translations.translation: uhanAM laI uhanAM dIAM karatUtAM dIAM burAIAM (bhAva bhair3e siTTa) pragaTa ho jANagIAM ate jisa (az2Aba) nUM uha makhaula samajhade sI, uha (naraka) uhanAM nUM ghera lavegI|

(manukkha dA tAM uha hAla hai ki) jadoM manukkha nUM koI takalIfa pujjadI hA tAM uha sAnUM (madada laI) pukAradA hai, jadoM asIM usa nUM ApaNe valloM koI inAma baqhaza daIe tAM AkhaNa laggadA hai ki iha (inAma) tAM mainUM ApaNe giAna (sUjha-bUjha) rAhIM miliA hai| (nahIM!) sagoM iha inAma tAM ika az2amAiza vajoM hai, praMtU vadhere loka ajihe hana jihar3e giAna nahIM rakkhade|
ihanAM toM pahilAM de loka vI iho galla kahiMde sI para uhanAM dA kItA kamAiA uhanAM de kujjha vI kaMma nahIM AiA|

so uhanAM nUM uhanAM karatUtAM dI saz2A milI (jihar3IAM uha karade sI) ate jihar3e ihanAM viccoM z2Alama hana uhanAM nUM uhanAM de kIte dI saz2A chetI hI milegI| iha (allAha nUM) Ajiz2a (bevasa) nahIM kara sakade|

kI uha nahIM jANade ki allAha jisa laI cAhuMdA hai riz2aka vica khullha paidA kara diMdA hai ate (cAhe tAM) taMga vI kara diMdA hai| bezakka isa vica ImAna rakkhaNa vAliAM laI batherIAM hI nizAnIAM hana|

(he nabI! allAha dA faramAna hai ki) he mere uha baMdio! jinhAM ne ApaNIAM jAnAM nAla dhakkA kItA hai (bhAva gunAha kIte hana), uha allAha dI rahimata toM nirAza nA hoNa| allAha sAre gunAhAM nUM baqhaza deNa vAlA hai| uha vaDDA baqhazaNahAra te rahima karana vAlA hai|[8]
translations.footnotes: [8] vekho sUrata ata-taubA, hAzIA Aita 121/9 ate vekho sUrata ala-furakAna, hAzIA Aita 70/25

translations.translation: tusIM sAre ApaNe pAlaNahAra valla mur3a Ao ate use de AgiAkArI baNa jAo, isa toM pahilAM ki tuhADe utte acaNaceta koI az2Aba A jAve ate phera tuhADI koI sahAitA vI nahIM kItI jAvegI|

ate tusIM usa uccatama cIz2a (.kuraAna) dI pairavI karo jihar3I tuhADe valla tuhADe pAlaNahAra ne nAz2ila kItI hai, isa toM pahilAM ki tuhADe utte acaNaceta koI az2Aba A jAve ate tuhAnUM patA vI nA lagge|
(phera iMja nA hove ki) koI viakatI iha kahe ki hAe afasosa! maine allAha dI baMdagI karana dA hakka adA karana vica vadhIkI kItI hai, sagoM maiM tAM makhaula karana vAliAM nAla hI zAmila rihA|
jAM uha kahe ki je allAha mainUM hidAita diMdA tAM maiM vI parahez2agArAM (bhAva rabba dA Dara-bhau rakkhaNa vAliAM) viccoM huMdA|
jAM az2Aba vekha ke Akhe ki kAza! kise tarhAM merA (saMsAra vica) mur3a jANA ho jAve tAM maiM vI neka lokAM viccoM ho jAvAM|

(allAha pachatAvA karana vAle viakatI nUM AkhegA) tainUM saz2A kiuM nA mile, jadoM tere kola merIAM AitAM (hidAitAM) pahuMcIAM tAM tUM uhanAM nUM jhuThalAiA te haMkAra kItA| tUM tAM kAfirAM viccoM sI|
ate jinhAM lokAM ne allAha ’te jhUTha ghar3hiA sI, tusIM vekhoge ki kiAmata vAle dina uhanAM de mUMha kAle ho gae hoNage| kI ghamaMDIAM dA TikANA naraka nahIM hai?
ate jinhAM ne parahez2agArI kItI bhAva burAIAM toM bacAo kItA, allAha uhanAM dI safalatA de kArana (saz2A toM) bacA lavegA, nA tAM uhanAM nUM koI kazaTa hovegA ate nA hI koI Dara-bhai hovegA|
allAha hareka cIz2a dA paidA karana vAlA hai ate uhI hareka cIz2a dI dekha bhAla vI karadA hai|
use kola akAza te dharatI de khaz2AniAM dIAM kuMjIAM hana| jinhAM ne vI allAha dIAM AitAM (.kuraAnI hukamAM) dA inakAra kItA uhI ghATe vica rahiNa vAle hana|
(he nabI!) tusIM Akha dio ki he jAhilo! kI tusIM mainUM allAha toM chuTTa dUjiAM dI ibAdata karana laI Akhade ho?

jada ki (he muhaMmada sa:!) tuhADe valla vI ate tuhAthoM pahilAM de sAre nabIAM nUM iho vahI bhejI jA cukkI hai ki je tusIM ziraka kItA tAM tuhADe sAre hI kIte karAe kaMma viaratha jANage ate tusIM ghATe vica rahiNa vAliAM viccoM ho jAvoge|
tusIM allAha dI hI baMdagI karo ate dhaMnavAdIAM viccoM ho jAo|

ate uhanAM (muzarikAM) ne allAha dI kadara nahIM kItI jiveM ki usa dI kadara karana dA hakka hai| kiAmata vAle dina sArI dharatI usa dI muTThI vica hovegI ate akAza usa de sajje hattha vica valeTe hoe hoNage| uha pAka hai ate usa ziraka toM saravuca hai jo iha loka karade hana|

jadoM sUra (narasiMghA) vica phUMka mArI jAvegI tAM jo koI vI (jIva-jaMtU) akAza te dharatI vica hai, uha sAre behoza ho jANage, chuTTa uhanAM toM jinhAM nUM allAha jiUMdA rakkhe| phera jadoM dUjI vAra usa vica phUMka mArI jAvegI tAM uha acaNaceta khar3he ho ke vekhaNa lagga paiNage|

ate dharatI ApaNe rabba de nUra nAla lizakA mAregI, karama-pattarIAM (rabba de haz2Ura) peza kItIAM, jANagIAM paig2aMbarAM te gavAhAM nUM hAz2ara kItA jAvegA ate lokAM vicAle niAM-pUravaka faisalA kItA jAvegA ate unhAM ’te koI z2ulama nahIM hovegA|
ate jisa viakatI ne jo vI karama kItA ru usa nUM usa dA pUrA-pUrA badalA dittA jAvegA| lokI jo kujjha vI karade hana uha usa nUM bhalI-bhAMta jANadA hai|

(faisaliAM picchoM) kAfirAM de Tole de Tole naraka valla hakke jANage, jadoM uha (kAfira) usa de ner3e pahuMcaNage tAM usa de bUhe uhanAM laI kholha ditte jANage ate utthe de pahiredAra uhanAM toM pucchaNage, kI tuhADe kola tuhADe viccoM rasUla nahIM Ae sI jihar3e tuhAnUM tuhADe rabba dIAM AitAM par3ha ke saNAuMde sana ate tuhAnUM usa (kiAmata) dina dI milaNI toM DarAuMde sana? uha (kAfira) kahiNage ki hAM! (Ae sana)| huNa az2Aba dA faisalA kAfirAM laI ThIka siddha ho giA hai|[9]
translations.footnotes: [9] vekho sUrata Ale-imarAna, hAzIA Aita 85/3

translations.translation: kihA jAvegA ki huNa tusIM naraka de bUhiAM vica praveza kara jAo, jitthe tusIM sadA rahoge| so ghamaMDIAM dA (iha) TikANA bahuta hI bhair3A hai|

jihar3e loka (saMsAra vica) ApaNe rabba toM Darade sI uhanAM dIAM TolIAM dIAM TolIAM jaMnata valla ghallIAM jANagIAM| jadoM uha usa (jaMnata) de ner3e jANage tAM usa de bUhe khullha jANage ate utthe de pahiredAra uhanAM nUM AkhaNage ki tuhADe ’te salAma hove, tusIM (gunAhAM toM) pAka ho| huNa tusIM sadA laI isa savaraga vica dAqhala ho jAo|

uha neka loka kahiNage ki allAha dA zukara hai jisa ne apaNA vacana sacca kara vikhAiA ate sAnUM isa (savaraga) dI dharatI dA vArasa baNA dittA, huNa asIM jaMnata vica jitthe cAhIe utthe hI ApaNA TikANA baNA sakade hAM| so neka amala karana vAliAM laI kiMnA sohaNA badalA hai|

ate tusIM farizatiAM nUM allAha de taqhata de Ale-duAle gherA pAIM vekhoge, jada ki uha ApaNe rabba dI tasabIha kara rahe hoNage ate lokAM vicAle inasAfa nAla faisalA kItA jAvegA ate kihA jAvegA ki sArIAM tArIfAM allAha laI hana, jihar3A sAre jahAnAM dA pAlaNahAra hai|
hA, mIma|
iha kitAba (.kuraAna) dA utaranA usa allAha valloM hai jihar3A vaDDA z2orAvara ate sabha kujjha jANana vAlA hai|

gunAhAM nUM baqhazaNa vAlA ate taubA nUM kabUla karana vAlA hai| karar3I saz2A deNa vAlA ate vaDDA dAtA dAtAra hai| usa (allAha) toM chuTTa hora koI (saccA) izaTa nahIM, sAriAM ne use valla mur3a jANA hai|
allAha dIAM AitAM (.kuraAna) bAre kevala inakArI hI jhagar3ade hana| so uhanAM (inakArIAM) dI zahirAM vica callata phirata tuhAnUM kise dhokhe vica nA pA deve|

ihanAM (makke vAliAM) toM pahilAM nUha dI kauma ne ate usa de magaroM dUjIAM kaumAM ne vI (paig2aMbarAM nUM) jhuThalAiA sI| hara ummata ne ApaNe rasUla nUM griphatAra karana dA irAdA kItA ate uhanAM nAla aNahakkA jhagar3A kItA tAM jo hakka nUM (jhUTha rAhIM) nIvAM vikhaAiA jAve| phera maiMne (bhAva allAha ne ika dina) uhanAM nUM nappa liA| so vekho! mere valloM uhanAM nUM kiho jihI saz2A dittI gaI|
ise tarhAM uhanAM lokAM utte tuhADe rabba dA hukama DhukavAM siddha hoiA, jinhAM ne (rasUlAM dA) inakAra kItA sI| nirasaMdeha, uha sabha narakI hana|

jihar3e farizatiAM ne rabba de araza (siMghAsana) nUM cukkiA hoiA hai ate uha jihar3e usa de Ale-duAle (sevA laI) rahiMde hana, uha ApaNe rabba dI zalAghA de nAlo-nAla usadI pAkI biAna karade hana ate usa ’te ImAna rakkhade hana ate ImAna vAliAM laI baqhaziza dIAM duAvAM karade hana| uha Akhade hana ki he sADe pAlaNahAra! tUM ApaNI mihara te giAna sadakA hara cIz2a ’te chAiA hoiA hai| so tUM uhanAM lokAM nUM baqhaza de jihar3e taubA karade hana ate (tere valla AuNa vAle) rAha ’te calade hana, tUM uhanAM nUM naraka de az2Aba toM bacA lai|

(farizate aradAsa karade hana) he sADe rabbA! tUM uhanAM (ImAna vAliAM) nUM sadIvI bAg2AM vica dAqhala kara jisa dA tUM uhanAM nUM bacana dittA hoiA hai ate uhanAM de pio, dAde, patanIAM ate aulAdAM viccoM vI jihar3e neka amala karade hana (savaraga vica lai jA)| bezakka tUM hI z2orAvara te hikamata vAlA hai|

(iha vI benatI hai ki) ihanAM (ImAna vAliAM) nUM burAIAM toM bacA ke rakkha, saccI galla tAM iha hai ki usa dina (kiAmata vele) taine jisa nUM burAIAM (dI saz2A) toM bacA liA hakIkata vica taine usa utte rahima kItA, iho vaDDI kAmayAbI hai|

bezakka jinhAM lokAM ne kufara kItA sI uhanAM nUM pukAra ke AkhiA jAvegA ki ajja tuhAnUM jinnA bhArA g2ussA ApaNe Apa ’te A rihA hai isa toM kite vaddha allAha nUM tuhADe ’te g2ussA usa sameM AuMdA sI jadoM (saMsAra vica) tuhAnUM ImAna liAuNa laI kihA jAMdA sI para tusIM inakAra kara diMde sI|

phera uha (kAfira) AkhaNage ki he sADe pAlaNahAra! tUM sAnUM do vArI mauta dittI ate do vArI hI jIvana dittA, asIM ApaNe gunAhAM dA ikarAra karade hAM, kI huNa isa (naraka viccoM) bacaNa dA koI rasatA hai?

(uttara vica kihA jAvegA ki) tuhAnUM iha az2Aba (saz2A) isa laI hai ki jadoM tuhAnUM ikko-ikka allAha valla bulAiA jAMdA sI tAM tusIM (tauhIda dA) inakAra karade sI| je usa (allAha) de nAla kise nUM zarIka kItA jAMdA tAM tusIM (usa zarIka) nUM maMna laiMde sI| huNa tAM iha (saz2A dA) hukama usa allAha valloM hai jo saravaucca te mahAna hai|

uhIo tAM (allAha) hai jihar3A tuhAnUM ApaNIAM nizAnIAM vikhAuMdA hai ate tuhADe laI akAza toM riz2aka bhejadA hai, para ihanAM (nizAnIAM) toM sikkhiA kevala uhIo viakatI laiMdA hai jihar3A (allAha valla) mur3a AuMdA hai|
so (he nabI!) tusIM allAha laI ApaNI baMdagI nUM vizeza karade hoe use nUM hI (madada laI) pukAro bhAveM kAfirAM nUM kiMnA hI bhair3A lagge|

uha (allAha) ucce darajiAM vAlA ate araza (taqhata) dA mAlika hai| uha ApaNe baMdiAM viccoM jisa ’te cAhuMdA hai ApaNe hukama nAla vahI bhejadA hai tAM jo uha (nabI) lokAM nUM milaNI vAle dina (kiAmata) toM DarAve|

jisa dina uha sAre kabarAM viccoM bAhira nikala AuNage ate uhanAM dI koI vI galla allAha toM lukI hoI nahIM rahegI (usa dina uhanAM toM pucchiA jAvegA ki) ajja pAtazAhI kisa dI hai? (uttara dittA jAvegA) kevala ikko ika sarava-sattAvAna allAha dI hI hai|
ajja hara ika jAna nUM usa dI karanI dA badalA dittA jAvegA, ajja kise ’te koI z2ulama nahIM hovegA| bezakka allAha chetI hI hisAba laiNa vAlA hai|

(he nabI!) tusIM ihanAM (lokAM) nUM ner3e AuNa vAle dina toM DarAo jadoM kAlaje mUMha nUM A rahe hoNage| usa dina z2AlamAM dA nA koI sahAI hovegA te nA koI sifArazI hovegA ki jisa dI galla maMnI jAve|
uha (allAha) corI corI vekhaNa vAlIAM naz2arAM nUM ate dilAM vica lukIAM hoIAM gallAM nUM jANadA hai|

allAha hakka anusAra niA karegA ate jinhAM nUM uha (kAfira) loka usa (allAha) nUM chaDDa ke pukArade hana, uha koI vI faisalA nahIM kara sakade| bezakka allAha hI (harake galla nUM) suNana vAlA te (hareka cIz2a nUM) vekhaNa vAlA hai|

kI uha (inakArI) loka dharatI ’te ture phire nahIM ki uha vekha laiMde ki uhanAM toM pahile inakArIAM dA aMta kiveM hoiA sI| uha zakatI vica vI ate dharatI utte ApaNIAM nizAnIAM chaDDaNa vica vI ihanAM nAloM kite vAdhU sana| phera allAha ne uhanAM nUM uhanAM de pApAM kArana nappa liA ate uhanAM nUM allAha de az2Aba toM bacAuNa vAlA koI nahIM sI|

iha (saz2A) uhanAM nUM isa kArana hoI sI ki uhanAM de rasUla uhanAM kola sapazaTa te pratakkha nizAnIAM laike Ae sana, para uhanAM ne savIkAra nahIM kItA, aMta allAha ne uhanAM nUM nappa liA| bezakka uhIo zakatIzAlI ate karar3A az2Aba deNa vAlA hai|
asIM mUsA nUM ApaNe valloM (nabIM hoNa dIAM) nizAnIAM ate khullhIAM dalIlAM deke bhejiA|
(jadoM mUsA) firaauna, hAmAna ate kArUna valla AiA tAM uhanAM ne AkhiA ki (uha mUsA tAM) jAdUgara ate jhUThA hai|

phera jadoM uha (mUsA) sADe valloM (bhAva allAha valloM) uhanAM kola hakka (saccAdIna) lai ke AiA tAM uhanAM ne AkhiA ki jihar3e vI isa (mUsA) de nAla ImAna liAe hana uhanAM de puttarAM nUM mAra dio ate dhIAM nUM jiuMdIAM rakkho| para inakArIAM dI iha cAla tAM ukkA hI asafala rahI|

firaauna ne ApaNe sAthIAM nUM AkhiA ki mainUM chaDDa dio ki maiM mUsA nUM katala kara davAM| isa (mUsA) nUM cAhIdA hai ki ApaNe rabba nUM (madada laI) bulA lave| mainUM tAM iha vI Dara hai ki iha tuhADA dharama hI nA badala deve jAM deza vica koI fasAda hI nA karA deve|
mUsA ne kihA ki maiM hareka usa haMkAre hoe toM tuhADe rabba dI zarana vica AuMdA hAM, jihar3A puccha-giccha vAle dina (kiAmata) ’te ImAna nahIM rakkhadA|

firaauna de parivAra viccoM ika momina puraza, jisa ne ApaNe ImAna nUM lukAiA hoiA sI, AkhaNa lagiA, kI tusIM isa viakatI nUM kevala isa laI katala karade ho ki uha kahiMdA hai ki merA rabba allAha hai ate tuhADe kola tuhADe rabba valloM (nabI hoNa dIAM) khullhIAM dalIlAM lai ke AiA hai? je uha jhUThA hai tAM usa dA jhUTha Apa use ’te A paegA hai ate je uha saccA hai tAM (az2Aba) dA kujjha hissA tuhAnUM vI milegA jisa dA uha tuhAnUM vAadA karadA hai| bezakka allAha usa viakatI nUM siddhI rAha nahIM vikhAuMdA jihar3A (nA-faramAnI vica) haddoM TappaNa vAlA hove ate (nAla hI) jhUThA vI hove|

(use viakatI ne AkhiA) he merI kauma! ajja rAja tuhADA hI hai kiuM jo dharatI ’te tusIM hI g2aliba (bhArU) ho| phera sAnUM allAha de az2Aba toM kauNa bacAvegA je uha sADe ’te A DiigaA? firaauna boliA ki maiM tAM tuhAnUM uhIo bacAo vAlA rAha vikhAuMdA hAM, jo maiM Apa vekha rihA hAM maiM tAM bhalAI valla hI tuhADI agavAI karadA hAM|

jihar3A viakatI ImAna liAiA sI usa ne kihA ki he merI kauma vAlio! mainUM tAM isa galla dA Dara hai ki tuhADe ’te uhI dina (dA az2Aba) nA A jAve jihar3A (mAr3A samAM) hora ummatAM utte (rasUlAM nUM jhuThalAuNa kArana) A cukkiA hai|
jiveM nUha dI kauma, Ada, samUda te uhanAM toM bAada vAle lokAM dA hAla hoiA sI| allAha ApaNe baMdiAM utte kise prakAra dA z2ulama nahIM karanA cAhuMdA|
ate kihA ki he merI kauma vAlio! maiM tuhADe utte usa pukArana vAle dina (kiAmata) toM vI DaradA hAM|

jisa dina tusIM piTTha vikhAke bhajjoge phera tuhAnUM allAha (de az2Aba) toM bacAuNa vAlA koI nahIM hovegA ate (saccI galla iha hai ki) jisa nUM allAha hI gumarAha kara deve usa nUM koI vI hidAita deNa vAlA nahIM|

bezakka isa (mUsA) toM pahilAM tuhADe kola yUsufa vI (nabI hoNa dIAM) dalIlAM lai ke AiA sI, phera vI tusIM usa de bAre zakka vica hI rahe jo uha tuhADe kola nizAnIAM liAiA sI| itthoM taka ki jadoM uha (yUsufa) dA akAla calANA ho giA tAM tusIM AkhiA sI ki iha toM magaroM allAha huNa kise rasUla nUM nahIM bhejegA| allAha usa viakatI nUM ise tarhAM gumarAha karadA hai jihar3A haddoM TappaNa vAlA hai te zakkI hai|

jihar3e loka allAha valloM AuNa vAlIAM AitAM (nizAnIAM) vica jihar3IAM uhanAM kola AiAM hana binAM kise dalIla toM hI jhagar3ade hana, uhanAM dA iha vatIrA allAha ate ImAna vAliAM dIAM naz2arAM vica g2ussA cAr3haNa vAlA hai| ise laI allAha hara haMkAre hoe sarakaza (bAg2I) de dila utte ThappA lA diMdA hai (tAM jo samajha soca nA sake)|
firaauna ne kihA ki he hAmAna! tUM mere laI ika uccA bhavana usAra de tAM jo maiM (usa ੳtte car3r3ha ke) gahAM tIka pahuMca jAvAM|

akAza dIAM rAhAM tIka (pahuMca jAvAM), tAM jo maiM mUsA de rabba nUM jhAta mAra ke vekha lavAM| bezakka maiM tAM usa nUM jhUThA samajhadA hAM, isa tarhAM firaauna laI usa dIAM bhair3IAM karatUtAM zobhAvAna baNA dittIAM ate usa nUM siddhe rAhoM roka dittA giA ate firaauna dI hareka cAla asaphala ho ke rahi gaI|
use ImAna liAuNa vAle viakatI ne kihA ki he merI kauma! tusIM sAre mere picche laggo, maiM tuhAnUM bhalAI vAlI rAha valla lai jAvAMgA|
he merI kauma vAlio! iha saMsArika jIvana tAM thor3he sameM laI hai jada ki sadA laI paraloka vica hI rahiNA hai|

jisa ne vI koI pApa kItA tAM usa pApa anusAra hI usa nUM badalA (saz2A) dittA jAvegA ate jisa ne koI nekI kItI hovegI bhAveM uha marada hove bhAveM aurata, para hoNa ImAna vAle tAM iho loka savaraga vica jANage ate uhanAM nUM aNagiNata riz2aka dittA jAvegA|
ate usa ne iha vI kihA ki he merI kauma! merA isa vica kI lAbha hai? maiM tAM tuhAnUM naraka toM mukatI valla bulA rihA hAM jada ki tusIM mainUM agga valla bulA rahe ho|

tusIM mainUM isa valla bulA rahe ho ki maiM allAha dA inakAra karAM ate usa de nAla usa nUM sAMjhI baNAvAM jisa nUM maiM jANadA vI nahIM ate maiM tuhAnUM vaDDe z2orAvara te baqhazaNahAra (izaTa) valla bulA rihA hAM|

iha vI galla sacca hai ki tusIM jinhAM valla mainUM bulA rahe ho nA tAM uha saMsAra vica pukArana de yoga hana ate nA hI Aqhirata vica| iha galla vI lAz2amI hai ki sADA sabha dA parataNA allAha valla hI hai ate nirasaMdeha, haddA nUM TappaNa vAle (bhAva ulaMghaNAkArI) hI naraka vica jANa vAle hana|

chetI hI (bhAva kiAmata vAle dina) tusIM merIAM uhanAM gallAM nUM yAda karoge jo maiM tuhAnUM kahi rihA hAM| maiM ApaNA mAmalA allAha de havAle karadA hAM| bezakka allAha tAM sAre baMdiAM nUM vekha rihA hai|
phera asIM uhanAM dIAM bhair3IAM cAlAM toM usa ImAna vAle nUM bacA liA ate firaaunIAM nUM atiaMta karar3e az2Aba ne ghera liA|
uha (az2Aba) naraka dI agga hai jisa de sAhamaNe uhanAM nUM savere-zAma peza kItA jAMdA hai ate jisa dina kiAmata AvegI (hukama hovegA ki) firaaunIAM nUM atiaMta karar3e az2Aba vica suTTa dio|

jadoM uha naraka vica ika dUje nAla jhagar3aNage tAM kamaz2ora (hINe) loka haMkAra karana vAliAM nUM AkhaNage ki asIM tAM (saMsAra vica) tuhADe picche lagge hoe sI| kI tusIM sAthoM agga dA kujjha bhAga haTA sakade ho?
ghamaMDI loka AkhaNage ki asIM sAre hI isa agga vica (sar3a rahe) hAM| bezakka allAha ne ApaNe baMdiAM vicAle faisalA kara dittA hai|
jadoM uha sAre loka jihar3e agga vica hoNage tAM uha naraka de pahiredArAM nUM AkhaNage ki tusIM ApaNe rabba nUM benatI karo ki uha sADe az2Aba vica kevala ika dina laI kamI kara deve|

uha (farizate) pucchaNage, kI tuhADe kola tuhADe rasUla khullhIAM nizAnIAM lai ke nahIM Ae sana? uha (narakI) AkhaNage kiuM nahIM?uha (farizate) AkhaNage ki phera tusIM Ape hI (allAha nUM) benatI karo jada ki kAfirAM dIAM sArIAM benatIAM viaratha hI jANagIAM|
bezakka asIM ApaNe paig2aMbarAM dI ate ImAna vAliAM dI madada saMsAra vica vI karade hAM ate usa (kiAmata vAle) dina vI karAMge jadoM gavAha (vajoM farizate te paig2aMbara) khar3he hoNage|
usa dina z2AlamAM nUM uhanAM dA bahAnAM kise kaMma nahIM AvegA sagoM uhanAM laI z2alAlata hI z2alAlata hovegI ate uhanAM laI bhair3A TikANA hovegA|
bezakka asIM mUsA nUM hidAita (tauraita) baqhazI ate banI-isarAIla nUM usa kitAba dA vArasa baNAiA|
(iha kitAba) akala vAliAM laI hidAita ate nasIhata hai|

so (he nabI!) tusIM sabara karo, bezakka allAha dA vAadA saccA hai| ApaNIAM bhullAM dI baqhaziza laI duAvAM maMgo ate savere-zAma (hara vele) ApaNe pAlaNahAra dI vaDiAI de nAla usa dI tasabIha biAna karo|[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] vekho sUrata ana-nisA, hAzIA Aita 106/4

translations.translation: jihar3e lokI allAha dIAM AitAM (nizAnIAM) vica, jihar3IAM uhanAM kola A cukkIAM hana, binAM kise dalIla toM jhagar3ade hana uhanAM de dilAM vica vaDiAI dA bhUta savAra hai, uha usa (vaDiAI) taka pahuMca vI nahIM sakade| so tusIM (uhanAM dIAM zarAratAM toM) allAha dI panAha maMgade raho| bezakka uhIo suNana vAlA ate vekhaNa vAlA hai|
akAza te dharatI dI racanA manukkhI racanAM toM kite vaddha vaDDA kaMma hai, praMtU vadhere loka nahIM jANade|

annA ate sujAkhA iko barAbara nahIM ho sakade ate nA hI uha loka jihar3e ImAna liAe ate uhanAM ne bhale kaMma vI kIte ate burAI karana vAle, barAbara hana| tusIM loka bahuta hI ghaTTa nasIhata grahiNa karade ho|
isa vica kiAmata dI ghar3I z2arUra AvegI, praMtU vadhere loka isa galla nUM nahIM maMnade|

tuhADe pAlaNahAra dA faramAna hai ki mainUM hI pukAro, maiM tuhADIAM duAvAM nUM kabUla karAMgA| sacca jANoM ki jihar3e loka merI baMdagI karana toM mUMha mor3ade hana uha loka z2alIla hoke naraka vica praveza karanage|

allAha uha hai jisa ne tuhADe laI rAta baNAI tAM jo tusIM isa vica ArAma kara sakoM ate dina baNAiA tAM jo tusIM vekha sakoM| allAha ApaNe baMdiAM ’te kripAlatA karana vAlA hai para bahute loka zukara adA nahIM karade|
iho allAha tuhADA rabba hai ate hareka cIz2a dA paidA karana vAlA hai, isa toM chuTTa hora koI saccA izaTa nahIM| tusIM kiddharoM bahikAe jA rahe ho?
ise prakAra uha loka vI bahike phirade rahe, jihar3e rabba dIAM AitAM (AdezAM) dA inakAra kariA karade sana|

allAha uha hai jisa ne dharatI nUM tuhADe laI Thahirana vAlI thAM ate akAza nUM chatta baNAiA| usa ne tuhADIAM zakalAM baNAIAM ate bahuta hI sohaNIAM baNAIAM| usa ne tuhAnUM pAkIz2AM te sAfa sutharA riz2aka dittA| allAha tuhADA pAlaNahAra hai ate bahuta hI barakatAM vAlA hai ate sAre jahAna dA pAlaNahAra hai|

uha (sadA laI) jiUMdA hai, usa toM chuTTa hora koI (saccA) izaTa nahIM| so tusIM ApaNI baMdagI nUM usa laI qhAlisa karade hoe use nUM (madada laI) pukAro| sArIAM sifatAM allAha laI hI hana jihar3A sAre jahAnAM dA rabba hai|

(he nabI!) tusIM Akha dio ki mainUM uhanAM sabha dI ibAdata karana toM roka dittA hai ki maiM uhanAM dI ibAdata karAM jinhAM nUM tusIM allAha toM chuTTa pukArade ho, jada ki mere kola rabba valloM sapazaTa nizAnIAM A cukkIAM hana ate mainUM iha hukama hoiA hai ki maiM sAre jahAnA de rabba dA AgiAkArI baNa ke rahAM|

(allAha) uhIo hai jisa ne tuhAnUM (pahilI vAra) miTTI toM sAjiA, phera vIraja toM, phera lahU de lothar3e toM, phera uha tuhAnUM bacce de rUpa vica (mAM de garabha ’coM) kaDDhadA hai, phera tuhAnUM vadhAuMdA hai tAM jo tusIM ApaNI pUrI javAnI nUM pahuMca jAo, phera (vadhAuMdA hai) tAM jo tusIM buDDhe ho jAo| tuhADe viccoM kujjha isa (buDhApe) toM pahilAM hI pUre ho jAMde hana| (bhAva mara jAMde ho) ate (iha sabha isa laI hai) tAM jo tusIM ApaNI niyata umara taka pahuMca jAo ate tusIM (hakIkata nUM) samajha sako|[2]
translations.footnotes: [2] vekho sUrata ala-hajja, hAzIA Aita 5/22

translations.translation: uhI jIvana diMdA hai, uhI mauta diMdA hai phera jadoM uha kise kaMma nUM karanA cAhuMdA hai tAM kevala iho kahiMdA hai ki ho jA te uha ho jAMdA hai|
kI tusIM uhanAM nUM nahIM vekhiA ki jihar3e allAha diAM AitAM (.kuraAna) vica jhagar3ade hana? uha kidharoM phirAe jA rahe ho|
jihanAM lokAM ne isa kitAba (.kuraAna) nUM jhuThalAiA ate uhanAM (sikkhiAvAM) nUM jhuThalAiA, jinhAM nAla asIM ApaNe rasUlAM nUM bhejiA sI uha chetI hI (hakIkata nUM) jANa laiNage|
jadoM uhanAM dIAM garadanAM vica saMgala te (pairAM vica) ber3IAM hoNagIAM jinhAM nAla jakar3a ke uha ghasITe jANage|
(pahilAM) uha ubbalade hoe pANI vica ate phera (naraka dI) agga vica suTTa ditte jANage|
phera uhanAM toM pucchiA jAvegA ki jinhAM nUM tusIM (rabba dA) zarIka baNAuMde sI ajja uha kitthe hana?

allAha toM chuTTa dUje izaTa kitthe hana? uha (muzarika) AkhaNage ki uha tAM sAthoM guAca gae| asIM tAM isa toM pahilAM hI (allAha toM chuTa) kise nUM vI nahIM pukArade sI| allAha kAfirAM nUM ise tarhAM kurAhe pAuMdA hai|
kihA jAvegA ki tuhADA iha bhair3A aMta isa laI hoiA hai ki tusIM dharatI ’te ghamaMDa karade sI ate (iha aMta) isa laI vI hai ki tusIM Akar3ade sI|
huNa tusIM naraka vica sadA rahiNa laI usa de bUhiAM vica dAqhalA ho jAo| uhanAM haMkAriAM laI kiMnAM bhair3A TikANA hai|

so he nabI! tusIM dhIraja rakkho, bezakka allAha dA vAadA saccA huMdA hai| je asIM cAhIe tAM tuhAnUM usa az2Aba viccoM kujjha vikhA daIe jisa dA asIM ihanAM kAfirAM nAla vAadA kItA hai, jAM asIM isa toM pahilAM hI tuhAnUM mauta de daIe| aMta nUM uha sAre sADe valla hI paratAe jANage|

he nabI! bezakka asIM tuhAthoM pahilAM vI bahuta sAre rasUla bheja cukke hAM jinhAM viccoM kujjha (rasUlAM) de hAlAta asIM tuhAnUM dassa cukke hAM ate kaIAM de hAlAta tuhAnUM biAna vI nahIM kIte| kise vI rasUla dI iha tAkata nahIM sI ki uha koI mauajaz2A (nizAnI) allAha dI AgiA toM binAM lai Ave| jadoM allAha dA az2Aba AuNa dA hukama A giA, phera uhanAM dA inasAfa nAla faisalA kara dittA giA te usa sameM jhUThe loka ghATe vica rahe|
allAha uha hai jisa ne tuhADe laI mavezI paidA kIte, inhAM viccoM kujjha dI tusIM savArI karade ho ate kujha nUM tusIM khAMde ho|

uhanAM (mavezIAM) vica tuhADe laI hora vI kaI lAbha hana| tusIM uhanAM ’te savAra ho ke ApaNI usa thAM taka pahuMcade ho jisa dI cAhata tuhADe dilAM vica huMdI hai| tusIM ber3IAM ’te vI savAra huMde ho|
uha allAha tuhAnUM ApaNIAM nizAnIAM vikhAuMdA hai| tusIM allAha dIAM kihar3IAM kihar3IAM nizAnIAM dA inakAra karoge|

kI uhanAM (inakArIAM) ne dharatI dI saira nahIM kItI, phera uha vekhade ki uhanAM (inakArIAM) dA aMta kiho jihA hoiA sI, jihar3e uhanAM toM pahilAM hoe sI| uha giNatI vica vI ihanAM toM kite vaddha sana ate vadhere zakatIzAlI sana ate dharatI utte chaDDe hoe ciMnAM pakkhoM vI ihanAM toM vAdhU sana| uha loka jo vI karade sana uha uhanAM de kise kaMma nahIM AiA|

jadoM vI uhanAM lokAM kola uhanAM de rasUla sapazaTa pramANa laike AuMde tAM uha ApaNe hI jhUThe giAna utte haMkAra karade rahe jihar3A giAna uhanAM de kola sI| aMta jisa (az2Aba) dA uha makhaula kariA karade sI usa ne uhanAM nUM A gheriA|
jadoM uhanAM ne sADA az2Aba vekhiA tAM AkhaNa lagge ki asIM ikko ikka allAha utte ImAna liAe hAM ate jinhAM nUM asIM usa dA sAjhI baNAuMde sI, asIM uhanAM sabha dA inakAra karade hAM|

praMtU jadoM uhanAM ne sADA az2Aba vekha liA tAM uhanAM de ImAna liAuNa ne uhanAM nUM kujjha vI lAbha nahIM dittA| iho allAha dA niyata tarIkA hai, jihar3A usa de baMdiAM vica sadA toM lAgU hai ate usa sameM inakArI ghATe vica pai gae|
hA, mIma|
(iha.kuraAna) atiaMta diAlU te kripA karana vAle(allAha) valloM utAriA hoiA hai|
iha ajihI kitAba hai, jisa dIAM AitAM dA varaNana visathAra nAla kItA giA hai| iha.kuraAna arabI bhAzA vica hai, uhanAM lokAM laI (lAbhadAika hai) jihar3e giAna rakkhade hana|
(iha.kuraAna caMge kaMma karana vAliAM nUM) qhuzaqhabarIAM ate (bhair3e kaMma karana vAliAM nUM naraka toM) DarAuNa vAlA hai| para ihanAM viccoM bahutiAM ne mUMha mor3a liA ate uha suNade hI nahIM|

uha Akhade hana ki (he muhaMmada sa:!) tUM sA` jisa (.kuraAna) valla bulA rihA hai, usa (toM bacana) laI sADe dila g2alAfAM vica hana ate sADe kaMnAM vica DATa hana (tAM jo asIM nA samajha sakIe nA suNa sakIe) tuhADe ate sADe vicAle ika par3adA A piA hai| so tUM ApaNA kaMma kara, asIM ApaNA kaMma karIM jAvAMge|

(he muhaMmada sa:!) tusIM uhanAM nUM Akho ki maiM tAM tuhADe jihA hI ika manukkha hAM| para mere kola valla (rabba valloM) vahI bhejI jAMdI hai ki tuhADA sabha dA izaTa tAM basa ikko-ikka allAha hI hai| so tusIM ika citta hoke use valla dhiAna dio ate use toM bhullAM dI muAfI maMgoM ate muzarikAM laI barabAdI hai|
(uha vI barabAda hoNage) jihar3e z2akAta nahIM diMde ate paraloka nUM nahIM maMnade|
jihar3e ImAna liAe ate uhanAM ne bhale kaMma vI kIte, uhanAM laI ajihA badalA hai jisa dA kade aMta nahIM hovegA|

(he nabI!) tusIM uhanAM nUM puccho, kI tusIM usa (allAha) dA inakAra karade ho jisa ne do dinAM vica dharatI nUM baNAiA ate tusIM usa de sAMjhI vI baNAuMde ho? jada ki uhIo sAre jahAnAM dA pAlaNahAra?|

ate (use allAha ne) dharatI utte maz2abUta pahAr3a baNAe ate isa (dharatI) vica barakatAM rakkhIAM ate isa vica lor3a anusAra khAdha-khurAka dA samAna juTAiA| iha sAre kaMma cAra dinAM vica ho gae| pucchaNa vAliAM laI iho ThIka javAba hai|

phera usa (allAha) ne akAza valla dhiAna dittA jihar3A usa vele nirA dhUMA sI, phera allAha ne usa (akAza) nUM ate dharatI nUM kihA ki tusIM doveM hoMda vica A jAo, bhAveM tusIM qhuzI nAla Ao bhAveM nA cAhuMde hoe (majabUrI nAla) Ao, dovAM ne AkhiA ki asIM doveM qhuzI nAla hoMda vica AuNa laI hAz2ara hAM|

phera asIM do dinAM vica sata akAza baNA ditte ate hara akAza nUM usa de anusAra Adeza ditte, asIM dunIAM (vica disaNa vAle) akAza nUM carAg2AM nAla (bhAva tAriAM) nAla sajAiA [1] ate usa nUM caMgI tarhAM surakkhiata kara dittA| iha tadabIra atiaMta z2orAvara ate jANanahAra dI hai|
translations.footnotes: [1] vekho sUrata ala-anAma, hAzIA Aita 97/6

translations.translation: je phera vI uha (kAfira) mUMha mor3ade hana tAM tusIM (he nabI!) Akha dio ki maiM tAM tuhAnUM usa kar3akadAra (asamAnI az2Aba) toM DarAuMdA hai jihar3I Ada te samUda dI kar3aka vAMga hovegI|

jadoM paig2aMbara uhanAM (samUdIAM) kola uhanAM de agge-picche iha kahiMde hoe Ae ki tusIM allAha hI dI ibAdata karo, tAM uhanAM ne uttara vica kihA ki je sADA pAlaNahAra cAhuMdA tAM (iha galla dassaNa laI) farizate bhejadA| jo sunehA tuhAnUM deke ghalliA giA hai asIM usa dA inakAra karade hAM|

jihar3I Ada dI kauma vAle sI uhanAM ne dharatI utte aNahakkA ghamaMDa kItA ate kahiNa lagge ki sAthoM z2orAvarI vica vadhere kauNa hai kI (uhanAM AdIAM ne) nahIM vekhiA ki bezakka jisa allAha ne uhanAM nUM paidA kItA hai uha uhanAM toM kite vaddha z2orAvara hai, (praMtU) uha sADIAM AitAM dA (aqhIra takka) inakAra hI karade rahe|

aMta asIM uhanAM (Ada dI kauma) ’te azubha (siddha hoNa vAle) dinAM vica tez2a zUkadI hoI havA bheja dittI tAM jo uhanAM nUM saMsArika jIvana vica z2alIla karana vAle az2Aba dA suAda cakhA deIe| jadoM ki paraloka dA az2Aba tAM isa toM kite vaddha rusavAI vAlA hai ate utthe uhanAM dI koI sahAitA vI nahIM kItI AvegI|

jihar3e samUda sI, asIM uhanAM dI vI (paig2aMbara bheja ke) agavAI kItI, para uhanAM ne rAha vekhaNa nAloM aMne baNe rahiNA hI pasaMda kItA, phera uhanAM dIAM karatUtAM kArana uhanAM nUM hINatA bhare az2Aba dI kar3aka ne nappa liA|
ate asIM ImAna vAliAM nUM ate rabba dA Dara-bhau rakkhaNa vAliAM nUM (isa az2Aba toM) bacA liA|
ate jadoM allAha de vairI ikaTThe kara ke naraka valla ghera ke liAe jANage tAM uhanAM dI darajAbaMdI (pApAM anusAra) kItI jAvegI|

jadoM uha sAre (rabba de duzamana) utthe (naraka ner3e) pahuMcaNage tAM uhanAM de viruddha uhanAM de kaMna, uhanAM dIAM akkhAM ate uhanAM de sarIra dIAM camar3IAM (uhanAM valloM kIte kaMmAM dI) gavAhI deNagIAM|

uha (aparAdhI) ApaNIAM camar3IAM toM pucchaNage ki tusIM sADe viruddha kiuM gavAhI dittI? uha kahiNagIAM ki sAnUM use allAha ne bulavAiA hai jisa ne hara cIz2a nUM bolaNA sikhAiA hai| use ne tuhAnUM pahilI vAra paidA kItA sI ate tusIM use valla paratAe gae ho|

tusIM (iha soca ke burAI toM) nahIM bacade sI ki tuhADe kaMna, akkhAM te tuhADI camar3I tuhADe viruddha gavAhI deNage sagoM tusIM iho samajhade rahe ki jo kujjha vI tusIM kara rahe ho, allAha uhanAM viccoM kaIAM dIAM karatUtAM toM be-qhabara hai|
tuhADA iho gumAna (vicAra), jo tusIM ApaNe rabba bAre karIM baiThe sI, uhIo tuhAnUM lai DubbiA| aMta tusIM ghATe vica rahiNa vAliAM nAla jA rale|
huNa je uha lokI sabara vI karana tAM vI uhanAM dA TikANA naraka hI hai ate je uha muAfI maMgaNa tAM vI uha muAfa kIte hoe lokAM viccoM nahIM hoNage|

asIM uhanAM (kAfirAM) de kujjha ajihe sAthI baNA chaDDe sI, jihar3e uhanAM de agale-pichale sAre amalAM nUM sohaNA te vadhIA baNA ke vikhAuMde sana| aqhIra uhanAM utte vI allAha valloM uhIo az2Aba dA faisalA hoiA jihar3A uhanAM toM pahilAM bIte hoe jiMnAM te manukkhAM de garohAM ’te lAgU ho cukkiA hai| nirasaMdeha, uha loka z2arUra hI ghATe vica rahi jANa vAle hana|
ate kAfira (ika dUje nUM) kahiMde sana ki tusIM isa.kuraAna nUM nA suNo, jadoM isa nUM par3hiA jAve tAM DaMDa (vighaNa) pAo tAM jo tusIM hI bhArU hovo|
so jinhAM lokAM ne inakAra kItA sI asIM uhanAM kAfirAM nUM karar3I saz2A dA suAda caqhAvAMge ate jihar3IAM bhair3IAM karatUtAM uha karade rahe hana asIM uhanAM nUM uhanAM dA badalA z2arUra devAMge|
iha agga hI allAha de vairIAM dI saz2A hai, ihanAM laI ise vica sadIvI ghara hai| iha saz2A usa aparAdha dI hai ki uha sADIAM AitAM (Adeza) dA inakAra karade sana|

ate kAfira AkhaNage ki he sADe rabbA! sAnUM jiMnAM te manukkhAM viccoM uha loka vikhA jinhAM ne sAnUM (siddhe rAhoM) bhaTakAiA sI tAM jo asIM uhanAM nUM ApaNe pairAM heTha latAr3Ie, tAM jo uha z2alIla lokAM vica ho jANa|

nirasaMdeha, jinhAM lokAM ne kihA ki sADA pAlaNahAra allAha hai phera use (galla) ’te DaTe rahe[2], uhanAM utte farizate (iha kahiMde hoe) uttarade hana ki nA tAM tuhAnUM koI ciMtA hai nA kise prakAra dA koI Dara-qhaufa, sagoM isa jaMnata toM qhuza ho jAvo jisa dA tuhADe nAla vAadA kItA giA sI|
translations.footnotes: [2] maz2abUtI nAla DaTe rahiNa toM bhAva hai ki uha ImAna ate tauhIda te kAima rahe| kevala ika allAha dI ibAdata kare jihar3e caMge kaMma karana dA allAha ne hukama dittA hai usa dI pAlaNA kare ate bure kaMmAM toM bace|

translations.translation: asIM saMsArika jIvana vica vI ate paraloka vica vI tuhADe sAthI sI| isa (jaMnata) vica tuhADe laI uha sabha kujjha hai jisa nUM tuhADA jI cAhavegA ate isa vica uha sabha kujha hai jo tusIM maMgoge|
uha mahimAnadArI tuhADe laI usa valloM hovegI jihar3A baqhazaNahAra te miharAM vAlA hai|
usa viakatI toM sohaNI galla bhalAM kisa dI ho sakadI hai jihar3A (lokAM nUM) allAha valla sadde ate neka kaMma vI kare ate iha vI kahe ki maiM AgiAkArIAM viccoM hAM|

nekI te burAI ikka barAbara nahIM ho sakadI, tusIM burAI nUM ajihI galla nAla dUra karo jihar3I vadhere sohaNI hove| tusIM vekhoge ki uha viakatI jisa nAla tuhADI duzamanI hai uha iMja ho jAvegA jiveM koI jigarI dosata hove|
para iha guNa uhanAM nUM hI nasIba huMdI hai jihar3e sabara karade hana ate iha (sifata) use nUM nasIba huMdI hai jihar3A vaDDe bhAgAM vAlA huMdA hai|
je tusIM zaitAna valloM koI (burAI vala) ukasAhaTa mahisUsa karo tAM allAha dI zarana maMgoM, bezakka uhIo sabha kujjha suNana vAlA te jANana vAlA hai|

iha dina te rAta, sUraja te caMna usa (allAhAM) dI nizAnIAM viccoM hana| tusIM loka nA sUraja dI pUjA karo nA caMna dI, je tusIM vAsatava vica use dI ibAdata karade ho, tAM tusIM usa allAha nUM sijadA karo jisa ne (ihanAM sabha nUM) paidA kItA hai|

je phera vI uha (kAfira) haMkAra te ghamaMDa karana [3] (tAM koI paravAha nahIM kiuM jo) uha (farizate) jihar3e tuhADe rabba de nikaTavaratI hana, uha rAta dina (bhAva hara vele) usa dI tasabIha (zalAghA) karade hana ate uha kade thakkade nahIM|
translations.footnotes: [3] vekho sUrata ala-hajja, hAzIA Aita 9/22

translations.translation: usa (rabba) dIAM nizAnIAM viccoM iha vI hai ki tusIM dharatI nUM dabI hoI (baMjara) vekhade ho| jadoM asIM usa ’te mIMha pAuMde hAM tAM uha harI bharI ho uThadI hai| (ise tarhAM) jisa ne isa (dharatI) nUM jiUMdA kItA hai uha muradiAM nUM vI jiUMdA kara sakadA hai| bezakka uha hareka cIz2a nUM paidA karana dI samarathA rakkhadA hai|

jihar3e loka sADIAM AitAM (.kuraAna) vica biMga vala labhade hana uha sAthoM luke hoe nahIM| (ratA soco) ki jihar3A agga vica suTTiA jAve uha caMgA hai jAM jihar3A kiAmata vAle dina amana-amAna vica rahe? tusIM bhAveM jo cAhe karo uha tuhADA sabha kItA karAiA vekha rihA hai|
jinhAM lokAM ne z2ikara (kuraAna) nUM nahIM maMniA jadoM ki uha uhanAM kola AiA sI, (aMta uha vekha laiNage ki) bezakka iha tAM ika vaDDI z2orAvara te ucca koTI dI kitAba hai|
jhUTha tAM isa (.kuraAna) de ner3e vI nahIM A sakadA ate nA isa de aggioM ate nA hI picchioM A sakadA hai| iha tAM ati hikamatAM vAlI te zalAghAyoga hasatI valloM utAriA giA hai|
(he nabI!) tuhAnUM vI uhIo kihA jAMdA hai jihar3A tuhAthoM pahile rasUlAM nUM kihA giA hai| bezakka tuhADA rabba baqhazaNahAra vI hai ate daradanAka az2Aba deNa vAlA vI hai|

je asIM isa.kuraAna nUM ajamI (arabI toM chuTTa kise hora) bhAzA vica utArade tAM uha (kAfira) Akhade ki isa dIAM AitAM dA varaNana sapazaTa rUpa vica kiuM nahIM kItA giA? acaraja hai ki kitAba dI bhAzA ajamI ate paig2aMbara arabI? (he nabI!) tusIM Akho ki ImAna vAliAM laI tAM uha hidAita te (mana de rogAM dA) ilAja hai ate jihar3e ImAna nahIM liAMde uhanAM de kaMnAM vica DATa te akkhAM toM aMnhe hana| iha uha loka hana (jihar3e hakka sacca galla nahIM suNade) jiveM uha dUroM pukAre jA rahe hoNa|

asIM mUsA nUM kitAba (tauraita) dittI para usa vica vI matabheda kItA giA| je tere rabba valloM ika galla dA pahilAM hI faisalA nA ho giA huMdA tAM uhanAM (inakArIAM) dA niber3A kadoM dA ho cukkiA huMdA| bezakka uha (inakArI) isa.kuraAna de saMbaMdha vica duvidhA vica pA deNa vAle zakka vica phase hoe hana|

jihar3A vI koI bhale kaMma karadA hai uha ApaNe hI bhale laI karadA hai ate jihar3A mAr3e kaMma karadA hai usa dA doza vI use utte hai| tuhADA pAlaNahAra ApaNe baMdiAM utte kise prakAra dA z2ulama karana vAlA nahIM|

usa (kiAmata) de AuNa dA giAna usa (allAha) valla hI mor3hiA jAMdA hai| jihar3A vI phala ApaNe g2alAfAM viccoM nikaladA hai ate jihar3I madIna garabhavatI huMdI hai ate baccA jaNadI hai uha sabha allAha de giAna adhIna hai| ate jisa dina uha allAha uhanAM (muzarikAM) nUM pucchegA ki mere zarIka kitthe hana? uha kahiNage ki asIM tAM benatI kara cukke hAM ki ajja sADe viccoM (ziraka dI) gavAhI deNa vAlA koI nahIM|
ate jinhAM dI uha pUjA karade sana uha sabha guAce jANage ate uha samajha laiNage ki huNa uhanAM de nassaNa laI koI rAha nahIM|
manukkha bhalAI (laI duAvAM) maMgadA kade vI nahIM thakkadA ate je usa nUM koI bipatA A khar3I hove tAM uha nirAza ho jAMdA hai|

je usa bipatA magaroM asIM use viakatI nUM ApaNI mihara dA suAda cakhAuMde hAM tAM uha AkhadA hai ki iha tAM mere hI laI hai ate maiM nahIM samajhadA ki kiAmata AvegI| (ate Akhade hana) jekara maiM ApaNe rabba de kola paratAiA vI giA tAM vI mere laI usa kola bhalAI hI hovegI| phera asIM usa kAfirAM nUM dassa diAMge jo uha (saMsAra vica) kariA karadA sI ate asIM usanAM nUM karar3IAM saz2AvAM dA suAda cakhAvAMge|

(he nabI!) jadoM asIM manukkha nUM ApaNI miharAM nAla nivAz2ade hAM tAM uha (dhaMnavAdI hoNa toM) mUMha mor3a laiMdA hai ate sagoM Akar3a ke parAM ho jAMdA hai ate jadoM koI bipatA A pahuMcadI hai tAM laMmIAM laMmIAM duAvAM karana vAlA baNa jAMdA hai|

(he nabI!) tusIM Akha dio ki (he inakArIo!) ratA iha tAM dasso ki je iha (.kuraAna) allAha valloM hove ate tusIM isa dA inakAra karo, tAM phera usa viakatI toM vaddha rAhoM bhaTakiAM hoiA kauNa hovegA, jihar3A isa (hakka) dI virodhatA karadA hoiA dUra taka caliA jAve|

bahuta chetI asIM uhanAM nUM ApaNIAM nizAnIAM saMsAra vica vI vikhAvAMge ate uhanAM dI ApaNI z2Ata vica vI vikhAvAMge, itthoM taka ki iha galla uhanAM utte sapazaTa ho jAvegI ki bezakka iha.kuraAna hakka hai| kI iha galla kAfI nahIM ki tuhADA rabba hara cIz2a dA gavAha hai?
qhabaradAra! bezakka uha loka ApaNe rabba dI milaNI vica zakka vica hana| qhabaradAra bezakka usa ne hareka cIz2a nUM ApaNe ghere vica kara rakkhiA hai|
hA, mIma|
aina, sIna, kAfa|
(he rasUla!) allAha jihar3A z2orAvara te yukatImAna hai, uha tuhADe valla vI ate ise tarhAM tuhAthoM pahilAM bIta cukke lokAM valla vI vahI (rabbI paig2Ama) bhejadA rihA hai|[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] vekho sUrata ana-nisA, hAzIA Aita 163/4

translations.translation: akAzAM te dharatI vica jihar3A kujjha vI hai uha sabha use dA hai| uha saravaucca te vaDDIAM zAnAM vAlA hai|

ho sakadA hai ki akAza (allAha de jalAla toM Darade hoe) ApaNe uttoM pATa jANa| farizate ApaNe pAlaNahAra dI zalAghA karade hoe usa dI tasabIha (simarana) kara rahe hana ate dharatI de vasanIkAM laI baqhaziza dIAM aradAsAM karade hana| cete rahe ki bezakka allAha hI vaDDA baqhazaNahAra te miharAM vAlA hai|
jinhAM lokAM ne allAha nUM chaDDa ke dUjiAM nUM ApaNA kAraja-sAdhaka baNA liA hai, allAha hI uhanAM dA nigarAna hai| (he muhaMmada!) tusIM uhanAM de z2iMmevAra nahIM|

(he nabI!) ise tarhAM asIM tuhADe valla arabI (bhAzA vica).kuraAna isa laI ghalliA hai tAM jo tusIM makke vAliAM nUM ate isa de Ale-duAle vasaNa vAliAM nUM suceta kara dio ate ikaTThiAM hoNa vAle dihAr3e (bhAva kiAmata) toM DarA dio, jisa de AuNa vica koI vI zakka nahIM| (usa dina) lokAM dA ika dhar3A jaMnata vica jAvegA te dUjA (dhar3A) bhar3akaNa vAlI aga vica vica jAvegA|[2]
translations.footnotes: [2] vekho sUrata Ale-imarAna, hAzIA Aita 85/3

translations.translation: je allAha cAhuMdA tAM ihanAM sAriAM nUM ika hI ummata (mudAi) baNA diMdA, para uha jisa nUM cAhuMdA hai (hidAita de ke) ApaNIAM miharAM vica dAqhala kara laiMdA hai ate z2AlamAM dA nA koI mittara hai ate nA hI koI sahAI|

kI uhanAM lokAM ne usa (allAha) toM chuTTa dUjiAM nUM kAraja-sAdhaka baNA liA hai? kAraja-sAdhaka tAM kevala allAha hI hai, uhIo moiAM nUM (kiAmata dihAr3e) surajIta karegA| uha hara prakAra dI samarathA rakkhadA hai|

(dharama de saMbaMdha vica) jisa galla vica vI tusIM matabheda rakhade ho usa dA faisalA karanA allAha de z2iMme hai| uhIo allAha merA rabba hai, use utte merA bharosA ru ate maiM usa valla mur3a AuMdA hAM|

akAzAM te dharatI dA sirajanahAra vI uhIo hai| use ne tuhADI jinasa viccoM tuhADe laI jor3e baNAe ate pazUAM viccoM vI uhanAM dI jinasa de jor3e baNAe| isa tarhAM uha tuhADIAM nasalAM nUM phailAuMdA rahiMdA hai| (srizaTI dI) koI vI zaia usa varagI nahIM| uha (hara galla nUM) caMgI tarhAM suNadA hai te (hara kaMma nUM) caMgI tarhAM vekhadA hai|

akAzAM te dharatI de qhaz2AniAM dIAM kuMjIAM use kola hana| uha jisa nUM cAhuMdA hai, khullhA-DullA riz2aka diMdA hai ate jisa laI cAhuMdA hai, roz2I vica taMgI kara diMdA hai| bezakka uha hareka cIz2a toM caMgI tarhAM jANU hai|

(he muhaMmada!) usa ne tuhADe laI vI uhIo dharama niyata kItA hai, jisa dA hukama usa ne nUha nUM dittA sI ate asIM uhI vahI tuhADe valla bhejI hai ate ise dA tAkIdI hukama asIM ibarAhIma, mUsA ate IsA nUM dittA sI ki tusIM sAre ise dIna nUM kAima rakkho ate tusIM isa vica aDDo-aDDa nA ho jANA|[3] (he nabI!) jisa galla (bhAva ika allAha) valla tusIM uhanAM nUM saddA de rahe ho, iho galla ihanAM muzarikAM nUM ati bhair3I jApadI hai| allAha jisa nUM cAhuMdA hai ApaNe laI cuNa laiMdA hai ate hidAita use nUM baqhazadA hai jihar3A usa valla mur3a AuMdA hai|
translations.footnotes: [3] vekho sUrata Ale-imarAna, hAzIA Aita 103/3

translations.translation: uha loka ApaNe kola giAna A cukkaNa magaroM kevala ApaNe vicAle dI haTa dharamI kArana dhar3ebaMdI dA zikAra hoe| (he nabI!) je tuhADe rabba valloM ika niyata sameM taka laI faisalA agge pAuNa dI galla pahilAM toM hI nA AkhI huMdI tAM uhanAM dA niber3A kadoM dA ho cukkiA huMdA| jihar3e loka uhanAM toM bAada allAha dI kitAba de vArasa baNAe gae uha usa pratI duvidhA bhare zakka vica hana|

so (he muhaMmada!) tusIM lokAM nUM ise (dharama isalAma) valla saddA dio ate jihar3A tuhAnUM hukama dittA giA hai use utte drir3atA pUrabaka DaTa jAo| ihanAM lokAM dIAM kAmanAvAM de picche nA turo ate Akha dio ki jihar3I kitAba allAha ne utArI hai maiM usa utte ImAna liAiA hAM ate mainUM hukama hoiA hai ki maiM tuhADe vicAle inasApha karAM| sADA pAlaNahAra vI allAha hai ate tuhADA pAlaNahAra vI ੳhIo hai| sADIAM karanIAM sADe laI hana ate tuhADIAM karanIAM tuhADe laI hana| tuhADe te sADe vicAle koI jhagar3A nahIM| (kiAmata dihAr3e) allAha sAnUM sAriAM nUM jamhAM karegA ate use valla sAriAM ne parataNA hai|

jihar3e loka allAha de sadde nUM paravAna kara laiNa toM bAada allAha de saMbaMdha vica vAda-vivAda karade hana, uhanAM dIAM iha dalIlAM uhanAM de rabba dIAM naz2arAM vica jhUThIAM hana| (allAha dA) uhanAM utte karopa hai ate uhanAM laI karar3A az2Aba hai|[4]
translations.footnotes: [4] vekho sUrata Ale-imarAna, hAzIA Aita 85/3

translations.translation: allAha uha hai jisa ne hakka sacca nAla iha kitAba ate mIz2Ana (inasAfa karana vAlI takar3I) nUM utAriA| tusIM kI jANo! ho sakadA hai ki kiAmata ner3e hI hove|

jihar3e lokI usa (kiAmata) utte vizavAsa nahIM rakhadde, uha tAM usa laI kAhalIAM pA rahe hana| para jinhAM dA usa utte ImAna hai uha usa toM Darade hana kiuM jo uha jANade hana ki usa dA AuNA aTala saccAI hai| sAvadhAna raho! jihar3e loka kiAmata de bAre jhagar3ade hana uha gumarAhI vica bahuta dUra nikala gae hana|
allAha ApaNe baMdiAM utte bahuta miharabAna hai, uha jisa nUM cAhuMdA hai riz2aka diMdA hai| uha vaDDA balavAna te DADhA z2orAvara hai|

jihar3A viakatI Aqhirata dI khetI dA cAhavAna hai asAM usa laI use khetI vica vAdhA kara diMde hAM ate jihar3A viakatI saMsAra dI khetI cAhuMdA hai asIM usa nUM usa viccoM hI kujjha de diMde hAM| para usa laI Aqhirata vica kujjha vI hissA nahIM|

kI ihanAM laI (allAha toM chuTTa) kujjha hora zarIka hana jinhAM ne ihanAM laI uha dIna nIyata kItA hai jisa dA hukama allAha ne nahIM dittA? jekara faisale (kiAmata) dI galla nizacita nA ho gaI huMdI tAM ihanAM dA niber3A kadoM dA ho giA huMdA| bezakka ihanAM z2AlamAM laI dukhadAI az2Aba hai|

tusIM ihanAM z2AlamAM nUM (kiAmata dihAr3e) vekhoge ki uha ApaNIAM karaNIAM dI saz2A toM Dara rahe hoNage, jadoM ki uha saz2A uhanAM nUM mila ke rahegI, ate jihar3e loka ImAna liAe te uhanAM ne bhale kaMma vI kIte uha loka jaMnata de bAg2AM vica hoNage| uhanAM laI uhanAM de rabba de kola uha sabha kujjha hovegA jo uha cAhuNage| iho sabha toM vaDDI kripAlatA hai|

iho uha cIz2a hai jisa dI qhuzaqhabarI allAha ApaNe uhanAM baMdiAM nUM diMdA hai jihar3e ImAna liAe te neka kaMma karade rahe| (he nabI!) tusIM (ihanAM lokAM nUM) Akha dio ki maiM tuhAthoM isa (dharama pracAra) laI kise badale dI maMga nahIM karadA| para hAM! sAka-saMbaMdhiAM vAlA premabhAva z2arUra cAhuMdA hai|[5] je koI nekI kamAvegA tAM asAM usa laI usa bhalAI vica suhappaNa dA vAdhA kara diMde hAM| bezakka allAha (bhullAM nUM) baqhazaNavAlA ate (nekIAM dI) kadara karana vAlA hai|
translations.footnotes: [5] bhAva maiM isa dharama pracAra dA tuhAthoM koI badalA nahIM cAhuMdA para tuhAthoM iha benatI karadA hAM ki ApaNe ate mere vicakAra dI rizatedArI dA dhiAna rakhade hoe mainUM takalIfa nA dio tusIM mere kabIle de ho, isa laI tusIM merI pAlaNA karo ate jisa tauhIde de akIde valla maiM tuhAnUM bulA rihA hAM usa dI pairavI karanA tuhADe laI lAz2amI hai|

translations.translation: (he nabI!) kI uha (kAfira tuhADe saMbaMdha vica) Akhade hana ki isa rasUla ne allAha utte jhUThA Aropa ghar3hiA hai je allAha cAhe tAM tuhADe dila utte ThappA lA diMdA| allAha jhUTha dA saravanAza karadA hai ate hakka sacca nUM ApaNI bANI rAhIM sacca kara vikhAuMdA hai| bezakka uha sIniAM (dilAM) de luke hoe bhetAM nUM caMgI tarhAM jANadA hai|
uhI tAM hai jihar3A ApaNe baMdiAM dIAM taubA nUM kabUla karadA hai ate uhanAM dIAM burAIAM nUM muAfa karadA hai| tusIM loka jo vI karade ho uha sabha jANadA hai|
uha uhanAM lokAM dI duA kabUla karadA hai jihar3e ImAna liAe te uhanAM ne bhale kaMma vI kIte| uha uhanAM nUM ApaNI kripAlatA nAla hora vI vadhA ke diMdA hai ate kAfirAM laI karar3A az2Aba hai|

je allAha ApaNe sAriAM baMdiAM nUM khallhA-DulhA riz2aka de diMdA tAM uha z2arUra hI dharatI utte sarakazI karade para uha ika hisAba nAla jinnA cAhuMdA hai (riz2aka) utAradA hai| nirasaMdeha uha ApaNe baMdiAM (de hAla) toM bA-qhabara hai ate (uhanAM nUM) vekha rihA hai|
uhI hai jihar3A lokAM de nirAza hoNa picchoM mIMha barasAuMdA hai ate ApaNI rahimata nUM Ama kara diMdA hai| uhI kAraja sAdhaka te zalAghAyoga hai|
akAzAM te dharatI dI racanA ate uha jIa-jaMtU jihar3e usa ne doveM thAIM failA rakkhe hana, usa dIAM nizAnIAM viccoM hana jadoM vI uha cAhe uhanAM nUM ikkaThiAM karana dI samarathA dA hai|
tuhADe utte jihar3I vI bipatA AI hai uha tuhADIAM ApaNIAM hI karatUtAM kArana AI hai ate bahuta sArIAM bhullA-cukkAM nUM tAM uha aiveM hI muAfa kara diMdA hai|
tusIM dharatI utte usa (allAha) nUM bevasa nahIM kara sakade ate tuhADe laI chuTTa allAha toM koI kAraja-sAdhaka nahIM ate nA hI koI sahAI hai|
use dIAM nizAnIAM viccoM samuMdara vica callaNa vAle pahAr3AM vAMga jahAz2a hana|

je uha (allAha) cAhe tAM havA nUM roka lave phera uha (jahAz2a) samuMdara dI sataha (piTha) utte khalote hI rahi jANa (nirasaMdeha, isa vica hareka sabara te zukara karana vAle viakatI laI vaDDIAM nizAnIAM hana|
jAM je uha (cAhe tAM) uhanAM (kAfirAM) dIAM karatUtAM kArana uhanAM (jahAz2AM nUM) tabAha kara deve ate je cAhe tAM bahuta sAre (aparAdhAM) nUM muAfa kara deve|
tAM jo uha lokI, jihar3e sADIAM AitAM (nizAnIAM) vica jhagar3ade hana, uha jANa laiNa ki uhanAM de nassaNa laI koI vI thAM nahIM|

(he loko!) tuhAnUM jo vI dittA giA hai uha saMsArika jIvana dI tuccha jihI samaggarI hai| para jo allAha de kola hai uha uhanAM lokAM laI isa toM kite vadhIA te sadA rahiNa vAlA hai, jihar3e ImAna liAe uha ApaNe rabba utte hI bharosA karade hana|
ate uha ImAna vAle loka jihar3e mahAM pApAM te azalIla kaMmAM toM bacade hana [6] ate jadoM g2ussA Ave tAM uha muAfa kara diMde hana|
translations.footnotes: [6] mahAM pApa toM bhAva hai ki allAha de nAla kise hora dI ibAdata karanA, mApiAM dI nA-faramAnI karanA, aNa-hakkA katala karanA, jhUThI gavAhI deNA ate corI karanA Adi zAmila hai|

translations.translation: ate uha loka jihar3e ApaNe rabba dA hukama maMnade hana, namAz2a kAima karade hana ate uhanAM dA hareka kaMma Apo vica salAha mazavare nAla najiTThiA jAMdA hai ate asIM jo kujjha vI (riz2aka) uhanAM nUM baqhaziA hai uha usa viccoM (allAha dI rAha vica) qharaca karade hana|
jadoM uhanAM nAla koI vadhIkI kItI jAMdI hai tAM uha basa usa dA hI badalA laiMde hana|
burAI dA badalA uho jihI burAI hai, phera jihar3A muAfa kara deve ate sulAha kara leve tAM usa dA badalA deNA allAha de z2iMme hai| bezakka allAha z2AlamAM nUM pasaMda nahIM karadA|
jihar3e loka z2ulama hoNa magaroM badalA laiNa, uhanAM dA koI doza nahIM|
doza tAM uhanAM dA hai jihar3e dUjiAM utte z2ulama karade hana ate dharatI utte anucita vadhIkIAM karade hana| ajihe lokAM laI dukhadAI az2Aba hai|
para hAM! jihar3A dhIraja toM kaMma lave ate muAfa kara deve tAM bezakka iha dalerI de kaMmAM viccoM hai|

jisa nUM allAha hI gumarAha kara deve usa nUM allAha picchoM koI vI sAbhaNa vAlA nahIM| (he nabI!) tusIM z2AlamAM nUM vekhoge ki jadoM uha az2Aba nUM vekhaNage tAM AkhaNage, kI bhalAM huNa (saMsAra valla) mur3a ke jANa dA vI koI rAha hai?

(he nabI!) tusIM uhanAM nUM vekhoge ki jadoM uha naraka de sAhamaNe hAz2ara kIte jANage tAM hINatA kArana jhuke jA rahe hoNage ate naz2arAM bacA bacA ke kanakkhIAM nAla vekhade hoNage| jihar3e ImAna liAe hana uha AkhaNage ki bezakka ghATe vica tAM uhIo loka hana jinhAM ne ajja (kiAmata dihAr3a) ApaNe Apa nUM ate ApaNe ghara vAliAM nUM ghATe vica pAIM rakkhiA| qhabaradAra! z2Alama loka sadIvI az2Aba vica phase rahiNage|
ate uhanAM laI chuTTa allAha toM koI vI ajihA mittara nahIM hovegA jihar3A uhanAM dI sahAitA kara sake| jisa nUM allAha hI kurAhe pA deve, phera usa laI (hidAita dA) koI rAha nahIM|

(he loko) tusIM ApaNe rabba dA hukama maMna lao, isa toM pahilAM ki allAha valloM uha dina A jAve jihar3A (kise vI tarhAM) TalaNa vAlA nahIM| usa dihAr3e tuhADe laI koI zarana sathAna nahIM hovegA ate nA hI tuhAthoM gunAhAM dA inakAra hI kItA jAvegA|

(he nabI!) je uha mUMha mor3ade hana tAM mor3a laiNa asIM tuhAnUM uhanAM utte koI nigarAna baNA ke nahIM bhejiA? tuhADe z2iMme tAM (rabbI paig2Ama nUM lokAM takka) pahuMcA deNA hI hai| jadoM manukkha nUM asIM ApaNIAM miharAM dA suAda cakhAuMde hAM tAM uha seqhIAM mAradA hai, je usa nUM ApaNIAM karatUtAM kArana koI bipatA A pahuMcadI hai tAM (sAre ahisAna bhulla ke) vaDDA nA-zukarA baNa jAMdA hai|
