akAzAM te dharatI dI pAtazAhI dA mAlika allAha hI hai| jo uha cAhuMdA hai paidA karadA hai| jisa nUM cAhuMdA hai (kevala) dhIAM hI baqhazadA hai ate jisa nUM cAhuMdA hai (kevala) puttara diMdA hai|

jAM (je cAhuMdA hai tAM) uhanAM nUM puttara te dhIAM ralA-malA ke (bhAva doveM) diMdA hai ate jisa nUM cAhuMdA hai be-aulAda rakhadA hai| bezakka uha vaDDA jANanahAra te mahAna samarathA rakkhadA hai|

koI vI manukkha isa yoga nahIM ki allAha usa nAla (siddhI) galla bAta kare, para ilahAma rAhIM (bhAva dila vica koI galla pA deNA jAM supane vica vikhA deNA) jAM par3ade de picchioM jAM farizate bheja ke, (galla karadA hai) ate uha farizate allAha de hukama nAla hI AuMde hana| allAha jo cAhuMdA hai uhIo karadA hai|[7] bezakka uha saravaucca te dAnAI vAlA hai|
translations.footnotes: [7] vekho sUrata ana-nisA, hAzIA Aita 163/4

translations.translation: (he nabI!) ise tarhAM asIM tuhADe valla ApaNe hukama nAla ika rUha (.kuraAna) dI vahI bhejI| (isa toM pahilAM) tusIM nahIM jANade sI ki kitAba kI hai ate ImAna kI hai? para asAM isa kitAba nUM nUra baNA dittA| asIM ApaNe baMdiAM viccoM jisa nUM cAhuMde hAM isa nUra (bhAva.kuraAna) rAhIM hidAita baqhaza diMde hAM| bezakka tusIM siddhe rAha valla vI agavAI karade ho|
ate he nabI! usa allAha valla (agavAI karade ho) jihar3A akAzAM te dharatI dI hareka cIz2a dA mAlika hai| qhabaradAra! sAre mAmale allAha valla hI paratade hana|
hA, mIma|
rauzana kitAba dI suMha|
bezakka asIM isa kitAba nUM arabI (bhAzA) dA.kuraAna baNAiA hai tAM jo tusIM samajha sako|
bezakka iha.kuraAna sADe kola mUla kitAba (lauhe-mahafUz2a) vica likhiA hoiA hai| jo ki saravaucca zAna vAlI te yukatIAM nAla bharapUra kitAba hai|
(he loko!) kI bhalAM asIM tuhAthoM isa laI nasIhata karana toM mUMha mor3a laIe ki tusIM (allAha dIAM niyata kItIAM hoIAM) haddAM dI ulaMghaNA karana vAle loka ho? [1]
translations.footnotes: [1] vekho sUrata ala-bakaraha, hAzIA Aita 165/2

translations.translation: (nahIM iMja nahIM) asAM pahilAM bIta cukke lokAM vica kiMne hI nabI bheje|
ate uhanAM kola jihar3A vI nabI AuMdA sI uha usa dA makhaula uDAiA karade sana|
phera asIM ihanAM (makke vAliAM) nAloM kaI guNA vadhere z2orAvara lokAM nUM barabAda kara dittA| pichalIAM kaumAM dIAM udAharaNAM bIta cukkIAM hana|
(he nabI!) je tusIM ihanAM toM pucchoMge ki akAzAM te dharatI nUM kisa ne sAjiA hai? tAM uha iho AkhaNage ki ihanAM nUM ika vaDDI z2orAvara te jANanahAra hasatI ne sAjiA hai|
uha (allAha) hai jisa ne dharatI nUM tuhADe laI paMghUr3A baNAiA ate ise vica tuhADe laI rasate baNA ditte tAM jo tusIM ApaNI maMz2ila dI rAha pA sako|

uha (allAha) jisa ne ika qhAsa mAtarA vica akAzoM pANI utAriA, phera asIM use (pANI) duArA muradA zahira (baMjara dharatI) nUM jiUMdA (upajAU) kara dittA, ise tarhAM tusIM vI (kabarAM viccoM kiAmata dihAr3e) kaDDhe jAvoMge|
uha jisa ne sAriAM de jor3e paidA kIte ate tuhADe laI ber3IAM ate cAra pairAM vAle jAnavara baNAe, jinhAM utte tusIM savAra huMde ho|

tAM jo tusIM uhanAM (pazUAM) dI piTTha utte car3r3ha ke baiTho| jadoM tusIM caMgI tarhAM baiTha jAo tAM ApaNe rabba dI niamata nUM yAda karo ate Akho ki allAha (hara aiba toM) pAka hai, jisa ne isa (savArI) nUM sADe vasa vica kara chaDDiA hai, jada ki asIM isa nUM kAbU kara laiNa dI samarathA nahIM sI rakkhade|
asIM z2arUra hI ApaNe rabba valla paratana vAle hAM|
ate ihanAM lokAM ne allAha de hI kujjha baMdiAM nUM usa dA aMza (saMtAna) thApa dittA| bezakka manukkha sapazaTa rUpa vica (rabba dA) nA-zukarA hai|
kI usa (allAha) ne usa viccoM, jo uha paidA karadA hai, (ApaNe laI tAM) dhIAM dI ’coMNa kara laI ate tuhAnUM puttarAM nAla nivAz2a dittA?

jadoM uhanAM viccoM kise nUM usa (dhI paidA hoNa) dI qhuzaqhabarI suNAI jAMdI hai, jisa dA saMbaMdha iha loka rahimAna (bhAva allAha) nAla jor3ade hana, tAM usa de cihare utte kAlasa chA jAMdI hai ate uha soga nAla bhara jAMdA hai|
kI uha (isatarI) jihar3I gihaniAM vica pAlI posI jAMdI hai ate vAda-vivAda sameM ApaNI galla vI sapazaTa naIM kara sakadI, allAha dI dhI ho sakadI hai?

uhanAM ne pharizatiAM nUM, jihar3e ki rahimAna de baMde hana, rahimAna (allAha) dIAM dhIAM maMna liA| kI uha (pharizatiAM) de janama sameM hAz2ara sana? ihanAM dI gavAhI z2arUra likhI jAvegI ate ihanAM toM isa (galla) dI puccha-giccha vI kItI jAvegI|
uha (muzarika) Akhade hana ki je allAha cAhuMdA tAM asIM ihanAM jhUThe izaTAM dI ibAdata kade vI nA karade| iha loka kujjha vI giAna nahIM rakkhade, nire tIra-tukke calA rahe hana|
jAM asIM isa toM pahilAM ihanAM nUM koI kitAba dittI hoI hai jisa nUM iha loka maz2abUtI nAla phar3I phirade hana?
nahIM, sagoM iha loka Akhade hana ki bezakka asIM tAM ApaNe pio dAdiAM nUM ika rAha utte hI vekhiA hai ate asIM tAM uhanAM dI pairavI karana vAle hAM|

(he nabI!) isa tarhAM tahAthoM pahilAM asIM jisa basatI vica vI koI DarAuNa vAlA (paig2aMbara) bhejiA tAM utthe de qhuzahAla lokAM ne iho AkhiA ki asIM ApaNe pio dAdiAM nUM ise ika rAha utte hI vekhiA hai te asIM uhanAM dI hI pairavI karAMge|

hareka nabI ne (ApaNI basatI vAliAM nUM) iho pucchiA, (ki phera vI inakAra karoge) bhAveM maiM tuhAnUM usa nAloM vadhere siddhA rAha darasA diAM, jisa utte tusIM ApaNe pio dApadaAM (baz2uragAM) nUM vekhiA hai? javAba vica uhanAM sabha ne (paig2aMbarAM nUM) iho AkhiA ki tuhAnUM jihar3A dharama de ke bhejiA hai, asIM usa dA inakAra karade hAM|
so asAM uhanAM (inakArIAM) toM badalA liA| ratA vekho tAM sahI ki jhuThalAuNa vAliAM dA aMta kiho jihA hoiA|
(he nabI! uha velA vI yAda karo) jadoM ibarAhIma ne ApaNe pio te ApaNI kauma nUM AkhiA sI ki bezakka merA ihanAM butAM nAla koI saMbaMdha nahIM jinhAM dI pUjA tusIM karade ho|
chuTTa usa toM jisa (allAha) ne mainUM paidA kItA hai ate uha chetI hI merI agavAI karegA|
ate ibarAhIma ApaNI aulAda laI ise (tauhIda de kalame nUM) sadA bAkI rahiNa vAlA kalamA baNA giA tAM jo uha (allAha valla) parata AuNa|

sagoM maiM uhanAM nUM ate uhanAM de pio dAdiAM nUM (jIvana samaggarI de ke) lAbha pahuMcAiA, itthoM taka ki uhanAM kola hakka (bhAva saccA dharama) te sapazaTa rUpa vica (allAha de hukamAM nUM) biAna karana vAlA rasUla A giA|
jadoM iho hakka (.kuraAna) ihanAM (makke vAliAM) kola pahuMciA tAM iha AkhaNa lagge, iha tAM nirA jAdU hai, asIM isa de inakArI hAM|
ate AkhiA ki iha.kuraAna ihanAM dovAM basatIAM (makkA jAM tAifa) de kise vaDDe AdamI utte nAz2ila kiuM nahIM kItA giA?

(he nabI!) kI tuhADe rabba dI mihara dI vaMDa iha loka karade hana? jada ki asIM hI saMsArika jivana vica ihanAM vicAle roz2I vaMDI hai ate asAM hI maratabiAM vica ihanAM nUM ika dUje toM uccA darajA dittA hai, tAM jo uha ika dUje toM sevA karavA sakaNa| tuhADe ’te rabba dI mihara (bhAva paig2aMbarI) usa dhana-padAratha nAloM kite vaddha kImatI hai jo iha jamhAM kara rahe hana|

je iha zaMkA nA huMdI ki sAre hI loka ika hI TolA (bhAva kAfira) ho jANage tAM asAM uhanAM lokAM laI, jihar3e rahimAna (allAha) dA inakAra karade hana, uhanAM de gharAM dIAM chattAM ate paur3IAM cAMdI dIAM baNA diMde, jinhAM utte uha car3hade hana|
ate uhanAM de gharAM de bUhe ate taqhata vI (cAMdI de baNA diMde) jinhAM utte uha takIe lA ke bahiMde hana|
ate iha sabha sone de vI baNA diMde ate iha sabha saMsArika jIvana samaggarI hai, jada ki Aqhirata dI samaggarI, tuhADe rabba dI naz2ara vica kevala rabba dA Dara-bhau maMNana vAliAM laI hai|
jihar3A viakatI rahimAna (allAha) de simarana toM aMnAM (be-surata) huMdA hai tAM asIM usa ’te ika zaitAna niyukata kara diMde hAM, phera uha usa dA sAthI baNa jAMdA hai|
uha (zaitAna) uhanAM nUM siddhe rAha toM rokadA hai jada ki uha Apa iha samajhade hana ki uha hidAita (vAlI rAha) utte hana|
aqhIra,jadoM uha(kurAhe piA hoiA viakatI) sADe kola AvegA tAM(zaitAna nUM) AkhegA, kAza! mere te tere vicAle pUraba te pacchama jinnI dUrI huMdI,tUM tAM bahuta hI bhair3A sAthI hai|
usa vele uhanAM kAfirAM nUM AkhiA jAvegA ki jadoM tusIM vadhIkIAM kara cukke tAM ajja iha galla (AkhaNI) tuhADe laI kujjha vI lAhevaMda nahIM hovegI, ajja tusIM sAre az2Aba vica bhAIvAla ho|
(he nabI!) kI tusIM boliAM nUM suNA sakade ho? jAM anhiAM nUM rAha vikhA sakade ho, jihar3e khullhI gumarAhI vica pae hoe hana?
je asIM (he muhaMmada!) tuhAnUM saMsAra toM cukka vI laIe phera vI asIM ihanAM (z2AlamAM) toM badalA laiNA hI laiNA hai|
jAM (ho sakadA hai ki) asIM uha az2Aba tuhAnUM (jiUMde jI) vikhA daIe jisa dA bacana asIM ihanAM nAla kItA hoiA hai| bezakka asIM iha sabha karana dI samarathA rakkhade hAM|
(he nabI!) jihar3I vahI tuhADe valla ghallI gaI hai tusIM usa nUM maz2abUtI nAla phar3I rakkho| bezakka tusIM siddhe rAha utte ho|
bezakka iha.kuraAna tuhADe laI te tuhADI kauma laI nasIhata hai, chetI hI tuhAthoM (tuhADe amalAM dI) puccha-giccha hovegI|
(he nabI!) asIM jihar3e vI rasUla tuhAthoM pahilAM ghalle sana uhanAM toM puccha lao, kI asIM rahimAna (allAha) toM chuTTa koI hora izaTa vI niyukata kIte sana ki uhanAM dI ibAdata kItI jAve?

nirasaMdeha, asIM mUsA nUM ApaNIAM nizAnIAM sahita firaauna ate usa (dI kauma) de saradArAM valla bhejiA ate mUsA ne uhanAM nUM AkhiA ki maiM kulla jahAna de pAlaNahAra (allAha) dA bhejiA hoiA rasUla hAM|
jadoM uha (mUsA) uhanAM (firaaunIAM) kola sADe muajaz2e (nizAnIAM) laike AiA tAM uha loka uhanAM (nizAnIAM) dA makhaula uDAuNa lagge|
asIM uhanAM nUM jihar3I vI nizAnIAM vikhAuMde uha pahilI nizAnI nAloM vadha-car3ha ke huMdI| aMta asIM uhanAM nUM az2Aba vica nappa liA tAM jo uha ApaNIAM karatUtAM toM bAz2a A jANa|

(jadoM az2Aba A giA tAM) uhanAM (firaaunIAM) ne (mUsA nUM) AkhiA ki he jAdUgara! tere rabba ne jihar3A tere nAla (duA kabUla karana dA) vAadA kItA hoiA hai, usa de AdhAra ’te tUM sADe laI duA kara, phera asIM z2arUra hI hidAita prApata kara lavAMge|
jiveM hI asIM uhanAM toM az2Aba dUra kara diMde tAM uha use vele ApaNA vacaNa tor3a diMde|

ika dina firaauna ne ApaNI kauma vica munAdI karavAI| usa ne AkhiA ki he merI kauma! kI misara dI pAtazAhI ate iha nahirAM, jihar3IAM mere mahilAM de heTha vagadIAM hana, merIAM nahIM? kI tusIM vekhade nahIM?
ate kihA maiM tAM isa (mUsA) toM kite vadhIA hAM, iha tAM ika z2alIla viakatI hai ate ThIka bola vI nahIM sakadA|
(je iha allAha dA rasUla hai) phera isa laI sone de kaMgaNa kiuM nahIM utAre gae? jAM isa dI aradala vica farizate kiuM nahIM AuMde?
iMja firaauna ne ApaNI kauma dI matta mAra dittI te uhanAM ne usa dI galla maMna laI| nirasaMdeha, uhI loka avaggiAkArI sana|
phera jadoM uhanAM (firaaunIAM) ne sAnUM g2ussA cAr3ha dittA tAM asIM uhanAM toM badalA liA ate uhanAM sabha nUM (ikkaThiAM) Doba dittA|
isa tarhAM asIM uhanAM nUM hoe-bIte kara dittA ate AuNa vAliAM nasalAM laI (sikkhiA dAika) udAharana baNA chaDDiA|
(he nabI!) jadoM marIama de puttara (IsA) dI udAharana dittI gaI tAM tuhADI kauma (qhuzI nAla) raulA pAuNa lagga paI|
ate AkhaNa laggI kI sADe izaTa caMge hana jAM uha (IsA)? uhanAM ne iha udAharana tuhADe nAla jhagar3A karana laI biAna kItI sI| saccAI iho hai ki iha loka nire jhagar3AlU hana|
uha (IsA) tAM kevala ika baMdA hai jisa ’te asAM inAma kItA ate banI-isarAIla laI ApaNI kudarata dA ika camatakAra baNA dittA|
je asIM cAhuMde tAM (tuhADe viccoM hI) farizate baNA diMde, jihar3e dharatI utte (tuhADe) jAnazIna huMde|
bezakka uha (IsA) kiAmata dI nizAnI hai| so tusIM isa (kiAmata) de AuNa vica zakka nA karo ate merI pairavI karo, iho siddhA rAha hai|
(he loko!) zaitAna tuhAnUM (siddhI rAha toM) nA roka deve, kiuM jo uha tuhADA khullhA vairI hai|

jadoM IsA khullhIAM nizAnIAM (muajaz2e) laike AiA tAM usa ne (kauma nUM) AkhiA, maiM tuhADe laI hikamata (yukatI) laike AiA hAM tAM jo maiM tuhADe utte kujjha uhanAM gallAM nUM sapazaTa kara devAM jinhAM vica tusIM mada-bheda karade ho| so tusIM allAha toM Daro ate merI tAbedArI karo|
bezakka allAha hI merA te tuhADA rabba hai| so tusIM use dI ibAdata karo, iho siddhA rAha hai|
phera uhanAM (banI-isarAIla) viccoM kaI dhar3iAM ne Apo vica matabheda kItA te jinhAM lokAM ne z2ulama kItA uhanAM laI dukhadAI dihAr3e dA barabAda karana vAlA az2Aba hai|
kI iha loka kiAmata dihAr3e dI uDIka kara rahe hana ki uha acaNaceta ihanAM utte A jAve te ihanAM nUM qhabara vI nA hove|
usa dihAr3e rabba dA Dara-bhau maMNana vAliAM toM chuTTa bAkI sAre mittara-piAre ika dUje de vairI baNa jANage|
(usa dina neka lokAM nUM kihA jAvegA ki) he mere baMdio! ajja nA tuhAnUM kise tarhAM dI koI ciMtA hovegI ate nA hI koI dukkha hovegA|
bhAva jihar3e loka sADIAM AitAM utte ImAna liAe ate uha sADe AgiAkArI baNa ke rahe|
(uhanAM nUM AkhiA jAvegA) tusIM savaraga vica dAqhala ho jAo, jitthe tuhAnUM te tuhADIAM patanIAM nUM nihAla kara dittA jAvegA|
uhanAM de agge (savaraga vica) sone de thAla te sAgara (piAle) phirAe jANage ate hara mana-bhAuMdI ate akkhAM nUM sohaNI laggaNa vAlI cIz2a isa vica hovegI ate tusIM ise vica sadA laI rahoge|
iho uha savaraga hai jisa de tusIM vArisa (hissedAra) baNAe gae ho, ApaNe uhanAM neka karamAM de badale jo tusIM (saMsAra vica) karade rahe ho|
isa (savaraga vica) tuhADe laI anekAM hI phala hoNage jinhAM viccoM tusIM khAuMge|
ate aparAdhI loka naraka de az2Aba vica sadA laI phase rahiNage|
uha az2Aba ghaTAiA nahIM jAvegA ate uha usa vica nirAza pae rahiNage|
asAM uhanAM utte koI z2ulama nahIM kItA sagoM z2Alama tAM uha Ape hI sana|
uha (naraka de pahiredArAM nUM) AkhaNage ki he mAlika! caMgA hove je tuhADA rabba sADA kaz2IAM hI mukA deve| uha (farizate) AkhaNage ki huNa tUM sadA ise az2Aba vica rahegA|
asIM tere kola hakka laike Ae sI para tuhADI bahu giNatI hakka nUM nA-pasaMda karana vAlI sI|
kI ihanAM (makke de kAfirAM) ne sADe viruddha koI faisalA kara liA hai? tAM asIM vI ika faisalA karana vAle hAM|
kI uha samajhade hana ki asIM ihanAM dIAM gupata gallAM te kAnAphUsIAM nahIM suNade? kiuM nahIM suNade, sagoM sADe farizate ihanAM de lAge hI likhade rahiMde hana|
(he nabI!) tusIM Akha dio! je rahimAna (allAha) dI saMtAna huMdI tAM sAriAM toM pahilAM maiM usa dI ibAdata karana vAlA huMdA|
akAzAM te dharatI dA rabba te arazAM dA mAlika uhanAM sArIAM gallAM toM pAka hai jihar3IAM iha (muzarika) karade hana|

so tusIM ihanAM de hAla ’te chaDDa dio, uha tAM ApaNe tatthahINa vicArAM vica ulajhe hoe hana ate kheDAM vica masata hana, itthoM taka ki iha ApaNe usa dina nUM vekha laiNage, jisa dA ihanAM nAla vAadA kItA hoiA hai|
uhIo allAha akAzAM vica vI izaTa hai ate dharatI vica vI uhIo izaTa hai| uhIo vaDDA yukatImAna te jANanahAra hai|

uha z2Ata bahuta hI barakatAM vAlI hai jisa laI akAzAM te dharatI ate jo ihanAM de vicAle hai uhanAM sabha dI pAtazAhI hai, ate kiAmata dA giAna vI use kola hai, ate tusIM sAre use valla paratAe jAuMge|
uha allAha nUM chaDDa ke jinhAM nUM benatIAM karade hana uha sifAriza karana dA adhikAra nahIM rakkhade| chuTTa uhana lokAM toM jinhAM ne hakka dI gavAhI dittI hove ate uha giAna vI rakhade hana|[2]

asAM thor3hI dera laI ihanAM toM az2Aba dUra karana vAle hAM, bezakka tusIM loka mur3a uhIo (inakAra) karana vAle ho|
jisa dina asIM karar3AI nAla phar3AMge| bezakka (usa dina) asIM pUrA-pUrA badalA laiNa vAle hAM|
asIM ihanAM (kAfirAM) toM pahilAM firaauna dI kauma nUM parakhiA ate uhanAM kola ika patavaMtA rasUla AiA sI|
usa (rasUla) ne firaauna nUM AkhiA ki allAha de baMdiAM bhAva (banI-isarAIla) nUM mere havAle karade| iha vI kihA ki bezaka maiM tuhADe laI ika amAnatadAra paig2aMbara hAM|
tusIM allAha de agge sarakazI nA karo, nirasaMdeha, maiM tuhADe sAhamaNe (rasUla hoNa dIAM) sapazaTa dalIlAM peza karadA hAM|
maiMne ApaNe rabba te tuhADe rabba dI zarana isa laI laI hai ki kite tusIM mainUM pattharAM nAla hI nA mAra dio|
je tusIM merI galla ’te vizavAsa nahIM karade tAM maithoM aDDa ho jAo|
phera usa (mUsA) ne ApaNe rabba nUM benatI kItI ki iha loka tAM aparAdhI hana|
(rabba valloM hukama hoiA ki) mere baMdiAM nUM rAta de sameM lai ke tura jA, bezakka tuhADA picchA kItA jAvegA|
ate tUM samuMdara nUM usa de hAla ’te chaDDa ke pAra ho jA| bezakka iha (sArA firaaunI) lazakara Dubba jAvegA|

pApIAM dA bhojana hai|
