rAta te dina de badala-badala ke AuNa-jANa vica ate usa riz2aka (pANI) vica jihar3A allAha ne akAzoM nAz2ila kItA hai, phera usa rAhIM moI paI dharatI nUM jiUMdA karadA hai ate havAvAM dIAM dizAvAM badalaNa vica sUjha-bUjha rakkhaNa vAliAM laI kiMnIAM hI nizAnIAM hana|
iha allAha dIAM AitAM (nizAnIAM) hana jinhAM nUM asIM tuhADe sAmhaNe hakka sacca nAla biAna kara rahe hana| huNa uha usa (allAha) dIAM nizAnIAM toM magaroM kihar3I galla ’te ImAna liuNage?
hareka jhUThe gunAhagAra laI barabAdI hai|

jadoM allAha dIAM AitAM usa de sAmhaNe par3hIAM jAMdIAM hana ate uha unhAM nUM suNadA vI hai, para uha haMkAra vica A ke ApaNI galla utte ar3a jAMdA hai jiveM usa ne kujjha suNiA hI nahIM| (he nabI!) tusIM usa nUM daradanAka az2Aba dI qhuzaqhabarI suNA dio|
jadoM uha sADIAM kujjha AitAM (AdezAM) viccoM kujha nUM jANa laiMdA hai tAM uhanAM dA makhaula uDAuMdA hai, ajihe lokAM laI hINatA bhariA az2Aba hai|

uhanAM de agge naraka hai| jo kujjha vI uhanAM ne saMsAra vica kamAiA hai, uha uhanAM de kujjha vI kaMma nahIM AvegA ate nA hI uha izaTa kaMma AuNage jinhAM nUM uhanAM ne allAha toM chuTTa ApaNA kAraja-sAdhaka baNA chaDDiA hai ate uhanAM laI dukhadAI az2Aba hai|
iha (.kuraAna) tAM hidAita hai ate uha loka jinhAM ne ApaNe rabba dIAM AitAM (hukamAM) dA inakAra kItA hai, uhanAM laI lohar3e dA dukhadAI az2Aba hai|

allAha uha hai jisa ne samuMdara nUM tuhADe adhIna kara rakkhiA hai tAM jo usa de hukama nAla isa vica ber3IAM callaNa, tAM jo tusIM usa viccoM usa dA faz2ala (riz2aka) dI bhAla kara sakoM ate usa de dhaMnavAdI hovoM|

usa (allAha) ne ApaNe valloM, jo kujjha akAzAM vica ate jo kujjha dharatI vica hai, uha sabha tuhADe adhIna kara chaDDiA hai| bezakka isa vica uhanAM lokAM laI nizAnIAM hana jihar3e soca vicAra karade hana|

(he nabI!) tusIM ImAna vAliAM nUM Akha dio ki uha uhanAM lokAM dI paravAha nA karana jihar3e allAha valloM mAr3e dinAM (bhAva kiAmata) de AuNa dA vizavAsa nahIM rakkhade, tAM jo allAha kujjha lokAM nUM uhanAM (de karamAM) dI saz2A deve jo uha kamAuMde rahe hana|
jihar3A koI neka kaMma karegA tAM usa dA lAbha usa nUM hovegA ate jisa ne bure kaMma kIte tAM usa dI saz2A vI uhIo bhogegA ate tusIM sAre ApaNe rabba valla hI paratAe jAvoge|
(isa toM pahilAM) asIM banI-isarAIla nUM kitAba (tauraita), hakUmata ate paig2aMbarI baqhazI sI ate uhanAM nUM pavittara riz2aka baqhaziA ate uhanAM nUM kulla jahAna dIAM kaumAM utte vaDiAI baqhazI|

ate asIM uhanAM nUM dharama pakkhoM khullhIAM dalIlAM baqhazIAM| phera ApaNe kola giAna AuNa magaroM, kevala Apo vica haTadharamI kArana uhanAM vicAle matabheda ho gae| bezakka tuhADA rabba kiAmata dihAr3e uhanAM gallAM dA faisalA kara devegA jinhAM vica uha matabheda karade rahe hana|
(he nabI!) asIM tuhAnUM dharama de mAmale vica ika zarIata (sapazaTa rAha) utte kAima kItA hai, so tusIM usa rAha ’te turo ate uhanAM lokAM dIAM kAmanAvAM de picche nA laggo jihar3e agiAnI hana|

bezakka iha loka (allAha de az2Aba toM bacAuNa laI) tuhADe kujha vI kaMma nahIM AuNage| bezakka z2Alima loka hI ika dUje de mittara hana ate allAha muttakIAM (rabba dA Dara rakkhaNa vAliAM) dA mittara hai|
iha (.kuraAna) lokAM laI hidAita vAlIAM dalIlAM ’te AdhArita hai ate uhanAM laI hidAita ate rahimata hai jihar3e isa utte vizavAsa rakhade hana|[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] vekho sUrata yUnusa, hAzIA Aita 37/10

translations.translation: kI uha loka jinhAM ne burAIAM kItIAM hana, iha samajhIM baiThe hana ki asIM uhanAM nUM ate ImAna liAuNa vAliAM te bhale kaMma karana vAliAM nUM ikko jihA kara diAMge ki uhanAM dA jiUNa marana ika barAbara ho jAve? uha bahuta hI bhair3e faisale kara rahe hana|
allAha ne akAzAM te dharatI nUM hakka de AdhAra ’te sAjiA hai, tAM jo hareka viakatI nUM usa de amalAM dA ThIka-ThIka badalA dittA jAve| uhanAM utte koI z2ulama nahIM kItA jAvegA| [2]
translations.footnotes: [2] vekho sUrata ala-hijara, hAzIA Aita 23/15

translations.translation: kI tusIM kade usa viakatI nUM vekhiA hai jisa ne ApaNI manokAmanA nUM ApaNA izaTa baNA rakkhiA hai| allAha ne usa nUM kurAhe pA suTTiA ate usa de kaMnAM ate dila (akala) utte mohara lA chaDDI hai ate usa dIAM akkhAM ’te par3adA pA dittA, jada ki usa nUM (hakka-sacca dA) giAna sI| allAha toM chuTTa hora kauNa hai jihar3A usa nUM hidAita deve? kI tusIM phera vI nasIhata grahiNa nahIM karade?

uha loka Akhade hana ki sADA jIvana tAM bassa iho (saMsArika jIvana) hai, asIM itthe hI marade hAM ate itthe hI jiUMde hAM, sameM dA phera hI sAnUM halAka karadA hai|[3] (he nabI) ihanAM lokAM nUM isa dI kujjha vI jANakArI nahIM| iha loka tAM nirI aTakala de AdhAra ’te hI gallAM karade hana|
translations.footnotes: [3] saMsAra vica jo kujha vI huMdA hai kujha loka usa nUM sameM dI ghaTanA samajhade hana jihar3IAM ApaNe Apa hI ghaTadIAM hana jada ki iha akIdA unhAM lokAM dA hai jihar3e dharamAM nUM nahIM maMnade| hakIkata iha hai ki jo kujha vI saMsAra vica huMdA hai usa sabha allAha dI raz2A anusAra hI huMdI hai| isa laI hadIsa vica saMsAra vica vAparana vAlIAM ghaTanAvAM nUM sameM de nAla jor3anA toM rokiA giA hai| ika hadIsa vica allAha de rasUla ne faramAiA ki allAha faramAuMdA hai ki AdamI jadoM z2amAne nUM gAlAM kaDadA hai tAM uha mainUM satAuMdA hai| hAlAM ki z2amAnA maiM hI hAM, sAre kaMma mere hattha vica hana ate rAta dina dA phera badala maiM hI karadA hai| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 4826)

translations.translation: jadoM ihanAM nUM sADIAM sapazaTa AitAM suNAIAM jAMdIAM hana, tAM uhanAM dI dalIla tAM bassa iho huMdI hai ki uha kahiMde hana ki jekara tusIM sacce ho tAM sADe pio dAdiAM nUM uThA liAo|

(he nabI!) tusIM Akha dio ki allAha hI tuhAnUM jiUMdA karadA hai, uhIo tuhAnUM mauta diMdA hai, phera kiAmata dihAr3e uhIo tuhAnUM jamhAM karegA, jisa de AuNa vica kujjha vI zakka nahIM| para vadhere loka jANade nahIM|
akAzAM te dharatI dI pAtazAhI allAha dI hI hai ate jadoM kiAmata dI ghar3I AvegI, usa dina jhUThe loka ghATe vica rahiNage|

(he nabI!) usa dina tusIM hareka ummata nUM goDiAM bhAra DiggiA vekhoge| hareka ummata nUM usa dI karama-paratI valla saddiA jAvegA| (uhanAM nUM AkhiA jAvegA ki) ajja tuhAnUM uhanAM karamAM dA badalA dittA jAvegA jihar3e tusIM (saMsAra vica) karade hare sI|
AkhiA jAvegA ki iha (karama-patarI) sADI kitAba hai| iha tuhADe bAre sacca boladI hai| nirasaMdeha, asIM uhIo likhavAuMde sI jo tusIM karama karade rahe ho|
paraMtU jihar3e loka ImAna liAe ate uhanAM ne kaMma vI bhale kIte allAha uhanAM nUM ApaNI mihara (bhAva savaraga) vica dAqhila karegA| iho asalI kAmayAbI hai|
ate jinhAM lokAM ne inakAra kItA uhanAM nUM pucchiA jAvegA ki kI tuhAnUM merIAM AitAM nahIM suNAIAM jAMdIAM sI? para tusIM ghamaMDa kItA, kiuM jo tusIM aparAdhI sI|

jadoM tuhAnUM AkhiA jAMdA sI ki allAha dA vAadA saccA hai, kiAmata de AuNa vica koI zakka nahIM, tAM tusIM Akhade sI ki asIM nahIM jANade ki kiAmata kI hai? sAnUM tAM bassa ika bharama jihA hai, para asIM yakIna nahIM kara sakade|
(usa dihAr3e) ihanAM de sAhamaNe ihanAM dIAM karatUtAM pragaTa ho jANagIAM ate phera ihanAM nUM uha az2Aba ghera lavegA jisa dA iha makhaula uDAiA karade sana|

uhanAM (narakIAM) nUM AkhiA jAvegA ki ajja asIM tuhAnUM use tarhAM bhulla jAvAMge jiveM tusIM isa dihAr3I dI milaNI nUM bhulla gae sI ate tuhADA TikANA agga hai, jitthe tuhADA koI vI sahAI nahIM hovegA|

(iha tuhADA aMta) isa laI hoiA hai kiuM jo tusIM allAha dIAM AitAM (.kuraAna) dA makhaula baNA chaDDiA sI ate saMsArika jIvana ne tuhAnUM dhokhe vica pA rakkhiA sI| so ajja uha isa naraka ’coM kaDDhe nahIM jANage te nA hI uhanAM toM allAha nUM rAz2I karana (laI muAfI) dI maMga kItI jAvegI|[4]
translations.footnotes: [4] isa toM bhAva hai ki manukkha ne duniAM vica jo vI karama kIte hoNage uhanAM anusAra hI unhAM nUM badalA dittA jAvegA kise vI tarhAM de bahAne toM kaMma nahIM callegA| kevala usa dA karama hI usa de nAla jAvegA| bAkI sabha kujha ise saMsAra vica rahi jAvegA| ika hadIsa vica allAha de nabI ne faramAiA ki mayyata de nAla tiMna cIz2AM jAMdIAM hana, unhAM viccoM do mur3a AuMdIAM hana ika usa de nAla rahi jAMdI hai| isa de picche usa de ghara vAle ate dhaMna padAratha ate usa de karama jAMde hana| phera ghara vAle te dhaMna padAratha tAM mur3a AuMde hana jada ki karama usa de nAla rahi jAMde hana| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 6514)

translations.translation: so sArIAM tArIfA allAha laI hI hana jihar3A akAzAM te dharatI dA rabba hai ate kulla jahAnAM dA pAlaNahAra hai|
akAzAM te dharatI vica use dI vaDiAI hai, uhI vaDDA z2orAvara ate yukatImAna hai|
hA, mIma|
isa kitAba (.kuraAna) nUM utAranA usa allAha valloM hai jihar3A vaDDA z2orAvara ate hikamata vAlA (yukatImAna) hai|

asIM akAzAM te dharatI ate jo ihanAM dohAM de vicAle hai (usa nUM) hakka ’te AdhArita ate ika nizacita sameM laI paidA kItA hai| jihar3e lokAM ne (rabbI nizAnIAM) dA inakAra kItA hai, uha uhanAM cIz2AM toM mUMha mor3I baiThe hana, jinhAM toM inhAM nUM DarAiA giA hai|

(he nabI!) tusIM Akha dio! caMgA iha dasso ki jinhAM (izaTAM) nUM tusIM allAha nUM chaDDa ke pukArade ho, mainUM vikhAo ki uhanAM ne dharatI vica kI paidA kItA hai? jAM uhanAM dA akAza (de baNAuNa) vica koI hissA hai? je tusIM sacce ho tAM isa (.kuraAna) toM pahilAM AI hoI koI kitAba jAM koI giAna dI rahiMda-khUMdha hai tAM uha mere kola lai Ao!

usa toM vaddha gumarAha kauNa ho sakadA hai, jihar3A allAha toM chuTTa usa nUM pukAradA hai, jihar3A kiAmata taka uhanAM nUM uttara nahIM de sakadA? jada ki uha uhanAM dI pukAra toM hI besurata hana|[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] vekho sUrata ala-bakaraha, hAzIA Aita 165/2

translations.translation: jadoM lokI ikaTThe kIte jANage tAM uha (ghar3he hoe izaTa) uhanAM de vairI hoNage| uha (izaTa) uhanAM dI pUjA pATha de inakArI hoNage|

jadoM uhanAM (inakArIAM) nUM sADIAM sapazaTa AitAM suNAIAM jAMdIAM hana tAM kAfira loka isa hakka (.kuraAna) de saMbaMdha vica Akhade hana ki iha tAM khullhA jAdU hai, jada ki iha uhanAM kola A cukkiA hai|

sagoM uha tAM iha vI Akhade hana ki usa (muhaMmada sa:) ne isa (.kuraAna) nUM Ape ghar3ha liA hai| (he nabI!) tusIM Akha dio! je maiMne iha Ape ghar3hiA hai tAM mainUM allAha de az2Aba toM bacAuNA tuhADe vassa vica nahIM| uha uhanAM gallAM nUM caMgI tarhAM jANadA hai jo tusIM isa (.kuraAna) de saMbaMdha vica baNAuMde ho| mere te tuhADe vicakAra use dI gavAhI kAfI hai| uha ati baqhazaNahAra te ati rahima vAlA hai|

(he nabI!) iha vI Akha dio! maiM rasUlAM vica koI niArA rasUla nahIM| maiM nahIM jANadA ki mere nAla te tuhADe nAla kI vAparegA| maiM tAM basa use dI pairavI karadA hAM, jihar3I vahI (rabbI sunehA) mere valla bhejI jAMdI hai| maiM tAM kevala sAvadhAna karana vAlA hAM|

(he nabI!) ratA iha vI puccho ki je iha.kuraAna alAha valloM hove ate tusIM isa dA inakAra kara dittA tAM tuhADA kI bacegA? banI-isarAIla dA ika viakatI iho jihe (kitAba uttarana dI) gavAhI de cukkiA hai, uha ImAna lai AiA, para tusIM ghamaMDa kItA| bezakka allAha z2AlamAM nUM hidAita nahIM diMdA|[2]
translations.footnotes: [2] vekho sUrata ala-mAidA, hAzIA Aita 66/5

translations.translation: kufara karana vAliAM ne ImAna liAuNa vAliAM nUM AkhiA, je iha (dharama) caMgA huMdA tAM dUje loka usa nUM kabUla karana vica sAthoM agge nA laMghade| jadoM uhanAM ne isa (.kuraAna) toM hidAita prApata kItI hI nahIM phera uha tAM huNa iho kahiNage ki iha tAM purANA jhUTha hai|

isa (.kuraAna) toM pahilAM mUsA dI kitAba (tauraita) agavAI karana vAlI ate rahimata sI ate huNa iha (.kuraAna) arabI bhAzA vica usa (tauraita) dI puzaTI karana vAlI kitAba hai, tAM jo uha uhanAM lokAM nUM (naraka toM) DarAve, jinhAM ne z2ulama kItA hai ate nekIAM karana vAliAM laI isa vica qhuzaqhabarIAM hana|
bezaka jinhAM lokAM ne iha kihA ki sADA rabba tAM allAha hai phera ise ’te kAima rahe, uhanAM laI (kiAmata dihAr3e) nA koI Dara-qhaufa hai te nA hI uha (kiAmata dihAr3e) dukhI hoNage|
iho loka jaMnatI hana, uha sadA laI isa vica rahiNage| iha uhanAM de (neka) amalAM dA badalA hai jihar3e uha (saMsAra vica) kariA karade sana|

asAM manukkha nUM usa de mApiAM nAla sohaNA vihAra karana dA Adeza dittA| usa dI mAtA ne usa nUM kazaTAM nAla DhiDDa vica rakkhiA te kazaTa sahi ke hI jaNiA| usa de garabha ate duddha chuDAuNa vica tIha mahIniAM dA samAM hai| itthoM taka ki jadoM uha ApaNI puUrI javAnI nUM pujiA ate cAlI varhiAM dA ho giA tAM usa ne duA kItI ki rabbA! mainUM bala baqhaza ki maiM terI usa niamatAM dA dhaMnavAda karAM jo tUM mainUM te mere mApiAM nUM baqhazIAM hana| mere rabbA! mainUM hiMmata de ki maiM uha neka kaMma karAM jisa nUM tUM pasaMda kareM| tUM mere laI merI saMtAna dA sudhAra kara| bezaka maine tere haz2Ura taubA kItI hai ate maiM musalamAnAM (AgiAkArIAM) viccoM hAM|

iha uha loka hana jinhAM de neka amalAM nUM, jihar3e uha karade hana, asIM kabUla karade hAM ate uhanAM dIAM burAIAM nUM muAfa karade hAM, iha jaMnatIAM viccoM hoNage| iha saccA vAadA hai jihar3A uhanAM nAla (rabba valloM) kItA jA rihA hai|

ate jisa kise ne ApaNe mApiAM nUM AkhiA, aphasUsa hai! tuhADe dovAM (dI soca) ’te, kI tusIM doveM mainUM iha vacana diMde ho ki mainUM (kabara) viccoM (jiUMdA) kaDDhiA jAvegA, jada ki maithoM pahilAM bahuta sArIAM ummatAM bIta cukkIAM hana? jada ki uha doveM (mAM te pio putarra laI) allAha toM aradAsa karade hana, (te Akhade hana ki) putarra ImAna lai A, nahIM tAM tUM barabarAda ho jAveMgA| bezakka allAha dA vAadA (kiAmata AuNa dA) saccA hai| para uha (puttara) AkhadA hai ki iha sabha bIte sameM dIAM kahANIAM hana|

iha uha loka hana jinhAM utte allAha valloM az2Aba AuNa dI galla ThIka baiTha cukkI hai (ate uhanAM utte vI jihar3e) jiMnAM te manukkhAM de Tole ihanAM toM pahilAM bIta cukke hana| bezaka uha ghATe pAuNa vAle loka sana|
hareka laI usa de karamAM anusAra daraje hana, tAM jo allAha uhanAM de karamAM dA pUrA-pUrA badalA deve| uhanAM nAla kise tarhAM dI vadhIkI nahIM kItI jAvegI|

jisa dina kAfirAM nUM agga de sAmhaNe peza kItA jAvegA tAM uhanAM nUM AkhiA jAvegA ki tusIM tAM saMsArika jIvana vica hI ApaNe hisse dIAM niamatAM dA pUrA-pUrA suAda lai liA ate tusIM uhanAM toM pUrA lAbha vI uThAiA, so ajja (kiAmata dihAr3e) tuhAnUM hINatA bhariA az2Aba dittA jAvegA| isa laI ki tusIM dharatI utte aNa-hakkA haMkAra karade rahe ate isa laI vI ki tusIM nA-faramAnIAM karade rahe|

(he nabI!) ratA Ada de bharA (hUda) nUM yAda karo jadoM usa ne ahakAfa (yamana) vikhe ApaNI kauma nUM (rabbI az2Aba toM) DarAiA sI| bezaka isa (hUda) toM pahilAM vI kiMne hI DarAuNa vAle (rasUla) bIta cukke ate isa toM magaroM vI ho cukke hana| (hareka ne iho AkhiA ki) tusIM allAha toM chuTTa kise hora dI baMdagI nA karo| bezakka maiM tuhADe bAre ika vaDDe dihAr3e (kiAmata) de az2Aba toM DaradA hAM|

uhanAM (kauma) ne AkhiA, (he hUda!) kI tUM sADe kola isa laI AiA hai ki tUM sAnUM sADe izaTAM (dI pUjA) toM phera deveM? je tUM saccA hai tAM sADe laI uha az2Aba lai A jisa toM tUM sAnUM DarAuNadA hai|

(hUda ne) AkhiA ki isa (az2Aba) de AuNa dA giAna tAM kevala allAha kola hI hai, maiM tAM tuhAnUM uha sunehA pahuMcA rihA hAM jisa de nAla mainUM bhejiA giA hai| para maiM tuhAnUM ajihe loka vekha rihA hAM jihar3e agiAnatA toM kaMma lai rahe hana|

phera jadoM uhanAM (hUda dI kauma) ne usa (az2Aba) nUM vekhiA ki uhanAM dIAM ghATIAM valla ika badalla turiA A rihA hai tAM uha AkhaNa lagge ki iha baddala tAM sADe ‘te mIMha varhAuNa vAlA hai| tAM hUda ne AkhiA ki nahIM iha tAM az2Aba hai, jisa laI tusIM kAhalI karade sI| iha hanerI hai jisa vica dukhadAI az2Aba (lukiA hoiA) hai|

uha (hanerI) ApaNe rabba de hukama nAla hareka cIz2a nUM barabAda kara devegI, phera uha iMja ho gae ki uhanAM de gharAM toM chuTTa utthe kujjha vI nahIM sI disadA| asAM aparAdhIAM nUM ise tarhAM saz2A diA karade hAM|

asIM Ada kauma nUM uha kujjha dittA sI jo tuhAnUM nahIM baqhaziA| asAM uhanAM nUM kaMna, akkhAM te dila ditte, para nA uhanAM de kaMnAM ne, nA uhanAM dIAM akkhAM ne ate nA hI uhanAM de dilAM (akalAM) ne uhanAM nUM koI lAbha dittA, sagoM uha allAha dIAM AitAM (nizAnIAM) dA inakAra karade rahe ate uhanAM nUM usa az2Aba ne ghera liA jisa dA uha makhaula uDAiA karade sana|
asAM tuhADe Ale duale dIAM basatIAM nazaTa kara chaDDIAM| asIM ApaNIAM AitAM nUM tarhAM-tarhAM biAna kItA tAM jo uha sADe valla parata AuNa|

phera uhanAM lokAM ne uhanAM dI sahAitA kiuM nahIM kItI jinhAM nUM uhanAM ne allAha dI ner3atA prApata karana laI allAha nUM chaDDa ke izaTa baNA rakkhiA sI| sagoM uha izaTa tAM uhanAM koloM guAca gae iha sabha uhanAM dA jhUTha te uhanAM dIAM ghar3hIAM hoIAM gallAM sana|

(he nabI! ratA yAda karo) jadoM asIM jiMnAM dI ika TolI nUM tuhADe valla dhiAna duAiA sI jadoM ki uha.kuraAna suNade sI| jadoM uha jiMna usa.kuraAna nUM suNana laI hAz2ara hoe tAM (ika dUje nUM) AkhiA “cuppa ho jAo”| jadoM uha par3hiA jA cukkiA phera uha ApaNI kauma valla (rabba toM) DarAuNa vAle baNa ke Ae|

uhanAM (jiMnAM ne) AkhiA ki he sADI kauma! bezakka asIM ika kitAba suNI hai jihar3I mUsA toM picchoM utArI gaI hai| uha uhanAM kitAbAM dI (allAha valloM hoNa dI) puzaTI karadI hai jihar3IAM isa toM pahilAM dIAM hana| uha kitAba hakka sacca valla te siddhe rAha valla agavAI karadI hai|
he sADI kauma vAlio! allAha valla saddA deNa vAle dI galla kabUla kara lao ate usa utte ImAna lai Ao| uha tuhADe gunAha baqhaza devegA ate tuhAnUM dukhadAI az2Aba toM bacA lavegA|[3]
translations.footnotes: [3] vekho sUrata Ale-imarAna, hAzIA Aita 85/3

translations.translation: ate jihar3A koI allAha de dAaI (rabba valla saddaNa vAle) dI galla nahIM maMnegA tAM uha dharatI utte allAha nUM bevasa nahIM kara sakegA| allAha toM chuTTa usa dA koI sahAI vI nahIM hovegA| iho loka sapazaTa kurAhe pae hoe hana|

kI uhanAM ne vekhiA nahIM ki bezakka uha allAha hai, jisa ne akAzAM ate dharatI nUM sAjiA ate uha ihanAM dI racanA racAuNa vica thakkiA nahIM| kI uha muradiAM nUM jiUMdA karana dI samarathA nahIM rakhadA? kiuM nahIM! nirasaMdeha, uha tAM hareka cIz2a dI samarathA rakhadA hai|

jadoM kAfirAM nUM (naraka dI) agga de sAhamaNe liAMdA jAvegA, (phera uhanAM nUM pucchiA jAvegA), kI iha (naraka) sacca nahIM hai? tAM uha AkhaNage ki kiuM nahIM! sADe rabba dI suMha! (iha sacca hai)| allAha AkhegA, huNa tusIM ApaNe inakArI hoNa kArana az2Aba dA suAda cakho|

(he nabI!) tusIM dhIraja toM kaMma lao, jisa tarhAM (tuhAthoM pahilAM) hiMmata te hausale vAle rasUlAM ne dhIraja toM kaMma liA sI|[4] ihanAM kAfirAM laI az2Aba maMgaNa vica kAhalI nA karo| jisa dina uha (kAfira) usa (az2Aba) nUM vekha laiNage, jisa dA ihanAM nAla vAadA kItA jA rihA hai (tAM uha samajhaNage) ki uha tAM (saMsAra vica) dina dI basa ika ghar3I hI Thahire sana| (he nabI) iha (rabbI paig2Ama lokAM takka) pahuMcA dio hai, so nA-faramAna lokAM toM chuTTa hora koI vI barabAda nahIM hovegA|
translations.footnotes: [4] allAha ne dunIAM vica vaDDI saMkhiA vica paig2aMbara bheje sI para inhAM vica paMja uha paibaMbara hana jihar3e bahuta hI bar3I hiMmata ate hauMsale vAle hana| jinhAM vica haz2arata muhaMmada (sa:), haz2arata nUha, haz2arata ibarAhIma, haz2arata mUsA, haz2arata IsA zAmila hana|

translations.translation: jinhAM lokAM ne (rabbI AdezAM toM) inakAra kItA ate (dUjiAM nUM vI) allAha dI rAha callaNa toM rokiA, allAha ne uhanAM de karamAM nUM akAratha kara chaDDiA hai|[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] vekho sUrata Ale-imarAna, hAzIA Aita 85/3

translations.translation: jihar3e loka ImAna liAe te bhale kaMma kIte ate uha usa (.kuraAna) utte ImAna liAe jo haz2arata muhaMmada (sa:) ’te utAriA giA ate uha uhanAM de rabba valloM hakka-sacca ’te AdhArita hai, allAha ne uhanAM dIAM burAIAM uhanAM toM dUra kara dittIAM ate uhanAM dA hAla suAra dittA|

iha isa laI ki jinhAM lokAM ne (.kuraAna dA) inakAra kItA hai, uhanAM ne kUr3a kusati (jhUTha) dI pairavI kItI hai ate jihar3e loka ImAna liAe, uhanAM ne ApaNe rabba valloM AI hoI hakka-sacca dI pairavI kItI| isa tarhAM allAha lokAM de laI uhanAM dIAM udAharaNAM biAna karadA hai|

so jadoM ihanAM inakArIAM nAla (jaMga de maidAna vica) tuhADI muThabher3a ho jAve tAM (sabha toM pahilAM) ihanAM dIAM dhaunAM vaDDo|[2] jadoM tusIM uhanAM nUM caMgI tarhAM kucala dio tAM kaidIAM nUM caMgI tarhAM baMnha lavo, isa toM picchoM jAM tAM tusIM uhanAM ’te ahisAna karo jAM fidIyA (firautI) lai lao, itthoM taka ki lar3AI ApaNe hathiAra suTTa deve (bhAva jaMga qhatama ho jAve), tuhADe laI hukama iho hai| je allAha cAhuMdA tAM Apa hI uhanAM toM badalA lai laiMdA, para usa ne tuhAnUM hukama dittA hai tAM jo uha tuhADI ika dUje rAhIM parakha kara sake| jihar3e loka allAha dI rAha vica katala (zahIda) kIte gae, allAha uhanAM de kIte (neka) kaMma ajAIM nahIM jANa devegA|
translations.footnotes: [2] vekho sUrata ala-bakaraha, hAzIA Aita 190/2 ate vekho sUrata ata-taubA, hAzIA Aita 20/9

translations.translation: uha chetI hI uhanAM dI agavAI karegA ate uhanAM de hAla suAra devegA|
uha uhanAM nUM usa (jaMnata) vica dAqhala karegA, jisa toM uha uhanAM nUM jANU karA cukkA hai|
he ImAna vAlio! je tusIM allAha dI sahAitA karoge tAM uha tuhADI sahAitA karegA ate tuhADe pairAM nUM pakkiAM kara devegA|
para jinhAM lokAM ne inakAra kItA hai tAM uhanAM laI barabAdI hai ate allAha uhanAM de karamAM nUM ajAIM kara devegA|
iha isa laI hai ki bezakka uhanAM ne usa cIz2a (.kuraAna) nUM nA-pasaMda kItA hai jihar3I allAha ne utArI hai| phera usa (allAha) ne uhanAM de (neka) karamAM nUM ajAIM kara dittA|

phera kI uha dharatI utte ture-phire nahIM ki uha uhanAM lokAM dA aMta vekha laiMde jihar3e uhanAM toM pahilAM (inakArI) sana?allAha ne uhanAM nUM barabAda kara suTTiA| inakArIAM laI ajihIAM hI saz2AvAM niyata karade hAM|
iha isa laI ki bezakka allAha uhanAM lokAM dI madada karadA hai jihar3e ImAna liAe ate jihar3e inakArI hana uhanAM dA koI vI sahAika nahIM|

bezakka jihar3e loka ImAna liAe ate uhanAM ne neka te bhale kaMma vI kIte tAM allAha uhanAM lokAM nUM ajihe bAg2AM vica dAqhala karegA, jinhAM heTha nahirAM vagadIAM hana ate jinhAM lokAM ne (rabba ate usa de rasUla dA) inakAra kItA, uha saMsAra dA hI lAbha uThAuMde hana| uha iMja nizaciMta hoke khAMde-pIMde hana jiveM DaMgara-pazU khAMde hana| aMta agga hI uhanAM dA AqharI TikANA hai|

(he nabI!) kiMnIAM hI uha basatIAM tuhADI isa basatI (makkA) nAloM jisa (de vasanIkAM) ne tuhAnUM bAhara kaDDha dittA, kite vaddha z2orAvara sana| asIM uhanAM nUM barabAda kara suTTiA, phera uhanAM dI sahAitA karana vAlA koI vI nahIM sI|

bhalAM kI uha viakatI, jihar3A ApaNe rabba valloM pratakkha te sapazaTa hidAita utte hove, uha usa viakatI vAMga ho sakadA hai jisa laI usa dI bhair3I karanI zobhAmAna baNA dittI gaI hai ate uha ApaNIAM icchAvAM de picche lagga giA hove?

jisa jaMnata dA vAadA parahez2agArAM nAla kItA giA hai, usa dI zAna iha hai ki usa vica ajihe pANI dIAM nahirAM hana, jihar3A badalaNa vAlA nahIM ate ajihe duddha dIAM nahirAM hana jisa de savAda vica koI faraka nahIM AiA hovegA ate ajihI zarAba dIAM nahirAM hana jihar3IAM pINa vAliAM laI suAdalI hovegI ate pAka-sAfa zahida dIAM nahirAM hana| utthe uhanAM laI hara prakAra de phala hoNage te uhanAM de rabba valloM baqhaziza hovegI| kI iha (neka loka) uhanAM lokAM vAMga ho sakade hana jihar3e sadA naraka vica rahiNa vAle hana| utthe uhanAM nUM ubaladA hoiA pANI piAiA jAvegA jo uhanAM dIAM AMtar3AM de ToTe-ToTe kara devegA|

(he nabI!) ihanAM (munAfikAM) vica hI kujjha loka ajihe hana jihar3e tuhADe valla kaMna lAIM rakkhade hana| jadoM uha tuhADe koloM nikalade hana tAM uha uhanAM toM jinhAM nUM (AsamAnI kitAbAM dA) giAna dittA giA hai, pucchade hana ki isa (nabI) ne huNe-huNe tuhAnUM kI AkhiA sI? iha uha loka hana jinhAM de dilAM utte allAha ne mohara lA chaDDI hai ate uha ApaNIAM icchAvAM de picche lagge rahe|
jihar3e loka siddhe rAha pae hana allAha uhanAM nUM vadhere hidAita diMdA hai ate uhanAM nUM uhanAM de hisse dA Dara-bhau diMdA hai|

iha loka tAM huNa kiAmata dI uDIka kara rahe hana ki uha acaNaceta uhanAM ’te A jAve| bezakka usa dIAM nizAnIAM tAM A cukkIAM hana| so jadoM uhanAM kola kiAmata A pujjegI tAM uhanAM laI nasIhata kabUla karana dA kihar3A maukA bAkI rahi jAvegA?[3]
translations.footnotes: [3] bhAva usa sameM taubA nahIM kara sakaNage nA hI taubA lAbhadAika hovegI| vekho sUrata ala-anAma, hAzIA Aita 158/6

translations.translation: so (he nabI!) caMgI tarhAM jANa lao ki allAha toM chuTTa koI saccA izaTa nahIM hai tusIM ApaNe laI vI ate momina maradAM ate momina auratAM de gunAhAM laI vI (rabba toM) muAfI maMgo| allAha tuhADe turana-phirana (saragaramIAM) toM ate tuhADe TikANe toM vI jANU hai|

jihar3e loka ImAna liAe uha Akhade hana ki koI sUrata (jihAda de saMbaMdha vica) kiuM nahIM utArI gaI? jadoM koI sapazaTa te pakkI sUrata utArI jAMdI hai, jisa vica katala karana dI caracA kItI jAMdI hai| (he nabI!) kI tusIM uhanAM lokAM nUM vekhiA, jinhAM de dilAM vica roga sI, uha tuhADe valla usa viakatI vAMga vekhade hana jiveM kise ’te mauta chA gaI hove| so uhanAM laI barabAdI hai|
tAbedArI karanA te caMgIAM gallAM AkhaNIAM vadhIA galla hai para jadoM (jihAda dA) samazaTa hukama A jAMdA hai tAM je uha allAha nAla kIte praNa vica sacce rahiMde tAM uhanAM laI vadhere caMgA hai|
so (he munAfiko!) tuhAthoM tAM iho Asa kItI jA sakadI hai ki je tusIM hAkama baNa jAo tAM tusIM dharatI vica vigAr3a pAoge ate ApaNe rizatiAM nUM tor3oge|[4]
translations.footnotes: [4] allAha de rasUla ne faramAiA ki rizatedArIAM taur3ana vAlA jaMnata vica dAqhila nahIM hovegA| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 5984)

translations.translation: iho uha loka hana jinhAM utte allAha ne phiTakAra pAI hai| phera usa (allAha) ne uhanAM (munAfikAM) nUM bolA baNA dittA ate akkhAM toM aMnhA kara dittA|
kI uha loka.kuraAna utte vicAra nahIM karade jAM uhanAM de dilAM utte jaMdare lagge hoe hana?

bezakka jihar3e lokAM ne piTThAM phera laIAM jada ki uhanAM utte hidAita sapazaTa ho cukkI sI phera zaitAna ne uhanAM de bhair3e amalAM nUM zobhAmAna baNA chaDDiA hai ate allAha ne uhanAM nUM Dhilla de chaDDI|

iha isa laI sI ki bezakka uhanAM ne uhanAM (yahUdI) lokAM nUM, jinhAM ne isa cIz2a (.kuraAna) nUM nA-pasaMda kItA, jihar3A allAha ne utAriA sI, AkhiA ki kujjha mAmaliAM vica asIM tuhADIAM gallAM maMnAMge| allAha uhanAM de dilAM dIAM gallAM caMgI tarhAM jANadA hai|
usa vele kI hovegA, jadoM farizate uhanAM de mUMhAM te piTThAM utte mArade hoe uhanAM de prANa kaDDhaNage|

iha (mAra-kuTTa) isa laI hovegI ki uhanAM ne usa cIz2a dI pairavI kItI jisa ne allAha nUM nArAz2a kara dittA ate uhanAM ne allAha dI raz2AmaMdI nUM nA-pasaMda kItA| so allAha ne uhanAM dIAM sArIAM karanIAM ajAIM guA dittIAM|
kI uhanAM lokAM ne, jinhAM de dilAM vica roga hai, iha samajha baiThe hana ki allAha uhanAM de dilAM de khoTa nUM pragaTa nahIM karegA?

je asIM cAhuMde tAM uha munAfika tuhAnUM akkhIM vikhA diMde, phera tusIM uhanAM nUM uhanAM de cihariAM toM pachANa laiMde| tusIM uhanAM dI bola-bANI toM uhanAM nUM jANa lavoge| allAha tuhADe karamAM nUM jANadA hai|

(he momIno!) asIM tuhAnUM z2arUra hI az2amAvAMge tAM jo asIM vekha laIe ki tuhADe viccoM jihAda karana vAle te sabara karana vAle (bhAva maidAna vica DaTe rahiNa vAle) kauNa hana ate tuhADe dilAM de hAla dI parakha karIe|

bezakka jinhAM lokAM ne inakAra kItA ate dUjiAM nUM vI allAha dI rAha toM rokiA ate rasUla (sa:) dI virodhatA kItI, jadoM ki uhanAM utte siddhI rAha sapazaTa ho cukkI sI,[5] uha allAha dA kujjha vI vigAr3a nahIM sakade| chetI hI uha uhanAM de amalAM nUM ajAIM guA devegA|
translations.footnotes: [5] vekho sUrata ala-fAtihA, hAzIA Aita 6/1

translations.translation: he ImAna vAlio! tusIM allAha dI AgiA dI pAlaNA karo ate rasUla dI tAbedArI karo ate ApaNe karamAM nUM ajAIM nA karo|
bezakka jinhAM lokAM ne kufara kItA ate dUjiAM nUM allAha dI rAha toM rokiA, phera uha use kufara dI hAlata vica hI mara gae, tAM allAha uhanAM nUM kade vI muAfa nahIM karegA|[6]
translations.footnotes: [6] vekho sUrata Ale-imarAna, hAzIA Aita 85/3

translations.translation: so tusIM susatI nA vikhAo, nA hI sulAha laI benatI karo jada ki tusIM hI g2Alaba (bhArU) rahiNa vAle ho| allAha tuhADe aMga-saMga hai, uha tuhADe karamAM (de savAba)nUM kade vI ghaTTa nahIM karegA|

saMsArika jIvana tAM ika kheDa-tamAzA hai| (he loko!) je tusIM (allAha te usa de rasUla muhaMmada sa: utte) ImAna lai Ao te burAIAM toM bace raho tAM allAha tuhAnUM tuhADe karamaphala devegA| uha tuhAthoM tuhADe sAre dhana-padAratha nahIM maMgadA|
je allAha tuhAthoM uha (mAla-daulata) maMga lave ate isa laI z2ora pAve, tAM phera tusIM kaMjUsI karoge ate uha tuhADe (dilAM de) khoTa bAhara kaDDha liAvegA|

suNo! tusIM tAM uha loka ho ki jihanAM nUM saddA dittA jAMdA hai ki tusIM allAha dI rAha vica qharaca karo, tuhADe viccoM kujjha uha vI hana jihar3e kaMjUsIAM karade hana| jihar3A koI kaMjUsI karadA hai (uha suNa lave!) uha tAM ApaNe Apa nAla hI kaMjUsI karadA hai| allAha tAM beparavAha hai, tusIM hI usa de muthAja ho| je tusIM (usa toM) mUMha mor3oge tAM allAha tuhADI thAM dUje lokAM nUM badala devegA, phera uha tuhADe varage (nA-faramAna) nahIM hoNage|
(he nabI!) bezakka asIM tuhAnUM khallhI fatiha baqhaza dittI hai|
tAM jo allAha tuhADIAM sArIAM agalIAM pichalIAM bhullAM nUM muAfa kara deve [1] ate tuhADe utte ApaNI niamata (inAma) nUM pUrI kare ate tuhAnUM siddhI rAha dI hidAita baqhaze|
translations.footnotes: [1] haz2arata mUg2airA bina zAabA toM patA lagadA hai ki nabI (sa:) tahajjada dI namAz2a vica iMnI dera khar3e rahiMde sI ki unhAM de pairAM utte sojA A jAMdA sI| lokAM ne kihA ki allAha ne tAM tuhADe agale pichale sAre hI gunAha baqhaza ditte hana phera tusIM iMnI tapassiA kiuM karade ho| tAM Apa (sa:) ne faramAiA, kI maiM allAha dA dhaMnavAdI baMdA nA baNAM? (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 4836)

translations.translation: ate allAha tuhADI bharapUra madada kare|

uhIo (allAha) hai jisa ne mominAM de dilAM vica sakInata (mana dI zAMtI) utArI tAM jo uhanAM de ImAna vica hora vAdhA hove| akAza te dharatI dIAM sArIAM faujAM allAha de hI adhIna hana| allAha vaDDA jANanahAra te yukatImAna hai|

(iha sabha kujjha isa laI kItA hai) tAM jo uha momina purazAM nUM te momina isatarIAM nUM ajihe bAg2AM vica dAqhala kare jinhAM de heTha nahirAM vagadIAM hana| uha sadA uhanAM bAg2AM vica hI rahiNage ate uhanAM dIAM burAIAM nUM uhanAM toM dUra kara devegA| allAha dI naz2ara vica iha bahuta vaDDI kAmayAbI hai|

tAM jo munAfika (pakhaMDI) puraza ate munAfika isatarIAM ate muzarika puraza ate muzarika isatarIAM nUM az2Aba (saz2A) deve jihar3e allAha de saMbaMdha vica bhair3e vicAra rakkhade hana| burAI de phera vica uha Ape hI hana| uhanAM utte allAha dI karopI hoI ate usa ne uhanAM utte phiTakAra pAI ate usa ne uhanAM laI naraka tiAra kara rakkhI hai ate uha bahuta hI bhair3A paratana vAlA TikANA hai|
akAzAM te dharatI dIAM sArIAM faujAM allAha de hI adhIna hana| allAha vaDDA z2orAvara ate hikamata vAlA (yukatImAna) hai|
(he muhaMmada sa:!) bezakka asIM tuhAnUM (hakka dI) gavAhI deNa vAlA, (jaMnata dIAM) qhuzaqhabarIAM suNAuNa vAlA ate (naraka toM) DarAuNa vAlA baNA ke bhejiA hai|[2]
translations.footnotes: [2] vekho sUrata ala-bakaraha, hAzIA Aita 42/2

translations.translation: (so he loko!) tusIM allAha te usa de rasUla (muhaMmada sa:) utte ImAna liAo, tusIM usa (rasUla) dI madada karo ate usa dA satikAra karo ate savere-zAma (hara vele) usa (allAha) dI pAkI biAna karo|

(he nabI!) bezakka jihar3e loka tuhADe nAla ‘baiata’ (pratiggiA) kara rahe hana, asala vica uha allAha nAla ‘baiata’ kara rahe hana| allAha dA hattha uhanAM de hatthAM utte hai| huNa jihar3A ApaNI pratiggiA nUM tor3egA, usa dI pratiggiA tor3ana dA doza usa de ApaNe hI sira hovegA| ate jihar3A usa ‘baiata’ nUM tor3a nibhAegA jo usa ne allAha nAla kItI hai tAM allAha usa nUM chetI hI vaDDA-uccA badalA devegA|

(he nabI!) araba-baddUAM viccoM (jaMga vica) picche rahi jANa vAle loka tuhAnUM z2arUra AkhaNage ki sAnUM sADe mAla-padArathAM ate bAla-bacciAM ne rujheviAM vica pA rakkhiA sI, so tusIM sADe laI baqhaziza dI duA karo| uha ApaNe mUMhoM uha gallAM Akha rahe hana jo uhanAM de dilAM vica nahIM| tusIM uhanAM nUM Akho ki uha kauNa hai jihar3A tuhADe mAmale vica allAha valloM kIte gae faisaliAM de saMbaMdha vica koI adhikAra rakhadA hai, je uha tuhAnUM koI hAnI pahuMcAuNA cAhe jAM koI lAbha deNA cAhe? (iha adhikAra kise nUM vI nahIM)| sagoM allAha hI tuhADe karamAM toM caMgI tarhAM jANU hai?

sagoM tuhADI soca tAM iha sI ki rasUla te ImAna vAle kade vI parata ke ApaNe parivAra valla nahIM A sakaNage ate iha vicAra tuhADe dilAM nUM sohaNA jApadA sI| tusIM bahuta hI bhair3A gumAna kItA sI| (he munAfiko!) tusIM tAM barabAda hoNa vAle loka ho|
jihar3A viakatI allAha te usa de rasUla utte ImAna nahIM liAiA [3] tAM asIM ajihe kAfirA laI bhar3akadI hoI agga tiAra kara rakkhI hai|
translations.footnotes: [3] vekho sUrata Ale-imarAna, hAzIA Aita 85/3

translations.translation: akAzAM ate dharatI dI pAtazAhI allAha laI hI hai| uha jisa nUM cAhe muAfa kara deve te jisa nUM cAhe az2Aba (saz2A) deve| allAha atiaMta baqhazaNahAra te rahima faramAuNa vAlA hai|

(he nabI!) tusIM chetI hI mAle-g2anImata prApata karana laI (qhaibara valla) jAoge tAM picche chaDDe jANa vAle loka tuhAnUM z2arUra AkhaNage ki sAnUM vI ApaNe nAla callaNa dI AgiA dio| uha allAha de hukama nUM badala deNA cAhuMde hana| so tusIM Akha dio! ki tusIM kade vI sADe nAla nahIM calloge, kiuM jo allAha iha hukama pahilAM hI faramA cukkiA hai| phera uha AkhaNage ki iha galla nahIM, sagoM tusIM tAM sADe nAla IrakhA karade ho (jadoM ki ajihA nahIM)| iha loka ThIka gala nUM ghaTTa hI samajhade hana|

(he nabI!) tusIM ihanAM picche chaDDe jANa vAle dihAtIAM (araba-baddUAM) nUM Akha dio ki chetI hI tuhAnUM ika lar3AkU kauma nAla yuddha karana laI saddiA jAvegA jAM tusIM uhanAM nAla lar3ade hI rahoge jAM uha musalamAna (bhAva AgiAkArI) baNa jANage| so je tusIM (allAha de) hukamAM dI pAlaNA karoge tAM allAha tuhAnUM sohaNA badalA devegA| para je tusIM mUMha mor3hiA (bhAva avagiAkArI kItI) jiveM ki tusIM pahilAM (hudaibIA vele) mUMha mor3hiA sI, tAM allAha tuhAnUM dukhadAI az2Aba devegA|

hAM je aMnhA, lUlA-laMgar3A te rogI (jihAda laI) nA jAve tAM koI gunAha nahIM| jihar3A vI koI allAha te usa de rasUla haz2arata (muhaMmada sa:) de Akhe laggegA, allAha usa nUM ajihe bAg2AM vica rakkhegA jisa de heTha nahirAM vagadIAM hana ate jihar3A koI (hakka sacca toM) mUMha pheregA tAM uha (allAha) usa nUM dukhadAI saz2A devegA|

bezakka allAha ImAna vAliAM nAla use sameM rAz2I ho giA sI jadoM uha ika rukkha de heTha tuhADe (muhaMmada sa:) nAla pratiggiA kara rahe sana| so jo uhanAM de manAM vica sI, allAha ne usa nUM vekha liA sI| phera allAha ne uhanAM utte sakInata (manAM dI zAMtI) utArI ate badale vica nikaTa bhavikkha vica prApata hoNa vAlI jitta (dI qhuzaqhabarI) dittI|
ate Dhera sArA mAle-g2anImata vI baqhaziA, jo uha prApata kara laiNage| allAha bahuta hI z2orAvara te yukatImAna hai|

allAha ne tuhAnUM Dhera sAre mAle-g2anImata dA vacana dittA hai ki tusIM usa nUM (jaMga vica) prApata karoge, so usa ne chetI hI tuhAnUM (qhaibara vica) uha (mAla padAratha) baqhaza ditte| lokAM de hattha tuhADe virudha uTThaNa toM roka ditte tAM jo iha ImAna vAliAM laI ika nizAnI baNa jAve ate uha (allAha) tuhAnUM siddhe rAha dI hidAita baqhaze|
dUjIAM g2anImatAM vI baqhazIAM, jinhAM ’te tusIM kAbU nahIM sI pA sakade| para allAha ne uhanAM sabha nUM ApaNe ghere vica kara rakkhiA hai| allAha nUM hara prakAra dI samarathA prApata hai|
je (qhaibara vica) uha kAfira tuhADe nAla lar3ade tAM phera uha z2arUra hI piTTha vikhA jAMde| phera uhanAM nUM nA koI mittara te nA hI koI sahAI labhadA|
iho allAha dI mariAdA hai jo muDDhoM callI A rahI hai| tusIM allAha dI mariAdA vica kade vI tabadIlI nahIM vekhoge|

uha allAha hI hai jisa ne makke dI ghATI vica uhanAM (kAfirAM) de hattha tuhAthoM ate tuhADe hattha uhanAM toM roka ditte (bhAva lar3AI nahIM hoI), jadoM ki isa de magaroM usa (allAha) ne tuhAnUM uhanAM utte bhArU kara chaDDiA sI| allAha uha sabha kujjha vekha rihA hai jo tusIM kara rahe ho|

iha uha loka hana jinhAM ne (tuhADA) inakAra kItA ate tuhAnUM satikArayoga masIta (qhAnA-kAabA) jANa toM rokiA ate kurabAnI de jAnavarAM nUM vI kurabAnagAha jANa toM rokIM rakkhiA| je (makke vikhe) kujjha ImAna vAle puraza ate ImAna vAlI isatarIAM nA huMdIAM jinhAM (de ImAna) nUM tusIM jANade vI nahIM sI, (je iha qhatarA nA huMdA ki) tusIM (kAfirAM nAla lar3ade hoe) uhanAM (ImAna vAliAM) nUM vI latAr3a suTToge te aNajANapuNe vica hoe uhanAM de katala kArana tuhAnUM dukkha huMdA (tAM tuhAnUM lar3ana dI AgiA de dittI jAMdI, para iMja nahIM kItA) tAM jo allAha jisa nUM cAhe ApaNIAM miharAM vica dAqhala kara lave| je uha (ImAna vAle te inakArI) vakhare-vakhare ho jAMde tAM jihar3e uhanAM viccoM inakArI sI, asIM uhanAM nUM dukhadAI saz2A diMde|

jihar3e lokAM ne kufara kItA jadoM uhanAM ne ApaNe dilAM vica haTadharamI paidA kara laI, haTadharamI vI agiAnatA vAlI, tAM allAha ne ApaNe rasUla te mominAM utte sakInata (zAMtI) utArI ate uhanAM nUM allAha de Dara utte kAima rakkhiA, kiuM jo uhIo usa de vadhere hakkadAra te yoga sana| allAha hareka cIz2a dA giAna rakhadA hai|

bezakka allAha ne ApaNe rasUla nUM supane vica hakka-sacca nAla sUcanA dittI sI ki je allAha ne cAhiA tAM tusIM ApaNe sira munavAuMde hoe ate ApaNe vAla kutaravAuMde hoe satikArayoga masIta (qhAnA-kAabA) vikhe z2arUra hI praveza karoge| tuhAnUM (kise dA vI) koI Dara nahIM hovegA| allAha uha gallAM jANadA hai jo tusIM nahIM jANade| so usa allAha ne usa (phatiha mukkA) toM pahilAM tuhAnUM ika ner3e dI fatiha (bhAva suleha hudaibIA) baqhazI hai|

uha allAha hI tAM hai jisa ne ApaNe rasUla nUM hidAita ate saccA dharama de ke ghalliA hai tAM jo uha isa dharama (isalAma) nUM sAre dharamAM utte g2Aliba (bhArU) kara deve ate isa de hakka hoNa ’te allAha dI gavAhI kAfI hai|

muhaMmada (sa:) allAha de rasUla hana ate jihar3e loka uhanAM nAla (bhAva sahAbI) hana, uha kAfirAM laI tAM bahuta karar3e te kaThora hana para Apo vica atiaMta miharabAna hana| tusIM uhanAM nUM rukUa te sijadA karade hoe vekhoge ate uha allAha dI kripAlatA te raz2A dI bhAla vica rujhe rahiMde hana| uhanAM dI vizeza pachANa uhanAM de matthiAM utte sijadiAM de nizAna hana| uhanAM dI iho sifata tauraita vica hai ate iMjIla vica uhanAM dI iha sifata usa khetI vAMga hai jisa ne ApaNI pahilI tUI kaDDhI, phera usa nUM pakiAI dittI, phera uha gadarAI ate phera ApaNI nAlI utte khalo gaI| kisAnAM nUM uha (khetI) qhuza kara diMdI hai| allAha ne iha isa laI kItA hai tAM jo ihanAM (sahAbA) de kArana kAfira sar3a jANa| allAha ne uhanAM lokAM laI (jihar3e ImAna liAe ate neka te bhale kaMma kIte) baqhaziza ate vaDDe ucce daraje dA badalA deNa dA vacana dittA hai|
he ImAna vAlio! allAha ate usa de rasUla (muhaMmada sa:) toM (kise pakkhoM vI) agAMha nA vadho [1] ate allAha toM Darade rihA karo, allAha (hara galla) suNana vAlA ate jANana vAlA hai|
translations.footnotes: [1] bhAva dIna de mAmale vica allAha ate usa de rasUla toM agge vadhana dI koziza nahIM karanI cAhIdI kiuM jo allAha taAlA ne isa dI saqhata nakhedI kItI hai| jihar3A koI dIna de vica navIM galla vadhAuMdA hai usa nUM bidaatI kihA jAMdA hai|

translations.translation: he ImAna vAlio! ApaNIAM AvAz2AM nabI (muhaMmada sa:) dI avAz2a nAloM uccI nA karo ate nA hI uhanAM nAla uccI AvAz2a karake galla karo jiveM tusIM ika-dUje nAla uccI AvAz2a nAla gallabAta karade ho| kite iMja nA hove ki tuhADe kite karAe sAre kaMma viaratha hI cale jANa ate tuhAnUM patA vI nA lagge|

jihar3e loka allAha de paig2aMbara (muhaMmada sa:) dI haz2UrI vica ApaNIAM AvAz2AM nIvIAM rakkhade hana, iho uha loka hana jinhAM de dilAM dI parakha allAha ne parahez2agArI laI kara laI hai| uhanAM laI (allAha valloM) baqhaziza hai ate (caMge kaMmAM dA) bahuta vaDDA badalA hai|
(he nabI!) jihar3e loka tuhAnUM kamariAM de bAharoM AvAz2AM diMde hana uhanAM viccoM bahute loka be-akala hana|
je uha loka sabara toM kaMma laiMde ki tusIM Apa hI uhanAM kola A jAMde tAM uhanAM laI vadhere caMgA huMdA| allAha vaDDA baqhazaNahAra ate miharabAna hai|

he ImAna vAlio! je koI jhUThA viakatI tuhAnUM koI sUcanA deve tAM usa dI jAMca-par3hatAla kara liA karo| iMja nA hove ki tusIM kise kauma nUM aNajANapuNe vica nukasAna pucA baiTho ate phera tuhAnUM ApaNI karanI ’te pachatAvA hove|

bhalI bhAMta jANa jAo! ki tuhADe vicAle allAha dA rasUla maujUda hai| je uha sAre mAmaliAM vica tuhADI galla maMna liA kare tAM tusIM Apo aukar3AM vica phasa jAMde, para allAha ne tuhAnUM ImAna dA moha baqhaziA ate usa nUM tuhADe laI mana-bhAuMdA baNA dittA ate usa ne tuhADe laI kufara, jhUTha te avaggiA nUM nA-pasaMda baNA chaDDiA hai| iho loka siddhI rAha callaNa vAle te hidAita vAle hana|
iha sabha allAha dA ahisAna ate inAma hai ate allAha sabha kujjha jANana vAlA ate yukatImAna (hikamata) vAlA hai|

ate (he musalamAno!) je ImAna vAliAM de do dhar3e Apo vica lar3a paiNa tAM uhanAM vicAle mela-milApa karA dio| (je uhanAM vicAle sulAha nA hove tAM) phera jihar3A uhanAM ’coM dUje nAla vadhIkI karadA hai tAM tusIM vadhIkI karana vAle nAla lar3o, itthoM taka ki uha allAha de hukamAM nUM maMNana vAlA baNa jAve| je uha sulAha valla parata Ave tAM inasAfa nAla sulAha karavA dio ate niA karo, kiuM jo allAha niA karana vAliAM nUM hI muhabbata karadA hai|
(yAda rakkho ki) sAre hI ImAna vAle (ika-dUje de) bharA hana, so tusIM ApaNe bharAvAM vicAle (je lar3AI ho jAve) sulAha karA diA karo ate allAha toM Daro tAM jo tuhADe ’te mihara kItI jAve|

he ImAna vAlio! purazAM dA koI dhar3A dUje purazAM dA makhaula nA uDAve, ho sakadA hai ki uha loka uhanAM nAloM caMgere hoNa, ate nA hI z2anAnIAM dUjIAM z2anAnIAM dA makhaula uDAuNa, ho sakadA hai ki uha (z2anAnIAM) uhanAM nAloM caMgIAM hoNa| ate Apasa vica ika dUje dIAM burAIAM nA karo, nA hI kise nUM bhair3e nAM nAla pukAro, ImAna liAuNa magaroM bhair3e nAM nAla pukAranA gunAha hai| jihar3e loka (gunAha karana magaroM) taubA nahIM karade uhIo z2Alima hana|

he ImAna vAlio! bahute gumAna karana toM baco kiuM jo kaI gumAna tAM gunAha huMde hana| tusIM ika dUje dI Toha vica nA raho ate nA hI tuhADe viccoM koI kise dI cug2alI kare| kI tuhADe viccoM koI ApaNe mare hoe bharA dA mAsa khANA pasaMda karegA? sagoM tuhAnUM tAM isa toM ghriNA AvegI| [2] allAha toM Daro (je koI pApa ho giA tAM taubA karo) bezakka allAha taubA kabUlaNa vAlA ate miharabAna hai|
translations.footnotes: [2] allAha de rasUla ne faramAiA ki he loko! tusIM bada gumAnI toM baco kiuM jo bada-g2umAnI sabha toM bhair3I cIz2a hai| dUjiAM dI Toha vica nA raho, kise de aiba nA labbho nA ika dUje toM vaddhaNa dI bejA lAlasA karo ate nA Apasa vica IrakhA karo ate nA ika dUje toM mUMha phairo| he allAha de baMdio! Apasa vica bhAI bhAI baNa ke raho| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa, 6066) dUjI hadIsa vica hai ki nabI (sa:) do kabarAM de ner3ioM laMghe tAM Apa ne faramAiA ki inhAM kabarAM vAliAM nUM az2Aba ho rihA hai kiuM jo inhAM viccoM ika paizAba de chITiAM toM nahIM bacadA sI ate dUjA cug2alaqhora sI| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 6052)

translations.translation: he loko! asAM tuhAnUM sabha nUM ikka puraza ate ika isatarI (Adama te havA) toM padA kItA hai| ika dUje dI pachANa laI tuhADe qhAnadAna ate kabIle (gotara, barAdarIAM) baNA dittIAM (praMtU) allAha dIAM naz2arAM vica sabha toM vadhere Adara-mAna vAlA tuhADe viccoM uhIo hai jihar3A sabha toM vaddha (rabba toM) DaradA hai| bezakka allAha sabha kujjha jANadA hai ate hareka galla dI qhabara rakkhadA hai|

dihAtI (baddU) Akhade hana ki asIM ImAna liAe hAM| tusIM (he nabI!) uhanAM nUM Akho ki (hakIkata vica tAM) tusIM ImAna nahIM liAe, hAM iMja kaho ki asIM isalAma liAe hAM jada ki sacca iha hai ki ajihe taka tuhADe manAM vica (sacce) ImAna ne praveza nahIM kItA| je tusIM allAha dI ate usa de rasUla (muhaMmada sa:) dI faramAMbaradArI karoge tAM allAha tuhADe amalAM viccoM kujjha vI ghATa nahIM karegA| bezakka allAha baqhazaNahAra ate diAlU hai|

hakIkata vica (sacce) momina tAM uha hana jihar3e allAha te usa de rasUla (muhaMmada sa:) ’ta pakkA ImAna liAe, phera uhanAM ne kise vI prakAra dA koI zakka nahIM kItA ate uhanAM ne ApaNe dhaMna ate ApaNIAM jAnAM nAla allAha dI rAha vica jihAda (saMgharaza) kItA, uhIo loka sacce ImAna vAle hana|

(he nabI! tusIM ImAna de dAavedArAM nUM) Akho, kI tusIM allAha nUM ApaNI dInadArI toM jANU karavAMde ho?jada ki akAzAM ate dharatI vica jo kujjha vI hai, usa toM allAha bhalI-bhAMta jANU hai ate allAha hI hara cIz2a dA giAna rakkhadA hai|

(he nabI!) uha (baddU) tuhADe utte ApaNe musalamAna hoNa dA ahisAna jatAuMde hana| tusIM uhanAM nUM Akho ki ApaNe musalamAna hoNa dA ahisAna mere sira nA dharo, sagoM tuhADe ’te allAha dA ahisAna hai ki usa ne tuhAnUM ImAna dI hidAita baqhazI, je tusIM sacce ho| (tAM isa ahisAna nUM kabUlo)|
bezakka allAha akAzAM ate dharatI dIAM sArIAM gupata gallAM nUM jANadA hai ate tusIM jo vI kara rahe ho allAha usa nUM vI caMgI tarhAM vekha rihA hai|
kAfa| kasama hai satikArayoga.kuraAna dI|

sagoM uhanAM (makke vAliAM) nUM rurAnI hoI ki uhanAM kola uhanAM viccoM hI ika viakatI (bhAva muhaMmada sa:) uhanAM nUM (rabba de az2Aba toM) DarAuNa vAlA A giA, tAM kAfira AkhaNa lagge ki iha tAM ajIba galla hai|
kI jadoM asIM mara jAvAMge te miTTI ho jAMvAge (tAM kI rabba sAnUM mur3a jiUMdA karegA?) uha mur3a vApasI (rabba de kola) akaloM parAM galla hai|

(he loko!) dharatI uhanAM (muradA sarIra viccoM khAke) jo ghaTAuMdI hai uha sabha sADe (bhAva rabba de) giAna vica hai ate sADe kola ika kitAba hai jisa vica yAda rakkhaNa vAlIAM sArIAM gallAM surakkhiata hana|
sagoM uhanAM (makke de inakArIAM) ne hakka (.kuraAna) nUM jhuThalAiA| jadoM uha (.kuraAna) uhanAM (makke vAliAM) kola pahuMciA tAM uha sAre ulajhaNa vica pai gae|
kI ihanAM (inakArIAM) ne ApaNe utte akAza valla nahIM vekhiA ki asIM isa nUM kiveM baNAiA hai? ate isa nUM (tAriAM te caMna nAla) sajAiA ate isa (akAza) vica koI cheka vI nahIM hai?
ate asIM dharatI nUM (faraza vAMga) vichAiA ate isa vica pahAr3a gaDDa ditte ate isa vica bhAMta-bhAMta dIAM sohaNIAM disaNa vAlIAM cIz2AM ugA dittIAM|
ate iha sArIAM cIz2AM hara usa viakatI dIAM akkhAM kholhaNa laI ate sikkhiA laI hana jihar3A hakka valla paratanA cAhuMdA hai|
ate asIM akAza toM barakatAM vAlA pANI utAriA jisa toM bAg2a ate anAja dIAM kaTTaNa vAlIAM fasalAM ugAIAM|
ate khajUrAM de ucce laMbe rukkha paidA kIte jinhAM ’te de phalAM nAla ladde hoe gucche lagade hana|
(iha sabha prabaMdha) baMdiAM nUM roz2I deNa laI hai| asIM pANI rAhIM muradA (baMjara) dharatI nUM jiUMdA (upajAU) kara dittA| ise prakAra kabarAM toM vI (jiUMdA ho ke) bAhira AuNA hai|
ihanAM (makke vAliAM) toM pahilAM nUha dI kauma ne ate rasa vAliAM ne ate samUda ne (rasUlAM nUM) jhuThalAiA sI|
kaume-Ada, firaauna ate lUta de bharAvAM ne vI (jhuThalAiA sI)|
ate aikA vAliAM ne ate tubbA dI kauma ne (bhAva uhanAM sabha ne) rasUlAM nUM jhuThalAiA, aMta uhanAM ’te (merA az2Aba dI galla) pUrI ho ke rahI|
kI asIM pahilI vAra paidA karake thakka cakke hAM? (nahIM) uha tAM mur3a jIvata hoNa de zakka vica phase hoe hana|
bezakka asIM manukkha nUM paidA kItA ate asIM usa de mana vica ubharana vAlIAM zaMkAvAM toM bhalI-bhAMta jANU hAM| asIM usa (manukkha) dI zAha-raga nAloM vI vadha usa de ner3e hAM|
manukkha jo vI karadA hai, tAM do likhaNa vAle (farizate) likha laiMde hana| jihar3e usa de sajje ate khabbe (moDhiAM utte) baiThe hana|[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] vekho sUrata ala-anAma, hAzIA Aita 61/6

translations.translation: manukkha jihar3A vI zabada mUMhoM kaDDhadA hai, usa nUM likhaNa laI ika nigarAna (farizatA) tiAra (baiThA) hai|[2]
translations.footnotes: [2] vekho sUrata ala-anAma, hAzIA Aita 61/6

translations.translation: (he inakArIo!) mauta dI saqhatI hakka (saccAI) nUM sAhamaNe laike A gaI| AkhiA jAvegA ki iha uha (mauta) hai jisa toM tUM bhajjadA sI|
ate jadoM sUra (bigula) vica phUMka mArI jAvegI, uha dina az2Aba dA hovegA jisa dA vAadA kItA giA sI|
ate usa dina hara viakatI (rabba de haz2Ura) AvegA| usa nAla ika hikka ke liAuNa vAlA (farizatA) hovegA ate ika gavAhI deNa vAlA vI hovegA|
bezakka tUM isa dihAr3e (kiAmata) toM be-surata sI| asIM uha par3adA cukka dittA, jihar3A tere agge piA hoiA sI ate ajja terI nigAha bahuta tez2a hai|
usa dA sahiyogI (farizatA) AkhegA ki iha hai uha (amala-patarI) jihar3I mere kola tiAra paI hai|
(allAha farizatiAM nUM Adeza devegA ki) tusIM hara bAg2I te kAfira nUM naraka vica suTTa dio|
jihar3A neka kaMma karana toM rokadA sI ate (sarakazI vicca) haddoM TappaNa vAlA ate (kiAmata dihAr3e vicca) zakka karana vAlA sI|
jisa ne allAha de nAla hora vI izaTa baNA lae sI tusIM doveM usa nUM karar3e az2Aba vica suTTa dio|
usa dA sAthI (zaitAna) AkhegA ki he rabba! maiMne isa nUM terI rAha toM nahIM bhaTakAiA, sagoM uha Apa hI rAhoM dUra kurAhe piA hoiA sI|
allAha AkhegA ki merI haz2UrI vica jhagar3A nA karo, maiM tAM pahilAM hI bhair3e aMta toM tuhAnUM qhabaradAra kara cukkA sI|
mere darabAra vica (kahI hoI) galla badalI nahIM jAMdI ate nA hI maiM ApaNe baMdiAM ’te z2ulama karana vAlA hAM|
jisa dina asIM naraka toM pucchAMge ki kI tUM (pApIAM nAla) bhara gaI hai? uha (naraka) uttara vica pucchegI ki kI kujjha hora vI hai?[3]
translations.footnotes: [3] allAha de rasUla ne faramAiA ki narakI naraka vica suTTe jANage para naraka AkhadI rahegI ki hora vI kujha hai? ithoM takka ki allAha ApaNA paira isa vica rakkha devegA usa sameM naraka AkhegI ki basa basa maiM bhara gaI| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 4848)

translations.translation: ate savaraga prahez2agArAM (burAIAM toM bacaNa vAliAM) de ner3e kara dittI jAvegI, dUra nahIM hovegI|[4]
translations.footnotes: [4] iMja hI allAha vI ImAna vAliAM toM dUra nahIM hovegA| sagoM jaMnata vica uha loka ApaNe rabba dA dIdAra karanage| hadIsa vica hai ki haz2arata jUbaira bina abadullAha (raz2a:) biAna karade hana ki asIM rAta vele allAha de rasUla kola beThe sI ki Apa jI ne caMda valla vekha ke faramAiA ki tusIM ApaNe rabba nUM ise tarhAM vekhoge jiveM isa caMna nUM vekhade ho| tuhAnUM usa nUM vekhaNa vica koI kaThinAI nahIM hovegI| so tusIM pahu faTana toM pahilAM dI namAz2a ate sUjara DubbaNa toM pahilAM dI namAz2a kise dujje kaMma vica rujheveM kArana nA chaDDo| phera Apa ne sUrata kAfa dI Aita naMbara 39 dI tilAvata faramAI (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 554)

translations.translation: AkhiA jAvegA ki iha uha (savaraga) hai jisa dA tuhADe nAla vAadA kItA giA sI| iha vAadA hara usa viakatI laI sI jihar3A (rabba valla) mur3a-mur3a parataNa (taubA karana) vAlA ate (allAha de hukamAM dI) nigarAnI karana vAlA sI|
ate jihar3A viakatI bina vekhe rahimAna (allAha) dA Dara rakkhadA sI ate jihar3A (rabba valla) mur3a AuNa vAlA dila liAiA hove|
usa nUM kihA jAvegA ki tusIM isa savaraga vica salAmatI nAla praveza kara jAo| uha sadA laI (savaraga vica) rahiNa vAlA dina hai|
uha (neka loka) utthe (savaraga vica) jo vI cAhuNage uha uhanAM nUM milegA, sagoM sADe kola tAM hora vI bahuta kujjha (uhanAM nUM deNa laI) hai|

ihanAM makke vAliAM toM pahilAM vI asIM bahuta sArIAM kaumAM nUM nazaTa kara cukke hAM jihar3IAM uhanAM toM kite vaddha balavAna sana| uhanAM ne zahirAM vica vadherI naTTha bhajja kItI, phera kI uhanAM nUM az2Aba toM bacaNa laI koI zarana milI?
(nirasaMdeha, isa itihAsa vica) hara usa viakatI laI sikkhiA hai (jihar3A socaNa samajhaNa vAlA dila) rakkhadA hai jAM uha jihar3A dhiAna nAla galla suNe ate uha hAz2ira (dimAg2a) vI hove|
asIM dharatI ate akAza ate uhanAM vicAle dIAM sArIAM cIz2AM nUM kevala che dinAM vica paidA kItA ate sAnUM kujha vI thakAna nahIM hoI|

so he nabI! uha (makke vAle) tuhAnUM jo kujjha vI kahiMde hana tusIM usa ’te sabara karo ate ApaNe pAlaNahAra dI, usatata de nAla usa dI tasabIha, sUraja nikalaNa toM pahilAM vI ate sUraja DubbaNa toM pahilAM vI, karade raho|
ate rAta vele vI ate sijadiAM (namAz2a) toM magaroM vI usa dI tasabIha karo|
suNo! jisa dina DauMDI piTTaNa vAlA ner3e toM hI pukAregA|
jisa dina usa bigula dI tez2a kaMna phAr3aNa vAlI AvAz2a nUM uha sAre yakIna nAla suNa laiNage, uha dina (kabarAM viccoM) nikalaNa dA hovegA|
bezakka asIM hI jIvana diMde hAM ate asIM hI mauta diMde hana ate sADe valla hI sAriAM ne parata ke AuNA hai|
jisa dina dharatI pATa jAvegI ate uha sAre (kabarAM viccoM nikala ke) sADe kola bhajja ke AuNage, uhanAM nUM ikattarata karanA sADe laI bahuta hI AsAna hai|

he nabI! jo iha muzarika tuhAnUM Akhade hana asIM usa nUM caMgI tarhAM jANade hAM| tusIM uhanAM nAla z2aura z2abaradasatI karana vAle nahIM, so tusIM isa kuraAna rAhIM hara usa viakatI nUM nasIhata karade raho jihar3A merI citAvanI toM DaradA hai|
suMha uhanAM havAvAM dI jihar3IAM (dhUr3a) uDAuNa vAlIAM hana|
phera uhanAM baddalAM dI jihar3e pANI dA bhAra cukkaNa vAle hana|
(suMha) uhanAM ber3IAM dI jihar3IAM AsAnI nAla vagaNa vAlIAM hana|
(suMha) uhanAM farizatiAM dI jihar3e kaMma vaMDaNa vAle hana|
ki bezakka (kiAmata dihAr3e) jisa dA vAadA tuhADe nAla kItA jA rihA hai uha saccA hai|
nirasaMdeha, karamAM dA badalA z2arUra milaNa vAlA hai|
suMha hai unhAM akAzAM dI jihar3e rAhAM vAle hana|
bezakka tusIM (paraloka bAre) vAda vivAda vica pae hoe ho|
usa ImAna toM uhIo bemukkha huMdA hai jihar3A bhalAI toM bemukhA hove|
aTakala-paccU gallAM karana vAle tAM mAre gae|
uha loka jihar3e gafalata vica be-surata hana|
uha pucchade hana ki badale vAlA dina kadoM AvegA?
(praloka usa dina AvegA) jadoM uha (be-surata loka) agga vica sAr3e jANage|
ate AkhiA jAvegA ki huNa ApaNe az2Aba dA suAda vekho, iho uha az2Aba hai jisa laI tusIM kAhalI pA rahe sI|
bezakka usa dihAr3e muttakI (bhAva rabba toM Darana vAle) bAg2AM te cazamiAM vica hoNage|[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] vekho sUrata ala-bakaraha, hAzIA Aita 2/2

translations.translation: jo vI uhanAM dA rabba uhanAM nUM devegA, uha usa nUM (qhuzI qhuzI) lai rahe hoNage| bezakka uha isa (dihAr3e AuNa) toM pahilAM nekI karana vAle loka sana|
uha rAtAM nUM bahuta hI ghaTTa sauMde sana|
ate uha saraghI vele baqhaziza (dI duAvAM) maMgade sana|
uhanAM dI dhana-daulata vica maMgatiAM te mahirUmAM (lor3avaMdAM) dA vI hakka huMdA sI|[2]
translations.footnotes: [2] vekho sUrata ana-nisA, hAzIA Aita 37/4

translations.translation: vizavAsa karana vAliAM laI dharatI vica (bahuta sArIAM) nizAnIAM hana|
ate tuhADI ApaNI z2Ata vica vI (nizAnIAM) hana, kI phera vI tusIM vekhade nahIM?
tuhADI roz2I ate uha cIz2a vI (savaraga-naraka) jisa dA tuhAnUM vacana dittA jA rihA hai, akAza vica hai|
akAza te dharatI de rabba dI suMha, iha (kiAmata) ika aTalla saccAI hai, jiveM tuhADA bolaNA|
(he nabI!) kI tuhADe kola ibarAhIma de patavaMte mahimAnAM dI qhabara pahuMcI hai?
jadoM uha (farizate mahimAna baNa ke) usa (ibarAhIma) kola pahuMce tAM uhanAM ne salAma AkhiA ibarAhIma ne AkhiA ki tuhAnUM vI salAma hove, phera mana vica hI kihA ki tusIM loka tAM aNapachAte ho|
phera cupa-capItA ApaNe ghara AiA ate ika moTA tAz2A (bhujjA hoiA) vacchA liAiA|
ate uhanAM agge peza kItA ate (jadoM uhanAM ne nahIM khAiA tAM) AkhiA ki tusIM khAMde kiuM nahIM?
phera uha (dila hI dila vica) uhanAM koloM Dara giA| ate uhanAM (mahimAnAM) ne AkhiA ki tUM sAthoM nA Dara ate usa nUM ika giAnavAna puttara hoNa dI qhuzaqhabarI suNAI|
iha suNa ke ibarAhIma dI patanI (sArA) hAe-duhAI pAuMdI hoI sAhamaNe AI, usa ne ApaNA mUMha-matthA piTTa liA te AkhiA ki maiM ika buDDhI bAMjha hAM (bhalAM mere aulAda kiveM hovegI)|[3]
translations.footnotes: [3] jadoM haz2arata sArA ne iha kihA sI ki mere baccA kiveM ho sakadA hai usa sameM haz2arata sArA dI umara 99 sAla sI|

translations.translation: uhanAM (farizatiAM) ne AkhiA ki tuhADe rabba ne iho faramAiA hai| bezakka uha yukatImAna te vaDDA jANanahAra hai|
ibarAhIma ne pucchiA, he bheje hoe farizatio! tuhADe AuNa dA kI udeza hai?
uhanAM ne AkhiA ki sAnUM ika aparAdhI kauma valla bhejiA giA hai|
tAM jo asIM usa ’te khaMgharAM dA mIMha varhA deIe|
jihar3e tuhADe rabba kola haddoM TappaNa vAliAM (utte suTTaNa) laI nizAna lAe pae hana|
phera asIM usa basatI viccoM ImAna vAliAM nUM kaDDha liA|
asIM utthe kevala ika hI ghara musalamAnAM (AgiAkArIAM) dA vekhiA|[4]
translations.footnotes: [4] ika hadIsa vica allAha de nabI ne faramAiA ki merI umata vica ika dhar3A sadA hI hakka utte kAima rahegA| jo koI vI usa nUM nukasAna pahuMcAuNA cAhegA jAM jhuThalAegA uha unhAM dA kujha nahIM bigAr3a sakegA| ithoM takka ki allAha dA hukama A pahuMcegA ate uha ise hAlata vica rahiNage| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 7460)

translations.translation: asIM uhanAM lokAM laI, jihar3e dukhadAI az2Aba toM Darade hana, ika nizAnI rakkha chaDDI|
mUsA de kisse vica vI ika vaDDI nizAnI hai, jadoM asIM usa nUM firaauna valla ika moajaz2A (sapazaTa dalIlAM) deke bhejiA|
usa ne ApaNI tAkata de balabUte ’te hakka toM mUMha mor3iA ate kihA ki mUsA tAM jAdUgara hai jAM sudAI hai|
aMta asIM usa nUM ate usa dIAM faujAM nUM phar3a liA ate uhanAM sAriAM nUM samuMdara vica suTTa dittA, kiuM jo uha niMdana yoga kaMma karade sana|
Ada de kisse vica vI nizAnIAM hana, asIM uhanAM utte ika azubha hanerI bhejI|
jisa uttoM vI uha laMghadI usa nUM cUrA-cUrA baNA chaDDadI|
samUda de kisse vica vI (kudarata dI) nizAnI hai jadoM uhanAM nUM (uhanAM de rasUla ne) AkhiA sI ki tusIM ika vizeza sameM taka (saMsAra dA) lAbha uThA lao|
para uhanAM ne ApaNe rabba de hukamAM dI ulaMghanAM kItI, aMta uhanAM nUM ika kar3aka ne A nappiA, jadoM ki uha usa nUM vekha rahe sI|
phera nA tAM uhanAM vica uTThaNa dI himmata sI te nA hI uha ApaNA badalA lai sakade sI|
isa toM pahilAM asIM nUha dI kauma nUM halAka kItA, bezakka uha loka nA-faramAna sana|
akAza nUM asIM ApaNe hatthI baNAiA, bezakka asIM isa dI samarathA rakkhade hAM|
asIM dharatI nUM (faraza vAMga) vichAiA, asIM kiMne vadhIA vichAuNa vAle hAM|
asIM hara jIva-jaMtU dA jor3A paidA kItA tAM jo tusIM nasIhata prApata kara sako|
so tusIM allAha valla nasso, maiM tuhAnUM usa (az2Aba) toM sapazaTa rUpa vica DarAuNa vAlA hAM|[5]
translations.footnotes: [5] vekho sUrata Ale-imarAna, hAzIA Aita 85/3

translations.translation: tusIM allAha de nAla kise hora nUM izaTa nA baNAo, nirasaMdeha, maiM tuhAnUM isa toM sapazaTa rUpa vica DarAuNa vAlA hAM|
ise tarhAM jihar3e loka ihanAM toM pahilAM bIta cukke hana, uhanAM kola jihar3A vI rasUla AiA tAM uhanAM ne basa iho AkhiA ki iha tAM jAdUgara hai jAM koI sudAI hai|
kI uha ika dUje nUM iho galla dassade Ae hana? nahIM sagoM uha tAM sAre bAg2I hana|
(he nabI!) je tusIM ihanAM toM mUMha phera lao tAM tuhADe laI koI gunAha nahIM|
so tusIM nasIhata karade raho kiuM jo nasIhata karanA ImAna vAliAM laI lAhevaMda hai|
maiMne jiMnAM ate manukkhAM nUM kevala isa laI sAjiA hai ki uha merI hI baMdagI karana|
maiM uhanAM koloM koI roz2I nahIM cAhuMdA te nA hI maiM iha cAhuMdA hAM ki uha mainUM khavAuNa|
nirasaMdeha, allAha tAM Apa hI roz2I deNa vAlA hai, vaDDA z2orAvara te zakatIzAlI hai|
so jinhAM ne vadhIkIAM kItIAM hana uhanAM de bhAgAM vica az2Aba hai jiveM uhanAM de sAthIAM de bhAgAM vica sI| isa laI iha loka maiMtho (az2Aba laI) kAhalI nA pAuNa|
aMta inakArIAM laI barabAdI hai, usa dihAr3e jisa dA ihanAM nAla vAadA kItA jA rihA hai|[6]
translations.footnotes: [6] haz2arata anasa nabI (sa:) toM rivAita karade hana ki allAha unhAM narakIAM toM pacchegA jinhAM nUM sabha toM ghaTa saz2A dittI jAvegI ki je tuhA` uha sabha kujha mile jAve jo dharatI utte hai tAM kI tusIM usa de badale isa bipatA toM mukatI pAuNA pasaMda karoge? uha AkhaNage ki he allAha! z2arUra hI karAMge| allAha AkhegA ki jadoM tusIM Adama dI piTTha vica sI tAM maine tuhAthoM isa toM bahuta hI ghaTa maMga kItI sI| para tusIM mere nAla dUjiAM izaTAM dI vI pUjA karade rahe| so huNa tusIM naraka dA vI savAda lavo| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 3334)

translations.translation: suMha hai tUra (pahAr3a) dI|
suMha, usa kitAba dI, jihar3I (lauhe-mahifUz2a vica) likhI hoI hai|
jihar3I khullhe (sAfa) kAg2az2a utte likhI hoI hai|
suMha, rasade vasade ghara dI|
uccI chatta dI suMha|
bhar3ake hoe samuMdarAM dI suMha|
bezakka tuhADe rabba dA az2Aba z2arUra vAparegA|
usa (kiAmata) nUM rokaNa vAlA koI nahIM|
uha usa dina vAparegA, jisa dina akAza burI tarhAM Daka-Dole khAvegA|
pahAr3a turana lagga paiNage|
so usa dina jhuThalAuNa vAliAM laI barabAdI hai|
jihar3e hakka nUM jhuThalAuNa vica kheDa vajoM masata hana|
jisa dina uhanAM nUM dhakke mAra-mAra ke naraka dI agga vica dhakeliA jAvegA|
AkhiA jAvegA ki iho hai uha agga jisa nUM tusIM jhuThalAiA karade sI|
kI iha jAdU hai? jAM tusIM vekhade hI nahIM?
huNa tusIM isa naraka vica dAqhala ho jAo, huNa bhAveM tusIM sabara karo jAM nA karo, tuhADe laI ikka barAbara hai| tuhAnUM use dI saz2A dittI jAvegI jo tusIM karade sI|
nirasaMdeha, muttakIna (rabba toM Darana vAle) bAg2AM ate niamatAM vica hoNage|
uha uhanAM cIz2AM dA AnaMda mANa rahe hoNage jo uhanAM de rabba ne uhanAM nUM dittA hai| ate uhanAM de rabba ne uhanAM nUM naraka de az2Aba toM vI bacA liA|
uhanAM nUM AkhiA jAvegA ki mauja nAla khAo pIo, ApaNe uhanAM amalAM de badale, jo tusIM kariA karade sI|
jadoM ki uha AhamaNe sAhamaNe taqhatAM utte gAve lAIM baiThe hoNage te asIM uhanAM nUM sunakkhIAM hUrAM nAla viAha diAMge|

jihar3e loka ImAna liAe ate uhanAM dI aulAda ne vI ImAna nAla uhanAM dI pairavI kItI tAM asIM uhanAM dI aulAda nUM (jaMnata vica) uhanAM nAla mela karA devAMge| asIM uhanAM de amalAM viccoM kujjha vI ghaTTa nahIM karAMge| hara viakatI ApaNI kItI hoI kamAI de badale gahiNe piA hoiA hai|
ate asIM uhanAM nUM uhanAM de manacAhe suAdale phala te mAsa diAMge|
utthe uha ika dUje toM vaddha ke zarAba de jAma lai rahe hoNage, jisa nUM pINa nAla nA koI ghaTIA galla hovegI te nA hI koI gunAha dA kaMma hovegA|[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] vekho sUrata ala-bakaraha, hAzIA Aita 219/2

translations.translation: uhanAM (dI sevA) laI navIM umara de muMDe uhanAM de Ale-duAle nassade phira rahe hoNage, ajihe sohaNe jiveM lukA ke rakkhe hoe motI hoNa|
ate jaMnatI Apo vica ika dUje dA hAla pucchaNage|
uha AkhaNage ki bezakka isa toM pahilAM asIM ApaNe parivAra vica rahiMde hoe allAha toM DariA karade sI|
phera allAha ne sADe ’te kripA kItI ate usa ne sAnUM lUha deNa vAlI tattI havA de az2Aba toM bacA liA|
bezakka asIM pahilAM hI toM usa (allAha) nUM pukAriA karade sI|[2] bezakka uhIo sohaNA ahisAna karana vAlA te miharabAna hai|
translations.footnotes: [2] vekho sUrata ala-bakaraha, hAzIA Aita 165/2

translations.translation: so (he nabI!) tusIM nasIhata karade raho tuhADe utte rabba dI kripA hai ki nA tAM tusIM pAMdhe ho te nA hI sudAI|
kI uha kAfira Akhade hana ki iha (nabI) kavI hai ate asIM isa laI kAla cakkara (bhAva mauta) dI uDIka kara rahe hAM?
(he nabI!) Akha dio ki tusIM vI uDIka karo tuhADe nAla maiM vI uDIkadA piA hAM|
kI uhanAM lokAM dIAM akalAM uhanAM nUM iho sikhAuMdIAM hana jAM uha loka hI bAg2I hana?
kI uha Akhade hana ki isa ne iha.kuraAna Ape ghar3ha liA hai? asala galla tAM iha hai ki iha ImAna nahIM liAuMde|
je uha (ApaNI katthaNI vica) sacce hana tAM uhanAM nUM cAhIdA hai ki isa (.kuraAna) jihI ika bANI dI racanA kara liAuNa|
kI iha loka binAM kise racanAhAra toM paidA hoe hana jAM uha Apa hI ApaNe racanAhAra hana|
kI akAza te dharatI dI racanAM uhanAM ne kItI hai? sacca tAM iha hai ki iha ihanAM gallAM ’te vizavAsa nahIM rakkhade|
kI ihanAM de kabaz2e vica tuhADe rabba de qhaz2Ane hana? jAM iha (qhaz2AniAM de) darog2e hana?
kI ihanAM kola koI paur3I hai jisa ’te car3ha ke (akAza dIAM gallAM) suNa laiMde hana? ihanAM gallAM nUM suNana vAle nUM cAhIdA hai ki uha (galla suNana dI) koI sapazaTa dalIla tAM lai ke Ave|
kI usa (allAha) laI tAM kevala dhIAM hana te tuhADe laI puttara hana|
kI tusIM (he nabI!) ihanAM toM (dharama pracAra dA) koI badalA maMgade ho ki iha usa de karaz2a heTha dabbe jAMde hana|
kI ihanAM kola parokha (dA giAna) hai jisa de AdhAra ’te iha likhade hana|
kI iha koI dhokhA deNA cAhuMde hana? so jinhAM lokAM ne inakAra kItA hai, dhokhA tAM iha khAIM phirade hana|
kI ihanAM laI allAha toM chuTTa koI hora izaTa hai allAha pAka hai usa ziraka toM, jo iha loka kara rahe hana|
(ihanAM dA hAla iha hai ki) je iha akAza toM DigadA hoiA koI ToTA vI vekha laiNa phera vI AkhaNage ki iha tAM uppara thalle baddala hana|
(he nabI!) tUM uhanAM nUM uhanAM de hAla ’te chaDDa de, itthoM taka ki uhanAM dA vAsatA usa dina nAla pai jAve jisa dina uha sAre behoza ho jANage|
jisa dina uhanAM nUM uhanAM dIAM cAlAM kujjha vI lAbha nahIM deNagIAM ate nA hI uhanAM dI (kise pAsioM vI) sahAitA kItI jAvegI|
bezakka z2AlamAM laI paraloka de (az2Aba) toM pahilAM (saMsAra vica) vI ika az2Aba hai|[3] praMtU ihanAM lokAM viccoM vadhere jANade hI nahIM|
translations.footnotes: [3] vekho sUrata ala-anAma, hAzIA Aita 93/6

translations.translation: he nabI! tusIM ApaNe rabba dA hukama AuNa taka sabara karo| bezakka tusIM sADIAM akkhAM de sAhamaNe ho (bhAva maiM tuhAnUM hara pala vekha rihA hAM)| jadoM savere uTTho tAM ApaNe rabba dI pAkI ate usa dI prazaMsA biAna karo|
ate rAta de kujha bhAva vica vI ate tAre DobaNa toM magaroM vI tusIM use rabba dI tasabIha (bhAva hara vele prasaMzA te guNagANa) kariA karo|
suMha hai tAre dI jadoM uha DigadA hai|
tuhADA sAthI nA tAM bahikiA hoiA hai ate nA hI rAhoM bhaTakiA hoiA hai|
uha ApaNI icchA nAla nahIM boladA|
uha tAM ika vahI (rabba bANI) hai jihar3I usa valla bhejI jAMdI hai|
usa nUM iha sabha zakatIzAlI (jibarAIla) ne sikhAiA hai|
jihar3A vaDDA z2orAvara hai| so uha ApaNe asalI rUpa vica siddhA A khaloiA|
jadoM uha (jibarAIla) akAza de utale disahadde ’te sI|
phera uha ner3e AiA te utAMha ahilla hoke ruka giA|
phera (muhaMmada te jibarAIla vicAle) do kamAnAM (dhanukhAM) jiMnhA dUra, sagoM usa toM vI vaddha ner3e ho giA|
phera usa (jibarAIla) ne allAha de baMde (haz2arata muhaMmada) nUM uha vahI pucAI jo vahI usa nUM (rabba valloM) pucAI gaI sI|
usa (rasUla) ne jo kujjha vI (miarAja vele) vekhiA usa de dila ne (usa saMbaMdha vica) jhUTha nahIM boliA|
kI tusIM loka usa cIz2a ’te usa (nabI) nAla jhagar3ade ho jo uha (akkhIM) vekhadA hai|[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] iha toM bhAva miarAja hai| bhAva allAha de rasUla ApaNe zarIra te prANa de nAla asamAnAM de safara te gae| visathArapUravaka vekhaNa laI vekho sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 3260|

translations.translation: usa rasUla ne isa (jibarAIla) nUM ika vAra hora vI vekhiA|
sidarAtula-munatahA (bhotika jagata dI AqharI sarahada utte sathita berI dA rukkha) de ner3e (vekhiA)|
usa de lAge hI jaMnatula-mAvA (rahiNa vAlI jaMnata) hai|
usa vele sidarA (bhAva jaMnatI berI) utte (allAha dI kudarata) chA rihA sI jo kujjha vI usa utte chAuNA sI|
nA tAM usa dI naz2ara bahikI hai te nA hI haddoM TappI hoI|
usa (rasUla) ne ApaNe rabba dIAM kujjha vaDDIAM-vaDDIAM nizAnIAM vekhIAM|
tusIM mainUM ‘lAta’ te ‘uz2z2A’ dI qhabara dio|
ate tIjI (devI) ‘manAta’ dI, jisa dI asalIata bahuta hI ghaTIA hai|
kI tuhADe laI puttara hana te allAha laI dhiAM?
iha tAM vaDDI hI beinasAphI vAlI (bhAva kANI) vaMDa hai|

iha tAM kevala nAM hI nAM hana jihar3e tuhAne te tuhADe bApa-dAdiAM ne rakkha chaDDe hana| jada ki allAha ne ihanAM (devI devatiAM) laI koI mAnatA pattara nahIM ghalliA| uha loka tAM aTakala de picche ture jA rahe hana ate usa dI cIz2a dI pairavI kara rahe hana jo uhanhAM dA mana cAhuMdA hai| jada ki uhanAM de rabba valloM uhanAM kola hidAita A cukkI hai|
kI manukkha jo vI icchA kare, uha cIz2a usa nUM milaNI cAhIdI hai?
allAha hI loka te paraloka dA mAlika hai|
akAzAM vica kiMne hI farizate hana jinhAM dI sifAraza kujjha vI kaMma nahIM AvegI| para hAM jisa viakatI laI allAha (sifAraza karana dI) AgiA de deve ate pasaMda kare (phera sifAraza ho sakadI hai)|
jihar3e lokI paraloka nUM nahIM maMnade uha farizatiAM de nAM isatarIAM jihe rakkhade hana|
jada ki uhanAM nUM isa dA kujjha vI giAna nahIM, uha tAM kevala aTakala de picche lagge hoe hana, jada ki aTakala hakka sacca de mukAbale vica kujjha vI lAbhadAika nahIM|
so he nabI! tusIM vI usa viakatI toM mUMha mor3a lavo (bhAva ciMtA nA karo) jihar3A sADe z2ikara (yAda) toM mUMha mor3adA hai ate kevala saMsArika jIvana hI cAhuMdA hai|

uhanAM de giAna dI pahuMca iho hai| bezakka tuhADA rabba usa viakatI nUM caMgI tarhAM jANadA hai jihar3A usa de rAha toM bhaTaka giA ate uhIo usa viakatI nUM vI jANadA hai jihar3A siddhe rAha ’te hai|

akAzAM te dharatI vica jo kujjha vI hai allAha hI uhanAM sabha dA mAlika hai, so uha uhanAM lokAM nUM jinhAM ne (saMsAra vica) burAIAM kItIAM hana uhanAM dIAM karaNIAM dI saz2A deve ate jinhAM ne nekIAM kItIAM hana uhanAM nUM vadhIA badalA deve|

uha loka jihar3e mahAM pApAM toM te azalIlatA toM bacade hana chuTTa isa toM ki koI choTA moTA gunAha ho jAve, bezakka (uhanAM lokAM laI) tuhADe rabba dI baqhaziza ati vizAla hai| uha tahAnUM usa sameM toM jANadA hai jadoM usa ne tuhAnUM dharatIoM (bhAva miTTI toM) paidA kItA sI| jadoM tusIM ApaNIAM mAvAM de garabha vica bhUraNa avasathA vica hI sI| so isa laI tusIM ApaNI pAkI biAna nA karo| uha caMgI tarhAM jANadA hai ki rabba dA Dara-bhau rakhaNa vAlA kauNa hai|
kI tusIM usa viakatI nUM vekhiA hai jisa ne hakka toM mUMha mor3iA hai?
usa ne bahuta hI thor3hA mAla (rabba dI rAha vica) dittA, phera uha vI (deNA) baMda kara dittA|
kI usa viakatI kola g2aiba (parokha) dI jANakArI hai ki uha (sabha kujjha) vekha rihA hai?
kI usa nUM uhanAM gallAM dI jANakArI nahIM dittI gaI jihar3I mUsA de sahIfiAM (pothIAM) vica hai?
ate jo ibarAhIma de sahIphiAM (pothIAM) vica hai, jihar3A (rabba dA) vafAdAra sI?
ki koI bhAra cukkaNa vAlA kise dUje dA bhAra nahIM cukkegA|
ki manukkha laI basa uhIo hai jisa laI uha kozizAM karadA hai |[2]
translations.footnotes: [2] allAha de rasUla ne faramAiA jadoM koI viakatI mara jAMdA hai tAM usa de amalAM dA silasilA vI samApata ho jAMdA hai| chuTa tiMna gallAM toM 1਼ sadakA-e-jArIA, 2਼ uha giAna jisa toM lAbha uThAuNa, 3਼ neka aulAja jihar3I ApaNe mApiAM laI rabba toM duAiAM karadI hai| (sahI musalima, hadIsa: 1631)

so (he manukkha!) tUM ApaNe rabba dIAM kihar3IAM-kihar3IAM niamatAM vica zakka kareMgA?
iha (rasUla) tAM pahilAM toM Ae hoe DarAuNa vAliAM viccoM ika DarAuNa vAlA hai|
ner3e AuNa vAlI (kiAmata) hora ner3e A laggI hai|
usa kiAmata nUM, chuTTa allAha toM, hora koI pragaTa karana vAlA nahIM|
kI tusIM ise (.kuraAna dI) galla utte rurAnI pragaTa karade ho?
tusIM hasade ho, rauMde nahIM|
tusIM kheDa-kudda vica masata ho|
tusIM (bAz2a A jAo te) allAha nUM sijadA karo ate usa dI baMdagI karo|
kiAmata ner3e A gaI hai te caMna pATa giA|[1]

translations.translation: je uha (muzarika) koI moajaz2A (rabbI camatakAra) vekhaNa tAM mUMha mor3a laide hana ate Akhade ki iha jAdU tAM sadA toM hI caliA A rihA hai|
uhanAM ne (isa rabbI camatakAra nUM) jhuThalAiA ate ApaNI icchAvAM de picche turade rahe, jada ki hara kaMma dA ika samAM nizacita hai|
uhanAM kola uha sArIAM sUcaNAvAM A cukkIAM hana jinhAM vica citAvanI vI hai te sikkhiA vI hai|
sikhara nUM pahuMcI hoI yukatI vI hai, para kevala citAvanIAM hI kaMma nahIM AuMdIAM|
so (he nabI!) ihanAM toM mUMha mor3a lavo| (yAda karo) jadoM saddaNa vAlA ati bhair3I cIz2a (naraka) valla saddegA|
(usa sameM) uhanAM dIAM naz2arAM jhukIAM hoNagIAM| uha kabarAM viccoM iMja nikalaNage jiveM uha khiMDIAM hoIAM TiDDIAM hoNa|
jadoM uha (loka) sadanna vAle (rabba) valla nasade jA rahe hoNage tAM kAfira AkhaNage ki iha dihAr3A tAM bahuta hI karar3A hai|
ihanAM toM pahilAM nUha kauma ne jhuThalAiA sI, so uhanAM ne sADe baMde nUM jhUThA dassiA te AkhiA ki iha tAM sudAI hai ate (usa nUM) jhir3aka dittA giA|
tada usa ne ApaNe rabba nUM pukAriA ki bezaka maiM bevasa hAM, huNa tUM hI ihanAM toM badalA lai|
so asIM mUsalAdhAra mIMha nAla akAza de mUMha khola ditte|
asIM dharatI vica cazame vagA ditte te (akAza te dharatI) dA pANI Apo vica mila gae (bhAva har3a A giA), jihar3A (uhanAM dA) mukaddara baNa cukkiA sI|
asIM nUha nUM taqhatiAM te killAM vAlI (ber3I) utte savAra kItA|
uha (ber3I) sADIAM akkhAM sAhamaNe turadI sI| asIM iha sabha usa viakatI (nUha) dA badalA laiNa laI kItA sI jisa nUM jhuThalAiA giA sI|
asIM usa (ber3I nUM) ika nizAnI (baNA) char3r3iA| phera koI hai jihar3A nasIhata prApata kare?
phera (vekho) merA az2Aba te merI citAvanI kiho jihe sI|
bezakka asIM isa.kuraAna nUM sikkhiA laiNa laI sukhAlA baNAiA hai, hai koI sikkhiA prApata karana vAlA?
‘Ada’ dI kauma ne jhuThalAiA, phera vekho merA az2Aba te merI citAvanI kiho jihI sI|
asIM uhanAM utte niraMtara azubbha dihar3e ika zUkadI tUfAnI havA bhaijI|
uha (havA) lokAM nUM cukka-cukka ke iMja suTTa rahI sI jiveM ki uha jar3oM ukhar3e hoe khajUra de moche hoNa|
phera vekho merA az2Aba te merI citAvanI kiho jihI sI|
bezakka asIM.kuraAna nUM nasIhata laI bahuta hI saukhA kara dittA hai, hai koI nasIhata prApata karana vAlA?
(samUda dI) kauma ne citAvanI deNa vAle (nabI) nUM jhuThalAiA|
uhanAM ne AkhiA ki bhalAM ika ajihA viakatI jihar3A sADe viccoM hove asIM usa de picche turIe? phera tAM asIM kurAhIAM ate sudAIAM viccoM hovAMge|
kI sADe viccoM usa ’te hI vahI (rabbI sunehA) utArI gaI hai? (nahIM!) sagoM uha tAM bahuta hI jhUThA te zeqhI qhorA hai|
bhalake (bhAva kiAmata dihAr3e) hI uhanAM nUM patA lagga jAvegA ki kauNa jhUThAhai te kauNa zeqhIAM mAradA hai|
bezakka asIM uhanAM dI az2amAiza laI ika UThaNI (caTTAnAM vicco kaDDha ke) bhejaNa vAle hAM| so (he sAleha!) tUM uhanAM (de aMta) dI uDIka kara te dhIraja toM kaMma lai|
uhanAM nUM dassa dio ki pANI nUM ihanAM (basatI vAliAM te UThaNI) vicakAra vaMDiA jAvegA ate hareka ApaNI vArI vAle dina (pANI pINa laI) AvegA|
para uhanAM lokAM ne ApaNe ika sAthI nUM saddiA ate usa ne (UThaNI nUM) phar3hiA te vaDDa suTTiA|
phera vekho merA az2Aba te merI citAvanI kiho jihI sI?
bezakka asIM uhanAM utte ika caMgiAr3a bhejI tAM uha bAr3a vAliAM dI latAr3I hoI vAr3a vAMga (cUrA-cUrA) ho ke rahi gae|
bezakka asIM.kuraAna nUM nasIhata laI AsAna baNAiA hai| kI koI nasIhata laiNa vAlA hai?
lUta dI kauma ne DarAuNa vAle (nabI) nUM jhuThalAiA|
chuTTa lUta de ghara vAliAM toM, asIM uhanAM utte patharAo karana vAlI havA bhejI, asIM uhanAM ImAna vAliAM nUM saraghI vele bacAiA|
ApaNI vizeza kripA nAla (bacA liA), asIM iMja hI zukara karana vAliAM nUM badalA diMde hAM|
bezakka lUta ne uhanAM (basatI vAliAM) nUM sADI pakar3a toM DarAiA, para uhanAM ne ihanAM DarAviAM vica zakka kItA|

uhanAM (basatI vAliAM) ne lUta koloM usa de mahimAnAM dI maMga (ApaNI kAmavAsanA pUrI karana laI) kItI sI tAM asIM uhanAM dIAM akkhAM mITa dittIAM| so huNa tusIM mere az2Aba te mere DarAuNa dA suAda vekho|
savera vele ika aTala az2Aba ne uhanAM nUM halAka kara suTTiA|
so tusIM mere az2Aba te mere DarAuNa dA suAda lavo|
bezakka asIM.kuraAna nUM nasIhata laI saukhA baNAiA hai| so hai koI nasIhata laiNa vAlA|
bezakka firaaunIAM kola vI DarAuNa vAle (mUsA te hArUna) Ae|
para uhanAM (firaaunIAM) ne sADIAM sArIAM nizAnIAM nUM jhuThalAiA| phera asIM uhanAM nUM ika vaDDe z2orAvara vAMga nappa liA|
he araba vAlio! kI tuhADe kAfira tuhAthoM pahilAM de kAfirAM toM vadhIA hana jAM tuhADe laI pahilIAM kItAbAM vica koI mukatI likhI hoI hai?
kI uha (muzarika) Akhade hana ki sADA jatthA hI bhArU rahiNa vAlA hai
(he nabI!) chetI hI uhanAM dA jatthA hAra jAvegA ate uha piTTha phera ke nassa jANage|
ihanAM nAla milaNa dA asala vAadA tAM kiAmata hai ate kiAmata ika vaDDI bipatA dI ghar3hI te vadhere kair3I ghar3I hai|
bezakka iha aparAdhI gumarAhI te divAnagI vica phase hoe hana|
jisa dina iha mUMha de bhAra agga vica ghasITe jANage [2] ate AkhiA jAvegA ki huNa tusIM naraka de kazaTa dA suAda vekho|
translations.footnotes: [2] vekho sUrata banI isarAIla, hAzIA Aita 97/17

phera uha pahAr3a khilarI dhUr3a jahi ho jANage|
tusIM loka tiMna TolIAM vica ho jAoge|
(ika hana) sajje hattha vAle, sajje hattha vAliAM dA kI kahiNA|
(dUje hana) khabbe hattha vAle, kiMne maMdebhAgI hana khabbe hattha vAle|
(tIje hana) agge rahiNa vAle tAM agge hI rahiNa vAle hana|
iho loka (rabba de) nikaTavaratI hana|
ihanAM laI niamatAM bhare bAg2a (jaMnatAM) hana|
(ihanAM vica) ika vaDDA jatthA pahiliAM (bhAva sahAbAM) viccoM hovegA|
ate thor3he loka pichaliAM viccoM hoNage|
uha loka sone dIAM tArAM nAla saje takhatAM utte baiThe hoNage|
uha ika dUje de AhamaNo sAhamaNe takIe lAIM baiThe koNage|
uhanAM dI sevA laI sadIvI avasathA vica rahiNa vAle muMDe hoNage|
ate iha muMDe piAle, te surAhIAM te zarAba de vagade some dI zarAba nAla Dako-Daka bhare jAma cukkI bhajje naTThe phirade hoNage|
iha zarAba pINa nAla nA tAM uhanAM de sirAM vica darada hovegA ate nA hI uhanAM dI akala mArI jAvegI|
uhanAM kola ajihe suAdale phala hoNage jinhAM nUM uha pasaMda karanage|
ate uhanAM dI icchA anusAra paMchIAM dA gozata (mAsa) hovegA|
uhanAM laI vaDDIAM-vaDDIAM sohaNIAM akkhAM vAlIAM hUrAM hoNagIAM|
jiveM g2alAfAM vica surakkhiata rakkhe motI|
iha uhanAM de karamAM dA badalA hai|
uha jaMnata vica nA koI bekAra gallAM suNanage nA hI gunAha dI galla suNanage|
hAM ika bola salAma, salAma (boliA jAvegA)|
sajje hattha vAle kiMne bhAgAM vAle hana sajje hattha vAle|
uha binAM kaMDiAM dIAM berIAM vica hoNage|
ate tahi-para-tahi car3he hoe keliAM vica hoNage|
dUra taka phailIAM laMmIAM laMmIAM chAvAM heTha hoNage|
(utthe) hara vele vagadIAM nahirAM hoNagIAM|
aNag2iNata phala hoNage|
jihar3e nA kade mukkaNage ate nA hI khANa dI manAhI hovegI|
(beThaNa laI) uccIAM thAvAM hoNagIAM|
uhanAM (sajje hattha vAliAM) dIAM patanIAM nUM asIM vizeza tarIke nAla paidA karAMge|
asIM uhanAM nUM kuArIAM baNA diAMge|
jihar3IAM mana muhaNIAM ate (patI dIAM) hANanAM hoNagIAM|
iha sabha kujjha sajje hattha vAliAM laI hai|
ihanAM dI vaDDI giNatI pahiliAM (bhAva nabI de sAthIAM) viccoM hI hai|
ate pichaliAM viccoM vI ika vaDDI giNatI hovegI|
ate khabbe hattha vAle! kiMne maMdabhAge hana khabbe hattha vAle|
uha saqhata garama havA ate ubbalade hoe pANI vica hoNage|
ate kAle dhUMeM dI chAM vica hoNage|
nA uha ThaMDI hovegI te nA hI sukkhadAI hovegI|
iha loka isa (kiAmata de vAparaNa toM pahilAM) vaDDe nakhariAM vica pale sana|
uha mahA pApa (bhAva ziraka) utte ar3iA karade sana|[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] vekho sUrata Ale-imarAna, hAzIA Aita 130/3

translations.translation: uha Akhade sana ki jadoM asIM mara jAvAMge ate miTTI te haDDIAM baNa jAvAMge tAM kI asIM mur3a surajIta kIte jAvAMge?
ate kI sADe pio dAdiAM nUM vI uThAiA jAvegA?
(he nabI!) tusIM Akha dio nirasaMdeha, pahilAM vI ate pichale vI (bhAva sAre uThAe jANage)|
bezakka ihanAM sabha nUM ika nizacita dihAr3e ikkatara kItA jAvegA|
he kurAhIo ate inakArIo!
tusIM loka thohara de rakkha avazza khAoMge|
(tusIM) isa nAla hI ApaNA DhiDDa bharoMge|
isa de uttoM garama ubbaladA hoiA pANI pioMge|
tusIM piAse UMTha vAMga pANI pioMge|
kiAmata dihAr3e iho ihanAM (khabbe hattha vAliAM) dI mahimAnadArI hovegI|
(he inakArIo!) asAM hI tuhAnUM sabha nUM paidA kItA hai| phera tusIM (mur3a jI uTThaNa dI) puzaTI kiuM nahIM karade|
bhalAM dasso jihar3A vIraja tusIM TapakAuMde ho?
kI usa vIraja toM baccA tusIM paidA karade ho jAM asIM usa de racanAhAra hAM?
asIM hI tuhADe mukaddara vica mauta likhI hai ate asAM iMja karana vica bevasa nahIM|
sagoM isa galla dI samarathA rakkhade hAM ki tuhADe varagI hora makhalUka lai AIe ate tuhAnUM ajihA rUpa de daIe jisa nUM tusIM nahIM jANade|
tusIM ApaNe pahile janama toM tAM jANU hI ho, tusIM nasIhata grahiNa kiuM nahIM karade?
ratA iha dasso ki jo tusIM bIjade ho|
kI usa nUM tusIM ugAuMde ho jAM ugAuNa vAle asIM hAM?
je asIM cAhIe tAM isa (fasala) nUM cUrA-cUrA kara ke rakkha daIe phera tusIM rurAnI nAla gallAM karade rahi jAoge|
tusIM Akhoge ki sADe utte tAM puTThI caTTI pai gaI|
(nahIM) sagoM iha vI Akhoge ki sADe tAM bhAga hI phuTTe hoe sana|
bhalAM iha dasso ki iha pANI jihar3A tusIM pIMde ho|
kI isa (pANI) nUM baddalAM toM tusIM utAriA hai jAM usa nUM utArana vAle asIM hAM|
je asAM cAhIe tAM isa (pANI) nUM khArA baNA daIe| phera vI tusIM zukara adA kiuM nahIM karade?
bhalAM iha dasso ki jihar3I agga tusIM sulagAuMde ho|
kI usa dA rukha tusIM paidA kItA hai jAM asAM paidA karana vAle hAM?
asAM hI usa agga nUM yAda duAuNa dA sAdhana baNAiA hai ate yAtarIAM laI lAbhadAika baNAiA hai|
so (he nabI!) tusIM ApaNe rabba de nAM dA simarana karo, jihar3A sabha toM vaDDA hai|
maiM tAriAM de DigaNa dI suMha khAMdA hAM|
je tuhAnUM patA hove tAM iha bahuta vaDDI suMha hai|
bezakka iha.kuraAna atiaMta satikArayoga te AdaramAna vAlA hai|
ika surakkhiata kitAba (lauhe-mahafUz2a) vica daraja hai|
isa kitAba (.kuraAna) nUM pAka pavvitara farizate hI chUade hana|
iha (.kuraAna) sAre jahAnAM de pAlaNahAra valloM utAriA giA hai|
kI tusIM phera vI isa bANI toM beparavAhI varatade ho?
tusIM isa niamata (bhAva.kuraAna) vica ApaNA hissA iho rakkhade ho ki tusIM isa dA inakAra karade ho|
phera tusIM kiuM nahIM ApaNI rUha nUM roka laiMde jadoM uha saMgha taka pujja jAMdI hai|
tusIM usa vele vekha rahe huMde ho|
asIM tuhAthoM kite vaddha usa rUha de ner3e huMde hAM, para tuhAnUM disade nahIM|
je tusIM kise de adhIna nahIM|
tusIM usa (rUha) nUM mor3a liAuMde, je tusIM sacce ho?
je uha (marana vAlA allAha de) nikaTavaratIAM viccoM hove|
phera tAM (usa de laI) sukha-suvidhA, sugaMde ate niamatAM vAle bAg2a hana|
je uha (marana vAlA) sajje hattha vAliAM viccoM hoiA|
tAM usa nUM AkhiA jAvegA ki tere laI salAmatI hI salAmatI hai, bezakka tUM sajje hattha vAliAM viccoM hai|
para je uha inakAra karana vAlA kurAhe pae lokAM viccoM hoiA|
tAM usa dI sevA ubbalade hoe pANI hovegA|
ate usa nUM naraka vica hI jANA hai|
nirasaMdeha, iha sArA kujjha hoNA aTalla hai|
so (he nabI!) tusIM atiaMta mahAna rabba de nAM dI tasabIha karo|
akAzAM te dharatI vica jihar3I vI cIz2a hai, uha allAha dI tasabIha karadI hai| uhIo atiaMta z2orAvara ate yukatImAna hai|
akAzAM te dharatI dA pAtazAhI use laI hai, uhIo jiUMdA karadA hai, uhIo mauta diMdA hai ate uhIo hara kaMma karana dI samarathA rakhadA hai|
