uhIo (srizaTI dA) AraMbha hai ate uhIo aMta hai| uhIo pragaTa hai te gupata vI uhIo hI hai ate uha hara cIz2a dA jANanahAra hai|

uhI hai jisa ne akAzAM te dharatI nUM che dinAM vica sAjiA, phera araza (rAja siMghAsana) utte jA baiThiA| uha jANadA hai, jo cIz2a dharatI vica jAMdI hai ate jo isa viccoM nikkaladI hai ate jo cIz2a akAza viccoM uttaradI hai te jo usa vica car3hadI hai| tusIM jitthe vI huMde ho uha tuhADe aMga-saMga huMdA hai| tusIM jo vI karade ho allAha usa nUM caMgI tarhAM vekhadA hai|
allAha laI hI akAza ate dharatI dI pAtazAhI hai ate sAre mAmale (niber3aNa laI) use valla paratAe jAMde hana|
uhIo rAta nUM dina vica ate dina nUM rAta vica dAqhala karadA hai| uha dilAM de bhetAM nUM vI jANadA hai|

(he loko) allAha ate usa de rasUla ’te ImAna lai Ao ate usa mAla viccoM qharaca karo jisa dA usa (allAha) ne tuhAnUM jAnazIna baNAiA hai| tuhADe viccoM jo loka ImAna liAe ate uhanAM ne (allAha dI rAha vica) qharaca kItA uhanAM laI vaDDA badalA hai|

tuhAnUM kI ho giA ki tusIM allAha utte ImAna nahIM liAuMde? jadoM ki rasUla tuhAnUM saddA de rihA hai ki tusIM ApaNe pAlaNahAra ’te ImAna lai Ao jada ki uha tuhAthoM (pahilAM hI) pakkA vacana lai cukkiA hai, je tusIM ImAnadAra ho| (tAM maMna lao)

uhI tAM hai jihar3A ApaNe baMde (muhaMmada sa:) utte sapazaTa AitAM (Adeza) utAradA hai tAM jo uha (rasUla) tuhAnUM hanerhiAM toM ujAle valla kaDDha liAve| bezakka allAha tuhADe ’te atiaMta miharabAna te rahima karana vAlA hai|

tuhAnUM kI ho giA ki tusIM allAha dI rAha vica qharaca nahIM karade? jadoM ki akAzAM te dharatI dI malakIata allAha laI hai| tuhADe viccoM jinhAM lokAM ne makke dI fatiha toM pahilAM qharaca kItA te jihAda kItA, iha uhanAM lokAM de barAbara nahIM jinhAM ne makkA fatiha hoNa toM bAada iho kaMma kItA| uha (pahilAM qharaca karana vAle) loka daraje vica uhanAM lokAM toM ucce hana, jinhAM ne isa (fatiha) toM bAada qharaca kItA te jihAda vI kItA| allAha ne hareka nUM vadhIA badalA deNa dA vAadA kItA hai| allAha caMgI tarhAM jANadA hai jo tusIM amala karade ho|
uha kauNa hai jihar3A allAha nUM sohaNA karaz2a deve tAM jo allAha usa (de dhaMna) vicca hora vAdhA kare te usa de (karaz2a deNa vAle) laI iho vadhIA badalA hai|

(he nabI!) usa (kiAmata) dihAr3e tusIM ImAna vAle ’te ImAna vAlIAM nUM vekhoge ki uhanAM dA nUra uhanAM de agge-agge te uhanAM de sajje pAse nassadA hovegA| AkhiA jAvegA ki ajja tuhAnUM ajihe bAg2AM dI qhuzaqhabarI hai jinhAM de heTha nahirAM vagadIAM hana| uha uhanAM vica sadA rahiNage, iho sabha toM vaDDI kAmayAbI hai|

usa dina munAfika (pakhaMDI) puraza ate munAfika isatarIAM ImAna liAuNa vAliAM nUM AkhaNage ki tusIM sADI uDIka karo ki asIM vI tuhADe nUra viccoM kujjha cAnaNa prApata kara laIe| uhanAM nUM AkhiA jAvegA ki ApaNe picchAMha mur3a jAo te phera nUra nUM labbho| phera uhanAM vicAle ika kaMdha khar3I kara dittI jAvegI jisa dA ika bUhA hovegA, usa de aMdara rahimatAM hoNagIAM te usa de bAhara az2Aba hovegA|

uha (munAfika) ihanAM (mominAM) nUM AkhaNage, kI (saMsAra) vica asIM tuhADe saMga nahIM sI? uha AkhaNage ki hAM! kiuM nahIM! para tusIM ApaNe Apa nUM az2amAizAM vica pA liA sI ate tusIM ImAna vAliAM pratI (bhair3e) sameM dI uDIka vica sI| tusIM (dIna vica) zakka vI kItA ate tuhAnUM tuhADIAM icchAvAM ne dhokhe vica rakkhiA, itthoM taka ki allAha dA hukama A pahuMciA ate dhokhebAz2a zaitAna ne tuhAnUM allAha de bAre dhokhA dittA|

so ajja nA tuhAthoM ate nA hI uhanAM lokAM toM jinhAM ne kufara kItA sI koI chuDavAI kabUla kItI jAvegI| tuhADA TikANA tAM agga hai| tuhADe yoga tAM ihIo TikANA hai ate iha bahuta hI bhair3A paratana TikANA hai|

kI ImAna vAliAM laI ajihe uha samAM nahIM AiA ki uhanAM de dila allAha dI yAda nAla jhukka jANa ate (isa.kuraAna de laI) jo hakka (allAha) valloM utAriA giA hai| uha uhanAM lokAM vAMga nA ho jANa jinhAM nUM isa toM pahilAM kitAba (tauraita) dittI gaI sI| phera uhanAM ’te ika laMmA samAM bIta giA tAM uhanAM de dila kaThora ho gae ate ihanAM viccoM bahute tAM jhUThe hana|

tusIM caMgI tarhAM iha jANa lao ki bezakka allAha hI dharatI nUM usa dI mauta (baMjara) picchoM surajIta (upajAU) karadA hai| so asIM ApaNIAM AitAM (Adeza) tuhADe laI biAna kara ditte hana tAM jo tusIM kujjha samajha sakoM|

bezakka sadakA (sacce mano puMna-dANa) deNa vAle puraza, isatIAM ate jinhAM ne allAha nUM karaz2e-hasanA (sohaNA karaz2A) dittA hai, nirasaMdeha, uhanAM ­nUM kaI guNA vadhA ke (vApisa kara) dittA jAvegA ate uhanAM laI bahuta hI sohaNA badalA hai|

jihar3e loka allAha ate usa de rasUlAM ’te ImAna liAe uhIo ApaNe rabba dIAM naz2arAM vica siddIka (saciArA) ate zahIda hana| uhanAM laI uhanAM de amalAM dA sohaNA badalA hovegA ate (uhanAM de saMga) uhanAM dA nUra hove| ate jinhAM lokAM ne (sADe hukamAM dA) inakAra kItA ate sADIAM AitAM (.kuraAna) nUM jhuThalAiA hai, uha sabha narakI hana|

(he loko!) tusIM iha galla jANa lao! ki saMsArika jIvana kevala ika kheDa tamAzA te sajAvaTa dI cIz2a hai| Apo vica ghamaMDa karanA ate mAla daulata te saMtAna pakkhoM ika dUje utte vaDiAI jatAuNA hai| (isa dI udAharana tAM iMja hai) jiveM varakhA, jisa toM magaroM upajaNa vAlI paidAvAra kisAnAM nUM qhuza karadI hai| phera uha (paidAvAra) sukka jAMdI hai bhAva pakka jAMdI hai tAM tusIM usa nUM pIlI (murajhAI) huMdI vekhade ho, phera uha cUrA-cUrA ho jAMdI hai| aiveM hI Aqhirata vica (kAfirAM laI) karar3A az2Aba hai ate (ImAna vAliAM laI) allAha valloM baqhaziza ate usa dI raz2AmaMdI hai| saMsArika jIvana tAM dhokhA deNa dA ika sAdhana hai|

so (he ImAna vAlio!) tusIM ApaNe rabba dI baqhaziza te usa jaMnata valla daur3o jisa dI vizAlatA akAza te dharatI jihI hai| iha uhanAM lokAM laI tiAra kItI gaI hai jihar3e allAha te usa de rasUlAM ’te ImAna liAe hana| iha allAha dA faz2ala (kripAlatA) hai, uha jisa nUM cAhuMdA hai diMdA hai, allAha bahuta vaDDA kripAlU hai|
dharatI ’te jAM tuhADIAM jAnAM utte jihar3I vI bipatA AuMdI hai uha tAM tuhADe janama toM pahilAM hI kitAba vica likhI hoI hai| iMja karanA allAha laI bahuta hI saukhA hai|

iha sabha isa laI dassiA jA rihA hai tAM jo je koI cIz2a tuhADe hatthoM khusa jAve tAM tusIM dukhI nA hovo ate je uha (allAha) tuhAnUM navAz2adA hai tAM tusIM zeqhIAM nA mArade phiro| allAha kise vI zeqhIqhore ate ghamaMDI nUM pasaMda nahIM karadA|

(ate nA hI allAha uhanAM nUM pasaMda karadA hai) jihar3e Ape vI kaMjUsI karade hana te dUjiAM nUM vI kaMjUsI karana laI prerita karade hana| jihar3A koI viakatI (allAha de hukamAM toM) mUMha mor3adA hai tAM allAha nUM isa galla dI koI ciMtA nahIM, uha tAM Apa hI atiaMta zalAghAyoga hai|

bezakka asAM ApaNe rasUlAM nUM sapazaTa nizAnIAM nAla bhejiA ate asIM uhanAM nAla kitAba (rabbI bANI) te mIz2Ana (inasAfa karana vAlI takar3I) utArI tAM jo loka inasAfa ’te kAima rahiNa| asIM lohA paidA kItA, isa vica bahuta zakatI hai[1] ate lokAM laI anekAM lAbha hana| tAM jo allAha nUM giAna ho jAve ki kauNa bina vekhiAM usa dI te usa de paig2aMbarAM dI madada karadA hai| bezakka allAha atiaMta zakatIzAlI ate z2orAvara hai|
translations.footnotes: [1] isI lohe toM talavArAM baNadIAM hana jiveM de saMbaMdha vica kihA jAMdA hai ki jaMnata talavArAM dIAM chAvAM heTha hai| (sahI rabaqhArI, hadIsa: 2818)

translations.translation: bezakka asIM nUha nUM ate ibarAhIma nUM (rasUla baNA ke) bhejiA| asIM uhanAM dohAM dI saMtAna vica paig2aMbarI ate (rabbI) kitAba rakkha dittI, phera ihanAM viccoM hI kujjha hidAita prApata karana vAle hana ate ihanAM viccoM hI bahute loka nA-faramAna hana|

phera asIM ihanAM de picche lar3IvAra rasUla bheje ate ihanAM sabha de picche marIama de puttara IsA nUM bhejiA| usa nUM asIM iMjIla dittI ate uhanAM de dilAM vica jinhAM ne uhanAM dI pairavI kItI, naramI te muhabbata rakkha dittI| saMsAra tiAga prathA tAM uhanAM dI ApaNI baNAI hoI hai, asIM uhanAM laI iha faraz2a nahIM sI kItA, para allAha dI raz2A dI talAza vica uhanAM ne Apa hI iha sabha kItA sI| uhanAM ne isa galla dA dhiAna nahIM rakkhiA jiveM ki rakhaNA cAhIdA sI| phera asIM uhanAM lokAM nUM jihar3e uhanAM viccoM ImAna liAe, uhanAM de (ImAna dA) badalA dittA ate ihanAM viccoM vadhere loka tAM jhUThe hana|

he ImAna vAlio! tusIM allAha toM Daro ate usa de rasUlAM utte ImAna liAo, allAha tuhAnUM ApaNI mihara dA duharA hissA baqhazegA[2] ate tuhADe laI ajihA nUra baNAvegA jisa dI rauzanI vica tusIM calloMge ate uha tuhAnUM baqhaza devegA| allAha muAfa karana vAlA ate atiaMta rahima faramAuNa vAlA hai|
translations.footnotes: [2] vekho sUrata ala-kasasa, hAzIA Aita 54/28 ate sUrata Ale-imarAna, hAzIA Aita 85/3

translations.translation: tAM jo kitAba vAle (yahUdI ate IsAI) iha jANa laiNa ki uha allAha dI kripAlatA nAla kise zaia ’te kudarata nahIM rakkhade| bezakka sAre faz2ala (kripAlatA te baqhazizAM) allAha de hattha vica hI hana| uha jisa nUM cAhuMdA hai (ApaNI kripA nAla) de diMdA hai ate allAha atiaMta kripAlU hai|

(he nabI!) allAha ne usa z2anAnI (bIbI khaulA) dI galla suNa laI jadoM uha ApaNe patI (osa bina sAmata) de saMbaMdha vica tuhADe nAla jhagar3a rahI sI| uha allAha agge zikAita kara rahI sI ate allAha tuhADe dovAM dI galla-bAta suNa rihA sI| bezakka allAha vaDDA suNana vAlA ate vekhaNa vAlA hai|

tuhADe viccoM jihar3e loka ApaNIAM patanIAM nAla ‘z2ihAra’ kara baiThade ho[1] uha uhanAM dIAM mAvAM nahIM, uhanAM dIAM mAvAM tAM uhIo hana jinhAM ne uhanAM nUM jaNiA hai| bezakka iha loka bahuta hI bhair3I te jhUThI galla Akhade hana| bezakka allAha vaDDA khimA karana vAlA te baqhazaNahAra hai|
translations.footnotes: [1] z2ihAra toM bhAva hai ki patanI nUM iha kahi deNA ki terI piTha mere laI merI mAM dI piTha vAMga hai jAM iha kahi deNA ki tUM mere utte merI mAM vAMga hI harAma hai|

translations.translation: jihar3e lokI ApaNIAM patanIAM nAla ‘z2ihAra’ karana phera ApaNI AkhI hoI galla toM mur3a AuNA cAhuMde hana tAM ika dUje nUM hattha lAuNa toM pahilAM (patI nUM) ika g2ulAma az2Ada karanA cAhIdA hai| isa (hukama) dI tuhAnUM nasIhata kItI jAMdI hai ate allAha nUM isa galla dI qhabara hai jo tusIM karade ho|

phera jisa viakatI nUM g2ulAma nA jur3e tAM uha do mahIniAM de lar3IvAra roz2e rakkhe isa toM pahilAM ki uha ika dUje nUM hattha lAuNa| phera jo isa dI himmata nA rakkhadA hove uha saTTha muthAjAM nUM bhojana karAve| iha hukama isa laI hana ki tusIM allAha te usa de rasUla utte ImAna liAe ho| iha allAha dIAM haddAM hana, nA maMNana vAliAM laI daradanAka az2Aba hai|

bezakka jihar3e loka allAha te usa de rasUla dI virodhatA karade hana uhanAM nUM rusavA kItA jAvegA, jiveM uha loka rusavA (hINe) hoe sana jihar3e ihanAM toM pahilAM sana| asIM sapazaTa Adeza utAre hana te nA maMNana vAliAM laI hINatA bhariA az2Aba hai|[2]
translations.footnotes: [2] vekho sUrata Ale-imarAna, hAzIA Aita 85/3

translations.translation: jisa dihAr3e allAha uhanAM sabha lokAM nUM mur3a surajIta karegA phera ihanAM nUM dassegA ki uhanAM ne kI kaMma kIte hana| allAha ne uhanAM sabha de karamAM nUM giNa rakkhiA hai jada ki uha tAM uhanAM nUM bhulI baiThe sI| jada ki allAha hara cIz2a dA rAkhA hai|

(he nabI!) kI tusIM nahIM vekhade ki bezakka allAha sabha jANadA hai jo kujjha akAzAM vica hai ate jo dharatI vica hai| tiMna (viakatIAM) vicAle kade koI kAnAphUsI nahIM huMdI jada ki uhanAM vicAle ’coMthAM (bhAva allAha) huMdA hai ate nA hI paMja viakatIAM dI kAnAphUsI huMdI hai sagoM uhanAM vicAle chevAM allAha huMdA hai, uha bhAveM ghaTTa hoNa jAM vaddha, jitthe kite vI uha hoNa, uha uhanAM de nAla huMdA hai| phera uha uhanAM nUM kiAmata dihAr3e dassa devegA jihar3e uha kaMma (saMsAra vica) karade sana| bezakka allAha hara cIz2a nUM caMgI tarhAM jANadA hai|[3]
translations.footnotes: [3] vekho sUrata hUda, hAzIA Aita 18/11

translations.translation: kI tusIM uhanAM lokAM nUM nahIM vekhiA jinhAM nUM kAnAphUsI karana toM rokiA giA sI phera vI uha uhIo (harakatAM) karI jA rahe hana, jinhAM toM uhanAM nUM rokiA giA sI? uha pApa, vadhIkI te rasUla dI avaggiA dIAM gallAM (bhAva sAz2izAM) karade hana| (he nabI!) jadoM uha tuhADe kola AuMde hana tAM tuhAnUM uhanAM (zabadAM) nAla salAma Akhade hana ki allAha ne kade tuhAnUM uhanAM zabadAM nAla salAma nahIM kItA ate uha ApaNe mana vica Akhade hana ki asIM jo Akhade hAM allAha sA` ihanAM gallAM utte az2Aba kiuM nahIM diMdA? he nabI! uhanAM laI tAM naraka hI batherI hai, uha use vica dAqhala kIte jANage| uha bahuta hI bhair3A TikANA hai|

he ImAna vAlio! jadoM tusIM Apo vica gupata gallAM karo tAM pApa, vadhIkI te rasUla dI nA-faramAnIAM vAlIAM gallAM nA karo, sagoM nekI te parahez2agArI dIAM gallAM karo| allAha toM Daro jisa dI haz2UrI vica tusIM ikattara hoNA hai|

(bhair3I) kAnAphUsI tAM zaitAna valloM hI huMdI hai, tAM jo uha ImAna vAliAM nUM dukhI kara sake jada ki uha uhanAM nUM allAha de hukama toM binAM koI hAnI nahIM pucA sakadA| mominAM nUM tAM allAha utte hI bharosA rakkhaNA cAhIdA hai|[4]
translations.footnotes: [4] allAha ’te bharosA ika momina dA sabha toM vaDDA hatthiAra te sahArA hai| hadIsa vica hai ki allAha de rasUla ne faramAiA ki merI ummata de sattara haz2Ara viakatI binAM lekhA-jokhA toM jaMnata vica jANage ate iha loka uha hana jihar3e dama nahIM karavAuMde nA hI zaguna laiMde hana ate uha ApaNe allAha utte bharosA karade hana| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 6472)

translations.translation: he ImAna vAlio! jadoM tuhAnUM AkhiA jAve ki ApaNIAM majalisAM (sabhAvAM) vica khullha paidA karo tAM khola diA karo, allAha tuhAnUM khullha baqhazegA| jadoM AkhiA jAve ki uTha jAo tAM uTha khar3he ho jAiA karo| tuhADe viccoM jihar3e ImAna liAe hana ate jinhAM nUMgiAna baqhaziA giA hai allAha uhanAM de darajiAM nUM uccA karegA, allAha nUM sabha qhabara hai jo vI tusIM karade ho|

he ImAna vAlio! jadoM tusIM rasUla nAla gupata vAratA karo tAM ApaNI vAratAlApa toM pahilAM kujjha sadakA (dAna) kara diA karo| iha tuhADe laI caMgerA hai te pavittaratA vica vI vaddha hai| je tuhADe vica (puMna-dAna karana dI) samarathA nahIM hai (tAM koI galla nahIM) bezakka allAha vaDDA baqhazaNahAra ate miharabAna hai|

kI tusIM isa galloM Dara gae ki gupata vAratA toM pahilAM tuhAnUM puMna-dAna karanA pavegA? caMgA! je tusIM iMja nahIM kItA tAM allAha ne tuhAnUM isa toM muAfa kara dittA| so tusIM namAz2a kAima karo te z2akAta adA karo ate allAha ate usa de rasUla dI tAbedArI karo| allAha nUM sabha patA hai jo tusIM karade ho|

kI tusIM uhanAM (munAfika) lokAM nUM nahIM vekhiA ki jinhAM ne usa kauma (yahUdIAM) nAla mittaratA kItI jinhAM utte allAha dI karopI hoI sI?nA uha tuhADe viccoM hana ate nA hI uhanAM (kAfirAM) viccoM hana, uha jhUThIAM kasamAM khAMde hana hAlAM ki uha sabha jANade hana|
ki allAha ne uhanAM laI karar3A az2Aba tiAra kara chaDDiA hai, bahuta hI bhair3IAM karatUtAM hana jihar3IAM uha karade hana|
uhanAM ne ApaNIAM kasamAM nUM DhAla baNA chaDDiA hai, uha lokAM nUM allAha de rAha toM rokade hana, so uhanAM laI z2alIla karana vAlA az2Aba hai|
uhanAM dI dhana-daulata te uhanAM dI saMtAna uhanAM nUM allAha de az2Aba toM bacAuNa laI (kiAmata dihAr3e) kujjha kaMma nahIM AvegI, iho loka narakI hana, uha isa vica sadA laI rahiNage|

jisa dina allAha uhanAM sabha nUM mur3a surajIta karegA tAM uha usa (allAha) de sAhamaNe vI kasamAM khAMNage jiveM tuhADe sAhamaNe kasamAM khAMde hana ate uha samajhade hana ki uha ThIka rAha utte hana| sAvadhAna raho! bezakka uha jhUThe hana|
ihanAM utte zaitAna bhArU ho giA hai, phera usa ne uhanAM de dilAM ’coM allAha dI yAda nUM bhulA chaDDiA hai, iha zaitAna dA TolA hai, bezakka zaitAnI TolA hI ghATe vica rahiNa vAlA hai|
bezakka jihar3e loka allAha te usa de rasUla dI virodhatA karade hana uha sabha toM vaddha hINe lokAM viccoM hana|
allAha ne likha rakkhiA hai ki aMta maiM te mere rasUla hI bhArU rahiNage| bezakka allAha vaDDA balavAna ate z2orAvara hai|

(he nabI!) tusIM koI vI kauma ajihI nahIM vekhoge jihar3I allAha te kiAmata dihAr3e utte ImAna rakkhadI hove para uha uhanAM lokAM nAla dosatI kare jihar3e allAha te usa de rasUla dI virodhatA karade hoNa, bhAveM uha uhanAM de pio hana jAM puttara jAM bharA jAM parivAra vAle hI hoNa| iho uha loka hana jinhAM de dilAM vica allAha ne ImAna likha chaDDiA hai ate ApaNe valloM rUha bheja ke bhAva g2aiba toM uhanAM dI sahAitA kItI hai| uha uhanAM nUM ajihIAM jaMnatAM vica dAqhala karegA jinhAM de heTha nahirAM vagadIAM hoNagIAM, uha uhanAM vica sadA rahiNage| allAha uhanAM toM rAz2I ho giA ate uha allAha toM rAz2I hana, iho allAha dA TolA hai| jANa lao! ki bezakka jihar3A allAha dA TolA hai uhIo safalatA prApata karana vAlA hai|
allAha dI pavittaratA dA varaNana hara uha cIz2a kara rahI hai jihar3I akAzAM vica hai te dharatI vica hai ate uhIo vaDDA z2orAvara te yukatImAna hai|

iha allAha uhI hai jisa ne kitAba vAliAM de inakArIAM nUM pahile deza nikAle sameM hI uhanAM de gharoM kaDDha dittA sI| (he nabI!) tusIM tAM kade iha sociA vI nahIM sI ki uha (madIne toM) nikkalaNage ate uha (ahile kitAba) iha samajhade sana ki bezakka uhanAM dIAM gar3hIAM uhanAM nUM allAha de az2Aba toM bacA laiNagIAM, para uhanAM utte allAha dA az2Aba usa pAsioM AiA jidharoM uhanAM dA dhiAna vI nahIM sI giA| use ne uhanAM de dilAM vica roaba pA dittA| uha ApaNe hatthIM ApaNe ghara ujAr3a rahe sana ate mominAM de hatthoM vI barabAda ho rahe sana| so he akkhAM vAlio! (isa ghaTanAM toM) sikkhiA grahiNa karo|
je allAha ne uhanAM laI deza nikAlA nA liikhaA huMdA tAM uha uhanAM nUM saMsAra vica hI az2Aba de suTTadA ate paraloka vica tAM uhanAM laI agga dA az2Aba hai|
iha (az2Aba) isa laI hai ki uhanAM ne allAha te usa de rasUla dI virodhatA kItI hai ate jihar3A vI koI allAha dI virodhatA karegA tAM bezakka usa nUM allAha karar3I saz2A deNa vAlA hai|
tusIM jihar3e vI khajUrAM de rukkha vaDDhe hana jAM jinhAM nUM uhanAM dIAM jar3hAM utte khar3e rahiNa dittA tAM iha sabha allAha de hukama nAla hoiA hai tAM jo uha ulaMghaNakArIAM nUM rusavA kare|

allAha ne uhanAM (kAfirAM) valloM jihar3A vI (dhaMna padAratha) ApaNe rasUla valla paratAiA hai, usa de laI tusIM ghor3e te UMTha nahIM daur3Ae (bhAva tusIM kujha vI nahIM sI kItA| para allAha ApaNe rasUlAM nUM jisa ’te cAhuMdA hai bhArU kara diMdA hai| allAha hara prakAra dI samarathA rakkhadA hai|

allAha ApaNe rasUla valla basatIAM vAliAM dA jo (mAla) vI paratA deve uha allAha laI ate usa de rasUla laI ate usa de sake-saMbaMdhIAM, yatImAM, muthAjAM ate musAfarAM laI hai, tAM jo iha daulata tuhADe dhanavAna lokAM vicAle hI cakkara nA kaTTadI rahe| allAha dA rasUla tuhAnUM jo vI deve usa nUM lai lavo ate jisa toM roke usa nUM chaDDa dio|[1] allAha toM Darade raho bezakka allAha saz2A deNa vica karar3A hai|
translations.footnotes: [1] isa Aita vica allAha ate usa de rasUla (sa:) dI tAbedArI dA hukama hai, jisa dA aratha hai ki allAha de rasUla (sa:) dI tAbedArI allAha dI tAbedArI hai ate sahAbA ne vI isa Aita toM iho aratha samajhiA hai ate uhanAM ne binAM kise kiMtU-praMtU hadIsAM ’te use tarhAM amala kItA jiddAM.kuraAna ’te amala kItA sI ate hadIsa nUM vI uhIo mahattatA dittI jo.kuraAna dI sI|

translations.translation: uha mAla uhanAM g2arIba mahAjarAM laI hai jihar3e ApaNe gharAM ’coM te jAidAdAM ’coM bAhara kaDDha ditte gae, uha allAha de faz2ala ate usa dI raz2A de cAhavAna hana ate jihar3e allAha te usa de rasUla dI madada karade hana, uhIo sacce loka hana|

ate (uhanAM laI ru) jinhAM ne (madIne nUM hI) ApaNA ghara baNAiA sI (bhAva madIne de vasanIka sana) ate ihanAM mahAjarAM toM pahilAM ImAna liAe sana, uha (madIne de momina) uhanAM nAla muhabbata karade hana jihar3e uhanAM valla hijarata karade hana| uha ApaNe dilAM vica isa (mAla) dI koI cAhata nahIM rakkhade jihar3A ihanAM (mahAjarAM) nUM diA jAMdA hai| (uha ApaNI) z2Ata utte uhanAM nUM pahila diMde hana, bhAveM uhanAM nUM kiMnI hI lor3a hove| jisa ne ApaNe Apa nUM lAlaca toM bacA liA uhIo safalatA prApata karana vAlA ru|

uha loka jihar3e hijarata magaroM ImAna liAe uha Akhade hana ki he sADe pAlaNahAra! tUM sADe uhanAM bharAvAM nUM jinhAM ne ImAna liAuNa vica sAthoM pahila kItI, baqhaza de| sADe dilAM vica mominAM pratI IrakhA nA rahiNa de| he sADe rabbA! bezakka tUM ati naramAI vAlA te atiaMta rahima vAlA hai|

(he nabI!) kI tusIM uhanAM lokAM nUM nahIM vekhiA jinhAM ne munAfakata (doraMgI) apaNAI hai? uha ApaNe kitAba vAle kAfira bharAvAM (yahUdIAM) nUM Akhade hana ki je tuhAnUM gharAM viccoM kaDDhiA giA tAM asIM vI tuhADe nAla hI (madIne viccoM) nikkalAMge ate tuhADe (viruddha) asIM kise prakAra dI galla nahIM maMnAMge| jekara tuhADe nAla jaMga kItI gaI tAM asIM tuhADI sahAitA karAMge| praMtU allAha uhanAM de jhUThe hoNa dI gavAhI diMdA hai|

(jada ki hakIkata iha hai ki) je uhanAM kAfirAM nUM gharoM (madIne viccoM) kaDDhiA giA tAM iha (munAfika) uhanAM de nAla nahIM nikkalaNage| jekara uhanAM nAla koI jaMga kItI gaI tAM iha uhanAM dI madada nahIM karanage| je uhanAM dI madada nUM A vI gae tAM piTTha vikhAke bhajja jANage, phera uhanAM nUM kise (hora pAsioM) madada nahIM milegI|
(he musalamAno!) sacca jANoM ki uhanAM de dilAM vica allAha nAloM kite vaddha tuhADA roaba hai| iha isa laI hai ki bezakka uha besamajha loka hana|

uha sAre mila ke vI tuhADe nAla lar3a nahIM sakade, je lar3aNage vI tAM kilA baMda basatIAM vica baiTha ke jAM kaMdhAM uhale luka chipa ke (lar3aNage)| uhanAM (kAfirAM) dI Apo vicAlI lar3AI vI bahuta saqhata hai| tusIM uhanAM nUM ikajuTa samajhade ho, jada ki uhanAM de dila ika dUje toM pATe hoe hana, bezakka uha sAre be-akala loka hana|
ihanAM dI misAla uhanAM lokAM dI tarhAM hai jihar3e ihanAM toM kujjha sameM pahilAM hI (badara vica) ApaNe karamAM dI saz2A bhugata cukke hana ate uhanAM laI daradanAka az2Aba hai|

ihanAM (munAfikAM) dI udAharana zaitAna vAMga hai, pahilAM tAM manukkha nUM AkhadA hai ki tUM (rabba dA) inakAra kara, jadoM uha (manukkha) inakAra kara baiThadA hai tAM zaitAna AkhadA hai, maiM taithoM barI hAM, maiM tAM sAre jagga de pAlaNahAra toM DaradA hAM|
so ihanAM dovAM (munAfikAM te zaitAna) dA aMta iha hovegA ki uha sadA laI (naraka dI) agga vica rahiNage| z2AlamAM dI iho saz2A hai|

he ImAna vAlio! (tusIM sadA) allAha toM Darade rihA karo ate hareka viakatI nUM iha vekhaNA cAhIdA hai ki kalla (kiAmata) laI usa ne kI kujjha agge bhejiA hai| tusIM allAha toM (hara vele) Darade raho[2] bezakka allAha tuhADe sAre hI kIte karamAM nUM jANadA hai|
translations.footnotes: [2] vekho sUrata asa-sajadA, hAzIA Aita 16/32, sUrata ala-hijara, hAzIA Aita 23/15 ate sUrata ata-taubA, hAzIA Aita 111/9

translations.translation: ate (he musalamAno!) tusIM uhanAM lokAM vAMga nA ho jANA jinhAM ne allAha nUM bhulA dittAM tAM allAha ne uhanAM nUM uhanAM dA ApA bhulA dittA, ajihe loka rabba de nA-faramAna huMde hana|
agga vAle (narakI) te bAg2AM vAle (jaMnatI) ika barAbara nahIM ho sakade| savaragAM vica jANa vAle hI asala vica kAmayAba hana|

je asIM (allAha) isa.kuraAna nUM kise pahAr3a utte nAz2ila kara diMde tAM (he loko!) tusIM vekhade ki uha pahAr3a rabba de Dara nAla dabba jAMdA ate pATa jAMdA |[3] asIM iha misAlAM lokAM agge isa laI biAna karade hAM tAM jo lokI uhanAM utte soca vicAra karana|
translations.footnotes: [3] isa toM patA laggadA hai ki per3a-paude vI kujjha hadda taka surata rakkhade hana| isa dI puzaTI hadIsa toM vI huMdI hai jisa vica ika rukkha de hoNa dI caracA kItI gaI hai bhAveM ki iha nabI (sa:) dA mUajaz2A hai para phera vI isa toM rukkha de surata vica hoNa dA patA caladA hai| hadIsa vica hai ki allAha de rasUla (sa:) jume vAle dina ika rukkha jAM ika TAhaNI nAla DhAhasaNA lA ke khar3hiA karade sI| anasAra dI ika aurata jAM marada ne benatI kItI, he allAha de rasUla! asIM tuhADe laI ika miMbara nA baNavA daIe? Apa (sa:) ne faramAiA, caMgA tuhADI icchA, phera uhanAM ne miMbara baNavA dittA| jadoM jume dA dina AiA tAM Apa miMbara ’te padhAre, rukkha dI TAhaNI ika bAlaka vAMga roNa lagga paI, Apa (sa:) miMbara toM heTha uttara rukkha nUM chAtI nAla lAiA, isa ’te uha rukkha iMja roNa laggiA jiveM kise nUM tasallI dittI jAMdI hai| Apa (sa:) ne faramAiA, iha rukkha isa laI roMdA hai ki pahilAM iha allAha dA nAM suNadA sI| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 3584)

translations.translation: uha allAha hI hai jisa toM chuTTa koI izaTa nahIM| gupata te pragaTa hoNa vAlI hareka cIz2a dA jANanahAra hai, atiaMta miharabAna ate rahima faramAuNa vAlA hai|

uhIo allAha hai jisa toM chuTTa koI pUjaNahAra nahIM| uha pAtazAha hai, atiaMta pavittara hai, saMpUrana salAmatI amana-zAMtI vAlA, dekha-bhAla karana vAlA, vaDDA z2orAvara ate vaDDiAIAM vAlA hai| allAha usa ziraka toM pAka hai, jo iha loka kara rahe hana|

uhI allAha hai, sirajaNahAra hai, zakalAM-sUratAM baNAuNA vAlA hai, sAre sohaNe nAM use laI hana, hareka cIz2a bhAveM uha akAzAM vica hai bhAveM dharatI vica hai, use rabba dI pAkI biAna karadI hai[4] ate uhIo z2orAvara te yukatImAna hai|
translations.footnotes: [4] vekho sUrata ala-ArAfa, hAzIA Aita 180/7

translations.translation: he ImAna vAlio! tusIM mere ate ApaNe vairIAM nUM ApaNA mittara nA baNAo| tusIM tAM uhanAM valla dosatI de sunehe ghallade ho jada ki uha, jihar3A hakka (saccA dharama) tuhADe kola AiA hai usa de inakArI hana| uha rasUla (muhaMmada sa:) nUM te tuhAnUM vI isa laI (makke toM) deza nikAlA de rahe hana ki tusIM ApaNe rabba utte ImAna rakkhade ho| je tusIM merI rAha vica jihAda laI te merI raz2A dI bhAla laI nikale ho tAM kAfirAM nUM dosata nA baNAo| tusIM uhanAM kAfirAM valla luka-chipa ke dosatI de paig2Ama bhejade ho| maiM caMgI tarhAM jANadA hAM jo tusIM lukAuMde ho ate jo vikhAuMde ho| tuhADe viccoM jihar3A vI koI ajihA karegA tAM uha z2arUra hI siddhI rAha toM bhaTaka giA |[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] vekho sUrata Ale-imarAna, hAzIA Aita 149/3

translations.translation: je uha (kAfira) tuhADe utte kAbU pA laiNa tAM uha tuhADI jAna de duzamana ho jANa ate burAI de irAde nAla, ApaNe hatthAM te z2ubAnAM nAla, tuhAnUM kazaTa pacAuNa| uha cAhuMde hana ki kise tarhAM tusIM vI (hakka toM) munakara ho jAo|

tuhADIAM rizatedArIAM kiAmata dihAr3e tuhAnUM koI lAbha nahIM deNagIAM ate nA hI tuhADI aulAda kise kaMma AvegI| uha tuhADe vicAle faisalA kara devegA, allAhA tuhADIAM karanIAM nUM caMgI tarhAM vekhaNa vAlA hai|

tuhADe laI, ibarAhIma te usa de sAthI, ika sohaNA Adaraza hana| jadoM uhanAM ne ApaNI kauma nUM AkhiA sI ki asIM tuhAthoM te tuhADe uhanAM izaTAM toM jinhAM nUM tusIM allAha nUM chaDDa ke pUjA karade ho ukkA hI abAz2Ara hAM| asIM tuhADA inakAra karade hAM| sADe te tuhADe vicAle sadA laI vaira-virodha te IrakhA sapazaTa ho cukkI hai jadoM taka ki tusIM ikko ika allAha utte ImAna nahIM liAuMde| ibarAhIma dA ApaNe pio nUM iha kahiNA (Adaraza nahIM) ki maiM tuhADe laI ApaNe rabba toM khimA dI aradAsa karAMgA para maiM tuhADe laI (allAha valloM) koI adhikAra nahIM rakkhadA (ki merI aradAsa maMnI hI jAve)| (ibarAhIma ne benatI kItI ki) he sADe pAlaNahAra! asIM tere utte hI bharosA karade hAM ate tere valla hI bhao Ae hAM ate tere valla hI asIM parataNA hai|
he sADe rabba! tUM sAnUM uhanAM lokAM laI az2amAiza nA baNA jinhA ne (terA) inakAra kItA hai| tUM sADIAM bhullAM nUM muAfa karade| bezakka tUM hI vaDDA z2orAvara ate yukatImAna hai|

nirasaMdeha, uhanAM lokAM (de pUraniAM) vica tuhADe laI ate hara usa viakatI laI ika sohaNA Adaraza hai jihar3A allAha (nUM milaNa) ate aMtima dihAr3e (bhAva kiAmata) dI Asa rakkhadA hai| ate jihar3A koI hakka toM bemukkha ho jAve tAM allAha vaDDA beparavAha te zalAghA yoga hai|
ho sakadA hai ki allAha tuhADe te uhanAM lokAM vicAle mittaratA paidA kara deve jinhAM nAla ajja tuhADA vaira hai| allAha vaDDA kudarata vAlA hai ate allAha baqhazaNahAra te miharabAna hai|

allAha tuhAnUM uhanAM lokAM bAre nahIM rokadA, jihar3e dharama de mAmale vica tuhADe nAla nahIM lar3e ate nA hI uhanAM ne tuhAnUM tuhADe gharAM viccoM kaDDhiA hai, ki tusIM uhanAM nAla bhalAI karo te uhanAM nAla inasAfa karo| bezakka allAha inasAfa karana vAliAM nUM pasaMda karadA hai|

allAha tuhAnUM kevala uhanAM lokAM nAla dosatI karana toM rokadA hai jihar3e dharama de mAmale vica tuhADe nAla lar3e, tuhAnUM tuhADe gharAM ’coM kaDDhiA, ate tuhADe deza-nikAle vica sahAI baNe| jihar3A koI ihanAM nAla dosatI karegA uhIo z2Alama hai|

he ImAna vAlio! jadoM tuhADe kola momina bIbIAM hijarata karake AuNa tAM tusIM uhanAM (de momina hoNa) dI jAMca-par3atAla kara liA karo| allAha uhanAM de ImAna nUM caMgI tarhAM jANadA hai| phera je tuhAnUM tasallI ho jAve ki uha ImAna vAlIAM hI hana phera uhanAM nUM kAfirAM valla vApasa nA bhejo, kiuM jo huNa nA uha (momina auratAM) ihanAM kAfirAM laI halAla (jAiz2a) hana ate nA hI uha kAfira ihanAM laI halAla hana| tusIM uhanAM kAfirAM nUM jo uhanAM ne (mahira Adi) qharaca kItA hai uhanAM nUM mor3a dio| je tusIM uhanAM nUM mahira [2] de ke uhanAM nAla nikAha kara lavo tAM tuhADe utte koI pApa nahIM| tusIM kAfira auratAM nUM ApaNe kabaz2e vica nA rakkho, jo tusIM uhanAM (kAfira auratAM) ’te qharaca kItA hai uha vApasa maMga lao ate jihar3A qharaca uhanAM kAfirAM ne (musalamAna auratAM) utte) kItA hai uha vI maMga laiNa| iha allAha dA hukama hai uha tuhADe vicAle niA puravaka faisalA karadA hai| allAha bhalI-bhAMta jANana vAlA ate yukatImAna hai|
translations.footnotes: [2] mahira toM bhAva viAha sameM lAr3e valloM lAr3I nUM dittI jANa vAlI koI dhana-rAzI jA koI cIz2a ru iha aurata dA z2arUrI hakka hai ate usa nUM adA karana laI vizeza hukama hai| mahira AdamI dI himmata anusAra hoNI cAhIdI hai isa vica loka vikhAvA laI mahira dI vaDDI-vaDDI rAzI nUM nA-pasaMda kItA giA hai himmata rakkhade hoe vI nA mAtara mahira vI zarIata de rUha de viruddha hai|

translations.translation: je tuhADIAM patanIAM vicoM koI (tuhAthoM aDDa ho ke) kAfirAM kola calIAM jANa (ate tuhAnUM kItA hoiA qharaca nA mile) tAM tusIM (kAfirAM nAla) lar3o| (tAMjo g2anImata hattha lagge) jinhAM dIAM patanIAM calIAM gaIAM sana uhanAM nUM uhanAM nUM usa (mahira) de barAbara dio jo uhanAM ne qharaca kItA hai| tusIM allAha toM Daro jisa utte tuhADA ImAna hai|

he nabI! jadoM momina isatarIAM tuhADe kola baiata (praNa) karana laI AuNa ki uha allAha de nAla kise nUM zarIka nahIM baNAuNagIAM, nA corI karanagIAM, nA z2anAM karanagIAM, nA ApaNI aulAda nUM katala karanagIAM, nA ApaNe hatthAM-pairAM de agge koI Uja ghar3ha ke liAuNagIAM ate nA kise bhale kaMma vica tuhADI nA-faramAnI karanagaIAM, phera tusIM uhanAM toM baiata lai lao ate uhanAM laI allAha toM khimA maMgo| bezakka allAha vaDDA baqhazaNahAra te miharAM karana vAlA hai|

he ImAna vAlio! tusIM usa kauma nAla mittaratA nA karo jinhAM utte allAha dI karopI hoI hai, jihar3e aMtima dihAr3e toM nirAza ho gae hana| jiveM kabarAM vica pae kAfira (mur3a jIvana) toM nirAza hana|
allAha dI tasabIha hara uha cIz2a karadI hai jihar3I akAzAM te dharatI vica hai| uha vaDDA z2orAvara ate yukatImAna hai|
he ImAna vAlio! tusIM uha galla kiuM Akhade ho jo tusIM karade nahIM?
allAha dIAM naz2arAM vica iha nArAz2a hoNa vAlI galla hai ki tusIM uha galla Akho jihar3I tusIM karade nahIM|
bezakka allAha uhanAM lokAM nUM pasaMda karadA hai jihar3e usa dI rAha vica paMkatIAM baMnha ke (bhAva ika juTTa ho ke) lar3ade hana [1] jiveM ki uha sikke vicca DhAlI hoI ika kaMdha hoNa|
translations.footnotes: [1] isa Aita vica rabba dI rAha vica lar3aNa vAliAM dI vaDiAI biAna kItI gaI hai| hadIsa vica vI allAha dI rAha vica jihAda karana vAliAM dI mahatattA dassI gaI hai, kise ne allAha de rasUla nUM pucchiA ki lokAM vica sabha toM uccA darajA kisa dA hai? allAha de rasUla (sa:) ne faramAiA, uha momina jihar3A allAha dI rAha vica jAna te mAla nAla jihAda kare, lokAM ne pucchiA phera koNa? Apa (sa:) ne faramAiA, uha musalamAna jihar3A kise pahAr3a dI khoha vica rahe, allAha toM DaradA hove ate lokAM toM aDDa rahi ke uhanAM nUM ApaNe zara (zarAratAM) toM surakkhiata rakkhe| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 2789)

translations.translation: jadoM mUsA ne ApaNI kauma nUM AkhiA ki he merI kauma! tusIM mainUM tasIhe kiuM diMde ho? jadoM ki tusIM bhalI-bhAMta jANade ho ki maiM tuhADe valla bhejiA hoiA allAha dA rasUla hAM| phera jadoM uhanAM ne TeDhapuNA iqhatiAra kara liA tAM allAha ne vI uhanAM de dila TeDhe kara ditte| allAha nA-faramAna lokAM nUM hidAita nahIM diMdA|

jadoM marIama de puttara IsA ne AkhiA ki he banI-isarAIla! bezakka maiM tuhADe valla allAha dA rasUla hAM, usa kitAba dI puzaTI karana vAlA hAM jihar3I maithoM pahilAM (tauraita) nAz2ila hoI hai| maiM ika rasUla dI qhuzaqhabarI deNa vAlA hAM, uha maithoM bAada AvegA te usa dA nAM ‘ahimada’ [2] hovegA, phera jadoM uha rasUla (bhAva haz2arata muhaMmada sa:) uhanAM kola khullhIAM nizAnIAM lai ke AiA tAM uha loka AkhaNa lagge, iha tAM khullhA jAdU hai|
translations.footnotes: [2] ‘ahimada’ nabI (sa:) dA dUjA nAM hai jisa dA aratha hai ajihA viakatI jihar3A dUjiAM de mukAbale vaddha toM vaddha allAha dI zalAghA kare| nabI (sa:) ne faramAiA, mere paMja nAM hana maiM muhaMmada, ahimada, mAhI, hAzara te Akiba hAM| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 3532)

translations.translation: bhalA usa viakatI toM vaDDA z2Alama kauNa hovegA jihar3A allAha utte jhUTha mar3he, hAlAM ki usa nUM allAha valla saddiA jAMdA hai? ate allAha z2Alama lokAM nUM hidAita nahIM diMdA|

uha (inakArI) tAM iho cAhuMde hana ki allAha de nUra (isalAma) nUM ApaNe mUMha dIAM phUkAM nAla bujhA deNa| jada ki allAha ApaNe nUra nUM pUrI tarhAM phailAuNa vAlA hai bhAveM kAfirAM nUM kiMnA hI nA-pasaMda hove|

uha (allAha) hai, jisa ne ApaNe rasUla nUM hidAita ate saccA dharama de ke bhejiA hai tAM jo uha usa nUM sAre dharamAM utte g2Aliba (bhArU) kara deve bhAveM ki muzarika isa nUM nA-pasaMda hI kiuM nA karana|
he ImAna vAlio! kI maiM tuhAnUM uha vapAra dassAM jo tuhAnUM dukhadAI az2Aba toM bacA deve?

tusIM allAha te usa de rasUla (muhaMmada) utte ImAna liAo te allAha dI rAha vica ApaNe dhaMna te ApaNIAM jAnAM nAla jihAda (saMgharaza) karo| iha tuhADe laI bahuta hI caMgA hai, je tusIM kujjha giAna rakkhade ho|

uha (allAha) tuhADe gunAhAM nUM baqhaza devegA ate tuhAnUM uhanAM jaMnatAM vica dAqhala karegA jinhAM heTha nahirAM vagadIAM hana| sadIvI rahiNa vAlIAM jaMnatAM vica pavittara mahila hana, iho vaDDI safalatA hai|
ate ika hora niamata jisa nUM tusIM pasaMda karade ho uha allAha dI madada ate nikaTa vica ho jANa vAlI fatiha hai, isa dI qhuzaqhabarI ImAna vAliAM nUM suNA dio|

he ImAna vAlio! tusIM allAha de sahAI baNa jAo, jiveM marIama de puttara IsA ne ApaNe havArIAM nUM AkhiA sI ki allAha dI rAha valla (saddA deNa vica) merA sahAI kauauNa hai? havArIAM (sAthIAM) ne AkhiA ki asIM allAha de sahAI hAM| banI-isarAIla viccoM ika TolI ImAna liAI ate dUjI TolI ne inakAra kara dittA| asIM ImAna liAuNa vAle lokAM nUM uhanAM de vairIAM viruddha tAkata baqhazI tAM uha bhArUu[3] ho gae|
translations.footnotes: [3] iha viAkhaNa usa sameM dA hai jadoM haz2arata IsA nabI baNa ke banI-isarAIla valla ghalle gae sI, phera Apa nUM jiUMdA akAza utte cukka liA giA ate kiAmata de ner3e Apa mur3a dharatI utte virAjamAna hoNage| usa sameM Apa nabI karIma (sa:) de ika ummatI vajoM hoNage, para allAha Apa (IsA) jI toM vaDDe-vaDDe kaMma lavegA ate Apa rAhIM IsAIata dA aMta karegA ate isalAma hI gAliba hovegA| allAha de rasUla (sa:) ne faramAiA, kasama hai usa z2Ata dI jisa de kabaz2e vica merI jAna hai, tuhADe vica chetI hI marIama dA puttara IsA uttaregA uha niA pUrabaka hakUmata karege ate zalIba nUM tor3egA, ate jaz2IA laiNA baMda kara devege ate dhana-daulata iMnI hovegI ki koI usa nUM laiNa vAlA nahIM hovegA| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa 2222) ● bhAva musalamAnAM de AgU baNa ke AuNage ate IsAIAM laI, jihar3e ApaNe ApanUM haz2arata IsA dA pairokAra kahiMde hana uhanAM nUM saqhata citAvanI hai ki uha salIba tor3a deNage, jaz2IA laiNA baMda kara deNage dA aratha hai ki sAre de sAre manukkha isalAma kabUla kara laiNage, isa toM chuTTa hora koI rAha vI nahIM hovegA|

translations.translation: jihar3I vI koI cIz2a akAzAM te dharatI vica hai uha sabha allAha dI tasabIha (pavittaratA dA varaNana) karadI hai| uha pAtazAha hai, pAka z2Ata hai, z2orAvara te yukatImAna hai|

uhI hai jisa ne aNapar3hAM vicca ika rasUla bhejiA jihar3A uhanAM viccoM hI sI| uha uhanAM nUM usa dIAM (bhAva.kuraAna dIAM) AitAM suNAuMdA hai| uhanAM dA jIvana suAradA hai ate uhanAM nUM kitAba (bhAva਼kuraAna) te hikamata (yukatI) dI sikkhiA diMdA hai, jadoM ki isa toM pahilAM uha sapazaTa kurAhe pae hoe sana|
iha rasUla uhanAM dUje lokAM laI vI bhejiA giA hai jihar3e aje taka uhanAM nUM nahIM mile| uha (allAha) z2orAvara te vaDDA yukatImAna hai|
iha allAha dI kripA hai ki uha jisa nUM cAhuMdA hai ApaNI kripA nAla nivAz2a diMdA hai, uha vaDDe faz2alAM vAlA hai|

uhanAM lokAM dI udAharana, jinhAM nUM tauraita dA cukkaNahAra baNAiA giA sI, para uha usa de bhAra nUM cukka nA sake, usa gadhe vAMga hai jihar3A kitAbAM dA bojha cukkadA hai (para par3hadA nahIM)| isa toM vI bhair3I udAharana usa kauma dI hai jinhAM ne allAha dIAM AitAM (AdezAM) nUM jhuThalA dittA hai, ajihe z2AlamAM nUM allAha hidAita nahIM diMdA|

(he nabI!) tusIM Akha dio ki he yahUdI baNa jANa vAle loko! je tusIM isa galla dA mAna karade ho ki bAkI sAriAM lokAM nUM chaDDa ke kevala tusIM hI allAha de dosata ho tAM ratA mauta dI icchA tAM karo je tusIM (ApaNI katthaNI vica) sacce ho|
uha kade vI iha icchA nahIM karanage, kiuM jo uha ApaNIAM bhair3IAM karatUtAM ApaNe hatthI agge bheja cukke hana| allAha z2AlamAM nUM caMgI tarhAM jANadA hai|

ihanAM nUM Akho ki jisa mauta toM tusIM nassade ho uha z2arUra hI tuhAnUM milaNa vAlI hai| tusIM use valla paratAe jAvoge jihar3A gupata ate pragaTa dA jANanahAra hai| uha tuhAnUM dassegA jo tusIM (saMsAra vica) karade sI|

he ImAna vAlio! jadoM jume (zukkaravAra) de dihAr3e namAz2a laI az2Ana dittI jAve tAM tusIM allAha de z2ikara (bhAva namAz2a laI masIta valla) nasso ate qharIda-veca (vapAra) karanA chaDDa dio| iho tuhADe laI vadhere caMgA hai je tusIM jANade ho|
jadoM namAz2a pUrI ho jAve phera tusIM dharatI utte khilara jAo ate allAha de faz2alAM (roz2I) dI bhAla karo allAha nUM vaddha toM vaddha yAda karo, zAida ki tusIM safalatA nUM prApata kara sako|

(he nabI!) jadoM uha koI vapAra jAM koI kheDa-tamAzA huMdA vekhade hana tAM usa valla nassa jAMde hana ate tuhAnUM ikallA khalotiAM chaDDa jAMde hana, tusIM Akha dio ki jo kujjha vI allAha kola hai uha ihanAM kheDa-tamAziAM toM ate vapAra toM kite vadhIA hai ate allAha sAriAM toM vadhIA roz2I deNa vAlA hai|

(he nabI!) jadoM munAfika (bhAva dogale) tuhADe kola AuMde hana tAM Akhade hana ki asIM gavAhI diMde hAM ki bezakka tusIM allAha de paigabaMra ho ate allAha gavAhI diMdA hai ki iha munAfika jhUThe hana|
uhanAM (munAfikAM) ne ApaNIAM kasamAM nUM DhAla baNA rakkhiA hai, isa tarhAM uha lokAM nUM allAha dI rAha toM rokade hana| bezakka uha jo vI karade hana bahuta hI bhair3A amala karade hana|
bhAveM ki uha ImAna liAe para phera vI uhanAM ne inakAra hI kItA ise laI allAha ne uhanAM de dilAM utte mohara lA chaDDI hai, uha samajhade nahIM|

jadoM tusIM uhanAM nUM vekhoge tAM tuhAnUM uhanAM de sarIra (jusse) bhale caMge lagade hana| je uha koI galla AkhaNa tAM tusIM uhanAM dIAM gallAM kaMna lA ke suNo (para hakIkata vica) uha iMja hana jiveM ki uha kaMdha nAla cina ke rakkhiAM hoIAM lakar3IAM hoNa| uha hara uccI AvAz2a nUM iho samajhade hana ki uhanAM utte (koI bipatA A khar3I) hai, uhIo tuhADe asalI duzamana hana| so tusIM uhanAM toM sAvadhAna raho, allAha uhanAM nUM halAka kare, uha kitthe phirIM jA rahe hana?

jadoM uhanAM nUM AkhiA jAMdA hai ki Ao tAM jo rasUla tuhADe laI (allAha toM) baqhaziza dI duA kare tAM uha (inakAra vica) sira hilAuMde hana| tusIM uhanAM nUM vekhade ho ki uha haMkAra vica Ake rasUla kola AuNa toM ruka jAMde hana|
he nabI! tusIM bhAveM uhanAM laI muAfI maMgo bhAveM nA maMgo uhanAM laI ika barAbara hai, allAha uhanAM nUM kade vI muAfa nahIM karegA| bezakka allAha nA-faramAna kauma nUM hidAita nahIM diMdA|[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] vekho sUrata ana-nisA, hAzIA Aita 138,145/4

translations.translation: iha uhIo hana jihar3e iha Akhade hana ki jo loka allAha de rasUla de nAla rahiMde hana tusIM uhanAM (mahAjarAM) utte qharaca nA karo tAM jo uha (madIne ’coM) nassa jANa| jadoM ki akAzAM ate dharatI de sAre qhaz2Ane allAha de hI hana, para munAfika iha galla nahIM samajhade|

uha iha vI Akhade hana ki je asIM mur3a madIne vikhe gae tAM jihar3e patavaMte hana uha hINe lokAM nUM uthiੱoM kaDDha deNage, jada ki Adara-mAna tAM allAha, usa de rasUla te mominAM laI hai, praMtU munAfika loka isa saccAI nUM nahIM jANade|
he ImAna vAlio! tuhADe mAla ate tuhADI saMtAna tuhAnUM allAha dI yAda toM gAfila nA kara deve| jihar3A koI ajihA karegA uhIo ghATe vica rahiNa vAlA hai|

ate jo asIM tuhAnUM roz2I dittI hai tusIM usa viccoM isa toM pahilAM pahilAM (allAha dI rAha vica) qharaca karo ki tuhADe viccoM kise nUM mauta A jAveM phera uha Akhe ki he mere rabba! mainUM kujjha sameM dI mohalata kiuM nahIM dittI ki maiM sadakA (puMna-dAna) karadA ate maiM vI neka lokAM viccoM ho jAMdA| [2]
translations.footnotes: [2] vekho sUrata Ale-imarAna, hAzIA Aita 180/3 ate sUrata ana-nisA, hAzIA Aita 37/4

translations.translation: jadoM usa dI mauta dA samAM A jAvegA phera allAha kade vI kise nUM mohalata nahIM devegA| tusIM jo kujjha vI amala karade ho allAha usa dI qhabara rakkhadA hai|

hara uha cIz2a jihar3I vI akAzAM te dharatI vica hai allAha dI hI tasabIha (pavittaratA varaNana) karadI hai| pAtazAhI vI use laI hai ate hara prakAra dI prazaMsA vI use laI hai, hareka cIz2a usa de kAbU heTha hai|
uhIo hai jisa ne tuhAnUM sAjiA phera tuhADe viccoM koI inakArI hai te koI ImAna vAlA hai| tusIM jo kujjha vI karade ho allAha usa nUM caMgI tarhAM vekhadA hai|
use ne akAza te dharatI nUM hakka (bhAva inasAfa) nAla sAjiA ate tuhADIAM zakalAM-sUratA baNAIAM ate tuhAnUM bahuta hI sohaNIAM sUratA baqhazIAM ate tusIM sabha ne use valla parataNA hai|
jo kujjha vI akAzAM te dharatI vica hai uha sabha jANadA hai ate (uha vI jANadA hai) jo tusIM lakoMde ho ate pragaTa karade ho| allAha dilAM de bhetAM nUM bhalI-bhAMta jANadA hai|
kI tuhAnUM uhanAM lokAM dI qhabara nahIM jinhAM ne isa toM pahilAM inakAra kItA sI? phera uhanAM ne ApaNIAM karatUtAM dA suAda cakhiA, uhanAM laI dukhadAI az2Aba hai|

iha (saz2A) isa laI hai ki jadoM uhanAM de rasUla uhanAM kola (rasUla hoNa dIAM) khullhIAM nizAnIAM liAuMde tAM uha (inakArI) Akhade ki kI sA` manukkha rAha vikhAuNage? iMja uhanAM ne inakAra kItA ate hakka sacca toM mUMha mor3a liA, phera allAha vI uhanAM toM be-paravAha ho giA| allAha bahuta hI be-paravAha hai ate uhIo zalAghA yoga hai|

inakArIAM dA dAavA iha hai ki uhanAM nUUM (kabarAM viccoM) kade vI (jiUMdA) uThAiA nahIM jAvegA| (he nabI!) Akha dio, kiuM nahIM, mere rabba dI suMha tuhAnUM z2arUra uThAiA jAvegA, phera tuhAnUM dassiA jAvegA jo tusIM (saMsAra vica) karade sI| iha kaMma karanA allAha laI bahuta hI saukhA hai|
tusIM allAha, usa de rasUla ate usa nUra (.kuraAna) utte ImAna liAo jihar3A asIM tuhADe ’te utAriA hai| allAha hara usa kaMma nUM caMgI tarhAM jANadA hai jo tusIM karade ho|

jadoM uha (allAha) tuhAnUM ikattara hoNa vAle dina ikattara karegA, uha hAra jitta vAlA dina hovegA ate jihar3A koI allAha ’te ImAna liAe te neka kaMma kare tAM allAha usa toM usa dIAM burAIAM dUra kara devegA ate usa nUM jaMnata vica dAqhala karegA jisa de heTha nahirAM vagadIAM hoNagIAM ate uha usa vica sadA rahegA, iho sabha toM vaDDI kAmayAbI hai|
jinhAM lokAM ne inakAra kItA ate sADIAM AitAM (bhAva AdezAM) nUM nahIM maMniA uha sabha narakI hana ate sadA use vica hI rahiNage,[1] uha bahuta hI bhair3A sathAna hai|
translations.footnotes: [1]| vekho sUrata Ale-imarAna, hAzIA Aita 85/3

translations.translation: jihar3I vI koI bipatA AuMdI hai uha allAha de hukama nAla hI AuMdI hai| je koI allAha ’te ImAna liAe tAM uha usa de mana nUM hidAita diMdA hai| allAha hara cIz2a nUM jANadA hai|
tusIM allAha ate usa de rasUla de hukamAM dI pAlaNA karo| je tusIM hakka toM mUMha mor3oMge tAM sADe rasUla dA kaMma tAM kevala AdezAM nUM sapazaTa karake pahuMcA deNA hai|
allAha uha hai jisa toM chuTTa koI (saccA) izaTa nahIM ate ImAna vAliAM nUM cAhIdA hai ki use ’te hI bharosA karana|

he ImAna vAlio! bezakka tuhADIAM patanIAM ate tuhADI aulAda viccoM kujjha tuhADe duzamana hana, so tusIM uhanAM toM baco, je muAfa kara dio ate (bhullAM dI) aNadekhI kara dio ate khimAM baqhazo tAM bezakka allAha baqhazaNahAra te miharabAna hai|
bezakka tuhADe mAla ate tuhADI aulAda tAM ikka fitanA (az2amAiza) hai ate vaDDA badalA tAM allAha kola hai|

so jitthe taka ho sake tusIM allAha toM Daro, (allAha de hukamAM nUM) dhiAna nAla suNo ate pAlaNA karo ate (allAha dI rAha vica) qharaca karo, tuhADe laI iho vadhIA galla hai| jisa ne ApaNe Apa nUM lAlacI hoNa toM bacA liA uhIo loka safalatA prApata karana vAle hana|

je tusIM allAha nUM karaz2a dio tAM karaz2e hasanA (sohaNA karaz2a) dio, tAM uha tuhAnUM kaI guNA vadhA ke mor3a devegA ate tuhADIAM bhullAM nUM baqhaza devegA| allAha tuhADI kadara karana vAlA hai ate bahuta hI naramAI vAlA hai|
uha g2aiba ate z2Ahira dA giAna rakkhaNa vAlA hai, uha vaDDA z2orAvara te yukatImAna hai|

he nabI! jadoM vI tusIM isatarIAM (patanIAM) nUM talAka dio tAM uhanAM nUM uhanAM dI iddata (de AraMbhika dinAM) vica hI talAka dio ate iddata (de dinAM) dI giNatI rakkho|[1] allAha toM Daro jo tuhADA pAlaNahAra hai| iddata de dinAM vica nA tusIM uhanAM nUM uhanAM de gharoM kaDDho ate nA hI uha Apa nikalaNa, para je uha koI pratakkha burAI kara baiThaNa (tAM kaDDha sakade ho) iha haddAM allAha dIAM niyata kItIAM hoIAM hana| jihar3A koI allAha dIAM haddAM dI ulaMghaNA karegA uha ApaNe ’te Apa z2ulama karegA| (he loko!) tusIM nahIM jANade ki isa (talAka) toM magaroM allAha (mela milApa dI) koI navIM rAha kaDDha deve||
translations.footnotes: [1] “iddata de sameM vica talAka dio” toM bhAva hai ki iddata de AraMbha vica bhAva jadoM auaurata mAhavArI toM pAka ho jAve tAM usa nAla saMbhoga kare binAM talAka dio, pAkI dI hAlata isa dI iddata dA AraMbha hai| hadIsa vica hai ki abadulA bina umara ne nabI (sa:) de sameM vica ApaNI patanI AmanA binata guffAra nUM mAhavArI de dinAM vica hI talAka de dittI, haz2arata umara ne isa saMbaMdha vica nabI= karIma (sa:) nUM pucchiA tAM Apa (sa:) ne faramAiA, ApaNe puttara nUM kaho ki uha parata jAve ate isa auaurata nUM mAhavArI toM pAka hoNa taka ApaNe kola rahiNa dio itthoM taka ki usa nUM mur3a mAhavArI A jAve, phera uha mAhavArI toM pAka hove phera usa nUM adhikAra ru ki je uha usa nUM rakkhaNA cAhe tAM rakkha lave je talAka deNA cAhave tAM saMbhoga toM pahilAM talAka deve ate iho iddata hai jisa nUM allAha ne niyata kItA hai ki auauratAM nUM uhanAM dI iddata vica hI talAka dio| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 5251)

translations.translation: phera jadoM uha ApaNI iddata (dI samApatI) nUM pujja jANa tAM uhanAM nUM jAM tAM bhale tarIke nAla (ApaNe nikAha vica) roka lavo jAM uhanAM nUM bhale tarIke nAla chaDDa dio| jadoM talAka dio tAM tusIM ApaNe viccoM do viakatIAM nUM gavAha baNA lao, jihar3e niAkAra hoNa ate gavAhI nUM allAha vAsate kAima rakkhaNa| ihanAM hukamAM dI nasIhata usa nUM kItI jAMdI hai jihar3A koI allAha te aMtima dihAr3e (kiAmata) utte ImAna rakkhadA hai ate jihar3A viakatI allAha toM DaradA hove tAM uha (allAha) usa laI aukar3AM viccoM nikalaNa dI rAha kaDDha diMdA hai|

uha usa nUM utthioM riz2aka diMdA hai jitthio usa dA citta cetA vI nahIM huMdA| jihar3A viakatI allAha ’te bharosA kare tAM usa laI uhIo kAfI hai| bezakka allAha ApaNA kaMma pUrA karake rahiMdA hai| allAha ne hareka cIz2a laI ika takadIra niyata kara chaDDI hai|

tuhADIAM (talAka zudA) isatarIAM viccoM jihar3IAM mAsaka dharama toM beAsa ho jANa je tuhAnUM uhanAM bAre koI zakka ho rihA hove tAM uhanAM dI iddata tiMna mahIne hai ate iho hukama uhanAM laI hai vI jinhAM nUM ajihe ruz2a (mAsaka dharama) nahIM AiA| garabhavatI isatarIAM dI iddata dI hadda baccA jaNana taka hai| jihar3A viakatI allAha toM DaradA hai tAM uha usa de kaMmAM vica AsAnIAM paidA kara diMdA hai|[2]
translations.footnotes: [2] vekho sUrata ala-bakaraha, hAzIA Aita 234/2

translations.translation: iha allAha dA hukama hai jihar3A usa ne tuhADe valla utAriA hai, jihar3A viakatI allAha toM DaradA hai tAM allAha usa dIAM burAIAM nUM usa toM dUra kara diMdA hai te usa de badale vica hora vAdhA kara diMdA hai|

tusIM (iddata de sameM vica) uhanAM nUM usa thAM rakkho jitthe tusIM Apa rahiMde ho jiho jihI thAM tuhAnUM jur3adI hove| uhanAM nUM taMga karana laI uhanAM nUM koI kazaTa nA dio| je uha garabhavatIAM hoNa tAM baccA jaNana taka uhanAM ’te qharaca karo, phera je uha tuhADe bacce nUM ApaNA duddha piAuNa tAM tusIM uhanAM nUM usa dI ujarata dio ate iha ujarata bhale tarIke nAla ApasI salAha mazavare rAhIM taia karo| je tusIM ApasI z2ida bAz2I karo tAM usa nUM koI dUjI isatarI ApaNA duddha pilAegI|

qhuzahAla viakatI nUM cAhIdA hai ki ApaNI rusIata anusAra qharacA kare ate jisa dI roz2I vica taMgI hove tAM uha use viccoM qharaca kare jihar3A allAha ne usa nUM dittA hai| allAha kise vI viakatI utte unnI hI z2iMmevArI pAuMdA hai jinnA kujjha usa nUM dittA hai| allAha taMgI toM bAada chetI hI khullha devegA|
kiMnIAM hI basatIAM hana jinhAM ne ApaNe rabba te usa de rasUlAM de hukamAM toM sarakazI kItI tAM asIM uhanAM dA lekhA-jokhA liA ate uhanAM nUM karar3I saz2A dittI|
aMta uhanAM basatIAM vAliAM ne ApaNIAM karatUtAM dA suAda vekha liA ate uhanAM dIAM karatUtAM dA aMta ghATA hI ghATA hai|
allAha ne (paraloka vica) uhanAM laI karar3A az2Aba tiAra kara chaDDiA hai| he akala vAlio! je tusIM ImAna liAe ho tAM allAha toM Daro| allAha ne tuhADe valla z2ikara (.kuraAna) utAriA hai|

ate ika ajihA rasUla bhejiA hai jihar3A tuhAnUM allAha dIAM sapazaTa AitAM (Adeza) suNAuMdA hai tAM jo uhanAM lokAM nUM, jihar3e ImAna liAuNa te caMge kaMma karana, haneriAM viccoM rauzanI valla kaDDha liAve| jihar3A viakatI allAha utte ImAna liAve ate neka kaMma kare uha (allAha) usa viakatI nUM uhanAM jaMnatAM vica dAqhala karegA jinhAM de heTha nahirAM vagadIAM hoNagIAM uha usa vica sadA laI rahiNage| allAha ne ajihe viakatIAM laI sohaNA riz2aka rakkhiA hoiA hai|

allAha uha z2Ata hai jisa ne satta akAza sAje te dharatIAM vI oMnIAM hI (bhAva satta) sAjIAM| ihanAM dovAM vicAle hI usa dA hukama uttaradA hai iha galla tAM tuhAnUM isa laI dassI gaI hai tAM jo tusIM jANa lavo ki nirasaMdeha, allAha hara cIz2a dI samarathA rakkhadA hai| allAha ne hareka cIz2a nUM ApaNe giAna de ghere vica lai chaDDiA hai|

he nabI! tusIM (usa cIz2a nUM) kiuM harAma (nA-jAiz2a) karade ho jihar3I allAha ne tuhADe laI halAla (jAiz2a) kItI hai? kI tusIM ApaNIAM patanIAM dI qhuzI cAhuMde ho| allAha baqhazaNahAra ate miharabAna hai|
allAha ne tuhADe laI tuhADIAM (nA-jAiz2a saMhuAM) nUM tor3aNA faraz2a kara dittA hai| allAha tuhADA maulA hai, uha vaDDA jANanahAra te yukatImAna hai|

jadoM nabI (sa:) ne ApaNI kise patanI nUM ika galla malakar3e jihe AkhI para jadoM use patanI ne (uhIo gala dUjI patanI nUM) dassa dittI tAM allAha ne usa (vAratAlApa) toM isa (nabI) nUM sUcita kara dittI, tAM nabI ne (dUjI patanI) nUM kujjha hadda taka gallAM dassa vI dittIAM ate kujjha TAla dittA| phera jadoM nabI ne usa (pahilI patanI) nUM uha sArI galla suNAI tAM uha pucchaNa laggI, tuhAnUM iha sabha kisa ne dassiA hai? usa (nabI) ne pharamAiA, mainUM iha sArI jANakArI sabha kujjha jANana vAle te qhabara rakkhaNa vAle allAha ne dittI hai|

kiuM jo tuhADe dila saccAI toM haTa gae hana so tusIM doveM (patanIAM) allAha toM taubA kara lavo tAM tuhADe laI vadhIA hai| je tusIM isa (nabI) de viruddha ekA kItA tAM allAha Apa hI usa dI sahAitA karegA, ate jibarAIla, neka momina te ihanAM de nAla-nAla sAre farizate vI usa de sahAI hana|

je uha (nabI) tuhAnUM talAka de deve tAM ho sakadA hai ki badale vica usa dA rabba usa nUM tuhAthoM caMgIAM patanIAM de deve| uha musalamAna, momina, AgiAkArI, taubA karana vAlIAM, baMdagI karana vAlIAM, roz2A rakkhaNa vAlIAM, uha pahilAM viAhIAM hoIAM (bhAva vidhavA), jAM kuArIAM hoNagIAM|

he ImAna vAlio! tusIM ApaNe Apa nUM te ApaNe ghara vAliAM nUM usa agga toM bacAo jisa dA bAlaNa (kufara karana vAle) manukkha te (pUje gae) patthara hana| isa (naraka utte) ati kharave subhA vAle te kaThora-citta farizate (niyukata) hana| allAha uhanAM nUM jihar3A hukama deve uha usa dI nA-faramAnI nahIM karade| ate jo uhanAM nUM hukama dittA jAMdA hai uha use dI pAlaNA karade hana|
he kAfiro! ajja tusIM koI bahAnA nA ghar3ho| bezakka ajja tuhAnUM usa dA badalA dittA jAvegA jo tusIM karade sI|[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] vekho sUrata Ale-imarAna, hAzIA Aita 85/3

translations.translation: he ImAna vAlio! tusIM allAha dI haz2UrI vica qhAlisa (sacce mano) taubA karo, Asa hai ki tuhADA rabba tuhAthoM tuhADIAM burAIAM dUra kara deve ate tuhAnUM uhanAM jaMnatAM vica dAqhala kare jisa de heTha nahirAM vagadIAM hana | [2] usa (kiAmata) dihAr3e allAha nabI nUM ate usa de nAla ImAna liAuNa vAliAM nUM z2alIla nahIM karegA| uhanAM dA nUra uhanAM de agge-agge te sajje pAse nassa rihA hovegA| uha AkhaNage ki he sADe rabbA! tUM sADe nUra nUM sADe laI saMpUrana karade ate sADI baqhaziza kara, bezakka tUM hara cIz2a dI samarathA rakkhadA hai|
translations.footnotes: [2] allAha de rasUla ne faramAiA ki kiAmata dihAr3e pAlaNahAra ApaNI piMnI kholegA tAM sAre momina marada te auratAM sijade vica Diga paiNage, para uha loka rahi jANage jihar3e saMsAra vica loka vikhAve laI te neka akhavAuNa laI ibAdata karade sana, uha vI sijadA karanA cAhuNage para uhanAM dIAM piTThAM Akar3a jANagIAM so uha sijadA nA kara sakaNage| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 4919)

translations.translation: (he nabI!) kAfirAM te munAfikAM nAla jihAda (saMgharaza) karo ate uhanAM utte karar3AI karo| uhanAM dA TikANA naraka hai jihar3A ki bahuta hI bhair3A TikANA hai|

inakAra karana vAliAM laI allAha ne nUha ate lUta dIAM patanIAM dI udAharana dittI hai| uha doveM sADe neka baMdiAM de nikAha vica sana| para uhanAM dovAM ne ApaNe patIAM nAla vizavAsaghAta kItA, phera uha doveM rasUla uhanAM dovAM (auratAM) nUM (az2Aba toM) bacAuNa vica kujjha vI kaMma nA A sake ate uhanAM nUM kihA giA ki tusIM doveM vI naraka vica dAqhala hoNa vAliAM vica dAqhala ho jAo|

allAha ne ImAna vAliAM laI firaauna dI patanI dI udAharana dittI hai,[3] jadoM usa ne benatI kItI ki he mere rabba! mere laI ApaNe kola jaMnata vica ika ghara baNA ate mainUM firaauna ate usa de amalAM toM bacA lai te mainUM z2Alama kauma toM chuTakArA duAde|
translations.footnotes: [3] firaauna dI patanI dA nAM AsIA sI, uha ika pAka-pavittara momina aurata sI ise laI hadIsa vica isa dI zalAghA kItI gaI hai| so nabI karIma (sa:) ne pharamAiA, purazAM vica tAM bahuta sAre pahuMce hoe loka hoe hana para auratAM vica AsIA firaauna dI patanI ate marIama imarAna dI dhI hI kamAla nUM pahuMcIAM ate haz2arata AizA dI mahattatA ihanAM sabha ’te iMja hai jiveM sarIda dA dUjIAM khANa vAlIAM cIz2AM ’te| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 3411)

translations.translation: ate udAharana imarAna dI saputtarI marIama dI vI hai jisa ne ApaNI iz2z2ata AbarU dI rAkhI kItI, phera asIM usa de (galAMve) aMdara ApaNI rUha phUMka dittI ate usa ne ApaNe rabba de bolAM dI ate usa dIAM kitAbAM dI puzaTI kItI ate uha AgiAkArIAM viccoM sI|
uha z2Ata (allAha dI) atiaMta barakatAM vAlI hai jisa de hattha vica (kulla jahAna dI) pAtazAhI hai ate harake cIz2a usa de kAbU vica hai|
uha jisa ne mauta ate jIvana nUM sAjiA hai tAM jo tuhAnUM parakhe ki tuhADe viccoM vadhere caMge kaMma kauNa karadA hai|[1] uha vaDDA z2orAvara hai te baqhazaNahAra vI hai|
translations.footnotes: [1] bhAva tuhADe viccoM vadhIA te caMge DhaMga nAla neka amala kauNa karadA hai jo ki kevala allAha dI raz2A laI te haz2arata muhaMmada (sa:) dI sunnata anusAra hoNa?

translations.translation: uha jisa ne uppara-thalle satta akAza baNAe| (he inasAna!) tUM rahimAna (bhAva allAha miharabAna) dI racanA vica kise tarhAM dA koI asAMvApaNa nahIM vekhegA| phera vekha kI tUM koI tarer3a vekhadA hai?
mur3a-mur3a nigAha daur3A, terI nigAha thakka hAra ke te asafala ho ke parata AvegI|

nirasaMdeha, asIM saMsAra vica (disaNa vAle) akAza nUM carAg2AM (bhAva tAriAM) nAla sajAiA hai ate ihanAM (tAriAM) nUM zaitAnAM nUM mAra bhajAuNa dA sAdhana baNAiA hai [2] ate asIM ihanAM zaitAnAM laI bhar3akadI hoI agga tiAra kara chaDDI hai|
translations.footnotes: [2] vekho sUrata ala-anAma, hAzIA Aita 97/6

translations.translation: jihanAM lokAM ne ApaNe rabba dA inakAra kItA hai, uhanAM laI naraka dA az2Aba hai ate uha bahuta hI bhair3A TikANA hai|
jadoM uhanAM nUM usa vica suTTiA jAvegA tAM uha usa dIAM dahAr3AM suNanage ate uha joza khA rahI hovegI|
ho sakadA hai ki uha karopI de z2ora vica paTa hI jAve| jadoM vI koI TolI usa vica suTTI jAvegI tAM (naraka de) pahiredAra uhanAM toM pucchaNage, kI tuhADe kola koI DarAuNa vAlA nahIM AiA sI?
uha AkhaNage ki kiuM nahIM? DarAuNa vAlA sADe kola AiA tAM sI, para asIM usa nUM jhuThalAiA ate AkhiA ki allAha ne kise utte kujjha vI nahIM utAriA| tusIM tAM vaDDI gumarAhI vica phase hoe ho|
uha (inakArI kiAmata dihAr3e) AkhaNage ki kAza asIM (rasUla dIAM gallAM nUM dhiAna nAla) suNade jAM samajhade tAM ajja asIM narakIAM viccoM nA huMde|
isa tarhAM uha ApaNe aparAdhAM nUM Apa maMna laiNage, so uhanAM narakIAM utte phiTakAra hai|
jihar3e loka ApaNe pAlaNahAra toM binAM vekhiAM Darade hana uhanAM laI baqhaziza te vaDDe badale hana|
tusIM ApaNI galla bhAveM lukA ke Akho jAM AvAz2a nAla Akho| bezakka uha dilAM de bheta jANadA hai|
kI uha nahIM jANegA jisa ne sabha nUM paidA kItA hai? uha vaDDA sUkhamadarazI hai te hara prakAra dI qhabara rakkhadA hai|
uhIo hai jisa ne dharatI nUM tuhADe adhIna kara chaDDiA hai| so tusIM usa dIAM rAhAM utte calade hoe usa de riz2aka viccoM khAo| tusIM use valla mur3a surajIta ho ke jANA hai|
kI tusIM usa (allAha) toM be-qhaufa ho gae ho, jihar3A akAza vica hai ki uha tuhAnUM dharatI vica dhasA deve ate acaNaceta iha (dharatI) kaMbaNa laga jAve?
kI tusIM usa allAha toM nizaciMta ho gae ho jihar3A akAza vica hai ki uha tuhADe utte patharAo karana vAlI tez2a havA bheja deve? phera tuhAnUM patA laggegA ki merA DarAuNA kiho jihA huMdA hai|
bezakka jihar3e ihanAM toM pahilAM bIta cukke hana, uha vI (paig2aMbarAM nUM) jhuThalA cukke hana, phera vekha lao ki merA az2Aba kiho jihA sI|
kI uhanAM (inakArIAM) ne ApaNe utte uDDaNa vAle paMchIAM de khaMbha khilare hoe te sukar3e hoe nahIM vekhe| uhanAM nUM allAha toM chuTTa koI nahIM thaMmadA| bezakka uha hara cIz2a nUM vekhadA hai|
bhalA uha kauNa hai jihar3A tuhADI sainA baNa ke, chuTTa rahimAna toM, tuhADI sahAitA kare? inakArI tAM ukkA hI dhokhe vica phase hoe hana|
je rahimAna ApaNA riz2aka roka lave phera bhalA uha kihar3A hai jihar3A tuhAnUM riz2aka de sake? para uha (kAfira) sarakazI te hakka sacca toM mUMha mor3aNa utte ar3e hoe hana|
kI bhalA jihar3A viakatI mUMha nIvAM karake (pazUAM vAMga) turadA hai uha vaddha hidAita vAlA hai jAM uha jihar3A siddhA ho ke (sira cukkIM) ika paddharI rAha ’te tura piA hove?
(he nabI!) Akha dio, uhIo allAha hai jisa ne tuhAnUM paidA kItA hai ate tuhADe kaMna, akkhAM, ate dila baNAe, para tusIM ghaTTa hI zukara adA karade ho|
Akha dio, uhIo hai jisa ne tuhAnUM dharatI utte pasAriA ate use dI haz2UrI vica tusIM sAre ikaTThe kIte jAoge|
ate uha inakArI Akhade hana ki kiAmata AuNa dA vacana kadoM pUrA hovegA, je tusIM sacce ho tAM dasso?
he nabI! Akha dio ki bezakka isa dI jANakArI kevala allAha kola hI hai, maiM tAM kevala tuhAnUM sapazaTa rUpa vica sAvadhAna karana vAlA hAM|
jadoM uha (inakArI) usa isa (kiAmata) nUM ner3e toM vekhaNage tAM kAfirAM de cihare vigar3a jANage ate kihA jAvegA ki iho hai jisa dI tusIM maMga karade sI|
(he nabI!) Akha dio, bhAveM mainUM ate mere sAthIAM nUM allAha halAka kara deve jAM sADe utte miharAM kare, para kAfirAM nUM daradanAka az2Aba toM kauNa bacAvegA?
Akha dio ki uha (z2Ata) rahimAna dI hai, asIM use ’te ImAna liAe hAM ate use ’te asIM bharosA karade hAM, so tusIM chetI hI jANa laoge ki kauNa sapazaTa kurAhe piA hoiA hai|
he nabI! Akha dio ki je tuhADe khUhAM dA pANI dharatI heTha uttara jAve tAM kauNa hai jihar3A tuhADe kola pANI kaDDha ke liAvegA?
kasama hai nUna, kalama dI ate usa dI jo uha (farizate) likhade hana|
(he nabI!) tusIM ApaNe rabba dI kripA nAla ukkA hI sudAI nahIM|
bezakka tuhADe laI (rabba valloM) bahuta vaDDA badalA hai|
bezakka tusIM sadAcAra de vaDDe ucce daraje ’te ho|
chetI hI tusIM vI vekha lavoge te uha (kAfira) vI vekha laiNage|
ki tuhADe viccoM sudAI kauNa hai|
bezakka tuhADA rabba isa galla nUM bhalI-bhAMta jANadAhai ki kauNa usa dI rAha toM bhaTakiA hoiA hai ate kauNa siddhe rAha ’te hai|
so (he nabI!) tusIM jhuThalAuNa vAliAM de picche nahIM laggaNA|
uha (kAfira) tAM iha cAhuMde hana ki (kujjha) tusIM naramI vikhAo tAM uha vI narama pai jANa|
tusIM bahutIAM sahuMAM khANa vAle z2alIla viakatI dI galla ukkA hI nA maMno|
jihar3A mihaNe deNa vAlA te cug2alaqhora hai|
bhalAI de kaMmAM toM rokaNa vAlA hai, ate haddAM TappaNa vAlA ate mahAM-durAcArI hai|
ojjar3a de nAla-nAla harAmaz2AdA (nIca) vI hai|
iha sabha isa laI hai, ki uha dhaMnavAna te puttarAM vAlA hai|
jadoM usa nUM sADIAM AitAM suNAIAM jAMdIAM hana tAM kahiMdA hai ki iha tAM bIte sameM dIAM kahANIAM hana|
asIM chetI hI isa dI suMDa (bhAva nakka) ’te dAg2a lAvAMge|

bezakka asIM ihanAM (makke vAliAM) nUM use tarhAM parakkhiA sI jiddAM asIM bAg2a vAliAM nUM parakkhiA sI, jadoM uhanAM ne sahuM khAMdI sI ki savera huMde hI asIM isa bAg2a de phalAM nUM tor3a lavAMge|
uhanAM ne inazAallAha (bhAva je rabba ne cAhiA) nahIM kihA sI|
tuhADe rabba valloM ika bipatA usa bAg2a ’te A paI jada ki hAle uha sutte pae sana|
ate uha bAg2a vADI kItI hoI khetI vAMga ho giA|
savera huMde hI uhanAM ne ika dUje nUM AkhiA|
ki je tusIM phala tor3aNe hana tAM ApaNe bAg2AM valla savere-savere nikkala turo|
so uha tura pae te Apo vica haulI-haulI kahi rahe sana|
ki ajja tuhADe bAg2a vica koI vI muthAja nahIM var3anA cAhIdA|
uha savere savere iho socade (bAg2a valla) tura pae ki uha muthAjAM nUM roka sakade hana|
para jadoM uhanAM ne bAg2a nUM vekhiA tAM AkhiA ki “asIM tAM rAha hI bhulla gae hAM”|
(ate kihA ki) nahIM asIM rAha nahIM bhulle sagoM sADe tAM bhAga hI phuTTa gae|
uhanAM viccoM jihar3A sabha toM caMgA sI uha AkhaNa laggiA ki maiM tuhAnUM AkhiA nahIM sI ki tusIM (ApaNe pAlaNahAra dI) tasabIha kiuM nahIM karade?
phera uha AkhaNa lagge ki pAka hai sADA rabba bezakka asIM hI z2Alama sAM|
phera uhanAM viccoM hareka ika dUje nUM kosaNa lagga piA|
ate uha AkhaNa lagge ki hAe afasosa, bezakka asIM hI (rabba de) bAg2I ho gae sAM|
ho sakadA hai ki sADA rabba badale vica sAnUM isa toM vI vadhIA bAg2a de deve, asIM ApaNe rabba nAla moha rakkhaNa vAle hAM|
az2Aba tAM isa tarhAM vI huMdA hai para Aqhirata dA az2Aba sabha toM vaddha karar3A hai| kAza! ihanAM nUM isa dA giAna huMdA|
bezakka rabba toM Darana vAliAM laI uhanAM de rabba kola niamatAM bhare bAg2a hana|
kI asIM musalamAnAM (bhAva AgiAkArIAM) nUM aparAdhIAM de barAbara kara diAMge|
tuhAnUM kI ho giA hai? tusIM kiho jihe faisale karade ho?
kI tuhADe kola koI kitAba hai jisa viccoM tusIM iha sabha par3hade ho?
ki jisa vica tuhADe mana bhAuMdIAM gallAM hoNa|
kI tusIM sAthoM kiAmata dihAr3e taka dIAM saMhuAM lai rakkhIAM hana ki tuhADe laI ohIo hovegA jisa dA faisalA tusIM karoge?
ihanAM toM puccho ki tuhADe viccoM kauNa isa dI z2amAnata laiMdA hai?
kI (isa de z2Amina) ihanAM de mitthe hoe (rabba de) zarIka hana? tAM uhanAM nUM cAhIdA hai ki uha ApaNe zarIka liAuNa je uha sacce hana|
jisa dina piMnI kholha dittI jAvegI bhAva aukhA velA AvegA ate uhanAM inakArIAM nUM sijadA karana laI bulAiA jAvegA tAM uha sijadA nahIM kara sakaNage|[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] vekho sUrata ata-taharIma, hAzIA Aita 8/66

translations.translation: uhanAM dIAM naz2arAM jhukIAM hoNagIAM te uhanAM ’te hINatA chAI hovegI| jadoM saMsAra vica uhanAM nUM sijade laI bulAiA jAMdA sI usa vele tAM uha bhale caMge sana|

so (he nabI!) ajja mainUM te usa nUM jihar3A hadIsa (bhAva.kuraAna) nUM jhuThalAuMdA sI (dovAM nUM ikallA) chaDDa dio| asIM usa nUM haulI-haulI barabAdI valla lai jAvAMge ki usa nUM patA vI nahIM lagga sakegA|
maiM ihanAM nUM Dhilla de rihA hAM, bezakka merI cAla vaDDI z2abaradasata hai|
(he nabI!) kI tusIM uhanAM toM badalA bhAlade ho ki iha usa tAvAna (caTTI) de bhAra heTha dabe jA rahe hana?
kI ihanAM kola parokha dA giAna hai, jisa toM iha likha liAuMde hana|
so tusIM ApaNe rabba dA hukama AuNa taka dhIraja toM kaMma lavo ate macchI vAle (yUnusa a:) vAMga nA ho jANA ki jadoM usa ne (allAha nUM) saddiA sI usa sameM uha g2ama nAla bharapUra sI|
jekara usa de rabba dI mihara usa nUM nA jur3adI tAM uha ika rar3e maidAna vica suTTa dittA jAMdA jada ki uha hINA te rusavA vI huMdA|
aMta usa de rabba ne usa nUM ApaNIAM miharAM nAla nivAz2iA, ate usa nUM bhale purakhAM vica ralA liA|

jadoM iha (inakArI) usa z2ikara (bhAva.kuraAna) suNade hana tAM tuhAnUM ApaNIAM (bhair3IAM) naz2arAM nAla iMja takkade hana jiveM uha tuhADe paira (siddhI rAha toM) ukhAr3a deNage ate Akhade hana ki bezakka uha (muhaMmada) tAM sudAI hai|
jada ki iha (.kuraAna) tAM sAre jahAnAM laI ika nasIhata hai|
vAparana vAlI, huNe vAparana vAlI hai|
kI hai, uha vAparana vAlI?
tuhAnUM vAparana vAlI dI qhabara kisa ne dittI hai?
‘samUda’ ate ‘Ada’ ne isa barabAda karana vAlI kiAmata nUM jhuThalAiA|
jihar3e ‘samUdI’ sana uha ika vaDDI tez2a DarAuNa vAlI AvAz2a nAla halAka kara ditte gae|
ate jihar3e ‘AdI’ sana uha tez2a zUkadI hanerI nAla barabAda ho gae|

allAha ne uhanAM ’te lagAtAra satta rAtAM ate aTTha dina isa (hanerI) nUM cAr3hIM rakkhiA, je tusIM utthe huMde tAM tusIM usa kauma nUM iMja barabAda pae vekhade jiveM uha khajUra de pole ho cukke moche hoNa|
kI tusIM uhanAM kaumAM dA kujjha vI bAkI baciA hoiA vekhade ho?
ate firaauna jihar3A ihanAM toM pahilAM sI ate uppara thalle kItIAM gaIAM basatIAM vAle vI pApa karade sana|
uhanAM ne ApaNe rabba de rasUla dI nA-faramAnI kItI tAM uhanAM de rabba ne uhanAM nUM karar3AI nAla phar3a liA|
bezakka jadoM pANI dA har3ha AiA tAM asIM tuhAnUM (nUha te usa de sAthIAM nUM) caladI ber3I vica savAra kara dittA|
tAM jo asIM tuhADI isa ghaTanA nUM sikkhiAdAI baNA deIe, tAM jo cete rakkhaNa vAle kaMna isa nUM yAda rakkhaNa|
phera jadoM sUra (narasiMghe) vica ika hI vAra phUMka mArI jAvegI|
ate dharatI te pahAr3a cukka ke ika hI saTTa vica cUra cUra kara ditte jANage|
usa dihAr3e vAparana vAlI ghaTanA (kiAmata) vAparegI|
ate akAza phaTTa jAvegA usa dina uha bodA ho jAvegA|
ate farizate usa de kaMDhiAM ’te hoNage ate usa dina aTTha farizate tuhADe rabba dA araza ApaNe utte cukkI hoNage|
usa dihAr3e tuhADI pezI (rabba de haz2Ura) hovegI, te tuhADA koI vI bheta lukiA nahIM rahegA|
usa vele jisa dI karama-pattarI usa de sajje hattha vica dittI jAvegI, uha AkhegA, lao merI karama-pattarI par3ho|
bezakka mainUM bharosA sI ki mainUM ApaNe lekhe jokhe nAla milaNA hai|
so uha mana bhAuMdI jIvanI vica hovegA|
uccIAM jaMnatAM vica hovegA|
jisa de phalAM de gucche kola hI jhukke hoNage|
AkhiA jAvegA ki maujAM nAla khAo pIo ApaNe uhanAM karamAM de badale jihar3e tusIM bIte sameM vica agge bheje sana|
para jisa dI karama-pattarI usa de khabbe hattha vica dittI gaI uha AkhegA, kAza mainUM merI karama-pattarI nA dittI jAMdI|
mainUM patA hI nA huMdA ki merA lekhA-jokhA kI hai?
kAza! uhIo (jihar3I saMsAra vica mauta AI sI) niranAika siddha huMdI|
mainUM mere mAla ne kujjha vI lAbha nahIM dittA|
merI hukamarAnI maithoM khusa gaI|
hukama hovegA ki isa nUM phar3a lavo ate isa de saMgala pA dio|
phera isa nUM naraka dI agga vica suTTa dio|
phera ika z2aMjIra vica, jihar3I sattara gaz2a laMmI hai, isa nUM jakar3a dio|
bezakka uha allAha utte, jo ki saravuca hai, ImAna nahIM liAiA sI|
ate nA hI muthAja nUM khANA khavAuNa laI preranA diMdA sI|[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] allAha de rasUla (sa:) nUM pucchiA giA ki isalAma dI kihar3I qhasalata sabha toM vadhIA hai? Apa (sa:) ne faramAiA, bhukkhe nUM bhojana karavAuNA, hara musalamAna nUM salAma karanA, bhAveM tusIM usa nUM jANade ho jAM nahIM| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 12)

translations.translation: so ajja itthe koI usa dA hamadarada dosata nahIM|
ate nA hI z2akhamAM de dhoNa toM chuTTa koI bhojana hai|
chuTTa aparAdhIAM toM isa nUM koI nahIM khAMdA|
so maiM uhanAM cIz2AM dI sahuM khAMdA hAM jo tusIM vekhade ho|
ate uhanAM dI vI jo tusIM nahIM vekhade|
bezakka iha (.kuraAna) ika satikArayoga rasUla dA kathana hai|
iha kise kavI dA kathana nahIM, para tusIM loka ghaTTa hI ImAna liAuMde ho|
ate nA hI kise pAMdhe dA kathana hai, para tusIM loka ghaTTa hI nasIhata grahiNa karade ho|
iha (.kuraAna) tAM sAre hI jahAnAM de pAlaNahAra valloM uttAriA giA hai|
jekara iha (muhaMmada sa:) sADe nAM nAla koI galla ghar3ha liAuMdA|
tAM asIM usa dA sajjA hattha nappa laiMde|
phera asIM usadI ghaMDI vaDDha suTTade|
phera tuhADe viccoM koI vI sAnUM (bhAva allAha nUM) isa kaMma toM rokaNa vAlA nahIM sI|
nirasaMdeha, iha.kuraAna muttakIAM (burAIAM toM bacaNa vAliAM) laI ika nasIhata hai|
bezakka asIM jANade hAM ki tuhADe viccoM kujjha loka isa nUM jhuThalAuMde hana|
ate bezakka uha (jhuThalAuNA) kAfirAM laI pachatAve dA kArana hai|[2]
translations.footnotes: [2] vekho sUrata Ale-imarAna, hAzIA Aita 85/3 ate sUrata yUnusa, hAzIA Aita 37/10

translations.translation: nirasaMdeha, iha ika aTalla saccAI hai|[3]
translations.footnotes: [3] vekho sUrata ara-raada, hAzIA Aita 28/13

translations.translation: so (he nabI!) tusIM ApaNe saravuca te mahAna rabba de nAM dI tasabIha karo|
ika maMgaNa vAle ne az2Aba maMgiA hai, jihar3A vAparana vAlA hai|
iha az2Aba kAfirAM laI hai, koI isa nUM TAlaNa vAlA nahIM|
ate (iha az2Aba) usa allAha valloM hai jihar3A ucce maratabiAM vAlA hai|
farizate ate rUha (jibarAIla) usa de haz2Ura ika ajihe dina car3ha ke jAMde hana jisa dI miNatI paMjAha haz2Ara sAla hai|
so (he nabI!) tusIM sohaNe DhaMga nAla sabara toM kaMma lao|
bezakka iha loka usa (kiAmata) nUM dUra vekhade hana|
jada ki asIM usa nUM ner3e vekhade hAM|
jisa dina akAza pighale hoe tAMbe vAMga ho jAvegA|
ate pahAr3a dhuNakhI hoI raMga-baraMgI unna vAMga ho jANage|
koI vI dosata ApaNe jigarI dosata nUM nahIM pucchegA|
jada ki uha (dosata) ika dUje nUM vikhA vI ditte jANage| aparAdhI cAhegA ki kAza| az2Aba toM bacaNa laI ApaNe puttarAM nUM chuDavAI vajoM de deve|
ApaNI patanI te ApaNe bharA nUM vI|
ate ApaNe parivAra nUM vI jihar3A usa nUM zarana diMdA sI|
ate dharatI utte jinne vI vasanIka hana uhanAM sAriAM nUM chuDavAI vajoM de deve tAM jo usa nUM (az2Aba toM) mukatI mila jAve|[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] vekho sUrata az2a-z2AriAta, hAzIA Aita 60/51

translations.translation: kade vI nahIM (baca sakegA) bezakka uha tAM ika bhar3akadI hoI agga hai|
jihar3I camar3IAM nUM udher3a deNa vAlI hai|
ate uha hara usa viakatI nUM, jisa ne vI (hakka toM) piTTha pherI ate mUMha mor3hiA, hAkAM mAra-mAra ke ApaNe valla saddegI|
ate dhana ikaTThA kItA ate usa nUM saiMta-saiMta ke rakkhiA|
bezakka manukkha nUM be-sabarA (thur3a-dilA) paidA kItA giA hai|
jadoM usa nUM koI nukasAna pahuMcadA hai tAM uha ghabarA jAMdA hai|
jadoM koI bhalAI miladI hai, tAM uha kaMjUsI karana laggadA hai|
para uha namAz2I|
jihar3e ApaNIAM namAz2AM utte sadA kAima rahiMde hana|
ate jinhAM de mAlAM vica (dUje lokAM dA) hakka nizacita hai|
(jiveM) maMgaNa vAle ate mahirUmAM dA (hissA hai)|
ate jihar3e loka badale vAle dina (bhAva kiAmata) dI puzaTI karade hana|
ate jihar3e ApaNe rabba de az2Aba toM Darana vAle hana|
bezakka uhanAM de rabba dA az2Aba koI nA Darana vAlI cIz2a nahIM|
jihar3e ApaNIAM gupata-iMdarIAM dI rAkhI karana vAle hana|
chuTTa ApaNIAM patanIAM jAM ApaNIAM golIAM toM (je rAkhI nahIM karade) tAM uhanAM dA koI doza nahIM|
para jihar3A koI ihanAM (dovAM) toM chuTTa hora (auratAM) cAhave uhIo haddAM toM TappaNa vAle hana|
ate jihar3e ApaNI amAnatAM dI rAkhI te ApaNe vacanAM dI pAlaNA karana vAle hana|
ate jihar3e ApaNIAM gavAhIAM utte kAima rahiMde hana|
ate jihar3e ApaNIAM namAz2AM dI rAkhI karade hana|[2]
translations.footnotes: [2] vekho sUrata ala-bakaraha, hAzIA Aita 238/2

translations.translation: uhIo loka bAg2AM (bhAva jaMnatAM) vica Adara-mAna vAle hoNage|
(he nabI!) kAfirAM nUM kI ho giA hai ki uha tuhADe valla nasse A rahe hana|
sajjioM vI ate khabbioM vI Tole de Tole (A rahe hana)|
kI ihanAM viccoM hareka viakatI nUM iha lobha hai ki usa nUM niamatAM bharIAM jaMnatAM vica dAqhala kItA jAvegA|
ukkA hI nahIM! bezakka asIM uhanAM nUM usa cIz2a toM sAjiA hai, jisa nUM uha jANade hana|
so maiM pUrabAM ate pacchamAM de mAlika dI sahuM khAMdA hAM ki asIM hI samarathA rakkhade hAM|
asAM ihanAM dI thAM ihanAM toM vadhIA lokAM nUM liAIe| sAnUM isa kaMma toM rokaNa vAlA koI nahIM ate nA hI sADe utte koI bhArU hai|
so (he nabI!) tusIM uhanAM dI ciMtA karanI chaDDa dio, uha gallAM baNAuNa te kheDaNa vica rujjhe rahiNa itthoM taka ki uha ApaNe usa dina nUM pujja jANa jisadA ihanAM nAla vAadA kItA giA hai|
jisa dina uha kabarAM viccoM nikkala ke nasse jANage, jiveM uha ApaNe asathAnAM valla nassa rahe hoNa|
uhanAM dIAM naz2arAM nIvIAM hoNagIAM te uhanAM ’te hINatA chA rahI hovegI, iho uha dina hai jisa dA uhanAM nAla vAadA kItA giA hai|
bezakka asIM nUha nUM usa dI kauma valla ghalliA ki uha ApaNI kauma nUM DarAve isa toM pahilAM ki uhanAM nUM daradanAka az2Aba A nappe|
usa (nUha) ne AkhiA ki he merI kauma! maiM tuhAnUM sapazaTa rUpa vica DarAuNa vAlA (paig2aMbara) hAM|
tusIM allAha dI baMdagI karo, use toM Daro ate merI AgiAkArI karo|

phera uha tuhADe gunAhAM nUM baqhaza devegA ate tuhAnUM ika nizacita sameM laI mohalata devegA| bezakka jadoM allAha dA niyata kItA hoiA samAM A jAve tAM uha TaladA nahIM| kAza! tuhAnUM isa dA giAna hove|
usa (nUha) ne AkhiA ki he mere rabbA! bezakka maiMne ApaNI kauma nUM rAta-dina (tere valla) saddiA|
para mere isa sadde ne uhanAM de (hakka sacca toM) pharAra hoNa vica vAdhA hI kItA hai|

maine jadoM vI uhanAM nUM saddiA tAM jo tUM uhanAM nUM baqhaza deveM tAM uhanAM ne ApaNIAM uMgalIAM ApaNe kaMnAM vica pA laIAM ate ApaNe Apa nUM kappar3hiAM nAla Dhakka liA ate haTadharamI ’te ar3e rahe ate ghamaMDa vica haddoM Tapa gae|
maine uhanAM nUM khullhama-khullhA (tere valla AuNa laI) saddiA sI|
maine uhanAM nUM sapazaTa rUpa vica vI te gupata rUpa vica vI samajhAiA|
so maine kihA ki tusIM ApaNe rabba toM khimA maMgo| bezakka uhIo baqhazaNahAra hai|
uha tuhADe utte akAza toM mUsalAdhAra mIMha barasAegA|
uha tuhAnUM mAla te aulAda nAla nivAz2egA ate tuhADe laI bAg2a paidA karegA ate nahirAM vI jArI karegA|
tuhAnUM kI ho giA hai ki tusIM allAha laI kise gaurava (te vaDiAI) dI Asa nahIM rakkhade|
jada ki usa ne tuhAnUM tarhAM-tarhAM nAla sAjiA hai|
kI tusIM vekhiA nahIM ki allAha ne satta akAza uppara thalle kiveM sAje hana|
ate use ne uhanAM vica caMna nUM cAnaNa ate sUraja nUM cirAg2a baNAiA hai|
ate allAha ne tuhAnUM dharatIo (adabhuta rUpa nAla) ugAiA hai|
phera uha tuhAnUM ise dharatI vica mor3a liAvegA ate uha tuhAnUM ise viccoM mur3a kaDDhegA|
allAha ne tuhADe laI dharatI nUM vichauNe vAMga vichA dittA hai|
(he nabI!) tAM jo tusIM isa dIAM khullhIAM rAhAM ’te turo phiro|
nUha ne kihA, he mere rabbA! bezakka uhanAM ne merI nA-faramAnI kItI ate uhanAM de picche lagge jinhAM nUM uhanAM de mAla te aulAda ne vadhere ghATe vica hI rakkhiA hai|
uhanAM ne vaDDIAM-vaDDIAM cAlAM callIAM|
uhanAM ne AkhiA, tusIM ApaNe izaTAM nUM nA chaDDo ate nA tusIM ‘vadda’ nUM, nA ‘suA’ nUM, nA ‘yaUsa’ nUM, nA yaUka nUM ate nA hI ‘nasara’ (nAM dI devIAM dI pUjA) nUM chaDDo|
uhanAM ne vadhere lokAM nUM gumarAha kItA, so he allAha! tUM z2AlamAM dI gumarAhI vica vAdhA kara|
uha ApaNe aparAdhA kArana Doba ditte gae ate naraka vica dAqhala kara ditte gae, phera uhanAM nUM chuTTa allAha toM hora koI sahAI nahIM labbhiA|
ate nUha ne kihA ki he mere rabbA! dharatI utte vassaNa vAle kise vI kAfira nUM nA chaDDIM|
je tUM uhanAM nUM chaDDa dittA tAM uha tere baMdiAM nUM kurAhe pA deNage ate (agge nUM vI) kAfira hI paidA hoNage|

he mere rabbA! tUM merI ate mere mApiAM dI baqhaziza pharamA ate hara usa viakatI dI jihar3A mere ghara vica ImAna vAlA baNake dAqhala hove ate momina puraza te momina isatarIAM dI vI (baqhaziza faramA) ate z2AlamAM dI barabAdI te halAkata vica vAdhA kara|

(he nabI!) Akha dio ki mere valla vahI (rabba sunehA) ghallI gaI hai ki jiMnAM dI ika TolI ne (.kuraAna) dhiAna nAla suNiA te phera (ApaNe kauma nUM jA ke) AkhiA ki bezakka asIM ika acarajamaI਼kuraAna suNiA hai|
jo siddhI te hidAita vAlI rAha darasAuMdA hai| so asIM usa ’te ImAna liAe hAM ate huNa asIM kise nUM vI rabba dA zarIka nahIM ThahirAvAMge|
ate iha vI kihA ki sADe rabba dI zAna vaDDI uccI hai| usa ne kise nUM ApaNI patanI jAM puttara nahIM baNAiA|[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] vekho sUrata ala-bakaraha, hAzIA Aita 116/2

translations.translation: ate kihA ki sADe mUrakha sAthI allAha de bAre jhUThIAM gallAM Akhade rahe hana|
jada ki asIM iha samajhade sI ki manukkha te jiMna kade vI allAha bAre jhUTha nahIM bolaNage| [2]
translations.footnotes: [2] jiddAM manukkha nUM miTTI toM, farizatiAM nUM nUra toM paidA kItA giA hai aiveM hI jiMna vI allAha dI racanA hai jihar3I agga toM sAjI gaI hai|

translations.translation: bezakka manukkhAM viccoM kujjha loka jiMnAM viccoM kujjha lokAM dI zarana maMgiA karade sana| isa tarhAM uhanAM ne uhanAM (jiMnAM) dI sarakazI (haMkAra) vica hora vI vAdhA kara dittA|
ate uhanAM (manukkhAM) ne vI iho vicAra kItA sI ki jiveM tusIM (jiMnAM ne) sociA sI ki allAha kise nUM vI mur3a (kabarAM ’coM) nahIM uThAvegA (te nA hI rasUla bhejegA)|
ate iha ki asIM akAza nUM TaToliA tAM usa nUM karar3e pahiredArAM nAla ate aMgiArAM nAla bhariA hoiA|
ate asIM akAza de TikANiA vica suNa-guNa laiNa laI baiThiA karade sana, so huNa jihar3A vI suNana dI koziza karadA hai tAM ika aMgiAra nUM ApaNI ghAta vica laggA vekhadA hai|
ate iha ki asIM nahIM jANade ki kI uhanAM de rabba ne dharatI vAliAM laI bhair3e vihAra karana dA irAdA kItA hai jAM uhanAM laI bhalAI dA irAdA kItA hai?
ate iha ki sADe viccoM neka vI hana ate kujjha loka isa toM heThAM (bhAva bure) vI hana, asIM vakkho-vakkha rAhAM (dharamAM) vica vaMDe hoe hAM|
ate sAnUM vizavAsa ho cukkiA sI ki asIM allAha nUM dharatI utte bevasa nahIM kara sakade ate nA hI nassa ke usa nUM bevasa kara sakade hAM|
ate iha ki jadoM asIM hidAita vAlI galla suNI tAM usa ’te ImAna liAe| jihar3A koI ApaNe rabba ’te ImAna liAiA, phera nA tAM usa nUM kise prakAra dI hAnI hoNa dA Dara hovegA ate nA hI kise vadhIkI dA|
ate iha ki sADe vica kujha musalamAna (AgiAkArI) vI hana ate kujha z2Alama (inakArI) vI hana| phera jihar3A koI isalAma iqhatiAra karegA tAM usa ne hidAita vAlI rAha labbha laI|
para jihar3e z2Alama hana uha naraka dI agga dA bAlaNa baNanage|
(he nabI! Akha dio ki) mere utte vahI kItI gaI hai ki je loka siddhI rAha utte kAima rahiMde tAM asIM uhanAM nUM caMgI tarhAM rajA diMde|
phera asIM uhanAM nUM az2amAuMde ate jihar3A koI ApaNe rabba dI yAda toM mUMha mor3egA tAM uha (allAha) usa nUM ghaTade vadhade az2Aba vica phasA devegA|
ate iha vI ki masItAM kevala allAha laI hana, so tusIM uhanAM vica allAha de nAla kise hora nUM nA pukAro|[3]
translations.footnotes: [3] vekho sUrata ala-bakaraha, hAzIA Aita 165/2

translations.translation: ate iha ki jadoM allAha dA baMdA (muhaMmada) allAha nUM pukArana laI khar3hA hoiA tAM saMbhava sI ki lokI (kAfira) usa utte TuTTa paiMde|
(he nabI!) Akha dio! ki bezakka maiM ApaNe rabba nUM hI pukAradA hAM ate usa de nAla kise hora nUM sAMjhI nahIM baNAuMdA|
(ate kihA) Akha dio! nirasaMdeha, maiM tuhADe laI nA kise prakAra dI hAnI dA te nA hI kise lAbha dA adhikAra rakkhadA hAM|
Akha dio! mainUM allAha de az2Aba toM koI bacAvegA nahIM ate nA hI usa toM chuTTa koI zarana asathAna mila sakadA hai|

(Akha dio!)allAha dA hukama ate usa dA sunehA pahuMcAuNa toM chuTTa merA kujjha vI adhikAra nahIM ate jihar3A allAha ate usa de rasUla dI nA-faramAnI karegA tAM bezakka usa laI naraka dI agga hai, uha usa vica sadA laI rahiNage|[4]
translations.footnotes: [4] vekho sUrata Ala-isarAna, hAzIA Aita 85/3

translations.translation: itthoM taka ki jadoM uha usa az2Aba nUM vekhaNage ki jisa dA uhanAM nAla vAadA kItA giA hai tAM uhanAM nUM chetI hI patA lagga jAvegA ki kisa de sahAI kamaz2ora hana ate kisa dA jatthA giNatI vica ghaTTa hai|
(he nabI!) Akha dio ki maiM nahIM jANadA ki jisa az2Aba dA tuhADe nAla vAadA kItA giA hai uha ner3e hI hai jAM usa laI mere rabba ne koI laMmAM samAM niyata kara rakkhiA hai|
uhIo g2aiba (parokha) dA jANanahAra hai ate uha ApaNA giAna kise ’te vI pragaTa nahIM karadA|
chuTTa usa rasUla toM jisa nUM uha (parokha dA giAna deNAM) pasaMda kare, phera usa (rasUla) de agge-picche rAkhe niyukata kara diMdA hai|
tAM jo uha jANa lave ki uhanAM rasUlAM ne ApaNe rabba de sunehe nUM (lokAM takka) pahuMcA dittA hai ate usa ne uhanAM de Ale-duAle gherA pAiA hoiA hai ate uha ne hara cIz2a dI giNatI kara rakkhI hai|
he kapar3A or3a lapeTa ke paiNa vAle!
rAta vele thor3he sameM laI (namAz2a laI) khalotA rihA kara|
bhAva addhI rAta jAM isa toM kujjha ghaTTa kara lao|
jAM isa toM kujjha vadhA lao ate.kuraAna nUM caMgI tarhAM Thahira-Thahira ke par3ho|[1]
