translations.footnotes: [1] isa Aita vica nabI (sa:) nUM.kuraAna par3haNa dI preranA dittI gaI hai, jisa dA asala udeza ummata nUM prerita karanA hai| kiuM jo.kuraAna dA pATha karanA, usa nUM kaMDha karanA ate isa dA giAna rakkhaNa dA bahuta mahattava hai, iha uha kaMma hana ki jinhAM nUM iha cIz2AM mila jANa uha razaka karana yoga hana, jiveM ki hadIsa vica hai ki allAha de rasUla ne faramAiA ki razaka kevala do viakatIAM ’te hI kItA jA sakadA hai| ika uha jisa nUM allAha ne.kuraAna de giAna nAla navAz2iA hove ate uha dina-rAta use dI talAvata bhAva par3haNa vica viasatha rahe, phera usa dA par3hosI razaka kara sakadA hai ki kAza! mainUM vI iha.kuraAna isa viakatI vAMga yAda huMdA tAM maiM vI ise tarhAM isa dI talAvata kariA karadA| dUjA uha jisa nUM allAha ne daulata nAla navAz2iA hove ate uha usa nUM bhale kaMmAM vica qharaca karadA hove| usa nAla iMja razaka kItA jA sakadA hai ki kAza! mainUM vI ajihI daulata mila jAMdI tAM maiM vI usa nUM usa dI tharAM allAha dI rAha vica qharaca karadA| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 5026)

translations.translation: bezakka asIM chetI hI tuhADe utte ika vaDDI bhArI z2iMmevArI (dharama pracAra) dI pAuNa vAle hAM|
hakIkata hai ki rAta dA uThaNA mana nUM kAbU karana laI bahuta prabhAvakArI hai ate z2ikara te simarana karana laI vadhere ucita hai|
bezakka dina vele tuhADe laI vadhere rujheveM hana|
tusIM ApaNe rabba dA nAM yAda karo ate sAriAM toM vakkha ho ke use valla dhiAna dio|
uha pUraba ate pacchama dA rabba hai[2] chuTTa usa toM hora koI izaTa nahIM, so tusIM use nUM karatA-dharatA baNA lao|
translations.footnotes: [2] vekho sUrata Ale-imarAna, hAzIA Aita 173/3

translations.translation: ate jo kujjha uha (inakArI) Akhade hana uhanAM ’te sabara karo ate bhalamaNasI nAla uhanAM toM aDDa ho jAo|
mai` ate jhuThalAuNa vAle qhuzahAla lokAM nUM ikallA chaDDa dio| ate uhanAM nUM kujjha cira laI mohalata de dio|
bezakka sADe kola (uhanAM laI) ber3IAM te lATAM mAradI agga hai|
ate gala vica phasaNa vAlA bhojana ate dukhadAI az2Aba hai|
jadoM dharatI ate pahAr3a kaMba uTThaNage ate pahAr3a reta de Dhera vAMga hoNage|
bezakka asIM tuhADe valla ika rasUla (muhaMmada sa:) bhejiA jihar3A (kiAmata dihAr3e) tuhADe utte gavAha hovegA,[3] jiveM asIM firaauna valla rasUla bhejiA sI|
translations.footnotes: [3] vekho sUrata ala-bakaraha, hAzIA Aita 252/2

translations.translation: firaauna ne usa rasUla dI nApharamAnI kItI tAM asIM usa nUM karar3AI nAla phar3a liA|
tusIM az2Aba toM kiveM bacoge, je tusIM usa dina dA inakAra kItA jihar3A bacciA nUM buDDhA kara devegA|
ate jisa dI saqhatI nAla akAza faTTa jAvegA, allAha dA vAadA kiAmata AuNa dA pUrA ho ke rahegA|
bezakka iha (kuraAna) ika nasIhata hai, huNa jo koI cAhave ApaNe rabba dI rAha phar3a lave|

(he nabI!) tuhADA rabba jANadA hai ki tusIM lagga-bhagga do tihAI rAta jAM addhI rAta jAM ika tihAI rAta namAz2a laI khar3e rahiMde ho| tuhADe sAthIAM viccoM vI ika TolI iho karadI hai| allAha hI rAta ate dina dA lekhA-jokhA rakkhadA hai| uha jANadA hai ki tusIM isa (rAta de kiAma) nUM nibhA nahIM sakoge so usa ne tuhADe utte kripA kItI, huNa jinnA.kuraAna tusIM AsAnI nAla par3ha sakade ho par3ha liA karo| uha jANadA hai ki tuhADe viccoM kiMne loka bImAra hoNage ate kiMne dharatI utte allAha dA faz2ala (roz2I) labbhade phirade hoNage ate kiMne allAha de rAha vica lar3ade hoNage| so isa (kuraAna) viccoM jinnA vI AsAnI nAla par3hiA jA sake par3ho ate namAz2a kAima karo, z2akAta adA karo, allAha nUM sohaNA karaz2A dio| tusIM ApaNe laI jihar3I vI nekI agge bhejoge usa dA badalA allAha de kola vadhere caMgA hai te bahuta vaDDA hai ate allAha koloM baqhaziza maMgade raho| bezakka allAha baqhazaNahAra te miharabAna hai|
he kapar3A (kaMbala) or3a lapeTa ke paiNa vAle!
uTho ate (lokAM nUM) DarAo|
ate ApaNe rabba dI vaDiAI dI caracA karo|
ate ApaNe kappar3hiAM nUM pAka-sAfa rakkho|
apavittaratA toM dUra raho|
vadhere prApata karana laI ahisAna nA karo|
ate ApaNe rabba laI sabara toM kaMma lao|
jadoM sUra (narasiMghA) vajAiA jAvegA|
tAM uha dihAr3A bahuta hI karar3A hovegA|
kAfirAM laI sokhiAI nahIM hovegI|
mainUM (bhAva allAha nUM) ate usa viakatI nUM ikallA chaDDa dio jisa nUM maiM ikallA paidA kItA hai|
usa nUM Dhera sArA mAla dittA hai|
usa de aMga saMga rahiNa vAle puttara ditte|
usa nUM khullhI-DhullhI jIvana samaggarI (bhAva qhuzahAlI) nAla nivAz2iA|
phera vI uha lobha karadA hai ki maiM usa nUM hora vadhere diAM|
kade vI nahIM! nirasaMdeha, uha sADIAM AitAM nAla vaira rakkhadA hai|
chetI hI usa nUM maiM (bhAva allAha) ika kaThina car3hAI car3hAvAMgA|
usa ne soca vicAra kItA ate kujjha galla jor3haNa dA jatana kItA|
so uha tAM mAriA jAvegA, usa ne kiho jihI galla baNAuNa dA jatana kItA|
uha tAM mAriA jAvegA, kiho jihI galla baNAuNa dA jatana kItA|
phera usa ne lokAM valla vekhiA|
phera matthe vaTTa pAiA ate mUMha vigAr3hiA|
phera piTTha pherI te haMkAra vI kItA|
phera usa ne AkhiA iha (.kuraAna) tAM ika jAdU hai jihar3A pahilAM toM turiA A rihA hai|
iha tAM kevala ika manukkhI bANI hai|
maiM chetI hI usa viakatI nUM ‘sakara’ vica suTTa devAMgA|[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] vekho sUrata banI-isarAIla, hAzIA Aita 97/17

translations.translation: tusIM kI jANoM ki sakara kI hai?
(iha ‘sakara’ naraka hai) jihar3I (zarIra nUM) nA bAkI rakkhegI te nA chaDDegI|
khallar3I nUM jhulasA deNa vAlI hai|
isa (sakara bhAva naraka) utte unnI (19) pahiredAra niyukata hana|

asIM farizate hI naraka de pahiredAra baNAe hana, ate asIM uhanAM dI giNatI nUM kAfirAM laI az2amAiza baNA chaDDiA hai, tAM jo kitAba vAle (yahUdIAM te IsAIAM) nUM vizavAsa ho jAve ate ImAna vAliAM de ImAna vica hora vAdhA ho jAve, kitAba vAle ate ImAna vAle kise zakka vica nA rahiNa, tAM jo dilAM de rogI te kAfira AkhaNa, isa udAharana toM allAha dA kI bhAva hai? ise tarhAM allAha jisa nUM cAhuMdA hai kurAhe pA diMdA hai ate jisa nUM cAhuMdA hai hidAita baqhaza diMdA hai| tuhADe rabba dIAM faujAM nUM kevala uhIo jANadA hai ate uha (naraka) manukkha laI kevala ika nasIhata hI tAM hai|
ukkA nahIM sahuM hai caMna dI|
ate rAta dI jadoM uha DhalladI hai|
ate savere dI jadoM uha rauzana huMdI hai|
bezakka iha naraka vI vaDDIAM cIz2AM viccoM ika hai|
manukkhAM laI DarAvA hai|
usa laI (DarAvA hai) jo tuhADe viccoM (nekI valla) agAMha vadhaNA jAM pichAMha rahiNA cAhuMdA hai|
hara viakatI ne jo vI (karama) kItA hai use de badale uha gahiNe piA hoiA hai|
chuTTa sajje hattha vAliAM toM|
uha jaMnata de bAg2AM vica hoNage ate ika dUje dA hAla puchaNNage|
aparAdhIAM bAre gallAM karanage|
(uhanAM toM pucchaNage) tuhAnUM kihar3I cIz2a ne naraka vica suTTiA hai?
uha AkhaNage ki asIM namAz2IAM viccoM nahIM sI|[2]
translations.footnotes: [2] vekho sUrata ala-anafAla, hAzIA Aita 39/8

translations.translation: ate nA hI asIM muthAjAM nUM bhojana karavAuMde sI|
asIM (jhUThIAM gallAM) baNAuNa vAliAM de nAla rujhe rahiMde sI|
asIM badale vAle dina (kiAmata) nUM jhUTha dassade sI|
itthoM taka ki sAnUM mauta ne A jhapphiA|
huNa sifArazIAM dI koI vI sifAraza uhanAM nUM kujjha vI lAbha nahIM devegI|
bhalA ihanAM lokAM nUM kI ho giA ki nasIhata (.kuraAna) toM mUMha mor3a rahe hana|
jiveM iha koI bidake hoe gadhe hoNa|
jihar3e zera nUM vekha ke nassa khalote hoNa|
ihanAM (kAfirAM) viccoM hara viakatI iho cAhuMdA hai ki usa nUM khullhIAM pothIAM dittIAM jANa|
ukkA nahIM! asala galla iha hai ki iha loka Aqhirata toM nahIM Darade|
ukkA nahIM! iha (.kuraAna) tAM ika nasIhata hai|
jihar3A koI cAhe isa (nasIhata) nUM yAda rakkhe|
jada ki uha (kAfira) isa nUM yAda nahIM rakhaNNage, chuTTa allAha hI je ajihA cAhe| uha isa yoga hai ki usa toM DariA jAve ate uhIo khimA karana de yoga hai|
maiM sahuM khAMdA hAM kiAmata dihAr3e dI|
ate maiM niMdana yoga mana dI sahuM khAMdA hai|
kI manukkha samajhadA hai ki asIM usa dIAM haDDIAM nUM ikattara nahIM kara sakAMge?
kiuM nahIM! sagoM asIM tAM usa dI pora-pora ThIka karana ’te samaratha hAM|[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] iha ika saccAI hai ki hareka viakatI de vizeza uMgalA de nizAna saMsAra de kise vI dUje manukkha nAla nahIM milade| iha Aita use valla agavAI karadI hai ki sADA pAlaNahAra sabha toM uccA te vaDiAI vAlA hai ate hareka cIz2a dA baNAuNa vAlA uhIo hai, chuTTa usa toM hora koI baMdagI de yoga nahIM|

translations.translation: manukkha tAM cAhuMdA hai ki agAMha nUM vI durAcAra vAle kaMma karadA rahe|
uha pucchadA hai ki kiAmata dihAr3A kadoM hai|
(iha dihAr3A usa vele hovegA) jadoM akkhAM patharA jANagIAM|
caMna be-nUra ho jAvegA|

translations.footnotes: [2] allAha de rasUla (sa:) ne faramAiA, kiAmata dihAr3e sUraja te caMna doveM be-nUra ho jANage| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 3200)

ukkA nahIM! utthe koI zarana-asathAna nahIM|

piMnI nAla piMnI jur3a jAvegI|[3]

translations.translation: usa dihAr3e tuhADe rabba valla calaNA hovegA|
nA tAM usa ne (saMsAra vica hakka dI) puzaTI kItI ate nA hI namAz2a par3hI|
sagoM usa ne tAM hakka nUM jhuThalAiA ate mUMha mor3a liA|
phera uha ApaNe parivAra kola Akar3adA hoiA giA|
so ajja tere laI barabAdI hI barabAdI hai|
barabAdI hI barabAdI hai tere laI|
kI manukkha samajhadA hai ki usa nUM aiveM hI (bhAva binAM hisAba kitAba toM) chaDDa dittA jAvegA|
kI uha vIraja dI ika bUMda nahIM sI jihar3I (mAM de) garabha vica TapakAI jAMdI hai|
phera uha lothar3A baNiA, phera allAha ne usa nUM paidA kItA ate usa de aMga ThIka-ThAka kIte|[4]
translations.footnotes: [4] vekho sUrata ala-hajja, hAzIA Aita 5/22

translations.translation: phera usa toM nara te madIna dA jor3A baNAiA|
phera kI uha (allAha) isa dI samarathA nahIM rakkhadA ki muradiAM nUM jiUMdA kara deve|
z2arUra hI manukkha utte anaMta-kAla dA ika ajihA samAM vI bIta cukkA hai jadoM uha koI varaNana yoga cIz2a nahIM sI|
bezakka asIM manukkha nUM (marada te aurata de) rale mile vIraja toM sAjiA hai, asIM usa nUM parakhaNA cAhuMde hAM isa laI asIM usa nUM suNana vAlA ate vekhaNa vAlA baNA dittA|
asIM usa nUM siddhe rAha dI hidAita baqhazI huNa bhAveM uha zukaraguz2Ara hove jAM nA-zukarA|
nirasaMdeha, asIM kAfirAM laI z2aMjIrAM, saMgala te bhar3akadI hoI agga tiAra kara rakkhI hai|
bezakka neka loka (savaraga vica) ajihe jAma toM (zarAba) pINage jisa vica kapUra-jala dA ralA hovega|
uha ika cazamAM hai jisa viccoM allAha de neka baMde (zarAba) pINage ate jitthe vI cAhuMNage usa dIAM zAqhAM kaDDha laiNage|
uha (saMsAra vica) ApaNIAM sukkhAM pUrIAM karade hana ate usa dihAr3hio bhai-bhIta rahiMde hana jisa dI bipatA (cAroM pAse) phailI hoI hovegI|
ate allAha dI muhabbata vica muthAjAM, yatImAM ate kaidIAM nUM bhojana khuAuMde sI|
(ate Akhade hana ki) asIM tuhAnUM kevala allAha (nUM qhuza karana) laI khANA khuA rahe hAM| asIM tuhAthoM nA tAM isa dA koI badalA cAhuMde hAM te nA hI cAhuMde hAM ki tusIM sADA dhaMnavAda karo|
asIM tAM ApaNe rabba toM cihare vigAr3a deNa vAle atiaMta karar3e dihAr3e (bhAva kiAmata) dA Dara khAMde hAM|
so allAha uhanAM nUM usa dihAr3e de az2Aba toM bacA lavegA ate uhanAM nUM tAz2agI te AnaMda nAla navAz2egA|
ate uhanAM de sabara de badale uhanAM nUM jaMnata ate rezamI vasatara devAMgA|
uha jaMnata vikhe siMghAsaNA utte takIe lAIM baiThe hoNage, utthe nAM dhuppa vekhaNage te nA hI ThArI hovegI|
ate jaMnata dIAM chAvAM uhanAM ’te jhukIAM hoNagIAM ate usa de phalAM de gucche uhanAM dI pahuMca heTha kara ditte jANage|
ate uhanAM de agge cAMdI de bhAMDe te zIze de piAle ghumAe jA rahe hoNage|
zIze vI uha jihar3e cAMdI (dI kisama) de hoNage ate (sAkI) uhanAM nUM ThIka aMdAz2e sira (bhAva caMgI tarhAM) bharaNage|
utthe uhanAM nUM ajihe jAma (zarAba de) piAe jANage jinhAM vica suMDha dA ralA hovegA|

(AkhiA jAvegA) iha tuhADA (nekIAM dA) badalA hai ate tuhADIAM kozizAM isa yoga hana ki uhanAM dI kadara kItI jAve|

so tusIM ApaNe rabba de hukama utte sabara karo bhAva drir3atA nAla jameM raho ate ihanAM viccoM kise pApI jAM nA-zukare de picche nA laggo|
savere-zAma (bhAva hara vele) ApaNe rabba de nAma dA simarana karo|
ate rAta de kise sameM use nUM sijade karo ate rAta rahiMde taka usa dI tasabIha karade raho|

asIM hI ihanAM nUM sAjiA hai te ihanAM de jor3a-baMda pakke kIte hana, jadoM asIM cAhIe ihanAM varage hora loka liAIe|

(AkhiA jAvegA) jihar3e dina laI uhanAM (dI gavAhI) nUM agAMha pAiA giA sI?
faisale de dina (bhAva kiAmata) laI?

jekara tuhADe kola koI cAla mere viruddha kheDaNa laI hai tAM kheDa lao|
usa dina jhuThalAuNa vAliAM laI barabAdI hai|
bezakka muttakI (rabba dA Dara-bhau maMNana vAle) loka ThaMDIAM chAvAM heTha te vagade hoe cazamiAM vica hoNage|
ate suAdale phalAM viccoM jisa tarhAM de uha cAhuNage (phala hAz2ara hoNage)|

usa dina jhuThalAuNa vAliAM laI tabAhI hovegI|

usa dina jhuThalAuNa vAliAM laI barabAdI hai|
jadoM uhanAM nUM AkhiA jAMdA hai ki rukUa karo (bhAva jhuka jAo) tAM uha rukUa nahIM sI karade|[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] rukUa toM bhAva namAz2a par3haNA hai ate namAz2a par3haNa toM bhAva musalamAna hoNA hai, kiuM jo namAz2a toM binAM koI musalamAna nahIM ho sakadA isa laI musalamAna dI pachANa vica namAz2a nUM pahila dittI jAMdI hai| jihar3A viakatI qhAnA-kAabA valla mUMha karake namAz2a par3hadA hai usa dI jAna-mAla surakkhiata hovegA jiveM ki hadIsa vica hai ki mainUM hukama hoiA ki lokAM nAla jaMga karA itthoM taka ki uha lA ilAhA ilalla lAha nUM maMna laiNa, jadoM uha isa kalame dA ikarAra kara laiNa phera uha sADe vAMga namAz2a par3haNa lagga jANa ate namAz2a vica sADe kAabe valla mUMha karana jiddAM asIM z2ibaha karade hAM use tarhAM z2ibaha karana tAM sADe laI uhanAM dI jAna te mAla harAma ho gaI, para hakka anusAra halAla hai ate isa dA hisAba allAha de z2iMme hai| maimUna bina sihA ne haz2arata anasa bina mAlika ra:a: nUM pucchiA ki kihar3I cIz2a AdamI dI jAna te mAla nUM harAma toM surakkhiata kara diMdI hai, uhanAM ne kihA ki jihar3A koI Akhe lA ilAhA ilalla lAha bhAva gavAhI deve ki allAha toM chuTTa sADA koI izaTa nahIM ate sADe kibale valla mUMha karake ate sADe vAMga namAz2a par3he ate sADA z2ibaha kItA hoiA jAnavara khAve tAM uha musalamAna hai ate jihar3A hakka dUje musalamAnAM dA hai uhIo hakka usa dA hai jihar3e karatavva dUje musalamAnAM ’te lAgU huMde hana uhIo use ’te hoNa| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 393-392)

ate tusIM varAsata dA sArA mAla hUMjha ke khA jAMde ho|
ate tusIM dhana padArathAM nAla haddoM vaddha moha rakhade ho|
(usa sameM pachatAve dA lAbha) ukkA nahIM hovegA jadoM dharatI nUM kuTa kuTa ke paddara kara dittI jAvegI|
ate tuhADA rabba pragaTa hovegA jadoM farizate katArAM vica hAz2ira hoNage|
usa dina naraka (lokAM de) sAhamaNe liAMdI jAvegI ate usa dina manukkha ApaNIAM karatUtAM nUM yAda karegA, para usa sameM yAda karana dA koI lAbha nahIM hovegA|
uha AkhegA kAza! maiMne ApaNe isa jIvana laI kujjha agge bhejiA huMdA|
so usa dina usa jihA az2Aba deNa vAlA koI nahIM hovegI|
ate nA hI usa jihA koI baMNana vAlA hovegA|
(para neka lokAM nUM farizate AkhaNage) he zAMta AtamA!
tUM ApaNe rabba valla isa hAla vica tura ki tUM usa toM rAz2I ate uha tethoM rAz2I hai|
phera tUM mere neka baMdiAM vica jA rala|
ate merI jaMnata vica dAqhala ho jA|
nahIM maiM sahuM khAMdA hAM isa zahira (makke) dI|
(he nabI!) tusIM isa zahira makke de vasanIka ho|
(manukkhAM de) pio (Adama) ate usa dI saMtAna dI sahuM|
bezaka asIM manukkha nUM aukhiAI vica (jIvana batIta karana laI hI) paidA kItA hai|
kI uha samajhadA hai ki koI usa ’te kAbU nahIM pA sakadA?
uha AkhadA hai ki maiMne DherAM de Dhera mAla luTA chaDDiA hai|
kI uha samajhadA hai ki usa nUM kise ne nahIM vekhiA|
kI asIM usa nUM do akkhAM nahIM dittIAM?
ate ika jIbha te do bulla nahIM ditte?
kI usa nUM doveM rasate (nekI te burAI de) nahIM darasAe?
para uha (nekI dI) ghATI viccoM dI ho ke nahIM laMghiA|
tusIM kI jANoM ki uha aukhI ghATI kI hai?
uha hai ki kise manukkha nUM g2ulAmI toM Az2Ada karavAuNA|[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] hadIsAM vica g2ulAma nUM Az2Ada karana dI bahuta mahattatA dassI gaI hai so rasUla (sa:) ne faramAiA jihar3A viakatI kise musalamAna g2ulAma nUM Az2Ada kare allAha usa de hara aMga nUM g2ulAma de aMga de badale naraka dI agga toM bacAegA| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 2517)

translations.translation: jAM bhukkha vAle dina bhojana karavAuNa|
kise rizatedAra yatIma nUM|
jAM kise miTTI ’ca rulade muthAja nUM (bhojana karavAuNA)|
(iha bhale kaMma karana vAlA) uhanAM lokAM nAla raliA hovegA, jihar3e ImAna liAe ate jinhAM ika dUje nUM sabara karana dI ate ika dUje ’te diA karana laI preraNA dittI|
iha loka sajje hattha (pAse) vAle hana|
jinhAM ne sADIAM AitAM (AdezAM) dA inakAra kItA uha khabbe hattha vAle hana|
uhanAM utte agga chAI hoI hovegI |[2]
translations.footnotes: [2] vekho sUrata aMbIA, hAzIA Aita 100/21

translations.translation: sUraja ate usa dI dhuppa car3aNa dI sahuM|
ate caMna dI jadoM uha usa (sUraja) de picche AuMdA hai|
ate dina dI jadoM uha sUraja nUM sapazaTa karadA hai|
ate rAta dI jadoM uha usa nUM Dhakka laiMdI hai|
ate akAza dI ate usa dI, jisane usa nUM baNAiA|
ate dharatI dI ate usa dI, jisa ne usa nUM vichAiA|
ate (manukkhI) jAna dI ate usa dI, jisa ne usa nUM ThIka baNAiA|
phera usa dI, jisa ne usa dI burAI ate nekI usa nUM samajhAI|
bezakka safalatA use ne hI prApata kItA jisa ne ApaNe mana nUM pavittara rakkhiA|
ate bezakka uha nA-murAda hoiA jisa ne usa nUM apavittara kItA|
samUda dI kauma ne ApaNI sarakazI kArana (nabI nUM) jhuThalAiA|
jadoM use kauma dA sabha toM vaDDA abhAgA viakatI (UMThaNI nUM vaDDaNa laI) uTThiA|
tAM uhanAM nUM allAha de rasUla (sAleha) ne AkhiA ki allAha dI UThaNI dI ate usa de pANI pINa dI rAkhI karo (bhAva vighaNa nA pAo)|
para uhanAM ne usa (nabI dI galla) nUM jhuThalAiA ate UThaNI nUM mAra suTTiA tAM uhanAM de rabba ne uhanAM de pApAM kArana uhanAM ’te az2Aba bheja ke uhanAM sabha dA safAiA kara dittA|
ate uha isa (tabAhI) de aMjAma toM nahIM DaradA|
rAta dI sahuM jadoM uha chA jAve|
ate dina dI jadoM uha camake|
ate usa hasatI (allAha) dI sahuM jisa ne nara te madIna nUM paidA kItA|
hakIkata iha hai ki tuhADIAM (sabhanAM dIAM) kozizAM vakkho-vakkha hana|
so jisa kise ne (allAha dI rAha vica dAna) dittA ate (rabba toM) DaradA rihA|
ate usa ne saccI galla (kalamA-e-tauhIda) dI puzaTI vI kItI|
tAM asIM z2arUra hI usa nUM saukhe rAha (jaMnata) vala jANa dIAM sahUlatAM diAMge|
para jisa ne kaMjUsI kItI ate (rabba dI) paravAha nahIM kItI|
ate usa ne saccAI nUM jhuThalAiA|
tAM asIM usa nUM kaThina rAha (naraka vala) jANa vAlIAM sahUlatAM diAMge|
ate jadoM uha (kaMjUsa viakatI naraka vica) suTTiA jAvegA tAM usa dA dhaMna usa nUM kujjha vI lAbha nahIM devegA|
bezakka hidAita deNA sADe hI z2iMme hai|
bezakka loka-paraloka sADe hI kabaz2e vica hai|
so maiMne tuhAnUM (naraka dI) bhar3akadI hoI agga toM DarA dittA hai|
isa naraka vica uha be-bhAga jAvegA|
jisa ne (saccAI nUM) jhuThalAiA ate mUMha pheriA|
ate muttakI (rabba toM DaraNa vAliAM nUM) isa (naraka) toM avazza hI dUra rakkhiA jAvegA|
jihar3A pAka hoNa laI ApaNA mAla (rabba dI rAha vica) diMdA hai|
ate isa utte kise dA koI ahisAna vI nahIM, jisa dA badalA usa ne deNA hai|
hAM jihar3A kevala ApaNe rabbe baratara dA ciharA vekhaNA cAhuMdA hai (uhIo usa dI rAha vica mAla qharaca karadA hai)|
bezakka uha (allAha) chetI hI usa toM rAz2I ho jAvegA|
dina car3he hoe dI sahuM|
ate rAta dI jadoM uha chA jAve|
(he nabI sa:!) tuhADe rabba ne nA tAM tuhAnUM (ikallA) chaDDiA hai ate nA hI uha tuhAthoM nArAz2a hai|
bezakka tuhADe laI Aqhirata, dunIAM toM kite vadhIA hai|
ate chetI hI tuhADA rabba tuhAnUM iMnA (inAma) devegA ki tusIM qhuza ho jAoge|
kI usa (allAha) ne tuhAnUM yatIma huMde hoe vadhIA TikANA nahIM dittA|
ate tuhAnUM aNajANI rAha toM siddhI rAha nahIM baqhazI|
ate tuhAnUM g2arIbI toM dhanavAna nahIM baNAiA?
so tusIM (kise vI) yatIma utte saqhatI nA karo|
ate nA hI savAlI nUM jhir3ako hai|
sagoM ApaNe rabba valloM (baqhazIAM gaIAM) ihanAM niamatAM dI caracA karade raho|
(he nabI sa:!) kI asIM tuhADA sInA (hakka dI rauzanI) laI nahIM kholhiA|
ate sAne tuhADe uttoM tuhADA bojha utAra dittA|
jisa (bojha) ne tuhADI DhUMhI tor3a suTTI sI|
ate asIM tuhADe laI tuhADe z2ikara (caracA) nUM uccA kara dittA|
bezakka hareka aukhiAI toM magaroM saukhiAI hai|
bezakka hareka taMgI de nAla AsAnI jur3I hoI hai|
so jadoM vI tusIM (tabalIga toM) vihale hovo tAM (ibAdata vica) mihanata karo|
ate ApaNe rabba nAla hI moha rakkho|
sahuM hai aMjIra ate z2aitUna dI|
ate tUra pahAr3a dI|
ate isa amana vAle zahira (makke) dI|
bezakka asIM manukkha nUM sabha toM vaddha sohaNe rUpa vica paidA kItA|
(usa dIAM kuratUtAM kArana) phera asIM isa (manukkha nUM naraka dI) ghaTIA toM ghaTIA (bhAva heThalI) thAM vica suTTa dittA|
para jihar3e lokI (rabba ate muhaMmada (sa:) dIAM gallAM ’te) ImAna liAe ate uhanAM ne (.kuraAna anusAra) caMge kaMma vI kIte| uhanAM laI haddoM vaddha (caMgA) badalA hai|
(he manukkha!) isa (.kuraAna) toM bAada vI tainUM kihar3I galla ne badale vAle dina nUM jhuThalAuNa laI prerita kItA hai|
bhalAM kI allAha sAre hAkamAM toM vaDDA hAkama nahIM hai?
(he muhaMmada sa:!) par3ho ApaNe (usa) rabba dA nAM laike jisa ne (sabha nUM) paidA kItA hai|
usa ne manukkha nUM jamme hoe qhUna (de ika lothar3e) toM paidA kItA|
par3o tuhADA rabba atiaMta karIma (udAra) hai|
uha hasatI jisa ne kalama rAhIM giAna sikhAiA|
usa ne manukkha nUM uha giAna dittA jo uha jANadA nahIM sI|
saccAI iha hai ki manukkha haddoM Tapa jAMdA hai|
kI uha ApaNe Apa nUM (rabba kola jANa toM) beparavAha samajhadA hai?
bezakka sabha ne tuhADe rabba valla hI mur3a jANA hai|
kI tusIM usa nUM vekhiA hai jihar3A rokadA hai?
ika baMde nUM jadoM uha namAz2a par3hadA hai?
(tuhADA kI vicAra hai ki) je bhalAM uha (baMdA) siddhI rAha ’te hove?
jAM Dara bhAo maMNana dI preranA diMdA hove?
bhalAM jekara uha (hakka nUM) jhuThalAuMdA hove ate usa toM mUMha mor3adA hove (phera kI hovegA)|
kI uha nahIM jANadA ki allAha usa nUM vekha rihA hai?
ukkA nahIM (rabba toM DaradA), je uha (ApaNIAM karatUtAM toM) nA rukiA tAM asIM usa nUM matthe de vAlAM toM phar3a ke z2arUra hI ghasITAMge|
uha matthA jihar3A dozI hai|
so usa nUM cAhIdA hai ki (ApaNe bacA laI) ApaNe saMga baiThaNa uTThaNa vAliAM nUM bulA lave|
ate asIM vI az2Aba deNa vAle farizatiAM naM bulA liAMge|
ukkA nahIM, tusIM usa (jhuThalAuNa vAle) de picche nahIM laggaNA, sagoM sijadA karo ate rabba dI ner3atA prApata karo|
bezakka asIM isa (.kuraAna) nUM (ramaz2Ana mahIne dI) ika bhAgAM vAlI rAta vica utAriA|[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] iha bhAgAM vAlI rAta pavittara ramaz2Ana mahIne de AqharI dasa dinAM dI TAMka rAtAM viccoM koI ika rAta hai| jiveM satikArayoka muhaMmada (sa:) ne faramAiA “lailAtula-kadara (bhAgAM vAlI rAta) ramaz2Ana mahIne de AqharI dasa dinAM dIAM TAMka rAtAM vica labbho|” (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 2017)

translations.translation: ate tusIM bhalA kI jANoM ki uha bhAgAM vAlI rAta kI hai?
iha bhAgAM vAlI rAta (hara pakkhoM) haz2Ara mahIniAM toM vadhIA hai|
isa rAta vica farizate ate rUha (jibarAIla) ApaNe rabba de hukama nAla hara kaMma laI (akAza toM dharatI utte) uttarade hana|
(uha pUrI rAta) pahu phaTTaNa taka salAmatI hI salAmatI hai|
ahale kitAba bhAva yahUdI te IsAIAM viccoM kujjha kAfira te muzarika (udoM taka kufara toM) rukaNa vAle nahIM sana, jadoM taka ki uhanAM kola (rabba valla) koI sapazaTa dalIla nA A jAve|
(bhAva) allAha valloM ika paig2aMbara Ave, jihar3A pavittara (.kuraAna de) paMne par3he|
jisa vica ThIka te saMtulita Adeza hana|
ate jinhAM lokAM nUM kitAba dittI gaI sI uhanAM vica matabheda uhanAM kola khullhIAM dalIlAM AuNa toM magaroM hoe|

jada ki uhanAM nUM iho hukama dittA giA sI ki uha ApaNI baMdagI nUM allAha laI hI qhAlisa karake ikAgara hoke use dI ibAdata karana, uha namAz2a kAima karana ate z2akAta adA karana, iho saccA dharama hai|

bezakka ahale kitAba (tauraita ate iMjIla de maMNana vAliAM) viccoM jihar3e lokAM ne kufara kItA ate rabba dA sAMjhI baNAuNa vAle (muzarika) naraka dI agga vica suTTe jANage, jitthe uha sadA laI rahiNage| uhIo sabha toM bhair3I makhalUka hai|[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] vekho sUrata Ale-imarAna, hAzIA Aita 85/3

translations.translation: para jihar3e ImAna liAe ate uhanAM ne neka kaMma vI kIte, uhIo (sArI) maqhalUka viccoM vadhIA (loka) hana|

uhanAM dI jaz2A (vadhIA badalA) uhanAM de rabba kola sadA rahiNa vAle bAg2a hana jinhAM de heTha nahirAM vagadIAM hana| uha (ImAna vAle) sadA laI usa vica rahiNage, allAha uhanAM toM rAz2I hai ate uha allAha toM rAz2I hana| iha (badalA) uhanAM nUM hI miladA hai, jihar3e ApaNe rabba toM Darade hai|
jadoM dharatI z2ora nAla hilA dittI jAvegI|
ate dharatI ApaNA sArA bojha bAhara kaDDha suTTegI|
ate (usa sameM) manukkha AkhegA ki isa nUM kI ho giA?
usa dina uha ApaNe (Apa ’te bIte hoe) hAlAta varaNana karegI|
kiuM jo tuhADA rabba usa nUM (iho) hukama devegA|
usa dina lokI vakkhare vakkhare ho ke parataNage tAM jo uhanAM nUM uhanAM de karama vikhAe jANa| [1]
translations.footnotes: [1] vekho sUrata hUda, hAzIA Aita 18/11

translations.translation: so jisa ne ratA bhara vI nekI kItI hovegI uha usa nUM vekha lavegA|
ate jisa ne ratA bhara vI burAI kItI hovegI uha usa nUM vekha lavegA|
tez2a bhaja ke sAMha car3hAuMde hoe ghor3hiAM dI sahuM|
phera TApAM mAra ke caMgiAr3IAM kaDDhaNa vAliAM dI sahuM|
phera savere de sameM hamalA karana vAliAM dI sahuM|
phera usa sameM jadoM uha dhUla ur3AuMde hana|
phera usa sameM jadoM uha vairI dhira de vicAle ghussa jAMde hana|
bezakka manukkha ApaNe pAlaNahAra dA nA-zukarA hai|
ate isa galla laI (uha Apa vI) gavAhI diMdA hai|
ate bezakka uha mAla de moha vica burI tarhAM phasiA hoiA hai|
kI uha nahIM jANadA jadoM uha sabha bAhara kaDDhiA jAvegA jo kujjha kabarAM vica hai|
ate uha sabha sapazaTa kara dittA jAvegA jo kujjha dilAM vica hai|
bezakka uhanAM (manukkhAM) dA rabba usa (kiAmata) dihAr3e uhanAM de (hAlAM) toM bhalI-bhAMta jANU hovegA|
khar3akhar3A deNa vAlI (Afata z2arUra AvegI)|
bhalAM kI hai uha khar3akhar3A deNa vAlI (ghaTanA)?
ate tusIM kI jANoM ki uha khar3akhar3A deNa vAlI (Afata) kI hai?
(iha uha dina hai) jadoM lokI (aiveM) ho jANage, jiveM khilare hoe bhamakkar3a|
ate pahAr3a piMjI hoI raMga-baraMgI unna vAMga ho jANage|
ate phera (usa dina) jisa viakatI dA pAlar3A (neka amalAM nAla) bhArI hovegA|
uha (savaraga vica) ApaNI mana bhAuMdI z2iMdagI vica hovegA|
ate jisa viakatI de palar3e halake hoNage|
tAM usa dA TikANA ‘hAviA’ hovegA|
ate tuhAnUM kI qhabara ki iha (hAviA) kI hai?
uha ika dahakadI hoI (naraka dI) agga hai|
bahutA (dhaMna) hoNa dI icchA ne tuhAnUM (paraloka toM) beqhabara kara chaDDiA hai|
itthoM taka ki tusIM kabarAM vica pahuMca gae (bhAva mara gae)|
ukkA hI nahIM, chetI hI tusIM jANa lavoge|
phera (suNa lavo) ki ukkA hI nahIM, chetI hI tusIM jANa lavoge|
ukkA nahIM, je tusIM pUre vizavAsa nAla kiAmata dihAr3e nUM jANa laiMde (tAM tusIM kade vI isa toM beqhabara nA huMde)|
huNa tusIM z2arUra hI naraka nUM vekhoge|
phera tusIM isa nUM vizavAsa karana vAlI akkha nAla vekhoge|
usa dina tuhAthoM (rabba valloM dittIAM gaIAM) niamatAM pratI z2arUra pucchiA jAvegA|[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] saMsAra vica manukkha nUM jihar3IAM vI niamatAM milIAM hoiA hana paraloka vica ihanAM de bAre pucchiA jAvegA| jiveM haz2arata abU-hurairA dassade hana ki ika hadIsa anusAra ika vAra rAta jAM dina dA samAM sI allAha de rasUla (sa:) bAhara Ae tAM haz2arata abUbakara te haz2arata umara (raz2a:) ne vekhiA te uhanAM toM pucchiA, isa sameM tusIM bAhara kiuM Ae ho? uhanAM ne javAba dittA ki bhukkha kArana he allAha de rasUla!

translations.translation: z2amAne dI sahuM|
bezakka manukkha ghATe vica hai|

chuTTa uhanAM lokAM toM, jihar3e ImAna liAe ate uhanAM ne caMge karama vI kIte, ate ika dUje nUM hakka sacca (AkhaNa) dI nasIhata kItI ate ika dUje nUM (hara hAla vica) sabara karana (bhAva DaTe rahiNa) dI nasIhata kItI| [1]
translations.footnotes: [1] iha suNa ke Apa (sa:) ne faramAiA, sahuM hai usa z2Ata dI jisa de hattha vica merI jAna hai maiM vI ise laI bAhara AiA hAM jisa laI tusIM bAhara nikale ho (Apa (sa:) ne faramAiA) callo! tAM uha Apa jI de nAla tura pae, phera Apa (sa:) uhanAM nUM ika anasArI de ghara lai gae jihar3A bAharo pANI laiNa giA hoiA sI| kujjha dera bAada uha mur3a AiA tAM Apa te Apa (sa:) jI de sahAbIAM nUM vekha ke qhuzI nAla AkhaNa laggiA, allAha dA zukara hai ki ajja de dina kise kola ajihe patavaMte mahimAna nahIM jiho je mere kola hana| phera uha khajUrAM dA ika gucchA liAiA jisa vica addha-pakkIAM sukkIAM te tAz2A khajUrAM sana ate uhanAM nUM khANa laI kihA phera usa ne churI phar3I te Apa ne duddha deNa vAlI bakkarI nUM z2ibaha karana toM manhAM kItA| so usa ne ika bakkarA z2ibaha kItA tAM sAriAM ne usa dA mAsa te khajUrAM khAdIAM te pANI pItA| jadoM sAre rajja gae phera allAha de rasUla ne faramAiA, sahuM hai usa z2Ata dI jisa de hattha vica merI jAna hai tuhAthoM kiAmata dihAr3e isa niamata de bAre z2arUra pucchiA jAvegA| tusIM ApaNe gharAM toM bhukkhe nikale sI phera ghare nahIM mur3e itthoM taka ki tuhAnUM iha niamata mila gaI| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 2038)

translations.translation: hara tAane-mihane deNa vAle te burAIAM dI Toha vica rahiNa vAle (viakatI) laI tabAhI hai|[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] vekho sUrata hujarAta, hAzIA Aita 12/49

translations.translation: (ate usa laI vI) jisa ne dhana-daulata nUM jor3hiA ate usa nUM giNa giNa rakkhiA|
uha samajhadA hai ki usa dA mAla usa nUM sadA laI jIUMdA rakkhegA|
bilakula vI nahIM, usa nUM z2arUra hI ‘hotAmAM’ vica suTTiA jAvegA|
ate tuhAnUM kI patA hai ki uha (hotAmAM) kI hai?
uha allAha valloM bhar3akAI hoI agga hai|
jihar3I dilAM taka pahuMcegI|
bezakka uha (agga) uhanAM ’te (hara pAsioM) baMda kara dittI jAvegI|
uha laMme-laMme thaMmhAM vicAle (baMda kara dittI jAvegI)|
kI tusIM (he nabI!) nahIM vekhiAM ki tuhADe rabba ne hAthI vAliAM nAla kI kItA sI?
kI usa ne uhanAM dI cAla bekAra nahIM sI kara dittI?
usa ne uhanAM (dI fauja) utte DArAM dIAM DArAM paMchIAM dIAM bhejiAM|
jihar3e uhanAM utte pattharAM dIAM ror3hIAM suTTa rahe sana|
phera iMja allAha ne uhanAM nUM jugAlI kItI hoI tUr3I vAMga kara dittA| [1]
translations.footnotes: [1] iha ghaTanA usa varhe dI hai jadoM rasUla (sa:) janame sI| habazA de bAdazAha valloM yamana vikhe abarAha alaazarama gavaranara sI| usa ne sanaA vikhe ika girajA ghara usAriAM sI ate cAhuMdA sI ki lokI qhAnA-kAabA dI thAM ibAdata te hajja-umarA laI itthe AiA karana| iha galla makkA vAliAM laI te dUje kabIliAM laI bahuta hI nA-pasaMda sI| so karaiza de ika viakatI ne abarAha de baNAe hoe pUjA sathAna nUM gaMdagI nAla qharAba kara dittA| jadoM abarAha nUM isa dA patA lagiA tAM uha gusse vica be-kAbU ho giA ate lar3aNa vAlA lazakara de nAla makke ’te hamalA kara dittA ate qhAnA-kAabA nUM maliAmeTa karana dA irAdA kara liA| terhAM hAthIAM nAla jadoM iha lazakara agge vadhiA tAM jisa kabIle ne vI usa nUM rokaNa dI koziza kItA use nUM tabAha hoNA piA itthoM taka ki makke de ner3e pahuMca giA, jadoM abarAha dA lazakara musahAsara basatI vikhe pahuMciA tAM allAha ne paMchIAM de jhuMDa bheja ditte jinhAM dIAM cuMjhA vica te paMjiA vica roDIAM sana jihar3IAM choliAM jAM masara de dAne samAna sI, jisa vI phaujI nUM iha ror3I laggadI uha pighala jAMdA te usa dA mAsa jhar3a jAMdA ate mara jAMdA| iMja uha lazakara burI tarhAM qhatama ho giA| abarAha ne bhajja ke jAna bacAuNa dI koziza kItI, para sanaA tIka pahuMcade pahuMcade usa dA aMta ho giA| iMja allAha ne ApaNe ghara dI rAkhI kItI te makke vAliAM nUM jitta baqhazI| isa ghaTanA toM bAada sAre araba dA ilAkA qhAnA-kAabA dA satikAra te utthoM de rahiNa vAliAM dA Adara-mAna karadA hai| (tafasIra ibane kasIra)

translations.translation: kiuM jo kuraiza vAle gijjha gae|
arathAta siAla te hAr3ha dA safara karana vica gijjha gae|
so inhAM lokAM nUM cAhIdA hai ki uha isa ghara (qhAnA-kAabA) de mAlika dI ibAdata karana|
jisa (mAlika) ne uhanAM nUM bhukkha toM bacA ke khANa laI dittA ate (badaamanI de) Dara toM bacA ke amana zAMtI dittI|
kI tusIM (he nabI!) usa viakatI nUM vekhiA hai jihar3A badale de dina (kiamata) nUM jhuThalAuMdA hai| [1]
translations.footnotes: [1] yatIma de pAlaNa-pozaNa karana dI bahuta mahattatA hai jiveM rasUla (sa:) ne faramAiA, maiM te yatIma dI paravariza karana vAlA doveM jaMnata vica iMja ner3e hovAMge Apa jI (sa:) ne ApaNI zahAdata dI uMgala (aMgUThe de nAla laggadI uMgalI ate vicAralI uMgalI (dovAM nUM milA ke izArA kItA| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 6005) ● isa toM patA laggadA hai ki yatIma dA pAlaNa pozaNa ohIo karegA jihar3A Aqhirata dI jaz2A-saz2A nUM maMnadA hovegA nahIM tAM yatImAM nUM dhakke hI devegA jiveM Aita dassadI hai|

translations.translation: iha uha viakatI ru jihar3A (yatIma) nUM dhakke diMdAM hai| [2]
translations.footnotes: [2] masakIna te g2arIba nUM bhojana karAuNa dI bahuta vaDDI mahattatA hai isa laI vI prerita kItA giA hai| so rasUla (sa:) ne faramAiA ki vidhavA te muthAja dI dekha bhAla dI koziza karana vAlA allAha dI rAha vikhe jihAda karana vAle jAM sArI rAta namAz2a laI khar3A hoNa te roz2A rakkhaNa de barAbara hai| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 5353)

translations.translation: ate muthAjAM nUM bhojana karavAuNa laI dUjiAM nUM prerita nahIM karadA|
uhanAM namAz2IAM laI tabAhI hai|
jihar3e ApaNIAM namAz2AM pratI aNagailIAM varatade hana|
uha (vI) jihar3e vikhAvA karade hana|
ate uhanAM laI vI (tabAhI hai) jihar3e Ama varatana vica AuNa vAliAM cIz2AM deNa toM nA-nukkara kara diMde hana|
(he nabI!) bezakka asIM tuhAnUM kausara [1] baqhaza chaDDI hai|
translations.footnotes: [1]਼ allAha de rasUla ne miarAja de kisse vica faramAiA ki maiM ika nahira ’te pahuMciA uhade kaMDiAM ’te motIAM de khemeM sI maiMne jibarAIla toM pucchiA? iha kiho jahI nahira hai? uhanAM ne javAba dittA “iha kausara hai”| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 4964)

translations.translation: so tusIM ApaNe rabba (dI raz2A) laI hI namAz2a par3ho ate (use de nAM dI) kurabAnI karo|
bezakka tuhADA vairI hI jar3a-kaTA hai| [2]
translations.footnotes: [2]਼ iha makke de muzarikAM nUM javAba sI, jihar3A kihA karade sI ki kiuM jo allAha de rasUla (sa:) de narIna auaulAda jiUMdA nahIM bacI sI huNa ihanAM dI nasala kiveM agge vadhegI iha chetI hI be-nizAna ho jANage, para allAha ne faramAiA, bezakka tere duzamana hI be-nAmo nizAna hoNage (bhAva uhanAM dIAM nasalAM barabAda ho jANagIAM| ● so ajja iMja hI ho rihA hai| Apa (sa:) de vairIAM dA koI vI nAM nahIM laiMdA jada ki nabI karIma (sa:) de nAM dI caracA musalamAna dI z2ubAna ’te hara vele rahiMdA hai te Apa (sa:) dI muhabbata hara musalamAna de dila vica hai ate Apa (sa:) nAla muhabbata karanA ImAna hai jiveM ki allAha de rasUla (sa:) ne faramAiA ki tuhADe viccoM koI vI udoM taka musalamAna nahIM ho sakadA jadoM taka ki mainUM ApaNe mApiAM, saMtAna te sAre manukkhAM toM vaddha ke muhabbata nahIM karadA| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 15)

translations.translation: (he nabI!) Akha dio ki he (allAha de) inakArIo!
maiM ukkA hI ihanAM (butAM) dI baMdagI nahIM karadA, jinhAM dI baMdagI tusIM karade ho|
ate nA hI tusIM usa (ikko allAha) dI baMdagI karana vAle ho, jisa dI baMdagI maiM karadA hAM|
ate nA hI maiM uhanAM dI baMdagI karana vAlA hAM, jinhAM dI baMdagI tusIM karade ho|
ate nA tusIM usa dI baMdagI karana vAle ho, jisa dI baMdagI maiM karadA hAM|
(so) tuhADe laI tuhADA dIna (dharama) ate mere laI merA dIna|
(he nabI!) jadoM allAha dI madada ate (kAfirAM utte) jitta prApata ho jAvegI|
phera tusIM vekhoge ki lokAM de jatthiAM de jatthe allAha de dIna (isalAma) vica praveza kara rahe hoNage|
so tusIM ApaNe rabba dI hamada (tArIfa te zukarAniAM) de nAla-nAla usa dI tasabIha (pavittaratA) varaNana karo ate usa toM baqhaziza dI duA maMgo| bezakka uha vaDDA taubA kabUlaNa vAlA hai|
TuTa jANa abU-lahaba de hatha, uha tAM barabAda ho giA| [1]
translations.footnotes: [1]਼ isa sUrata de saMbaMdha vica AuMdA hai ki jadoM iha sUrata uttarI ki ApaNe sake-saMbaMdhIAM nUM DarAo tAM araba de ravAja anusAra nabI (sa:) safA nAM dI pahAr3I ’te car3ha gae ate lokAM nUM hokA dittA, jadoM lokI jamAM ho gae tAM Apa (sa:) ne faramAiA, je maiM tuhAnUM AkhAM ki pahAr3a de dUje pAse ikka lazakara tuhADe ’te hamalA karana vAlA hai tAM kI tusIM vizavAsa kara laoge? uhanAM ne AkhiA ki kiuM nahIM, sAne tuhAnUM kade jhUTha bolade nahIM vekhiA| Apa (sa:) ne faramAiA, suNo! maiM tuhAnUM DarAuMdA hai usa qhaufanAka az2Aba toM jihar3A ImAna nA liAuNa dI hAlata vica tuhADe ’te AuNa vAlA hai| abU-lahaba, jihar3A Apa (sa:) dA cAcA sI, ne kihA ki tUM barabAda hoveM, kI tUM sAnUM ise laI bulAiA sI? phera uha uTha ke calA giA isa ’te iha sUrata nAz2ila hoI| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 4971)

translations.translation: nA hI usa de dhana ne ate nA hI usa de (amalAM dI) kamAI ne usa nUM koI lAbha dittA|
z2arUra hI uha lATAM mAradI hoI agga vica dAqhala hovegA|
usa dI patanI vI, jihar3I lAI bujhAI karana vAlI hai (uha vI usa de nAla hI hovegI)|
usa dI garadana vica muMja dI rassI hovegI|
(he nabI!) tusIM Akho ki uha allAha ika hai|
allAha beniAz2a hai|
usa ne kise nUM vI nahIM janamiAM ate nA hI usa nUM kise ne janamiAM hai [1]
translations.footnotes: [1]਼ “allAha dI aulAda kahiNA” hadIsa vica isa ` allAha ` gAlAM kaDDhaNIAM kihA giA hai| vekho sUrata ala-bakaraha, hAzIA Aita 116/2

translations.translation: ate nA hI usa jihA hora koI hai| [2]
translations.footnotes: [2]਼ iha bahuta hI vaDDI mahattatA vAlI sUrata hai| isa nUM ika vAra par3haNA do tihAI.kuraAna par3haNa de savAba de barAbara hai| so haz2arata abU-saIda qhudarI ra:a: dassade hana ki ika viakatI ne dUje viakatI nUM ‘kula ho vallAM ho Ahada’ dI talAvata karade vekhiA jo usa nUM mur3a-mur3a par3ha rihA sI, savera nUM uha viakatI nabI (sa:) dI sevA vikhe hAz2ara hoiA ate Apa (sa:) nUM iha galla dassI jiveM ki uha isa sUrata dI talAvata nUM kAfI nA-samajhadA hove| allAha de rasUla (sa:) ne faramAiA, sahuM hai usa z2Ata dI jisa de kabaz2e vica merI jAna hai iha sUrata.kuraAna de ika tihAI de barAbara hai| haz2arata AizAM biAna karadIAM hana ki allAha de rasUla (sa:) ne ika viakatI (kalasUma bina z2aida ra:a:) nUM ika faujI lazakara dA saradAra baNA ke bhejiA uha namAz2a dI hara rakAata kula hu-vallA ’te qhatama karadA, jadoM lazakara de loka gharAM nUM parate tAM uhanAM lokAM ne iha galla Apa jI (sa:) nUM dassI, Apa (sa:) ne faramAiA, uha toM puccho ki uha iMja kiuM karadA hai? lokAM ne pucchiA tAM usa ne kihA ki isa sUrata vica allAha dIAM sifatAM dassIAM gaIAM hana, mainUM isa nUM par3haNA mahabUba hai| Apa (sa:) ne faramAiA ki usa nUM kahi dio ki allAha vI tere nAla muhabbata karadA hai| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 7335-7334)

translations.translation: (he nabI!) tusIM Akho ki maiM savere de rabba dI zarana vica AuMdA hAM|
hareka usa cIz2a dI burAI toM (bacaNa laI) jihar3I usa ne paidA kItI hai|
ate hanerI rAta dI burAI toM jadoM uha chA jAMdI hai|
ate gaMDhAM vica phUkAM mArana vAliAM dI burAI toM|
ate IrakhA rakkhaNa vAliAM dI burAI toM bacaNa laI jadoM uha IrakhA kare|
(he nabI!) Akha dio ki maiM manukkhAM de rabba dI zarana vica AuMdA hAM|
sAre manukkhAM de pAtazAha dI (zarana vica)|[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] allAha de rasUla (sa:) ne faramAiA, allAha kiAmata vAle dina dharatI nUM ApaNI muTThI vica lavegA ate akAzAM nUM ApaNe sajje hattha vica lapeTa lavegA| phira faramAegA, maiM bAdazAha hAM, dharatI de bAdazAha kitthe hana? (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 7382

translations.translation: ate sAre manukkhAM de izaTa (allAha) dI (zarana vica AuMdA hAM)|
usa bharama bhulekhA pAuNa vAle zaitAna dI burAI toM (bacaNa laI), jihar3A (allAha dA nAM suNade hI) bhajja jAMdA hai| [2]
translations.footnotes: [2] isa toM bhAva zaitAna hai te isa dA bhAva manukkhI icchAvAM vI hana kiuM jo uha vI manukkha nUM Ama karake burAI valla hI laike jAMdIAM hana jiveM ki hadIsa vica hai, allAha de rasUla (sa:) ne faramAiA ki naraka manukkhI icchAvAM vica ghirI hoI hai ate jaMnata uhanAM kaMmAM vica ghirI hoI hai jihar3I dila nUM burIAM laggadIAM hana| (sahI buqhArI, hadIsa: 6487) ● isa toM bhAva hai ki manukkhI icchAvAM te ruvAnI jaz2abAta naraka valla hI agavAI karade hana jada ki icchAvAM ’te kAbU pAuNA pavittaratA dhArana karanA, nekI de dUje kaMma te allAha ate usa de rasUla dI tAbedArI jaMnata valla laike jAMdI hai| jihar3IAM karatUtAM naraka dA kArana baNadIAM hana uhanAM dA karanA bahuta sauaukhA dissadA hai jada ki jaMnata dI prApatI vAle kaMma auaukhe vikhAI diMde hana|

translations.translation: jihar3A lokAM de manAM vica bharama bhulekhe pAuMdA hai|
uha bhAveM jiMnAM viccoM hove jAM manukkhAM viccoM|
